Bab-Dummadi, gebe-negasailaunni, nibneg, napneg obinnisad.
Deunni, napneg gwen nabir-daklesulid, neg olloo-dakleged, unnila dii-wilasailad-birgi negsichidbi naid. Bab-Dummad-Burbadi dii-birgi aibannaid.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad sogded: “Neg-meegwad nagu.” Agi, neg-meegwad nagunonikid.
Geb Bab-Dummad dakded, neg-meegwad, ibnuedi. Agi, Bab-Dummad neg-meegwad, negsichid-ebo bachikii imaknonikid.
Bab-Dummad neg-meegwad ibginedye onug-imaksad. Negsichiddi mutikidye onug-imaksad. Weyob neg osedosad, geb neg oibosbalid. Deyob, ibagwenadgi neg gusad.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad sogdebalid: “Neg-ollor-dummad nagu, adi, diimar bachikii naguegar.”
Deyobi, Bab-Dummad neg-olloled-dummad nasiksad. Neg-ollor-dummad-birgi dii nagunonikid, degi, neg-ollor-dummad-urba dii nagunonibalid. Deyob gunonikid.
Bab-Dummad a-neg-olloled-dummad mogir-aradye onugsasad. Weyob neg osedosad, geb neg oibosbalid. Deyob, ibabogwadgi neg gusad.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad sogdebalid: “Dii-mogir-arad-urba-naid bachiki nagu, adi, neg-dinnagwad naguegar.” Deyob gunonikid.
Bab-Dummad, neg-dinnagwad, napaye onugsasad. Geb diidina, demarye onugsanonikid. Geb Bab-Dummad dakded, we-ibmar bela nueganbi.
Agi, Bab-Dummad sogdebalid: “Bela ibmar-durbamar napagi nagu: Gaganmar-gwag-nikad ambikumar, degine, akar-akar sapi-sunna-sanmakmalad, e-sangi gwag-nika gusun. Ibmar-durbamar akar-akar bela na egad-egad-balibimaladba ambikumarsun.” Deyob gunonikid.
Geb napagi ibmar-durbamar nagunonikid: Gaganmar-gwag-nikamalad bela na akar-akar egad-egad-balibimaladba, degi, sapimar-e-sangi-gwag-nikumalad bela akar-akar na egad-egad-balibimaladba ambikunonimalad. Bab-Dummad dakdebalid, we-ibmar bela nueganbi.
Weyob neg osedosad, geb neg oibosbalid. Deyob, ibapaagwadgi neg gusad.
Geb degi, Bab-Dummad sogdebalid: “Nibneggi gwallumar nagu, adi, neg-mutikid, neg-ibgined-ebo bachikii guegar. Adi, ibagan-nagumaid, yolamar-nagumaid, birgamar-nagumaid magar daklegegar.
Degi, gwallumar-niba-naid napneg-mee saegar.” Deyob gunonikid.
Bab-Dummad gwallu-dummagan gwabo obinyenonikid: Gwallu-dummad, neg-ibginedgi negdaknai guegar. Gwallu-senigwaddi, neg-mutik negdaknai guegar. Degine, niisgwamar obinnisbalid.
Bab-Dummad napneg-mee-imakega, gwallumar, niisgwamar, nibneggi nasiksad.
Adi, neg-ibginedgi negdaknai guegar, degi, neg-mutikidgi negdaknai gubaligar. Adina, neg-meegwad, negsichid-ebo bachikii imakegar. Bab-Dummad dakded, we-ibmar bela nueganbi.
Weyob neg osedosad, geb neg oibosbalid. Deyob, ibabakegwadgi neg gusad.
Geb degi, Bab-Dummad sogdebalid: “Diigi ibmar-dulamar bela akar-akar ambikumar, degine, nuumar ambikumar, we-napneggi nabir niba gukudii gumalagar.”
Bab-Dummad demargi ibdula-dummagan obinnisad, degine, diigi belagwapa ibmar-dulamar obinnisbalid. Bela na egad-egad-balibimaladba obinnisad. Degine, Bab-Dummad bela nuumar na egad-egad-balibimalad obinnisbalid. Bab-Dummad dakded, we-ibmar bela nueganbi.
Bab-Dummad a-ibmar-durgangi ise-nued-binsaedgi amarga sogded: “Bemar dula-mergumai gumarsun. Demargi bukidar-dula-mergumai gumarsun. Degine, nuumar, bemar we-napneggi bukidar-dula-mergumai gumarmosun.”
Weyob neg osedosad, geb neg oibosbalid. Deyob, ibataledgi neg gusad.
Geb degi, Bab-Dummad sogdebalid: “Napagi bela ibmar-durgan na egad-egad-balibimaladba ambikumar: Ibmar-durgan-sunna-akwilemalad, ibmar-durgan-napagi-garmakdimalad, ibmar-durgan-sapurbarmalad, bela na egad-egad-balibimaladba ambikumar.” Deyob gunonikid.
Bab-Dummad bela ibmar-durgan-sapurbarmalad na egad-egad-balibimaladba obinnisad. Ibmar-durgan-sunna-akwilemalad bela na egad-egad-balibimaladba obinnisbalid. Degine, ibmar-durgan-napagi-garmakdimalad bela na egad-egad-balibimaladba obinnisbalid. Bab-Dummad dakded, we-ibmar bela nueganbi.
Geb degi, Bab-Dummad sogdebalid: “Emisgindi, anmar, dule-obinyesun, anmar-sunnague anmar imakoed. Dulede, we-ibmar-durganmargi gangued-nika guoed: Uamargi, nuumargi, ibmar-durgan-sunna-akwilemaladgi, ibmar-durgan-sapurbarmaladgi, ibmar-durgan-napagi-garmakdimaladgi, bela we-ibmarmargi we-napneggi gangued-nika guoed.”
Bab-Dummad dule-obinyenonikid, na e-sunnague obinyenonikid. Bab-Dummad e-sunnague na imaksad. Machered, ome-ebo obinnisad.
Bab-Dummad we-dulemargi ise-nued-binsasadba, ega sogded: “Bemar mimmigan-bukidar nikumar. We-napneggi dula-bukidar urbemar, degi, bela we-napneg-ugakaase ambikumar. Bemar we-napneggi be gangued-nikadba bela we-ibdurganmargi be obindii gumarsun: Uamargi, nuumargi, degi, ibmar-durgan-napagi-garmakdimaladgi.”
Geb degi, Bab-Dummad dulega sogdebalid: “We-napneggi bela gagan-nabir-gwag-nikumalad, degi, bela sapimar-e-sangi-gwag-nikumalad, an bemarga uked. A-ibmar-durba bela bemar-masga guoed.”
Bab-Dummad we-napneggi bela we-ibmar-durganga sogdebalid: “Bela ibdula-unimaladga, bela nuumarga, bela ibdurgan-napagi-garmakdimaladga, bela gagan-ara-aramalad e-masga-guega an ega uked.” Deyob gunonikid.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad dakded, bela ibmar-na-obinnisadi, bela-bela nueganbi. Weyob neg osedosad, geb neg oibosbalid. Deyob, ibanergwadgi (6) neg gusad.
Deyobi, nibneg obinnilesad, napneg obinnilesad, amargi ibmar-akar-akar obinnilesad, bela deyob ambikunonikid.
Ibanergwadgi (6) Bab-Dummad bato bela ibmar-obinnissoggu, ibagugled-nagunonigu (7), Bab-Dummad obunnosad, bar arbassulid.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad ibagugledgi (7) ise-nued binsasad. Bela ibmar-obinnisad-bergusgu, obunnosad. A-ulale, a-iba, iba-islidikidye onugsasad.
Deyob napneg obinnilesad, degi, nibneg obinnilesad. Bab-Dummad-Jehová, we-napneg, degi, nibneg obinnisgua,
amba sapimar napneggi sated, amba yoo gaganmar-aragana ainidabalid. Ar ade, Bab-Jehová amba yoo dii napagi owidaged, degi, dule napagi-arbaega satebalid.
Unnila napagi dii-bupurmakmaid, bergwapa napa ogegar.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová napa susgu, a-napagi dule-sobsad. Bab-Jehová dule-sobsagu, dule-asugi buu imaksad. Geb agi, dule burba-nika gunonikid. Agine, dule dula-gunonisunnad.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová dad-nakwedsik, Edénʼgi nainu-nued nasiksad. Agi, Bab-Dummad-Jehová we-dule-obinnisad ogwisnonikid.
Agine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová sapimar akar-akar bela yeerdaklemalad ainiega imaksad. A-sapimar-e-san bela yeer-gulle imaksad. Nainu-nued-abargi, sapi-wargwen gwichid. Dule we-sapi-e-san guchale, dula-gudii guoed, gwen burgosulid. Degine, sapi-baid gwichibalid. Dule we-sapi-e-san guchardina, wisguoed, ibu ibnuedi, ibu ib-isganabali.
Degine, Edénʼgi diwar maid. Agi, e-saila-siid. A-diwar nainu-nued ogmaid. A-diwar ana-sogabake nikad.
Gebe-ana-gwensakgadi Pisónʼye nugad. A-diwar bela Havila-yalaganba bipirmakmaid. Aginbali, a-yargi or nikad.
Havila-yargine or-nikadi, or-nuedid. Agi sapi-nued-gichi-nikad-bedelioʼye-nugad nikad. Degi, akwa-nued-óniceʼye-nugad nikabalid.
Diwar-ana-sogbogwaddi Gihón-diwarye nugad. A-diwar bela Cus-yalaganba bipirmakmaimogad.
Diwar-ana-sogapaagwaddi Hidekelʼye nugad. A-diwar, Asiria-dad-nakwedsik maid. Diwar-sogabakegwaddi Éufratesʼye nugad.
Nainu-nued-Edén-akwega, Bab-Dummad-Jehová, dule-ogwisnonikid, agi arbaegar.
Agine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová dulega igar-uksad: “We-nainu-nuedgi sapimar-bukwad-e-sanmar sunna bela be gunned.
Unnila sapi-wargwen-e-sandi melle be gunno. We-sapi, ibmar-nued-wisi, ibmar-isgana-wisi dule-saed. A-sapi-e-san be guchale, a-ibagi be burgoed.”
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová sogded: “Dule wargwen-gudiir, akuu dakleged. Degisoggu, dulega e-abirgined an imakoed, adi, e-bendaked-nuedga guegar.”
Bab-Dummad-Jehová napagi bela ibmar-durgan, bela nuumar obinnisad. Bab-Jehová we-ibdurganmala Adánʼse senonikid. Adi, Adán ega nug amiegar. Dule ibmar-durganga nug-amisad, abali, ibmar-durgan nugnanaed.
Weyobi dule bela we-ibmar-durgan: Ibmar-durgan-sunna-akwilemaladga, bela nuumarga, bela ibmar-durgan-sapurbarmaladga, nug amisad. Degi-inigwele, Adánʼgardi e-bendaked sate gusad.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová Adán-ise-nue-gabega imaksad. Adán nue-gabmaigu, Bab-Jehová Adán-e-dikargar-wargwen onosad. Geb Bab-Dummad-Jehová gannar Adán-e-san edisad.
Bab-Dummad-Jehová we-dikargargi ome-obinnisad. Agi, macheredga ome-senonikid.
Adán ome-dakdegu, sogded: “Ar wedi an-galado, ar ade, an-gargi obinnilealedid. Wedi an-sanado, ar ade, an-sangi obinnilealedid. Ar Bab-Dummad we-ome macheredgi obinnisad. We nugguodo, Omeye.”
A-ulale, machered e-babgi bangudoed, e-nangi bangudoed. Geb machered e-ome-ebo garmakdii guoed. Ebogwadi, san-wargwennagwadga gunonikoed.
Deunni, Adán, Eva-ebogwa, uka-swili garmakdimalad, gwen binged nikasurmalad.
Bab-Dummad-Jehová we-napneggi bela ibmar-durgan obinnisad. Amar-abargi, naibedi ibmar-durgan-baiganba dule-binsaed-gaedgi bur buledid. Naibe omega sogded: —¿Etto, Bab-Dummad bemarga sogsa: ‘We-nainu-nuedgi sapimar-gwichid-e-san melle bipisaale gunmaloye?’
Ome naibe-abin sogded: —Ar igid-sapi-e-san anmar we-nainu-nuedgi gunbimala, sunna bela anmar gunmalad.
Unnila nainu-nued-abargi sapi-wargwen-gwichid-e-sanbi geg anmar gunned. Bab-Dummad anmarga sogsado: ‘Melle a-sapi-e-sandi be gunmaloye, degine, melle be ebumarbaloye. Ar bemar guchale, bemar burgwemaloye.’
Ar naibedi omega sogded: —Suli, degisuli. Bemar gwen burgosuli.
Ar Bab-Dummad nue-wisid, bemar we-sapi-e-san guchale, ibmar-wisii gudmaloed. Geb agine, bemar Bab-Dummadyob ibmar-wisi gudmaloed, ibi ibnuedi, ibi ib-isganabali.
Ome sapi-san-dakdegu, dakalid, sapi-san yeerdaklege, nued-gulle-daklege, degine, nue-ibmar-wisi sunna dule-imake daklege. Degisoggu, ome sapi-san-gwachagu, guchad. Geb ome e-suiga uksamogad. E-suide guchamogad.
Geb agine, na ebobela neg-ittos nadmalad, emarde uka-swili garmakdii. Geb degine, saburega gagan-urwagiid-higueraʼye-nugad maksamalad. Agi, na saburusmalad.
Dule, e-omebogwa, neg-sedogudanikidgi itoarmalad, Bab-Dummad-Jehová, nainu-nued-abargi garmakdii. Dule, e-omebo deyob itosmargu, Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼgi nainu-nuedgi sapimar-bukwad-imbaba dukunadmalad. Adi, mer Bab-Jehová emar-dakegar.
Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼdi macheredse goted, ega sogded: —¿Bia be gudii?
Dule abin-sogded: —An be-itosad, nainu-nued-imbaba be gudii. Ar an uka-swili-gudisoggu, an be-dobee itoged. A-ular, an be-idu dukusad.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad macheredse egichialid: —¿Ar doa bega sogsa, be uka-swilii gudiiye? An bega sogsad: ‘Sapi-wargwen-e-san mer be gunnoye.’ ¿A-sapi-e-sande be guchasi?
Dule Bab-Dummad-abin sogded: —Ome-anbo-garmakdiguega be anga-uksadi, a, anga sapi-e-san uksad. Geb an guchasunnad.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová omese egichided: —¿Ibiga deyob be imaksa? Ome abin-sogded: —Ar naibe an-yardaksad. A-ular, sapi-e-san an guchad.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová naibega sogded: “Ar weyob be imaksasoggu, ibmar-durgan-akwilemaladba, degi, ibmar-durgan-sapurbarmalad-baiganba, bedi bur bule be ukabsalesun. Emi-iba-onodedgi, be napagi unimakdii gusun, degine, be-burgwedse, napa-madii be gusun.
Ome-ebogwa na be isdar-dakdii an be-imakoed. Ome-e-wagwa, be-wagwa-ebo na isdar-dake gumaloed. Ome-e-wagwa be-nonogi annaoed. Bedina e-mali-gasigi onakliksaoed.”
Bab-Dummad omega sogded: “Be sikwi-bakalile, nunmaked-dummad an bega ukoed, nunmakedgi be ugakguoed. Be-suibina be sogdii guoed. Be-sui be-iduedga guoed.”
Bab-Dummad macheredga sogdemogad: “Ar be-ome-sogedba, sapi-e-san-mer-gunnoye an bega sogsadi, be guchasoggu: Deyob be imaksad-ular, we-napa iwiles nagusun. Be burgwedse ise-arbaar-alamakdiidgi, be masgunned-amidii gusun.
Napa bega ikomar nikuoed, napa bega gagan-ikobiid nikuoed. Gagan-nainuginmalad-gunne be guoed.
Be-wimaked-osuurmakedgi na be masgunned-amidii guoed. Deyob be guoed, be napaga gannar guedse. Ar ade, napagi be danikid. Ar be napasoggu, be burgwisale, napaga gannar be binyoed.”
Ar omede bela dulemar-dula-gunonikoed-e-nanga guosoggu, Adán na e-ome Evaʼye onugsasad.
Bab-Dummad-Jehová, macheredga, degi, omega ibmar-durgan-uka morga imaksad. Geb macheredga, degi, omega mor yossunnad.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová sogded: “Emigindi, dule anmar-sunnaa gunonimogad. Dulemarde ibmar-nued-wisi, degine, ibmar-isgana-wisi gunonikid. Ar dule sapi-e-san-dula-dule-imaked-guchale, degisadegu dula-gudii guoed. Degisoggu, melle dulemar we-sapi-e-san gwanegala, degi, melle gunnegala, dulemar-nainu-nuedgi-gudiid, an onogoed.”
Degisoggu, a-ular, Bab-Dummad-Jehová, nainu-nued-Edénʼgi dule-gudiid onossunnad. Degine, napagi-arbaega dule-imaksad. Ar ade, napagi dulede danikid.
Bab-Jehová, Adán nainu-nuedgi-gudiid onosgua, nainu-nued-dad-nakwedsik baliwiturmar-querubinʼye-nugad ogwichisad. Degine, es-suid-gwabunye-gwichid bela bipirmakgwichi imaksabalid. Adi, melle dule-wargwensaar sapi-dula-dule-imakedse warmakmalagar.
Adán e-ome-Evaʼse-gochagu, Eva gurgin-nika gunonikid. Evaʼga susugwa uklenonikid, Caínʼye onugsasad. Ar Eva sogded: “Bab-Jehová na e-sogedba susugwa anga uksad.”
Geb a-sorba, Evaʼga Abel uklenonikid, Caín-e-urba. Abel sibad-wawaad-edarbedga gusad. Caínʼdi sapurba-arbaed-dulega gusad.
Ibagan-nasad-sorbali, Caín na e-ibmar-sanmaksamalad wesad. Geb Bab-Jehováʼga-ukega senonikid.
Abelʼdi na Bab-Jehováʼse sibad-wawaad-gebegwalulesmalad senonimogad, geb oburgwisad. A-sibad-wawaad-e-gwallu ogumakar Bab-Jehováʼga uksad. Bab-Jehová Abel-yeer-daksad, degine, ega-ibmar-uksad yeer daksabalid.
Bab-Jehová Caín-yeer-daksasulid, degine, ega-ibmar-senonikid amba yeer daksasurbalid. A-ulale, Caín bela-bela sae-itoalid. E-wagar-daklegedi magar-dakleged, nue sae-itoged.
Geb degine, Bab-Jehová Caínʼga sogded: “¿Ibiga sae be itoge? ¿Ibiga be-wagar urwakwaa daklege?
Ar ibmar-nued be imakele, ¿an be-abingassurmogar be insae? Eye, an be-abingasmogale. Ar emigindi, be ibmar-nued imaksursoggu, isgued begi-aibinega guakwaa be-edarbediid. Degi-inigwele, sunna isguedgi be obined.”
Ibagwengi, Caín e-urbaga sokalid, sapurba wis-garmakdii sanamarye. Geb ebo-sapurba-gudiidgi, Caín e-urba-Abel-sarsosad, geb oburgwisad.
Geb degine, Bab-Jehová Caínʼse egichided: —¿Bia be-urba-Abel nade? Caín, Bab-Jehová-abin sogded: —An wissuli. ¿Ar ande an-urba-edarbedsi?
Bab-Jehová Caínʼga sogded: —Ar wede, ¿ibi be imaksa? Be-urba-ablis be eosad. Emide, a anga sogeyob an itoged: ‘Anga be igar-naboye.’
Be be-urba oburgwisadba, napa be-urba-e-ablis gobsad. A-ulale, be ukabsalessunnad.
A-ular, be nainugi arbaoen-inigwele, bega ibmar sanmakosulid. Be we-napneggi dule-wakindiiyob negsuli gudii guoed.
Geb degine, Caín, Bab-Jehová-abin sogded: —Weyob sabsur be an-odurdakele, gwen guo an itosulid.
Ar emi-ibagi, nainugi-arbaedgi be an-ononaisoggu, we-napneggi garmakdii, dikasur begi bangus gudii, dule-wakindiiyob negsuli, obunnoged-sate an gudii gudoed. Degisoggu, doa-dule an-dakalile, an-oburgoed.
Bab-Jehová Caín-abin sogded: —Suli, deyob guosuli. Ar dule be-oburgwele, we-dule-be-oburgwisad ilagugle (7) bur bule sabsur-odurdaklegoed. Geb degine, Bab-Jehová Caínʼgi wilub nasiksad, adi, dule-gwensak Caín-dakalile, melle oburgwegar.
Caín Bab-Jehováʼgi bangudgu, Nod-yargi megidapid. Nod-yarde Edén-dad-nakwedsik naid.
Caín e-omese-gochagu, e-ome gurgin-nika gunonikid. Machigwa-ega-uklesad, Enocʼye onugsasad. Caín, neggwebur urbenonikid. E-machi-nugba, we-neggwebur Enocʼye onugsanonikid.
Enoc, Irad-e-babad. Iradʼdi, Mehujael-e-babad. Mehujaelʼdi, Metusael-e-babad. Metusaelʼdi, Lamec-e-babmogad.
Lamecʼdi ome-warbo-nikusad: Wargwen Adaʼye nugad, baiddi Zilaʼye nugad.
Ada machi-nikusad, Jabalʼye onugsasad. Jabal-inse dordoneg-sobed onoded. A-inse ibmar-durgan-akwedgi-arbaed onodbalid.
Jabal urba nikusad, Jubalʼye nugad. Jubal-inse gar-arpa-ogoled onoded. A-inse gammu-ogoled onodbalid.
Zilaʼdi machigwa-nikunonimogad. Tubal-Caínʼye a-machigwa onugsasad. Tubal-Caín-inse esgoro-gordikidgi-ibmar-sobed onoded, degi, esgorogi-ibmar-sobed onodbalid. Tubal-Caín bun-wargwen nikusad. E-bunde, Naamaʼye nugad.
Ibagwengi, Lamec e-omemarga sokalid: “Ada, Zila, an bemarga ibmar-sogoedi, nue be an-itomalo: Dule naibi-an-imaksad-ular, an oburgwisad. Machigwa an-sarsosad-ular, an oburgwisad.
Ar dule Caín-oburgwisale, we-dule ilagugle (7) buged-mai, sabsur-odurdaklegoye sogleged. Ar dule an-oburgwisardi, we-dule an-oburgwisad-ular, dulapaa-gakambe-gakagugle (77), bur bule sabsur-odurdaklegergebed.”
Adán e-omese gochabargu, Eva susugwa-nikunonikid. Geb Eva sogded: “Caín, e-urba-Abel-oburgwissoggu, Bab-Dummad susugwa anga Abel-anar uknonikid.” A-ular, Eva a-susugwa Setʼye onugsasad.
Set machigwa-nikusmogad, Enósʼye onugsasad. A-ibagan-akar, dulemar Bab-Jehováʼse gotemalad.
We, Adán-e-wagan-nugmar-narmakar-mamaid-e-gardad. Bab-Dummad dule-obinnisgua, deunni na e-sunnague dule-imaksad.
Bab-Dummad machered ome-ebogwa obinnisad. Wemargi ise-nued binsasad. Bab-Dummad dulemar-obinnisgua, amarga sogsad: “Bemar, duleye nugguoye.”
Adán birga-dulanergwa-gakambe-nikadgi (130), e-machi gwalulesad, Setʼye onugsanonikid. Setʼde bela Adánʼsun-dakleged, degine, bela e-bab-daeyobi dabalid.
A-sorba, Adán birga-dulataled-ilabaabak (800) napi-gudii gusad. Adán, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Adán bela birga-dulataled-ilabakebak gaka durgwen-gakambe (930) dula-gudii gusad. Degi-birga-nika Adán burgwisad.
Set birga-dulatar-gakatar-nikadgi (105), e-machi-Enós gwalulesad.
A-sorba, Set birga-dulataled-ilabaabak gakagugle (807) napi-gudii gusad. Set, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Set, bela birga-dulataled-ilabakebak gakambe-gakabo (912) dula-gudii gusad. Degi-birga-nika Set burgwisad.
Enós birga-dulabake-gakambe-nikadgi (90), e-machi-Cainán gwalulesad.
A-sorbali, Enós, birga-dulataled-ilabaabak gakambe-gakatar (815) napi-gudii gusad. Enós, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Enós, bela birga-dulataled-ilabakebak gakatar (905) dula-gudii gusad. Degi-birga-nika Enós burgwisad.
Cainán, birga-dulapaa-gakambe-nikadgi (70), e-machi-Mahalaleel gwalulesad.
A-sorbali, Cainán, birga-dulataled-ilabaabak gaka dulabo (840) napi-gudii gusad. Cainán, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Cainán, bela birga-dulataled-ilabakebak gakambe (910) dula-gudii gusad. Degi-birga-nika Cainán burgwisad.
Mahalaleel, birga-dulapaa-gakatar-nikadgi (65), e-machi-Jared gwalulesad.
A-sorba, Mahalaleel, birga-dulataled-ilabaabak gaka dulagwen-gakambe (830) napi-gudii gusad. Mahalaleel, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Mahalaleel, bela birga-dulataled-ilabaabak gaka dulabake-gakambe-gakatar (895) dula-gudii gusad. Degi-birga-nika Mahalaleel burgwisad.
Jared, birga-dulabaabak-gakabo-nikadgi (162), e-machi-Enoc gwalulesad.
A-sorba, Jared, birga-dulataled-ilabaabak (800) napi-gudii gusad. Jared, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Jared, bela birga-dulataled-ilabakebak gaka dulapaa-gakabo (962) dula-gudii gusad. Degi-birga-nika Jared burgwisad.
Enoc, birga-dulapaa-gakatar-nikadgi (65), e-machi-Matusalén gwalulesad.
Matusalén-gwalulesad-sorba, Enoc, birga-dulataled-ilapaa (300) Bab-Dummad-walikaa nanadii gusad. Enoc, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Enoc, bela birga-dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulapaa-gakatar (365) dula-gudii gusad.
Ar Enoc, Bab-Dummad-walikaa nanadii gussoggu, ibagwengi sate daklealid, ar ade, Bab-Dummad na-sesad.
Matusalén, birga-dulabakebak-gakagugle-nikadgi (187), e-machi-Lamec gwalulesad.
A-sorba, Matusalén, birga-dulataled-ilagugle gaka dulabake-gakabo (782) napi-gudii gusad. Matusalén, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Matusalén, bela birga-dulataled-ilabakebak gaka dulapaa-gakabakebak (969) dula-gudii gusad. Degi-birga-nika Matusalén burgwisad.
Lamec, birga-dulabakebak-gakabo-nikadgi (182), e-machi gwalulesad.
Noéʼye e-machi-onugsasad. Ar ade, sogded: “Bab-Jehová we-napa-ukabsassoggu, a-ular, anmar ise-alamaknai arbaergebed. Ar emigindi, we-machigwa anmarga obunnoged ukoed.”
Noé-gwalulesad-sorba, Lamec, birga-dulataled-ilatar gaka dulabake-gakambe-gakatar (595) napi-gudii gusad. Lamec, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Lamec, bela birga-dulataled-ilagugle gaka dulapaa-gakambe-gakagugle (777) dula-gudii gusad. Degi-birga-nika Lamec burgwisad.
Noé, bato birga-dulataled-ilatar (500) nikagua, e-masmala gwalulenonikid: Sem, Cam, degi, Jafet.
Dulemar we-napneggi merguarmargu, degi, ega bunormala gwalulemaiguargu,
masmala-Bab-Dummadba-nanamalad dakalid, dulemar-yagan yeer daklemala. Degisoggu, masmala-Bab-Dummadba-nanamalad dulemar-yagana-ebo-nikuega na e-abegedba susdamalad.
Agi, Bab-Jehová sokalid: “Ar dulemar unnila dule-gumarsoggu, An-Burba dule-dula-imaked degisadegu eba gudii guosulid. Degisoggu, dulemar burgoed. A-ular, unnila birga-dulanergwa (120) dula-bukwa gumaloed.”
Masmala-Bab-Dummadba-nanamalad, dulemar-sisgan-nikudmargu, mimmigan-baknonimalad. A-burwigan dule-mas-bipisuli gusmalad. Wemala, epennegwa dule-gala-ibegan, degi, dule-nuga-nika gusmaladid. A-akale, dule-masdummagan we-napneggi-nika gunonikid.
Bab-Jehová dakalid, we-napneggi dogdar dulemar-isgued mergugusa, degine, we-dulemar unnila ibmar-isgana-imakedginbi binsadimala.
Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová ulubgi nue bukib-binsaedba, sogded: “Dulemar an we-napneggi urbissulina, bur nabirinad.”
A-ular, Bab-Jehová sogded: “An dule-obinnisad we-napneggi an obelogodo. Degine, bela ibmar-durgan, bela ibmar-durgan-napagi-garmakdimalad, degi, nuumar an obelobalodo. An we-ibmarmar-obinnisadgi, nue-nunmak an itoged.”
Ar degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová Noéʼbi nued-gudii daksad.
Noé-igar weyob maid: Noé ibmar-inniki-imaked-duled. A-ibagangine, dule Noéʼgi akar-ibmar-soged sated. Noé Bab-Dummad-walikaa nanadii gusad.
Noé machimala-walapaa nikusad: Sem, Cam, Jafet.
Deunni, bela-dulemar, Bab-Dummad-asabin, we-napneggi nue-isgus gudidiid. Deginbali, dulemar na sabsur-imakbukwamarbalid.
Bab-Dummad-dakded, bela-dulemar we-napneggi dogdar nue-isgus gudidimala, degisoggu, neg nue-isgus naisunnad.
A-ulale, Bab-Dummad Noéʼga sogded: “Bela dulemar an osulosokalid. Dulemar galagwensulidaed, muchub-muchub sabsur-imakmaladi yaisulid. A-ulale, dulemar an obelogoed, degine, we-napneg-naid an obelobaloed.”
Bab-Dummad sogdebalid: “Noé, ur-dummad na be sobo. Suar-goferʼye-nugad-e-urgomar be ebugoed. Ur-soboedgi gwardumar be sioed. Ur-dummad-be-soboeddi magaba, degine, yaba baryagi bela be magoed.
Weyob ur-dungu be soboed: E-sugued, dali-dulapaa-gakambe-gakatar (75) be imako. E-matardungueddi, daliambe-gakabo-abala (12½) be imako. E-nibgued, daligugle-abala (7½) be imakbalo.
Ur ailapaa-nika be soboed, e-uas-urba e-yawagak-bipigwad achabogi urba be sioed, degine, e-dikarba yawagak be ogwisbaloed.
”We-napneg-odogega muusaila an barmidagoed. Bela we-napneggi ibmar-dula-gudidimalad an obelogoed, bela burgoed.
”An bebo igar-meso. We-ur-dummadyaba be dogo: Be, be-ome, be-masmala, degi, be-balamar.
Be-sunnaa durgumogoed. Ur-dummadyaba, bela we-napneggi ibmar-durgan-nikadi, abirgunagwar-abirgunagwar be oubogo.
Bela ibmar-dula na egad-egad balibimaladba, abin-abin war-warbo ur-dummadyaba beba ubomogo: Bela nuumar, bela ibmar-durgan, bela ibmar-durgan-napagi-garmakdimalad, adi, bela amar durgumarmogagar.
”Degine, bela mas akar-akar be onmakbalo, degi, nue sabobalo, adi, we-mas be gunnegar. Degine, ibmar-dula-gudidimalad we-mas gunmogagar.”
Ar igi Bab-Dummad Noéʼga sogsa, aba bela Noé ibmar imaksad.
Geb a-sorba, Bab-Jehová Noéʼga sogded: “Emi-ibagangi, dulemar-bukwad-abargi, unnila bebi an-asabin inniki nanadiid. Degisoggu, be, be-gwenadganmala ur-dummadyaba be doge.
Geb bela ibmar-durgan-swilidikmalad: Machered-walagugle (7), ome-walagugle, ur-dummadyaba be oubogo. Ibmar-durgan-swilidiksurmaladdi unnila machered-wargwen, ome-wargwen be oubogo.
Nuumala amba deyob be imakbaloed: Nuumar-swilidik-akar-akar-nikadi, gwagugle-gwagugle (7-7), abirgunagwar-abirgunagwar ur-dummadyaba be oubogo. Adi, we-napneggi bela ibmar-durgan, nuumarse-bakar, egad-egad balibimalad mer e-dula berguegar.
”Ar ade, ibaguglese (7) dii an owioed, iba-dulabo (40) mutikidba, degi, ibginedba dii-winai an imakoed. ¡We-napneggi bela ibmar-dula-obinnilesad, bela an obelogoed!”
Ar igi Bab-Jehová Noéʼga sogsa, aba bela Noé ibmar imaksad.
We-napneggi muusaila-nosgua, deunni, Noé birga-dulataled-ilanergwa (600) nikad.
Noé-ur-dummad-sobsadyaba-dogsamaladi, wemalad: Noé, e-ome, e-masmala, degi, e-balamar, adi, muusailaba melle burgwemalagar.
Ibmar-durgan-swilidikmalad, ibmar-durgan-swilidiksurmalad, nuumar, ibmar-durgan-napagi-garmakdimalad,
a-ibmar-durgan, igi Bab-Dummad Noéʼga sogsadyobi, Noéʼba ur-dummadyaba war-warbo abirgunagwar-abirgunagwar dogsamalad.
Ibagugle-gusgu (7), muusaila napneggi muluded.
Noé birga-dulataled-ilanergwa-nikadgi (600), nii-warbogwad-ibambe-gakagugledgi, dii-wilasailadgi bela napa-urba-dii-sailagan-mamaid utuded, degine, nibneggi-dii-sailagan-mamaid argaded.
Napneggi iba-dulabo (40) bane-bane mutikidba, ibginedba, dii-winai gusad.
Noé, ur-dummadyaba-dogsad-ibagi, wemar eba dogsamarmogad: E-ome, e-machi-Sem, e-machi-Cam, e-machi-Jafet, degi, e-masmala-omegan. We-dulemarbi ur-dummadyaba dogsamalad.
Wemarba bela ibmar-durgan-na-egad-egad-balibimalad dogsamarbalid. A-ibdurgan wemalad: Ibmar-durgan-sapurbarmalad, ibmar-durgan-sunna-akwilemalad, ibmar-durgan-napagi-garmakdimalad, nuumar, degi, bela ibmar-sakan-nikamalad. We-ibmar-durgan, Noéʼba ur-dummadgi dogsamarmogad.
Bela ibmar-dula-gudidimalad Noéʼba ur-dummadyaba war-warbo dogsamalad.
Bab-Dummad Noéʼga-sogsadba bela ibmar-durgan-akar-akar na abirgunagwar-abirgunagwar dogsamalad. Geb a-sorba, Bab-Jehová ur-dummad-yawagak edisad.
Iba-dulabo (40) napneggi dii-winai gusad. Dii-muludgu, ur muamakded. Degisoggu, ur-dummad dii-birgi muamaknai gusad.
Dii sabsur-muremai-muremai guded. Ur-dummaddi dii-birgi muamaknai gussunnad.
Dii bela-bela mulussoggu, napneggi-yar-dummagan-bukmalad bela dogsad.
Bela yarmar dogsa-sigisgu, amba dii dalipaa-abala-wilub (3½) muremai gusad.
Weyob bela ibmar-durgan-we-napneggi-bukwad burgwisad: Nuumar, ibmar-durgan-sunna-akwilemalad, ibmar-durgan-sapurbarmalad, ibmar-durgan-unimalad, degi, bela dulemar burgwismarmogad.
We-napneggi ibmar-dula-gudimalad, bela burgwisad.
Weyob bela we-napneggi we-ibmarmar obelolesad: Dulemar, ibmar-durgan, ibmar-durgan-napagi-garmakdimalad, degi, nuumar, amar bela burgwismalad.
Unnila, Noé, degi, ur-dummadyaba-bukwamaladbi durgusmalad. Dakargu, iba-dulagugle-gakambe (150) bela napneggi dii-saila mulus nagusad.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad Noéʼgi, degi, ibmar-durgan-sapurbarmaladgi, ibmar-durgan-sunna-akwilemaladgi, bela ur-dummadyaba-bukwadgi binsaded. Bab-Dummad we-napneggi burwa ogornonikid. Geb degi, dii ilided.
Deginbali, demar-wilasailadgi dii-sailagan-mamaid atided, degine, nibneggi dii-sailagan-mamaid atidmogad. Dii bar wissulid.
Agine, dii binna-binna ilided. Iba-dulagugle-gakambe-gusgu (150), dii nue ilided.
Geb nii-walagugled-ibambe-gakagugledgi, ur-dummad Ararat-yalagangi megidapid.
Dii nue-iremai gualid. Nii-warambed-gebe-iba-onodedgi bato yar-dummagan-e-mullumar noalid.
Iba-dulabogwad-sorba (40), Noé ur-dummadgi yawagak-bipi-soblesad egasad.
Geb agi, sikwisichid barmisad. Sikwisichiddi gannar-gannar gukudii gusad, dii-dingued edarbedii gusad.
Noé sikwisichid-barmisad-sorba, nuu barmisad, adi, dakega sana napa dingudibeye.
Ar napa amba yoo dingusoggu, nuu siged amissurgusad. Degisoggu, gannar ur-dummadse nonikid. Noé e-argan onosgu, nuu-gasad, ur-dummadyaba gannar nuu-odosad.
Noé ibagugle (7) napi edarbisbalid, a-sorba gannar nuu barmisbalid.
Bato nue neg-mutikguali, nuu gannar nonikid. E-nugargi olivo-gagan senonikid. Agi, Noé nabir neg-nue-dingumaid mag daksad.
Noé amba ibagugle (7) napi edarbisbalid, geb agi, gannar Noé nuu barmisbalid. Agindi, nuu Noéʼse bar gannar nonisulid.
Degidgine, Noé birga-dulataled-ilanergwa-gakagwensak-nikadgi (601), napneg nue dingusad. Nii-gebe-gwisguded-ibagwenadgi, Noé ur-dummad-e-uas earisad. Geb agi dakded, napa dingusnai.
Nii-warbogwad-iba-dulagwen-gakagugledgi, napa nue-dingusad.
Geb degi, Bab-Dummad Noéʼga sogded:
“Ur-dummadyaba-be-gudiid be nodago. Be-ome, be-masmala, degi, be-balagan beba nodamarmogo.
Ibmar-dula-gudidimalad ur-dummadyaba-bukwad bela be onobalo: Nuumar, ibmar-durgan, degi, ibmar-durgan-napagi-garmakdimalad, adi, amar bela we-napneg-naid-ugakaase mimilemalagar. Deginbali, dula ichesur mergumalaga, we-napneg-naidgi bela ambikumalagar.”
Geb degine, ur-dummadyaba-bukwadgi nosmarsunnad: Noé, e-ome, e-masmala, degi, e-balamar.
Bela ibmar-durgan ur-dummadyaba-bukmaladi na-egad-egad-balibimaladba, ainismarmogad: Bela ibmar-sapurbarmalad, degi, bela ibmar-durgan-akwilemalad, bela ibmar-durgan-napagi-garmakdimalad, bela nuumar, ur-dummadgi ainismalad.
Geb agine, Noé, Bab-Jehová-nug-odummogega, ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila sobsad. Geb Noé bela ibmar-durgan-swilidikmalad, degi, nuumar-swilidikmalad akar-akar-ugakaase susad. Geb degine, ailagi ogumakar Bab-Jehováʼga uksad.
Ibmar-ogumakaled-yeer-yapanned Bab-Jehováʼse-mosgu, Bab-Jehová sogded: “We-napneg dulemar-isgued-ular, bar an ukabsaosulid. Ar dulemar gusgu na sapingwagwad-akar e-gwagegi unnila isguedginbi binsadimalad. Degine, an emi-imaksadyob, muusailaba bela ibmar-dula-gudidiid bar an ogilogosulid.
Amba we-napneg-naidgi, ibmar diglegoed, ibmar welegoed, neg uere guoed, neg diopii guoed, yola-nii naguoed, dii-wied-nii naguoed, neg-ibgined naguoed, neg-mutikid nagubaloed. Bela wemar-ibmar nikagu guoed, sate guosulid.”
Bab-Dummad Noéʼgi, degi, e-masmalagi ise-nued binsasad. Weyob ega sogsad: “Mimmigan-bukidar be nikumar, we-napneggi dula be omelomar, bela we-napneg-ugakaase ambikumar.
Bela we-napneggi ibmar-dula-gudidimalad be-dobedba bemar-asabin gwakidmaloed: Bela ibmar-durgan-gukumalad, bela ibmar-durgan-napaginmalad, bela ibmar-durgan-napagi-garmakdimalad, bela ibmar-durgan demarginmalad. Bela-a-ibmar-durgangi be obine gumaloed.
”Bela ibmar-dulamalad, degi, gagan-araragana-sunna-gullemalad sunna bemar gunmaloed. Ani an bela bega uknaid.
”San-abebiid, melle be gunmalo. Ar abegi burba-dulagued danikid.
Ar ibmar-durgan be-oburgwisale, an we-ibdurgan oburgwemogoed. Dule, dule-oburgwismogale, amba oburgwilemogoed.
Ar Bab-Dummad dule e-sunnague-obinnissoggu, dule-gwensak dule-oburgwisale, dule-baid a-dule-oburgwemogoed.
”Bemardi mimmigan-bukidar nikumar. Be-mimmigan we-napneggi mergumai gusun.”
Bab-Dummad Noéʼga, degi, e-masmalaga sogdebalid:
“Nabir, ani an bemarbo, degi, be-waganmarbo an igar mesoed.
Degine, bela ibmar-dulamalad bemarba ur-dummadyagi-bukwa-ainisad: Nuumar, ibmar-durgan-sunna-akwilemalad, ibmar-durgan-sapurbarmalad. ”Bela we-ibmar-durgan-we-napneggi-bukmaladbo an igar mesoed.
An-bemar-ebo-igar-mesoedi gwen gwagosulid: Bela dulemar, degine, bela ibmar-durgan muusailagi bar an ogilogosulid. We-napneg obelogega bar muusaila murosulid.
”An bemar-ebo, degine, an bela ibmar-durganbo-igar-mesnaidi, degisadegu maiguoed. A-e-wilubgan weyob maiguoed: Sue maiguoed.
Mogir-imbaba an sue-mesoedi, we-napnegbo an igar-mesoed-e-wilubga guoed.
We-napneggi mogirmar-gutumakalile, an-sue mogir-imbaba megnonikoed.
Geb an nue-ebinsaoed, an bemarbo, degi, bela ibmar-durganbo igar mesisad. Bela ibmar-dulamalad-ogilogega, baid-muusaila-weyobid bar murosulid.
Mogir-imbaba sue megnonikile, an dakoed. Agi, ani, Bab-Dummad, bela dulemarbo, degine, bela ibmar-durgan-we-napneggi-bukmaladbo degisadegu-igar-mesisad an ebinsaoed.
”We-napneggi bela dulemarbo, degi, ibmar-durganbo an igar-mesisadi, sue, e-wilubga guoed.” Deyob Bab-Dummad Noéʼga ibmar sogsad.
Noé-machimala ur-dummadyaba-nosmaladi, wemardo: Sem, Cam, Jafet. Camʼde, Canaán-e-babad.
Wemar-warbaagwad Noé-masmala gumalad. We-napneggi dulemar-bukmalad, belagwapa wemargi danimalad.
Noé napagi arbadgua, uva digsad.
Ibagwengi, Noé vino gobsagu, mumgusad. Noé e-dordonegyaba uka-swiri meremai gusad.
Canaán-e-bab-Cam, e-bab-Noé uka-swiri-mai-daksagu, nodegusad. E-iamar-warbogwad-magaba-gwichidga sogdapid.
Geb degi, Sem, Jafet-ebo e-bab-edugega mor-dummad amismalad. Geb gukinba mor-dummad-gani sorsik-sorsik nadegusmalad. Baidsik ataknadapi gusmalad, adi, mer e-bab uka-swiri-maid dakegar. Geb a-mor-dummadgi e-bab-edusmalad.
Noé nue-wibamasgu, atakalid. E-machi-bipigwad igi e-imaksa deyob, wisgusgu sogded:
“¡Canaán, be iwigusun! Be-iamar-e-mai-mesagwaledga be gusun.”
Geb degi, Noé sogdebalid: “Sem-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, a-e-nug odummolesun. Sem-maiga Canaán gudii gusun.
Bab-Dummad, Jafet-neg gatik nasgumai imakena gadin. Jafet, Sem-e-dordoneggi gudii gusun, degine, Canaán Jafet-maiga gusun.”
Muusaila-mulusad-sorba, Noé amba birga-dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulabo-gakambe (350) dula-gudii gusad.
Degisoggu, Noé, birga-dulataled-ilabakebak gaka dulabo-gakambe-nikadgi (950) burgwenonikid.
Noé-masmala, wemalad: Sem, Cam, Jafet. Wemarde muusaila-mulusad-sorba, na mimmigan nikusmalad. Noé-masmala-e-wagan ambikusmalad, wemalad:
Jafet-masmala, wemalad: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javán, Tubal, Mesec, degi, Tiras.
Gomer-masmaladi, wemalad: Askenaz, Rifat, Togarma.
Javán-masmaladi, wemalad: Elisa, Tarsis, Quitim, degi, Dodanim.
Wemar, Jafet-wagan gumalad. Wemar, demar-gakaba ambikusmalad. Gaya emar-emarbi sunmakmalad. Degine, na e-dadgan-e-dadganba, dulemar na emar-emar ambikusmalad.
Cam-masmala, wemalad: Cus, Mizraim, Fut, degi, Canaán.
Cus-masmaladi, wemalad: Seba, Havila, Sabta, Raama, degi, Sabteca. Raama-masmaladi, wemalad: Seba, Dedán.
Cus, Nimrod-e-babad. Nimrod-insega we-napneggi nuga-nikad gusad, dule-dutusulid gusad.
Nimrod, Bab-Jehová-nabir-egi-binsasadba sapurba ibmar-maked-dule gusad. A-ulale, weyob-sogleged: “Dule-Nimrodʼyob ibmar-maked-duleye.”
Nimrod, we-neggweburmargi negsemai gusad: Babelʼgi, Erecʼgi, Acadʼgi, degi, Calneʼgi. We-neggweburmar, Sinar-yargi bukwagusad.
Geb Nimrod Sinar-yargi-nodegusgu, Asiria-yarse nadegusad. Agi, we-neggweburmar urbidapid: Nínive, Rehobot, Cala, degi, Resén.
Resén-neggwebur-dummad, Nínive, Cala-ebo-abingunaid-abargi siid.
Mizraim-wagan, wemalad: Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naftuhim,
Patrusim, Casluhim, degi, Caftorim. Casluhim-dulegi Filistea-dulemar danikid.
Canaánʼdi, Sidón-e-babad. Sidónʼde, Canaán-machi-sailaginedid, geb degine, Hetʼye-nugad, baksabalid.
Canaán-wagan, wemalad: Jebuseo-dulemar, Amorreo-dulemar, Gergeseo-dulemar,
Heveo-dulemar, Araceo-dulemar, Sineo-dulemar,
Arvadeo-dulemar, Zemareo-dulemar, Hamateo-dulemar. Geb sorbali, Canaán-dulemar na e-dadgan-e-dadganba aisakidmalad.
Canaán-dulemar e-yar-gasadi, wemalad: Sidón-neggweburgi onoded, Gerar-yalasik, Gaza-neggweburse warmaksad. We-yar-e-neggweburmarde, wemalad: Sodoma, Gomorra, Adma, degine, Zeboimʼsik, Lasa-neggweburse.
Wemar, Cam-e-wagan gumalad. E-dadgan-e-dadganba, degine, gaya emar-emarbi-sunmake ambikusmalad. Yar-egad-egad, degine, dulemar emar-emarbi ambikusmalad.
Deginbali, Jafet-e-ia-Sem, machimala-nikusmogad. Heber-masmala, bela Sem-wagan gumalad.
Sem-masmala, wemalad: Elam, Asur, Arfaxad, Lud, degi, Aram.
Aram-masmaladi, wemalad: Uz, Hul, Geter, Mas.
Arfaxad, Sala-e-babad. Salaʼdi, Heber-e-babad.
Heber machimala-warbo nikusmogad: Machi-sailagined Pelegʼye nugad. Ar ade, a-ibagangi dulemar aisakided. Peleg-e-urba, Joctánʼye nugad.
Joctán-masmala, wemalad: Almodad, Selef, Hazarmavet, Jera,
Adoram, Uzal, Dicla,
Obal, Abimael, Seba,
Ofir, Havila, degi, Jobab. Wemar belagwapa, Joctán-machimala gued.
Wemar Sefar-yalagansik, Mesa-nadedgi, bukwagusmalad. We-yalagande dad-nakwedsik naid.
Wemar Sem-e-wagan gumalad. E-dadgan-e-dadganba, degine, gaya emar-emarbi-sunmake ambikusmalad. Yar-egad-egad, degine, dulemar emar-emarbi ambikusmalad.
Wemar, Noé-machimala, e-gwenadgan-e-gwenadganba ambikusmalad. Na e-wagan-e-wagan yar gasmalad. Wemar muusaila-mulusad-sorba, bela we-napneggi-aisakis ambikusmalad.
Epennegwa, bela dulemar unnila gaya-gwennaa sunmakmalanad.
Dad-nakwedsik dulemar nadgua, Sinarʼgi nebabi-nai dakdapid. Agi ambikudapmalad.
Ibagwengi, na ga muchub-muchub sokarmalad: “Anmar dakebinne, anmar napa-ginnid akwayob dutusuli sobe, geb degine, anmar soogine ogumakar imakoed.” Weyob akwa-anar napa-ginnid-akwayob-dutusuli-sobaled ebusmalad, degine, barya ebusmarbalid, ebo acha-acha imakegar.
Geb a-sorba, sogdemarbalid: “Anmar dakebinne, anmar neggwebur-dummad sobmala. Geb neg-matusulid nibnegse-warmakedse, anmar sobbaloed. Anmar deyob imakele, bela anmar nug-nika gumaloed, dule-dummaganga anmar gumaloed, degine, adi, mer anmar we-napneggi aisakimalagar.”
Geb Bab-Jehováʼdi, dulemar-neggwebur-dummad-sobnanaid, degine, dulemar-neg-matusulid-sobnanaid-dakega aidenonikid.
Geb Bab-Jehová binsaded: “Wemar, unnila dulemar-soggwenna gued, unnila gaya-soggwenna sunmakmalad. We-arbaedgebe-imaklenaid-obelosmalale, sogdamarbaloed, arbaed-baid anmar imakmarbarye. Degisoggu, bar galegosurmalad.
A-ulale, anmar aidenaergebed, ei gaya oburnaegar, adi, na aku itomaloed.”
Deyobi, Bab-Jehová belagwapa we-napneggi dulemar-osakisad. Degisoggu, we-neggwebur bar sobsasurmalad.
We-neggweburgine, Bab-Jehová weyob dulemar gaya-akar-akar-sunmakega imaksad. A-ulale, we-neggwebur Babelʼye nuggusad. Geb wegine, Bab-Jehová bela dulemar we-napneg-ugakaase osakisad.
Wemar, Sem-e-wagan gumalad: Birgabogus muusaila-nasad-sorba, Sem-machi-Arfaxad gwalulesad. Deunni, Sem birga-dulatar (100) nikad.
A-sorbali, Sem birga-dulataled-ilatar (500) napi-gudii gusad. Sem machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Arfaxad birga-dulagwen-gakambe-gakatar-nikadgi (35), e-machi-Sala gwalulesad.
A-sorbali, Arfaxad birga-dulataled-ilabake-gakapaa (403) napi-gudii gusad. Arfaxad machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Sala birga-dulagwen-gakambe-nikadgi (30), e-machi-Heber gwalulesad.
A-sorbali, Sala birga-dulataled-ilabake-gakapaa (403) napi-gudii gusad. Sala machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Heber birga-dulagwen-gakambe-gakabake-nikadgi (34), e-machi-Peleg gwalulesad.
A-sorbali, Heber birga-dulataled-ilabake gaka dulagwen-gakambe (430) napi-gudii gusad. Heber machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Peleg birga-dulagwen-gakambe-nikadgi (30), e-machi-Reu gwalulesad.
A-sorbali, Peleg birga-dulataled-ilabo-gakabakebak (209) napi-gudii gusad. Peleg machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Reu birga-dulagwen-gakambe-gakabo-nikadgi (32), e-machi-Serug gwalulesad.
A-sorbali, Reu birga-dulataled-ilabo-gakagugle (207) napi-gudii gusad. Reu machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Serug birga-dulagwen-gakambe-nikadgi (30), e-machi-Nacor gwalulesad.
A-sorbali, Serug birga-dulataled-ilabo (200) napi-gudii gusad. Serug machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Nacor birga-dulagwen-gakabakebak-nikadgi (29), e-machi-Taré gwalulesad.
A-sorbali, Nacor birga-dulatar-gakambe-gakabakebak (119) napi-gudii gusad. Nacor machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Taré bato birga-dulapaa-gakambe-nikadgi (70), e-masmala Abram, Nacor, degi, Harán gwalulesad.
We, Taré-e-igar: Taré, Abram-e-babad. Nacor, degi, Harán amba Taré-masmalamogad. Haránʼde, Lot-e-babad.
Harán e-bab-Taré-iduar Caldea-dulemar-yargi, Ur-neggweburgi burgwisad. Urʼde Harán-gwalulesad-neggweburad.
Abram, Sarai-nikusad. Nacorʼdi, Milca-nikusad. Milcaʼde, degi, Isca, Harán-e-sisgan gumalad.
Saraiʼdi geg mimmi nikued, ar ade, gusgu muu-neggi geg mimmi-bake danikid.
Taré Canaán-yarse-naega Caldea-dulemar-yargi Ur-neggweburgi noar gusad. Taré na eba wemar sear gusad: E-machi-Abram, e-wagwa-Lot Harán-machi, degine, e-bala-Sarai e-machi-Abram-ome. Degi-inigwele, Taré, Harán-neggweburse-mosgu, agi megidapmalad.
Geb Taré, Harán-neggweburgi birga-dulataled-ilabo-gakatar-nikadgi (205) burgwisad.
Ibagwengi, Bab-Jehová Abramʼse gornonikid, ega sognonikid: “Be-neggweburgi be noe, be-gwenadgangi be bangu, be-bab-neggi-be-gudiid be nae. An bega neg-oyogoedse be nae.
Begine, dulamar bukidar-mergue an imakoed. An begi ise-nued-binsaedgi, an bega ibmar imakoed. Dule-nue-nug-nikadga an be-imakoed. Degine, be-nuggi dulemargi ise-nued binsalemarmogoed.
Dulemar-ise-nued-begi-binsamaladgi, an ise-nued egi binsamogoed. Dulemar-be-ukabsamaladgi, an ukabsaar sunmakmogoed. Be-nuggi, bela dula-we-napneggi-bukwamaladgi ise-nued an binsaoed.”
Abram, Bab-Jehová-ega-sogsadba Harán-neggweburgi-maid nodegusad. Lot, Abramʼba nadegusmogad. Abram birga-dulapaa-gakambe-gakatar-nikadgi (75), Haránʼgi-mai noalid.
Abram Canaán-yalase-argua, wemar eba sealigusad: E-ome-Sarai, e-niga-Lot, e-maimar-Haránʼgi-amisad. Degine, na ibmar-nikad bela sealigusbalid. Abram, degi, eba-nadapmalad Canaán-yarse modapmarsunnad.
Geb Abram Canaán-yalagi dogded. Siquem-neggweburse warmakdapid, bia sapi-islidikid-Moreʼye-nugad-gwichidse. Deunni, a-yalagangine, Canaán-dulemala bukwamalad.
Agine, Bab-Jehová Abramʼse magarosad, ega sogded: “We-yar an be-waganga ukoed.” Agine, Abram Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila sobsad, ar ade, Abram soged, Bab-Jehová wegi anse magarosaddeeye.
Geb agine, Abram yalagansik naded. We-yalagande Betel-neggweburgi dad-nakwedsik siid. Agi, dordoneg sidapid. Degisoggu, Betel-neggwebur egi dad-argwanedsik signonikid. Hai-neggweburdi dad-nakwedsik egi signonikid. Abram agi Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-baid sobsabalid. Geb degine, Bab-Jehováʼse agi gochasunnad.
Geb a-sorba, Abram Neguev-yalagansik binna-binna nadap gusad.
Deunni, a-ibagangine, bela Canaán-yargi ukud-dummad nagunonikid. Ar Abram na e-maidgi mas-satesoggu, Abram Egipto-yarse sikwas megnad gusad.
Abram Egipto-yarse warmakdanigu, e-ome-Saraiʼga sogded: “Omegwa, an wisdo, be yeerdakleged.
Degisoggu, Egipto-dulemar be-dakalile, sogdamaloed: ‘We-omegwa, we-machered-e-omeye.’ Andi an-oburgwemaloed, bedi be-oburgosurmalad.
Degisoggu, mer an-oburgwemalaga be sogodo, be an-bunye. Adi, be-ular anga ibmar bela nueganbi guegar.”
Abram Egipto-yarse modapgu, Egipto-dulemar dakalid, Sarai bela-bela yeerdaklege.
Dummagan-Faraónʼga-arbamalad daksamarmogad, Sarai yeerdaklege. Amar Faraónʼse nadegusmalad, ega sogdapmalad, ome bela-bela yeerdakleye. Wemar-dummagan Faraón-negse Sarai-sesa gusmalad.
Sarai-ulale, Faraón Abram-nued-akwisad. Sibad-wawaadmar, moli-bebe-nikamalad, moli-uayasuid-machergan, moli-uayasuid-omegan, mai-machergan, mai-omegan, degine, moli-yargan-muremalad Abramʼga uksad.
Degine, Faraón e-negse Abram-e-ome-Sarai-sesad-ulale, Bab-Jehováʼdi Faraón, degi, e-negyaginmalad-sabsur-odurdaksad, boni-dummagan ega uksad.
A-ulale, Faraón Abramʼse gochad, ega sogded: “¿Ibiga wede deyob be an-imaksa? ¿Ibiga be anga sogsasuli, we-omegwa an-omeye?
Emide, be anga sogsad, we-ome, an-bunye. Ar emide sunna an-omega an imaked-nagad. ¡Be-ome na be sede! ¡Be nae!”
Geb degine, Faraón na e-sordamarga igar-uksad, Abram, e-ome, degi, bela ibmar-nikad sedoye, Egipto-yargi-naed imakoye.
Abram Egipto-yargi-noargu, e-ome, degi, bela na ibmar-nikadi sealid. E-niga-Lot eba aligusmogad. Amar Neguev-yalaganse gannar nonimalad.
Ar Abram ibmar-durgan-bukidar-nika nonikid, mani-bukidar, degi, or-bukidar-nika nonikid. Degisoggu, dule-mani-ibedga gusad.
Neguev-akar, Abram gannar binna-binna alid. Betel-neggweburse geb warmakdapid. Geb degi, gannar naded, bia gebe na dordoneg sisagusadse. We-negde Betel-negabargi, degi, Hai-negabargi siid.
Agine, deunni, Abram Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila sobsa gusad. Agine, Abram Bab-Jehováʼse gocha gusad.
Lot amba dule-mani-ibedmogad. E-gilor-Abramʼyob sibad-wawaadmar, moli-bebe-nikamalad, degi, dordonegmar nikamogad.
Ar emar-mamaidgi, ibmar-durgan bukidar nikamarsoggu, ibmar-durganga mas unnisuli gualid. A-ular, Abram, Lot-ebogwa geg na walikaa gudigue guarmalad.
Molimarga mas unnisulidba, Abramʼga-dule-moli-bebe-nikad-akwemalad, Lotʼga-dule-moli-bebe-nikad-akwemalad-ebo na uluardamalad. Aginbali, a-ibagangine, Canaán-dulemar, degi, Ferezeo-dulemar a-yargine amba bukwamarmogad.
Ibagwengi Abram Lotʼga sokalid: “Anmar na gwenadgan gumalad. Degisoggu, anmar na boni-nika gudiile, ibnuedsulid. Degi, anga-moli-bebe-nikad-edarbemalad, bega-moli-bebe-nikad-edarbemarmogadbogwa urwemarmogale, we ibnuedsurbalid.
Emi be dakena, napa unniguar be-asabin naid. Degisoggu, be-abegedba na be sudo, igid bur be suoe. Degisoggu, angi be bangusun. Ar be argan-sapiledsik naye be sogele, andi argan-nuedsik naoed. Argan-nuedsik be naye sogele, andi argan-sapiledsik naoed.”
Lot bela Jordán-diwarsik Zoar-neggweburse neba-naid dakded. A-nebagi dii nue-nika, degine, Bab-Jehová-nainu-nuedyob-daklege dakalid. E-daklegedde Egipto-yaryob daklebalid. Ar Bab-Jehová Sodoma-neggwebur, degi, Gomorra-neggwebur-obelogoed-iduale, we-neggweburmar yeer daklegenad.
Geb degine, Lot bela Jordán-diwarsik-neba-naid susad. Na e-maidgi dad-nakwedsik nade gusad. Weyobi, Abram, Lot-ebogwa, na bangud gusmalad.
Abramʼdi, Canaán-yalagi besad. Lotʼdi, nade gusad. Nebagi neggweburmar-bukwadse megnade gusad. Geb Lot Sodoma-neggwebur-waliksaar e-dordornegmar sisad.
Sodomaʼgi dulemar-bukwad bela-bela isgana nanaed, isgued-dummagan Bab-Jehová-asabin imakdimalad.
Lot Abramʼgi-bangusad-sorba, Bab-Jehová Abramʼga sokalid: “Be-maidgi be dad-nakwedsik, dad-argwanedsik, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik nue be neg dako.
We-napnegmar be dakedi, bela bega an ukoed. We-yalagan begadga degi, be-wagangadga degisadegu guoed.
Ukubyob be-wagan yaisur-mergu, an imakoed. Ar igi ukub geg ebislege, deyobi, be-wagan geg ebisle gumogoed.
Degisoggu, emisgindi, bela we-yalaganba be nae, ar we-yala an bega ukoed.”
Geb degine, Abram nade gudsunnad, e-dordonegmar-siid sesa gusad. Abram Hebrón-neggwebur-walik megnaded, sapi-islidikmalad-Mamreʼgi-bukwadse. Agi, Abram Bab-Jehová-nuggi, Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila sobsad.
Deunni, we-reymar negdakmamaid: Sinar-e-rey-Amrafel, Elasar-e-rey-Arioc, Elam-e-rey-Quedorlaomer, degi, Goim-e-rey-Tidal, wemar, neg-dakmaid.
A-ibagangi, deunni, we-reymar-walabakegwad, baigan-reymar-ataled-ebo bila-onogega na atosmalad. We-reymar-walataled atosmarmogad: Sodoma-e-rey-Bera, Gomorra-e-rey-Birsa, Adma-e-rey-Sinab, Zeboim-e-rey-Semeber, degi, Bela-e-rey. We-Bela-neggweburde, Zoarʼye nugbalid.
Wemar-e-ataled, e-sordamar Sidim-nebagi urbisad, Demar-Gagbidye-nugad-walik.
Rey-Quedorlaomer birgambe-gakabogus (12) we-reymar-walataled-e-dummadga-gudigu, we-reymar-walataled birgambe-gakapaagusgu (13), sogdemalad: “Anmar we-rey-Quedorlaomerʼgi gwisguergeboye.”
Birgagwen-nasad-sorba, Quedorlaomer, degine, reymar-eba-nanaimalad Astarot-Karnaim-yalagansik bila-ononadmalad. Agine Refa-dulemargi nakwismalad. A-sorba, Hamʼgi Zuz-dulemargi nakwismalad. Geb Save-Quiriataimʼgi Emita-dulemargi nakwismalad.
Seir-yalagangindi Horí-dulemargi nakwismalad, Parán-nebase baregichamalad. We-Paránʼde nega-dulesulid-walik naid.
Quedorlaomer, degine, reymar-eba-gudidimalad we-dulemar-sogabakegwadgi-nakwisgu, gannar aibiris armalad. Geb Enmispatʼye-neg-nugadse nonimalad. We-Enmispatʼde, Cadesʼye nugbalid. Rey-Quedorlaomer, degi, reymar-eba-gudidimalad Amalec-dulemar-yalaganba bela ibmar obelonadap gusmalad. Deyob Amorreo-dulemar-imaksamarbalid. We-Amorreo-dulemarde Hazezon-Tamar-yalagangi bukwamalanad.
Geb degine, Sodoma-e-rey, Gomorra-e-rey, Adma-e-rey, Zeboim-e-rey, Bela-e-rey, bila-onomalaga, Sidim-nebase nonimalad. Bela-neggweburde, Zoarʼye nugbalid.
Agi, we-reymar-e-ataled, baigan-reymar-warbakegwadbo uludmalad. Ebo-ulusmaladi, wemalad: Elam-e-rey-Quedorlaomer, Goim-e-rey-Tidal, Sinar-e-rey-Amrafel, degi, Elasar-e-rey-Arioc, we-reymar ulusmaladid.
Dakargua, bela Sidim-nebagi yaa-dummagan-bukidar-bukwa nanaed. We-yaa-dummagande barya-yaisur nikad. Sodoma-e-rey, degi, Gomorra-e-rey urwenanaigua, wakite gusmalanad. Degi-inigwele, yaa-dummadgi argwatapmalad. E-sordamar-baigandi yalaganba wakitemalad.
Reymar-nakwismaladi, Sodoma-neggweburgi, degi, Gomorra-neggweburgi, bela masgullemalad, degi, bela ibmar-nuegan sesmalad.
Ar Abram-niga-Lot, Sodomaʼgi-maimosoggu, reymar-nakwisad Lot-sesa gusmarmogad, degi, bela e-ibmar-nikad e-ibe sesa gusmarbalid.
Ar dule-wargwen nabir wakichasoggu, Abramʼga bela ibmar sognonikid. Abramʼde Hebreo-duled. Abramʼde Amorreo-dule-e-sapi-dummagan-walik maid. We-Amorreo-dulede Mamreʼye nugad. Mamreʼdi, gwenadgan nikad, amarde wemalad: Escol, Aner. Wemala, Abramʼba naimaladid.
Abram itoargu e-niga gales-selesye, geb e-maimar-e-neg-yagi-gwalulesmaladse gochad. Wemarde bila-onomaladid. Belagwapa dulataled-ilapaa gakambe-gakabaabak (318) mergued. Amarmala, Dan-neggweburse reymar-Lot-gasa-sesmalad-balegitemalad.
Abram, dulemar-eba-nadapmalad danar-danar oambikusgu, mutikidba ukiar reymargi ubodapmalad. Abram, degi, e-sordamarmala, emargi nakwismargu, we-reymar-wakitemalad Hoba-neggweburse balegichamalad. Hobaʼde Damasco-neggwebur-dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik siid.
We-reymar-ibmar-sesadi, Abram bela gannar susad. Deyobi, Abram e-niga-Lot-galesad onosad, degi, bela gannar Lot-e-ibmar susbalid. Deginbali, omegan-onosbalid, degi, bela dule-baigan-galesmalad amba onosbalid.
Abram Quedorlaomerʼgi, degi, Quedorlaomerʼba-reymar-gudidimaladgi nakwis-danigua, Sodoma-e-rey, Save-neba-naidgi Abram-abindakega abin noalid. Save-nebade Rey-Nebaye nugbalid.
Geb degine, Salem-e-rey-Melquisedec, madu, degi, vino Abramʼga senonikid. We-Melquisedecʼde dule-irwa-Bab-Dummad-Bur-Biriginedse-goledid.
Geb degine, Melquisedec, Abramʼgi ise-nued-binsaedgi, weyob sogded: “Abram, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined begi ise-nued binsaoed. We-Bab-Dummad, nibneg, degi, napneg bela obinnisadid.
Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-e-nug odummolesun. A-Bab-Dummad be-isdarmaladgi-nakwega be-imaksad.” Geb degine, Abram bela ibmar-gannar-susadi, yopira-emarbi-sogambegi (10) mamarisad. A-gwensak Melquisedecʼga uksad (10%).
Geb degine, Sodoma-e-rey Abramʼga sogded: —Dulemarbi be anga udage. Ibmarmardi be sue.
Ar Abramʼdi abin-sogded: —Suli. Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-Jehováʼga ise-sogar an imaksad. We-Bab-Dummadde nibneg, degi, napneg bela obinnisad.
Aga, an sogsad: ‘Bipisaale ibmar an be-ibe suosurye, dubamar, degi, sapat-dubse-bakar, an-nag-uka-edinnega gwen an bei suosurye. Adi, melle be an-annik sogega, an we-dule mani-ibedga imaksaye.’
Andi an ibmar abesulid. Unnila sapingana-anba-gudidimalad-e-mas-guchamaladbi anga unnigualed. Degine, dule-anba-arbimalad, Aner, Escol, degi, Mamre, amardi igar-maidba ibmar sumaloed.
Weyob-gusad-sorbali, Abram negburgan-daksad. Agi, Bab-Jehová ega sunmakded, ega sogded: “Abram, melle be dobguo, ar sigu-abgaedyobi, an be-irwa gwisgudioed. Degine, bega-ibmar-nued-uklegoedi, bega ibmar-dummadga guoed.”
Abram Bab-Jehová-abin sogded: —Bab-Jehová-Bela-Negsemaid, ar be wisid, an mimmigan-sated, degite, ibmar-dummad be anga ukoye sogedi, ¿ar wede ibi-nuedga anga guosunna? Degisoggu, bela-an-ibmar-nikadi, we-anga-neg-daked-Damasco-dule-Eliezer, an-sorba bela ibmar gaoed.
Abram sogdebalid: —Ar be anga mimmi-uksasursoggu, anga-arbaed-dule an-sorba bela ibmar gasunnoed.
Bab-Jehová Abram-abin sogded: —Suli, degisuli. Be-sorba ibmar-bela-gaoedi, be-machi-sunnad bela be-ibmar gaoed. We-Eliezerʼdi suli.
Geb degine, Bab-Jehová magaba Abram-sesad, ega sogded: —Nue be niba atake, be niisgwamar ebise, ar sunna be ebisodibe. Weyob-mergu wagan be nikuoed.
Abram, Bab-Jehová-ega-ibmar-soged gwen bengussulid. Degisoggu, a-ulale, Bab-Jehová, dule-isgussulidyob Abram-daknonikid.
Bab-Jehová Abramʼga sogded: —Ani an Bab-Jehová gued. Caldea-dulemar-yargi Ur-neggweburgi be-maigu, ani an be-onosad, adi, we-yar an bega ukega, degi, begadga guegar.
Abram Bab-Jehová-abin sogded: —Bab-Jehová-Bela-Negsemaid, degite, ¿igi nue an wisguosunna, we-yarde nue angadga guoe?
Bab-Jehová abin-sogded: —Anga be we-ibmar sedagoed: Moli-bebe-nikad-ome-birgapaagwad, sibad-birgapaagwad, sibad-wawaad-machered-birgapaagwad, sapur-nuu-gwagwen, degi, wagnuu-e-mimmi-gwagwen be anga sedabalo.
Abram bela we-ibmar-durgan Bab-Jehováʼga senonikid. Geb amar negabala-daasa marisad. Geb degi, asabin-asabin mesisad. Nuumardi marissulid, gwagwar mesisad.
Geb mulamala we-ibmar-durgan-burgwarmaladse duurmaknonikid. Ar Abramʼdi we-mulamar-ononnonai gualid.
Neg-mutikguargu, Abramʼgi bela-bela gabed gwichigunonikid. Ukiar, negsichid bela Abram-ebilis nagusad. Agine, nue dobe itoalid.
Geb degine, Bab-Jehová Abramʼga sogded: —Nue be wisguergebed, be-wagan e-yarsulidgi gudii gumaloed. Agi maiganga gumaloed, degine, a-yargi birga-dulataled-ilabake (400) sabsuli be-wagan-wiomaloed.
Dulemar-be-wagan-maiga-imakoedi, ani, an sabsur-odurdakoed. Agi, be-wagan ainidamalogu, ibmarmar-nuegan nue-nika ainidamaloed.
Ar bedina nue-sered-mai be burgoed, degine, nue-bogidikidgi be diglegoed.
Ar emigindi, amba yoo Amorreo-dulemala bela-bela isgumarsoggu, be-wagan ilabakegus-gwagedgi, geb we-yarse be-wagan gannar nonikoed.
Bato neg-mutikgusgu, bela-bela bato negsichinadedgi, sianargi waa bupurmaksii daklealid. Degine, acha-gwallu-gamai daklearbalid. A-sianar, degi, a-gwallu ibmar-durgan-negabar-maraled-bukwad-abargi nadapid.
A-ibagi, Bab-Jehová Abram-ebo igar mesisad. Agi Abramʼga sogded: —We-yala be-waganga an ukoed, Egipto-diwar-maid-akar, diwar-dummad-Éufrates maidse.
Yarmar an bega sogedi, wemardo: Ceneo-dulemar-bukwad-yala, Cenezeo-dulemar-bukwad-yala, Cadmoneo-dulemar-bukwad-yala,
Het-dulemar-bukwad-yala, Ferezeo-dulemar-bukwad-yala, Refa-dulemar-bukwad-yala,
Amorreo-dulemar-bukwad-yala, Canaán-dulemar-bukwad-yala, Gergeseo-dulemar-bukwad-yala, Jebuseo-dulemar-bukwad-yala, bela we-yalamala an be-waganga ukoed.
Sarai e-sui-Abramʼga geg mimmi bake gusad. Saraiʼde e-mai-Egiptoʼgined nikad, Agarʼye nugad.
Geb Sarai, Abramʼga sogded: —Bab-Jehová geg goe-bake an-imaksad. Degisoggu, an bese wilesakwaa egissundo, bunagwa an-maiga-gudiidse be gole. Abakale a-omebali, an mimmi nikualile. Abram Sarai-ega-soged nabir itosad.
Deunni, Abram birgambegus (10) Canaán-yargi maid. Geb a-ibagangine, Sarai bunagwa-Egiptoʼgined-Agarʼye-nugad, Abramʼga urmaksad, ese golegar.
Abram Agarʼse-gochagu, Agar gurgin-nika gunonikid. Agar gurgin-nikagudi-itoargu, e-dummad-Sarai-ibgwensur dakded.
Geb degine, Sarai Abramʼga sogded: —¡Be-ular, emide, Agar ibgwensur an-dakalid! An-sunnad an bega Agar-urmaksad, ese be golegar. Ar emide, mimmi-nikuo-itogedba, anba bur dummarba san-imaked. Emigindi, Bab-Jehová sogoed, wede doagi ataklegoe: Begine, igi angine.
Geb degine, Abram Sarai-abin sogded: —Be-itoleged, be-mai begi siid. Ar igi be Agar imakbie, be imakodo. Geb degine, Sarai sabsur Agar-imakalid. Degisoggu, a-ular, Agar wakitesunnad.
Ar Bab-Jehová-e-baliwitur nega-dulesulidganba, Shur-igar-maidsik dii-saila-siidgi Agar-abingualid.
Bab-e-baliwitur Agarʼse egichialid: —Sarai-e-mai-Agar, ¿bia be daniki? ¿Bia be nae? Agar abin-sogded: —An-dummad-Sarai-idu an wakinmai.
Geb degine, Bab-Jehová-baliwitur ega sogded: —Be-dummadse gannar be nae. Ar igi bega sogdagoe, bela aba be ibmar imako.
Aginbali, Bab-Jehová-baliwitur Agarʼga sogdebalid: “Be-wagan bela-bela an omelogoed. Degisoggu, geg dule ebise guoed.”
Bab-Jehová-baliwitur sogdebalid: “Be bonigwar-gudiidi, susugwa be nikuoed. Bab-Jehová be-wilediid itossoggu, we-machigwa Ismaelʼye be onugsaoed.
We-machigwade yaisurdae guoed, moli-uayasuid-sapurbalidyob guoed. We-machi dulemar-baiganbo bela urwoed, degi, bela-dulemar-baigan ebo urwemarmogoed. Degine, e-gwenadgangi gwisgubalo-inigwele, e-gwenadgan-abargi-mai guoed.”
Ar Agarʼde Bab-Jehová-ebo sunmaksasoggu, Bab-Dummad an-dakmaidye neg onugsasad. Ar ade soged, Bab-Dummad-an-daksaye. Degite, amba an dula-gudiiye.
A-ulale, dia nugad, Dia-Dule-Dulad-An-Dakmaidye. We-diadega Cades, degi, Bered-ebo-abingunaid-abargi siid.
Geb degine, omegwa-Agar, Abramʼga machigwa baknonikid. Geb Abram, a-machigwa Ismaelʼye onug-imaksad.
Ismael gwalulenonigua, deunni, Abram birga-dulabake-gakanergwa (86) nikad.
Abram birga-dulabake-gakambe-gakabakebak-nikadgine (99), Bab-Jehová ese magarononikid, ega sognonikid: —Ani, an Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadid. An-sogedba be nue-innikii nanadii guo.
An bebo igar-mesisad, gannar an bega sogbar: ‘Wagan-bukidar-nikuega an be-imakoed.’
Geb degine, Abram Bab-Dummad-asabin napase e-bebe-ebulegedse dulluu imaksad. Bab-Dummaddi ega sogdebalid:
—Weyob an bebogwa igar-mesoed: Be, dule-yar-baid-baidgi-ambikumaloed-e-dad-dummadga an be-imakoed.
Ar dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-ambikumaloed-e-dad-dummadga an be-imakosoggu, be bar Abramʼye nugguosulid. Emi-onodoedgine, Abrahamʼye be nugguoed.
Wagan-bukidar-nikuega an be-imakoed. Begine, reymar ainidagoed, degine, yar-baid-baidgi be-waganmar-bukwa an imakoed.
Degisadegu, an bebo igar-mesoed, degine, yoedse be-wagan-ebo an igar mesbaloed. Ani, an degisadegu be-Bab-Dummadga guoed. Degine, be-sorba be-wagan-e-Bab-Dummadga degisadegu an gubaloed.
Emi, Canaán-yala be-yalasur-inigwele, degite, a-yalagi be garmakdiid. We-Canaán-yalade, bela degisadegu an bega uked, degi, be-sorba, be-waganga an ukbaloed. A-yalade, degisadegu bemargadga guoed. Deginbali, ani, an be-wagan-e-Bab-Dummadga gubaloed.
Deginbali, Bab-Dummad Abrahamʼga sogdebalid: —Be, degi, bela be-wagan degisadegu anbo-igar-mesnaidba be nanamalo.
Weyob an bebogwa igar-mesnaid, be-wagan we-igar-mesnaidba imakmarmogoed: ‘Bela bemar-abargine, masmala e-abgan-uka-duku sikmaloed.’
”Bemala be-abgan-uka-duku sikergebed. Weyob we-ibmar-imakedgi bemar-anbogwa-igar-mesisad mag daklegoed.
Emi-ibagan-onodoedgi, bela masmala, ibabaabakgus (8) gwalulegedgi e-abgan-uka-duku ega siklegoed. Deyob degibi be-wagan be imakmarmogoed. Be-wagansurmalad amba deyob imakmarmogoed. Be-mai be-neggi gwalulesaddibe, be-mai manigi be dule-baidse baksaddibe, amba deyob be imakbaloed.
Be-mai be-neggi-gwalulesaddibe, be-mai manigi be dule-baidse baksaddibe, wemar e-abgan-uka-duku-siksuli be imakosulid. Weyob an bemar-ebo igar-mesnaid be-abgangi degisadegu mag daklegoed.
”Ar dule e-abgan-uka-duku siksulile, we-dule bemar-abargi onolegergebed. Ar bemarbo an-igar-mesisad-sogedba imaksasulid agala onolegergebed.”
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad Abrahamʼga sogdebalid: —Be-ome bar Saraiʼye nugguosulid. Emi-onodoedgine, Saraʼye nugguoed.
Be-omegi ise-nued an binsaoed. Bemarga machigwa an ukoed. Eye, napiragwa, be-omegi ise-nued an binsaoed. Sara dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-ambikumaloed-e-nanaga guoed, degine, e-wagana dulemar-e-reyga gumaloed.
Abraham napase e-bebe-ebugedse dulluu imaksad, geb allided. Agi, binsaded: “¿Ar wede dule-birga-dulatar-nikad (100) sunna babga gusi? ¿Ar wede Sara birga-dulabake-gakambe-nikadgi (90) sunna nanga gusi?”
Geb degi, Abraham Bab-Dummadga sogded: —¡Bitigi Ismaelʼgi be nued binsaena gadin! An-sorba bela an-ibmarmar Ismaelʼgadga guena gadin.
Bab-Dummad Abraham-abin sogded: —Suli. Deyob guosuli. Ar an bega soged, be-ome-Sara bega mimmi bakoye. A-machigwa Isaacʼye be onugsao. An bebo-igar-mesisadi, be-machigwa-Isaac-ebo gannar we-igar an obinogoed. Ar degisadegu Isaac-e-wagan-ebo we-igar mai guoed.
”Emi, be-machi-Ismaelʼga be ibmar-egichisadi, an be-itosbalid. Be-machi-Ismaelʼgine ise-nued an binsamogoed. Mimmigan-bukidar-nikuega an imakoed, degine, wagan-bukidar-merguega an imakbaloed. Ismael, dule-dummagan-nuga-nikamalad e-ambe-gakabogwad-e-dadga (12) an imakoed, degine, e-dulamar ichesur an imakoed.
An-bebo-igar-mesisaddina, Isaac-ebogwa igar-maigu an imakoed. Sara birgagwense we-ibaganse bega mimmi bakoed.”
Bab-Dummad Abraham-ebo-sunmaknaid-bergusgua, nade gusad.
A-ibagi-gines, Abraham e-machi-Ismael-e-abgan-uka-duku siksad. Ar igi Bab-Dummad ega sogsa, bela e-maimar-e-neggi-gwalulesmalad, bela e-maimar manigi-baklesad, degi, belagwable machergan-e-neguyagi-gudidimalad e-abgan-uka-duku-sikega imaksad.
Abraham birga-dulabake-gakambe-gakabakebak-nikadgi (99), e-abgan-uka-duku siksad.
Ismaelʼdi birgambe-gakapaa-nikadgi (13), e-abgan-uka-duku ega siksamalad.
Abraham, degi, e-machi-Ismael-ebo iba-galagwen abgan-uka-duku-siked-igar imaksamalad.
Machergan-bela-Abraham-neguyagi-gudidimalad, e-maimar-e-neg-yagi-gwalulesmalad, dule-baidse maimar-manigi-baklesad, amar Abrahamʼba belagwable abgan-uka-duku-siked-igar imaksamalad.
Bab-Jehová sapimar-islidikmalad-Mamreʼgi-gwichid-dikarba Abrahamʼse magarosad. Deunni, yorukudba, Abraham e-dordoneg-yawagakgi siid.
Abraham atakdegu, dakded, machergan-walapaa gwichi. Deyob dakdegu, Abraham abindaknaega gwichibin imaksad. Ese modapgu, a-dulemar-abin napase e-bebe-ebulegedse dulluu imaksad.
Abraham amarga sogded: —An-dummad, an bese ise-wilesakwaa egised, melle be bakar nao. An-negse be obunnoda.
Ar be nabir-itogele, an bemarga dii aminao, adi, bemar nag-enukegar. Geb a-sorba, bemar sapi-urba obunnonamaloed.
Ar bemar an-neg-maid-walik-nadapsoggu, an bemar-ogannogega bemar-naed-idu an bemarga masgunned sunaoed. Dule-warbaagwad abin-sogdemalad: —Nueddo. Be-sogedbardo.
Abraham gwae-gwae e-dordonegyaba-dogdegu, e-ome-Saraʼga sogded: —¡Gwaegwa! Madubur-bur-nued, nued-mergu madu-sobega be sue.
Geb degi, Abraham, moli-bebe-nikamalad-bukwadse abarmakdebalid. Moli-senigwad-bur-nued, bur-san-dutugwad susad. Geb degine, dule-ega-arbaedgala uksad. Geb a-dulede, gwae yog duar-imaksad, adi, mas-gunmalagar.
Abraham we-dulemar-warbaagwadga moli-san uksad, moli-nunis uksabalid. Geb degine, moli-nunis-gwamakaled ega uksabalid. Abrahamʼdi amar-sapi-urba-mas-gunbukwad, daksii gusad. Abakalegi ibmar-baigan abearbalirye binsaed.
Geb dulemar-warbaagwadi Abrahamʼse egichiarmalad: —¿Bia be-ome-Sara nade? Abraham abin-sogded: —Dordonegyaba gunai.
Geb degi, warbaagwad-wargwen sogded: —Baid-birgase gannar an bese nonibaloed. A-ibagangi, be-ome-Sara bato susugwa-nika gudioed. Ar Saraʼdi, neg-dogedyaba Abraham-yarganba dulemar-Abraham-ebo-sunmaknanaid bela itogwichid.
Dakleargua, Abraham, degi, Sara, bato nue selebagusmalad. Deginbali, Sara bato wagub-guchabalid.
A-ulale, Sara allided, ulubgi binsaded: “Bato ande selebagusad, degi, an-suide selebagusmogad. Wegiid an bar dakosur-itole. ¿Ar wede sunna an bar mimmi nikuosi? Geg bar an nikued.”
Ar Bab-Jehováʼdi, Abrahamʼga sogded: —¿Ar ibiga Sara alle? ¿Ar ede seredgussoggu, geg bar mimmi-nikuye binsade?
¿Ar Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-geg-gued nikasi? Suli. Baid-birgase gannar an bese ataknonibaloed. A-ibagangine, Sara machi-wargwen bato nikuoed.
Sara Bab-Jehová-weyob-ibmar-soge-itoargu, Sara dobe-itoded. A-ular, osuloded, sogded: —An alle-gwissuli. Ar Bab-Jehováʼdi abin-sogded: —¡Suli! Be allisa.
Geb a-sorba, dulemar-warbaagwad gwisgusmargu, Sodoma-neggwebursik atakdemalad. Geb degi, asik nadmarsunnad. Abraham sikwas eba nade gusmogad, adi, amarga sogega, degimaloye.
Geb degine, Bab-Jehová binsaded: “¿Ar an ibmar-imaksokalid Abrahamʼgi an odukuode?
Abrahamʼde dulemar-bukidarad-e-babga guosoggu, degine, dulemar-dutusulid-e-babga gubalosoggu, an ibmar-imaksokalid an ega sogergebed. Deginbali, an ega sogsabalid: ‘Begi bela we-napneggi yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladgi an ise-nued binsaoye.’
Deginbali, Abraham an susbalid, adi, an-igar-maidba e-mimmigan-odurdakega, degi, e-wagan-odurdakega, adi, igar-nueganba nanamalaga, degine, igar-innikigwadbi imakdii gumalagar. ”Adi, an Abrahamʼga ibmar-imakoye-sogsadba, an imakegar.”
Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová Abrahamʼga sogded: —Dulemar-e-isgued doggus wilub-obichagusad, anse binnasur gorbukmalad, sogdemalad: Sodoma-neggweburgi-bukwamaladi, degi, Gomorra-neggweburgi-bukmaladi, nue-galagwensur damalad, degine, nue-bela-belad isgus bukmalad.
Degisoggu, neggweburse an amar-daknadapid, ar bule anga nabir sogmala. Ar degisulile, an-sunnad an nue-dakoed.
Atakdimaladi, warbogwa Sodoma-neggweburse nadmalad. Abrahamʼdi Bab-Jehová-asabin gwisgusad.
Geb degine, Abraham Bab-Jehováʼse walikaa naded, ega sogded: —¿Ar dule-isgudisurmalad, dule-isgudimaladba be obelogode?
”Ar dule-nuegan dulabo-gakambe (50) we-neggweburgi gudidiile, ¿amba be we-neggwebur obelogode? Ar we-dule-nuegan dulabo-gakambe (50) gudidimalad-sabed-ular, ¿we-neggwebur melle obelogodeeye be sogosurde?
Dogdar-itole, dule-ibmar-isgana-imakdisulid, dule-ibmar-isgana-imakdiidba be oburgwer. Ebobela emarbi isgusadyob be imako itole. Mer deyob be sae. Bee be, bela dule-we-napneggi-bukmaladga, igar-naboged-e-dummadsoggu, ¿igar-innikii maidba be imakosurde? Eye. Be igar-innikii maidba imakoed.”
Geb degine, Bab-Jehová abin-sogded: —Ar e-dulabo-gakambe (50) dule-nuegan Sodoma-neggweburgi gudidiile, amar-ular Sodoma-neggwebur an obelogosulid.
Ar Abrahamʼdi gannar Bab-Jehováʼga sogdebalid: —Dummad, bese nue-wilesakwaa an egised, ar bedi Dummadid, andi dule-binsaledid.
Igidibe, dule-nuegan dulabo-gakambe-guega (50), e-walatar-napile. ¿Amba walatar-napid-ular, bela Sodoma-neggwebur be obelogode? Bab-Jehová Abraham-abin sogded: —Ar we-neggweburgi dulabo-gakatar (45) dule-nuegan amba wis gudiile, an obelogosulid.
Gannar Abraham sogdebalid: —¿Ar unnila dulabo (40) dule-nuegan gudiile, bela Sodoma-neggwebur be obelogode? Bab-Jehová abin-sogded: —A-dule-nuegan-dulabogwad-ular (40), we-neggwebur an obelogosulid.
Ar Abrahamʼdi gannar Bab-Jehováʼga sogdebalid: —Dummad, gannar-gannar an bega ibmar-sognaidgi, melle be isdar an-itogo. Ar unnila dulagwen-gakambe (30), dule-nuegan gudidiile, ¿bela Sodoma-neggwebur be obelogode? Bab-Jehová gannar abin-sogdebalid: —Ar we-neggweburgi unnila dulagwen-gakambe-gudidimalad-ular (30) an obelogosulid.
Abraham sogdebalid: —Dummad, weyob an bega sunmakewilubsulinad, degi-inigwele, ¿we igi-balile, unnila dulagwen (20) dule-nuegan we-neggweburgi gudiir? Bab-Jehová Abraham-abin sogdebalid: —Amar-dulagwenad-ular (20), we-neggwebur an obelogosulid.
Amba Abraham gannar sogdebalid: —Dummad, wis an bese egis, melle be isdar an-itogo. Napi an bega soge. A-sorba, bar an bega ibmar sogosulid: ¿Igi be imaksale, unnila warambe (10) dule-nuegan gudiir? Bab-Jehová Abraham-abin sogded: —Ar dule-warambegwad-ulale (10), an we-neggwebur obelogosulid.
Bab-Jehová, Abraham-ebo-sunmaked-bergusgu, na naded. Abrahamʼdi gannar e-dordoneg-siidse nonikid.
Nue neg-gutulesa, baliwitur-warbogwad Sodoma-neggweburse modapmalad. Deunni, Lot, neggwebur-doged-yawagakgi siid, ar ade, agi gusgu dummagan ambikunonidamalad. Lot, a-dulemar-warbogwad-daksagua, abin nadegusad. Lot dulemar-warbogwad-asabin napase e-bebe ebulegedse dulluu imaksad.
Lot amarga sogded: —Dummagan, an bese wilesakwaa wis egisdo, emi-mutik an-neggi bemar obunnobi an abedo. An-neggi sunna bemar nag enukmalad. Geb oibosar, wakudaryala bemar sunna naed. Geb amar-warbogwad Lot-abin sogdemalad: —Suli, nued be anmargi binsaendo. Anmardi neg-magaba gaboe.
Degi-inigwele, Lot amargi alamaknai gusad. Geb a-warbogwad sogdemarsunnad: “Eye, anmar beba naoe.” Geb Lot-negse modapmargu, Lot amarga mas-nued imaksad, ega madu-inasulid imaksad. Ebogwad nue-mas guchamalad.
Amba yoo megmaladgine, bela machergan-Sodoma-neggweburginmalad, sergan, degine, sapinganse-bakale, neg-ebilis ambikunonimalad.
Lotʼga binnasur sogdemalad: —¿Bia machergan emi-mutik be-negse-nonimalad nade? ¡Anmarga be onoge! ¡Anmar we-machergangi dodobied!
Geb agi, Lot magaba dulemarse nononikid, e-sorba yawagak ise-ediar imaksad.
Geb Lot dulemarga sogded: —Aimar, an bemarse wilesakwaa egismar. Melle bemar galagwensuli neg-imakmalo.
An walabo sisgan nikad, amba yagan-nanaed. Amar an bemarga onogoed. Ar igi bemar amar-imakbimala, be-itolegedmardo. Wemar-warbogwad-anse-nonimaladdi melle bemar oakalomalo, ar ade, wemar an-negse ubononisoggu, we-dulemar an nue-akwergebed.
Dulemar-oimakbukwad Lot-abin sogdemalad: —¡Be ainire! Be anmar-neggweburginedsulid. ¿Be anmar-dummadsi? Be anmar-dummadsuli. Emigindi, we-machergan-warbogwadba bur bule anmar be-imakoed. Geb degine, sabsur Lot-imakarmalad. Agine, yawagak-omukumalaga, yawagakse duurmakdemalad.
Lotʼse-atakdimaladdi yawagak-imbaba argan-onosmargu, Lotʼgadebin imaksamalad, negyaba odosmalad, geb degine, yawagak edismalad.
Geb wemar-warbogwad dulemar-bela-magaba-bukwad geg-atake imaksamalad. Belagwapa, sapinganse, degine, serganse-bakale, geg-atake gusmalad. Yawagak acha-acha-aminanaid, budar-itoarmalad.
Geb degine, dule-warbogwad Lotʼga sogdemalad: —¿Amba gwenadgan-baigan be nika? Be-sapingan, be-masmala, be-bunamala, bela we-neggweburgi gwenadgan-be-nikadi be sede. Bela be-gwenadgan we-neggweburgi be onogo, degine, dikasur be sede.
Ar ade, anmar we-neggwebur obelosokalid. Ar we-neggweburgi-dulemar-bukmalad bela-bela nue-isgus galagwensulidamalad Bab-Jehováʼse warmaksad. A-ular, Bab-Jehová we-neggwebur-obelogega anmar-barmialid.
Geb degine, Lot e-sapinganga-gumaloed daknaded. Amarga sogdapid: —¡Gwisgumar, be nomar, ar ade, Bab-Jehová we-neggwebur obelosokalid! Ar e-sapingandi Lot-ega-ibmar-soged baisur-itosmalad.
Ar bato neg-oibodanigussoggu, baliwiturmar Lotʼga sokalid: —¡Gwaegwa! Be nae. Be-ome, degine, be-sisgan-warbogwad be sede. Ar be sedsulile, anmar we-neggwebur-sabsur-odurdaksokalidba, bemar burgwemarmogoed.
Ar Lot binnaa gunaisoggu, baliwitur-warbogwad, Lot, e-ome, degi, e-sisgan-warbogwad argangi gadebin imaksamalad. Geb neggweburgi wemar-onosmalad, adi, bendaklemalagar. Ar Bab-Jehováʼdi nue Lot-wiledaksoggu, baliwiturmar a-ular, weyob Lot-imaksamalad.
Bato neggweburgi nosmargua, baliwitur Lotʼga sokalid: —¡Be abarmakdemar, mer be burgwemalagar! Mer bar yarganba gannar atako, deginbali, yalaganba be wakinmalo. Melle nebagi be obunnobalo. Ar degisulir, bemar burgwemaloed.
Lotʼdi abin-sogded: —¡Suli dummagan, deyob suli! Ar bese wis wilesakwaa an egised.
Emide, ibmar-nuegan bukidargus bemar anga imakdanikid. Degine, nued bemar angi binsasad, bemar an-bendaknonigu. Degi-inigwele, yalaganba geg an wakinned. Ar neg-bergudele, an sunna igarba bargalesaled. Ar degiile, an burgwemogo-itole.
Wegi itakasaale neggwebur-bipigwad-siidse an sunna wakichaled. ¡Ase naed be an-imake, adi, an bendaklegegar, an melle burgwegar! A-neggweburdi nue bipigwad.
Geb dule abin-sogded: —An be-itos. Be anse egisnaidba an bega imakoed. We-neggwebur-bipigwad be anga obaredi, adi, an obelogosulid.
¡Be nae! Gwae be a-neggwebur-bipigwadse be nae. Be neggwebur-bipise-warmakedse geb an neg obelogoed. A-ulale, a-neggwebur-bipigwad, Zoarʼye onugsalesad.
Bato neg-oibosadgi, Lot, Zoar-neggweburse modapid.
Geb degi, Bab-Jehová nibneg-akar Sodoma-neggweburgi, degine, Gomorra-neggweburgi soo, degi, azufre egi odesad.
Bab-Jehová wemar-neggwebur, degi, agi bela gudidimalad, degi, bela a-nebagine gaganse-bakale, obelosad.
Ar Lot-e-omedi, yarganba atakded. Agi, yog balu-warga binyale-naded.
A-bangine, wakudaryalaba Abraham nadegusad, bia Bab-Jehová-ebo sunmakgwichigusa, ase naded.
Abraham, Sodomaʼsik, degi, Gomorraʼsik, degi, bela nebasik atakdegu, dakded, bela-bela waa bupurmagwichi. Soo-yagi waa bupurmakgwichiyobi daked.
Weyobi, Bab-Dummad Lot-maigusadgi neggweburmar-nebagi-bukwad obelosad. Bab-Dummad Abrahamʼgi nued-binsaed-ular, Lot-onosad, melle Lot dule-baiganba burgwegar.
Weyob neg-gusad-sorbali, Lot Zoar-neggweburgi dobe-mege gualid. Aga, Lot, e-sisgan-warbogwadmala yalaganba nade gusad. Na e-warbaagwa akwasaila-ollorsiidyaba megidapmalad.
Ibagwengine, ior na urbaga sokalid: —Anmar-bab bato nue-selebagusad. Wegi machergan sated, adi, igar-maidba anmarse golegar.
Degisoggu, anmar-bab anmar omumsamalo. Geb agi, anmar ese goloed, adi, anmar ega anagan-urbegar.
A-mutikidba, vinoʼgi e-bab-ogobsamalad. E-sisgwa-dummad e-babse gochad. Ar e-babdi gwen itossulid, sana e-sisgwa e-yarba megisa, degine, sana gannar gwisgusbali.
A-bangine, ior urbaga sokalid: —Sae-mutik bab-yarba an megisad. Degisoggu, emi-mutik anmar bab-omumsabalo, adi, bab-yarba megmogagar. Geb degiir, anmar geb ega anagan urboed.
A-mutiki, vinoʼgi gannar e-bab ogobsamarbalid. Geb degine, urba e-babse gochamogad. Ar Lot gwen itossurbalid, sana e-sisgwa-bipigwad e-yarba megisa, degine, sana gannar gwisgusbali.
Weyob Lot-e-sisgan-warbogwad bonigwar e-babgadga gunonikid.
E-sisgwa-dummadga susugwa uklenonikid. A Moabʼye onugsasad. Agi, Moab-dulemar-bukwadi danikid.
E-sisgwa-bipigwadga susugwa uklenonimogad. Adi, Benammiʼye onugsasad. Agi, Amón-dulemar-bukwadi danimarmogad.
Abraham e-maidgi bangud gusad. Neguev-nebaganba nade gusad. Gerar-neggweburgi megidapid. We-neggweburde Cades, degi, Shur, amar-negabargi siid.
Agi Abraham maigua, sogsagusad, e-ome-Sara, e-bunye. Gerar-neggwebur-e-rey-Abimelec, Sara-nikuega Saraʼbina gochad.
A-mutikidba, Bab-Dummad Abimelecʼse gabgi nonikid, ega sognonikid: —Be we-ome-sealid-ular, be burgo. Ar we-omede sui nikad.
Ar Abimelec amba yoo Saraʼse gorsoggu, Abimelec Bab-Dummad-abin sogded: —Dummadye, ¿ar bede dule-neg-oakalossulid oburgoye be sogde?
Ar Abraham-sunnad anga sogsad: We-ome, an-bunye. Degine, omegwa anga sogsamogad: We-machered, an-susye. Ar degisoggu, gwen ichakwa-binsasulidgi an ibmar imaksad. Ibmar-isgana an imaksasulid.
Bab-Dummad Abimelecʼga gabgi sogsad: —An nue be-wisid, ichakwa-binsasulidgi be imaksad. A-ulale, omese-golega an be-imaksasulid, adi, melle be angi noegar.
Ar emigindi, ome e-suiga gannar be berbena. Ar we-machered Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogedsoggu, be-ular Bab-Dummadse goloed, adi, mer be burgwegar. Ar omegwa gannar e-suiga be berbenasulirdi, be, degi, be-gwenadgan burgwemaloed.
Oibosgu, wakudaryalaba Abimelec gwisgusgu, bela e-maiganse gochad, amarga bela sogsad, igi ede gabdaksa. Itosmargua, bela nue-dobe itodmalad.
Geb a-sorbali, Abimelec, Abrahamʼse-gochagu, ega sogded: —¡Emi, be-neg-oakalosad be dake! ¿Ibigi an begi nosa? Emisgi isgued-dummad be angi, degi, an-sordamargi senonigu. Weyob be ibmar imakewilubsulinad.
Abimelec Abrahamʼga sogdebalid: —¿Ar ibiga deyob be imakye be binsaali?
Abraham, Abimelec-abin sogded: —Wegi dule-Bab-Dummad-dobee-nanaed sateye an biendo. Degisoggu, an-ome-ular an-oburgwemaloeddeeye an binsasad.
Ar nabiri, we-omegwa an-bunad. An-bab-e-sisgwad, an-nandi e-nansulid. Deginbali, we-ome, an-omebalid.
Bab-Dummad anga igar-uknonigu: Be-bab-neggi-be-gudiid be naye. Geb an we-omega sogsad: ‘Bia anmar modapile, nue be an-sabele, be sogoye, be an-bunye.’
Geb degine, Abimelec, Abrahamʼga e-ome-Sara gannar uksasunnad. Geb aginbali, Abrahamʼga sibad-wawaadmar, moli-bebe-nikamalad, mai-machergan, degi, mai-omegan, uksabalid.
Abimelec, Abrahamʼga sogdebalid: —Be dake, we an-yala. Bia be megbie be-itolegedba be yar sue.
Saraʼga sogdemogad: —An be-susgala mani-miligwen-aidikue (1,000) uksad. We-mani dule-beba-gudidimalad-asabin be oyogo, adi, oyogega bedi gwen nossurye. Dule-wargwensaale gege begi sunnasur sunmaked.
Geb degine, Abraham Bab-Dummadse goted, geb Bab-Dummad Abimelec-onugusad, degi, e-ome-onugusbalid. Deginbali, e-maimar-omegan-onugusbalid, adi, nabir sunna mimmi-bake gumalagar.
Ar ade, Abraham-e-ome-Sara-ulale, Bab-Jehová omegan-Abimelec-negginmalad geg mimmi-bakega imaksanad.
Bab-Jehová e-sogsadba Saraʼgi ise-nued binsasad. Saraʼga ise-sogar-imaksadba ega ibmar imaknonikid.
Degisoggu, Sara bonigwar gunonikid. Deunni, Abraham bato nue seredgusad. Bab-Dummad Abrahamʼga-sogsadyobi, a-ibagangi Sara susugwa baknonikid.
Abraham, Sara-ega-susugwa-baksadi Isaacʼye onugsasad.
Isaac ibabaabakgus-gwalulesadgi (8), Abraham Bab-Dummad-ega-sogsadba, Isaacʼga abgan-uka-duku siksad.
Abraham birga-dulatar (100) nikadgi, Isaac gwalulenonikid.
Geb degine, Sara sogded: “Bab-Dummad an-oallisad, bela dulemar susugwa-nikusye an-wisguarmalale, anba weligwaledba allemarmogoed.”
Sara sogdebalid: “¿Ar wede doa Abrahamʼga sogoen be insae, ani, Sara, ega mimmi bakoye? Dule sogosulina. Ar emigindi, be dakena, ar Abraham bato seredgus-inigwele, degite, anga machigwa baksad.”
Machigwa-Isaac dunguded, degine, mam-iargunonikid. Mam-iargusad-ibagi, Abraham iba-dummad onosad.
A-iba-ononaidgi Sara dakded, Agar-e-machi-Ismael Isaacʼgi dodonai. We-machide Agar Abraham-ebo baksadid. Agarʼde Egipto-duled.
A-ular, Sara Abrahamʼga sogded: —¡We-mai, degine, e-machi we-neggi be onoge! We-mai-e-machi an-machi-sunnagwadyob geg an-machi-Isaacʼba, be-ibmar-beoedi abingamogad.
Ar Ismael Abraham-machi-sunnad gusoggu, Sara weyob Abrahamʼga ibmar-sogsadi, Abraham nue-nunmak itosad.
Ar Bab-Dummaddi Abrahamʼga sogded: “Melle be-machigi, degine, be-maigi nunmak be itoge. Ar ibi Sara bese egichialile, aba be ibmar sae. Ar ade, Isaac-waganbi be-wagan-sunnadga gumaloed.
Ar be-mai-machidi be-machibarsoggu, amba deyob an imakbaloed, dule-bukidar-guega an imakmogoed.”
Neg-oibosadgi, wakudaryalaba, Abraham Agarʼga madu, degi, buglugi dii ega uksad. Abraham Agar-gukingi bela ega ibmar nasiksad. Geb degi, Agarʼga e-machi-Ismael-uksagu, barmisad. Agar nadegusad, Beersebaʼsik nega-dulesulidganba bipirmakdii gusad.
Buglugi dii-siid bergusgu, Agar sapi-urba e-machi sisad.
Agarʼdi bannabasaar wilubba-banguedgi signaded. Ar ade, binsasad: “Machi burgwialir, an dakbisulid.” Agar sigidapgu, machi boalid.
Bab-Dummad, machigwa bosiid itosad. Bab-Dummad-e-baliwitur nibneg-akar Agarʼse gornonikid, ega sogded: “¿Agar, igi be itoge? Mer be bukib itoge, ar Bab-Dummad be-machi-bosiid itosad.
Be nae, be-machi be suna. Nue be-argangi be gao, mer indako. Ar ade, an we-machigwagi dule-bukidar-gued an imakoed.”
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad Agar dia-siid-dakega imaksad. Agar diase nade gusad. Geb buglugi dii enosad. Geb degine, diigi Ismael-ogobsad.
Ismael-dungumaidba Bab-Dummad Ismael-bendaksad. A-machigwade nega-dulesulidgi maigusad. Agi, yeer sigu-mie gunonikid.
Sapingwagusgu, Parán-nega-dulesulidgangi-maidgi, e-nan ega ome-Egiptoʼgined uksad.
A-ibagangine, deunni, Abimelec Abrahamʼga sunmaknade gusad. Ficol eba nade gusmogad. Ficolʼde Abimelec-e-sordamar-e-dummadga gudiid. Abimelec, Abrahamʼga sogdapid: —Bela be ibmar-imakdele, Bab-Dummad nue-be-bendake anmar daked.
Degisoggu, weyob, Bab-Dummad-nuggi ise-sogar be anga soge, akar be an-imakosurye, degine, an-mimmigan, degi, an-wagan akar be imakosurbarye. Igi-nued an be-imaksamoga, deyob be an-imakmogoed, degine, emi we-yargi-be-gudiid-e-dulemar deyob be imakbaloed.
Abraham, Abimelec-abin sogded: —Napira-Bab-Dummad-nuggi ise-sogar an bega soged: ‘Eye, an imakosuli.’
Geb degine, Abraham, Abimelecʼga sogded, igi Abimelec-e-maimala e-ibe dia susmala.
Abimelec Abraham-abin sogded: —An wissulid wede doa deyob imaksa. Ar bede anga sogsasulid. Ar emi geb an itogwichid.
Geb degine, Abraham sibad-wawaadmar, moli-bebe-nikamalad susad, geb degine, Abimelecʼga uksad. A-ibagine, Abimelec Abraham-ebo igar mesismalad.
Ar Abrahamʼdi e-sibad-wawaad-bukwadgi sibad-wawaad-ome-senigana walagugle (7) susad. Geb degine, amar bachikii urbisad.
A-ulale, Abimelec Abrahamʼse egichialid: —¿Ar ibiga-wede be sibad-wawaad-ome-senigana walagugle (7) be bachikii urbisa?
Abraham abin-imakded: —Ar we-sibad-wawaad-ome-senigana walagugle (7) an bega uked, adi, soglegegalad, we-dia, ani an akwisye.
A-ulale, emar-gunanaidgi Beersebaʼye onugsasmalad. Ar ade, na ebogwa sogsamalad, anmar ibmar-sogsamaladi imakedseye, geg anmar imaksuli guye.
Beersebaʼgi na igar-nabosmargu, Abimelec, degine, e-sordamar-idued-Ficolʼmala gannar Filistea-neggweburmarse nadmalad.
Abrahamʼdi Beersebaʼgi ingwa-soled-sapi digsad. Agine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Degisadeguadse gochad.
Abraham birga-suitii Filistea-dulemar-yargi maigusad.
Undar birgamar nasadgine, Bab-Dummad Abraham-wilub-dakesokalid, bule egi nue bensurdibeye. Bab-Dummad nugba Abrahamʼse gornonikid: —¡Abraham! Abraham Bab-Dummad-abin sogded: —Na, degite, an be-itomai.
Bab-Dummad Abrahamʼga sogded: —Isaac, be-machi-wargwennagwad be nue-sabedi, Moriah-yalaganse be sede. A-yalagan-mosale, an bega yar-oyogoedgi be-machi be anga ogumakoed.
Oibosgu, wakudaryalaba Abraham gwisgusad, e-moli-uayasuid guakwaa nasiksad. Sapan amisbalid, machigwa-ogumakar-uklegoedgi ogaegar. Abraham bia Bab-Dummad ega-naoye-sogsadse nadegusad. E-machi-Isaac, degi, e-maimar-warbo eba nadmarmogad.
Abraham ibapaagus-nanaedgi yar egi dikasur-noe dakalid.
Geb degine, Abraham e-maimarga sogded: —Wegi bemar moli-uayasuidmala an-edarbemalo. Machigwa-anbogwa Bab-Dummad-e-nug-odummogega andi naoed. Geb degine, gannar anmar bese nonikoed.
Abraham ibmar-ogumaklegoed-ogaegala sapan susad, geb Isaac-e-gukingi mesisad. Abrahamʼdi es, degi, acha-gwallu-ogaar sesad. Geb degidgine, Abraham e-machi-ebo nade gusad.
Sikwas nanaedgine, Isaac Abrahamʼga sogded: —¡Baba! Abraham abin-sogded. —Degite machi, soge. Isaac sogded: —Anmar sapan, degi, acha-gwallu-ogaar sedanikid, degite, ¿bia sibad-wawaad-senigwad anmar Bab-Dummadga-ogumakar-ukoedde? Abraham Isaac-abin sogded:
—Machi, Bab-Dummad anmarga sibad-wawaad-senigwad udagoed, anmar ega ogumakar ukegar. Deyob, ebogwa imakenadap gusmalad.
Abraham, degi, e-machi-Isaac-ebo Bab-Dummad-ega-yar-sogsadse modapmargu, Abraham Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila sobsad. Geb a-aila-birgi sapan urbisad. Geb degine, e-machi-Isaac-edichagu, we-aila-birgi sapan-birgi Isaac-mesisad.
Abraham e-machi-oburgwegala es susgua,
Bab-Jehová-e-baliwitur niba ese gollalid: —¡Abraham! ¡Abraham! Abraham Bab-Jehová-e-baliwitur-abin sogded: —Degite. Wegi an gunai.
Bab-Jehová-e-baliwitur Abrahamʼga sogded: —Melle machigwa be oakaloge. Melle be naibi-imake. Ar bato an wisid, be Bab-Dummad-dobee nanadiid. Ar be gwen sogsasulid, an-machi-wargwensakad melle be anga ukodeeye.
