Abraham dakded, sibad-wawaad-machered sapi-imbaba e-bebegi galesnai. Abraham agi sunaded. Sibad-wawaad-machered-susgua, ogumakar e-machi-anar Bab-Dummadga uksad.
Geb a-sorbali, Abraham weyob we-neg onugsasad: Bab-Jehová ibmar-unnitiba-ukedye. A-ulale, amba we-garda narmaklenaidse sogleged: Bab-Jehová-yargine ibmar-unnitiba-uklegoedye.
Bab-Jehová-e-baliwitur gannar irbogi niba Abrahamʼse gornonibalid,
ega sogded: —Bab-Jehová soged: ‘Ani, an bega ise-sogar soged: Ar be-machi-wargwensakad mer be anga ukodeeye be sogsasursoggu,
an bela-bela ise-nued begi binsaoed. Be-wagan bela-bela-mergu an imakoed, niisgwamar-niba-nanaidyob, degi, ukub-demar-gakagi-nikadyob an imakoed. Deginbali, be-wagan e-isdarmaladgi nakwedii guoed, degi, e-neggweburgan ei sudii guoed.
Deginbali, ar an bega-ibmar-sogsadyob be imaksasoggu, bela dula-we-napneggi-bukwamalad be-waganba an egi ise-nued binsamogoed.’
Abraham bia-e-maimar-obesa, ase gannar nonikid. Degine, bela Beerseba-neggweburse nade gusmalad. Agine, Abraham megidapid.
Degi-undaradgine, Abrahamʼga soglenonikid, e-urba-Nacor machimala-nikamoye, Milca ega baksaye.
Gebe-machigwa ega gwalulesad, Uzʼye nugad. A-sorba, e-urba-Buz gwalulesad. Degi, Kemuel gwalulesad. Kemuelʼde, Aram-e-babad.
Deginbali, Nacor-e-masmala-baigan, Milcaʼbo-baksabalid, wemalad: Quesed, Hazo, Pildas, Jidlaf, degi, Betuel.
We-Betuelʼde Rebeca-e-babad. Wemar-walabaabakadi (8) Nacor-machimalad, Milca-ebo baksadid. Nacorʼde Abraham-e-urbad.
Deginbali, Nacor, Reúma-ebo baid-machimala nikusbalid. Reúmaʼde e-ome-dikarbalidid. We-ebogwa machimala-baksadi, wemalad: Teba, Gaham, Tahas, degi, Maaca.
Sara birga-dulanergwa-gakagugle-nikadgi (127) burgwisad.
Sara Canaán-yalagangi, Quiriat-Arba-neggweburgi burgwisad. Quiriat-Arbaʼde, Hebrónʼye bilebalid. Abraham Sara-burgwisadba nue-bosad, degine, nue-Sara-ebinsadii gusbalid.
Geb degine, Abraham Sara-burgwar-maid-obes nade gusad. Het-dulemarse naded.
Geb Abraham Het-dulemarga sogded: —Ar an bemar-abargine weginedsur-inigwele, anga wis be neg-uan manigi ukmala, adi, an-ome-mui agi an digegar.
Het-dulemar Abraham-abin sogdemalad:
—¡Dummad, bega an sogmardo! Ar Bab-Dummad anmar-abargine, dule-dummadga be-susad. Degisoggu, be-ome-mui anmar-neg-uan-bur-nuedgi be dige. Ar anmar-wargwensaar bega sogosulid: Melle be-ome-e-mui be anmar-neg-uangi digye.
Geb degine, Abraham gwisgusad, Het-dulemar-bukmalad-asabin dulluu imaksad.
Geb degi, amarga sogded: —Ar bemar wegi an-ome-burgwisad nue-digbi abegele, an bemarse wilesakwaa egisdo, an-nuggi bemar Zohar-machi-Efrónʼse egismar:
‘Anga, e-nainu-dikarba-akwasaila-ollor-siid, Macpelaʼye-nugad, manigi ukye.’ Ar e-mani-gargeguedba, an bennukoed. Ar degiir, geb an neg-uan wegi nikuoed.
Ar Het-dule-Efrón emar-abargi simosoggu, bela Het-dulemar, degi, dule-bela-neggweburse-ubomamaid e-itomalaga, Abraham-abin sogded:
—¡Dummad, degisuli! An-nainu, degine, akwasaila-ollor-siid binsa an bega ukoed, maniginsuli. An-sordamar-bukwad anmar-daksiid, amar-asabin an bega we-akwasaila-ollor-siid binsa uknaid. Agi be-ome-mui be dige.
Abrahamʼdi Het-dulemar-asabin gannar na dulluu imakded.
Abraham bela dulemar-e-itobukwad-abargi Efrón-abin sogded: —¡Bemar bela nue an-itogo! An bega soged, mani be sue. Nainu an bese bakoed. Geb a-sorba, an-ome-mui an digoed.
Geb degi, Efrón abin-sogded:
—Dummad, nue be an-itogo: Nainu-e-gargegued mani-dulataled-ilabake-aidikued-wilub (400) gargegued. Wegindi anmar na abin-abin imakosurmalad. Degisoggu, be-ome be dignado.
Abraham, Efrón Het-dulemar-abargi ega nainu-gargegued-sogsad nabir-itosad. Degisoggu, dule-ibmar-ukmalad-igar-maidba mani-dulataled-ilabake-aidikued-wilub (400) mie-mie bennuksad.
Weyobi, Mamre-dad-nakwedsik Efrón-nainu-Macpelaʼgi-naidi, Abrahamʼgadga gunonikid. A sogleged, nainu, akwasaila-ollor-siid, bela sapimar, Abrahamʼgadga gunoniye.
Het-dulemar, degi, dule-bela-neggweburgi-dogmamaid, nue-amar-daksii gusmarmogad.
Geb agine, Abraham akwasaila-ollor-siidgi e-ome-Sara-mui-digsa gusad. We akwasaila-ollor-dummad, Macpela-nainugi siid, Mamre-dad-nakwedsik. Mamre-neggweburde Hebrónʼye nugbalid, Mamre-neggwebur Canaán-yargi siid.
Weyob we-nainugi akwasaila-ollor-siid, Abrahamʼgadga gunonikid. We-nainude Het-dulemar Abrahamʼga manigi uksad, adi, Abraham we-nainu e-neg-uanga imakegar.
Abraham bato nue selebagusad. Bab-Jehová Abrahamʼgi bela ise-nueganbi binsadii gusad.
Ibagwengine, Abraham e-mai-bur-undargus-arbadiidse gochad. We-mai bela ega ibmar-dakega gudiid. Abraham a-maiga sogded: —Be anga ise-sogar-ibmar-sogegala, an-dua-urba be-argan be mese.
Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Nibneg-Dakmaid-nuggi, degi, napneg-dakmaid-nuggi ise-sogar be anga soge. Wegi, an Canaán-dulemar-abargi an maid. A-Canaán-yagan-wargwensaar mer an-machi-Isaac-onikued be sao.
Bur be an-yarse nao. Agine, an-gwenadgan-e-sisgan-wargwen, an-machi-Isaacʼga be aminao, adi, a-yagwa Isaac-nikuegar.
E-mai abin-sogded: —Nued, dummad. Ar yagwa we-negse yapa anba dagele, ¿igi an imakosunna? ¿Ar degiile, be-yargi be aligusadse, an be-machi sedsunnode?
Abraham abin-sogded: —¡Suli, mer an-machi ase be sedo!
Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Nibneg-Dakmaidi an-bab-neggi an-onosad, degi, an-babgan-yalagi an-onosbalid. A anga sogsad: ‘Napira ise-sogar an bega sogye: Emi-be-maidgi we-yala an be-waganga ukoye.’ Degisoggu, a-Bab-Dummad e-baliwitur be-idu barmidoed, adi, weba an-machiga ome be sedagegar.
Ar ome beba dagbisulile, be ise-sogar anbo igar-mesisadgi be ollorguodo. Unnila an bega soged, ¡bipisaale melle an-machi be weba sedo!
Geb degine, Abraham-e-mai, e-dummad-Abraham-dua-urba e-argan mesisgu, Abrahamʼga ise-sogar imakded, eyeye, an be-sogedba an imakoye.
Geb a-sorbali, Abraham-e-mai moli-yargan-mureged-warambe (10) susad. Abraham-ibmar-nuegan-nikad binsa-ukega susbalid. Geb degine, Mesopotamia-yarse, Nacor-neggweburse naded.
Abraham-e-mai Nacor-neggwebur-magaba modapgu, deun bato neg-sedogualid. A-wachigi omegan dii-weenad damalad. Abraham-e-mai moli-yargan-muremalad dia-naba-obunnogega sindigar osisad.
Geb degine, Abraham-e-mai Bab-Dummadse goted: “Bab-Jehováʼye, an-dummad-Abraham-e-Bab-Dummadye, emi-ibagi nued anga ibmar-gued be imakena yeerban, degine, an-dummadgi nued be binsabalina gadin.
Wegi dia-naba an siidgi, yagana-we-neggweburginmalad wese dii wedanimaloed.
A-yagwa-wargwenga an sogoedga, ‘wis be-buglu be odeye, adi, an dii gobegarye.’ A-yagwa weyob an-abinsaalile: ‘Dii be gobye, be-moli-yargan-muremaladga dii an ukmogoye.’ Agi an wisguoed, a-yagwa be-mai-Isaac-e-omega-guega be susa. Degi, be an-dummadgi-ise-nued-binsasad an wisgubaloed.”
Abraham-e-mai amba yoo Bab-Dummadse-goled bergue, dakded, yagwa-gwensak e-gukingi buglu-sii daniki. Dakleargua, we-yagwade Betuel-e-sisgwad, Rebecaʼye nugad. Betuelʼde Milca-e-machid. Milcaʼdi Nacor-e-omed. Nacorʼdi Abraham-e-urbad.
Rebeca yeer dakleged, amba yagwad, sui-sated. Rebeca diase aideded, e-buglu enosad, geb gannar nakwialid.
Agine, Abraham-e-mai gwae yagwa-abin naded. Yagwase modapgu, ega sogded: —Be-buglugi be dii-semaidi wis be anga udage.
Yagwa abin-sogded. —Dummad, be gobe. Geb degi, yog e-buglu-odear imaksad. E-argangi buglu-ganiki, diigi ogobsad.
Abraham-e-mai nue-gobsagua, Rebeca ega sogded: —Moli-yargan-muremaladga an dii weemogoed, adi, bela na dii-gobbimaladba gobmalagar.
Geb degine, yagwa e-buglugi-dii-semaidi dii-siedgi eodapid. Deyobi ichesuli nanasad, bela moli-yargan-muremalad unniguar dii gobsamaladse.
Ar Abraham-e-maidi unnila daksigusad, ar ade, nue wisgubied, e-nonikidgi bule Bab-Jehová egi nued binsasdibeye.
Bela moli-yargan-muremalad dii gobsamargua, Abraham-e-mai, yagwa-e-asugi olasu yosad. We-olasude gramo-nergwa (6) aidikued. Deginbali, sakwagi-nasikleged-olobiid, gwabo ega uksabalid. We-sakwagi-nasiklegedde gramo-dulatar (100) obinesaar aidikued.
Geb degine, Abraham-e-mai yagwaga sogded: —¿Be doa-sisgwa? Degi, anmar obunnogega, ¿be-bab-walik neg-nika be dake?
Yagwa abin-sogded: —An Betuel-sisgwa. An-babde Nacor-machid, Milcaʼbo baksadid.
Anmar-neggine bemar gabmalaga unniguar neg-nikad. Deginbali, molimar-yargan-muregedga unniguar gagan, degi, mas-maed nikabalid.
Geb degine, Abraham-e-mai yokorgi sindigar sigisad. Geb Bab-Jehováʼse goted, e-nug odummoded,
sogded: “¡Bab-Jehováʼye be-nug odummolesun! Bedi an-dummad-e-Bab-Dummadid. Bedi an-dummadgi be-sabgued, degi, be-napiragwad gwen galakudisulid. Degine, Bab-Jehováʼye be an-sealid. Be anga igar-oyosad, adi, an-dummad-e-gwenadgan-negse an warmakegar.”
Rebeca, bela ibmar-gusad e-nan-negginmaladga-sogega e-nan-negse abarmakded.
Rebecaʼde sus-nikad, Labánʼye nugad. Labán Abraham-e-mai-aminaega dia-siidse abarmakded.
E-sus e-bun-Rebeca olasu-yoi, degi, sakwagi-nasikleged-nai daksad. Degine, Labán itosbalid, igi e-bun-Rebeca machered-ega-ibmar-sogsagusadi, e-nanga sognai. Geb Labán, Abraham-e-maise naded. Abraham-e-mai, degi, moli-yargan-muremalad amba dia-walik bukwamalad.
Geb Labán Abraham-e-maiga sogded: —Bedi dule-nuedid. Begi Bab-Jehová ise-nued binsasad. ¿Ar ibiga magaba be mellesii? Be anba dage. Ar bato neg guakwaa an bemarga nudaksad, degi, be-moli-yargan-muremaladga guakwaa an neg nudaksabalid.
Geb degine, Abraham-e-mai Labánʼba negse alid. Agi, moli-yargan-muremaladgi ibmarmar-bukwad odesad. Degine, Labán a-molimarga masgunned uksad. Deginbali, Abraham-e-maiga, degi, eba-danimaladga dii senonikid, adi, nag enukmalagar.
Abraham-e-maiga mas guakwaa sisgu, Abraham-e-mai sogded: —Mas-inse an gunnosuli. Bina an bega ibmar-sogbied soggwelergebed. Labán abin-sogded: —Degite, sogdo.
Abraham-e-mai sogded: —Ani, an Abraham-e-maid.
Bab-Jehová ibiba nued an-dummadgi binsasa, mani-ibedga imaksad. We-ibmarmar ega uksad: Sibad-wawaadmar, moli-bebe-nikamalad, ormar, manimar, mai-machergan, mai-omegan, moli-yargan-muremalad, degi, moli-uayasuigan-bukidar ega uksad.
”Aginbali, e-ome-Sara, deun bato nue seleba-gusadgi, ega mimmi-baksad. An-dummad bela e-machiga ibmar uksad.
An-dummad ise-sogar-ibmar-imakega an-imaksad, anga sogsad: ‘Anmar we-Canaán-yargi-maidgi, melle an-machi e-yagan-nikuega be imakoye.
Bur an-bab-e-gwenadganse be naoye, an-gwenadgan-e-sisgan-wargwen an-machi-nikuega be aminaoye.’
”An-dummad-abin an sogsad: ‘Dummad, ¿ar yagwa yapa anba dagele, igi an saoe?’
”Geb degine, an-dummad an-abin sokalid: ‘Ani an, Bab-Jehová-igarba nanadiiye. A-Bab-Jehová e-baliwitur beba barmidoye, adi, be-naoedba bega nueganbi ibmar guegarye. Weba an-machiga an-gwenadgan-e-sisgwa be amioye, adi, nikuegarye.
Ar an-gwenadgan yapa bega e-sisgwa-ukerdina, adi, be ise-sogar-anga-sogsadi, bar beginsurye, adi, be ollorguoye.’
”Emi, deyob an diase nonisunnad. An Bab-Jehováʼse gotegu, an sogded: Bab-Jehováʼye, an-dummad-Abraham-e-Bab-Dummadye. We an nonikidse, ar napira be anga ibmar-imakoye be nue-sogele,
Bab-Jehováʼye, an wilesakwaa an bese egisye. Emi dia-naba an siidgi, weyob ibmar-gubi an abeye: Yagwa-gwensak dii-weenonikoedi, an ega sogoedga, ‘wis be-buglu be odeye, adi, an dii gobegarye.’
A-yagwa weyob an-abinsaalile: ‘Dii be gobye, be-moli-yargan-muremaladga dii an ukmogoye.’ Agi an wisguoed, a-yagwa be-mai-Isaac-e-omega-guega be susye.
”Bab-Dummadga weyob an sogsiid amba yoo an obeloge, Rebeca e-gukingi buglu-sii-daniki an dakalid. Dii-weegala diase aideded. Rebeca dii-wesgu, an ega sokalid: ‘Wis be anga dii udaye.’
“Rebeca yog e-buglu odear imaksad. Geb degi, anga sogded: ‘Dii be gobe, degine, be-moli-yargan-muremaladga dii an ukmogoed.’ Rebeca anga dii uksad, degine, an-molimarga dii uksabalid.
”Geb degine, an ese egichided: ‘¿Be doa-sisgwa?’ ”Bunagwa an-abin imaksad: ‘An Betuel-sisgwaye. An-babde Nacor-machiye, Milcaʼbo baksadye.’ ”Geb degine, an ega e-asugi olasu yosad, geb deginbali, e-sakwamargi sakwagi-nasikleged an ega nasiksabalid.
Geb degi, yokorgi sindigar an sigisad. Geb degine, Bab-Jehováʼse an goted, Bab-Jehová-nug an odummoded. Bab-Jehová an-dummad-Abraham-e-Bab-Dummadga gumogad. A-e-nug an odummoded, igar-nuedba an-senonikidba an e-nug odummoded. Adi, an-dummad-e-urba-e-sisgwa an-dummad-machi-e-omega guegar.”
Abraham-e-mai sogdebalid: —Ar emigindi, be anga nue sogmalo, an-dummadgi bemar nued, degi, napiragwadgi binsaodibe. Ar deyobsulile, bemar nue anga sogmarbalo, adi, an wisgubaloed, igi an imakoe.
Geb degine, Labán, Betuel-ebo abin-sogdemalad: —We-ibmar bela Bab-Jehováʼgi danikid. Degisoggu, geg anmar bega soged eyeye, geg an bega sogbalid surye.
Wegi Rebeca gwichi, be sede. Bab-Jehová-sogsadba, Rebeca be sedo, adi, be-dummad-machi-e-omega guegar.
Abraham-e-mai deyob-ega-soge-itosgu, Bab-Jehová-asabin yokorgi sindigar sigided, napase e-bebe-ebulegedse dulluu imaksabalid.
Geb degine, Abraham-e-mai ibmar-bukidar onosad: Olomar, manimar, degi, mormar. Geb Rebecaʼga uksad. Deginbali, Abraham-e-mai Rebeca-e-susga, degi, e-nanga ibmar-bukidar binsa uksabalid.
A-sorbali, Abraham-e-mai, degi, eba-gudidimalad mas guchamalad, gobsamalad, degine, geb gabismalad. Oibosgua, Abraham-e-mai gwisgusgua, sogded: —Emi, anmar gannar an-dummad-negse-naega be anmar-imaksun.
Ar Rebeca-e-sus, degi, e-nana, sogdemalad: —Bunagwa anmar-walik napi-ibambe (10) gudii guoye. Geb a-sorbali, naoye.
Abraham-e-maidi abin-sogded: —Melle bar an-igar gamalo. We-an-bese-nonikidi Bab-Jehová bela ibmar-nueganbi-guega imaksad. Degisoggu, gannar an-dummad-negse-naed be an-imakmarsun.
Geb degine, Abraham-e-mai-abin sogdemalad: —Anmar bunagwase gormalo, ar bunagwade igi sogdamogodibe.
Rebecaʼse gochamalad, ese egisdemalad: —¿Emisgwa we-macheredba be nabie? Bunagwa abin-sogded. —Eye, an nabie.
Geb degine, Rebeca-barmismarsunnad, degi, ome-gusgu-Rebeca-akwedidaedi eba nadmogad. Abraham-e-mai, degi, eba-gudidimalad nadmarmogad.
Rebeca-e-gwenadgan Rebecaʼgi ise-nued binsadmalad, weyob ega sogdemalad: “Buna, bela-bela-dulemar-mergued-nanga be gusun. Be-wagana, e-isdarmalad-neggwebur egadgaguega imaksun.”
Geb degine, Rebeca, degi, Rebeca-e-maimar moli-yargan-muregedgi nakwismarsunnad, Abraham-e-mai-sorba nadap gusmalad. Weyobi, Abraham-e-mai Rebeca-sesa nadsunnad.
Deunni, Isaacʼdi dia-Lajay-Roíʼye-nugadse-gudii danikid, ar ade, Neguevʼye-neg-nugadgi maid.
Isaac deunni sedogidbali binsa sapurba wis garmakdii sanaded. Agi dakalid, moli-yargan-muremalad daniki.
Rebeca atakdemogu, Isaac-dani dakalid. Agine, Rebeca, moli-yargan-mureged-birgi-siidgi aideded.
Geb degine, Abraham-e-maise egichided: —Dule sapurba anmarsik-danikidi, ¿we doa-dule? Abraham-e-mai Rebeca-abin sogded. —We an-dummadi. Geb degi, Rebeca e-muswe susad. Geb e-wagar odukusad.
Geb degine, Abraham-e-mai e-ibmar-imaksad bela Isaacʼga sogsad.
Geb degi, Isaac e-nan-dordonegyaba Rebeca-sesad. Agi, na nikusmalad. Geb degine, Isaac Rebeca-nue-sabe gusad. Isaac, Rebeca-nikadba yeer-itodii gusad, a-ulale, e-nan-Sara-burgwisadgi wis baisur-itosad.
Abraham ome-baid-nikusbalid, a-ome Ceturaʼye nugad.
A-omebogwa, mimmigan-nikusad wemalad: Zimram, Jocsán, Medán, Madián, Isbac, Súa.
Jocsán-e-masmala, wemalad: Seba, Dedán. Dedán-e-waganmar, wemalad: Asurim-dulemar, Letusim-dulemar, Leumim-dulemar.
Madián-e-masmaladi, wemalad: Efa, Efer, Hanoc, Abida, degi, Elda. Bela-wemala Cetura-e-wagan gumalad.
Abraham bela ibmar-nikadi e-machi-Isaacʼga bela uksad.
Abraham omegan-baiganba-mimmi-nikusmaladgardi, unnila ibmar ega wis ichesaar binsa uksad. Amba Abraham dula-gudigua, e-mimmigan-baigan e-machi-Isaacʼgi dikasur dad-nakwedsik barmisad.
Abraham birga-dulabaabak-gakambe-gakatar-sergu (175) megisad.
Nue-selebaa-mai burgwisad, ar ade, bato burgwedginmogad. Deyob na e-sergan-burgwarmamaidse megidapmogad.
E-masmala, Isaac, degi, Ismael, Mamre-dad-nakwedsik akwasaila-ollor-siid-Macpelaʼye-nugadgi, Abraham-digsamalad. A-nainude, Efrónʼgadinad. Efrónʼde Zohar-machid, Het-duled.
We-nainu, Abraham Het-dulemarse baksad. We-akwasaila-ollor-siidgi e-ome-Sara-dikarba Abraham diglesad.
Abraham-burgwisad-sorba, Bab-Dummad Isaacʼgi ise-nued binsasad. Isaacʼde dia-naba megidapid. We-diade Lajay-Roíʼye nugad.
Ismael, Abraham Agarʼbo-machi-baksadid. Agarʼde, Sara-e-maid, Egipto-duled.
Ismael-e-masmala e-gwalulesadba ilemakar naid. Weyob nugmalad: Nebaiot. A e-machi-dummad, geb a-yarba, Cedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Misma, Duma, Massa,
Hadar, Tema, Jetur, Nafis, degi, Cedema.
Wemala, Ismael-e-masmala-warambe-gakabogwad-e-nugmalad (12). Na megismaladgi, e-nugba neg onugsasmalad. Ar wemala, e-sordamar-e-dummadga gusmarbalid.
Ismael birga-dulanergwa-gakambe-gakagugle-nikadgi (137) burgwisad. Deyob e-sergan-burgwarmamaidse megidapmogad.
Ismael-e-wagana Egipto-yar-asabin, Havila-yar, degi, Shur-yar-abargi, Asiria-yar-igarba, ambikudapmalad. Amba e-gwenadgan egi gwisgunanaigus-inigwele, agi megidapmalad.
Abraham-machi-Isaac-e-igar weyobdo. Abrahamʼga e-machi-Isaac gwalulenonikid.
Isaac birga-dulabo-nikadgine (40), Rebeca-nikunonikid. Rebecaʼde, Betuel-sisgwad. E-susdi, Labánʼye nugad. Amarde, Arameo-dulemalad, Padan-Aram-neggweburgi bukwamalad.
Rebeca geg mimmi-baked. Degisoggu, Isaac Bab-Jehováʼse ega gochad. Bab-Jehová Isaac-ese-gochad itosad. Agi, Rebeca gurgin-nika gunonikid.
Ar warbogwadi amba sapidukugi-mamaiunni, bato gaemamaid. Agi, Rebeca binsaded: “¿Ar ibiga anga weyob gunai? Degisoggu, a-ular, Bab-Jehováʼse igar-aminad gusad.”
Bab-Jehová Rebeca-abin sogded: “Be-sapi-dukugine, neggwebur-sogabo danikid, amba yoo napnegse-aideged-idu, bato neggwebur-sogabogwad na ebo gae-nanaid. Gwensak, baidba bur-dutusur guoed, ia, urba-sogedba nanadii guoed.”
Rebeca-e-nugued-ibagan warmaknonikid. Susugwa ega warbo uklenonikid.
Gebe-aidenonikidi saila gisii nikad, bela wawaadikid. A-susugwa Esaúʼye onugsasmalad.
Geb a-sorba, e-urba e-argan-nailikgi e-ia-maligi-akanai aidenonikid. A-ulale, Jacobʼye onugsasmalad. Deunni, Isaac birga-dulapaa (60) nikad.
Masmala-warbogwad dungudmalad. Esaú ibmar-make-duledid. Sapurba-gudiile, yeer-itodaed. Jacobʼdi dule-boo-daedid. Neggi-gudiile, bur-yeer-itodaed.
Isaac bur bule Esaú-sabed, ar ade, Esaú-ibmar-maked-gunned yeer-itodaed. Ar Rebecaʼdina bur bule Jacob-sabmogad.
Ibagwengine, Esaú sapurba-gudii, nue-geggus nonigua, Jacob ingwa-burwi-gisi-dunai daknonikid.
Geb Esaú, Jacobʼga sokalid: —An ukudmaada itoged, wis be anga we-ibmar-gisi-dunaid be udage. (A-ulale, Esaú, Edomʼye bilebalid).
Jacob abin-sogded: —Nabirdo. Degiile, ar be machi-sailaginedsoggu, bela-bega-ibmar-uklegoed, be anga udagodo.
Esaú abin-sogded: —An ukudba burgwedanisoggu, anga-bela-ibmar-uklegoed, an bega ukodo. ¿Ar ibiga bar an we-ibmar abesunna? An abesuli.
Geb Jacob sogded: —Emisbinne, ise-sogar be anga sogdo, deyob an bega ibmar ukedseye. Esaú abin-sogded: —Ise-sogar an bega sogye, deyob an bega ibmar ukedseye. Esaú, machi-sailagined-guedgi-bela-ega-ibmar-uklegoed e-urba-Jacobʼga uksad.
Geb degine, Jacob, Esaúʼga ingwa-burwi-gisi-dualed madubo ega uksad. Esaú masgunned-bergusgua, degi, gobsabargua, gwisgusad, geb nadegusad. Weyob, Esaú na machi-sailagined-guedgi bela-ega-ibmar-uklegoedi, baisur-daksad.
A-ibagangine, ukud-dummad nagunonikid, igi Abraham-ibagangi nagusmoga deyob nagunonimogad. A-ulale, Isaac Gerar-neggweburse nade gusad. Deunni, Filistea-dulemar-e-rey-Abimelec, agi maimogad.
Agine, Bab-Jehová Isaacʼse magarosad, ega sogded: “Melle be Egipto-yarse nao. Bia an bega sogoe, agi be megoed.
Ar emigindi, wegi sikwas be mego. An beba gudii guoed, degine, ise-nued an begi binsaoed. Ar ade, begala, degine, be-wagangala we-yar an ukoed. Ar igi be-bab-Abrahamʼga ise-sogar an sogsa, deyob an imakedsegad.
Be-wagan ichesur niisgwamar-nibneggi-merguedyob an imakoed. Be-wagangala bela we-yar ega an ukoed. Deginbali, bela dulemar-we-napneggi-bukmalad be-wagwaba ise-nued an egi binsaoed.
Ar ade, Abraham an-sogedba, an-igar-maidba, an ega ibmar-sogsadba, an-ibmar-odurdakedba nanadii gusad.”
Geb degine, Isaac Gerarʼgi bessunnad.
Dulemar-Gerarʼgi-bukmalad ese egichiarmargu, we-Rebeca, doaye, Isaac dobe-soggusad, Rebeca e-omeye. Degisoggu, sogdedaed, Rebeca e-bunye. Ar Rebeca yeerdaklesoggu, Isaac binsaed, abakalegi machergan-we-yarginmalad Rebeca-ular an-oburgwiarmalarye.
Ibagan-nasad-sorbali, ibagwengi Isaac Gerar-neggweburgi-maidgine Filistea-dulemar-e-rey-Abimelec yawagak-bipigi-atakgwichidgi dakalid, Isaac e-ome-Rebeca-ibe wagar unai.
Geb degine, Abimelec, Isaacʼbina gochad, ega sogded: —Etto, ¿Rebeca, we be-ome? ¿Ar ibiga be anmarga sogsa, Rebeca an-bunye? Isaac abin-sogded: —Ar ade, an binsasad, abakalegi we-ome-ular an-oburgwiarmalarye.
Ar Abimelecʼdi abin-sogded: —¿Ar ibiga-wede deyob be anmar-imaksa? Machered-gwensak, we-neggweburgined ar be-omese gochana, isguega be anmar-imaksanad.
Geb degine, Abimelec bela e-sordamarga igar mesisad: —Ar dule-wargwen we-machered-ibgwensur-imakalile, igidibe, e-omese achaalile, we-dule oburgwilegoye.
A-birgagine, Isaac na e-maidgi ibmar-gwag-digsadi bela-belad nue wesad, ar ade, Bab-Jehová ise-nued egi binsasad.
Isaac mani-ibed gunonikid, ibmar-bukidar-nika gunonibalid:
Sibad-wawaadmar, moli-bebe-nikamalad, degi, maigan ichesur-nika gunonikid. A-ulale, Filistea-dulemar egi nobguarmalad.
A-ular, Filistea-dulemar diamar omulusmalad, napa egi eosmalad. A-diamarde, Isaac-e-bab-Abraham dula-gudigua, Abraham-e-maimar akwismalad.
Geb degine, Abimelec, Isaacʼga sogdesunnad: —Ar be anmarba bur gannarbasoggu, wegi-maid be nae.
Geb Isaac Gerar-nebase nade gusad. Geb agi megidapsunnad.
Abraham dula-gudigua, diamar akwisad. A-diamar Abraham-burgwisgu, Filistea-dulemar omulusad. A-diamar gannar Isaac akwisad. Isaac a-diamar e-bab-onugsasadba gannar onugsasmogad.
Ibagwengine, Isaac-e-maimar nebagi dia-akwinanaigua, dii-aryomai amismalad.
Ar Gerar-nebagi-sibad-wawaad-edarbedimaladdi Isaac-sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad-ebo uluarmalad, ar ade, sogmalad: We-dii anmargadye. A-ulale, Isaac we-dia Esekʼye onugsasad. A-sogleged: Urwedye. Ar ade, a-diabina ulusmalad.
A-sorbali, Isaac-e-maimar dia-baid akwismarbalid. Gerar-dulemar a-diabina uluarmarbalid. A-ular, Isaac a-dia Sitnaʼye onugsasad. A-sogleged: Na isdar-dakmaladye.
Agi, Isaac dikasur nadsunnad. Agi, dia-baid akwidapid. Ar we-dia-binardi ulussurmarsoggu, Isaac Rehobotʼye dia-onugsasad. A-sogleged: Na e-itoleged-gudiguedye. Ar ade, soged: “Ar emigindi, Bab-Jehová anmar nabir-itodiguega, anmarga we-neg uksad, adi, anmar wegi nasguegar.”
Isaac agi-mai, Beersebaʼse nade gusad.
A-mutikidgine, Bab-Jehová Isaacʼse magarosad, ega sogded: “Ani, an be-bab-Abraham-e-Bab-Dummadid. Melle be dobguo, an beba gudiguad. An-mai-Abraham-ulale, begi ise-nued an binsaoed, wagan-bukidar an bega ukoed.”
Agine, Isaac ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila sobsad. Geb Bab-Jehováʼse gochad. Beersebaʼgi Isaac megidapid. Geb e-maimar agi dia akwismalad.
Ibagwengine, Abimelec Isaacʼbo sunmakega Gerar-akar nonikid. Eba e-ai-Ahuzat nonimogad, degi, Abimelec-e-sordamar-e-dummad-Ficol nonimogad.
Isaac Abimelecʼga sogded: —¿Ibiga be an-dakdanimala? Ar bemar an-abesulid, degine, bemar-yargi be an-ononnosmalad.
Abimelec Isaac-abin sogded: —Bab-Jehová beba gudigu anmar daked. Emigi, anmar bega sogbied, anmarbo be igar mesye. Weyob anmar igar mesmalodo:
Be anmargi ichakwa daosulid. Anmar begi ichakwa daosurmogad. Ar anmar gusgu nued begi damalad, anmar nuedgi be-barmiarmalad. Ar emide, Bab-Jehová begi ise-nued binsamaid.
Geb degine, Isaac Abimelecʼga iba-dummad onosad. Emar nue-mas guchamalad, degi, nue-gobsamarbalid.
Oibosgua, wakudaryalabali gwisgusmalad, ise-sogar na ega sogsamalad, anmar we-ibmar-sognaid imakedseye. Geb agine, Isaac Abimelecʼga sogded, degimaloye, geb Abimelec-e-sordamala Isaacʼga sogdemarmogad, degimaloye. Degine, aigwale na egi bangudmalad.
Amba a-ibagine, Isaac-e-maimar Isaacʼga gaya-nued senonimalad, ega sognonimalad: Anmar dia-akwinanaidgi dii amismarye.
Isaac a-dia Sebaʼye onugsasad. A-ulale, a-neggwebur deyob Beersebaʼye nugad.
Esaú birga-durbo-nikadgine (40), Judit-nikusad. Juditʼde Beeri-sisgwad, Het-duled. Esaú, Basemat-nikusbalid. Basematʼde Elón-sisgwad, amba Heteo-dulemogad.
We-omegan-warbogwad, Isaacʼga, degi, Rebecaʼga nunmaked-dummad onosad.
Isaac bato nue selebagusad, degi, aku-atakgusbalid. Ibagwengine, Isaac, e-machi-dummad-Esaúʼse gochad. Geb ega sogded: —¡Machi! Esaú abin-sogded: —Degite. ¿Ibua?
Geb Isaac sogdebalid: —Mag be an-daked, an nue-selebagusad. Ukiar sunna an burgwed.
A-ular, sapurba-nabi an be-abedo. Anga ibmar-maknaega warsi be sedo, sigu be sedbalo.
Ibmar be maksale, an mas-gunbidaedyob ise-nue-imakar be anga mas saoed. Geb we-mas-gunnega be anga sedagoed. A-sorba, an-burgwed-iduar, ise-nued-an-begi-binsaedgi an bega ibmar sogoed.
Isaac-Esaúʼga-ibmar-sogsadi, Rebecaʼdi bela itosad. A-ular, Esaú sapurba e-babga ibmar-maknadgu,
a-sorba, Rebeca e-machi-bipigwad-Jacobʼga sogded: —Nue be an-itogo. Be-bab, be-ia-Esaúʼga sunmakgwisgu, ega-soge an itosad:
‘Sapurba be ibmar-maknaye, a-mas ise-nue-imakar anga be saoye. Geb an burgwed-iduar Bab-Jehová-asabin, an-begi-ise-nued-binsaedgi an bega ibmar sogoye.’
Machi, degisoggu, nue be an-itogo. An-ibmar-bega-sogoedba, bela be imako.
Degisoggu, sibadmar-bukwadse be nae, sibad-mimmi-senigwad-warbo-bur-nuedid be anga sedago. Be-bab mas-gunbidaedyob an ise-nue-imakar an ega mas saoed.
Geb degine, be-bab a-mas-gunnega ega be sedoed. Adi, be-bab e-burgwed-iduar, ise-nued-binsaed bega sogoed.
Ar Jacobʼdi e-nan-Rebecaʼga sogded: —Ar nabir be sogendo. Ar an-iadi wawaad. Andi degisulid.
Ar an-bab an-abagan-ebualile, mag an-itogoed, ande an Jacobʼad. Geb angi binsaoed, an egi dodonaiye. Ar bur an-ukabsaoed, ise-nued-angi-binsaed bar anga sogosulid.
Ar e-nandi Jacob-abin sogded: —Machigwa, be ukabsaleye sogele, ani an ukabsalegoed, bedi ollordo. Degisoggu, an-ibmar-bega-sognaidba be imake. Sibad-mimmi-senigana-warbo be anga sedage.
Jacob sibad-mimmi-seniganabina naded. Geb e-nanga senonikid. Agi e-nan Isaac-mas-abedaedyob sibad-e-san ise-nue-imakar imaksad.
Geb degine, Rebeca, e-machi-dummad-Esaú-e-mor onosad. A-morde bur mor-nuedid, e-neggi ise-nue-saboar bukwad. Agine, Rebeca e-machi-bipigwad-Jacobʼga a-mor-yoega uksad.
Geb deginbali, Rebeca sibad-bipi-e-uka-wawaadgi Jacob-e-surgan, degine, e-dukarba obipirmaksad, bia absarsuli-nanaedgi nasiksad.
Geb degine, Rebeca mas ise-nue-saale Jacobʼga uksad, adi, Jacob e-bab-Isaacʼga ukegar. Geb madu-imaksadi ega uksabalid.
Geb degine, Jacob, e-bab-siidse dogdapid, ese gordapid: —¡Baba! Isaac abin-sogded: —An wegi sii. ¿Be biti-an-machi?
Jacob abin-sogded: —An, Esaú, be-machi-dummad. Be anga-sogsadba bato an imaksad. Baba, be-dage. Wis wese be sigdage. An-ibmar-maksad be gundage. Geb be ise-nued-angi-binsaed be anga sogoed.
Geb degine, Isaac e-machiga sogded: —Machi, ¿igi nabir bato be ibmar abingusbinne? Jacob e-bab-abin sogded. —Bab-Dummad-Jehová gwae-gwae ibmar-abinguega an-bendaksad.
Ar e-bab-Isaacʼdi abin-sogded: —Anse be dage, an be-ebubie, bule be an-machi-Esaú-sunnaddibe.
Jacob e-bab-walikaa naded, adi, e-ebugegar. Geb degine, Isaac sogded: —Be-sunmaked Jacobʼyob be sunmaked. Be-sakwamardi Esaú-sakwamar an itoged.
Isaac Jacob-e-sakwamar e-ia-Esaú-sakwamaryob absar yaisur-itossoggu, Isaac magar-itossulid. A-ular, Isaac ise-nued-binsaed Jacobʼga soged-iduale,
gannar Jacobʼga sogded: —¿Ar nue be an-machi-Esaú-sunnadi? Jacob abin-sogded: —Eye, an Esaú-sunnadi.
Geb degine, e-bab Jacobʼga sogded: —Machi, anga be mas dake, adi, be-ibmar-maksad an gunnegar. Geb a-sorba, an-ise-nued-begi-binsaed an bega sogoed. Jacob e-babga mas daksasunnad, degi, ega vino senonibalid. Isaac nue-mas-guchad, degi, nue-gobsabalid.
Geb degine, Isaac Jacobʼga sogded: —Machi, anse be dage, be an-wagar udage.
Jacob e-bab-wagar-uega e-bab-walikaa nonigua, e-bab, Jacob-mor-yoid usad. Geb degine, Isaac, Jacobʼgi-nued-ise-binsadedba, ega weyob sogded: “Eye, weyob an-machi-Esaú yapanned. E-yapannedi sapuryob yapanned Bab-Jehová sapurgi ise-nued binsasadyob yapanned.
Bab-Dummad bega nibneggi dii-boo-mimai saoed. We-napneggi nainumar-nuegan bega ukoed, orosgi-dakleged-e-gwag-bukidar bega ukoed, vino-bukidar bega ukoed.
Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladi bukidar bega arbamalaga gumaloed, dulemar-akar-akar-soga-iliba be-asabin yokorgi-sindigar sigmaloed. Be-gwenadgan-e-iduedga be guoed. Be-nan-e-masmala be-asabin bela sindigar sigmaloed. Dulemar-be-ukabsamalale, amar ukabsalemogoed. Dulemar-ise-nued-begi-binsamalale, amargi ise-nued binsalemogoed.”
Isaac, ise-nued-binsaed-Jacobʼga-sognaid bergusgua, Jacob nodeyalaba, Esaúʼdi sapurba-ibmar-makdiid dognonikid.
Esaú mas nued-gulle e-babga imaksamogad. Geb e-babga sesa gusad, ega sogdapid: —Baba, be gwisgu. Be-machi, bega ibmar-maksad be gunne, be-angi-ise-nued-binsaed be anga sogsun.
Geb degine, Isaac, Esaúʼga sogded: —¿Be doa-dule? Esaú abin-sogded. —Ani, an Esaú, be-machi-gebesailagined.
Isaac geger-itoged, nue-wawanmake sogded: —Degite, ¿wede doa be-iduar ibmar-maksad, yeer-gulle anga senonisunna? Be-nonikid-iduar, dule-anga-mas-senonikid bela an guchad. Bato be-iduar-dule-arbidga, egi ise-nued-binsaed bela an ega sogsad. Ar emigindi, bato egi ise-nued binsalessunnad. Geg bar an oakaloged.
Esaú, e-bab weyob ega soge itosgu, nue-nunmak binnasur ise-ogormakar boded. Geb e-babga sogded: —¡Baba, ise-nued-binsaed be anga sogmoga!
Ar Isaacʼdi e-machi-abin sogded: —Be-urba bato anse arbid. An-yardaksad. Ise-nued-binsaleged begadinad, be-ibe atursasad.
Geb Esaú sogded: —¡Ar nabir ega Jacobʼye nug nasiksamala! ¡Ar emide ilabogus an-yardakdanikid! Gebe unni, an machi-sailagined-guedba anga ibmar-uklegoenad an-ibe susad. Emide, angi ise-nued-binsaleged an-ibe susbalid. Esaú sogdebalid: —Baba, degite, angi ise-nued-binsaleged, ¿wis be anga obessuli?
Geb degi, e-bab-Isaac abin-sogded: —Be-dummadga-gued-igar Jacobʼga an uksad. Bela e-gwenadgan e-maiga-gued-igar, an ega uksabalid. ”An-ise-nued-egi-binsaedba, an ega sogsabalid: Bitigi orosgi-dakleged-bukidar nikuena gadinye, degine, vino-bukidar nikubalina gadinye. Ar emigindi, machi, ¿igi-bar-an-saosunna?”
Esaú e-babgi alamaknai gusad: —¿Baba, be-ise-nued-binsaed wis soggwensaar geg be anga soge? ¡Be angi ise-nued binsamoga! Degine, Esaú gannar ise-ogormakar bodbalid.
Geb, Isaac na e-machi-Esaúʼga sogded: “Napaneg-nuedgi be megosulid, degine, nibneggi-boo-batedi sate be gubaloed.
Be-es-suidgi na be san bendakdii guoed. Degine, be-urba-e-maiga be gubaloed, ar be dutusur-gusale, geb be-urbagi be nooed.”
Weyob-gusad-akale, Esaú, Jacob-sae-dakded, ar ade, e-annik ise-nued-egi-binsaleged egwachad. Degisoggu, Esaú binsadisunnad: “Emisgwasaar an-bab-burgosoggu, aba anmar bukib-binsadii guoed. A-sorbali, an-urba-Jacob anse oburgwilegoye.”
Rebeca wisgusgu igi e-machi-dummad-Esaú binsadii, e-machi-bipigwad-Jacobʼse gochad, ega sogded: —Be-ia-Esaú be-oburgwebi gudiid. Yamo baisur-itogeyob gudiid.
Degisoggu, machi, nue be an-itogo: Emisbinne, Harán-neggweburse an-sus-Labán-e-negse be wakinne.
Agi, be-ia sae-itoged baisur-ito-gusadse be undar gudii guoed.
Be-ia-Esaú ibmar-iegedse be gudii guoed. A-sorba, be gannar-dagega an be-owisogoed. Ar iba-galagwengi an-masmala-warbobela an surgubisulid.
Geb degine, Rebeca e-sui-Isaacʼga sokalid: —Esaú, Het-dule-e-sisgwa-nikusad-ular, an budar-itogusad. We-Canaán-yargi Het-dulemar-bukwad-e-sisgwa-wargwen-weyob-damogadi Jacob nikusale, ar an bur burgwed, nabirid.
Geb degine, Isaac Jacobʼse gochad, geb egi ise-nued binsasad. Geb ega sogded: —Melle we-yar-Canaánʼgined-ome be nikuo.
Padan-Aram-neggweburse, be-nan-e-bab-Betuel-negse be nao. Agi, be-nan-e-sus-Labán-e-sisgwa be nikuo.
Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad ise-nued begi binsaena gadin, degine, bukidar-mimmigan bega ukbalina gadin, adi, begi dulamar-bukidar ainiegar.
Bab-Dummad Abrahamʼgi ise-nued binsasad, begi, degi, be-wagangi ise-nued binsamogana gadin. Adi, we-yar-anmar-egi-gudiid begadga guegar. We-yarde, Bab-Dummad, Abrahamʼga uksad.
Weyobi, Isaac Padan-Aram-neggweburse Jacob-barmisad. Jacob, Labán-negse modapid. Labánʼde Arameo-dule-Betuel-e-machid, Rebeca-e-susud. Rebecaʼde Jacob, degi, Esaú-e-nanad.
Esaú daksad, e-bab-Isaac Jacobʼgi ise-nued-binsaleged ega sogsa. Geb degine, Padan-Aram-neggweburse ome-nikuega Jacob-barmisbali. Esaú daksabalid, e-bab Jacobʼgi ise-nued-binsasgu, ega sogsagusad, melle Canaán-ome be nikuoye.
Jacob, e-bab, degi, e-nan ega sogsadba imaksad. Jacob Padan-Aram-neggweburse nade gusad.
Weyob-gusadba, Esaú magar daksad, e-bab Canaán-omegan-nabir gwen daksuli,
a-ulale, Esaú Ismael-daknadgusad. Ismaelʼde Abraham-e-machid. Esaú Ismael-e-sisgwa-Mahalatʼye-nugad nikusad. Mahalatʼde Nebaiot-e-bunad. A-iduale, Esaú bato Canaán-omegan nikumaibalid.
Jacob, Haránʼse naega Beersebaʼgi node gusad.
Nadapgu, bia ega neg-mutikgude, agi gabided. Nono nakwis-megegala akwa amisad, e-nono-urba siegar. Agi, gabided.
Geb Jacob, gabdakargu, dakalid, arsan napagi-gwichidi nibnegse-warmakgwichi. A-arsangi Bab-Dummad-baliwiturmar nakwemamai, degine, aidemamai daksad.
Jacob daksabalid, Bab-Jehová arsan-birgi gwichi. Bab-Jehová ega sogded: “Ani, an Bab-Jehová, be-dad-Abraham-e-Bab-Dummad, be-bab-Isaac-e-Bab-Dummad. Begala, degine, be-wagangala, be-gabmaid-napanega an ukoed.
Be-wagan we-napneg-ukub-merguedyob bela-bela mergu guoed. Degine, be-wagan dad-nakwedsik, dad-argwanedsik, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik bela aisakis ambikuoed. Degine, bebali bela dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad, degi, be-waganbali, egi ise-nued binsalegoed.
An beba gudiguad. Bia be nade sogele, an beba gudii guoed. Gannar we-yarse be daged, an be-imakoed. An be-metosulid, bela an bega-ibmar-sogsad an imakoed.”
Jacob gabdakmaid-ataksagua, binsaded: “Nue-napiragwad. Bab-Jehová wegi gudiid an wissulinad.”
Jacob nue-dobe itoded, binsaded: “We-nega, nega-islidikidid. Wegi Bab-Dummad maid. ¡Wegi, nibnegse-doged-yawagak gwichid!”
Oibosgu, wakudaryalaba Jacob gwisgusad. E-nono-megega-akwa-ebusad susad. A-akwa ogwichisad. Geb, gwallu-wawa egi eosad, adi, oyogega, wede nue-islidikidye.
Iduale, agi neggwebur-siidi, Luzʼye nuganad. Jacobʼdi a-neggwebur Betelʼye onugsasad.
Agi, Jacob weyob ise-sogar sogsad: “Ar Bab-Dummad anba gudiguale, an emi-nadapidgi an-edarbele, anga masgunned ukele, degi, anga mor-yoed ukbalile,
degine, an-bab-negse nuedgi, ise-bendaklegaledgi gannar an aibilisale, ar deyobile, Bab-Jehová an-Bab-Dummadga an imakoed.
”We-akwa an ogwichisad, we Bab-Dummad-e-negga guoed. ”Bab-Dummad, bela ibmar-be-anga-ukoedi, ambegi gwensak (10%) an bega ukoed.”
Jacob dulemar-dad-nakwedsik-bukmaladse nade gusbalid.
Sapurba-nadapidgi dia sii dakalid. Ar sibad-wawaadmar a-dii gobdamarsoggu, a-dikarba sibad-wawaadmar-danapaa obunnobukwa dakdapid. Dia-birgindi, akwa-dummad siid.
Bela sibad-wawaadmar danar ase ambikunonikile, sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad akwa-dummad onir damalad, adi, diigi sibad-wawaad-ogobmalagar. Geb a-sorbali, gannar akwa-dummad dia-birgi sidamalad.
Jacob sibad-wawaad-edarbemaladse egichided: —¿An-aimar, bemar biarmaladi? Abin-imaksamalad: —Anmar Harán-neggweburginedi.
Jacob amarga sogdebalid: —¿Bemar, Nacor-e-machi-Labán-mag-dake? Abin-imakdemalad: —Eye, anmar mag dake.
Jacob ese egisdebalid: —¿Labánʼde nued gudii? Sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad abin-imakdemalad: —Eye, Labán nued gudii. Be dakena, e-sisgwa-Raquel e-sibad-wawaadmar sedanikid.
Geb degine, Jacob sogded: —Sibad-wawaad e-urbilegedgi-urbelegegala amba dad-dikasulid. ¿Ar ibiga bemar geg sibad-wawaadmarga dii ukmala? Geb sorbali, bemar sibad-wawaadmar-gagan-mamalaga gannar sedmaloed.
Ar sibad-wawaad-edarbemaladdi abin-sogdemalad: —Geg anmar deyob imakmalad. Anmar gusgu bela sibad-wawaadmar-danar-ambikued edarbedamalad. Adi, anmar akwa-dummad-dia-edisiid oniregar. Geb anmar sibad-wawaadmar diigi ogobmaloed.
Jacob, dulemar-ebo sunmakgwisgua, Raquel e-bab-sibad-wawaadmar senonikid. Ar Raquel e-babga sibad-wawaadmar-edarbedga gudiid.
Raquelʼde, Labán-e-sisgwad. Labánʼdi, Rebeca-e-susud. Jacob, e-gilor-Labán-sisgwa Labán-sibad-wawaadmar-sedani-daksagu, dia-birgi akwa-dummad-siid-onirega nade gusad. Geb onirisgua, sibad-wawaadmarga dii uksad.
Geb degine, Jacob Raquel-wagar-udapid, ega sogega, be nued sogeye. Geb degine, Jacob binnasur boded.
Jacob Raquelʼga sogdesun, ede Rebeca-machiye. Labánʼdi e-gilorye. Geb Raquel deyob itosgu, e-babga-sogega abarmakde gusad.
Labán itoargu, e-bun-Raquel-machi-Jacobʼgi ega sunmake, agi Labán abarmakded, Jacob-abin-daknaegar. Modapgu, Jacob e-nigasoggu, ise-angaagwar Jacob-imakdapid, ei-wagar usbalid, ega sogega, be nued sogeye. Geb agine, e-negse Jacob-sesad. Geb degine, Jacob bela e-gusad-igar Labánʼga sogsad.
Labán Jacobʼga sogded: “Ar be nue anbo ablis-mesadid.” Jacob Labán-walik nii-walagwen gudii gualid.
Niigwen-gusad-sorbali, Labán Jacobʼga sokalid: —Be an-gwenad-inigwele, binsa geg be anga arbaed. Anga be soge, igi-mani be-bennukbi be an-abege.
Dakargu, Labán sisgan-warbo-nikad: Dummad, Leaʼye nugad. Bipigwaddi, Raquelʼye nugad.
Lea e-ibya mommoo dakleged. Raquelʼdi bela-bela yeer dakleged.
Ar Jacob Raquel-abearsoggu, Labán-abin sogded: —Be-sisgwa-bipigwad-Raquel an nikuegala, an bega birgagugle (7) arbaoed.
Geb degine, Labán Jacob-abin sogded: —Ar an-sisgwa dule-baidga-ukedba bur an bega uked nabirid. Degisoggu, be an-walik beedo.
Ar weyob Jacob Raquel-nikuegala birgagugle (7) arbasad. Ar Jacob nue-Raquel-abesoggu, dogdar birga-suitii itossulid.
Birgaguglegus (7) Jacob arbaedgine, Labánʼga sokalid: —Ar an bega sogsadyob Raquel-nikuega bato birgaguglegus (7) an bega arbadanisoggu, anga be Raquel-udage.
Geb degi, Labán e-neg-dikarba-neg-baidsik-mamaidse gochad, adi, e-sisgwa-sui-nikued-ibase dagmalagar.
A-mutiki, Labánʼdi e-sisgwa-Lea-sesad, Jacobʼga ukdapid. Jacobʼdi Raquelʼye biensoggu, aga Leaʼse gochasunnad.
Aginbali, Labán e-sisgwa-Leaʼga e-mai-wargwen uksad, adi, Leaʼga ibmar-imakegar. A-mai, Zilpaʼye nugad.
Neg-oibosgu, Jacob dakalid, Lea e-dikarba mai. Degisoggu, Jacob Labánʼga sokalid: —¿Igi be an-imaksa? Be angi dodo-soge. ¿Ar ande Raquelʼbina an bega arbassursi? ¿Ibiga degite be an-yardake?
Labán Jacob-abin sogded: —Wegine, anmarga-igar-maisulid, urba e-ior-idu sui-nikuoye.
Degisoggu, igar-maidba Lea bebogwa itoged-irgwen gudii guodo. Geb a-sorbali, an bega Raquel-ukbaloed, ar be soger, Raquelʼbina birgagugle (7) an bega arbabaloye.
Jacob sogsado, eyeye, ede arbaoye. Lea-nikusad-itoged-irgwenad-bergusgu, Labán Jacobʼga Raquel-uksabalid, adi, Jacob Raquel-nikuegar.
Labán e-mai-wargwen Raquelʼga uksamogad, adi, Raquelʼga ibmar-imakegar. A-mai, Bilhaʼye nugad.
Jacob Raquelʼse gochad. Jacob, Leaʼba-bur bule Raquelʼbina sogsasoggu, degidbali, amba birgagugle (7) Labánʼga arbadii gusbalid.
Bab-Jehová dakdegu, Jacob bur Lea-baisur-dake, Lea mimmi-nikuega imaksad, Raquelʼdi geg mimmi-bake imaksad.
Lea bonigwar gunonikid. Bab-Jehová-machigwa-ega-uksadi, Rubénʼye onugsasad, ar ade, soged: “Bab-Jehová wile-itodiid an-daksad. Ar emigindi, an-sui an-sabguoed.”
A-sorbali, Lea machigwa-baid-nikunonibalid. Adi, Simeónʼye onugsasad. Geb agi sogded: “Bab-Jehová an-sui-baisur-an-daked daksad. A-ular, Bab-Jehová machigwa-baid anga uksabalid.”
Lea gannar machigwa-baid-nikunonibalid. Adi, Levíʼye onugsanonikid. Ar ade, Lea soged: “An-suiba machimala-walapaagus an bakdanisoggu, ar emigindi, an-sui bur bule an walikaa guoed.”
Lea amba machigwa-baid-nikunonibalid. Adi, Judáʼye onugsasad, ar ade, Lea soged: “Ar emigindi, Bab-Jehová-nug an odummogoed.” A-sorbali, Lea mimmigan-nikued galesad.
Raquel geg Jacobʼga mimmi-bake-itoargu, e-ior-Leaʼgi nobgualid. Raquel e-sui-Jacobʼga sogded: —¿Ibiga geg be anga mimmi bake? Mimmi an abege. Be anga baksulile, an burgoed.
Jacobʼdi Raquelʼse uluded, ega sogded: —¿Ar ani an Bab-Dummadsi? Ar Bab-Dummad geg mimmi-bake be-imaksad. Ani an deyob be-imaksasulid.
Geb degine, Raquel Jacobʼga sogded: —An-mai-Bilhaʼse be gole. A-omegwa mimmigan-nikusale, an-sunnad mimmigan-nikusadyob an guoed.
Weyob Raquel e-sui-Jacobʼga e-mai-Bilha-uksad, adi, Jacob Bilhaʼse golegar. Geb degine, Jacob Bilhaʼse gochad.
Agi, Bilha bonigwar gunonikid, Jacobʼba machi-wargwen baknonisunnad.
Geb degine, Raquel sogded: “Ar Bab-Dummad anga igar-nued imaksad. Ar Bab-Dummad an ese-gordiid an-itosadba, anga machigwa uknonikid.” A-ular, we-machigwa Danʼye nugguoed.
A-sorbali, Raquel-e-mai-Bilha machigwa-baid Jacob-ebo baknonibalid.
Agi, Raquel sogded: “An-iorbo an nue-urwedii gusad, emidi an egi obichad. A-ular, we-machigwadi Neftalíʼye nugguoed.”
Lea geg bar mimmigan-bake-itoargu, e-mai-Zilpaʼye-nugad, Jacobʼga uksad, adi, Jacob Zilpaʼse golegar.
Agi, Zilpa Jacobʼba machigwa baknonikid.
Geb degi, Lea sogded: “¡Ibiyob nued angi binsalesa!” A-ulale, a-machigwa Gadʼye onugsasad.
Geb a-sorbali, Lea-e-mai-Zilpa Jacob-ebo machigwa-baid baknonibalid.
Geb agine, Lea sogded: “¡Yeer-itoleged! Emigindi, omegan sogmaloed, ande weligwar-itoye.” A-ulale, machigwa Aserʼye onugsasad.
Ibagwengine, orosgi-dakleged-trigo-weed-ibagangine, Rubén sapurba naded. Agi, sapi-bipi-sanmar mandrágoraʼye-nugad amisad. A-sapi-bipi-sanmar e-nan-Leaʼga sesad. Raquel a-sanmar-daksagu, Leaʼga sogded: —Mandrágora-e-sanmar be-machi-bega-senonikid, wis be anga udamoga.
Ar Leaʼdi abin-sogded: —¿Ar emide, be angi-sui-egwachad, unni be itosursi? Ar emide, mandrágora-sanmar an-machi-anga-senonikid be abebalid. Raquel abin-sogded: —Be-machi-mandrágoraʼmar-bega-senonikid be anga ukele, emi-mutik Jacob bese goloed.
Sedogidba, Jacob sapurba-gudidanigu, Lea Jacob-abin noded, ega sogded: —Emi-mutik be anse goloed, ar ade, an-machi mandrágora-e-san-anga-senonikidbo an be-ogwasad. A-mutik, Jacob, Leaʼse gochasunnad.
Bab-Dummad Lea-ese-goled-itosadba, Lea bonigwar gunonisunnad. Lea wesega Jacobʼga masmala walatargus bakdanikid.
Geb degine, Lea sogded: “Ar an-suiga an-machi an uksadbali, Bab-Dummad nabir angi binsasad.” Lea we-machigwa Isacarʼye onugsasad.
Geb a-sorbali, Lea baid-machigwa Jacob-ebo nikunonibalid. Agi, machimala walanergwa (6) guded.
Lea sogded: “Bab-Dummad ibmar-nued anga uksad. Emigindi, an-sui bur-yeer an-dakoed, ar ade, an ega masmala walanergwagus (6) nikudanikid.” A-ulale, we-machigwa Zabulónʼye onugsasad.
Napidgine, Lea bunolo nikunonikid. A-bunolo, Dinaʼye onugsasad.
Bab-Dummad Raquelʼgi nued binsadmogad. Bab-Dummad Raquel-ese-goledi itosad, mimmigan-nikuega imaksad.
Geb degine, Raquel bonigwar gunonisunnad, machigwa ega uklenonikid. Agi, Raquel sogded: “An geg-mimmi-bakedba an-bingegudiidi, Bab-Dummad anga osulosad.
Bitigi Bab-Jehová baid-machigwa anga ukbalina gadin.” A-ulale, machigwa Joséʼye onugsasad.
Raquel goe-José-baksad-sorbali, Jacob Labánʼga sogded: —An-yarse gannar an naega be anga igar uke.
Ar be nue-wisid, igi an-omegan-ular an bega arbasa. Degisoggu, an-omeganga, degi, an-mimmiganga be igar uke, anba namalagar.
Ar Labánʼdi abin-sogded: —Ar nued be angi binsaele, mer be nagwele, wis be napi-begwele. Ar an nerse-oyosadba an wisgusad, be-nukad, Bab-Jehová ise-nued angi binsamaid. Labán Jacobʼga sogdebalid:
—Anga be sogdo, igi-manigi anga be arbaoe. An be-bennukoed.
Geb degine, Jacob ega sogded: —Ar nue be wisid, igi an bega arbasa, igi an bega be-ibmar-durgan an akwisa.
An-nonikid-idu ibmar-ichee-be-nikadi, bega napiragwad merguded, ar ade, an bese nonikid-akar Bab-Jehová ise-nued begi binsasad. Degite, ¿emide, sana an-mimmiganga an na arbadmogosunna?
Geb Labán Jacobʼse egisdesunnad: —Degite, ¿igi-mani be-bennukbi be an-abesunna? Jacob weyob abin-sogded: —Mer be an-bennuke. Ar ibmar an bega sogoed nabir be itogele, napi an bega be-sibad-wawaadmar an edarboed.
Emi an be-sibadmar-abargi, bela sibad-wawaadmar-gutu-nanaimalad, mata-matamalad, sibad-wawaad-senigan-sichigana egwaoed. Deginbali, sibadmar-gutu-nanaimalad, mata-matamalad an egwabaloed, adi, weyob-daklemalad angadga guegar. We-ibmar-durgangi be an-bennukodo.
Degisoggu, ibagwengi be dakdanikogu, be dakoed, an bule ibmar-inniki-imaked-duledibe. An-sibadmar-abargi, sibad-gutu-nanaisurmalad, mata-matasurmalad, sibad-wawaad-senigan-sichiganasurmalad gudiile, an bei atursasdo.
Labán Jacob-abin sogded: —Nueddo. Be-sogedba an imakodo.
Degi-inigwele, aka Labánʼdi, a-ibagi, e na sibad-machergan bara-baramalad, mata-matamalad, sibad-omegan gutu-nanaimalad, wis sipu-sipu nanaimalad, degine, sibad-wawaad-sichigana, bachikii urbisad. Geb degine, Labán e-masmalaga uksad, adi, ega akwemalagar.
Geb Jacobʼgi we-sibadmar-obanguegala, ibapaa-bangu-nanalege-wilub sesad. Jacobʼdina, sibad-baigan Labánʼga akwedii gusad.
Jacob we-sapi-e-anagan siksad: Álamo-e-ana, almendro-e-ana, degi, castaño-e-ana. Degine, amar-sapi-anagan bara-bara-daklegegala, a-e-uka saguar-saguar esisad.
Geb degine, sibadmar-dii-gobnonidamaladgi sibadmar-asabin, a-sapi-anagan-bara-bara-dakleged urbisad. Ar ade, agi sibad-machergan sibad-omegangi nakwenonidamalad.
Ar suarmar-bara-barad-asabin sibadmar nakwedamarsoggu, e-mimmigan bara-bara, gutu-gutu, degine, mata-mata gwalulemamaid.
Geb degine, Jacob a-sibadmar Labán-e-sibadmar-bukwad-asabin bachikii urbisdaed. Weyob Jacob Labán-sibadmargi na e-sibad bachikii urbemai gusad.
Sibadmar-bur-wardadamalad omegi-nakwed-irbali, Jacob sibadmar-dii-gobedgi suarmar-bara-barad urbisdaed, adi, omegi nakwialile, suarmar-bara-barad dakegar.
Ar sibadmar-garagana-nakwialirdi, Jacob suarmar-bara-barad urbedasulid. A-ulale, sibadmar-garagandi, Labánʼgad daed. Sibad-wardummagandi, Jacobʼgad daed.
Weyob Jacob mani-ibedga gunonikid, ichesur sibadmar-wawaad, maigan-machergan, maigan-omegan, moli-yargan-muremalad, degine, moli-uayasuigan-nika gunonikid.
Jacob wisgualid, Labán-e-masmala weyob sunmakdiiye: “Jacob bela anmar-bab-e-ibmar susye. Agi, mani-ibedga gunoniye.”
Deginbali, Jacob daksabalid, Labán idualeyobi bar nued e-daksuli.
Geb degine, Bab-Jehová Jacobʼga sogded: “Be-babgan-yarse, be-gwenadgan-bukwadse be nae. Ani, an beba gudii guoed.”
Jacob sapurba e-sibad-wawaad edarbe-maidgi, Raquelʼse, degi, Leaʼse gochad, ese dagmarye.
Jacob Raquelʼga, degi, Leaʼga sogded: —An mag daked, bemar-bab idualeyob bar nued an-daksulid. Ar degi-inigwele, an-bab-e-Bab-Dummad gusgu anba gudiguad.
Ar bemar-sunnad nue wismalad, igi an be-babga an arbadii.
Emidi, be-bab an-yardakdiguad. An-bennuked anga irambegus (10) ogwadanikid. Deginbali, Bab-Dummad be-bab-an-naibi-saegala gwen imaksasulid.
Ar be-bab anga sogsale: ‘Ibmar-durgan-gutu-nanaimaladgi an be-bennukoye,’ degidbali, sibadmar-e-mimmigan-gwalulemamaid, bela gutu-nanaimaladbi gwalulenonidaed. Degi, be-bab anga sogsabalile: ‘Ibmar-durgan-bara-baramaladgi an be-bennukoye,’ degidbali, e-mimmigan-gwalulemamaid bela bara-baradbi gwalulenonidabalid.
Weyob, Bab-Dummad anga-ukegala, be-bab-ibe e-ibmar-durgan susad.
”Ibagwengine, ibdurgan-idudigu, an gabdaksad. An dakalid, sibad-machergan omegi-nakwenanaid bara-bara-nanaed, gutu-gutu-nanaed, degine, mata-mata-nanaed.
An we-gabdakedgine, Bab-Dummad-e-baliwitur an-nugba anse gochad. An abin-imaksad: ‘An be-itomai.’
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-e-baliwitur anga sokalid: ‘Nue be dako. Be dakena, sibad-machergan omegi-nakwenanaid bela bara-bara-nanaed, gutu-gutu-nanaed, degine, mata-mata-nanaed. Ar ade, an bela wisid, igi Labán be-imakdii.
Ani an Bab-Dummad, Betelʼgi bese magarosadid. Agi, be akwagi gwallu-wawa eosad, adi, oyogega, we-negde nue-islidikidye. Degine, anga ise-nue-sogar be imaksabalid, an imakedseye. ¡Be gwisgu! ¡Wegi-maid be nae! Be-gwalulesad-yarse gannar be nae.’ ”
Geb degine, Raquel, Leaʼbogwa Jacob-abin sogdemalad: —An-bab-neggine bar anmar ibmar nikasulid.
Ar anmar-bab dulemar-baidyob anmar-imaksad, e-sisganyob gwen anmar-daksulid, bur manigi anmar-uksad. Degine, be anmar-nikuega ega be manigi-arbasad, bela a-mani biin imaksad.
Ar napiragwad, Bab-Dummad bela an-babgi ibmar-susadi, ¿ar wede anmargadsursi? Eye, anmargadi, degi, anmar-mimmigangadi. Degisoggu, bela Bab-Dummad bega ibmar-sogsadba be imakdo.
Degine, Jacob Canaán-yarse e-bab-Isaac-maidse, gannar dagega, guakwaa ibmar dakalid. Jacob moli-yargan-muregedgi e-mimmigan, degi, e-omegan-onakwisgu, ali gusad.
Degine, Jacob Padan-Aramʼgi e-arbasadgi bela ibmar-nikusadi sealid, bela ibmar-durgan-nikadse-bakale, searbalid.
Deunni, Labánʼdi baidsik naded, e-sibad-wawaadmar-e-absar esinaded. Raquelʼdi e-bab-naded-sorba, e-bab-ibe nuchu-mimmimar atursasad.
Weyob Jacob, Arameo-dule-Labán yardaksad. Jacob, Labánʼga gwen sogsasulid, ede naesokarye.
Jacob wakitedo, bela ibmar-nikadi, sesagusad. Nadedgi, Éufrates-diwargi bato obaksabinned, degine, Galaad-yarmarsik nade gusad.
Ibapaagwad-sorbali, geb Labán wisgualid, Jacob wakiteye.
Geb degine, Labán e-gwenadgan-abalagine, Jacob-baregite gusad. Ibagugle-gusgu (7), Galaad-yalagangi Jacob-bargadapid.
A-mutikidgine, Bab-Dummad Arameo-dule-Labánʼse gabgi magarosad, ega sogsad: “Nue be an-itogo, melle Jacobʼga urwedgi sabsur be ibmar sogo.”
Labán Galaad-yalaganba Jacob-bargadapid, ar ade, agi Jacob obunnodapid. Agi, Labán e-gwenadganmala obunnodapmogad.
Labán wis gannadginsaar Jacobʼga ibmar sogded: —¿Igi be anga gude? ¿Ibiga be an-yardaksa? ¡Emide, be an-sisgan bila-onoedgi-galesdamaladyob sealid!
¿Ibiga be an-yardaksa? ¿Ibiga an-arbak an-owisossuli be wakinnali? Be an-owisosana, weligwaledgi an bega sogsanad, nuedgi be naye. Degine, namakedgi, gar-tambor, degi, gar-arpa goled-abalagi be alinad.
Emide, bipisaale, be an-sisgan, degi, an-wagan-e-wagar-uega gwen be an-imaksasulid, degimaloye amarga sogega be an-imaksasurbalid. ¡Emide, dule-binsaedsulidyob be anga gusad!
Ar emide, sunna an bela bemar-onailiksaed. Degi-inigwele, mutik be-bab-e-Bab-Dummad anga sunmaksad, weyob anga sogsad: ‘Nue be an-itogo, melle Jacobʼga urwedgi sabsur be ibmar sogoye.’
Ar emide, bela-bela be-bab-negse be gannar dagbiedde, degite, ¿ibiga an-nuchu-an-bab-dummagan be ani atursassunna?
Geb degine, Jacob, Labán-abin sogded: —Ar ade, an dobgusad. An binsasad, abakalegi be-sisgan be angi ise-urwedgi be sualirye.
Ar wegi dule-wargwen be-ibe nuchu-be-bab-dummagan ganikile, ¡a-dule oburgwilegodo! Anmar-gwenadgan anmar-barsogega guoed: Be-ibmar be amie, ar an be-ibe ibmar-ganidibe, be sedodo. Ar ade, Jacob, Raquel nuchumar-atursasad wissulid.
Labán Jacob-e-dordonegyaba dogsad. Geb a-sorba, Lea-dordonegyaba, degine, maimar-warbogwad-dordonegyaba dogsabalid. Degi-inigwele, nuchumar-gwen-amissur gusad. Labán, Lea-dordonegyaba-noargu, geb Raquel-dordonegyaba dognonikid.
Ar ade, Raquel nuchumar-susadi, moli-yargan-mureged-e-gan-urba odukusad. Geb degine, a-birgi Raquel sigisad. Labánʼdi nuchumar bela negyaba amidigus-inigwele, amissur gusad.
Geb degine, Raquel e-babga sogded: —Baba, an gwisgusulir, mer be anse urwo, ar ade, an emi mor-enukdiid.
Ar Labánʼdi nuchumar-amidiid amissursoggu, a-ulale, Jacob uluded, Labánʼga binnasur weyob sogded: —Ar emide, ¿ibigi an begi nosa? ¿Ibigi an begi isgus be an-daksunna? Ar emide, ise-aporsaar be an-baregindigu.
An-ibmar bela be argasad. ¿Ar ibi-be-ibmar be an-neggi be amissunna? Be ibmar-amisad, be-gwenadgan-asabin, an-gwenadgan-asabin be urbedo, adi, sogmalaga, ar doa-anbogwadi bur-nabir ibmar soge.
”Birga-dulagwen (20) an bega arbasad. Bipisaale be-sibadmar, degi, sibad-wawaadmar, mimmi-nikudanikir, igarba gwen melledsulid. Be-sibadmar-abargi, bipisaale be-ibe sibad-wawaad-machered-wargwensaar an guchasulid.
Ibmar-durgan-sapurbarmalad bei sibad-oburgwisale, an bennukewilubsulinad, aka an bur bennukdedaed. Mutikidbardibe, ibginedbardibe, bei-sibad-aturimaklesale, be angi mani gadaed.”
Jacob Labánʼga sogdebalid: —An bega arbadigusgu, ibgine, neg-diopisulidba an burgwebidaed. Neg-mutikdi, neg-diopigwadba an burgwebidabalid. ¡Ar gabedse-bakar, gwen gabbi an-itodasulid!
Birga-dulagwen (20) an be-neggi gudii gusad. Unnila, wemarbi an nikusad: Be-sisgan-warbogwadbina birgambe-gakabake (14) an bega arbasad. Be-sibadmarbina birganergwa (6) an bega arbasad. Degine, be-an-bennukedi, be anga irambe (10) ogwadii gusad.
”Ar Bab-Dummad Abraham-e-Bab-Dummadga maid, degine, an-bab-Isaac a-Bab-Dummad-dobekwaa nanadii gusad. A-Bab-Dummad anba gudisulina, arganagwabi be an-barmialinad. Napira an bega soged: Ar Bab-Dummad, wile-an-itodiid magar-daksad, degine, an-arbadiid magar-daksabalid. A-ulale, mutik bese magarosad, ibmar binnasur bega sogsad.”
Geb degine, Labán Jacob-abin sogded: —Be-omegan, an-sisganad. Burwigana, an-waganad. Sibad-wawaadmar, an-sibad-wawaadmalad. ¡Bela we-ibmarmar be dakedi, bela angadbiid! Ar an-sisgansoggu, ¿igi an bar saosunna? Degine, an-sisgan-mimmiganbarsoggu, ¿igi an imakbalosunna?
Degisoggu, a-ular be dage, be anbogwa igar-mesdo, adi, agi be anbo igar-mesnaid-wilubgan mag daklegegar.
Geb degine, Jacob akwa-dummad susad, a-akwa ebo igar-mesnaid-wilubgan-oyogega ogwichisad.
Geb degine, e-gwenadganga sogded: —¡Akwa-onmakmar! Bela akwa-ichesur-urbegala, akwa-onmaksamalad. Agine, akwa-ichesur-bukwad-walik mas-guchamalad.
Labán e-gayaba a-neg Jegar-Sahadutaʼye onugsasad. Jacobʼdi e-gayaba a-neg Galaadʼye onugsasmogad.
Geb degine, Labán sogded: —Emi-ibagi, we-akwa-dunnumakbukwad anmar-igar-mesnaid-e-wilubgan-oyogega gued. A-ular, a-nega Galaadʼye nuggusad.
Deginbali, a-neg Mizpaʼye nuggusbalid, ar ade, Labán sogsad: —Anmar na gi yoggudmalo-inigwele, Bab-Jehová anmar-dakdii guoed.
Degine, an-sisgan sabsur be imakalile, igidibe, omegan-baid be nikuarbalile, ar dule-baigan amba-be-daksur-inigwele, be ebinsao, Bab-Dummaddi anmar-dakoed, a anmar-barsogega guoed.
Degine, Labán Jacobʼga sogdebalid: —Nue be dake, akwamar-odunnumakbukwad, degi, akwa-dummad-gwichid, anmar-deyob-igar-mesisad, anmarga-oyogega gued.
We-akwa-sogbogwadi anmarga-sogega guoed, bedi be ansik obakosurye, degine, anmoga an besik obakosurmoye, adi, melle na anmar sabsur imakmalagarye.
Be-dad-Abraham-e-Bab-Dummad, degi, an-dad-Nacor-e-Bab-Dummad, anmarga igar-nabogega guoed. Geb degine, Jacob e-bab-Isaac-Bab-Dummad na e-Bab-Dummadga-imakdimogad-nuggine ise-sogar sogded, ede deyob imakedseye.
Geb degine, Jacob yar-birgine Bab-Dummadga ibmar-ogumakar uksad. Geb Jacob agi mas-gunmalaga e-gwenadganse gochad. Agi bela e-gwenadgan mas-guchamalad. Degine, a-yar-birgi gabismarbalid.
Oibosgu, wakudaryalaba Labán gwisgusad, degimaloye-sogega bela e-wagan-wagar usad, degine, e-sisgan-wagar usbalid. Geb a-sorbali, bela amargi ise-nued-binsaedgi ega ibmar sogsad. Geb degine, Labán gannar e-negse ali gusad.
Jacob e-maidgi nadegusbalid. Nadapgu, Bab-Dummad-baliwiturmar Jacob-abin noalid.
Jacob, baliwiturmar-daksagu, sogded: “We-nega, Bab-Dummad-e-sordamar-neg gued.” A-ulale, Jacob a-nega Mahanaimʼye onugsasad.
Jacob e-iduale, Edom-yalaganba, dule e-barsogega Seir-neggweburse barmisad. Adi, e-ia-Esaúʼga sogega, ede daniye.
Jacob sogded: “An-dummad-Esaúʼga weyob be sogo: ‘Be-mai-Jacob soged: Ede emi-ibadse Labán-walik-gudii gusye.
Emidi, ede bukidar we-ibmarmar nikaye: Molimar-bebe-nikad, moli-uayasuigan, sibad-wawaadmar, sibadmar, maigan-omegan, maigan-machergan. ” ’Dummad, we-gayaburba an bese barmisiid. Degisoggu, bitigi nued be an-abin-daksana yeerban.’ ”
Dule-gayaburba-sesmalad gannar aibilismargu, Jacobʼga sognonimalad: —Anmar be-ia-Esaúʼse arbimalad. Na e-sunnad be-abin danikid, degine, machergan e-dulataled-ilabake (400) eba danimarmogad.
Jacob dulemar-weyob-ega-soge itoargu, bela-bela dobe-itonaded, degi, nue bukib-binsaded. Jacob dulemar-eba-danimalad danabo urbisad. Amba deyob sibad-wawaadmar, moli-bebe-nikamalad, degi, moli-yargan-muremalad imaksabalid.
Ar ade, Jacob binsasad: “Ar Esaú dulemar-danagwenadgi-gwisgualile, danagwenad-baid sunna wakinneddeeye.”
Geb degine, Jacob Bab-Dummadse goted, ega sogded: “Bab-Jehováʼye, be an-dad-Abraham-e-Bab-Dummad-gued, degi, an-bab-Isaac-e-Bab-Dummad-gubalid. Be anga sogsad: ‘Be-yarse, degi, be-gwenadganse be naye. An bega bela ibmar-nueganbi-gued an imakoye.’
An wisi, be angi nued binsamaid, gwen be angi nodisulid, ar deyob be an-imake-wilubsulinad. We-Jordán-diwar an obaksagua, deunni, ibmar-bipisaar gwen an semaigussulid, unnila, gaapoledbi an semai gusad. Ar emigindi, ibmar-dummagan-danabo an nikad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, ¡an-ia-Esaúʼgi wis be an-bendake! An dobe-itoged. Abakalegi an-oburgwialile, degi, an-omemar, an-mimmimar-oburgwiarbalile.
Ar bede nue anga sogsad: ‘Bela ibmar-nueganbi-gued an bega imakoye. Be-wagan bela-bela ukub-merguedyob-guosoggu, geg dule ebise guoye.’ ”
A-mutiki, Jacob agi gabisad. Geb bangine, e-ibmar-bur-nuegan susad, adi, e-ia-Esaúʼga ukegar:
Sibad-omegan, waladulataled-ilabo (200), sibad-machergan, waladulagwen (20), sibad-wawaad-omegan, waladulataled-ilabo (200), sibad-wawaad-machergan, waladulagwen (20).
Moli-yargan-mureged-e-omemar-emisgwa-mimmi-nikusmalad, e-mimmiganse-bakar, waladulagwen-gakambe (30), moli-bebe-nikad-e-omegan, waladulabo (40), moli-bebe-nikmalad-machergan, warambe (10), moli-uayasuid-omegan, waladulagwen (20), degi, moli-uayasuid-machergan, warambe (10).
Geb degine, Jacob ega-arbamaladga ibmar-durgan danar-danar-uksagu, ega sogded: “Bemar an-idu namar. Bemar na gi undar bangu-bangu danar-danar-nadapi be imakmalo.”
Jacob gebe-dulemar-barmisad-e-iduedga weyob sogsad: “An-ia-Esaú be-abingualile, degi, bega sokardibe: ‘¿Doa be-dummadye? ¿Bia be nadapye? Degine, be ibmar-durgan-semaidi, ¿we doagadye?’
Abin be sogoed: ‘We-ibmar-durgan, be-mai-Jacobʼgadye. Dummad-Esaú, an-dummad-Jacob bega we-ibmar-durgan barmiarye. Degi, Jacob e-sunnad anmar-sorba danimoye.’ ”
Degine, dulemar-baid-sogbogwad danar-barmisbalid. Degine, dulemar-sogbaagwad amba deyob danar-barmisbalid. Degine, Jacob bela danar-danar-ibmar-durgan-semamaidga sogsad: “An-ia-Esaú bemar-abingualile, bemar degibi sogmarmogoye.
Deginbali, ega sogbaloye: ‘Be-mai-Jacob, an-sorba daniye.’ ” Ar ade, Jacob binsaed: “An-ia sae-itogedi, we-ibmarmar-an-ega-uknaidgi an binsaed-gaoeddeeye. Geb a-sorbali, an-sunnad an-ia an dakoye. Ar wegii saedgi nued an-abingaaliirye.”
Degisoggu, Jacob na e-iaga-ibmar-uknaid e-idu barmisad. Na edi e-neggi besad, agi mutik gabegar.
A-mutiki, Jacob e-omegan-warbogwad, e-maigan-omegan-warbogwad, degi, e-masmala-warambe-gakagwensakad (11), Jaboc-diwar-dinnagwadsik-obakega imaksad.
Deginbali, bela ibmar-durgan-nikadi diwargi-obakega imaksabalid.
Jacob walagwen besgua, dule-wargwen ese nonikid. We-dule Jacob-ebo neg-oibogedse gala-maada urwenai gusad.
Ar dule Jacobʼgi geg obin-itosoggu, duagar-dikar-gwadilenaidgi sarsosad. Degisoggu, Jacob urwenaigu, e-duagar nosad.
Geb degine, dule Jacobʼga sogded: —Be an-indake. Bato neg-oibodanikid. Jacob abin-sogded: —Be angi ise-nued-binsaedgi be anga ibmar-sogsulile, an be-indakosulid.
Dule Jacobʼse egichided: —¿Igi be nuga? Jacob abin-sogded: —Jacobʼye, an nuga.
Geb degine, dule ega sogded: —Jacobʼye bar be nugguosulid. Ar ade, be Bab-Dummadbo-galitosadgi, degi, dulemarbo-galitosadgi be obichasoggu, be Israelʼye nugguoed.
Jacob dulese egisdemogad: —Emigi, be-nug anga be sogmoga, ¿igi be nugmoga? Dule abin-imakded: —¿Ibiga be anse an-nug egise? Geb degine, dule Jacobʼgi ise-nued-binsaedgi ega sogded. “Bela bega ibmar-nueganbi gusunno.”
Geb Jacob a-nega Penielʼye onugsasad. Ar ade, Jacob soged: “Bab-Dummad-wagar nue an daksad, degite, amba an dula gudiid.”
Jacob bato Penielʼgi nue-bangumaigua, dad-nakwialid. Ar ade, Jacob dikargi naibigussoggu, muya-muya nanagusad.
A-ulale, emi-ibase Israel-dulemar ibdurgan-e-duagar-dikar-gwadilenaid-e-dub-wardummad-maid-sinnigwad wissur gunmalad, ar ade, agi Israel sarsolesad, a-dub-wardummad sinni gusad.
Jacob dakdegu, Esaúʼba machergan e-dulataled-ilabake-mergu (400) daniki, mimmigan danar-danar Leaʼba, Raquelʼba, degi, e-maigan-omegan-warbogwadba mimisad.
Gebedgi, Jacob e-maigan-omegan e-mimmiganmala iduega imaksad. Geb a-sorba, Lea e-mimmiganmala nasiksad. Geb napidgine, Raquel e-machi-Joséʼbo nasiksad.
Geb degine, Jacobʼdi bela wemar-idusad, dulluu e-bebe napase ebulegedse ilagugle (7) e-iase warmaksadse imaknadapi gusad.
Ar Esaúʼdi e-urba-Jacobʼse abarmakded, bela angaagwar Jacob-gadapid, degi, e-wagar udapbalid, ebobela ise-boale bodmalad.
Geb a-sorbali, Esaú, omegan-dakargu, degi, mimmigan-dakargu, egichided: —Wemardi, ¿we doamala? Jacob abin-sogded. —We-mimmigan Bab-Dummad angi-nabir-binsaedba anga uksadid.
Geb degine, e-omegan-maigan na e-mimmiganmala Esaúʼse warmaknonimalad. Geb degine, dulluu e-bebe napase ebulegedse imaksamalad.
Geb a-sorbali, Lea e-mimmiganmala deyob dulluu imaknonimarmogad. Geb napidgine, José e-nan-Raquelʼbo nonikid, amba deyob dulluu imaknonimarmogad.
Geb degine, Esaú egichidbalid: —¿Ar ibiga we-ibmar-durgan danar-danar be anga barmiali? Jacob ega sogded: —Be angi-nued-binsaega, an bega barmialid.
Esaú sogded: —Urba, deyobsuli. An ibmar-durgan unniguar-nikamogad. Be-ibmar-durgan begadid. Na be sue.
Degi-inigwele, Jacobʼdi e-iagi alamaknai gusad: —Suli ia, degisuli. An we-ibmar-bega-sedanikidi, bitigi be abingasana yeerban. Ar be nued be anmar-abindaksasoggu, an be-dakdedgine, Bab-Dummad-wagar-dakdeyob an itonaded.
Degisoggu, nue-wilesakwaa an bese egised, we an bega-ibmar-durgan-uknaid be sue, ar ade, Bab-Dummad mani-ibedga an-imaksad. Ibmar-durgan unniguar an nikad. Ar Jacob e-ia-Esaúʼgi alamaknaigusoggu, Esaú ibmar-durgan-abingassunnad.
Geb degine, Esaú sogded: —Nabir. Anmar namarsundo. An be-idugoed.
Jacob e-ia-abin sogded: —Ia, nabirindo. Ar be nue wisid, mimmigan binnaa nanamalad. Degisoggu, geg anmar darekwaa naed. Degine, sibad-wawaadmar-e-mimmigangi, degi, moli-bebe-nikamalad-e-mimmigangi an binsaergebbalid. Ar sibad-wawaadmar geggusmalale, sunna ibagwen bela giir gued.
Ar bur-nuediled be an-idu naer. Ar andi binnale be-sorba nadapoed. Ibmar-durgan-nanaed-e-ganguedba, degi, mimmigan-nanaed-e-ganguedba an be-sorba nadapoed. Anmar Seir-yargi abingumalodo.
Esaú abin-sogded: —Nabirdo. Machergan-anba-nonimaladi, abala an bega obego. Jacobʼdi e-ia-abin sogded: —¿Ar ibiga be obegoe? Bato unniguar nued be angi binsasad.
Ar aka a-ibagi Esaú Seir-yarse gannar naded.
Ar Jacobʼdi Sucotʼse naded. Agi, e-neg sobsad, degine, e-ibmar-durganga galu sobsabalid. A-ulale, Jacob a-nega Sucotʼye onugsasad.
Jacob Padan-Aram-neggweburgi-mai Canaán-yarse-nonigu, bonisuli nuedgi nonikid. Jacob Siquem-neggwebur-asabin megnonikid.
Jacob Hamor-e-masmalase mani-gwadulatargi (100) nainu baksad. Hamorʼde Siquem-e-babad. A-nainugi Jacob dordoneg sisad. Jacob agi megnonikid.
Geb a-sorbali, Jacob Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila sobsad. A-aila Jacob El-Elohe-Israelʼye onugsasad.
Ibagwengine, Dina, neggweburse bunamalase ataknad gusad. Dinaʼde Lea-sisgwad, Jacobʼbo-baksadid.
Siquem a-bunagwa-dakargu, gadebin imaksad, egi nue-dodosad. Siquemʼde Hamor-e-machid. Hamorʼdi, Heveo-duled, neggweburgi nue-nug-nikagwadid.
Ar bela-bela Siquem Jacob-sisgwa-Dinaʼbina nue-sogsoggu, e-abegega egi alamaknai gusanad.
Degi, Siquem, e-bab-Hamorʼga sogded: “Jacobʼse be anga Dina egisnae. An nue-nikubied.”
Jacob wisgusad, e-sisgwa-Dinaʼgi Siquem nue-dodosye. Ar e-masmala sapurba e-ibmar-durgan-edarbedimarsoggu, Jacob e-masmala-negse-nonikidse geb ibmar sogsad.
Degidgine, Siquem-e-bab-Hamor, Jacobʼbo-sunmakega Jacobʼse nade gusad.
Jacob-masmala-sapurba-gudidimalad neggusad-wisgusmargu, gannar negse nonimalad. Ar ade, e-bab-Israel-nug nue-gagalesad. Aginbali, Siquem e-bungi-dodosad-ular, nue-gwage-nunmak-itomalad, degi, nue-sae-itomarbalid. Ar ade, Siquem weyob imakewilubsulinad.
Ar Hamorʼdi Jacob-e-masmala-ebo sunmaksad, ega sogded: —An-machi-Siquem bela-bela bemar-bun abeged. Bemar be-bun an-machi-ebo-nikued wis be imakmala.
Bemar anmar-gwenadga gumardo, adi, anmar nabir bemar-sisgan-nikue gumaloed, degine, bemar nabir anmar-sisgan-nikue gumarmogoed.
Wegi bemar megmarmoga. Anmar-yar guakwaa bemar-idu naid, bemar anmar-walik megdo, be arbamardo, degine, nainu be bakmardo.
Ar Siquemʼmoga Dina-e-babga, degi, Dina-e-susmarga sogdemogad: —Anmar-ibmar-bega-sognaid be abingamala. Ar ibu be anse egismardibe, an bega ukmaloed.
Ome-nikuega ar gusgu igar-maidba ibmar-ukleged, aba bur dumma be anse ibmar-egisele, degi, ibmar-bukidar bega ukbi be an-abegele, an bemarga ibmar ukoed. Be-bun an nikuega bemar an-imakmala.
Degi-inigwele, ar Siquem Dinaʼgi nue-dodossoggu, Jacob-e-masmala Siquemʼga, degi, Hamorʼga, yamo-yardakar
ega sogdemalad: —Suli, degisuli. Geg anmar dule-abgan-uka-duku-sikarsulidga anmar-bun uked. Anmar deyob imakele, binged-dummad itole.
Bela bemar-machergan abgan-uka-duku be sikmalardi, nabirdo. Ar weyob be-machergan anmaryob imakerdi, nabirdo.
Ar deyob bemar imakele, bemar sunna anmar-sisgan nikumaloed, degine, anmar sunna bemar-sisgan-nikumarmogoed. Anmar sunna bemar-abargi megmaloed. Anmar bemarbogwa dule-wargwennayob gumaloed.
Bemar anmar-sogedba abgan-uka-duku-siksurmalale, wegi-anmar-gudiid anmar naoed. Anmar-bun anmar sedmaloed.
Hamor, degi, e-machi-Siquem Jacob-e-masmala-ega-ibmar-sogsamalad nued itosmalad.
Dogdar nadsuli, Siquem Jacob-e-sisgwabina nue-sogsoggu, e-abgan-uka-duku siksad. Ar Siquem e-gwenadgan-abargi bur nue-nug-nikagwadsoggu,
Siquem, e-bab-Hamor-ebogwa neggwebur-doged-yawagakse nade gusmalad, ar ade, agi igar-naboleged-negad. Agi, Siquem, e-bab-Hamorʼbo dulemarga sogdemalad:
—We-dulemar, anmar-aimalad. Anmar-abargi megmaloed, degi, wegi arbamaloed, ar ade, unniguar napa naid. Sunna anmar wemar-sisgan nikumalad, degi, wemar sunna anmar-sisgan nikumarmogad.
Ar anmar unnila dule-wargwennayob-guegala, sogmardo, emarde anmar-abargi megmalagala, emar imakdamarmogadyob, anmarde anmar-abgan-uka-duku sikmaloye.
Bela ibmar-nikmalad, degi, bela e-ibmar-durgan anmargadga gumogoed. Unnila anmar sogergebed, eyeye. Deyob anmar sogele, anmar-abargi megmalodo.
Bela machergan a-neggweburginmalad, Hamor, degi, e-machi-Siquem-ega-soged nabir-itosmalad. Degisoggu, bela e-abgan-uka-duku siksamarsunnad.
Ibapaagusgu, Jacob-e-masmala-warbogwad, Simeón, degi, Leví, Dina-e-susmar, e-es-suid-sesmargu, neggweburse nade gusmalad. Amba deun, machergan e-abgan-uka-duku-siksadba nunmak-itomaidgi modapmalad. Geb degine, Simeón, degi, Leví bela we-machergan es-suidgi oburgwismalad.
Simeón, Levíʼbo, es-suidgi-ewarar, Hamor, degi, e-machi-Siquem-oburgwismalad. Geb degi, e-bun-Dina Siquem-neggi-gudiid onosmalad. Agine, nade gusmalad.
Geb degine, Jacob-masmala-baigan nonimarmogad, burgwar-mamaidgi nasmargua, e-bun-Dinaʼgi Siquem nue-dodosad-ular, neggweburgi-ibmar-nikad bela sesa gusmalad.
Jacob-masmala we-ibmarmar sesa gusmalad: Sibad-wawaadmar, moli-bebe-nikamalad, moli-uayasuidmar, bela neggweburgi-ibmar-nikad, degi, sapurba-ibmar-nikamarbalid.
Neggi-ibmar-nikamalad bela atursasmalad, omegan, mimmigan, degi, bela ibmarmar-negyagi-bukmalad sesa gusmalad.
Geb degine, Jacob, Simeónʼga, degi, Levíʼga sogded: —Ar emigindi, boni-dummad bemar anga uksamalad. Dulemar-we-yargi-mamaimalad, Canaán-dulemar, Ferezeo-dulemar, isdar an-dakdamaloed. Emar, anmargi bila-onomalaga atodmaloed. Ar anmar machergan-ichee gumarsoggu, ani, degi, an-gwenadgan bela oburgwilemaloed.
Ar e-masmaladi, e-bab-abin sogdemalad: —¿Ar wede Siquem anmar-bun-Dina omegambanuchuyob imakoye soge? Suli, degisuli.
Bab-Dummad Jacobʼga sogded: “Be nae, Betel-neggweburse be megnae. Deun, be-ia-Esaúʼgi be wakinmaigu, ani, Bab-Dummad, an bese magarosadid. Betel-neggweburgi be anga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila be sobo.”
Geb degine, Jacob bela e-neguyaginmaladga, degi, bela eba-gudimaladga sogded: “Bemar be-bab-dummadga-imakdiid be sedidimalad, bela be metemalo. Bemar bela islidikidguega, be obmarbalo, degine, bela mor ogwamarbalo.
Anmar emisgwasaar Betelʼse naoed. Agine Bab-Dummad anse magaros gusad. A-Bab-Dummad-e-nug-odummogega an ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila ega sobdapoed. A-Bab-Dummadde an wile-itodigu, an-bendaksad. A-Bab-Dummad an-naddaedba anba gudiguad.”
Degisoggu, bela e-bab-dummadga-imakdimalad Jacobʼga senonimalad. Degine, e-uaya-dukugi olua-nanaid Jacobʼga uksamarbalid. Geb degi, Siquem-neggwebur-itakasaar Jacob bela a-ibmarmar sapi-encinaʼye-nugad-urba digsad.
Emar noarmargu, Bab-Dummad dulemar-neggweburmar-dikarbarmalad bela-bela Jacob-dobgumalaga imaksad. A-ulale, dulemar bar Jacob, degi, e-masmala-baregichasurmalad.
Jacob, degi, bela Jacobʼba-nadapmalad Luz-neggweburse modapmalad. A-neggweburde Canaán-yargi siid, degi, Betelʼye nugbalid.
Agi, Jacob Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila sobsad. Jacob e-iagi wakinmaigua, agi Bab-Dummad ese magaros gusad. A-ular, Jacob a-neg El-Betelʼye onugsasad.
Agi, Débora burgwisad. Déboraʼde Rebeca-akwisadid. Betel-waliksaar sapi-encinaʼye-nugad-urba digsamalad. Jacob Débora-digsad-neg Alón-Bacutʼye onugsasad. A-sogleged, Sapi-encina-bosadye.
Jacob Padan-Aramʼgi-mai gannar Betel-neggweburse nonibargu, Bab-Dummad ese gannar Betelʼgi magarononibalid. Bab-Dummad Jacobʼgi ise-nued-binsaedgi gannar ega sogded:
“Be Jacobʼye nuganad. Emigindi, bar deyob be nugguosulid. Be Israelʼye nugguoed.”
Bab-Dummad Jacobʼga sogdebalid: “Ani, an Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadid. Mimmigan-bukidar, degine, wagan-bukidar be nikuo. Begi dulemar-sogagwen nodagoed, degine, dulemar-sog-akar-akar begi nodabaloed. Be-waganmala reymarga gumaloed.
Abrahamʼga, degi, Isaacʼga, yar-an-ukoye sogsadi, a-yar an bega ukmogoed. Be-sorbali, be-waganga a-yar an ukbaloed.”
Bab-Dummad Jacob-ebo-sunmaksad-bergusgua, niba nade gusad.
Geb degine, Jacob akwa susad, Bab-Dummad-ega-sunmaksadgi a-akwa ogwichisad. Geb a-sorbali, a-akwagi gwallu-wawa, degi, vino egi eosad, oyogega, we-akwa, Bab-Dummadgadye.
A-neggi Bab-Dummad Jacob-ebo sunmaksad. A-ular, Jacob a-neg Betelʼye onugsasad.
Geb a-sorbali, Jacob, degi, bela eba-gudimalad Betelʼgi nade gusmalad. Amba Efrata-neggweburgi-yeer-banguedgi, Raquel goe-nikunonikid. Goe-nikuegala, undar-boniganba galitosad.
Raquel bur bule bonigan-itonaidgi, muu-sikwigaed ega sogded: “Melle be dobgu, machigwa-baid bega uklesbalid.”
Ar Raquelʼdi napi-iche-iche-maidgi e-goe Benoniʼye onugsasad. Ar e-bab-Jacobʼdi machi-bipi Benjamínʼye onugsanonikid.
Weyob Raquel burgwisad. Efrataʼse-naed-igarba Raquel-mui digsamalad. Emigindi, a-neggwebur, Belénʼye nugad.
Jacob Raquel-neg-uan-birgi akwa-dummad ogwichisad. A-akwa amba we-garda narmaklesmaidse Raquel-digar-maid oyonaid.
Israel nade gusad. Neg-suid-Migdal-Edarʼdaksik megidapid. Agi, Israel e-dordoneg sidapid.
Israel bato Migdal-Edarʼgi nue-mai, Rubén e-bab-ome-Bilha-maidse nade gusad. Agi, Rubén Bilhaʼse gochad. Jacob wisgusgu, Rubén Bilhaʼse gochaye, Jacob nue-sae itosgusad.
Jacob masmala-warambe-gakabo (12) nikusad: Jacob-Leaʼbo-masmala-nikusadi, wemalad: Rubén, e-machi-sailagined, Simeón, Leví, Judá, Isacar, degi, Zabulón.
Jacob-Raquelʼbo-masmala-nikusadi, wemarmogad: José, degi, Benjamín.
Jacob Raquel-e-mai-Bilhaʼbo-masmala-nikusadi, wemarmogad: Dan, degi, Neftalí.
Jacob Lea-e-mai-Zilpaʼbo-masmala-nikusadi, wemarmogad: Gad, degi, Aser. Wemala, Jacob-machimala gumalad, Padan-Aramʼgi gwalulesmaladid.
Jacob Mamre-neggweburse e-bab-Isaac-daknade gusad. Mamre-neggweburde, Arba-neggwebur-walik siid. Mamre-neggweburde, Hebrónʼye bimarbalid. A-neggweburgine, Abraham, degi, Isaac mai gusad.
Isaac nue seleba-mai birga-dulabakebak-nika (180) burgwisad.
E-sergan-abargi mesismalad. E-masmala Esaú, degi, Jacob, e-bab-Isaac-digsamalad.
Esaú, Edomʼye nugbalid. Esaú e-anagan nikusad.
Esaú Canaán-yargined-omegan-nikusadi, wemalad: Gebesailagine, Ada-nikusad. Adaʼde Elón-e-sisgwad, Het-duled. Esaú, Aholibama-nikusbalid. Aholibamaʼde Aná-e-sisgwad, Zibeón-e-wagwad. Zibeónʼde Heveo-duled.
Degine, Esaú, Basemat-nikusbalid. Basematʼde Ismael-e-sisgwad, Nebaiot-e-bunad.
Esaú Canaán-yargi-maigu, machimala-nikusadi, wemalad: Adaʼbo baksadid, Elifaz. Basematʼbo baksadid, Reuel,
Aholibamaʼbo baksadid Jeús, Jaalam, degi, Coré.
Esaú, e-omemar, e-masmala, e-bunamala, degi, bela eba-gudidimalad yar-baidse sesa gusad. Deyob, e-urba-Jacob-idu bangud gusad. Bela e-ibmar-durgan, degi, bela e-ibmar-Canaán-yargi-nikusad sesa gusad.
Ar Esaú, Jacob-ebo bela ibmar-durgan-ichesur-nikamarsoggu, geg ebo walikaa-gudii gumalad. Ar e-mamaidgine, ibmar-durgan mas-mamalaga napa unniguarsulid.
A-ulale, Esaú Seir-yalaganba megnad gusad. Esaúʼde, Edomʼye nugbalid.
Edom-dulemar-e-dadgan Seir-yalaganba bukwagusmalad. Wemala, Esaú-wagan gumalad.
Esaú-e-masmala weyob nugmalad: Ada-e-machi-Elifaz.
Wemardi, Elifaz-e-masmala gumarmogad: Temán, Omar, Zefo, Gatam, degi, Cenaz.
Esaú-machi-Elifaz, ome-dikarbalid nikagusad, Timnaʼye nugad. Elifaz Timnaʼbo machi-nikusad, Amalecʼye nugad. Wemar, Ada-e-wagan-gumalad.
Reuel-e-masmaladi, wemalad: Nahat, Zera, Sama, degi, Miza. Wemar, Esaú-ome-Basemat-e-wagan-gumalad.
Aholibama, Esaú-ome-baid gubalid. Aholibamaʼde Aná-e-sisgwad, Zibeón-e-wagwad. A-ome Esaúʼbo masmala-baksadi, wemalad: Jeús, Jaalam, degi, Coré.
Esaú-e-wagan dule-idumaladga-gusmaladi, wemalad: Esaú-machi-gebesailagined, Elifaz. Elifaz-e-masmala dule-idumaladga-gusmarmogadi, wemalad: Temán, Omar, Zefo, Cenaz,
Coré, Gatam, degi, Amalec. Wemar, Elifaz-e-masmala, Edom-yalagangi dule-idumaladga gusmalad. Bela wemar. Esaú-e-ome-Ada-wagan gumalad.
Esaú-machi-Reuel-e-masmala, dule-idumaladga-gusmarmogadi, wemalad: Nahat, Zera, Sama, degi, Miza. Wemar, Reuelʼsik, Edom-yalagangi dule-idumaladga gusmarmogad. Wemala, Basemat-wagan gumalad. Basematʼde Esaú-e-ome-baid gued.
Esaú-ome-Aholibamaʼdi Aná-sisgwad. Aholibama-e-masmala dule-idumaladga-gusmaladi, wemalad: Jeús, Jaalam, degi, Coré.
Bela wemala, Esaú-e-wagan gumalad. Esaúʼde, Edomʼye nugbalid. Bela wemala, e-dulemar-idumaladga gusmalad.
Seir-e-masmala amba Edom-yalagi bukwa gusmarmogad. Seirʼde, Horí-duled. Seir-e-masmaladi, wemalad: Lotán, Sobal, Zibeón, Aná,
Disón, Ezer, degi, Disán. Wemala, Seir-e-wagan, Edom-yalaganba Horí-dulemar-e-idumaladga gusmalad.
Lotán-e-masmala, wemalad: Hori, Hemam. Lotán-e-bundi, Timnaʼye nugad.
Sobal-e-masmaladi, wemalad: Alván, Manahat, Ebal, Sefo, degi, Onam.
Zibeón-e-masmaladi, wemalad: Aja, degi, Aná. We-Aná e-bab-Zibeónʼga nega-dulesulidganba moli-uayasuid-edarbedigu, dian-diopisulid amisad.
Aná mimmigan-warbo-nikusadi, wemalad: Machigwa nugad, Disón. Bunagwa nugad, Aholibama.
Disón-e-masmaladi, wemalad: Hemdán, Esbán, Itrán, degi, Querán.
Ezer-e-masmaladi, wemalad: Bilhán, Zaaván, degi, Acán.
Disán-e-masmaladi, wemalad: Uz, degi, Arán.
Horí-dulemar-e-dummaganga gusmaladi, wemalad: Lotán, Sobal, Zibeón, Aná,
Disón, Ezer, degi, Disán. Wemala, Seir-yalaganba Horí-dulemar-idumaladga e-gwenadgan-e-gwenadganba gusmalad.
Israel-dulemar amba yoo rey-nikumargu, deun we-reymar Edom-yargi negsemai gusmalad.
Beor-machi-Belaʼye-nugadi, Edom-yargi reyga megisad. E-neggweburga-gusadi, Dinabaʼye nugad.
Rey-Bela burgwisgua, a-sorba, Jobab negdaknonikid. Jobabʼde, Zera-e-machid, Bosra-neggweburginedid.
Jobab burgwisgua, a-sorba, Husam negdaknonikid, Husamʼde, Temán-yalaginedid.
Husam burgwisgua, a-sorba, Hadad negdaknonimogad. Hadadʼde, Bedad-e-machid. Hadad, Moab-yargi Madián-dulemargi nakwisad. Hadad-e-neggweburga-gusadi, Avitʼye nugad.
Hadad burgwisgua, a-sorba, Samla negdaknonikid. Samlaʼde, Masreca-neggweburginedid.
Samla burgwisgua, a-sorba, Saúl negdaknonikid. Saúlʼde, Rehobotʼginedid. Rehobot-neggweburde, Éufrates-diwar-gakaba siid.
Saúl burgwisgua, a-sorba, Baal-Hanán negdaknonikid. Baal-Hanánʼde, Acbor-e-machid.
Acbor-machi-Baal-Hanán burgwisgua, a-sorba, Hadar negdaknonikid. Hadar-e-omedi, Mehetabelʼye nugad. Mehetabelʼde, Matred-e-sisgwad, Mezaab-e-wagwad. Hadar-e-neggweburga-gusadi, Pauʼye nugad.
We-dulemar, Esaú-e-wagan-dummaganga gumalad. E-gwenadganmarba ilemakar danikid, e-yarmarba ilemakar danikid, degi, e-negmar-megismaladba ilemakar danikid. We, e-nugmalad: Timna, Alva, Jetet,
Aholibama, Ela, Pinón,
Cenaz, Temán, Mibzar,
Magdiel, degi, Iram. Wemala e-yargi bia-megismaladgi, Edom-dulemar-idumaladga gusmalad. Esaúʼdi, Edom-dulemar-e-dad-sailad. Esaúʼde, Edomʼye nugbalid.
Jacob e-bab-maigusmogadgi-megega, Canaán-yargi besad.
Jacob-e-igar weyob maid. José sapingwaunni, birgambe-gakagugle-nikagua (17), e-iamarmala sibad-wawaad-edarbedii daed. E-iamardi Bilha, degi, Zilpa-e-masmalad. Bilhaʼde, degi, Zilpaʼde Jacob-e-omeganad. José negse-modapir, e-iamar-sunnasurdaed e-babga sogdapdaed.
Ar Israel nue-selebagusadgi José gwalulessoggu, Israel, e-masmala-baiganba bur bule José-sabed. Israelʼde, Jacobʼye nugbalid. Degisoggu, Israel, Joséʼga mor-suid yeerdakleged-akar-akar maksad.
E-iamar dakarmargu, e-bab bur bule emarba José-sabdae, degidbali, e-iamar José-sae-dakdemalad, degi, bipisaar ese bar-gordii gussurmalad.
Ibagwengi, José gabdaksad. Na e-gabdaksad e-iamarga sogsad. A-ular, e-iamar bur bule José-sae-dakarmalad.
Ar ade, José e-iamarga weyob sogsad: —Bemar nue-an-itomalo, an-gabdaksad an bemarga soggwelo.
An gabdaksad: Bela-anmar sapurba gudiiye. Orosgi-dakleged-trigo duk-dukgwen-imaknaigu, ukiagwar an-trigoʼdi gannaa gwisguded. Ar bemargaddi angad-dikarba bela ebilis ambikusmalad, degine, bela angad-abin dulluu imakdemalad.
Geb degine, e-iamar abin-sogdemalad: —Ar be sogsunde, ¿be anmar-reyga guoye? ¿Be anmar-dummadga megoye? Adi surbali. We deyob-gabdaksadba degi, e-iamarga e-gabdaksad-sogsadba e-iamar bur bule José-sae dakdemalad.
A-sorbali, José gabdaksabalid. A-gabdaksad e-iamarga sogsabalid. Weyob ega sogded: —An-gabdaksad be nue-itomarbalo: An dakalid, dad-ibeler, nii, degi, niisgwamar-gwaambe-gakagwensak (11) bela an-asabin dulluu imakdemalad.
José weyob-gabdaksadi, e-babga, degi, e-iamarga sogsagua, e-bab Joséʼga sabsur-ibmar sokalid, ega sogded: —We deyob be gabdaksadi, ¿wede ibu be obare? ¿Ar ade, ani, be-nan, degi, be-iamar, anmar be-nug-odummonai gumalode? Adi surbali.
E-iamar bur bule José-isdar dakdemalad. Ar e-babdi José-gabdaksadgi nue-binsadii gualid.
Ibagwengine, José-e-iamar e-bab-sibad-wawaadmar gagangi-omaega, Siquem-neggwebursik nade gusmalad.
Geb degine, Israel Joséʼga sokalid: —Be-iamar Siquem-neggwebur-naba sibad-wawaad-edarbedimalad. Be-iamar-daknabi an be-abedo. José abin-sogded: —Nuedgi an naodo.
Israel sogded: —Nueddo. Be nae, be-iamar be daknae, igi gudimardibe, degi, sibad-wawaadmar nued bukwadibe. Be gannar anse nonikoed. Be anga sognonikoed, be-iamarde nueganbidibe. Israel Hebrón-neba-akar José-barmis gusad.
José Siquemʼse modapgu, dule-wargwen, José sapurba-bipirmadii abingualid. Joséʼse egichialid: —¿Ibu be amidii?
José abin-sogded: —An-iamar an amidii. ¿Sunna be anga sogsale, bia an-iamar sibad-wawaadmar edarbedimala?
Dule abin-sogded: —Bato wegi nadmalad. Be-iamar soge an itosad, emarde Dotán-neggweburse naye. Geb degine, José e-iamar-aminadap gusad. Dotán-neggwebur-dikarba abingudapid.
E-iamar, José-danikid bato dikasuli daksabinmalad. José amba yoo ese warmake, idu igar amismalad, José-oburgwemaloye.
Geb sogdemalad: —¡Be dakmalana, dule-gabdakegwa dani!
Ginebinne, anmar oburgwenae. Geb a-sorba anmar dia-yaagi metemaloed. Anmar sogmaloed, ibmar-sapurbalid-ursirmalad guchaye. ¡Anmar dakodo, bule-nabir e-gabdaksad ega guodibe!
Rubén e-urbamar weyob-sunmaknanai-itosgua, José-bendakbi gualid. Degisoggu, e-urbamarga sogded: —Melle anmar José-oburgwemalo.
Melle bemar José-ablis eomalo. Wegi nega-dulesulidganba dia-siid-yaba be odomalo. Melle be oburgwemalo. Rubén José-bendakbiedba, deyob sogsad, adi, e-babga gannar José-dula-ukegar.
José e-iamar-bukwadse modapgu, e-iamar José-gasmalad. Geb ei mor-suid-yeerdakleged-akar-akar-makaled esusmalad.
Geb dia-yaba José-metemalad. We-diade ollobi dinna siid.
Geb a-sorbali, e-iamardi mas-gunnega sigismalad. Geb agine, Ismael-dulemar danagwen Galaad-akar danimalad. E-moli-yargan-muregedgi gwallu-wawadikmalad, ina-wawadikmalad, sapi-gunnugiid-wawadikmalad-mirraʼye-nugad, Egipto-yarse semamaid.
Geb degine, Judá, e-gwenadganga sogded: —Ar anmar anmar-urba-oburgweye-soger, ¿ibi-nued anmar egi amiosunna? Ibmar-nued anmar egi amiosulid. Ar a-sorbali, anmar neg-oakalosad odukubalirgebed.
Deginbali, José anmar-urbabalid, bab mesamaladid. Bur-nuediled anmar bur Ismael-dulemarga manigi-uker. Judá-ibmar-soged bela e-gwenadgan yeer-itosmalad.
Ismael-dule-ibmar-ukmalad José-e-iamar-bukwadse mosmargu, José-e-iamala José-dia-yaagi-siid-onosmalad. Ismael-dulemarde Madiánʼginmaladid. Degine, mani-gwadulagwengi (20) José-uksamalad. Weyobi Ismael-dulemar Egiptoʼse José-sesmalad.
Rubén dia-siidse gannar nonigu, José-sate dakalid. Geb agi, Rubén e-mor esirmaksad, oyogega, ede, nue-nunmak itoye.
Geb a-sorbali, e-urbamar-bukwadse nonikid, amarga sognonikid: —¡Machigwa bar dia-yaba sisulid! Ar emigindi, ¿igi an gudoe?
Geb degine, e-iamar José-mor-suid-susmargu, sibad-bipi-oburgwisad-abegi mor dudismalad.
Geb degine, e-babse José-mor senonimalad. Degine, weyob Israelʼga sognonimalad: “Anmar we-mor amismala. Nue be dake, ¿we be-machi-e-mor-suid be dake?”
Jacob dakdegu e-machi-mola, weyob sogded: “¡Eye, we an-machi-mor-suidi! An-machi ibmar-dula-sapurbalid-ursilidse gullesad.”
Geb degine, Jacob e-mor esirmakded. Geb wile-itogedba mor-sommed yosad, degine, iba-ichesuli e-machi-burgwisad-ular bodii gusad.
Bela e-masmala, degi, e-bunamala aisaale Jacob-gwage-baisur-itoge-imaknaidaenad, ar Jacobʼdi e-gwage-baisur-itoged abesurdaed. Aka bur bule e-machibina bodii daed, sogdii daed: “An-machi-burgwisad-ular, an burgwedse bodii guoye.”
