Sedequías birga-dulagwen-gakagwensak-nikadgi (21), yar-sear gusad. Jerusalén-neggweburgi birgambe-gakagwensak (11) yar sesad.
Sedequías, Bab-Dummad-Jehová-asabin ibmar-isganabi imaksad. Sedequías, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Jeremías, ega Bab-Jehová-nuggi sunmaksagu, Bab-Jehová-abin san-bipii imaksasulid.
A-ukinbali, Sedequías, Bab-Dummad-asabin Nabucodonosorʼga ise-sogar imaksanad: “An beba ibsadii guoye.” Degi-inigwele, Sedequías aka Nabucodonosorʼgi gwisguded. Sedequías aka bur bule burguded, Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼba gwen ibsassulid.
Aginbali, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degi, dulemar, bela-bela isgusmalad. Dulemar-epenne-bukwagusmalad ibmar-isgana-imaksadba isgudmarmogad, degi, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg oichosmalad. A-nega Bab-Jehová swilidik imasgusanad.
Degi-inigwele, e-dadgan-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, bela-bela e-dulemar-sabsoggu, degi, ese-goled-neggi binsabarsoggu, amarga bali-bali e-gayaburba-barsogmaladba e-gayaburba barmisanad.
Degi-inigwele, Judá-dulemar, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmaladgi dododgusmalad, e-gayaburba sae-itodgusmalad, degi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmaladnik sogdegusmalad: “Binsa gordimarye.” Geb degi, ibagwengi, Bab-Jehová-sae-itogedba e-dulemargi gwichigussunnad, degi, bar bendakdii gussulid.
Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová, Babilonia-dulemar-e-rey Judá-dulemargi-gwisguega Judá-yarse barmialid. Degi, a-rey bela sapingana Bab-Dummadse-goled-negyaba es-suidgi ogilosad. Degine, Bab-Dummad, Nabucodonosorʼga bela dulemar-urmaksad: Sapingana, yagana, degi, serganse-bakar, degi, dad-seleganse-bakar, urmaklesad.
Bela Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ibmar-ebulemalad-dummagan-bukwad. Ibmar-ebulemalad-bipigan-bukwad. Degi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ibmar-gargermalad-bukwad selesad. Reygad ibmar-nuegan-gargermalad-bukwamogad, degi, dummagan-reyga-arbamaladgad ibmar-nuegan-gargermalad-bukwabalid, bela Caldeo-dulemar-e-rey Babiloniaʼse sesad.
A-ukinbali, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg ogumaksamarbalid, Jerusalén-e-galu-matusulid earismarbalid, reynegmar bela soogi ogumaksamarbalid, degi, bela ibmar-gargemalad-bukwad bibichismarbalid.
Dule-burgwissurmaladdi, Babiloniaʼse galesa selesmalad. Agi, rey-maiga gudapmalad, degi, rey-e-masmala-e-maiga gudapmarbalid. Geb Persa-dulemar-yar-sealidse deyobi gudii gusmalad.
Deyobi, Bab-Jehová-gayaburba-Jeremíasʼba-soglesgusad gunonikid. Bela dulemar Israel-yargi-bar-bukwasulidgi, napaneg bogidik naigusad. Igar-maidbali, napaneg birga-dulapaa-gakambe (70) bogidik naigusad.
Rey-Ciro, Persa-dulemar-e-rey, gebe-megided-birgagi, Bab-Jehová, a-rey-e-gwage ebusad e-gayaburba-oniega, degi, garda narmakar mimiegarbar. Adi, e-gayaburba-barsoged-Jeremías-sogsagusadba ibmar guegar. Degisoggu, Rey-Ciro bergwable-yar-ganikidgi, gayaburba gardagi narmakar, degi, gayagi-sogar gaya-mimisad, weyob sogsiid:
“Persa-dulemar-e-rey-Ciro, weyob soged: ” ‘Bab-Jehová, Bab-Dummad-Nibneggi-Maid, bela-yarmar-nanaid anga uksad. Degi, anga sogsabalid: Judá-yargi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi ese-goled-neg soboye. Dulemar-anmar-abargi-gudiid, na Judío-dule-itogele, degi, Bab-Jehová, e-Bab-Dummad-itogele, Jerusalénʼse e-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼba naodo.’ ”
Rey-Ciro, Persia-yar-e-reyga maigusad. Ciro-gebe-reyga-megided-birgagi, Bab-Jehová, Rey-Ciro-e-gwage ebusad, adi, bela e-yar-dakmaidgi igar-mesegar. Adi, we-igar-megoedba, nabir Bab-Jehová Jeremíasʼba gayaburba-sogsadba guegar. Degine, Rey-Ciro bela yar-ganikidgi igar-mesisad sogsa gusad, degi, gardagi-narmakar imaksabalid. Weyob sogsad:
“Persia-rey-Ciro weyob soged: ” ‘Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Nibneggi-Maidi, anga we-napneg-dirbir-naidgi bela yarmar-nanaid uksad. Degi, anga sogsabalid, Judá-yargi Jerusalén-neggwebur-siidgi ese-goled-neg ega soboye.
Degisoggu, anmar-abargi-Judá-dulemar-gudimalad Jerusalén-neggweburse be namar. Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼga ese-goled-neg be sobnamar. We-Bab-Dummadde, Jerusalénʼgi maid. Degi, a-Bab-Dummad bemarba naena gadin.
A-ukinbali, an igar-ukbardo, dule-bamaladi Judío-dulemar-amba-gudidimalad-bendakega we-ibmar ukmalo: Mani, olo, ibmar-nuegan, degi, e-ibmar-durgan ukmalo. De-ukinbali, dulemar Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ukleged e-binsaedba Bab-Dummadse-goled-negga ukbalo.’ ”
Degidgine, Judá-wagan-e-dummagan-neguya-sedimalad, Benjamín-wagan-e-dummagan-neguya-sedimalad, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, degi, Levita-dulemar, degi, Bab-Dummad bela dule-gwenna-gwenna-e-gwage-ebusmaladmala, amar Jerusalén-neggweburse Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sobnaega guakwaa ambikusmalad.
Bela dulemar e-neg-nagaba-mamaimalad bendaksamarmogad. We-ibmarmar ega uksamalad: Mani, or, ibmar-nuegan, ibmar-durgan, degi, ibmar-gargerbamalad ega uksamalad. Deginbali, dulemar, bela ibmarmar-akar-akar e-binsaedba Bab-Dummadse-goled-negga uksamarbalid.
Epenne, Jerusalénʼgi Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neggi-ibmar-ebulemalad, Nabucodonosor Babiloniaʼse sear gusad. Geb e-bab-dummadse-goled-negse urbenoni gusad. Emide, a-ibmarmar Persa-rey-Ciro onisad.
Degi, Persia-rey-Ciro, e-mani-daked-Mitrídatesʼga ibmar-onilesmalad uksad, adi, ebisegar. Bela ebichisgu, Judá-dulemar-e-dummad-Sesbasarʼga we-ibmarmar uksad.
Ar ibmar-ebislesmalad, wemalad: Bate-dummagan-orbiid, gwadulagwen-gakambe (30). Bate-dummagan-manibiid, miligwen (1,000). Estin, gadulagwen-gakabakebak (29).
Nog-orbiid, gwadulagwen-gakambe (30). Nog-manibiid, gwadulataled-ilabake gakambe (410). Degi, ibmar-baigan-ebulemalad, miligwenba (1,000).
Ibmar-ebulemalad-orbiid, degi, manibiid, bela miliatar gaka dulataled-ilabake-mergu (5,400) daklealid. Bela we-ibmarmar Sesbasar gannar Jerusalén-neggweburse sesa gusad, deun Judá-dulemarga soglesgu, bemar gannar Babilonia-neggweburgi-bukwad Jerusalén-neggweburse namaloye.
Babilonia-rey-Nabucodonosor, Judá-yargi dulemar-bukidar Babilonia-yarse sesa gusad. Geb a-sorba, ise barmiar Jerusalén-neggweburse imaksad, degi, Judá-yargi neggweburmar-bukwadse barmisbalid. Degine, dulemar na e-neggwebur-e-neggweburse nonigusmalad.
Dulemar-Zorobabelʼba-nonigusmaladi, wemalad: Jesúa, Nehemías, Seraías, Reelaías, Mardoqueo, Bilsán, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baana. Israel-dulemar e-yarse-nonimaladi, wemalad:
Paros-wagan, milibo gaka dulabaabak-gakambe-gakabo (2,172).
Sefatías-wagan, dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulapaa-gakambe-gakabo (372).
Ara-wagan, dulataled-ilagugle gaka dulapaa-gakambe-gakatar (775).
Pahat-Moab-wagan, a sogleged, Jesúa-e-waganye, degi, Joab-e-waganye, milibo gaka dulataled-ilabaabak gakambe-gakabo (2,812).
Elam-wagan, miligwen gaka dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakambe-gakabake (1,254).
Zatu-wagan, dulataled-ilabakebak gaka dulabo-gakatar (945).
Zacai-wagan, dulataled-ilagugle gaka dulapaa (760).
Bani-wagan, dulataled-ilanergwa gaka dulabo-gakabo (642).
Bebai-wagan, dulataled-ilanergwa gaka dulagwen-gakapaa (623).
Azgad-wagan, miligwen gaka dulataled-ilabo gaka dulagwen-gakabo (1,222).
Adonicam-wagan, dulataled-ilanergwa gaka dulapaa-gakanergwa (666).
Bigvai-wagan, milibo gaka dulabo-gakambe-gakanergwa (2,056).
Adín-wagan, dulataled-ilabake gaka dulabo-gakambe-gakabake (454).
Ater-wagan, a sogleged Ezequías-e-waganye, dulabake-gakambe-gakabaabak (98).
Bezai-wagan, dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulagwen-gakapaa (323).
Jora-wagan, dulatar-gakambe-gakabo (112).
Hasum-wagan, dulataled-ilabo gaka dulagwen-gakapaa (223).
Gibar-wagan, dulabake-gakambe-gakatar (95).
Belén-neggweburginmalad, dulanergwa-gakapaa (123).
Netofa-neggweburginmalad, dulabo-gakambe-gakanergwa (56).
Anatot-neggweburginmalad, dulanergwa-gakabaabak (128).
Azmavet-neggweburginmalad, dulabo-gakabo (42).
Quiriat-Jearim-neggweburginmalad, Cafiraʼginmalad, degi, Beerotʼginmalad, dulataled-ilagugle gaka dulabo-gakapaa (743).
Ramá-neggweburginmalad, degi, Gebaʼginmalad, dulataled-ilanergwa gaka dulagwen-gakagwensak (621).
Micmas-neggweburginmalad, dulanergwa-gakabo (122).
Betel-neggweburginmalad, degi, Haiʼginmalad, dulataled-ilabo gaka dulagwen-gakapaa (223).
Nebo-neggweburginmalad, dulabo-gakambe-gakabo (52).
Magbis-neggweburginmalad, dulagugle-gakambe-gakanergwa (156).
Elam-neggweburginmalad, miligwen gaka dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakambe-gakabake (1,254).
Harim-neggweburginmalad, dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulagwen (320).
Lod-neggweburginmalad, Hadidʼginmalad, degi, Onoʼginmalad, dulataled-ilagugle gaka dulagwen-gakatar (725).
Jericó-neggweburginmalad, dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulabo-gakatar (345).
Senaa-neggweburginmalad, milipaa gaka dulataled-ilanergwa gaka dulagwen-gakambe (3,630).
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-nonimalad, wemalad: Jesúa-gwenadgansikid Jedaías-wagan, dulataled-ilabakebak gaka dulapaa-gakambe-gakapaa (973).
Imer-wagan, miligwen gaka dulabo-gakambe-gakabo (1,052).
Pasur-wagan, miligwen gaka dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakagugle (1,247).
Harim-wagan, miligwen gakambe-gakagugle (1,017).
Levita-dulemar-nonimalad, wemalad: Jesúa-wagan, degi, Cadmiel-wagan, a sogleged Hodavías-e-waganye, dulapaa-gakambe-gakabake (74).
Dule-namakmalad-nonimalad, wemalad: Asaf-wagan, dulanergwa-gakabaabak (128).
Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-yawagak-dakmalad-nonimalad, wemalad: Salum-wagan, Ater-wagan, Talmón-wagan, Acub-wagan, Hatita-wagan, degi, Sobai-wagan. Amar, dulanergwa-gakambe-gakabakebak (139) mergued.
Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbamalad, wemalad: Ziha-wagan, Hasufa-wagan, Tabaot-wagan,
Queros-wagan, Siaha-wagan, Padón-wagan,
Lebana-wagan, Hagaba-wagan, Acub-wagan,
Hagab-wagan, Salmai-wagan, Hanán-wagan,
Gidel-wagan, Gahar-wagan, Reaía-wagan,
Rezín-wagan, Necoda-wagan, Gazam-wagan,
Uza-wagan, Paseah-wagan, Besai-wagan,
Asena-wagan, Meunim-wagan, Nefusim-wagan,
Bacbuc-wagan, Hacufa-wagan, Harhur-wagan,
Bazlut-wagan, Mehída-wagan, Harsa-wagan,
Barcos-wagan, Sísara-wagan, Tema-wagan,
Nezía-wagan, degi, Hatifa-wagan.
Salomónʼga-arbamalad-e-wagan, wemalad: Sotai-wagan, Soferet-wagan, Peruda-wagan,
Jaala-wagan, Darcón-wagan, Gidel-wagan,
Sefatías-wagan, Hatil-wagan, Poqueret-Hazebaim-wagan, degi, Ami-wagan.
Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbamalad-e-wagan, degi, Salomónʼga-arbamalad-e-wagan, bela dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulabake-gakambe-gakabo (392) mergued.
Deginbali, dulemar-baigan geg oyo gusmalad, doamar e-dadganmala, degine, emarde bule-nabir Israel-dule-gumarbali. We-neggweburmargi noar gusmalad: Tel-Mela-neggweburgi, Tel-Harsa-neggweburgi, Querub-neggweburgi, Addán-neggweburgi, degi, Imer-neggweburgi noarmaladid.
A-dulemarde, wemalad: Delaía-wagan, Tobías-wagan, Necoda-wagan, bela dulataled-ilanergwa gaka dulabo-gakambe-gakabo (652) mergued.
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad abala geg oyo gusmarmogad, doamar e-dadganmala, emarde bule-nabir Israel-dule-gumarbali. Amala, wemalad: Habaía-wagan, Cos-wagan, degi, Barzilai-wagan. Ar ade, dule, Barzilai-Galaadʼgined-e-sisgwa nikus gusad. Degidbali, a-dule e-sakba Barzilaiʼye nuggunonikid, degi, e-wagan Barzilai-waganye bilenonikid.
Wemala na e-dadgan-nug amidmargu, amissurgusmalad. Degisoggu, dule-swilidiksulid-soglesadba, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledga onolesmalad.
Degidgine, dule-dummadga-negdakmaid igar-uksad, we-dulemar melle Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ukleged gunnamaloye, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-gwensak, Urimʼba, degi, Tumimʼba Bab-Dummadse idakedseye.
Bela dulemar dule-wargwennayob danar-ambikunonimaladi mili-dulabo-gakabo gaka dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulapaa (42,360) mergued.
Wemar-abargi e-mai-machergan, degi, e-mai-omegan, miligugle gaka dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulagwen-gakambe-gakagugle (7,337) mergueddi obarlesulid. Degine, e-namakmalad-machergan, e-namakmalad-omegan, dulataled-ilabo (200) mergu-nikaddi obarlesurbalid.
A-ukinbali, dulemar-gannar-nonimaladi, ibmar-durgan-ibmar-semalad, weyob nikamalad: Moli, dulataled-ilagugle gaka dulagwen-gakambe-gakanergwa (736). Moli-uaya-senigwadmar, dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakatar (245).
Moli-yargan-muremalad, dulataled-ilabake gaka dulagwen-gakambe-gakatar (435). Moli-uayasuid, milinergwa gaka dulataled-ilagugle gaka dulagwen (6,720) nikamalad.
Gwenna-gwenna babgan-neguya-sedimaladi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-siidse nonimalad. Agine, na e-binsaed-e-binsaedba ibmar-nuegan Bab-Dummadse-goled-negga uksamalad, adi, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg gebe-iduar-sii-gusadgi gannar sobegar.
Degine, dulemar e-ganguedba, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-soblenaid-e-mani-dakedga ibmar uksamalad. A-ibmarmar wemalad: Or, nibir-miligwen gaka dulatar aidiku (1,100) uksamalad. Mani, nibir-milinergwa aidiku (6,000) uksamarbalid. Degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-mormar, goadulatar (100) uksamarbalid.
Degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladi, Levita-dulemar, dule-namakmaladi, degine, dulemar-bamaladi, Jerusalénʼgi megismalad. Degi, dule-yawagak-dakmaladi, dule-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbamaladi, e-neggwebur-e-neggweburgi megismalad. Degine, bela Israel-dulemar-baigan na e-neggwebur-e-neggweburgi megis nanaed.
Bela Israel-dulemar nii-walaguglegus (7) bato e-neggwebur-e-neggweburgi mamaimaladgi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi bulakwaa dule-soggwennayobi ambikunonimalad.
Degidgine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Jesúa Josadac-e-machi, na e-gwenadgan-dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladbo, degi, Salatiel-machi-Zorobabel, na e-gwenadganmala, Israel-e-Bab-Dummadga ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila sobdemalad. Adi agine, Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummadga ibmar-ogumakar ukmalagar. Igi Bab-Dummad-e-mai-Moisés-e-Igar narmakar-mai, deyob gusad.
Ar Israel-dulemar, dulemar-baid-baid-bukwadgi nue-dobe ito-inigwele, Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila gebe-iduar-sii-gusadgine gannar sobsamalad. Geb bane-bane wakdaradba, sedogidba, ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged, Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi ukdemalad.
Deyobi, Igar-narmakar-sogmaidbali Neg-Matargana-Sobaled-E-Iba-islidikid onosmalad. A-iba-onolegedgi, gusgu-bane-bane-ibmar-uklegedba Bab-Dummadga ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-bukidar uksamalad.
A-ukinbali, gusgu ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged Bab-Jehováʼga ukdamalad, degi, nii-gwapid-yoleged-irba ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged uksamarbalid. Geb degine, Bab-Jehováʼga iba-dummagan-onolegedgi-ibmar-ukleged uksamarbalid. Degi, dule na-e-binsaedba, Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-ukleged uksamarbalid.
Amba-yoo Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-e-saila-sobleda-inigwele, gebe-nii-walagugled (7) gwisgusadgi, dulemar Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged ukdemalad.
Geb agine, akwa-neg-sobedgi-arbamaladga, urgo-sobedgi-arbamaladga mani uksamalad. Sidón-dulemarga, Tiro-dulemarga, gobed, masi, olivo-gwallu uksamalad, adi, Ciro Persia-yar-e-rey, a-igar-uksadba, wemar nabir urwar-urgo Líbano-yar-akale, demarba, Jope-neggweburse sedamalagar.
Israel-dulemar birgabogus Jerusalén-neggweburse-nonimaladgine, a-nii-warbogi Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg sobbarmalad. Salatiel-machi-Zorobabel, Josadac-machi-Jesúa, degi, na e-gwenadgan-dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-abargi, degi, Levita-dulemarmala, degi, dule-galesgusmalad-Jerusalénʼse-nonimalad-abargi Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg sobdemalad. Levita-dulemar birga-dulagwen (20) nikamaladi, degi, birga-durgwen-obine (20+) nikamaladi, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-soblenaid-dakedga nugsasmalad:
Degidgine, Jesúa, e-masmalamala, degi, e-gwenadganmala arbadmalad. Degine, Judá-dule-Cadmiel, e-masmalamala arbadmalad. Amardi, Hodavías-e-waganad. Degine, Henadad-e-wagan, e-masmalamala, degi, e-gwenadganmala arbadmalad. Bela-a-dulemar, Levita-dulemalad. Amala, bulale dule-wargwennayobi dulemar-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbananaid-dakega arbadmalad.
Dule-akwa-neg-sobedgi-arbamalad Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-e-saila mesismargu, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad na e-mor yoyoidbi, gar-trompeta gani-gani gwisguarmalad. Degine, Asaf-wagan-Levita-dulemardi, gar-címbalo-abin-abin-gormalad gani-gani gwisguarmarmogad, igi Israel-rey-David, igar-uksagusadyob, Bab-Jehová-nug odummogegar.
Bela namakdemalad, Bab-Jehová-nug ogannodmalad, degine, Bab-Jehováʼga dog-nuedye sogdemalad, degi, baigandi sogdemalad: “Bab-Jehová bela-belad dule-nuedid, wile Israel-dulemar-dakmai degisadeguad.” Bela dulemar weligwaledba oimakdemalad, degine, Bab-Jehová-nug ogannodmalad. Ar ade, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-e-saila megis dakmalad.
Bukidar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, Levita-dulemar, degi, babgan-neguya-sedimalad bato selebagusmalad. Amala, gebe-Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-soblesad daksamalad. A-ulale, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg gannar soblenai dakarmarbargu, bela-belad binnasuli ise-boale bodmalad. Baigandina, weligwaledba binnasuli oimakbukwad.
Dulemar oimakbukwadbali, dulemar-bobukwad itolesulid, ar ade, dulemar ise-gandikidba oimakbukwad, degine, e-oimakedi dikasuli-bannabaa itoleged.
Judá-dulemar-e-isdarmalad, degi, Benjamín-dulemar-e-isdarmalad wisguarmargu, dulemar-galesgusmalad gannar e-neggweburse-nonimaladi, Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼse-goled-neg sobnanaiye.
Geb agine, a-isdarmalad Zorobabelʼse, degi, Israel-dulemar-neguya-sedimalad-e-dummaganse nonimalad, ega weyob sognonimalad: —Anmar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg bemarba sobbimarmodo. Ar ade, bemar-Bab-Dummad-nug-odummodiid, a-Bab-Dummad-nug anmar odummodimarmogad. Asiria-rey-Esar-Hadón we-yarse anmar-senonikid-akale, be-Bab-Dummadga ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged anmar ukdimogad.
Geb degine, Zorobabel, Jesúa, degi, Israel-dulemar-neguya-sedimalad-e-dummagan, abin-sogdemalad: —Suli. Anmarba be Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sobega anmar be-abesuli. Ar anmarbi, Israel-dulemar-Bab-Dummadga, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg soboed. Ar igi Persa-yar-e-rey-Ciro, anmarga igar-uksadba.
Degidgine, Judá-yar-dikarba-dulemar-bukwad, Judá-dulemar-niga-egwannega ese urwenonimalad, degine, ogwakismalad, adi, mer bar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sobnanai gumalagar.
A-ukinbali, a-dulemar, dule-binsaed-dakmalad-gwenna-gwenna manigi binsaed-gasbalid, adi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-soblenaid galegegar. Ciro, Persia-yar-e-reyga maigusad-akale, Persia-yar-e-rey-Darío-megis-gusadse, deyob gusad.
Deginbali, Rey-Asuero gebe reyga megnonigua, Judá-dulemar-e-isdarmalad, reyse garda narmakar barmismalad. Judá-dulemargi, degi, Jerusalén-dulemargi, yamo ise-yolegar egi sunmaksamalad.
Geb sorba, Artajerjes, Persa-dulemar-e-reyga megnonikid. A-ibagangine, amba deyob Bislam, Mitrídates, Tabeel, degi, e-sordamar-baigan, Rey-Artajerjesʼse garda narmaksamarmogad. A-garda, Arameo-gayaba narmaklesad, geb Persa-gayaba odulolesad.
A-ukinbali, dule-dummad-neg-dakmaid-Rehum, degi, dule-garda-narmaked-Simsai, Rey-Artajerjesʼse garda narmakar barmismalad. A-gardagi Jerusalén-dulemargi ise-yolegar sunmaksamalad.
Dule-dummad-neg-dakmaid-Rehum, degi, dule-garda-narmaked-Simsai, we-garda narmaksad. Deginbali, we-e-sorda-bakamalad we-gardagi e-goo-burba mesismalad: Dule-igar-nabiromalad, saila-dummagan, dule-dummagan, Persaʼginmalad, Erecʼginmalad, Babiloniaʼginmalad, degi, Elam-dulemar Susaʼginmalad.
We-gardagi, dule-baigan e-goo-burba mesismarmogad. Epenne, dule-dummad-dule-nug-nikad-Asnapar, we-dulemar-gasa-sesa-gusad, geb Samaria-yalagangi oambikudap gusad, degi, Éufrates-diwar-dad-argwanedsik neggweburmar-baigangi oambikudap gusbalid. Bela amala we-gardagi e-goo-burba mesismarmogad. We-gardagi weyob sogsiid:
“Rey-Artajerjes, be-maimar Éufrates-diwar-dad-argwanedsik-bukmalad bega sogsiid:
”Rey, na be wisguega, anmarse be Judío-dulemar-barmialidi, Jerusalén-neggweburse nonimalad. Emide, we-dulemar we-neggwebur-isgana, degi, beba-ibmar-imaksulid, gannar sobnanaid. Bato neggwebur-e-saila mesisbinmalad. Degine, we-neggwebur-e-galu-matusulid gannar sobnanaimalad.
”A-ukinbali, Dummad, an be-owisobardo, ar bela galu-matusulid-ogusmalale, degi, gandik neggwebur-sigisale, wemar begi gwisgudamaloed, gwen mani-galeged bennukosurmalad, neggweburga-mani-weleged ukosurmarbalid, degi, ibmar-ebumaloed gwen bennukosurmarbalid. Degisoggu, reyga bar manimar ubogosulid.
Ar anmar be-neggi bega-arbamaladsoggu, geg anmar be-nug-mesagwar imaked. Agala, be-owisogega, anmar bega garda barmisimalad.
Dummad, be-garda-bukwadgi, be-sergan-e-gardamar-mamaidgi be e-igar amisale, a-gardagi we-dulemar-ibmar-imaksamalad be dakdagoed. Agi, be wisguoed, we-Jerusalén-dorgande bela-bela galagwensuli gudii gusad, degi, reymargi, neggwebur-bamaladgi yoledii gusad. Degi, dikasurgus we-neggweburginmaladde reymargi gwisgudii gusmalad. A-ulale, we-neggweburde bela oitoles gusad.
Rey, a-ulale, an bega sogdo, we-neggwebur gannar soblesdibele, e-galu-matusulid-bela-ogulesale, neggweburmar-Éufrates-diwar-dad-argwanedsik-bukwadi bar begadga guosulid.”
Geb degi, rey abin-sogsamogad: “Ani, Rey-Artajerjes, an bemarse garda barmisimogad: Dule-dummadga-negdakmaid-Rehum, dule-garda-narmaked-Simsai, geb bela e-sordamar-Samaria-neggweburgi-bukmalad, degi, dule-baigan Éufrates-diwar-dad-argwanedsik-bukmalad: ‘Bemar nued sogeye.’
”Bemar, anga garda-barmiarmaladi, bela ise-mag-itoleale anga absolesad.
Degine, Jerusalénʼginmalad-e-igarmar-amiega an igar uksad. Agi, daklealid, we-neggweburginmaladde dikasurgusa bato reymar-baigangi gwisgudimala, a-sogedba igar-imakdisurmala, gusgu na urwed-onodii damala.
Degine, Jerusalén-neggweburgine, reymar-gangued-nikmaladi megis nanae. We-reymar bela yarmargi Éufrates-diwar-dad-argwanedsiki, e-ganguedba negsemamai gusmala. Degine, daklearbalid, dulemar neggwebur-bennuklegedi ega ukdii gusmala, neggweburga-mani-weleged ega ukdii gusmala, degi, neg-mamaid-bennukdii nanasmala.
Degisoggu, an sogdo, we-dulemarga be-sogmalo, melle bar arbamaloye, melle bar we-neggwebur-sobmaloye, ani an gannar igar-ukedse.
Degisoggu, an bega-we-igar-ukedi melle be ieged-imakmalo, adi, melle anga boni-dummad onogega, melle an-mani-bukwad galakuega.”
Rey-Artajerjes-garda-barmialidi Rehum-asabin, dule-garda-narmaked-Simsai-asabin, degi, e-sorda-bamalad-asabin absolesgu, bela Jerusalén-neggweburse duurmakdemalad. Geb sabsur-urwedigine, Judío-dulemar-neg-sobnanaidi ganonimalad, mer bar neg-sobmalagar.
Weyob, Rey-Darío, Persa-yargi birgabogus negsemai-gusadse, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg Jerusalén-neggweburgi-soblenaidi galesad.
Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad Hageo, degi, Iddo-wagwa-Zacarías, amar Judíoʼmar Judá-yargi-gudimaladga, degi, Jerusalénʼginmaladga, Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-nuggi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba barsognai guarmalad.
Degidgine, Salatiel-machi-Zorobabel, degi, Josadac-machi-Jesúa, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg Jerusalén-neggweburgi-siid gannar sobdemalad. Agine, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad, we-dummaganba gudii gusad, degine, amar-bendakdii gusad.
Amba a-ibagangine, Tatnai, Éufrates-diwar-dad-argwanedsik dummadga-negdakmaidi, degi, Setar-Boznai, degi, e-sordamarmala Judío-dulemarse modapid, geb ese egichidmalad: “¿Doa bemarga igar-uksa, we-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg sobega, e-galumar sobega?”
Degine, ese egichismarbalid: “Dulemar-neg-sobnanaid-e-idumalad, ¿we igi nugmala?”
Ar Bab-Dummad Judío-dulemar-e-dummagan nue-bendakmaisoggu, dummagan-negdakmamaid Rey-Daríoʼse neg-soblenaid-garda-barmidedse, geb rey-e-abin-imakedse, Judíoʼmar neg-sobnanaid gwen indaksasurmalad.
Geb Tatnai Éufrates-diwar-dad-argwanedsik dummadga-negdakmaidi, degi, Setar-Boznai, degi, e-sordamar Éufrates-diwar-dad-argwanedsik-dummaganga-negdakmamaidi, Rey-Daríoʼse garda barmismalad.
Garda wegii sogsiid: “Rey-Darío, bitigine be nued-gudina gadin.
”Rey, anmar na be-owisosun, anmar Judea-yalase arbimalad, Bab-Dummad-Dule-Dummad-e-negse. A-nega, akwa-dummagangi soblenaid, degi, bato urgomar e-galu-dikargi nasiklenaid, e-arbalenaidi nue-nasgumaid, gwae-gwae arbalenaid.
”Geb degi, anmar e-dummaganse egichismalad: ‘¿Doa bega igar-uksamala we-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg be sobmaloye, e-galumar be sobmarbaloye?’
Deginbali, anmar ese egichisbalid, dule-arbananaid-e-dummagan igi-nugmarye, adi, bese gardagi-narmakar barmidegar.
”Geb Judío-dummagan anmar-abin-imaksamalad: ” ‘Anmar Bab-Dummad-Nibneg-Dakmaid-e-mai, degi, Napneg-Dakmaid-e-mai gumalad. Anmar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg dikasurgus birgabargus-soblesgusad, anmar gannar sobnanaid. A-neg, Israel-dulemar-e-rey-gandikidi bela ogus gusad.
Ar anmar-dadgan Bab-Dummad-Nibneg-Dakmaid-oulusgussoggu, Bab-Dummad, Babilonia-rey-Nabucodonosorʼga Caldeo-dulega, anmar-dadgan-urmaksasunnad. A-rey a-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg earis gusad. Geb agine, Babilonia-yarse, dulemar-gasa sesa gusad.
” ’Geb a-sorba, Babilonia-dulemar-e-rey-Ciro, gebe reyga-megided-birgagine, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg gannar soblegega igar uksad.
A-ukinbali, epenne Nabucodonosor Jerusalén-neggweburgi Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ibmarmar-ebuleged-orbiid, manibiid, Babilonia-dulemar-e-bab-dummadse-goled-negse sesagusad. A-ibmarmar, Rey-Ciro onisad. Geb Rey-Ciro Sesbasarʼga, Judá-yar-e-dummadga-nug-imaksadga a-ibmarmar uksagusad.
Degine, Rey-Ciro Sesbasarʼga sogsad: We-ibmar-ebulemalad be sue, be nae, Jerusalén-neggweburgi Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-siidse gannar be sede. Gannale Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg be sobo, bia-gebe-iduar-sii-gusadgi.
Geb degi, Sesbasar Jerusalén-neggweburse nonisunnad. Geb Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-e-saila mesnonikid. Emide, emi-ibase amba-soblenaid, amba yoo ogule naid.’
”Rey, ar be nabir-itogele, Babilonia-e-reymar-ibmar-imaksad-gardagi igar-maid be-amiodo. Be adi dakegar, bule-nabiri Rey-Ciro Judío-dulemarga igar-uksagusa, Jerusalén-neggweburgi Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg gannar-sobegar. De-ukinbali, be anmar-owisogodo, igi we-igarsik be nue-binsamoga. Be itogua.”
Geb degine, Rey-Darío igar-uksad, Babilonia-yargi-ibmar-nuegan-saboleged-neggi gardamar-sabolegedgi, garda-mamaid amioye.
Degi, Acmeta-neggweburgi, reyneg-gandikidgi garda amilesad. Acmeta-neggweburde Media-yargi siid. A-gardagi weyob narmakar naid:
“Rey-Ciro gebe reyga-megided-birgagi, e-sunnad, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg Jerusalénʼgi-siid-sobega, Judío-dulemarga igar-uksad: Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg Jerusalén-neggweburgi-sii-gusanad be gannar sobmar, e-neg-saila be mesmar. Adi agine, Bab-Dummadga ibmar-ogumakar ukmalagar. We-nega-e-nibguedi daliambe-gakatar-sugu (15) be imako, degi, e-yaadungued amba deyob be imakbalo.
Degine, akwa-dummagan ile-sogapaa be sobmalo, degi, urgodi ile-wargwen sobmarbalo. We-ibmarmar-baklegoedi, rey-manigi bela bennuklegoed.
A-ukinbali, Jerusalénʼgi Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ibmarmar-ebuleged-orbiid, degi, manibiid, Nabucodonosor-Babiloniaʼse-sesa-gusadi be gannar Jerusalénʼse sedamalo. Degi, ibmar gannar e-ambikuedgi Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-Jerusalénʼgi be urbemalo.”
Degidgine, Rey-Darío, Tatnaiʼga igar-uksasunnad. Tatnaiʼde, Éufrates-diwar-dad-argwanedsik dummadga-negdakmaid. Degine, Setar-Boznaiʼga, degi, e-sordamar-dummadga-negdakmamaidga, weyob igar-uksad: “Jerusalén-dulemargi be bangumar.
Melle Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-soblenaidi, be igar-gamalo. Baisuli, na e-itomaladba Judío-dulemar-e-dummad-negsemaid, degi, girmar-dummagan, na e-sordagan-bulakwaa Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg, gebe-iduar-sii-gusadgi sobmaloed.
”Deginbali, an igar ukbalid: Bemar, Judío-girmar-dummagan-bendakmalo, adi, nabir bemar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg sobnai guegar. Dulemar-Éufrates-diwar-dad-argwanedsik-bukmalad neggweburgi-mani-bennuklegedgi rey-bennukdamalad. A-mani, Judío-dulemarga iba-sogedba be ukmalo, adi, ibmar-baklesmaladi bennukegar. Deyobsulile, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-soblenaidi galegoed.
A-ukinbali, bemar bane-bane ibmar-ukoed: Moli-bebe-nikad-sapingana, sibad-wawaad-machergan, sibad-wawaad-sapingana be ukmalo. Adi, Bab-Dummad-Nibneg-Dakmaidga ogumakar ukegar. Deginbali, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-Jerusalénʼgi-bukmalad-sogedba, orosgi-dakleged-trigoʼdibe, baludibe, vinoʼdibe, igi, olivo-gwalludibe, bemar ukbaloed. Melle ukesuli be gumalo.
Ar deyobi, wemar-Babse-gormalad, nabir Bab-Dummad-Nibneggi-Maidga yeer-itogedgi ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged ukmaloed, degi, Bab-Dummadse anga-gormaloed, degi, an-masmalaga gormarbaloed.
”Degine, an igar ukbalid: Doa-dule, an igar-uksadba dasulile, a-dule-ibe, e-neg-nagubir ungilegoed. Geb a-dule a-nagubir-swiswidikidgi yolegar nasiklegoed. Geb, bela e-neg eyarlegoed.
Bela reymar, igi, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladi, we-igar-an-mesnaid oakalobimalale, Bab-Dummad-Jerusalén-neggweburgi-maidi a-dulemar-obelosun. Deginbali, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg Jerusalén-neggweburgi-siid e-yarbimalale, a-dulemar-obelobarsun. ”Ani, Rey-Darío, an we-igar mesisad. Degisoggu, we-igar-maid-sogedba be nuekwa damalo.”
Geb degi, Tatnai Éufrates-diwar-dad-argwanedsik dummadga-negdakmaidi, degi, Setar-Boznai, degi, e-sordaganmala, Rey-Darío-igar-uksadba nue-inniki imaksamarsunnad.
Igi Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Hageo, degi, Iddo-wagwa-Zacarías-sogsagusa, deyobi Judío-dulemar-e-dummagan, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbalenaid-nasomai gusmalad. Deyobi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbalenaid obelosmalad. Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-sogsagusadba, degi, Persa-yar-e-reymar: Ciro, Darío, Artajerjes, we-reymar-igar-uksadba, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg bela ogulesad.
Rey-Darío birga-nergwagusa (6) negdakmaidgi Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg ogulesad, Adar-nii-gwichid-ibapaagi.
Degidgine, Israel-dulemar: Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, Levita-dulemar, dule-baigan-gales-gannar-nonimalad, amar weligwaledgi Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-soblesadi, Bab-Dummadga nug-imaksamalad.
We-neg Bab-Dummadga nug-imaksamaladgi, Bab-Dummadga we-ibmar-durgan ogumakar uksamalad: Moli-bebe-nikad-sapingana, waladulatar (100). Sibad-wawaad-machergan, waladulataled-ilabo (200). Sibad-wawaad-sapingwagwad, waladulataled-ilabakebar (400). Degi, Israel-dulemar e-dadgan-warambe-gakabogwad-iliba (12), e-isgued-ular, na war-wargwen sibad-machergan, warambe-gakabo (12) uksamarbalid.
Geb degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad e-arbaed-imakega urbilesad, degi, Levita-dulemar amar e-ibmar-imakedgi-bendakega urbilesmogad, adi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi Bab-Dummadga arbamalagar. Igi Moisés-gardagi-narmakar-nai, deyob gusad.
Dulemar-galesgusmalad Jerusalén-neggweburse-gannar-nonimaladi, gebe nii-onoded-ibambe-gakabakegi, Oburgwilegoenad-Iba onosmalad.
Ar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, Levita-dulemar dule-wargwennayobi bato na san-uruksamalad, bela na swilidik-gusmalad. Degisoggu, Levita-dulemar, Israel-dulemar-gales-gannar-noni-gusmaladga, Oburgwilegoenad-Ibagi gusgu sibad-wawaad-sapingwagwad-oburgwedamalad, oburgwismalad. Degi, Levitaʼmar, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladga, degine, na e-nuki oburgwismarmogad.
Israel-dulemar-galesgusmalad gannar Jerusalén-neggweburse-nonimaladi, Oburgwilegoenad-Ibagi sibad-wawaad-sapingwagwad guchamalad. Amar-abargi, dule-baigan Israel-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-igarba-nanaega, dulemar-galagwensulidaedgi-bangusmaladi, a-mas guchamarmogad.
Judíoʼmar, ibagugle (7), Madu-Inasuli-Gulleged-Iba weligwaledba onosmalad. Ar ade, Bab-Jehová, Asiria-dulemar-e-rey Israel-e-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg gannar-sobega imaksadba, yeer-itosmalad.
Bela we-ibmarmar-gusad-sorbali, Artajerjes Persa-dulemar-e-rey, yar-semaiunni, dule-wargwen gudii gusad. A-dulede, Esdrasʼye nugad. Esdras, Seraías-e-machi. Seraía, Azarías-e-machi. Azarías, Hilcías-e-machi.
Hilcías, Salum-e-machi. Salum, Sadoc-e-machi. Sadoc, Ahitob-e-machi.
Ahitob, Amarías-e-machi. Amarías, Azarías-e-machi. Azarías, Meraiot-e-machi.
Meraiot, Zeraías-e-machi. Zeraías, Uzi-e-machi. Uzi, Buqui-e-machi.
Buqui, Abisúa-e-machi. Abisúa, Finees-e-machi. Finees, Eleazar-e-machi. Eleazar, Aarón-e-machi. Aarónʼde, gebe dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledga gusadid.
We-Esdras Babilonia-neggwebur-akar nonikid. A-dule, dule garda-narmaked-duled, degi, Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová Moisésʼba-Igar-uksa-gusad nue-wisbalid. Ar Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová Esdrasʼba nue gudigusoggu, Rey-Artajerjes, Esdras ese-ibmar-egichisadi bela ega-sogedba uksad.
Rey-Artajerjes birgaguglegus-yar-dakmaidgi (7), Israel-dulemar gwenna-gwenna Esdrasʼba Jerusalén-neggweburse nonimalad Amarde, wemalad: Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, Levita-dulemar, dule-namakmalad, dule-yawagak-dakmalad, degi, dule-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbamalad. Amala, Esdrasʼba Jerusalénʼse nonimalad.
Degisoggu, Esdras, Rey-Artajerjes birgaguglegus (7), negdakmaidgi a-nii-walatargine, Jerusalén-neggweburse nonigusad.
Esdras Babilonia-neggweburgi gebe-nii-gwisgusad-iba-onodedgine, noaligusad. Ar Bab-Dummad dule-wiledaked-maid eba gudigussoggu, geb Jerusalén-neggweburse gebe-nii-walatar-gwisgusad-ibagi nonigusad.
Esdras, Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maid-durdakegala Bab-Igargi nue-alamaknai gusad. A-Igar-Maid-sogedba-ibmar-saega, degi, Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maidgi, degine, Bab-Dummad-Igar-sogsadgi Israel-dulemar-odurdakega Bab-Igargi nue-alamaknai gusad.
Rey-Artajerjes, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Esdrasʼga we-garda uksagusad. Dule-garda-narmaked-Esdrasʼde, Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maid nue-wisidid. Deginbali, Bab-Dummad Israel-dulemarga-ibmar-sogsad nue-wisbalid. Rey weyob garda narmaksad:
“Ani Artajerjes, reymar-e-rey, Esdrasʼse an we-garda an-barmisiid. Bedi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledid, degi, garda-narmaked-dule-gubalid. Deginbali, Bab-Dummad-Nibneg-Dakmaid-Igar be nue wisbalid: Bitigine be nueganbina gadin.
”An igar-uksad: Bela Israel-dulemar an-yargi-bukwad, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladi, degi, Levita-dulemarse-bakale, Jerusalén-neggweburse beba nabimalale, namalodo.
Ani rey, degi, anga-binsaed-dakmalad-gugled-nuggine (7), Judea-yalase, Jerusalén-neggweburse, dulemar-daknaega an be-barmisiid. Igi be be-Bab-Dummad-Igar-wisi, deyobi bule-nabiri, we-Judío-dulemar Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba nanabukmarmodibe.
”Deginbali, or be sedo, mani be sedbalo. Wede, ani rey, degi, dulemar-ega-binsaed-dakmalad e-binsaedba Israel-e-Bab-Dummadga uksamalad. We-Bab-Dummadde, Sión-yalagi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi maid.
Degine, Babilonia-yalagi, mani, ormar bega uklesale, be sedbalo. Deginbali, dulemar, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg Jerusalén-neggweburgi-siidga e-binsaedba-ibmar-ukmaloedba be sedmalo.
A-manigi, ibmar-durgan be baksuli gudager: Moli-bebe-nikad-sapingana, sibad-wawaad-machergan, sibad-wawaad-sapingana. De-ukinbali, Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-uklebaloed be bakbalo: Ibmar-gwagmar, vinoʼmar. Geb degi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi bemar-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi Bab-Dummadga ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-siidgine, bemar we-ibmarmar Bab-Dummadga-ogumakar ukoed.
”Mani-gwabgumaloedi, or-gwabgumaloedi, be dakedba, degi, be-gwenadgan-dakedba na be imakmaloed. Degi-inigwele, bemar-Bab-Dummad-sogedba be imakmalo.
Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ibmar-ebulemalad bega-uklesadi, a-neggi be urboed. Adi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi be-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ebulegegar.
Ibmar-baigan be-Bab-Dummadse-goled-negga nue abegele, rey-mani-bukwadgi, baklegoed.
”Emide ani, Rey-Artajerjes, bela dulemar Éufrates-diwar-dad-argwanedsik mani-dakmalad-bukmaladga an we-igar uked: Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Esdras, Bab-Dummad-Nibneggi-Maid-e-Igar nue-wisidi, bemarse ibmar egichialile, ega be ibmar ukmalo.
Sunna ega be we-ibmar ukmaloed: Mani, nibir-miligugle gaka dulataled-ilabo gaka dulapaa (7,260). Orosgi-dakleged-trigoʼye-nugad, tambor-gwadulatar (100). Vino, galón-gwa-dulataled-ilatar gaka dulabo-gakambe (550). Olivo-gwallu, galón-gwa-dulataled-ilatar gaka dulabo-gakambe (550). Degine, baludi, wilubsarsuli ega be ukmaloed.
”Bela Bab-Dummad-Nibneggi-Maid igar-uksadba, a-sogedbali, ese-goled-negga inniki be ibmar-ukmaloed, ar adi melle Bab-Dummad, rey-negsemaidgi, degi, e-masmalagi urwegar.
An bemar-owisobalid, melle we-dulemar neggwebur-bennukega be imakmalo: Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, Levita-dulemar, degi, dule-namakmalad. Deginbali, dule-yawagak-dakmalad, dule-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbamalad, degi, dule-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-ibmar-imakmalad, ”Melle we-dulemarse ibmar-weleged be egismarbalo, degi, ibmar-sedanikidgi-mani-galeged melle bennukega be imakmarbalo.
”Esdras, bedi, Bab-Dummad-binsaed nue-nikasoggu, dule-igar-nabiromaladi, dule-dummagan-neggwebur-semaladi be nug-imako. Adi, amar bela dulemar-Éufrates-diwar-dad-argwanedsik-bukmaladga igar-nabogegar. A-dulemardi, bela dulemar Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maid wismaladid. Deginbali, dulemar amba Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maid-wissulile, be amar-odurdakbalo.
Ar, dule-gwensak be-Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba ibmar-imaksulile, degi, rey-igar-mesisadba dasurbalile, we-dule ise-sabsur-odurdaklegoed: Oburgwilegodibe, neggweburyagi ononnolegodibe, igi egi-mani-dummad galegodibe, igi, esgaryagi odolegodibe.”
Geb degidgine, Esdras Bab-Dummadse gotesunnad: “Bab-Jehová, anmar-dadgan-e-Bab-Dummadye, be nug odummolesun. Emide, Rey-Artajerjes-e-gwage be ebusad, Jerusalén-neggweburgi bese-goled-neg-siid ogannogegar.
Bab-Dummad, bedi wile an-dakedbali, rey, degi, dulemar-ega-binsaed-dakmalad, dule-dummagan-gangued-nikamalad, a-dulemar-asabinni, yeer an-dakega be an-imaksad. Bab-Jehová, bedi anba gudigusoggu, an-niga gangusad.” Degisoggu, Israel-dule-dummagan, Jerusalén-neggweburse anba-naega an oambikusad.
Rey-Artajerjes Babilonia-yalagi negdakmaiunni, babgan-neguya-sedimaladi, degi, dulemar e-dadgan-e-dadganba-ilemakar-nug-mamaidi Babilonia-akale, Jerusalén-neggweburse anba-noni-gusmalad. Amarde, wemalad:
Finees-wagansikid, Gersón. Itamar-wagansikid, Daniel. David-wagansikid, Hatús.
Hatúsʼde, Secanías-wagansikidid. Paros-wagansikid, Zacarías. Zacaríasʼbali, machergan, dulagugle-gakambe-mergu (150) nonikid.
Pahat-Moab-wagansikid, Zeraías-machi-Elioenai. Elioenaiʼbali, machergan, dulataled-ilabo-mergu (200) nonikid.
Secanías-wagansikid, Jahaziel-machi. Jahaziel-machibali, machergan, dulataled-ilapaa-mergu (300) nonikid.
Adín-wagansikid, Jonatán-machi-Ebed. Ebedʼbali, machergan, dulabo-gakambe-mergu (50) nonikid.
Elam-wagansikid, Atalías-machi-Jesaías. Jesaíasʼbali, machergan, dulapaa-gakambe-mergu (70) nonikid.
Sefatías-wagansikid, Micael-machi-Zebadías. Zebadíasʼbali, machergan, dulabake-mergu (80) nonikid.
Joab-wagansikid, Jehiel-machi-Obadías. Obadíasʼbali, machergan, dulataled-ilabo gakambe-gakabaabak-mergu (218) nonikid.
Selomit-wagansikid, Josifías-machi. Josifías-machibali, machergan, dulabaabak-mergu (160) nonikid.
Bebai-wagansikid, Bebai-machi-Zacarías. Zacaríasʼbali, machergan, dulagwen-gakabaabak-mergu (28) nonikid.
Azgad-wagansikid, Hacatán-machi-Johanán. Johanánʼbali, machergan, dulatar-gakambe-mergu (110) nonikid.
Napi-sorba-nonimaladi, Adonicam-wagansikmalad, wemalad: Elifelet, Jeiel, Semaías. Amarbali, machergan, dulapaa-mergu (60) nonikid.
Degine, Bigvai-wagansikmalad, Utai, Zabud. Amarbali, machergan, dulapaa-gakambe-mergu (70) nonikid.
Ani, Esdras, Ahavaʼse dii-iirmakmaid-gakaba dulemar an oambikusad. Agi, ibapaa anmar ambikusad. Agi bela dulemar-bukwa, degi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-bukwa an daksad. Levita-dulemardi an gwen daksasulid.
Geb degine, dule-dummaganse an gochad: Eliezerʼse, Arielʼse, Semaíasʼse, Elnatánʼse, Jaribʼse, baid-dule-Elnatánʼse, Natánʼse, Zacaríasʼse, degi, Mesulamʼse. Degi, odurdaked-sailagan-Joiaribʼse, Elnatánʼse, an gochabalid.
Degi, Iddoʼse geb we-dulemar an barmisad. Iddoʼde, Casifiaʼye-neg-nugad-e-dummadid. Amar bela Iddoʼga ibmar-sogmaloedi, Iddo-e-gwenadganga ibmar-sogmaloedi, Casifiaʼginmaladga-ibmar-sogmaloedi, an ega sogsad. Adi, anmar-Bab-Dummadse-goled-negga, anmarga dule-arbamalad-barmidagegar.
Dog-nuedye anmar-Bab-Dummadga an sogdo. Bab-Jehová nued-anmargi binsamaid. Anmargala, dule-ibmar-nue-wisid Serebíasʼye-nugad barmialid. Serebíasʼde Mahli-wagangi-danikid. Mahliʼdi, Leví-wagangi-danimogad. Levíʼdi, Israel-e-machid. Serebías, e-machimala, degi, e-gwenadgan nonimalad. Serebíasʼbali bela machergan, warambe-gakabaabak-mergu (18) nonikid.
Deginbali, anmarga Hasabías barmilearbalid. Hasabíasʼbali, Jesaías Merari-wagangi-danikid nonimogad, degi, e-gwenadgan, degi, e-machimala nonimogad. Bela machergan, waladulagwen-mergu (20) nonikid.
Deginbali, anmargala, dulemar-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbamalad dulataled-ilabo gaka dulagwen-mergu (220) barmiarbalid. Deun a-dulemar-e-dadgande, epenne, David-maiun, degi, e-dummagan-bukwaun, Levita-dulemar-bendakega na nug-imaksa gusad. Geb e-nugmar bela megisgusad.
Degine, Ahava-dii-iirmakmaid-walikaa anmar mas-gunsuli-Bab-Dummadse-golega ambikusad, adi, anmar-Bab-Dummad-asabin na san-bipi-imakegar. Degine, anmar-naoedba Bab-Dummad anmar-bendakega. De-ukinbali, anmar-mimmigan, degi, anmar-ibmar-nuegan-sedoedi bonisuli guegar.
Sordamar igarba anmar-isdarmaladgi anmar-bendakega, an reyse, sordamar danar-danar-bukwad anga barmidagega, an binge egisgusad. Deginbali, dule-moligi-urwemalad anga barmidagega, an binge ese egisgusbalid. Ar ade, anmar bato reyga sogsagusbinned: Dule Bab-Dummadba-gudimaladi, Bab-Dummad nue bendakmaiye, egi nued binsamaibarye. Degi-inigwele, dule-Bab-Dummad-igarba-dasurmaladdi, Bab-Dummad ourwega na imakdamarye.
Degisoggu, anmar Bab-Dummadse-golega mas-gunsuli-gudii gussunnad, degi, anmar-Bab-Dummadse anmar nue gochad, adi, anmar-bendakegar. Degine, Bab-Dummad anmar-ese-goled itosad, geb anmar-bendaknonikid.
A-sorbali, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-dummagan, e-dummagan-warambe-gakabo (12) an bachikii urbisad. Amarde, wemardo: Serebías, Hasabías, degi, e-gwenadgan e-ambebar (10).
Geb agine, rey, ibmar-ebulemaladi, mani, olo, anmar-Bab-Dummadga uksagusad, degine, dule-ega-binsaed-dakmalad, dule-dummagan, degi, bela Israel-dulemar-gudigusmalad uksamarmogad, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sobega. A-ibmarmala a-dulemar-asabinni nibirgi an wilubdaksad.
Nibirgi an wilub-daksadi, wemalad: Mani, nibir-milidulabo-gakabaabak gaka dulataled-ilagugle gaka dulabo-gakambe (48,750). Ibmar-ebulemalad-manibiid, nibir-miligugle gaka dulataled-ilatar (7,500). Ormar, nibir-miligugle gaka dulataled-ilatarba (7,500).
De-ukinbali, nog-dummagan-orbiid gwadulagwenba (20). A-nogmar nibirambe-gakabakebak (19) aidikued. Nog-nuegan-esgoro-gordikidgi-sobaled ise-daarmakarmalad, oryob-gargeguedi, gwabobar.
Geb a-sorbali, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladga an sogded: “Bemala, degi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-ibmar-ebulemalad, Bab-Jehováʼga nug-imaklesmalad. E-binsaedba-ibmar-uksamaladi, we-ibmarmalad: Mani, degi, olo. Amardi, Bab-Jehová-anmar-dadgan-e-Bab-Dummadgadid.
Nue we-ibmarmar be dakmalo, nue sabomalo, Jerusalén-neggweburgi Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-imbagi ibmar-wilub-imaklegedse. Agi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan-asabin, degi, Levita-dulemar, babgan-neguya-sedimalad-asabin, wilub-imaklegoed.”
Degisoggu, mani, olo, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-ibmar-ebulemalad, bela wilub-imaklesadi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladga, degi, Levita-dulemarga, uklesad, adi, amar Jerusalénʼse anmar-Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse sedmalagar.
Gebe-Nii-gwichid-ibambe-gakabogi anmar Ahava-dii-iirmakmaidgi-bukwa, Jerusalénʼse aligusad. Igarbali, Bab-Dummad bela-belad anmar-bendaksad, anmar-isdarmaladgi, degi, dule-ibmar-atursamaladgi anmar-bendaksabalid.
Geb Jerusalénʼse anmar modapidgi, wis ibapaa an obunnosmalad.
Geb ibabakegi, anmar-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi, mani, olo, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-ibmar-ebulemalad, anmar wilub-imaksamalad. Geb, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Meremot Urías-machi, aga ibmar-wilub-imaklesadi anmar uksad. Degine, Finees-machi-Eleazar, Meremot-walik gwismogad. Amar-abargi Levita-dulemar gwismarmogad. Amardi, wemalad: Jesúa-machi-Jozabad, degi, Binúi-machi-Noadías.
A-ibagi bela ibmarmar ebislesad, degi, wilub-imaklesad, degi, bela e-aidikuedi narmaklesad.
A-sorbali, Israel-Dulemar-galesgusmalad-gannar-nonimaladi Israel-e-Bab-Dummadga ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged ukdemalad. A-dulemar we-ibmar-durgan uksamalad: Moli-bebe-nikad-sapingana, warambe-gakabo (12). Sibad-wawaad-machergan, waladulabake-gakambe-gakanergwa (96). Sibad-wawaad-sapingana, waladulapaa-gakambe-gakagugle (77). Degine, e-isgued-ular uksamarbalid: Sibad-machergan, warambe-gakabo (12). Bela Bab-Jehováʼga weligwaledgi we-ibmarmar-ogumakar uklesad.
Geb degine, Éufrates-diwar-dad-argwanedsik dummagan-negdakmamaidga, degi, suar-ibed-dummaganga, rey-igar-uksadi, uklesad. Amarde, Israel-dulemar-bendaksamarmogad, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-soblesad bendaksamarbalid.
Bela we-ibmarmar-bergusad-sorbali, dule-dummaganga-mamaid anse nonimalad, weyob anga sognonimalad: “Anmar-Israel-dulemar, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, degi, Levita-dulemarse-bakale, dulemar-baigangi bangusurmalad, degine, e-galagwensur-daedgi amba nanadimalad. A-dule-baigan, wemalad: Canaán-dulemar, Het-dulemar, Ferezeo-dulemar, Jebuseo-dulemar, Amón-dulemar, Moab-dulemar, Egipto-dulemar, degi, Amorreo-dulemar. Israel-dulemardi, a-dulemar-daedba ibmar-isgana imakdimarmogad.
”Ar Israel-dulemar, we-dulemar-baigan-omegan-nikudmalad. Deginbali, Israel-dulemar, e-masmalaga, dule-baigan-e-sisgan-ukdemalad. Bab-Dummad-na-e-dulemar-susadi, emide, dulemar-baiganbo ablis-apurudmalad. Dule-dummagan, dule-negsemamaid, a-inseba na we-isguedgi isgudmalad.”
Deyob an itosgua, an mor-yoidi, degi, an-suba-dummad-yoidi, nunmak-itogedbali, siir-siir an imaksad, sailagia unge-unge an imaksad, degi, aku-sigamarse-bakale, deyob an imaksad. Geb degi, nue-wile-itogedbali, napagi-maada an sigisad.
Dulemar-galesgusmalad-nonimalad-e-isgusad-ular, anse Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba-gudimaladi ambikunonimalad. Ar andi, neg-sedoguedse Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-wachise gwage-nunmak an itosii gusad.
Sedogusgua, Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-wachigine, an gwage-nunmakedi wis gadigusad. Degi, an mor-yoidi, suba-dummad-yoibalidi esiirmakagwale, napagi yokorgi-sindigar an-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼse-golega an argan onakwisad.
Degi, Bab-Dummadga an sogded: “Bab-Dummadye, bela-belad an akusunna itoged, an bingedar bese goled. Ar anmar-isguedi nue anmargi wilub-obicha naid. Anmar galagwensuli-bela-bela-isguedgi-nanadiidi bese warmaksa naid.
Anmar-dadgan-ibagan-akale, emi-ibagansega, bela-belad anmar begine dummad-nodiid. Anmar-isgued-ular, bela anmar, anmar-reymar, degi, anmar-irwa-bese-gormalad, reymar-yar-baid-baidsik-negdakmamaidga anmar urmaklesad. Anmala, emarse es-suidgi naibigusad, gales gusad, anmar-ibe ibmar sulesad, ise-mesagwale anmar gusad, emi-ibagi amba imaklediidyob.
”Anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼye, emide be, sikwas be-sabguedi be anmarse oyosad. Anmar-gwenna-gwenna dulemargi-ollor-guega wis be anmar-imaksad. Bese-goled-neg-islidikidgi-ambikuega be anmar-imaksabalid. Degi, ibagan-nued be anmarse oyosad, anmar maiga-bukwa-gusadgi dula-gudiguega wis be anmar-imaksabalid.
Bab-Dummadye, anmar dulemar-e-maiga-gudigus-inigwele, bedina gwen anmargi bangussulid. Aka bur Persia-yar-e-reymar wile anmar-dakega be imaksad. Bese-goled-neg-bibichis-gusadi, gannar-sobega be anmargi burba-nuegan oubosad. Judá-yalagi, degi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi be anmar-bendakmaid, adi, melle bonigan anmarse warmakegar.
”Emide, Bab-Dummadye, anmar we-ibmar-isgana-imaksadgine, ¿ibu an bega sogmaloe? Ar ade, anmar be-Igar-Maidbali gwen ibmar imaksasulid.
Be-maigan-be-gayaburba-barsogmaladba, be iduakwaa anmar-owisosgusad. Deun, weyob be sogsagusad: ‘Bemar we-yarse dogmaloedi, degi, we-yar be gamaloedi, nue-isgus-naiye, dule-gudimalad ibmar-isgana-imakedba, bela-belad we-yar nue-gagalesye. Bela a-yala nue-isgus-naiye be anmar-owisosanad.’
Deginbali, be anmarga sogsagusbalid: ‘Bemar, melle be-sisgan, we-macherganga be ukmaloye. We-dulemar-e-bunamaladi, melle be-masmalaga be ukmarbaloye. Degine, we-dulemarbo, melle be igar mesmaloye. Melle be bendakmaloye, adi, bemar gandikidba nanadii-gumalaga, degi, we-yargi ibmar-nuegan-nikad-gundii gumarbaligar. We-yar-nued geb be-mimmiganga degisadegu be obemaloye.’
”Bab-Dummadye, anmar bela-belad isgusad an na magar itoged. Anmar sabsur-odurdaklegedwilubbinad. Degite, be anmar-Bab-Dummad-guedgi, be sabsur anmar-odurdaksasulid. Wile be anmar-dakedbali, napi-ichee be anmar-obedapid.
Bab-Dummadye, ¿anmarde Be-Igar-Maidba bar nanasuli gumalode? ¿Gannar we-dulemar-baigan-omegan ibmar-galagwensuli-imakmaladbo nikumai gumarbalode? Adi surbali. Bab-Dummad, ar deyobile, ¿be anmarse ulussulirde, be anmar obelossulirde? Be anmarse ulusale, bela be anmar-obelosale, dule wargwensaar begi gwen wakichasuliled.
”Bab-Jehováʼye, Israel-e-Bab-Dummad, bedi dule-napiragwadid. Bedi, emi-ibasega, nabir danakwaa wis-ambikuega be anmar-imaksad. Anmar be-asabin ambikued-wilubsulinad. Ar anmar begi isgusad, degi-inigwele, anmar be-asabinni bukwamalad.”
Esdras Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-asabin, Israel-dulemar-isgusad-ular, ise-boale, degi, yokorgi-sindigar, Bab-Dummadse gorsiidgine, bukidar Israel-dulemar: Machergan, omegan, mimmiganse-bakale, ese ambikunonikid. A-dulemar, bela ise-boedbimarmogad.
Geb degine, Jehiel-machi-Secanías, Elam-wagangi-danikid, Esdrasʼse aligusad. Geb weyob ega sogded: “Anmar, omegan-Israel-dulesurmalad nikus-nanasoggu, anmar-Bab-Dummadgi nue-nosad. Degi-inigwele, amba sunna anmar bendakleged.
Degisoggu, anmar, anmar-Bab-Dummadbo, igar mesmardo. Emi, bela we-omegan-Israel-dulesurmalad anmar metemaloye, mimmigangi bangumarbaloye, be anmargala binsaed-uksadba, deyob anmar imakodo. Degi, dule-Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba-nanadimalad-sogsamogadba, deyob anmar imakodo.” Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba imaklesundo.
Geb degi, Esdrasʼga sogdemalad: “Gwichibin be imake, ar we-igarde be imakergebed, ar anmar be-bendakmogoed, gandik be-sae, be ibmar imake.”
Degidgine, Esdras gwichibin imaksad. Geb Esdras, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, Levita-dulemala, bela Israel-dulemala ibmar-sogsamaladba-ise-sogar-imakega, imaksad. Degisoggu, Israel-dulemala ise-sogar eyeye na sogsamalad, deyob imakmaloye.
Geb agi, Esdras, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-asabin-sii nadsunnad. Geb Johanán-e-gabednegse naded. Johanánʼde, Eliasib-machid. Agine, dulemar-galesgusmalad-gannar-nonimalad-e-isgusadba, Esdras, nue bukib-binsaedba, gwen gobsasuli, mas-guchasuli, gabided.
Geb sorbali, dulemar-galesgusmalad-nonimaladse gorlesad. We-dulemarse gorlesad: Judá-yalagi-bukmaladse, degi, Jerusalénʼgi-bukmaladse. Ega weyob soglesad: “Jerusalén-neggweburse ambikunonimaloye.”
Degi, ega soglesbalid: “Dule ibapaagwadgi nonisulile, bela ei e-nainumar-nikadi sulegoye. Ar igi-dummagan, degi, Judío-girmar-dummagan igar-mesisa, deyob guoye. Degi, dulemar-galesgusmalad-nonimalad-imbagi, bemar-ononnolegoye,” ega soglesad.
Geb degine, a-ibapaagwadgi, bela machergan Judá-yarginmalad, degi, Benjamín-yarginmalad, Jerusalén-neggweburse ambikunonimalad. Deunni, nii-walabakebakgi, e-iba-durgwengi, bela dulemar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ambikued-neg-naidgi ambikusmalad. Degi, weyob ibmar-soglesadba, nue dobee itodmalad. De-ukinbali, dii nue-winaibarsoggu, a-bakas bela-belad wawanmakbukwad.
Geb degi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Esdras gwichibin imaksad. Geb amarga weyob sogded: —Bemar, bela-belad Bab-Dummadgi nue isgusad, omegan-Israel-dulemarsurmalad be nikusmalad. Degidbali, bela-belad Israel-dulemar-isguega be imaksamalad.
Emi, anmar-dadgan-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-asabin, be-isgusmalad be barsogmarsun. Bab-Jehová-ibmar-abegedba be imakmalo. Degine, dule-Bab-Jehová-wissurmaladgi be bangumalo, omegan-be-dulamarsulid be metemalo.
Geb, bela dulemar gandikidba, Esdras-abin sogdemalad: —Ar deyobdo. Degiirdi nabir, be-sogedba anmar imako.
Degi-inigwele, anmar bukidarsoggu, degine, diide nue-winaibarsoggu, anmar geg weyob magaba bukwa gued. Ar we-igarde binsa ibagwenadye, degi, ibabogwadye soglesulid, ar ade, anmar bukidar na we-igargi isgusmaladbiid.
”Degisoggu, anmar sogsundo, dule e-neggweburga-dummadga-gudimalad, e-sordagan-ular, wegi beoye, adi, amar-ular sunmakegar. Geb dulemar-omegan-Israel-dulesulid-nikusmalad iba-sogedba nonimaloed. Wemar dule-dummagan-abargi, dule-igar-nabiromalad-abargi, degi, e-neggwebur-e-neggwebur-iliba wese nonimaloed. Adi, Bab-Dummad anmar egi-isgusad-ular anmarse-urwemaidi, melle bar anmarse urwegar.”
Geb degi, unnila Asael-machi-Jonatán, Ticva-machi-Jahazías, wemar-ebogwad, we-ibmar-sogsamaladgi gwisgusad, degine, Levita-dulemar-ebogwad Mesulam, Sabetai, we-dulemarba nai gusmarmogad.
Dulemar-gales-selesgusmalad-nonimaladdi, na sogedba imaksad. Geb degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Esdras, neguya-gwenna-gwennagi dummadga-gudimalad amisad, adi, dulemar-omegan-Israel-dulesulid-nikusmaladga igar-amiegar. Geb, nii-warambegi, a-ibagwenadgi, dulemar e-neggweburmar-ular dummadga-besmaladi na igar-amidmalad.
Degi, gebe-nii-yolesad-ibagwenadgi, bela-dulemar omegan-Israel-dulemarsulid-nikusmaladga igar-nabiroleged bergusad.
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-wagan, omegan-Israel-dulesulid-nikusmalad, wemalad: Josadac-machi-Jesúa, Josadac-wagangi-danikid, degi, e-gwenadgan: Maasías, Eliezer, Jarib, Gedalías.
We-dulemar na nue-ise-sogar sogsamalad, we-omegan-Israel-dulesurmalad anmar metemaloye. Degine, amarde, e-isgued-eliega, Bab-Dummadga sibad-wawaad-machered-wargwen ogumakar uksamarbalid.
Imer-wagansikid: Hanani, Zebadías.
Harim-wagansikid: Maasías, Elías, Semaías, Jehiel, Uzías.
Pasur-wagansikid: Elioenai, Maasías, Ismael, Natanael, Jozabad, Elasa.
Levita-wagansikid: Jozabad, Simei, Kelaía. Kelaíaʼde, Kelita-duled. Petaías, Judá, Eliezer.
Dule-Namakmalad-e-wagansikid: Eliasib. Dule-yawagak-dakmalad-e-wagansikid: Salum, Telem, Uri.
Deginbali, Israel-dulemar-baigansikmalad. Paros-wagansikid: Ramía, Jezías, Malquías, Mijamín, Eleazar, Malquías, Benaía.
Elam-wagansikid: Matanías, Zacarías, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremot, Elías.
Zatu-wagansikid: Elioenai, Eliasib, Matanías, Jeremot, Zabad, Aziza.
Bebai-wagansikid: Johanán, Hananías, Zabai, Atlai.
Bani-wagansikid: Mesulam, Maluc, Adaía, Jasub, Seal, Ramot.
Pahat-Moab-wagansikid: Adna, Quelal, Benaía, Maasías, Matanías, Bezaleel, Binúi, Manasés.
Harim-wagansikid: Eliezer, Isías, Malquías, Semaías, Simeón,
Benjamín, Maluc, Semarías.
Hasum-wagansikid: Matenai, Matata, Zabad, Elifelet, Jeremai, Manasés, Simei.
Bani-wagansikid: Madai, Amram, Uel,
Benaía, Bedías, Quelúhi,
Vanías, Meremot, Eliasib,
Matanías, Matenai, Jaasai,
Bani, Binúi, Simei,
Selemías, Natán, Adaía,
Macnadebai, Sasai, Sarai,
Azareel, Selemías, Semarías,
Salum, Amarías, José.
Nebo-wagansikid: Jeiel, Matatías, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, Joel, degi, Benaía.
Bela-wemar, omegan-Israel-dulemarsurmalad-nikusmaladid. Geb degi, na e-omegangi bangudmarsunnad, e-mimmigangi aibatemarsunnad.
Ani, Nehemías Hacalías-machi, angi-ibmar-gusad an narmaksiid. Rey-Artajerjes birga-durgwengus (20) negdakmaidgi Nii-Quisleuʼye-nugad gwichidgi, deunni, an Susa-neggwebur-gandikidgi gudiid. We-Susaʼgi reyneg-siid.
Agi, deunni an-urba-Hanani, dule-Judá-yarginmaladba anse nonikid. Geb degi, a-dulemarse an egichided, Judío-dulemar-abonolesmaladi, igi gubukye, degine, Jerusalén-neggwebur, igi gusimoye.
Degidgine, anga sokarmalad: “Judío-dulemar-abonolesa Jerusalén-neggweburse gannar-nonimaladi, bela-bela wilebukmalad, degi, binged-dummad-abargi gudidimalad. Jerusalén-neggweburdina, e-galumar bela omukulesad, e-yawagakmardi soogi ogumaklesad.”
An deyob itosgua, an bosii gualid. Degine, ibagan undarsaar an bela-bela ulubgi nunmak-itodigusad. Geb degi, gwen mas-gunsuli an Bab-Dummad-Nibneggi-Maidse gornaigussunnad.
Geb agi, an ega sogded: “Bab-Jehováʼye, Bab-Dummad nibneg-e-ibedye, be, be bela-bela gangued nikad. Dule-be-sabmalad, degi, be-igar-mamaidba-nanamalad be sabdaed. Degi, be amar-ebo igar-mesisadba be imakedsedaed.
Bab-Dummad, bese an wilesagwa egissun, wis be an-itogena gadin, degi, an, be-maiga-gued, bitigi nued be dakena yeerban. An be-maigan-Israel-dulemarga bane-bane mutikidba, ibginedba an bese gornaid. Anmar-Israel-dulemar begi nue-nosad. A-ular, nunmak-itogedgi an na bega na barsogsunnad. Deginbali, ani, geb bela an-gwenadgan, anmar begi nue-nosmalad.
Degi, anmar bela-bela begi isgusmalad, degine, be-Igar-Mesisadba, degi, be-sorda-Moisés-sogsadba anmar nanassurmarbalid.
”Emisgi be ebinsao, be-sorda-Moisésʼga be-ibmar-sogsad: ‘Bemar angi nosmardibe, ani dule-yar-baid-baid-bukwadgi an be-oaisakioye.
Degi-inigwele, bemar gannar anba nanamalale, geb an-Igar-Maidba bemar damalale, degi, aba bemar innikii gudimarbalile, gannar an bemar-suoed. Ar bemar dikasur mimilesdibe, an gannar bemar-suoed. Geb bia bemarga an neg nasiksa, a-negse an bemar-sedagoed, agi, angi nue binsadii gumalagar.’
”Bab-Jehová, anmar be-maiganad, degi, be-dulamarbalid, ar bela-bela be-ganguedba be anmar-abonosad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, bese an wilesakwaa egissun, wis be, be-maiga-an-gued, be itogena gadin, degi, be-maimar bese-wilesagwa-gornaid be itogena gadin. Ar amardi bela be-nug-odummobimalad. An bese egisbardo, bitigi rey-asabin igar-nueganbi be anga uksana gadin.” Deunni a-ibagangine, an reyga nog-dakedid.
Rey-Artajerjes birga-dulagwengus (20), negdakmaidgi, a-ibagwengi, Nisán-nii-gwichidgi, an ega vino uknaigua, rey bukib-itoge an-daksad. Ar rey gwen bukib-binsa an-dakdisursoggu, anse egisalid:
—¿Ar ibiga be bukib-itoge? Ar gwen-nailikgu an be-daksurbalid, degisoggu, ibmar-baidba be bukib-binsadiirgebed. Agine, an bela-bela dobe-itonaded.
Geb agi, reyga an sogded: —¡Dummad, bitigi be suibasaar dulamai-gusana yeerban! ¿Igi an bukib-itosuli an daklegosunna? Ar ade, neggwebur bia an-dadgan-napa-mamai bela bibisgar-siid, degine, e-yawagakmar sooba bela gummaksabalid. Aga, an bukib-binsadiid.
Geb rey anse egichialid: —¿Ibu bega imakbi be an-abesunna? Geb agi, Bab-Dummad-nibneg-ibedse an goted.
Geb agi, rey-abin an sogded: —Dummad, ar be nabir itogele, nabir angi be binsaele, Judá-yarse be an-barmiddo, neggwebur bia an-babgan-napa-mamaidse, adi, a-neggwebur gannar an sobbaligar.
Deunni, rey, e-omeyalaba siid. Agi, rey anse egichialid: —Be nadele, ¿bule-melu be yogguoe? ¿Sana gannar be danibaloe? Geb an reyga sogsagu sana an gannar danikoe, agi, rey nuedgi an-barmisad.
Geb degi, reyga an sogsabalid: —Dummad, be nabir itogele, an bese wilesakwaa egissundo, dummagan Éufrates-diwar-dad-argwanedsik-negdakmamaidga be anga gardamar narmake, adi, Judá-yargi an bonisuli dogegar.
Geb reyga-sapur-daked-Asafʼse garda be narmakbalina yeerban. We-gardagi Asafʼga be sogodo: ‘Sapi-warmar Nehemíasʼga be ukoye, adi, urgomar-mamarega. We-urgomar, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-dikarba neg-gandikid-siid-e-yawagakmarga ebulegoed. Degine, neggwebur-e-galumargi yawagakmar-siid sobega we-urgomar ebulebaloed. Deginbali, Nehemías e-meged-neg sobega urgomar ega be ukbaloye.’ Ar Bab-Dummad angi nued-binsasoggu, rey we-gardamar anga uksasunnad.
Geb an Éufrates-diwar-dad-argwanedsik dummagan-negdakmamaidse an nadsunnad. Geb agi, rey-garda-narmaksad, a-dummaganga an uksad. A-ukinbali, rey, suar-ibed-dummagan, degi, dule-bila-onomalad-moli-birgi-simalad anba barmisad.
Degi-inigwele, Sanbalat Horón-neggweburgined, geb Tobías Amón-dulemarga-arbaed, Israel-dulemar-bendakega dule-gwensak noniye, itosmargua, bela-bela sae-itodmalad.
Geb an Jerusalén-neggweburse modapid. Geb agine, ibapaagus an gudiidgine,
mutikidbali an naded, anbali dulemar-ichesaar an sesad. Amargala bipisaale Bab-Dummad Jerusalén-neggweburga ibmar-imakbie-abeged an sogsasulid. Unnila anbi moli-birgi-sii nadapgusad, baigandi nagab nadapgusmalad.
A-mutiki, Neba-Yawagak-Noedsik an nosad. Bia dii-e-saila-Dragónʼye-nugad-siidsik, degi, bia Ibmar-Isgana-Mied-e-Yawagak-Noed-siidsik an naded. Agine, an Jerusalén-neggwebur e-galumar-ganna-ganna-bukwad an daksad. Degine, e-yawagakmar bela soo-abin gummakar an daksabalid.
Degidgine, Dii-e-saila-Yawagak-Dogedsik, degi, Rey-Dii-Wila-naidsik an naded. Degi-inigwele, geg an dogegusad, ar ade, moli-birgi-an-siidgi geg doged.
Degisoggu, amba mutiksoggu, dian-maidba an nakwid gusad. Agi, neggwebur-e-galu-matusulid an nue argasad. Geb degine, gannar an bilisad, Neba-Yawagak-Noedsik an dognonikid.
Ar deunni, dummagan-negdakmamaid wissurmalad, bia an arbi, degi, ibu an imakapi. Ar ade deunni, amba yoo an Judíoʼmarga ibmar-soged: Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladga, dule-dummaganga, dummagan-negdakmamaidga, degi, dule-arbananaimaladga amba yoo an ibmar soged.
Geb amarga an sogded: —Ar bemar nue wismalad, anmargala nue-neg-gagales-naid: Jerusalén-e-galumar-matusulid bela nue bibisgar-siid, degine, e-yawagakmar bela soose gummaksad. Degisoggu, anmar Jerusalén-e-galu-matusulid gannar sobnamarsun, adi, melle bar dulemar anmargi dodomalagar.
Geb degine, amarga an sogdebalid, igi Bab-Dummad angi nued-binsasa, degine, igi anga rey sogsabali. Deyob-itosmargua, anga sokarmalad: —Anmar guakwado. Anmar neggwebur-e-galu-matusulid sobnamardo. Deyobi ibmar-nued saegala, yeer-itogedba arbadmarsunnad.
Geb Sanbalat Horón-neggweburgined, Amón-dulemar-e-dummad-wargwen Tobíasʼye nugad, degi, Árabe-dule-Gesem, deyob itosgu, anmargi dodoarmalad, gegegwaye anmargi sokarmalad. Amar anmarga sokarmalad: —¿Ar bemar ibu imaknanai? ¿Ar bemarde reygi-gwisguoye sogmarde?
Ar andi a-dulemar-abin sogded: —Bab-Dummad-Nibneg-Ibed, a anmar-ibmar-imaknaidgi nasguega anmar-imakoed. Anmardi e-maigan-gumalad. Anmar Jerusalén-neggwebur e-galu-matusulid obinosokalid. We-neggwebur bemargadsulid. Degisoggu, bemar ibmar-soged sate, ar be-dadgande weginmaladsurbalid. A-ulale, bemar anmarba arbaed sate.
Degidgine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-e-dummad Eliasibʼye nugad, na e-sordagan dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladmala, Sibad-Wawaad-Yawagak sobsamalad. Degine, a-yawagak Bab-Dummadga nug-imaksamalad, geb e-gwichi-gusadse ogwichiapmalad. Deginbali, neggwebur-galu-matusulid sobdemarbalid, neg-matusulid-warakwagwad-Hamea-nugadgi onoded, geb neg-matusulid-warakwagwad-Hananeel-nugadse sobsamalad.
Geb a-dikarba galu-soblededi Jericó-dulemar egi arbasad. Geb amar-nagaba, Imri-machi-Zacur arbasmogad.
Senaa-e-wagan Ua-Yawagak gannar sobsamalad. Geb e-yawagak-gamalad e-dikargi mesisad, degi geb, a-yawagak e-gwichi-gusadse ogwichiapmalad, geb a-yawagak-edimalad, degi, yawagak-abargi urgo-mesleged mesismarbalid.
Geb a-yawagak-gwichidgi galu-soblededi, Cos-wagwa Urías-machi-Meremot, a-ailagi arbasad. Geb a-nagabali, Mesezabeel-e-wagwa Berequías-machi-Mesulam galu-sobsamogad. Geb Mesulam-arbanaid-nagaba, Baana-machi-Sadoc galu sobsamogad.
Geb Tecoaʼginmalad a-galugi-arbasmarmogad. Degi-inigwele, Tecoa-dule-e-dummagandi a-arbaedgi bendaksasurmalad, yapa eba ibsagusmalad.
Paseah-machi-Joiada, degi, Besodías-machi-Mesulam Yawagak-Seredye nugad gannar sobsamalad. Geb e-yawagak-gamalad e-dikargi mesisad, degi, geb a-yawagak e-gwichi-gusadse ogwichiapmalad, geb a-yawagak-edimalad, degi, yawagak-abargi urgo-mesleged mesismarbalid.
Geb a-yawagak-gwichidgi galu-soblesadi, Melatías Gabaón-neggweburgined, degi, Jadón Meronot-neggweburgined egi arbasmogad. Amarbali, Gabaón-neggweburginmalad, degi, Mizpa-neggweburginmalad arbasmarmogad. A-dulemarde, Éufrates-diwar-dad-argwanedsik dule-negsemaid e-maiganga gusmalad.
A-dulemar-nagaba, Harhaía-machi-Uziel, galu-sobsamogad. Harhaíaʼde, or-sobedid. Degi, Hananías, dule-ina-wawadikid-sobedid, a-dikarba galu-sobsamarmogad. Amar-ebogwa, Jerusalén-neggwebur-e-galumar gannar sobsamalad, Galu-Matar-Dummadye-nugad-nagase arbasmalad.
A-nagabali, Hur-e-machi-Refaías galu-nudaksamogad. Hurʼde, Jerusalén-neggwebur-abala dummadga-maigusad.
A-nagabali, Harumaf-machi-Jedaías, e-neg-asabin arbadmogad. Degine, a-nagaba, Hasabnías-machi-Hatús, arbasmogad.
Geb amar-nagaba, Harim-machi-Malquías, Pahat-Moab-machi-Hasubʼmala, arbasmarmogad. Degi, amar Neg-Suid-Soo-Galuye-nugadgi arbasmalad.
A-nagabali, Halohes-machi-Salum, na e-sisganmala galu sobnanai-gusmarmogad. Salumʼde, Jerusalén-neggwebur-abala dummadga mai gusad.
Degine, Hanún, Zanoa-neggweburginmaladmala Neba-Yawagak sobsamarmogad. Degine, e-yawagak-gamalad e-dikarba mesismalad, a-yawagak e-gwichi-gusadse ogwichiapmalad, geb a-yawagak-edimalad, degi, yawagak-abargi urgo-mesleged mesismarbalid. Degi, neggwebur-e-galumar dali-dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakambe-sugu (250) onudaksamalad, Ibmar-Isgana-Mied-e-Yawagak-Noed siidse.
Deginbali, Recab-machi-Malquías, Ibmar-Isgana-Mied-e-Yawagak sobsamogad. Recabʼde, Bet-Haquerem-yar-dakmai-gusad. Malquías yawagak-edimalad, degi, yawagak-abargi urgomar-mesleged mesisad.
Colhoze-machi-Salum Dii-Saila-e-Yawagak nudaksad. Colhozeʼde, Mizpa-yargi-dummadga-maigusad. Salum, Dii-Saila-Yawagak-uas gannar sobsad, e-yawagakmargi urgo-dummagan-sommeremalad nasiksad, geb e-gwichi-gusadse ogwichiapid. Salum, yawagak-edimalad, degi, yawagak-abargi urgomar-mesleged mesisad. Deginbali, dii-wilasar-naid, Siloéʼye-nugad, a-galu-matusulid, Salum nudaksabalid. We-dii-wilasar-naidde, Rey-Nainu-naba naid. A-akale, Salum, David-neggweburse arsanmar aidemaidse, galu nudaksad.
Salum-arbanaid-nagaba, Azbuc-machi-Nehemías, galu-nudaksamogad. Nehemíasʼde, Betsur-neggwebur-abala dummadga-maigusad. A-dulede, David-neg-uan-asabin neg-naidsega, degi, dii-wila-naidse, degine, sordamar-neg-bukwadse, arbasad.
Nehemías-nagaba, Levita-dulemar, degi, Bani-machi-Rehum, galu-nudaksamarmogad. A-nagabali, Hasabías, e-yar-nuggi galu nudaksamogad. Hasabíasʼde, Keila-neggwebur-abala dummadga-maigusad.
Hasabías-sorba e-gwenadgan arbasmarmogad, Henadad-machi-Bavai. Henadadʼde, Keila-neggweburmar-abala dummadga-maigusmogad.
Jesúa-machi-Ezerʼdi, gingimar-saboleged-neg-bukwadse galu nudaksamogad. Jesúaʼde, Mizpa-neggweburgi dummadga-maigusad.
Amar-nagaba, Zabai-machi-Baruc, bela-bela yeer-itogedgi galu-nudaksamogad. E-dikar-abingunaidgi onoded, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummad-Eliasib-e-neg-yawagakse, Baruc nudaksamogad.
Baruc-nagaba, Urías-machi-Meremot, galu-nudaksamogad. Eliasib-neg-doged-akar, a-neg-bergunaidse, Meremot galu-nudaksad. Meremotʼde, Cos-wagwad.
Meremot-nagaba, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad Jerusalén-dikarba-mamaimaladi galu-nudaksamarmogad.
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-nagaba, Benjamín, Hasubʼmala, na e-negmar-asabin galu-nudaksamarmogad. Geb amar-nagaba, Maasías-machi-Azarías, e-neg-asabin galu-matusulid nudaksamogad. Azaríasʼde, Ananías-e-wagwad.
Azarías-nagaba, Henadad-machi-Binúi, galu-matusulid nudaksamogad. Binúi, Azarías-e-neg-akar-onoded, galu-abingunaidse nudaksad.
Uzai-machi-Palal, galu-abingunaidgi galu-nudaksa-gusad. A-galu-nudaklesadi, neg-suid-gwichid-asabin nudaklesad. A-neg-suidde esgarya-neg-imbasik reyneg-nagaba siid. Faros-machi-Pedaías, Palal-nagaba, galu nudaksamogad.
Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbamalad, Ofel-yar-mullugi-mamaimaladi, dad-nakwedsik Dii-Yawagak-Noed-asabin galu nudaksamalad. Neg-suid-nogwichidse nudaksamalad.
Amar-nagaba, Tecoaʼginmalad, neg-suid-nogwichid-akar, Ofel-galuse nudaksamarmogad.
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad na e-neg-e-neg-asabin Moli-Yawagak-Noed-akar galu nudaksamalad.
Amar-nagaba, Imer-machi-Sadoc, e-neg-asabin galu-nudaksamogad. Sadoc-nagaba, Secanías-machi-Semaías, a-galu-nudaksamogad. Secaníasʼde, Dad-Nakwedsik-Yawagak-Noed-siid-dakedid.
Semaías-nagaba, Selemías-machi-Hananías, degi, Salaf-machi-nergwad (6) Hanúnʼye-nugadmala galu nudaksamarmogad. Wemar-nagaba, Berequías-machi-Mesulam, e-neg-asabin galu-nudaksamogad.
Degine, Mesulam-nagaba, Malquías dule-orgi-ibmar-sobedi, galu nudaksamogad. A-dule, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbamalad-e-negse, degi, ibmarmar-manigi-ukleged-negse, nudaksad. A-galu, Igar-Itoleged-e-Yawagak-Noed-asabin, dulemar-ambikued-neg-e-galu-abingunaidse nudaksad.
Degine, dule-ambikued-neg-akar Sibad-Wawaad-Yawagak-Noedse dule-orgi-ibmar-sobmalad, degine, dule manigi-ibmar-ukmalad galu-nudaksamarmogad.
Sanbalat itoargu, anmar Jerusalén-neggwebur-e-galu sobnanaiye, bela-bela sae-itoded, geb nue-uluded. Agine, Judíoʼmargi dododed.
Geb Sanbalat e-gwenadgan-wagab, degi, Samaria-sorda-bila-onomalad-wagab sogded: —We-Judíoʼmar, gegegana, ¿we, ibu-imaknanai? ¿Wede we-neggwebur-galu gannar sobmaloye sogmarde? ¿Ar Judíoʼmarde gannar e-Bab-Dummadga ibmar-ogumakar-uknai-guoye sogmarde? ¿Ar ibagwen-dummad we-arbaed gagamaloye sogmarde? ¿Ar akwa-gummaksamalad, bela ubigwar-gusmalad, gannar ebugoye sogmarde, we-galu gannar a-akwagi sobegar? Adi surbali.
Sanbalat weyob sogsagu, deunni, Amón-dule Tobías, e-dikarba gwichid. We-dule sogdemogad: —We-galu-akwabi-sobnanaidgi, achu-bunnu-wawaad egi nakwidele, yaar-nadeled.
Degi, an Bab-Dummadse goted: “Anmar-Bab-Dummadye, nue be itoge, bule nue-isdarsunna anmar-dake be daksunna. Isdar anmargi-sunmaknanaid, egi dukin-aibined be imake. E-isdarmaladga be urmake. E-isdarmaladse yogasaar-gales-yar-baid-baidse ebipileged.
Bab-Dummad, ar we-dulemar galu-sobnanaidgi sunnasur sunmaksamarsoggu, melle e-ibmar-isdar-imaksamalad igi-barsaye be sogo. E-isgusmalad, melle ega be osulogo.”
Degisoggu, anmar anba galu-matusulid sobnai-guarmarsunnad. Ar dulemar bela-bela nue yeer-itogedgi arbanai gusmarsoggu, bato negabargus anmar galu onakmalad.
Ar Sanbalat, Tobías, Árabe-dulemar, Amón-dulemar, degi, Asdodʼginmalad itoarmargu, Jerusalén-neggwebur-e-galu-matusulid gannar soblenaiye, degine, galumar bato nue edilemaiye, amar nue bela-bela sae-itosmalad.
Degisoggu, we-dulemar igar-amismalad, adi, Jerusalénʼgi gwisgunamalagar, bela Jerusalén-neggwebur oichomalagar.
Geb degine, anmardi anmar-Bab-Dummadse goted. Degidgine, anmar igar-amisad, mutikidba, degi, ibginedba sordamar neggi-nakulegega ogwismaloye.
Deunni, Judá-yargi-bukmaladdi sogdemalad: “Dulemar-akwa-berbemalad geggusmalad, deginbali, akwamar-mileded yaisursoggu, anmar galu-matusulid geg bar-sobdo.”
Degine, anmar-isdarmalad sogdemalad: “Melle anmar-wisguega anmar imakmalo, degi, melle anmar-dakega imakmarbalo. Judíoʼmar bato yaba-gudii anmar-dakdamaloed, geb agi, anmar oburgwemaloed. Deyob anmar imakoed, adi, melle galu-matusulid bar-nudakmalagar.”
Judíoʼmar-gwenna-gwenna amar-abargi-mamaimalad bali-bali anmarga sognonidamalad: “Sanbalat-sordamala ukiar bemargi galagwensuli baidsik-baidsik bemar-bukwadgi gwisgunonimaloye.”
Geb agine, dulemar e-gwenadgan-e-gwenadganba danar-danar an oambikusad. Guakwa es-suidgi gani-gani an oambikusad. E-sigu, e-gingi bato guar-guar gani, galu-matusulid-dikarba, bur-baisursunna-anmargi-ubogedgi an amar-urbisad.
Geb degidgine, neg nue an daksagua, an gwichiguded. Geb agi, dummaganga, sorda-idumaladga, degi, bela dulemarga an sogded: “Melle anmar-isdarmalad-abin gwayemalo. Nue insamalo, Bab-Dummad, dule-dummadid, bela-gangued-nika-maid. Be-gwenadgan-ular, be-masmala-ular, be-bunamala-ular, be-omegan-ular, degi, be-negyaur-ular be bila-onomalo.”
Anmar-isdarmalad wisguarmalad, anmarde guakwaa bukwamarye, ar e-igar-mesismalad Bab-Dummad ei obelosye. Agi, anmar gannar galu-matusulid sobdemalad, na egad-egad arbaed imakdemalad.
A-iba-onoded-akar, an-sordamar-negabar arbananai gusad. Abaladi, guakwaa e-ilawar-swiswidikmalad, e-sigu-abgaed, warsi, degi, e-binasgargi mor-esgorobiid-yoi gudii gusmalad. Judá-dummagan guakwa-bukwamarmogad e-sordagan-bendakega.
Dulemar galu-matusulid-sobnanaidi, degi, dulemar-ibmar-berbemaladi, sakwa-nailiki arbananai gusad, sakwa-baidsikdi eswar-gani gunanai gusad.
Ar dule-galu-sobnanaimaladdi, na e-sadergi es-suid-nai gunanai gusmarbalid. Deyob arbananai gusmalad. Dule gar-trompeta-ogoleddi an-dikarba gwichid.
Ar ade dummaganga, dule-nue-nug-nikamaladga, degine, bela dulemar-baiganga an sogsad: “We-arbaedi, arbaed-dummadid, bipisulid. Emide, anmar galugi banna-banna dika-dikasur gunanaid.
Degisoggu, ar bia gar-trompeta gole bemar itogoe, asik bemar anmarbogwa ambikunonimalo. Ar anmar-Bab-Dummad bila-onolegedgi anmar-ular gwisguoed.”
Degisoggu, deyobi anmar arbananai gusmalad. Dad-nakwialid-akar, neg-mutikguedse anmar arbaed indakdedamalad. Dule-negabala arbananai gusmalad, baigan-abaladdi eswar-gani guakwaa nakulebukwa gusmalad.
Geb degine, dulemarga an sogsabalid: “Bemala, be-bendakmaladmala Jerusalén-neggwebur-yaba be ambikumalo, adi, mutiki be nakulemalaga, ibgindi bemar arbamaloed.”
A-ulale, an-gwenadgan, an-sapingana, degi, sordamar-an-edarbemaladi, bipisaale binsa-gannaa-bukwadasurmalad, unnila obsokalirbi geb bogiguddamalad.
Degidgine, dulemar, degi, e-omegan binnasuli e-gwenadgan-Judíoʼmargi oimakarmalad.
Gwenna-gwenna sogdemalad: “Anmar mimmigan bukidar nikamalad, degisoggu, anmar nabir mas-gunnega ibmar-gwag-gullemalad egisergebed, adi, mer burgwegar.”
Baigan sogdemarmogad: “Anmar ukud-dummad-naidba, anmar-nainu, degine, anmar-uva-nainu manigi odogar nagusad, degi, anmar-nega dule-baidga manigi-odogar sigwisbalid, adi, anmar a-manigi mas bakegar.”
Baigandi sogmarmogad: “Anmar rey-bennukegala, anmar-nainu, anmar-uva-nainu, manigi-odogar nasiksad.
Ar anmar, we-dulemarbo emar-gumalad, anmar-mimmigan emar-mimmiganbo akarsulid, emalad. Degi-inigwele, anmardi anmar-masmala, degi, anmar-sisgan maiga-guegala anmar manigi-ukergebed. Bato anmar-sisgan gwenna-gwenna maiga-gudidimalad, amala geg anmar bar oakaloged. Ar ade anmar-nainu, anmar-uva-nainu bato dule-baigangadid.”
Ani, Nehemías, we-dulemar isdar-itogedba oimakbukwa an itosgua, bela-bela sae-an-itoded.
Nuekwaa an egi binsasgua, dule-nug-nikamaladga, degi, dule-dummaganga sabsuli ibmar an ega sogded: —Ar be-gwenadganga ibmar be uksale, egi mani-onogega, ¿mani-dummarba be gadamarde? Deginbali, bela we-igar-itogegala dulemar-onmakega an imaksad.
Amarga an sogded: —Anmar, bela-bela alamaknanai gusad an-gwenadgan-Judíoʼmar, dulemar-Judíoʼsurmaladse manigi-uklesmalad-onogegar. ¿Ar emide bemar gannar be-gwenadgan-uknaibarde, adi, anmar a-gwenadgan gannar manigi onomarbaligar? Dule-nuga-nikamalad, degi, dummagan gwen anmar-abin-imaksasurmalad. Ar ade, ¿ibu anmarga sogosunna? Anmarga soged-satemala.
Degidgine, an sogdebalid: —Bemar ibnued imaknanaisurmalad. Ar bemar anmar-Bab-Dummad dobee nanae-wilubmalanad, adi, anmar-isdarad-Judíoʼsurmalad melle anmargi dodomalagar.
Ani, an-gwenadgan, degi, dule-anga-arbamalad, anmar dule-wileganaga mani gaar-uksad, orosgi-dakleged-trigoʼye-nugad gaale an uksamarbalid. Degisoggu, dule-anmargi-ibmar-ganikidbali anmarga gannar ibmar-ukoed, obichadi suli.
Degisoggu, dummagan gandikidgi an bemarga sogdo: Emisbinne, bemar ega e-nainumar, e-uva-nainumar, e-olivo-nainumar, degi, e-negmar gannar ukmala. Deginbali, mani-e-sangi-mani-onolesad mer be e-annik-suo, degi, ibmar-gwaggi, vinoʼgi, degi, olivo-gwallugi, e-gaka-obicha-ukleged, mer be egiso.
Dummagande an-abin sogdemalad: —Nueddo, bela be anmarga ibmar-sogsadba an imakmaloed. Anmar gannar ega e-ibmarmala ukoed, bipisaale anmar ese ibmar-egisosulid. Geb degidgine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladse an gochad. Amar danar an oambikusad. Amar-wagab dule-nug-nikamalad, degi, dule-dummagan na e-ibmar-sogsad anga ise-sogar-imakega an imaksad.
Agine, an-mor-dummad binnasur mor-mor an imaksad, geb an sogded: —We-ibmar-sognaidba dule-wargwen imaksasulile, Bab-Dummad a-dule-neg, degi, e-ibmarmar-nikad an-mor-dummad an mor-mor imaksayobi imakoed. Deyobi mor-mor guoed, na ibmar sate-guoed. Bela dulemar-bukwadi sogdemalad: —¡Ar deyob guodo! Geb bela dulemar Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummodmalad, bela dulemar ibmar-sogsadba imaksamalad.
Rey-Artajerjes birga-dulagwengus (20), reyga maidgi, an Judá-yar-daked-dummadga nuggunonikid. A-gan an sesigusad, Rey-Artajerjes birga-dulagwen-gakambe-gakabo (32) megisadse. We-birgambe-gakabogwadgi (12), an-dummadga maigusan-inigwele, ani, degi, an-bendakmaladse-bakale, ibmarmar dule-dummadga-ukleged, anmar gwen ebussurmalad.
Ar an-idu-dummaganga-megismaladdi, dulemargi mani-dummad gasmalad. Na e-mas gunnega, e-vino gobega, mani-nibir-dulabo (40) aidikued-wilub gasmalad. Deginbali, ega-arbamaladmoga dulemar-wiosmarmogad. Ar andi Bab-Dummad-dobed-ular, deyob an imaksasulid.
Neggwebur-galu-matusulid gannar-nudakega an arbanai gusad, degine, anga dule-arbamalad arbanai gusmarmogad. Anmar bipisaale nainu baksasur gusmalad.
A-ukinbali, Judíoʼmar, degi, dule-dummagan, dulagugle-gakambe (150) mese-naba anba mas-gunnonidamalad. Degine, dule-neggwebur-baiganginmalad anse ataknoni-gusmaladdi obarlesulid.
Bane-bane, moli-bebe-nikad, wargwen, sibad-wawaad-nuegan, walanergwa (6) oburgwiledaed. Deginbali, nuumar-oburgwiledabalid. Ibambe-ibambegi (10-10), vino-ichesuli anga selenonidaed. Degi-inigwele, an dummadga-guedgi anga-ibmar-uklegoenad an ese egichissulid. Ar ade, an daked, ar weyobile, we-dulemarga mani-bipisuli nosaled.
¡An-Bab-Dummadye, bela we-dulemarga an ibmar-imaksad, nue be ebinsao! ¡Angi nued be binsamogo!
Sanbalat, Tobías, Árabe-dule Gesemʼye-nugadi, degi, an-isdarmalad-baigan itoarmargua, Jerusalén-neggwebur-galu-matusulid an nudaksaye, degine, yaa-ollogwad sateye, bela bato atisye. (Ar a-ibagangi amba yoo yawagakmar nasikleged).
Degidgine, Sanbalat, degi, Gesem anga gayaburba barmiarmalad, sogsiid: “Neba-Onoʼye-nugadgi, neggwebur-burwigana-gwensakgi anmar abingumalo.” Ar emardi, bato angi ichakwa binsasmalad.
Geb agine, amarga dule gayaburba-berbemalad an barmisad, ega sogega: “Ande bela-bela arbaed nue-nikaye, arbaed-dummad an imaknaye. Degisoggu, bemar-abinguega an naele, an-arbaed galegodole.”
Ilabake, gannar-gannar anga we-gayaburba barmisad. Degi, ilabake, gannar-gannar an abinsasmogad.
Ilataledgine, Sanbalat na e-maiba anga garda-argaar barmialid.
Gardagi weyob narmakar-naid: “Dule Gasmuʼye-nugadi soged, degi, dule-Judíoʼsurmalad sogmarmogad: ‘Bede, Judíoʼmarbo galu-sobnanaiye, adi, be-reygi be aibinmalaga. A-ulale, bemarde galu-matusulid sobnanaiye. Weyob sogmalad, bede, e-reyga guoye.’
Degine, bede Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad-onugsasye, adi, amar Jerusalén-neggweburgi begi sogmalagar: ‘Judá-yargi anmar rey-nikamarye.’ Ar Rey-Artajerjesʼse we-gayaburba warmakosoggu, be anmarse dage, anmar sunmakmalagar.”
Geb degine, an abin-imaksad: “Bela be ibmar-sogedi bela gakanbiid. Ar na be wargwengi yogasaar gordiid.”
Ar ade, wemar binsa yamo anmar-ogwayebimalad. Binsamalad ar deyobile, anmarde bar arbabi gudagosurmarye. Andi, an Bab-Dummadse gochad: “Bab-Dummadye, emigindi gangued be anga udasun, adi, melle galakuega.”
Geb a-sorbali, Delaía-machi-Semaías-negse an nadsunnad. Semaíasʼde, Mehetabel-e-wagwad, a-dule na e-neggi nomaisulid. Geb anga sokalid: —Anmar Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse ambikunamar. Anmar Bab-Dummad-negse dogogu, yawagak edioed, ar ade emi-mutik be-oburgwedanimaloed.
Ar andi an abin-imakded: —An dule-wakinnedsuli. Dule-anyobmalad e-san-abonogega Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse gwen dukunaosulid. An dukuosulid.
Ar ade mag an daksad, Bab-Dummad Semaías-barmiarsulid. Ar we-dule deyob sogedi, Tobías, Sanbalatʼbo we-dule-binsaed-gasad, ar manigi baksad deyob sogegar.
Ar ade, Semaías manigi baklesad, adi, an-ogwayegar, an-oichogegar. Ade, Tobías, Sanbalat-ebo binsasmalad, deyobi an-imaksale, angi isdar sunmakmaloed, an-nug oichomaloed.
“An-Bab-Dummadye, Tobías, Sanbalatʼbo, na e-ibmar-imaksadi be ebinsao. Deginbali, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-bundor-Noadías, degi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-baigan, an-ogwayebi-gusmaladi be ebinsabalo.”
Jerusalén-neggwebur-e-galu-matusulid-soblenaidi, nii-Elulʼye-nugad iba-dulagwen-gakatargi bergusad. Galu-matusulidgi, iba-dulabo-gakambe-gakabo (52) nue egi arbalesad.
Anmar-isdarmalad itoarmargu, anmarde arbaed-obelosye, bela anmar-dikarba-dulamar-bukwad, dobe-itonadmalad. Bela amala na nug-bipii itonadmalad. Amar mag itosmalad, we-arbaed anmar-Bab-Dummad-sogedba imaklesad.
A-ibagangi, Judá-yargi dummaganga-mamaid, Tobíasʼga bukidar garda barmimai-gusmalad, degine, Tobíasʼmoga bukidar amarga garda barmimai-gusmogad.
Adega, bukidar-dummagan-Judá-yargi-mamaid Tobíasʼba nanaimalad. Ar ade, Tobías, Ara-machi-Secanías-e-sapinid. Degine, Tobías-machi-Johanán, Berequías-machi-Mesulam-sisgwa nikusad.
Deginbali, bukidar-dulemar Tobías-ibmar-nuegan-imaked an-asabin sognonidamalad. Geb degine, bela an ibmar-sogdaed, Tobíasʼga sogdapdamalad. Degine, Tobías yamo an-ogwayega, anse gardamar barmimai-gusad.
Jerusalén-galu-matusulid bela nudaklesgua, e-yawagakmar ogwichilesad. Geb e-yawagak-dakmalad onugsalesad, degi, dule-namakmalad onugsalesbalid, degi, Levita-dulemar amilesbalid.
Geb degine, an-urba-Hanani, Jerusalén-neggwebur-e-dummadga-megega an nugsasad. Degi, Hananíasʼdi, Jerusalénʼgi reyneg-siid-dakedga an nugsasad. Hananíasʼde, dule-napiragwadid, dule-baiganba bur bule Bab-Dummad-dobee nanadiid-duled. We-dulemar-warbogwadga an igar-uksad.
Amarga an sogsad: “Dad-nakwialile, Jerusalén-neggwebur-e-yawagakmar argadoed. Geb, dad-argwaned-idu, dule-yawagak-dakmalad amba arbananai, e-yawagakmar sakdiledoed, degi, be urgo iduar-mesoed nue edilegega. ”Deginbali, Jerusalénʼginmalad neggweburgi-nakulegega an onugsasad, amala gwenna-gwenna ega-soglesad bia nakulegoe, abala na e-neg-e-neg-asabin nakulemaloed.”
Jerusalén-neggweburde bipisursoggu, olloo-dakleged. Ar ade amba yoo negmar gannar soblesoggu, dulemar-ichee bukwad.
Geb degidgine, Bab-Dummad an-gwage ebusad, dule-dummagan, dule-nuga-nikamalad, degi, bela dulemar na e-gwenadgan-e-gwenadganba urbega, adi, e-dadgan-e-dadganba amar-ebisega. Geb agine, an garda amisad, dulemar an-idu-nonimalad-e-dadgan-nugmar narmakar-nanai. Agi, narmakar-naid:
Wemar, Babilonia-e-rey-Nabucodonosorʼse-galesa, Babiloniaʼse-selesmalad. Amar gannar Judá-yarse, degi, Jerusalén-neggweburse-nonimalad-e-nugmar narmakar-nai an dakalid. Wemar, na e-neggwebur-e-neggweburse gannar nonimalad:
Zorobabelʼba, Jesúaʼba, Nehemíasʼba, Azaríasʼba, Raamíasʼba, Nahamaniʼba nonimalad. Degine, Mardoqueoʼba, Bilsánʼba, Misperetʼba, Bigvaiʼba, Nehumʼba, degi, Baanaʼba nonimalad. Israel-dulemar gannar nonimalad, wemalad:
Paros-wagan, milibo gaka dulabaabak-gakambe-gakabo (2,172).
Sefatías-wagan, dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulapaa-gakambe-gakabo (372).
Ara-wagan, dulataled-ilanergwa gaka dulabo-gakambe-gakabo (652).
Pahat-Moab-wagan, a sogleged, Jesúa-waganye, degi, Joab-waganye, milibo gaka dulataled-ilabaabak gakambe-gakabaabak (2,818).
