Elam-wagan, miligwen gaka dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakambe-gakabake (1,254).
Zatu-wagan, dulataled-ilabaabak gaka dulabo-gakatar (845).
Zacai-wagan, dulataled-ilagugle gaka dulapaa (760).
Binúi-wagan, dulataled-ilanergwa gaka dulabo-gakabaabak (648).
Bebai-wagan, dulataled-ilanergwa gaka durgwen-gakabaabak (628).
Azgad-wagan, milibo gaka dulataled-ilapaa gaka durgwen-gakabo (2,322).
Adonicam-wagan, dulataled-ilanergwa gaka dulapaa-gakagugle (667).
Bigvai-wagan, milibo gaka dulapaa-gakagugle (2,067).
Adín-wagan, dulataled-ilanergwa gaka dulabo-gakambe-gakatar (655).
Ater-wagan, a sogleged, Ezequías-waganye, dulabake-gakambe-gakabaabak (98).
Hasum-wagan, dulataled-ilapaa gaka durgwen-gakabaabak (328).
Bezai-wagan, dulataled-ilapaa gaka durgwen-gakabake (324).
Harif-wagan, dulatar-gakambe-gakabo (112).
Gabaón-wagan, dulabake-gakambe-gakatar (95).
Belénʼginmalad, degi, Netofaʼginmalad, dulabakebak-gakabaabak (188).
Anatotʼginmalad, dulanergwa-gakabaabak (128).
Bet-Azmavetʼginmalad, dulabo-gakabo (42).
Quiriat-Jearimʼginmalad, Cafiraʼginmalad, degi, Beerotʼginmalad, dulataled-ilagugle gaka dulabo-gakapaa (743).
Ramá-neggweburginmalad, degi, Geba-neggweburginmalad, dulataled-ilanergwa gaka durgwen-gakagwensak (621).
Micmas-neggweburginmalad, dulanergwa-gakabo (122).
Betel-neggweburginmalad, degi, Hai-neggweburginmalad, dulanergwa-gakapaa (123).
Nebo-neggwebur-baidginmalad, dulabo-gakambe-gakabo (52).
Elam-baid-wagan, miligwen gaka dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakambe-gakabake (1,254).
Harim-wagan, dulataled-ilapaa gaka durgwen (320).
Jericó-wagan, dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulabo-gakatar (345).
Lod-wagan, Hadid-wagan, degi, Ono-wagan, dulataled-ilagugle gaka durgwen-gakagwensak (721).
Senaa-wagan, milipaa gaka dulataled-ilabakebak gaka durgwen-gakambe (3,930).
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-nonimalad, wemalad: Jedaía-wagan, Jesúa-gwenadgansikid, dulataled-ilabakebak gaka dulapaa-gakambe-gakapaa (973).
Imer-wagan, miligwen gaka dulabo-gakambe-gakabo (1,052).
Pasur-wagan, miligwen gaka dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakagugle (1,247).
Harim-wagan, miligwen gakambe-gakagugle (1,017).
Levita-dulemar, wemalad: Jesúa-wagan, degi, Cadmiel-wagan, amala, Hodavías-e-waganad, dulapaa-gakambe-gakabake (74) mergued.
Dule-namakmalad, wemalad: Asaf-wagan, dulagugle-gakabaabak (148).
Dule-yawagak-dakmalad, wemalad: Salum-wagan, Ater-wagan, Talmón-wagan, Acub-wagan, Hatita-wagan, degi, Sobai-wagan, dulanergwa-gakambe-gakabaabak (138).
Dule-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbamalad, wemalad: Ziha-wagan, Hasufa-wagan, Tabaot-wagan,
Queros-wagan, Siaha-wagan, Padón-wagan,
Lebana-wagan, Hagaba-wagan, Salmai-wagan,
Hanán-wagan, Gidel-wagan, Gahar-wagan,
Reaía-wagan, Rezín-wagan, Necoda-wagan,
Gazam-wagan, Uza-wagan, Paseah-wagan,
Besai-wagan, Mehunim-wagan, Nefisesim-wagan,
Bacbuc-wagan, Hacufa-wagan, Harhur-wagan,
Bazlut-wagan, Mehída-wagan, Harsa-wagan,
Barcos-wagan, Sísara-wagan, Tema-wagan,
Nezía-wagan, degine, Hatifa-wagan.
Salomón-maimar-wagan, wemalad: Sotai-wagan, Soferet-wagan, Perida-wagan,
Jaala-wagan, Darcón-wagan, Gidel-wagan,
Sefatías-wagan, Hatil-wagan, Poqueret-Hazebaim-wagan, Amón-wagan.
Dule Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbamalad, degi, Salomónʼga-arbamalad-wagan, dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulabake-gakambe-gakabo (392).
Baigandi: Tel-Melaʼgi, Tel-Harsaʼgi, Querubʼgi, Adónʼgi, degi, Imer-neggweburmargi noarmarmogad. Amarde, geg oyogusmalad, doamar e-dadganmala, degi, emar Israel-dulemar-gumarbardibe.
Amardi, wemardo: Delaía-wagan, Tobías-wagan, degi, Necoda-wagan, dulataled-ilanergwa gaka dulabo-gakabo (642).
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladmoga, geg oyogusmarmogad, emarde Israel-dulemar-gumardibe. Amardi, wemardo: Habaía-wagan, Cos-wagan, degi, Barzilai-wagan. Barzilai-wagwa-gwensakde, Barzilai-sisgwa-wargwen nikusad. We-Barzilaiʼde, Galaadʼginedid. Abali, na e-nug susad.
Wemala, na e-dadgan-nug amidmargu, amissurgusmalad. Degisoggu, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledga bar gussurmardo, ar ade, swilidikidsuryenik soglesad.
Degidgine, saila-dummadga-maid igar-uksamogad, we-dulemar melle Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-uklegaled gunnamaloye. Geb dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-wargwen Urimʼba, degi, Tumimʼba Bab-Dummadse-egisedse nabir we-dulemar mas-swilidikid gunmalodibe, surdibe.
Bela dulemar-danar, mili-dulabo-gakabo gaka dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulapaa (42,360) mergu ambikunonimalad.
Wemar-abargi, e-mai-machergan, degi, e-mai-omegan obarilenaisulid. Emarbi, miligugle gaka dulataled-ilapaa gaka durgwen-gakambe-gakagugle (7,337) mergued. E-namakmalad-machergan, degi, e-namakmalad-omegan, dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakatar (245) mergu nikad.
Molimar weyob mergued: Dulataled-ilagugle gaka dulagwen-gakambe-gakanergwa (736) mergu nikad. Moli-uaya-senigwadmardi, dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakatar (245) mergu nikad. Moli-yargan-muremaladdi, dulataled-ilabake gaka durgwen-gakambe-gakatar (435) mergued. Moli-uayasuiddi, milinergwa gaka dulataled-ilagugle gaka durgwen (6,720) mergumogad.
Bukidar babgan-na-neguya-sedimalad, Bab-Dummadga arbaed-imakega ibmar uksamalad. Jerusalén-neggweburgi dummadga-maid ibmar-uksad: Or-nibirambe-gakabakebak (19) uksad, nogmar gwadulabo-gakambe (50) uksabalid, degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-mor-yomalad, goadulataled-ilatar gaka dulagwen-gakambe (530) uksabalid.
Babgan-na-neguya-sedimalad, Bab-Dummadga weyob-arbaed-imakega ibmar-uksamarmogad: Or, nibir-dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulapaa-gakambe-gakatar (375) aidiku uksad. Mani, nibir-milibo gaka dulataled-ilagugle (2,700) aidiku uksabalid.
Dule-baiganmoga: Or, nibir-dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulapaa-gakambe-gakatar (375) aidiku uksamarmogad, Mani, nibir-milibo gaka dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakambe (2,250) aidiku uksamarbalid. Degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-mor-yomalad, goadulapaa-gakagugle (67) uksamarbalid.
Degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, Levita-dulemar, dule-yawagak-dakmalad, dule-namakmalad, dule-neggweburginmalad, dule-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbamalad, degi, bela Israel-dulemar, na e-neggwebur-e-neggweburse megnadmalad. Nii-walaguglegusgu (7), bela Israel-dulemar na e-neggwebur-e-neggweburgi bato mamaimalad.
Geb degidgine, bela dulemar na bulakwaa danar-ambikunonidamaladse ambikunonimalad. We-ambikuedde, Dii-Yawagak-Noedye-nugad-asabin naid. Dule-garda-narmaked-Esdrasʼye-nugadga, sogdemalad, Moisés-Igar-Mesisad-garda sedaye. We-Igarde, Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼba Israel-dulemarga uksa-gusad.
Nii-walagugled iba-onodedgine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Esdras, Bab-Dummad-Igar-narmakar-maid dulemar-bukwadse senonikid. Agi, machergan, omegan, degi, dulemar-baigan bela-nabir-mag-itomalad bukwamalad.
Esdras wakudaryalaba, yorukudse dulemar-ambikuedgi, dulemar-wagab, Dii-Yawagak-Noed-asabin garda absoded. Bela dulemar Bab-Dummad-Igar-gardagi-narmakar-maid nue-itobukwa gusmalad.
Dule-garda-narmaked-Esdrasʼde, urgo-aila-nibakwaa-soblealed-birgi gwichigusad, ar ade, agala urgo-sobsagusmalad. Esdras-dikarba: Matatías, Sema, Anías, Urías, Hilcías, degi, Maasías, e-argan-nuedsik gwichi-gusmalad. Esdras-e-argan-sapiledsikdi: Pedaías, Misael, Malquías, Hasum, Hasbadana, Zacarías, degi, Mesulam, gwichigusmarmogad.
Esdrasʼdi, dulemarba bur-nibakwaa gwichisoggu, dulemar bela Esdras-dakbukwa gusmalad. Esdras garda egadgu, dulemar bela gwisgusmalad, nue-boo ambikusmalad, adi, nuekwaa itomalagar.
Geb degidgine, Esdras, Bab-Jehová, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Dummad-nug-odummoded. Bela dulemar argan onakwidmargu, sogdemalad: “¡Ar deyobdo! ¡Ar deyobdo!” Agine, dulemar Bab-Jehová-nug-odummogega napase e-bebe-ebulegedse dulluu imakdemalad.
Levita-dulemar, dulemarga Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maid odulobukwa-gusmalad. We-Levita-dulemar-Igar-odulobukwadi, wemalad: Jesúa, Bani, Serebías, Jamín, Acub, Sabetai, Hodías, Maasías, Kelita, Azarías, Jozabed, Hanán, degi, Pelaía. Bela dulemardi na nue-itobukwa-gusmalad.
We-Levita-dulemar Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maid ise-nue-absoar imaknanai-gusmalad, degine, ise-nue-odulogar dulemarga imaksamalad, adi, ise-nue-magar itomalagar.
Geb degidgine, saila-dummad-Nehemías, degi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled, dule-garda-narmaked-Esdras, geb Levita-dulemar dulemarga-odulonanaid, dulemarga bela sogdemalad: “Emi-iba, anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-iba-islidikid. Degisoggu, melle be bukib-itomar, melle be bomar.” Ar ade, dule-Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maid-itobukmalad bela boedbimalad.
Degine, Nehemías sogded: “Bemar namar, mas-birigined be gunnamar, gobed-birigined be gobnamar. Degine, bemar mas-nikamalad, dule mas-satemaladga be ukmalo, ar ade, emi-iba anmar-Bab-Dummad-ibad. Melle be bukib-itomar, be wergumala, ar ade, Bab-Jehováʼgi-wergued, anmar-ogannogediid.”
Levita-dulemarmoga dulemar-baisur-itogega amarga sognanaimalad: “Melle be bukib-itomar, melle be bomar, ar ade, emi-iba, iba-islidikidid.”
Degisoggu, bela dulemar nue mag-itosmarsoggu, bela wergunadmalad, gobnadmalad, mas-gunnadmalad, degine, dulemar-mas-satemaladga mas uknadmalad. Ar ade, Bab-Dummad-Gardagi e-odurdaklesad nue-magar-itosmalad.
Banedgine, oibosgua, bela babgan na-neguya-sedimalad, degi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, degi, Levita-dulemar, Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maid-durdakmalaga dule-garda-narmaked-Esdrasʼse ambikunonimalad.
Israel-dulemar Bab-Dummad-Jehová Moisésʼba-Igar-Uksad, gardagi-narmakar-mai dakarmalad: “Israel-dulemar nii-walagugledgi, iba-onodedgi neg-matarganagi megmaloye.
Degine, bela neggwebur-iliba dule-baigan-owisomaloye, degi, Jerusalénʼgi owisomarbaloye, sogoye: ‘Be sapurba namar, olivo-sapi-anagan sedamaloye, olivo-sapurbalid-anagan, sapi-arrayánʼye-nugad-e-gagan-wawadikmalad sedamaloye, ogobgi-dakleged-gagan, degi, bela sapi-dummagan-gagan sedamaloye, adi, neg-matargwa-matargwa sobmalagarye, ar igi gardagi narmakar-naidba.’ ”
Degisoggu, dulemar sapi-anagan-amiega ainidsunnad, geb na senonimalad. Agi, neg-matargana sobsamalad. Gwenna-gwenna na e-neg-birgi neg-ollornaidgi sobsamalad, baiddi e-neg-imbagi, baiddi Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-imbagi sobsamalad, baiddi Dii-Yawagak-Noedye-nugad-asabin sobsamalad, baidmoga dulemar-danar-ambikuedgi sobsamalad, degi, baiddi Efraín-Yawagak-Noedye-nugad-asabin dulemar-danar-ambikuedgi neg-matargana sobsamalad.
Bela we-dulemar-gales-gusmalad-nonimaladi, neg-matargana sobsamalad. Geb a-neg-matarganagi megismalad. Ar Israel-dulemar weligwar-itosmalad, ar ade, Nun-machi-Josué-akale, we-ibasega Israel-dulemar weyob neg-matarganagi nue megdisurmalad. Degisoggu, bela-bela weligwaledgi iba-dummad onosmalad.
Esdrasʼde, gebe-iba-onoded-akar, Neg-Matargana-Iba-bergunaidse bane-bane dulemarga Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maid absosad. Ibagugle (7) Iba-onosmalad. Geb a-banedgine, bela-dulemar bulakwaa igar-sogmaidba Bab-Jehová-nug odummosmalad.
Nii-walagugled iba-durgwen-gakabakegi, Israel-dulemar na bular ambikunonimalad, adi, mas-gunsuli Bab-Dummadse-golega. Geb emar bela-bela bukib-itoged-oyogega, mor-sommed yosmalad, degi, e-nonogi buru eosmarbalid.
Israel-dulemar dule-baigangi bachikii ambikusmargua, gwichi na e-isgued Bab-Dummadga barsogdemalad, degi, e-dadgan-isgusad Bab-Dummadga barsogdemarbalid.
Deyob-gwichi, E-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Igar-Maid-garda wachi-ilapaa absosmalad. Geb baid-wachi-ilapaa, e-isgued e-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼga barsogsamarbalid, degi, baid-wachi-ilapaa, e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-nug odummosmarbalid.
Agine, Levita-dule: Jesúa, Bani, Cadmiel, Sebanías, Buni, Serebías, Bani, degi, Quenani, nibakwaa urgo-aila-soblealid-birgi nakwismalad. Agi, binnasuli e-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼse gotemalad.
Weyobi, Levita-dulemar: Jesúa, Cadmiel, Bani, Hasabnías, Serebías, Hodías, Sebanías, degi, Petaías sogdemalad: “Bemar gwisgumar. Bab-Jehová-gusgu-maiguad, degisadegu-maigubaloed, a-e-nug be odummomar. ‘Bab-Jehová, be-nug odummolesun. Bur bule be-nug-gandikidgi, nued binsaledii gusana yeerban, ibmar-baiganba bur bule be-nug odummolesana yeerban.
” ’Unnila bebi Bab-Jehová-gued. Nibneg be nasiksadid: Bela nibneg-naid ugakaase, bela e-niisgwamar ega be nasiksad. Be, be napneg nasiksabalid, degi, bela ibmarmar-bukwad be obinnisbalid. Deginbali, demar-nanaidi, degi, bela agi ibmarmar-bukwad be obinnisbalid. Bela we-ibmarmala dula-gued be imaksad. A-ulale, sordamar-nibnegginmalad bese gotemalad, bela-belad be-nug-odummomalad.
” ’Be, Bab-Dummad-Jehová-gued. Be, be Abram-susad. Be, Abram Caldea-dulemar-neggwebur-Urʼgi be onosad. A-dulega be nug-ogwasad, Abrahamʼye be onugsasad.
Be, Abraham-e-gwage-ulub be daksad, nue-inniki beba nanadii guo be daksad. A-ulale, Abraham-ebogwa be igar-mesisad, e-waganga we-yarmar ukoye be sogsad: Canaán-dulemar-yar, Het-dulemar-yar, Amorreo-dulemar-yar, Ferezeo-dulemar-yar, Jebuseo-dulemar-yar, degi, Gergeseo-dulemar-yar. We-yarmar, Abraham-waganga ukoye be sogsad. Bab-Dummad, be-ibmar-sogsad be imaksad. Ar ade, be dule-innikigwadid.
” ’Anmar-dadgan-Egipto-yargi-wilebukwa-gusadi, be daksad. Demar-Ginnidye-nugad-gakaba bese binnasur gotemargu, be itosad.
Be, be ibmar-gegerdaklemaladi, degi, ibmar-dakledisurmaladi Faraónʼgi be imaksad. Faraón-e-dummagangi, degine, bela Egipto-yargi-dule-bukmaladgi be imaksabalid. Ar ade, Egipto-dulemar be-dulamargi na-san dummarba-itogedba, gandikidgine-ibmar-imaksamalad be daksad. A-ulale, emi-ibadse, be-nug dummarba gued.
Israel-dulemar-wagab, demar negabar be egasad. A-demar-abargi, Israel-dulemar neg-dinnagwadgi obaksagusmalad. Ar Israel-dulemar-baregindanimaladdi, dii-ulakse be egwachad, igi akwa dii-ulakse egwalleddaedyob be imaksad.
Ibgine, mogir-bubawaryob-gwichidba be semai-gusad. Mutikdi, soo-bubawaryob-gwichid-gwabunyemaidba be semai-gusad, adi, igar-namaloedba, ega neg-mee imakegar.
” ’Sinaí-yarse be aidenonigusad, Israel-dulemarga nibneg-akar be sunmaksad. Igar-innikimalad, igar-napiramalad ega be uksa-gusad. Igar-Mesisad, igarmar-be-anmarga-sogsad, ber nuegan-gued.
Israel-dulemarga be sogsagusad, obunnoged-iba-islidikidgi be obunnomaloye. Beba-nanadiid-Moisésʼba, be igarmar-sogsadi, igarmar-be-mesisadi, degine, Igar-Maidi be uksad.
” ’Madu-nibneggined Israel-dulemarga be uksad. A-madugine be Israel-dulemar oimmosad. E-uku-uku-itoged-osulogega, akwa-dummadgi ega be dii onosad. Ega be sogsagusad, bemar yar-suegala na be a-yarse-dognamarye. Ega be ise-sogar sogsagusad, an bega we-yar ukedseye, a-yar ega be uksad.
” ’Ar anmar-dadgandi, na san-dummarba imaksamalad. Be-Igar-Mamaidba ibsassurmalad.
Anmar-dadgan yapa be-ito gusmalad. Degine, ibmar-dakledisulid-ega-be-imaksadi, gwen ebinsassurmalad. Ar be-itossurmarsoggu, amar begi-yoledmalad. Geb na e-dummad-amismalad, adi, gannar Egiptoʼse na maiga-wiledii gunamalagar. Degi-inigwele, Bab-Dummad, bedi amargi bangussulid. Ar Bab-Dummad, bedi dule-wiledaked maid. Bedi sabedgi igar-nudaked, dule-wiledakedba sabedgi be ibmar imaked. Be wissur gwae-gwae sae-itodaed. Be-sabgueddi bur dummarba gued. A-ular, be-dulamar, be iessulid.
” ’Ar moli-bebe-nikad-sapingwagwad-orbiid na ega imaksagua, na sogsamalad: We, anmar-bab-dummad-dake, Egipto-yargi anmar-onosmalad-dake. Anmar-dadgan begi bela-bela yolesmargua, begi nue-dummad-nosmalad.
Bab-Dummad, ar be-sabgued bur-dummarbasoggu, nega-dulesulidgangi gwen be-dulamar be metesulid. ” ’Mogir-bubawaryob-gwichid igarba e-idumai-guega, ibginedba gwen egi aibachasulid, degine, mutikidba mogir-bubawaryob-gwabunne-gwichid gwen egi aibachasurbalid, adi, emar igar-namaloedba ega igar-mee imakegar.
” ’Bab-Dummad, Be-Burba-Nued be-dulamarga be barmialid, adi, inniki amar-odurdakegar. Be madu-maná ega ukmai-gusadi, gwen ega be osulossulid, degine, uku-uku-itogedgi ega be dii ukmai-gusad.
Birga-dulabo (40) nega-dulesulidganba Israel-dulemar-akwedii be gusad. Emarga gwen ibmarmar akussulid. E-mormala gwen nungussulid. Degine, e-nagmar gwen engussurbalid.
” ’Neggwebur-dummagan, ega be uksad, dule-baigan-bukwad-yarmar ega be uksabalid. Bela negmar bachik-bachik ega be uksa-gusad. Hesbón-yala susagusmalad, a-yar, Rey-Sehón-yarga gusanad. Degine, Basán-yala be uksagusbalid. A-yar, Rey-Og-yarga gusanad.
Israel-dulemarga mimmigan be omelos gusad. Niisgwamar-nibneggi-nanaidyob, ega be omelosad. Be napa ukoye, e-dadganga ise-sogar-sogsadse be amar-sesa gusad.
Geb e-mimmigan a-yalagi ubos-gusmalad, degine, a-yala egadga gunonikid. Canaán-dulemar-a-yargi-bukwamalad, be, Israel-dulemar-wagab ibgwensuli be imaksad. Israel-dulemarga a-dulemar be urmaksa-gusad. Amba e-reymar, degi, dulemar-a-yargi-bukwad Israel-dulemarga be urmaksa-gusad. Adi, Israel-dulemar na igi we-dulemar-imakbimala, deyob imakega.
Neggweburmar-nue-sakdigar-siid susagusmalad. Napa-gadi-ibmar-sanmakmalad susagusmarbalid. Negmar ibmar-nuegan-ena-bukwad egadga-gunoni gusmalad. Diamar-soblearbukwad, uvaʼmar-digar-nanaid, olivo-nainumar, degine, sapi-durgan akar-akarmalad, bela na egadga gunoni gusmalad. Nue guchamalad, nue immediki gusmalad, degi, nue wardungus gusmarbalid. Degine, nued-egi be binsasadgi, nue-wergus gusmalad.
” ’Ega be ibmar-nueganbi imaksa-inigwele, degite, be-sogedba dassurmalad, begi gwisgusmalad. Be-Igar-Maid obacha gusmalad, be-gayaburba-barsogmaladi gannar be-igarba-nanaega ega sunmaksamalanad, emide, oburgwis gusmalad. ¡Anmar-dadgan bela-belad be-nug oichosmalad!
A-ulale, e-isdarmaladga be urmakde gussunnad. Amar, anmar-dadgan-nue-wiosmalad. Anmar-dadgan nue wile-itobukmaladgi bese gotegusmalad. Bedi nibneg-akar amar-itosad. Degine, be sabgued-dummarba-nikadba, be-dulamar-wilebukwadgi-onogegala, ega be dule-barmimai gusad, adi, anmar-dadgan-isdarmaladgi emar-bendakegar.
Anmar-dadgan, gales-bukwadgi ollorgunonimalale, gannar be-asabin isguddamalad. Degidgine, e-isdarmaladga be urmakdedasunnad, amarse wilebukwa guddamalad. Anmar-dadgan gannar bese binnasuli gotedamalad. Bedi nibneg-akar amar-itodaed. Be sabgued-dummarba-nikadba, an-dadgan gannar-gannar be abonomai gusad.
Ega be sogsanad, be-Igar-Maidba be damarye. Ar anmar-dadgandi, na san-dummarba imaksamalad. Ega be-Igarmar-Uksadba gwen ibsassurmalad, ar Be-Igarmar-Mamaidgi bur annadmalad. Dule-be-Igar-Mamaidba-nanamaladdi, dula be imaked. Anmar-babgan begi nosmalad, uaya-sate-daedba be-obachamalad. Binsaed-sate gusmalad, be-itobi gussurmalad.
” ’Epennegwa, be anmar-dadgangi gwae-gwae urwedii gussulid. Bedi, be-Burbaba be-gayaburba-barsogmaladga sunmaksad, adi, anmar-dadganga be ibmar-sogegar. Ar degite, gwen be-itossurmalad. A-ulale, anmar-dadgan be dulemar-baigan-we-napneggi-bukmaladga be urmaksa gusad.
Degi-inigwele, ar be-sabgued dummarba-gusoggu, be anmar-dadgan-obelossulid, degine, wargwen be metesurbalid, Bab-Dummad, ar ade bede-sabedgi igar-nudaked, nue-wile be dule-daked.
” ’Emigindi, anmar-Bab-Dummad, bedi, Bab-Dummad-bur-dummadid, bur-dutusulidid, bela dulemardi, be-dobdaed. Bab-Dummad, bedi, dule-napiragwadid, dulemarbo be igar-mesisale, be imakedse-daed, degine, be anmar-sabgumaiguad. Bab-Dummadye, be-asabin anmar dummad-wilediid. Degisoggu, anmar-reymar, anmar-saila-dummagan, anmarga-dule-irwa-bese-gormalad-wilediid, melle be baisursunna dako. Degine, anmarga-be-gayaburba-barsogmalad, anmar-babgan, degi, bela be-dulamar, Asiria-reymar-maigusad-akar, emi-ibadse nue-wilediidi, melle be baisursunna dako.
Bela-anmargi-ibmar-gusmaladi, igar-innikigwadba be imaksad. Ar bedi dule-innikigwadba be ibmar-imaked, ar anmardi begi nue-dummad nosmalad.
Anmar-reymar, anmar-saila-dummagan, anmar-irwa-bese-gormalad, anmar-babgan, Be-Igar-Maidba nanassurmalad. Amarde, Be-Igar-Mamaid itossurmalad, degine, iduakwaa be owisonai-gusadi gwen itossurmarbalid.
Bab-Dummadye, amar-negsemaigu, ibmar-nuegan ega be uksad. Anmar-babganga be yar-dummad gadi-ibmar-sanmaked-yala be uksagu, degite, bese gochasurmalad, degine, igar-isgana-imakdimalad gwen metesurmarbalid.
” ’A-ulale, emi anmar maiga-gusa-bukwamalad. Anmar-dadganga be yala-uksadgi, anmar maiga-gusa-bukwamalad. We-yala anmar-dadganga be uksanad, e-ibmar-sanmaked-gunmalagar, bela ibmar-agi-nikadi gunmalagar.
Emigindi, we-napagi ibmar-sanmakedde, bela reymarga uklemaid. We-reymarde, anmar-dummadga be onugsanonikid. Anmar-isgusadba we-reymar anmar-dummadga gunonikid. We-reymarde, gangued nikasoggu, na e-ibmar-imakbiedba anmargi, degi, anmar-ibdurgangi imakdedamalad. Emide, anmar nue-bukib itobukmarsunnad.’ ”
Israel-dummagan Bab-Dummadse gotebalid: “Bela wemar-ulale, anmar ise-sogar sogbukmalad, anmarde imakedseye, degine, anmar narmakar messundo. A-ulale, anmar-saila-dummagan, anmar-Levita-dulemar, degi, anmar-irwa-bese-gormalad, we-garda-anmar-narmaksadgi anmar-dummagan-e-goo-burba omeslesundo.”
Dulemar gardagi e-goo-burba-mesismalad, wemalad: Saila-dummad-Nehemías Hacalías-e-machi, degi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, wemalad:
Sedequías, Seraías, Azarías, Jeremías,
Pasur, Amarías, Malquías,
Hatús, Sebanías, Maluc,
Harim, Meremot, Obadías,
Daniel, Ginetón, Baruc,
Mesulam, Abías, Mijamín,
Maazías, Bilgai, degine, Semaías. Amala, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad gumalad.
Geb degine, Levita-dulemardi, wemalad: Azanías-machi-Jesúa, Henadad-e-wagwa-gwensak Binúi.
Cadmiel. Cadmiel-e-gwenadgan: Sebanías, Hodías, Kelita, Pelaías, Hanán,
Micaía, Rehob, Hasabías,
Zacur, Serebías, Sebanías,
Hodías, Bani, degine, Beninu.
Neggwebur-e-dummagan goo-burba-mesismaladdi, wemalad: Paros, Pahat-Moab, Elam, Zatu, Bani,
Buni, Azgad, Bebai,
Adonías, Bigvai, Adín,
Ater, Ezequías, Azur,
Hodías, Hasum, Bezai,
Harif, Anatot, Nebai,
Magpías, Mesulam, Hezir,
Mesezabeel, Sadoc, Jadúa,
Pelatías, Hanán, Anaías,
Oseas, Hananías, Hasub,
Halohes, Pilha, Sobec,
Rehum, Hasabna, Maasías,
Ahías, Hanán, Anán,
Maluc, Harim, degine, Baana.
Degine, dule-baigan: Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, Levita-dulemar, dule-yawagak-dakmalad, dule-namakmalad, dule-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbamalad. Degi, bela Israel-dulemar Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba nanamalaga, dule-Judíoʼsurmaladgi-aibachamaladi, degi, e-omemala, e-masmala, e-bunamala, degine, bela dule-mag-neg-itomalad.
Amala, na e-gwenadgan-e-gwenadganba, e-dummaganmala ambikunonimalad, adi, ise-sogar sogega, emarde Bab-Dummad-Moisésʼba-Igar-uksa-gusadba damaloye. Degine, emarde Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba, Igar-uksadba, degi, e-igar-sogsadba nanamaloye.
A-ukinbali, anmar sogsabalid: “Anmar-sisgan dule-yar-baid-baidginedga anmar ukosurye, degine, anmar-masmalaga anmar a-sisgan-ukosurmarbarye.
”Deginbali, dulemar-yar-baid-baidginmalad, obunnoged-ibagi ibmarmar-ukdanikir, igi mas-ukdanidibe, anmar a-ibagi ibmar ese bakosurye. Ibamar-islidikidgi ibmar-ukdanidibe, anmar ese ibmar-bakosurmarye.” Deginbali, anmar sogsabalid: “Birgagugle-irba (7) anmar nainumargi gwen arbaosurmarye. Dule anmargi ibmar-ganikile, bar anmarga muchub ukosurmarye.”
A-ukinbali, anmar sogsamarbalid: “Birga-ilibali, Bab-Dummadse-goled-negga mani-bipi-uklegoye (4 gramos), adi, a-manigi Bab-Dummadse-goled-negga ibmar-abelesiid bakegar.
”Adi, a-manigi: Bab-Dummadga bane-bane-madu-ukleged bakega, ega ibmar-gwag-ukleged, degine, bane-bane ibmar-durgan-ogumakar-ukleged bakegar. ”Degine, a-manigi obunnoged-ibagi Bab-Dummadga ibmar-ukleged, nii-binidgi ibmar-ukleged, degi, iba-dummagangi ibmar-ukleged, Bab-Dummadga ibmar-islidik-ukleged bakegarbar. Degine, Israel-dulemar-isgusad-eliegala, Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-uklegoed bakega, degi, bela ibmarmar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-ebulemalad, bakegarbar.
”Deginbali, anmarbali dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, Levita-dulemar, degi, dule-neggweburginmalad, anmar-gwenad-gwenadganba na wilubdaknai-guarmalad, adi, wisguega doamar-e-gwenadgan-inse, birgagi igar-megisadba Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-uklegedgi-sapan-ebuleged, Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼse-goled-negse sedagodibeye, adi, Bab-Dummad-Igargi igar-narmakar-maidba, Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ukleged-ailagi ogalegegar.”
A-ukinbali, anmar sogsamarbalid: “Birga-irba, anmar-nainugi gebe-ibmar-sanmakmalad, degine, bela sapi-e-san-gebe-sanmakmalad, Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼse-goled-negse sedagoye.
”Deyobbardo, Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maidba anmar-masmala-gebe-gwalulemaladi Babga-arbaega ukoye, degine, ibmar-durgan anmar Bab-Dummadga ukbaloye. Anmar-moli-bebe-nikamalad, degi, sibad-wawaad-mimmi-gebegwalulemaladi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbananaimaladse sedmaloye.”
Deginbali, anmar sogmarbalid: “Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ibmar-sabolegedse gebe-madubur-imakleged sedmaloye. Bab-Dummadga ibmar-gwag-ukleged, bela sapi-san, vinoʼmar, olivo-gwallumar, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladse sedmaloye. Degine, anmar-nainugi bela ibmar-welegoed anmar Levita-dulemarga sedoye, degine, anmar na neggweburgi-ibmar-welegoed, we-Levita-dulemarga ambegi gwensak (10%) uklegoed. Wemarde na ambegi gwensak-weemaladid.
”Levita-dulemar ibmar-ambegi gwensak (10%) weenadele, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-wargwen Aarón-e-wagwa, eba naoye. Levita-dulemar, ibmar-ambegi gwensak-wesad (10%), anmar-Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse sedoed, adi, ibmar-sabolegedgi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi sabogegar.
”Israel-dulemar, degi, Levita-dulemar, Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-gwag-uklesadi, vinoʼmar, degine, olivo-gwallu-uklesad, ibmar-sabolemalad-negse sedoed. Degine, Bab-Dummadga ibmar-uklemalad-ebulemalad a-neggi ambikuoed, degi, agine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-arbananaid, degi, dule-yawagak-dakmalad, degi, dule-namakmalad, agi bukwa-gumarmogoed.” Deginbali, anmar sogsabalid: “Anmar-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg anmar gwen iegosurmarye.”
Dulemar-neggweburgi-dummaganga-gudidimalad Jerusalén-neggweburgi megnonimalad. Ar Jerusalén-neggwebur, neggwebur-swilidikid-gued. Degi, dulemar-baigandi, na wilubdaknanai-guarmalad, doa-dule, dule-e-ambegine gwensak (10%) Jerusalén-neggwebur-islidikidse megnamaloe, degine, baigan-walabakebakaddi (9) e-neggwebur-baiganse megnamaloed.
Bela-dulemar na dukin-dukin sogsamalad, emarde Jerusalén-neggweburgi megmaloye. A-ular, Israel-dulemar nue-yeer a-dulemargi binsasmalad.
Dulemar Judá-yar-neggwebur-baigangi na e-nainu-nainugi-megismaladi, degi, na e-neggwebur-e-neggweburgi-megismaladi, wemar-dake: Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, Levita-dulemar, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-dule-arbamalad, degi, Salomón-maigan-e-wagan. Israel-yar-e-dummaganga-gudimaladi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi megismalad.
Amala, abala Judá-waganad, degi, abala Benjamín-waganmogad. Judá-wagandi, wemalad: Uzías-machi-Ataías. Uzíasʼde, Zacarías-machid. Zacaríasʼdi, Amarías-machid. Amaríasʼdi, Sefatías-machid. Sefatíasʼdi, Mahalaleel-machid. Mahalaleelʼdi, Fares-wagwad.
Degine, Baruc-machi-Maasías, Barucʼde, Colhoze-machid. Colhozeʼdi, Hazaías-machid. Hazaíasʼdi, Adaías-machid. Adaíasʼdi, Joiarib-machid. Joiaribʼdi, Zacarías-machid. Zacaríasʼdi, Siloni-machid.
Bela Fares-wagan, Jerusalén-neggweburgi dulataled-ilabake gaka dulapaa-gakabaabak (468) mergu megismalad. Bela wemala, bila-onomalad-sorda-gumalad.
Benjamín-wagan Jerusalénʼgi megismaladi, wemalad: Mesulam-machi-Salú, Mesulamʼde, Joed-machid. Joedʼdi, Pedaías-machid. Pedaíasʼdi, Colaías-machid. Colaíasʼdi, Maasías-machid. Maasíasʼdi, Itiel-machid. Itielʼdi, Jesaías-machid.
Degine, Jesaías-gwenadgan-gargwenmaladdi, Gabai, degi, Salai, bela amarse-bakale, dulataled-ilabakebak gaka dulagwen-gakabaabak (928) mergumalad.
Zicri-machi-Joel, wemar-e-dummadga gued. Degine, Senúa-machi-Judá, dummad-sorbali Jerusalén-neggweburgi negdakedmogad.
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladdi, wemalad: Joiarib-machi-Jedaías, Jaquín,
Hilcías-machi-Seraías. Hilcíasʼde, Mesulam-machid. Mesulamʼdi, Sadoc-machid. Sadocʼdi, Meraiot-machid. Meraiotʼdi, Ahitob-machid. We-Ahitobʼde, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-e-dummadid.
Degine, bela e-gwenadgan Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbananaid, dulataled-ilabaabak gaka dulagwen-gakabo (822) mergued. Deyobi, Jeroham-machi-Adaías, Jerusalénʼgi megismogad. Jerohamʼde, Pelalías-machid. Pelalíasʼdi, Amsi-machid. Amsiʼdi, Zacarías-machid. Zacaríasʼdi, Pasur-machid. Pasurʼdi, Malquías-machid.
Degine, Adaías-gwenadgan, e-neg-yaurgi na negsedimalad, bela dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakabo (242) mergue megismarmogad. Deginbali, Azareel-machi-Amasai, megismogad, Azareelʼde, Azai-machid. Azaiʼdi, Mesilemot-machid. Mesilemotʼdi, Imer-machid.
Degine, Amasai-gwenadgan, dule-gala-ibeganad, bela dulanergwa-gakabaabak (128) mergued. Gedolim-machi-Zabdiel amar-dummadga-gued.
Levita-dulemardi, wemalad: Hasub-machi-Semaías, Hasubʼde, Azricam-machid. Azricamʼdi, Hasabías-machid. Hasabíasʼdi, Buni-machid.
Sabetai, Jozabadʼbo, megismarmogad. Wemar, Levita-dulemar-e-dummagan-gumalad, degi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-magabalid-soblenaid, e-dummaganga-gumalad.
Micaía-machi-Matanías, a-dule-namaked-e-iduedid. Bab-Dummadse-goter, a-inse Bab-Dummad-nug ogannoddaed, degi, dog-nuedye Bab-Dummadga sogdedaed. Micaíaʼde, Zabdi-machid. Zabdiʼdi, Asaf-machid. Degi, Bacbuquías Matanías-sorbalidi, Jerusalénʼgi megismogad. Degi, Samúa-machi-Abda, Samúaʼde, Galal-machid. Galalʼdi, Jedutún-machid.
Bela Levita-dulemala, Jerusalén-neggwebur-islidikidgi, dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabake-gakabake (284) mergue megismalad.
Yawagak-dakmaladdi, wemalad: Acub, Talmón, degine, e-urbamar. Wemala, yawagakgi-nakulemaladid. Amar, dulabaabak-gakambe-gakabo (172) bela mergumalad.
Geb Israel-dulemar-baigandi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-baigandi, degi, Levita-dulemar-baigandi, Judá-yargi baigan-neggweburmargi, na e-nainu-e-nainugi mamai-gusmalad.
Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbamaladdi, Ofel-yargi megismalad. Ziha, degi, Gispa, amar, amar-dummadga gusmalad.
Bani-machi-Uzi Jerusalén-neggweburgi, Levita-dulemar-e-dummadid. Baniʼde, Hasabías-machid. Hasabíasʼdi, Matanías-machid. Mataníasʼdi, Micaía-machid. We-Micaíaʼde, Asaf-wagwa-gwensakadid. Wemarde, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi dule-namakmalad-gumalad.
Ar ade, rey igar-uksagusad, degi, bane-bane dule-namakmalad igarmar-mamaidba ibmar imakmaloed.
Rey, e-nuggi Mesezabeel-machi-Petaías bela-dulemarga-igar-nabogegala, onug-imaksad. Mesazabeelʼde, Zera-wagwa-gwensakad-gued. Zeraʼde, Judá-wagwa-gumogad.
Israel-dulemar-baigandi, Judá-yargi neggwebur-dummagangi, degi, e-neggwebur-burwigangi megismalad. A-neggweburmardi, wemalad: Quiriat-Arba-neggwebur, Dibón-neggwebur, Jecabseel-neggwebur.
Jesúa-neggwebur, Molada-neggwebur, Bet-Pelet-neggwebur.
Hazar-Sual-neggwebur, Beerseba-neggwebur,
Siclag-neggwebur, Mecona-neggwebur,
En-Rimón-neggwebur, Zora-neggwebur, Jarmut-neggwebur,
Zanoa-neggwebur, Adulam-neggwebur, Laquis-neggwebur, Azeca-neggwebur. Beerseba-neggwebur-akar, Hinom-nebase ambikusmalad.
Benjamín-wagandi we-neggweburmargi ambikusmalad: Geba-neggweburgi, Micmas-neggweburgi, Aía-neggweburgi, Betelʼgi, degi, e-neggwebur-burwigangi ambikusmalad.
Neggwebur-baigan, wemarbalid: Anatot-neggwebur, Nob-neggwebur, Ananías-neggwebur,
Hazor-neggwebur, Ramá-neggwebur, Gitaim-neggwebur,
Hadid-neggwebur, Seboim-neggwebur, Nebalat-neggwebur.
Lod-neggwebur, Ono-neggwebur, degi, Argangi-Ibmar-Sobmalad-Nebagi ambikusmalad.
Levita-dulemar gwen-gwena Judá-yargi megismalad, degine, Benjamín-dulemarba megismarbalid.
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladi, degi, Levita-dulemar, Salatiel-machi-Zorobabelʼba, degi, Jesúaʼba nonigusmalad. Amarde, wemalad: Seraías, Jeremías, Esdras,
Amarías, Maluc, Hatús,
Secanías, Rehum, Meremot,
Iddo, Gineto, Abías,
Mijamín, Maadías, Bilga,
Semaías, Joiarib, Jedaías,
Salú, Amoc, Hilcías, degi, Jedaías. Amala, Jesúa-ibagangi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degi, e-gwenadgan-gumalad.
Levita-dulemardi, wemalad: Jesúa, Binúi, Cadmiel, Serebías, Judá, degi, Matanías. Amala, na e-gwenadganmala Bab-Dummad-nug-ogannogedgi namakmalad.
Degine, e-gwenadgan-Bacbuquías, degi Uni, amar-asabin ambikunonidamalad, Bab-Dummad-nug-odummomalagar.
Jesúa-wagan, wemalad: Jesúaʼde, Joiacim-babad. Joiacimʼdi, Eliasib-babad. Eliasibʼdi, Joiada-babad.
Joiadaʼdi, Jonatán-babad. Jonatánʼdi, Jadúa-babad.
Joiacim negdakmaigu, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad e-neg-yaurgi dummaganga gudimalad. Amarde, wemalad: Seraías-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Meraías. Jeremías-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Hananías.
Esdras-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Mesulam. Amarías-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Johanán.
Melicú-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Jonatán. Sebanías-gwenadgan-e-dummad, José.
Harim-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Adna. Meraiot-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Helcai.
Iddo-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Zacarías. Ginetón-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Mesulam.
Abías-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Zicri. Miniamín-gwenadgan, Moadías-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Piltai.
Bilga-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Samúa. Semaías-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Jonatán.
Joiarib-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Matenai. Jedaías-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Uzi.
Salai-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Calai. Amoc-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Eber.
Hilcías-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Hasabías. Jedaías-gwenadgan-e-dummad, Natanael.
Levita-dulemar-neguya-sedimaladi, degi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-neguya-sedimaladi, Eliasib-ibagangi, Joiada-ibagangi, Johanán-ibagangi, degi, Jadúa-ibagangi, Persa-dule-Rey-Darío negdakmaigu, we-dummagan-nug garda-selemaidgi narmaklesad.
Eliasib-machi-Johanán-maigusad-ibase, Levita-dulemar-neguya-dummaganga-gumalad-e-nugmar garda-selemaidgi narmaklesad.
Levita-dulemar-neguya-dummagana, wemalad: Hasabías, Serebías, Cadmiel-machi-Jesúa. Amar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbaega egad-wachi-omosale, na e-gwenadgan, e-asabin ambikunonidamalad, adi, Bab-Dummad-nug-odummomalagar, degi, Bab-Dummadga dog-nuedye sogmalagar, ar igi David Bab-Dummadga-arbaed-dule, igar-mesisadba.
Yawagak-dakmalad, wemalad: Matanías, Bacbuquías, Obadías, Mesulam, Talmón, degi, Acub. Deginbali, amala, yawagak-dogedgi ibmarmar-saboleged-negmargi nakulebukwa-gusmarbalid.
Bela amala, Jesúa-machi-Joiacim-ibagangi gudii gusmalad. Joacimʼde, Josadac-wagwad. Degine, amar Nehemías-Saila-Dummadga-maigusad-ibagangi, degi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-ibagangi gudii gusmalad. Degine, dule-garda-narmaked Esdrasʼye-nugad-ibagangi gudii gusmarbalid.
Jerusalén-galu-matusulid-ogulesadi Bab-Dummadga nug-imaklesokargua, Levita-dulemar-banna-banna-mamaid bela amiapmalad. Geb Jerusalén-neggweburse amar-searmalad, adi, weligwaledba Bab-Dummadga galu-nug-imaklenaidgi werguegar, ega dog-nuedye namaklegedgi sogega, degi, garmar-címbaloʼba, salterioʼba, degine, cítaraʼba Bab-nug-odummogega.
Degidgine, Levita-dule-namakmalad, Jerusalén-neggwebur-dikarba-mamaidi, degi, Netofa-neggwebur-dikarba neggwebur-burwiganagi-mamaid bela nonimalad.
Deginbali, Gilgal-neggweburginmalad, Geba-neggweburginmalad, degi, Azmavet-neggweburginmalad nonimarmogad. Ar ade, dule-namakmalad Jerusalén-neggwebur-dikarba neggwebur-burwigana sobsamalad.
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, degi, Levita-dulemar, bela na san-uruksamalad. Geb a-sorbali, dulemarga san-uruksamarmogad. Degi, yawagakmar, degi, galu-matusulid swilidik-imaksamarbalid.
Ani, Nehemías, Judá-saila-dummagan Jerusalén-galu-matusulidgi-nakwega an imaksad. Degine, ichesur dule-namakmalad danabo an urbisad. Adi, amar galu-matusulid-birgi namakale Bab-Dummadga dog-nuedye sogegar. Danagwenad-soggwenaddi, galu-matusulid-argan-nuedsik, Ibmar-Isgana-Mied-Yawagak-Noedsik ilekwaa nadapgusmalad.
Wemar-sorbali, Osaías Judá-saila-dummaganmala ilekwaa nadapgusmarmogad. Amala, wemalad:
Azarías, Esdras, Mesulam,
Judá, Benjamín, Semaías, degi, Jeremías.
Amarba, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, gar-trompeta sedanigusmaladi, wemalad: Jonatán-machi-Zacarías. Jonatánʼde, Semaías-machid. Semaíasʼdi, Matanías-machid. Mataníasʼdi, Micaías-machid. Micaíasʼdi, Zacur-machid. Zacurʼdi, Asaf-machid.
Zacarías-e-gwenadgandi, wemalad: Semaías, Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Natanael, Judá, degi, Hanani. Wemala, Bab-Dummadga-arbaed-David-igar-mesisadba gar-ogormalad semamai gusad. Degine, dule-garda-narmaked-Esdras, we-dulemar-idumai gusad.
Dii-Saila-Yawagak-Noed-innikgusgu, David-neggweburse-doged-arsan-maidgi nakwide-gusmalad, galu-matusulidse-nakwileged-birgi nakwide gusmalad. Geb David-neg-niba-nasmargu, Dii-Yawagak-Noedse, dad-nakwedsik modapmalad.
Dule-namakmalad-danabogwaddi, obakar nadapgusmarmogad. Ani, an a-sorba, degi, dulemar-neggweburginmalad-negabaladbo galu-matusulid-birgi, neg-matusur-warakwagwad-Soo-Yaaye-nugad-akar, Galu-Matusulid-Matardummadse, anmar nadapgusmalad.
Anmar Efraín-Yawagak-Noedgi nasmalad, Yawagak-Sered-Noedgi, Ua-Yawagak-Noedgi nasmalad. Geb neg-suid-Hananeelʼye-nugadgi, degi, neg-suid-Hameaʼye-nugadgi nasmarbalid. Sibad-Wawaad-Yawagak-Noedgi nasmargu, geb Esgarya-Yawagak-Noedse anmar ambikudapmalad.
Geb degidgine, dule-namakmalad-danabogwadi Bab-Dummadga dog-nuedye-sogsamargu, Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse modapmalad. Geb e-gwisgudapmaloedgi gwisgudapmalad. An deyob dummagan-abargi anba-gudimalad-abargi gwisgudapmogad.
Degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, gar-trompeta ogorgwismalad, wemalad: Eliacim, Maaseías, Miniamín, Micaías, Elioenai, Zacarías, Hananías,
Maasías, Semaías, Eleazar, Uzi, Johanán, Malquías, Elam, degi, Ezer. Dule-namakmaladdi, binnasuli ise-namakar bukwa-gusmalad, Izrahías amar-idu gwichi gusad.
A-ibagine, Bab-Dummadga ichesuli ibmar-ogumakar uksamalad. Degine, ar Bab-Dummad, nue-weligwale amar-imaksasoggu, nue wergusmalad. Omegan, degi, burwigana nue wergusmarmogad. Jerusalén-neggweburgi-wergubukmalad dikasuli itolesad.
A-ibagine, dulemar-onugsalesad: Mani-weleged-daked, Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-weleged-daked, ibmar-gebe-welemalad-ukleged-daked, ambegi-gwensak (10%) ibmar-ukleged-daked. We-dulemar-onugsalesmalad ibmarmar nainu-baid-baidgi neggwebur-dikarbarmaladgi-danikidi, ibmar-sabomalad-neggi sabomalaga. Adi, Igar-Maidba dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladga, degi, Levita-dulemarga ibmar-ukegar. Ar ade, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, degi, Levita-dulemar ibmar-nuegan-imaknanaidgi Judá-yargi-bukmalad ber weligwar-itosmalad.
Dule-nugsalesmaladi, Bab-Dummadga-arbaedgi arbananai gusmalad, degi, dule-isgusmalad-anar Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged imaknanai gusmalad. Amba deyob, dule-namakmalad, degi, dule-yawagak-dakmalad eba arbananai gusmarmogad, ar igi David, degi, e-machi-Salomón igar-uksadba.
Ar ade, dikasurgus, David-akar, degi, Asaf-akar, bato dule-namakmalad-e-idued-nika danikid. Bab-Dummadga-namakleged-namakmalad-nika danibalid, degi, Bab-Dummadga-dog-nuedye-sogdimalad-nika danibalid.
Degine, Zorobabel-ibagangi, degi, Nehemías-ibagangi, bela Israel-dulemala, dule-namakmaladga, dule-yawagak-dakmaladga mas ukdamalad. Degine, amarga ibmar-uklemalad na e-iba-maidgi ega ukdedamalad. Deginbali, amba Levita-dulemarga deyob ibmar-ukdamarbalid. Geb, we-Levita-dulemar, Aarón-waganga ukdedamarmogad.
A-ibagangine, Moisés-garda-narmaksad dulemarga absolesad. Agi, weyob narmakar-nai daklealid: “Amón-dulemar, degi, Moab-dulemar bipisaale Bab-Dummad-dulamarga guosurye.
Ar ade, we-dulemar Israel-dulemar-Egipto-yar-akar-danimargua, gwen dii ega uksasurmalad, degi, mas ega uksasurmarbalid. Aka bur Balaam-bennuksamalad, adi, Balaam Israel-dulemar-ukabsaega. Ar anmar-Bab-Dummaddi we-ukabsalegedi, ibmar-nued-guega imaksad.”
Dulemar bela Igar-Maid-absolesad itosmargua, dulemar Israel-dulesulid onismalad.
We-iduale, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Eliasib, Babse-goled-neggi ibmar-sabolemalad-neg-dakedga maid. Ar Eliasibʼde, Tobías-ai-nuedsoggu,
gabedneg-dummad-gwagwen Tobíasʼga uksad. A-gabedneggine, ibmarmar Bab-Dummadga-ukleged urbileged: Agine, ina-wawadikmaladi, bormomar-Bab-Dummad-neggi-ebulegedi, ibmar-gwagmar-uklemaladi, vinoʼmar, olivo-gwallumar urbileged. Bela we-ibmarmar ambegi-gwensak (10%) Levita-dulemarga-uklegedi, dule-namakmaladga-uklegedi, dule-yawagak-dakmaladga-uklegedi, degi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladga-uklegedi, a-neggi urbileged.
Weyob ibmar-gusgua, deunni Jerusalén-neggweburgi an gudisulid, ar ade, Babilonia-rey-Artajerjes birga-dulagwen-gakambe-gakabogus (32) negdakmaidgi, an rey-maidse nadegusad. A-ibagan-undar-nasadgi, reyse an egichisad, wis Jerusalénʼse gannar an nabiye.
Agi, geb an wisgunonikid, Eliasibʼde, nue-dummad-nosa. Tobías-nabir-ito-imakegala, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ega gabedneg-gwagwen uksad.
We-ibmar-gusadi, nue-sae an itosad. A-ulale, Tobías-neggi bela ibmarmar-bukwadi magaba ibe mie-mie an imaksad.
Geb degine, neg-swilidik-imakegala, an neg-nudaksad. Deginbali, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-ibmarmar-ebulemalad gannar sedagega, an imaksabalid. Bab-Dummadga ibmar-gwag-uklemalad, degi, ina-wawadikmalad gannar sedagega, an imaksabalid.
Deginbali, an wisgusbalid, Levita-dulemarga-ibmar-uklegedi gwen ega uklemaisurye. Degine, an wisgusbalid, Levita-dulemar, degi, dule-namakmalad na e-nainu-nainuse arbanadmarbarye.
Geb degine, dummaganga apor ibmar an sogded: “¿Wede ibiga Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg olloo mellesii?” A-sorbali, a-dummagan gannar an urbisad, ega e-arbaed-e-arbaed an uksad.
Geb degidgine, bela Judá-dulemar ibmar-sabolemalad-negse ibmar-gwag-welesad, vino, degi, olivo-gwallu ambegi gwensak (10%) senonimalad.
Ibmar-sabolemalad-neg-dakega, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Selemías, dule-garda-narmaked-Sadoc, degi, Levita-dule-Pedaías, an nug-imaksad. Wemar-bendakegala Zacur-machi-Hanán, an ega nug-imaksad. Hanánʼde, Matanías-wagwad. Ar amarde, dule-innikii-ibmar-imakmaladid. We-dulemala e-bakamaladga na ibmar mimimaloed.
Ani, Nehemías, Bab-Jehováʼse an goted: “An-Bab-Dummadye, we-ibmar-imaksad-ulale, melle be an-iego, degi, be angi nued-binsao, bese-goled-neggi ibmar-nuegan be-nug-odummogega an imaksadi, melle be iegoye.”
A-ibagangine, Judá-yargi an daksabalid, dule gwenna-gwenna obunnoged-ibagi uva-egurnanai. Baigandi, moli-uayasuid-birgi orosgi-dakleged-trigo senadapi. Deginbali, vinoʼmar, uvaʼmar, higoʼmar, degi, ibmar-baigan-akar-akar obunnoged-ibagi Jerusalén-neggweburse moli-uayasuidgi sedanimala an daksabalid. Manigi mas-uksamalad-ulale, we-dulemarse an ulusad.
Deginbali, Tiro-dorgan-Jerusalénʼgi-mamaimalad obunnoged-ibagi, ua, degi, ibmar-uklemalad-baigan manigi-ukega Jerusalén-neggweburse sedanidamalad. Degine, obunnoged-ibagi Judá-dulemarga, we-ibmarmala manigi ukdedamalad.
Geb degine, Judá-dulemarse binnasuli an uluded, amarga an sogded: “Ar bemar nue-isgunanaid, ¿obunnoged-iba-naid be daksurmarsi?
Ar be-babgan weyob ibmar-imaksamarmogad. Ar a-ulale, anmar-Bab-Dummad anmargi, degi, anmar-neggweburgi we-ibmar-isganamar barmialid. Degite, ¿Bab-Dummad gatik bur bule sabsur anmar-odurdakbi be abemarde? Emide, obunnoged-iba-naid be daksurmalad.”
Geb agine, an igar-uksad, Jerusalén-neggwebur-yawagakmar obunnoged-iba-iduar, sedogusar edimaloye. Geb obunnoged-iba-sorba a-yawagakmar gannar egalegoye. Geb degine, gwenna-gwenna dule-anga-arbamalad, yawagakgi an urbisad, adi, melle obunnoged-ibagi Jerusalén-neggweburgi ibmar-oubomalagar.
Dule-mani-onomalad, dule-ibmar-galagwensuli-ukmalad, Jerusalén-neggwebur-magaba irgwen, irbodibe, gabismalad.
Ar ani, Nehemías, apor amarga ibmar an sogded: “Melle galu-matusulid-dikarba be ambikumala. Ar gannar be nonibalile, an esgaryagi bemar-metoed.” A-ibagan-akale, bar obunnoged-ibagi nonisurmalad.
Geb Levita-dulemarga an sogded, bemar na san-uruknamar, bemar yawagak edarbenamar, adi, obunnoged-iba swilidik-guegar. Ani, Nehemías, Bab-Jehováʼse an gotebalid: “An-Bab-Dummadye, we-ibmar-imaksad-ulale, melle be an-iego, degi, be sabgued-dummarba-nikadba, wile be an-dakoye.”
Degine, a-ibagangine an daksabalid, Judío-dulemar Asdod-dorgan-sisgan nikumamai, Amón-dulemar-sisgan, degine, Moab-dulemar-e-sisgan nikumamai an daksad.
Abala e-mimmigan Asdodʼgaya sunmakmalad, degine, dule-baigan-gayaba sunmakmarbalid. Ar ade, Judío-gayadi sunmaksurmalad.
Degidgine, a-dulemarbo an ulusad, amar an ukabsasad, amar an gwenna-gwenna bibyosad, amar-ibe an e-sailagia-unnusad. Degine, amar anga-ise-sogar-sogega an imaksad. Ega an sogsad: “Melle bemar Judíoʼsurmalad-masmalaga be-sisgan-ukmaloye, degi, a-e-sisgan melle bemar be-masmalaga ukmarbaloye, degi, bemar a-e-sisgan amba nikuosurmarmoye an sogsad.
¿Ar a-ulale, Salomón Israel-e-reyde, Bab-Dummadgi isgussursi? Ar ade, yar-baigangine, Rey-Salomónʼyobid dule maigussulid. Bab-Dummad we-rey nue-sabgusad, Israel-reyga-guega imaksad. Degi-inigwele, omegan-Israelʼginsurmalad we-rey-isguega imaksad.
¿Ar degite, bemar deyob isgumarmogode? ¿Bab-Dummadgi bemarde dummad-nomarmogode? ¿Bemarde omegan-Israel-dulesurmalad-nikumarmogode? Adi surbali.”
Joiada-machi-wargwen, Sanbalat-sisgwa nikusad. Joiadaʼde, Eliasib-machid. Eliasibʼdi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-dummadid. Sanbalatʼde, Horón-neggweburginedid. Degisoggu, a-dule, an ononnosad.
Ani, Nehemías, Bab-Dummadse an gotebalid: “An-Bab-Dummadye, a-dulemar be insao. Wemarde, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-igar-ichomaladid. Wemarde, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad igar-mamaid bisgemaladid, degine, Levita-dulemar-igargi annamaladid.”
Degisoggu, bela Judíoʼsurmalad an ononnosad. Degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, degi, Levita-dulemar danar-danar an urbisad. Amarga na e-arbamaloed-e-arbamaloed an uksad.
Amba dulemar sapan na e-ibagangi amimaloed, deyob an urbisbalid. Degine, dule ibmar-gebe-sanmakmalad Bab-Dummadga-ukleged-dakmaloed, amba deyob an urbisbalid. Ani, Nehemías, Bab-Dummadse an gotebalid: “An-Bab-Dummadye, melle an-iego, nued be angi binsaoye.”
Rey-Asuero yarmar-sogadulanergwa-gakaguglegi (127) reyga-mai gusad. We-yarde, India-yar-akar, Etiopía-yalase dungued.
A-ibagangine, Rey-Asuero, Susa-neggweburgi e-ologana sinonikid. Degisoggu, Susa-akale, Rey-Asuero na yarmar-semai gusad.
Rey-Asuero birgapaagus reyga-maidgine, bela dummagan-sordamar-idudimaladga, degi, ega-arbamaladga iba-ononai gusad. A-iba-onolenaidse, Persia-yargi, degi, Media-yargi sordamar-idudimalad-bur-dummagan, igar-nabomalad-e-dummagan, degi, yar-baid-baidgi dummaganga-mamaid arbimalad.
Rey-Asuero, nii-walanergwa (6) na e-ibmar-nuegan-bukidar nikad, degi, bela-bela e-negsemaid-dungued, e-gangued-nikad oyonai gusad.
A-ibagan nasad-sorbali, Rey-Asuero iba-baid ibagugle (7) ononai gusbalid. We-ibade, bela Susa-neggweburgi dulemar-bukwamaladga, dulemar-nug-dummarba-nikamaladga, degi, dulemar-binsarmaladga ononai gusad. We-iba reyneg-imba-ollornaidgi onolesad.
Reyneg-imbagi atued-dummad-sibu, atued-dummad-arad, degi, gwili-absargiid naigusad. We-atued-dummagan, lino-dub-nuegangi, degi, suir-akwagiid-dubgi, atinnar naid. We-dubmar, mani-orokwagwad-yaa-simaladgi-odogar-odogar maid, geb mármol-akwa-buarmargi atinnar naid. Deginbali, gan-megmalad-ologi-sobaled, manigi-sobaled bukbalid. We-gan-megmalad napa-mármol-akwabiid-birgi, napa-dimmur-birgi, degi, napa-akwa-yeerdaklemalad-birgi bukwad.
Nog-dummagan-olobiid-akar-akar-sobarmaladgi rey-e-vino mimilenai gusad. We-vino obinebaka goblenai gusad, ar ade, rey ibmar-obinebaka-ukedid.
Degi-inigwele, rey na e-neggi-arbamaladga igar-uksagusad, vino-gobega melle dulemargi alamaknai gumalo. Dulemar na gobbiedba gobmaloed.
Rey-ome-Vastiʼdi, dummagan-e-omeganga Rey-Asuero-neggi iba-ononai gusmogad.
Ibaguglegus (7) iba-nonaidgine, Rey-Asuero vino-gobedba bela-bela weligwar itoded. Geb degine, dulemar-walagugle-e-walik-arbamaladse (7) gochad: Mehumánʼse, Biztaʼse, Harbonaʼse, Bigtaʼse, Abagtaʼse, Zetarʼse, degi, Carcasʼse gochad.
Geb Rey-Asuero wemarga igar-uksad, e-asabin e-ome-Vasti ologurgin-yoi sedamarye. Adi, dulemar, degi, dule-dummagan, Vasti bela-bela-e-yeerdakleged dakmalagar. Ar rey-omede bela-bela yeerdakleged.
Ar dulemar-rey-walik-arbamalad rey-ome-Vastiʼga rey-igar-uksad sogdapmargu, Vastiʼdi, Rey-Asueroʼse yapa-nae gusad. Degisoggu, Rey-Asuero bela-bela sae-itonaded, uluded.
Geb Rey-Asuero, dule-igar-wismaladse egisnai gualid, ibu imakergebe. Ar ade, gusgu igar-maid, rey dulemar-nue-igar-wismaladse binsaed-egised.
We-dule-igar-wismalad bur rey-walikamalad, wemalad: Carsena, Setar, Admata, Tarsis, Meres, Marsena, degi, Memucán. We-dulemar-walagugled (7), Persia-yar-e-dummaganad, degi, Media-yar-e-dummaganad. Wemala, reyga binsaed-dakmaladid, deginbali, Rey-Asuero-yargi dummaganga gudimarbalid.
Geb Rey-Asuero we-dulemarse egichided: —Igar-maidbali, ¿an-ome-Vasti, igi imaklegergebe? Ar ade, an-gayaburba-berbemaladba an ega igar-uksagusadba gwen ibsassulid.
Geb degine, Memucán, reyga, degi, dule-dummaganga sogdesunnad: —Rey-ome-Vasti, unnila reyginbi dodossulid. Ar belagwable dule-dummagan-bukwadgi dodosad, degi, Rey-Asuero-yarmargi bela-dulemar-bukwadgi dodosbalid.
Ar bela omegan-bamalad rey-ome-weyob-ibmar-imaksad wisgumaloed, degisoggu, omegan e-suimargi bar binsaed-nikaa guosurmalad. Ar ade, sogdamaloed: ‘Rey-Asuero na e-ome-Vasti ese sedamalaga imaksanad, ar e-omedi gwen ese arbisulid.’
Ar Persa-dummagan-e-omegan, degi, Media-dummagan-e-omegan rey-ome-weyob-ibmar-imaksad wisguarmalale, ar deyopira e-suimar-abin-imakdemarmogoed. Geb degine, omegan na e-sui-ibgwensur-imakdagoed. Geb agi, urwed nodasunnoed.
”Degisoggu, Rey-Asuero, na be yeer-itogele, be igar uksundo. We-igar Persa-dulemarga, degi, Media-dulemarga geg-bar-gwage weyob igar-narmakar-mai guoed: ‘Rey-Asueroʼse mer e-ome-Vasti bar dagoye.’ Rey-Asuero, ome-baid Vastiʼba-bur-nueddaed rey-omega-guega be amie.
Bela-we-yar-dummad-naidgi rey-igar-uksad wisguarmalale, bela omegan na e-suimargi binsaed-nikaa nadmaloed. Belagwable dummagan-e-omegan, degi, dule-binsarmalad-e-omeganse-bakale, na e-suimargi binsaed-nikaa damaloed.”
Weyob ibmar-soglesadi Rey-Asuero, degi, e-dummagan-negdakmamaid yeer-itosmalad. Degisoggu, rey, Memucán-ibmar-sogsadba ibmar imaksad.
Rey bela e-yar-naidgi neggweburmar-bukmaladse na e-gwabinduku-akar-akar-sunmakmaladba gardamar narmakar barmisad. We-gardagine igar uklenaid, bela machergan e-negyaurgine negsedii gumaloye. Degine, e-dulemar-e-gwabinduku-sunmakedba we-garda ainioed.
We-ibmar-gusad-sorbali, Rey-Asuero na sae-itodiid baisur-itogusadgine, e-ome-Vasti ebinsaalid, igi e-omede neg-imaksagusa, degi, igi e-omega igar megis gusbali.
Geb degine, Rey-Asuero-bendakdimalad, degi, e-dule-dummagan sogdemalad: “Reyga yagan-yoo-sui-nikumalad yeerdaklemalad aminamala.
Rey-Asuero, bela be-yar-dakmaidgine, bela-neggwebur-iliba be dulemar-onugsae, adi, wemala yagan-yoo-sui-nikumalad-yeerdaklemalad Susa-neggweburse, rey-omegan-negmar-siidse sedamalagar. Geb a-neggine, Hegai we-yagan-akoed. Hegaiʼde, bur-rey-walikagwadid, rey-omegan-edarbedid. Geb Hegai, we-yaganga yeerdaklegega-wagargi-ibmar-maglemalad ukoed.
Geb rey, yagwa-bur-yeerdakleged, Vasti-anar e-omega suoed.” Weyob-soglesadi, Rey-Asuero yeer-itosad. Geb deyob ibmar-imakmalaga igar uksad.
Susa-neggweburgi, reyneg-siidgine, Judío-dule-wargwen, Jair-machi-Mardoqueoʼye-nugad gudiid. Jairʼde, Simei-e-machid. Simeiʼdi, Quis-e-machid. Quisʼdi, dad-dummad-Benjamínʼgi danikid.
Mardoqueo dulemar-galesgusmaladba Jerusalén-neggweburgi seleargusad. We-dulemar, Judá-e-rey-Jeconíasʼmala Babilonia-Rey-Nabucodonosorʼse gales selesgusmalad.
Mardoqueo, e-sia-wargwen na e-ibe-sergan-burgwisad odungusad. E-babgan-burgwisgua, Mardoqueo na-e-bunoloyob susad. We-yagwa Hadasaʼye-nugad, deginbali, Esterʼye nugbalid. Ester bunagwa-nued-itoged, bela-bela yeerdakleged.
Rey-igar-mesisad wisgusmargua, yagan-bukidar Susa-neggweburse, reynegse selenonimalad. Agi, Hegai we-yagan-akwenonikid. Ester, we-yagan-abargine reynegse selenonimogad. Agi Hegai. Ester-akwisad. Hegaiʼde, rey-e-omegan-edarbedga gudiid.
Hegai, Ester-yeerdaksad, degi, nued daksabalid. A-ulale, Hegai, Esterʼga yeerdaklegega-wagargi-ibmar-maglemalad yoga-ukar imaksad. Bur mas-nuegan ega uksabalid. Deginbali, Hegai Esterʼga-ibmar-imakmalaga reyneggi-yagan-bur-nuegan-gudidiid walagugle (7) uksabalid. Geb Ester we-yagan-walagugledmala (7) rey-e-omegan-neg-bur-nuedse selesad.
Ester na sogsasulid ede bialidi, degi, doamar e-gwenadgan gubali. Ar ade, Mardoqueo ega sogsagusad: “Melle be-dulemargi, degi, be-sergangi be sunmakoye.”
Mardoqueoʼdi, bane-bane rey-e-omegan-neg-bukwad-asabin nasdaed. Adi, na wisguega, Ester nued gudiidibeye, igi imakdimardibeye.
Yagan reyse-daged-iduale, birgagwen igar-maidba yeerdaklegega-ibmar-ebulemalad magdidii gumaloed. Nii-walanergwa (6) sapi-mirra-e-gwalluginbi abagan-magdii gumaloed. Geb baid nii-walanergwa (6), gwallu-wawadikmalad-bur-yeer-yapanmaladgi, degi, ina-wawadikmalad-bur-nuegangi abagan-magdii gumarbaloed. Geb a-ibamar-sorbali, we-yagan war-wargwen Rey-Asueroʼse nonimaloed.
Yagwa-wargwen reyse dagsokalile, bela rey-e-omegan-neggi ibmar-sedbied ega ukledaed. Geb we-ibmar-yoi reynegse naddamalad.
Neg-sedogusale, yagan war-wargwen reynegse naddamalad. Geb banedgine, omegan neg-baidsik barmilesdaed. A-neggi, Saasgaz neg-akwediid. Ar we-dulede, a-neggi rey-omegan edarbediid. Geb a-sorbali, we-omegan bar gannar reyse nonisurdamalad. Ar rey na biti-ome-wargwen gannar dakbierdi, degi, ese gornamalaga imaksale, unnila aginbi a-ome gannar reyse nonidaed.
Mardoqueo-e-gilor-Abihail-e-sisgwa-Esterʼga, Rey-Asueroʼse naed-e-ibagan-warmaknonigua, rey-omegan-edarbed-Hegai, ibi ibmar-ese-egisoye ega sogsagusa, unnila a-ibmarbi Ester, Hegaiʼse egichisad. Bela dulemar Ester-walik-gudimaladi yeer Ester-dakmalad.
Rey-Asuero birgaguglegus reyga-maidgi, a-nii-ambe-gwichidgi, Ester, rey-asabin-gwisgunaega reynegse selesad. A-nii Tebetʼye-bilebalid.
Rey-Asuero, omegan-bamaladba bur bela-bela Ester-abesad. Yagan-bamaladba bur Esterʼbina nue-soge itosad. Degisoggu, Rey-Asuero, Ester-nonogi ologurgin sisad, geb Vasti-anar Rey-omega Ester-sunonikid.
Geb sorbali, Rey-Asuero e-dummagan-negdakmamaidga, degi, ega arbamaladga, Ester-nuggi iba-dummad onosad. Rey-Asuero bela e-yarmar-dakmaidgi mani-uklegergebed bipi-imaksad. Deginbali, rey na yeer-itogedba ibmarmar obinebaka binsa-uknai gusbalid.
Yagan-suisurmalad gannar rey-omegan-negse selenonimargua, Mardoqueoʼdi, reyneg-yawagakgi neg-daksii gusad.
Ester, Mardoqueo ega igar-uksadba sogsasulid doamar e-sergana, degi, ede bialidbali. Ar Ester, Mardoqueo-walik-gudiunni igi eba ibsadae, deyobi, Mardoqueo-sogedba ibmar imaksad.
Mardoqueo reyneg-yawagak-naba-sigu, Bigtán, degi, Teres sunmake itoalid. We-dulemardi, dummagan-warbogwad reyneg-yawagakgi-nakulemaladid. We-dulemar nue-sae-itogedgine, Rey-Asuero-oburgwega igar-aminanaid.
Mardoqueo we-dulemar weyob sunmaknai itosgu, Rey-ome-Esterʼga we-gayaburba ogwasad. Agine, Esterʼmoga Mardoqueo-nuggi reyga we-gayaburba ogwasmogad.
A-ulale, Rey-Asuero we-gayaburba-baraminai gualid, wede bule nabiri. Geb baramisgu, daklealid, we-gayaburba nue-napiragwa. Degisoggu, we-dule-ebogwad-dummagan dukargi-galegar burgwismalad. Geb bela we-ibmar-gusadi, rey-wagab rey-gardamargi narmakles megisad.
Weyob ibmar-gusad-sorbali, Rey-Asuero, Hamedata-machi-Amán-nug odummononikid. Hamedataʼde, Agag-duled. Rey-Asuero, bela dule-dummagan-negdakmamaidba bur-dummadga Amán-onugsasad.
Bela reyneggi-arbamalad-yawagakgi-gwismaladi, Amán-asabin yokorgi-sindigar sigisdamalad, deginbali, e-asabin dulluu imakdamarbalid. Ar deyobi, Rey-Asuero igar-uksagusad. Mardoqueoʼdi, Amán-asabin gwen yokorgi-sindigar sigdisulid, deginbali, gwen dulluu e-asabin imakdisurbalid.
Geb degine, reyneggi-arbamalad-yawagakgi-gwismaladi, Mardoqueoʼse egichismalad: “¿Ibiga be, rey-igar-uksadba ibsasuli?”
We-dulemar bane-bane degibi ese egisdii gusmalad, ar Mardoqueoʼdi, gwen eba ibsassulid. A-ulale, Amánʼga, Mardoqueo-barsogsamalad, adi, dakega, Mardoqueoʼde, na emarga ibmar-sogsagusad bule Amánʼga sogmogodibeye. Ar ade, Mardoqueo we-dulemarga sogsagusad, an Judío-duleye.
Amán dakalid, Mardoqueo gwen e-asabin yokorgi sindigar sigsuli, degi, gwen e-asabin dulluu imaksurbali, agi, sae-itoded.
Ar ade, Amánʼga bato sogsamarsoggu Mardoqueoʼde, Judío-duleye. A-ulale, Amán unnila Mardoqueo-oburgwedginbi binsassulid, bela Mardoqueo-e-dulemar-obelobi gusad. Amán bela Judíoʼmar Rey-Asuero-yar-semaidgi-bukwamalad-obelogega na igar-amisad.
Rey-Asuero birgambe-gakabogus reyga-maidgine, gebe nii-yolededgi, nii-Nisánʼye nugadgi, Amán-wagab ibmar-Purʼye-nugadgi dodoar-wilubdaksamalad. Weyob-dodoarwilubdaksamalad, adi, dakega, Amán-igar-amisadi ibu-niigi, degi, ibi-ibagi imaklegoe. Geb agine, nii-warambe-gakabogi, nii-Adarʼye nugadgi, Amán-igar-amisad-imaklegega iba nagunonikid.
Geb degine, Amán Rey-Asueroʼga sogded: —Bela be-yarmar-dakmaid-abargine, dulemar-soggwen mimiles-bukwad. Amardi, dulemar-bamaladba na igar akar nikamalad, deginbali, rey-igar-maidba ibsasurmarbalid. Degisoggu, dummad, ar be we-dulemar dula-gudii imakele, ibu-ibmar-nued egi be nikuosunna. Sate.
Rey, we-ibmar na be yeer-itogele, we-dulemar-oberguegala be igar-messundo. Ar andina talento-mani-miliambe (10,000), be-mani-dakmaladga an ukoed, adi, rey-mani-sabomalad-neggi we-manimar odogegar.
Geb degine, Rey-Asuero e-olargan unnusad. We-olargangine e-wilub naid. We-wilub oyonaid e-gangued nikad. Geb rey olargan Agag-dule-Hamedata-machi-Amánʼga uksad. Amánʼde, Judíoʼmar e-isdaradid.
Geb rey, Amánʼga sogded: —Be we-mani-uknaidi na be sue. Ar be we-dulemar igi imakbie, deyob be imakdo.
Gebe-nii-yoleded ibambe-gakapaagine reyga-garda-narmakmaladse gorlesad. Ar igi Amán igar-uksagusa, deyobi garda narmaklesad. We-garda we-dulemarse narmaklesad: Reyga-dummagan-negdakmamaid-Sátrapaʼmarye-nugmaladse, dummagan-yarmar-dakmamaidse, degi, bela neggweburmargi dummaganga-gudimaladse. We-gardamar bela dulemar-galagwensuli akar-akar e-gwabinduku-sunmakmaladba narmaklesad. We-gardamar Rey-Asuero-nuggi, degi, e-olargan-wilub-nai narmaklesad.
Geb sorbali, we-gardamar bela Rey-Asuero-yarmar-dakmaidse garda-berbemaladba barmilesad. We-gardagi weyob igar-uklenaid: “Ibagwen-dummad bela Judío-dulemar: Sergan, sapingan, omegan, degi, burwiganase-bakale, oburgwemaloye, deginbali, e-ibe ibmar sumarbaloye. Nii-warambe-gakabogwad ibambe-gakapaagwadgi, weyob ibmar-guoye soglesad. Nii-warambe-gakabogwadde, nii-Adarʼye nugad.”
We-igar-megisad garda-bamaladse-ogwalesadi bela yar-iliba gardamar mimilesad, adi, dulemar-owisogega, iba-sulesadgi guagwar gudii samaloye.
Rey-sogedba gardamar-berbemalad gwae nadmalad. Deginbali, we-igar-megisadi, Susa-neggweburgi, bia rey-negsemaidgi mimilesbalid. Ar Rey-Asuero, Amán-ebo vino gobbukwadgine, Susa-neggweburgine neg-gagalenai gusad.
Mardoqueo bela we-ibmar wisgusgua, wile-itogedba na-mor-yoid esirmaksad. Geb sagumor-sommed yosad. E-nonogi buru eosbalid, geb galimbaba neggweburgi ise-boar binnasur-gornadapi gusad.
Deyobi, Mardoqueo reyneg-yawagakse mosad. Reynegyabardi dogsasurgusad, ar ade, dule sagumor-sommed-yoi reynegyaba-doged igar maisulid.
Bela neggweburmar-bukwadgi Rey-Asuero-e-igar-uksad-wisgusmargua, Judío-dulemar bela-bela wile-itodmalad, bar mas-guchasurmalad, ise-boar gudii gusmalad, degi, gwage-nunmaked-dummad itodii gusmalad. Bukidar Judíoʼmar sagumor-sommed-yoi buru-birgi megismalad.
Rey-ome-Esterʼga yagan-arbamalad, degi, machergan-egi-nakulemalad, bela we-ibmar-gunaid Esterʼga sogsamalad. Ester we-ibmar-itosgua, nunmaked-dummad itononimogad. Geb degine, Mardoqueoʼga mormar barmisad, adi, Mardoqueo sagumor-sommed-yoid-anar, we-mormar yoegar. Degi-inigwele, Mardoqueoʼdi, we-mormar yapa yoe gusad.
Geb degine, Ester, machered-egi-nakuleged-Hatacʼse gochad. Geb Hatacʼga igar uksad, adi, Mardoqueo-daknaega, degi, Mardoqueoʼse egisega igi neg-gunai, deginbali, ese egisbaliga, ibiga be deyob gudiiye.
Degisoggu, Hatac, Mardoqueo-daknadsunnad. Mardoqueoʼdi, neg-ollornaidgi, dulemar-ambikuedgi, reyneg-yawagak-asabin siid.
Mardoqueo, Hatacʼga bela neg-gunaid sogsad. Deginbali, ega sogsabalid, igi Amán, Judío-dulemar-obelogega rey-mani-gamaladga mani uknai.
Geb Mardoqueo, Hatacʼga Susa-neggweburgi gardamar-mimilesadi, uksabalid. A-gardagi, Judío-dulemar-obelogedgi sunmaknaid. Geb Mardoqueo, Hatacʼga sogsad: “We-garda Esterʼga oyogoye, degi, bela ega ibmar-guoed sogbaloye.” Mardoqueo, Hatacʼga sogsabalid: “Esterʼga be sogoye: ‘Be Rey-Asuero-daknaoye, adi, reyse be wilesagwa egisegarye, mer Judío-dulemar oburgweye.’ ”
Hatac gannar Esterʼse nonikid. Geb bela Esterʼga Mardoqueo ega ibmar-sogsad sognonikid.
Geb degine, Ester gannar Hatac-barmisad, adi, Mardoqueoʼga weyob sogega:
“Bela reyga-arbamalad, degi, bela dule-rey-e-neggweburmargi-bukwamalad igar-maid wismalad. Ar dule-machereddibe, omedibe, rey-ese-gochasuli rey-dakega reyneg-imbagi dogsadibe, a-dule oburgwilegoye. Ar rey na e-olo-gaapoled a-dulegi oyosardi, we-dule bendaklegoye, bar oburgwilegosurye.” Ester sogdebalid: “Ar bato iba-dulagwen-gakambe-gusad (30), Rey-Asuero anbo-sunmakega bar anse gorsulid.”
Hatac, Ester-ega-ibmar-sogsadi Mardoqueoʼga sogdapid.
Geb Mardoqueo, Esterʼse gannar Hatac-barmisad, adi, Esterʼga weyob sogega: “Mer be binsaoye: ‘Ar andi reyneggi-maisoggu, andi bendaklegoye, andi Judío-dulemarba burgosurye.’
Ar emi-ibagi, be sunmaksurdibe, baidsik Judío-dulemar-bendakleged danikoed. Ar bedi, degi, be-gwenadgan bela burgwemaloed. An ebinsagu, be we-ibmar-gunaidgi be-dulemar-bendakega, be rey-omega gunonikid.”
Geb degine, Ester weyob Mardoqueo-abin-imaksad:
“Bela-Judío-dulemar Susa-neggweburgi-gudimalad be onmaknae, adi, an-ular mas-gunsuli gudii gumalagar. Ibapaa mer mas gunmalo, degi, mer gobmarbalo. Ar andi anga-yagan-arbamaladmala bemaryob mas-gunsuli gudii gumarmogoed. A-sorbali, ar amba yogasaar-reyse-naed-igar-maisur-inigwele, andi reyse naoed. ¡Ar a-ular, an-oburgwebimalale, an-oburgwemalodo!”
Geb degine, Mardoqueo, Ester-bela-ega-ibmar-sogsadba ibmar imaksad.
Ibapaagine, Ester, rey-omegan-mor-yoed na yosad. Geb Ester reyneg-imbase, Rey-Asuero neg-obunnoged-asabin gwisgudapid. We-neg-obunnogedgi, Rey e-ologangi, yawagak-doged-asabin siid.
Geb Rey-Asuero, e-ome-Ester neg-imbagi-gwichi-dakargua, yeer itoded. Geb e-olo-gaapoled-ganikid Esterʼsik oyosad. Geb degine, Ester rey-walikaa nonikid, agine, Ester rey-e-olo-gaapoled-e-duku ebusad.
Rey-Asuero, Esterʼse egichided: —Ester, ¿Igi be itoge? ¿Ibu be abege? ¡Be anse an-yar-naid-negabar amba egisele, an bega uksaled!
Geb Ester abin-sogded: —Dummad-Rey, be nabir itodibe, emi an bega masgunned-iba-onosokalidse, be, Amánʼbo be dagbi an be-abedo.
Geb rey ega-arbamaladga sogded: —Gwae be Amán-aminamala, adi, anmar Ester-masgunned-iba-onosokalidse naegar. Degisoggu, Rey-Asuero, Amánʼbo Ester-masgunned-iba-ononaidse nadmalad.
Geb Rey-Asuero vino gobsigu, gannar Esterʼse egisded: —Be anga soge, ibu be abege, an bega ukoed. ¿Ibu be egisbie? ¡Be anse an-yar-naid-negabar amba egisele, an bega uksaled!
Geb Ester rey-abin sogded: —An-ibmar-abeged, an-ibmar-egised unnila wedid:
Dummad-Rey, ar yeer-ito an be-imaksale, ar an-ibmar-abeged, an-ibmar-egisoed, be anga nuedgi ukbiele, banedse, masgunned-iba-baid an bega onosokalidse be Amánʼbo dago. Geb agi, be-anse-emi-ibmar-egisnaid an bega sogoed.
A-ibagine, Amán bela-bela weligwar-itogedgi, degi, yeer-itogedgi masgullenaidgi nodegusad. Amán, rey-yawagak-noedgi Mardoqueo gwen e-asabin dulluu imaksuli, gwen e-dobsurbali dakargu, bela-bela sae itoded.
Degi-inigwele, Amán e-sae-itoged bargasad. Geb e-negse naded. Geb Amán e-negse-mosgua, e-aimarse-gornamalaga, degi, e-ome-Zeresʼse-gornaega igar uksad.
Geb Amán e-ibmar-nuegan-bukidar-nikadgi, masmala-bukidar-nikadgi sunmaknai gusad. Deginbali, rey, e-nug-odummosgusadgi, degi, rey-sorba-negmar-dakmamaid-birgi, igi rey e-odungusa, degi, dule-reyga-arbamalad-e-dummagan-birgi, igi rey e-odungusbali, agi sunmaknai gusbalid.
Geb Amán sogdebalid: —Rey-ome-Ester, reyga mas-imaksadse-atakdagega unnila ansebi gochad. Deginbali, oibosale, gannar Reyba mas-gunnabaliga unnila ansebi gochabalid.
Degi-inigwele, we-Judío-dule-Mardoqueo reyneg-yawagakgi-sii an daked-ilibali, dummadga-nugsalessuliyob an itoddaed.
Geb degine, e-ome-Zeres, degi, bela e-aimar Amánʼga sogdemalad: —Suar daliambe-gakabo-gaka-negabar-nibgued (12½) be ogwiso. Geb banedse, be Reyse egisoed, Mardoqueo dukargi edinnar bannu-bannu nasikye. Degidbali, be weligwar Reybo mas-gunnaoed. Weyob ega binsaed-uksamaladi, Amán yeer-itosad. Geb Amán suar-ogwisguega igar-uksad, agi Mardoqueo-e-dukar gaegar.
A-mutikidgine, rey geg gabe gualid. Degisoggu, e-yargi-ibmar-gusmalad-garda-narmakar-mamaid, degi, reymar-ibmar-imaksad-garda-narmakar-mamaid ega sedamalaga imaksad, adi, ega absomalagar.
Geb a-gardagine narmakar-nai dakarmalad, igi Mardoqueo, reyga-nakulemad-e-dummagan-warbogwad Bigtán, degi, Teres-barsogsagusa. Deunni, wemar Rey-Asuero-oburgwega igar amisgusad.
Geb agine, rey egichialid: —Mardoqueo, weyob ibmar-imaksad-ulale, ¿ibu ibmar-nued ega uklesa? Reyga-arbamalad, degi, e-sordamar-idudimalad, reyga sogdemalad: —Dummad-Rey, we-dulega ibmar-nued uklessuli.
Deyob sunmaknanaidgine, Amán reyneg-imbagi dognonikid, adi, Reyse-egisega, suar-ogwichisadgine dukargi-edinnar Mardoqueo-bannu-bannu nasikye. Degisoggu, rey egisdesunnad: —¿Doa we neg-imbagi gudii?
Reyga-arbamalad reyga sogdemalad: —Dummad, Amán neg-imbagi gudii. Geb Rey sogded: —Ega be sogmar, be dogdaye.
Amán dognonigua, Rey-Asuero ese egichided: —An dule-wargwen-nug-odummobiele, ¿Igi an a-dule imakoe? Amán na binsaded: “¿Rey, doa-dule-nug-odummobisunna? Unnila an-nugbi odummolegergebed, geg dule-baid-nug odummoleged.”
Amán reyga sogdesunnad: —Rey, be dule-nug-odummobiedgala,
be-mor-yosad, degi, be-moli-birgi-sigisad ega sedamala. Deginbali, a-dule-nonogi reyyobi ologurgin ega sibaloed.
Geb we-ibmarmar reyga-arbaed-e-dummad-wargwenga uklegoed, adi, dule-nug-odummolenaidga reymor-yosad yoegar. Deginbali, rey-moli-birgi-sii neggwebur-galimbaba sedbaloed. Agi, reyga-arbaed-e-dummad dule-nug-odummolenaid-iduar binnasuli gornadapi guoed: ‘¡Weyobi, rey, dule-nug-odummobied, imaked!’
Geb Rey-Asuero, Amánʼga sogded: —Gwae be mor sunae, degi, be moli sedabalo. Ar igi na be ibmar-sogsadyobi, Judío-dule-Mardoqueo reyneg-yawagakgi-siidi, deyob be imaknae. Bela na be ibmar-sogsadi, mer be soggwensaar imaksuli guo.
Degisoggu, Amán reymor susad, degi, rey-moli searbalid. Geb Amán Mardoqueoʼga mor-yosad. A-sorbali, Amán moli-birgi Mardoqueo-onakwisad, geb galimbaba sesad. Agine, Amán, Mardoqueo-idunadapi, weyob binnasuli gornadapi gusad: “¡Weyobi, Rey, dule-nug-odummobied, imaked!”
Weyob-gusad-sorbali, Mardoqueo gannar reyneg-yawagakse nonikid. Amánʼdi, bela-bela bukib-itoge, na bingegudedba wagar-odukuar gwae-gwae e-negse nadsunnad.
Geb Amán e-ome-Zeresʼga, degi, e-aimarga bela we-ibmar-gusadi sogsa gusad. Geb Amánʼga dulemar-ega-binsaed-daked, degi, e-ome-Zeres sogdemalad: “Ar Mardoqueo-abin be-nug-bipi-gudedi, we-dule, Judío-dule-guele, mer egi be nakodeeye binsao. Aka bur bule ese be galakuoed.”
Amba wemar Amánʼbo sunmaknanaidgine, reyga-arbamalad nonimalad, geb Ester-mas-imaknaidse gwae Amán-sesmalad.
Rey-Asuero Amánʼbo, rey-ome-Ester-mas-imaksadse nadmalad.
Geb ibbogwadgine, vino-gobsimaladgine, Rey-Asuero, Esterʼse gannar ibmar egichialid: —Ester, be anga soge, ibu be abege, ar an bega ukoed. Amba an-yar-naid-negabar be anse egisele, an bega uksaled.
Geb degine, e-ome-Ester rey-abin sogded: —Rey, be yeer-an-dakele, be nued-itogele, an bese ibmar egisoed be anga imakodo. Unnila an bese egised, mer be an-oburgwena gadin, dula-gudii be an-imakena gadin. Deginbali, an bese egisbalid, mer be an-dulemar-oburgwemogana gadinye.
Ar ade, ani, bela an-dulemarmala-oburgwilegega manigi ukles bukwad. Ar weyob guele, reyga boniga gudoed. Ar anmar unnila maiga-guega-uklesana, adi, an sunmakosulinad. An bese wilenaisulinad.
Geb degine, Rey-Asuero, Esterʼse egichided: —Degite, ¿Doa-dule we-ibmar-isgana imakbi gudisunna? ¿Bia we-dule gudii?
Geb Ester, reyga sogded: —¡Anmar-isdarad anmargi gwisgudiidi, we-dule-isgana, Amán gued! Amán weyob-itosgua, rey-asabin, degi, rey-ome-Ester-asabin dobedba ganna gwisgusad.
Geb Rey-Asuero urwedgi gwichibin-imaksad, bar gobsasulid, geb reyneggi-dutumar-galuse noded. Ar Amánʼdi, rey e-oburgoed daksabinsoggu, rey-ome-Ester-walik bessunnad, adi, e-san-bendakega Esterʼgi nue-wilenai guegar.
Rey-Asuero reyneggi-dutumar-galuse-gudiidgi gannar neg-mas-gullenaidse-dognonigua, daknonikid, Amánʼdi, Ester-maidgi dulluu gunai. Rey weyob-daksagua, binnasur goted: —An-wagab, an-neggi, ¿be an-ome gagabibarde? ¡Adi, sulirgebed! Suar-ibmala Rey weyob-gole-itosmargua, dognonimalad. Geb Amán-e-wagar edusmalad.
Suar-ibed-wargwen Harbonaʼye-nugad, Rey-Asueroʼga sogded: —Amán e-neg-nagaba Judío-dule-rey-san-bendaksagusad-Mardoqueo-dukar-gaega, suar ogwichisad. We-suarde daliambe-gakabo gaka negabar-nibgue (12½) gwichid. Geb Rey-Asuero igar ukded: —¡Be a-suargi dukar-gaale Amán-nasikmar!
Deyobi, Amán, Mardoqueo-e-dukar-gaega suar-ogwichisadgi, dukargi-edinnar nasiklesad. Geb rey baisur-itoded.
A-ibagine, Rey-Asuero, Judío-dulemar-e-isdarad-Amán-e-neg e-ome-Esterʼga uksad. Geb Mardoqueo, Rey-Asuero-asabin gwisgunonikid, ar ade, Ester, Reyga sogsagusad Mardoqueoʼde, e-gwenadye.
Rey na e-olargan-Amán-annik-gannar-susadi unnusad, geb Mardoqueoʼga uksad. Ester bela Amán-e-ibmarmarga-gusad-dakega Mardoqueo-onugsasad.
Geb Ester, Rey-asabin ise-boar, sindigar-sii, wilesagwadgi gannar ese egisdebalid. Adi, Agag-dule-Amán, Judío-dulemar-oburgwega igar-isgana-uksagusad-osuloye, reyga sognai gusad.
Geb degine, Rey-Asuero e-olo-gaapoled Esterʼsik oyosad. Agine, Ester gwisgusad. Geb Rey-asabin-gwichi,
Reyga sogded: —Rey, be yeer-an-dakele, be binsadibe napiragwadba an ibmar-egisnaiye, be nabir itogele, gardagi-narmakar be igar uksundo. Adi, Agag-dule Hamedata-machi-Amán Judío-dulemar bela rey-yarmargi-bukmalad-oburgwega garda-narmaksa-gusadi, be obelodo.
Ar an-dulemar-ogilolealile, ¿igi baisur-an-dakosunna? An-dulemar-oburgwilealile, ¿igi boo-an-dakosunna? An deyob geg gued.
Geb degine, Rey-Asuero, e-ome-Esterʼga, degi, Judío-dule-Mardoqueoʼga sogded: —An Esterʼga, Amán-neg uksad. Ar Amán Judío-dulemar-oburgwebigusad-ulale, dukargi-atinnar bannu-bannu-nai burgwisad.
Emigindi, igi Judío-dulemar-bendaklebi be abemala, deyobi an-nuggi bemar garda narmakmala. Geb we-gardagi an-olargan-e-wilub bemar nasikmaloed. Ar ade, garda-soggwen an-nuggi narmaklesale, degi, a-gardagi an-olargan-e-wilub nasiklesale, narmakar-igar-uklesadi gege bar elileged.
Geb degine, nii-warbaagi, Siván-nii-gwichidgi, e-iba-durgwen-gakapaagi reyga-garda-narmakmaladse yog-gollar imaksamalad. Dule-garda-narmakmalad bela Mardoqueo ega igar-uksadba narmaksamalad: Judío-dulemarga, dummagan-negdakmamaid-Sátrapaʼmarye-nugmaladga, sordamar-idudimaladga, degi, India-yala-akale, Etiopía-yalase yarmar dulanergwa-gakagugle-naid (127), e-dummagan-negdakmamaidga garda narmaklesad. A-gardamar na gwabin-akar-akar-sunmakmaladba narmaklesad. Deginbali, Judío-dulemarga na e-gwabin-sunmakedba narmaklesmogad.
Mardoqueo, Rey-Asuero-nuggi garda narmaksagusad. Geb rey-e-olargan-e-wilub we-gardamargi nasiksad. Degine, reyga-gardamar-berbemaladba barmisad. We-dulemar rey-molimar-bela-belad-abarmakmalad-birgi-sii abarmakmaladid.
Rey garda-narmaksadgine bela neggwebur-iliba Judío-dulemar-na-san-bendakega sunna danar-ambikuye igar uksad. Deginbali, rey igar-uksabalid, doa-dulemar Judío-dulemar-oburgwebi-gudanimalale, Judío-dulemar sunna a-dulemar, e-omegan, degi, e-mimmigan oburgweye. Deginbali, Judío-dulemar sunna e-isdarmalad-ibe ibmar subarye.
Judío-dulemar, bela-Rey-Asuero-yargi nii-warambe gakabogi, e-iba ibambe-gakapaagi, weyob-ibmar-imakega, iba mesismalad. We-nii-warambe-gakabogwadde Adar-niiye-nugad.
Bela dulemar wisgumalaga, bela neggweburmar-iliba matagwen-matagwen igar-narmakar-megisad mimilegoed. Adi, a-ibagi, Judío-dulemar na e-isdarmalad-idu guagwar-bukumalaga, e-isdarmalad-abin gwisguegar.
Dule-garda-berbemaladi Rey-sogedba molimar-bela-belad-abarmakmalad-birgi-sii gwae-gwae nadmalad. Deginbali, we-igar-narmakar-megisadi, Susa-neggweburgi mimilesmogad.
Mardoqueo rey-asabin-gwichi, reymor-arad-yoi, reymor-sipugwad-yoi, ologurgin-dummad-sii, degi, suba-lino-nued-suir-akwagiid-yoi noded. Bela Susa-neggweburginmaladi weligwar-itogedba oimakdemalad.
Judío-dulemargardi bela yeer-neg-itogedbi nagusad, weligwar itodmalad, nug-dungudmalad.
Bela yarmar-iliba, neggweburmar-iliba rey-igar-mesisad-modapile, Judío-dulemar na weligwar-itoddamalad, yeer-itoddamalad, na iba-dummad onoddamalad. Bukidar dulemar-yar-baidsikmalad Judío-dulemar-dobedba na emarde Judío-duleye sogdemalad.
Rey-e-igar-mesisadi, e-igar-uksadi, nii-warambe-gakabogi, e-ibambe-gakapaagi, imaklegoye soglesad. We-nii-warambe-gakabogwad, Adar-niiye nugad. A-ibagine, Judíoʼmar-e-isdarmalad, Judío-dulemar-ogilomaloye binsasanad. Degi-inigwele, aka bur ibmar sorsik-gusad. Ar a-ibagine, Judío-dulemar e-isdarmaladgi naknonimalad.
Bela Rey-Asuero-yarmar-dakmaidgine, Judío-dulemar, e-isdarmalad-e-oburgwebimalad-abin-samalagala, na guagwar e-neggwebur-e-neggwebur-mamaidgine ambikusmalad. Degi-inigwele, bipisaale dulemar, Judío-dulemar-abin gwisgussurmalad, ar ade, bela Judío-dulemar-dobgudmalad.
Bela yarmargi-dummaganga-mamaid, dummagan-Sátrapaʼmar, sordamar-dummagan, degi, reyga-dummaganga-gudimaladi, Mardoqueo-dobed-ular, Judío-dulemar-bendaknai gusmalad.
Mardoqueoʼde, reyneggi dule-dummadga gunonikid. Bela yarmar-ugakaase e-nug dungumai gusad. Bane-bane bur gangumai gusad.
Judío-dulemar es-suidgi e-isdarmalad-oburgwismalad, bela giir-imaksamalad. Judío-dulemar, e-isdarmalad-igi-imakbie, deyobi na imaksamalad.
Judío-dulemar, Susa-neggweburgine dulataled-ilatar (500) dule-oburgwismalad.
Deginbali, we-dulemar-oburgwismarbalid: Parsandata, Dalfón, Aspata,
Porata, Adalía, Aridata,
Parmasta, Arisai, Aridai, degi, Vaizata.
Wemar, Hamedata-machi-Amán-e-masmala-warambegwadid (10). Amánʼde, Judío-dulemar-e-isdaradid. Degi-inigwele, Judío-dulemar amar-ibe e-ibmarmardi sussurmalad.
A-ibagine, Rey-Asuero Susa-neggweburgi igi-mergu dulemar-burgwisye wisguargua,
e-ome-Esterʼga sogded: —Ar Judíoʼmar Susa-neggweburgi dulataled-ilatar (500) dule-oburgwismalale, degi, Amán-masmala-warambegwad (10) oburgwismarbalile, ¿An-yarmar-baigangi, igi neg-imaksamarbar be insae? Ester, be anga sogbali, ¿Ar ibu be egisbibali? Ar bega uklegoed. ¿Ibu be abebali? Ar be-sogedba bega ibmar imaklegoed.
Ester, Reyga sogded: —Rey, be yeer-itogele, Judíoʼmar igi emi neg-imaksamala, deyobi, banedse be igar-megisadba, Judíoʼmar-Susa-neggweburginmalad na e-isdarmalad-obelogega be igar uke. Amán-e-masmala-e-ambegid-e-muimardi (10) bannu-bannu nasikega be imake.
Rey-Asuero, Ester-ibmar-sogsadba, ibmar-imakega igar uksad. Susa-neggweburgi igar-uklenai gusad. Geb Amán-e-masmala-e-ambegid-e-mui (10) bannu-bannu nasiksamalad.
Judío-dulemar-Susa-neggweburginmaladi nii-Adarʼye-nugadgi, e-ibambe-gakabakegi na bulakwaa ambikusmarmogad. Geb agi, dulataled-ilapaa (300) dulemar-oburgwismalad. Degi-inigwele, e-ibmarmardi gwen e-ibe sussurmalad.
Judíoʼmar-baigan Rey-yar-bamaladgi-gudidimaladdi, na e-isdarmaladgi san-bendakmalaga, degi, e-isdarmaladgi ollorgumalaga na danakwaa ambikusmarmogad. Amala, mili-dulapaa-gakambe-gakatar (75,000) e-isdarmalad-oburgwismalad. Degi-inigwele, e-ibmarmardi e-ibe sussurmalad.
Weyob neggusadi, Adar-nii-ibambe-gakapaagi (13) gusad. A-banedgine, Judío-dulemar obunnosmalad. A-ibagi, weligwaledgi iba-dummad onosmalad.
Ar Judío-dulemar-Susa-neggweburginmalad, ibambe-gakapaagi, degi, ibambe-gakabakegi na bulakwaa ambikusmalad. Amardi, ibambe-gakatargi obunnosmalad. Geb a-ibagine, weligwaledgi iba-dummad onosmarmogad.
A-ulale, Judío-dulemar-neggwebur-burwigangi-bukmalad Adar-nii-ibambe-gakabakegi (14) weligwaledgi iba-dummad onodamalad. A-ibagi, na muchub-muchub binsa ibmar ukdamalad.
Mardoqueo we-ibmarmar-gusad narmakar mesisad. Mardoqueo bela Judío-dulemar Rey-Asuero-yarmar-dikasulidgi-bukwadse, degi, itakaa-bukwadse gardamar barmisad.
A-gardagine, Mardoqueo Judío-dulemarga igar-uknaid, birga-iliba, nii-Adarʼye-nugad-ibambe-gakabakegi, degi, e-ibambe-gakatargi iba-onodii gumaloye.
Adi, ebinsamalaga, a-ibagi Judío-dulemar e-isdarmaladgi ollorgusye. Deginbali, ebinsamarbaliga, igi a-niigi Judío-dulemar-e-bukib-binsaed, e-wile-itoged, ega weligwaledga, degi, iba-dummadga gunoni gusye. A-ulale, a-iba weligwaledgi, mas-bukidar-gullenai onomaloed. Aginbali, na muchub-muchub ibmar-uknanai imakmarbaloed, deginbali, dule-wileganga ibmar-uknai gumarbaloed.
Ar igi Mardoqueo gardagi-narmakar ega igar-uksagusa, deyobi, Judío-dulemar we-iba-onoleged onodii gumaloye sogsamalad.
Ar ade, Agag-dule-Hamedata-machi-Amán, bela Judío-dulemar-ogilogega na igar-amisgusad. Amánʼde, Judío-dulemar-e-isdaradid. Geb Amán, Purʼgi wilub-daksad, adi, wisguega ede sana Judíoʼmar-obelogoe.
Ar Ester, Rey-Asuero-asabin-gwisgudapgua, rey gardagi-narmakar igar uksad. Amán Judío-dulemargi igar-isgana-amisgusadi, aka Amánʼgi aibinega imakye. Degi, Amán e-machimarmala dukargi-edinnar suargi nasikmarye.
A-ulale, wilub-daked-Purʼye-nugadba we-ibamar Purimʼye onugsasmalad. Deyobi, Judío-dulemar garda-narmaklesadba, degi, ibmar-daksamaladba, degine, ibmar-gusad-itosadba, igar mesismalad.
Judío-dulemar, na emarga, e-waganga, degi, bela eba-nanaimaladga, we-iba onoleged-igar mesismalad. We-iba degisadegu birga-irba ibabo-onoledii guoye igar mesismalad. Ar igi gardagi we-iba onolegoye sognai, deyobi onolegoed. Deginbali, ibi-ibagi onolegoye sognai, a-ibagi onolegoed.
Bela Judíoʼmar, degi, e-wagan-danimaloed, bela yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad, bela neggwebur-baid-baidgi-bukmalad, we-iba ebinsadii, degi, onodii gumaloed. Judíoʼmar we-iba gege onosuli gumaloed, adi, e-wagan melle we-iba iemalagar.
Abihail-sisgwa-Rey-ome-Ester, Judío-dule-Mardoqueoʼbo, bela gangued-nikadba we-garda-sogbogwadgi Purim-Iba-onogedgi narmaksamalad.
We-gardamar nuedgi, degi, napiragwadgi narmakale, bela Judío-dulemar Rey-Asuero-yarmar-dulanergwa-gakaguglegi-bukwadse (127) barmismalad.
We-gardagine, Mardoqueo, Esterʼbo Judío-dulemarga, degi, e-waganga igar uknaid. Purim-Iba-onoleged na gusgu-e-iba-maidba onomaloye. Deginbali, a-gardagine sognaibalid, igi mas-gunsuli-gudigued-e-iba onomarbaloe, degi, igi wile-itoged na oyomarbaloe.
Ester-igar-uksadi, Purim-Iba-onolegoed-e-igar-maid bargindisad. Bela we-ibmarmar gardagi narmakar megisad.
Rey-Asuero bela e-yarmargi, degi, bela dupumargi-dulemar-bukwadgi mani-gaega imaksad.
Bela Rey-Asuero e-ganguedba ibmar-imaksadi, degi, igi Mardoqueo-nug-ogannosbalidi, bela we-ibmar-gusadi Media-yargi, degi, Persia-yargi reymar-megismalad-gardagi narmakar maid.
Ar Judío-dule-Mardoqueo, Rey-Asuero-e-yarbalidga dummadga sigismogad. Mardoqueo Judío-dulemar-abargi dule-dummadga gunonikid, degi, e-gwenadgan yeer Mardoqueo-daksamogad. Ar ade, e-dulemarga bur ibmar-nued-imakedgi binsadaed, degi, e-gwenadganga neg-bogidik nasiksabalid.
Dule-gwensak Uz-yar-naidgi gudii gusad. We-dule, dule-nuedid, dule egi-geg-akar sunmaked, we-dule Jobʼye nugad. Job, Bab-Dummad-dobekwaa nanadiid, ibmar-isgana imakdisulid.
Job, walagugle (7) masmala nikad, bunamalabi walapaa nikabalid.
We-dule ibmar-nika gudii gusad. We-ibmar-durgan nikananaed: Sibad-wawaad, miligugle (7.000) nikad, moli-yargan-mureged, milipaa (3.000) nikad, moli-bebe-nikad-abin-abinnid-napa-imumalad, dulataled-ilatar (500) nikad, moli-uayasuid-omegan, dulataled-ilatar (500) nikad, degine, bukidar e-maiga-gudimalad nikabalid. We-Job dule-dad-nakwedsikidmaladba bur nug-dummarba gued.
E-masmala iba-onoardamalad. Muchub-muchubbi e-neggine, iba-onoardamalad. Iba-onoarmalale, eba mas-gundamalaga e-bunmar-warbaagwadbina gordamalad.
Iba-onolesad-sorbali, Job e-masmalase gotedaed, ese dagmalaga, adi, Bab-Dummad-asabin swilidik-gumalagar. Job, bolegoedbali e-masmala-nuggine, wala-walagwenga ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged imakardaed, ade binsadaed: “Abakale, an-masmala, Bab-Dummadgi yolesmarsuaye, e-gwagegi ichakwa binsasmarsuaye.” Job weyob bali-bali ibmar imakardaed.
Ibagwengi, baliwiturmar Bab-Dummad-asabin-ambikunonimalad. Agine, nia-saila-Satanás nonimogad.
Bab-Jehová, nia-Satanásʼga sogded: —¿Bia be daniki? Nia-saila-Satanás abin sogded: —An napneg-naid-ebirdii danikid.
Bab-Jehová ega sogdebalid: —¿An-mai-Job be daksa? ¿Igi gudii be dake? Ar we-napneggine, dule Jobʼyobid sulid. Jobʼde angi gwen yoledisulid, an-dobekwaa nanadiid, igar-isganaba nanadisulid.
Geb nia-saila-Satanás, Bab-Jehová-abin weyob sogded: —¿Ar Jobʼde, binsa be-dobekwaa nanadii be ebinsae? Binsa deyob gudisulid. Ar ega be ibmar-ukedba deyob gudiid.
Ar melle akarguega, be nued akwediid. Ar ega e-mimmigana be nue-sabgudibalid. Ar bela e-ibmar-nikadi, ega be nued akwedibalid. Agala, ega be bela-bela e-ibmar-imaked nasguega imakdibalid. A-ulale, Job we-napneggine, moli-bebe-nikamalad, degi, sibadmar nue-nikad.
Napira an bega soged, ar be Job-sabsur-imakdibe, e-ibmar-nikadi bela e-ibe be osulodibe, be daksaled, ar be-asabin begi sabsuli-ulusaled.
Agine, Bab-Jehová, nia-Satanásʼga sogded: —Degirdi, nabirdo. Job-bela-e-ibmar-nikadi an bega-urmaksundo. Saedba be sao. E-duledi mer be oakalogo. Agine, geb nia-Satanás, Bab-Jehováʼgi banguded.
Geb ibagwengine, Job-masmala, e-bunmarmala, e-ia-sailagined-neggi iba-onobukwa gusmalad.
Degidgine, dule-gaya-berbeged Jobʼse nonikid, ega sognonikid: “Molimar-bebe-nikad napa-imunaigua, dikarba molimar-uayasuid-omegan gagan-manaimogua,
ukiagwale atursamalad-Sabeoʼginmalad nonimalad, bela molimar-bukwad sesmalad. Dule-arbamaladdina, bela es-suidgi oburgwilesmalad. Unnila anbi an wakichad, aga nabir an bega we-ibmar sogdanikid.”
Amba we-dule-gaya-berbeged-sunmaknai-yoo-bergue, dule-baid nonibalid, weyob sognonimogad: “Sibad-wawaadmargine, degine, sibad-wawaad-edarbemaladgine, mala aidesad. Bela burgwismalad, unnila anbi an durgusad. Agala, an nabir bega we-ibmar sogdanikid.”
