Amba we-dule-durgusad-sunmaknai-yoo-bergue, dule-baid nonibalid, weyob sognonimogad: “Caldea-dulemar sogapaa danar-danar ukiagwar nonimalad, bela moli-yargan-mureged-bukwad sesmalad. Dule-arbamaladdina bela es-suidgi oburgwilesmalad, unnila anbi an wakichad. Agala, nabir an bega we-ibmar sogdanikid.”
Amba we-dule-durgusad-sunmaknai-yoo-bergue, dule-baid nonibalid, weyob sognonimogad: “Be-masmala, degine, be-bunamala, e-gwenad-sailagined-neggi mas-gunbukmargua, degine, gobbukmarbargua,
ukiagwale, burwa-dummad nega-dulesulidgansik-danikidi neggi yolenonikid, bela ese neg ayarisad. Bela be-mimmigangi neg marwenonikid, degisoggu, bela burgwismalad. Unnila anbi nabir san-onosad. Agala, nabir an bega we-ibmar sogdanikid.”
Degidgine, Job gwichibin imaksad, nunmak-itogedbali mor-dummadyoid siir imaksad, degine, e-nono swiri imaksabalid, napase dulluu imaksad, Bab-Dummad-nug odummosad.
Weyob sogded: “Uka-swiri an we-napnegse aidenonikid. Deyobi, ibmar-sate an gannar nabaloed. Ar Bab-Jehová we-ibmarmar anga uksad, emide, na Bab-Jehová, we-ibmarmar susbalid. Degisoggu, ¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummolesun!”
Degite, Job, weyob-ibmar-gusadgine, Bab-Dummadga sogsasulid, ibiga deyob be an-imaksaye. Job, Bab-Dummadgi gwen yolessulid.
Ibagwenginbali, baliwiturmar Bab-Dummad-asabin ambikunonibalid. Amar-imbagi nia-saila-Satanás nonibalid.
Bab-Jehová, nia-Satanásʼga sogded: —¿Bia be daniki? Nia-saila-Satanás abin-sogded: —An napneg-naid-ebirdii danikid.
Bab-Jehová ega sogdebalid: —¿An-mai-Job be daksa? ¿Igi gudii be dake? Ar we-napneggine, dule, Jobʼyobid sulid. Jobʼde, angi gwen yoledisulid, an-dobekwaa nanadiid, igar-isganaba nanadisulid. Ar Job gwen ibmar-oakalossuli, an egi yolegega be angi alamaknaigus-inigwele, degine, e-ibe be bela e-ibmar-nikad obelononibar-inigwele, degite, Job amba innikigwadba gudiid, gwen nossulid.
Nia-saila-Satanás, Bab-Jehová-abin sogdebalid: —Ar dule e-san-bendakegala, na e-ibmar-nikad bela ukdaed.
Napira an bega soged, ar be e-dulesunnad sabsur-imakdibe, be daksaled, ar be-asabin begi nue-sabsur ulusaled.
Bab-Jehová, nia-saila-Satanásʼga sogded: —Degir nabirdo. Be Job-naibi-imakega an bega urmaksun, degi-inigwele, mer oburgweddi be oburgo.
Agine, nia-Satanás, Bab-Jehováʼgi banguded. Geb nia-saila-Satanás, Jobʼga boni-dummad-yaabiid uknonikid. Job, bela e-nag-dukuse, degine, nonose-bakale, boni-yaabiid nikunonikid.
Degidbali, Job buru-birgi sigisad. Uka-aimakalile, nog-goagi godidaed.
E-ome ega sogded: —Job, ¿ar bede dule-nuedye nue-sogsunde? ¡Bab-Dummadgi be sabsur-urwe! ¡Be burgwesunna!
Job, e-omega sogded: —Dule-binsaed-satedyob be sunmaked. Ar Bab-Dummad anmarga ibmar-nuegan-ukedi, anmar abingadiid. Degitega, ¿ibiga geg anmar bonigandi abingabarsunna? Anmar, bonigan abingabalirgebed. Weyob Job wiles-inigwele, degite gwen Bab-Dummadgi yolessurgusad, isdar egi sunmaksasurbalid.
Job-e-aimar-warbaagwadi, Job-boniganba-galaitonaid wisgunonimalad. We-dule-warbaagwadi Job-dakdamalaga, degi, ega-gwage-armakega, daredibi na e-yargi noargusmalad. Amar, wemalad: Temán-neggweburgined-Elifaz, Súah-neggweburgined-Bildad, degine, Naamat-neggweburgined-Zofar, wemala Job-e-aimalad.
We-dulemala Job-maidse nonimalad. Bannaba Job-dakarmargua, oemalad, we, doa-dule. Geb nue-dakdemargua, binnasuli bodmalad, bukib-binsaedbali e-mor-yoyoid siir-siir imaksamalad. Degine, nunmak-itogedbali nonogi ukub eosmalad, degi, nonogi buru eosmarbalid.
Deyobi, Job-e-aimar ibagugle (7) mutik-mutik Job-nagaba napagi sigismalad. Ar Job boniba-galitosisoggua, e-aimar gwen Jobʼga sunmakbigussulid.
Job na boniganba geg-itogusadgine, e-iba-gwalulesadgi isdar sunmakded.
Job weyob sogded:
“Ibiga an-iba-gwalulesad geg bergudibe. Ibiga a-mutikidba soglenaigusdibe, ‘susugwa gwalulesye,’ a-mutikid nagussulina gadinad.
A-iba, negasichidga nagusana nuedinad. Bab-Dummad, a-ibagi binsassulina gadinad, a-ibagi negsichidbi nagusana nuedinad.
A-iba neg-gubyagwaledga nagusana gadinad, a-iba mogir-sichidga nagusana nuedinad. A-iba dad-ibeler-galegedyobi nagusana nuedinad.
A-neg-mutikidgi nega-gudureged nagusana gadinad. A-iba, nii-gardamar-abargi-naidgi elilesunna, a-iba, birgamar-ibagangi-naid elilesunna.
We-neg-mutikidgi geg dule gwalulegena gadinad. We-neg-mutikidgi mer dule wergusunna.
Ibiga dule-ina-isgana-imakmaladi, we-iba-ukabsassurdibe. Ibiga we-dulemar-ibdula-demarginedgi-gangued-nikamaladi, a-iba-ukabsassurdibe. A-iba ukabsalesana, nuedinad.
Ibiga a-ibagi niisgwamar-bolego-noardaed nodibe, ibiga a-ibagi dad-ibeler gasdibe, dad-ibeler gassulina bur nuedin.
Ibiga a-mutikidbali an gwalulesdibe, emide, bonigan-gunaid mag-dakega an-imaknaid.
”Ibiga an sapidukugi-maigu, burgwissurdibe, ibiga an gwalulenaigu, burgwissurdibe, burgwisana bur nabirinad.
Ibiga an gwalulenaigu, an-abingasmardibe, ibiga an gwalulesgua, an-onusmardibe.
An burgwisana, nue-imas an meremainad, gwen itomaisulinad.
Reymar-gannar-neg-dummagan-sobmalad-burgwismalad-abargi an obunnomainad. Dule-dummagan-gannar-negdummagan-sobmalad-burgwismalad-abargi, an gabmainad.
Ar dule-nuga-nikamalad or-ibed-gudigusmalad-abargi, na e-neg-dummagangi ena mani-urbisgusmalad-abargi, an nue-imas meremainad.
Igi sikwi amba yoo aideged-iba-omoe burgwar-aidenonidae, gwen-neg-daksasuli digleddae, ayobi, ibiga an gussurdibe.
Ar dule-isganamar burgwenonikile, ase e-ibmar-isgana-imaked bergusiid. Ar dule-gegus-gudimalad burwa-dulega gunonikile, ase obunnosiid.
Ar dule-galesgudimalad burgwenonikile, ase na obunnosiid. Degine, we-dulemar dummad-e-wiodiid-ese-iseedi-goledi, asega bar itogosurmalad.
Ar dule-bulegana, degi, dule-belagwamaladi burwa-dulega gunonikile, bela na emarbi daklesiid, dule egi obined sulid. Degine, dule-maiga-gudiidi burgwenonikile, geb na e-dummadgi ollorgusiid.
”Bab-Dummad, ¿ar ibiga be dule-naibi-itodiid gwalulegega be imaksa? ¿Ar ibiga be dule-isdar-itodiid dula-gudiguega be imake?
Ar wemar burgwebigudidaenad, ar geg burgwesunnad. Aisaar gwae burgwebigudidaenad, ibmar-nued-amidiiyobi, burgwed amididaenad.
Ar wemar yeer itosmalaled, geb neg-urba-aidedele, weligwar itogoed.
Ar Bab-Dummad dulega igar-obured, negsichigi aka-aka-gudidaeyobi, emar-imaked.
An-akiginnedi dii-aryomaiyobi gued, bane-bane-masgullegedyobi, an naibid itodiid.
Aka bur bule an ibmar-dobgudiid anga nagunonikid, ar an ibmargi-gwayediid anga daklenonikid.
Neg-bogidikid bar anga naisulid, nue bar an obunnodisulid. Unnila surbinsa-itogedbi an dakedisunnad.”
Elifaz Temán-neggweburgined, weyob Jobʼga sogded:
“Job, an bega ibmar-sogoedi, be isdar-itogodibe, degi-inigwele, an bega ibmar sogergebed.
Emide, be emar-bukidar odurdakdidaed, be emar-niga-ogannodidaed,
be-sunmakedgi wile-itodimalad-ogannodidaed, degine, be dule-gege-itomalad-bendakdidaed,
degite, emisgindi, begi bonigan-yolenonikidi geger be itoged. Bonigan begi obin na be itoged.
Ar Bab-Dummadgi be dobekwaa gudiiye-sog-inigwele, degite, ¿ibiga be Bab-Dummadgi bensunna? Na be nued gudiiye-binsadiidde, degite, ¿igi be gudsunna?
”Nue be itogena: Ar dule ibmar-oakalodsulile, ¿sunna we-dule oburgwiledasi? Dule ibmar-inniki-imakdiile, ¿sunna we-dule oakaloledasi? Suli.
Bato an nue neg-daksamogad, ar dule ibmar-isgana-imakdidibe, ibmar-isgana egi aibined.
Ar Bab-Dummad dule-isganagi-uludele, unnila e-bunnogedgi sunna oburgwed.
Amba achumigur-nono-wawaad uludele, degi, e-mimmigan uludmogale, e-nugarmar bibisgoed. Bab-Dummad deyob dule-isgana-imakoed.
Ar igi-achumigurmar, mas-satedba burgwiddae, degi, e-mimmigan banna-banna aineba duurmakdedae, Bab-Dummad deyob dule-isgana-imakoed.
”Gayaburba-gwensak anse arbakee nonikid, unnila an sikwas-bollee itosad.
Deunni, mutiki dulemar bela gabmamaigua, negburgan an dakalid, agine, an sulibinsa-itoalid,
angi dobed-dummad nagunonikid, an wawanmakded, bela an-niga batided.
Ibmar-burba an-ebus an itononigu, bela an-abagan iko-iko itonaded.
Agine, geb an-asabinni duleyob gwisgunoniki an itoged, e-daklegeddi aku dakleged. Gwisgunonigu, bela neg boo nagunonikid, e-sunmaked sikwas-soge an itoged:
” ‘¿Ar dule Bab-Dummadba bur bule innikidaed nikasi? ¿Ar dule we-napnegse-e-odenonikidba bur bule dule-islidikga gusi?
Ar Bab-Dummadi, e-maiga-gudimaladginbela bengudiid. Ar Bab-Dummadi, e-baliwiturmarbela egi yole daked.
Degisoggu, dulemargin-bulesunna, dulemardi unnila napsa gued, dule ukub-birgi neg-soblessiidyob gued, samuyob baisursunna abulemaladid.
Wakdaradbali, nued-gudii gued, sedogidbali, bato bergus gued. Unnila dulemar sikwas wis-dula gudii gued. Ar burgwidele, bar dulegi binsalegosulid, deyob dule yoggudoed.
Na e-mormar-nikad bela e-ibe miledoed, gwen binsaed-nikagussuli burgwidoed.’ ”
Elifaz sogdebalid: “Job, emisgindi be binnasuli golena, doa be-abin-imakdagodibe. Ar biti-baliwitur-gwensakse be golodibe.
Ar emargi-isdar-binsalegedi, dule-binsaedsulid-oburgwed. Emargi-nobgulegedi, dule-binsaedsulid-oburgwed.
An-sunnad an dakdaed, dule-binsaedsulidaedi igi nasgumaidae, degite, sikwas-naogua, e-neguya wioleddabalid.
Dule-binsaed-sulidaed-e-mimmigandina, dule-e-bendaked satedaed, igar-naboleged-neggine nue-ibitodamalad, dule-e-irwa-gwisgued satedaed.
Deginbali, dule-binsaedsulidaed-e-ibmar-digarmaladi, dule-ukudmaada-gudimalad e-ibe wedamalad. Gunmalagala iko-abargi e-ibe wedamalad. Dule-uku-uku-itodimaladi, a-dule-ibmar-nuegan-bukidar-nikadgi nue-nobe itodamalad.
Ar ibmar-isgana, yogasaar ainisulid. Ar bonigan-abingalegedi, walagwen noardasulid.
Ar igi soo-e-ditismakedi soogi daniki, debayobi, naibi-itolegedi dulegi danimogad.
”Ani an weyob gunaina, bato an dika Bab-Dummadga an-bonigan an sogsabinnena.
Ar Bab-Dummad ibmar-gegerdaklemalad imaked, bukidar ibmar-dakledisurmalad imaked. Akusunna-itoge anmar-imaked.
Ar Bab-Dummadi dii owimaid, sapurgi dii-wiega imakmaid.
Bab-Dummadi, dule-san-dummarba-imaksulid-e-nug ogannoged, degine, dule-naibi-itodimalad bendakbalid.
Bab-Dummadi, dule-emar-binsaed-gaed-ibe binsaed obured, adi, e-ibmar-imakedgi mer nasguegar.
Bab-Dummadi, dule-emar-binsaed-gaed-e-binsaed, egi aibinega imaked, degi, ibmar-isgana-imakbied e-ibe oburbalid.
Bab-Dummadi, a-dule ibgine yolegega imaked. Ar amba neg-meegwadgi-gudiiyob-gudiile, mutikidba-gudiiyob yolegega imaked.
Bab-Dummadi, dule-wileged bendaked, dule-isdar-sunmakdimaladgi bendakbalid, degi, dule-sabsur-emar-imakdimaladgi bendakbalid.
Ar Bab-Dummadi, dule-wileged ogannoged, degine, dule-ibmar-isgana-imaked-gaya-maklegega imakbalid.
”Dule Bab-Dummadse-nuguega-odurdaklegedi, ¡egi nued binsalesadid! Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi be-odurdakele, mer be isdar itoge.
Ar Bab-Dummadi, naibi-emar-imak-inigwele, emar-nudakbalid. Bab-Dummadi, amba emargi-yole-inigwele, emarga nunmaked osulobalid.
Bab-Dummadi, bonigangi be-ollorsamaiguad. Ar amba be bonigan-abalagi-gunaile, be-bendakoed.
Ukud-dummad-nagunonikile, Bab-Dummadi be-oburgwega be-imakosulid. Bila-onoleged-nagualile, es-suidgi-burgwega be-imakosurbalid.
Gaya-isgana begi milealile, Bab-Dummadi, akarguega be-imakosulid. Degine, neg-isgued-nonikile, bai be itogosulid.
Aka be neg-isgued-abin alledii guoed, ukud-abin be werguoed. Degine, ibdurgan-ursirmar-abin be gwayosulid.
Ar akwamar be-nainu oichogosulid, ibnuedga bega guoed. Ibdurgan-ursirmar be-ibmar-digarmalad be-ibe ebugosulid.
Be-neguyagine, nueganbi be garmakdii guoed, degine, be-sibad-wawaadmar be ebichialile, bega sogedba bukwa be dakoed.
Mimmigan-bukidar be nikuoed, waganmar gaganmar-aineyobi be nikuoed.
Seredgi amba nollosuli be neg-uangi megdapoed. Igi ibmar-gwag-goresadgine, e-iba-sogedbali welege, deyobi, be-iba-sogedba be burgwidoed.
”Ar anmar bela we-ibmar bega sogedi, bato anmar nue-daksad, we nue-napiragwadid. Degisoggu, nue be itoge, be-sunnad be itoge. Ar bega ibmar-nuedga guoed.”
Degine, Job ega-sunmaknaid-abin weyob sogded:
“An-naibi-itodiidi, an-wiles-itodiidbogwa, nabir nibirgi-aidolegena nuedinad.
Ar nabir-aidolegena, demar-ukubba bur bule aidikueled. An-sunmakedi bemar geger itogewilubsulid.
Ar Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-e-sigumar naibi-an-imaksad. E-sigu-bonimar, bela an-sangi gwichigunonikid. Bab-Dummadi dobed-dummadi anga barmialid.
Moli-uayasuidi gagan-dikarba-gunaile, ¿masbina bonaidae? Moli-bebe-nikadi, e-mas-bukwad-dikarba, ¿masbina bonaidae? Suli. Deyobsuli.
¿Ar mas balu-sulile, nued-gulle be ebinsae? Suli. Nued gullesuli. ¿Ar gannir-akwa-e-sipugwadi nued gulle be ebinsae? Suli.
An bonigan-abganaid-abesulidi, emide, an-masga gunonikid.
”Bitigi Bab-Dummadi, an-ibmar-egisnaidi, anga imaksana gadin. Bitigi Bab-Dummadi, an-ibmar-abegedi, anga uksana gadin.
Bab-Dummad ilagwen an-obelosunnana gadin, an-oburgwedse an-imaksunnana yeerban.
Ar adi, anga bonigan ibnuedga gusaled, an yeer-itosaled. Ar Bab-Dummad-isligwaledgi an yolessurgusad.
”Bato an bela gudisoggu, ¿ibu bar an edarbosunna? ¿Ibiga bar an gudii guosunna?
¿Ar an akwayob gangusi? ¿Ar an-ukade, esgoro-gordikidyob gangusi?
An wargwen geg na dukin bendaked, an-bendakmalad bela bergusad.
”Dule-naibi-itodidbela, e-ai ega-gwage-armaked nikad. Amba dule-Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadba-dasulidbela, e-ai-egi-bangusulid nikamogad.
Ar bemardina, an-aimar-inigwele, be baisur an-dakdemalad. Ar diwar-dinguddaeyobi, degi, noddabaliyobi be damalad.
Ar dii-gwamakar-bukwad daludele, dii-amuregedga naddae, degine, diwar engudedae, deyobi, be gumalad.
Ar igi yor-mosale, diwar-dinnamaile geg bar iirmake, degi, neg-uedikidbali bela dinguddae, deyob, be gudmalad, baisur be an-dakdemalad.
Dulemar-danagwen-dummad-nadapdamaladi, e-igar-nadapidgi aibatele, nega-dulesulidganba yogguddamalad, agi burgwiddamalad.
Temánʼginmalad-danagwenmaladi, dii-amiegala naddamalad, Sabá-neggweburginmalad-ibmar-ukmaladi, na binsadamalad, bitigi dii an amisana gadinye.
Dii-nue-amio-itosmalanad, degi-inigwele, dii-dinna-mai dakdapmalale, nabir-itoardasurmalad.
Debayobi, bemar gudmarmogad, ibmar-gacharsuli-dakebayobi be angi gwakidmalad.
¿An bemarse ibmar egichasi, wis be anga ibmar udamarye? ¿An-bendakmalaga an bemarse mani egichisbarsi? Suli.
¿An bemarse gochasi, an-isdarmaladgi be an-bendakdamarye? ¿An bemarse egichisbarsi, dule-sabsur-emar-imakmaladgi be an-bendakye? Suli. An bemarse ibmar egichissulid.
”Be anga sogmardo, ibugi nodii be an-dake. Ar an nodiile, bar an sunmakosurdo.
Bemar innikigwadba be anga ibmar sognaina, an bemar-abin isdar itogosulinad. Emide, be yogasaar angi sunmaknanaid.
Mer an-sunmakedba be angi yolemala, ar an surbinsa-itogedba an deyob soged. We-ibmar-an-sogedi bela bergudoed.
An be-dakedi, sunna be dule-sergan-sated ibmargi-dodoar-wilubdakar be uksamalar an be-dakdo, degine, bemar sunna ibmarbina be-ai be uksamalar an be-dakbardo.
”Nue be ise-nuu an-dakmala. Be anga sogmala, bule an bemarga gakansanai.
Be nue itomala, mer yogasaar be angi yolemala. An ibmar-oakalodisulid, be magar an-dakmala.
An-bemarga-ibmar-sogedi, gakansulid. ¿Ar an napira-ibmar-sogedi, gakansaed-ebo emarbi-dakye be angi binsamarde? Suli, degisuli.”
Job sogdebalid: “Ar dule we-napneggi bela arbamalargebed. E-ibagan, dule-undar-arbadiid-e-ibaganyob gued.
Igi maigagudiid gwae-neg-mutikgusana gadinye binsadidae, igi dule-arbadiid e-bennukleged-iba edarbedidae,
deyobi, an nii-irbali wile-itodii gusad, mutikidbali nunmakedba an galitodii gusad.
An mutikidba megisale, an binsamaidaed, sana anga neg oibogodibeye. Mutikid anga bergusurdaed. Deyobi, an bindumakmai gabsuli oiboardaed.
Bela an-san nus biinid. An-uka sommere-sommere itoleged. An-uka-daas-dasadba sibudik-sibudik nis ariomamaid.
An-bergued-ibagan binna-binna nadapsulid, e-ibagan omosad. Gwen an bar-gannarsegued itosulid, bato an bela itoged.
”Bab-Dummad, be ebinsao, an-gudiidi, unnila bunnolegedyob an gudiid. Neg-nued bar an dakosulid.
An bergudele, dulemar gwen bar an-dakosulid. Be an-amidii gumaloenad, be an-amiosurmalad. Ar andi bar gudii guosulid.
Igi mogirmar aisakiddae, gwen bar dakleddasuli, debayobi, dule neg-uangi-digledele, geg bar gannar noed.
E-negse geg gannar bar aibired, bar egi binsalegosulid, deyob yoggudoed.
”Degisoggu, an sunmakedi gege bar an boggued. Nue-bukib-binsaed sunmakega an-imaked. Neg-nued-dakdisulid-abalagi an ibmar sogoed.
¿Demargi ibdula-dummad-gudiiyob be an-daksi? Emide, be angi nakulebukwad.
Imbagwenar an binsaardaed: ‘An gabidele, we an-bendakoye. Gabedi, anga naibid osulogoye.’
Amba an gabmaidibe, be an-ogwayeardaed, gabgi gwayed-dummadi be anga ukdaed.
Bur an-gammu-gasmarsunnana gadin, adi, an-gudiidi bar an itogosulid.
An-gudiidi, nabir an gwen itosulid, bar an dula-gudii gubisulid, burgwisa an binsaed. Ies be an-imake, an wegi-gudiidi gwen-nabirsulid.
”¿Wede dule ibusunna, bede dummarbaa imaked? ¿Ar ibiga duleba be bukib binsae?
¿Ar ibiga be bane-bane egi be atakdii? ¿Ar ibiga be bane-bane wilubdakdibali?
Bab-Dummad, ¿sana be angi-nakulediid iegoe? Wis gwen be an-indaksulid, gwen wii-doega be an-imaksulid.
Ar an begi nosye-sogele, ¿igi an-isguedde be-imakosunna? Ar be dulegi nakuleged gudiid. ¿Ibiga be sabsur an-imake? ¿Isdarsunna be an-dake?
Bab-Dummad, ¿ibiga geg be an-isgued elisunna? ¿Ibiga geg be an-isgued ies imaksunna? Bato an-burgwed omosad. Bato an napaga binyesokalid. Be an-amidagoenad, bato satebin be an-dakdagoed.”
Súah-neggweburgined-Bildad, Jobʼga sogded:
“¿Ar sanagwadse weyob be sunmakmai guoe? Be-sunmakedi, burwa-dummad-noedyobi be sunmaked.
Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, ¿ibmar-inniki-maid oichogo be ebinsasi? Bab-Dummadi, ¿ibmar-inniki-imaklegedgi yolego be ebinsasi? Gege yoleged.
Ar be-masmala, Bab-Dummadgi yolesmalargebed. Ar degubinne Bab-Dummadse nabir odurdaklesmalad.
Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad be baramiele, ega be sogele, wile be an-dakye,
be islidik-gudiile, be ibmar akar-imakdisulile, Bab-Dummad be-bendakoed. Bega gannar ibmar-iduar-nikusadi ukoed.
Ar yoedse be ibmar-nikuoedi, ibmar-nikusadba bur bule be nikuoed.
”Dadganse be nue ibmar egise, be-babgan-ibmar-bar-amismaladi, be durdake.
Ar anmardi geb emicharmaladid, gwen we-ibmar wissurmalad. Anmar we-napneggi-gudiidi, unnila an sikwas gudimalad.
Ar we-dulemardi sunna be-odurdakoed, ibmar-bukidar-wisguega be-imakoed. E-ibmar-wismalad bega sogoed.
”Gagan-papiroʼye-nugad neg-matagangi-dungumaladi, ega neg-mata dingudele, ¿sunna dungusi? Gagan-diigi-dungumaladi, ega dii-dingudele, ¿sunna dungusi?
Ar we-gaganmala, amba aramaksiile, degi, amba siklessuli, ega dii-dingudele, yog-dinguar naddaed. Gagan-bamaladba bur bule itosur dinguddaed.
Dulemar Bab-Dummad-ieddamaladi, we-gaganmaryob gumalad. Dule-isganamar na e-ibmar-edarbediidi degibergudoed.
Dule-isgana e-ibmar-edarbediidi ega dub-garagwadyobi gued. E-bensulid-nikadi, dibamaryob baisursunna e-ibe berguddaed.
Ar dule dibagi akaye-sogele, gege egi akaed, ar yoga-itirar naddaed. Debayobi, e-bensulid-nikadi ega yoga-berguar naddaed.
Dule-isganamar, sapi dad-duurmaknaid-abin-gwichiyob gued. E-anagan-nasgudele, bela napagi-gagan-naid odukued.
Degine, e-malimar akwa-imbaba uboddaed, sabsur-akwagangi e-malimar diglesdaed.
Ar dule we-sapi-olasale, dulemar gwen egi bar binsaosurmalad, we-sapide wegi gwichidaeddeeye.
Deyobi, dule-isganamar weligwar-itodiid berguddamogad, e-sorba baigan dunguardaed.
”Bab-Dummad gwen dule-innikidaed iedisulid, degine, dule-isganadi ese obanledaed.
Bab-Dummad gannar yeer-itogega be-imakoed, degine, yeer-itogedbali be binnasuli gordii guoed.
Dule-isdar-be-dakdimaladi, binge-gudii gumaloed, degine, dule-isdarmalad-e-neguyamar bela bergudoed.”
Job, deyob Bildad-sunmaksad-itosgua, weyob abin-sogded:
“An nue-wisimakar-inigwele, we nue-napiragwa, degite, ¿igi dule Bab-Dummad-asabin isgussuliyob na san-oyogosunna? Gege dule na deyob san-oyoged.
Ar dule Bab-Dummad-ebo gachimakye-sogele, gwen dule Bab-Dummadgi, nakwissuliled.
Ar Bab-Dummad binsaed-ibed maid, e-gargangued dutusulid. Degisoggu, ¿ar doa-dule, Bab-Dummadgi obichar be ebinsasunna? Dule egi obichasuliled.
Ar Bab-Dummad uludele, yar-dummagan-bukwad onired. Yar-dummagan bato ainirisbin daklenonidaed.
Bab-Dummad napneg-naid ogiglimaked, degi, napneg-e-sailagan-mamaid ogiglimakbalid.
Bab-Dummad dad-ibeler-mer-noega imaked, niisgwamar mer-bar-gaega imakbalid.
Bab-Dummad na e-ganguedba nibneg nasiksad, degine, Bab-Dummad bogi demar-sabalid.
Bab-Dummad bela niisgwamar danar-danaled nasiksad: Niisgwa-danaled-Osaʼye-nugad, niisgwa-danaled-Oriónʼye-nugad nasiksad. Degi, bela niisgwa-danaled-Pléyadesʼye-nugad-naguega imaksabalid. Bela dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik niisgwa-danar-danar nasiksabalid.
Ar Bab-Dummad ibmar-dummagan-magar-itolesulid imaked, degine, bukidar ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-geg-ebisleged imaked.
Ar Bab-Dummad an-nagaba nadapye-sogele, an daksasuliled. Angi bangudye-sogele, an itossurbaliled.
Bab-Dummad ibmar-suye-sogele, ¿doa ega sogoe: ‘Mer be suye?’ ¿Doa ega sogoe: ‘Ibu be imaknaiye?’ Dule ega soged, sate.
Ar Bab-Dummad uludele, ibdula-dummad-demargined, degi, e-sordaganse-bakale, Bab-Dummad-asabin dulluu ambikumalad.
”Ar deyobile, degite, ¿igi an Bab-Dummad-abin-imakosunna? An abin-imakegala, ¿igi an sogsale? Geg an abin-imake.
Amba an ibmar-akar-imaksasuli-inigwele, Bab-Dummad-asabin geg an san-bendaked. Ar unnila an Bab-Dummadse ise-wilegar bendakleged an egised.
Ar an Bab-Dummadse igar-itogega gorye-sogele, degine, anse nonikile, gwen an-itosar an ebinsasulid.
Aka bur angi burwa-dummadiyob yolenonikiled, aka bur an-naibid-itodiid anga omelonai gualiled.
Gwen obunnogega an-imaksasuliled, aka bur wile-itoged anga omelononikiled.
Ar garganguedgi sunmakleye-soglegele, Bab-Dummad bur bule emarba gargangued nikad. Ar Bab-Dummadga igar-itoleye-soglegele, ¿doa igar-itoleged-abarse Bab-Dummad-ogwichosunna?
Amba an ibmar-akar-imaksasurye sogele, an-sunmaked angi dukin aibinnonikoed. Amba an innikigudiiye-sogele, Bab-Dummad nosadga an-imakoed.
”Ar an ibmar oakalossur-inigwele, degite, Bab-Dummad amba deyob angi binsasulid. A-ulale, an burgwebigussunnad.
Ar bela dulemar emarbiid, degisoggu, an sogdo: ‘Ar Bab-Dummad dule-nued, dule-isgana obeloged.’
Ar boni-gwensak ukiagwar dule-oburgwenonikile, an sogdo, Bab-Dummad, dule-ibmar-oakalodisulid-surbinsa-itogedga allesii guoye.
Dule-isgana yar-ganonikile, Bab-Dummad dule-igar-nabomalad igar-noar-imakmalaga imaked. Ar Bab-Dummad weyob-imaksulile, degite, ¿doa imaksunna?
”An-ibagan-bergued bato mosad, an-ibagan binna-binnagwad bar abarmaksisulid. Weligwaled an gwen-itogosuli an-ibagan bergudoed.
An-ibagan, ur-binnasur-nadapiyobi, nadapid. Sulubagi e-masbina-gwichigumaiyobi, an-ibagan gued.
Amba an sogdibe: ‘We-ibmar-nabir-an-itodisulidi, an iegoye. An-wagar-wile-itoged, an ogwaoye, an alledii guoye,’
degite, an bela-bela-nunmaked-itodiidba, amba an dobe itodaed. An wisbalid, ar Bab-Dummad-asabinni, amba an ibmar-oakalossuliyob daklegosulid.
Ar an ibmar-oakalosye soglesoggu, ar ¿ibiga bar an alamaknai guosunna? Binsarsunna bar an alamaknai guo itole.
Amba an-uka an dii-diregwadgi ise-enukye-sogele, morgaukgi an-argan dagur-dagur an imakye-sogele,
amba Bab-Dummad, ibmar-isgana-milegedse an-bar-meteled, ar an-mormarse-bakale, ima an-itosaled.
”Ar Bab-Dummaddi anyobsulid, andi dule gued. Degite, ¿igi an igar-nabolegedse Bab-Dummad-sedosunna? Gege an seded, ar Bab-Dummad dulesulid.
Ar anmarga-igar-nabogega igar-naboged-dule, wargwensaar gudisulid.
Ar Bab-Dummad-angi-urwenaid-osulogega, dule-wargwensaale, gudisulid. Adi, mer an Bab-Dummad-e-urwed dobguegar.
Aisaar an dobsuli sunmakbienad, geg an gued, ar an dobe itoged.”
Job, Bildadʼga sogdebalid: “¡An budar wegi-gudiidi itogusad! Agala, yogasaar an sunmakargussunnad. An-nabir-itosulid na dukin barsognagussunnad.
”Bab-Dummadga an sogoed: ‘Mer weyob be an-wioye. Anga be sogye, ¿ibiga weyob be an-imaknai?
Bab-Dummadga an sogbaloed: ¿Weyob be an-imaknaid yeer be an-dake? ¿Isdarsunna be dule-obinnisadi dake? ¿Dule-isganamar isdarsunna-angi-binsananaidi, be baisur-dake?
¿Dulemar-daeyob be emar-dake? ¿Anmar-ibmar-dakeyob be dakmoga?
¿Ar be-ibagande, anmar-ibaganyobmoga? ¿Ar bega birgamar-nanamaid dulega-nanamaidyobmoga?
Degite, ¿ibiga be an-isguedi wisgubisunna? ¿Ar ibiga be an-isguedi bela be bar-amibisunna?
¿Ar be nue-wissursi, ani an ibmar-oakalossulid? ¿Ar be nue-wissursi, begine geg an dukued?
” ’Ar be-sunnad be an-imaksad, be-sunnad be an-obinnisad. Degite, be-binsaed be gwagdode, ¿ar an-obelogedgi be binsadode?
Be ebinsao, igi sianar napsagi soblege, deyob be-sunnagwad be an-sobsad. Degite, ¿gannar napsaga be an-obinyebalode?
¿Moli-nunis-owirmaklegedyob be an-imaksasursi? ¿Moli-nunis-gwamaklegedyob be an-imaksasursi?
Bee be, anga sanmar nasiksad. Bee be, anga ukamar enirisad. Ar bee be, an-garmar gwadisad. Bee be, anga an-san-dubagan mesisbalid.
Burba-dulad be anga uksad, be-sabguedi be anga oyosbalid. Degine, be nue-an-akwisbalid, be an-niga ogannosbalid.
” ’Degi-inigwele, ibmar-soggwendi be angi odukusad. Ar an wisid, be weyob binsadigusad:
Angi be nakuledii gusad, abakale an begi isgunonikirye. Ar an isgunonikile, be baisur-dakosulid.
An nue-isgunonikile, an dule-wiles. Ar an isgussur-daklenonikile, amba geg an weligwar itoged. Nue-binged-dummad angi naid. Nunmakedba-an-galitodiid nue magar an na itodiid.
An gwisguye-sogele, achumiguryob be anbina melleardaed, be-gargangued be angi oyononidaed.
Be-isdar-itoged aka angi barbulomaid, dule-angi-yolemalad aka be gatik amisbalid. Be-sordamar angi ukin-ukin yolenanaid.
” ’¿Ar ibiga gwalulegega be an-imaksa? Bur an burgwisana gadinad, adi, dule bar an-dakosulinad.
Bur an gudisulina gadinad, an burgwar-aidenonikina gadinad, adi, yog-diglegar an guoenad.
¿Ar an-ibagande bergued-mossursi? Degisoggu, mer bar be anse gole. An nasokalid-idu napi an wis-yeer itodigweled.
Emide an-nasokalid, bar an dagegarsulid. Negsichidse an naesokalid. We-an-naesokalidi, bar an aibiregarsulid.
Neg-gubyagwaledse an naesokalid, neg-gagalesnaidse an naesokalid. Amba neg-meegwad-negsichidyob-daklegedse, an naesokalid.’ ”
Naamat-neggweburgined-Zofar Jobʼga sunmakded, ega sogded:
“¿Ar be we-ibmar-sognaidi, abin-imaklegosurde? ¿Ar we-dule gadi-sunmakedba, nodisuliyob daklegode? Sulirgebed.
¿Bela-we-ibmar-soglesad-abin anmar gaya-maklegode? ¿Dule-be-abin-imakosulidba emargi-dodogoye be soge? Gege be emargi dodoged.
Emide, be soged: ‘An-ibmar-soged innikigwadye, Bab-Dummad-asabinni an ibmar-oakalossurye.’
Bitigi Bab-Dummad begi gwichigunonikina gadin. Bitigi begi sabsur-sunmaknonikina yeerban, yeer an be-daksaled.
Ar Bab-Dummad binsaed-nikadba bega ibmar sogoed. Ar we-igar-dukuarmamaid akusunna itoleged. Agi, be geb magar Bab-Dummad-be-odurdaknaidi, be itosaled, be-isguedba bur bule, be odurdaklegewilubbinye.
”¿Sunna be Bab-Dummad-e-ibmar-burbar-mamaid wisguosi? ¿Sunna be Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-ibmar-wisiyob be guosi? Gege be deyob gued.
Ar Bab-Dummad-e-binsaed, nibnegba obined, degite, ¿igi be wisguega imakosunna? Bab-Dummad-e-binsaed yaa-matusulidba obined. Degite, ¿igi be e-binsaed wisguosunna?
Deginbali, Bab-Dummad-e-ibmar-burbar-mamaidi, napneg-naidba bur dummadid, demar-matasuid-naidba bur bipisulid.
”Ar Bab-Dummad esgaryase be-metedibe, degine, igar-nabogega bese gollarbardibe, ¿doa ega sogoe, mer deyob be imakye? Dule geg ega soged.
Ar Bab-Dummadi dule-yardakdimalad magasar daked, degine, e-ibmar-isgana-imaked baisur-dakosulid.
Moli-uayasuid-sapurbalidgine dule gwalulenonikile, geb dule-binsaedsulidaedi, binsaed-ibedga guoed.
”Ar Bab-Dummadga be gwage ukele, be-argan ese be onakwele,
ibmar-isgana-imaksadgi be banguele, geb be-neguyagi ibmar-isgana be osulobalile,
be bar bingeguosulid, bar be dobgudii guosulid.
Naibid-itodigusadgi bar be binsaosulid, ukiagwar-ibmar-gusayob be itogoed.
Neg-ibegwar-naiyob bega neg nagunonikoed, weligwar be itononikoed. Negsichidi, bolegoe neg-ainakwiardaeyobi bega mee nagunonikoed.
Ar be bendaklegoed-wissoggu, be Bab-Dummadgi bensuli-gudii guoed. Bab-Dummad be-dikarba bega nakuledii guoed, degidbali be nue-gabdii guoed.
Dule gwen bar be-ogwayedii guosulid, nued be obunnodii guoed. Deginbali, dulemar bese wilenonimarbaloed.
Dule-isganamardina wakinnosulid. E-ibyamar bela akitoed. Unnila burgwed-edarbedimalad.”
Agine Job, Zofarʼga weyob sogded:
“Ar bemar odurdaked-sailaye be sogmarsunde. Ar bemar burgwidele, ¿bemarba binsaed-nikaa-dalegedi burgwidmosunnode?
An bemaryobi binsaed nikamogad, gwen be angi obinsurmalad. Ar bemar-ibmar-sogsamaladi, ¿doa we-ibmar wissur be ebinsae? Bela wismala.
”Gebeunni an Bab-Dummadse-gotele, Bab-Dummad an-abin-imakdaenad. Emigindina, aka an-aimar-oallega an guded. An ibmar-oakalossulin-inigwele, aka an-aimarga an dodogedga guded.
Dule-gwen-boni-itodisurmaladi weyob sogdemalad: ‘Dule-boni-itodiidi mer bai be dake, dule-aimukubi-gudiid gatik be egee imake.’
Dule-ibmar-atursamaladi, e-negyagi na yeer itodimalad. Ar wemar Bab-Dummad-ourwedimaladid, Bab-Dummad-gege-anmar-oakaloye, sogdimaladid.
”Ibdurganse be ibmar egismalana, ar wemar bemar-odurdaksamalaled. Sikwimarse be ibmar egismalana, ar wemar bega ibmar sogsamalaled.
Napneg-naidbogwa be sunmakena, ar we bemar-odurdaksaled. Demargi uamar-bukwadbogwa be sunmakena, wemar bemarga ibmar sogsamalaled.
Ar wemar Bab-Jehová-bela-ibmar-imaksad, bela wismalad.
Bab-Dummadgine, bela burba-dulad siid. Bab-Dummadgine, bela dule dula-gued siid.
Ar uaya, ibmar-goled magar itoged, degi, gwabin, ibmar-igi-gulleged magar itoged.
Deginbali, dule-selebagus-gudimaladi, magasar neg-itomalad, binsaed-ibegan nanamalad.
”Ar Bab-Dummaddi bur bule binsaed-nikaa gued. Abi gargangued bur bule nikabalid. Binsaed-nued-ukleged Bab-Dummadgadbiid, degine, magar-neg-itoleged egadbibalid.
Ar Bab-Dummad ibmar-earisale, dule-wargwensaale bar sobosulid. Ar Bab-Dummad esgaryagi dule-metele, dule-wargwensaale gege bar onoged.
Ar Bab-Dummad dii-owisulile, bela ibmar dingudeled. Ar dii-owierdi, bela neg-dogdebaliled.
Bab-Dummadgine gargangued maid, degine, binsaed-nikagued egi danibalid. Bab-Dummadgi-siid, emar-yardaked, degi, dule-emarse-yardaklediid, igi imakoe.
Ar Bab-Dummadi dule-binsaed-ibedmar-obingegsaed, degine, dule-igar-nabomalad suli-suli obinsabalid.
Bab-Dummad, reymar-ibe e-negsemamaid osuloged, degine, rey maiga imakbalid.
Bab-Dummad dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-obingegsaed, degine, dule-bulegan-surbinsa-itogega imakbalid.
Bab-Dummad dule-binsaed-dakmalad-e-gaya-maked, degine, girmar-dummagan-binsaedsuli imakbalid.
Bab-Dummad dule-nuga-nikamalad-obingegsaed, degi, dule-gandik-gudimalad gargangued-sate imakbalid.
Bab-Dummad ibmar-yaa-matusurmaladgi-bukwad magar-dakle imaked, degine, negasichidgi ibmar-bukwad magar-daklegega imaked.
Bab-Dummad neggwebur-merguega imaked, neggweburmar obelobalid. Bab-Dummad neggweburmar-oambikuega imaked, neggweburmar-aisakiega imakbalid.
Bab-Dummad dule-dummagan-yar-sedimalad-ibe e-binsaed-oburega imaked. Degidbali, negsulidganba-gudiiyobi imakbalid.
Negsichigangi-unimakdiiyobi imaked, mummuganyob banamakdiiyobi imaked.”
Job sogdebalid: “Bela bemar ibmar-sogsamaladi bato an itosad, bato an we-ibmar daksad.
Ar bemaryopira an wismogad, gwen be angi obinsurmalad.
Bur an Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadbogwa an sunmakbied, Bab-Dummadbogwa an-igar bur an nudakbied.
Ar bemardi unnila gakansamaladid, ina-durgan-ibmar-wissurmaladyobi be gumalad, gwen an-bendaksulid.
Ar bemar wis boo ambikuele, degidba, bemar binsaed-nikagued oyosmalaled.
Emisgindi, nue an-sunmaked itomalo, an-ibmar-bega-soged-nikad be itomarmogo.
¿Bemar Bab-Dummad-nuggi gakansaode? ¿Gakansaedgi bemar Bab-Dummad-bendaknaimarye sogode?
¿Ar bemar ega ibmar-nued imaknaiye binsasunde? ¿Ar bemar Bab-Dummad-bendakmaladye sogmarsunde?
Ar Bab-Dummad bemar-wilubdaknonikile, ¿igi be gusmalale? Ar bemar dulemargi-dodolegeyob, ¿Bab-Dummadgi be dodomarye sogmarsunde? Gege bemar Bab-Dummadgi dodoged.
Ar bemar arbakee dule-wargwenbi bendakbigualile, Bab-Dummad bemargi sabsur-gwichigusaled.
Ar Bab-Dummad-e-gargangued-yeerdakleged be-ogwayenonimalaled. Bemar e-abinni bela-belad gwayidmalaled.
Ar bemar binsaed-nued-nika-sunmakedi binsaledid, bemar-ibmar-sognaidi gwen gangued nikasulid.
”Mer bar sunmakmala, an sunmakmogwelo. Ar igi an-guoe, ar deyob an guodo.
Ar an naibigubier, an naibiguodo, bar san-bendaklegedgi an binsasulid.
Ar Bab-Dummad an-oburgwebiele, an-oburgodo. An bendaklegodeeye, bar an binsasulid, bato an bela gudiid. Unnila Bab-Dummad-asabinni, an-gudiid na barsogoed.
Ar Bab-Dummad na e an-bendakoedid. Ar dule-isganadi, Bab-Dummad-asabinni gwen gwisgunonikosulid.
”An-binsaed nue itomalo, an-ibmar-sognaid be nue itomalo.
An-sunmakoed bato guakwaa an ilemaksad. Bato an wisid, Bab-Dummad ibmar-oakalossuli an-daknonikoed.
Ar dule-angi-yoleged-nikardina, bar an golosurdo, an burgwed-edarbesunnodo.
”Bab-Dummadye, ibmar-sogbo an bese egised. Ar we-ibmar be anga ukele, an bar begi dukuosulid:
Soggwengi: Mer bar be sabsur-an-odurdako. Sogbogi: Mer bar be sabsur-an-ogwayo.
Na san-bendakegala, be-asabin-gwisgudagega be anse gole, adi, nabir an be-asabin sunmakoed. Be anse gorsulile, an-inse an bega sunmakodo, geb bee be an-abin-imakoed.
Be anga soge, ibugi an begi isgusa, ibu ibmar-isganamar an imaksa, biti-be-igargangi an annasa, ibugi an begi yoledii gusa.
Bab-Dummadye, ¿ar ibiga be angi dukue? ¿Ar ibiga be-isdaradyob be an-dake?
Ar andi gagan-dinnagana burwaba-seledaedyob gued. Degisoggu, ¿ibiga be an-obelobisunna?
Emide be, nunmaked-dummad-itogega be an-imaknaid. Sapingwaun an ibmar-isgana-imaksad-ular, ¿deyob be an-imaknaisunde?
Sepo-yaba be an-nag-odosad. Bia an nadesogele, bela be angi nakuleged, an-nag-gannarmarba be angi nakulediid.
”Dule urgo-nunguddaeyob berguddaed, mor udubiin-gusar-bergudaedyobi, dulemar berguddaed.”
Job sogdebalid: “Dule gwalulenonikile, unnila sikwas gudii gued, ar bonigandi bukidar daed.
Dulemar dutumaryobid. Dutumar argadele, bato dinguddaed, debayobi, dulemar gued. Sikwas-negsichid-nagunonidaeyobi, dulemar berguddaed.
Bab-Dummad, ¿be deyob duledaedgi ataknasunde? ¿Be-asabin-igar-nabodagega be anse gornasunde?
Degite, ¿ar doa ibmar-nued, ibmar-isganagi onogoe? Gege dule deyob imaked.
Dulega ibagan-bergued bato sogles maid, bee be, bato ega niiwarbigwa-wilub-gudiguega ega ibagan mesisad. Degisoggu, gege a-ibagan-obicha gudii gued, ar deyob be imaksad.
Mer bar egi be nakulege, ies be sae, na e-arbadiid-manigi wergudii be imakgwele.
”Ar sapimarbela amba siklesale, gannar ainiardaed, degi, e-anagan dunguddaed.
Ar sapi-e-malimar nungumai-inigwele, e-saila nungumai-inigwele,
egi dii-aryoderdi, gannar sunna durgued. Sapi-gebe-diglesadyob e-anagan ainiardaed.
Ar duledina, burgwisar bar daklegosulid. Ar dule burgwisale, ¿bia nadoe?
Ar igi demar dinguddae, degine, igi diwar dinguddabali,
deyob dulemar berguddaed, bar gwisgusurdamalad. Ar mogir-arad-naid-berguedsega, geb dule-burgwismalad gwisgumaloed. Dule-burgwismalad e-gabmamaidgi geb atakdemaloed.
”Be-urwemaid-berguedse neg-uangi be an-odukuena yeerban. Bitigi an-ebinsaega be ibagan nasikena yeerban.
Dule burgwisale, geg bar gannar durgued. A-ulale, an-bendakleged-iba an bane-bane edarbedii gusaled.
Geb agi be anse gornonikoed. An be-abin-imaknonikoed. Ar bee be, an-obinnisadsoggu, be yeer an-daknonikoed.
Be an-gudiid emi be daked, an-isguedgindi bar be binsassulid.
Ibmar-sagugi-ise-atinnar-melleddaedyobi, be an-isgued dikasuli meted. An-isgumalad bela be anga elisad.
”Ar igi yar-dummad-mamaridele, akwamar-babatidele, baidsik ambakusdae, deyobi, be dule-e-ibmar-edarbediid be imaked.
Ar igi-diimar akwamar-sabsursae, deginbali, diwar-dummad-nomaile, bela ese ibmarmar ebipilege, deyobi, dule-ibe e-bendakleged be osuloged.
Bela-bela be we-dule oitoged, be we-dule-obelogega imaked, bar e-wagar-daklesuli be imaked. Deyob, be we-dule neg-uanse barmeted.
Ar e-mimmigan-nug ogannolenaile, we-duledi gwen bar wisguosulid. Ar e-mimmigan mesagwar-imaklenaile, we-duledi gwen wisguosulid.
Unnila e-san-nunmakedbi itoged, na e-nunmakdiidbali, wile-itodiid.”
Geb agine, Temánʼgined-Elifaz, Jobʼga weyob sogded:
“Dule-binsaed-ibedi yogasaar sunmaksulid. Dule-binsaed-ibed yogasaar urwesulid.
Dule-binsaed-ibedi, dule-baidbo abin-abin-imaknaidgine, yogasaar sunmaksulid. Dule-binsaed-ibedi, igar-nudakedgi sunmaksuli gusulid.
Bedina, aka be Bab-Dummad-dobekwaa-nanaedi obelonaid. Aka be dule-bamalad mer Bab-Dummadse-golega imaknaid.
Be-sunmakedi be-isguedba be sunmaknaid, dule-galagwensulidamaladyobi be sunmaked.
Be-sunmakedi dukin begi yolenaid, andi begi yolenaisulid. Be-gwabin-duku dukin be-wioged.
”¿Be-inse gwalules be itoge? ¿Yarmar-nanaid-idu, be-inse gwalules be itoge?
¿Bebi binsaed-ibed be itosi? ¿Bab-Dummadde bese binsaed egissi?
Anmar bela be-ibmar-wisidi wismogad, bela be-ibmar-magar-itogedi anmar magar itomogad.
Anmar-abargine dadagan bukwad, be-babba bur selegan nanaed.
¿Bab-Dummad gadi-gadi be-gwage-imaked be baisurdaksunde? ¿Bab-Dummad bega binnalegwadgi sunmaked be baisurdaksunde?
¿Ibiga be surbinsa urwed-itoge? ¿Ibiga be urwakwaa atake?
¿Ibiga be Bab-Dummadse urwe? ¿Ibiga egi be yogasaar sunmake?
”¿Igi-dule na ibmar-oakalodisurye sogosunna? ¿Doa nodisurye sogosunna?
Bab-Dummad e-nug-odummodimaladginbela bengued, amba nibnegbela swilidik daksulid.
Dulemarginbulesunna, e-abin swilidikidsulid. Duledi, gobedbinagudiiyobi, isguedbina gudiid.
”Job, nue be an-itogo, an bega ibmar soggwelo. An-ibmar-daksad an bega sogesokalid.
We-ibmar dule-binsaed-ibegan anmar-odurdaksadi, na e-babganba durdaksamaladid.
Agala, Bab-Dummadi a-dulemarga yala uknonikid. Dule-ainebarmalad a-yargi eba bukwa gussulid.
Dule-isganadina, bane-bane nunmakedba-gar-itodii gudoed, degine, dule-sabsur-emar-imakdiidgala, e-ibagan-bergued bato sogles naid.
Dule-isgana ibmargoled-emar-ogwayed itoged, degine, na bogidik-gudiidgine, dule-atursamalad egi gwisgunonikoed.
Dule-isgana negsichidgi-wakinnodeeye gwen binsasulid, es-suidse-ibitogoed ega igar maid.
Igar-wissuli garmakdiid, mula-masga-guega gudiid. Dule-isgana e-oburgwileged-ibagan-mosad na wisid.
Wileged-dummad, suli-suli-itoged, bela-bela dobe-itogega imaked. We-ibmarmala, rey-egi-yolesokaliyob itoge imaked.
Ar Bab-Dummadgi ise-urwar argan-oyonai-gusad-ulale, na san-bule-bule Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadga imaknai-gusad-ulale, ede na dobe itodiid.
Ar dule-isgana Bab-Dummad-asabin ise-urwar gunaigusad, ar Bab-Dummad-ourwega, sigu-abgaed-sommed urwedgi ega oyonai gusad.
”Ar dule-isgana amba wagar-dukwa-dukwa-nika-inigwele, degi, saban-dummad-inigwele,
neggwebur-ayaraledgi mai guoed, negmar-ollo-ollo-siidgi gudii guoed, negmar-aimukudanimaladgi mai guoed.
We-dule-isgana, bar ibmar-ibedga guosulid, e-ibmar-nuegan-nikadi bela e-ibe bergudoed, e-nainumar, bela e-ibe surgudbaloed.
Burgwedgi wakinnosulid, sapi-gannar-ainiardaed soogi-gummakeyob guoed. Ar Bab-Dummad unnila e-bunnogedgi we-dule-obelogoed.
Dule-isgana, ibmar-baisurmaladgi-yardaklediid iege, ibmar-baisurmaladgi-bengudisulid iege. Ar we-ibmarmargi gwen ibmar-nued amiosulid, we-ibmarmar, binsaledid.
Igi sapi e-sikleged-ibagan-idu sikleddae, e-anagan aramakosuli sikleddae, deyob, we-dule-isgana burgwidoed.
Igi uva-dub-e-san, amba yoo-nue-gue batiddae, degi, igi olivo-sapi e-durbamar-ainissuli berguddae, deyob, dule-isgana bergudoed.
Degidbali, dule-isganamar e-anagan nikuosulid, degine, manigi-emar-binsaed-gamaladdina, e-neguya bela soogi gummakoed.
Dule ibmar-isgana-imakedgi-binsaed, ibmar-isgana imaknonikoed, e-gwagegi unnila emar-yardakedgi binsadiid.”
Job Elifaz-abin weyob sogded:
“We-ibmar bukidargus an weyob itodanikid, bemar-ibmar-soged gwen an-bendaksulid.
¿Ar bemar-yogasaar-sunmaked geg bergumarsi? ¿Ar ibiga geg bemar an-ies imakmala?
Ar bemar an-gunaiyob be gunanaimogana, an bemarga deyob sunmaksamogaled. An bemargi-yolelega, gaya-nueganbi bemarga sunmaksamogaled. Bemar-wiledakeyob an bemarga nono-ege-ege imaksabaliled.
An-sunmakedgi an bemar-ogannosmalaled. Bemar ibmar-nunmak-itodimaladi, an-sunmakedbali gadi-gadi be itosmalaled.
”Ar an sunmaknaid gwen an-bendaksulid, ar gwen anga ibmar-nunmak-itonaidi osulosulid, ar an sunmaksurbalile, gwen anga surgusurbalid.
Bab-Dummad napiragwadba an-obelosad, an-neguyaginmaladse-bakale bela obelosad.
Bab-Dummadse nue an galesgunaid, nue angi yolesgunaid. An-uka-dunnumakega an-ibe imaksad, degisoggu, garagus an dakleged.
”Bab-Dummad nue anse urwed, an ese balegillenaid, nue-ibitos itoleged. Achu-angi-nugar-oyonaiyob gunaid, e-isdaradga an-imaksad.
An-isdarmalad angi dododmalad, an-wagar ogotemalad. We-dule-isdarmalad buladik angi yoledmalad.
Bab-Dummad dule-isganamarse-ibitogega an-imaksad, dule-gakansamaladse ibitogega an-imaksad.
Iduardina, an bogidik gudiinad, emisgindi, Bab-Dummad nue an-wiosad, dukar-walaba an-ganonikid, saga-saga an-imaksad. Bela-bela angi yolenonikid.
E-sigu-mimalad nue an-ebirisad, e-sigumar, an-sabangi sabe-sabe-yolenonisulid, bela an-samurmar, napase yaarmakded.
Bia an naibigusa, agi gannar angi yolenonidaed, bila-onoged-duleyob angi gwisgunonikid.
”An-naibi-itodiid-oyogegala, an wile-itoged-mor-yonai gualid. Napayala an gudii gualid.
An boedba an-wagar ginnitibigusad, an-ibyamar-dakleged guduregus dakleged.
Degi-inigwele, an dule-emar-sabsur-imakedsulid, Bab-Dummadse innikigwadgi an gordiid.
”Ar an burgwenonisundibe, napnega, an-ibmar-oakalossulid-barsognai gusana gadin.
Ar dule-an-barsogoedi nibneggi maid. Nibneggine, dule-an-ular-sunmakoedi maid.
Ar an-ai an-irwa-goledid, an an-ai-asabin ise-boar an gunaid,
adi, an-ai an-ular Bab-Dummadse golegar. Ar igi dule na e-ai-bendakega sunmake, deyobi, an-ular sunmakegar.
Bar an birga-suitii naosulid, an-burgwed-ibagande, bato mosad. Gwen an bar aibirosulid.”
Job sogdebalid: “Napi an iche-iche bunnomaid, an-ibagande nue-bergudanikid, neg-uan bato an-edarbemaid.
Dule-emargi-dodomaladbi unnila an-ebiris-gunanaid, emide, a-dulemarbi an dakdisunnad.
”Bab-Dummad, be an-ular mani-bennukega be an-bendakdage. ¿Ar doa bar an-bendakdagosunna?
Bab-Dummad, we-dulemar-ibe be ebinsaed oburusad. A-ulale, amar nakwegala be imakosulid.
Ar dule manibina e-ai-urmakdibe, na e-mimmigan-burgwed daknonikoed.
”Bab-Dummad, dulemar-angi-dodogar-sunmakega be imaksad, aka an-wagargi-wiiakmalaga be imaksad.
Ibmar-nunmakedba bar an nue ataksurgusad, bela an garbigus dakleged.
Dule-nuegan an-dakalile, geger an-dakardamalad. Degidbali, we-dulemar dule-isganamargi uluddamalad.
Degi-inigwele, ar dule-innikidaedi, e-gudiidbali, bur nued gudii guoed. Dule-ibmar-oakalossulidi, bur bule gangumaid.
”¡Dagmala! Anse gatik gwisgudamala. Ar an wisid, ar bemar-abargi dule-binsaed-ibed gwen gudisulid.
An-bergued-ibagan nue-walikgusad, an-ibmar-abeged gwen anga gusulid, degine, an-ibmar-imakoye-sogsad, gwen anga gusurbalid.
We-dulemar neg-mutikid neg-ibginedyob dakdamalad. Amba neg mutikile, sogdedamalad, neg oibodaniye.
¿Ibu bar an edarbosunna? Unnila napa-yaba-dogedbi an napid, negsichidgi an mai guoed.
Ar neg-uan an-babga guoed, nusmar an-nanga, an-gwenadganga gunonimogoed.
Degisoggu, ¿bia bendakleged-igar an amiosunna? ¿Bia ibmar-nued bar anga danikosunna?
An ibmar-nued-edarbediid anba bergudoed, anba napaga gudmogoed.”
Degine, geb Bildad Súah-neggweburgined, Job-abin-sogded:
“¿Sana be sunmaked bogilegoe? Binsaed-nikaa be sunmakena, anmar nuedgi sunmaksaled.
¿Ibiga ibdulamaryob be anmar-dake? ¿Ibiga binsaedsurmaladyob be anmar-dake?
Ar be urwed doggussoggu, abali, na be dukin wionaid. ¿Ar degidbali, napaneg swiri naguoye be binsasi? ¿Ar be-sogedba akwamar ainiroye be binsasi?
”Ar dule-isganamar-e-gwallu akitoed, e-soo-gaedi baligaosulid.
Dule-isgana-e-neguyagine neg sichiledoed, e-gwallu-gasiid akitoed.
Dule-isgana gandikidba-nanaed bergudoed, degine, e-igar-mesisadgi dukin yardaklegoed.
Na e-nanadiidba dukin yardakledii guoed, dukin e-sakigi galenai guoed,
e-nagmatarba galegoed, egi bar noosulid, bela egi apurnai guoed.
Dule-isgana-iduale, napagi dukuar dub bukwad, adi, nadapile, egi galegegar.
Dule-isganaga neg-gwayed nagunonikid, gwayed eba sorba gudiguad.
Bonigan-egi-yoleged bogigunaisulid, dule-isgana ukudba belagus nadapid.
E-ukamar, boniganse ibitonaid, e-arganmar, e-nagmar, burgwedanikid.
Dule-isgana na neguyagi-baisur-binsadiid bergusad, emisgindina, burgwed-igarse nadapsunnad.
Dule-isgana-e-neguya, soo-sailase bela ibitosad. E-ibmar-nikadi, soo-azufreʼse bergusad.
Igi sapi-saila, e-malimar, e-anagan, dinguddae, debayobi, dule-isgana gued.
We-napneggi bar dule-isganagi binsalegosulid, e-nug-dummarba-megisad bela bergunonikoed.
Dule-isgana neg-meegwadgi-gudiidi, negasichidse barmelledoed, we-napneggi-gudiidgi ononnolegoed.
Dule-isgana na e-neggweburgi mimmigan, gwen obegosulid, e-gudigusadgi, gwenadgan gwen obegosurbalid.
Dulemar dad-nakwedsik-bukwamaladi, degine, dad-argwanedsik-bukwamaladi, dule-isgana-deyob-gusad geger itomaloed. Degisoggu, gwayed egi nagunonimaloed.
Weyob dule-isgana bergued, dulemar-Bab-Dummad-akudakdimalad weyob bergued.”
Degidbali Job, Bildad-abin-imakded. Weyob sogded:
“¿Sanagwadse bemar an-wionai guoe? ¿Sanagwadse bemar angi-sunmaknaid indakmaloe?
Bemar angi gannar-gannar yolenanaidi, ¿bemar bingesurmarsi?
Ar an nue-isgusye soglegele, angi siido, an na wargwen gunaid.
Bemar bur anba dule-nuedye sogmarsunde, emide, an-isgusadba be angi dododmalad.
Bemar wisgumalargebed, Bab-Dummad weyob an-imaknaid, ar Bab-Dummad e-sakigi an-gasa gunaid.
”Aisaar an binnasuli gornainad: ‘¡An-oburgwebimarye!’ Dule-wargwensaale, gwen an-itosulid. An bendakleged egisnai-inigwele, gwen an-bendaksurmalad.
Bab-Dummadi an-idu igar edusad, gege bar an obake gusad. An-nanaedbali negasichidbi an-idu nasiksad.
Bab-Dummadi, an-ibmar-bukidar-nikadi bela an-ibe sunonikid. An-nug-dummarba-gued bela an-ibe obelononibalid.
Sapiyobi, bela an-obelosad. An-ibmar-edarbediid, sapi-e-saila-bergusayobi an-ibe obelosad.
Bab-Dummadi nue angi dummad-urwenaid, e-isdaradga an-imaksa gunaid.
Bela e-bila-onomalad an-ebiris ambikunonimalad, an-dordoneg-ebiris bukunonimalad. Napa-arsanyob-nakwemai sobsamalad degi, angi gwisgunonimalad.
”Bab-Dummadi an-gwenadgan-angi-banguega imaksad, an-aimarse-bakale, angi bangudmalad.
An-gwenadgan an-iedmalad, dule-magar-an-dakdimalad an-iedmarmogad.
An-neggi-gudimalad aku an-dakdemalad, bunormar-anga-arbadimaladse-bakale, dule-baidiyob an-dakdemalad.
An-maiga-gudiidse an gotedaenad, gwen an-abin-imaksurdaed. Amba ise-wilegar an gordibe, amba an-itodasulid.
An-gaya-yapannedde gwen nabir-yapansulid, an-ome ima an-itoged. An-gwenadgan-gargwenmaladse-bakale, imasun an-daked.
Burwiganase-bakale, angi dododmalad. An-dakarmalale, biir naddamalad.
An-aimarbela imasar an-dakdemarmogad, an-gwenadganbela angi aibitemalad.
An-garmar bus-bus gusad, an-san bar daklesurgusad. Unnila napi an bunnodiid.
An-aimar, nue-wile be an-dakmala, ar Bab-Dummad nue an-wionaid. ¡Nue-wile be an-dakmala!
¿Ar ibiga Bab-Dummad-an-wionaidyob bemar an-imaknaimarmoga? ¿Ar bemar an-wionanaid baisur-itomala?
”Bitigine an-sunmakedi gardagi narmaklegena yeerban, gardagi narmakar megisana yeerban.
An-sunmakedi akwagi degisadegu narmakar megisana yeerban, esgoro-madaregedgi degisadegu narmakar megisana yeerban.
An nue-wisid, an-Bab-Dummad-An-Ollor-Imaked dula maid. We-dule dummad-an-wilenaidgi an-ogwisguoed an nue-wisid.
An-san bela bergussundibele, amba an-ibyagwar an Bab-Dummad-dakedsegad.
Amba Bab-Dummad-dakoedi an nue-wisid, an-sunnagwad an dakoed, dule-baid dakosulid. We-ibagan an nue bela-bela edarbediid.
”Bemar sogbalid: ‘Anmar egi yolegoe, ar a-dulegi isgued nue-maid.’
Nue salakarmalo, es-suidse ibitodamalar. We-es-suidgi Bab-Dummad dule-isgana obeloged. Bemar wisgumar, Bab-Dummad anmar-wilub-daked maid.”
Weyobi, Zofar Naamat-neggweburgined, Job-abin sogded:
“An we-ibmar-itosad sunmakebier an-imaked. An-binsaed-oburusadba sunmakebier an itoged.
We-ibmar-sunmaklesad-an-itosadi, isdarsunna an-imaked. An ibmar-wismogadba an abinsamogargebed.
”Neg-gusad be nue-wisimakaled, gebesailanagine, we-napneggi dule-aidenonikid-akale,
dule-isgana-werguedi sikwas nagudaed. Unnila sikwas yeer-itodii gudidaed, bato yog-berguar naddaed.
Dule-isgana-e-san-dummarba-imakedi, amba nibnegse warmakdibe, dule-isgana-e-nono amba mogir-ebudibe,
we-dule, e-ibmar-isgana-berguddaedyobi bergudoed. E-aimar sogdemaloed: ¿Bia we-dule nade?
We-dule gabdaklegedyobi bergudoed, negburgan-daklegedyobi sikwas daklegoed.
Dulemar, we-dule-isgana-daksagusmalad bar dakosurmalad. E-neguyagi-gudigusmaladse-bakale, bar dakosurmalad.
We-dule-isgana-e-mimmigan, dule-wilegana-wiolesad bendakedsegad. We-dule-isgana-e-mimmigan, dule-wilesmalad-ibe ibmar-nuegan-susmaladi gannar ukedsegad.
Dule-isgana sapingwagwadgine, gandik na itodiile, ibagwengi amba neg-urba dogedsegad.
”We-dule ibmar-isgana ibnuedga imakdiid, ibmar-ochiganayob dakdiid.
Gwen ibmar-isgana metebigudisulid, aka egi wergudiid.
Igi-dule ibmar-ochigwad dogdar-masale, saban-nunmaked ega ukdae, deyobi, ibmar-isgana dule-isganaga naibe-e-gichiyob gunonikoed.
Ibmar-bukidar-emar-yardakedgi-amisad gannar e-ibe sulegoed. Bab-Dummad-sogedba gannar e-ibe bela sulegoed.
Dule-isgana-e-isguedi naibe-e-gichiyob gued, we-gichigi dukin burgoed.
Bela moli-nunis-bukidar, achanis-bukidar, diwar-ariomaiyob-guedgi gwen wergudii guosulid.
Ibmar-bukidar-amisadi, gannar uknai dakledagoed, gwen egi werguosulid, egi ibmar-nued amiosulid.
Dule-isgana dogdar dule-wilemalad wiosad, gwen negmar-e-sobsasulid emar-ibe susbalid.
”We-dule-isgana sulibinsa ibmarbina-itodii gusad, gwen ibmar-nikad itossulid. Bela ese ibmar sulemai gusad.
Ibmar gwen abin sigissulid, bela ese sulesad. A-ulale, e-ibmar-nasgumaid bergudoed.
Ibmar-bukidar-nikadbali, sulibinsa-itodii gudoed, degidbali, ega boni-dummagan nonikoed.
Dule-isgana ibmarba nue-yeer-itodiidgine, Bab-Dummad egi yolenonikoed, egi ise-urwar gwichigunonikoed.
Dule-isgana aisaar gingimar-esgorogi-sobaledgi wakinbi-gudagoenad, sigu-esgoro-gordikidgi ibitogoed.
Sigu-esgoro-gordikidbiid egi yolenonikoedi, ungebigudagoenad, sigu-duku binagi buudu-noedi ungebigudagoenad. Dobedbali, surbinsa itodoed.
Negasichidi, dule-isgana-edarbenaid, soo-dule-ogaed-abesulidi, dule-isgana-obelogoed, e-negse-bakale, ogumakoed.
Nibneg, dule-isgana-e-isgusad magar-dakle imaknonikoed. Napneg, dule-isgana-isgusad barsognonikoed.
Bab-Dummad-urwenonikoed-ibagine, dule-isgana-e-neg-bukwad, dii-dummad-muredba seledoed.
Weyobi, Bab-Dummad dule-isganaga bergued nasiksad. Weyobi, Bab-Dummad, dule-isganaga bergued-igar mesisad.”
Agine Job abin-sogded:
“Bemar nue an-sunmaked itomala, adi, bemar nabir gadi-gadi an-imakmaloed.
An sunmaknaile, mer sulibinsa alled-itomalo. An sunmaked-bergusale, bemar allebier, allemaloed.
”An-urwenaidi, dulemarbo an urwenaisulid. A-ulale, geg an san bargaed.
Nue be an-dakmar. Geger be an-dakmaladba, gaya be gamaloed.
We-ibmargi an binsaddibe an gwakiddaed, bela an-abaganmar iii naddaed.
¿Ibiga dule-isganamar amba dula-gudinanae? Aka bur bule nasgumamaid, deyob seredgumamaid.
Dule-isganamar e-mimmigan-nasgumai daked, e-waganmar-nasgumai daked.
Dule-isganamar e-neguyagi neg-bogidikid-nika gudidamalad, dobedsuli gudidamalad, Bab-Dummadse gwen sabsur-odurdaklesurmalad.
Dule-isgana-e-molimar-bebe-nikad e-dula-bakmalad sunsogmaladid. E-moli-omegandina, mimmigan-nikualile, gwen e-ibe mellesulid.
Dule-isgana-e-mimmigan sibad-wawaadyob abarmakdidamalad, dodonaigusmalale, oallenagusdamalad.
Gar-tambor-goledbali, gar-arpa-goledbali, namakdedamarbalid. Gar-gammu-goledbali, wergunaidamarbalid.
Ar dule-isganamar-e-gudiidi, nueganbi gudidamalad. Burgwidmalale, nuedgi burgwiddamalad.
Dule-isganamar Bab-Dummadga sogdedamalad: ‘Mer be anse gole, anmar Be-Igar-Maidba nanabisurmalad.
Anmar e-nug-odummogega, Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadde, ¿doasunna? Anmar ese gorye sogele, ¿ibu-nued egi amilesunna?’
Dule-isganamar na e-ibmar-nuegan-nika-guega egi sisulid. Bipisaale, amar-binsaed-isgana-ukedba an binsaed galegosulid.
”Dule-isganamar geg burgwe gudimalad. Undar iba-suitii gudidamalad. Dule-isganamar boni-dummaganba-gar-itodii dasurmalad.
Dule-isganamar, gagan-dinnagwadyob, burwa-dummadba-selemai dakledisulid. Dule-isganamar, burwa-ooredba gaganyob-selemai dakledisurbalid.
Anga sogdamaloed, Bab-Dummad dule-isgana-e-mimmiganbi sabsur-odurdakoye, e-babgandi, odurdakosurye. Bab-Dummad bur bule e-babgan sabsur-odurdakena gadin, adi, magar na itomaloed.
Dule-isgana e-wilegoed, e-ibyagwar na daksun. Dule-isgana, Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-sabsur-e-odurdaked itosun.
Dule-isganamar bar undar-gudii guosulidbali, e-sorba-e-gwenadgan-beoedi, gwen bai dakosulid, gwen egi binsaosulid.
”¿Doa Bab-Dummad binsaed-nuegan-nikuega odurdakosunna? Bab-Dummad bur emar-wilubdaked maid, nuga-nikamaladse-bakale, ese wilub-daklemalad.
Abar-dulemar nuchukwagwadgi burgwemalad, nue yeer-neg-itodimaladgi burgwemalad, nue bogidikid-gudiidgi burgwiddamalad.
Ibmar-bukidar-nikaa gudidamalanad, san-nuedi, bonisuli gudidamalanad, deyob burgwiddamalad.
Abar-dule sulibinsa-isdar-itodii burgwiddabalid, gwen ibmar-nuedgi-wergudsuli burgwiddamalad.
Bela we-dulemar napa-yaba-burgwarmamaile, emarbi gumalad. Napa-urba nusbiini mamai gumaloed.
”Ar bemar-binsabukwadi an wisid, unnila bemar an-wiogedgi binsabukwad.
Bemar-binsananaid an wisbalid. Bemar binsabukwad: ‘¿Bia we-dule-nuga-nikad-e-neg-dummad nade? ¿Bia we-dule-isgana-e-neg nade?’
¿Dule-bukidar-igarba-nanamaladse be egissurmarsi? ¿A-dulemar-sunmaked be nue-itosurmarsi?
Dule-isgana bonigan-nonikile, akar-gusurdamalad. Sabsur-odurdakleged-ibagi, san-onosdamalad.
¿Doa dule-isganaga e-gudiidgi akar sogosunna? ¿Doa ega asabinmakar ibmar sogosunna? ¿Doa dule-isgana sabsur-odurdakosunna?
Dule-isgana-burgwisar, neg-uanse-selesdibe, e-neg-uangi dule-nakulemalad ogwichilesdaed.
Neg-uanse-e-bardakmalad bukidar ainiardaed. Napa-nuedgi digles mesilesdaed, nuedgi bogidik mesilesdaed.
”Degite, ¿igi bemar an-gwage gadi-gadi imakosunna? Yogasaar be anga sunmaknanaimalad, bemar anga ibmar-sognaid inniki anga sunmaknanaisurmalad.”
Agine, Temán-neggweburgined-Elifaz, Job-abin sogded:
“Dule-gwensak binsaed-nikarbadibe, ¿Bab-Dummadgala ibnuedga gue? Suli. Dule-deyobid na dukin ega ibnuedga gued.
¿Be-innikidaedgi Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad ibmar-nued amisi? Suli. Ar gwen ibmar-nued egi amisulid. ¿Be-nued-nanaedgi Bab-Dummad ibmar-nued amisi? Suli. Ar gwen ibmar-nued egi amisulid.
”Ar Bab-Dummad sabsur bega ibmar-sognaile, degi, bega igar itonaile, ar be e-dobegudiidbarsulid.
Ar be-isgued-doggus-merguedba, degi, be-isgued-bargalesulidba, deyob be-imaknaid.
Be-gwenadgan bese ibmar-egisdanidibe, gwen be ibmar-abesulidgi, gandikidgi, e-ibe ibmar-anar, mor be susdaed. Dule-wilemalad-ibe mor bela be susdaed, uka-swana be metedaed.
Dule-ukudmaad-gudimaladga, gwen gobed be ukdasurbalid. Dule-masbina-gudimaladga, be gwen mas ukdasurbalid.
Be dule-buled megissoggu, dule-nainu-ibed be megissoggu, be binsasanad, ani an napa-ibedye.
Omegan-ei-sui-burgwismaladga, gwen ibmar-uksasuli be barmiddaed. Sergan-satemalad-ibe be ibmar bela susdabalid.
A-ulale, emisgindi galesnaiyob be itoged, ukiagwar nue-dobe be itoardaed.
Negsichidgi-gudiiyob be itoged, a-ulale, ibmar-daksuli be-imaked. Diwar-dummadse-selemaiyob be itoged.
”¿Bab-Dummadi nibneggi maisursi? ¡Be dakena! Niisgwamar-dikasurnanaid matusuli begi nanaid.
Emide be soged: ‘Bab-Dummad, ¿ibi wissunna? ¿Bab-Dummad sunna negsichid-abalagi emar-wilubdaksi?’
Be sogbalid: ‘Mogirmar Bab-Dummad-idu bipirmaknaiye, mogir-gudureged ebirisnaiye. Agala, Bab-Dummad gege anmar-dakye.’
”Dule-isganamar-galagwensuli-nanasmaladba, ¿be nanamogode?
Be ebinsao, we-dulemar nuchukwagwadgi burgwisgusmalad, diwar-dummadba ibmar-selegedyobi bergusmalad.
Aka Bab-Dummadga sogdegusmalad: ‘Mer be anmarse gorye, Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, ¿ibu be anmarga imaksunnoye?’
Bab-Dummad ega ibmar-nuegan-ukdii gusanad. Andina, dule-isgana-e-binsaed-isganaba binsaed-galeged, sate.
”Dule-nuegan, dule-isganamar-ibitonanaid-daksagua, yeer-itosmalad, dule-ibmar-oakalodisurmalad egi dododmalad, sogdemalad:
‘Anmar-isdarmalad burgwismalad, e-ibmar-nikad soose bela ei-gummaksad.’
”Job, Bab-Dummad-urbaligwa be nanae, ebo be igar nudake, Bab-Dummad gannar ibmar-nikuega be-imakoed.
Bab-Dummad-e-sunmakmaid be nue abingae, e-igar-durdakleged be-gwagegi nue-sedii be gue.
Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadse be gannar wilesakwaa atakdedibe, be-neguyagi ibmar-isgana be obangusbardibe, bela be nugunonikoed, weligwar be gunonikoed.
Be or-nuegan-nikadi napagi be miele, Ofir-e-ormar diwar-akwamar-imbagi be miele,
Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad be-or-nuedga gunonikoed, Bab-Dummad be-mani-nuedga gunonikoed.
Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad yeer-ito be-imakoed. Bab-Dummad-asabinni bar be bingeguosulid.
Bab-Dummadse be gotele, be-itogoed. Bedi ega ibmar-imakoye-sogsad be imakedsegad.
Be ibmar-imaksokalile, bega ibmar-nueganbi gudoed. Be-iduale gwallu-ganaiyob bega neg-nagunonikoed.
Bab-Dummadi, dule-san-dummarba-imakdiid, san-bipii imaked. Dule-na-san-bipi-imakdimalad-e-nugdi, odummoged.
Bab-Dummadi, dule-ibmar-oakalodisurmalad bendaked. Be dule-innikidaedba Bab-Dummad be-bendakoed.”
Job, Elifaz-abin-imakded:
“Emi amba an naibi-itoged-abalagi sunmakoed, amba Bab-Dummad sabsur-an-imaknaid.
An wisina, bia Bab-Dummad mai, degi, an e-maidse sunna nabir moena,
an san-bendakegala an bela ega ibmar sogsaled.
Bab-Dummad-ibmar-sogbied an wisgusaled. Degidbali, an magar itononikiled.
Bab-Dummad angi sabsur-gwisguega, ¿e-gangued angi oyogergebsi? ¡Suli! Angi gwisgussuliled, unnila an-itonai gusaled.
Dule-innikidaedi, Bab-Dummad-asabinni sunna na san-bendaked. Andina, anga-igar-naboged-asabin degisadegu ollorgusaled, ibmar-oakalossuliyob an-daksaled.
”Aisaar an Bab-Dummad-amidiinad. An dad-nakwedsik nadele, an daksulid, dad-argwanedsik nadbalile, an daksurbalid.
Bab-Dummad dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik-gunaile, an daksurbalid. Dad-nakwed-nuedsik-gunaile, an daksurbalid.
Bab-Dummaddi bela an-gudiid nue-wisimakaled. Bab-Dummad an-wilubdakye-sogele, or-swilimakaleyob an gusaled.
Bab-Dummad-Igarba an nue-nanadiid, e-sogedba an nanadiid, an egi bangudisulid.
E-Igar-sogsagusadgi an bangudisulid. E-ibmar-sogsadi, an-gwage-ulubgi an sediid.
”Bab-Dummad na ibmar-imakbiedba imakmaid, ¿doa ega akar-sogoe? Na e-abegedba ibmar imakmaid.
Bab-Dummad, igi-an-imakoye na sogsa, deyob an-imakoed. Ibmar-baigan-bukidar ayobi, na e-abegedba imakoed.
Agala, an Bab-Dummad-asabin dobee itodaed. We-ibmargi an bela binsaddibe, nue-dobe an itoddaed.
Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi an-niga-egwachad, nue-dobed anga uksad.
We-ibmar-bela-angi-gunaidi, an-gayamakosulid, an nunmaked-dummad-itonai-inigwele, amba an ibmar sogedsegad.”
Job sogdebalid: “¿Ibiga Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, dule-isgana-odurdakleged-iba nasiksuli? Adi, dule-Bab-Dummadba-nanaimalad dakmaloenad.
Dule-isganamar nainu-suegala, nainu-dikar-abingunaidgi dogdedamalad, degine, molimar-atursasmalad akwedidamalad.
Sergan-satemalad-ibe moli-uayasuid susdamalad. Ome-ei-sui-burgwisad-ibe ibmar-ganikid-anar moli-bebe-nikadi susdamarbalid.
Dule-isganamar dule-wilemalad-igarba-abingualir, e-idu ainirmalaga imaked, e-dobedba e-idu dukumalaga imaked.
Dule-wilemalad, moli-uayasuid-sapurbalidyobi wakudaryalaba negsulidganba masbina gudidamalad. Nega-dulesulidganba e-mimmiganga mas amied.
Dule-wilemalad emar-nainuganse ibmar-obichad-weegala, naddamalad. Dule-isganamar-e-uva-nainugi uva-san-babatisad weenai damalad.
Dule-wilemalad mutikgusale, morsurmaladbali uka-swana megiddamalad. Atued-sulidbali dambed-abalagi neg-oiboardamalad.
Yalaganba dii-wiedba waradik gudidamalad, dukued-sate gudidamalad, unnila akwa-imbaba dukubukwadamalad.
Dule-isganamala, goe-bab-sated e-nan-annik sumalad. Egi-mani-ganikid-anar dule-wilemalad-ibe mimmigan sudamalad.
Dule-wilegana mor-satedbali, uka-swiri gudidamalad. Emar-nainugi ibmar-gwag gwaada semaidamalad. Degidbali, ukudbali burgwiddamalad.
We-dule-wilegana, olivo-gwallu-egurega e-naged-akwa obipirmaknagusdamalad. Uva-e-nis-onogegala egi annanagus damarbalid, degi-inigwele, ukudmaada gunanaidba burgwiddamalad.
Neggweburgine dule-burgwedanimamaid-e-akiginned magar itoleged. Dule-undar-naibigusmalad aisaar Bab-Dummadse bendakleged egisnaidamalanad, degi-inigwele, Bab-Dummad gwen bai dakdasulid.
”Gwenna-gwenna dulemar igar-nued abedasurmalad, isdarsunna dakdamalad. Igar-innikigwadba nanabisurdamalad, ibmar-isgana-imakdiid magar itosurmalad.
Dule-emar-gindaked dule-wilemalad-oburgwega, degi, ibmar-abesa-gudimalad-oburgwega, oibosayala gwisguardaed. Neg-mutikgudele, dule-ibmar-atursaedga binyiddabalid.
Dule-galagwensuli-e-omesulidbo-nanaed neg-mutikgued edarbedidaed, weyob sogdidaed: ‘Dule gwen an-dakosuli.’ Deyob dukuakwaa gudidaed.
Dule-ibmar-atursaed mutikidba emar-negse dogdaed. Neg-ibgindina e-negyaba dukumaidaed. Isdar neg-ibgined dakdaed.
Bela we-dule-isganamargala, neg-ibginedi mutikidyob gued. Neg-mutikid-neg-galagwensur-guardaed bur abedamalad.”
Zofar weyob sogded: “Dule-isganamar dii-iirmakmaiyobi gwae-gwae wakitedamalad, e-nainu-naidi nue-ukabsales naid. A-ulale, gwen dule e-uva-nainugi gannar bar arbabidasulid.
Igi dad-dummad-gaedi, neg-diopisulidi, boo-batenaid berguega-imake, deyobi, dule-isgudimaladi burgwedse berguddamalad.
Dule-isganamar-bergudele, e-nangan bar egi binsaosulid. Amar napa-urba-dogdele, nus-masga gudoed. Dulemar gwen dule-isganamargi bar binsadii guosurmalad. Igi sapimar olaledae, deyobi, gumaloed.
Dule-isganamar ome-geg-mimmi-baked, sabsur-imakdidamalad. Degi, omegan-ei-sui-burgwismalad-sabsur imakdidamarbalid.
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Dummad e-garganguedba dule-isganamargi yoleged. Bab-Dummad uluddibe, dule-isganamar geg abin gwisgued.
Bab-Dummad dule-bulegan-dobsuli imaked, degi, egi bensuli imaked, degi-inigwele, Bab-Dummad amba we-dulemargi nakuleged.
Amar-e-nug unnila sikwas odummoleged, yog-berguar naddaed. Dule-isganamar oros-welegeyob gumalad, gagan-gummakeyob gummakmalad, yoga-berguar naddaed.
”¿Doa anga sogosunna, an-sunmaknaidi gakanye? Dule gege anga soged, we gakanye.”
Súah-neggweburgined-Bildad, Job-abin weyob sogded:
“Bab-Dummadi, dule-gandikidid. Dobesar dule-imakedid. Bab-Dummadi bela nibneggine igar-ilemakmaidid.
E-sordagan-merguedi, gege ebisleged. Bela dulemargi Bab-Dummad-e-gwallu gaed.
¿Sunna dule ibmar-oakalossuliyob Bab-Dummad-asabinni gwisgusi? ¿Sunna dule Bab-Dummad-asabinni islidikidga na san-imaksi?
Ar niibela Bab-Dummad-asabinni bollee gaed, niisgwamarbela e-asabinni gannarba gasurmogad.
Dule-bulesunna, nus-musgimakmaiyob gudiid, dulede, napa-nusyob gued.”
Job Bildad-abin weyob sogded:
“¿Weyob be dule-gegudiid-bendaksunde? ¿Weyob be dule-nollogudiid nue-bendakye be sogsunde?
Ibiyobi dule-ibmar-wissulidga binsaed-nued-uke an be-dake. Ibiyobi nue-binsaed-nikaye na be san oyoge.
¿Doa weyob-sunmakedgi be-odurdaksa? ¿Doa weyob sunmakega be-imaksa?” Bildad, Job-abin-sogdebalid:
“Dule-burgwarmalad demar-wilad-urbali-mamaidi, Bab-Dummad-asabinni, wawanmakmaid.
Burgwarmalad-meged-galumar bela Bab-Dummad-asabinni, magar daklemamaid. Burgwed-igar Bab-Dummad-asabinni, dukumaisulid.
Bab-Dummadi, bela nibneg-naid neg-olloledgi nasiksad, napnegdi, ibmargi-akanaisuli nasiksabalid.
Bab-Dummadi, mogirmargi dii nasiksabalid, Bab-Dummadi, mogir nabir dii-bargae imaksabalid.
Bab-Dummadi, nii-dalunaid-eduegala, irwa mogir nasiked.
Bab-Dummadi, magatibali demargi igar-maiyob imaksad, adi, nabir neg-ibgined, neg-mutikidgi bachiki-nai guegar.
Bab-Dummad-urwed-abinni nibneg-bargamaladi, dobedbali wawanmakdedamalad.
Bab-Dummadi, e-ganguedgi demar-uurmaked obogileged. Bab-Dummadi, e-ibmar-wisidbali ibdula-Rahabʼye-nugad ese ibitosad.
Bab-Dummadi, e-bunnogedgi mogir oaisakied. E-argangine, ibdula-dummad-demargined oitoged.
We-ibmar unnila-sikwas Bab-Dummad-e-gangued oyonaid. Anmar unnila-sikwas, Bab-Dummad-e-gangued itonaid. ¿Doa Bab-Dummad-e-gangued bela magar itogosunna? Dule gege magar itoged.”
Job weyob sogdebalid:
“Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-nuggine, degine, anga igar-nudaksulid-nuggine, sae-itogega an-imaked-nukine, ise-sogar an soged:
Amba an dula-gudiidgine, an nue garmakdiidgine,
an gaya-isgana sogosulid, gakansaale an ibmar sogosulid.
Bemar-angi-sunmakedi nabir be sogmarye an sogosulid. Amba an dula-gudiidgine an ibmar-oakalossurye an sogoed.
An ibmar-oakalossursoggu, an sikirmakosulid, gwen akar an binsanaisulid. An dula-gudiidgine gwagegi akar an itogosulid.
”Bab-Dummad, dule-isganamaryobi an-isdarmalad be obeloge. Dule-inniki-nanasurmaladyobi an-isdarmalad be obeloge.
Bab-Dummad dule-isganamar-oburgweye-sogele, ¿bia bar bendakleged amimalosunna?
Amargi boni-dummagan gwichigunonikile, Bab-Dummad amar-ese-binnasuli-goled itogosulid.
¿Ar dule-isgana Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadgi wergudisi? ¿Ar Bab-Dummadse bane-bane gordibarsi?
An bega Bab-Dummad-e-gangued oyogwelo. Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-e-igarmar an bega odukuosulid.
Ar bela bato bemar we-igarmar daksabinmaladde, degite, ¿ibiga bemar yogasaar sunmaknanaisunna?”
Zofar Job-abin weyob sogded: “Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi dule-isganamarga we-igarmala sabosad. Bab-Dummadi dule-galagwensurdamaladga sabsur-odurdakleged-igala, weyob mesisad:
Ar dule-isgana mimmigan-ichesur-nika-inigwele, amba es-suidgi burgwemaloed, a-e-mimmigandi, ukudmaada gudii gudmaloed.
Dule-isgana amba besmalale, boniganse burgwemaloed. E-omegan-bemaloedi, gwen e-suimar-burgwismaladga boosurmaloed.
Dule-isganamar, amba mani-bukib ukubyob-onmaksale, mormar suar-ena-ena nikuele,
dule-nued-daedi a-mormar yononikoed, dule-inniki-gudiid a-mani sunonibaloed.
Dule-isgana-neg-sobedi sikwi-uu-baisur-ayareyob gued, dule-nakuleged-neg-matar-baisur-ayared-sobsadyob e-neg dakleged.
Dule-isganamar, napi-mani-ibed-gudii gabiddamalad, neg-oibosale, mani-sate oiboardamalad. Dule-wilegedga nadmalad.
Dule-isgana neg-ibgine, gwayed-dummad egi nagunonidaed. Neg-mutikgusale, burwa-dummad egi gordanikiyob itodaed.
Burwa-uereged sabsur-gornonikile, we-dule-isgana gwen abin gwisguosulid, burwa-dummadi e-neg-maid sedoed.
Bab-Dummadi, dule-isganagi sabsur-yoleged, dule-isgana Bab-Dummadgi, aisaar wakinnoeyob itodaenad.
Weyobi, dulemar, dule-isgana-ibitonai-dakarmalale, yeer dakdamalad, ega argan ogotedamalad, ega sabsur-wigoddamalad.”
Job sogdebalid: “Manimala, ormala napa-urba amileged, sooyagi diree imaklesiid.
Esgoromala, napa-yaba onolesiid, esnon-goromardi akwamargi onolesiid.
Dule-akwa-nuegan-amimaladi, bar negsichid-nai daksurmalad. Negsichidgi-akwamar-bukwadi ese onilebukwad. Yaamargi-akwa-nuegan-nikadi bela onimalad.
Neg-uluba-nanaledisulidgi yaamar akwimalad. Matusuli yaa akwimalad. Dubba bannumakar aidedamalad. Dulemargi dikasuli neg-urba gunanaidamalad
Yaa-matusulidgine arbananaidamalad, neg-uere-itoledaed-yabali gunanaidamalad, abali, masgunned amididamalad.
A-yabali, akwa-dummagangine akwa-nued-zafiroʼye-nugad onomalad, a-napa-yabali, or amimarbalid.
Sulubmar we-yaa-gwisaled dakdisurmalad, sulub-e-atakedi, we-yaa-gwisaled-e-gulluse ataksulid.
Ibdula-ursirmaladbela, a-yaa-gwislegaledyaba dogdisulid. Achumigurbela ese walikgudisulid.
Dule-akwa-nuegan-amimaladi akwa-nuegan-amiegale, akwa-dutusulid sarsonagusdamalad, akwa-e-sailamarse-bakale, onodamalad.
Akwa-dummagan-akwimalad a-yaba dii-oiirmakega yaa-dummagan omesdamalad. Dii-iirmakmaidbali akwa-nuegan-bukwadi bela magar dakdamalad.
Akwa-nuegan-amiegala, diwar-e-sailase warmakdamalad. Ibmar-dukuar-bubukwad bela negache onodamalad.
”Degite, ¿bia binsaed-nued-nikagued danisunna? ¿Bia gurgin-nuegan-nikulegedde danimosunna?
Binsaed-nued-gargeguedi dule wissulid. We-binsaed-nuedi we-napneggi danisulid.
Muu-billi-maidbela soged: ‘Binsaed-nuedi, angi danisurye.’ Demarbela sogmogad: ‘Binsaed-nuedi, angi amilesurmoye.’
Or-nuegangine, binsaed-nuegana amilesulid, manigine, binsaed-nuegana baklesulid.
We-napneggi amba or-Ofir-bukwadgi binsaed-nuegan gege bakleged. Amba akwa-nued-óniceʼye-nugadginbela gege bakleged, akwa-nued-zafiroʼye-nugadginbela gege baklebalid.
Binsaed-nuedi, bur or-nueganba, akwa-diamanteʼye-nugadba bur gargerbasailad. Olua-or-nuegangi-sobaledbo geg binsaed-nuedi ogwaleged.
Binsaed-nuedi, akwa-bisgi-nueganba ibnuedid, dimmurgiid-e-akwa-yeerdaklegedba bur sunsogedid.
Akwa-nued-topacioʼye-nugad Etiopíaʼgi-nikadi, gege binsaed-nued-nikagued-ebo yobi gued. Binsaed-nued-nikaguedi gege or-sunsogedgi bakleged.
”Degite, ¿bia binsaed-nued-nikaguedde danisunna? ¿Bia gurgin-nuegan-nikulegedde noarsunna?
Binsaed-nued-nikagued bela emargi dukumaid, nuumarbela gege binsaed-nued-nikagued baramimogad.
Bergulegedi, degi, burgwedi, weyob soged: ‘Unnila, anmar binsaed-nikagued-e-nug-dummarba-guedbi itodimoye.’
”Unnila Bab-Dummadbi binsaed-nikagued-igar wisid. Binsaed-nuedi bia daniki, bia binsaed-nikaguedi amilebali, nue-wisbalid.
Bab-Dummadi, we-napneggi galu-sukunmar-bubukwadse-bakale, wisid. Soggwensaale, napneggi-ibmar-bukwad gwen egi yoggusisulid.
Bab-Dummadi, burwaga e-gangued mesnaigua, degine, muu-billiga e-dungued mesnaibargua, binsaed-nued-nikaguedi daksagusad.
Bab-Dummad, dii-wiedga igar mesnaibargua, mar-goledga igar mesnaibargua,
binsaed-nued-nikaguedi daksagusbalid. Bab-Dummadi binsaed-nued-e-gargegued daknaigusbalid, degine, binsaed-nued-nikagued wilubdaknaigusbalid, geb binsaed-nued-nikagued bargannononikid.
Bab-Dummad dulemarga sogded: ‘An-dobekwaa-nanaedi, binsaed-nued-nikaadaedye. Degine, ibmar-isgana-imakedgi-banguedi, ibmar-wisi-daedbarye.’ ”
Job gannar sunmakdebalid, weyob sogded:
“Bitigi Bab-Dummad-nue-an-akwedigusad-ibagan-nasadyobi, gannar an gudigusana gadin.
Ar negsichiganba dobsuli an gudidaed, ar Bab-Dummad gwalluyob an-idudidaed.
An sapingwaunni, amba an gannarba-gudidaeunni, Bab-Dummad nued-angi-binsaedba an-neguya mer akarguega imakdaed.
”Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad anba gudidaeunni, an-mimmigan an-ebiris gudidaed.
Deyob-gudiidgine, an-mesegine wilub-obicha mas an nikagudaed. Olivo-gwallumar e-akwa-eguredgi wilub-obicha ariomaidaed.
Igar-itogegala, neggwebur-e-yawagak-noedse an signadele, dule-igar-nabomalad-abargi an signadele,
sapingan, yog-ainiar an-iduar imakdamalad, sergana, yog-gwichibin an-abin imakdamarmogad.
Dule-nuga-nikamaladi, bogi-ambikusdamalad, bar-sunmakdasurmalad. An-abin e-gaya gasa imakdedamalad.
Dummadga-negdakmamaidse-bakale, an-asabinni binnasdikii sunmakdedamalad, imbagwenale bar-sunmaksurdamalad.
Dulemar an-sunmaked itodmalale, nued angi sunmakdamalad. An-dakdemalale, an-nug ogannoddamalad.
Dule-wilegana, anse wiledanikile, an bendakdaed. Sergan-sated, an bendakdabalid. Ar dule-e-bendakmalad sated.
Dule-na-bela-itodimaladi, angi ise-nued binsadamalad. Omegan-ei-sui-burgwismalad, an yeer-ito imakdabalid.
An gusgu igar-innikigwad an imakdaed, an igar-sogmaidba ibmar imakdaed. An we-ibmar-imakedi, mor-nued-yoeyobi anga gudaed, gurgin-nued-sieyob anga gudaed.
Dule-aku-atakmaladga e-ibyayobi an gudii gusad. Dule-yaku-yaku-nanamaladga, e-maliyobi an gudii gusbalid.
Dule-ibmar-abesa-gudimaladga, an e-babyobi gudii gusad. Dule-yar-baidsikmaladi, an bendaksabalid.
Dule-isganamar-e-gangued an obelosdabalid. We-dulemar, bar emar-wiogega an imaksasulid.
”An weyob binsadii gualid: ‘Undar an gudii guoye, an-neggi nuedgi sereddii an burgoye.
Andi sapi-diwar-naba-gwichiyobi gued, sapi-anagan boo-mutik-batedgi-obgwichiyobi an gued.
An-nug-dummarba-maid berguosurye, an-gargangued berguosurye,’ an binsadii gualid.
”Dulemar an-sunmaked-itodmalale, ise-itogar bukusdamalad. Bogidikgi an-binsaed-uknaid itosigisdamalad.
An-gayaburba-sunmakedi nue yeer itodamalad, dule gwen an-abin-imakdasulid.
An-sunmaked edarbedidamalad. Igi dii-wied-edarbeledae, deyobi, an-sunmaked-edarbedidamalad.
An dulemarga allee gualile, geger an-dakdamalad. An-ega-allee gusale, e-niga ganguddamalad.
Ani an ega igar oyodaed, ibi-igarba namaloe, degi, ani an idumaidaed. Rey e-sordamar-abargigudiiyobi, an emar-abargi gudidaed. Dule-gwage-naibi-itodiid-baisur-itoge-imakedyob an gued.”
“Emisgindi, sapingan-burwigana anga alliardamalad. Ar we-sapingan-e-babgana an-achu-sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad-edarbega an imaksasuliled.
Ar anga-arbamarye-sogele, ¿ar ibu wis anga imaksamalale? Ar bar gargangued nikasurmalad.
We-dulemar, neg-mutikidba negsulidganba gaamakdidamalad, ukudmaada gudidamalad, boniganba galitodidamalad.
We-dulemar ibmar-gunnegala, gagan-moododba ibmar-gwag wedidamalad, gagan-e-malimarse-bakale, gundii damarbalid.
Neggweburginbela isdar we-dulemar-dakdamalad, atursamaladye gin sogdamalad.
Agala, we-dulemar dian-dinnaganaba gudidamalad, akwa-yaba, degi, ibegan-imbaba gudii damarbalid.
Moli-uayasuid-goledyobi gagan-bulaba gormakdidamalad, degine, ikoganba doge-doge gudidamarbalid.
We-dulemar dule-abelesurmaladid, agala, neggweburgi ononnolesmalad.
”Emisgindi, aka we-sapinganga an dodogedga gued, amar-oalledga an gued.
Ima an-dakdemalad, deyob-an-dakedbali angi bangudmalad, angi wii-minanai gusdamalad.
Emidi, Bab-Dummad bela-bela mesagwar an-imaksasoggu, dule-an-bendaked-satesoggu, anga bela-bela sabsur-ibmar sognanaid.
Dule-isganamar an-argan-nuedsiki angi noarmalad, an-oitogegala, an-idu dukuar ambikusmalad. Angi-gwisguegala, napa-nakwemai sobsamalad.
An-obelogegala, an-iduar gwisgunonimalad. Dule-bargaed-sate, an-obelononimalad.
Igi bila-onomalad igar-ollo-imaksamaladba danidae, degi, galumar-ese-ailasmalad-birgi danidae, deyobi angi gwisgunonimalad.
Ise an gwayale gusad, an nug-nika bar an itonadsulid, an-bendakleged mogirmar-yoggudeyob berguded.
”Emisgindi, nue an-san bergudani an itoged, nunmaked-dummad-ibagan an-wionaid.
An-garmarse-bakale, nunumaker an itogusad. Abali, an mutikidba galitomaidaed. Nunmaked gwen anga bergu an itosulid.
Bab-Dummadi dukarba-an-gasagunaiyob an-wionaid. Akus-akus-bunnonaiyob an-imaknaid.
Bab-Dummad olligangi an-barmeted, ukubyobi, degi, buruyobi an-imaksad.
”Bab-Dummad, an bese gornainad, gwen be an-itosulid. Be-asabinni an gwisgunonikinad, gwen be an-daksulid.
Bab-Dummad, gwen-sabe be an-imaksulid, be-gangued-nikadba be an-baregindiid.
Igi ibmar burwaba-seleddae, deyobi, be an-imaksad. Burwa-oored-dummad-abarse be an-barmeted.
Bab-Dummad, neg-uan-urba be an-semaid an nue-wisid. Dule-burgwisar-seleddaedse be an-semaid.
”Dule-galakusmaidi, geg be bar sarsoged, dule-suli-suli-itogedgi-bendakleged-egisnaidi, geg be bar wioged.
¿Dule-boniba-galitodimaladba an bonai gussursi? ¿Dule-wilemalad an wiledaksasursi?
Anga-ibnued-gued an edarbediidgine, aka ibmar-isgana anga gunonikid. Ibagan-nuegan an edarbediidgine, aka ibagan-isgana anga nagunonikid.
Bane-bane sulibinsa an itodiid, gwen baisur-itoge an gudisulid. Unnila boniganba bane-bane an galitodiid.
An wile-itodiid, an bodiidbiid. Aisaar an, an-dulemarse bendakleged egisnaidaenad, degi, an bendakleged abenaidaenad, gwen an-bendaksurdamalad.
Emide, achu-sapur-e-gwenadganayob an gunonisunnad, irmon-senigan-e-gwenadganayob an gunonisunnad.
An-ukamar bela gudure naded, an-ukamar an-ibe yaas-yaas naded. Uellegedbali an-uka-diopisuli an itoged.
An-gar-arpa-goledi, wilesakwaa gorgusad, an-gar-gammu-goledi, wilesakwaa gorgusbalid.”
Job sogdebalid: “An weyob sogsanad: ‘An ome-gwensak-dakalile, bipisaale galagwensuli an egi binsaosurye.’
¿Ibu-ibmar-nued Bab-Dummad-Bur-Biriginedgine amilege? ¿Ibu-ibmar-nued Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadgi nikulege?
¿We-odurdaklegedde dule-isganamargadsursi? ¿Boni-dummagan-amilegedi dule-isganamargadsursi?
Bab-Dummad, ¿an-ibmar-nued-imakdiid daksursi? Bab-Dummad, ¿an-nanadiid daksursi?
”An igar-isganaba nanasale, an gakanginbi sunmaksale,
Bab-Dummad an-wilubdaksundo. Geb agi Bab-Dummadi, an-ibmar-isgana-imakdisulidi dakoed.
An ibmar-nued-imakedgi bangusale, ibmar-isgana-imakedgi an binsadiile, ibmar an atur-imaksa gudiile,
an-ibmar-digsadi bela ani gunmarsundo. An-nainugi-ibmar-naidi bela ani sumarsundo.
”Ome-gwensakse an binsaed galesale, dule-an-neg-dikarbamaid-e-ome an argadii gusale,
an-ome dule-baid-omega gusunnodo, dulemar an-omebo galagwensuli gumarsunnodo.
Ar deyob an ibmar imaknonikile, binged-dummad anga gunonikiled. An sabsur-odurdaklegergebed.
Soo-dummad-neg-gasayob gusaled, an-nainumar bela gummaksayob gusaled.
”An-maiga-gudimalad anga sognonimalale, be anga igar-maidba imaksasurye, an ega igar nudakedsedaed.
Degisulile, Bab-Dummad igar-itogega anse gollalile, ¿igi an abin sogosunna?
Bab-Dummadi, we-napnegse-an-odenonikidid, an-maiga-gudiid-odenonimogadid, ¿A-Bab-Dummadi emarbi sapidukugi anmar-mesissursi?
”Dule-wilemaladi ibmar-abealile, an ega ukdidaed. Omegan-ei-sui-burgwismaladi, an ukudmaada imakdisulid.
Bipisaagwale walagwen an mas gundisulid, sergan-satedga an mas ukdii gusad.
An sapingwad-akale, we-dulemarga e-babyob an gudii gusad. An gwalulesad-akale, omegan-ei-sui-burgwismalad-bendakdii an gusad.
Dule-wilemaladi an morsuli imakdii gussulid, an-wagab dule-wilegedi morsulidbali dambedba burgwissurgusad.
An dule-wilegedga an-sibad-wawaad-mor uksagusad. Degidbali, nuedye anga sogsagusad.
Dule-sergan-satedgi an dodossulid, igar-itolealir, an-garganguedgi egi yolegodeeye an binsassulid.
An yamo-gakansanaile, an-swidamar bela batesunnodo, an-surgan-e-garmar-abingunanaidi bela bus-bus nosunnodo.
An gusgu Bab-Dummad-emar-sabsur-odurdakedgi dobekwaa gudiid. Bab-Dummad uludele, e-gangued-asabin an gwisgussuliled.
”Orginbi an atakdii gussulid, orbina sulibinsa an itodii gussulid.
An ibmar-bukidar-nikadba an na san dummarba imaksasulid. An-arbasadba bukidar-ibmar-amisadgi an na san-dummarba imaksasulid.
Deginbali, dad-ibeler-ganai an dakdaed, nii-bela-bela-ganaid nadapi an dakdaed.
Degi-inigwele, bipisaagwale, an emar-wagab we-e-nugmar odummodisulid, arbakebela an odummodisurbalid.
An we-ibmar-nug odummosana, an odurdaklegedinad. Bab-Dummad-Bur-Biriginedgi an dummad-nosan-itole.
”An-isdarmalad boniganse sabsur-odurdaklenaile, egi burgunai an gudisulid. Egi boni-dummagan danikile, ega gwen an yeer itodisurbalid.
Degine, an-isdaradgi ukabsaale, an sunmakdisulid. Ibiga wemar geg burgwedibeye, an sogdisurbalid.
Dule-gwensak an-negse-ataknadele, masgi an ogunnedsedaed. Ukudmaada an barmidisulid.
Dule-ainebalid an-neggi an nuekwaa ogabdiid, neg-magaba an ogabdisulid.
Dulemar-isgued-odukuedyobi an-isgued an odukudisulid. Dulemar-dobedba, an-ibmar-oakalosad odukuodeeye an binsadisulid.
An-gwenadgan-isdar-an-dakmalad-abin an boo sigissulid, amar-abin an gayamaklessulid.
”Bitigi Bab-Dummadi an-itosana gadin. Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi an-abin-imaksun. An-sunmaksadi, gardagi ise-narmakar an messunnad. Bab-Dummad angi akar-sogbiele, anga narmakar mesmosunna.
Bab-Dummad-akar-angi-sogoedi, nuedgi an sedii guoed, ologurginyobi an sii gudigusaled.
Bab-Dummad-asabin an gwisgudapile, bela an na barsogoed. Gwen an Bab-Dummad-asabin bingeguosulid.
”An-nainumar angi gwisgunanaile, bela napa-imulesmaladi boedbimalale,
gwenadgan-ibe, ibmar-gwag-bennussuli an guchale, degine, e-ibmala-yardaknai an gusale,
an-nainugi trigo-digaled-muchubbi, gagan-ikobiid ainisundo. An-nainugi cebada-digaled-muchubbi, gagan-isgana ainisundo.” Job-sunmaked wese bergunaid.
Job-e-aimar-warbaagwadi magar-itosmargua, Job na ibmar-oakalodisurye-sognaidi, bar abin-imaksasurmalad.
Degine, sapin-gwensak Eliúʼye-nugadi, Job-sunmaked-itosgua, Jobʼde inniki-gudiiye, degine, Bab-Dummad egi ichakwa-binsamaye sogsad-itosgua, Jobʼse sabsur-uluded. Eliúʼde Baraquel-machid, Buz-e-wagwad, dad-dummad-Ramʼgi danikidid.
Deginbali, Eliú, Job-e-aimar-warbaagwad nue-Job-abin-imaksasurmaladba, degi, Jobʼgi-ataknaigusmaladba amargi uludbalid.
Eliú iduar sunmakbigusanad. Ar Eliúʼdi bur sapingwasoggu, e-aimar-eba-selegan-inse Jobʼga sunmaked edarbisgweled, adi, a-sorba sunmakegar.
Ar Eliú dakdegua, e-warbaagwadi, gwen bar sunmaksurmala, degidbali, na san bargassuli, nue-ulude gusad.
Geb Buz-e-wagwa Baraquel-machi-Eliú sunmakded. Weyob sogded: “Andi amba bemar-imbagi sapingwagwad, bemardi bato uka-sele-selebagusad. A-ulale, an bemar-abin-sunmakegala, dobe sunmakdaed.
‘Bur ibmar-wismalad-inse sunmakmaloye, an binsasad. Uka-selebamalad-binsaed-nikamalad-inse, neg-dakdiidba sunmakmaloye an sogsad.’
Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-e-burba, dulegi-maidi magar neg-ito emar-imaked.
Dule-serganbi binsaed-ibegan gusulid, dule-birga-seleganbi magar-ibmar-ito gusulid.
”Degisoggu, bemar, nue be an-itomalo, an ibmar-soggwen-soged nikamogad.
Bemar sunmaknaigua, boo an bemar-itosad. Bemar-binsamalad, degine, bemar binsaed-akar-akar-sognanaigusmalad, an nue itosad.
Nue an bemar-itosii gusad, bemar gwen oyossulid, Jobʼde nue-nodii gusye. Deginbali, Job-sunmaksad bemar nue-abin-imaksasurbalid.
Mer be anga sogmalo: ‘Anmar binsaed-nikaa gumarye. Bab-Dummadbi Job-abin-imakye, dulemardi Job-abin-imaksurye.’
Job anga sunmaksasursoggua, an bemaryob Jobʼga ibmar sogosulid.
”Job, wemar-warbaagwadi gege bar be-abin-imakmalad, ar aku itonanaid, e-binsaed galakudmalad.
Wemarde bar sunmaksurmarsoggua, ¿geg an bar sunmakmosunde? Suli. Andi sunmakoe.
An ibmar-soged nikamogad, an-binsaed an bega sogmogoed.
An ibmar sogebier-itosoggua, burba-angi-maidi sunmakebier an-imaksoggua, an ibmar sogmogoed.
An-gwage-itolegedi, vino-e-bugluyaba-mus-musmaksiiyob an itoged. Vino e-buglu-binidgi-siidyob-marebieyob an itoged.
