An sunmakergebed, adi, an nabir ollorgudoed. An bega ibmar sogergebed.
Emarba-nai an sunmakosulid, emar-nabir-obinsaega an sunmakosurbalid.
Yogasaar-gakansaale an emargi nued sunmakosulid. An deyob imakdele, Bab-Dummad-we-napnegse-an-odenonikid, sabsur-an-odurdako itole.”
Eliú sogdebalid: “Job, wis be an-itomogo, an-sunmakoed nue be itogo, bela an bega ibmar-sogoed nue be itogo.
Emiskwaa an bega sunmaksokalidi, bela an bega ibmar sogedsegad.
An-sunmakoedi, an-gwagegi innikigwadba an bega sunmakoed. An-gwabinduku gakansaale bega ibmar sogosulid.
Bab-Dummad-Burba an-obinnisad, Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad burba anga uksad.
Be nabir an-abin-imakele, be an-abin-imakodo. Sunmakega be guakwaa sigo.
Bab-Dummad-asabinni, anmar anbogwa na emalad, anmar napsagi danikid.
Degisoggu, mer be an-abin gwayo, an begi obinsurmogad.
”Job, be-sunmaked an wis-itosad, weyob sognaiyob an be-itosad:
‘An isgudisurye, isgued angi maisurye, an ibmar oakalodisurye.
Emisgindi, Bab-Dummad, ibmar-oakalosadyob an-dakdeeye, e-isdaradyob emisgindi an-dakmaiye.
Bab-Dummadi naggi esgoro-dubgi an-edichaye, bane-bane angi nakuledigussunye.’ ”
Eliú sogdebalid: “Job, degiirdi nabir, an bega sogo. Be we-ibmar-sogsad, be noar soged. Ar Bab-Dummadi dulemarba bur dumma maid.
¿Ibiga Bab-Dummadgi be deyob sunmake? ¿Bab-Dummad be-abin-imakergebye, be sogsunde? Degisuli, be dummad nodiid.
Ar Bab-Dummad anmarga sunmaked, gusgu bane-bane anmarga sunmakmaid, degi-inigwele, dule itosurdaed.
Imbagwena, anmar-ise-gabar-maidgine, yakumaksiidgine, Bab-Dummad gabdakedba anmarga sunmaked, negburgan-dakedgine anmarga sunmakdabalid.
Bab-Dummad anmarga sunmaked, ibmar-danikidgi anmar-owisogedba dule-ogwayed.
Bab-Dummad ibmar-isganagi-banguegala anmar-owisobalid, mer anmar san-dummarba-imakdiguegala, anmarga sunmaked.
Mer burgwed-igar-itogegala, mer es-suidse-burgwegala, anmarga sunmaked.
”Imbagwenale, Bab-Dummad anmar-odurdakegala, boniganba gala-itogega anmar-imaked anmarga abagan-nunmakedi uked.
Degidbali, san-nuegan-gullemalad, isdarsunna be dakdoed, degisoggu, mas-gunbi bar be itogosulid.
Anmar-abaganmar bela malemai gudoed, garmar-mamaid magar-daklege gudoed.
Be-burba burwaga-gued-ibaganse warmakdanikid, neg-uangi-meged modanikid.
”Baliwiturmar-miligwen-bukwad-abargine (1,000), baliwitur-gwensak dule-bendakegala gwisgunonisunnad. We-baliwiturde, ibu-imakoye ega sognonisunnad.
We-baliwitur wile-dule-dakedbali, Bab-Dummadse weyob wilesakwaa egisdesunnad: ‘Bab-Dummadye, we-dule mer napa-urba-megega be imakye. Ar we-dulega ollor-gued-igar maiye.’
Agine geb, dule gannar nuchukwaa gunonikiled, bipigwaun-gudigusayob gunonikiled.
Agine, geb dule Bab-Dummadse gotoed, geb Bab-Dummad na abinsaoed. Degidbali, dule Bab-Dummad-wagar nabir daknonikoed. Degi, weligwar-itogedba na binnasur-gornai gudoed. Geb Bab-Dummad ibmar-oakalossuliyob dule-daknonikoed.
Deyob geb dule, dulemarga weyob sognai gudoed: ‘Amba an nue isgus-inigwele, an igar-inniki-maidgi yolenoni-inigwele, an sabsur-odurdaklegewilubbinye, degite, an deyob odurdaklessurye.
Ar Bab-Dummad burgwedgi nue-an-bendaknonisoggua, emisgindi, an dula-gudiidi, an nabir neg-itodisunnad.’ ”
Eliú sogdebalid: “Bela we-ibmarmar, Bab-Dummad imakmaid, ilabigwa dulemarga imakbie, Bab-Dummad na e-sogedba imakmaid.
Burgwedgi anmar-bendakmaid, degine, nued-gudii anmar-imaked.
”Job, nue be an-itoge. Mer be sunmake. Ani an sunmaknaid.
Be ibmar-soged-nikamogale, be an-abin-imakmogodo. Be nabir sogele, an nuedgi be-itogoed.
Degisulile, nue-bogimakale, be an-itoge. Nabir-binsaed-nued-nikuega an be-imakoed.”
Eliú sogdebalid:
“Bemar-binsaed-ibegan-gumalad, nue an-sunmaked be itomalo. Bemar-nue-ibmar-wismalad, nue be an-itomalo.
Ar igi anmar-gwabin magasar yeer masgulleged-itoge, deyobi, uaya magasar gayaburba yeer itomogad.
Degisoggu, anmar, we-igar bulakwaa daksunnodo, anmar igar-nuedse bulakwaa onogoed.”
Eliú sogdebalid: “Ar Job weyob sogye: ‘An ibmar-oakalossurye, Bab-Dummaddina deyob an-daksurye.
An dule-nued-gudi-inigwele, dule-gakansaedyob daklesunye. Amba an ibmar-akar-imaksasur-inigwele, Bab-Dummaddi nue-naibi an-imaknaiye.’
¿Ar bia be dule Jobʼyobid dakdimala? Ar we-dule unnila Bab-Dummadgi dododiid.
”Ar Jobʼde, dule-isganaba akadigued bur yeer itodaed, dule-isganamarba bur gudii gubidaed.
Job anmarga sogbalid, ‘Bab-Dummadba-ibsalegedi, dule gwen ibmar-nued egi amisurye.’
”Bemar dule-machergan-nue-binsaed-nikamalad, nue be an-itomalo: Anmar geg soged, Bab-Dummaddi, ibmar-isgana nabir-imakye, Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikaddi, sunna ibmar noar-imakye.
Bab-Dummad dule-na-ibmar-imakedbali, dulega ibmar uked. Dule-daedbali dulega ibmar imaked.
Geg anmar sogbalid, Bab-Dummad ibmar-isgana imakye. Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, igar-inniki-maid oichobarye.
Bab-Dummad we-napneg-seega, ¿doa ega gargangued uksa? ¿Doa Bab-Dummadga negseed-igar uksa?
Ar Bab-Dummad anmargi burba-dula-maid gannar suye-sogele, anmar-bunnodiidi obeloye-sogele,
bela dule-gudimaladi bergudmalaled, dulemar bela napaga binnidmalaled.
”Job, be we-ibmar magasar-itodibe, an-ibmar-sogoed, nue be itogodo.
¿Sunna dule ibmar-isgana-imakdiidi, nabir negseosi? Suli. Geg gue. Degisoggu, gege be Bab-Dummad-innikigwadgi, bela-gangued-nikadgi be yoleged.
Reymar, degi, dule-dummagan isganamalale, ar Bab-Dummad gwen binsaosulid mer an oakalogodeeye.
Bab-Dummad dule-negsemaidba nagusulid. Degi, dule-mani-ibedba nagusulid, dule-mani-satedba nagusurbalid, bela emarbi daked. Bab-Dummad bela emarbi amar-imaksad.
Dulemar ukiagwar mutikidba burgwiddamalad. Dulemar oimakbukwadamalad, degi, berguddamalad. Dule-bulegan-negsedimaladi, negsediidgi dule-oakalossuli ukiagwar egwalleddamalad.
”Bab-Dummad bela dulemar-gudiid dakmaid, bela dulemar-e-gudiidgi nakulediid.
Dule-isganamarde negsichidgi, neg-guduregedgi dukuye-sogele, gege amba Bab-Dummadgi dukued.
Bab-Dummad, dulega igar-nabogega dulega iba messulid.
Bab-Dummad dule-bulegan-negsemamaid-onogegala, igar-amiegala, emarse idaksulid. Amar-muchub dule-baid omesed.
Bab-Dummad dulemar-ibmar-imaked bela wisid, mutikidbali egi gwisgued, bela ese ibitomalad.
Bab-Dummadi, bela dulemar dakmalaga, dule-e-isguedbali, dule-sabsur-odurdaked.
Dulemar Bab-Dummadgi-banguddamaladbali, degi, eba ibsasurdamaladbali, deyob gunonidamarsunnad.
Degine, wemar sabsur dule-wilemalad-obosmalad, sabsur dule-ibmar-abese-gudimalad-wiosmalad. Degidbali, Bab-Dummad dule-wilemalad-e-ogormaked itosad.
Ar Bab-Dummad ibmar sogsulile, ¿doa ega akar sogosunna? Dule geg ega akar soged. Ar Bab-Dummad dule-idu wagar-odukuele, ¿doa e-wagar dakosunna? Bab-Dummadi, bela dulemargi nakulemaid,
adi, dule-isganamar mer negsemalagar, degi, mer dulemar-yardakdii gumalagar.
”Job, amba be Bab-Dummadga weyob sogele: ‘Nabirye, nue an nosye, bar an begi yolegosurye.
Be an-odurdaksunye, magar-neg-itogedse be an-imakye. An ibmar-isgana-imaksadi, bar an imakosurye.’
Job, be deyob sogdibe, degite, be Bab-Dummad-obacha-inigwele, ¿Bab-Dummad bega be-ibmar-abeged uked abesunde? Sulirgebed. Andi be-ular sogosulid, ar bee be sogoedid. Degisoggu, na be-binsaedi be soge, igi na be binsae.
”Bemar, an-itobukwadi dule-binsaed-ibeganad, be magar neg-itomaladid. Degisoggu, be anga sogmardo:
‘Job yogasaar sunmakye, e-sunmakedi gwen binsaed-nika itolesurye.’
Ar Job-e-sunmakedi dule-isganayobi anmarga sunmaked. Degisoggu, bela-bela Job-gudiid nue-wisguleged abeleged.
Job unnila dule-isganabisulid, uayasulidbalid. Ar anmar-wagab anmargi dododiid. Ar Bab-Dummadgi, bela-belad ise-yolegar sunmaksad.”
Eliú sunmakdebalid, weyob sogded:
“Job, nabir ibmar-sognaiye be sogsunde, bede soged: ‘Bab-Dummadba bur an ibmar innikii imakdiiye.’
Emisgindi, be Bab-Dummadga weyob sogbalid: ‘¿An isguye sogele, akarsi? An-isguedde, ¿igi-be-imaksunna?’
Job, degiir nabir, an bega ibmar soggwelo, be-aimarga an ibmar sogmogwelo.
Niba be atakena, nue nuu be dakena, mogir-naid be dakena.
Ar be isguye-sogele, ¿ibugi be Bab-Dummad oakalogosunna? Ar be ichesur isgudisogele, gwen be Bab-Dummad-oakalogosulid.
Ar be nued-ibmar-imakdiiye sogele, Bab-Dummadga ¿ibu be ukosunna? Ar Bab-Dummad egi ibmar-nued amiosulid.
Ar be ibmar-isgana imakdibe, be ibmar-nued imakdibe, unnila be-abargi-gudimaladi, beba wilegoed.
”Ar neg nue-isgusnaisoggua, dulemar na bendakleged amidimalad. Dule-bulegan-emar-wionaidgi-noegala, bendakleged egisnanaid.
Degi-inigwele, dule gwen sogsulid: ‘Bia Bab-Dummad-an-obinnisad nadye. Mutikidba an-niga-ogannoardaedi,
ibmar-durganba, bur ibmar-wisi-anmar-imakedi, ¿bia nadsunye? Sikwimarba bur binsaed-nued-anga-ukedi, ¿bia nadsunye?’
Ar dulemar Babse gornanai-inigwele, dule-isganamarsoggu, na san-odummogedginbi binsadimarsoggu, a-ulale, Bab-Dummad we-dulemar-abin-imaksulid.
A-ulale, Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, binsarsunna-ibmar-egisnanaid itosulid, Bab-Dummad a-dulemar baisur-daked.
Amba be sogdibe: ‘An Bab-Dummad daksurye,’ degi-inigwele, amba be-igar itolegedsegad, degisoggu, be Bab-Dummad-edarbedsegad.
Bede soged, ‘Bab-Dummad wissur-urweye, wissur-emar-sabsur-odurdakye, degine, ibmar-isgana baisurdakye.’
Job, be yogasaar sunmaked, binsa-ee-be gwichid, binsaedsuli be sunmaked.”
Eliú sunmakdebalid, weyob sogded:
“Ar an Bab-Dummadgi amba an nued bega ibmar-soged-nikasoggu, mer be budar itogo.
An-bela-bela-nue-ibmar-wisid an bega oyogwelo. Abali an bega oyogoed, Bab-Dummad-an-obinnisadi innikii ibmar imakmaiye.
Inniki an bega soged, bega an gakansaosulid, an be-asabinni dule-binsaed-ibed gwichid.
”Bab-Dummad dule-gandikidid, dule-ibmar-oakalodisulid obandisulid. Bab-Dummad gandikidid, bela magar neg-itomaid.
Bab-Dummad dule-isgana gudiguega imaksulid. Dule-wiledimaladgardi igar nabiroged.
Bab-Dummad dule-nuegan nue-akwed, dule-nuegan reymar-abargi-sigega imaked, degine, dule-nuegan-nugmar odummoged.
Ar we-dulemar esgaryagi-sigega galenonikirdi, wile-itoged egi dognonikirdi,
Bab-Dummad we-dulemarga e-isgusad ega oyonaido, degine, ega oyonaibardo, na san-dummarba-imakedbali igi-isgusmala.
Degidbali na magar itomaloed, wede Bab-Dummad ega sunmaknai, be nue-nanamarye, ibmar-isganagi be bangumarye.
Ar we-dulemar Bab-Dummadba ibsaele, Bab-Dummadga arbadele, e-burgwedse nasgumai gumaloed, weligwar-gudii gumaloed.
Ar Bab-Dummadba ibsasurmalardi, wisguosuli ukiagwar es-suidgi burgwenonimaloed, binsaedsulidbali burgwenonimaloed.
”Dule-isganamar na sae-itodamalad. Amba Bab-Dummadse sabsur-odurdaklenaile, bipisaale bendakleged egisdasurmalad.
Bab-dummaganse-goled-neggi-dule-gambasamalad-burgweyobi, nuchukwaa burgwiddamalad.
Bab-Dummad dule-wiledimalad e-wilediidgi bendaked. E-nunmaked-itodiid, baisur-itogega imaked.
”Job, ar Bab-Dummad bonigangi be-bendakoed, neg-nuedse be-ogwisgunonikoed, bega mas-nuegan ena be-mesegi urboed.
Emide, dule-isganamar-wilubdaklegedyob be gunaisunnad, igar-nabolegedse be gales gunaisunnad, igar-inniki-imaklegedse be odurdaklegega gunaisunnad.
¡Degisoggu, nue salak! Abakalegi be manibina surbinsa itodager, manise be binsaed-galenai gudager, ese be baklenai gudager.
Be mani-ibedguedgi be bendaklegosulid, be-garganguedgine be bendaklegosurbalid.
Neg-mutikid be edarbedii gudager, mer abdako. Ar mutikidba dulemar obeloleged.
Nue salakar. Mer be gannar ibmar-isgana-imakedgi binsao. Ar be ibmar-isgana-imakdigusadba be wilesad.
”Bab-Dummad na e-ganguedba gannarba maid. ¿Dule Bab-Dummadyob dule-odurdaked-saila gudii? Sate.
¿Doa Bab-Dummadga sogoe, ibiga be deyob ibmar imaknaiye? Gege dule Bab-Dummadga weyob sogbalid, noar be ibmar-imaksaye.
Bab-Dummad-ibmar-imaked be gatik-ogannogo, ar namaklegedba we-ibmar-ogannolenai gusad.
Bela dulemar Bab-Dummad-ibmar-imaksadi dakmalad. Ar dulemar dikasuli Bab-Dummad-ibmar-imaksadi sunna bela dakmalad.
Bab-Dummad dule-dummad-maisoggu, degidbali, gege anmar e-daed baramied, e-birga-nikadi gege anmar wisgubalid.
”Bab-Dummad anmarga dii barmimaid, dii-wiedbali diwar-enguega imakmaid.
Mogirmar-dii-owiega imaked, bela-belad dulemargi dii-owiega imaked.
¿Doa wisguoe, ibiga mogirmar nanae? ¿Doa wisgubaloe, mar-gollalile bia noardae?
Bab-Dummadi, demargine mar-gaedi barmied, degidbali, magatiba demar-naid magar-daklege imaked.
Bab-Dummad bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad semaid, mas-bukib ega ukmaid.
Bab-Dummad mar-dakarmakmaid e-argangi gaed, bia mar-odebie, na e-sogedba mar-odeged.
Mar-goled Bab-Dummad-maid oyoged, mar-goledi, Bab-Dummad-sae-itogedi oyoged.”
Eliú sogdebalid: “An we-ibmar-dakdedbali, an-gwage dik-dik-naded, ber an-gwage noebieyob an itoged.
Be nue itomala, Bab-Dummad-e-sunmaked mar-gollomakeyob-sunmaked be itomala, binnasuli-sunmaked be itomala.
Bab-Dummad e-mala-ibyedi, bela nibneg-gaed, e-ibyemaidi, bela napneg-ugakaasega ibyed.
Bab-Dummad-e-sunmakedi, binnasur-itoleged, e-mala-ibyedi, galesulid.
Bab-Dummad binnasuli-sunmakdele, ibmar-gegerdakleged oyoardaed. Anmar-ibmar-magar-itosulid oyoardaed.
Bab-Dummadi, boo-batedga igar-ukdaed, ‘¡Napase batemaloye!’ ega sogdaed. Dii-wiedga igar-ukdabalid, ‘¡Be-gangued-oyomaloye!’ ega sogdaed.
Bab-Dummad deyob ibmar-imakedbali, dulemar bar aineba ainidasurmalad, adi, Bab-Dummad-ibmar-imakmaid magasar dakdamalad.
Ibmar-durgan na dukuegala, e-dukued-yaba na bukusdamalad, agine na dukubukusdamalad.
Dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik burwa-goledba, burwa-oored danidaed. Dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik burwa-goledba, neg-dambed danidaed.
Bab-Dummad-bunnogedbali, dii gwamakleddaed. Bela dii-dummad-naidi negdammipegwadba dutusuli naddaed.
Bab-Dummadi dii-wiedi mogirmargi urbed, degidbali, a-mogirmargi mar-ibyedi onoged.
We-mogirmar napneg-naid ebirbukwad. Bab-Dummad-ega-igar-mesisadba iirmakbukwad.
Bab-Dummad na e-sogedba dii owied, imbagwenale, dulemarga dii-wiedi ibnuedga gued, imbagwenale, dulemarga dii-wiedi dule-wiogega gued.
”Job, nue be itogo, Bab-Dummad-ibmar-gegerdakle-imaksadgi be binsagwelena.
¿Be wisi, igi Bab-Dummad mogirmar see? ¿Be wisi, Bab-Dummad mar-ogaega igi imake?
Degite, be soged, bela an ibmar wisye. Be anga sogdo, ¿igi Bab-Dummad niba mogirmar-naguega imake?
Emide, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik burwa-ued-danikidbali, mor-yoid be geger itodaed.
Bab-Dummad nibneg-egasadgi, esgoro-gordikidiyob daarmakar-nasiksadgi, ¿be Bab-Dummad-bendaksasi?
”Anmarga be soge, igi anmar Bab-Dummad-abin-saoe. Anmardi ibmar-wissursoggu, geg anmar Bab-Dummad-abin-imaked.
Ar Bab-Dummadi an-ibmar-sogedi, ¿dule-baid-ega-soged abege? Suli. ¿Doa ega ibmar akala sogosunna? ¿Doa ese burgwebisunna?
”Mogir dad-irwa-naid dadgi banguddibe, gege dule dad-ganaidgi ataked.
Emide, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsiki neg dakarmakdanikid. Bab-Dummad danikid, bela-bela e-gargangued-yeerdaklegedba danikid.
Anmar gege Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadyob gued. E-gangued-maidi bipisuli maid. E-ibmar-inniki-imakedi, degine, e-igar-nabogedi yeer gangu maid, mesagwar emar-imaksulid.
Bab-Dummad, dule-na-ibmar-wisirbaye-sogdiidi, gwen ibmar-wisi daksulid. A-ulale, dulemar Bab-Dummad-dobmalad.”
Bab-Dummad burwa-ooreged-bipirmaknaidba Jobʼga sunmakded. Weyob ega sogded:
“¿Be doasunna? Emide be, an-binsaed-nikarbadgi be bengunaigu. Emide be, binsaedsuli sunmaknaigu.
Be an-abin gwisgudena, an bese egisodo, bule be an-abin-imakodibe.
”An napneg-e-sailamar-urbenaigua, ¿bia be gudiinsunna? ¡Anga be sogena, be nue-ibmar-wisye soged!
¿Doa napneg-naid-e-dungued imaksa? ¿Doa napneg-dungued wilubdaknai gusa?
Napneg-e-sailamar, ¿ibu-birgi bukwasunna? ¿Doa degite, e-akwasaila sisasunna?
Deunni, niis-buksurmar namaknanaigu, degi, baliwiturmar yeer-itogedba oichomaknanaigu, ¿be gudii? Be gudisulid, be sated.
”Deunni, demar napagi-nagudgua, ¿doa ega abingued-igar mesissunna?
An demargala moryobi mogirmar nasiksagua, degi, ega garsonyobi mogirmar-gudureged nasiksabargua, ¿be gudii?
Ani an demarga abingued-igar nasiksagua, yawagak-dummaganyob ega an nasiksagua, e-yawagakgi yabiyob ega an nasiksabargua, ¿be gudii?
Demarga an weyob sogsagua: ‘Wese be warmakoed, bar be naosurye. Be-daomakedi, wese iirmakbukwa guoye,’ ¿deunni be gudii?
”¿Negmeegwad-naguega bolegoedga be sogsa, naguye?
¿Negmeegwad bela napneggi-naguye be sogsa, adi, dule-isganamar magar daklegegar?
Neg-meegwadbali napneg-e-yar-mullugana magar daklenonidaed, e-daklegedi morgi-morgomar-akar-akar-odolesayob daklenonidaed.
Degidbali, dule-isganamar negmeegwad-abin ambikuosurmalad, dule-isgana-e-garganguedi, bela bergunonikoed.
”¿Ar be wila-arad-naid-solase be aideapi? ¿Bela be dii-ulakbali bipirmaksa?
Deginbali, ¿burgwed-negse be aideapbali? ¿Dule-burgwarmalad-e-galuse be arbi?
¿Napneg-dungued be wisi? Ar be we-ibmar nue-wisile, degite, be anga sogdo.
”Deginbali, ¿be wisbali, bia gwallu-meegwad-neg sii? ¿Be wisbali, bia negsichid-neg sibali?
¿Sunna be we-ibmarmar e-igarmarba-moed be imake? ¿Sunna be gannar e-negse sedabali?
Be wisirgebed, ar be deunni bato be gwalulesargebed. Ar be dikasurgus gudisursi.
”¿Ar dambed-sibudikmalad-sabolebukwad be dakapsi? ¿Dii-ologan-akwaga-binyarmalad-sabolebukwad be dakapsi?
An dii-ologan-sabolebukwadi, naibid-dummad-ibagi-ebugega an sabobukwad. Degi, bila-onoged-ibagangi-ebugega, urweleged-ibagi-ebugega an sabobukwad.
¿Be wisi, negmeegwad bia noardae, degi, igi nasguddae? ¿Be wisi, dad-nakwedsik-burwa-goled igi onoardae?
”¿Be wisbali, doa dii-dummad owie? ¿Doa dii-dummadba-mesa mar-ogollomakmai imake?
¿Doa nega-dulesulidganba dii owie? ¿Doa dule-buksurmaladba napaneg oge?
¿Doa gaganmar-aradik-oniega, dii owie? ¿Doa napa-dutuu-imakega, dii owie?
”¿Dii-wiedde bab nikasi? ¿Doa boo ogwalulesibali?
Be anga sogena, ¿bia dii-gwamakaled soblesii? ¿Doa dii-sibudikid onisibali?
¿Doa dii akwayob-dutusuli imake? ¿Doa demar-dummad-naid osatelegega imake?
”¿Sunna be niisgwamar-Pléyadesʼye-nugad danar-danar-naguega imake? ¿Sunna be niisgwamar-Oriónʼye-nugad aisakiega be imake?
¿Sunna be bolegoedba niisgwamar-danar-danar-nanaid, e-wachiba-onogega be imake? ¿Sunna be niisgwamar-Osa-Mayorʼye-nugad, degi, Osa-Menorʼye-nugad nabir-bipirmakega be imake?
¿Be nibneg-seleged-igarmar-mamaid, be wisi? ¿Sunna be a-igarmar-mamaidba be napneg see?
”¿Sunna be mogirga sogsale, begi dii-dummad owiye?
¿Be-sogedba mar gotedae? ¿Be sunmakdele, bebali mala yoga ibsaardae?
Degite, be anga sogdo, ¿doa gannir-macheredga binsaed uksa? ¿Doa sikwi-gikamarga binsaed daksa?
¿Sunna be mogirmar ebise? ¿Doa napamar-sergudele, dinnaa nadele,
dutuu-imakegala dii owie?
”¿Sunna be achumigurmarga masgunned amie? ¿Sunna e-mimmigan masgi be omae?
Achumigur e-negyaba dukumamaile, sapur-yaba masbina gudimalale, ¿sunna ega be mas amie?
¿Ar bee be sikwisichimar masgi omae? E-burwigana yoggusgudimalale, degi, mas-satedba ukudmaad-gudiidba, anse gordimalale, ¿ega be mas amie?”
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “¿Be wisi, ibu-ibagine sibad-sapurbarmalad milege? ¿Goe-sapur-mileged be dakdii?
¿Be wisi, goe-sapur milegega nii-walabigwa nanae? ¿Be wisi sana milegoe?
Ar goe-sapur milesokalile, ega nued-aidegega, sinni sigisdaed. Degiid-bergusale, geb ega nunmaked bergued.
Geb e-mimmigan sapurba dungudamalogua, na gannarbagus itomalale, e-nangi banguddamalad, bar e-nanse nonidasurmalad.
”¿Doa moli-uayasuid-sapurbarmalad yogasaar gudiguega imaksa? ¿Doa achikar-gudigumalaga imaksabali?
Ani an moli-uayasuidmarga, nega-dulesulidgan e-negga imaksad, agi gudigumalaga an imaksad.
Na wargwen e-itolegedba-gudimarsoggua, neggweburgi-neg-oimaked bai itodasurmalad, degi, dule-moli-seed-ese-goledi baisur itodamalad.
Deyob moli-uayasuidmar yalaganba gudidamalad, gagan-ara-arad amididamalad.
”Ar moli-bebe-nikad-ursilid, ¿sunna bega arbasar be ebinsae? ¿Sunna be-molimar-gabedgi megisar be ebinsae?
¿Ar we-moli-ursilid, sunna be e-dukarba edinne? ¿Sunna be-sorba napa-imudaniguega be imake?
¿Ar we-moli-e-garganguedgi be bengusuli guoe? ¿Ar we-moli-ursilid bega be-arbaed imako be ebinsae?
¿Sunna be we-moli ibmar-gwag-onmakega be imake? Degine, ¿ibmar-gwag-welesad e-neg-sabolegedse bega danakwaa-urbenaega be imake?
”Ar nuu-avestruzʼye-nugadi, weligwaledba na e-sakan mer-mer imakardaed, dabgalayob-gukuega sakan niksulid.
We-nuu-dummad-dukar-suid e-akwa ukubgi urbed, ukubgi-uee-siega, urbed.
We-nuu-dummad e-akwa-sisad-birgi na annaele, gwen bai itosulid. Ibmar-durgan-egi-annaele, gwen bai daksulid.
We-nuu-dummad e-mimmigan egadsuliyobi sabsur-imaked, e-ibe surgudele, gwen bai itodasulid.
Ar Bab-Dummadi, nuu-dummad-dukar-suidga binsaed uksasulid. Magar-neg-itoged ega uksasulid.
Degi-inigwele, we-nuu, sakan-nallaa-imakdele, degi, abarmakde-sogele, molimarba bur bule abarmaked, dule-moligi-abarmakedgi burgued.
”¿Ar be, molimarga gargangued uksasi? ¿Ar be moliga sailagia nasiksabarsi?
¿Ar be, moli ses-ichomakeyobi be imaksasi? ¿Ar be we-moli, sabsur-e-bunnogedgi emar-ogwayed be imaksasi?
Moli sabsur-annanagusdaed, e-gargangued-nikadba weligwar itonadaed, deyobi, neba-naidbali, ise-abarmakar naddaed.
Moli dobed wissulid, ibmar dobsulid, urwelenaile, es-suid-abin sikirmaksulid.
Sigumar moli-dikargi-nanaidi gornanaid, arbon-suarmar, degi, eswarmar-moli-dikargi-nanaidi, dakarmaknanaid.
Sabsur-abarmakedbali, dikasur-abarmakdedaed. Gar-gotele, gege bar galeged.
Ar moli gargote-itogele, abarmakega aka binnasur-bunnogar-gotedaed. Bila-onolenaile, dikasuli magar-itoged, bilagi-dulemar-oimaknanaile, dikasur magar-itobalid.
”¿Ar bee be, noomar-gukuega imaksa? ¿Ar be-binsaedba noomar dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik-gukuega be imaksa?
¿Ar be-sogedbali sulubagimar dikasuli-gukuega be imaksasi? ¿Ar be-sogedbali sulubagimar matusuli e-uu-sobega be imaksasi?
Ar sulubagi akwasaila-dummagan e-negga imaked, agi na e-gabed siid. A-akwasaila-dummad-birgi e-neg-gandikid siid.
A-akale, bannaba na e-mas-gaega masbina ataksidaed.
Sulubagi-e-mimmigan ibmar-durgan-e-ablisgi ibmeremalad. Ar bia ibdurgan-burgwar-mai-sogele, agi mula gudidaed.”
Bab-Jehová, Jobʼga sunmakdebalid, weyob ega sogded:
“¿Ar dule Bab-Dummad-Bur-Biriginedgi-urwenaidi, gan-bipigi Bab-Dummad-osioye binsasunde? Ar degite, we-dule, Bab-Dummad-abinsado.”
Geb Job, Bab-Dummad-abin sunmakded, weyob sogded:
“¿Igi an be-abin-imakosunna? Ar an dule-nuedsulid. Geg an be-abin-imaked.
Bato ilagwen an sunmaksabinned, bar an sunmakosuli. Bato an ibmar sogsabinned, bar an gannar-gannar ibmar sogosuli.”
Bab-Jehová burwa-gammuba Jobʼga sunmakded. Weyob ega sogded:
“An-abin, machered na be san-imako. Be an-odurdakega, emisgi ani an bese ibmar egisgwelo.
”¿Be an-ibmar-inniki-imaked be osulosunnode? Na be sogega, bedi ibmar inniki-imakdiiye, ¿aga be angi gwisgusunnode?
¿Be-surgande an-surganyob gangude? Ar be-sunmakedde, ¿an-sunmakedyob gangu-sunmakde?
”Ar deyobile, be-gangued-yeerdakleged be oyodo, be-ganguedba be-nug-dummarba be imakdo. Be-gangued-yeerdakleged be oyodo, bela-bela be-yeerdakleged be oyodo.
Be-isdarsun-itodiid mer be bargae, dule-san-dummarba-itodimalad be dake, mesagwar be imake.
Dule na san-bule-bule-imakdiid be dake, a-dule be obingegsae. Dule-isganamar bia gudii be dakalir, bela be obeloge.
Bela we-dulemar be dige-dige imake, napa-urba ise digar be imake.
Ar deyob ibmar-saele, magar an be-dakodo, be dule-buledye, be-ganguedgine be bendakleged amiye.
”Be dakena, ibdula-Behemotʼye-nugad, moli-bebe-nikadyob unnila gaganbi maed, igi an be-obinnisa, deyob an we-ibdula obinnismogad.
We-ibdula-e-garganguedi bela e-sorgargi, degine, e-saderba siid.
E-bunnu urwaryob banamaked, e-dua-gasimar yeer gangu nikabalid.
E-gar-nikadi esgoro-gordikidyobi nikad, e-nagmar esgoroyob-gangue nikad.
”An ibmar-durgan-obinnisad-abargi we-ibdula emargi obinmaid. An we-ibdula oburgwebiele, sunna an oburgwed.
Sapurmar-nanaidi, ega masgunned uked, a-sapurgi ibdurganmar ichomakdididamalad.
We-ibdula negsichigi obunnomaidaed, masar-matagan-imbaba dukumaidaed.
Sapimar-urba obunnomaidaed, gaganmar-mata-imbaba gudidaed.
We-ibdula diwar-noalile, gwen bai itodasulid, diwar-Jordán e-gayase ubomaile, gwen bai itodasulid.
¿Doa we-ibdula nuu-e-dakmai gaoe? ¿Doa ega asu udkoe?”
Bab-Jehová weyob sogdebalid: “¿Sunna be ibdula-Leviatánʼye-nugadi, achwergi be sosale? ¿We-ibdula-e-gwabin sunna dubgi be edichale?
¿Sunna e-asumurgi dub be nasiksale? ¿E-aku sunna esgoro-swiswidikidgi be boodo imaksale?
Ar we-ibdula-Leviatánʼde, ¿nuedgi bese ibmar-egisosi? Ar bega sogosi, wile be an-dakye.
Ar be-maiga-guega, ¿bebo igar-mesosi?
¿Sikwibo-dodolegeyob be we-ibdulabo dodosale? ¿Be-bunamala egi dodogega, ega be dubgi edichale?
¿Sunna dule-ibmar-ukmaladi we-ibdula uksamalale? ¿Sunna dule-ibmar-ukmaladi ibdula-Leviatán-goamakar uksamalale?
¿Sunna we-ibdula-e-uka esgi-siksar be itoge? ¿Sunna arbon-suargi-makar e-nono bayosar be itoge?
Ese be achaena, ebo be urwena. Ar bar be ese achaedgi binsassuliled, mer bar deyob guena gadinye be binsasaled.
Mer be binsao, an we-ibdula baisursunna gaoye, unnila e-daklegedbi unnid. Ar unnila be dakdele, bato be negoedbinneled.
We-ibdula-Leviatánʼse dule gege achaed. Degite, ¿doa an-abindi nabir gwisguosunna?
Ar bela napneggi-ibmar-bukwadi angadbiid. Degisoggu, doa anga sogosunna, be angi ibmar ganiye.
”Ibdula-Leviatán-e-malimargi an sunmakergebed, e-gargangued-dutusulidgi, e-dakleged-yeerdunguedgi an sunmakergebed.
¿Doa e-ibe e-uka edarisale? ¿Doa ese warmaksale? ¿Doa e-ibe e-gaya edichabalile?
Ibdula-Leviatán-e-nugarmar-swiswimakaled-dakegala, ¿doa e-ibe e-gaya-mee imakoe?
Ibdula-Leviatán-e-yargan, sigu-abgaed-senigana-daklegeyob madar-madar nanaid, akwayob dachak-dachak nanaid.
Bela e-ukamar-madar-madar-nanaidgi ollor naisulid, degine, burwabela egi geg doged.
Bela e-ukamar-abingunanaid, ise achamakar nanaid. Gege dule e-ibe ollo-ollo imaked.
We-ibdula-Leviatán asmidele, mar-ibyeyob asmied. E-ibya-gaedi, dad-ibelergaeyob gaed.
E-gayabali, soo gwabunyeardaed, ditismakar soo ainiardaed.
E-asa-yabali, waa bupurmakardaed, dii-gwakwarmaknaid-birgi waa-bupurmaknaidyobi bupurmakardaed.
E-bunnogedgi soo ogaed, e-gaya-yabali, soo mied.
Ibdula-Leviatán-e-gargangued e-dukargi siid, e-abinni bela dulemar niga argwatedamalad.
E-san-nikadi sommereged, egi geg ibmar doged. E-sanmar-bur-dutugwadbela, amba selelleged.
Ibdula-Leviatán-e-binasgar akwayob dutusulid, ibmar-gwag-naged-akwayob gangued.
Ibdula gwisgudele, ese gwakiddamalad. Binnasurgualile, bela idu duurmakdedamalad.
Es-suid egi gwisgunonikile, gege bayoged. Arbon-suarmarbela, sigubela, degi, ibmar-swiswidikidbela, gwen bayosulid.
Ibdula-Leviatán esgoro-suar gaganyobi ibigwensur daked esgoro-gordikidbela urgo-nunudyob daked.
We-ibdula-Leviatán sigumar dobsulid, akwamied-dubgi-akwa-milegedbela ibmar-dutukwayob daked.
Mardo-dummadgi sarsolenaile, baisur-itoged, egi gagan iir-iir-gunaiyob itoged, eswar-suid-goled yeer-itodaed.
Ibdula-Leviatán-e-dikarmar nugaryobi swichwi-swichwi dakleged. Unimakdedibele, gwala-esgorobiidgi neg-durwilesayob e-gannarmar megisdaed.
Ibdula dii-urba-burdidele, dii-gwakwarmaknaiyob neg-imaked, ina-wawad butegi-sik-sik-imaklenaidyob neg-imaked.
E-sorbali, e-igar dagudik diigi megisdaed, sailagia-sibudikidyob e-igar makumakar megisdaed.
We-ibdula-Leviatán gwen ibmar dobsulid, ibdulamar we-ibdulayob-dakleged gwen nikasulid.
We-ibdula-Leviatán, dule-bulegan-sogdimalad-mesagwar imaked, degine, bela ibdula-ursilimalad-e-reyga maid.”
Job Bab-Jehová-abin sunmakded, weyob ega sogded:
“An nue-wisid, bela be ibmar imaked. Ar be-igar-mesisad gege dule be-ibe oichoged.
Be sognai gusad: ‘We doa-dule yogasaar sunmaknaiye, an-binsaed-oburnaiye.’ An yogasaar ibmar-wissuli-sunmaksadi an magar itoged. Anga ibmar-gegerdaklemaladba sunmaklenai gussoggu, an aku-itonai gusad.
”Be anga sogsa gusad: ‘Emisgindi, an bega sunmakgweloye, nue be an-itogoye. An bese-ibmar-egisoedgi be an-abinsaoye.’
Unnila dulemar begi-sunmakedbi an itodidaed, an be-dakdisulid. Emisgindi, an-ibyagwar an be-daksasunnad.
Degisoggu, an ibmar-sogsadi, begi-ibmar-akar-sogsasuliyob be an-dake. An bukib-itogedba, buru-abargi mellesisunnad.”
Bab-Jehová bela Jobʼga sunmaksad-sorbali, Bab-Jehová, Temánʼgined-Elifazʼga sogdemogad: “Be-ibmar-sogsad an-oulusdo, be-aimar-ebogwad an-oulusmarmodo. Ar bemar angi sunmaksamaladi, gwen innikigwadba bemar sunmaksasurmalad. Ar an-mai-Jobʼdi, innikigwadba sunmaksad.
”Emisgi, bemar Job-bardaknamalo, geb moli-bebe-nikad-senigana walagugle (7) anga ogumakar ukmalo, degine, sibad-wawaad-machered walagugle (7) anga ogumakar ukmarbalo. Degine, an-mai-Job anse bemarga goloed. Job bemarga anse-goloedbali, an sabsur-bemar-odurdakosulid. Bemar odurdaklegewilubbinad, bemar Jobʼyobi sunmaksasulidi, be magar itomalargebed. Ar bemar angi sunmaksamaladi, inniki sunmaksasurmalad.”
Degidbali, Temánʼgined-Elifaz, Súahʼgined-Bildad, degine, Naamatʼgined-Zofar, Bab-Jehová-ega-ibmar-sogsadba imaksamalad. Agine, Bab-Jehová Job-ese-goled itosad.
Job e-aimarga Bab-Dummadse-gochagua, Bab-Jehová gannar Job-ibmar-bukidar-nikuega imaksad. Bab-Dummad Jobʼga ibmar-iduar-nikusadba ilabo-wilub ega ibmar uksad.
Geb bela Job-e-gwenadgana, e-bunmarse-bakale, degine, dule-magar-Job-dakmaladse-bakale, Job-dakmalagala e-negse nonigusmalad. Agine, iba-dummad onosmalad, mas gullenai gusad. Job-ogannonanai gusmalad, Bab-Jehová-egi-bonigan-bukidar-barmiargusadba mer-bar-bukib-binsaye ega sognanai gusmalad. Geb e-gwenadgan war-wargwen Jobʼga mani-gwa-gwagwen uknanai gusmalad, degine, olargan deyob ega gwa-gwagwen uksamarbalid.
Bab-Jehová, Job-e-ibagan-napi-gudiidgi bur bule nued binsanai gusad. Iduar-gudigusadba bur nued gudigusad. Job bela weyob ibmar nikunonikid: Sibad-wawaad, miliambe-gakabake (14,000), moli-yargan-mureged, milinergwa (6,000), moli-bebe-nikad-abin-abinnid-napa-imumalad, miligwen (1,000), moli-uayasuid-omegan, miligwen (1,000).
Job, masmala walagugle (7) nikunonibalid, degine, bunamaladina, walapaa nikunonikid.
Bunolo-sailanagined Jemimaʼye onug-imaksad, sorbaliddi Cesiaʼye onug-imaksad, napiddi Keren-Hapucʼye onug-imaksad.
We-Job-bunamala-e-warbaagwadi, we-yarnaidgine, omegan-bamalad-gudimaladba bur yeerdaklemalad. Job igi e-bunamalaga e-ibmar-nikad mimisa, deyobi, e-masmalaga, e-ibmar-nikad ega mimismogad.
A-sorbali, Job birga-dulagugle (140) gudii gusad. Na e-mimmigan dungualid daksagusad, degine, e-wagan daksagusbalid. Wagan-yokorginmalad-yalabarmalad daksa gusbalid.
Job bela ibagan-nueganbi gudii gusad, geb undar-selebagusadgi burgwenonisunnad.
Dule, dule-binsaed-isganaba nanadisulile, dule-isgudimaladba akadisulile, dule-Bab-Dummadgi-dododimalad-abargi gudisulile, we-dulegi, Bab-Jehová nued binsadiid.
We-dule, Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maidgi bur wergudisunnad. A-igargi, mutikidbali, ibginedbali, egi binsadisunnad.
We-dule, igi sapi diwar-naba aramakgwisdae, e-iba-sogedba sanmakdedae, deyobi gued. Bela na e-ibmar-imaked ega nueganbi naddaed.
Dule-isganamardi, degisulid. Igi oros-uka burwaba mileddae, deyobi, dule-isganamardi guoed.
A-dule-isganamarga igar-itolealile, gwen san-onogosurmalad. Degisoggu, dule-isganamar dule-nuegan-abargisii guosurmalad.
Bab-Jehová dule-nued-damalad nue-bendakmaid. Dule-isganamardi, degi-bergudmaloed.
¿Ibiga dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad, Bab-Jehováʼgi binsarsunna urwebukwa? ¿Ibiga dulemar Bab-Jehováʼgi-aibinedgi binsarsunna binsabukwa?
Reymar-negsemamaid, Bab-Jehováʼgi aibitemalad. Dulemar-nuga-nikamalad, Bab-Jehováʼgi isdar-binsadmalad. Bab-Jehová-na-nug-imaksadgi aibitemarbalid.
We-dulemar, weyob sogdemalad: “Anmar e-gangued obeloge, e-negsemaidgi anmar ollorgumala.”
Bab-Jehová-Niba-Neg-Dakmaid ega alled, Bab-Dummad amargi dodoged.
Bab-Jehová a-dulemarse urwed. A-dulemar, Bab-Dummad-urwedba abin gwakidmalad.
Bab-Jehová weyob ega sogded: “Ani an-yar-islidikid-Siónʼye-nugadgi, an-rey an mesisad.”
Bab-Jehová-Igar-Mesisad an soggwelo. Bab-Dummad weyob anga sogsad: “Be an-machi gued, emi-ibagi, an be-babga gunonikid.
Anse be ibmar egise, ar bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad an bega ukoed, yarmar-nanaid bela ugakaase an bega ukbaloed.
Sabsur-gandikidba be negseoed, sianar-irgwensur-mamariddaedyobi, be a-dulemar-imakoed.”
Reymar, degisoggu, wisigarmar, nue-binsaed-nikaa damalo. Dulemar-negsemamaid, ¡nue salakarmar! Bab-Jehová bega ibmar-sognaidba be damar.
Bemar, Bab-Jehová-e-nug nue-itoakwaa odummomalo, ise-itoakwaa Bab-Jehová-mag-dakedgi be wergudii gumalo.
Bab-Jehová-mer-urwega, E-Machi-urbalikwaa be nanamarsun. Ar Bab-Jehová bemarse-uludele, bemar sunna ese oburgwilemalad. ¡Bab-Jehová dule-egi-bensuli-nanamaladgi, nued binsadaed!

¡Bab-Jehová, an-isdarmalad dogdar mergued! ¡An-isdarmalad bukidar angi aibitemalad!
An-isdarmalad bukidar an-annik sogmalad: “Bab-Dummad bendakosulid.”
Bab-Jehová, bedi an-isdarmalad-idu, sigu-abgaedyob be an-irwa gwisguedid. Be, an-ganguedid. Be, an-niga-ogannogedid.
Bab-Jehováʼse binnasur an goled. Na e-neg-islidikid-akale, an-abin-imaked.
Ar Bab-Jehová an-edarbedsoggu, an dobsuli meged, nue an gabed. Neg-oibosale, bogidikidgi an gwisgued.
Degisoggu, an-isdarmalad miliambe (10,000) an-ebiris-bukwamalad, an dobsulid. ¡Bab-Jehováʼye, wis be an-itoge!
¡Bab-Jehováʼye, be an-bendakdage! ¡Bab-Dummadye, an-isdarmaladgi be an-ollor-imakdage! An-isdarmalad-e-akugar be sarsodage, we-dule-isganamar-e-nugar be obatedage.
Bab-Jehová, beginbi abonoleged danikid. ¡Be-sordamargi be nued-binsao!

Bab-Dummad, igar-bulegan-idu be an-irwa-gwisguedid. An bese gotele, bitigi be an-itosana gadin. Bab-Dummadye, an suli-suli itoged, wis be an-bendake. Wile be an-dake. An bese-goled be an-itoge.
Emide, ¿sanagwadse bemar, an-nug-oichodiidi, iemaloye be soge? ¿Sana be ibmar-igarga-gwen-guosulidgi-alamakdimaladi, be iemaloye soge? ¿Sana be gakan-igarba-nanamalad, be iemaloye soge?
Be itomar, dule-Bab-Jehováʼba nue-nanadiile, Bab-Dummad, a-dulebina itogerba daed. A-ular, Bab-Jehováʼse an gotele, an-itodaed.
Be sae-itoalile, nue salakarmar. Melle Bab-Dummadgi isgumalo. Mutik be gabesokalir, bogidik be-ulubgi, be ibmar-imaksadgi nue-binsamai samalo.
Bab-Dummad-bese-ibmar-napiragwad-egismaidba Bab-Dummadga be ukmalo. Melle Bab-Jehováʼgi be bengumalo.
Bukidar dulemar sogdidinanaed: “¿Wede doa anmarga ibmar-nued wis oyogoe?” Bab-Jehováʼye, wis be anmarga ibmar-nued oyoge, be-sabgued be anmarse-oyoge.
Dulemar bukidar-masgunned-nikale, gobed-nikale, na weligwar itodidamalad. Bab-Dummad, bedi a-dulemarba bur bule weligwar-itogega be an-imaked.
Bab-Jehová, ar bebi unnila an-edarbedisoggu, dobsulidgi an megidoed, bogidikidgi an gabidoed.

Bab-Jehováʼye, an bega ibmar-sogedi, be an-itoge. Nunmakedgi an bega ibmar-biedi, nue be an-itoge.
Bab-Jehová, be an-Bab-Dummad gued, be an-rey gued. Ar an bese gornaisoggu, an bese wilenaidi, nue be itosunna.
Bab-Jehová, wakudaryalaba an bese-goledi be an-itodaed, wakudaryalaba an-wile-naidi, an bega sognonidaed. Be-an-abin-imakedi, an edarbedidaed.
Bab-Dummad, ar bedi ibmar-isgana abesulid, Dule-isgana be-walikaa gudii guosulid.
Dule-san-dummarba-imakmalad, bese gwen dogosulid. Dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmalad, nue-sae be dakdaed.
Dule-gakansamalad be obelogoed. Bab-Jehová, bedi dule-gindakmalad, dule-yardakmalad, nue-sae dakdaed.
Bab-Dummad, ar bedi nue-wile-an-daksoggu, andi nabir bese-goled-negse dogsunnad. Nabir an be-neg-islidikidsik sindigar-ataksii an be-nug odummosunnad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, an-isdarmalad an bukidar-nikadba be-igar-innikigwadba be an-nie. Be-Igar-Maid magar-dakega be an-imake.
Dule-isganamar innikigwadba sunmaksurmalad, e-ulubgi ibmar-isgana-imakedginbi binsadimalad. Yamo dule-nug-odummogar sunmakmalad, yardakar emar-obelogega, guagwar bukwamalad.
¡Bab-Dummadye, a-dule-isganamar be sabsur-odurdake! Dule-isganamar yamo dule-yardaked-igar mesismalad. A-igar na dukin egi aibinega be imake. We-dulemar gannar-gannar ibmar-isgana-imakdimalad-ular, be obane. Ar ade, begi nue-gwisgusmalad.
Dule-begi-bendakleged-amidimaladi, wergumarsun, degisadegu weligwar namakmarsun. Bab-Dummad, be amar-bendakdaed. Dule-be-sabgudimaladi, begi wergumarsun.
Bab-Jehová, dule-ibmar-innikii-imakedgi be nued binsaoed. Bab-Jehová, be-sabedi dulega sigu-abgaedyob guoed.

Bab-Jehováʼye, melle ise-urwaledgi be sabsur-an-odurdake, melle sae-itogedgi be sabsur-an-imake.
Bab-Jehováʼye, wis be wile-an-dake, ar an boniganba nue negoebied. Bab-Dummadye, be an-bendake, ar an-abagan nue-bibichis itoleged.
Bab-Jehováʼye, ¿sanase be an-bendaknonikoe? Emide, an nue-naibid-dummad itonaid.
Bab-Jehováʼye, be sabed-nikarbadbali, wis be an-bendakdage, mer baisur be an-dake.
Ar dule-burgwarmaladdi, bar begi binsamamaisulid. Ar neg-urbardi, ¿doa be-nug odummogoe? Gwen dule be-nug odummogosulid.
Bela-bela an bodiidbali, gege an sagusad. Bane-bane mutikidbali gachiyala, an ise-ogormakar maidaed. An-ibyanisbali, an-gas-megedi dinnasurgus naidaed.
An-isdarmalad-nukad, an-ibya an-ibe mommoleded. An-ibya, nunmakedbali, nue bar ataksurgusad.
¡Dule-isganamar! Be angi bangumala. Ar Bab-Jehová, an-bodiid itononikid.
Bab-Jehová an ese wilesakwaa-gornaid an-itononikid. An-ese-gornaid an-itosad.
Ar bela an-isdarmaladi, surbinsa-itodmaloed, an-isdarmaladi, bingegudmaloed. Bingegudedba wakitemaloed.

An-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼye, be an-bendake, ar an begi bendakleged amied. ¡Dulemar-an-balegindimaladgi be an-bendake! ¡Amargi be an-ollor-imake!
Ar be an-bendaksulile, ¿doa bar an-bendakosunna? Dule-baid an-bendaked sated. Ar igi achumigur dule-ichimake, deyobi, an-isdarmalad an-imakmaloed. Ar igi achumigur dule-gunne, deyobi, an-obelomaloed.
An-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼye, we-ibmar-soggwengi nosa be an-dakdibe: An ibmar-isgana imaksadibe,
an-aigi an nue-yolesdibe, an-isdarad-ibe an yogasaar ibmar-susdibe,
adi, an-isdarmalad an-baleginner, akarsurdo, an-isdarmalad an-bargado, dii-dii napagi an-oburgwedse angi annamardo. An-nug-dummad-nikad obelomalar, akarsurdo.
Bab-Jehováʼye, be sae-itogedba an-isdarmalad-anse-urwebukwadgi be gwisgudage. Anga be igar nabodage. An-Bab-Dummadye, anba be nague, igar-innikigwadba be anga igar naboge.
Bab-Jehováʼye, dulemar-baid-baid be-asabin-ambikuega be imake. Nibnega-akar a-dulemar-e-saila-dummadga be gue.
Bab-Jehováʼye, be dulemarga igar itosoggu, an-ibmar-inniki-imakdiidba be anga igar itoge, an-nossulidba be anga igar naboge.
Bab-Jehová, bedi Bab-Dummad-innikigwadid, bedi dule-binsaed bela baramied. Degisoggu, dule-isganamar-e-ibmar-isgana-imakdimalad be obeloge. Dule-nuegandi, melle be osikirmakega imake.
Bab-Dummad, sigu-abgaedyob an-irwa-gwisguedid, Bab-Dummad, na dule-gwage-ulubgi-inniki-binsadimalad bendakedid.
Bab-Dummad, dulega igar-itogedgine, innikigwadba ega igar nabiroged, bane-bane dule-isganamar sabsur-odurdaked.
Ar dule-isganamar, na e-isguedga bukib-binsasulile, amar-idu, Bab-Dummad es-suid-e-nugar ebinoed, amar-idu e-warsi guagwar dakbaloed.
Ar deyopira, Bab-Dummad ibmar-dule-gindakmalad guagwar urbisbalid, sigu-sooba-gamalad sobsabalid.
Dule-isgana, igar-isganaginbi binsadaed, ibmar-isgana-imakega igar amidaed, geb igar-isgana imaknonidaed.
Dule-isgana, yaa-matusur akwisad. A-yaa-matusulidgi na dukin argwanoed.
Dule-isgana, na e-igar-isgana-imaked egi aibinoed, e-sabsur-urwed egi aibinoed.
Bab-Jehová anga igar-inniki-nabosadba, an e-nug odummogoed. Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-Jehováʼga, an namaked.

Bab-Jehová, be anmar-Dummad gued. Ibiyobi bela we-napneggine, be-nugdi dummarba gue. Bela be-ganguedi nibnegse-bakale, magar-yeerdaklege be nasiksad.
Be-isdarmalad-begi-yolesad-ular, burwigan-namakedgi, mimmigan-namakedgi, be-nug-odummoged-igar be mesisad. Adi, be-isdarmalad, dule-begi-gwisgudimalad, be-abin gaya-maklegar sigegar.
Bab-Dummad, mogir-billigi be-ibmar-nasiksad an nue dakdele, nii-naid an nue dakdele, niisgwamar-naid an nue-dakdebalile,
Bab-Dummad, an binsaddaed: “¿Wede, dule ibusunna, egi be binsanonigu? ¿Wede, dule ibusunna, be akwenonigu?”
Ar dule baliwiturmarba wis yaisaale be imaksad. Napneggi, dummadga-guega, gangued-yeerdakleged bela-bela-nikuega be nug-imaksad. Degi, nug-dummarba-nikuega be imaksabalid.
Bela be ibmar-obinnisadgi gangued-nika-guega be dule-imaksad. Bela e-argan-yaurgi we-ibdurgan ega be uksad:
Bela sibad-wawaadmar, bela moli-bebe-nikamalad, bela ibdurganmar-sapurba-bukwamalad.
Bela nuumar, bela demar-wilaganba uamar-iirmakbukmalad, degi, muu-billigi, bela ibdurganmar-bukwamalad. Bela we-ibdurgangi gangued-nika-guega, be dule-imaksad.
Bab-Jehová, be anmar-Dummad gued. Ibiyobi bela we-napneggine, be-nugdi dummarba gue.

Bab-Jehováʼye, bela-belad an be-nug odummogoed. Bela be-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-imakdiidgi an sunmakoed.
Bab-Dummadye, begi an werguoed, begi an yeer itogoed. Bab-Dummad-Bur-Biriginedye, be-nuggi an namakoed.
An-isdarmalad be-abin wakitemalad, amar yoledapmalad, amar be-abin bela burgwismalad.
Be-ologanagi be sigisad, dulemarga innikigwadba be igar naboged. A-ulale, innikigwadba be anga igar nabosad, be anba nagunonikid.
Bab-Dummad, dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamaladse be sabsur-ulusad, dule-isganamar be obelosad. A-dule-isganamargi dulemar bipisaale bar binsaega be imakosulid.
An-isdarmalad bela bergusmalad, dule-wargwensaale gwen gudii gussulid. E-neggweburmar bela napabi nagusad, bipisaale gwen bar egi binsalegosulid.
Bab-Jehováʼdi dulemarga igar-itogega e-ologanagi sigisad. Bab-Jehováʼdi degisadegu maigu guoed.
Bab-Jehová dulemarga innikigwadba igar naboged, degi, dulemarga igar-innikigwadba negseed.
Bab-Jehováʼye, be neg-dukuedyob dule-mesagwar-imakledimaladga gued. Ibagan-suli-suli-itolegedgi, Bab-Jehováʼye, a-dulemarga be galu-gandikidyob gued.
Bab-Jehováʼye, dulemar-be-amimaladi be wargwen bipisaale metedisulid. A-ular, dule-magar-be-dakmalad begi bensurmalad.
Bab-Jehová, Sión-neggweburgi negdakmaid. A-Bab-Jehováʼga namakmar. E-ibmar-dummagan-imakedgi, dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladga be sunmakmar.
Bab-Dummad, be dule-gindakmalad buged-mai-imakosurdeeye sogsulid, Bab-Jehová dule-wiledimalad-ese-gornaid nue itodaed. Amar-iegodeeye sogsulid.
Bab-Jehováʼye, wile be an-dake. Nue be dakena, isdar-an-dakmalad nue an-wionanaid. Melle dulemar an-oburgwega be imake,
adi, Jerusalén-neggwebur-dogedgi, dulemarga an be-nug-odummogega, degine, be an-bendakedgi an weligwar-itogegar.
Dule-aku-be-dakmalad na dukin yardaklesmalad. Emar-gaega, saki-odukuar-nasismaladgi, na dukin e-nag galesmalad.
Bab-Jehová-igar-innikigwadbi-imaked, bela nue-magar daksamalad. Dule-isganamardi, dukin e-ibmar-isgana-imaksadgi yardakledimalad.
Dule-isganamar, bela burgwed-negse seledmaloed. Dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad Bab-Dummad-ieddamalad, amar neg-urba burgwed-negse seledmaloed.
Ar dule-wiledimaladdi, be degisadegu iegosulid, dule-baidse-sabsur-wiledimalad be-ibmar-edarbedimalad, berguus be imakosulid.
¡Bab-Jehováʼye, nue be atake! ¡Dulemar melle begi-nakwed be imake! Dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladga be igar-itoge. A-dulemar be sabsur-odurdake.
Bab-Jehováʼye, dulemar-e-niga be egwane. Dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad wisgued be imake, emarde, Bab-Dummadsurmarye, unnila dule-gumarye.
Bab-Jehováʼye, ¿ibiga be angi yoggus gudii? ¿Ibiga be an-idu dukue? An bonigan-abalagi-gunaidgi, aisaar an bebina bela-bela gudidaenad.
Dule-isgana na-san-bule-bule-imakedgi, sabsur dule-wileged-baregindaed. Degi-inigwele, we-dule-isgana, na dukin e-ibmar-isgana-imakedgi yoleged.
Dule-isgana, sulibinsa-ibmarbina-sogedgi na san-ogannodiid. Dule-isgana, dule-ibmarbina-suli-suli-itodimalad-e-nug ogannoged, Dule-isganadi, isdar be-daked.
Bab-Dummadye, dule-isgana bule-bule-san-imakedbali, be-amisulid. Bipisaale begi binsasulid.
Bela-ibmar-imakdele, ega ibmar-nueganbi naddaed. Bab-Dummad, we-dule-isgana, Be-Igar-Mamaidgi gwen binsadisulid, ar akusunna daked. Ar dule-isgana, mesagwar e-isdarmalad-imakdaed.
E-gwagegi weyob binsadaed: “Dulemar gwen-an-oakalogosurye, bipisaale an boni nikuosurye, unnila, an weligwar gudii guoye.”
E-sunmakedi, unnila dule-ukabsaedginbi sunmaked, gakansaedginbi sunmaked, dulemar-sabsur-imakedginbi sunmaked. E-gayaburba unnila emar-oakalogedginbi sunmaked.
Dule-isgana emar-naibi-imakega, galimbaba gudidaed. Arbakee dulemar-argadidaed, emar-idu dukusidaed, adi, ukiar emar-oburgwegar.
We-dule, igi achumigur dule-baisur-binsadiidgi-ichomakegala, e-dukued-yaba-dukusidae, dule-ganonikir, ebipiddae, deyobi, we-dule-isgana, emar-naibi-imakega gudiid.
Ar deyobi, dule-e-bendakedsuli-gudiidi, dule-isganase-galenonikile, ese nue sabsur-ibitoged.
We-dule-isgana ulubgi binsaed: “Bab-Dummad we-ibmargi gwen binsamaisurye. We-ibmar-mer-dakegala, e-wagar biir imakdaye. Ar Bab-Dummad neg-gunaid gwen dakmaisurye.”
¡Bab-Jehováʼye, be dake! ¡Bab-Dummadye, be-gangued be oyoge! ¡Melle be dule-wilediid iege!
¿Ibiga we-dule-isganade, e-sunmakedgi mesagwar be-imakosunna? ¿Ibiga we-dule-isganade, ulubgi binsaosunna: “Bab-Dummad gwen anga akar sogosurye?”
Bab-Jehováʼye, ar bedi bato neg-gunaid daksad, sabsur-ibitonanaid bato be daksad, nunmakedba-galitonanaid be daksad. Ar bedi, sogedba be we-ibmar nudakoed. Dule-ibmar-suli-gudimaladi, begi bensur gudimalad. Ar be, dule-sergan-sated-bendakedid.
¡Bab-Dummadye, dule-isgana-ibe be e-gangued-osuloge! ¡Dule-isgana e-isgued-imakedba be sabsur odurdake! ¡We-dulemar we-napneggi-obelogedse be imake!
Bab-Jehováʼye, be degisadegu Reyga maid. Dulemar-aku-be-dakmaladdina, be-yargi bela obelolemaloed.
Bab-Jehováʼye, dule-wilegana-bese-goled be itodaed. Dule-wilegana-e-niga be ogannodaed. Bese ibmar-egisder ega be ukdaed.
Bab-Jehová dule-sergan-satedga, degi, dule-wiledimaladga, igar-innikigwad imakdaed, adi, dule-we-napnegginmaladi, melle bar emar-wiodii gumalagar.
Bab-Jehováʼgi, an bendakleged amied. Degisoggu, ¿ibiga anga sogmalosunna, sikwiyob yalaganba be wakinye?
Be dakmala, dule-isganamar e-warsi guagwar ganimalad, e-sigu guagwar warsigi-yoi ganimalad. Dule-gwage-innikii-gudimaladgi sigu-miega, negsichigi dukuar gwichimalad.
Ar we-napneggi, igar-innikii-selemaid-bergudele, dule-innikidaed, geg bar ibmar imaked.
Bab-Jehová, e-neg-islidikidgi maid. Bab-Jehová, nibneggi ologanagi siid, e-ibyagwar dulemar-ibmar-imaked nue-dakmaid.
Bab-Jehová, dule-innikidaed, degi, dule-isganadaed bela baramied. Bab-Jehová, dule-sabsur-emar-imakdiidgi-wergudiid isdardaked.
Bab-Jehová, dule-isganamargi, soo azufreʼba-mesa odegoed. Dule-isganamar bela burwa-ueregedba burgwemaloed.
Bab-Jehová, dule-innikigwadid, igar-inniki-maid-sabedid. A-ulale, dule-inniki-nanadiiddi, Bab-Jehová-e-wagar dakoed.

Bab-Jehováʼye, be anmar-bendake. Dule-be-sogedba-nanamalad bergusad. We-napneggine, dule-napiragwad bar-daklesulid.
Dulemar na muchub-muchub gakangi sunmakmalad, nue-nabiridyob sunmakmalad. Asginbi nued sunmakmalad, ulubgindi, emar-yardakedgi binsamalad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, dule-nue-nabiridyob-sunmakmalad, bela be obeloge. Dule-san-dummarba-sunmakmalad, bela be osuloge.
We-dulemar sogdimalad: “Sunmakedgi anmar dulemargi obinoed. Aga anmar gwabin-duku nikasursi. Anmar-gwabin-duku dule-baidgadsulid. ¿Degite, doa anmargi obinosunna? Dule anmargi-obined sate.”
Emide, Bab-Jehová, bede soged: “Dule-e-bendaked-satemalad mesagwar-imaklediid-ular, an gwisguoye. Dule ibmar-sate-gudimaladba bela-belad-bodimalad, an bendakoye.”
Bab-Jehová-gayaburba isedar-swilimakaledid. Igi mani swilimakar-imaklegega, soo-yagi gannar-gannar ilagugle (7) dulege, aba bur bule Bab-Dummad-gayaburba swilidik gued.
Bab-Jehováʼye, bebi-unnila dule-isganamar-idu, be anmar-edarboed. We-dule-isganamar-idu, degisadegu, be anmar-irwa gwisguoed.
Dule-isganamar anmar-ebirdiile, bee be anmar-edarboed. We-napneggi igar-isganamar bur yeerdaklealile, bee be anmar-bendakoed.

Bab-Jehováʼye, ¿sana be angi wis binsanonikoe? ¿Sana be anse wis wagar oyononikoe?
¿Sana an bane-bane-surbinsa-itodiid anga berguoe? ¿Sana an ulubgi-nunmak-itodiid anga berguoe? ¿Sanadse an-isdarad angi obindii guoe?
Bab-Jehováʼye, be an-Bab-Dummadid, wis be an-dake, wis be an-abin-imake, be anga niga-ogannoge. Deyob be imakele, an bar burgosulid.
An-isdarad angi weligwar-itogosulid. Weyob sogosulid: “Anse galakusye.”
Ar andi, be-sabgued-dummarba-nikadgi bensulid. Be-an-abonogedgi an weligwar itoged. Bab-Jehováʼye, an bega namaked, Be nued-angi-binsamaidba, an bega namaked.
Dule-binsaedsulidaed, weyob e-gwagegi sogdiid: “Bab-Dummad maisulid.” Dulemar nue-isgus gudimalad, unnila ibmar-isganabi imakdimalad. Dule-wargwensaale, ibmar-nued-imaked gudisulid.
Bab-Jehová nibneg-akale, dulemar-napneggi-gudimalad dakmaid, abakale, dule-gwensak magar-neg-itoged gudiile, abakale, dule-gwensak magar-Bab-Dummad-dakbied gudiile.
Degi-inigwele, dulemar Bab-Dummadgi bela bangus gudimalad, dule ibmar-nued-imaked gwen wargwensaale, gudisulid, bela nue isgus gudimalad.
¿Ar dule-isganamar na ibmar-isgana-imakdimalad, nue wismalansursi? Ar nue wismalanad. Emide, igi dulemar madu-gunmala, deyob an-dulemar ese dolediid. We-dule-isganamar, gwen bipisaagwar Bab-Jehováʼse gordisurmarbalid.
Emisgindi, be dakmalana, emide, wawanmakbukwad. Ar Bab-Dummaddi dule-innikidamaladba gudisoggu, dule-isganamardi, dobgubukwad.
Dule-isganamar dule-wilemalad-e-igar obured, degi-inigwele, dule-wilemaladdi Bab-Jehováʼgi bendaklegoed.
Bitigi Bab-Jehová, Israel-dulemarga abonoleged-igar, Sión-yala-akale, barmialina gadin. Bab-Jehová na e-dulamar-galesbukwad, gannar na e-yarse-senonikile, Jacob-e-wagan wergudmaloed, Israel-dulemar weligwar itodmaloed.
Bab-Jehováʼye, ¿doa bese-goled-neg-selegedgi nabir mai guoe? ¿Doa be-yar-islidikidgi nabir gudii guoe?
Unnila weyob-damaladbi gudii guoed: Dule-inniki-nanadiid, dule-igar-innikigwad-imakdiid, dule-napiragwadba-ibmar-soged.
Dule-baidgi-wissur-gakansaed, dule-aimar-naibi-imakdisulid, dule-emar-mesagwar-imakdisulid.
Dule, dule-Bab-Jehováʼse-obanlesad obanmogad. A-dule, Bab-Jehová-dobekwaa-nanadiid-e-nugdi ogannoged. Dule, ibmar-imakoye-sogsad, ega nuedga-guosur-inigwele, imakedse-daed.
Dule, dule-baidga mani-uksale, e-gaka egi-onosulid. Dule, dule-ibmar-oakalossulidgi-aibinega dule-baiganse manigi-bakledisulid. Ar dule weyob-daedi, bipisaale gwen galakuosulid.
Bab-Dummadye, be an-bendake, an begi dukued amidiid.
Bab-Jehováʼga an sogsad: “Bebi unnila be an-Dummadga-guye, dule-baidgi ibnued an amisurye, unnila beginbi ibnued an amiye.”
Dule-gwage-swilidikmalad we-yargi-bukmaladgi an yeer-itoged. Dule-gwage-inniki-gudimaladgi an yeer-itoged.
Dulemar ibmar-bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladga nue-alamakdimaladdi, dukin nunmaked-onasguega imakdimalad. Andi, ibmar-bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladga ablis-uklegedi, bipisaale gwen ukosulid. An-gwabindukubela, gwen e-nug biosulid.
Bab-Jehová, bela ibmar-nueganba be anga ibmar-biriginedga gued. Be angi doggus ise-nued-binsamaid. An-san-burba, bela be-argan-yaurgi siid.
Napa-nuegan be anga uknonikid, napadar-nued be anga daksad.
Bab-Jehová-anga-binsaed-ukmaid-nug an odummogoed. E-binsaedi, mutikidba an-ulubgi, anga ibmar-soge an itodaed.
Gusgu Bab-Jehováʼse an idaked, ar anba-gudiguad. Ar an-yalaba gwichigusoggu, dule gwen an-oakalogosulid.
A-ulale, an-gwagegi an yeer-itoged. Bela an-ulubgi an weligwar itoged. Bela an-san-burba begi-bensuli gudii guoed.
Gwen be an-san-burba neg-uangi oyogsaosulid, ar be-mai-gwage-swilidikid-e-mui gwen neg-uangi onunsaega be imakosulid.
Igar-nuedba-gudigued be anga oyosad, be-asabinni bela-belad weligwar-gudii be an-imaked. Be-yalaba degisadegu-gudiid an yeer-itoged.
Bab-Jehováʼye, an bese napiragwadgi wilesagwa-goledi, wis be an-itoge. An bese-binnasuli-goledi, be an-itoge. An bese-goledi, nue be itoge, yamo an be-yardaknaisulid.
Bab-Dummadye, be ibmar-innikigwad-magar-daked-ular, bee be an-bendakedga gue.
Be an-binsaed nue-dakdaed. Mutikidba an nue-ulubgi-binsamaid be baramidaed. Nue be an-wilubdaksad, ibmar-isgana be angi amissurgusad. An na sogsad, an-sunmakedgi an begi isguosurye.
Be-igar-nued-mesisad-ular, dulemar-baigan-daedyobi an dasulid, ibmar-isgana-imakedgi an nanadisulid.
Be-Igar-Maidba bur an nanadiid, a-igargi gwen an bangudisulid.
Bab-Dummad, ar be an-abin-imakdasoggu, a-ular, an bese binnasuli goled. Wis be an-itoge, an bese-goled nue be itoge.
¡Be-sabed-sunsoged be anga oyoge! Dulemar begi-bendakleged-amididamaladi, dulemar-isganamarse baregilledidamaladi, a-dulemar, be-ganguedgi be bendakdaed.
Ar dule-isganamar angi dummad-yolenanaisoggu, igi be-ibyagwag na be akwe, deyobi, be an-akwemoga.
Ar dule-an-oburgwebimalad bato an-walik guakwaa gudimarsoggu, igi gannir e-sakan-urba na e-mimmigan odukue, deyobi, be an-odukumoga.
A-dulemar, dule-wiledaked satemalad, unnila na san-dummarba-imakedgi sunmakmalad.
An-isdarmalad-an-baregindimalad an-walikagusad, angi ukiar sabsur-yolemalaga, guakwaa gudimalad.
Achumigur mas-gabiedyobi, an-isdarmaladde anbina gudimalad. Achumigur e-mas-gaega balidakagwar maidaedyobi, anbina gudimalad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, ginebinne, an-isdarmalad-abin be nodage, an-isdarmalad be obelodage. Bab-Dummadye, be an-abonogega, be-es-suidgi an-isdarmalad be oburgwedage.
Bab-Jehováʼye, be-gangued-nikadba, an-isdarmaladgi be an-onoge. We-dulemar unnila we-napnegginbi ibmar-nika gudimalad. We-dule-isganamar, be-ibmar-nuegan nue-nika gudimalad. E-mimmigan, e-babgan-sorba, a-ibmar-nuegan abingadimarmogad. Degine, e-wagangarmoga bela ibmar-nuegan obine abingadimarmogad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, andi, ibmar-oakalossurye be angi-sogsadba, an be-wagar dakoed. Sikwas an be-wagar-daksale, bato gusbin an itogoed.

Bab-Jehováʼye, nue an be-sabed, be an-niga-ogannoged maid.
Bab-Jehováʼye, be an-akwasailaga gued. Be an-garganguedsoggu, an begi bensulid. Bab-Jehováʼye, be an-neggandikidid. Sigu-abgaedyob be an-idu bonigan-irwa gwisgued. Be-garganguedgi be an-bendaked. Bebi unnila bonigan-idu an-odukued-birigined maid. Bab-Jehováʼye, be an-ollor-imakedid. Bonigangi be an-ollor-imakdiid. Ar an bese gotele, an-isdarmaladgi-nakwega be an-imaked.
Bab-Jehováʼye, be-nug an ogannoged, ar be-nug innikigwadba odummoleged maid. Bab-Jehováʼye, an-isdarmaladgi an bendaklegoed.
Burgwed-igar nue an-ebiris gunaid. Diwar-dummad-nomaiyobi, burgwed angi gwisgunonikid.
Bato an gachiyala megis-itoged, gwillo angi-biles-maiyob an itoged, gwen bar san-onoged an itosulid. Burgwed-igar, an-idu saki-milesnaiyob naid.
An surbinsa-itodiidgi Bab-Jehováʼse an gote gusad, Bab-Dummadse ise-gollar an imaksad. Agine, e-neg-akale, an-itononikid. Bab-Jehováʼse-an-gornaidi, e-uayagwar an-itosad.
Bab-Jehová-uludgua, neg giglimakded, yar-sailagan-mamaidse-bakale, giglimakded.
Bab-Jehová-bunnodedbali waa bupurmakded, e-gaya-yaba soo-gwabunyeded, ginnitibi soo-mialid.
Bab-Jehová mee mogir-egasad, geb abali aidealid, mogir-gudureged-birgi aidealid.
Bab-Jehová baliwitur-querubinʼye-nugad-birgi-sii, mogir-imbaba nadapid. Burwa-gandik-gormaidba gukumai gualid.
Bab-Dummad neg-gudureged-abargi nadapid. E-irwa mor-dummad-naiyob mogir nagusad. We-mogir dii-dummad-widanikiyob dakle sigisad.
Bab-Jehová-sabsur-gadedbali, mogirmar aisakided, mogirmar dii-akwamaryob mileded, sogunmar ginnitibi mileded.
Bab-Jehová nibneg-akale, mogirmar-dii-akwamaryob-milemaid-abalagine, sogunmar-ginnitibi milemaid-abalagine, mala-gollomakmaiyob binnasuli sunmakded. Bab-Jehová-Bur-Birigined-e-sunmaked bela neg-gaded.
Bab-Jehová sigu-milegeyob e-isdarmaladgi mar-odealid. Bab-Dummad e-isdarmalad-oduurmaksad, e-isdarmalad-oabarmakega imaksad.
Bab-Jehová, be-uludedbali demar-urba-napa-naid mag-dakle gunonikid. Bab-Jehová, be-bunnodedbali, napasaila daled gunonikid.
Bab-Jehová nibneg-akale, anse e-argan oyononikid. An demar-wilagi-gundilenai an-ononnonikid.
Bab-Jehová an-isdarad-buledgi an-bendaksad. Bab-Jehová isdar-an-dakdimaladgi, an-ollor-imaknonikid. An-isdarmalad-angi-obinmaladgi an-abonononikid.
Boniganba-an-galitonaidgi an-isdarmalad angi gwisgunonikid. Agine, Bab-Jehová an-bendaknonikid.
Bab-Jehová wile-an-dakedbali, an-bendaknonikid, neg-nuedgi an-ogwisgunonikid.
Bab-Jehová an ibmar-nued-imakedba anga ibmar-nued uked. Ibmar-isgana-imakdisulidba nued angi binsaed.
Ar Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maidba an gudiid, ibmar-isgana an imakdisulid, Bab-Dummadgi an bangudisulid.
Ade, bela e-igar-uksad an nue-gasa gudiid, e-Igar-Maidgi an bangudisulid.
Bab-Jehováʼga sogedba an gudiid, ibmar-isgana-imaklegedgi an na san-bargas gudiid.
Bab-Jehová an ibmar-nued-imakedba anga ibmar-nued uked. Ibmar-isgana-imakdisulidba nued angi binsamaid.
Bab-Jehová, dule-beba-bane-bane-inniki-nanadiidgine, egi be bane-bane inniki damogad. Bab-Jehová, dule-igar-innikigwadba-nanadiidga, ega be inniki ibmar-imaked.
Bab-Jehová, dule-bega-gakansasulidga, be gakansasurmogad. Be dule-emar-yardakedgardi, e-igar e-ibe be obured.
Bab-Jehová, dulemar na-san-bipi-imakdimalad, bonigangi-obinega be imaked. Dule-na-san-dummarba-imakdimaladdina, be sabsur-wioged.
Bab-Dummad-Jehová, be dula-gudii an-imaked. Bab-Jehová, an bonigan-abalagi-gudiidgi, san-burba-dula-gudii be an-imaked.
Bab-Jehová, be-an-bendakedbali, sordamar-danar-bila-onomalad an ogilogoed. An-Bab-Dummad, be-an-bendakedbali, neggweburmar-galu-matusulid-nikad an obelogoed.
Bab-Dummad-e-ibmar-imakedi innikigwad imaked, e-gayaburba sunsogedid. Bab-Jehová dule-egi-dukumaladga sigu-abgaedyob gued.
¿Doa Bab-Jehováʼyob Bab-Dummadga mai? Dule sate. Unnila Bab-Jehováʼbi maid. ¿Doa Bab-Dummadyob-gangued mai? Dule sate. Unnila Bab-Jehováʼbi maid.
Bab-Jehováʼbi unnila anga gargangued ukmaid, Bab-Dummadbi dobsuligudii an-imaked.
Bab-Dummad goe-sapur-abarmakedyob an-oabarmaked, yar-billiganaba geg baparmakega an-imaked.
Bab-Jehová an-surgan ogannoged, adi, an nabir bila-onogegar. Bab-Jehová an-swidamar ogannoged, adi, nabir warsi-esgoro-gordikidbiid an dopee imakegar.
Sigu-abgaedyob be an-irwa gwisgued, be-garganguedgi be an-bendaked. Be nued-angi-binsaedba nasguega be an-imaked.
Bab-Jehová, an nabir nanaega, melle an aimukuega, anga be neg-ollor-dummad nasiksad.
An an-isdarmalad-baregitegusgua, an indaksasulid, an bargadapid. Bela an-isdarmalad-obelogedse an imaksad.
Bela-bela an an-isdarmalad naibi-imaksad, degisoggu, gege bar angi gwisgu gusmalad. An-isdarmalad anse nue-galakusmalad.
Bab-Jehová, bila-onogega be an-ogannosad, an-isdarmalad anse-ibitogega be imaksad.
An-isdarmalad anse-galakudedba, wakinnega be imaksad. Deyob isdar-an-dakdimalad an obelosad.
An-isdarmalad aisaar dule-e-bendakegala, emarse gornanai gusmalanad, dule-e-bendaked sate gusmalad. Bab-Jehováʼse gochamalanad, Bab-Jehováʼdi abin-imaksasulid.
An-isdarmalad anse sanyob ichi-ichi gusad. Amar ukub burwa-abin-mileddaedyob anse gusmalad, sabsur-enalenai anse gusmalad.
Bab-Jehová, dule-angi-urwedimaladgi be an-bendaksad, dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad-e-dummadga be an-imaksad. Dulemar-aku-an-dakmalad an-maiga gunonimalad.
Ibmar-imakoye an sogsale, a-dulemar, yog anba ibmar-imakar damalad. Wemar-Israel-dulesurmaladi, an-nug odummodimalad.
We-Israel-dulesurmaladi, an-gaya-itosale, nig-argwate damalad, e-dukued-yaba-bukwa-noarmalale, wawanmakdani noardamalad.
¡Bab-Jehová dula-mai! ¡Bab-Jehová, unnila bebi an-bendaked maid! ¡Be-nug an odummosun! Bab-Jehová, be an-abonogedid. Be-nug bela-bela odummolesun.
Bab-Dummad anga an-isdarmalad-buged-mai imaksad, Bab-Dummad, dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad an-maiga-gumalaga anga imaksad.
Bab-Dummadye, an-isdarmalad-angi-gwisguargua, be an-abonononikid. An-isdarmaladgi-obinega be an-imaksad, dule-ursilimaladgi be an-ollor-imaksad.
Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová, Israel-dulesurmalad-abargi an be-nug ogannoged, Be-nug-odummogegala an namaked.
Bab-Jehová, e-rey bela-bela e-isdarmaladgi-obinega na imaked. Na nug-imaksa-gudiidga, e-sabgued oyoged. Davidʼga, degi, e-waganga, e-sabgued oyoged. Degisadegu, e-sabgued ega oyodii guoed.

Mogir-naidi, Bab-Dummad-e-gangued-yeerdaklegedgi sunmaknaid. Mogir-billi-aradgi bela-ibmar-naidi, Bab-Dummad-e-ibmar-obinnisad oyonaid.
Bela-ibmar-naidi, bane-bane ibginedbali, Bab-Dummad-e-gangued-yeerdaklegedgi na sunmaknanaid, Bela-ibmar-naidi, bane-bane mutikidbali, Bab-Dummad-e-gangued-yeerdakleged na barsognanaid.
We-ibmarmar duleyob-sunmaksur-inigwele, ibmar-bisurmar-inigwele, e-gaya-goled-itolesur-inigwele,
we-ibmarmar-naid-e-sunmakedi, napneggi bela itoleged, bela napneg-dirbir-naid-ugakaase warmaked.
Bab-Dummad dad-ibelerga mogir-billigi neg-nasiksad. Ar igi machered-ome-nikusad neg-oibosale, e-gabedneggi weligwar-noardae, deyobi, dad-ibeler wakudaryalaba noardaed. Ar Igi dule-abarmaked abarmaksokalir, yeer-itodae, deyobi, dad-ibeler nakwiardaed.
Dad-ibeler mogir-billi-nagagi nakwidagogu, mogir-billi-bergunaidse argwandapdaed. Dad-ibeler-e-ueregedgi ibdula gwen dukuosulid.
Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maidi, napiragwadid, dule-burba-ogannogedid. Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maidi, sunsogedid, egi geg benguleged. Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maidi, dule-binsaedsulidaed binsaed-ibedga imaked.
Bab-Jehová-Islidik-Igar-Mesisad innikigwadid, gwage-weligwar dule-saed. Bab-Jehová-e-Igar swilidikidid, magar-ibmar-itoge dule-imaked.
Bab-Jehová-dobee-nanaed-igar swilidikidid, degisadegu mai guoed. Bab-Jehová-igar-naboged, napiragwadid, bela innikigwadbiid.
Bab-Jehová-e-Igar orba bur bule nuedid, or-nuedba bur bule e-bina sogleged. Bab-Dummad-e-Igar achanisba bur bule ochigwad, achanis-aryomaidba bur bule osidikid.
Be-Gayaburba anga iduakwaa ibmar-soged: “Nue salakarye.” Ar dule a-Gayaburbaba ibmar-imakele, bukidar ibmar-nuegan nikuoed.
¿Doa e-nodiid na magar-itoge? Bab-Jehováʼye, ibugi an begi nodidibe, an na wissulid. Agi be an-ollorsae.
Deginbali, an yamo-begi-yoledaedgi, be an-ollorsabali. We-isgued mer angi obined be sae. Adi, dulemar bar angi sunmakosulid, bar an isgued-dummad imakosulid.
Bab-Jehová, be an-edarbedid, be an-odukuedid. Degisoggu, an-sunmaked be yeer-itosana gadin, ulubgi-an-binsaed be yeerdaksana gadin.

Dobedba be suli-suli itogele, Bab-Jehová be-itogena gadin. Jacob-e-Bab-Dummad-nuggi, be bendaklegena gadin.
Bab-Jehová e-neg-islidikid-akale, bega bendakleged barmidagena gadin. Bab-Dummad Sión-yar-akale, be-bendakena gadin.
Ega be ibmar-ukedi, Bab-Dummad bela insaena gadin, ega be ibmar-ogumakar-ukedi, be-abin nuedgi abingaena gadin.
Be ibmar-abediidbali, Bab-Dummad bega ukena gadin. Be ibmar-imakedgi-binsaedi, bega bela nueganbi guena gadin.
Boni-dummagangi be obichale, anmar weligwar-itogedba oimakdemaloed. Anmar-Bab-Dummad-nuggi, olo-bander omemmermakdemaloed. Bab-Jehováʼse be ibmar-egichisadi, bela bega sogedba imakena gadin.
Ar emigindi an wisdo, Bab-Jehová, e-nuggi-rey-nugsalegaled bendakoed. Bab-Jehová e-ganguedgi, bila-onolegedgi, rey-nakwemai-guega imakoed. Bab-Jehová e-nibneg-islidikid-akale, rey-abinsaoed.
Dulemar gwenna-gwenna unnila moli-ur-bila-onomaladginbi bensurmalad, baigandi e-molimarginbi bensurmarmogad. Anmardina, unnila anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼgi bensurmalad.
We-dulemardi nue geg gugus galakudmalad. Anmardina, amba Bab-Jehováʼgi-bensulidba ganna gudimalad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, sorda-bila-onomaladgi, rey-nakwega be imako. Bab-Jehováʼye, anmar bese gotele, be anmar-abinsao.

Bab-Jehová, be-ganguedgi rey weligwar itoged. E-isdarmaladgi-nakwega be imaksadba, rey nue-weligwar itoged.
Bab-Jehová, e-ulubgi ibmar-abediid ega be uksad. Ibmar-bese-egichisadi, mer an ega gwen ukodeeye be sogsasulid.
Bab-Jehová, reygi be nued binsasad. E-nonogi, gurgin-olobiid ega be sisad.
We-reyde, san-burba-dula-gudigued bese egichisad. Suitii degisadegu dula-gudiguega be imaksad.
Bab-Jehová, be rey-bendakedba, rey bila-ononanaidgi-nakwega be imaksad. Be-bendakedba, e-gangued dummarba naded. Be-bendakedba, e-nug nue be odungusad. Bela-bela e-gangued-yeerdakleged reyga be uksabalid.
Bab-Dummad, reygi nuedbi degisadegu be binsamaid. Eba be gudiidbali, rey weligwar itodaed.
Bab-Jehová-Bur-Birigined-e-sabgued geg bergusoggu, rey a-Bab-Jehováʼgi bensulidbali, gandik megoed, onolegosulid.
Bab-Jehová, be-ganguedgi bela be-isdarmalad bese galegoed, bela begi gwisgudidimalad bese galebaloed.
Bab-Jehová, be nonikile, be-isdarmalad sooga be obinyoed. Bab-Jehová, be ulude-sogele, igi soo bela ibmar-obelodae, deyobi, bela be-isdarmalad bese bergumaloed, bela bese girgumaloed.
Bab-Dummad, bela we-napneggi be-isdarmalad-e-mimmigan be osulogoed, dulemar-abargi bela e-anagan be sate imakoed.
Amba akar be-imakbimalandibe, amba gwen be-oakalogosurmalad. Ibmar-isgana-imakega igar-amimardibe, gwen imakosurmalad.
Be-warsi be-isdarmaladgi be oyodogu, be-abin yogasaar duurmakdemaloed.
¡Bab-Jehováʼye, be-nug-odummolegega be-gangued be oyoge! ¡Be-ganguedgi namakar anmar be-nug odummomaloed!

Bab-Dummadye, ¿ibiga be an-obacha? Be an-bendakegala, ¿ibiga be angi dikasur-gunai? ¿Ibiga an-gormaknaid gwen be itosuli?
Bab-Dummadye, ibginedba an bese gornadaenad, gwen be an-abin-imakdasulid. Mutikidba an bese gornadabalinad, gwen be an-abin-imakdasurbalid. An obunnodisulidba nue-geggus itolegusad.
Be dule-islidikidid, Israel-dulemar bega namakmalad.
Anmar-dadgan begi bensurgusmalad. Begi-bensurgusmaladba be bendaknonikid.
Bese-gochamaladba be bendaknonikid. Begi-bensurgunonimargu, be obinge-imaksasulid.
An dulesuliyob itoleged, napa-nus-musgimakdiidyob itoleged. Dulemar ibmar-dodogedga an-imaknanaid, bela dulemar isdarsun an-dakmalad.
An-dakarmalale, anga alliardamalad. Anga akar-akar gunanai damarbalid, nono ege-ege gunanai damarbalid. Weyob sogmalad:
“Bab-Jehováʼgi bensurye-sogdiid, degite, Bab-Dummad e-bendakdado. Bab-Dummadgi-wergudiiye-sogdiid, degite, Bab-Dummad-e-sunnagwad we-ibmargi e-ollor-imakdado.”
Bab-Dummadye, sapidukugi-an-maigu, bee be an-odenonikid. An-nan-nukugi nue-obunnogega be an-imaksabalid.
Bab-Dummadye, sapidukugi-an-maigu, be nue an-akwisad. Amba sapidukugi-an-maigu, bato be an-Bab-Dummadid.
Bab-Dummadye, mer wargwen be an-mete, ar an surbinsa itoged, ar dule-an-bendaked gwen nikasulid.
An-isdarmalad an-ebiris gudimalad, Basán-moli-bebe-nikad-ursirmaladyobi an-ebiris gudimalad.
Igi-achumigur masbina uurmaknagusdae, igi-san-gasale, ichimaknagusdae, deyob, an-isdarmalad angi gwisgunonimalad.
Dii-napagi-eolenaiyob bela an-san na itoged, bela an-garmar nue-gwatiris itolebalid. Igi-baka-gwallu soo-abin daluddae, deyob, an-ulubgi an-gwage nade an itoged.
Dobedba bela an-gaya dinguded. An-gwabinse-bakale, gege bar banamakgusad. Napa-urba bato ber an megisayob na itoged.
Dule-isganamar achu-soemaladyob an-ebiris gunanaid. Bela an-argan, an-nag-matarse-bakale, uudu imaksamalad.
An-garmar daled daklegusad. An-isdarmaladi an-indaknanaisulid, an-ebiris an-dakbukwad.
An-mormar mimismarsunnad, an-mor-suega, egi wilubdaknanai gusmalad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, be an-niga-ogannogedid. ¡Mer be angi bangue! ¡Gwae be an-bendakdage!
Mer es-suidse-oburgwilegega be an-imake. Dule-achumaryob-gudimaladgi be an-bendake.
Achumigur-nono-wawaadyob-gudimaladgi be an-bendake. Moli-bebe-nikad-ursirmaladyob-gudimaladgi be an-ollor-imake.
Bab-Jehováʼye, an-gwenadganga an begi sunmakoed. Dulemar-onmaked-abargi an be-nug-odummogoed.
Bemar, Bab-Jehová-dobekwaa-gudimalad, Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummomar. ¡Jacob-e-wagan! Bab-Jehová-magar-dakdii nanamar. ¡Israel-e-wagan! Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummomar.
Bab-Jehová, dule-wileged-e-naibi-itodiid baisur-daksulid, wagar-biria daksulid. We-dule-ese-gollalile, abin-imaked.
Bab-Jehová, be-dulamar-onmaked-abargine, be-nug-odummogega be an-imaked. An bega ibmar-imakoye-sogsadi, dulemar-be-nug-odummodimalad-asabin an bega imakoed.
Dule-wilemalad nue immeledmaloed. Dule-Bab-Jehová-amidimalad, Bab-Jehová-e-nug-odummodimalad, e-ulubgi weligwar-itodmaloed, deyob sadegu gudmaloed.
Bela we-napneggi-dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad, dulemar-ablis-akar-akar-bukwamalad-ugakaasega, Bab-Jehová-ebinsadmaloed, Bab-Jehováʼse gannar aibirnonimaloed, sindigar abin ambikunonimaloed.
Ar Bab-Jehová bela we-napneg ganikid, bela dulemar-bukwad, e-argan-yaurgi gudidiid.
Dule burgwesuli geg gued. Degisoggu, bela we-napneggi ibmar-bukidar-nikagudimalad, dulemar-burgwedani-gudimalad, Bab-Jehová-asabin sindigar sigmaloed, e-nuggi iba onomaloed.
Bela mimmigan-danimalad, Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummomaloed. Yoedse-danimalad, Bab-Jehová-e-nug-odummodii gumaloed.
Amba-yoo-dulemar-gwalulemaladga soglemogoed, Bab-Jehová ibmar-innikigwad imakmaiye, degi, ibmar-dummagan oyomaiye.
Dule-sibad-wawaad-edarbedyobi, Bab-Jehová, an-edarbed gued. Unniguar ibmar-nika an-imaked.
Igi sibad-wawaad gagan-ara-aradgi obunnomegisdae, deyobi, Bab-Jehová egi-obunnogega an-imaked. Degi, igi dule dii-boo-naidse sibad-wawaad-niddae, deyobi, Bab-Jehová neg-bogidikidse an-niddaed.
Bab-Jehová an-san-burba anga ogannodaed. Igar-innikimaladba an-seddaed. Mer e-nug-isguega, deyob an-imakdaed.
Ar neg-gudureged-sunnasulid-imbaba an nadapile, amba an dobguosulid. Bab-Jehová, ar be anba gudisoggu, an akar-guosulid. Be-suar-gaapoled an-niga-ogannoged, dobsuli an-imaked.
Bab-Jehová, be an-isdarmalad-asabin, mas-bur-nued be anga ukdaed. Be-nonikidi nued-an-be-dakye be anga-sogega, gwallu-wawad an-nonogi be eodaed. Degi, igi gobed noggi-engudele, aryomaidae, deyobi, an-ulubgi ise-weligwar an itodaed.
Bab-Jehová, nue-napira bane-bane an-burgwedse wile be an-dakdii guoed, an-burgwedse be angi nued-binsadii gubaloed. Geb Bab-Jehová-neggine, degisadegu an maiguoed.
Bela we-napneg-naidi, bela egi ibmarmar-bukwadi, Bab-Jehováʼgadid. Bela yalagan-nanaidi, dulemar-egi-bukwadi, bela Bab-Dummadgadbiid.
Bab-Jehová, demar-naidgi napaneg onakwisad, dii-wilagangi napaneg nasiksad.
¿Doa Bab-Jehová-yarse nakoe? ¿Doa Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-islidikidgi gudiguoe? Unnila weyob-gudimaladbi gudii guoed:
Dule-ibmar-nueganbi-imaked, dule-gwage-swilidikid, dule-ibmar-bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladse-gordisulid, yamo-ibmar-ise-sogar-imakdisulid, amarbi unnila, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negse dogoed.
Dule-deyob-daedgi, Bab-Jehová ise-nued-binsaoed, Bab-Jehová-e-abonogedid ega nuedgi igar-nabogoed.
Bab-Dummad, dule-be-amidimaladi, weyob damalargebed, dulemar Jacob-e-Bab-Dummad-dakbi-gudimaladi, weyob nanamalargebed.
Yawagak-dummagan, be argamarsun, yawagak-degisadegu-gwichimalad, be argamarsun, we-yawagakgi, Rey Gandikidba-Yeerdakleged dogesokalid.
¿We doawa, Rey Gandikidba-Yeerdakleged? We-Rey, Bab-Jehová-Dule-Gandikidid, dule-buledid. Bab-Jehová bila-onogedgi dule-buledid.
Yawagak-dummagan, be argamarsun, yawagak-degisadegu-gwichimalad, be argamarsun, we-yawagakgi Rey Gandikidba-Yeerdakleged dogesokalid.
¿We doawa, Rey Gandikidba-Yeerdakleged? We-Rey, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nika-Maidid. We, Rey Gandikidba-Yeerdaklegedid.
Bab-Jehováʼye, an be-bensuli an bese goled.
An-Bab-Dummadye, an begi bendakleged amied, mer bingeguega be an-imake. ¡An-isdarmalad mer angi-dodoged be imake!
Ar begi-bendakleged-amimalad bipisaar bingeguosulid, dulemar igarsuli emargi-gwisgudimaladdi bingegumaloed.
Bab-Jehová, Be-Igarmar be anga oyoge, Be-Igarmargi be an-odurdake.
Be-Igar-innikigwadba be an-nide, a-Igargi be an-odurdake. Bedi, an-Bab-Dummad-an-abonogedid, andi, gusgu beginbi bendakleged amied.
Bab-Jehová, be-ebinsao, be wile-dule-dakedid, be dule-sabguedid. Weyob be-daedi, anga be oyodiguad.
An sapingwaun isgudigusaddi, an begi-yolesaddi, mer be ebinsao. Bab-Jehová, be-wile-dule-dakedba, wile be an-dako. Bab-Jehová, ar bedi dule-nuedid.
Bab-Jehová dule-nuedid, dule-innikigwadid, a-ular, dule-isganamarga igar-maid-imakega oyoged.
Bab-Jehová igar-innikigwadba dulemar-san-bipi-imakdimalad nied, Bab-Dummad e-igargi dulemar-san-dummarba-imakdisurmalad odurdakbalid.
Bab-Jehová-Igar-Mesisadba-ibsadimaladga, Bab-Jehová-Igar-Islidikid-Mesisadba-nanadimaladga, bela Bab-Jehová-e-Igarmar, sabgued-igalad, napiragwad-igalad.
Bab-Jehová, na be-nug-sabedba, an-nue-isgusadi, be anga osuloge.
Bab-Jehová, dule-e-dobee-nanadiidga oyogoed, biti-igarba nanaoe.
A-dule, nued-gudii guoed, e-wagandi nainumar gamaloed.
Bab-Jehová dulemar-e-nug-odummodimaladbo walikaa gued, amarga e-igar-mesisad sogbalid.
Ar Bab-Dummaddi emar-yamoged-igargi an-ollorsaed. A-ular, Bab-Jehováʼginbi an ataked.
Bab-Jehováʼye, be wile-an-dake, andi walagwen gudiid, an wile itodiid.
Bab-Jehováʼye, an-suli-suli-itoged bur bule gangumaid. An-bukib-binsadiid, be anga osuloge.
Bab-Jehováʼye, an-ulubgi-naibi-itoged be dake, an boniganba-galitodiid be dake. Bela an-isgued be anga elie.
Bab-Jehováʼye, be dake, ibiyobi an-isdarmalad mergusa, bela-bela nue-isdar an-dakmalad.
¡We-dulemar-idu be an-odukue! ¡We-dulemargi be an-ollorsae! Mer bingegued be an-imake, ar andi begi bensulid.
An-ibmar-oakalossulid, an-inniki-daedi, an-bendakedga gued. Ar andi begi bensulid.
¡Bab-Dummadye, Israel-dulemar suli-suli-itogedgi, be bendake!
Bab-Jehováʼye, an-akar-akar-gudisulid be oyoge. Begi an bengussulid, begi gwen an bangussulid.
Bab-Jehováʼye, be an-wilubdake, an-ulubse be an-dake, bela an-binsanaid be dake, an-gwage-naid bela ulubse be dake.
Be-sabed an nue wisid, an be-igar-napiragwadba nanadiid.
Dule-galagwensurdamaladbali an nanadisulid, wagar-darbodamaladbali an sigdisurbalid.
Dule-galagwensurdamalad an isdarsun-daked, dule-isganamar an-aiga an imakdisulid.
An ibmar-isganase-achadisulidba, an-argan swilidik gued. Agala, an sunna nabir be-ibmar-ogumakleged-aila-ebirdii gued.
Bab-Jehová, agi be-nug-odummogegala, an binnasur namakdii guoed, be-ibmar-dakledisulid-imaksad-barsogegala, an binnasur gordii guoed.
Bab-Jehová, bese-gorleged-neggi-be-maidbina an nue-soged, be-gargangued-oyomaid-negbina an nue-soged.
An burgwisale, dule-galagwensulid-abargi, dule-gindakmalad-abargi, mer megega be an-imako.
Ar unnila, we-dulemar ibmar-isganabi imakdimalad, emar-yardakedginbi binsadimalad, manigi emar-binsaed-gaed gudimalad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, andi innikigwadba gudiid. Be an-bendake, wile be an-dake,
ar an inniki nanadiid. Bab-Jehová, dulemar-onmakmalad-abargi, an be-nug-odummodii an guoed.
Bab-Jehová anga burba-dulad ukedid, an-abonogedid. ¿An doa dobguosunna? Bab-Jehová an-gandikidga gued. ¿An doase gwayosunna?
Dule-isganamar an-obelogega angi gwisguarmargu, an-isdarmalad an-oburgwega angi gwisguarmargu, aka bur amar burgwismalad.
Ar amba sordamar-bila-onoged, an-ebiris-bukwa-inigwele, andi an dobguosulid. Amba angi bila-onolealile, andi an bukib-binsaosulid.
Bab-Jehováʼse unni ibmar-soggwen an egichisad, abi an abeged: E-neggi-degisadegu-gudigued an abeged. Adi, an Bab-Jehová-e-yeerdakleged dakega, e-neggi ese gordii gubaligar.
Ar Bab-Jehová, ibagan-bulegangi na ese-goled-neggi an-odukuoed, na e-neg-megedgi an-odukuoed, akwasaila-birgi an-ogwichoed.
A-sorbali, an-isdarmalad-an-ebiris-bukwamaladgi-nakwega an-imakoed. Ese-goled-neggi, an e-nug odummogoed, Bab-Jehováʼga andi namakoed.
¡Bab-Jehováʼye, an bese-goled, be itoge! ¡Be wile-an-dake, be an-abinsae!
An-gwage anga-soge an itoged: “Be Bab-Jehová-amie.” Bab-Jehová, an be-amied.
¡Bab-Jehováʼye mer be angi dukue! ¡Mer be isdar-itogedgi be an-obane! Ar be an-bendakedid. Bab-Jehová an-abonogedye, mer be walagwen an-obege, mer be an-mete.
Ar amba an-bab, degi, an-nan an-obachale, Bab-Jehováʼdi an-suoed.
Bab-Jehová, an-oburgwebimalad-ulale, be-igarba be an-nide, igar-nueganba be an-idue.
Bab-Jehová, an-isdarmaladga mer be an-urmake, ar gakansaar-emar-barsogmalad, emar-sabsur-imakmalad, angi gwisgunanaid.
Degisoggu, an nue-wisimakaled, an we-napneggi-gudiidgi Bab-Jehová-dulemargi-nued-binsamaid an dakoed.
¡Bab-Jehováʼgi mer be bengue! ¡Be gangue! ¡Be niga-gandik sae! ¡Eye, Bab-Jehováʼgi mer be bengue!
Bab-Jehováʼye, an bese gole, ar bedi an-bendakedga gued. Bab-Dummadye, melle be an-itosuli gue. Be an-itosulile, bato dule-burgwarmaladba, e-galuse-nadapiyob an guoed.
Bab-Jehováʼye, an bese wilesakwaa-gotele, bitigine, be an-itosana gadin. Bab-Dummadye, an-bendakega an bese-gotele, an bese-golega be-Neg-Ise-Islidikidsik argan onakwidele, bitigine, be an-daksana gadin.
Bab-Jehováʼye, dule-isgudimaladba melle be sabsur-an-wiogo, dule-ibmar-isgana-imakdimaladba, melle be sabsur-an-imako. We-dulemar, unnila asgi dule-baiganga nueganbi sunmakdidamalad. E-gwage-ulubgindina, egi isdar-binsadidamalad.
Dule-isgudimalad e-ibmar-isgana-imakedba, e-galagwensuli-nanaedba, be buged imake. Dule-isgudimalad e-ibmar-galagwensuli-imakedba, be buged sae.
Ar Bab-Jehová-ibmar-imaksadgi bar binsasurgusmarsoggu, Bab-Jehová-ibmar-imaksad baisur-dakarmarsoggu, Bab-Jehová bela a-dulemar obelogoed, baligannarse imakosulid.
Bab-Jehová-nug odummolesun, an ese wilesakwaa-goled an-itosad.
Bab-Jehová, an-ogannogedid, sigu-abgaedyob an-irwa-gwisguedid. Bela-belad gwage-ulubgi an egi bensulid, Bab-Jehováʼgi an bendaklesad. An-gwage-ulubgi, bela-belad-weligwale an itoged, an-namakedgi dog-nuedye an ega soged.
Bab-Jehová, na e-mimmiganga dule-gandikidga gued, Bab-Jehová, na e-nuggi rey-nugsalegaledga abonoged-gandikidga gued.
Bab-Jehováʼye, be-dula be abonoge, be-mimmigangi be ise-nued binsae. Sibad-wawaad-edarbed e-sibad-edarbedyobi, be-mimmigan be edarbe, degisadegu bendakdii be gusun.
Bemar baliwiturmar, Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummomar, Bab-Jehová-e-ganguedgi, e-yeerdaklegedgi be sunmakmar.
Bab-Jehová, Bab-Dummad-gued-ulale, e-nug be odummomar, Bab-Jehová-e-neg-islidikidgi, be Bab-Dummad-nug ogannomar.
Bab-Jehová-sunmakedi muu-billigi gollomakemaid. Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad gollomakemaid. ¡Bab-Jehová muu-billi-dummad-birgi negsemaid!
Bab-Jehová-sunmaked dutusur sunmaked, Bab-Jehová-sunmaked dutusur goled.
Bab-Jehová-sunmaked iksiwar-bibisged. ¡Líbano-Yar-e-iksiwarmar Bab-Jehová-sunmakedba bibisged!
Bab-Jehová, Líbano-yar, Sirión-yar ogiglimaked. Moli-bebe-nikad-sapingana-ichomakeyob Bab-Jehová we-yarmar-oichomaked. Moli-bebe-nikad-sapurbarmalad-ichomakeyob Bab-Jehová we-yarmar-oichomaked.
Bab-Jehová-sunmaked ginnitibi milemaid.
Bab-Jehová-sunmaked nega-dulesulidgan ogiglimaked, ¡Bab-Jehová nega-dulesulidgan-Cadesʼye-nugad ogiglimaked!
Bab-Jehová-sunmaked sapi-encinaʼmar bibisged, sapurmar swanga nasiked. Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neggi bela-dulemar Bab-Dummad-nug odummomalad.
Bab-Jehová dii-barigan-e-sailaga gued, Bab-Jehová bela negsemai degisadeguoed.
Bab-Jehová na e-dulemarga gangued ukoed, Bab-Jehová e-dulemarga bela neg-bogidikid nasiked.

Bab-Jehová, an be-nug ogannoged, ar be an-bendaksad. An-isdarmalad mer angi wergumalaga be imaksad.
An-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, an bese gochagu, be an-nudaknonikid.
Bab-Jehová, an burgwedani-maigu, be an-bendaknonikid. Burba-dulad be anga uksad. Mer burgwarmalad-abargi-megega, be gannar an-ogwisgusad.
Bemar Bab-Dummad-e-sordagan, Bab-Jehováʼga be namakmar, e-nug-islidikid be ogannomar.
Bab-Dummad uludele, unnila sikwas-urwed. Ar nued-emargi-binsaeddina, degisadeguad. Ar mutikidba, boed nagunonidibe, neg-oibosardi, wergued nagunonikoed.
Anga ibmar-nasgumaigu, an weyob sogsagusad: “Bipisaale dule an-osikirmakosurye.”
Bab-Jehová, ar be-nued-angi-binsaedba, yar-dummad-siidyobi, ganna be an-osisad. Be angi aibategua, suli-suli an itonaded.
Bab-Jehová, an bese goled, Bab-Dummadye, an bese ise-wilegar goled.
Ar an burgwisale, ¿ibu-ibmar-nued egi amilegoe? An neg-uanse diglenader, ¿ibu-ibmar-nued egi amilegoe? ¿Ar dule-burgwaledde be-nug odummogoe? ¿Ar dule-burgwaledde be-igar-innikigwad barsogoe?
Bab-Jehováʼye, be an-itoge, wile be an-dake. Bab-Jehováʼye, ¡be an-bendake!
Bab-Dummad, an-gwage-naibi-itonaid, be weligwar imaknonikid. An nunmaked-mor-yoid be anga ungenonikid, weligwaled-mor be anga yononikid.
Bab-Dummad, degisoggu, an bega namaked, be-nug-odummoged bar an galegosulid, Bab-Dummad-Jehová, degisadegu, an bega dog-nuedye sogdii guoed.

Bab-Jehová, an begi bensulid. Mer bingeguega be an-imake. ¡Be-igar-innikigwadgi, be an-bendake!
Bab-Jehováʼye, be an-itoge, gwae be an-bendakdage. ¡Be an-akwasaila-gandikidyob gued, be an-abonoged-gandikidyob gued!
Bab-Jehová, be an-akwasaila-gandikid-dukuedid, an-abonoged-neggandikidid. Degisoggu, be-nug-sabed-ular, be an-idue, be an-nide.
Bab-Jehováʼye, an-isdarmaladi emar-yamoged-igar-an-idu-mesismaladgi be an-ollor-imake, ar bedi an-dukuedid.
Bab-Dummad, be-argangi an-san-burba an uksun. Bab-Dummad-Jehová-napiragwad, bee be an-abonosad.
Dule-ibmar-babyob-imakleged-e-nug-odummodimalad an isdar-daked. Ar andi, Bab-Jehováʼgi bensulid.
Bab-Jehová, an be-sabguedgi yeer itoged, an egi wergubalid. Ar bedi an-ulubgi-naibi-itoged daksad, an-ulubgi-surbinsa-itoged be wisid.
Bab-Jehová an-isdarmaladga be an-uksasulid, be an-ollor-imaksad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, wile be an-dake, ar andi surbinsa-itoged. An wile-itogedba an-ibya mommoleded, an-abagan, an-ulub bela nunmaked.
An-naibi-itogedba bela an-abagan nollomakded, an bukib-binsaedbi birgamar onamaid. An-isgued-ular, an-gangued bela berguded, an-garmar bela nollomakded.
Bela an-isdarmaladga an ibmar-dodogedga gued, an-neg-dikarba-mamaid bur bule angi dodomalad. Dulemar-magar-an-dakmalad an-dakalile, an-dobguddamalad, ¡Dulemar igarba an-abingualile, angi gwakiddamalad!
Burgwisayobi dulemar bar angi binsasulid, nog-mamarisayobi an gunonikid.
Dulemar-bukidar emargi-gakansaar-sunmakmar an itoged. An bia naddibe, an dobee itoged. Ar dulemar angi-aibinega na atosmalad, an-oburgwedgi binsamalad.
Bab-Jehová, ar andi begi bensulid. Andi soged: “¡Be an-Bab-Dummadye.
An be-nugginbi gudiiye!” An-isdarmaladgi, an-balegindimaladgi, be an-ollor-imake.
Bab-Jehováʼye, angi be nued binsae, ¡Be-sabgued-dummad-nikadba be an-abonoge!
Bab-Jehováʼye, ar an bese gochasoggu, mer bingeguega be an-imake. Dule-isganamardi bingeguega be imake, gaya-bogidiki burgwarmalad-meged-galugi be mese.
Dule-gakansilimar-e-gaya bogidik be imake. Na san-dummarba-imakedba, dule-mesagwar-imakedba, dule-nuedgi ibmar-sabsur-sogdimalad.
