Bab-Jehová, be-sabgued ibiyobi dungue. Dule-be-nug-odummodimaladga, be-sabed be oyoged. Dulemar-wagab, dule-begi-bengusurmaladga, be-sabgued be oyoged.
Bab-Jehová, dule-nued dule-egi-isdar-binsaedgi, be-walik be odukued. Dule-nued dule-urwedginbi-sunmakmaladgi, bese-goled-neg-sunna-selegedgi be odukued.
Bab-Jehová-nug an odummosun. Ar sordamar neggwebur-ebiris an-oburgwega bukwagusmargu, e-sabgued-dummad anga oyosad.
An surbinsa-itogedba an sogde gusad: “Be-asabin bar be an-ogwisguosurye.” Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová, an bese gochagua, bedi an-wilesakwaa-gornaid itosad.
Bela-bemar-Bab-Jehováʼba-nanaid, Bab-Jehová-sabgumala. Bab-Jehová, dule-ega-galakudisurmalad na edarbed. Ar Bab-Jehová dule-na-san-dummarba-imakdimaladdi, sabsur-odurdaked.
Bela Bab-Jehováʼgi-bensurmalad gangumala, niga-ogannomala.
Bab-Jehová, dulega e-galagwensuli-gudigusad elisale, e-isgusad ega osulosale, Bab-Jehová egi nued binsanonidaed.
Bab-Jehová, dulega e-isgudigusad bar insasuli gunonikile, egi-isgued-naid ega osulononikile, Bab-Jehová egi nued binsanonidaed.
Bab-Jehováʼga, an-isgued an sogsulidbali, bane-bane an akigindiidbali, an-abagan galalemai guded.
Mutikidbali, ibginedbali, sabsur be an-imaked. Igi yorgi dutu dad-ibeler-abin dinguddae, deyobi, an na itoged.
Geb degi, an-isgued na bega barsognonikid, gwen an begi an-isgued odukussulid. Weyob an sogsad: “Emi, Bab-Jehováʼga an-isgued an barsogoye.” Agine, an-galagwensuli-gudigusad be elinonikid, an-isgudi-gudigusad be anga osulononikid.
A-ulale, dule-be-sogedba-nanadimaladi, suli-suli-itogedgi, bese gormalad. Boni-dummagan-ainialile, ese warmakosulid.
Bee be an-odukuedid, nega-bulegangi bee be an-edarbedid, bendakleged-igarmargi-namakega, be an-imaked.
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ani an be-odurdakoed, ani an bega sogoed, ibu-igarba be nanaoe, ani an bega binsaed ukoed, ani an begi nakuledii guoed.
Igi moli, degi, moli-uayasuid, ibmar-akusunna itodamala, deyob melle be dao. Ar wemardi, bese warmakmalaga, e-dukargi, dub-nasiklegergebed, e-gayagi, e-gaya-bargaed nasiklegergebed. Degisulile, bese warmakosurmalad.”
Dule-galagwensuli-nanadimaladi, ega gwage-nunmaked-dummad danikid. Dule Bab-Jehová-abdakakwaa-gudimaladdi, Bab-Jehová ise-wile dakoed.
Bemar, dule-innikidamaladi, be weligwar-itomarsun, Bab-Jehováʼgi be wergumarsun. Bemar, dule-gwage-nuegan-gumaladi, bela yeer-itogedgi namakmarsun.
Bemar, dule-ibmar-inniki-imakmalad, Bab-Jehováʼgi be wergumar. Dule-nuegan, Bab-Jehová-e-nug-odummomalar, yeer itoledaed.
Bab-Jehová-nug gar-arpa-ogoledba be odummomar, Bab-Jehová-nug gar-arpa-dub-giambe-nikadba (10) be odummomar.
Namaked-binid Bab-Jehováʼga be namakmar, Nue ega weligwaledgi gar be ogormar.
Ar Bab-Jehová-sunmaked, napiragwadid, bela na e-ibmar-imakedi, napiragwadbiid.
Bab-Jehová, igar-innikigwad, igar-napiragwad nue-sabed. Bab-Jehová-sabguedi, bela we-napneg-gasa naid.
Bab-Jehová na e-sunmakedginbi nibneg nasiksad, na e-bunnogedginbi bela niisgwamar nasiksad.
Bab-Dummadi demar-dummagan danar nasiksad, ibmar-sabolegedyobi demar danar urbisad.
Bela we-napneggi-bukmalad Bab-Jehová-nug ogannomar. Bela bemar-we-napneggi-bukmalad Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar.
Ar Bab-Jehová sunmaksagu, bela ibmar gunonikid. Bab-Dummad igar-ukdegu, bela deyob gunonikid.
Bab-Jehová, dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-igar-amimalad-ibe ei igar bisged. Dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-igar-amimalad-ibe ei igar obured.
Bab-Jehová-ibmar-imakbieddi, degisadegu mai guoed. Bab-Dummad-binsaed, degisadegu mai guoed.
Dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad Bab-Jehová e-Bab-Dummadga imakmaladi, we-dulemargi nued binsalesad. Bab-Jehová we-dulemar-egadga-imakegala na susad.
Bab-Jehová nibneg-akale atakmaid, Bab-Dummad bela dulemar-dakmaid.
Bab-Jehová na e-maidgi atakmaid, Bela we-napneggi-dule-bukmalad dakmaid.
Bab-Dummad bela dulemarga gwage nasiksad, degisoggu, ulubgi-be-binsanaid be-wisid.
Rey, na e-sordamar-ichesur-nikadba bendaklegosulid, dule-dutusulid, na e-gangued-nikadba wakinnosulid.
Moli, dutusur-inigwele, bila-onogedgi e-ganguedba geg-dule-bendaked.
Bab-Jehová dule-e-dobee-nanadimaladgi nue nakuledaed, dule-e-sabgued-edarbedimaladgi nue nakuledaed.
Bab-Jehová melle we-dulemar-burgwega bendakmaid, ukud-dummad-nagunonikile, we-dulemar-bendakmaid.
Bab-Jehová, anmar begi bensulidgi be-edarbebukwad. Bedi anmar-bendakedid. Bedi sigu-abgaedyob be anmar-irwa gwisgudiid, a-ulale, anmar begi bensulid.
Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad, begi anmar wergusunnad, ar ade, anmar be-nug-islidikidgi bengussulid.
Bab-Jehová, be-wile-anmar-daked, anmar begi edarbediid. Ar anmar begi bensulid.

An bane-bane Bab-Jehová-e-nug-odummodii an guoed, an ega namakdii guoed.
Bab-Jehováʼba an nug-dummarba itoged. Deyob dule-na-san-dummarba-imakdisurmalad itononimaloed, agi Bab-Jehováʼgi wergudmarmogoed.
Bemar an-balikwaa Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummomar, anmar bela danakwaa e-nug odummomar.
An Bab-Jehová-amidigua, an-abin-imaknonikid. An ibmar-dobgudiidgi, an-ollor-imaknonikid.
Dulemar Bab-Jehováʼse-idaksamaladi, egi gangunonimalad, bipisaale bingeguosurmalad.
Ani, an dule-wileged, an Bab-Jehováʼse-gochagu, an-itononikid, agine, bela bonigangi an-ollor-imaknonikid.
Bab-Jehová-e-baliwitur dule-e-nug-odummodiid-bendakegala, ese nonidaed.
Bemar-sunnagwad be dakdamala, Bab-Jehová-ibidar-nuedid be dakmala. Dule, Bab-Jehováʼgi-bensurgudiid, egi nued binsalediid.
Bemar Bab-Jehová-sordamar, Bab-Jehová-dobekwaa nanamar. Dule-Bab-Jehová-dobekwaa-nanadimaladi, ibmarsuli-gudii guosurmalad.
Dule-mani-ibmala, dule-wilegedga nadmaloed, ukud-itodii gudmaloed. Dule-Bab-Jehováʼgi-bensur-gudimaladdina, ibmarsuli-gudii guosurmalad.
Mimmigan, dagmala, an-itodamala: Bab-Jehová-dobekwaa-nanaedgi an be-odurdakmaloed.
Ar dule na wergudii gubiele, iba-nuegangi weligwar nanadii gubiele,
ibmar-isganagi-sunmaked na bargaergebed, gakansaar-sunmaked iegergebed.
Ibmar-isgana-imaked iegergebbalid, ibmar-nuedbi imakergebed. Neg-bogidikidbina gudiguergebed, neg-bogidik-imakdii gubalirgebed.
Bab-Jehová dule-inniki-gudimalad akwediid, wemar-ese-goled nue-itodaed.
Dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmaladgindina, egi yoleged. Bab-Jehová a-dulemargi yoleged, adi, we-napneggi mer bar egi binsalegegar.
Dule-inniki-gudimalad Bab-Jehováʼse-gotele, Bab-Jehová abin-imaked. Bab-Jehová bonigangi dule-inniki-gudimalad nue-bendaked.
Bab-Jehová dule-naibi-itodimaladba gudiid, dule-bukib-binsadimalad nue-bendakbalid.
Dule-inniki-gudiid, bonigan-bukidar nikued, degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehováʼdina, bela a-bonigangi ollor-imakoed.
We-dule-e-garmar akarguega imakosulid, gwen wargwensaale e-ibe-bibislegega imakosulid.
Dule-isganamar ibmar-isgana-imakdimaladba na dukin wioged. Ar dulemar dule-innikidamalad-isdardakdimaladi, odurdaklegedsemalad.
Bab-Jehová dule-ega-arbadimalad nue bendaked, Bab-Jehováʼgi-bengudisurmalad, sabsur-odurdaklegosurmalad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, angi-gwisgudimaladgi be gwichigue. Angi-bila-onodimaladgi be bila-onoge.
Bab-Jehová, be-sigu-abgaed-suid be sue, an-bendakega be dage.
An-balegindimalad-abin eswar be gae, akan be gae. Ani an be-abonogedye be anga soge.
An-oburgwebimalad, bingegumarsun, neg-aku-ito gumarsun. An-oakalobimalad, gannar sorsik namarsun, bingegus namarsun.
Amala, oros-e-uka burwa-abin-mileddaedyob gumarsun, Bab-Jehová-e-baliwitur amar-baleginne.
E-igar-nanaedi, ega negsichidyob gusun, e-igar-nanaedi, ega gware-gwareyob gusun. Bab-Jehová-e-baliwitur amar-baleginne.
Gwen an ibmar-oakalossuli, an-oburgwega, an-idu yaa akwismalad, an-idu saki nasiksamalad.
Boni egi ukiagwar yolesunna, na emar-yardakdiidgi, na dukin yardaklege. Na yaa-akwismaladgi, na dukin argwanmala.
Degidbali, Bab-Jehováʼgi an yeer itogoed, an e-abonogedgi weligwar itogoed.
Weyobi, binnasur an gotoed: “Bab-Jehováʼye, ¿doa beyobi, dule-nollogwad dule-dutusulidgi bendake? ¿Doa beyobi, dule-wileged dule-e-ibe-ibmar-suedgi bendake? ¿Doa beyobi, dule-ibmar-abediid, dule-e-ibe-ibmar-suedgi bendake? Dule beyobid sated.”
Dule-barsogmalad-isganamar angi gwisguarmalad, an-ibmar-wissulid anse egismalad.
Andi wemargi nueddaed, emardi, angi ichakwadamalad. Weyob-damalad ulubgi nunmak an-imaked.
Ar wemar uellemaigusgu, andi nue-bukib eba itodii gusad, andi wile-itoged-mor-yoi gudii gusad. Ulubgi-naibi-itogedba an mas guchasulid, an ega Babse-goled gwen bogigussulid.
An-ai-burgwisayobi, an-gargwenad-burgwisayobi, an bukib-itodii gusad. An-nan-burgwisayobi, an bodii gusad. An ulubgi-naibi-itogedba, an bukib-binsadii gusad.
An sabsur-wilesgu, emardi yeer-itosmalad, na atosmarbalid. Dule-isganamar aku-an-dakmaladyobi, angi aibinmalaga na atosmalad, an-san goa-goa imaknaidbi gusmalad.
Sabsur-an-imaknanai gusmalad, angi dodonanai gusmalad, isdar-an-dakmaladba anse uludmalad.
Bab-Jehová, ¿sanagwadse be we-dulemar yeerdakoe? Dulemar-an-gindakbiedgi be an-bendake, dulemar achumigur-nono-wawaadyob an-obelobiedgi be an-bendake.
Dulemar-bukidarad-abargi, an bega dog-nuedye sogoed. Dulemar-bukidarad-abargi, an be-nug odummogoed.
An-isdarmalad-angi-aibindimaladi, mer angi wergumala. Binsa-isdar-an-dakdimaladi, mer angi dodomala.
Ar wemar neg-bogidik-nasikedgi sunmaksurmalad, unnila dulemar-gwage-eikwaa-damaladgi gakansaar sunmakmalad.
Anga ise-allar allemalad, sogmalad: “¡Anmar-sunnad anmar e-isgusad daksamarye!”
¡Bab-Jehová, bela be daksad! ¡Mer be gayamaklege! ¡Mer be angi bangue!
An-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼye, anga igar-innikigwad-imakega be dage, an-arsogega be dage.
An-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼye, be-igar-innikigwadba be anga igar naboge. ¡We-dulemar mer angi dodomalaga be imake!
Mer weyob binsamalaga be imake: “¡Anmar weyopira dakbigusye!” Mer weyob sogmalaga be imake: “¡Anmar we-dule obelosye!”
An-sabsur-wilesadgi bela yeer-itodimaladi, bingegumala, neg-aku-itodii gumala. Dulemar angi bur san-dummarba-itodimaladi, bela-bela bingegumala, nug-bipii gumala.
Anba-nanaimalad, binnasur namakmar, wergumar. Sogdii gumarsun: “Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummolesunye, Bab-Jehová e-mai-gwage-bogidikid yeerdakye.”
Be-igar-innikigwadgi an sunmakoed, bane-bane an be-nug-odummodii gudoed.

Dule-Bab-Dummadgi-isgudiid weyob soged: “Isgudiid an yeer-itoged.” Bab-Dummad-dobe-nanaodeeye gwen binsasulid.
Dule-isgana e-nug-odummolegoye binsaed, e-isgued akudaklegoye binsaed. Bab-Dummad ega akar-sogosurye binsaed.
E-sunmaked, galagwensuli sunmaked, gakansaale sunmaked. Dule-binsaedsulidga naded, ibmar-nued-imaked ieded.
Megidele, isgued-imakedginbi binsamegisdaed. Igar-nued-imakedgi gwen binsadasulid. Isguedgi bangugwelodeeye gwen binsadasulid.
Bab-Jehová, be-sabguedi bela nibnegse warmaked, be-innikidaedi, bela mogir-billise warmaked.
Be-igar-innikimaladi, yala-dummagan-gandik-bukwadyob gued. Muu-billi-wilasaila-naibayobi, be-igar-nabomalad mamaid. Bab-Jehová, bela be dulemar-akwemaid, bela be ibdurgan-bukwadi, akwemaibalid.
Bab-Dummad, ibibayobi bedi bela-belad wile dule-dakmai. Gannir e-mimmigan e-sakan-urba-odukueyob, dulemar begi bendakleged amied.
Be-neggi ega be mas-obineba-ukmaidgi, nue immelebukwad, be-dii-nued-ariomaidgi nue-immelebukwa be imaked.
Ar beginbi, san-burba-geg-bergued danikid. Anmar unnila beginbi, san-burba-dula-gued amied.
Bab-Dummad, dule-beba-ibmar-imakdimaladi be wiledaksun. Dule-gwage-nuegan, be-igar-innikigwadba be bendaksun.
Dule-san-dummarba-imakdimaladi, melle an-ogalakuega be sao. Dule-isgudimaladse, melle galakuega be an-imako.
Nue be dakmar, dule-isgudimaladi, igarga gudasulid. Galakuddamalad, gege bar igarga gudamalad.
Dule-isganamar-nasgumaidba mer be sae itoge, Dule-isganamargi mer be nobgue.
Ar we-dulemar gaganyobi emiskwaa bergudmaloed, gagan-dinguddaedyobi emiskwaa surgudmaloed.
Bab-Jehováʼgi mer be bengu, ibmar-nuegan be imake. We-napneggi galakusuli be gudii guoed.
Bab-Jehováʼgi be nue-wergudii sae. Ar be ibmarbina-sogdiid, Bab-Dummad bega ukoed.
Be-ibmar-imakbied, Bab-Jehováʼga be uke. Mer be Bab-Jehováʼgi bengue, ar Bab-Jehová bega ibmar imakoed.
Igar-maidba be-ibmar-imakedi, Bab-Dummad bega dad-ibeleryob odalogoed. Deyobi dule bela magar daknonikoed, bede, dule-napiragwadid, bede, igar-maidba ibmar-imakedid.
Bab-Dummad-asabin bogidik-gudii be imake. E-bega-ibmar-imakedse edarbedii be sae. We-dule-ibmar-isgana-imaked nasgumai be dakele, mer be sae-itogo.
Be-isdar-itoged na be bargae, be-sae-itoged be iege. Melle be urwe, abakalegi be neg-oichoalile.
Ar dule-isganamar burgwemaloed. Dule-Bab-Jehováʼgi-ibmar-edarbedimaladdi, neg-nued-bonisulid ega uklegoed.
Dule-isganamar napi-ichee gudidimalad. Ar a-dulemardi be-amidigumaloen-inigwele, gwen be-amiosurmalad.
Ar dule-san-dummarba-imaksurmalad neg-nued-bonisulid egadga guoed, amala bela nue-nasgumaidbali, weligwar itomaloed.
Dule-isgana dule-nuedgi sunnasur binsadaed. Dule-isgana dule-nued-dakdele, bela-bela nue-sae dakdaed.
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehováʼdi dule-isganaga alloed, ar wisid, we-dulemar-bergued bato ese warmaksad.
Dule-isganamar, dule-wilegana-oburgwega, dule-nued-nanamalad-ogilogega, e-es-suid ononanaid, e-sigumar guagwar ebisbukwamalad.
Degi-inigwele, e-es-suid e-gwagegi yolegoed, e-warsimardi ei bibislegoed.
Dule-nued ibmar-ichee-nikale, dule-isgana-ibmar-bukidar-nikadba, bur nuedid.
Ar Bab-Jehová, we-dule-isganamar-e-gangued ei osulogoed. Dule-igar-inniki-imakmaladdi bendakoed.
Bab-Jehová, dule-inniki-nanadimalad-edarbediid. A-dulemarga ibmar-uklegoedi, degisadegu egadga guoed.
Dule-inniki-nanadimaladga ibagan-bulegan-noni-sogele, akar-guosulid. Ukud-dummad nagunonikile, mas-nika guoed.
Dule-isganamardi, bergudmaloed. Bab-Jehová-isdarmaladdi, gagan-burgweyobi burgwidmarmogoed. Waayob bergudmaloed.
Dule-isganamar aimargi mani-gasale, bar bennukdasulid. Dule-nueddi dule-wiledakedba aimarga ibmar ukdedaed.
Dulemar Bab-Jehováʼse-nabir-binsalesmaladi, neg-nued egadga guoed. Dulemar Bab-Jehováʼse-ukabsalesmaladdi, girgumaloed.
Dule-wargwen e-daedgi Bab-Jehová-yeer-ito imakele, Bab-Dummad we-dule-nued-nanadii imaked.
Dule-nued gwatirnoni-sogele, deyob degisadegu gudii guosulid, ar Bab-Jehová we-dule-bendakoed.
An sapingwa-danikid-akale, an seredgusadse, an dakdisulid, dule-nuedi nue-dummad-wiledii, e-mimmigan mas-egisdii an dakdisulid.
Dule-nuedi aimarga ibmar-ukalile, nuedgi yeer-itogedba ukdedaed. E-mimmigan ega ibnuedga gued.
Ibmar-isganagi be bangu, ibmar-nueganbi be imakdii gue. Ar deyob be imakele, Bab-Dummad bega-yar-ukoye-sogsadgi degisadegu be gudii guoed.
Ar Bab-Jehová igar-inniki-imakleged yeer dakdaed, dule-eba-nue-nanadiidgi, bangusulid, Bab-Jehová amar-nue-edarbedidaed. Dule-isganamardi, bergumaloed, gwen wagan-nikuosurmalad.
Dule-nuegan-damaladdi, Bab-Dummad ega yar-ukoye-sogsadgi degisadegu mai gumaloed.
Dule-nued sunmakdele, nue-binsaed-nikaa sunmakdedaed, Dule-nued sunmakdele, igar-inniki-maidba sunmakdedaed.
E-Bab-Dummad-igar-maid e-gwagegi sedidaed. A-ulale, isgusurdaed.
Dule-isgana dule-nued-oburgwega arbakee dule-nued-argadidaed,
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehováʼdi dule-isganaga dule-nued-urmakosulid. Dule-nuedga igar-itolear-sogele, egi isgusye-sogega imakosulid.
Bab-Jehová-abdakdii be gue, a-sogedba be nanadii gue. Bab-Jehová be-nug-odummogoed, neg-nued begadga-guegala, bega ukoed. Dule-isgana-bergumaloedi, be-sunnad be dakoed.
An dule-isgana daksad, urwar-sapi-dummad-neg-ganikidyob, na san dummarba imaked.
Degi-inigwele, we-dulemar emiskwaa bergudoed. We-dulemar bato sulibinne dakledagoed. Be amialile, be dakosurguoed.
Dule-nuegan-damalad be dake, dulemar igar-maidba-damalad be dake. We-dulemar-nueddamaladga igar-nued ega maid.
Ar dulemar igar-maidgi-yoledimaladdi, bela burgwemaloed, Dule-sunnasur-damaladdi, bela bergudmaloed.
Dule-nuegan-damalad-e-bendakleged Bab-Jehováʼgi danikid. Ibagan-suli-suli-itogedgi, Bab-Jehová dule-nuegan-bendakedga gued.
Bab-Jehová bonigangi dule-nued-bendakoed, ar Bab-Jehováʼgi bensuli-gudii gusad. Bab-Jehová dulemar-isganagi we-dule-onogoed, dulemar-isganagi bendakoed.

Bab-Jehováʼye, mer be anse urwe. Be sae-itogedgi, mer be sabsur an-imake.
Be sabsur-angi-uludedba an naibigunonikid, be angi sabsur-gwisgunonikid.
An-isgusad-ular, be anse uludedbali, an-san bar nuedsulid, an-garmar bar nuedsulid.
An-isgued bela an-nonogagas naid, ibmar-aidikidyob angi signonikid.
An binsaedsuli gudigusad-ulale, an-sanse-bakale, nunusar yapangusad, bela sibudik-sibudikgusad.
Nue-ibitos itoleged, bela-bela an oitolesad, nue-wiles itoleged.
Bela-bela an uedik itoged, an-san bela ibitosad.
Nue geggus itoleged, nunumakesar itolegusad. An gwage-nunmaked-dummad nue-itonaid.
Bab-Dummad, an-ibmar-abeged bela be wisid, an-ibmarbina-gudiid begi dukunaisulid.
An-gwage sabesur dik-dik-naid, an-niga argwated, nue an ataksurgusad.
An bonigan-nikadba, an-aimar, an-sordamar, angi bangudmalad. An-gwenadgan angi deyob bangudmarmogad.
An-oburgwebi-gudimaladi, an-yardakega angi arbananaid. An-oitomaloye-sogdimaladi, an-yardakega arbakee bane-bane igar-aminanaid.
Degi-inigwele, uayasuliyob an imaksad, yamo amar-itonaisuliyob an imaksad. Amar-abin an sunmaksasulid, wissur-sunmakeyob an imaksad.
Degisoggu, dule-uayasulidyob an gued, wissur-emar-abinsaedyob an gued.
Bab-Jehová, unnila an beginbi ibmar-edarbediid. An-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, bebi unnila wemar-abin-imakoed.
Unnila ibmar-soggwen an egised: An ailanonikile, mer anga allemalaga be imako, mer angi burgumalaga be sao.
Nue an galakue itoged, ibmar-nunmaked gwen-an-indakbisulid.
Degisoggu, an-isgusad an na barsogergebed, an isgusadba nue-wiles an itoged.
An-isdarmaladdina nue baligannosmalad, yogasaar-isdar-an-dakdimaladi nue mergusmalad.
An ibmar-nued-imaked-ular, dulemar angi yolenanaid. An ibmar-nued-imaked-ular, dulemar angi gwisgunanaid.
Bab-Jehováʼye, mer be an-barmete, an-Bab-Dummadye, mer be angi bangue.
Gwae be an-bendakdage, Bab-Dummad, be an-abonogedid.

An na dukin sogsad: “An itoakwaa nanadii imakoye, adi, an-sunmakedgi mer an isguegar. Ar dule-isgana an-asabin gwichile, andi ibmar-sogosulid.”
Degisoggu, an sunmaksasulid, ar ibmar-nuedse-bakale, bar an bissulid. Degi-inigwele, nunmakeddi anga ulubgi nasgumai gusad.
An-gwagedi uelleded. An we-ibmargi-binsasiidgi an isdar itoded, geb an sogdesunnad:
“Bab-Jehová, an-ibagan-berguoed be anga soge, birgabigwa an napi-dulagudiguoed be anga soge, adi, an sikwas-gudiguoed magar itogegar.
Bab-Jehová, wis-ichee-dulagudigued be anga uksad, an-birga-nikaddi be-asabinni birgamar-nassuliyob be daked. We gakansulid, bela-dulemar-gudidiid sikwas-bunnogedyob gudidimalad.
”Ar napiragwad, anmar we-napneggi unnila sikwas gudimalad. Dule binsarsunna sulibinsa itodiid. Ar binsa na ibmar-nuegan saboged, ar wissulid, doa we-ibmar sunonikoe.
”Bab-Jehováʼye, degisoggu, ¿bia an bendakleged amiosunna? Unnila an beginbi bendakleged amied.
Bab-Jehováʼye, bela an-isguedgi be an-ollorsae, mer dule-binsaed-nikasurmalad angi-dodomalaga be imake.
”An bar sunmaksasulid, an bar ibmar-sogsasulid, ar bee be deyob ibmar imaked.
”Bab-Jehováʼye, mer bar be sabsur-an-odurdake, ar be an-oburgwednaga an-imaknaid.
Be dule-isgued-sabsur-odurdakedba dule-nudaked, na bur e-ibmar-binasoged uduyob be e-ibe obeloged. We gakansulid, bela-dulemar-gudidiid, sikwas-bunnogedyob gudidimalad.
”Bab-Jehováʼye, an bese-goled be itoge, an bega-ibmar-soged be itoge, an-boed mer be itosuli gue. Andi bega dule-ainebalid gued, bela an-dadgan-nanadigusadyobi an yar-obak-obak gudiid.
Mer isdar be an-dake. An we-napneggi-naed-iduar, an gannar weligwar itogoed.”

Ulubgi-abitoakwaa, Bab-Jehová-abdakdii an gusad. Ansik aibilisad, an ese-goledi, magar an-itosad.
San-burba-bergued-galu-yagi an-onosad, nega-matagangi an-onosad. Akwasaila-birgi an-ogwisgusad, nega-nuedgi an-ogwisgusad.
Bab-Jehová an-gwabindukugi namaked-gwapid nasiksad, e-nug-ogannoedgi-namakega an-imaksad. Deyob an-dakarmargua, bukidar dobe itodmalad, Bab-Jehováʼgi bensuli gudmalad.
Dule, Bab-Jehováʼgi-bensuliguedi, Bab-Jehová egi nued binsadiid. Dule, san-dummarba-samalad-barwisodisulidi, bab-dummad-baidse-gormalad-barwisodisulidi, Bab-Jehová egi nued binsadiid.
An-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼye, ibibayobi ibmar-dakledisurmaladi be imaksa. Ibibayobi be anmargi nued binsasa. ¡Dule beyobid sulid! Aisaar an bega bela be-ibmar-imaksad sogbienad. Igi an bega sogergebele, ar gege bela bega sogleged.
Bega-ibdula-uklemalad gwen be abessulid, bega-ibmar-gwag-gullemalad-ukleged gwen be abessurbalid. Unnila beba-ibsaega be an-imaksad. Bega-ibdula-ogumakar-uklegedi, isgued-eliega ibdula-uklegedi, gwen be egichissulid.
A-ulale, an sogdesunnad: “Bab-Dummad, be-gardagi angi-narmakar-maiyob an danisun.
Bab-Dummad, an be-sogedba ibmar-imakedi ibiyobi an yeer-itodae. Be-Igar-Mesisadi an-gwage-ulubgi an sediid.”
Dule-bukidarmalad-abargi an be-igar-napiragwadgi sunmakdiid. Bab-Jehová, bedi nue an-wisid be-igarba-sunmakedi an gwen boggudisulid.
Be-igar-napiragwadi dulemarga an gwen odukudisulid. Be-innikidaedgi, be-abonoleged-igargi, an obinmakdiid. Bipisaale, dule-bukidarmalad-abargi be-sabguedi, be-igar-napiragwadi, an gwen odukudisulid.
Bab-Jehováʼye, melle be-sabguedi be angi obano. Be nue-an-sabedgi, be-igar-napiragwadba, be an-sedii guo.
Isguedi bukidar an-ebiris naid, isgued bukidarsoggu, gege na bega bela bied. Isgued angi dar nue obined, an akusunna-itogusad. Isgued an-sailagiaganba bur bule mergued, bar-gannarbaa an itosurgusad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, we-isguedgi wis be an-onodage. Bab-Dummadye, gwae be an-bendakdage.
Dule-an-obelobimaladi be obingegsae, akusunna ibmar-itogega be imake. Dule-an-oichobigudimaladi, binged-abargi duurmakemai be sae.
Dule-an-wagar-daksuli an-dikarba-sunmakdimaladi, bingedar-itogwichi be imake.
Dule-be-amidimaladi, begi wergumarsun, begi yeer-itomarsun. Dule-abonoleged-igarbina-nue-sogdimaladi, weyob sogdii gumarsun: “¡Ibiyobi Bab-Jehováʼdi dule-gandikid guye!”
Bab-Jehováʼye, melle be an-iego, andi dule-wilesa gudiid, ibmar-abesa garmakdiid. Bab-Dummad, bee be an-bendakedid, igar-bulegangi bee be an-onogedid. Bab-Dummadye, melle be undar-yogguo.

Dule, dule-wileged-bendakedgi binsaele, Bab-Jehová, a-dulegi nued-binsaed. Ar ade, ibagan-isgana ega nagunonikile, Bab-Jehová we-dule-bendakoed.
Bab-Jehová we-dule-edarboed, we-napneggi dula-gudii imakoed, we-napneggi we-dulegi nued-binsalegoed. E-isdarmaladga we-dule-urmakosulid.
We-dule nailikgumaile, Bab-Jehová bendakoed. Bab-Jehová we-dulega nailikgued osulogoed.
Bab-Dummadga, an sogsad: Bab-Jehováʼye, wile be an-dake. Ar an begi nos-inigwele, an-nailikgumaid be anga osuloge.
An-isdarmalad angi isdar sunmakmalad, sogmalad: “¿Wede sana burgoe? ¿Wede sana berguoe?”
Anse atakdanimalale, gakansaar anga sunmakmalad. Geb nadmalogua, angi sunmakdedamalad.
Dule-isdar-an-dakmalad danar ambikunonimalogu, angi urwebukdamalad. Angi isdar binsabukdamalad, sogbukdamalad:
“We-dule-nailikgumaidi gwisguosulid, burgoed. Boni-dummad egi naid.”
Ar an-ai-nued-anba-masgundiid, an-egi-bensur-gudiid, a-bela angi aibitemogad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, wile be an-dake. An-nailikgumaidi, be anga nudake, adi, an-isdarmaladgi an gwisguegar.
An-isdarmalad-angi-nakosulidba an magar dakoed, yeer-ito an be-imaksad.
Bab-Dummad, an isgussulidba, be an-ogannodii guoed, be-asabin-gudigu be an-imakoed.
¡Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, be-nug odummolesun! Birga-birgaba degisadegu be-nug odummoledii gusun. ¡Deyob gusunno!

Bab-Dummad, igi goe-bebe-nikad diibina ogormakdidae, an deyob bebina sogdiid.
Bab-Dummadbina an nue-soged, Bab-Dummad-san-burba-ukmaidbina an nue-soged. ¿Ar sana Bab-Dummad-asabin an gwisgunonikoe?
Bane-bane an bodiid, ar an-boed an-masgunnedga anga gunonikid. An-isdarmalad bane-bane anga sogdimalad: “Emisgindi, ¿bia be-Bab-Dummadde nade?”
An ebinsaddaed, igi an dulemar-abalagi an nadapdae, igi an Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse dulemar-semaidae. An ebinsaddaed, iba-dummad-onolealile, weligwaledgi an dulemar-semaidae, bela-belad namakagwale an nadapdamalad. An we-ibmar ebinsadele, naibid-dummad angi nonidaed.
¿Ibiga an suli-suli-itogoe? ¿Ibiga an bukib-itogoe? ¡Gwen an deyob itogewilubsulinad! Bab-Dummad-abitodii an guoed, Bab-Dummad-e-nug-odummodii amba an guoed. Ar Bab-Dummad, an-abonogedid. Bab-Jehová, an-Bab-Dummadid.
Bab-Dummadye, nue an suli-suli-itoged. A-ulale, an begi Jordán-diwar-akale binsadiid, Hermón-yar-dummagan-akale, an begi binsadiid, Mizar-yalagan-akale, an begi binsadiid.
Igi ibe-sailagi diwar-dummad-aryomaidae, dii sukamakmaidae, sabsur uurmakmaidae, deyobi, wile-itolegedi be angi-gwisguega imaksad.
Bab-Dummad, an bese weyob goled: Bitigi be-sabgued be anga ibginedba oyogena gadin, neg-mutikidba an-bega-namakeddi berguosulid.
Bab-Dummadga an sogoed: “Be an-Bab-Dummadid, be an-bendakdiidid. ¿Ibiga be an-ies-gudii? ¿Ibiga wilesakwaa an-isdarmalad-nukad an itodii guoe?”
An-isdarmalad-angi-allenanaid, nue-nunmak an-imaked, bela-bela ulubse an-ebuged. An-isdarmalad weyob anga sokardamalad: “¿Bia be-Bab-Dummadde nade?”
¿Ibiga an suli-suli-itogoe? ¿Ibiga an bukib-itogoe? ¡Gwen an deyob itogewilubsulinad! Bab-Dummad-abitodii, an guoed, Bab-Dummad-e-nug-odummodii amba an guoed. Ar Bab-Dummad, an-abonogedid. Bab-Jehová, an-Bab-Dummadid.
Bab-Dummad, anga be igar-naboge, dule-beba-naisurmalad-abin be an-idu gwisgue, dule-isganamargi, dule-gakansilimargi be an-ollorsae.
Bedi an-Bab-Dummadid, be an-ganguedid. ¿Ar ibiga be an-obacha? ¿Ar ibiga an-isdarad an-sabsur-imaked-ular, an wile-itodioe?
Be-magar-ito-ibmar-imakedi, be-igar-napiragwadi, be anga udage. Adi, igar-nuedba an-idugega, be-yar-islidikidse an-nidega, be-maidse an-sedegar.
Bab-Dummad, be-ibmar-ukleged-ailase an warmakoed. Agi, an gar-arpaʼba bega namakoed. Ar be, an-Bab-Dummadid, weligwar be an-imakedid.
¿Ibiga an suli-suli-itogoe? ¿Ibiga an bukib-itogoe? ¡Gwen an deyob itogewilubsulinad! Bab-Dummad-abitodii an guoed, Bab-Dummad-e-nug-odummodii amba an guoed. Ar Bab-Dummad, an-abonogedid. Bab-Dummad, an-Bab-Dummadid.

Bab-Dummad, epenne ibmar-dakledisurmalad be imaksadi, anmar-sunnagwad uayagwar itosad. Epenne-ibmar-gusadi, anmar-dadgan anmarga sogsad.
Be-sunnagwadi, dule-be-wissurmalad be onisad. A-muchubbi, anmar-dadgan be urbisad. Dule-be-wissurmaladi be sabsur-odurdaksad, anmar-dadgandi nasgumai be imaksad.
Dadgan gwen e-es-suidgine yar sussurmalad, gwen e-surgangine dulemargi obichasurmalad. Unnila be-ganguedgi, be-surgangi, be anmar-dadgan-bendaksad. Eba-be-gudigusadgi be amar-bendaksad. Ar bede, dadgan-nue-sabedbali, deyob imaksad.
Bebi unnila be an-Bab-Dummadid, bebi be, an-reyd. ¡Be-igar-ukedba dulemargi-nakwega be anmar-imaksad!
Be-ganguedgi anmar-isdarmaladgi anmar nakwisad. Be-nuggi anmargi-gwichigudimaladi anmar obelosad.
An-warsigi bendakleged an amiosulid, an-es-suid dulemargi-nakwega gwen an-imakosulid.
Be anmar-isdarmaladgi-nakwega be anmar-imaksad. Bebi, dule-anmargi-gwisgudimalad-obingegsaega be imaksad.
¡Bab-Dummad, anmar beginbi nug-dummarba-itodii gumaloed! ¡Anmar be-nug-odummodii gumaloed!
Emisgindi, be anmar-obachad, be anmar-obinge-imaksad. Bar be anmar-sorda-bila-onomaladba nanasurgusad.
Dule-isdarmalad-abin sikirmakega be anmar-imaksad. Dule-sae-anmar-dakdimalad, anmar-ibe ibmar-atur-imaksamalad.
Sibad-wawaadyob be anmar-oburgwega anmar-urmaksad. Dulamar-bamalad-imbagi be anmar-oaisakisad.
Be-dulamar mani-bipii be uksad, egi be ibmar-nued gwen-amissulid.
Dule-anmar-neg-dikarba-mamaid-abin, dule-gegegwaga be anmar-imaksad. Dulemarga anmar dodogedga guded, dulemarga anmar alledga guded.
Neggweburmar-oallega be anmar-imaksad. Anmar-dakalir, yamo-yamo anmarga guardamalad.
Bane-bane bingedar an itodigussunnad. An akusunna-itogedba bingeguarsunnad.
An-isdarmalad-buged-an-imakbi-gudimaladse, an-isdarmalad-sae-an-dakdimaladse, an-isdarmalad-an-dikarba-urwedimaladse, an bingedar-itoged.
Bela we-ibmar anmargi gusad. Degi-inigwele, anmar be-iessulid. Dadgan-Ebo-Be-Igar-Mesisadi anmar gwen-bichissulid.
Anmar bega uayasuli gussulid, be-Igargi anmar gwen bangussurbalid.
Ar bedi achusapur-bunnu-wawaad-e-gubya-yaba be an-balimetemalad, negasichidbi be anmar-idu nasiksad.
Bab-Dummad, ar anmar be-iesana, be-muchub anmar bab-dummad-baidse gochana,
¿ar be wisguosulin be insae? Ar bede bela ulubgi dulemar-binsaed mag-daked.
Be-ular, anmar bane-bane oburgwilediid. Sibad-wawaad-oburgwelegedyob anmar imaklediid.
¡Bab-Dummad, atake! ¡Mer gabe! ¡Gwisgue! Mer be anmargi bangudii gue.
¿Ibiga be anmar-idu dukue? ¿Ibiga be anmar-wilediid be iege? ¿Ibiga be anmar-sabsur-imaklediid be iege?
Anmar napa-nukuse yasulemamaigus-naed. Napayala baparmakdigusmalad.
Bab-Dummadye, be dage. Be anmar-bendakdage. Be-sabguedgi be anmar-bendakdasun.

An-ulubgi ibmar-nued sogbie an itoged. An reyga an-namaked-narmaksad soged. An-gwabin garda-suar-yeer-narmakeyobi gued.
Rey, be bur dulemar-baiganba yeerdakleged, be bur yeer-sunmaked, ar Bab-Dummad degisadegu begi ise-nued binsasad.
Rey, be-ganguedgi, be-yeerdaklegedgi, be-es-suid be-saderba be nasike.
Be-gangued-yeerdaklegedgi nakwemai be imake. Igar-napiragwadbina urwedii be sae. Dule-wileganaga ibmar-innikigwad-imakdii be gue. ¡Rey, be-ganguedgi ibmar-dummagan-imakdii be nanae!
Be-sigu-swiswidikmaladgi, be-isdarmalad-bese-galakudii be imake. A-sigumar, rey-e-isdarmalad-gwagegi yoledapoed.
Bab-Dummad, be-negsemaid degisadeguoed. Be-negsemaid, igar-maidba be imaked.
Igar-innikigwad-imaked be yeer-itodaed, ibmar-isganadi, be isdar-daked. A-ulale, Bab-Dummad-be-Bab-Dummadi, be-aimar-baiganba be-susad. Be-Bab-Dummad, ina-wawadikidgi be-wawamaksad, weligwar-ito be-imaksad.
Be-mola, we-ina-wawadikmaladbi yapanned: Mirraʼye-nugadbi, áloeʼye-nugadbi, canelaʼye-nugadbi yapanned. Reyneg-marfilʼgi-ise-nudakaled-akale, gar-bega-ogorlenaidi weligwar be-imaked.
Yagana-be-ebilidmaladi, reymar-sisgan nanaed. Be-ologana-argan-nuedsik rey-ome siid. We-rey-omede, Ofir-or-nuedgi ise-nudakar siid.
Bunagwa, an bega-ibmar-sogoedi, nue be an-itogo. Be-dulemar be iege, be-gwenadgangi mer be bar binsae.
Be-yeerdaklegedba rey nue-be-abeged. Rey be-dummadid, degisoggu, eba be ibsae.
Tiro-dorgan binsa-ibmar-uklemalad bega sedagoed. Dule-mani-ibgan ega-ibmar-nued-imakbi be-abemaloed.
Rey-e-sisgwa e-gabedyaba nue-nudakar maid. E-mor ber olobi dakleged.
E-mor-ise-nue-sobaled-yoi reyse seledoed. E-aimar-yagana e-sorba-nai nadapmaloed.
Weligwar itonadapmaloed, Rey-e-negse weligwaledgi dogdapmaloed.
Rey, be-masmala be-dadgan-negsemai-gusad-ganagi sigmaloed. Amar bela bemar-yala-semamai gumaloed.
An bega we-namaknaidgi, dulemar-be-iegega an imakosulid. Bela neggwebur-baiganginmalad be-ebinsadiguega an imakoed.

Bab-Dummad anmar-niga-ogannogedid. Bab-Dummad anmar-irwa-gwisguedid. Bab-Dummad wilubdaklegedgi, anmar-bendaked-sunsogedid.
Degisoggu, ar neg giglimakde-sogele, anmar dobguosulid. Yala-dummagan demar-wilagangi-dogdedibe, amba anmar dobguosulid.
Demar-dummagan-urwedbali, yala-dummagan giglimakdedibe, amba anmar dobguosulid.
Diwar-iirmakemaidi, weligwar Bab-Dummad-e-neggwebur imaked. Weligwar Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-e-neg-Islidikid imaked.
Bab-Dummad e-neggwebur-abargi gudiid, degisoggu, e-neggwebur akar-guosulid. Bab-Dummad, neg-oibosale, na e-neggwebur-bendakoed.
Bab-Dummad-sunmakdele, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad dobguddamalad, neggweburmar-bubukwad giglimakdedaed.
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad anmarba gudiid, Jacob-e-Bab-Dummad an-dukuedga gued.
¡Dagmala! Bab-Jehová-e-ibmar-imaksad be dakdamala. We-napneggi-ibmar-dakledisulid-imaksad be dakdamala.
Bab-Dummad we-napneg-ugakaase bela bila-onoleged obelosad. Warsimar bibisgisad, eswarmar bibisgisbalid, moli-urmar soogi ogumaksabalid.
“Boo be ambikumalo, magar be an-dakmalo, ani an Bab-Dummadid. Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad-abargi an-nug odummolegoed, we-napneggi an-nug odummolegoed.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad anmarba gudiid, Jacob-e-Bab-Dummad an-dukuedga gued.

¡Bela-dulamar, argan ogormala! ¡Weligwaledgi binnasuli Bab-Dummad-nug odummomala!
Ar Bab-Jehová-Bur-Birigined, dule-buledid, bela napneg-e-rey-dummadid.
Neggweburmargi-obinega anmar-imaksad, dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladgi-nakwega anmar-imaksad.
Bab-Jehová, anmarga we-yar susad, we-yar, Jacob-nug-dummarba-imakedid. Bab-Jehová na we-Jacob-wagan-sabgusadid.
Bab-Dummad dulemar-weligwar-oimakmalad-abargi, gar-trompeta-goled-abargi, e-ologanase nakwemai gusad.
¡Namakmala! Bab-Dummadga namakmala. ¡Namakmala! Anmar-reyga namakmala.
Ar Bab-Dummad bela napneg-e-reyd. ¡Ise-itoagwar namakmala!
Bab-Dummad dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-e-reyga maid, Bab-Dummad e-ologan-islidikidgi siid.
Dule-dummagan-neggwebur-dakmamaidi, Abraham-e-Bab-Dummad-e-dulamarbo onmaksamalad. Ar dule-dummagan-negdakmamaidi, Bab-Dummadgadid. ¡Bab-Dummad bela-bela odummoleged!

Bab-Jehová, duledar-dummadid. E-neggweburgi, e-yala-isligwaledgi, e-nug-birigined innikigwadba odummoleged maid.
Ibiyob Sión-yala yeerdaklege, bela napneg-naid weligwar imaked. Sión-yala, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik-siid, Bab-Dummad-e-neggweburga gued.
Bab-Dummadi, Sión-neg-suid-gandikmaladgi, dulemar-edarbedga gued.
Reymar na atosmalad, geb Jerusalénʼgi gwisguargusmalad.
Reymar a-neggwebur-dakargu, geger-dakarmalad, abin gwakidmalad, itosur-gwae duurmakdemalad.
Emargi bela-belad dobed nagusad, igi sior ugakgunair, e-boniba galitonaidae, debayobi, a-dulemargi dobed nagusad.
Dii-burwa-dummadba Tarsis-ulu-dummagan-aibinebayobi, dulemargi dobed nagusad.
Igi-anmar-sunnagwad uayagwar epenne na ibmar itosmala, emide, deyob Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-e-neggweburgi, anmar na ibyagwar daksamalad. Anmar-Bab-Dummad, na e-neggwebur, degisadegu-sii imakoed.
Bab-Dummad, anmar bese-goled-neggi, be-ise-wile-anmar-dakmaidgi binsabukwadamalad.
Bab-Dummad, bela napneg-ugakaase be-nug odummoleged. Be-nuggi nued sunmaklediid. Igar-innikigwadba be negsemaid.
Be-igar-innikii-imakedba Sión-yala yeer-itoged, Judá-neggwebur-burwigana weligwar itomarmogad.
Sión-yala be ebirnamalo, binnalee be namalo. E-neg-suigan-bukwad be ebismalo.
E-galu-matusurmalad nue be dakmalo, e-neg-gandikmalad nue be argamalo. Adi, yoo be-wagan-danikoedga be we-ibmar sogmalagar.
We-Bab-Dummadi, anmar-Bab-Dummad-degisadeguadid. Bab-Dummadi, anmar-idudii sadeguoed.

Bela bemar, nue an-itomar. Bela bemar, we-napneggi-bukmalad, nue be an-itomar.
Dule-dummagan, dule-binsarmalad, dule-mani-nikamalad, dule-wilegana, nue be an-itomar.
An sunmakoedi, nue-binsaed-nikaa an sunmakoed. An-ulubgi-binsaedi, nue-magar-itole an sogoed.
Ibmar-binsaed-nikaa-soglemalad nue-itoakwaa an sogoed. Gar-arpa-ogorsiidgi we-ibmar-soglegoed-e-obared an bega odulogoed.
Ar bonigan dani-sogele, ¿ibiga dobee an itogoe? Dule-isganamar an-ebilis ambikunonimalale, ¿ibiga an dobguoe?
Dule-mani-nikadba-dobsuli-itodimalad, na e-ibmar-nikadba san-dummarba-imakdimalad, ¿a-dulemarde an dobguode? Suli, an dobguosuli.
Dule wargwensaale na dukin bendakosulid. Na dukin burgwedgi san-onogegala, geg Bab-Dummad-bennuked.
San-onolegedi gargesailad. San-onolegegala, mani unniguarsulid.
Dule degisadegu dula-gudii guosulid. Dule burgosurdeeye sogsulid, burgwedsegad.
Bela dulemar burgwedbiid, dule-binsaed-ibedi, dule-binsaedsulidi, bela burgwedsemalad. E-ibmar-nikadi dulemar-baiganga beoed.
Ar nainu ichesur-nikus-inigwele, neg-uangi degisadegu mai guoed.
Ar dule mani-ibed-inigwele, degisadegu dula-gudiguodeeye sogsulid. Ibdurganyobi burgwemarmogoed.
Weyobi, dulemar e-manigi-alakwaa-gudimaladi, berguddamalad. Na dukin san-dummarba-imakmaladi, weyobi, berguddamarmogad.
Igi sibad-iduged e-sibad-wawaad-semaidae, deyobi, burgwed we-dulemar-semai gumogoed. E-neg-dummagan-nuegan-daklemaladgi, dikasuli e-mui neg-uangi nungumai guoed. Yoedsega dule-nuegan negsemamai gumaloed.
Ar Bab-Dummaddi burgwedgi an-ollorsaoed, Bab-Dummad eba an-sedoed.
Dule-wargwen mani-ibedga-gudele, mer bai be dako, e-neg yeerdakle nadele, mer geg be dako.
Ar we-dule burgwidele, na e-ibmar sedosulid, e-ibmar-yeerdaklemalad eba naosulid.
Ar we-napneggi dula-gudigua, weligwar itodigus-inigwele, dulemar e-nug-odummodigusmar-inigwele,
we-dule, e-babgan-burgwismogayobi, burgwemogoed, we-napneggi bar gudii guosulid.
Ar dule mani-ibed-inigwele, na aku itoged, ede ibdurgan-burgweyobi, burgwemogoed.
Bab-Jehová, Bab-Dummadbi-maidi, goled: Dulemar-dad-nakwedsik-bukmaladse goled, dulemar-dad-argwanedsik-bukmaladse, onmakega goled.
Bab-Dummad, Sión-neggwebur-yeerdaklegedba, dad-ibeler-gaeyob, e-maid oyomaid.
Anmar-Bab-Dummad-danikidi boo danisulid, e-iduale, soo-dummadi gadanikid, bela ibmar-ogumakdanikid. Burwa-oored bela Bab-Dummad-ebiris danikid.
Bab-Dummad nibnegse gochad, napnegse gochabalid, e-dulamarga-igar-nabolesokalid dakdamalagar. Bab-Dummad weyob soged:
“Anga dule-islidik-gudimalad onmakmalo, dulemar ibmar-ogumakar-uklegedgi anbo-igar-mesismalad, anga onmakmalo.”
Nibneg soged: Bab-Dummad dulega igar-naboged-innikigwad maiye.
“Israel-dulemar, an-itomala, an-sunmaksokalid nue-itomala. An-dulamar, an begi sunmaksokalid: Ani an be-Bab-Dummadid, unnila, anbi Bab-Dummad maid.
Bemar anga ibmar-ogumakar-ukdamaladgi an yolesulid. Bemar anga gusgu ibmar-nued-ukdamaladgi an yolesulid.
Be-moli-bebe-nikad-sapingana e-galugi-bukwadbina an sogsulid. Be-sibad-machergan e-galugi-bukwadbina an sogsulid.
Ar bela ibmar-durgan-sapurba-bukwad, angadbiid, bela molimar-yalaganba-bukwad, angadbiid.
Bela nuumar-sapurba-bukwad angi yoggusisulid, bela ibmar-durgan-yalaganba-gudinanaed, angadbiid.
Degisoggu, an mas-gunbiele, an bese gochasuliled. Ar bela we-napneg, angadbiid, bela ibmar-we-napneggi-bukwad, angadbiid.
¿Ar moli-bebe-nikad-e-san-gunnedgi an gudisi? ¿Ar sibad-machered-e-ablis-gobedgi an gudisi?
Anga weligwaledgi dog-nuedye be sogdage. Anga, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Biriginedga be ibmar-imakoye-sogsad, be imakdage.
Bonigan-abalagi be gunaidgi, anse be gole, an be-bendaknonikoed. Bedi be an-nug-odummogoed.”
Bab-Dummad dule-isganagardina, weyob soged: “¿Doa bega soge, An-Igar-Maid be absogoye? ¿Doa bega soge, An-Igar-Maidgi be sunmakoye?
Ar be durdakleged-igar abesulid. An-gayaburba be isdarsun-daked.
Ar be atursamalad-dakardibe, eba be naddaed, dule-gambasamalad nabir be daked.
Be-gayadina ibmar-isganagi sulibinsa sunmaked, be-gwabindukudina, unnila, gakansaedginbi sunmaked.
Ar be-gwenadgi gusgu be yolegar sunmaked, amba be-gargwenadgine be gakansabalid.
Bela be we-ibmar-imaksadba, an bese gochasulid. Ande beyobye, ¿be binsasunde? Emisgindi, an bese urwoed. Bega an bakar ibmar sogoed.
Bemar an-ieddamalad, an bega ibmar-sogsad nue egi be binsamalo. Degisulile, anse be ibitomaloed, dule-wargwensaale be-bendakosurmalad.
Dule anga dog-nuedye-sogega, ibmar-nued-ukedi, an-nug odummoged. Dule na e-daed ogwaele, an ega abonoleged-igar oyononikoed.”


Bab-Dummadye, be dule-wiledakedba, be wile-an-dake. Be bela-bela-dule-sabedba, an-isgued be anga elie.
Bela an-ibmar-isgana-imaksad be anga obeloge. Bela an-isgued be anga osuloge.
An ibmar-noar-imaksadi an magar itoged, an-isgusad an nue wisid.
Bab-Jehová, beginbi, unnila beginbi an isgusad. Be-asabin an ibmar-isgana imaksad. Agala, be-igar-nabogedgi be-igar-mesedi innikigwadid. Be-igar-naboged dule geg egi akarsoged.
An gwalulesad-akale, an dule-isgana gued, an sapibeneggi-maigusad-akale, bato an dule-isguedid.
An nue-wisid, be dule-inniki-gudiid nue-sabed. Burbale, nue-binsaed-nikadaed be an-odurdaksad.
An swilidik-guega, hisopo-gagangi be an-nudake. An boo-sibudikidba bur bule sipuu guega, swilidik be an-imake.
Weligwar be an-imake, yeer-ito be an-imake, be an-san-sabsur-odurdaksad gannar yeer-itoge be imake.
An-isgued mer be bar ebinsae, an-ibmar-isgana-imaksad bela be osuloge.
Bab-Dummadye, gwage-swilidikid be anga nasike. Burba-swilidikid be anga uke.
An be-walik-gudiidgi mer be an-ononnoge. Be-Burba-Isligwaled mer be angi obane.
Be-abonolegedgi-weligwar-itolegedi, gannar be anga udage. Uaya-nikadae be an-imake.
Geb deyobi, be-igar-maidgi-yoledimalad an be-igargi odurdakoed, geb dule-isgudimalad gannar bese nonimaloed.
An-Bab-Dummad-an-abonogedye, an dule-ibe-ablis-eosadgi be an-ollorsae, adi, an be-igar-innikigwadgi namakdii guegar.
Bab-Dummadye, an be-nug odummogega, ibmar-biega be an-imake.
Ibmar-ukleged an bega-ukele, be yeerdakosulid. Ibmar-durgan-ogumakar-ukleged an bega-ukele, be abingaosulid.
Ar begardi, dule-na-e-isguedga-wile-itogedi, ibmar-uklegedba bur-nued gued. Bab-Dummad, dule-na-e-isguedga-bukib-itogedi, bedi isdar daksulid.
Be-nued-binsaedbali, Sión-neggwebur-nasgumai be imake. A-Jerusalén-neggwebur-e-galu-dummagan be gannar ogwiche.
Geb be-igar-mesisadba-ibmar-bega-ukleged be abingaoed. Ibdurgan-bela-gwagwar-ogumakar-bega-uklegedi be yeer dakoed. Geb moli-bebe-nikad-sapingan bega-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi ukledoed.


Be, na-san-buled-imaked, ¿ibiga be-isguedgi be san-dummarbaa imake? ¡Bab-Dummaddi dule-sabgumaiguad!
Be-gwabin-duku, esbipi-nugar-datarmakaledyobid, emar-obelogedginbi binsaed, gakanginbi sunmaked.
Igar-nuedba bur bule, igar-isganabina be soged. Igar-nabiridba bur bule, gakansaedbina be itoged.
Gakansaed-gwabin-duku be sediid. Be-sunmakedgi emargi-urwed be yeer itodaed.
Bab-Dummaddi, ilagwen-be-obelogar imakoed. Be-negyaurgi be-onogoed, we-napneggi be-obelogoed.
Dule-nuegan, we-ibmar dakmaloed, nue-dobee itodmaloed. Weyob be-annik dodoakwaa sunmakdemaloed:
“We-dule-isgana, Bab-Dummadgi-bendakleged-amissulid, be dakmala. Unnila ibmar-nue-nikadba na yeer itosad, e-ibmar-isgana-imakedgi gwen bangussulid.”
Andi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi olivo-sapi-durbamakar-daedyob gued. Andi, degisadegu, Bab-Dummad-e-sabguedgi bensulid.
Bab-Dummad, andi be-ibmar-imaksadba be-nug-odummodii guoed. Bede dar dule-nuedsoggu, begine an bensuli gudioed. Dule-nuegan-abargi an bese gordii guoed.

Dule-binsaedsulidaed, e-gwagegi sogdiid: “Bab-Dummad maisurye.” We-dulemar nue-isgusgudidimalad, unnila ibmar-isganabi imakdidimalad. ¡Bipisaale dule ibmar-nued-imaked sated!
Bab-Dummad, nibneg-akale dulemar-napneggi-bukmalad dakded, abakalegi, dule-wargwen binsaed-nikadaed gudiile, abakalegi, wis dule-wargwensaar Bab-Dummad-amibied gudiile.
Bab-Dummad dakalid, bela dulemar egi bangus gudidimala, bela nue-isgus gudidimala. Wargwensaale ibmar-nued-imaked suli, bipisaale wargwengiid ibmar-nued-imaked, sate.
Dule-ibmar-isgana-imakdimalad akusunna itomalad, amarde, madu-gunneyob an-dulamar-imakdimalad, Bab-Dummadse gordisurmarbalid.
Dule-isganamar dobguewilubsurmalanad, degite, bela-bela dobedba wawanmakdemaloed. Bab-Dummad we-dulemar-obachadbali, be-isdarmalad-e-garmar oaisakioed. Bab-Dummad dule-isgana obingesaoed.
Bitigi Israel-neggwebur-bendakleged Sión-yar-akar danikina gadin. Bab-Dummad na e-dulamar gannar e-yarse senonikile, Jacob-e-wagan wergudmaloed, Israel-dulemar weligwar itodmaloed.


Bab-Dummadye, be an-bendake, be-nug-dummarba-maidba be an-bendakdage. Be-ganguedgi be an-bendakdage.
Bab-Dummadye, an-gornaid be an-itoge, an bega-ibmar-sognaid wis be an-itoge.
Ar dule-galagwensurdamaladi, angi gwisgunanaid. Ar dule-sabesulidamaladi, an-oburgwega anbina gudimalad. Ar we-dulemar, bipisaagwar begi binsadisurmalad.
Bab-Dummadbi unnila an-bendakedid, Bab-Dummadbi unnila an-sediid.
Bab-Dummad an-isdarmaladgi bonigan-yolegega imakoed. Bab-Dummadye be inniki-ibmar-imakmaidba, bela be an-isdarmalad oburgwe.
Bab-Dummad, an bebina-sogedba ibmar-nued an bega ukoed. Bab-Jehová, an be-nug odummogoed, ar deyob-imaked ibnuedid.
Bab-Dummad, bela bonigangine be an-ollor-imaksad. An-isdarmalad-galakued-dakega be an-imaksabalid.

Bab-Dummadye, an bese-goled be an-itoge, an bese-wilenaid mer be an-itosuli gue.
Be an-itoge, be an-abin-imake. Ar an-surbinsa-itogedi, anga gwage-bogidikid uksulid.
Dule-isdarmalad-sabsur-ibmar-soged an dobe itoged, dule-isganamar-e-sabsur-dule-imaked wile-ito an-imaked, ar gakansaar angi sunmakmalad, nue-urwedgi an-baleginmalad.
Ulubgi gwage nunmak an itoged, angi bela-bela dobe-burgwed nagunonikid.
Dobedbali an wawanmakgwichid, bela-bela an dobe itoged.
Geb an-sogsad: “¡Nuuyobi an sakan-nikana gadin! Adi, an gukusaled. Obunnoged-neg an aminadeled.
An wegine dikasur wakiteled, nega-dulesulidgangi an megisaled.
”Burwa-dummad-idu-wakinnega, dukued-negse an gwae wakiteled.”
Bab-Dummadye, we-dulemar be obeloge, e-sunmakmalad aku-ito be imake. Ar unnila neggweburgine sabsur-imakmaladbi, abin-abin-imakmaladbi an daked.
Mutiki, ibgine, e-galu-matusulid-ebirdii damalad, e-galu-matusulid-yabali ibmar-isganabi, yamo-dulemar-yardakedbi neg naid.
E-galu-matusulidgindi dule-obelogedbi neg naid, e-igar-imbaganbardi dule-wiogedbi, dule-yardakedbi neg naid.
Ar an-isdarad an-obinge-imaksana, an na san bargasanad. Ar dule-isdar-an-daked mesagwar an-imaksana, an e-idu dukusanad.
Ar emigindi, bee be weyob an-imaksad. Be an-ai-nuedid. Be anyob dule gumogad. Be an-sordad, be an-ai-bur-walikagwadid.
Be nuedgi anbo-walikaa gudidaenad, ai-nuedgi be anbo Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi gudidaenad. Emigindi, bee be angi weyob yolesad.
Burgwed ukiagwar an-isdarmaladgi yolesunna, neg-uangi napa-yaba dula odelesunna, ar e-neg-yaurgi ibmar-isganabi nikad.
Ar andi Bab-Dummadse goloed, Bab-Jehová an-bendakoed.
Wakdaradba, yorukudba, mutikidba an surbinsa-itogedgi Bab-Dummadse goloed, edi an-itogoed.
Ar dulemar bukidar angi aibinmar-inigwele, Bab-Dummaddi bogidikidgi angi-bila-ononanaidgi an-onogoed.
Bab-Dummad-gusgu-dummadga-maiguad an-itogoed. Bab-Dummad an-isdarmalad ibgwensur-imakoed. Ar wemar na e-daed ogwasurmalad, gwen Bab-Dummad dobsurmarbalid.
Dule-isgana dule-ebo-nued-gudiidgi aibined, e-igar-mesisadgine annaed.
Na e-ibmar-sogedi ochii ibmar-nueganbi soged. E-gwagegindi bila-onogedginbi binsanaid. Na e-sunmakedi, innikii sunmak itolegenad. Degi-inigwele, esyobi dule-naibi-imaked.
Bab-Jehováʼga, be-bukib-binsaed be soge, na e be-bendakoed. Ar Bab-Dummad, dule-nued degisadegu-galakudii imakosulid.
Bab-Dummad, bedi dule-isganamar oburgoed, napa-gullu-yaa be barmetoed. Dule-ablis-eodimaladi, dule-emar-yardakdimaladi, undar-dikasur dula-gudii guosurmalad. Ar andi begi bensulid.

Bab-Dummadye, wile be an-dake, dulemar an-balegindii nanaed. Bane-bane sae-an-dakmaladi, an-wiodimalad.
Bane-bane an-isdarmaladi, an-balegindii nanaed. Dule-san-dummarba-imakdimaladi, bukidar angi gwisgudimalad.
An dobe-itoalile, begi an benguosulid.
Bab-Dummad, an begi bensulid, an be-gayaburba odummoged. Bab-Dummad, an begi bensulid, an dobe-itosulid. Degisoggu, ¿ar igi dule an-imakosunna? Dule akar an-imakosulid.
Bane-bane an-sunmaked oakaloddamalad, gusgu an-oakalogedgi binsadamalad.
Danakwaa ambikusdamalad, na dukusdamalad. An-oburgwed na yeer-itomalad. Yamo arbakee an-ibmar-imaked dakdimalad.
Bab-Dummad, we-dulemar be sabsur-odurdaksun. Melle begi wakinnega be imako.
An-bukib-binsadiid be nue-wisid. An-ibyanis-aryodiid be daksabalid ¿Ar we-ibmar be-gardagi narmakar maisursi?
An-bendakega na bese gotele, an-isdarmalad duurmakdoed. Ibmar-soggwen an wisid: Bab-Dummad, nue anba naid.
Bab-Dummad, an begi bensulid, be-gayaburba an odummoged. Bab-Jehová, an begi bensulid, be-gayaburba an odummoged.
Bab-Dummad, an begi bensulid, an dobe-itosulid. Degisoggu, ¿ar igi dule an-imakosunna? Dule akar an-imakosuli.
Bab-Dummad, an be-asabinni ibmar-saoye-an-sogsadi, angi siid. Ibmar-uklegedi, an bega ukoed.
Bab-Dummad, burgwedgi be an-ollorsasad. Igar-bulegangi be an ollor-imaksad. Adi, be-asabinni, neg-meegwadgi dula-nanadii guegar.

Bab-Dummadye, wile be an-dake, Bab-Dummadye, wile be an-dake, ar begi an bensulid. Igi gannir e-sakan-urba na e-mimmigan odukue, deyobi, bonigan-berguedse, be an-odukue.
Bab-Dummad-Bur-Biriginedse an binnasuli goled. We-Bab-Dummad angi nued binsamaidaed.
Bab-Dummad, dule-an-isdarad-an-baregindiidgi-an-bendakega, e-gangued, nibneg-akar anse oyogoed. Bab-Dummad e-sabgued, e-igar-napiragwad anga oyomaid.
Achumiguryobi, dulemar an-ebiris bukwamalad, dulemar an-obelobimalad. E-nugarmar, sigumaryobi, warsimaryobi, nanaed. E-gwabin, es-suid-datarmakaleyobi gued.
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Dummad, bedi nibneggi maid. Be-gangued-yeerdakleged bela we-napneg-gani naid.
An-iduar saki nasiksamalad. An-iduar yaa gwichamalad. Naibid-dummad anga uksamalad. Degi-inigwele, emar agi na dukin argwachamalad.
Bab-Dummad, bega namakmalad-namakega, an-gwage guagwar naid.
An wakudaryalaba gwisgudagoed. An atakalile, gar-arpa, gar-lira, an ogoloed.
Bab-Dummad, neggweburmar-baigan-abargi be-nug an odummogoed, dulemar-baigan-abargi bega an namakoed.
Ar be-sabgued dummarbasoggu, nibnegse warmaked. Be-ibmar-napira-soged nibnegse warmaked.
Bab-Dummad, bedi nibneggi maid. Be-gangued-yeerdakleged bela we-napneg-gani naid.

Bemar, dule-bulegan-negsedidimalad, ¿ar innikigwadba be negsemamai? ¿Ar innikigwadba be dulemarga igar-nabomamai? Suli.
Aka bemar na be-gwagegi, unnila ibmar-isgana-imakedgi binsadidimalad. Ar bemar, we-napneggi unnila sabsur-ibmar-isgana-imakdidimalad.
Dule-isganamar amba sapibeneggi-maid-akale, bato isgus danimalad. Dule-gakansilimar amba yoo-gwaluleged-akale, bato gakansaar sunmakmalad.
E-sunmaked boni-dummad sediid naibe-boni-nikadyobi gudiid.
Dule-naibe-gaed, naibega sunmaknaigusale, igi-we-naibe, yamo uayasulidaeyob na imake, deyobi, dule-isgana, uayasulidaedba ibmar-isgana imaked.
Bab-Dummad, dule-isgana-e-nugarmar be bibisge, achumigur-ibe e-nugarmar-ungeyob be imake, dule-isgana-e-gargangued be obeloge.
Igi dii napagi-mileder, yogguddae, deyob geg gumargina. E-warsi-dopee-imakdemalale, bitigi e-sigu geg bisgegina.
Igi gole-masi-masid baisursunna berguddae, dule-isgana deyob geg gumargina. Igi goe-burgwar-aidenonikid, gwen neg dakdasuli, deyob dule-isgana geg gumargina.
Igi gagan-ikobiid-dinnagana sabsur-gummakdedae, deyobi, dule-isganamar baisur-binsadiidgi gummakena gadin. Dule-isganamar dula-gudimaladgi, bitigi burwa-dummadba selemalana gadin.
Dule-inniki-gudiidi, dule-isgana-sabsur-odurdaklenai dakalile, weligwar itodoed. Dule-isganamar-e-ablisgi dii-dii annanai guoed.
Agine, dulemar sogdemaloed: “Napirado. Dule-inniki-gudimaladga ibmar-nued ega ukleged. Bab-Dummad nue-mai dakledo, ar we-napneggi bela dulemarga igar innikii nabomaid.”

Bab-Dummadye, an-isdarmaladgi be an-ollorsae, angi aibinmaladgi be an-bendake.
Dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmaladgi be an-ollorsae, dule-gindakmaladgi be an-bendake,
ar an-oburgwebimalad. Bab-Jehová, an nossulinad, an isgussurbalinad, degite, dule-isganamar angi-aibinmalaga na atosmalad.
An ibmar-isgana imaksasur-inigwele, degite, an-oburgwebimalad. Bab-Jehováʼye, be gwae-dage, be an-bendakdage. Be dake, igi an be-asabin gwichi.
Bab-Jehová, be, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Gangued-Nika-Maid. Be, Israel-e-Bab-Dummadid. Dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad-sabsur-odurdakega gwae be dage, dule-isgana-emargi-aibinmalad, mer be wiledake.
Dule-isganamar, mutikidbali achumar-urwedidaedyobi gannar nonidamalad, geb neggweburgi bipirmakdidamalad.
Yogasaar sunmakmalad, emargi yolegar sunmakmalad. An-itogosurmaladdeeye sogdedamalad.
Bab-Jehová, ar bedi we-dulemarga be alled, bela dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamaladgi be dodoged.
Ar be an-ganguedsoggu, an begi bensulid. Ar be an-odukuedid.
Be, Bab-Dummad-wile-an-daked an-iduoed. Bab-Dummad an-isdarmalad-galakued anga oyogoed.
An-dulemar mer a-dule-isganamar-iegega, mer ilagwen-obelogar be imako. Be, Bab-Jehová, sigu-abgaedyob an-irwa-gwisguedid. Be-ganguedgi be oaisakie, be-garganguedgi be irgwensur-imake.
Na e-ibmar-isgana-sogedba, e-sunmakedba, emar-ukabsaedba, e-gakansaedba, san-dummarba-imakdimaladba, na dukin yardaklemarsun.
Bab-Dummad, urwedgi be amar-obeloge, mer bar dulagudigumalaga be obeloge. Deyobi, bela Israel-yargine wisgumaloed, Bab-Dummad bela we-napneg-ugakaase, negdakmaiye.
Dule-isganamar, mutikidbali achumar-urwedidaedyobi gannar nonidamalad, geb neggweburgi bipirmakdidamalad.
Masgunned-amiega gaamakdidamalad, immelessurmalale, mutikidba urwedidamalad.
Bab-Dummad, ar andi be-ganguedgi an namakoed. Wakudaryalaba be-dula-wiledakedgi an namakoed, ar bedi an-bendakedid. An-surbinsa-itoged-ibagi bedi an-dukuedid.
Be, an-ganguedid, an bega namakoed, ar bedi, Bab-Dummad, an-dukuedid. Bab-Dummad, be an-sabedid.


Bab-Dummad, bedi anmarse ulusad, be anmar-obachad, be anmar-wiosad. ¡Bab-Dummadye, be anmar-bendakdage!
Napneg-naid yeer be ogiglimaksad, yeer napamar argas-nanaed. E-yaa-argasmaladi be nudake, ar binna-binna babatemaigusad.
Yeer-gangu be-dulamar be wilubdaksad, vino-gagbid-gobega be anmar-imaksad.
Dule-sigu-miemaladgi san-onogega, beba-inniki-nanadimaladgala, igar-inniki-maid be oyosad.
Be-dulamar-be-nue-sabedi, nabir bendaklegega, be-ganguedgi be anmar-bendake, be anmar-abinsae.
Bab-Dummad, be-neg-islidikidgi be weyob sogsad: “An Siquem-neggwebur-mimioedgi, weligwale an itoged. An Sucot-neba-naid-ilemakoedgi, weligwale an itoged.
Galaad, angadga gued, Manasés, angadga gued. Efraín, an-bormo-gurginga gued. Judá, an-gaapoledga gued.
Moab, an-argan-enukedga gued. Edomʼgi, an-sapat bikiin an metoed. Filistea-neggweburgi, gandikidba an gormakoed.”
¿Doa, neggwebur-gandikidse an-nidoe? ¿Doa anga, Edom-yalase-aibillemaid oyogoe?
Bab-Dummad, ¿bee be anmar-obachagussursi? Bab-Dummad, bar be anmarga sorda-bila-onomalad-bendakdisurgusad.
Dule-isdarmaladgi-nakwega be anmar-imake. Ar dulemar anmar-bendakele, anmar gwen igarga guosulid.
Bab-Dummad, anmar bebali unnila anmar-isdarmaladgi nakoed. Be anmarga, anmar-isdarmalad obelogoed.

Bab-Dummadye ise-gollar an bese-goled, wis be an-itoge, an bese-ibmar-egised, wis be an-itoge.
An-yargi yeer-bangu an gudiidba, surbinsa-an-itogedba, an bese goled. Akwasaila-matusulidse be an-sede.
Bab-Dummad, bee be an-odukuedid. Bee be, neg-gandikidyob an-isdarmaladgi be an-bendakedid.
Bab-Dummad, be-dordoneggi degisadegu an gudii gubied, be an-edarbedigu an be-abeged.
Bab-Dummad, an bega ibmar-imakoye-ise-sogar-sogsad be itosad. Be-nug-odummodimaladga-yar-be-uksadi, be anga uksamogad.
Rey-suiti-gudii-guega be imake. We-napneggi degisadegu-gudiguega be imake.
Be-sogedba negsemaigu be imake. Be-sabgued-nikadba, be-igar-napiragwadba, egi nakuledii be imake.
Weyob be-nuggi namakdii an guoed, ibmar-an-bega-imakoye-sogsad bane-bane an bega imakdii guoed.

Bab-Dummadginbi an neg-bogidik amied, Bab-Dummadgi an-bendakleged danikid.
Bab-Dummadbi anga akwasailaga gued, Bab-Dummadbi bela-bela-an-bendakedid. An egi dukued amied, agala, gege an galakued.
¿Ar sanadse bemar dule-gwensakgi yolenanai gumaloe? Galu-aimukudani-gwichiyobi, olaegala, egemaknanaiyobi, emide, bemar dule-gwensak imaknanaid.
Unnila a-dule-wiogega gunanaid, e-nug-dummarba-nikad-oichogega gunanaid. Surbinsa gakansaedbina itomalad, ar e-sunmakeddi ibmar-nuedbi sogmalad, e-gwagegindina, emar-ukabsaedginbi binsadimalad.
An-gwage Bab-Dummadginbi neg-bogidikid amied, Bab-Dummadginbi unnila an bensulid nikad.
Bab-Dummadbi anga akwasailaga gued, Bab-Dummadbi bela-bela-an-bendakedid. An egi dukued amied, agala, gege an galakued.
Bab-Dummad bela-bela-an-bendakedid, egi an wergudiid. Unnila Bab-Dummadgi an-gangued siid, an-odukuedbalid.
¡Unnila Bab-Dummadginbi be bensuli gumalo! ¡Bab-Dummad-asabin be nadele, bela be-boni-nikad ega be sogo! ¡Ar Bab-Dummad, anmar-akwediidid!
Dule-wilemalad baisursunna bergued, dule-mani-nikamalad baisursunna bergumogad. Ebogwad nibirgi oaidiksaele, amba ukugwaled.
Ibmar-isganagi-mani-amilegedgi melle be binsaed galemalo, ibmar-atursalegedgi mer be binsamala. Amba ibmar-nue-bukidar-bega-mergude be dakele, mer we-ibmarginbi be binsadii gumalo.
Bab-Dummad weyob-ilagwen-sunmaksagusadi, ilabo an itosgusad: Bab-Dummadgi gangued daniye.
Bab-Dummad, bede bela-bela emar-wile dakmaiye, bede dule-e-ibmar-imakedba, sogedba be naboye.

¡Bab-Dummad, be an-Bab-Dummadid! ¡Bolegoedba an be-amioed! An uku-uku-itogeyob an bebina soged, an-sana bela bebina soged. Ar igi dule nega-dulesulidganba dii-satedgi dii-amididae, deyobi, an be-amied.
Bab-Dummad, an be-gangued-yeerdakleged-dakega, bese-goled-neggi an be-dakbied.
Dula-gudiguedba be-sabgued bur-nuedid. A-ulale, an bega namakoed.
Dula-gudiidgi an be-nug odummodii guoed. An be-nug-odummogega an-argan an onakoed.
Mas-nued-immerba-guchayobi an yeer-itogoed. An yeer-itogedgi bega namakoed.
An megidele, an begi binsamaidaed, bela mutikidbali, an begi binsamaidaed.
Ar be an-bendaksad, deyobi, be-an-bendaksadgi an yeer-itoged.
Andi begi alakwaa naid, ar be-gargangued an-bendaked.
Ar dule-an-oburgwebimaladdi bergumaloed, nega-urbali argwanmaloed.
Es-suidgi oburgwilemaloed, achu-sapur-masga gumaloed.
Ar reydi, Bab-Dummadgi weligwar-itogoed. Dule Bab-Dummad-nuggi-ibmar-ise-sogar-soged weligwaledgi Baba-Dummadga namakmaloed. Ar dule-gakansilimardi gaya-maklemaloed.

Bab-Dummadye, an-ibmar-isdar-itogedi, an bega sognaidi, wis be itoge. Bab-Dummadye, be an-bendake, an-isdarmalad dobe an itodiid.
Dule-isganamar-anbina-itosgudimalad-idu, be an-odukue. Dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmaladgi, be an-onoge.
Es-suid-nugar-datarmakle-daebayobi e-gwabin-duku imakmalad. Igi sigu-milege, debayobi, e-gwabin-duku gayaburba-isganagan dulegi mied.
Dule-gwen-neg-oakalossulidgi, yamo arbakee gwichiguddamalad, wile-gwen-daksuli, dulegi aibitedamalad.
Dule-isganamar, na muchub-muchub e-igar-isganagi ogannobukwadamalad. Idu igar-amibukwadamalad, igi imakmalodibeye. Sogdedamarbalid: “¿Ar doa anmar-dakosunna?”
Dule-isganamar igar-isgana-nue-amibukwadamalad, sogdamalad: “Anmar igar-napiragwad amibukwamalad.” Dule-binsaedi ibiyobi, nue-akusunna itolege.
Bab-Dummaddi a-dulemargi e-sigu midoed. Wissuli-bukwadgi galedamaloed.
Dukin na e-gwabin-sunmakedgi sabsur-odurdaklemaloed. Doa deyob dakdagoe, egi dodoar sunmakdoed.
Bela dulemar-bukwadgi dobed nagunonikoed. Degidgine, Bab-Dummad-ibmar-dummagan-imaksadgi sunmakdemaloed. Agine, magar Bab-Dummad-ibmar-imaksadgi binsadmaloed.
Dule-nuegan, Bab-Jehováʼgi wergudmaloed, egi bensuli gudmaloed. Dule-gwage-nuegan yeer itodmaloed.

Bab-Dummad-Sión-yargi-maid, be-nug odummolesun. Ibmar-imakmaloye-sogsamalad bega imakmalargebed.
Bab-Dummad, dule-bese-goled be itodaed, degisoggu, bese bela dulemar nonimaloed.
Anmar-ibmar-isgana-imaked anmargi obined, degi-inigwele, anmar-isgued be anmarga osulodaed.
Dule-wargwen be susale, we-dulegi nued binsalesad. We-dule, be-neggi-gudiguega, bese be senonidaed.
Bab-Dummad, be anmar-Abonogedid. Ibmar-innikigwadba be anmar-abin-imakdaed. Dulemar we-napneg-naid-ugakaase-bukmaladi bela begi bensurmalad. Dule-demar-obakar-dikasur-bukmaladi begi bensurmarmogad.
Bab-Dummad, bee, be-ganguedgi yalamar be nasiksad, agi be-gangued be oyomaid.
Bee, muu-billi-uurmakmaid obogileged, muu-billi-welegan-uurmakmaid bogidik be imaked, dulemar-oimakbukwad be osuloged.
Degisoggu, dulemar dikasuli-bukmalad be-ibmar-dakledisulid-imaked dobdamarsunnad. Dulemar-dad-nakwedsik-bukmalad, dad-argwanedsik-bukmalad be weligwar-ito imaked.
Bee be, napa nue-akwed. Napagi gatik ibmar sanmakega egi be dii owied. Dian-dummad-Babagadi gege-dinguedi, bela ibmar-sanmakega imaked.
Napa-guremaladgi dii be owied, agi dii be osurmaked, diigi napa be odutumaked. Napagi ibmar sanmakega be imaked. Weyobi, be-dulamarga-be-mas-ukega, napa guakwaa be-dulamarga be nasiked.
Be birga-nued nasikmaid, be ibmar unniguar-nika imakmaid.
Nega-dulesulidgangi gaganmar aradikid, yar-mullugan ber weligwaled.
Nebagangi sibadmar, sibad-wawaadmar, obiryamakded, orosgi-dakleged agi nue naibalid. ¡Bela agine ibmar-durgan oimakded! ¡Bela namakedibimalad!
Bela-dule-we-napneggi-bukwamalad, weligwaledgi Bab-Dummad-e-nug odummomar.
E-nug-dummarbaadga namakmar, gandikidgi e-nug odummomar.
Bab-Dummadga sogmar: “¡Be-ibmar-imakedi, geger-dakleged! Be gandik-maisoggua, be-isdarmalad be-urbaligwa gudimalad.
Bela-dule-we-napneggi-bukwad be-nug odummomaloed, bega namakmaloed, be-nuggi namakmaloed.”
¡Dagmala! Bab-Dummad-ibmar-imaksad dakdamala. Anmarga-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-imaksad be dakdamala.
Bab-Dummad demar dinnaa imaksad, diwar dinnaa imaksabalid. Degidbali, dulemar neg-dinnagwadgi nabir-obaksamalad. Degisoggu, anmar Bab-Dummadgi wergumarsunna.
Bab-Dummad gargandikidba degisadegu negsemaid, bela-dule-gudimaladgi nakulediid. Dulemar-eba-dasurmalad, gwen-abin gwisguosurmalad.
Bela dulemar, Bab-Dummad-nug odummomarsun. Bab-Dummadga-namaklenaid, bela itomalaga imakmarsun.
Ar Bab-Dummad anmar-san bendaksad, mer-galakuega anmar-imaksad.
Bab-Dummad, bee be, anmar-wilubdaksad, mani-swilidik-imaklegeyob be anmar-imaksad,
sakigi-galegega be anmar-imaksad, nunmaked-dummad be anmargi ogwisnonikid.
Dulemar anmar-nonogi-annaega be imaksad, soo-buleganba-ibitogega be anmar-imaksad, dii-buleganba-ibitogega be anmar-imaksad. Emisgindi be, neg-nuedse anmar-ogwisgunonikid.
An bese-goled-negse ibmar-ogumakar-ukega an nonikoed, an bega ise-sogar ibmar-imakoye-sogsad-imakega an nonikoed.
An bonigan-abalagi-gunaidgi, an bega ise-sogar ibmar-imakoye sogsa gusad.
An bega ibmar-ogumakegala, we-ibdurgan-waladummagan ukoed: Sibad-wawaad-machergan, moli-bebe-nikad-machergan, sibad-machergan, an bega ukoed.
Bab-Dummad-dobekwaa-gudimalad, ¡dagmala! ¡Itodamala! Bela Bab-Dummad-anga-ibmar-imaksad, an bemarga sogoed.
Bela-belad gandikidbali Bab-Dummadse an gocha gusad, an e-nug-odummonai gusad.
Ar an-gwagegi an isdar binsasana, Bab-Jehová an-itossulinad.
Emidi, Bab-Dummad an-itononikid, an-wilesakwaa-gornaid itosad.
¡Bab-Dummad-e-nug odummolesun! An-ese-gornaid nue an-itosad, e-sabgued gwen angi obachasurgusad.

Bab-Dummadye, wile be anmar-dake, be anmargi nued-binsae, bela-bela be-sabgued be anmarga oyoge,
adi, we-napneggi be-igar wisgumalagar, bela dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad be-abonoged wisgumalagar.
Bab-Dummad, dulemar be-nug odummomala, bela dulemar be-nug odummomala.
Dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad wergumala, weligwaledgi namakmala. Bedi, dulemarga innikigwadgi igar naboged. Napneggi dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad-e-iduedga be gued.
Bab-Dummad, dulemar be-nug odummomala, bela dulemar be-nug odummomala.
Napneggi bela ibmar-durba sanmakoed, Bab-Dummad, anmar-Bab-Dummad, anmargi nued-binsaoed.
Bab-Dummad, be anmargi nued-binsaoed, bela we-napneggi-yarmar-nanaid-ugakaase Bab-Dummad-dobgumaloed.

Bab-Dummad, dakebinne. Be-isdarmalad bela be oaisakisun. Dule-be-isdardakdimalad bela be-idu be oduurmaksun.
Igi waa burwaba yogguddae, debayobi, Bab-Dummadi dule-isganamar-imakoed. Igi baka-gwallu soo-abin daluddae, debayobi, dule-isganamar Bab-Dummad-abin bergudoed.
Dule-innikidamaladdi weligwale itomaloed, Bab-Dummad-asabin yeer itomaloed, weligwaledbali oichomakdemaloed.
Bab-Dummadga be namakmar, E-nuggi-namaklegedgi be namakmar, mogir-billigangi-sii-nanaed-e-nug be odummomar, ¡Bab-Jehováʼgi wergumala! ¡E-asabin be namakmala!
Bab-Dummad-e-neg-islidikidgi-maidi, dulemar-sergan-sated-e-babad, ome-ei-sui-burgwismalad-e-bendakedid.
Bab-Dummad, dule-wilesakwaa-walagwen-gudimalad, neguya-nikuega imaked, dule-galesbukwamalad-onogedid. Dule Bab-Dummadba-ibsadisurmaladdi, napa-isganagi ambikuoed.
Bab-Dummad, be Israel-dulemar-abargi-noargua, nega-dulesulidganba be idu-nadapgua,
napnega giglimakdegusad, mogir dii-owidegusad, Sinaí-yala, be-abin giglimakdegusad. Deyobi, Sinaí-yala Bab-Dummad-abin gusad, deyobi, Sinaí-yala Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-abin giglimaksad.
Bab-Dummad, bedi bela-belad dii-owisagusad, be-dulamar geggus-danimargua, be e-niga-ogannosad.
Bab-Dummad, a-napagine, be-dulamar ambikusad, dule-wilegedgi be nued-binsaedgi ega napa-nued be nasiksad.
Bab-Jehová, e-gayaburba uksad, omegana mili-milibali (1,000-1,000), a-gayaburba-nued weyob sogmalad:
“Reymar duurmakdemalad, sorda-bila-onomalad duurmakdemalad. E-isdarmalad-ibe-ibmar-sulesmaladi, omegan e-neggine mimidmalad:
Ibmar manigi-sobarmalad, orgi-sobarmalad, mimidmalad. Ar bemardi unnila sibad-wawaad-abargi meremai gusmalad.”
Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, reymar-oakinnaigua, Salmón-yala-birgi dambed-sibudik-sibudik-batemaibayobi reymar-imaksad.
Basán-yalagan, yalagan-dummagan nanaed. Basán-yalagan-e-billigan matusuli nanaed.
Yala-dummagan, ¿ibiga be Bab-Dummad-yala-nug-imaksadgi be nobe itomala? Ar Bab-Jehová degisadegu agi mai guoed.
Bab-Dummad-e-moli-ur-bila-onomaladi, mili-miliba mergued (1,000-1,000). A-abalagine, Bab-Jehová Sinaí-yalase nonikid, e-neg-islidikid-yaba dogenonikid.
Bab-Dummad-Jehová, niba be nakwisgua, dule-galesmalad beba be sesa gusad. Dulemar-ibmar-bega-binsa-uksad be susad, dule-uayasulidamalad-e-ibmar be susad. Adi, be be-dulamar-abargi gudii guegar.
¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummolesun! Bab-Dummad-anmar-abonogedi, iba-irbali anmar-bendakmaiguad.
Anmar-Bab-Dummadi, dule-bendakmaidid. Bab-Jehová-Bur-Dule-Dummad burgwed-igargi anmar-onogedid.
Bab-Dummad, dule-e-isdarmalad-nonogi annaoed, e-nono-binsaed-isganabi-sediid ei sagamakoed.
Bab-Jehová anmarga sogsad: “Basán-akale, gannar an be-barmidagoed. Demar-mata-wilaganba gannar-naega an be-imakoed.
Be-naga, be-isdarmalad-e-ablisbi-moodo-guega an imakoed. Be-achumar we-ablis elomaloed.”
Bab-Dummad, be-Neg-Islidikidgi dulemar-yaryarmakmamaidi, magar dakleged. Dule-duurmakmaidi, an-Bab-Dummadgadid, an-Reygad gued.
Dule-namakmaladi idumamaid, a-yalabali, yagana gar-panderetaʼmar ogornadapid, solaba dule-gar-ogormalad nadapmogad.
Danar-bukwadgi Bab-Dummad-nug be odummomalo, Israel-wagan, Bab-Jehová-nug be ogannomalo.
Benjamín-wagan we-dulemar-iduedga nadapid, amar-yalabali, Judá-dulemar-e-dummagan bukidar nadapmogad, solanapi, Zabulón-dulemar-e-dummagan, Neftalí-dulemar-e-dummagan nadapmarmogad.
Bab-Dummad, be-gargangued be oyoge, Bab-Dummad, be anmar-bendakegala be-gangued-oyosgusadi, be oyobali.
Bese-goled-neg Jerusalén-neggweburgi-siid-ulale, reymar bega ibmar ukmaloed.
Bab-Dummad, we-ibdula-masarganbalidga sabsuli be ibmar-soge. Moli-bebe-nikad-machergan-ursilimaladga, ise-sabsuli ega be ibmar soge. Yarmar-baiganbali, moli-bebe-nikad-sapinganayob-damaladga, ise-sabsuli ega be ibmar soge. Ibmar-bela-bela-nikubiedba dulemar-sabsuli-imakdiidga, sabsuli be ibmar soge. ¡Dule-bila-onogedgi-binsadimalad be oaisakisun!
Egipto-akale, dule-sapin-dummagan danimaloed, Etiopía-dorgandi, gwae-gwae Bab-Dummadse wilenonimaloed.
Napneggi-dule-bukmalad, Bab-Jehováʼga be namakmala. Namaklegedgi Bab-Dummadga be namakmala.
Mogir-negasailaun-nagusmalad-birgi-sii-nanaedga, be namakmala. E-sunmaked-itogega-dule-imakedga, be namakmala. E-sunmaked mala-gollomakeyob-goledga, be namakmala.
Bab-Dummad-e-gargangued magar be dakmala. E-ganguedi, Israel-neggweburgi maid. E-garganguedi, nibneg-akale oyonaid.
Bab-Dummad, be-Neg-Islidikidgi, bedi, dule-geger-dakleged maid. Israel-e-Bab-Dummad, e-neggweburga, gargangued ukedid, niga-gangued ukedid. ¡Bab-Dummad-nug odummolesun!

Bab-Dummad be an-bendake, ar dii an-gammu-nagagus-naid, ar an didulenaid.
Olli-mata-yaagi an dogmaid, gwisguega annaed an sated. Dii-wilasailad-abargi an naid, e-dukeba an selemaid.
Dule-baidse-bendakleged an budar egisgusad. An gammu dinnagusad. An-Bab-Dummadse an-bendakleged-edarbediidba, ataked an yegusad.
Dule-isdar-an-dakmalad, an-sailagiaba bur bule mergued. Bukidar binsarsunna isdar an-dakmalad. Isdar-an-dakmalad nue-gangued-nika gudmalad, binsarsunna an-oburgwebimalad. Ar an ei ibmar atursassulite, ¿ibu gannar ega an ukosunna?
Bab-Dummad, an binsaedsuligudigusad be wisid, an-isgued geg begi an odukued.
Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, dule-begi-bensurmaladi, melle an-nukad bingegued be imako. Israel-e-Bab-Dummad, dule-be-amidimaladi melle an-nukad suli-suli-itoged be imako.
Ar be-nug-ulale, dulemar sunnasur-angi sunmaksamalad. An bingedba an-wagar gisii naded.
An-gwenadgan dule-baidyobi an-daked, an-nan-mimmigana akusunna an-dakmalad.
An bese-goled-negbina-nue-soged-ular, egi nue-nobe an itoged. Dulemar-begi-isdar-sunmaknanaid angi yolenonimogad.
An bodele, mas-gunsuli an gudele, angi dododedamalad.
Bukib-itoged-mola an yosale, angi dodoardamalad.
Dulemar neggwebur-doged-yawagakgi-bukudamaladi, angi sunmakedibidamalad. Mummugana angi namakedibidamalad.
Bab-Jehová, andi an bese goledi, be-itolegedba be an-abin-imakdaed. Sabed-dummarba-be-nikadba be an-abinsadaed. Be sunna an-abonogedba be an-bendaked. Bab-Dummadye, ¡emiskwaa be an-bendake!
Olli-mata-dummadgi be an-onoge. Melle olli-matagi-doged be an-imake. Dule-isdar-an-dakmaladgi be an-onoge, dii-wilasailadgi be an-onoge.
Melle diiba-seleged be an-imake, melle biryaba-bipirmakega be an-sae, melle napa angi mured be imake.
Bab-Jehová, be an-abin-imake, ar bedi dule-nuedid, be-sabgued dummarba be nikad. Be bela-bela dule-wiledakmaidba, gannar be anse dage.
Bab-Dummad, be-mai-idu melle be dukue, be an-abin-imake, ar an boni-abargi naid.
Bab-Dummadye an-walikaa be dage, be an-bendakdage. ¡An-isdarmaladgi be an-onoge!
Bab-Dummad, nue be wisid dulemar angi yoledimalad, dulemar an-obingegsadimalad, dulemar angi dododimalad. Bab-Dummad, bela be wisid, doamar an-isdarmalad gumala.
Dule-angi-dododimalad nue-nunmak an-imaksamalad. Emide geg an barsagusad, an bendakleged sated. Dule-wile-an-daked an amidiinad, gwen an amissurgusad. Dule-wile-an-dakmalad satemalad.
An-masgi ina-nusu obatismalad. An uku-uku-itonaigua, ina-gagbid anga uksamalad.
E-iba-onobukwadgi, e-masi egi-aibinega be imake. E-nasgumaidi, egi-aibinega be imake.
Melle-atakmalaga, amar-e-ibya mommoo be imake. Nolloo namalaga, e-gangued ei be sue.
Be-urwed egi gwichigued be imake. Be-urwed amargi yoleged be imake.
E-negmar ollo-ollo-siged be sae. Amargi dulemar megsuli be imake.
Ar be dule-naibi-imaksad balegichamalad, ar be dule-naibi-imaksad-e-nunmakedgi dododmalad.
Wemar ibmar-isgana-imaksadyob be imakmoga. We-dulemar melle be wiledako.
We-dulemar garda-burba-duladgi-e-nug-narmakar-naid be elie. Melle dulemar-nueganba e-nug-narmakar be meso.
Bab-Dummad, ar andi an uellediid, an nunmak-itodiid, be an-ogwiche, be an-bendake.
Bab-Dummad, namakedgi an be-nug ogannogoed, dog-nuedye-sogedgi be-nug an odummogoed.
We-ibmar-uklegedi, Bab-Jehováʼga moli-bebe-nikad-ukedba, moli-sapingwagwad-bebe-nikad-ukedba, Bab-Jehová bur-yeer itodaed.
Dule-wilegana weyob-dakdagogua, nue-yeer itodmaloed, Bab-Dummad-amidimalad-e-gwage gannaledmaloed.
Ar Bab-Jehová dule-wilegana-ese-goledi itodaed. E-dulemar-galebukwad mesagwar daksulid.
Nibnega, napnega, muu-billigan, bela-agi-ibmar-bukmalad, Bab-Dummad-nug odummosun.
Ar Bab-Dummad Sión-yala bendakoed, Judá-neggweburmar gannar soboed. Agine na e-dulemar degisadegu ambikuega imakoed.
Be-dulamar-e-wagan, a-yala degisadegu egadga guoed. Dule-be-sabmalad, a-yalagi bukwa gumaloed.

Bab-Dummadye, gwae be an-bendakdage, Bab-Jehováʼye, gwae be an-irwa gwisgudage.
Dule-an-oburgwebigudimalad bela surbinsa be imake. Dule-angi-isdar-binsadimalad bela be obingegsae, gannar osikirmakega be imake.
Dule-angi-dododimalad, bingedba gannar osikirmakega be imake.
Bab-Dummad, dulemar-bebina-gudimalad, begi-wergumala, begi-yeer-itomala. Dulemar-be-abonoged-igar-sabgudimalad weyob degisadegu sogdii gumala: “¡Bab-Dummad, nue-Bab-Dummad-Bur-Biriginedid!”
An dule-wilegedid, ibmarbina an sogdiid. Degisoggu, Bab-Dummadye, gwae be anse dage, ar be an-bendakedga gued, ar be an-ollor-imakedid. ¡Bab-Jehováʼye, mer be edarbe! Gwae be dage.
Bab-Jehová, an begi bensulid, mer bipisaar bingeguega be an-imake.
Be-igar-innikigwadba be an-bendake, be an-ollorsae, wis be an-itoge, be an-bendake.
Bee be, an-akwasaila-dukuedga gue, adi, an ase bali-bali dukudii guegar. Bedi an-bendakega be igar uksad. Be an-akwasailaga gued, bedi an-ganguedid.
An-Bab-Dummad, dulemar-isgana-e-ganguedgi be an-ollorsae. Dule-isgudimalad-e-ganguedgi, be an-ollor-imake. Emar-sabsur-imakmalad-e-ganguedgi be an-ollorsae.
Ar bedi, Bab-Dummad-Jehová, an-bendakedid. Sapingwagwad-akale, an begi bengudisulid.
An sapidukugi-mai, be an-akwide gusad. Bee be, muu-neggi-mai we-napnegse be an-odesad. A-ulale, degisadegu an be-nug-odummodii guoed.
Dulemarga an ibmar-gegerdaklegedyob gued, ar bedi an-odukued-gandikidid.
Bab-Dummad, bali-bali an be-nug odummoged, be-ganguedgi, be-yeerdaklegedgi an sunmakdii osedoddaed.
Bab-Dummadye, an seredgusale, mer be an-obano, an-gangued bergudele, mer be an-obano.
Ar an-isdarmalad angi sunmakmalad, an-oburgwebimalad na muchub-muchub angi sunmakmalad,
weyob sogmalad: “Bab-Dummad we-dulegi bar binsamaisurye. Anmar baleginmala, ganamala, ar dule-e-bendaked sated.”
Bab-Dummadye, mer be angi bangue, an-Bab-Dummad, gwae be an-bendakdage.
An-isdarmalad bingegumarsun, burgwemarsun. An-oakalobimalad, bela-bela bingegumarsun, bela-bela oesgudii gumarsun.
Ar andi begi degisadegu benguosulid, bur bule an be-nug-odummodii guoed.
Be-Igar-innikigwad, be-abonoleged-igar, amba an wissuli-inigwele, an egi sunmakdii osedodoed.
Bab-Dummad-Jehová, be-ganguedba-be-ibmar-imaksad an sogoed, be-igar-innikigwad an ebinsaoed, unnila abi an ebinsaoed.
Bab-Dummad, sapingwagwad-akale, be an-odurdaksad, amba emise-bakale, an be-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-imaksadgi an sunmakdiid.
Bab-Dummad, an-seredgusale, an nono-dableargusale, mer be angi banguo. Amba dulemar-danimaloedga be-ganguedgi an sunmakbied, amba yoo-gwalulemaladga be-garganguedgi an sunmakbied.
Bab-Dummad, be ibmar-dummagan imaksad, be-igar-innikigwad nibnegse warmakmaid. Bab-Dummad, dule beyobid sulid.
Bedi, surbinsa-itolegedba galitonai an-imaksad, wile-itolegedba galitonai an-imaksad. Degi-inigwele, gannar be an-ogannogoed, napa-urba-mai gannar be an-odurguoed.
An-nug-dummarba be imakoed, gannar be baisur-itoge an-imakoed.
Deyobi, an bega gar-salterioʼba doggus-nuedye sogoed, An-Bab-Dummad, innikigwadba-be-ibmar-imakedgi gar-arpaʼba an bega namakoed, Israel-Bab-Dummad, an bega gar-liraʼba namakoed.
An bega namakdele, an weligwaledgi bega namakoed, ar ade, be an-abonosad.
Deginbali, be-igar-inniki-imaksadgi an sunmakdii guoed. An-oakalobimalad nue-bingegusmalad, nug-bipii gusmalad.
Bab-Dummad, be-naboged-igar reyga be uke. Be-Igar-innikigwadba-be-ibmar-saedi rey-machiga be uke.
Adi, rey, innikigwadba be-dulamarga igar nabogoed, wile-itodimaladga innikigwadba igar nudakoed.
Yalamar, dulemarga neg-bogidikid nasiknonikoed, yala-mullugan, dulemarga igar-innikigwad ukoed.
Rey, dule-bukib-binsadimaladga igar nabogoed. Rey, dule-ibmar-nue-abedimalad-e-mimmigana abonogoed, mesagwar-dule-imakdimaladdi, obelogoed.
¡Rey-nug odummolesun! Birga-birgaba rey yar-semai guoed. Igi-dad-ibeler birgabargus-naiyob, nii-ibeler birgabargus-naiyob guoed.
Igi-nainugi ibmar-digar-naidgi dii wiardae, deyob guoed. Igi dii-wied napa-dutuu imakdae, deyob guoed.
Rey-ibagangi igar-innikigwad dutu-achunnedyob guoed, rey-ibagangi ibmar nasgumai guoed, nii-naid-berguedse ibmarmar nasgumai guoed.
Rey demar-naid-ugakaase yar-semai guoed, Éufrates-diwar-maid-akale, bela napaneg-naid-ugakaase, rey yar-semai guoed.
Dulemar-nega-dulesulidganba-mamaid yokorgi-sindigale, rey-asabin dulluu imakmaloed, e-isdarmalad, rey-asabin napa-nagase dulluu imakmaloed.
Tarsis-e-reymar, dulemar-demar-gakagi-bukmaladi, neggweburgi-mani-galeged reyga ukmaloed. Sabá-e-reymar, Seba-e-reymar, ibmar-nuegan-binsa-ukleged reyga ukmaloed.
Bela reymar yokorgi-sindigale, e-asabin dulluu imakmaloed. Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladi, bela ega-arbamaloed.
Rey, dule-ibmar-nue-abediidba wilesagwa-gordiidi bendakoed. Dule-wile-itodiid, dule-e-bendakoyob-binsadiid, rey bendakbaloed.
Rey, dule-wileged nue-wile dakbaloed, dule-ibmar-nue-abediid nue-wile dakbaloed, dule-wilegana-abonogoed.
Mesagwar-imaklediidgi dule-onogoed, sabsur-imaklediidgi dule-onogoed, ar dule ega bela-bela ibnuedga gued.
¡Rey-nug odummolesun! Sabá-ormar ega uklesun. Bali-bali ega Babse-gorlesun. Bane-bane egi ise-nued-binsalesun.
Bela-napamargi, ibmar-gwag-gullemalad bukidar nikusun. Bela yalamar-birgi, Líbano-yargi-ibmar-gwag-gullemalad-nikayobi nikusun. Dulemar, gagan-nainugi-ainieyobi, neggweburgi mergusun.
Degisadegu rey-nug biledii gusun, dad-ibeler-naiyob e-nug naguoed. Bela dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladi rey-nuggine, dule-baigangi ise-nued-binsadii gumarsun, Bab-Dummad-egi-nued-binsasye sogmarsun.
Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-nug odummolesun, unnila abi ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-imaked maid.
¡Degisadegu, e-nug-gandikid odummoledii gusun! ¡Bela napneggi e-yeerdakleged neg-ganai gusun! ¡Deyob-gusun!
Isaí-machi-David, Bab-Dummadse-goled-narmaksadi, wese bergunaid.
Ibibayobi, Bab-Dummad Israel-dulemargi nued-binsae, ibibayob dule-gwage-swilidikmaladgi nueddae.
An iche-napinad isguednaganad, an iche-napinad nue-dummad-noenad.
Dule-san-dummarba-imakmaladgi an nobguded, we-dule-isganamar nasgumai an dakargua, an egi nobguded.
We-dulemar gwen boni nikasurmalad, na san-swilidik gudidimalad.
Dulemar-ibmarbina-sogeyob ibmarbina-sogdisurmalad, dule-baigan-wiledimaladyob, wiledisurmalad.
We-dulemar, e-san-dummarba-imaked, wingwa-dukargi-naiyob ise-daklegaled. E-sabsur-dule-imaked, mor-yoeyobi ise-oyogar damalad.
Ibmar-isgana-ulubgi-sediid ise-oyogar damalad, ibmar-isgana-imaked bakar-buud oyomalad.
Dulemar-baigangi sunnasur sunmakdamalad. Gadi dule-baigangi dododamalad. Na san-dummarba-imakmaladba aimar-ibgwensur imakmalad.
E-sunmakedgi Bab-Dummadgi isdar sunmakdamalad, e-sunmakedba bela dulemar eba selediid.
A-ulale, dulemar ese idaknaddamalad, ega ibmar-soged bela nabiridbiiye binsadamalad.
We-dule-isganamar sogdedamalad: ¿Ar wede, Bab-Dummad wisguosi? ¿Ar wede, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined mag-itogosi?
We-dule-isganamar dogdar-alamaknai dasurmalad, degite, baisursunna mani-ibedga guddamalad.
Binsarsunna, an gwage-swilidik gudiid, binsarsunna, an ibmar-nued imakdiid.
Ar emide, sabsur-an-imakdigumalad, wakudaryalaba an-sarsoardamalad.
An weyob sogsana: “We-dule-isganamaryob an sunmakoye.” An be-mimmigangi aibichanad.
An we-ibmarmala magar-itobi gusanad, suli-suli-itogega an-imaksad, aku an itogusad.
Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse an dogsagua, geb an magar-itosad, igi-dule-isganamar bergumaloe.
Bab-Dummad, be we-dulemar bonimar-abargi ogwichisad, we-dulemar na san-berguedse nadapmalad.
¡Wemar ukiagwar bergudmaloed! Wemar dobedba bergudmaloed.
Bab-Jehová, bedi, igi dule e-gabdaksad napiragwadsulidba baisursunna daknonidae, deyobi, be gwisgualile, we-dule-isganamar-baisursunna dakoed, be we-dulemar-obelogoed.
Bab-Dummad, suli-suli an itodigua, an-ulubgi nue-sae an itodii gusad.
Ar an ibmar-wissulidbali, gannar-gannar an imaksad, ibmar-durganyob an gusad.
Degi-inigwele, an begi bangussulid, bee be nue-an-nidii gusad.
Be anga binsaed-ukedba an nanadiid. We-napneg-bergusale, ise-nuedgi be an-abingaoed.
¿Ar doa nibneggi an-edarbemaisunna? Unnila bebi an-edarbemaid. Ar an beba gudiile, we-napneggi ibmar-baid an abesulid.
An-gangued bar nika an itosulid, degi-inigwele, Bab-Dummad, be an-ganguedid. Beginbi gudigu an sadeguoed.
Dulemar-begi-banguddamaladdi bese berguoed. Dule-be-sogedba-nanadisurmaladdi bese burgwemaloed.
Ar andina, Bab-Dummad-walikaa-gudigued bur nued an itoged. Be, an-Bab-Jehová gued, be, an-odukuedid. Degisoggu, bela be-ibmar-imaksad, dulemar-baiganga an sogoed.
Bab-Dummad, ¿ibiga be degisadegu anmar-obacha? ¿Ibiga be anmarse nue-urwe? Ar be-sibad-wawaadyob-danar-bukwadse, ¿ibiga be nue-urwe?
Be-dulamar negasailaun be susadi, mer be iego. Be-dulamar begadga-guega be bendaksagusadi, mer be iego. We-Sión-yar-siid be-negga be imaksadi, mer be iebalo.
We-neg bela-bibichis-bukwadse be dage, ar dule-be-isdarmalad, bese-goled-neg bela-bibichismalad.
Bab-Dummad, be-isdarmalad be-onmakedneggi oimakbukwad, nakwis-itomaladba e-bandermar digsamalad.
Dule sapurba-sapi-sikmaladyob, ibmar-olananai gusmalad.
Bela ibmar-urgogi-sobarmalad, e-akangi bibichismalad. Mardomargi bela bibichismarbalid.
Be-neg-siid soogi ogumaksamalad, bela swiri imaksamalad.
Dule-isdarmalad na e-gwagegi sogsamalad: “¡Bela anmar we-dulemar-obelogo!” ¡Geb we-yargi bese-goled-negmar-bukwad bela ogumaksamalad!
Anmar, anmar-bander gwen memermaknai bar-daksulid, dule-Bab-Dummad-e-gayaburba-barsogedbela bergusbalid. Anmar we-ibmargunaid-e-ibagan-bergudapoed gwen wissurbalid.
Bab-Dummad, ¿sanadse dule-isdarmalad begi dododii guoe? ¿Sanadse dule-isdarmalad be-nug oichodii guoe?
¿Ibiga be sabsur-odurdaksuli? ¿Ibiga be bai-gwen-daksuli?
Bab-Dummad, bedina bato-sailanagi an-reyga be maid. We-napneggi bendakleged-igar be oyomaid.
Be-garganguedgi be demar egasbalid, be ibdulamar-dummagan-diakinmalad-e-nono marisad.
Be ibdula-dummad-diakined Leviatánʼye-nugad-e-nono ubigwar be imaksad. Ibdurgan-negsulidganba-gudimalad Leviatán-e-san-gunmalaga be imaksad.
Dii-sailagan-ariogega be imaksad, dianmar-megega be imaksad, diwar-dummagan-mamaid-dinguega be imaksabalid.
Be neg-meegwad nasiksad, mutikid be nasiksabalid. Be nii nasiksad, dad-ibeler be nasiksabalid.
Napneg-naid-e-abingunanaid be mesisad, Be dii-wied-iba nasiksad, yolagued-iba be nasiksad.
Bab-Jehová, nue be ebinsao: Be-isdarad begi ulusad. Dule-galagwensurdamalad be-nug isdar-daksamalad.
Be-dula-belagwa-gudimalad mer be ibdurganga urmake. ¡Be-dula-wiledimalad mer be iego!
Bab-Dummad, be-dulaga-be-igar-mesisad be ebinsao, mer be iego. Ar we-napneggi bela neg isgusnaid, bela neg-urwed naid.
Dule-boniganba-galitodiid, melle be obingegsao. Dule-boniganba-galitodiid, dule-ibmar-abediid, be-nug-odummogega be imake.
¡Bab-Dummad, be-gargangued be oyoge! Be, dule-binsaedsuligudimalad bane-bane begi-urwedimalad, mer be baisurdake.
Be-isdarmalad-begi-oimaknanaid, mer be baisurdake. Ar begi-yoledimalad nue-mergumamaid.
