Bab-Dummad, anmar doggus-nuedye bega soged, anmar bese goled. Dulemar be-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-imaksadgi sunmakmalad.
Bab-Dummadye, be soged: “An igar-nabogoye-sokalile, innikigwadgi an igar nabogoed.
Napaneg-giglimakdele, bela egi-bukwamalad giglimakdele, ar ani an napneg-e-sailamar-ganikid ogannoged.”
Nug-dummarba-imakdimaladga an soged: “¡Mer be na nug-dummarba imakmar!” Dule-isganamarga an soged: “¡Mer be na san-dummarba imakmar!
¡Mer be na gangued-nikadba yamo san-gannarba imakmar! ¡Mer be na bule-bule sunmakmar!”
Ar nug-dummarba-guedi, dad-nakwedsik danikosulid, dad-argwanedsik danikosulid, nega-dulesulidganba danikosulid.
Ar unnila Bab-Dummadbi igar-nabogedid. Bab-Dummad belallaa dulemar-nug odummosulid. Abala e-nug-bipii imaked, abala e-nug-dummarba imaked.
Bab-Jehová sabsur-dule-isganamar-odurdakega e-argangi nog-enamakar vino-gagbid-ibmar-baiganba-oburaled siid. A-vino-gagbid-eodele, bela dule-isganamar-we-napneggi-gudidiid, vino-gagbid-e-asase-bakale, gobmaloed.
Ar andi, Jacob-e-Bab-Dummadgi degisadegu sunmakdii guoed, Jacob-e-Bab-Dummadga an namakdii guoed.
Ar Bab-Dummad, dule-isganamar-e-gangued bela obelogoed, dule-nued-e-gangueddi, ogannogoed.

Judá-yalagine, bela Bab-Dummad magar-dakmalad, Israel-yalagi, e-nuga dummarba gued.
Ese-goled-neg Salemʼgi siid, e-meged-neg Sión-yalagi siid.
A-yalagine, Bab-Dummad warsi-e-sigumar bibichisad, sigu-abgamalad bibichisad, es-suidmar bibichisad, bila-onolegedgi-ibmar-ebulemalad, bela obelosad.
Bab-Dummad, bedi dule-gandikidid, bedi yalamar-degisadegu-bukwadba bur gandikidid.
Dule-bulegan omilede gusmalad, burgwismalad. We-dule-bulegan gannale bar gwisguosurmalad.
Be, Jacob-e-Bab-Dummad, egi be gwichigusgua, e-moli-urmar, e-molimar geg bar nanae gusad.
¡Bebi, unnila be-dobmalad! Be uludegwale, ¿doa be-asabin gwisguoe? Suli, dule gwen gwisguosuli.
Bab-Dummad, be nibneg-akale igar-nabosad. Bab-Dummad, napneggi san-bipi-imakdimalad-abonogega,
be gwichiguargusgu, napnega dobee itosad, napnega bogi nagusad.
Dule-begi-urwedimalad aka be-nug-ogannogoed. Dule-begi-urwedimalad-besmaladi aka bega iba-dummad onomaloed.
Be-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼba, ise-ibmar-sogar be imakmar, ega sogedba be ibmar imakmarbalo. Bela yarmar-anmar-neggwebur-dikarba-bukwadi, Bab-Dummad-gandikidga ibmar-ukleged sedamalo.
Ar Bab-Dummadi, dule-dummagan-negdakmamaid obelogedid, napneggi reymar-mamaid-odobguedid.

Bab-Dummad an-itogega, an ese binnasuli goled. Suli-suli an itodiidgine, Bab-Dummadse an goted.
Bab-Dummadse mutikidba bogigusuli an argan-onakgwar gormai daed, degite, amba an-gwage naibi-itodaed.
Bab-Dummadgi an binsadele, nue-bukib an itodaed. An egi nue-binsadele, an boddaed, an binsaddaed bar an bendaklegosurye.
Bab-Dummad, gabsuli be an-imaked. Suli-suli an-itosoggu, geg sunmak an naddaed.
Ibagan-epenne-nasmalad an insaddaed, birgamar-epenne-nasmalad an insaddaed.
An mutikidba-namakmaidaed an ebinsaddaed, ulubgi an binsamaidaed, an egismaidaed:
“¿Ar Bab-Jehová degisadegu anmar-obandiguode? ¿Ar anmargi nued-binsadii bar guosurde?
¿Bab-Dummad degisadegu-anmar-sabgudiid bergussi? ¿Bab-Dummad anmarga-ibmar-imakoye-sogsad degisadegu bergussi?
¿Bab-Dummad dule-wiledaked iessi? ¿Bela-bela urwemaidba, bar anmar-sabguosurde?”
Geb an sogdesunnad: Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined bar epennegii anmarga ibmar imaksulid. We, nue-nunmak an-imaked.
Epenne Bab-Jehová-ibmar-dakledisurmalad-imaksad an ebinsaoed. Epenne Bab-Jehová ibmar-gegerdakleged-imaksad an ebinsaoed
Bab-Dummad-ibmar-dummagan-imaksad an egi binsaoed, be-ibmar-dummagan-imaklesadgi an sunmakoed.
Bab-Dummad, be-ibmar-imaked islidikidbiid. ¡Bab-dummagan-baigan anmar-Bab-Dummadyobid sulid!
Bab-Dummad, be ibmar-dakledisulid-imakedid. Be-gangued dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladse be oyomaid.
Be-ganguedgi, be-dulamar be ollor-imaksad, Jacob-wagan be ollor-imaksad, José-wagan be ollor-imaksad.
Bab-Dummad, demar be-daksagua, be-dobguded, muu-wilasailad be-daksagua, binnasuli giglimakded.
Mogirmar, dii-dummad owialid, nibneggi, malamar gollomakded, nibneggi, malamar ibyeded.
Burwa-bipirmakaled-imbaba be-goled malayobi binnasuli gollomakded, be-mala-ibyemamaid napaneg ibegwar-imakded, napaneg wawanmakded, bela giglimakded.
Demar-abargi, igar be mesisad, Muu-billi be egasad, a-abargi be nasad, degite, be-gannar daksasurmalad.
Sibad-wawaadyobi be-dulamar Moisésʼba, Aarónʼba be semai gusad.
An-dulamar, an-ibmar-odurdaked be nue itomala, an-ibmar-soged be nue itomala.
An ibmar-burbarmaladba sunmakoed, dikasurgus negasailaunni ibmar-dukuar-mamaidi, an osanalogoed.
Anmar bato we-ibmar itodiid, bato anmar wisid. We-ibmar anmar-babgan anmarga sogsadid.
Anmar anmar-mimmigangi we-ibmar odukuosulid. Anmar anmar-wagan-danimaloedga Bab-Jehová-e-ganguedgi sunmakoed, e-ibmar-dummagan-imaksadgi sunmakoed, e-ibmar-dakledisurmalad-imaksadgi sunmakoed.
Bab-Dummad, Jacob-waganga Igar mesisad, Israel-dulemarga Igar mesisad. Anmar-dadganga-Igar-uksagusad, be-wagan be odurdakoye,
adi, yoedse-be-wagan-danimaloedi, bela we-Igar wisgumalagarye, degi, yoedse-mimmigan-gwalulemaloedi, bela we-Igar wisgumarmogagarye, we-mimmiganmoga, we-Igargi na e-mimmigan-odurdakmogoed.
Deyobi, wemala, Bab-Dummadgi bensuli gumaloed, Bab-Dummad-e-ibmar-dummagan-imaksad iegosurmalad. Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba ibsamaloed.
E-dadganyobi guosurmalad. E-dadgandi, binsaed-sate, uayasuli gusmalad, e-gwagegi innikigwadba nanassurmalad, e-ulubgi Bab-Dummad-sogedba gudii gussurmalad.
Efraín-wagan, sigu-miemalad-buleganad, degi-inigwele, bila-onolenaid-ibagi wakite gusmalad.
Israel-dulemar Bab-Dummadbo-Igar-Mesisadba ibmar imaksasurmalad, Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba ibsassurmalad.
Bab-Dummad-ibmar-dummagan-imaksadi, ega ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-oyosadi, bela iesmalad.
Bab-Dummad Egipto-yargi, Zoán-nebagi, e-dadganga ibmar-dakledisurmalad-oyosgusadi, bela iesmalad.
Bab-Dummad, Israel-dulemar nabir-obakmalagala demar-dinnaa imaksad, demar gasdibiryob ganna mesisad.
Bab-Dummad, ibginedba mogirbali Israel-dulemar-idu-nadapi gusad, mutikidba soo-gaedbali idunadapi gusad.
Bab-Dummad, nega-dulesulidganba akwasaila marisad. A-akwagi dii-aryomai imaksad, geb a-dii-gobmalaga imaksad.
Bab-Dummad, akwagi dii-aryogega imaksad, diwaryobi dii-aryomai imaksad.
Degi-inigwele, Israel-dulemar gannar Bab-Dummadgi-isgunai gusmalad, nega-dulesulidganba Bab-Dummad-Bur-Biriginedgi gwisgunai gusmalad.
Israel-dulemar, yamo Bab-Dummad-wilubdakbi gusmalad, agala, e-abegedba Bab-Dummadse masgunned-egicha gusmalad.
Bab-Dummadgi sunmaksa gusmalad, sogsagusmalad: “¿Bab-Dummad, sunna anmarga nega-dulesulidganba mas-ukoe? Suli. Anmarga geg uke.
Ar napiragwa, Bab-Dummad akwasaila-sarsosgua, dii binnasuli aryoargusad. Ar anmarga-mas-ukegala, ¿deyob imakbalo be ebinsae? E-dulamarga, ¿sunna san ukbalo be ebinsae?”
Bab-Jehová, Israel-dulemar weyob-soge-itosgua, bela-belad uluded. Jacob-wagangi sae-itoded, Israel-dulemargi sabsur-uluded.
Ar Israel-dulemar Bab-Dummadgi bengusmalad, Bab-Dummad e-bendakosurye binsasmalad.
Bab-Dummad, nibneg-akale, mogirmarga igar-uksad, degidba, mogirmar argaded.
Bab-Dummad, Israel-dulemar mas-gunmalagala, mas-manáʼye-nugad ega obatisad, madu-nibneggined-gunmalaga imaksad.
Bela Israel-dulemar baliwitur-e-madu guchamalad. Nue-immelegedse-gunmalagala, Bab-Dummad ega mas barmialid.
Bab-Dummad, dad-nakwedsikid-burwa barmiar gusad. E-gangued-nikadba dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-burwa barmiar gusad.
Bab-Dummad, ukub-mileddaedyobi ega san obatisad, demar-gakaba ukub-mergunaiyob ega nuumar obatisad.
Bab-Dummad, dulemar-danar-danar-bukwamaladgi, nuumar-babatega imaksad, Israel-dulemar-e-neg-gabmalad-dikarba nuumar-obatisad.
Israel-dulemar bela-bela-immelegedse mas-guchamalad. Deyobi, Bab-Dummad, ibmar-egichamaladi ega uksad.
Ar undar-immerba-gudii gussurmalad, ar amba e-gaya-yaba mas-sigua,
Bab-Dummad-e-urwed egi gwisgunonikid. Bab-Dummad, e-ibe bur-dule-dutusurmalad oburgwisad, Israel-dulemar-bur-nuga-nikamalad ogilosad.
Degi-inigwele, Israel-dulemar amba isgudii gusmalad, Bab-Dummad-geger-ibmar-daklemalad-imaksadgi bengusmalad.
A-ulale, Bab-Dummad, Israel-dulemar-e-ibagan sikwas-bunnogedyobi, berguega imaksad, e-birgamar dobed-dummad-abalagi, berguega imaksad.
Ar Bab-Dummad Israel-dulemar-abar-oburgwisale, geb Israel-dulemar-baigan gannar Bab-Dummad-amiddamalad, gwae-gwae gannar Bab-Dummadse nonidamalad.
Geb ebinsaddamalad, Bab-Dummad ega akwasailayob guye, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined e-bendaked guye.
Ar Israel-dulemar e-gayaginbi, e-gwabin-dukuginbi, gakansaar Bab-Dummad-nug-odummodii damalad,
ar e-ulubgindi ega gakansadii damalad. Bab-Dummadbo-Igar-Mesisadba, sogedba imaksasurmalad.
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Dummaddi wemar-wiledaksad, e-isgusad ega elisad, wemar-obelossurgusad. Bab-Dummad, gannar-gannar na e-urwed-barganai gusad, e-urwedba ibmar-imaknai gussulid.
Bab-Dummad ebinsasgusad, wemarde unnila dulemar-guye, unnila burwa-goleyob guye, gwen bar daklegosurye.
Israel-dulemar, nega-dulesulidgangi, bukidargus Bab-Dummadgi-yoledanigusmalad. Nega-dulesulidgangi Bab-Dummad-wile-itogega imaksamalad.
Gannar-gannar Bab-Dummad-wilubdaknai gusmalad, Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaled-ourwenai gusmalad.
Bab-Dummad-e-gangued bipisaar ebinsassurmalad, e-isdarmaladse-wilebukwa-onolesgusadi, ebinsassurmalad.
Egipto-yargi, Bab-Dummad ibmar-dakledisurmalad-oyosad iesmalad, neba-Zoánʼye-nugadgi ibmar-dummagan-imaksad iesmarbalid,
Bab-Dummad, Egipto-yar-e-diwarmar abega obinnisad, Egipto-dulemar, a-diwar geg gobe gusmalad.
Bab-Dummad, Egipto-dulemargi, gukurmar-bela-ibmar-biin-imakmalad barmiar gusad. Noomar-ibmar-obelomalad barmiar gusbalid.
Bab-Dummad, Egipto-dulemar-e-ibmar-gwag-wesmaladi, sese-burwigana-omaega imaksad, e-ibmar-gwag-gullemalad-digarmaladi, sesega urmaksabalid.
Bab-Dummad, Egipto-dulemar-e-uvaʼdub-digarnanaid, dii-gwamakaled-obatisadgi obelosad, e-higo-sapimar, boo-gwamakarmaladgi obelosad.
Bab-Dummad, Egipto-dulemar-e-moli-bebe-nikamalad, dii-gwamakaled-obatisadgi oburgwisad. E-sibad-wawaadmar mar-egi-odesadgi obelosad.
Bab-Dummad, Egipto-dulemargi bela-bela-e-urwed, e-sae-itoged, e-isdar-itoged, e-sae-daked barmiar gusad. Baliwitur-ibmar-obelomalad danagwen barmiar gusad.
Bab-Dummad na e-urwed bar bargassur gusad. Burgwedgi, Egipto-dulemar bar ollor-imaksasulid, boni-dummaganga urmaksagusad.
Bab-Dummad, bela Egipto-dulemar-e-machi-sailaginmalad oburgwisad, Cam-dulemar-e-machi-sailaginmalad ogilosad.
Bab-Dummad, sibad-wawaad-danar-bukwadyobi, Israel-dulamar-idunadapi gusad, nega-dulesulidganba senadapi gusad.
Bab-Dummad, Israel-dulamar-mer-dobee-itomalaga, igar-nueganba semai gusad. E-isdarmaladdi demargi-gundilegega imaksad.
Bab-Dummad, na e-yar-islidikidse Israel-dulamar-senoni gusad, na e-garganguedgi we-yarmar-susadse senonikid.
Bab-Dummad, Israel-dulemar-nadapid-idu dule-baigan-bukwad onosgusad, we-dulemar-e-napamar, Israel-dulemargadga-guega ega uksad. Deyobi, Bab-Dummad, a-napamargi, Israel-dadgan-dummagan-wagan urbisad.
Degi-inigwele, Israel-dulemar Bab-Dummad-wilubdaknai gusmalad, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Biriginedgi aibitemalad, e-Igar-Maidba ibsassurmalad.
E-babganyobi Bab-Dummadgi aibatemalad, egi yolenai gusmalad. Israel-dulemar, warsi-binsaledyob dopere gusmalad.
E-bab-dummadse-goled-neg-sobsamaladba, Bab-Dummad-oulusmalad, ibmar-e-bab-dummadga-imakdimalad-e-wilub-sobsamaladba, Bab-Dummad-nobguega imaksamalad.
Bab-Dummad, weyob ibmar-daksagua, uluded, degidbali, bela Israel-dulemar-obachad.
Silo-neggweburgi e-neg-meged-siidgi aibated. Agi, Bab-Dummad dulemar-abargi maidaenad.
Bab-Dummad, na e-Ulu, e-gangued-yeerdakleged-e-wilubga guedi, e-isdarmaladse-galegega imaksad.
Bab-Dummad bela-bela e-dulamargi urwemaisoggu, es-suidgi e-dulamar-oburgwilegega imaksad.
E-dula-sapingan soogi gummaksamalad, e-yaganga sui-nikued-ibagi-namakleged namaklessulid.
E-dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad es-suidgi oburgwilesmalad, E-omegan-e-ibe-sui-burgwismaladi, e-suimarga gwen bonai gussurmalad.
Geb Bab-Dummad, igi-dule-gabmair atakardae, deyobi atakalid. Igi-dule-bila-onoged-buled vino-gobnair binnasuli gormakdedae, deyobi Bab-Dummad uludedba binnasuli goted.
Bab-Dummad, e-isdarmalad-sikirmakega imaksad, degisadegu bingeguega imaksad.
Bab-Dummad, José-wagan-obachad, Efraín-wagan-sussulid.
Bab-Dummad, aka bur Judá-wagan-sunonikid, na e-yar-bur-sabed-Sión sunonikid.
Bab-Dummad, ese-goled-nega nibnegyobi matusuli sobsad, Bab-Dummad, igi-napneg degisadegu-gangu-nasiksa, deyobi na e-neg gangu sisad.
Bab-Dummad, e-mai-David-sunonikid, sibad-wawaad-edarbedgi-arbadiidgi David-onosad.
Sibad-wawaad-baregindidaedgi, Davidʼse gochad. Bab-Dummad, ega e-dulamar-Jacob-wagan-akwega, Israel-dulemar-egad-gued-akwega, Davidʼse gochad.
David na e-gwage-innikigwadba Israel-dulemar-akwisad, e-binsaed-nue-nikadba dulemar-idudii gusad.
Bab-Dummad, dulemar-aku-be-dakmalad be-yargi ubosmalad. Bese-goled-neg-islidikid oichosmalad. Jerusalén-neggwebur akwabi-dunnumakbukwa imaksamalad.
We-dulemar, be-maimar-e-mui, mulamarga masga uksamalad. Dule-bega-inniki-nanadiid-e-sanmar, ibdurgan-ursilimarga masga uksamarbalid.
Be-maimar-e-ablis, bela Jerusalén-neggweburgi diiyobi eosmalad. Burgwismalad-digega dule sate gusad.
Dulemar-anmar-yar-dikarba-bukmaladi, anmargi dodomalad, dulemar-anmar-yar-dikarba-bukmaladga anmar e-dodoedga gued.
Bab-Jehováʼye, ¿sanagwadse be-urwed berguoe? ¿Sanagwadse degisadegu be urwemai guoe? ¿Sanagwadse be-nobgued sooyob gamai guoe?
Dulemar-aku-be-dakmaladse be urwe, dulemar-bese-gordisurmaladse be urwe.
Ar we-dulemar, Jacob-wagan obelosmalad. Jacob-wagan-e-yar akwabi-dunnumakbukwa imaksamarbalid.
Bab-Jehováʼye, anmar-epenne-isgusad, mer be bar ebinsae. Be-wiledaked gwae be anmarga oyoge, ar anmar bela-bela oitoles bukwad.
Bab-Dummad-anmar-abonoged, be-nug-dummarba-gued-ular, be anmar-bendake. Be-nug-sabed-ular, be anmar-ollorsae, anmar-isgusad be elie.
Ar ibiga dulemar-yar-baigangi-bukwad sogmaloe: “¿Bia e-Bab-Dummad nade?” Be anmarga oyoge, igi-be, be-dulamar-e-ablis-aryosad be buged-mai imake. Bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamaladga oyobali, igi-be, be-maimar-e-ablis-aryosad be buged-mai imake.
Dule-galesbukmalad-e-boed be itoge, dule-oburgwilesokarmaladi, be-garganguedba be bendake.
Bab-Jehová, dulemar-anmar-yar-dikarba-bukwamalad begi dummad-dododigusmaladi, ilagugle (7) deyob-egi-dodomarmogaga be imake.
Anmardi, be-dulamar-gumalad, be-sibad-wawaadmaryob-gumalad. Degisadegu, anmar dog-nuedye bega sogmaloed. Degisadegu, anmar bega namakmaloed.

Bab-Dummad, Israel-dulemar-edarbed, be anmar-itoge. Be, sibad-wawaad-edarbedyobi José-wagan-e-iduedid, be, baliwiturmar-querubinʼye-nugad-abargi negsemaidid.
Efraín-waganse, Benjamín-waganse, Manasés-waganse, be magar gue. Be-gangued be oyoge, be bela-bela anmar-bendakdage.
Bab-Dummad, igi-anmar epenne bukwagusa, deyobi, be gannar anmar-imake. Bab-Jehováʼye, be anmargi ise-nued-binsae, be bela-bela anmar-bendake.
Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, be-urwe-maid-ulale, ¿sanagwadse be-dulamar-bese-goled be itogosuli?
Boed-dummad e-masgunnedyob ega be uksad, ibyanis-obinebaka e-gobedyob ega be imaksad.
Dulemar-anmar-yar-dikarba-bukwamaladi, anmarga allega be imaksad, anmar-isdarmalad anmargi dodomalad.
Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, igi-anmar epenne bukwagusa, deyobi be gannar anmar-imake. Bab-Jehováʼye, be anmargi ise-nued-binsae, be anmar-abonoge.
Bab-Dummad, Egipto-yalagi be uva-dub seargusad, Canaán-yargi dulemar-Bab-Dummad-akudakmalad be ononnosgusad, geb we-uva-dub be digsagusad.
Ega be neg-emisad, uva-dub-e-maligan gatik-diglemai be imaksad, bela-yar-gasa nagusad.
Bela uva-dub-gagan-urba negsichigwadgi yarmar bukusad, e-dubagan, urwar-sapi-matusur-gwigwichidgi bipirmakde gusad.
E-anamar, demar-Mediterráneoʼse warmaksad, e-muugan, Éufrates-diwarse nasgumai gusad.
Bab-Dummad, ¿ibiga uva-nainu-e-galu-emakaled be earisa? Bela-dulemar-e-dikarba-nasdamaladi, e-ibe san gwandamalad.
Wedarmala bela-bela wionaid, ibdurgan-ursirmar gundamalad.
Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, be anmarse gannar dage, nibneg-akale be atake, we-uva-dub be bendakdage.
Be-sunnad we-uva-dub be digsagusad. Begadga-guega e-ana be odummosad.
Be-uva-dub aimukus maid, soogi ogumaklesad. Be-urwedbali be-dulamar burgwemamaid.
Dule na be susagusadi, be bendake, dule-begadga-guega na be odungusgusadi, be bendake.
Ar deyob be imakele, anmala begi aibanosurmalad. Gannar-dula-gudii be anmar-imake, anmar unnila besebi gordii gumaloed.
Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, igi-anmar epenne bukwagusa, deyobi be gannar anmar-imake. Bab-Jehováʼye, be anmargi ise-nued-binsae, be bela-bela anmar-bendake.

Bab-Dummadga weligwaledgi namakmala, e anmar-ogannogedid. Jacob-e-Bab-Dummadga binnasuli weligwaledgi namakmala.
Namakmala, gar-pandero ogormala, gar-lira ogormala, gar-arpa ogormala.
Nii-binid-gwisgunonikidgi, gar-trompeta ogormala. Nii-dalu-naidgi anmar-iba-dummad-guedgi, gar-trompeta ogormala.
Ar weyob-imakoye Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemarga igar uksad, weyob Jacob-e-Bab-Dummad igar mesisad.
José-wagan Egipto-yargi noargu, Bab-Dummad José-waganbo igar mesisad.
Dule-sunmaked an itosad, an wissulid, doa anga sunmake. Anga weyob soged: “Be-gukingi be ibmar-ukusulid-semaid an bega osulosad. Arbaed-dummad be imakdiidi an bega obelosad.
Bemar suli-suli-itoarmargua, be anse gochamalad, agine, an be-bendaksamalad. Mogir-gudureged-imbaba, an be-abin-imaksamalad. Mar-gollomakmaid-abargi, an be-abin-imaksamalad. Meriba-dii-naba an bemar-wilubdaksad.
”An-dulamar, an be-owisogega bega ibmar-sogedi, be itomala. Israel-dulemar, bitigi be an-itosmalana gadin.
Bab-dummagan-bamalad be-Bab-Dummadga be imakosurmalad, bab-dummagan-bamalad-asabin, be yokorgi sindigar sigosurmalad.
Ani, an be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová gued. Ani an Egipto-yargi bemar-onosad. Guagwar be bukumala, an bemarga mas-obinebaka ukoed.
”Degi-inigwele, an-dulamar an-itossurmalad, Israel-dulemar anba ibsabisur gusad.
A-ulale, na e-itolegedba-ibmar-imakega an imaksad. Na e-itolegedba-nanadii gusmarsunnad.
”Ar an-dulamar an-itosana, ar Israel-dulemar an-igar-mamaidba nanasmalana,
an ega e-isdarmalad irgwensuli osulosanad, an e-isdarmalad sabsur-odurdaksanad.
Dulemar-Bab-Jehová-isdar-dakmalad, Bab-Jehová-e-nug bela-bela odummodmaloenad. Degi-inigwele, an a-dulemar degisadegu sabsur-odurdakoed.
An-dulemardi trigo-gwag-bur-nuedgi an oguchaled, akwamargi-achanis-nanaidgi, immerba-itomalaga an imaksaled.”
Bab-Dummad, bab-dummagan-onmakbukwad-e-dummadga siid, amarga igar-nabogedga siid.
“¿Ar sanagwadse, bemar yogasaar igar-nabodii gumaloe? ¿Ar sanagwadse, bemar dule-isganamargarbi igar-nudakdii gumaloe?
”Be dule-e-sergan-sate-gudimalad, be bendakmala, be dule-bendaked-sate-gudimalad, be bendakmala. Dule-wilemaladga, be innikigwadgi igar-nabomala, dule-sabsur-imakledimaladga, be innikigwadgi igar-nabomala.
Dule-e-bendaked-satemalad be dule-isganamargi bendakmala, dule-ibmar-abedimalad be dule-isganamargi bendakmala.
”We-dule-isganamar ibmar wissurmalad, ibmar aku-itomalad, negsichidgi gaamakdimalad, weyob gudimaladba bela napneg-saila-giglimakega imakmalad.
”An bemarga sogsa gusad: ‘Bemar bab-dummagan gumarye, bela-bemar Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-e-mimmigan gumarye.’
Degi-inigwele, bemar dulemaryobi burgwemaloye, dummagan-negsemamaidyobi burgwemaloye.”
¡Bab-Dummad! We-napnegga be igar itodage, ar bela-dule-napneggi-bukwamalad begadid.

Bab-Dummad, melle be gaya-bogidik mege. Bab-Dummad, melle be sunmaksuli gue, melle be ibmar-imaksuli gue.
Bab-Jehová, be dake, ibibayobi be-isdarmalad uurmakbukwa, ibibayobi isdar-be-dakmalad begi gwisgunanai.
Be-dulamargi-aibinega yardakar igar-amismalad. Be-dulamar-na-be-sabgumaidgi-gwisgumalaga, yardakar bular igar-amismalad.
We-dulemar sogmalad: “Dagmala, anmar bela e-dulamar obelonae. Deyobi, Israel-e-nug bar bipisaar ebinsalegosulid.”
Dule-wargwennayob na igar-aminanaid, begi bila-onomalaga, we-dulemar na atosmalad:
Edom-dorgan, Ismael-dorgan, Moab-dorgan, Agar-dorgan,
Gebal-dorgan, Amón-dorgan, Amalec-dorgan, Filistea-dorgan, degi, Tiro-dorgan, bela wemar na atosmalad.
Asiria-dorganse-bakale, bela wemarba atosad. Lot-wagan-bendakega atosmalad.
Ar igi be Madián-dulemar-obelosgusa, deyobi be we-dulemar obelomoga. Ar igi be Sísara, degi, Jabín, Cisón-diangi-obelosgusa, deyobi be we-dulemar obelomoga.
We-dulemar Endorʼgi burgwismalad, ibmar-isganayob napagi miled gusmalad.
Ar igi be Oreb, degi, Zeeb, imaksagusa, deyobi be e-sordamar-dummagan imakmoga. Ar igi be Zeba, degi, Zalmuna, imaksagusa, deyobi be bela e-dummagan-nuga-nikamalad be imakmoga.
Wemar sogsagusad: “Bab-Dummad-e-yar-naidi, anmar e-ibe sumala.”
Bab-Dummad, we-dulemar burwaba-selegega be imake. Gaganmar burwaba-gukuddaeyobi be we-dulemar-imake.
Ar igi soo sapur-ogumakdae, degi, igi soo-gwabunyemaid yarmar-ogumakdae,
deyobi be we-dulemar, be-burwa-dummadgi be baleginne, be-burwa-ooredgi, be ogwaye.
Bab-Jehová, we-dulemar be obingegsae, adi, magar-be-dakmalaga, be Bab-Dummad gued.
We-dulemar, degisadegu bingegudii gumala, na bingegudii burgwemala.
Na wisgumala, bebi Bab-Jehová gued, weyobi be nugad. Na wisgumala, napneggine, bebi unnila Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined gued.

Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, ibibayobi be-meged-negmala yeerdaklege.
Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-imbabina, an bela-bela ulubgi itoged, agi an gudiguega an surbinsa itoged. Bela-belad an-ulubgine, an-gwagegine, Bab-Dummad-Dula-Maidga an weligwaledgi namaked.
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, an-e-rey, an-Bab-Dummad, amba gig-sikwibela, bese-goled-neggi neg-amied, amba wirsobbela, na e-mimmigan-urbega, bese-goled-neggi e-uu sobed.
Be-itoged-neggi-gudimaladi, egi nued-binsalesmaladid, ar degisadegu be-nug-odummodimalad.
Dule-begi-gangued-amiedi, egi nued-binsalesmaladid, unnila bese-goled-negse-dagedginbi binsadiid.
Ibyanis-aryoged-nebaba-nadapile, dii-sailagan-ariomaid-negga imaked. Gebe-dii-argwanedi, neba-naidgi nabir-binsadaed.
Dulemar, nanadapidbali e-ganguedi gangumai gued, Sión-yalagi Bab-Dummad-dakmaloed.
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, an bese-goled be itoge, Jacob-e-Bab-Dummad, be an-itoge.
Bab-Dummad, be anmar-irwa sigu-abgaedyob gued. Be-dule-nug-imaksadgi be nued binsae.
Magaba iba-miliba-gudiguedba, bur-nuedid, bese-goled-neg-imbagi ibagwen gudii gued. Dule-isganamar-abargi-gudiguedba, bur an an-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-yawagak edarbebied.
Bab-Jehová, dad-ibeleryob gued, sigu-abgaedyob gued. Bab-Dummad, anmar-nug dummarba imaked, anmarga gangued uked. Bab-Jehová, dule-galagwensuli-gudisurmaladga, e-ibmar-nikadi obinagwar uked.
¡Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, dule-begi-bensur-gudiid, egi nued-binsalesadid!

Bab-Jehová, be-dulamargi be ise-nued binsasad. Jacob-e-wagan-yar-baidgi-galebukmalad, be gannar e-yarse senonikid.
Be-dulamar-e-ibmar-isgana-imaksad ega be osulosad, bela e-isgusad begi nossuliyob be daksad.
Bab-Jehová, be-sae-itoged bela be osulosad, be-urwed na be bargasad.
Bab-Dummad-anmar-abonoged, gannar be anmar-nudake. Be-anmarse-urwemaid be obeloge.
¿Ar be degisadegu anmarbo sae-itodii guoe? ¿Be degisadegu urwemai guoe?
Ar anmar burgwaleyob-gusoggu, gannar be anmar-odulodage. Adi, anmar be-dulamar-guedi, begi weligwar itomaloed.
Bab-Jehováʼye, be-sabgued be anmarse oyoge, be anmar-abonoge.
Bab-Dummad-Jehová-ibmar-soged an itogoed, ar e-dulamarga, ega-inniki-nanadimaladga, bogidikidgi sunmakoed, adi, melle bar gannar Bab-Dummadgi bangumalagar.
E-nug-odummodimalad-bendakega, Bab-Dummad anmar-walikaa gudiid. E-gangued-yeerdakleged anmar-napneggi nai guoed.
Sabgued, na napiragwadbo abingunonimaloed. Igar-innikigwad-imaked, na bogidikidbo, angaagwar akanonimaloed.
Napiragwad napneggi nai guoed, Igar-innikigwad-imaked, nibneg-akale aidedani guoed.
Bab-Jehová-sunnad anmargi nued-binsaoed. Anmar-napaneg, nue-ibmar-sanmake guoed.
Igar-innikigwad-imaked, e-gayaburba-barsogedga guoed, Bab-Dummad-idu igar-mayoed.
Bab-Jehováʼye, wis be an-itoge, be an-abin-imake. Ar ande, dule-wilegedid, ibmarbina an bela-bela soged.
Bab-Dummadye, be an-bendake, ar ande begala sogedba nanadiid. Be, an-Bab-Dummadid. An begi bensulid. Be-mai be bendake.
Bab-Jehováʼye, wile-be-an-dake, ar an bese gordii osedoddaed.
Be-nug-odummodiid weligwar be imake, adi, Bab-Jehová, an bese golegar.
Bab-Dummad, be dule-nued gued, isgudsuliyob be emar-dakedid. Dulemar-bese-gormalad be bela-bela sabed.
Bab-Jehováʼye, an bese-gornaid be itoge, an-wilesagwar-gornaid be itoge.
An suli-suli-itogedgi an bese goled, ar be an-abin-imakdaed.
Bab-Jehová, bab-dummagan-beyobid sated, be-ibmar-imaksadyobi gege ibmar imakmalad.
Bela be dulemar-obinnisadi, be-asabin sindigar signonimaloed, be-nug odummomaloed.
Bab-Dummad, ar bebi dummarba-maid, ar bebi ibmar-gegerdakleged imaked. ¡Ar bebi unnila Bab-Dummad gued!
Bab-Jehová, an be-igar-innikigwadba nanadii guega, Be-Igar-Maid be anga oyoge. Bab-Dummad, an be-nug-odummodii nanaega, be an-gwage ogannoge.
An-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, bela-bela an napiragwadgi be-nug odummogoed, degisadegu, an be-nug odummodii guoed.
Ar bela-belad be an-sabed, degisoggu, burgwega be an-imaksasulid.
Bab-Dummad, dulemar-na-san-buled-imakmalad angi gwisgunanaid, dule-gindakmalad an-oburgwebied. We-dulemar gwen begi binsasurmalad.
Bab-Jehová, bedi dule-nuedid, emar-wiledakedid. Bedi, baisursunna urwesulidid, sabgued-dummad-nikadid, dule-innikigwadbalidid.
Bab-Dummad, be an-dake, wile-be-an-dake. Be-nug-odummodiidga be-gargangued be uke. Ome-be-nug-odummodiid-e-machi be bendake.
Bab-Dummad, an-isdarmalad dakmalaga, an-isdarmalad bingegumalaga, be-sabgued be angi oyoge. Ar be Bab-Jehová, be an-bendakedid, be an-gwage-armakedid.
Bab-Dummad-e-neggwebur-e-negsailamar yar-islidikidgi mamaid.
Bab-Jehová Jacob-wagan-e-negmarba bur bule Sión-yawagakmar sabed.
Bab-Dummad-neggwebur, ibiyobi be-yeerdaklegedginbi sunmakmalad.
Bab-Jehová soged: “Neggweburmar-magar-an-dakmalad-abargi sunna an we-neggweburmar bie-bie saed: Rahab, Babilonia. Filistea, Tiro, Etiopía. We-neggwebur-e-dulemar-annik sogleged: ‘Sión-neggweburgi Bab-Dummad-magar-daksamarye.’ ”
Sión-neggweburnik soglegoed: “We-dule, degi, wemoga, Siónʼgi gwalulesmarye.” Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined na e-sunnad Sión-neggwebur sisad.
Bab-Jehová neggweburmar-nug-mamaid-gardagi narmakoed: “We, Sión-neggweburgi gwalulesye.”
Namaknanaidgi, degi, gwirnanaidgi, sognanaid: “Anmar begi bela-danikid.”

Bab-Jehová, Bab-Dummad-an-bendaked, an bese ibginedba, mutikidba gordiid.
An bese-gornaidi be itoge. An bese wilesakwaa-goledi be nue itoge.
Bela-bela angi bonigan yolenaid, an burgwedani maid.
Dulemar bato burgwisayob angi binsamalad. An ganguedsulidyob dakleged.
Burgwarmalad-abargine an-metemalad, napa-urba mui-mellemaiyobi an gued. We-muimargi-bar-be-binsalesulidyob an gued, ar be wemar bar-bendaksasulid.
Yaa-bur-matusulidgi be an-balimeted, nega-sichiganba, napa-urba-solanaga be an-balimeted.
Be-sae-itogedi bela angine yolenonikid, be-urwed demargi-gundilenaiyobi an-imaksad.
An-aimar angi banguega be imaksad, an-aimar ima-an-dakega be imaksad. An dule-esgaryagi-mellesiidyob geg wakinned,
An bela-bela-boedbali an-dalamar momommakded. Bab-Jehová, bane-bane an bese gordiid, an bese argan onakdiid.
¿Ar dule-burgwarmalad-abargi ibmar-gegerdaklemalad be imake? ¿Dule-burgwarmalad be-nug-odummogega sunna durgudagosi?
¿Dule-burgwarmamaidgi sunna be-sabguedgi sunmaklesi? ¿Dule-burgwarmalad-neggi sunna be-innikidaedgi sunmaklesi?
¿Ar nega-sichigangi, be-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad wismarsi? ¿Ar napneg-ieleged-neggi, be-igar-inniki-imakleged wismarsi?
Bab-Jehová, an bese goled, be an-bendakye. Wakudaryalaba an bese-goledgi, an be-amied.
Bab-Jehová, ¿ibiga be an-obane? ¿Ibiga be angi be-wagar odukue?
An sapingwagwad-akale ibitodiid, an burgwed-naga gudidaed. Bab-Jehová, be angine gwage-nunmaked-dummagan barmialid, geg an bar gugusad.
Be-urwedbali an galitosad, be-ise-sabsur-an-imaksadi, an-obelosad.
Be-emargi-gwisguedi, demaryobi bane-bane an-ebirnaid, bela an-ebilis naid.
Be angine an-aimar obachad, be an-gwenadgan angi obachabalid. Emigindi, unnila negsichidbi an-aiyob gued.

Bab-Jehováʼye, an degisadegu be-sabguedgi namakdii guoed. An degisadegu bela dulemarga, be-innikidaedgi sunmakdii guoed.
An sogdii guoed: Be-sabguedi degisadegu gege berguye. Be-innikidaedi nibneg-naiyob degisadeguye.
Bab-Jehová, be sogsa gusad: “An-dule-susadbo an igar mesisye. An-mai-Davidʼga an ise-sogar sogsagusye:
‘Be-sorbali, be-wagan degisadegu reyga-megmalaga an imakoye, be-wagan degisadegu negsemamai an imakoye.’ ”
Bab-Jehová, be ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-imaksadba nibnegginmaladi be-nug odummomalad. Dule-gwage-swilidikmalad-onmakbukwadgi be-innikidaedgi sunmakmalad.
Nibneggine, ¿doa Bab-Jehováʼyopira gue? Dule deyobid sate. Nibnegginmalad-abargi, ¿doa Bab-Jehováʼyob gue? Dule deyobid sate.
Dule-gwage-swilidikmalad onmakbukwale, Bab-Dummad-dobee itodamalad. Bab-Dummad na e-ebiris-bukmaladba bur-dummadid, bur-dutusurbalid.
Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nika-Maid, ¿doa beyob gue? Dule beyobid sate. Bab-Jehová, bedi gandikidid, bedi innikidaedid.
Bab-Dummad, demar-dagumakmaid be bargaed. Demar-dummagan-arwemaid be obogileged.
Be ibdula-dummad-Rahabʼye-nugad, maataa be oburgwisad. Bela-bela be gangued-nikadba be-isdarmaladgi be nakwisad.
Bab-Jehová, nibneg begadid, napneg begadid. Be we-napneg-naidi obinnisad, bela egi-ibmar-bukwadi be urbisad.
Be dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik-yar-bukwad obinnisad, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik-yar-bukwad be obinnisbalid. Tabor-yar weligwar be-nugga namaked, Hermón-yar weligwar be-nugga namaked.
Bab-Jehová, bela-bela be gangued-nikadba be ibmar-dummagan imaked. Be-argan-nued be onakwed, ar be emargi obichad.
Bab-Jehová, igar-maidba, igar-innikigwadba be negsemaid. Dule-wiledaked be oyoged, igar-innikigwad be oyobalid.
Bab-Jehová, dulemar weligwaledgi-be-nug-odummomaladgi, nued binsalesad. Wemar be-sogedba nanadimalad.
Be-nuggi wergudii osedoddamalad, be-igar-innikii-imakedgi wergudimalad.
Ar be we-dulemar-e-gangued-e-yeerdakleged gued. Nued be anmargi-binsaedbali, be anmar-gangued ogannoged.
Be, Bab-Jehová, be anmar-sigu-abgaedga gued. Be, Israel-dulemar-e-reyd, Gwage-Isligwaledid.
Ibagwengine, be-dula-gwage-swilidikmaladga be negburgan oyosad, aba ega be sunmaksad. Be-dulamar-bega-nued-nanadimaladga be sogsagusad: “An dule-wargwen-buled bendaksad. Dulemar-abargi dule-bur-emargi-obindiid-e-nug an odummosad.
An-mai-David an sunonikid, reyga-guega an-gwallu-wawad, an e-nonogi eosad.
An bendakdii guoed. An-ganguedgine ogannodii an imakoed.
E-isdarmalad egi nakosulid, dule-isganamar sabsur-imakosulid.
An e-isdarmalad obelogoed, dule-e-isdardakdimaladi an osulogoed.
An degisadegu David-sabgudii guoed. An-nuggine e-gangued dungumai guoed.
David, demar-Mediterráneoʼye-nugad-naid-akar, Éufrates-diwar-maidse neg-gani guoed.
Anga sogoed: ‘Be an-baba, be an-Bab-Dummad-an-abonogedid, be an-edarbedid.’
Machi-sailaginedga an imakoed, bela reymar-baiganba bur dummadga-megega an imakoed.
An degisadegu sabgudii guoed, an-ebo-igar-mesisadi degisadegu-mai guoed.
E-wagan e-sorba negsemamai gumaloed, Igi nibneg degisadegu nai, deyobi e-wagan degisadegu negsemamai gumaloed.
”Ar e-wagan an-igar-maidgi bangudmalale, an-igar-maidba nanasurmalale,
An-igar-maidgi annadmalale, an-igar-uksadba ibsasurmalale,
e-uayasulidaed-ulale, an sabsur-odurdakoed, e-isgusad-ulale, an bibyogoed.
Degi-inigwele, an David-sabguosuli bipisaale guosulid, an egi innikidaedi oberguosurbalid.
An Davidʼbo-igar-mesisadi an bisgosulid, an-ibmar-sogsadi an osulogosurbalid.
An-nug-islidikid-ular, an unnila irgwennaa ise-sogar imaksad, an Davidʼga gakansaosulid:
David-sorba, e-wagan degisadegu negsemamai gumaloed. An-asabin, igi dad-ibeler degisadegu-nai, deyobi, e-wagan degisadegu negsemai gumaloed.
Igi nii nibneggi degisadegu-nai, deyobi, David-e-wagan degisadegu negsemai gumaloed.”
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Dummad, be Reyga-guega-dule-susadi, be meted, be obachad, a-dulegi bela-bela be uluded.
Be-maibo be igar-mesisadi be bichisad, e-wagan-degisadegu-negsemai-guoed e-ibe be obelosad.
Bela e-galu-dikar-matusulid e-ibe be omukusad, e-neg-gandikbukmalad e-ibe be obelosad.
Bela dulemar-a-igargi-nasdamaladi, e-ibe ibmar atursadamalad. Neggweburmar-e-dikarba-bukmalad egi dodomalad.
David-e-isdarmalad-e-gangued be ogannosad, e-isdarmalad weligwar-itogega be imaksad.
David-e-es-suid-nugar sate be imaksad, bila-onogedgine gwen be bendaksasulid.
E-gangued-yeerdakleged e-ibe be osulosad, e-ologana napase e-ibe be meted.
E-birga-dulagudigued e-ibe be osikirmaksad, binged-dummad ega be uksad.
Bab-Jehová, ¿wede degisadegu be dukumai guoe? ¿Wede sooyobi be-urwed degisadegu guoe?
Bab-Jehová, be insao, an-dula-gudiguedi unnila sikwas gued. Degisoggu, ¿ibiga be dule-obinnisa?
¿Ar doa burgosuli degisadegu dula gudiguoe? ¿Ar doa burgwedgine wakinnoe?
Bab-Jehová, be sabguedsailagined, be Davidʼga be-innikidaedba ise-sogar-sogsa-gusadi, ¿bia nade?
Bab-Jehová, be-maimargi-dodolediid, be ebinsao, dulemar-bukidar-angi-dodogedi an ulubgi sediid.
Bab-Jehová, be-isdarmalad anmargi dodomalad. Na be dule-susadgi dodomalad.
¡Bab-Jehová-e-nug degisadegu odummolesun! ¡Degisadegu odummolesun!
Bab-Jehová, be anmarga degisadegu, anmar-dukuedga gudiguad.
Bab-Jehová, amba yoo yarmar be urbegua, amba yoo napa be obinyegua, amba yoo napneg be obinyegua, degisadegu dikasurgus, emi-ibadse, bato bedi Bab-Dummad gued.
Bab-Jehová, be sogdele: “¡Dulemar, gannar napaga-binyemarye!” Be-sogedbali dulemar gannar napaga binyiddaed.
Bab-Jehová, birga-miligwenadi (1,000) bega sae-iba-nasadyob gued, bega sikwas-neg-mutikid-nasadyob gued.
Bab-Jehová, igi diwar-noder ibmar-seddae, deyobi, be dulemar-seddaed. Dulemar, unnila sikwas-gabdakedyobi dulagudigued. Dulemar, wakdaradba gaganmar-ainiar-daedyobi gued.
Wakdara e-dutumar achundagoed. Sedogusale, bato dingudoed, degi-burgwidoed.
Bab-Jehová, be-urwedi anmar-obeloged, be-sae-itoged anmar-dobe imaked.
Anmar-ibmar-isgana-imaked bela be wisid, anmar-isgued-ulubgi-naidi begi dukusulid.
Bab-Jehová, be-urwed-ular, anmar-san bergumaid, anmar-ibagan sikwas-bunnolegeyob gued.
Anmar birga-dulapaa-gakambese (70) dulagudigued. Anmar-bur-dutusur-gumaladdi, sunna birga-dulabakese (80) warmaked. Degi-inigwele, suiti-dulagudiguedi, unnila arbaed-dummad anmarga uked, wile-itoged anmarga uked. Igi anmar sikwas-dula-gudigue, deyobi, birgamar nasmogoed.
Bab-Jehová, ¿doa be-urwed-gangued magar-itoge? Be-urwed bela-bela-gangusoggu, anmarga dobed-dummad uked.
Bab-Jehováʼye, anmar sikwas dula-gudisoggu, be anmarga binsaed-nikagued uke, adi, anmar nued nanadii guegar.
Bab-Jehová, gwae be anmarse dage. Ar anmar be-dulamar gued. ¡Be-maimar be wile dake!
Wakudaradba, be-sabgued be anmarga oyoge, anmar bane-bane bega weligwaledgi namakdii guoed.
Igi birgabargus suli-suli-itogega, degi, wile-itogega be anmar-imaksa, emigindi, ibagan debayobi-mergue be anmar-weligwar imake.
Be-maimarga be-ibmar-imaked be oyoge, e-waganga be-gangued-dummarbad be oyoge.
Bitigi anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-nued-binsaedi, anmargi oyolenonikina gadin. Bab-Dummadye, anmar-ibmar-imakedgi be nued-binsae, anmar-ibmar-imaked be onasgumai imake.
Dule, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Biriginedgi-dukued-amiedi, Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nika-Maid e-edarbedga guoed.
An Bab-Jehováʼga soged: “Be an-dukuedid, be an-garganguedid, an-Bab-Dummad, an begi bensulidid.”
Bab-Jehováʼbi bonigan-dukuar-bukwadgi be-ollor-imaked, boni-bulegangi be-ollorsaed.
Igi gannir e-sakan-urba e-mimmigan-odukue, deyobi Bab-Jehová be-edarbedga guoed. Bab-Jehováʼgi be dukued amioed. E-gayaburba be-sigu-abgaedyob guoed, be-edarbedga guoed.
Mutikidba boni-noed be dobguosulid, ibginedba sigu-mileged be dobguosulid,
negsichidgi boni-gudiid be dobguosulid, yoruku boni-dule-ogiloged be dobguosurbalid.
Be-argan-sapiledsiki, miligwen (1,000) dulemar burgwemai guoed, be-argan-nuedsiki, miliambe (10,000) dulemar burgwemai guoed. Bedi akar-guosulid.
Dule-isganamar sabsur-odurdaklegoed, be-sunnad be dakoed. Bedi sabsur-odurdaklegosulid.
Ar bedi Bab-Jehová be-odukuedga imaksasoggu, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined be-edarbedga imaksasoggu,
ibmar-isgana gwen be-ebugosulid, boni-dummagan gwen be-neguyase warmakosulid.
Ar Bab-Jehová, e-baliwiturmarga igar-ukoed, bia be nadesogele, adi, be-edarbemalagar.
Mer be akwagi-gowarmakega baliwiturmar nakwaa be-semai guoed.
Achumigur-nono-wawaadgi be obinoed. Naibe-nuedgi be dii-dii annaoed. Be achumigur-nono-wawaad-sapingwagwad naibi-imakoed. Be naibe-bulegan oburgoed.
Bab-Dummad soged: “Ar an-sabsoggu, ani an ollor-imakoed, ar magar-an-daksoggu, bonigangi an bendakoed.
Ar anse-gollalile, an abinsaoed, na surbinsa-itogedgi an eba gudiguoed, an ollor-imakoed, an e-nug odummogoed.
An ega birga-ichesur-dula-gudigued ukoed, an-abonolegedgi weligwar-itodii an imakoed.”

Bab-Jehová, bega-doggus-nuedye-soglegedi, ibiyobi dog-nuedi. Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined, be-nuggi-namakedi, ibiyobi dog-nuedi.
Wakudaryalaba be-sabgued-dummadgi-namakedi, ibiyobi dog-nuedi. Mutikidba be-innikidaedgi-namakedi, ibiyobi dog-nuedi.
Gar-oimakar-goledba-namaked, gar-lira-goledba-namaked, ibiyobi dog-nuedi. Gar-arpa-goledba-namaked, gar-salterio-goledba-namaked, ibiyobi dog-nuedi.
Bab-Jehová, be be-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-imakedba, weligwar be an-imaked. A-ulale, be-ibmar-imaksadba, an weligwar-itoge an bega binnasur namakoed.
¡Bab-Jehová, ibibayobi be-ibmar-imaksad dummarba-gue! Bab-Jehová, be-binsaed bela-bela yeer-gangusoggu,
dule-binsaedsulidaed, magar itosulid, dule-ibmar-wissulid, aku itoged.
Amba dule-isganamar gaganyobi ainialile, dule-galagwensulidamalad dutuyob achunnalile, unnila degisadegu-berguega gumaloed.
Bab-Jehová, bebi unnila degisadegu bur-gandikidga maid.
Bab-Jehová, napiragwa, be-isdarmalad berguoed, bela dule-galagwensulidamaladi oaisakilegoed.
Bedi moli-bebe-nikad-ursilid-gangued-nikadyobi anga gargangued uked, gwallu-wawad-bur-nuedgi be an-nono wawamaksad.
An-isdarmalad-galakusad-dakega, be an-imaksad, an-isdarmalad-obelolesad-itogega, be an-imaksad.
Dule-nuegan, ogob-sanmakedyobi gumalad, Líbano-yargi urwarmar-dungumaiyobi gumalad.
Dule-nuegan, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neggi sapi-digar-gwichiyobi gumalad, anmar-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-imbagi dutuyobi achutemalad.
Dule-nuegan, amba sered-ugakine, sanmakgwichi gumaloed, san-nued-gudii, dutusur-gudii gumaloed,
adi, sogmalaga: “Bab-Jehová dule-innikigwadye. Bab-Jehová an-gandikidye, egine igar-isgana-imaked naisurye.”
¡Bab-Jehová, gangued-yeerdakle-nika negsemaid! Bab-Jehová, dummarba-gued oyosad, e-gangued oyosad. Innikigwadba napneg nasiksad, napneg bar bipisaar onirilegosulid.
Bab-Jehová, bedi gebe-negasaila-akale, bato negsemaid. ¡Bedi degisadegu maiguad!
Bab-Jehová, diwarmar dutusuli nomamaid, diwarmar binnasuli uurmakmaid, diwarmar binnasuli sukamakmaid,
Bab-Jehová, ar bedi demar-uurmakedba bur be dutusur gued, ar bedi muu-billigan-arwedba bur be dutusur gued, ar bedi nibneggi bur dutusur maid.
Bab-Jehová, Be-Igar-Mamaidgi dutusuli mamaid, gege bisged. Islidik-gued degisadegu bese-goled-neg-yeerdakle imaked.
Bab-Jehová-dule-buged-mai-imakedye, Bab-Dummad-dule-buged-mai-imakedye, be magarodage, dule-sabsur-imaklediid be buged-mai imakdage.
Bab-Jehová, be igar-naboged-dulesoggu, be-gangued be oyodage, dule-na-san-buled-imakdimalad, be sabsur-odurdakdage.
Bab-Jehová, ¿sanagwadse dule-isganamar yeer-itodii gumaloe?
Ar bela we-dule-isganamar, dule-ibmar-sabsur-sogmaladid, na san-dummarbaa imakmaladid.
Bab-Jehová, dule-isganamar be-dulamar-sabsur imakdimalad. Be-dulamar-mesagwar imakdimalad.
We-dule-isganamar, omegan-ei-sui-burgwismalad oburgwemalad. Wemar, dule-yar-baidsikid ogilomalad. Wemar, dule-babsuli-gudimalad gindakmalad.
Dule-isganamar sogmalad: “Bab-Jehová we-ibmar daksulid, Jacob-e-Bab-Dummad, we-ibmar wissulid.”
¡Dule-ibmar-aku-itomalad, be magar itomala! Bemar binsaed-satemaladi, ¿sanagwadse be binsaed-nika gumaloe?
Ar dule-anmarga-uaya-nasiksadi, ¿itogosuli? Ar dule-anmarga-ibya-sisadi, ¿dakosuli?
Ar dulemar-ibmar-noar-imaksad-onudakedi, ¿sabsur-odurdakosur be ebinsae? Ar dule-ibmargi-odurdakedi, ¿ibmar-wisguosur be ebinsae?
Bab-Jehová dulemar-binsaed bela wisid, Bab-Jehová wisid, dulemar unnila yogasaar binsamalad.
Bab-Jehová, dule-ibmar-noar-imaksad be nudakedi, we-dulegi be ise-nued binsasad. Be, be-igar-maidgi-dule-odurdakedi, we-dulegi be ise-nued binsasad.
We-dule, ibagan-bulegangi gwage-bogidiki gudiguoed. Dule-isganagardi, diglegega napa gwislegoed.
Bab-Jehová e-dulamar obanosulid. Bab-Dummad, e-dulamar-egadga-imaksad wargwen metosulid.
Igar-nabolegedi igar-innikigwadba imaklegoed, bela dule-gwage-inniki-gudimalad, igar-maidba damaloed.
¿Doa, dule-isganamar-abin an-irwa gwisgusa? ¿Doa, dule-isganamar-abin anba nagusa?
Ar Bab-Jehová an-bendaksasulina, bato an napa-uluba bergus mellemainad.
Bab-Jehová, an sogsagusgu, “an bergudaniye,” be-sabgued-nikadba yog be an-bendaknoni gusad.
An bela-bela suli-suli-itogedgine, baisur-itogega be an-imaksad, weligwaled be anga uksad.
Bab-Jehová, reymar-isganamar-e-aiga geg be gued. Ar we-reymar ibmar-isgana-imakega igar-mesmalad,
dule-nuegangi-aibinega igar-amimalad, dule-ibmar-akar-imaksasulid-oburgwega imakmalad.
Ar Bab-Jehová an-edarbedid, an-Bab-Dummadid, akwasaila-an-odukuedyob gued.
Bab-Jehová dule-isganamar-e-isguedi, dule-isganamargi-aibinega imakoed. Bab-Jehováʼse e-isgusad-ulale, dule-isgana berguoed. ¡Anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová we-dulemar-obelogoed!
¡Dagmala, anmar weligwaledgi Bab-Jehováʼga namakmala! ¡Anmar weligwaledgi Bab-Dummad-anmar-abonogedga namakmala!
Anmar Bab-Jehováʼga doggus-nuedye-sogedgi e-negse doge. ¡Anmar Bab-Jehováʼga namake!
Ar Bab-Jehová, bur Bab-Dummadid, bela ibmar-bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad-birgi, bur Rey-dummadid.
Bab-Jehová, na e-argan-yaurgi napa-billigan ganikid, yala-dummagan-matusurmalad na egadid.
Muu-billi-maidi, egadid, ar na e obinnisad, neg-dinnagwad-naidi na e obinnisbalid.
Dagmala, anmar Bab-Jehová-nug-odummogega napase wagar dulluu imakmala. Anmar Bab-Jehová-anmar-obinnisad-abin yokorgi sindigar sigmala.
Ar e anmar-Bab-Dummadid. Anmardi e-dulamar gumalad, e anmar-edarbedid. Anmardi e-sibad-wawaadyob gumalad, e anmar-akwediid. Ar emi bemar Bab-Jehová-gayaburba itogele,
melle be Meribaʼgi-gusmalayob, bur bule burgumalo. Ar igi deun nega-dulesulidganba Masahʼye-neg-nugadgi bur bule burgusgusmala, melle be deyob burgumalo.
Deun agine, be-dadgan amba an-ibmar-imaksad-daksamar-inigwele, an-wilubdaksa gusmalad, urwega an-imaksa gusmalad.
Birga-dulabo (40) an be-dadgan-ebo sae-itodii gusad. An sogsa gusad: “We-dulemar noar nanadimalad, an-igar-maidba ibsadisurmalad.”
Degisoggu, an sae-itogedgine, an weyob ise-sogar sogsa gusad: “Ega-yar-ukoye-an-sogsadgine, dogosurmalad, agine, an ega obunnoged ukoenad.”
Bab-Jehováʼga, namakleged-binidgine, be namakmala. Bela napneggi-dulemar-bukwad, Bab-Jehováʼga namakmala.
Bab-Jehováʼga namakmala, e-nug odummomala, e-isdarmaladgi-nakwisad bane-bane obarmala.
Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-abargi, e-gandikid-yeerdakleged sogmala, bela neggweburmar-abargi, e-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-imaked obarmala.
Ar Bab-Jehová, dule-dummadid. Bela-belad e-nug odummolegergebed. Bab-Jehová ibmar-bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladba bur bule dobguleged.
Neggweburmar-baigan-e-bab-dummaganga-imaklemaladi, Bab-Dummadsulid, unnila ibmargi sobarmaladid, ar Bab-Jehováʼdi nibneg obinnisad.
¡Bab-Jehová-walikaa neg-ibegwaled naid, dummarba-gued naid! E-neggine gangued oyolenaid, yeerdakleged oyolenaid.
Bela-dulemar-napneggi-bukwamalad, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomala, Bab-Jehová e-gandikid-yeerdakleged be obarmala.
Bab-Jehová-e-nug-gandikid-yeerdaklegedi be ogannomala. Ese-goled-neg-imbase be dogdamala, ega ibmar-ukleged be sedamala.
Bab-Jehová-e-nug, e-neg-yeerdaklegedgi be odummomala. Bab-Jehová-asabin bela-napneggi-dulemar-bukwad bela-belad dobekwaa ambikumarsun.
Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladga weyob be sogmala: “¡Bab-Jehová, Rey gued!” Innikigwadba napneg nasiksad, napneg bar bipisaale onirilegosulid. Bab-Jehová igar-innikigwadba dulemarga igar-naboged.
¡Nibnegmar weligue, napneg yeer-itoge! Muu-billi uurmake, bela egi ibmar-bukwad weligumala.
Sapurmar, weligwar namakmala. Bela sapurgi ibdurgan-bukwad, weligwar namakmala. Bela sapurgi sapimar-bubukwad, weligwar namakmala.
¡Bab-Jehová-asabin namakmala, bato danikid! Igar-innikigwadba dulemarga-igar-nabogega bato danikid. Bab-Jehová igar-innikigwadba dulemarga igar-nabogoed. Napiragwadgi dulemarga igar-nudakoed.
¡Bab-Jehová, Rey gued! ¡Napneg, wergumala! ¡Dupugan-dikasur-nanaid, wergumala!
Mogir-guduremalad Bab-Jehová-ebilis naid. Bab-Jehová igar-inniki-imakedba negsemaid, igar-innikigwadba negsemaid.
Soo, Bab-Jehová-idu nadapid, we-soo, Bab-Jehová-e-isdarmalad Bab-Jehová-ebiris-bukwad obeloged.
E-mala-ibyedi napneg-mee imaked. Napneg mala-ibyed-dakdegu, wawanmakded.
Yarmala baka-gwalluyob Bab-Jehová-abin daluded. Bab-Jehováʼde bela we-napneg-e-ibedid.
Mogirmar, Bab-Jehová-e-igar-innikigwad-imaked barsogmalad. Bela-dulemar, Bab-Jehová-gangued dakmalad.
Dule-bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imakdimalad, bingegumala. Dule, bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imakdimaladgi na san-dummarba-imakmalad, bingegumala. Bela bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imaklemalad, Bab-Dummad-asabin dulluu sigmala.
Bab-Jehová, be igar-innikigwad-imaked-ular, Sión-neggwebur, weligwar itoged, Judá-neggweburmar, yeer itomalad.
¡Ar be, Bab-Jehová-Bur-Birigined gued! ¡Be we-napnegba bur dummad gued! ¡Be, bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imaklemaladba bur dummad gued!
Bab-Jehová, dule-ibmar-isgana-isdar-dakmalad, sabed. Bab-Jehová, e-dulamar-inniki-nanadimalad, edarbed. E-isdarmaladgi wakinnega imakbalid.
Dule-nuegan, nue-binsaed-nikaa imaked, Bab-Jehová, dule-inniki-gudidimaladga weligwaled uked.
Bemar dule-nuegan, Bab-Jehováʼgi be wergumala, Bab-Jehová-nug-isligwaled be odummomala.
Bab-Jehováʼga namakleged-binidgi be namakmala, ar ibmar-dakledisurmalad imaksad. E-ganguedgi, e-swida-gandikidgi, e-isdarmaladgi nakwisad.
Bab-Jehová, na e-nakwisad bela magar-dakmalaga imaksad. Bela-dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladga e-igar-inniki-imaked oyosad.
Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemar-sabesaila maid. Ega ibmar-imakedseye-sogsa-gusad ebinsanonikid. Bela dulemar-napneggi-bukmalad, anmar-Bab-Dummad-bela-bela-e-bendaked daksamalad.
Bela-dulemar-napneggi-bukmalad, Bab-Jehováʼga weligwaledgi namakmala. Binnasuli weligwar-namaklegedgi ega namakmala.
Bab-Jehováʼga gar-arpaʼba namakmala, gar-liraʼba ega namakmala, yeer-namaklegedgi ega namakmala.
Bab-Jehová-Rey-guedga, weligwaledgi namakmala, gar-trompetaʼba ega namakmala, garmarba ega namakmala.
Demar-naid, bela egi ibmar-bukmalad namakmala, Napneg-naid, bela egi dulemar-bukmalad namakmala.
Diwarmar-mamaid, argan ogormala, bela yarmar-bubukwad, weligwaledgi namakmala.
Bab-Jehová-asabin weligwaledgi namakmala, ar Bab-Jehová napneg-seega danikid. Dulemar-bukwadga igar-innikigwad-imakedba igar nabogoed, dulemar-bukwadga emarbi igar nabogoed.
¡Bab-Jehová, Reyga maid! Bab-Jehová e-ologanagi baliwitur-querubinʼye-nugmalad-abargi siid. Neggweburmar wawanmakmala. Bela napneg giglimake.
Bab-Jehová Sión-neggweburgi bur dule-dummadid, bela neggweburmargi bur dule-dummadid.
¡E-nug-dummad, e-nug-buled odummomala! ¡Bab-Jehová, dule-isligwaledid!
Bab-Jehováʼye, be, Rey-gandikidid. Igar-innikigwad-imaked be sabed. Be, dulemarga yobi-gumalad-igar mesisad. Be, Israel-neggweburgi igar-innikigwadba, ibmar-imaksad, inniki-sogedba be ibmar-imaksad.
Anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-nug odummomala, Bab-Jehová-asabin, napase-dulluu Bab-Jehová-nug odummomala. ¡Bab-Jehová, dule-isligwaledid!
Moisés, Aarónʼbo dule-irwa-Babse-gormaladga gusmarmogad, Samuel, Bab-Jehová-nug-odummodii gusmogad. Wemala, Bab-Jehováʼse gordii gusmalad, geb Bab-Jehová abin-imaksadaed.
Wemarga mogir-bubawarba sunmaksad. Wemala, Bab-Jehová-Igar-Mesisadba nanadii gusmalad, Bab-Jehová-Igar-Uksadba gudii gusmalad.
Anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, wemar-bese-gochagu, be abin-imaksagusad. Amba e-ibmar-isgana-imaksamalad-ular, be sabsur-odurdaksa-inigwele, bedi, wemargala, Bab-Dummad-dule-isgussuliyob-dakedga gusad.
Anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-nug odummomala, e-yar-islidikidgi, e-nug odummomala. ¡Anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, dule-isligwaledid!
Bela-napneggi-dulemar-bukmalad, weligwaledgi, be Bab-Dummadga namakmala.
Weligwaledgi, Bab-Jehová-nug be odummomala. Yeer-itogedgi, e-asabinni be namakdamala.
Bab-Jehová-Bab-Dummad-gued be magar-dakmala. E anmar-obinnisad. Anmar, egadid. Anmar e-dulamalad. Anmar, e-sibad-wawaadyob gumalad.
Doggus-nuedye-sognai, ese-goled-negyaba be dogmala, Namakar e-nug-odummonai, e-neg-imbase be dagmala. ¡Ega be doggus-nuedye sogmala! ¡E-nug be odummomala!
Ar Bab-Jehová dule-nuedid, e-sabguedi degisadeguad. E-innikidaedi gege bergued.
Bab-Jehová, namaklegedgi an bega namakoed. Sabguedgi, an namakoed, igar-innikii-imaklegedgi an namakoed.
Nued nanadii an gubied. ¿Wede sana be anse ataknonikoe? An-neggi gwage-napiragwadgi an nanadii gubied.
Ibmar-isganagi an atakbisulid. Igar-isgana an imakbisulid. Dule-Bab-Dummad-Igargi-banguddamalad an sae-daked. Amala anse-warmaked an imakosulid.
Binsaed-isganamargi an banguoed. Ibmar-isgana an imakbisulid.
Dule dule-baidgi-arbak-sunmaked an obelogoed. Dule-san-dummarba-saed, anse-warmaked an imakosulid. Dule-baigangi-obinye-soged, anse-warmaked an imakosulid.
We-yargi dule-be-igarba-nanamalad, anba-gudigumalaga an amioed. Dule-be-igar-maidba-nanadimaladbi, anga arbamaloed.
Dule, dule-yardakmaladgi-arbamaladi, an-negyagi gudii guosulid. Dule gakansaar-sunmakedi an-asabin gudii guosulid.
Bane-bane we-yargi dule-isganamar-gudimalad obelomai an imakoed. Bela dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmalad, Bab-Jehová-neggweburgi an onogoed.

Bab-Jehováʼye, an bese-gornaid be itoge, wilesagwar-an bese-gornaid bese mosana gadin.
Bonigan angi-yolenonikile, mer be an-idu dukuo, nue be an-itogo. An bese-gornaile, gwae be an-abin-imako.
An-ibagande, waayob bergudedaed. An-garmardina, soogi-gummaknaiyob itoleged.
An-gwage ber nollomakded, gaganyob dinguded, ukuddi bar an itosurgusad.
An binnasuli-akiginnedbali, an-garmardi daledgusad.
Noo-negsulidganba-gukudiidyobi, an wargwen itoged. Irmon-neg-ayaraledgangi-gudiidyobi, an wargwen garmakdiid.
Bar an gabdisulid, sikwi-walagwen-uas-birgi-gudidaedyobi, an gudiid.
An-isdarmalad bane-bane mesagwar an-imakdimalad, yogasaar an-nug-oichogega an-nug-gadimalad.
Degisoggu, sooburu an madisunnad. An-ibyanisde, an-gobedba-mesa an gobdisunnad.
Bab-Dummad, be sabsur-uludedbali, sabsur-an-imaksa gusad. Sabsur-nakwaa be an-imaksagu, be an-barmeted. Deyob be an-wiosad.
An-ibagande, negsichiledanikiyobi, bato bergudanikid. Gagan-dinguddaedyobi, an guded.
Bab-Jehová, ar bedina, degisadegu be negsemai guoed. Be-nugdina berguosulid, degisadeguoed.
Be, Sión-dulemar bendaknonikoed, be-sabgued ega be oyononikoed. Ar a-ibagan bato nagunonikid.
Anmar-be-maimar, Jerusalén-neggweburbina nue-sogmalad. E-negmar-ayarar-bukwadi, nunmaked-dummad anmarga uked.
Bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamaladi, Bab-Jehová-nug-dobe-nanadii gumaloed. Bela-yar-baid-baidgi-reyga-mamaid, Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-yeerdakleged magar-dakmaloed.
Ar Bab-Jehová, Sión-neg-ayarar-siid gannar soboed, e-gangued-nikad oyononikoed.
Dule-ibmar-suli-gudimalad-ese-goledi itogoed, dule-ese-wilesagwar-gornaidi itogoed.
Wagan-danimalad wisgumalaga, we-ibmar narmaklego. Dulemar-gwalulemaloed, Bab-Jehová-nug-odummomalaga, we-ibmar narmaklego.
Ar Bab-Jehová, dulemar-gales-gorbukwad-itogega, e-neg-islidikid-akale, napneg-naid nue-dakded.
Bab-Jehová, dulemar-oburgwilegega-galesbukwad-onogegala, napneg-naid nue-dakded.
Bab-Jehová, dulemar Sión-yargi-e-nug-barsogmalagala, napneg-naid nue-dakded. Jerusalén-neggweburgi e-nug-odummomalagala, napneg-naid nue-dakded.
Bab-Jehová-nug-odummomalagala, bela we-dulemala danakwaa ambikudmaloed, reymar-negsemamaidi, bela ambikudmaloed.
An gudiidgine, Bab-Dummad, an-ibe an-niga onollomaksad, an-ibagan osikirmaksad.
Agala, an ise-wilegar ega sogded: “An-Bab-Dummadye, mer be an-ibe an-ibagan osikirmakye. Bab-Dummad, ar begardina ibagan geg bergued.
Gebesailaunni, napneg be nasiksad, degi, nibneg-naid be-argangi be nasiksabalid.
We-napnegdina, berguoed, nibnegmoga bergumogoed. Bedina berguosulid. Igi mormar serguddae, deyobi, bela nibneg, degi, napneg, sergudoed. Mormar-ogwalegeyob be ogwaoed. Mormar-milegeyob be imakoed.
Bab-Dummad, bedina amba gannar maid, be-ibagan gwen berguosulid.
Be-nug-odummodimalad-e-mimmigandina, nued-gudii gumaloed. E-waganmala, be-asabinni gudii gumarmogoed.”
Bab-Jehová-nug, an odummoged, Bab-Jehová-nug-isligwaledi, bela an-ganguedbali an odummoged.
Bab-Jehová-nug, an odummoged. Anga ibmar-nuegan-uksad an iegosulid.
Bab-Jehová, bela an-isgusad isgussuliyob daked. Bela bonigangi an-nudaked,
burgwedgi an-ollorsaed. Nue-an-sabed, nue-wile an-daked,
Bab-Dummad bela ibmar-nueganbi anga uked, sulubagi-gannar-ganguddaedyobi an-imaked.
Bab-Jehová, igar-innikigwad-imakedid, dule-baidse-wiledimaladbina urwedid.
Moisésʼga e-igarmar oyosad, Israel-dulemarga e-ibmar-imaksad oyosad.
Bab-Jehová dule-wiledakedid, dule-nuedid, irgwensuli urwesulid, e-sabguedi dummarbad.
Degisadegu urwemai guosulid. Dule-egi-nosale, degisadegu ebinsabalosulid.
Bab-Jehová anmar-isguedba anmar-sabsur-odurdaksulid, anmar-ibmar-isgana-imakedba anmar-sabsur-odurdaksulid.
Ar igi mogir napneggi matusur-nai, debayobi, e-sabgued dulemar-e-nug-odummodimaladgi dummarba nikad.
Ar igi dad-ibeler-nakwed, dad-ibeler-argwanedgi dikasur nai, debayobi, anmar-isgued anmargi obachad.
Ar igi bab na e-mimmigan sabe, debayobi, Bab-Jehová na dulemar-e-nug-odummodidimaladi sabgued.
Ar Bab-Jehová anmar-wisid, anmar ibu gue. Nue wisid, anmardi unnila napa gued.
Dule-dula-gudiguedi gaganyob gued, yog-berguar naddaed. E-ibagan, dutu-achutedaedyob gued.
Ar burwa gornaisale, dutu yoga babatiar naddaed, e-nagusad bar dakledasulid.
Ar Bab-Jehová-e-sabgueddi, degisadeguad. E-nug-odummodimaladgardi, e-sabgued-oyoged berguosulid. Wemar-e-wagangardi, Bab-Dummad-e-igar-innikigwad degisadeguad.
Ebo-Igar-Mesisadba-nanadimaladga, e-Igar-Islidikid-Mesisad-ebinsadimaladga, eba-ibmar-imakdimaladga, Bab-Dummad-e-Igar-innikigwad degisadeguad.
Bab-Jehová e-ologan nibneggi sisad. Bab-Jehová bela neg-dirbir-naidgi dummadga negdakmaid.
Bemar, Bab-Dummad-e-baliwiturmar-dule-bulegan, bemar, Bab-Dummad-sogedba-ibmar-imakmaladi, bemar, e-igar-uksadba-nanadimaladi, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar.
Bemar, bela e-sordamar, ega-arbamalad, e-sogedba-ibmar-imakmalad, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomala.
Bemar, bela ibmar-obinnilesmaladi, bela dummadga-negdakmaidgi, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomala. Bab-Jehová-nug an odummoged.
Bab-Jehová-nug an odummoged. An-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, duledar-gandikid be gued, gandikidba yeerdakleged-mola be yosad, ibiyobi-mola-yeerdakle be yosa.
Mola-dummad-yoiyobi nega-ibegwaledi begi ebirnaid, mola-dummad-nallaa-imaklegeyobi mogir-billi be imaked.
Diigine, be-nega-dummagan-urbega be imaked, mogirmala, be-moli-ur-bila-onomaladga be saed. Bedi burwa-ooreged-birgi-sii nanaed.
Burwamala, be-gayaburba-berbegedga be imaked, soo-gwabunyemaladi, be-maiganga be saed.
Napanega, e-saila-birgi be sisad, e-siidgi, bipisaale gwen bar ainirosulid.
Napanegga e-mor-dummad-naiyobi, muu-billi egi be nasiksad. Diimala, yalamar-birise nagusad.
Diimarse be uludedbali, diimala ilided. Be-dolewala-gollomakedbali, diimala uboded.
Diimala, yalamar-birise engusad, nebagansega diimala ilisbalid. Bia be ega neg-amisa, agi be diimala oambikusbalid.
Dii melle bar napneg-odogega, ega be igar mesisad, adi, a-igarse galegegar.
Bedi, ibe-diimar-ariogwichidi, dianganbali, oiirmakega be saed. Yalaganbali, suurmakega be imaked.
Ibdurgan-sapurbarmaladi, a-dii gobmalad. A-diigine, moli-uayasuid-sapurmar immelemalad.
A-dii-gakabali, sikwimala e-uu urbe damalad. Sapi-anagan-imbabali, nuumala namakbukwa damalad.
Be-nega-akale, yalamar be ogmaid. Be-ibmar-saedbali, napaneg yeer itoged.
Molimarga gagan-ara-aramalad-oniega be imaked, dulega ibmar-durgan-sanmakega be saed. Adi, agi we-masgunned amiega:
Vino-weligwar-emar-saed-amiega, olivo-gwallu-wagar-daarmakar-imaked-amiega, mas-burba-dula-uked-amiega be imakbalid.
Bab-Jehová e-sapimala-urbisadi, sapi-urwarmala Líbano-yargi urbisadi nue-obagwale gwigwichid.
A-sapimargine, nuumala e-uu sobbukwad, e-anagangine, dabgalamar ambikubukwad.
Yala-dummaganbali, sibad-sapurbarmalad bukwad. Akwa-olloganbali, nubimar dukubukwad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, yolamar-nagumaid-magar-daklegega, bee be nii nasiksad. Bee be dad-ibeler e-doged-wisguega be imaksad.
Neg-mutik-imakegala, be negsichidi nasikdaed. Agine, ibmar-durgan sapurba ainiardaed.
Achumigur-nono-wawaamalad e-masbina uurmakdidaed. Bab-Dummadse na e-masgunned egisdidaed.
Dad-ibeler-nakwialile, geb e-neg-olloledyaba gannar dogdedaed.
Geb dulemala, arbaega gwisguardamarmogad, neg-gutulegedse e-arbaed gadapdamalad.
Bab-Jehová, ibiyobi be ibmarmar-imaksadi, ichesur mergue. Be ibmar-wisidbali, bela we-ibmarmar be imaksad. Be ibmar-obinnisadi, bela napneggi nanaid.
Agine muu-billi-dummadi naid, a-yagine ibmar-durgan-bukidar bukwad. Ibmar-durgan-dummagan, ibmar-durgan-bipigana bukwananaed.
Muu-billigine, ulu-dummagan iirmakbukwad, agine, be, baka-dummaganyobid-obinnisadi gudiid, ulu-dummagangi dodogega be obinnisad.
Bela we-ibmar-durgana begi gudidiid, ega be sogedba e-masgunned ukmaid.
Ega be masgunned ukmaid, emardi be-abin gundidiid. Ega be-argan be oyomaid, nue-immeledidiid.
Be wagar-biriar-dakdele, be-abin gwayiddamalad. Be e-annik-mas-susale, burgwiddamalad, gannar napaga binniddamalad.
Be-Burba be barmialile, bela gannarse napneg obinoleddaed. Deyob gannarse napneg naguddaed.
Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-yeerdakleged degisadegusun. Bab-Jehová, e-ibmar-imaksadgi wergusun.
Bab-Dummadi napneg-dakdele, ese napneg wawanmakdedaed. Yalamar-ebudele, waa daasa sigisdaed.
An dula-gudiidgine, Bab-Jehováʼga an namakoed. Amba an dula-gudiidgine, namaklemaladgi an-Bab-Dummadga an namakoed.
Ulubgi-an-egi-binsaedi, Bab-Dummad yeer-itogoed, Bab-Jehováʼgi an weligwar itoged.
Dule-isgudimalad napneggi bergumarsun. Napneggi, dule-isgudimalad bar daklesuli gusun. ¡Bab-Jehová-nug an odummoged! ¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummolesun!
Bab-Jehováʼga dog-nuedye be soge, e-nug be odummomala. Bab-Jehová-ibmar-imaksad be dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamaladga soge.
Be namakmala, Bab-Jehová-e-nug-odummogega be namakmala. Bela e-ibmar-dakledisurmalad-imaksadgi be sunmakmala.
Bab-Jehová-nug-isligwaledgi be san-dummarba itomala. Dulemar-Bab-Jehová-amidimalad ulubgi wergumala.
Bab-Jehová be amimala, e-gangued be amimala. Bab-Jehová-amidigu be imakmala.
Bab-Jehová-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-imaksad be insamalo. E-ibmar-dummagan-imaksad be insamalo. E-igarmar-sogsad be insamalo.
Bemar, Bab-Jehová-mai-Abraham-e-wagan gumalad. Bemar, Jacob-e-wagan gumalad. Bab-Jehová e-dulemarga bemar-imaksad.
Bab-Jehová anmar-Bab-Dummad gued. Bela we-napneggine, Bab-Dummad-e-igarmar oyolemamaid.
Wagan miliba-gwago-inigwele, Bab-Dummad Israel-Dulemarbo-Igar-Mesisadi gwen iegosulid.
Bab-Jehová Abraham-ebo igar-mesisgusad, Isaacʼga ise-sogar-imaksad, an bega a-igar imakedseye.
Bab-Jehová, Jacobʼga igar-mesisgua, Israelʼbo degisadegu igar mesisgua,
ega sogsagusad: “Canaán-yala begadga-guega an bega ukoed.”
Anmar ichee-guen-inigwele, anmar yar-sate gudigusmar-inigwele,
anmar yar-baid-baidgi-gudigusmaladgi, neggwebur-baid-baidgi gudigusmaladgi,
Bab-Jehová, sabsur-anmar-imaklegega gwen imaksasulid. Anmar-ulale, reymarga sabsur-ibmar-sogsad.
Weyob sogsa gusad: “Melle an-dulamar-nugsalegarmaladse achao, melle an-gayaburba-barsogmalad naibi-imako.”
Bab-Jehová, Canaán-yalagi ukud-dummad nasiksad, agi masgunned sate imaksad.
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová, dule-wargwen-Joséʼye-nugad emar-idu Egipto-yalase barmisgusad. José maiga manigi ukles gusad.
Egipto-dulemar José-e-nag esgoro-dubgi edichagusmalad, geb esgaryagi metegusmalad.
José-ibmar-sogsa-gusadba neg-gunonigua, Bab-Dummad agi oyosad, ede idu-ibmar-sogsad, we napiraye.
Geb Egipto-rey sognonigusad, José esgaryagi-siid onomarye. A-rey, deunni, dule-bukidaradga negsemaid.
Rey, José bela e-neggi ega ibmar-dakega onugsanonigusad, bela e-dulemar-e-dummadga-guega imaksad.
Adi, José reyga-arbamalad-dummagan-odurdakega imaksad, e-girmar-selegan-binsaed-nikagued-odurdakega imaksad.
Geb a-sorbali, Israel, Egipto-yalase nonigusad. We-Jacobʼde, Cam-yalagi, e-yarsulidgi maigusad.
Agine, Bab-Jehová, e-dulamar-bukidar-merguega imaksad, e-isdarmaladba bur-dutusuli imaksabalid.
Bab-Jehová, Egipto-dulemar-e-binsaed ogwasad, isdar anmar-dakega imaksad, degisoggu, anmar-wioar gussunnad.
Agine, Bab-Dummad, e-mai-Moisés-susagusadi, Aarón-susagusadi, Egipto-yarse barmiargusad.
Agine, Bab-Dummad, wemar-ebogwad, Cam-yalagi ibmar-dakledisulid-imakega imaksad.
Bab-Jehová, Egiptoʼgi negsichid nasiksagusad, bela neg-gudure imaksagusad, degite, Egipto-dulemar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba itosurgusmalad.
Egipto-diwarmar abega obinnisgusad, e-uamala ogilosgusad.
Bela Egipto-yala ammanoo yaisur-nika imaksad, rey-e-negyaginse-bakar, ammanoomar-nika imaksad.
Bab-Dummad-sunmaksagu, gukurmar-bukidar ainiargusad, bela Egipto-yalagangi, guumar yaisur-nika imaksad.
Dii-wied-anar, dii-gwamakaled-wiega imaksad. Egipto-yalagi mar-dakarmakmai imaksabalid.
Uvaʼmar-digar-bukwadi, higueraʼmar-bukwadi ei obelosgusad. E-yalagangi sapimar-bukwad ei bibichisgusad.
Bab-Dummad sunmakdegua, ses-dummagan onisad. We-sesmarde, bela-bela-mergu batisad.
Sesmar, bela Egipto-yargi gagan-obelosad. Ibmar-durba-e-sanmar, bela obelosbalid.
Bab-Jehová, Egipto-yalagi bela machi-sailaginmalad oburgwisgusad, bela gebesailagi-gwalulesmalad ogilosgusad.
Bab-Jehová, Israel-dulemar or-bukidar-semamai, mani-bukidar-semamai onosgusad. E-dulemar-wargwensaale, gwen-burgwissurgusad.
Egipto-dulemala nue-dobe itomarsoggu, Israel-dulemar ainide-daksamargua, yeer itosgusmalad.
Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemarga mogir nasiksad, adi, a-urba ambikumalagar. Neg-mutik ega neg-mee imakega ega soo ogasad.
Bab-Dummadse mas-egichismargu, nuu-codornizʼye-nugad ega uksagusad. Madu-nibnegginedgi immeles gusmalad.
Ega akwasaila egasgusad, agi dii aryoargusad. Nega-dulesulidganba ega dii aryomai imaksad.
Bab-Dummad deyob imaksadi, e-mai-Abrahamʼga gayaburba-ise-sogar-sogsad gwen iessulid.
Bab-Dummad e-dulamar weligwaledgi onosgusad, ber yeer-itogedgi e-dulamar-susadi onosgusad.
Dulemar-baigan-yala na e-dulamarga uksad. Dulemar-baigan-arbasad-e-ibmar-sanmaksamalad na e-dulamarga uksabalid.
Bab-Jehová, na e-dulamar e-igar-uksadba binsaed-nika-gudi-imakmalaga imaksad, eba nanamalaga imaksabalid. ¡Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová-nuggi wergumarsun!
¡Aleluya! ¡Bab-Dummad-e-nug odummomar! Bab-Jehová-nug dummarba imakmarsun. Bab-Jehováʼga dog-nuedye sogmar. Ar Bab-Dummad, dule-nuedid, e-sabgued, degisadeguad.
¿Doa, Bab-Jehová-e-ibmar-bulegan-imaksad sogedba nabir barsogoe? ¿Doa, Bab-Jehováʼga-namaklegedgi sogedba sunmakoe? Dule barsoged sate.
Dule-igar-inniki-imakdimaladgi, igar-maidba gusgu ibmar-imakdimaladgi nued-binsalesad.
Bab-Jehová, wile be-dulamar be dakalile, wis be angi binsao. Be, be-dulamar-bendakdanikile, mer be an-iemogo.
Adi an, be-dulamar-susa-gudiidba, e-wergudimaladba wergumogoed. Be-dulamar-na-be-nug-imaksa-gudiid-abargi namakmogagala, be an-bendakdage.
Anmar, anmar-dadganyob isgusad, anmar, ibmar-isgana imaksad, anmar, galagwensuli-gudii gusad.
Anmar-dadgan Egipto-yargi-bukwagu, bela aku be-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-imaksad daksamalad. Degi, be-sabgued-dummarbadgi gwen binsassurmarbalid. Aka Demar-Ginnidye-nugad-dikarba begi-yolenai gusmalad.
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová na e-nug-sabed-maidba bendaknonikid, na e-gangued-dummarbad-oyogega deyob imaksad.
Bab-Dummad Demar-Ginnidye-nugadse gotegua, demar argaas naded, geb dinnaa megisad. Bab-Dummad demar-wilasaila-maigusadba, e-dulamar-semai gusad. Neg-dulesulidganba-nadapiyob, e-dulamar-semai gusad.
Bab-Dummad anmar-dadgan-bendaksad, e-isdarmalad-argan-yaurgi-bukwa bendaknonikid.
E-isdarmalad-birgi demar gannar-arwega imaksad, degisoggu, wargwensaale durgussulid, bela burgwismalad.
Geb anmar-dadgan Bab-Dummad-ibmar-imakoye-sogsadgine, bar bengussurgusmalad, agi, Bab-Dummadga namakde gusmalad.
Sikwas ibagan-nasgua, Bab-Dummad-ibmar-imaksad ienonimarbalid. Bab-Dummad-e-igar-imakbied edarbissurmalad.
Anmar-dadgan negsulidganba-gudigua, e-itolegedba ibmar imaksamalad. Wargwen-gudimaladbali, Bab-Dummad-wilubdaksamalad.
Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad, ese-ibmar-egisnanaidba ega ukdesunnad, Bab-Dummad, boni-buled-emar-ogiloged ega barmiarsunnad.
Deunni, negsulidganba gudidimargua, Moisésʼgi nobguargusmalad, Bab-Jehová-nug-imaksad-Aarónʼgi nobguargusmalad.
Geb agine, napa argadgusad, degidbali, Datán napase dolesgusad. Abiramʼye-nugad, degi, e-sordamarse-bakale, napa-yaba barmellede gusmarmogad.
We-dulemardi, soose bergus gusmalad. Bela-we-dule-isganamar soose gummaksa gusmalad.
Anmar-dadgan, Horeb-yargi, moli-bebe-nikad-sapingwagwad e-bab-dummadga-imakegala, sobsagusmalad. Bormo-sobaled-asabin dulluu imaknanai gusmalad.
Bab-Dummad-e-nug-odummoleged-anar, moli-bebe-nikad-gagan-maed-sobaled-e-nug odummodmalad.
E-Bab-Dummad-e-abonosaddi iedemalad, Egipto-yargi ega ibmar-gegerdakleged-imaksad bela iedemalad.
Cam-yar-naidgi, Bab-Dummad ega ibmar-dakledisulid-imaksad bela iedemalad. Demar-Ginnidye-nugad-dikarba, ega ibmar-bulegan-imaksad, iedemarbalid.
Ar Bab-Dummad Israel-dulemar-oburgwedgi binsasanad. Degi-inigwele, Moisés, Bab-Dummadgadga-nug-imaklesadi, wemar-irwa Bab-Dummad-asabin gwisgusad. Agala, Moisés wis Bab-Dummad-barganonikid, adi, Israel-dulemar, mer Bab-Dummadse ibitomalagar.
Deginbali, napneg-nued-ega-uklesadi, isdar-daksamarbalid. Bab-Dummad-ega-ibmar-imakoye-sogsadgi, bengusmarbalid.
Ar Bab-Jehová-ega-ibmar-sogsadba ibsassurmalad, aka e-dordonegyaba uurmakbukwa gusmalad.
Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad amargi yolenonisunnad. Adi, negasulidganba sabsur-odurdaklemalagar.
Adi, e-wagan dule-bamaladse sabsur-wilemalagar. Degi, yar-akar-akar-bukwadba mimilemalaga imaksad.
Baal-Peorʼye-nugad na-e-bab-dummadga imaksamarbalid. Bab-dummagan-burbasulidga ibmar-ukleged guchamarbalid.
E-ibmar-isgana-imakedbali, Bab-Jehová-nue-oulusmalad. Degisoggu, boni-dummad ega nagunonisunnad.
Agine, Finees igar-innikigwad imaknonikid, geb bonigan bargalenonikid.
Finees we-ibmar-nued-imaksadbali, degisadegu, egi nued-binsalemai gulesunnoed.
Meriba-dii-naid-dikarba, Bab-Jehová-oulusmarbalid. We-dulemar-nukad Moisésʼga neg isgunonikid.
Moisés-surbinsa-itogega imaksamalad, abali, Moisés bar-nue-binsassuli ibmar-soge-soge sunmaknai gusad.
Bab-Jehová ega sogsa gusanad, dulemar-bamalad-bukwad oburgwemaloye. Degi-inigwele, eba ibsassurmalad, oburgwissurmalad.
Aka e-dulesurmaladba apurudmalad, a-ibmar-imakmaladba akadmalad.
Dule-baigan-e-bab-dummagan-e-nug odummodmalad. Degisoggu, we-ibmar egi aibinnonisunnad.
Niamarga e-bunamala, e-masmala, oburgwenanai guarmalad.
Dule-ibmar-okalodisulid-e-ablis eosmalad, a-e-masmala-e-ablis eosmalad, a-e-bunamala-e-ablis eosmarbalid. Canaán-dulemar-e-bab-dummaganga amar-oburgwenanai guarmalad. Degidbali, ablis-aryosad-ular, napneg isgunonikid.
Weyob neg-imaksamaladbali, neg isgunonikid, bela isgunonimarsunnad.
Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová e-dulemargi nue-uluded, isdar e-dulemar-sunonikid-dakdesunnad.
Agala, Israel-dulesurmaladga urmaknonikid, e-isdarmaladse nilebukwa gusmarsunnad.
E-isdarmaladse sabsur-imaklebukwa guarmalad, amarse apor-imakledii gusmarsunnad.
Bab-Jehová bukidargus Israel-dulemar-bendakdii gusanad. Degi-inigwele, emardi, Bab-Dummadgi bur bule yoledgusmalad. Degidbali, isguedgi bur bule nanadmarsunnad.
Bab-Dummad e-dulamar-surbinsa-itonanai-dakdegua, gormaknanaid-itononigua,
e-dulamarbo-igar-mesisad ebinsaded. Sabbarsoggua, wile dakded.
Bab-Dummad, Israel-dulemar-e-isdarmalad Israel-dulemar-wiledakega imaksabalid.
Anmar-Bab-Jehováʼye, anmar-bendakdage, anmar-yar-baid-baidgi-mimiles-bukwadgi gannar be anmar-yarse be anmar-barmide, adi, anmar be-nug-isligwaled odummogega, weligwaledgi bega namakegar.
Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-nug dummarba gusun. ¡Degisadegu, e-nug odummolesun! Bela dulemar weyob sogmar: “¡Napira deyob gusun!” ¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar!
Bab-Jehováʼga dog-nuedye sogmala, ar edi, dule-nuedid. E-sabgued, degisadeguad.
Bab-Jehováʼse-abonolesmalad, Bab-Jehováʼse-e-isdarmalad-ganguedgi-bela-bela-bendaklesmalad,
Bab-Jehová bela-Israel-dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwad senonikid: Dad-nakwedsikmalad, dad-argwanedsikmalad, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikmalad, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikmalad. Amar Bab-Jehováʼga dog-nuedye sogmala, ar edi, dule-nuedid. E-sabgued, degisadeguad.
Dulemar-abala nega-dulesulidganba yoggus gaamakdii gusmalad. Neggwebur-megdapmaloedse-momalaga, gwen igar-amisuli-gudii gusmalad.
Na mas-gunbigudii gusmalad, uku-uku-itodii gusmarbalid, gwen san-bar-onoged itossurmalad.
Geb surbinsa-itogusmaladba Bab-Jehováʼse gochamalad, geb Bab-Jehová e-wiledimaladgi bendaknonikid.
Bab-Jehová neggwebur-megdapmaloedse-momalaga, igar-innikigwadba idumai gusad.
Dule-nue-wiledakmaid-ulale, Bab-Jehováʼga doggus-nuedye be sogmala. Dulemarga-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-imakdiid-ulale, Bab-Jehováʼga doggus-nuedye be sogmala.
Bab-Jehová dule-uku-uku-itodimaladga ukud obeloged. Dule-ukudmaad-itodimaladga bur mas-nued uked.
Abala nue-wile-itobukwa, emar-maiga-bukwa gusmalad. Negasichidgi, burgwednaga-bukwa gusmalad.
Ar Bab-Jehová-Bur-Birigined-igar-sogsadba ibsassurmalad. Ar Bab-Jehová-binsaed-uked isdar itosmalad.
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová arbaed-dummad ega urmaksad, aimukumai gusmalad, dule gwen bendaksasulid.
Geb surbinsa-itogusmaladba Bab-Jehováʼse gochamalad. Geb Bab-Jehová, e-wiledimaladgi bendaknonikid.
Negasichidgi-burgwednaga-bukwamaladgi onosad, emar-maiga-gudidiidgi onosad.
Dule-nue-wiledaked-ulale, Bab-Jehováʼga doggus-nuedye be sogmala. Dulemarga-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-imakdiid-ulale, Bab-Jehováʼga doggus-nuedye be sogmala.
Ar yawagakmar-esgoro-gordikidgi-sobaled bibichisad, yawagak-edimalad-esgorobiid ubi-ubi imaksad.
Anmar-dadgan Bab-Jehová-Igar-Sogsadba gwen ibmar-imaksasurmarsoggu, binsaed-satedyob gusmalad. Ibmar-isgana-imaked-ulale, wiledii gusmalad.
Bela ibmar-gullemaladi ega aged ukdaed. Bato e-bergued-ibagan ese warmaksa itosgusad.
Geb surbinsa-itogusmaladba Bab-Jehováʼse gochamalad. Geb Bab-Jehová, e-wiledimaladgi bendaknonikid.
Bab-Dummad na e-sunmakedba dulemar-nudaksad, deyobi, burgwedgi bendaksad.
Dule-nue-wiledaked-ulale, Bab-Jehováʼga doggus-nuedye be sogmala. Dulemarga-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-imakdiid-ulale, Bab-Jehováʼga doggus-nuedye be sogmala.
Bab-Jehováʼga doggus-nuedye-sogleged-ibmar-ukleged be ukmala, weligwaledgi e-ibmar-imaksad be sogmala.
Dulemar muu-billi-dummaganba mani-amiegala, muu-billiba urgi nanadimalad.
Wemala, Bab-Jehová-e-ibmar-imaksad daksamalad. Muu-billi-wilasailadgi e-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-imaksad daksamalad.
Bab-Dummad e-sunmakedba burwa binnasur ogochad, demardi bela-bela dunguded.
Urdi mogirmar-naidse nakwiddaed, muu-billi-wilaganse gannar aidenonidabalid. Ar dulemardi burgwe-itomaladba niga-argwatemalad.
Mummuyobi banamakdidii guarmalad. Aimukumamai guarmalad. E-ibmar-wisidi binsa-wismalad, gwen e-bendaksasulid.
Geb surbinsa-itogusmaladba Bab-Jehováʼse gochamalad, geb Bab-Jehová e-wile-itomaladgi bendaknonikid.
Bab-Dummad burwa-dummad bogidik imaksad, demar bipii imaksabalid.
Ar burwa-bogiledgua, dulemar yeer itosmalad. Deyobi, Bab-Jehová ur-naguedse dulemar-sesad.
Dule-nue-wiledaked-ulale, Bab-Jehováʼga doggus-nuedye be sogmala. Dulemarga-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-imakdiid-ulale, Bab-Jehováʼga doggus-nuedye be sogmala.
Bemar, dulemar-onmakbukwad-abargi, Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummomala. Girmar-dummagan-danar-bukwad-abargi, e-nug odummomala.
Bab-Dummadi, e-dulamar-ichakwadamalad-ular, diwarmar nega-dulesulidganga obinnisad, dianmar neg-dinnaganaga obinnisbalid.
Bab-Dummadi, e-dulamar-ichakwadamalad-ular, napa-gadi-ibmar-sanmakedi, napa-ichakwaga imaksad.
Bab-Dummad nega-dulesulidgan diimarga obinnisad, neg-dinnagwad dianmarga obinnisad.
Agi dulemar-uku-uku-itodimalad urbisad, geb we-dulemar megmalaga negmar sobsamalad.
Nainumargi ibmar-gwag digsamalad, uva-dubmar digsamarbalid. A-ibmardi ega bela-bela sanmaksad.
Bab-Dummad we-dulemargi nued-binsasad, e-dulamar mergudmalad, e-molimar merguega imaksabalid.
Ar e-dulemar icheleddibe, ibgwensur-imakleddibe, mesagwar-imaklebukwad-ular, deyob guoed. Sabsur-imaklebukwad-ular, nue-wilebukwad-ular, deyob guoed.
Bab-Dummad dulemar-nue-nug-nikamalad ibgwensur-daked, nega-dulesulidganba gaamakdii imaked.
Ar Bab-Dummad, dule-wilegeddi na e-wilediidgi onoged. E-gwenadgan, sibad-wawaad-mergueyobi, bukidar-nika imaked.
Dule-nuegan weyob-ibmar-dakoedba weligwar itomaloed. Ar dule-isganamardi, bar-sunmakosurmalad.
Ar dule, binsaed-ibedile, we-ibmar gwagegi sedii guoed, Bab-Jehová-e-sabgued magar itogoed.

Bab-Dummad, an-gwage guagwar-naid, an bega namaklemaladgi an namakoed, ar we, an-gandikidga gued.
¡Gar-arpa, gar-salterio be atakmala! Iba-gwapid-onodedga ogolega an imakoed.
Bab-Jehová, an be-nug neggweburmar-abargi odummogoed. Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwad-abargi an bega namaklemaladgi namakoed.
Be-sabgued nibneg-naidba bur-dummarba gued. Be-innikidaed nibnegse warmaknaid.
Bab-Dummad, bedi nibneggi maid. Gandikidba-be-yeerdakleged bela napneg-ebilis naid.
Bab-Dummad, be-neggwebur-be-nue-sabed-bendakega, be anmar-bendake, be anmar-abinsae.
Bab-Dummad e-neg-islidikid-akale sogsad: “Weligwaledgi an Siquem-neggwebur mimioed, weligwaledgi an Sucot-neba-naid ilemakoed.
Galaad-yala, angadi gued, Manasés-yala, angadi gued, Efraín-yala, an-bormo-gurginga gued, Judá-yala, an-gaapoledga gued.
Moab-yala, an-argan-enukedga gued, Edom-yargi, an-sapat bikiin an metoed, Filistea-sordamargi-nakwisadba, gandikidba an gormakoed.”
¿Doa, neggwebur-gandikidse an-idugoe? ¿Doa, anga Edom-yarse-aibillemaid oyogoe?
Bab-Dummad, ¿bee be anmar-obachagussursi? Bab-Dummad, bar be anmarga sorda-bila-onomalad-bendakdisurgusad.
Dule-isdarmaladgi-nakwega be anmar-imake. Ar dulemar anmar-bendakele, gwen anmarga igarga guosulid.
Unnila, Bab-Dummadbali, anmar, anmar-isdarmaladgi nakoed. E anmarga, anmar-isdarmalad obelogoed.
Bab-Dummad, an be-nug ogannoged. Melle be an-abin-imaksuli gue.
Dule-isganamar, dule-gakansamalad, angi gakansaar sunmakdimalad. Gakansaedgi an-nug oichodimalad.
Sae-an-dakmaladbali, sunnasur angi sunmakdimalad. Binsarsunna angi yolenanaid.
Andi, we-dulemar-nue-sabed, degite, emardi angi yolenanaid. Bab-Dummad, andi emarga bese gorsii daed.
Andi, ibmar-nued ega imaked, emardi, ibmar-isgana anga imaked. Andi, wemar-sabed, emardi, sae-an-daked.
Bab-Dummad, we-dulemarga-igar-nabogega, dule-isgana ega be ogwiche, dule-e-bendaknaid egi aibined be imake.
Ega igar-nabolealir, we-dulegi isgusye-sogleged be imake, bese-goledse-bakar, ega isguedga-guega be imake.
Gwae be oburgwe. Dule-baid ei arbaed-sued be imake.
E-mimmigan, bab-sate be imake. E-ome, suisuli be imake.
E-mimmigan, neg-sate be imake. Dule-baiganse mani-egisdii be imake. E-neg-bibisgar-siidgi ononnoged be imake.
Dule-ega-idu-mani-ukdidaed, bela ei ibmar-seled be imake. Na e-ibmargi-arbasad, ei dule-baigan-suega be imake.
Dule-baigan we-dule-wiledaksuli be imake. Dule-baid bipisaale e-mimmigan-sergan-sated, melle wiledaked be imake.
E-wagan bela be ogiloge. Dulemar we-dulemar-bela-ieged be imake.
Bab-Jehová, e-bab-ibmar-isgana-imakdigusad, mer be iego, e-nan-isgudigusad, melle be iebalo.
Bab-Jehová, melle e-isgued be iego. We-napneggi, dulemar we-dule-ieged be imake.
Ar we-dulede, dule-baigan-baisur-daksa gusad. Dule-wilegana-baregindii gusad, dule-ibmarbina-sogdimalad-baregindii gusad. Dule-gwage-naibi-itodiid-baregindii gusad. We-dulemar-oburgwedse baregindii gusad.
Ar aimar-ukabsaed yeer itodasoggu, dulemar-baigan e-ukabsamosun. Ar egi nued-binsaed abessursoggu, melle egi nued binsamarsun.
Dule, emar-ukabsaedi na e-mor-dummadyob ega gusun. Emar-ukabsaedi, dii-goblegeyob egi ubosun. Emar-ukabsaedi, ina-abagalaganse-ubogeyob ega gusun.
We-ukabsaedi, e-mor-dummadyobi gusun. Sadergi-molidub-guur-naiyob egi nagubarsun.
Weyobi, Bab-Jehová an-isdarmalad imaksun, weyobi, dulemar-sunnasur-angi-sunmakdimalad imaksun.
Bab-Jehová, bee be an-Dummadid, Be-nug-dummarba-nikadba wile be an-dake, dule-angi-sunmakdimaladgi be an-onoge, ar be-sabgued dummarba gued.
An wilegedid, an ibmar-sate gudiid, ulubgi ise-nue-naibi an itoged.
Binna-binna neg-gutulemaiyobi, an nolloo gumaid, ses burwa-goledba-seled-daedyobi, an selemaid.
An mas-gunsulidba an gaaragusad. An mas-gunsulidba an-yokor nue-nollogusad.
Dulemar an-dakalile, angi dodoardamalad, anga alliardamalad.
An-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼye, be an-bendake. Sabgued-dummarba-nikadba be an-bendake.
Bab-Jehováʼye, magar-itogega be dulemar-imake, ar bee be we-ibmar imaksad.
Be angi ise-nued binsae. Ar emardi an-ukabsaele, akarsulid. An-isdarmaladdi be obingegsae, andi be-maiga-guedi, weligwar-itoge be an-imake.
¡An-isdarmaladdi be dummad-obingegsae! ¡Bela-belad-bingeguega be imake!
Bab-Jehová-e-nug an-gayagi an odummogoed. Dule-bukidar-abargi be-nug an ogannogoed.
Ar dule-isgana dule-wilegana-oburgweye-sokalile, bee be dulemar-wilegana bendakdaed. A-ulale, be-nug an odummogoed.
Bab-Jehová an-Dummadga sogsad: “An-argan-nuedsik be sige, be-isdarmalad an bela ogalakuedse be sige.”
Bab-Jehová Sión-yar-akale, bega be-negsemaid-e-gargangued oyononikoed: Be-isdarmalad-be-urbalikwaa-nanaega, be imako.
Be-sordamala bila-onoleged-ibagi, sogedbali guakwaa bukumaloed, ilekwaa yeerdakle ambikumaloed. Bolegoedba boo-bateyobi, be-niga bega gannolemai-gannolemai guoed.
Bab-Jehová ise-sogar-imaksad e-sogsad bar ogwaosulid: “Be, Bab-Dummad-asabin Dule-Irwa-Gwisgued-Dummad-Degisadeguadid. Igi Melquisedec maigusa, deyob be gumogad.”
Bab-Jehová, Dule-Dummad be-argan-nuedsik siid. Sabsur-urwenonikoed-e-ibagi reymar-mamaid ese ibitomaloed.
Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad ese odurdaklemaloed. Muimar bukidar-omiledmaloed. Napneggi-dulemar-bukwad bela ese ibitolemaloed.
Igarbali, rey, dian-aryomaid goboed, degidba, e-niga gangunonikoed.
Dulemar-abargi, dule-nueganbo an bela-bela gwagegi Bab-Jehová-nug odummogoed.
Bab-Jehová-e-ibmarmar-imaksad doggus dungued, we-ibmarbina-itogerbamaladi, egi nergumalad.
Na e-ibmar-imaksad doggus gangu-dakleged, doggus yeerdakleged, na e-Igar-innikigwad degisadegu-maigu guoed.
Bab-Dummad, e-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-imaksad, degisadegu ebinsamalaga imaked. Bab-Jehová nued-binsaedgi-dulemar-bendakedid, dule-wiledakedid.
Bab-Dummad dulemar-e-nug-odummodimaladga mas uked, na Ebo-Igar-Mesisad degisadegu ebinsaed.
Na e-dulamarga e-ibmar-imaksadgi e-gangued oyosad. Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad-e-yar ega uksadba, e-gangued oyosad.
Na e-ibmar-imaksad, napiragwadid, innikigwadid. Bela e-Igar-Islidikid-Mesisad egi bengulesulid.
E-Igar-Mesisad degisadegu gangu maid, gege gwaged, napiragwadgi, innikigwadgi mesisad.
Bab-Dummad na e-dulemar-galebukwad ollor-imaksad. Degisadegu na ebo Igar mesisad. ¡E-nug-isligwaled, bur gannarbadid!
Bab-Jehová-dobee-nanaedgi binsaed-ibed-guedi danikid. Bab-Jehová-Igar-Mesisadba-ibmar-imakdimalad nue-ibmar-wisi gumalad. ¡Bab-Jehová-nug degisadegu odummoledii guoed!
¡Aleluya! ¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummolesun! Dule Bab-Jehová-dobee-nanadiidgi, Bab-Jehová nued binsasad. Dule Bab-Igar-Mesisadba bela-belad yeer-itodiidgi, Bab-Jehová nued binsasad.
Napneggi e-wagan dule-gandikidga guoed, dule-gwage-innikimalad-e-anagangi ise-nued-binsalegoed.
E-neggi ibmar-nuegan-bukidar-nika guoed, e-Igar-Inniki-Imaked degisadeguoed.
We-dulede, dule-innikidaedsoggu, wile-dule-dakdaedsoggu, itoakwaa-ibmar-imakedsoggu, dule-nueganga negasichidgi neg-meegwadyob gued.
Dule-nued-daedi, emarga obinagwar ibmar-ukedid. Igar-innikigwadba e-ibmar-baklemaid semaid.
Bipisaale gwen-galakuosulid dule-nued-daedi, degisadegu ebinsalegoed.
Garda-isganamar-itoalile, dobee itogosulid. E-gwagegi baisur-itogoed, Bab-Dummadgi bensuli guoed.
Na e-ulubgi gandik itogoed, dobee itogosulid. E-isdarmalad ese galakusad na dakoed.
E-ibmar-nikadi, dule-wilemaladga mimied. E-Igar-Inniki-Imaked degisadegu maigu guoed. E-ganguedi, gandikidba-yeerdakle ogannolegoed.
Deyob dule-isgudiid we-ibmar dakoed, na sae-itodoed, nugar-gormai na bergudoed. Dule-isgudiid-e-ibmar-abegedi bela bergudoed.
¡Aleluya! ¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummolesun! Bab-Dummad-Jehová-e-maimar, Bab-Jehováʼse be gormar, Bab-Jehová-nug be odummomar.
Emi-iba-akale, Bab-Jehová-nuggi degisadegu nued-binsalesun.
Dad-nakwed-akar, dad-argwanedse, Bab-Jehová-nugdi dummarba gusun.
Bab-Jehová bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwad semaid, Nibneggi e-gangued-yeerdakleged bur dummarba gued.
Anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-nibneggi-maidyobi, dule sated.
Bab-Jehová, e-maid-akale, nibneg dakmaid, napneg dakmaibalid.
Bab-Jehová, dule-wileged e-wilediidgi bendakdaed, Bab-Dummad, dule-ibmar-abesa-gudiid e-ibmar-abediidgi bendakdaed.
Adi, neggwebur-e-dummagan-abargi siegar. Dule-nuga-nikamalad-abargi siegar.
Ome geg mimmi-bakedi, nabir mimmi-bake imaked, nabir neguya-nika imaked. ¡Aleluya! ¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummolesun!
Israel-dulemar Egipto-yargi nosmargua, Judá-yar Babse-goled-negga gunonikid.
