Jacob-wagan dule-baigan-yargi-bukwa nosmargua, Israel-yar-naid bela Bab-Dummadgadga gunonikid.
Demar-naid Israel-dulemar-dakdegua, Israel-dulemar-abin argaded. Jordán-diwar-ariomaid e-abin gales megisad, bar aryossulid.
Sibad-wawaad-macheredyob yar-dummagan ichomakded, sibad-wawaad-mimmiganyob yar-senigana ichomakdemalad.
Demar, ¿ibiga be argade? Jordán-diwar, ¿ibiga be gales-megismoga?
Bemar yar-bukwamaladi, ¿ibiga bemar sibad-wawaad-macheredyob ichomakdemala? Bemar yar-senigana, ¿ibiga bemar sibad-wawaad-mimmiganyob ichomakdemarmoga?
Napneg-naid, Bab-Jehová-asabin be giglimake, Jacob-e-Bab-Dummad-asabin be giglimake.
Ar Bab-Jehová akwasaila dii-siedga imaksad, akwasailagi dii-aryomai imaksad.
Bab-Jehová, be-nug-odummolegega bega namakleged. Anmar-nug-odummolegega namaklesulid. Be dule-wiledakedba, be ibmar-innikigwad-sogedba, a-ular, bega namakleged.
Ar ibiga dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad anmarga sogoe: “¿Bia be-Bab-Dummad nadsunna?”
Anmar-Bab-Dummad nibneggi maid, ar ibi na imakbigusa, bela imaksad.
Dule-baigan ibmarmar-e-bab-dummadga-imakbukwadi, manigi sobaled, orgi sobaled, dulemar e-argangi sobsananaed.
We-ibmardi, gaya nikamalanad, degite, sunmaksurmalad. Ibya nikamalanad, degite, aku-atakmalad.
Uaya nikamalanad, degite, itosurmalad. Asu nikamalanad, degite, ibmar-yapanned usurmalad.
Argan nikamalanad, degite, ibmar ebusurmalad. Nag nikamalanad, degite, nanasurmalad. E-dolewar nikamalanad, degite, ibmar-soggwensaar bisurmalad.
E-sobmalad, deyobi gumarmogad, bela-egi-bengusurmalad, deyobi gumarmogad.
Israel-dulemar, ¡mer Bab-Jehováʼgi bengumala! Na e be-bendaked gued, be-sigu-abgaedga gued.
Aarón-wagan, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, ¡mer Bab-Jehováʼgi bengumala! Na e be-bendaked gued, be-sigu-abgaedga gued.
Bab-Jehová-urbali-gudimalad, ¡mer Bab-Jehováʼgi bengumala! Na e be-bendaked gued, be-sigu-abgaedga gued.
Bab-Jehová anmar-ebinsaed, anmargi nued binsaed, Israel-dulemargi nued binsaed, Aarón-wagangi nued binsaed.
Bab-Jehová, e-urbali-gudimaladgi nued binsaed, dule-nuga-nikamaladgi nued binsaed, dule-binsarmaladgi nued binsabalid.
Bab-Jehová bemarga bur bule mimmigan-mergumai imaksun, be-waganga mimmigan-mergumai imakbarsun.
Bab-Jehová-nibneg-obinnisadi, bemargi nued-binsaena gadin. Bab-Jehová-napneg-obinnisadi, bemargi nued-binsaena gadin.
Nibneg, Bab-Jehováʼgadid. Napnegdi, Bab-Jehová dulemarga uksad.
Dule-burgwarmalad Bab-Jehová-nug odummosurmalad. Dulemar-neg-urba-diglesmamaidi, Bab-Jehová-nug odummosurmalad.
Ar anmardi, emi-akale, Bab-Jehová-nug degisadegu odummodii gumaloed. ¡Aleluya! ¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummolesun!
Bab-Jehováʼbina, an bela-belad soged. An-ese-wilesakwaa-goledi an-itoged.
Ar Bab-Dummad an-itodasoggu, bane-bane an burgwedse ese gordii guoed.
Burgwed-igar nue an-ebiris nagusad. Burgwarmalad-meged-galu anbina nue-itos naid. Degidbali, surbinsa an itoded, gwage-nunmak an itonaded.
Degidgine, Bab-Jehováʼse an goted: “Bab-Jehováʼye, wis be an-bendakye.”
Bab-Jehová, wile-dule-dakedid, dule-innikidaedid. Anmar-Bab-Dummad, ise-wile-dule-dakedid.
Bab-Jehová, dule-belagwadamalad akwemaid. An nue-bela-maidgi, an-abonosad.
Emigindi, an bar bukib-binsaosulid, gwage-bogidik-gudii guoed. Ar Bab-Jehová angi nued binsasad.
Bab-Jehová, bee be burgwedgi an-san-burba-onosad, an-ibyanis be elisad, galagwensuli-gudiidgi be an-onosad.
Degisoggu, dule-bukwamalad-abargi, Bab-Jehová-asabin an gudii guoed.
An nue-bukib-itodiiye an sog-inigwele, amba an Bab-Dummadgi bensulid.
An sulibinsa-itogedgi an sogsad: Bela dulemar gakansaedbiiye.
Bab-Jehová bela-belad angi nued-binsasadi, ¿ibugi an bennukoe?
Unnila abonolesad-ular, Bab-Jehováʼga dog-nuedye-sogega, noggi an vino ukoed. Unnila Bab-Jehová-nuggi an goloed.
Unnila Bab-Jehováʼga an ibmar-imakoye ise-sogar-sogsadi, bela dulemar-asabin an imakoed.
Bab-Jehová dule-eba-nanaimalad-burgwedi bela-bela yeer daked, ega ibnuedid.
Bab-Jehová, ani an be-maiga gued. An be-machi-innikigwadid, an be-maiga gudiid. Galessiidgi be an-ollor-imaksad.
Bab-Jehová, an bega doggus-nuedye-sogega, ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged ukoed. Bab-Jehová, be-nuggi an goloed.
Bab-Jehováʼga an ibmar-imakoye ise-sogar-sogsadi, bela e-dulamar-asabin an imakoed.
Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-imbagi an imakoed, Jerusalén-neggwebur-abargi an imakoed. Aleluya, ¡Bab-Dummad-nug odummolesun!
Bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwad, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar. Bela dulemar-baid-baid-danar-danar-bukwamalad, Bab-Jehová-nug ogannomar.
Ar Bab-Jehová bela-bela anmar-sabed. Ar Bab-Jehová-ibmar-soged, guedsegad. ¡Aleluya! ¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummolesun!
Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummomar. Ar Bab-Jehová dule-nuedid. Ar Bab-Jehová-e-sabgued, degisadeguad.
Israel-dulemar, emisgi be sogmala: “Bab-Dummad-e-sabgued, degisadeguye.”
Aarón-e-wagan, emisgi be sogmala: “Bab-Dummad-e-sabgued, degisadeguye.”
Bab-Jehová-dobekwaa-gudimalad, emisgi be sogmala: “Bab-Dummad-e-sabgued, degisadeguye.”
An bonigan-abalagi-gudiidgi, Bab-Jehováʼse an gochagusad. An gochagua, an-abin-imaksad, neg-olloledgi an-ogwisgunonikid.
Bab-Jehová anba gudiid, degisoggu, an ibmar dobsulid, ar dule akar an-imakosulid.
Bab-Jehová anba gudiid, ar nue-an-bendakdiid. Degisoggu, isdar-an-dakdimalad, napayala-baparmakdii an dakoed.
Dulemargi-bensuliguedba bur Bab-Jehováʼgi-bengusuligued abeleged.
Dule-nug-nika-gudimaladgi-bensuliguedba bur Bab-Jehováʼgi-bengusuligued abeleged.
Dulemar-yar-baid-baidginmalad an-ebiris gusmalanad, degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová-nuggi anse ogilolesmalad.
Bela an-ebirismalanad, degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová-nuggi anse ogilolesmalad.
Burmaryobi an-ebirismalanad, degi-inigwele, gagan-soogi-gummakeyob anse gusmalad. Bab-Jehová-nuggi anse ogilolesmalad.
An-egwanmalagala, sabesuli an-barmete gusmalanad, degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová an-bendaknonikid.
Ar Bab-Jehová an-niga-gandikidga gued, an-namakedga gued. Ar Bab-Jehová an-abonogedid.
Dule-inniki-gudimalad, weligwaledgi oimakdemalad, bendaklenonimaladba e-neg-e-neggi weyob binnasur-gotemalad: “Bab-Jehová e-garganguedgi ibmar-bulegan imaked.
Bab-Jehová-e-gargangued, biriginedid. Bab-Jehová-e-gargangued ibmar-bulegan imaked.”
An burgosulid, an dula-gudii guoed. Bab-Jehová-ibmar-imaksad-barsogega an dula-gudii guoed.
Bab-Jehová undar-naibi an-imaksad, degi-inigwele, an-oburgwissurgusad.
Anga yawagak egamar, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-e-yawagak anga egamar, Bab-Jehová-nug-odummogegala, agi an dogoed.
We, Bab-Jehová-e-yawagak gued, agi dule-inniki-gudimaladbi dogmaloed.
Bab-Jehová, be an-abin-imaksasoggu, an bega dog-nuedye soged, ar be an-abonosad.
Akwa dule-neg-sobmaladse-oballesadi, neg-sobleged-e-akwasailaga gunonikid.
Bab-Jehová deyob we-ibmar imaknonikid, anmarga geger-dakle gunonikid.
We-ibagi Bab-Jehová anmarga ibmar imaksad, ¡anmar egi wergumarsun, yeer-itomarsun!
Bab-Jehováʼye, wilesakwaa an bese gornaid, be anmar-abonoge. Bab-Jehová, anmar-onasguega be anmar-imake.
Bab-Jehová-nuggi-dule-danikid, Bab-Jehová egi nued-binsasun. Bab-Jehová-e-neg-akale, anmar ega sogsun: “Bab-Jehová begi nued-binsasunye.”
Bab-Jehová, Bab-Dummadid. Anmarga gwallu-meegwadyobi gued. Igarba bipirmaknamalo, sapi-e-anagan semamai gumalo, Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi moli-bebeyob-nonaidse sedmalo.
Bab-Jehová, ar be an-Bab-Dummadid, agala, an bega dog-nuedye soged. Bab-Jehová, ar be an-Bab-Dummadid, agala, an be-nug-odummoged.
Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummomar, ar Bab-Jehová, dule-nuedid, ar Bab-Jehová-e-sabgued, degisadeguad.
Dulemar-inniki-nanadimalad, Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maidba nanadimalad. Amargi, Bab-Jehová, ise-nued binsaed.
Dulemar-Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba-gudimaladi, bela-bela-ulubgi-be-amidimaladi, amargi, Bab-Jehová, be ise-nued binsaed.
We-dulemar, bipisaale ibmar-isgana imakdisurmalad, unnila, Bab-Dummad-Igarbarbi nanadimalad.
Bee be Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaid mesisad, adi, a-sogedba nanamalagar.
Be-Igar-Mamaidba an nanadiguega, bitigi bela-bela eba an innikii nanadii gusana gadin.
Bela Be-Igar-Islidik-Mesisadba an nanaele, an binge-itogosulid.
Be-Igar-Inniki-Nabolemalad-Mamaid an durdaksale, an innikigwadbali ulubgi be-ogannogoed.
¡Be-Igar-Mamaid-Sogedba, an nanaoed! ¡Bipisaale melle be an-iego!
¿Igi-sapingwa melle-isguega, na nuekwaa nanadii guergebe? Unnila, Be-Gayaburba-Maidbarbi nanadii guergebed.
An gwage-ulubgi bela-belad, an be-amidiid. Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaidgi, melle aibanega be an-imako.
Melle begi-isguegala, Be-Gayaburba an-gwage-ulubgi an na sediid.
¡Bab-Jehová, be-nug-odummolesun! ¡Be-Igar-Mamaidgi be an-odurdake!
Igar-Megisadba bela be ibmar-sogsadi, dulemarga an sogsad.
Bela ibmar-nikadba bur bule Be-Igar-Mamaidba-nanadiidgi an weligwar itodiid.
Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaidgi an binsaoed, Be-Igarbarbi an nue-nanadii guoed.
Be-Igar-Mamaidgi an weligwar itogoed. Bipisaale, an Be-Gayaburba gwen iegosulid.
An be-mai-guedi, nue-wile be dakdii guo, deyobi, an nabir gudii guoed, be-Gayaburba-sogedba an nanadii guoed.
Be-Igar-Biriginmalad-Mamaid, magar-itogega be an-imake.
We-napneggine, an dule-baid gued, melle angi Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaid be odukue.
Bane-bane an Be-Igar-Nabolemalad bei-durdakbiedbali, an yaisur-itoged.
Dule-san-dummarba-imakmaladse be urwemaid. Dule-isganamar, Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaidgi-banguder, ega be sabsur-ibmar soged.
Melle we-dulemar isdar-an-dakmalaga, be imako. Melle ibgwensur-an-samalaga be imako, Ar an Be-Igar-Mamaidba an nanadiid.
Dule-gandikmalad angi ichakwa-sunmakmar-inigwele, andi be-mai-guedi, Be-Igar-Mamaidginbi binsadii guoed.
Be-Igar-Mamaid, weligwar an-imaked, anga binsaed-ukedid.
An san bela-itoged, Be-Anga-Ibmar-Sogsadba be an-ogannoge.
An-gudiidgi an bega sunmaksagua, be an-abin-imaksad. ¡Be-Igar-Mamaidgi be an-odurdake!
Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaidi, magar-itogega be an-imake, adi, be-ibmar-gegerdaklemaladgi an binsaegar.
An ulubgi wile-itogedba bodiid, degisoggu, Be-Gayaburbagi baisur-itogega be an-imake.
Gakan-igarmargi mer-nanaega be an-imake. Be-wile-dule-dakmaidba Be-Igar-Nuegan-Maidgi be an-odurdake.
Igar-Napiragwad-Maid an susad. Be-Igar-Mamaid angadga an imaksad.
Bab-Jehová, Be-Igar-Sogsadgi an alamaknaid, melle bingeguega be an-imako.
Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaidba an gwae ibsaoed, ar gwage-weligwar an-imakdaed.
Bab-Jehová, Be-Igar-Mamaidgi be an-odurdake, an eba nanadii guoed.
Be-Igar-Maidba-nanaegala, Be-Igar-Maid magar-itogega be an-imake. Geb gwage-ulubgi bela-belad eba an nanadii guoed.
Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaidba be an-iduge, ar agi an wergued amied.
Unnila Be-Igar-Mamaidbarbi-binsaega be an-imake. Melle ibmar-baiganbina-surbinsa-itoged be an-imake.
Melle ibmar-binsarmaladbina-sogega be an-imake. Be-Igar-Maidba-nanaega be an-imake.
Igi be dule-be-dobee-nanadimaladga be ibmar imaksa, deyobi, an-be-mai-guedga be Ibmar-Imakoye-Sogsad, be imake.
Mesagwar-imaklegedgi an dobe-itodiidgi be an-onoge, ar Be-Igar-Nabogedi, we, ibnuedid.
Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaidbina an nue-soged. Be-igar-innikii-imakedba dula-gudii be an-imake.
Bab-Jehová, igi na be Sogsa-Gusa, deyob be-sabgued be anse oyoge, deyob dule-bendaked be anse oyoge.
Deyobi, dule-isdar-an-dakmaladga an sogoed. Ar Be-Ibmar-Sogsadgi an bensulid.
An-gwabinduku, ibmar-inniki-soged be imake. Ar Be-Igar-Mamaidgi an bensulid.
Be-Igar-Mamaidba an degisadegu ibsadii guoed, Deyob degisadegu an imakoed.
An bonisuli nanadii guoed, ar an Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaid amisad.
Be-Igar-Mamaidgi reymar-asabin an sunmakoed, gwen an bingeguosulid.
Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaidbina an nue-soged, an egi wergued.
Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaid an nue-sabedbali, an-argan an onakoed, Be-Igar-Maidgi an binsaoed.
An-be-mai-guedga be Ibmar-Sogsa-Gusadi be ebinsao, a-Gayaburba-abdakagwar-gudiguega, be an-imaksad.
An bukib-binsaedba-wile-itodiidgi, a-Gayaburba baisur-itogega an-imaked, Be-Ibmar-Sogedi, an-ogannodaed.
Dule-san-dummarba-imakmalad angi nue-isdar sunmakdimalad, degi-inigwele, andi Be-Igargi bangudisulid.
Bab-Jehová, be epenne Be-Igar-Nabosadi an ebinsaed. A-Igarmala, an-gwage-baisur-itogega imaked.
Dule-isganamar Be-Igar-metemaladi, sae-itogega an-imaked.
An we-napneggi sikwas-gudiidgi, Be-Igar-Mamaid, an-namakedga gusad.
Bab-Jehová, mutikgusale, an be-ebinsaardaed. Be-Igar-Sogedba an nanabied.
Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaid-sogedba-nanadiguedi, angi siid, an imakedsegad.
Bab-Jehová, bebi angadga gued, Be-Gayaburbaba-nanaoye an sogsad.
Bela-bela gwagegi an be-amidiid. Be-Ibmar-Sogsadba ise-wile be an-dake.
An-daedgi an binsaargua, Be-Igar-Mamaidba an gannar nanaded.
Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaid-sogedba nanaegala, an undar-binsadii gussulid.
Dule-isganamar an-gaegala, an-ebirdimalad. Degi-inigwele, Be-Igar-Maidi an gwen-iessulid.
Be-Igar-Inniki-Maid-nukad, an bega dog-nuedye-sogegala, nega-gabigwenbali an gwichiguardaed.
Ani an, dulemar-be-dobekwaa-nanadimalad-e-aid. Ani an, Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaidba-nanadimalad-e-aid.
Bab-Jehová, ¡Be-Igar-Mamaidgi be an-odurdake! We-napneg-naidgi bela be-sabgued-nikadi oyolenaid.
Bab-Jehová, bee be, Be-Ibmar-Sogsadbali, be nued an-nidii gusad.
An Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaidgi an bensulid. Agala, gatik-ibmar-wisgued be an-imake, ibmar-mag-itoged be an-imake.
An sabsur-odurdakleged-iduale, an-itolegedba galagwensuli an gudii daed. Emigindi, Be-Gayaburba-Sogedba an nanadiid.
Bab-Dummad, bedi dule-nuedid. Be, ibmar-nuegan-imakedid. ¡Be-Igar-Mamaidgi be an-odurdake!
Dule-san-dummarba-imakmaladi angi isdar-sunmakmalad. Degi-inigwele, andi gwagegi bela-belad Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaid-sogedba an nanaed.
We-dulemar, gwage-dutusurmaladid. Andina, Be-Igar-Maidgi wergudiid.
Bur-nueddo, an sabsur-odurdaklesgu. Abali, an Be-Igar-Mamaid durdaknonikid.
Be-Igar-Maidi, olo-mili-milibalidba bur bule ibnuedid. Be-Igar-Maidi, mani-mili-milibalidba bur bule anga ibidar-nuedga gued.
Bee be, we-napnegse an-barmialid, bee be, anga burba uksad. Be-Igar-Mamaid-durdakegala, nono-nued be anga udage.
Dulemar-be-nug-ogannodimalad an-dakalile, weligwar-itodmaloed, ar an, Be-Gayaburbagi, bensuli gudiid.
Bab-Jehová, an wisid, Be-Igar-Mamaidi innikigwadbiid. Degisoggu, nabiridba sabsur-be-an-odurdaksado.
Be-sabguedi, an-gwage-baisur-itoge imaked. Ar Be-Anga-Sogsagusadba be imaksad.
Be-wile-dule-dakedi, anse be oyodage. Dula-gudii be an-imakdage. Ar Be-Igala, weligwar an-imakedid.
Dule-san-dummarba-imakmalad, obingegsalesun, ar binsarsunna an-ogakansadimalad. Andi Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaidgi bur binsaoed.
Dulemar-be-nug-ogannodimalad, gannar anbo-atogega be imaksun. Dulemar-Be-Igar-Mamaid-wismalad, gannar anbo-atogega be imaksun.
An-gwage Be-Igar-Mamaidba innikii nanasun, adi, an melle bingeguegar.
Bab-Jehováʼye, bela-belad be-an-bendaked an abdakdiid, Be-Ibmar-Sogsadgi an bensulid.
Be Anga-Ibmar-Sogsad-abdakdiidbali, an-dala galakuded. An weyob soged: “¿Sana wede gwage-baisur-itogega be an-imaknonikoe?”
Bato an seredgus-inigwele, wagar-bapigwargus-inigwele, amba Be-Igar-Mamaid gwen an iedisulid.
¿Bule napi an dula gudii guoe? ¿Sana be, dule-an-balegindimalad-sabsur-odurdakoe?
Dule-san-dummarba-imakdimaladi, an-yardakega igar amismalad. Be-Igar-Sogedba-nanadisurmaladi, an-yardakega igar amismalad.
Bela Be-Igar-Mamaidi innikigwadbiid. ¡Bab-Dummadye, be an-bendake! Binsarsunna an-balegindimalad.
Napneggi an-oburgwednaga gusmalad. Degi-inigwele, andi Be-Igar-Mamaidgi gwen bangussulid.
Be-sabed-dummarba-nikadbali, be anga burba-ogannosun. Be-Igar-Mamaid-sogedba an nanaoed.
Bab-Jehová, Be-Gayaburbadi degisadeguad, nibneggi, Be-Gayaburbadi gwen gwagmaisulid.
Be-innikidaedi, degisadeguad. Napneg be nasiksad, innikigwadba nagusad.
Be-Igar-Uksadbali, emi-iba-akale, we-ibmarmar amba bukwad. Bela we-ibmarmala be-sogedba ibmar-imakbukwad.
Be-Igar-Maid, weligwar an-imaksasulina, bukib-binsaedba an bato bergusbinnenad.
Bipisaale, Be-Igar-Mamaid an gwen iegosulid, ar we-igarbali, be an-san-burba dula imaksad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, be an-bendake, andi, begadga-gued. Andi, Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaid ulubse baramidiid.
Dule-isganamar an-obelobigudimalad. Andi, Be-Igar-Mamaid-magar-itogega alamakdiid.
Bela ibmarmar e-bergued-nika an dakdiid. Unnila, Be-Igar-Islidik-Mamaidbi gege bergued.
¡Be-Igar-Maidbina an nue soged! Bane-bane an egi binsadaed.
Be-Igar-Mamaidi, an-isdarmaladbali bur bule binsaed-nika an-imaked. Ar Be-Igar angadga an imaksad.
Bela an-odurdakmaladba bur bule an ibmar magar-itoged. Ar an Be-Igar-Mamaidgi binsadigu daed.
Girmarba bur bule an ibmar magar-itoged. Ar an Be-Igar-Mamaid-sogedba nanadiid.
Be-Gayaburba-Sogedba-nanaegala, bela igar-isganagi an bangusad.
Be-Igar-Mamaidgi an bangussulid, ar bee be an-odurdaksad.
Ibibayobi Be-Gayaburba anga ochii gue. Achanis-maedba bur bule anga ochii gued.
Be-Igar-Mamaidbali, an binsaed-nuegan amidiid. A-ulale, bela gakan-igarmar an isdar daked.
Be-Gayaburba gwallu-meegwadyobi an-iduedga gued. Neg-ibegwalebayobi anga igar oyoged.
An bega ibmar-ise-sogar-sogsadi, an imakedsegad. Be-Igar-Mamaid-sogedba an nanadii guoed.
Bab-Jehová, an bela-bela bato nue dummad-wilediid. ¡Be-Gayaburba-sogedba be an-ogannoge!
Bab-Jehová, an bega ibmar-sogedi be abingasana gadin. Be-Igar-Mamaidgi be an-odurdake.
Bonigan-abargi an-sandi gudiid, degi-inigwele, Be-Igar-Maiddi an iedisulid.
Dule-isganamar an-yardakbimalad, degi-inigwele, Be-Igar-Mamaidgi andi bangudisulid.
Be-Igar-Mamaidi, degisadegu angadga-guega an susad, ar an-gwage-weligwar imakdaed.
Degisadegu, an-burgwedsega gwage-ulubgi Be-Igar-Mamaid-sogedba nanadioye an sogsad.
Dule-wagar-darbo-damaladi, an isdar daked. Be-Igar-Islidikiddi, an nue-sabed.
Bab-Dummad, bedi an-odukuega gued, bedi an-sigu-abgaedibayobi anga gued, Be-Ibmar-Sogsadi, an edarbediid.
“¡Dule-isganamar, be angi bangue! An-Bab-Dummad-Igar-Mamaidba an nanabied.”
Be-Gayaburba-Maidbali, be an-ogannoge, agi an dula gudiguoed. An-ibmar-edarbediidgine, melle bingeguega be an-imake.
Be an-bendake, adi, an bendaklegoed. Be-Igar-Mamaidgi, an weligwar itodiguoed.
Dulemar-Be-Igar-Mamaidgi-nodimaladi, be isdar dakdaed. Ar gakansaedginbi binsadidamalad.
Napneggi dule-isganamar-bukwadi, ibmar-isgana-milediidyob be daked. A-ulale, an Be-Igar-Mamaidbina nue-soged.
An be-dobedbali, be-asabin an wawanmakgwichid, Be-Igar-Nabolemalad-dobee an itoged.
Igar-inniki-imaklemalad an imakdiid. Melle dule-mesagwar-an-imakdimaladga be an-urmako.
An-be-mai-guedga, igar-nueganbi-guega be imako. Melle dule-san-dummarba-imakmaladi mesagwar-an-imakega be imako.
Be an-abonogega, an be-abdakdiidba an-dala mommoleded. Be-Igar-Sogsad anga-guedi, an edarbediid.
Sabed-dummarba be nikadbali, be-mai be sabguo. Be-Igar-Mamaid be an-odurdake.
Andi be-mai gued. An Be-Igar-Mamaid-durdakega, Be-Igar-Mamaid mag-itoge be an-imake.
Bab-Jehová, ar Be-Igar-Mamaidba nanasurmarsoggu, be-ibmar-imakbied be imaksunna.

Bab-Dummad we-reymar-e-yarmar mimisad, e-Israel-dulamarga mimisad.
Bab-Jehová, be-nug degisadeguad. Bab-Jehová, dulemar degisadegu be-ebinsadii gumaloed.
Bab-Jehová na e-dulamarga igar nabogoed, e-maimar-wiledakoed.
Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad na e-bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imakbukwadi, orgi sobaled, manigi sobaled. Dulemar na e-argangi sobsa nanaed.
We-ibmarmar gaya-nikamalanad, degite, geg sunmakmalad. Ibya-nikamalanad, degite, ibmar-daksurmalad.
Uaya-nikamalanad, degite, ibmar-itosurmalad, deginbali, bunnosurmarbalid.
E-sobmalad, deyob gumarmogad, bela a-ibmargi-bengusurmalad deyob gumarmogad.
Israel-dulemar, ¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummomala! Aarón-wagan, ¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummomala!
Leví-wagan, ¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummomala! Bab-Jehová-dobee-nanadimalad, ¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummomala!
Sión-akale, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomala. Bab-Jehová, Jerusalénʼgi maid. ¡Aleluya! ¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummolesun!
Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummomar, ar Bab-Jehová, dule-nuedid. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummadbi-wargwenna-maid-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummadbi ibmar-gegerdaklemalad imaked. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad e-ibmar-wisidbali, nibneg-nasiksad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad diigine napneg nasiksad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad gwallu-dummagan nasiksad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad dad-ibeler-neg-ibgi-gaega imaksad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad nii-mutik-gaega nasiksad, niisgwamar neg-mutikid-gaega imaksad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad, Egipto-dulemar-e-masmala-sailaginmalad oburgwisad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad, Egipto-yargi Israel-dulemar onosad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad gangued-nikadba e-sakwa oyogwichigusad, e-surgan oyogwichigusad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad, Demar-Ginnidye-nugad egasad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad, Israel-dulemar-demargi-obakega imaksad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad, Demar-Ginnidye-nugadgi we-Faraón, e-sorda-bila-onomaladmala, ogundisad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad, e-dulamar-nega-dulesulidganba niargusad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad, rey-nuga-nikamalad oburgwisad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad, rey-gandikmalad ogilosad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad, Amorreo-e-rey-Sehón oburgwisad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad, Basán-e-rey-Og oburgwisad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad, we-reymar-e-yarmar e-dulamarga uksad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad, e-mai-Israel-dulemarga yar uksad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad, anmar-nue-yegus-gunanaidgi anmar-iedsulid. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad, anmar-isdarmaladgi anmar-ollor-imaksad. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Bab-Dummad, bela ibmar-durganga mas-ukmaid. A-e-nug odummomar. Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
¡Bab-Dummad-Nibneggi-Maid-e-nug odummomar! Ar e-sabguedi, degisadeguad.
Babilonia-diwar-naba anmar ambakudapdaed. Agi, anmar Siónʼgi-binsabukwadba, bobukwadaed.
Anmar, anmar-gar-arpa sapi-Sauceʼye-nugadgi, an nasikdamalad.
Dule-anmar-gasa-sesmaladi, anmarga sokardaed, namakmarye. Dule-anmar-ibe-ibmar-susmaladi, anmarga sokardaed, anmarde wergumarye. Anmarga sokardaed: “Be-Sión-yargi-namaklemaladi, be anmarga namakye.”
¿Wede igi anmar yar-baidgi Bab-Jehováʼga namakosunna?
Jerusalén-neggwebur, an be-iedele, an argan mer bar gar-ogolega gusun.
Jerusalén-neggwebur, an be-iedele, an-wergudiidba bar begi an binsasulile, geg bar namake an gusun.
Bab-Jehová, Babilonia-dulemar Jerusalénʼgi-nakwisgu, Edom-dulemar-sognanai-gusad, be insao: “¡Jerusalén-neggwebur bela be obelomarye! ¡Swanga be nasikmarye!”
Babilonia-neggwebur, ibagwengi be bibisgelemogoed. Bemar anmar-imaksayob be imaklemarmogoed. Dule-deyob-bemar-imakoedi, egi nued binsalegoed.
Dule be-mimmigan-gani akwagi-sabsur-omukuoed. Dule-deyob-be-mimmigan-imakoedi, egi nued binsalegoed.
Bab-Jehová bela-bela an-ulubgi an be-nug odummoged. Baliwiturmar-asabin an bega namakoed.
Bese-gorleged-neg-islidikid-siidsiki an dulluu napagi sigoed. Be-sabed-dummarba-maidbali, sogedba be ibmar-imakmaidbali, an be-nug odummogoed. Bab-Dummad, be ibmar-imakoye-sogsad, bela ibmar-birgi, sogedba be imaksad. Degidba be-nug na be ogannosad.
Bab-Dummad, an bese gochagua, be an-abin-imaksad, be an-niga ogannononikid.
Bab-Jehová, bela-reymar-we-napneggi-mamaid, bela be-sunmaked-itomaloedba, be-nug odummodmaloed.
Bab-Jehová-Igar-Mamaidgi namakdemaloed. Ar Bab-Jehová-e-gargangued dummarba gued.
Bab-Jehová, dule-biriginedid. Bab-Dummad, dule-na-san-dummarba-imaksulidgi, nued binsaed. Bab-Dummad, dule-na-san-dummarba-imakdiiddina, obaned.
Amba an bonigan-abalagi-gudidibe, amba dula-gudii be an-imakoed. Bab-Jehová, an-isdarmalad-urwedgi, be an-bendakoed. Be-ganguedba be an-bendakoed.
Bab-Jehová, angine bela ibmar-imakoye-sogsad imakedsegad. Bab-Jehová, be-sabgued gege gwaged, degisadeguad. Bab-Dummad, be an-obinnissoggu, mer wargwen be an-meto.
Bab-Jehová, be an-baramied. An-gudiid bela be wisid.
Sana an sigoe, sana an gwisguoe, be nue-wisimakaled. An begi dikasur-gudi-inigwele, bedi an-binsaed nue-wisimakaled.
An-nanaed, an-obunnoged, be nue-wisimakaled, bela an-igarmar be nue-wisid.
Bab-Jehová, ar amba yoo an ibmar-soge, bato bedi bela wisdaed.
Bela-belad be an-irwa gwisgudiguad. Be-argan-yaurgi be an-sediid.
Weyob be ibmar-wisidi, an bela-bela geger-itoged, ¡Bela-bela be ibmar-wisidi, an aku-itoged!
Bab-Dummad, ¿Ar bia be-Burbagi an banguoe? ¿An bia begi wakinnoe?
Ar an nibnegse naele, bedi agi maid. Ar an burgwarmalad-meged-galuse an naele, bedi agi gudibalid.
Ar an dad-nakwedsik naeyesogele, ar an magatiba naeyesogele,
amba be agine an-idu gudiid, be-ganguedgi be an-sedii guoed.
An sogdibe: Negsichid an-odukuoye, neg-meegwad anga neg-mutikidga guoye, an binsa-sogsaled.
Ar begardi negasichid negsichidga gusulid, begardi neg-mutikid neg-ibginedyob gued. Begardi negasichidi, neg-meegwadi, emarbi gued.
Bab-Dummad, bee be bela an-abagangi-ibmar-bukwad obinnisad. Bee be, sapidukugi an-mesisad.
Doggus-nuedye an bega soged, be-ibmar-obinnisadi, andi geger-daked. Be ibmarmar-imaksadi, geger-dakleged, ar we-ibmar an nue-wisid.
Ise-dukuale, an-abagangi arbalenaigu, an-garmardi begi odukulessulid. Ise-dukuale, an sapidukugi-mai angi-arbalenaigu, anga abgan-dubagan gwadilenai gusad.
An sapidukugi-maigua, bedi an-daksad. Amba yoo an we-napnegse aidedage, birgabigwa an dula-gudii guoe, bela bato be-gardagi narmakar maid.
Bab-Dummad, be-binsaed ibiyobi anga doggus-nued gue. ¡Be-binsaedi, ibiyobi mergue!
Ar be-binsaed an ebisye-sogele, bur bule ukubba mergueled. Ar an be-binsaed-ebised an obelo-sogele, amba be an-walik gudiiled.
Bab-Dummad, dule-isganamar be oburgwe. Dule-ablis-eomalad, angi be obangue.
Wemar-begi-dodoar-sunmakdimaladi, binsarsunna begi gwisgumalad.
Bab-Dummad, dulemar-isdar-be-daked, ¿an isdar-daksurmo be insae? Dulemar-be-abingasulid, ¿an sae-daksurmo be insae?
An bela-bela isdar-daked, an-isdarmaladga gunonimalad.
Bab-Dummad, be an-baramie, an-gwage-ulub be dake, be an-wilubdake, be an-binsaed dake.
An igar-isganaba nadapi be an-dakele, geg-igar-berguedba be an-sede.

Bab-Jehová, dule-isganamargi be an-ollor-imake. Sabesur-dule-imakmalad-idu be an-odukue.
Ar unnila e-gwagegi, ibmar-isgana-imakedginbi binsadii daed. Bane-bane urwed-onodii daed.
Naibe-nued-gangueyobi, e-gwabin-duku gued. Naibe-nued-e-gichi-boniyobi, e-sunmaked sedimalad.
Bab-Jehová, dule-isganamar-e-gangued-idu be an-odukue. Sabesur-dule-imakmaladgi be an-ollor-imake, ar an-ogalakuedgi binsadidamalad.
Dule-san-dummarba-imakmalad, an-yardakmalaga, an-idu dub nasiksamalad. An-idu igargi saki nasiksamalad. An-nanaedgi an-idu yardakleged-galu osismalad.
An Bab-Jehováʼga sogsad: “Be an-Bab-Dummadid. Bab-Jehová, wilesakwaa an bese-goledi be an-itoge.”
Bab-Jehová-Dule-Dummad, be an-Bab-Dummad-bur-gandikidid. Bila-onolegedgi be an-bendakedid.
Bab-Jehová, dule-isganamar e-ibmar-imakbiedi, melle imakega be imake. Melle na san-dummarba-itomalaga be imake, melle e-igarmar-nasgumai be imake.
Bab-Dummad, dule-an-balegindimalad, an-wiogega-igar-isgana-amismalad egi dukin-aibinega be imake.
Wemargine, sogun-ginnitibiid babatega be imaksun. Soo-yagine balimelledega be imaksun. Melle bar noega yaa-matusulidgi-argwanega be imaksun.
Dule-geg-gwabin-duku-bargaed, napneggi gudigu guosulid. Sabsur-dule-imakmalad, boni-dummaganse obelolesun.
An wisid, Bab-Jehová, dule-wile-itodiidga igar naboged, dule-ibmarbina-sogdimalad, Bab-Dummad bendaked.
Dule-nuegan, be-nug-odummomaloed. Dule-innikimalad be-walik-gudii gumaloed.
Bab-Jehová, sabsuli an bese goled: ¡Gwae be an-bendakdage! An bese gotele, be an-itoge.
An-bese-goledi, ina-wawadikid-nakwemaidaeyob bese nakwemai gusun. An-argan-bese-onakwedi, sedo-ibmar-ogumakar-ukledaeyob be dake.
Bab-Jehová an-gwabinduku-bargaed be an-imake. Bab-Jehová, mer ibmar-yogasaar-sunmaked be an-imake.
Melle an-gwage ibmar-isganagi-binsaega be imake, dulemar-ibmar-isgana-imakbiedba melle akaed be an-imake. Dulemar-ibmar-isgana-imaked-abargi, melle ibagi-masgulleged-gunnega be an-imake.
Dule-ibmar-innikii-imaked an-bibyoye-sogele, sabsur ibmar anga sogele, we, ibmar-nued anga imaknaid. Dulemar-isgana-e-gwallu-wawamar, an-nonogi, mer eolegega be imako. Bab-Dummad, mer an dule-isgana-e-ibmar-isgana-imakedgi-yolegega, an bese gornai guoed.
E-dummagan-negsemamaid akwasaila-birgi-gwichi gulluse barmelledmalale, agi geb itomaloed, an-ibmar-sogsadi, napiragwad.
Geb sogdemaloed: Anmar-garmar, napa-imules-argaarmaiyobi, anmar-garmar neg-uangi omiledoed.
Bab-Jehová-Dule-Dummad, bebi an-bendakedid. Bendakleged beginbi an amied. ¡Melle dulemar an-oburgwed be imako!
Dulemar an-idu dub-nasiksamaladgi mer aimukued be an-imako. Dule-isganamar yamo dule-yardakega-ibmar-imakmaladgi, melle yardakleged be an-imako.
Dule-isganamar na dukin e-sakigi-argwaned be imake. Bab-Dummadye, be an-bendake. Mer ese galegega be an-imako.

Bab-Jehováʼse ise-gollar bendakleged an egised, Bab-Jehováʼse ise-wilegar an e-sabgued egisnaid.
Bab-Dummadga naibi-itodiid, an sogoed, an-sulibinsa-itodiid, an ega sogoed.
Bab-Dummad, an geggus-itogele, bato be an-daksabinnedaed. An bia nadele, abala dulemar an-yardakega, an-iduar ibmar-sisadamalad.
An-argan-nuedsik an atakdele, dule-an-bendaked wargwensaale gwen daklesurdaed. Neg-dukued an sulid, dule-wargwensaale angi binsasulid.
Bab-Jehová, be-an-bendakegala, an bese gochad. An bega sogsad: “Bebi unnila an-bendaked maid. We-napneggi dulemar-bukwad-abargi bebi unnila anga gudiid.”
Bab-Dummadye, an-gornaid be itoge, an sulibinsa itoged. An-bareginnanamaladgi be an-bendake, ar anba bur bule gangumalad.
An be-nug-odummogega, wegi-an-galessiidgi be an-onodage. Ar be-sabed be anga oyononikile, dule-inniki-gudimalad weligwar an-ebiris ambikunonimaloed.
Bab-Jehováʼye, an bese-goled be itoge, an-wilesakwaa-goled, be itoge. Be-ibmar-soged-imakedba, be an-abinsae. Be-Igar-innikigwadba, be an-abinsae.
Dummad, mer be anga igar-itoge. Ar be-asabindi, dule-wargwensaale na nuedye sogosulid.
An-isdarmalad an-oburgwebied, napayala bikiin an-metemalad. Dule-dikasurgus-burgwismaladyob negasichidgi-megega an-imaksamalad.
Bar an nue-bunnosurgusad, an-gwage bogiled an-itoged.
Epenne ibagan-nasmalad an ebinsaded. Belagwable be-ibmar-dummagan-imaksadgi an binsaded. Be-ibmarmar-imaksad, nue an ebinsaded.
An-argan an besik oyoged, ar igi napa-dinnagwad dii-abedae, deyobi, an bebina soged.
Bab-Jehová, gwae be an-abinsae, ar an geg-sagusad. Be-wagar mer be angi odukue, ar degiile, dule-napa-yaba-digarmaidyobi, an guoed.
Wakudaryalaba be-sabgued be anga oyoge, ar andi begi bensulid. Ar andi bese goled, be anga oyoye, ibu-igarba an naoe.
Bab-Jehová, an-isdarmaladgi be an-ollorsae, ar andi begi dukued amied.
Be-sogedba-ibmar-imakedgi be an-odurdake, ar be an-Bab-Dummadid. Be-Burba-nued neg-bonigan-satedba an-idue.
Bab-Jehová, be-nug-ular, dula-gudii be an-imake. Be-Igar-innikigwad-ular, surbinsa-itogedgi be an-onoge.
Be-dule-wiledaked-ular, an-isdarmalad be ogiloge. Bela an-balengindimalad be obeloge, ar andi be-mai gued.
Bab-Jehová-nug odummolesun, an-akwasailaga guedid. Bila-onoged-idu, an-surgan-ogannogedid, urwed-idu, an-arganmar-ogannogedid.
Bab-Jehová, an-sabguedid, an-edarbedid, bonigan-idu an-odukuedid, bonigangi an-ollor-imakedid, an-sigu-abgaedyob an egi dukuedid, an egi bensulid-nikadid, an-urbaligwa-nanaega dulamar-imakedid.
Bab-Jehová, ¿wede, dule ibusunna, egi be binsanonigu? ¿Wede, dule ibusunna, be akwenonigu?
Ar dule unnila gayagi buu-imaklegaledid. Ar e-ibagan unnila negsichigwad-ukiar-nasdaeyobid.
Bab-Jehová, be-mogir be egae, be aidedage. Yalamar be ebuge, waa-obupurmake.
Mala-ibyemakale be odege, dule-isdardakmalad be oaisakie, be-sigumala egi be mie, dule-isdarmalad-oduurmakega be imake.
Nibneg-akale, be-gangued be anse oyoge, dii-wiladgine be an-onoge, dule-isganamargi be an-ollor-imake.
Ar sunmakdemalale, gakansaddamalad, argan-onakwidmalale, nabiridyob ibmar-ise-sogar imakdamalad.
Bab-Dummad, na begala namaked-gwapidgi an namakoed. Gar-arpa-dub-giambe-nikadba (10) an bega namakoed.
Bila-onolegedgi be reymar-onakwemaidid. Be-mai-David-melle-es-suidgi-burgwega be imakedid.
Be an-bendake, dule-isganamargi be an-ollorsae. Ar sunmakdemalale, gakansaddamalad, argan-onakwidmalale, nabiridyob ibmar-ise-sogar imakdamalad.
Anmar-mimmigan, e-dungumaidba sapimar-binnasuli-dungumaiyob be imako. Anmar-bunamala, reyneg-e-buarmar-sobarmaladyob, yeerdaklege be imako.
Anmar-ibmar-gwag-sabomaladgi bukidar masmar-akar-akar ena-ena bukuega be imake. Anmar-sibad-wawaadmar, mili-miliba-omelomai (1,000-1,000) be imake. Anmar-nainugi, mili-miliba-bukuega be imake.
Anmar-moli-bebe-nikad-omegan, obargudiguega be imake. Mileged-ibagan-iduar, melle milegega be imako. Melle anmar-neg-imbabali, bar dule, suli-suli-itogedba-gordiguega be imako.
Neggwebur we-ibmarmar bela nikale, egi-nued-binsalesdo. Neggwebur, Bab-Jehová e-Bab-Dummadga-imakdiile, egi-nued-binsalesdo.
An-Bab-Dummad, an-Rey, be-nug an odummogoed. Degisadegu, be-nuggi nued sunmakdigu an guoed.
Bane-bane degisadegu, be-nug-odummodii an guoed.
Bab-Jehová, Dule-Dummadid. E-nug nue-odummolegergebed. E-nug-dungued dule magar itogosurguoed.
Bab-Dummad, babgan be-ibmar-imaksamaladi, e-mimmiganga sogoed. Be-ibmar-dummagan-imaksamaladi, e-mimmiganga sogoed.
Be-ganguedgi, be-yeerdaklegedgi, an sunmakdii guoe. Be-ibmar-dummagan-imaksamaladgi, an binsadii guoe.
Be-ibmar-dummagan-imakedgi dulemar, sunmakmaloed, be dule-dummad-guedgi, an sunmakoe.
Be-sabgued-dummarba-nikadgi, sunmakmaloed, be-ibmar-inniki-imakedgi, namakmaloed.
Bab-Jehová wile dulemar-dakdaed, nue dulemar-sabdaed. Bab-Jehová wissur gwae-gwae urwed, nue dulemar-sabgumaid.
Bab-Jehová bela dulemargi nueddaed. Bela na e-ibmar-imaksad nue-sabed.
Bab-Jehová, bela be-ibmar-obinnisadi, be-nug odummosunna. Be-sordamar-napiramalad be-nug odummomarmosunna.
Be gannarba-negsemaidgi, sunmakmarsunna. Be-ganguedgi sunmakmala.
Adi, dulemar be-ibmar-dummagan-imaksad wisgumalaga, be-yeerdakleged, be-gangued wisgumarbaligar.
Be-negsemaidi, degisadeguoed, be-neg-ganikidi, berguosulid.
Bab-Jehová dule-wis-gwatirisdibe, dule-ogwisdaed, dule-nollo-itomalad ogannodaed.
Bab-Jehová bela ibmarmala ega be mas ukega bese atakbubuk-naed. Ega be iba-sekalaa masgunned ukmaid.
Nalledginsuli ega be mas ukmaid. Bela ibmar-dulaga mas unnitibali be ukmaid.
Bab-Jehová, bela-be-ibmar-imakedi, innikigwadbi imaked. Bela nue-sabedgi be ibmar imaked.
Bab-Jehová, dule-ese-napiragwadgi-gordimalad-bendakega egi walikaa gudidaed.
Bab-Jehová, dule-e-sabee-gudimaladga ibmar-abemalad ukdaed. Amar-ese-ibmar-egisedi ega ukdaed.
Bab-Jehová, dule-e-sabgudimalad-edarbedii daed. Ar dule-isganadi bela obelogoed.
Bab-Jehová, an be-nugdi ogannosunna. Bela ibmarmar be-nug ogannomarmosunna. Degisadegu, be-nug ogannodii gumarsunna.
¡Aleluya! ¡Bab-Dummad-e-nug-odummomarsun! Bab-Jehová, an-gwagegi an be-nug odummoged.
An dula-gudiidgi Bab-Jehová-nug an odummogoed. Bab-Dummadga-namaklegedgi an Bab-Dummadga namakoed.
Mer girmar-dummagangi be bensulid-nika guo, bipisaale mer dule-gwensakgi be bensulid-nika gubalo, ar wemargi bendakleged-igar maisulid.
Ar we-dulemar bergunonikile, gannar napaga binnidmaloed. Bela na ibmar-imako-sogsamalad, a-ibagi berguus ega naoed.
Dule Jacob-e-Bab-Dummadgi bendaklediile, we-dulegi nued-binsalesad. E-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼginbi bensuli gudiid.
Ar Bab-Dummad napneg-nasiksadid, nibneg-nasiksabalidid. Demar-naidi, bela-egi-ibmar-bubukwadi urbisbalid. Bab-Dummad ibmar-imakoye-sogsad, sogedba imaked, gakansamaisulid.
Bab-Jehová dule-sabsur-imakledimaladga sogedba ega igar naboged. Dule-ukud-itodimaladga masgunned uked. Dule-gales-bubukwad onobalid.
Bab-Jehová dulemar-ibyasulid nabir-atakega imaked. Dule-yore-nanamalad inniki-nanaega imaked. Bab-Jehová dule-innikidamalad nue-sabed.
Bab-Jehová Israel-dulesurmalad nue-akwed. Dule-babgansuli-gudimalad nue-bendakbalid. Ome-ei-sui-burgwisgudiid nue-bendakbalid. Bab-Dummad dule-isganamarga igar obured.
Sión-dulemar, be-Bab-Jehová degisadegu, negsemai gusun. ¡Aleluya! ¡Bab-Dummad-nug odummomarsun!
¡Aleluya! Bab-Jehová-nug odummolesun. Ar anmar, anmar-Bab-Dummadga-namaked ibnuedid. E-nug-odummoleged yeer-itolegedid.
Bab-Jehová Jerusalén-neggwebur gannar sobed, Israel-dulemar-e-yargi-onolesmalad gannar senonikoed.
Bab-Dummad, dule-gwage-nunmak-itodimalad nudaked. E-wile-itodiid baisur-itoge imaked.
Bab-Jehová bela wisid igi mergu niisgwamar nai, bela ega nug nasiksad.
Anmar-Bab-Jehová, dule-dummadid, e-gangued bipisurbalid, e-ibmar-wisid degisadeguad.
Bab-Jehová dule-wilegana bendaked. Dule-isgana-e-nugdi bipii imaked.
Bab-Jehováʼga yeer-itogedgi namakmala. Anmar-Bab-Dummadga gar-arpaʼba namakmala.
Bab-Dummad, nibneggi mogirmar nasiked, napaneggi dii owied, sapurgi gaganmar onied.
Bab-Dummad, ibmar-durganga mas uked. Sikwisichii-mimmigan mas-abealile, ega mas ukbalid.
Bab-Jehová moli-e-ganguedgi yeer-itosulid, dule-ibmar-bursur-imakedgi yeer-itosurbalid.
Bab-Jehová, e-nug-odummomaladgi yeer-itoged, e-sabgued-bensurmaladgi yeer-itobalid.
Jerusalén-neggwebur, Bab-Jehová-nug odummoge. Sión-yar, be Bab-Dummad-nug odummoge.
Bab-Jehová be-yawagak-bargamalad-e-suarmar bega ogannosad. Dule-be-yargi-gudidimaladgi nued-binsalesad.
Bab-Dummad be-yargi neg-bogidikid nasiked, orosgi-dakleged-trigo-bur-nuedgi immerba be-imaked.
Bab-Dummad napnegga ibmar-soged, e-ibmar-soged yog-imakar imakledaed.
Bab-Dummad ubsan-daklegedyob boo-sibudiki obated. Buru-bateyob boo-gwamakaled obated.
Bab-Dummad dii-gwamakaled akwanyob obated. Dii-gwamakaled-e-dambed, ¿doa baisur-itogoe?
Bab-Dummad-e-ibmar-sogedba dii-gwamakaled diree imaked. Burwa-golega imaked, geb dii gannar suurmakega imaked.
Bab-Dummad Jacob-waganga e-gayaburba uksad, Israel-dulemarga na E-Igar-Maid, E-Igar-Inniki-imaklemalad, uksad.
Bab-Dummad dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamaladdi, deyob imaksasulid. Amardi, bipisaale E-Igar-Mesisad wisgussurmalad. ¡Aleluya! ¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummolesun!
¡Aleluya! ¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummolesun! Nibneg-akar, Bab-Jehová-nug be odummomar. Nibneg-matusulid-akar, Bab-Jehová-nug be odummomar.
Bela Bab-Jehová-baliwiturmar, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar. Bela Bab-Jehová-sorda-bilagi-urwemalad, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar.
Dad-ibeler, Bab-Jehová-nug odummosun. Nii, Bab-Jehová-nug odummosun. Niisgwamar, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar.
Bela mogirmar-ugakaase-nanaid, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar. Diimar-mogirmar-niba-nanaid, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar.
Bab-Jehová-nug odummomarsun, ar e-ibmar-sogsadba, ibmarmar obinnilesad.
Degisadegu ibmarmar innikii urbilesad. E-igar-omesisadi, bar egi annalegegarsulid.
Napneg-akale, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar: Demargi ibdula-dummagan-bukwad, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar. Demar-wilagana, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar.
Mala-ibyemalad, dii-gwamakarmalad, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar. Boo-gwamakaled, boo-batemalad, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar. Burwa-dummagan-be-sogedba-ibmar-imakedi, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar.
Yalamar, bela yala-mullugan, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar. Sapi-san-nikamalad, bela urwarmar, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar.
Ibmar-dula-sapurbarmalad, ibmar-durgan-negginmalad, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar. Ibdula-unimalad, nuumar, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar.
Reymar-napneggi-mamaid, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar. Bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar. Dule-nuga-nikamalad, dule-dummagan-yar-semamaid, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar.
Sapingana, yagana, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar. Dadormar, mimmigan, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar.
Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar, ar a-nugbi unnila dummarba gued. E-gandik-yeerdakleged, napnegba, nibnegba, bur-gandik dakleged.
Bab-Jehová, e-neggweburga gangued uksad. Israel-wagan-bela-Bab-Jehováʼba-nanadimalad, e-dulamar-walikagwadga-gubalid, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar. ¡Aleluya! ¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummolesun!
¡Aleluya! ¡Bab-Jehová-nug odummolesun! Bab-Jehováʼga namaked-binid namakmala. Bab-Jehová-sordamar-abargi Bab-Jehová-nug odummomala.
Israel-dulemar, dule-bega-burba-uksadgi be wergumala, Israel-dulemar Sión-yargi-bukmalad, be-e-Reygi be wergumala.
Nue-weligwaledgi-dodonai, Bab-Dummad-e-nug ogannomala. Gar-pandero-ogornai ega be namakmala. Gar-arpa-ogornai ega be namakmala.
Ar Bab-Jehová e-dulemargi yeer itodaed. Dule-wiledimaladi e-isdarmaladgi-nakwega imakdaed.
Bab-Dummad-sordagan na be emargi-obichamaladgi, wergumala. Gachigi amba be maile, namakmai be imakmala.
Be-gammu-galagi Bab-Dummad-nug odummomala. Be-argangi es-suid-nugar-darbogwad-gani Bab-Dummad-nug odummomala:
Adi, dulemar-baigan buged-mai be imakmalaga, dulamar-baigan sabsur-odurdakega,
esgoro-dubgi e-reymar-edinnega, esgoro-dubgi e-dummagan-edinnegar.
Adi, Bab-Dummad, dulemar-sabsur-odurdakoye-sogsadba imaklegegar. Weyob gunonikile, bela bemar Bab-Dummad-sorda-gumaladi egi be wergumaloed. ¡Aleluya! ¡Anmar-Bab-Jehová-nug ogannomar!
¡Aleluya! Bab-Jehová-nug odummolesun. Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar. Bab-Dummad-nibneg-geger-dakle-nasiksadba, Bab-Dummad-nug odummomar.
E-ibmar-dummagan-imaksadba, Bab-Dummad-nug odummomar. E-gangued-dummarba-nikadba, Bab-Dummad-nug odummomar.
Gar-trompeta-goledba, Bab-Dummad-nug odummomar. Gar-arpa-goledba, Bab-Dummad-nug odummomar. Gar-lira-goledba, Bab-Dummad-nug odummomar.
Gar-pandero-goledba, Bab-Dummad-nug odummomar. Gwirnanai, Bab-Dummad-nug odummomar. Gar-dub-nikad-goledba, Bab-Dummad-nug odummomar. Gammu-goledba, Bab-Dummad-nug odummomar.
Gar-címbalo-binnasur-goledba, Bab-Dummad-nug odummomar. Gar-címbalo-yeer-goledba, Bab-Dummad-nug odummomar.
¡Bela dula-gudidiid, Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummomar! ¡Aleluya! ¡Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummomarsun!
David-machi-Salomón Israel-e-rey, we-binsaed-nuegan narmaksad:
Adi, binsaed-nikaa guega, igarmar-nuegan-mamaidba nanaega, gayaburba-dummagan-mamaid mamarega,
igar-mamaid-wisguega, itoakwaa ibmar-imakega, igar-innikii-mamaidba ibmar-imakega, igar-nabolegedgi igar-maidba imakega, emarbi-dulemar-dake nanaega.
Dule-nue-ibmar-wissulid ibmar-dukuar-maid-wisi imakega, sapingan nue-ibmar-wisi guega, sapingan mag-neg-itoakwaa nanaegar. Agala, Salomón, we-binsaed-nuegan narmaksad.
Dule-binsaed-ibedi, dule-nue-ibmar-wisidi, we-binsaed-nued itodaed, adi, gatik binsaed-nikaa guega, egi durdakbaligar.
Adi, binsaed-nuegan magar-itogega, e-burbagan-mamaid magar-itogega, dule-binsaed-nikaa-e-ibmar-soged magar itogega, oegedgi-sunmakleged magar-itobaligar.
Binsaed-nikaguedi, Bab-Jehová-dobee-nanaedgi danikid. Dule-binsaedsurmaladi, binsaed-nikagued abesulid, binsaed-nueganba nanabisulid.
Machi, be-bab-be-unaed nue be itogo. Be-nan-be-odurdakedba be dao.
Be-ibmar-durdaksad bega orgurginyobi ibnuedga guoed, bega ordubyobi ibnuedga guoed.
Machi, dule-isganamar be-yardakbi-gualile, melle ese binsaed galego.
Bega sokarmalale: “Anmarba be dage. Anmar dule-ibmar-oakalossulid oburgwenae. Anmar binsa-nabir-itogedba dule-baisur-binsadiid oburgwenae.
Igi napa dule-burgwaled-doe, deyob, anmar dule-neg-oakalossulid oburgwenamoga.
Anmar ibmar-nuegan ichesuli sumaloed. Anmar ibmar-sumaloedi, anmar-neggi ichesuli urbemaloed.
Anmarba be akae. Anmar ibmar-suoedi, anmar bega ukmogoed.”
Machi, melle amarba be akao, amar-igar-isganagi be banguo.
Ar we-dule-isganamar, ibmar-isgana bur gwae imakbidamalad, gwae dule-oburgwebidamalad.
Ar sikwimar e-wagab e-gaedsinai daksale, egi gwen dogosulid.
Ar we-dule-isganamardi, na dukin yardakledimalad, emar na dukin oburgwedimalad.
Dulemar-dogdar-maniginbi-binsamalad, deyob gunonidamalad. Dulemar-dogdar-maniginbi-binsamalad, dule-baidse burgwenonidamogad.
Binsaed-Nikaguedi, binnasuli galimbaba goled, dulemar-bukidar-ambikued-abargi isseed sunmaked.
Binsaed-Nikaguedi, dulemar-igar-itoged-abargi sunmaked, neggweburse-doged-yawagakgi sunmaked. Weyob soged:
“Sapingan, bemar-amba-nue-ibmar-wissurmalad, ¿ar sanagwadse, ibmar-wissuli be gudii gumaloe? ¿Ar sanagwadse, be dulemargi-dododiid, bar dulemargi dodosuli gumaloe? Dule-binsaed-satemalad, bemar, ¿sanagwadse ibmar-wisigued-isdar-daked sae be dakmalode?
¡An-ibmar-sabsur-soged be itomala! An-burba-nued an bega unnitiba ukoed. An-binsaed-wisguega an be-imakoed.
An bese gochamar-inigwele, yapa be an-itogusmalad. An bese achasmar-inigwele, gwen be amba ibsassurmalad.
Binsaed-nuegan-an-bega-uknaigusmaladi, aka be obachamalad. An-sabsur-bega-ibmar-sogsadi, gwen be itossurmalad.
A-ulale, bemar sabsur-odurdaklealile, an bemarga binnasuli alloed. Bemargi dobed nagunonikile, an bemarga alloed.
Burwa-dummad-goledyob bemargi dobed nagunonikile, an bemarga alloed. Burwa-ololedyobi bemargi nunmak-itoleged-dummad nagunonikile, an bemarga alloed.
”A-ibagine, geb be anse gordamaloed. Degi-inigwele, andi bemar-abin-imakosulid. Be an-amidii gumaloenad, degi-inigwele, be an-amiosurmalad.
Ar bemar binsaed-nikagued abessurmalad, Bab-Jehová-dobee be nanassurmalad.
An-bemarga-binsaed-nued-uked be itossurmalad, an-bemarga-sabsur-ibmar-sogsad be abessurmalad.
Na be-daed begi gannar aibinoed, be dule-yardakdimaladgi, na dukin be yardaklemaloed.
Be-isgusadba, be-ibmar-wissulidba, na be dukin berguoed. Be baisur-ibmar-dakedba, na be dukin oburgoed.
Ar dule anba-ibsaerdi, bogidik gudii guoed. Ibmar-isgana-dobsuli gudii guoed.”
Machi, an ibmar-bega-soged be itogele, an-igar-maidba be nanaele,
binsaed-nikaguedba be ibsaele, be-ulubgi bela-bela ise-itoagwar be ibmar imakele, geb be Bab-Jehováʼba-ibsaleged magar be itononikoed, magar be Bab-Dummad daknonikoed.
Machi, nue-ibmar-wisigued be egisele, magar-ibmar-itoged be egisele,
binsaed-nikagued maniyob be e-bina-sogdiile, or-nuegan-dukuar-bukwadyob be amiele,
geb be Bab-Jehováʼba-ibsaleged magar be itononikoed, magar be Bab-Dummad daknonikoed.
Ar Bab-Jehováʼbi binsaed-nikagued uked, Bab-Dummadbi nue-ibmar-wisi be-imaked.
Bab-Jehová dule-ibmar-innikii-imakmaladga binsaed-nikagued uked. Bab-Jehová amar-bendakdaed, amarba gudidaed.
Bab-Jehová dule-igar-maidba-ibmar-imakmalad nue-dakdidaed, Bab-Jehová dule-eba-nanadimalad edarbedidaed.
Geb agine, igar-inniki-mamaidba-imakleged, igar-nabolegedgi-igar-maidba-imakleged, emarbi-dulemar-dakleged, magar-itoge be guoed, wede ibi-obare.
Binsaed-nikagued be-ulubgi nagunonikile, nue-ibmar-wisidi, yeer-itoge be-imakoed.
Itoakwaadaedi be-bendakoed, nue-ibmar-wisiguedi be-bendakbaloed.
Binsaed-nikagued, igar-isganaba-nanaega be-imakosulid, dulemar-sunnasur-sunmakmaladgi be-ollor-imakoed.
Dulemar-igar-isganaba-bur-nanaega, igar-nuedgi-banguddamaladgi, binsaed-nikaguedi, be-ollor-imakoed.
Dulemar-ibmar-isgana-saedgi-wergumaladgi, ibmar-isgana-imakedba iba-onodamaladgi, binsaed-nikaguedi, be-ollor-imakoed.
Dulemar-igar-noar-noar-gudidamaladgi, igarmar-innikisulidba-gudidamaladgi, binsaed-nikaguedi, be ollor-imakoed.
Machi, binsaed-nikaguedi, dule-baid-e-omegi be-ollor-imakoed. Binsaed-nikaguedi, ome-agumakedba-emar-binsaed-gaedgi, be-ollor-imakoed.
A-ome, Bab-Dummad-asabin na abirgunagwar-gued-igar-mesisad ieded, degidbali, na e-suigi bar binsassulid.
A-ome-negse naye be sogele, burgwed-igarse be-sedoed.
Dule a-omese-gochale, bar gannarse guosulid, bar gannaryob nued-gudii guosulid.
Machi, deyobi, dule-nued-nanadimalad-igarba be nanaoed, igar-innikigwadbi be imakdii guoed.
Ar dule-igar-maidba-ibmar-imakmaladi we-napneggi gudii gumaloed. Dule-egi-ibmar-akar-soged-satemaladi, we-napneggi undar-suitii gudii gumaloed.
Dule-isganamardi we-napneggi bergumaloed, dule-ichomaladdi oburgwilemaloed.
Machi, melle an-igar-odurdaked be iego, be-gwage-ulubgi an-igar-maid be sedigu guo.
Ar deyob be imakele, we-napneggi suitii mai be guoed, weligwar-itodii be guoed.
Sabgued-igar melle be iego, napiragwad-igar melle be iebalo. Igi wingwa be-dukargi-naigu be gudidae, deyobi be imako, be-gwage-ulubgi sedigu be imako.
Deyob be imakele, Bab-Dummad nabir be-dakoed, dulemar nabir be-dakmogoed.
Melle be-ibmar-wisidba be nanadii guo. Bab-Jehováʼgi bela-belad-ulubgi-bensuli be nanadii imako.
Bela be ibmar-imakedgi Bab-Jehováʼse idakdii be imako. Deyob be imakele, Bab-Jehová bega igar nueganbi imakoed.
Mer be binsao, “An ibmar nue-wisye.” Bur be Bab-Jehová dobee nanae, bur be ibmar-isgana-imakedgi bangue.
Deyob be nanaele, we-igala, bela bega ina-nuedga guoed, bela bega be-abagan ogannogoed.
Be-ibmar-nikad-Bab-Jehováʼga-ukedgi Bab-Jehová-nug be odummoge. Gebe be-ibmar-sanmaked-Bab-Jehováʼga-ukedgi Bab-Jehová-nug be odummoge.
Deyob be imakele, be-ibmar-gwag-saboged-uu ena sii guoed, be-vino-binigan e-galugi ena sii guoed.
Machi, Bab-Jehová sabsur-be-odurdakalile, melle isdar be itogo, melle be urwebalo.
Igi baba na e-mimmi-sabedba sabsur-odurdakdae, deyobi, Bab-Jehová dulemar-sabedi sabsur-odurdakdamogad.
Dule binsaed-nikagued nikunonikile, we-dulegi nued binsalegoed. Dule ibmar-nue-wisi gunonikir, we-dulegi nued binsalegoed.
Binsaed-nikagued maniba bur bule ibnuedid, orba bur bule egi ibmar-nuegan amileged.
Binsaed-nikagued, akwa-nuegan-manisailadba bur ibnuedid. Ibmar-nue-wisigued, ibmar-nueganbina-sogleged-ebo yobsulid.
Ar binsaed-nikagued we-napneggi suitii mai be-imakoed. Deginbali, mani-ibedga be-imakbaloed, nug-nued-nikaguedga be-imakbaloed.
A-igarmarba-nanalegedi, yeer-ito dule-saedid, bela e-igarmar bogidik-gudii dule-imakedid.
Dule binsaed-nikagued-amisale, egi burba-dula-gudigued nikued. Dule binsaed-nuedgi-akas-gudiile, Bab-Dummad, we-dulegi nued binsaed.
Bab-Jehová binsaed-nikaguedgi, napneg nasiksad. Nue-ibmar-wisiguedgi, nibneg nasiksabalid.
Na ibmar nue-wisidba, diimar bachik-bachik nasiksad, nibneg-akale, dii-wiega imaksad.
Machi, nue-binsakwaa be ibmar imako. Itoakwaa-ibmar-imaked melle be iego.
Deyob be imakele, burba-dula-gudii be-imakoed. Bega ordubyobi ibnuedga guoed.
Geb agine, bonisuli be nanadii gudoed, be yoledii guosulid.
Be megid-sogele, be dobguosulid. Be gabidogu, bogidikidgi be gabidoed.
Ukiagwar-bonigan-noardaedi, be dobguosulid, dule-Bab-wissurmaladgi ukiagwar boni-dummagan-noardaedi, be dobguosurbalid.
Ar Bab-Jehová beba gudiguoed, dulemar-isganase yardaklegega be-imakosulid.
Dule-baidga-ibmar-nued-imaked begi siile, ega be imako, melle ega imaksuli be guo.
Melle ega be sogo: “Be nagwerye, banedse an be-bendakoye.” Ar emi sunna be a-dule-bendakele, bendaksabin be imako.
Melle be-ai-begi-bensuli-gudiidgi be aibino.
Melle dule-gwen-be-oakalossulidbo be urwo, ar dule gwen-be-oakalossulid.
Melle dule-sabsurdamalad-e-ibmar-imakdiidgi be nobguo, melle e-daedba be nanabalo.
Ar Bab-Jehová dule-isganamar nue isdar-dakdaed. Ar dule-nuegan-ebodi walikaa gudidaed.
Bab-Jehová, dule-nued-daed-e-neguyagi nued binsadaed, dule-isgana-e-neguyadi, ukabsadaed.
Bab-Jehová, dule-emargi-dododimaladgi dododamogad, ar dule-san-bipi-imakmaladdi, bendakdaed.
Dule-binsaed-ibegan-nug odummolegergebed. Ar dule-binsaedsulidamaladdi, egi dodoleddaed.
Machimala, bab-be-unaed nue be itomala, ibmar-nue-wisiguega nue-ise-itogale be imakmala.
Igar-nuegangi an be-odurdakgwelo, melle an-ibmar-odurdaked be itosuli guo.
An bipigwaunni, an-babba-an-gudigusgua, an-nana anbina bela-belad-sogdigusgua,
an-bab an-odurdaksad, weyob anga sogsad: “An-bega-ibmar-soged, ulubgi be nue-sedii imako. An-bega-ibmar-soged be imako. Deyob be imakele, we-napneggi suitii be gudiguoed.
Binsaed-nikagued be amie, ibmar-nue-wisigued be amie. Melle be an-gayaburba iego, melle egi be banguo.
Binsaed-nikaguedgi melle be bangue, ar a, be-bendakdii guoed. Binsaed-nikaguedbina bur be soge, ar a, be-edarbedii guoed.
Ibmar-baigan-idu, nue-binsaed-nikagued bur be amie. Bela ibmar baiganba, ibmar-nue-wisigued bur be amie.
Binsaed-nikaguedbina bur be soge, ar a, be-nug-odummogoed. Binsaed-nikagued bur be sabgue, ar a, be-nug-ogannogoed.
Binsaed-nikaguedi bega akwa-nuegan-ologurgingi-sigeyob gued. Ologurgin-nonogi sigeyobi bega gued.”
Machi, we-napneggi suibaksaar be gudiguega, an bega-ibmar-soged, nue be itoge.
Binsaed-nikagued-igarba an be-semaid, igar-innikigwadba-nanaega an be-imaked.
Be binnaa nadapsogele, bega ibmar-nueganbi guoed. Amba be gwae-gwae nadapsogele, bega ibmar-nueganbi gubaloed.
An be-odurdaked mer be iego, melle be indako, nue be sedio, we burba-dulagudiguega be-imaked.
Dule-isganamarba melle be akae. Amar-igarba melle be nanae.
A-dulemargi be bangue. Melle a-dulemar-walikaa be gudigue.
Dule-isganamar ibmar-isgana-imaksurmalale, geg gabdamalad, dule-oakalosurmalale, geg gabdamalad.
Ibmar-isgana-imaked mas-gunnedba bur-yeer itodamalad. Sabsur-emar-imaked, vino-gobedba bur-yeer itodamalad.
Igi bolegoe neg-ainakwiardae, deyobi, dule-nuegan-e-nanaedi gued. Dule-nuegan-e-daedi, neg ibegwaledse-nasgumai-nasgumai-daeyobi gued.
Dulemar-isgana-e-nanaeddi negsichid-naidyobi gued, wissurmalad, ibigi na yoledimala.
Machi, an bega binsaed-uked, nue be itoge, ibmar-bega-an-soged, nuekwaa be itoge.
An be-odurdakedgi melle be bangue, gwage-ulubgi nue-sedii be imake.
Ar dule binsaed-nikagunonikile, ega burba-duladga gued, we-dulega ina-nuedga gubalid.
Bela ibmar-sunsogmalad-baiganba, be-binsaedi nue-itoakwaa be ebugo. Ar we-binsalegedgine, gudiguleged danikid.
Gaya-isgana-sunmaked be indake, melle bar be gakansadii nanae.
Ibmar-nueganginbi be atake, yoo ibmar-danimaloedgi-atakdii be sae.
Be-nanadiid nue be dake. Bela be-ibmar-imakedi innikigwadbi be imake.
Melle igar-nuedgi be aibane. ¡Igar-isganagi be bangue!
Machi, an-binsaed-nikagued an bega-ukedi, nue be itoge, an ibmar-nue-wisidi an bega-sogedi, nue-ise-itogar be imake.
Adi, be sunmakalile, nue-itoakwaa sunmakegar, nue-ibmar-wisi be guegar.
Ome-sui-dikarba-yoleged-e-agumakedi, ibmar-nuediyob sunmaked. E-gwabin-ibmar-biedi, ibmar-nueganbi sogdaed.
Dule ese-binsaed-galesale, ina-gagbisailadyobi ega gued, es-suid-nugar-darbogwadba bur bule dule-naibi-saeyob gued.
Dule a-ome-ebogwa negsichidgi nanaele, burgwedse nilemaid. Neg-uanse selemaid.
A-ome dule-egi-sunmakmalad bai-itosulid. E-sunnasur-daedi, na bargasulid, e-ichakwa-nanadiidi na aku itoged.
Machi, emigi nue be an-itoge. An-ibmarmar-bega-sogedba be nanae.
Ome-e-sui-yardakdiidgi, be bangue. Melle e-neg-yawagakse be warmako,
adi, melle dule-baid-aku-be-dakedga be-arbasadgi-ibmar-nikusad be ukegar, melle be-burba-gandikid dule-baidga be ukegar.
Degiile, dule-baid be-ganguedgi yeer-itogoed. Degiile, be-arbasad-mani dule-baid-negse dogoed.
Geb agine, bela binna-binna be-san bergumaidba, be bodii gudoed.
Agi be sogdoed: “Ar wede, ibiga dule-anga-binsaed-uksamalad an itossuli. Ar wede, ibiga dule-sabsur-an-odurdaknaigua, an itossuli.
Dule-anga-binsaed-daknanai-gusmalad an itossulid. Dule-an-odurdaknanai-gusmaladba an ibsassulid.
Emide, dulemar-abargi, an oitolegednaga gudiid, wis ugak an gudiid.”
Be nog-gobbigualile, be-ome-ebo be nog gobo.
Unnila be-omesebi be golo, melle be-omesulidse be golo.
Be-ome unnila begadbiid, melle dule-baidga be-ome be urmakdii nanao.
Ome-bega-uklesadgi nued-binsalesun. Nuchukwagwadgi bega abirgin-uklesad-ebo be wergudii gusun.
Ome goe-sapuryob, yeer dakleged. Ome wasa-omeyob, yeer dakleged. Bele-bele be-imakar-sogele, egi be wergudii sao. E-sabguedgi be wergudii guo.
Machi, melle ome-baidse-binsaed-galedii be guo, melle ome-baid be-werguega, be imako.
Bab-Jehová bela dulemar-e-daed nue-wisid. Dulemar-nanaedi egi gwen yoggumaisulid.
Ibmar-isgana, dule-isganagi aibinoed, e-isguedgi ollorguosulid.
Dule-isgana, igar-maidba-nanabisulidbali burgwidoed. Na e-binsaed-satedbali, burgwidsunnoed.
Machi, dule-mani-gasad-anar, be bennukoye sogsale, igidibe, dule-baidga, be bennukoye igar mesisale,
na be imakoye sogsadgi, na be dukin yardaklesdo.
Degisoggu, machi, emidi be-aise be yardaklesad. Ar agi be ollorgubiele, weyob be imaksunna: Ese be nae, egi be wilenae, ega be sognae, an-bega-bennukoye-sogsadi, be anga osuloye.
Melle be ogabe, melle be banega saboge.
Igi goe-sapur, dule-e-makbied-idu wakinne, deyobi, dule-be-yardakbiedgi be wakinmoga. Igi nuu dule e-gabied-idu wakinne, deyobi, dule-be-yardakbiedgi be wakinmoga.
Dule-wiegala, nue be igli dake, e-ibmar-imaked nue be dake, binsaed-nikaguega eba be durdake.
Igli, ega-igar-uked sated, e-dummad sated, e-idued satebalid.
Degi-inigwele, dii-wisulidgine na e-mas onmaked, ibmar-durba-weleged-ibagine na e-mas onmakdaed.
Dule-wiegala, be meremaidi, ¿sanadse gwisguoye be soge? ¿Sanadse gabmaid be atakoe?
Be gabsiile, nono-yakumaksiile, sikwas napi-gabele, sakwa-bipirmakar wis obunnosiile,
ukiarmakale, dule-atursaeyobi, begi wileged nonikoed. Ukiarmakale, dule-negsuligudiidyobi, begi ibmarsuligued yolenonikoed.
Dule-isgana, dule-galagwensuli-nanaed, dule-gakansaedginbi-gudiid,
dule-yardakega, ibya-biri-emar-daked, dule-yardakega googi sunmaked, naggi sunmaked.
We-dulemar unnila ibmar-isgana-imakedginbi binsadidaed, aimar-ourwed yeer-itodaed.
A-ulale, ukiagwar egi bonigan yolenonikoed, ukiagwar berguoed.
Bab-Jehová ibmar soganergwa (6) sae-daked, napi-ibmar-sogagwenad-baid bur-bela-bela isdar daked. We-ibmarmar-sogagugled (7) isdar daked:
Dule-na-san-dummarba-imaked, dule-gadi-gakansaed, dule-binsarsunna-aimar-gindaked,
dule-galagwensuli-dule-baidgi-binsaed, dule-ibmar-isganabi-imakdidaed,
dule-ibmar-daksad-gakansaar-ibmar-soged, gwenadgan-gwenadgan-ourwed-dule. We-ibmarmar, Bab-Jehová isdar daked.
Machi, be-bab-be-odurdakedba be ibsae. Be-nan-be-unaedba, be dae.
Be-gwagegi-sedigu, be imake, ordub-be-dukargi-naiyob, be imake.
We-binsaed-nuegan, be bia nadele, be-idumai guoed. Be gabidele, be-edarboed. We-binsaed-nuegan, be atakar-sogele, bega sunmaknai guoed.
Igarmar-Mamaidi, gwalluyobi gued, ibmar-odurdakleged neg-meegwadyobi gued. Igar-nuegan-mamaidba-nanalegedi, be-odurdakoed igi be nanaergebe.
We-binsaed-nuegan, melle be ome-isganabo galagwensuli nanadiguega be-imakoed. Melle be ome-sui-dikarba-galagwensuli-gudiidbo nanaega be-imakoed. Melle we-ome-e-ibmar-nued-sogedgi be binsaed-galediguega be-imakoed.
Melle ome-isgana-e-yeerdaklegedbina be sogo. Ome-isgana be-dakedgi, melle ese be-binsaed galego.
Ar ome-gambanuchu-imaked unnila masbina gudiid. Ome-sui-dikarba-yolegeddi, bela be-sanbina sogdiid.
Ar dule na e-nukugi soo-sisale, ¿ei mor gummaksasulir be insae?
Ar dule soo-birgi nanaele, ¿ei nag gummaksasulir be insae? Ei gummaksale.
Dule, dule-baid-ome-ebo negsichigi nanaedi, soogi-gummakeyob boni-amiedsemogad.
Dule-atursaed ukudmaada-itogedba ibmar-atursasale, ¿isdar dakdamarsursi?
Dule-atursaed daklesardi, ilagugle (7) ibmar-atursasad bennukoed. Sulirdi, bela e-neggi-ibmar-nikad ukoed.
Dule ome-baidbo negsichidgi nanaele, we-dule, binsaed-satedid. Dule deyob-daedi, na dukin san-wioged.
Unnila binged-amiedid, na dukin naibid-amiedid. E-nug-gagalesad gwen ega alliosulid.
Ar we-ome-e-sui nobedba uludele, na san gwen bargaosulid, igi-barsaye gwen sogosulid.
Dule amba ome-e-suiga ibmar-ukye sogele, gwen abingaosulid. Ar amba ega ibmar-dummarba-ukye sogele, igi-barsaye gwen sogosulid.
Machi, bega-an-ibmar-sogedba be dae, igargan-an-bega-ukedba be nanae.
Igargan-an-bega-ukedba be nanaele, be dula gudiguoed. Be-ibyagwag be akweyobi, an-bega-ibmar-sogedba be ibsae.
An-be-unaedi, olargan-googi-yoiyobi, be sedii sae, be-gwagegi nue-ebinsadii be imake.
Binsaed-nikaguedga be soge: “Be an-bunye.” Ibmar-wisiguedga be soge: “Be an-ai-nuedye.”
Adi, wemar, ome-sui-dikarba-yolediidgi, be-ollor-imakoed, ome-e-agumakedba-emar-binsaed-gaedgi, be-ollor-imakoed.
An-neggi, yawagak-bipigwad-imbaba an atakded.
An dakalid, sapingana-binsaedsurmalad-abargi, machi-wargwen bur-binsaed-sated gudii.
We-sapingwade, igar-abingunaidse warmakdapid, agi ome-e-sui-dikarba-yolediid-negse naded.
Deunni, neg-sedomaid, neg nue-gutuleded, degi, neg nue-mutikguded.
Geb agine, ome e-abin-noalid. Ome gambanuchu-imakedyob mor-yoid. E-daedi, mag-dakleged, macherganbina sognadapid.
We-ome neg-gagadidaed, gwinni-gwinni daed, geg neggi siged, galimbabi wisid.
Galimbaba gudidaed, dulemar-bukidar-ambikuedgi gudidabalid. Igi-saele machered-wargwen-yardakodibeye binsadidaed.
We-ome, sapingwa-daksagua, gadebinne imaksad, ei wagar usa imaksad. Ega bingesuli sogded:
“Gwenatigwar-guega Bab-Dummadga an ibmar-ukoye an sogsad. Deyob an sogsadi, emi deyob an imaksad.
A-ulale, an be-abin noalid. An be-amidii gusad, emide an be-abingunonisunnad.
An-gabedgi atue-nued-yeerdakleged, lino-dubgi-sobaled-Egiptoʼgi-danikid an ogichad.
An-gabedgi ina-wawadikmalad, mirraʼye-nugad, áloeʼye-nugad, degine, canelaʼye-nugad an eosad.
Anba be dage. Anmar nog-gobmai oibodagoed. Oibogedse anmar nog-gobmai imakmaloed.
Ar an-sui neggi gudisulid, dikasuli neggwebur-baidse naded.
Mani-ichesuli sesa-naded, geb nii-dalu-naidse gannar negse aibiroed.”
Weyobi, ome, agumaksadgi, machigwa-binsaed-gasad.
Moli-alugwasualedi, e-oburgwilegedse ebipilemaiyobi, machigwa ome-sorba-nai nadapid. Goe-sapur galesgunaidgi sigu egi yolenonikiyobi, machigwa gued.
Igi nuu burgwed-wissuli saki-naidse naddae, machigwa deyobi gued.
Machi, emigi nue be an-itoge, an-be-unaed nue-itosii be imake.
Melle a-omegi-binsadii be sae, melle a-omese be binsaed galege.
Ar a-omese bukidar machergan yardaklediid. Machergan-bukidargus ese burgwedanikid.
We-ome-negse be nadele, be burgoed. A-igar burgwedse dule-semaid.
Binsaed-Nikagued, ¿anmarse iseedi gornaisursi? Ibmar-wisigued, ¿iseedi gornaisursi?
Binsaed-Nikagued, igarba yar-birigwagi gorgwisdaed, igarmar-abingunanaidgi gorgwisdaed.
Neggwebur-doged-e-yawagakmar-dikarba ise-gollar gornaidaed. E-yawagak-dogedgine binnasuli weyob-gornaid:
“Machergan, bemarse an gornaid, bela-dulemar-bukwadse an gornaid.
Bemar-ibmar-wissurmalad, itoakwaa be gudisamala. Bemar-binsaedsate-gudimalad, ibmar-magar-itoged be amimala.
Nue an-itomalo, an ibmar-nuegan sogesokalid. An-gwabinduku igar-innikigwadba sunmaksokalid.
An ibmar-sogedi gakangi sunmakosulid, ar gakanmar an nabir-daksulid.
An-gayaburbamar, igar-innikigwadbi sunmaked, darbo sunmaksulid, ibmar-isganagi sunmaksulid.
An-gayaburbamar, dule-magar-neg-itogedgala baisursunna-noed. Dule-binsaed-ibeganga, an-gayaburbamar innikigwadbi ega noed.
Mani-abelegedba an-ibmar-odurdakedbina bur bule be sogmala. Olo-nued-abelegedba ibmar-wisgulegedbina bur bule be sogmala.
Ar Binsaed-Nikagued, dimmurgiid-e-akwa-yeerdaklegedba bur bule ibnuedid. Ibmar-bur-nued egi obinsulid, ar ibmar-baid-ebo geg wilub-imakleged.”
“Ani an Binsaed-Nikaguedi, itoakwaa-binsaedbogwa an gudiid. Ibmar-wisigued an nikad, itoakwaadaed an nikabalid.
Dule, Bab-Jehová-dobekwaa nanadiile, isdar ibmar-isgana daked. Ar san-dummarba-imaked, an isdarsun daked, san-bule-bule-saed, an isdar dakbalid. Sunnasur-daed, galagwensur-sunmaked, an isdarsun dakbalid.
Binsaed-uklegeddi, angi maid, nuekwa-igar-nabolegeddi, angi maibalid. Neg-magar-itolegeddi, angi maid, gargangueddi, angi maibalid.
Ani an Binsaed-Nikaguedi, an-sogedba reymar wis negsedimalad. An-sogedba dule-nug-nikamalad, wis igar-innikii nabodimalad.
An-sogedba dule-nug-nikamalad negsedimalad, an-sogedba dule-negsedimalad napneg-sedimalad.
Dule-an-sabmaladi, an sabmogad. Dule-an-amidimaladi, baisursunna an-amimalad.
Ibmar-bukidar-nikuleged angi danikid, nuga-nued-nikuleged angi danibalid. Nue-nasguleged-degisadeguad angi danikid, igar-inniki-imakleged angi danibalid.
An-binsaed-ukedi, olo-nuedba bur-nuedid. Angi-binsaed-nued-amilegedi, mani-nuedba bur-nuedid.
Ani an Binsaed-Nikaguedi, igar-inniki-imaklegedba an nanaed, igar-inniki-naboleged-igarba an gudiid.
Dule-an-sabesar-gudimalad an onasgudiid, ibmar-nued-bukidar-nikubaliga an imakdiid.”
“Bab-Jehová ibmar-obinyed-iduale, bato anga burba-dulad uksad. Amba-yoo ibmar-obinyegua, bato an-obinnisad.
Yoo neg-nagued-iduale, Bab-Jehová an-obinnisad. Napneg amba yoo nagugua, sailanagi an-obinnisad.
An gwalulesgua, demar-wilagan amba yoo nagued. An gwalulesgua, suke-dummagan amba yoo megmalad.
Yala-dummagan-nagued-idu, an gwalulesad, yala-senigana-ambikued-idu, an gwalulesad.
Bab-Dummad amba yoo napneg-nasikgua, amba yoo sapurmar-bukwad-nasikgua, amba yoo napa-buru-napneg-sobsad-obinyegua, bato an gwalulesad.
Bab-Dummad mogir-arad-nasiknaigua, a-idu, bato an gudiid. Mogir-demarbo-abingunaid-nasiknaigua, a-idu, bato an gudiid.
Bab-Dummad mogirmar-nasiknaigua, a-idu, bato an gudiid. Demar-wiladgine suke-dummagan-ogannonaigua, a-idu, bato an gudiid.
Bab-Dummad demar-mer-murega, demargala igar-abingunanaid-ilemaknaigua, a-idu, bato an gudiid. Napneg-e-sailagan-mesnaigua, a-idu, bato an gudiid.
Bab-Dummadbogwa bela igar-ilemaknai an gusad. Iba-ilibali weligwar an-itodidaed. Bab-Dummad-asabinni iba-ilibali an wergudidaed.
Bab-Dummad-napneg-obinnisadgi an wergudiid, dulemar-gudimaladba an wergudiid.”
Ani an Binsaed-Nikaguedi sogbalid: “Degisoggu, mimmigan, nue an-itomalo: Dule an-igar-maidba-nanadiile, egi ise-nued binsalesad.
An-binsaed-uked be-nue-itomala, binsaed-nikaa be damala, mer baisur-dakmala.
Dulemar-nabir-an-itodimalad, bane-bane an-yawagak-naba an-edarbedimalad, we-dulemargi ise-nued binsalesad.
Ar dule an-aminonidibe, burba-dula-maid aminonikoed. Bab-Jehová we-dulegi nabir binsanonikoed.
Dule an-obandibe, na dukin bonigan-amioed. Dule isdar an-dakdibe, na burgwed-amied.”
Binsaed-Nikagued na e-neg-sobsad, e-buarmar walagugle (7) ogwichisad.
Binsaed-Nikagued iba-dummad onosad, vino-nued imaknai gualid, mese guakwaa siinai guarbalid.
Binsaed-Nikagued, e-garda-berbemalad barmisad, neggwebur-siid-birise barmisad agi iseedi gorbukwa gumalagar.
Dule-binsaedsurmaladga weyob sogded: “Dule-binsaedsurmalad, anse be dagmala.
Dagmala, an-mas-nued gundamala, an-vino-oburusad be gobdamala.
Ar be nabir-gudii gubimalale, be binsaedsuli-gudimalad osulomalargebed, binsaed-nikaa be gudigumalargebed. Deyobi, geb be nabir-gudii guoed.”
“Be dule-gwen-nabir-dasurmaladse be gotedibe, melle ibmar-isgana be imakye, aka bese-urwega ese be goloed. Ar be dule-isganase uluddibe, aka bese-urwega guoed.
Dule-gwen-nabir-dasulidse, mer be gole. Aka sae-be-dakega ese be goloed. Dule-binsaed-nikadse be gotedibe, mer ibmar-isgana be imakye, we-duledi, be-sabguoed.
Dule-binsaed-nikagued be odurdakele, a-dule, bur bule binsaed-nikaa naoed. Dule-inniki-gudiid be odurdakele, a-dule, bur bule binsaed-nikaa naoed.
”Dule binsaed-nikarba-gubidibe, Bab-Jehová-dobekwaa-gudii guergebed, Dule, Bab-Dummad-Isligwaled wisgubiele, ibmar-wisirba-gued na oyonaid.
Ar ani, Binsaed-Nikagued, angi be-ibagan-gudiid suitii guoed, an-nukad deyob guoed. Be-burba-dula-gudiid birgaba sugumai guoed.
Be nabir-binsaed-nikarbaddibe, we-binsaed-nikagued ibnuedga bega gunonikoed. Be galagwensulidaeddibe, na be dukin nunmaked-itodii guoed.”
Binsaedsulid, yaisur neg-gagadaed, gwen ibmar wissulid, gwen nabir binsasurbalid.
Binsaedsulid, e-neg-yawagak-naba sigoed. Neggwebur-dogedgine, bela-e-dakmalagala, neggwebur-birigwagi sigoed.
Binsaedsulid, dule-igarba-gudidamaladse gorsidaed, binsaedsate-gudidamaladse gorsidaed.
Weyob dule-binsaed-satemaladga sogdedaed: “Be anse dagmala.
Dii-atursaaled bur-nued gobleged, mas-nued arbakee-dukuar-gullegedi, bur-nued gulleged.”
Ar we-dule-binsaed-satemaladdina, agi burgwed-amileged wissurmalad. Ar dule-binsaedsulidba-ibsasmaladi, emisgindi neg-urba mamaid.
Salomón-e-binsaed-nuegan-narmaklesad: Machi-binsaed-ibedi, e-bab-gwage-weligwar imaked. Machi-binsaedsuliddina, e-nanga gwage-nunmaked-ukega gued.
Ibmar-isganagi-mani-amilegedi, ibnuedga gusulid. Ibmar-inniki-imaklegeddina, burgwedgi-san-onogega emar-imaked.
Bab-Jehová, dule-innikidaedi, ukudmaada-gudiguega imaksulid. Dule-isgana-sulibinsa-ibmarbina-itodimaladdi obaned.
Dule-wiesailamaladi, wilegega gued. Dule-gadi-arbamaladdina, e-ibmar ega nasgumai gued.
Dule-binsaed-nikadaedi, yorgine ibmar-gwag-gullemalad na onmaked. Dule ibmar-gwag-weleged-e-ibagangi gabedbi-gudiiddi, we-dule, na dukin binged-amied.
Bab-Dummadi, dule-innikidaedgi, nued binsaed. Gaya-isgana-sunmaklegedi, unnila dule-wiogega emar-imaked.
Dule-innikidaed-e-nuggi nued sunmakledidaed. Dule-isgana-e-nuggindina, bar-egi-binsalesulid.
Dule-binsaed-ibed igar-maidba ibsaed. Dule-binsaedsulidaeddi, e-sunmakedgi na dukin san-wioged.
Dule-nuekwa-nanadiidi, bonisuli nanadiid. Dule-galagwensuli-nanadiiddina, ibagwengi e-isgued magar-daklenonikoed.
Dule ibmar-isgana-gunaid baisur-dakedi, emarga naibid-uked. Dule-binsaedsulid e-sunmakedgi na boni-amioed.
Dule-innikidaed-e-sunmakedi, dulega ibnuedga gued. Dule-isgana-e-sunmakeddina, unnila yamo dule-ourwega sunmaked.
Sae-emar-dakedgi, urwed amileged. Sabgueddina, isgussuliyob emar-dake imaked.
Dule-itoakwaa-gudiid-e-sunmakedgine, binsaed-nikagued amileged. Dule-binsaedsulidaeddina, e-yargan-gordii gued.
Dule-binsaed-ibegan, e-ibmar-wisigued bur bule amied. Dule-binsaedsulidaeddina, e-sunmakedgi ukiagwar boni-onogedsedaed.
Dule-mani-ibedi, manigi e-gangued siid. Dule-wilegeddina, wileged ega boniga-gumogad.
Dule-innikidaed-e-ibmar-imakedi, ega ibnuedga gued. Dule-isgana-e-ibmar-imakeddina, ega ib-isganaga gued.
Dule igar-odurdaklegedba-ibsaele, burba-dulad-nikaa gudii gued. Dule igar-odurdaklegedba-ibsasuliddina, igar-isganaba naddaed.
Dule-gakansaerbadi, sae-emar-daked odukued. Dule-emargi-isdar-sunmakedi, binsaedsuli gued.
Dule-gadi-sunmaked, gege isgued sogsuli gued. Dule gwabinduku-bargaed-nikaddina, we-dule, dule-binsaed-ibedid.
Dule-innikidaed-e-sunmakedi, mani-nuedyobid. Dule-isgana-e-binsaeddina, ibnuedga gusulid.
Dule-innikidaed-e-sunmakedi, dulemarga binsaed-nued uked. Dule-binsaedsuliddina, noar-binsaedba na dukin burgwed-amied.
Bab-Jehová-nued-emargi-binsaedi, ibmar-nuegan uked, bukib-binsaed-igar egi maisulid.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedi, na galagwensuli-gudiidgi wergudiid. Dule-binsaed-nikarbaddina, e-binsaed-nikarbadgi na wergudimogad.
Dule-isgana, na ibmar-dobgudiid egi aibined. Dule-innikidaeddina, na ibmar-abediid ega nabir gued.
Dule-isgana boni-dummagan-abin gwen gwisguosulid, yog-berguar gued. Dule-innikidaeddina, boni-dummagan-abin gwen-sikirmaksuli degisadeguoed.
Igi-ina-soled nugar-iii-imake, igi waabali ibya aurmake, deyobi, dule-wiegala e-dummadga gued.
Dule-Bab-Jehováʼgi-dobekwaa-nanadiidi, ibagan-suitii gudii gued. Dule-isganamardina, ibagan-suitii gudii gusulid.
Dule-innikidaedgala, iba-nuegan ega danidaed. Dule-isganagardina, iba-isganamar ega nonidaed.
Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maidi, dule-innikidaedga bendakleged-igar gued. Dule-ibmar-isgana-imakdimaladgardina, ega boniga binyed.
Dule-innikidamaladi, bonigan-abin akar-guosulid. Dule-isganamardina, we-napneggi gudii guosulid.
Dule-innikidaed-e-sunmakedi, binsaed-nika sunmaked. Dule-galagwensuli-sunmakeddina, gaya-maklemaloed.
Dule-innikidaed-e-sunmakedi, yeer-ito dule-imaked. Dule-isganamardina, galagwensuli ibmar-isganagi sunmaked.
Bab-Jehová nibir-innikisulid isdar daked. Nibir-innikigwaddina, nued daked.
San-odummolegedgi, nug-oicholeged danikid. San-bipi-imaklegedgindina, binsaed-nikagued danikid.
Dule-innikidaedgala, e-daed e-iduedga gued. Dule-isganadina, na e-isguedgi dukin boni-amied.
Igar-naboleged-ibagan-nonikile, be-ibmar-bukidar-nikadi be-bendakosurguoed. Ibmar-inniki-imaklegedgindina, burgwed-igar amilesulid.
Dule-innikidaedgala, e-ibmar-inniki-imakedi ega igar-nuegan oyoged. Dule-isganadina, e-ibmar-isgana-imakdiidgi na dukin wilegoed.
Dule-innikidamaladi, ibmar-inniki-imakedgi bendaklemalad. Dule-isganamardina, sulibinsa-ibmarbina-sogedgi bipirmakmalad.
Dule-isgana-burgwidele, na ibmar-edarbediid eba-yoggudoed, na e-nug-dummarba-guedgi-gabdakdiid bela eba-bergudbaloed.
Dule-innikidaedga, bonigan-noalile, akar-gusulid. Dule-isganadina, boniganse ibitogoed.
Dule-isgana, e-gwabin-dukugi dule-e-neg-nabamaid wioged. Dule-innikidaeddina, e-binsaed-nued-nikarbadgi na san-onoged.
Dule-innikidaed-nasgudele, bela dulemar wergued. Dule-isgana-burgwiderdina, wergued-dummad nagued.
Dule-innikidaedi, e-ibmar-nued-oyogedgi neggwebur-ogannoged. Dule-isgana-e-gwabin-dukudina, neggwebur-wioged.
Dule-inniki-binsasulidi, mesagwar emar-imaked. Dule-itoakwaa-binsaeddina, na e-gwabin-bargaed wisid.
Dule-yogasaar-sunmakedi, ibmar-soged odukusulid. Dule-na-burba-bargaed-nikaddina, itoakwaa sunmaked.
Negseleged-igar inniki-maisulile, dulemar galagwensuli guddaed. Dule-binsaed-nued-dakmaladgi neg-inniki-seleged danikid.
Be dule-akudaked-mani-gasad-anar, mani be bennukoye sogsale, na be dukin boni-amioed. Be dule-akudaked-mani-gasad-anar, be mani bennukosurye sogsardi, be bonisuli gudii guoed.
Ome gwage-nued-nikad-oyodiile, e-nug ogannoledii guoed. Dule ibmar-imakerbaddi, unnila ibmar-bukidar-nika-gudii guoed.
Dule gwage-nued-nikad-oyodiile, ega ibmar-nuedga gued. Dule-sabsurdaeddina, na dukin nunmaked amied.
Dule-isgana ibmar-isgana-imakedgi-ibmar-amied binsaledid. Dule-ibmar-inniki-imakedgi-ibmar-amied, ega ibnuedga gued.
Dule-innikidaed, burba-dulad-nika gudiid. Dule-ibmar-isganabina-sogdiiddina, burgwed-igar ega ukleged.
Bab-Jehová dule-gwage-isgana-nikadi, nabir-daksulid, ar we-dulemar, ibmar-isganaginbi binsadimalad. Bab-Dummad dule-inniki-gudiiddina yeerdaked.
Dule-isgana, amba sabsur odurdaklegedsegad. Dule-innikidamaladdina, sabsur-odurdaklegosurmalad.
Olo-nued-sin-e-asugi-yoiyobi, ome-yeerdakleged-binsaedsulidaed gued.
Dule-innikidaedi, unnila ibmar-nued-imakedbi abeged. Dule-isganamar-e-ibmar-abegeddina, unnila urwedginbi binsadiid.
Dule-wilub-obicha-ibmar-ukedi, aka ibmar-bukidar ega ukleged. Dule, mani-ganikid gwen-bennukdisulile, dule-wilegedga gudoed.
Dule-wilub-obicha-ibmar-ukedi, ibmar ega nasgued. Dule emar-ogannodiile, ogannoledii gumogoed.
Dule ibmargwag-gulleged na ebi gaasa-imakele, dulemar egi isdar sunmaked. Dule ibmargwag-gulleged emarga weligwaledgi manigi-ukdibe, dulemar egi nued binsaed.
Dule ibmar-nued-imakedi, aimar-nued amied. Dule ibmar-isganabina-gudiiddi, ibmar-isgana egi aibined.
Dule e-ibmar-nikadgi-alakwaa-naidibe, we-dule galakudoed. Dule-innikidaeddina, sapi-durbamakgwichidyob gudoed.
Dule dukin e-neguya-oichogedi, na e-neguya-obelogega imaked. Dule-binsaedsulidaeddi, dule-binsaed-ibed-e-maiga gudii gued.
Dule-innikidaed-e-ibmar-imakedi, nued-gudii e-imaked. Dule, dule-bamalad-ibmar-nued-imake-saedi, dule-binsaed-ibedid.
Dule-innikidaedga, we-napneggi ibmar-nued ukleged. Dule-isganamar-bulesunna, ar e-ibmar-isgana-imakdiidba we-napneggi sabsur-odurdaklemaloed.
Dule igar-nuegan-mamaidbina-itogerbadi, binsaed-nikaguedbina nue-soged. Dule igar-nuegan-mamaid-isdar-dakeddi, dule-binsaedsulidaedid.
Dule-nueddaedgi Bab-Jehová nabir-binsaed. Dule-galagwensuli-binsaeddi, Bab-Dummadse apor-gued.
Dule ibmar-isgana-imakedgi gargangued amiosulid. Dule-innikidaed-e-gargangueddi, gwen gigli guosulid.
Ome-innikidaedi, e-sui-nug odummoged. Ome-galagwensulidaeddina, e-sui-nug oichoged.
Dule-innikidaed-e-igarmar-amiedi, ibmar-inniki-imakedgi binsaed. Dule-isgana-e-sunmakeddina, unnila emar-yardakedgi sunmaked.
Dule-isgana-e-sunmakedi, emar-yardakar sunmaked, ablis-eogedgi sunmaked. Dule-nuegan-e-sunmakeddina, dulemar egi bendakleged amied.
Bab-Dummad sulibinsa dule-isganamar-imaked, degidba berguddamalad. Dule-innikidaed-e-mimmigandina, gwen-berguosulid.
Dule e-binsaed-nikaguedba, e-nug odummoleged. Dule-gwage-isgana-nikaddina, isdar dakleged.
Dule-san-dummarba-imaked-masgunned-satedba, bur nuedid, dule-mesagwar-gudiid wis-e-mai-ega-ibmar-imaked-nikar.
Dule-innikidaedi, na e-moli-nikad nued akwediid. Dule-isganadina, baisur e-ibmar daked.
Dule-sapurba-gadi-arbaedi, mas nikagudaed. Dule, dule-gegeganaba-gudiiddina, binsaedsuli gued.
Ibmar-isganabina-surbinsa-itolegedi, dule-isganaga boniga gued. Dule-innikidaeddina, sapi-nued-durbamakgwichiyob gued.
Dule-isgana na dukin gakansaar-sunmakedgi boni-amied. Dule-innikidaeddina, boniganse galakusulid.
Dulemar-na-e-sunmakedba ibmar abingaed. E-ibmar-imakedba ibmar abingabalid.
Dule-binsaedsulidaed na e-igar inniki-maiye bidaed. Dule-binsaed-nikarbaddina, unaleged-igarba ibsaed.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedi, baisursunna uluddaed. Dule-itoakwaadaeddina, egi-dule-urwed igi-barsaye sogdaed.
Dule-inniki-gudiid ibmar-napiragwad sunmaked, dule ibmar-gusad-gakansaar-barsogeddina, unnila gakanbi-sunmaked.
Dule-yogasaar-sunmakedi, es-suidse-naibigulegeyob emar-imaked. Dule-binsaed-nikarbad-e-sunmakeddina, ina-nuedyob gued.
Dule-ibmar-napiragwad-sunmakedi, sereddii megoed. Dule-gakanbi-sunmakeddina, sikwas gudii guoed.
Dule-galagwensuli-binsaedi, emar-yardakedgi binsaed. Dulemar-neg-bogidik-imakmaladdina, werguleged uked.
Dule-innikidaedi, boniganse akar-guosulid. Dule-isganamardina, boniganse ibitomaloed.
Bab-Jehová dule-gadi-gakansamaladi, gwen-nabir daksulid. Dule-inniki-gudiiddi, nued daked.
Dule-binsaed-nikarbadi, ibmar-wisirba na san-imaksulid. Dule-binsaed-sulidaeddina, galagwensulidaed na oyoged.
Dule-gadi-arbaedi, negseoedid. Dule-wiegaladina, maiga gudii guoed.
Sulibinsa-itogedi, dule-gwage wioged. Gaya-nueddina, emar-weligwar imaked.
Dule-innikidaedi, binsaed-nued emarga uked. Dule-isganadina, e-isguedgi emar-oichoged.
Dule-wiegala masgunnedsuli gudidaed, dule-arbaegaladina, ibmar-nikagu daed.
Ibmar-inniki-imakleged-igargi undar-dula-gudiid amileged, we-igargine burgwed-igar amilesulid.
Machi-binsaed-ibed, e-bab-ega-binsaed-uked nabir-itoged. Machi-uayasuliddina, ega-binsaed-uked isdar-itoged.
Dule-inniki-sunmaked, na e-sunmakedgi ibnued amidii guoed. Dule-emargi-yolemaladdina, unnila urwedginbi gudii guoed.
Dule-na-e-gwabinduku-nabir-bargaed, na dukin e-san bendakdiid. Dule-na-e-gwabinduku-wissur-bargaeddina, na dukin e-san wioged.
Dule-wiegala, na e-ibmar-abediid gwen-abingaosulid. Dule-gadi-arbaeddina, na e-ibmar-abediid abingaedsegad.
Dule-innikidaed gakan-igar gwen nabir-daksulid. Dule-isganadina, binged-amiedid, degine, emar-wiogedid.
Ibmar-inniki-imakleged dule-inniki-gudiid-bendakedid. Ibmar-isganadina, dule-isgudiid-wiogega imaked.
Abar-dulemar mani-nikayob gudidamalad, degi-inigwele, ibmardi gwen nikasurmalad. Abar-dulemar ibmarsuliyob gudidamalad, degi-inigwele, ibmardi nue-nika gudidamalad.
Dule-mani-ibed mani-nikadbali, sunna dule-isganase galesar gudiid. Dule-wilegeddina, we-boni nikasulid, ar dulemar bai daksulid.
Dule-innikidaed-e-gudiidi, gwallu-gaeyob weligwaled oyodiid. Dule-isgana-gudimaladdina, negsichid-naiyob gued.
Dule-san-dummarba-imaked emarga urwed-amied. Dule-na-san-bipi-imakeddi, binsaed-nikaguedba gudiid.
Mani-yogasaar-amileged baisursunna-berguddaed. Dule-mani-saboged-wisiddina, binnasdikii ibmar-nikumaidaed.
Ibmar-edarbelediid-abingalesulile, gwage-nunmaked emarga uked. Ibmar-edarbelediid-abingalenonikile, weligwaled anmarga uked.
Dule igar-soglemaid isdar-dakele, na dukin boni-amied. Dule igar-soglemaidba ibsaele, ibmar-nued ega ukleged.
Dule-binsaed-ibed-e-ibmar-odurdaked, burba-dulad emarga uked. Dule-binsaed-ibed-e-ibmar-odurdaked, burgwed-igargi nabir emar-bendakbalid.
Unaleged-igar-innikigwad-uklegedi, nabir-itole neg-imaked. Dule-igar-maidba-ibsadisuliddina, boni-dummad na abgadii guoed.
Dule-itoakwaadaed, binsaed-nued-nikadgi ibmar imaked. Dule-binsaed-sulidaeddina, galagwensulidaed na oyoged.
Dule-gayaburba-berbeged-isgana, boni emarga amied. Dule-gayaburba-berbeged-nueddina, ibmar-nued emarga uked.
Dule, unaleged-igar isdar-dakele, dule-wilegedga gued, e-nuggi dodolebalid. Dule, unaleged-igar nabir-itogele, nug-dummarba nikuoed.
Ibmar-abeleged-abingalesale, emar-gwage-weligwar imaked. Ibmar-isganagi-banguleged, dule-binsaedsulidga gwen nabir-nosulid.
Dule, dule-binsaed-nued-nikadba akaele, binsaed-nued-nika gumogoed. Dule, dule-binsaedsulidba akaele, na dukin boni-amied.
Dule-isgana, ibmar-isganase bargaledidaed. Dule-innikidamaladdina, ibmar-nuegan abingaed.
Dule-nued-daed e-wagangala, ibmar-nuegan obeged. Dule-isgana-e-ibmar-nikaddina, dule-innikidaedga obeged.
Dule-wilemalad-e-nainugi, nue-ibmar sanmaked. Degi-inigwele, dule-ibmar-isgana-imakedba, bela we-ibmar yoggued.
Dule, e-machi-odurdaksulile, e-machi-isdar-dakeyob gued. Dule, e-machi-sabele, e-machi yolenonikile, igar-maidba odurdakoed.
Dule-innikidaed, nue-immee masgunned. Dule-isganadina, amba ukudmaada gudii guoed.
Ome-binsaed-ibed e-neguya onasgued. Ome-binsaed-sulidaeddina, na dukin e-neguya obeloged.
Dule-inniki-nanadiid, Bab-Jehová-sogedba gudiid. Dule-igar-isganaba-gudiiddina, isdar Bab-Dummad-dakdiid.
Dule-binsaedsulidaed-e-sunmaked, unnila na san-odummogedgi sunmaked. Dule-binsaed-ibeddina, e-sunmakedgi bendakleged.
Dule moli-bebe-nikad-satele, e-ob-aila binsa ollo sigoed. Ar moli-bebe-nikad-e-arbaedgi masgulleged nue-amileged.
Dule-ibmar-gusad-barsoged-innikigwad, wissur-gakansaed. Dule-ibmar-gusad-barsoged-napiragwadsuliddi, unnila gakangi sunmaked.
Dule-galagwensulidaedi aisaar binsaed-nued nikubi gudidaenad, degi-inigwele, gwen amiosur guoed. Dule-binsaed-nued-nikarbaddina, baisursunna ibmar durdaked.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedgi be bannaba gudisae, ar a-dulegi, gwen be binsaed-nued amiosulid.
Dule-itoakwaadaedi, binsaed-nued-nikadba na magar neg-itoge gudiid. Dule-binsaedsulidaeddina, na e-binsaedgi yardaklediid.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedi, unnila isguedgi burgudiid. Dule-nuedmargindina, Bab-Dummad nued-binsaed.
