Dule, na sana-walagwen e-nunmaked magar itoged. E-wergued, dule-baid eba itogosulid.
Dule-isgana-e-neguya bela bergudoed. Dule-innikidaed-e-neguyadina, nasgumai gudoed.
Imbagwenale, dule na e-ibmar-imakedi, inniki-imakye bidaed, degi-inigwele, e-ibmar-imakedgine, sunna burgwed-igar amied.
Imbagwenale, alled-abalagine, gwage-nunmaked itoleged. Imbagwenale, weligwar-itogedgine, nunmak itoledabalid.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedi, na e-igar-isganagi wergudiid. Dule-nued-daeddina, na ibmar-nued-imakedgi wergudimogad.
Dule-baisur-binsaedi, baisursunna binsaed-galeged. Dule-itoakwaa-binsaeddina, ibmar-imaked-iduale itoakwaa binsaed.
Dule-binsaed-ibedi, ibmar-isgana-abin dobekwaa nanaed, igar-isganagi bachikii gudidaed. Dule-binsaedsulidaeddina, na san-buled imaked, gwen-akar-guosurye na binsadabalid.
Dule-baisursunna-urwedi, galagwensuli ibmar imaked. Dule-itoakwaa-binsaeddina, na san-bargaed oyoged.
Dule-baisur-binsaedi, unnila galagwensur-binsaleged abingaoed. Dule-itoakwaa-binsaedgala binsaed-nikarbad uklegoed.
Dule-isganamar, dule-nued-asabin yokorgi-sindigar sigmaloed. Dule-isganamar, dule-innikidamalad-e-igar-itogedgi, gan-bipigi sii gumaloed.
Dule-wilegedi, e-aimarbela isdarsunna dakdamalad. Dule-mani-ibeddina, bukidar e-aimar nikad.
Dule, dule-mesagwar-imakdiile, bato isgusye sogleged. Dule, dule-wileged-sabgudiile, we-dulegi ise-nued binsalesad.
Dule-galagwensuli-binsadiid igar-noar imaked. Dule-ibmar-inniki-imakdiiddi, sabgued-igar amied, igar-innikigwad amibalid.
Nue-arbalegedgine, ibmar-nuegan amileged. Binsa-gayaginbi-soglegeddina, wilegedga emar-imaked.
Dule-binsaed-ibedi, e-binsaed-nikaguedgi e-nug dungued. Dule-binsaedsulidaeddina, e-binsaedsulidaedgi na e-wileged amied.
Dule-ibmar-gusad-barsoged-innikigwadi, burgwedgi nue-emar-bendaked. Dule-ibmar-gusad-barsoged-napiragwadsuliddi, unnila gakansaedba emar-wioged.
Bab-Jehováʼgi-dobekwaa-nanalegedgine, bela-bela bendakleged siid. E-mimmigana, Bab-Dummadgi bendakleged nue-amimarmogad.
Bab-Jehováʼgi-dobekwaa-nanalegedgine, nued-gudiguleged amileged. Dule-deyob-gudiile, muis burgosulid.
Rey-e-garganguedi e-dulemar-bukidarad-nikadba siid. Dule-nuga-nikadi e-dulemar-satedba, bingesaar dakleged, agi nollomaksiid.
Dule baisursunna-urwesulidi, magasar neg-itoged. Dule-bargaedsuli-gudiiddina, galagwensuli-binsaed yoga-oyogar imaked.
Dule-gwage-bogidik-nikadi, nued-gudii gued. Dule-nobgueddina, bela na san-oichoged.
Dule-wileged-apor-imakedi, Bab-Dummadgine-yolenaid. Dule-wileged-sabgudiiddina, Bab-Dummad-e-nug odummodiid.
Dule-isgana e-ibmar-isgana-imakedgi boni-amied. Dule-innikidaeddina, e-daedgine na san-bendaked amied.
Dule-binsaed-ibed-e-gwagegine binsaed-nikagued naid. Dule-binsaedsulidaeddina, binsaed-nikagued magar-itosulid.
Ibmar-inniki-imaklegedgi neggwebur ogannolesiid. Isguedgindina, neggweburmar wiolesiid.
Rey, e-mai-itoakwaa-gudiidgi, nued-binsaed oyoged. Dule-e-nuggi-dododiidgardina, e-urwed oyoged.
Binnalegwadgi dule-urwenaid-abin-imakedi, urweleged bargaleged. Urwedgi dule-urwenaid-abin-imakeddi, urweleged baligannoged.
Dule-binsaed-ibed-e-sunmakedi, binsaed-nuegan uked. Dule-binsaedsulidaed-e-sunmakeddina, binsaed-isgana uked.
Bab-Jehová bela negdakmaid. Dule-nuedgi nakulemaid, dule-isganagi nakulemaibalid.
Gayaburba-gwage-gadi-gadi-imakedi, ina-nuediyobid. Gayaburba-isganadina, emarga gwage-naibid uked.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedi, e-bab-e-unaed isdarsunna itodaed. Dule-e-bab-e-unaed-nabir-itogeddina, itoakwaadaed oyoged.
Dule-innikidaed-e-neggine, ibmar-bukidar nikaguad. Dule-isganadina, na e-ibmar-bukidar-amiedgine, bonigan ega noed.
Dule-binsaed-ibegan-e-sunmakedgi, binsaed-nuegan ainied. Dule-binsaedsulidamaladdina deyob sunmaksulid.
Bab-Jehová dule-isgana-ega-ibmar-ogumakar-ukedi, gwen nabir-daksulid. Bab-Jehová, dule-innikidaed-ese-goledgindina, yeer itodaed.
Bab-Jehová dule-isgana-e-daed gwen nabir-daksulid. Dule-igar-inniki-imakdiiddina, nue-sabed.
Dule-galagwensuli-gudiidga, sabsur-odurdakleged-igar maid. Dule-odurdakleged-igar-isdar-dakdiiddi, unnila oburgweleged-igar ega maid.
Bab-Jehováʼgi, neg-uan dukumaisulid, burgwed-igar dukumaisurbalid. Degite, ¡dule-gwage-bule-sunna!
Dule-gwen-nabir-dasulidi, dule-ese-goled isdar-itodaed, degite, dule-binsaed-ibedbali, akasurbalid.
Gwage-weligwaledi, wagargi magar dakleged. Gwage-wile-itogedi, wagargi magar daklebalid.
Dule-magar-neg-itogedi, unnila binsaed-nuedbina gudidaed. Dule-binsaed-sulidaeddina, ibmar-galagwensulid na e-masgunnedyob imakdiid.
Dule-wile-itodiidgala, iba-nuegan gwen naisulid. Dule-weligwaledgardina, bane-bane ibabi neg-naid.
Dule ibmar-bukidar-nikad-ular, sulibinsa-itodiidba bur nuedid, dule wis-ibmar-belagwa-nika-gudiir, Bab-Jehová-dobekwaa-gudigubalir.
Isdar-itogedgi, moli-san-isesaar-gunsiidba bur nuedid, sabedgi wis mas-yoaledbi gunsiir.
Dule-gadi-urwedi, emarga gadi-urwed amied. Dule na san-bargaed-nikaddina, neg-bogidik imaked.
Dule-wiegalaga neg ikoganbi gued. Dule-innikidaedgardina, akwan-eogaleyob igar-maid.
Machi-binsaed-ibedi, e-bab-weligwar imaked. Machi-binsaedsulidaeddina, e-nan-mesagwar imaked.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedi, e-binsaedsulidba na wergudiid. Dule-magar-neg-itogeddina, na dukin e-daed-gudiid nudaked.
Binsaed-nuegan-satele, igarmar apurnonidaed. Dule-binsaed-nuegan-bukidaradbali, neg nasguddaed.
Ibmar-nued-soglegedi yeer-itole emar-imaked. Ibmar-nued-soglegedi, e-ibagi-sogledele, bur bule nuedid.
Dule-binsaed-ibedi, igar-nueganba nakwemaid. Degidbali, burgwisale, odurdakleged-neg dakosulid.
Bab-Jehová, dule-san-dummarba-imakdiid-e-neg obeloged. Omegan-ei-sui-burgwismalad e-napaneg-abingunanaiddi, Bab-Jehová akar-guega imakosulid.
Bab-Jehová, dule-isgana-e-binsaed isdarsun-daked, gayaburba-nuegandi, nued itoged.
Dule-ibmarbina-suli-binsa-itogedi e-neguyaga boni-uked. Dule manigi-binsaed-galeged-isdarsun-dakeddina, nued-gudii gued.
Dule-innikidaedi, emar-abin-imaksokalile, ise-binsaar imaked. Dule-isganadina, e-sunmaked ibmar-isganaginbi sunmaked.
Bab-Jehová dule-isganamar-itosulid. Dule-innikidaed-ese-goterdi, nue-itoged.
Dule, weligwaledba-emar-dakedi, emar-gwage-weligwar imaked. Gayaburba-nuegana, emar-niga-ogannoged.
Dule, emar-ega-ibmar-nabir-sogedi nabir-itogele, dule-binsaed-ibegan-abargi gudii guoed.
Dule, odurdakleged-igar isdarsunna dakele, na dukin isdarsunna dakdiid. Dule, odurdakleged-igar nued-abin-gaele, ibmar-nue-wisidga gued.
Bab-Jehováʼgi-dobekwaa-nanalegedgi binsaed-nikagued amileged, egi odurdakleged-igar-nued amilebalid. Ar dule na e-nug-odummoleged-abegele, na san-bipii imakgwelergebed.
Dule na e-gwagegine-soged, ibmar-imakoye, degi-inigwele, ibmar-imakleged Bab-Jehováʼse bergusiid.
Dule na bela-ibmar-imakedi, inniki-imakdiiye-bied, degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová sogoed, bule ibmar-inniki-imakdidibe.
Be ibmar-imakbied, Bab-Jehováʼga be uke, deyob be imakele, nabir bega igarga gunonikoed.
Bab-Jehová-ibmar-imakedi, igar-nikaa imaked. Ar dule-isganagase-bakale, odurdakleged-iba ega imaklesmogad.
Bab-Jehová dule-na-san-buled-imakdiid gwen-nabir-daksulid, ar we-dule sogedba-odurdaklegedsegad.
Isgued-nudaklegegala, unnila sabgued-nikadba, degi, innikigwadba nudakleged. Bab-Jehová-dobekwaa-gudiidgine, isguedgi banguleged.
Bab-Jehová dule-e-daed nued-dakele, dule-e-isdarmaladse-bakale, ebo-nued-gudii imakbalid.
Dule ibmar-isgana-imakdiidgi ibmar-bukidar-amied, aba bur nuedid, dule ibmar-inniki-imakdiidba wis-belagwasaar-gudii gued.
Dule ibmar-imakoye na sogedi, Bab-Jehová-sogedba we-dulega ibmar-gumai guoed.
Ar rey-sogdibe, ibmar deyob guoye, rey-igar-mesnonikidi irgwen-sogar meged.
Nibir-innikigwadi, nibir-e-bate-sogedbalid, Bab-Jehováʼgadid, ar Bab-Dummad bela ibmar-wilubsaleged imaksad.
Rey, ibmar-isgana-imaklegedi nabir-daksulid, ar e-garganguedi, unnila ibmar-inniki-imaklegedgi siid.
Rey, gayaburba-innikigwad-sunmakleged yeer daked, dule-napiragwad-sunmakedi, nued dakbalid.
Rey-e-urwedi, burgwed-igar-daged obared. Dule-binsaed-ibeddina, rey-e-gwage bogidik imaked.
Rey weligwaledba-emar-dakedi, igar-nuegan-oyoged. Rey-emargi-nued-binsaedi, dii-wieyob gued.
Or-nued-nikuedba, binsaed-nued-nikued bur-nuedid. Mani-nikuedba, ibmar-nue-wisigued bur-nuedid.
Dule-innikidaedi ibmar-isganaba nanadisulid. Dule-deyob-gudiidi na san-burba-bendakdiid.
San-odummolegedgine, ibitoged-igar maid. San-dummarba-imaklegedgine, yoleged-igar maid.
Dule san-dummarba-imakdimalad-abargi ibmar-nuegan-abingaedba, bur nuedid, dule-mesagwar-gudimalad-abargi wilesakwasaar-gudii gued.
Dule gayaburba-itogedi ibmar-nuegan amied. Dule Bab-Jehováʼgi bengudisulile, ise-nued egi binsalesad.
Dule-binsaed-ibed-sunsogedgindi, sogleged, dule-gurgin-nued-nikadye. Dule gayaburba-nuedgi-sunmaked, dule-eba-daega imaked.
Dule-itoakwaa-ibmar-imakedi, undar-gudiguoed. Dule-binsaedsulidaeddina, e-binsadiidgi na sabsur-odurdaklegoed.
Dule-binsaed-ibed-sunsoged, e-sunmaked nabir na bargaed. E-gayaburba-sunmakedgine, ibmar-nuegan-wisguleged onisiid.
Gayaburba-nuegan achanis-malegedyobi, gwage-ulubgine yeer-ito emar-imaked. Gayaburba-nuegan, san-burbagala ina-nuediyob gued.
Imbagwenale, dule, na e-ibmar-imakedi inniki-imakye bidaed, degi-inigwele, e-ibmar-imakedgine, sunna burgwed-igar amied.
Dule-arbadiid mas-gunnega arbaergebed, ar e-ukumaad-itoged oarbaega-imaked.
Dule-isgana, unnila igar-isgana-imaked amidiid. E-sunmakedi, igi-soo-ibmar-ogumake, deyob emar-imaked.
Dule-isgana, emarga urwed-amied. Dule-binsa-yogasaar-ibmar-sogedi, ai-nuegan-mamaredid.
Dule-gadi-urwed e-ai-yardakerbad, e-ai-galagwensulidae imaked.
Dule-ibyagi-sunmaked, ibmar-isgana-imakedgi binsadaed. Dule-gaya-gunnar-imaked, ibmar-isgana bato imaksa gudiid.
Dule-selebagus-nono-sipu-gudiidi, ologurgin-nikayob gudiid. Ibmar-inniki-imakdiidbali, e-nug ogannolediid.
Dule-na-niga-gandik-oyodiidba bur-nuedid, dule-na-e-gwage-bargaed-nika gudigued. Dule gandikidgi neggwebur-suedba bur nuedid, dule na san-bargaed-wisi gudigued.
Ibmar-imaklegegala, wilub-daklegar imakleged. Degi-inigwele, ibmar-guoed, Bab-Jehováʼse bergusiid.
Urwed-abargi san-nued-gunsiidba bur-nuedid, weligwaledgi madu-dutusulid-gunsiir.
Mai-binsaed-ibedi, machi-galagwensurdaed-e-dummadga gudiguoed. Mai-binsaed-ibedi, machi-galagwensurdaed-e-gwenadganba e-babgan-ega-ibmar-obesad nikumogoed.
Olo, soogi wilubdakleged, bormo-crisolʼgi mani wilubdaklebalid. Dule-e-binsaeddina, Bab-Jehováʼse wilubdaklemogad.
Dule-isgana, dulemar-gaya-isgana-sunmakedba ibsaed. Dule-gakansaegwa, dule-gaya-isgana-sogedba gudiid.
Dule dule-wilegedgi-dododiidi, Bab-Dummadgi dodoged. Dule, dule-wileged-naibi-itodiidga-allediidi, odurdaklegedsegad.
Dad-e-werguedi, e-wagan-nikadgi siid. Mimmigan-e-werguedi, e-babgangi simogad.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedi, gaya-nuegan-sunmakedi egi nosulid. Dule-dummagan-negsemamaid, gakansaar-sunmakedi, egi nosurmogad.
Dule manigi-emar-binsaed-gaed-gudiidi, na binsadaed, ede, ina-nika-gudiiye. Ar deyobi, yogasaar ibmar-amididaed.
Dule, dule-egi-isgusad-egi-isgussuliyob-dakedi, ai-nikued-igar ogannoged. Ar dule, dule-egi-isgusadga ibmar gannar-gannar-obarele, aimar-isdaradga imaked.
Dule-itoakwaa-binsaedga sabsur-ibmar-soglegele, irgwen-itogaled. Dule-binsaedsulidaeddina, molidubgi ila-dulataledse (100) bibyolenaidibe, amba itosulid.
Dule-uayasatedaedi, gusgu urwed-amididaed. Ibagwengine, dule-eba-bur-egi-obined abingunonikoed.
Dule-binsaedsulidaed e-ibmar-imakedgi-alamakdiid-abinguedba bur-baisulid, wiob-urwediid-abingued.
Dule, ibmar-nued-ega-imaklesad-ular, ibmar-ichakwa-ukdibe, e-neguyagine, bipisaale bonigan berguosulid.
Dule, urwed-onoye-sogele, diwar-dummad-noedyobi, dummad-neg-gagaed. Degisoggu, bur-nuedid urwedgi yog-banguar-imaked.
Bab-Jehová ibmar-sogbo isdar daked: Dule, dule-ibmar-oakalosad, ibmar-oakalossulidyob daked. Dule, dule-ibmar-oakalossulid, ibmar-oakalosadyob daked.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedga mani-uklenonikile, ¿igi imako na itoge? ¿Egi binsaed-nikagued amio na itoge? Suli. Ar edi, dule-ibmar-wissulidid.
Dule, ai-guedgine, gusgu ai-sabguerbad. Degisoggu, boni-dummad-ibagan-nonikile, gwenad-gargwenadyob gued.
Dule-itoakwaa-binsasulidi, yogasaar emarbogwa igar-mesed, dule-mani-gasad-anar mani-bennukega gubalid.
Dule-isguedbina-itogerbadi, unnila urwedbina gudidaed. Dule-san-dummarba-imakedi, na dukin boni-amidaed.
Dule-gwage-isgana, bipisaagwale ibmar-nued amiosulid. Dule-gadi-gakansaar-sunmakedi, ibmar-isgana egi aibinoed.
Dule, machi-binsaedsulidaed-nikale, bukib-binsaed ega uked. Dule-binsaedsulidaed-e-babga-guedi, wergued egi amilesulid.
Dule, gwage-weligwaled-nikale, ina-nuedga gued. Gwage-wile-itolegeddi, niga-obated.
Dule-isgana dukuar dule-baidse manigi binsaed galeged. Agala, ibmar-galagwensuli-imakleged geg bergued.
Dule-itoakwaa-binsaedi, binsaed-nued-nikuedginbi binsaed. Dule-binsaedsulidaeddina, aku neg-itoged, gabdakedginbi gudiid.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedi, e-bab-ourwed gudiid. E-nanga, gwage-nunmaked-uked gudibalid.
Dule-ibmar-oakalossulid sabsur-odurdaklegele, ibnuedsulid. Dule-ibmar-innikidamalad naibi-imaklegele, ibnuedsurbalid.
Dule-magar-neg-itogedi, nabir na e-gwabinduku bargaed. Dule-itoakwaa-binsaedi, nabir na san-bargamogad.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedi bogidik gudiile, binsaed-ibedyob daklemogad. Sunmaksurbalile, dule-itoakwaa-binsaedye, egi binsalebalid.
Dule-na-eginbi-binsaedi, unnila egarbi ibmar-nued abeged, dule-ega-binsaed-nued-ukeddi, abesulid.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedi, magar-ibmar-itoged baisur-daked, unnila e-ibmar-sogedgi na san-odummodiid.
Ibmar-isgana-imaklegedgine, dule-sae-dakleged nononidaed. Bingegulegedba-mai dule-nug-gagaleged danidaed.
Dule-e-gayaburba, dii-wiladyob gued. Diwar-iirmakemaiyob egi binsaed-nikagued ainimaid.
Dule-ibmar-oakalosad ibmar-oakalossuliyob-imakedi, ibnuedsulid. Dule-ibmar-oakalossulidga ega igar-innikigwad-imaksulile, ibnuedsurbalid.
Dule-binsaedsulidaed-e-sunmakedi, unnila neg-urwed onoged, e-sunmaked emarga urwed-amied.
Dule-binsaedsulidaed e-sunmakedgi na dukin san-wioged, e-sunmaked na dukin egi aibinega-imaked.
Gakangi-sunmaklegedi, mas-nued-gullegeyobid. Gakangi-sunmaklegedi, ulubse uboged.
Dule, e-arbaedgi nue-arbasulile, dule-ibmar-ogiloged-e-sordaga gued.
Bab-Jehová-e-nug, neg-matusulid-gandikid-geg-ayaredyobid. Dule, bendakleged-amiegala, a-negse abarmakdedaed. Bab-Jehová-e-nug dule-innikimaladga deyob gued.
Igi neggwebur-e-akwa-galu-matusulid-ebirnai, mani-ibmalad na deyob e-ibmar-nikad egi ebirnai itoged. Degisoggu, gwen akar-guosuliyob na binsamalad.
Dule, ibitoged-idu, e-daed bule-bule na san-oyoged. Dule, e-nug-ogannoleged-idu, e-daed na san-bipii oyoged.
Yogasaar gwen ibmar-itossuli-emar-abinsaele, binsaedsulidalegedid, dule-emar-obingeg-saedid.
Dule-uelleged bonigan-itomaidgi niga-gandikgudele, gwae nugudoed. Ar dule-uelleged niga-batismaile, ¿adi, igi nuguosunna?
Dule-itoakwaadaed ibmar-nuegan baramied. Dule-binsaed-ibed gatik ibmar-wisgued-nikuegala, nue ibmar-itodaed.
Ibmar-binsa-uklegedba belagwable yawagakmar argaed, abali, dule-dummaganse warmakleged.
Dule-na-e-inse-san-bendakedi, e-ibmar-sogedi, e-gussuliyob sunmaked. Geb dule-baid-ebo-boni-nikadi, sorba ibmar-sognonimogale, akar egi sunmaknonimogoed.
Ibmargi-wilubdaklegar-imakleged igar-apurnaid nabir nudaked. Dule-gandikidga, dule-gandikid-baidbo boni-nika-gunair, nabir ega igar-nudakbalid.
Neggwebur-e-akwa-galu-ebiris-bukwad-earedba bur undarad, gwenad-oululesad-e-gwage gadi-gadi-imaked. Neggwebur-yawagak-geg-argaedba bur undarad, gwenadgan-na-muchub-muchub-urwemalad walikaa-gudigued.
Dule na e-sunmakedba yeer-itodiid, na e-sunmakedba immee gudiid.
Sunmaklegedgine, burba-dulad maid, burgwed-igar maibalid. Dule na e-sunmakedbali, e-igar abingaoed.
Dule ome-nikunonikile, ibnued nikued. Bab-Jehová-egi-nued-binsaed ega oyoleged.
Dule-wileged wilesakwaa ibmar egised. Dule-mani-ibeddina, sabsur dule-abin-imaked.
Dule, aimar-nikale, aigwar guergebed. Abar-aimar nikad, gwenad-gargwenadba bur bule walikaa daed.
Dule-emargi-gakansaar-sunmakedba, bur nuedid, dule-wileged inniki-nanadii gued.
Itoakwaa ibmar-imaksulidi, nuedsulid. Dule gwae-gwae-ibmar-imakedi, gadi noar-ibmar-imakdaed.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedi, e-binsaedsulidba yogasaar nanaddaed. Geb sogdedaed: “An-akargusadi, Bab-Jehováʼginye.”
Dule, ibmar-nuegan-nikadba bukidar aimar-nikuega gued. Ar dule-wilegeddi, na e-aise-bakale, egi bangued.
Dule-ibmar-daksad-gakansaar-sogedi, sabsur-odurdaklegosuli guosulid. Dule-gakansili na gwen san-onogosulid.
Dulemar-bukidar, dule-obinebak-ibmar-uked-e-aiga-guega amimalad. Bela dulemar, dule-ibmar-binsa-uked-e-aiga gumalad.
Ar bela dule-wileged-e-gwenadgan, dule-wileged-isdar-dakele, e-aimar-bursunna, bur bule isdar dakoed. Dule-wilegedi, na e-bendakega e-aimar-amidiguo-inigwele, bipisaar amiosulid.
Dule ibmar-magar-itoged-amiedi, na e-san sabed. Na ibmar-durdaksad imakele, ibmar-nued amioed.
Dule-ibmar-daksad-gakansaar-sogedi, sabsur-odurdaklegosuli guosulid. Dule-gakansaar-sunmakedi, na burgwed-amioed.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedi, ibmar-mani-gargerbad-nikuedi, egi nosulid. Dule-maiga-gudiid-bursunna, bur bule dule-dummagan-e-dummadga-guedi egi nosulid.
Dule-binsaed-nikadaedi, na urwed wisi bargaed. Dule-egi-nosad-egi-nossuliyob-dakeddi, e-nug dummarbaa imaked.
Rey-urwedi, achumigur-nono-wawaad-uurmakedyob gued. Ar rey-e-nued-binsaeddi, gagangi boo-bateyobi neg-imaked.
Machi-binsaedsulidaedi, na e-bab-wile-itogega imaked. Ome-e-ulus-ulusdaedi, dii-yakedyob gued, binna-binna sui-wioged.
Nega, degi, ibmar-nuegan, babgan uked. Ome-binsaed-nikadaeddi, Bab-Jehová uked.
Wieguedi, dulega gabed-uked. Dule-wiegala ukudmaada gudii guoed.
Dule-Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba-ibsaedi, dukin san-bendaked. Dule-Bab-Jehová-Igar-Mesisad-isdar-dakeddi, burgoed.
Dule-wilegedga-ibmar-ukedi, Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-uknaiyob gued. Bab-Jehová dule-ibmar-uksadga gannar ibmar uked.
Be-machi nued-nanaegala, bipigwadgi be unao. Be sabsur-odurdakalile, melle oburgwedse be imako.
Dule-gadi-urwedi, sabsur-odurdaklegoed. E-urwed-bargaega egi binsa alamakleged, aka bur bule uluddaed.
Bega-binsaed-uklegedi, be itoge. Be-unaedi mer be isdar-itoge, ar dule-binsaed-ibedga be guoed.
Dule ibmar-imakega bukidar igar-amied, degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová-ibmar-imakbiedbi imakleged.
Dule emar-innikii-eba-daed abeged. Dule-gakansiliba, bur nuedid, dule-wilegedga-gued.
Bab-Jehová-dobekwaa-nanaedi, dula-gudii dule-imaked. Bogidik-gudii dule-imaked, mer-bonigan-nikuega dule-imaked.
Dule-wiegala mas-gunnega bateyagi e-argan ododaenad, degi-inigwele, wiedba e-gayaba mas odosulid.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedi, unnila sabsur-odurdakedgi ibmar-durdaked. Dule-binsaed-nikagueddi, na ibmar-durdakega irgwen-ounaed abeged.
Dule e-bab-ibe-ibmar-atursaedi, neggi e-nan-ononnobalidi, a-dule, machi-isganad, dule-binged-satedid.
Machi, dule-be-unaed be itosulile, binsaed-nikaguedgi be bangudoed.
Dule-ibmar-daksad-gakansaar-soged igar-nabolenaidgi dodoged. Dule-isgana ibmar-isganaginbi sunmaked.
Dule-emargi-dododimaladga sabsur-odurdakleged-igar guagwar maid. Dule-binsaedsulidaedga bibyoleged-igar guagwar maimogad.
Inna-gagbidi, bingedsuli dule-imaked. Sisa neg-gagaega dule-imaked. Dule, wemar-gobsale, binsaedsuli naddaed.
Rey-urwedi, achumigur-nono-wawaad-uurmakedyob gued. Dule rey-ourwega-imakedi, na dukin boni amied.
Dule-e-urwedgi-banguedi, bur nug-dummarba gued. Dule-binsaedsulidaeddi, urwed-amied.
Dule-wiegala yorgi neg imaksulid, ibmar-gwag-weleged-ibagangi ibmar-gwag weosulid.
Dule-binsaedi, dii-wiladyob gued, dule-ibmar-nue-wisiddi irgwensuli dule-binsaed-baramied.
Dule-bukidar sogdamalad, ede dule-nuedye. Degi-inigwele, dule-inniki-ibmar-sogeddi, ¿doa amioe?
Dule-nuedi, innikigwadba nanaed. E-mimmigan e-bab-nanaedba-nanadimarmogadi, egi ise-nued binsalesad.
Ar rey igar-nabogega e-ologanagi sigisale, unnila e-atakedgi bela ibmar-isgana baramied.
Dule geg soged: “Andi gwage swilidik-nikaye, andi isgued sateye.”
Bab-Jehová ibmar-sogbogwad nabir daksulid: Nibir-noaled, wilubsaed-noaled.
Machigwa e-ibmar-imakedba magar dakleged, e-daed innikigwadid, degi, nuedbalid.
Bab-Jehová ibmar-sogbo yeerdakle obinnisad: Uaya, ibmar-itogegar. Ibya, ibmar-dakegar.
Mer be dule-wilegedga-guega, mer be gabedginbi binsae. Bur be arbaedginbi binsae, adi, mas obinebaka be nikuoed.
Dule-ibmar-bakedi, yamo sogdedaed: “¡Wedi nuedsuli! ¡Wedi ibmar-isgana!” Ar we-ibmar-baksad-sorbardi, weligwar itodaed.
We-napneggi, ormar-nika-inigwele, akwa-nuegan-nika-inigwele, dule-binsaed-ibed-e-sunmakeddi, we-ibmarmarba bur nuedid.
Dule-akudaked-anar dule-mani-bennukoye-sogsad-ibe, ibmar-nued be sue. Mani-bennukegala, dule-e-ibmar-nued be gae.
Dule, emar-yardakedgi masgunned-amiedi yeer-itoged, degi-inigwele, a-masgunnedi durgan-gunneyob gued.
Igarmar-nuegan-amilegedi, binsaed-nued-dakedba amileged. Bila-onolegegala, igar-nikaa imaklegergebed.
Dule-galagwensuli-sunmakedi, ibmar odukusulid. Degisoggu, dulemar-gadi-galagwensuli-sunmakmaladba mer be akae.
Dule e-bab-ukabsaele, e-nan-ukabsaele, nuchukwaa burgoed.
Gebegi ibmar-irgwensursunna-nikulegedgi, be yeer itogosulid.
Mer be sogo, an buged-mai imakoye. Mer be Bab-Jehováʼgi bensuli gue, ar e be-bendakoed.
Bab-Jehová nibirmar-noaled isdar-daked, ibmar-wilubdaked-noaled abesulid.
Bab-Jehová, dule-iduega gued. Degisoggu, dule na yoedse igi-guoed wissulid.
Nue-binsassuli Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-imakoye-soged bonidar-dummadid. Geb sogsad-sorba, binsadele, an ibiga deyob sogsadibeye. Deyob-binsaedi, bonidar-dummadid.
Rey-binsaed-ibedi, dule-isganamar-oaisakied. Ob-ubigwar-imaklegeyob ese ubigwar gumalad.
Dule-burba, Bab-Jehová-anmarga-uksadi, bela gwage-ulubse binsaed-baramied. Ar a-burba, gwallu-meegwadyob dulega uksad.
Wile-dule-daklegedi, degi, napiragwadgi-ibmar-soglegedi, rey-bendakega gued. Rey-e-negdakmaidi, wile-dule-daklegedgi gangumaid.
Sapingan-e-werguedi, e-garganguedgi siid. Sergan-e-werguedi, e-ibmar-wisidgi simogad.
Bibyolegedgi, degi, naibisalegedgi, dule-isgana nudakleged. Sabsur-imaklegedgi, galagwensur-binsaleged nudakleged.
Bab-Jehováʼgi, rey-e-binsaed diwar-iirmakmaiyob gued. Deyobi, rey, Bab-Dummad-ibmar-abegedba ibmar-imaked.
Dule na war-wargwengi e-ibmar-imaked nueganbi-imakye binsaed. Ar Bab-Jehováʼdi, dule-ibiga-ibmar-imakbied, bato wisid.
Bab-Dummad ibdurgan-ogumakar-ukedba, bur nued-daked, igar-inniki-imakleged, degi, innikigwadba-ibmar-imakleged.
Emar-ibgwensur-dakedi, san-dummarba-imakedi, dule-isganamar-e-binsaedi, bela wemar isgumaladid.
Nue-itoakwaa-igarmar-amilegedi, ibmar-nuedga gued. Gwae-gwae-igar-amilegeddi, ibmar-nuedga gusulid.
Gakansaedgi ibmar-nuegan-ichesur-nikuedi, booyob berguddaed, dule-oburgwega gubalid.
Dule-isganamar, dukin e-sabsur-ibmar-imakedse berguoed. Ar igar-inniki-imaklegedi, imakbisurmalad.
Dule-isgana-e-daedi, innikisulid, boni-nikad. Dule-nued-daeddi, innikigwadid.
Neg-dummadgi ome-gadi-urwedbo-gudisaedba, bur nuedid, neg-bipigwadgi-gudisaed.
Dule-isgana unnila ibmar-isganaginbi binsaed. Ar bipisaale, wile dule-bamalad-daksulid.
Dule-ibmar-nue-wissulid, dule-emargi-dododiid-sabsur-odurdaklegedgi ibmar durdaked. Dule-binsaed-nikagued ibmargi-odurdaklegele, dule-ibmar-nue-wissulidi ibmar durdaked.
Dule-nued, dule-isgana-e-neg dakdedaed, igi dule-isgana e-ibmar-nikadi berguddae.
Dule, dule-wileged-e-ibmar-egised itosulile, na ibmar-egichiarmogar, dulemar e-itogosurmarmogad.
Ibmar-binsa-uklegedi dulemar-wagab-uksulidi, sae-itoged boo imaked. Ibmarbina-sogdiidgi a-ibmar bega-uklenonikile, sabsur-urwed boo imaked.
Igar-innikigwad-imaklesale, dule-nued na yeer-itodaed. Dule-isganagardi, dobed nagunonidaed.
Dule, itoakwaa nanadisulile, burgwarmai dakledagoed.
Dule, galagwensuli-gudiguedginbi-binsaedi, dule-wilegedga guoed. Dule, mummudbi-gaamakdiidi, degi, ina-wawadginbi-mani-oediidi, bipisaale, mani-ibedga gwen guosulid.
Dule-isgana, dule-nued-anar sabsur-odurdaklegoed. Dule-emargi-aibined dule-inniki-nanadiid-anar, sabsur-odurdaklegoed.
Ome-gadi-urwed-nikuedba, ome-gadi-isdar-itoged-nikuedba, bur nuedid, ome-sate walagwen-gudisaed.
Dule-binsaed-nikagued-e-neggi ibmar-nuegan obinebaka nikad, ina-wawadikmalad obinebaka nikabalid. Dule-binsaedsulidaeddi, bela ibmar-nikad binsa diiga imakdaed.
Dule, igar-inniki-imakleged-amidiile, wile-dule-dakleged-amidibalile, san-dula-gudiguleged amied. Igar-inniki-imakleged amied. Nug-dummarba-guleged amibalid.
Dule-binsaed-ibed dulemar-gandikmalad-ibe neggwebur sued. Dule-binsaed-ibed dule-gandikmalad-e-ibmargi-bensuli-gudiid-ibe e-ibmar obelobalid.
Dule na itoakwaa-sunmaked, e-gwabinduku-bargabalid, bonigangi ollorgued.
Dule-na-doggus-san-buled-imakedi, dule-na-san-dummarba-imakedi, dule-emar-mesagwar-imakedi, weyob egi sogleged, wilub-obicha sabsur-isdar-nanadiidye.
Dule-wiegala bela ibmar nikubienad, degi-inigwele, budar arbaed.
Dule-wiegala, dule-baid-ibe ibmar-abedii osedoddaed. Dule-nueddi, wilub-obicha ibmar uked.
Bab-Dummad, dule-isganamar-ega-ibmar-ukedi, isdar-daked. Bur bule isdar daked, nabiridgi ega uksurmalar.
Dule-ibmar-daksad-gakansaar-soged burgoed. Dule, a-duleba-ibsaeddi, deyob guedsemogad.
Dule-isgana na ibmar-sogsadi gege ogwadaed. Dule-nueddi, na e-daed nudaked.
Nue-binsaed-nikaguedi, nue-ibmar-wisiguedi, degi, binsaed-nuegana, gwen Bab-Jehováʼgi obinsulid.
Dule bila-onogega moli guakwaa nasiked. Degi-inigwele, bila-onogedgi-nakwegala, Bab-Jehováʼgi siid.
Ibmar-nuegan-bukidar-nikadba, bur nuedid, nug-nued nikued. Bukidar-or-nikuedba, degi, mani-nikuedba, bur nuedid begi dulemar nued sunmaked.
Mani-ibed, degi, dule-wileged, ¿ibugi emar gumala? Bab-Jehová-ebobela-obinnisadgi emar gumalad.
Dule-itoakwaadaed magar bonigan-daked, bonigangi banguddaed. Dule-binsaedsulidaeddi, bonigan-idu bangusulid, degisoggu, boni amisdasunnad.
San-bipi-imaklegedgi, Bab-Jehová-nug-odummolegedgi we-ibmar-sogbaagwad danikid: Ibmar-nuegan-nikued, nug-dummarba-gued, dula-gudii-saed, danikid.
Dule-isganamar-gudiidbina, ikomar bukwad, sakimar bukwad. Dule-na-san-sabgudiiddi, a-ibmarmargi bangued.
Igar-innikigwadgi mimmigan be odurdake. Amba sered-ugakgusale, we-ibmargi banguosulid.
Dule-mani-ibed, dule-wilemalad-e-dummad gued. Dule-mani-ganikid, dule-mani-ega-uksad-e-maiga gued.
Dule-ibmar-isgana-imaked, bonigan amied. Bab-Dummad isdar-itogedgi we-dule-obelogoed.
Dule emar-wiledakele, egi nued binsalegoed. Ar we-dule, dule-wilemaladga masgunned uked.
Dule-gadi-urwed-amied be ononnoge, adi, na abin-abin-imaklegedi, urwelegedi, degi, sabsur-ibmar-soglegedi, berguoed.
Dule innikigwadgi-ibmar-sogedi, e-sunmaked-yeer-itolegedi, rey e-aiga imakoed.
Bab-Jehová dule-binsaed-ibedgi nakuleged. Bab-Jehová, dule-gakansili-e-ibmar-sogeddi oyoged, e-sunmaked gakanye.
Dule-wiegala yapa-arbaedba sogdaed: “Achumigur-nono-wawaad magaba gudiiye. An noddibe, an-gunnoye.”
Ome-sui-dikarba-yoleged-e-gaya, yaa-matusur-siidyob gued. A-yaagine, dule-Bab-Jehová-ourwega-imakedi, argwanoed.
Uayasulidaedi, gusgu burwigana-e-daedid. Molidubgi-bibyolegedgi uayasulidaed surgued.
Dule, mani-bur bule-nikuega, dule-wileged-mesagwar imaked. Dule, mani-ibedga binsa-ibmar-ukedi, na dule-wilegedga guoed.
Dule-binsaed-ibed-e-sunmakedi, nuekwaa be itoge. An be-odurdakedba, be ibmar imake.
Ar be we-ibmar nonogi-gaele, bela be gannar-gannar sogdiile, be yeer-itogoed.
Bab-Jehováʼgi be mer benguega, emi an be-owisonaid.
Emi, an bega durgwen-gakambe (30) binsaed-nuegan-ibmar-wisigued narmaksad.
Adi, be gayaburba-napiragwadi, wisi guega, adi, dule-bese-ibmar-egised-abin nabir be ibmar sogegar.
Melle dule-wileged-ibe be ibmar-atursae, ar wede, dule-wilegedid. Melle igar-naboleged-neggi dule-ibmar-sate-gudiid be sabsur-imakbalo.
Ar Bab-Jehová wemar-ular gwisguoed, geb dule-wileged-ibe-ibmar-susad-annik ibmar sumogoed.
Melle be dule-emar-sabsur-imaked-e-aiga gue. Melle be dule-emar-wiogedba akabali.
Ar e-ichakwadamalad be durdaksale, na be dukin boni-dummad amioed.
Melle be emar-anar ibmar-imakoye sogo. Melle be emar-anar mani-bennukega gubalo.
Ar be bennukega mani-sate-gualile, be-gabedse-bakale, be-ibe sumaloed.
Melle be-dadgan dikasurgus-nainu-abingunaidgi ibmar-ogwichismalad be oniro.
¿Dule e-arbaedgi nued-arbaed be dakdii? Dule-deyob-arbaedi, reymarga arbadii guoed, dule-binsarmaladga arbaosulid.
Be dule-dummadbo mas-gunsokalile, nue ebinsao, doa-asabin be sii.
Ar be gadi-mas-gunnele, masgunned bargao.
Melle be e-mas-yeer-gullegedbina soge, ar we-masdi, unnila dule-yardakedid.
Melle be ibmar-nuegan-nikuega surbinsa-itodii gue. Melle be ibmar-gargerbamaladginbi binsadii gue.
Ar be nuekwaa dakdele, be daksaled, ibmar-gargerbamalad baisursunna berguddaed.
Melle be dule-nallegaladbo mas-gunne. Melle be e-mas-yeer-gullegedbina sogbalo.
Ar e-masde, gammugi-sailagia-megeyob gued. Bega sogoed: “Mas-gunne, gobe.” Degi-inigwele, gwen gwage-nuedgi bega sogosulid.
A-sorbali, be bela mas-guchad agoed, ega be nuedgi-sunmaksadi, binsa be sunmakoed.
Melle be dule-binsaedsulidaedga binsaed dako. Ega be ibmar-sogoedi, be-abin isdar-itogoed.
Melle dikasurgus-nainu-abingunaidgi ibmar-ogwichismalad be oniro. Mer be dule-sergansated-e-nainugi dogbalo.
Ar wemar Dule-E-Bendaked-Gandikid nikad. Dule-sergansated-bendakegala, be-abin gwisguoed.
Ibmar-durdaksadba be ibmar imake, binsaed-nued-uklegedi, be nue-itoge.
Melle be mimmigan-odurdaksuli gue, molidubgi-bibyolegedba burgosulid.
Ar bur be molidubgi-bibyogele, burgwed-igargi be ollor-imaknaid.
Machi, be dule-binsaed-ibedga gunonikile, gwagegi an weligwar itomogoed.
Be-sunmakedi, napiragwadba be sunmakele, ulubgi an yeer itononikoed.
Melle be dule-isganamargi nobgue, bur be bane-bane Bab-Dummad-nug odummodii imake.
Adi, yoedse bega ibmar nueganbi guoed, na be ibmar-edarbediid nikudapoed.
Machi, nue be itoge, binsaed-nikaa be dae, igar-innikigwadbarbi be nanadii sae.
Dule-gadi-mumgumaladba mer be akae. Dule-gadi-masgunmaladba mer be akadii gubali.
Ar dule-gadi-mumgumaladi, degi, gadi-mas-gunmaladi, dule-wilegedga gumaloed. Ar dule-gabedginbi-binsaedi, unnila mor-siir-siir-yoi gudiguoed.
Be-bab-we-napnegse-be-odenonikid be itoge, be-nan seredgusale, mer be isdar-dako.
Igar-napiragwad, nue-binsaed-nikagued, be amie. Ibmar-durdaked, nue-ibmar-wisigued, be amie. Wemala, mer be ibmar-baid-anar ogwao.
Dule-nued-e-baba na bela-bela yeer itoged. Dule na machi-binsaed-ibed-nikad, weligwar itoged.
Be-bab, degi, be-nan, werguega be imake. Be-sergan-we-napnegse-be-senonikid wergumalaga be imake.
Machi, an-bega-binsaed-dakdiidgi be binsae, an-nanadiid be dake.
Ar ome-gambanuchu-imakedi, yaa-dummad-matusursiidyob gued. Dule-baid-ome-galagwensur-nanaedi, dia-garagwad-matusursiidyob gued.
We-omedi, dule-atursaedyob matarmakdidaed. We-ome, machergan-bukidar-e-ome-dikarba-yolemalaga imaked.
Dule-mumgued-iedisulidi, dule-sisamar-galagwensuli-gobedi, boed amied, ibmar-nunmaked-itoged amied, urwed amied, isdar-itoged amied, binsa-nailikgued amied, ibya-gudure-gued amied.
Dule-mumgued-iedisulidi, dule-sisamar-galagwensuli-gobedi, deyob gued.
Vino-gisi-daklesidaedbina mer be soge, vino-noggi-dakarmaksidaedbina mer be sogbali. E-goblegedi, nolloo gobleged.
Degi-inigwele, dubgi-warmakeyobi, be itogoed. Naibe-e-gichi-begi-ubodeyobi, be itogoed.
Ibya-apurega be-imakoed, galagwensuli-binsaega be-imakoed.
Magadba-yakumaknadapiyob be itogoed, urmor-suar-dukugi-maiyob be itogoed.
Be sogdagoed: “An-naibi-imaksamala, degite, gwen nunmak an itosulid. An-bibyosmala, degite, gwen bai an itosulid. An dadakusale, gannar an mumgunabaloed.”
Melle be dule-isganamargi nobgue, melle be eba-akaedgi binsabali.
Ar e-gwagegi unnila emar-sabsur-imakedgi binsamalad, unnila ibmar-isgana-imakedgi sunmakmalad.
Nue-binsaed-nikaguedba neg sobleged. Nue-ibmar-wisidba neg-e-sailamar mesleged.
Itoakwaa-binsalegedba e-gabednegmaryaba ibmar-gargermaladi, degi, ibmar-yeerdaklemaladi enoleged.
Dule-binsaed-ibedi, dule-gandikidid. Dule-nue-ibmar-wisidi, dule-dutusulidid.
Nue-igar-amiale, bila onoleged. Bukidar-dulemar-binsaed-dakmaladgi nakwileged siid.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedi, dule-binsaed-ibedga gwen guosurguoed. Igar-itolegedgi sunmakosulid, ar aku-itoged na ibi obaroe.
Dule unnila ibmar-isganaginbi-binsaedi, egi-soglegoed: “Dule-isganaye.”
Dule-binsaedsulidaedi, unnila isguedginbi binsaed. Bela dulemar dule-emargi-dododiid isdar-dakmalad.
Ar be bonigan-abin sikirmakele, amba be-gangued nollogwad.
Dulemar-burgwed-igarse-nadapmalad be ollor-imake, dulemar e-burgwed-modanimalad be bendake.
Ar amba be sogele: “An wissulinye.” ¿Dule-gwage-wilubdakedi, gwen wisguosur be insae? Dule-begi-nakulegedi gwen wisguosur, ¿be insae? Bab-Jehová dulemar-e-daedba dulemarga ibmar-uked.
Machi, achanis be mae, ar yeer-maleged, achanis ochii maleged.
Binsaed-nikaguedi, achanisyob bega ochii gumogoed. Binsaed-nikagued be amisale, yoedse bega ibmar nueganbi guoed, be-ibmar-edarbediid be nikudapoed.
Dule-isgana, melle be dule-nued-oakalogedgi binsae. Melle be e-neg-obelogedgi binsabali.
Dule-nuedi, amba ilagugle (7) aimukuele, gannar gwisgubaloed. Dule-isganamardi aimukusale, geg bar gannar gwisgued.
Be-isdaradi aimukusale, mer be yeer-itogo. Be-isdarad akar-gusale, mer be wergubalo.
Ar Bab-Jehová egi-be-wergue be-dakalile, be-daed nabir-dakosulid. Ar egi be werguele, Bab-Jehová be-isdarad bar sabsur odurdakosulid.
Melle be dule-isganamarba akae. Melle be egi nobgubalo.
Ar dule-isgana nuedgi berguosulid. Dule-isgana gwallu-akitedaedyob bergudoed.
Machi, Bab-Jehová-dobekwaa be nanae, rey-nug be odummoge. Uayasulidamaladba mer be akae.
Ar wemar ukiagwale, sabsur-odurdaklemaloed. Ar dule wissulid, ibi-bonigan egi danikoe.
Dule-binsaed-ibegan amba we-ibmar sogsamarbalid: Igar-nabirolegedgi dule-wargwenbarbi-nagued nuedsulid.
Dule-igar-naboged, dule-ibmar-oakalosad ibmar-oakalossuliyob dakele, neggweburmarse ukabsalegoed, dulemarse isdar daklebaloed.
Ar dule-igar-nabogedi, dule-ibmar-oakalosad-sabsur-odurdakerdi, dulemar yeer dakmaloed, dulemar egi ise-nued binsamaloed.
Napiragwadgi dule-abinsaed, yeer-itole dule-imaked.
Ibmar-digoed guakwa be urbe, ibmar-digega be-nainumar guakwa be nasike, geb a-sorbali, be-neg be soboed.
Melle be ibmar-daksasuli dule-baidgi sunmako, melle be egi gakansabalo.
Melle be sogo: “Igi be an-imaksa, deyob an be-imakmogoed. An deyopira imaked nikamoga.”
Dule-wiegala-e-nainu-dikarba an nasad, dule-binsaedsulidaed-e-uva-digaled-dikarba an nasad.
A-nainugine, ikomar yaisur an daksad, e-nainu bula-moodo-nai an daksabalid, e-galu-emakaled-nainu-ebiris-naidi aimukumai an daksabalid.
An weyob ibmar-daksadi bipisaale, an iessulid. We-ibmargine, ibmar-soggwen an durdaksad:
Ar be sikwas gabele, ar be sikwas megele, ar be sikwas obunnogele, unnila be sakwa-obirmasmaile,
wilegedi, dule-atursaedyob begi nonikoed, ibmar-sate-guedi, dule-gingi-nikadyob begi nonikoed.
We-binsaed-nuegana Salomón onosbalid. Judá-rey-Ezequíasʼga dule-garda-narmakmaladi we-binsaedmar nue-ilemakar narmaksad.
Ibmar-dukuar-mamaidi, Bab-Dummad-e-gandikid-e-wilub oyoged. Reymar, igar-dukuar-mamaid-balamiedi, dule-gandikmaladga gued.
Dule, nagase nibneg-nibgued balamiosulid, degi, nagase napneg-e-ulub-naid balamiosulid. Amba deyobi, reymar-binsaedi gege ulubse balamilemogad.
Mani-dulenaidgi-durgan-welegoed be mie. Geb a-manigine, dule-mani-sobedi, nog soboed.
Rey-asabin dule-isgana be onoge. Geb rey igar-innikigwadba yar-seoed.
Melle rey-asabin dule-nug-nikadga be san-imako. Melle dule-dummagan-imbagi yogasaar sigis be imako,
rey bur bega soged nabirid: “Wese be sigda” adi, melle dule-dummagan-abin rey be-obingegsaegar. Be-sunnagwad be ibmar-daksale,
melle gwae-gwae dummaganse-odonao. Ar dule yamo be-abin osulosale, igi be saoe. Aka dukin be bingeguoed.
Bebogwa igar-gwatirisad be nudako. Degi-inigwele, melle dule-bega-ibmar-sogedi, dule-baidga sogmogo.
Ar be dule-baidga ibmar-sogele, we-dule, sunna be-nug oichoged. Degidbali, bar be, nug-nued-nika guosulid.
Iba-sogedba ibmar-soglegedi, galimbaba dutumar-oyapateyobi gued.
Dule-binsaed-ibedi, nuedgi dulega gannabasaar-ibmar-sogsiile, dulega olargan-dummaganba bur bule ibnuedid, ega ormadaremaladba bur bule sunsogedid.
Igi-neg-diopisulidgi, neg-diopigwad yeer-itoledae, debayobi, dule-garda-berbeged-innikigwadi, e-dummadga niga-gandikid ukmogad.
Igi-dii-wioeyobi neg-ainakwis sii dakledae, debayobi, dule ibmar-ukoye-sogdidaedi, gege ibmar-ukdaed.
Gwae-gwaesuli, binnasdikigwadgi, dule-nuga-nikad-e-binsaed ogwaleged. Nuedgi, urwedginsuli-sunmaklegedi, bela igar-bulegangi obilleged.
Be achanis amisale, melle dogdar-mao. Ar doggus be masale, be agdoed.
Melle bali-bali dule-baid-negse nanao. Ichakwagwad, bali-bali-nanaer, abakalegi budar-be-dakedba, isdar be-dakalile.
Dule, e-aigi gakansaar-sunmakedi, akwa-mamaredyob gued. Es-suidyobi, degi, es-swiswidikidyob gubalid. Emar-wioged.
Dule, suli-suli-itogedgine, dule-isganagi bensuli gunonikile, nugar-nunmakedyob gued. Degi, nailik-mali-bisgar-gudiidyobi gued. Binsaedsuli daed.
Dule-bukib-binsaedba-wile-itodiidgala namaklemaladgi-namakedi, nuedsulid. Ega ukagi-yaa-siidgi balu-eogeyobid. Degi, neg-dambipigwadgi mor-esuedyobid. Gwen gadi-gadi imakosulid.
Be-isdarad ukudmaada-itogele, masgi ogunno, uku-uku-itogele, ogobo.
Deyob be a-dule-imakele, be nue-obingegsaoed, Bab-Jehováʼdi bega ibmar-buged ukoed.
Dii-burwa-goledbali dii-wied danidaed. Gaya-isgana-sunmakedbali, neg-urwed noardaed.
Ome-ursili-ebo neg-dummadgi-megedbali, bur nabirsursi, neg-sukungwaba-meremair.
Igi-uku-uku-itolegedgi dii-dambipigwad gobledae, deyobi, gayaburba-nuegan dikasur-danikir, itoledaed.
Dule-innikidaedi, dule-isgana-abin sikirmakele, dii-isgumaidaeyobi gued. Diagi-ib-isgana-mileddaeyobi gued.
Achanis-gadi-maele, ichakwagwad. Dukin-san-dummarba-imaked-amiedi, ichakwabalid.
Dule-san-bargaed-wissulidi, neggwebur-galu-matusulid-sateyobi gued.
Dambed-sibudik-sibudik-bated, yorgi batesulid. Ibmar-gwag-weleged, dii-wiedgi welesurmogad. Dule-binsaedsulidaed-e-nuga gwen odummolesurmogad.
Igi-sikwigolo igarsuli gukudidae, igi-wirsob uu-suli gudidae, debayobi, yogasaar-ukabsalegedi, gwen igarga guosulid.
Moli-bibyoged-duba, moli-bibyogega gued. Moli-gaya-bargaedi, moli-uayasuid-gaya-bargaega gued. Suardi, dule-binsaedsulidaed-bibyogega gumogad.
Melle be dule-binsaedsulidaed barwisogo, aka be bur dule-binsaedsulidaedga gudoed.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedga, bakar be ibmar-sogo, adi, melle e-ibmar-sogedba binsaed-ibedga na san-imakegar.
Dule, dule-binsaedsulidaedba garda barmiele, mali-siklegar-maiyob gued. Duleba garda-barmissuliyobi gued.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedi, binsaed-nuegangi-sunmakele, nabirsulid. E-sunmakedi, mali-burgwar-bellemaknaidyobi itoleged. Baisursunna itoleged.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedga nug-odummolegedi, akwa gunnu-akwa-miedgi-atinnar-naidyob gued. Dule-binsaedsulidaed-e-nug-odummolegedi, gwen nabirsulid.
Dule-binsaedsulidaedi, binsaed-nuegangi-sunmakele, aku-itodabalid. E-sunmakedi, dule-mummud e-argangi iko-yolesayobid, aku-itodaed.
Dule, e-neggi dule-binsaedsulidaed-oarbaele, sigu-mied-dule yogasaar sigu-miedba dule-onailiksaedyobid. Wissulid bia sigu argwatapoe.
Igi achu na e-agsad gannar maddae, debayobi, dule-binsaedsulidaedi, gannar-gannar ibmar-nabirsulid obariddaed.
¿Dule-binsaed-ibedye-na-sogdiid be dakdii? Dule-binsaed-ibedye-na-sogdiidba bur baisursunna, dule-binsaedsulidaedi ibmargi odurdakleged.
Dule-wiegala, yamo wiedbali weyob sogdedaed: “¡Igarba achu-sapur gudii daklesa! ¡Neg-galimbaba achumigur achiksa-gudii daklesa!”
Igi yawagak, e-naidgi egemakwisdae, debayobi, dule-wiegala e-megedgi nikwamakmaidaed.
Dule-wiegala mas-gunnega bateyagi e-argan ododaenad, degi-inigwele, wiedba e-gayaba mas odosulid.
Dule-wiegala, dule-binsaed-ibegan-e-walagugledba (7), bur binsaed-ibediyob itodaed.
Igi achu uaya-ebilenaidgi emargi aibine, deyobi, dule, dulemar-urwenaid-imbagi gotemogale, boni-amied.
Igi dule oes yogasaar sigu-soo-nikad mie,
deyobi, dule, e-ai-yamoged. Geb sorba ega sogdaed, “unnila, binsa an begi dodonaiye.”
Dule, soo-yagi sapan urbesulile, soo akitedaed. Deyobmodo, gakansaleged satele, urwed satedaed.
Sogungi soo oaramakledaed, sapangi soo ogaledaed. Deyobmodo, dule-ursilidgi urwed noardamogad.
Gakangi-sunmaklegedi, mas-nued-gullegeyobid. Gakangi-sunmaklegedi, ulubse uboged.
Igi yamo napsa-nog manigi oglege, debayobi, dule-gwage-isgana-e-sunmakedi yamo nabiridyobi sunmakdaed.
Sae-dule-dakedi, yamo nueganbi dulega sunmakdaed, ar e-ulubgindina, sae dule-dakdaed.
Ar sae-dule-dakedi, yamo bega nueganbi sunmakele, melle be itogo, ar e-gwage-ulubgindi, dogdar isdar binsadaed.
Amba yamo sae-dule-daksuliyob na san-saele, dulemar-abargindi e-isgued magar daklenonikoed.
Dule yaa-dummad-akwiele, na dukin a-yaagi-argwanega guoed. Ar dule akwa-dummad obaparmakele, na dukin e-birgi-sigega imakoed.
Gakansaed-gwabin-duku, gayaburba-nuegan isdar-itodaed. Yamo-nabiridyob-sunmaklegedi bela neg-oichoddaed.
Melle be san-dummarba-imakedgi binsao, ar be wissulid, ibagan begi igi-daniki.
Melle be dukin san-dummarba-imako, dule-baigan be-nug-odummogedi, bur nabirid.
Akwa ukusulid, ukubbela ukusurbalid, dule-binsaedsulid-e-urweddi, aba bur bule yeer-gangued.
Urwedi, yeer-gangued. Sae-itogedgi-urwedi, dule-wioged. Nobeddi, geg bargaleged.
Arbakee-sabgulegedba, bur nuedid, bakar-bega-ibmar-soged.
Be-isdarad-yamo-be-wagar-uedba, bur nuedid, be-ai-nued sabsur-bega-ibmar-soged.
Dule, nue-immeles-gudiile, bar ibmar abedasulid. Achanisse-bakar, budar madaed. Dule, ukudmaada-gudiirdi, ibmar-gagbiregedse-bakar gunned, ochigwayobi itodaed.
Dule, dikasuli aineba gaamakdiidi, dikasuli nuu e-uugi gaamakdiyobid, neguyagi sate daed.
Gwallu-wawadikmaladi, ina-wawadikmaladi, e-yapanned weligwar dule-saed, debayobi, ai-nued-binsaed-ukedi, dulega niga-ogannoged.
Melle be-ai-obanedgi be binsao. Melle be-bab-e-ai-obanedgi be binsabalo. Melle be-boni-itodiidi, be-gwenad-negse be sedo. Bur be-gwenad-bebo-urwediidba, bur nabirid, dule-be-neg-dikarba-maidse be naed.
Machi, dule-binsaed-nikaa be dae, weligwar be an-imake. Adi, an deebali, mesagwar-an-imakdimalad-gayamakoed.
Dule-itoakwaa-binsaedi, boni-noed bato daksabindaed. Degisoggu, mer boni-noega imakdaed. Dule-binsaed-sateddi, boni-noalir akudakdaed. Degisoggu, egi nue wileddasunnad.
Dule, dule-baid-ular mani-gasad-bennukoye-sogsale, mani-bennuksulile, e-ibe be mor weenao, dule-baid-mani-gasad-ular, be e-mor sioed.
Dule bolegoedba binnasuli e-aise nuedgi-goler, e-ai-gabmaidga ukabsalegedyob gued.
Ome-ursili, dii-wied-ibagi, dii-gargarmaknaiyobi gued. Urwedbi wisdaed.
Dule, e-igar-gaye-sogele, geg gaed, burwayobid, burwadi geg galeged. Argangi ibmar-gwallu-geg-abingalegeyobid.
Esgoro, esgoro-baidgi oswiswimakleged. Dule na ebo-idakmalale, igar-nuedse onomalad.
Dule, sapi-nue-akwele, e-san gunnoed, dule, e-dummadga nue-nakulediile, e-nug odummolegoed.
Igi diigi, magar wagar dakledae, deyobi, dule e-binsaedbali, na magar-daklesimogad.
Igi-neg-uan ollorgusisuli, degi, burgwed-igar galemaisuli, debayobi, dule ibmarbin-gadisogedi, napi-ibmar abedaed.
Bormo-crisolʼgi mani wilubdakleged, soogi or wilubdaklemogad, duledi, e-nug-odummolegedgi mag-daklemogad, igid-dule gue.
Dule-binsaedsulid be nagele, amba uki be nagbalile, degi, ibmar-gwagyob be osarwele, amba e-binsaed-sateddi, e-ibe be osulogosurguoed.
Be-sibad-wawaadmar nue be dakdii sao, be-molimar gatik nue be akwedii sao.
Ar ibmar-nuegana, degisadeguadsulid. Manimala, degisadeguadsurbalid.
Sapur emilesale, gagan-aradik ainidagoed. Sapurgi gagan-dutugana weledagoed.
Sibad-wawaadmar bega mor-yoed ukoed. Sibaddi, bega nainu-bakega guoed.
Sibad-e-nunis bukidar be nikuoed, adi, bedi, be-ome, be-mimmigana egi nabir itomaloed, degine, bela-bega-arbamaladi, yeer-itomarmogoed.
Dule-isgana dule-e-balegin-danikiyobi, oes abarmakmaidaed. Dule-nueddina, achumigur-nono-wawaadyobi, dobsurdaed.
Yargi, nue-neg-isgusnaile, dummagan-negdakmalad ogwalemaidaed. Dule-yar-seed nue-binsaed-nikale, igar-nikaa yar-selemaidaed.
Dule-isgana mesagwar-dule-wilediid-imakedi, dii burwaba-mesa ibmar-digar-naidgi wieyobid, bela ibmar-naid obeloged.
Dule, Igar-maidgi-banguddamaladi, dule-isgana-nug odummoddamalad. Dule, Igar-Maidba-nanadimaladdi, dule-isganamarbo gaardamalad.
Dule-isganamar, igar-innikigwad aku itodamalad. Dule, Bab-Jehová-Igarba-nanadimaladdi, bela magar ibmar-itodamalad.
Dule-mani-ibed-sunnasurdaedba, bur nuedid, dule-wileged-nueddaed.
Dule, Igar-Maidba-nanadiile, dule-binsaed-nikadaedid. Dule, dule-galagwensurdamaladba-nanaeddi, e-bab-obingegsaedid.
Dule, dule-baidga-mani-gaar-ukedi, e-gakagi mani-onogele, yamolegoed. Aka wiledimalad-bendakega, dule-wilemalad-bendakedga, omelodaed.
Dule, Igar-Maid-itobisulile, Bab-Dummad, a-dule-ese-goled itogosurmogad.
Dule, igar-isganaba dule-innikidaed-nidele, dukin egi igar-isgana aibinmogoed. Dule-gwage-nuegandi ibmar-nued abingaoed.
Dule-mani-ibedi, na binsadaed, ede, binsaed-ibedye. Dule-wileged-ibmar-nue-wisiddi, bela wisid, we-dulede, doa-dule.
Dule-innikidamalad nakwisale, iba-dummad onoleddaed. Dule-isganamar nakwenonikirdi, bela dulemar dobedba dukuddaed.
Dule, e-isgued gwageginbi sediile, nued-gudii guosulid. Dule, e-isgued na barsogerdi, egi banguerdi, Bab-Dummad wiledakoed.
Dule, gusgu Bab-Jehová-dobee nanadiidi, egi ise-nued binsalesad. Dule, gwage-dutusuliddi, nue-wilegoed.
Dule-yar-seed-isgana, dule-wilemalad-mesagwar-imakmaile, achumigur-nono-wawaad mas-gaeyobid, wiob mas-gasa gunaiyobid.
Dummadga-negsemaid aku-neg-itogedi, bur bule dulega neg-gagaed. Dummadga-negsemaid ibmar-nueganbina surbinsa-itosuliddi, undar suitii gudigued.
Emar-gindaksad-ular, dule balegillediile, oburgwilegedsegad. Gwen dule e-ular-gwisguosulid.
Dule, igar-nuedba napira nanadiidi, bendaklegoed. Dule-galagwensur-garmakdiiddi, ibagwengi dummad-wiolegoed.
Dule, arbaele, mas-bukidar-nika guoed. Dule, arbasulile, wilegedga gudoed.
Dule-nueddaedi, egi-ise-nued-binsaledii guoed. Dule, gwae-gwae mani-ibedga-gubieddi, sabsur-odurdaklesuli guosulid, odurdaklegedsegad.
Dulemar bela emarbi be dakoed, akar-akar be dakosulid. Akar-akar be dakele, igar-nuedsulid. Ar madu-wargwengi bato binsaed-galeddamalad.
Dule-manibina-surbinsa-itogedi, gwae mani-ibedga gubidaed, ar egi wileged-dummad danikodeeye binsasurdaed.
Dule, dule-baidga, nuedgi-sabsur-ibmar-sogele, sorba egi nued sunmakleged. Dulega-nuedgi-sunmakedba bur bule egi nued sunmakledaed.
Dule, e-sergan-ibe, ibmar-atursaele, ede, ibmar-oakalossurye sogbalile, we-dule, dule-isgana-e-aid.
Dule, ibmarbin-sogerbadi, neg-gagaedid. Dule Bab-Jehováʼgi bensulirdi, Bab-Dummadgi nasgumai guoed.
Dule, dukin na egi-bensulile, dule-binsaedsulidaedid. Dule, binsaed-nikaguedgi ibmar-saele, bendakleged.
Dule, dule-wilemalad-bendakedi, wilegedga guosulid. Dule, dule-wilemalad-bendaksuliddi, sabsur-ukabsalegoed.
Dule-isganamar nakwisale, bela dulemar dobedba dukuddaed. Dule-isganamar bergunonikirdi, dule-innikidamalad nasguddaed.
Dule, nuedgi-ega-ibmar-sogleged amba itossulile, wiledaklesuli, sabsur ukiagwale, sarsolegoed.
Dule-innikidamalad nasgudele, neggwebur yeer itodaed. Dule-isganamar negsealile, neggwebur bukib binsaddaed.
Dule, binsaed-nueganbina itogerbale, weligwar e-bab-saed. Dule, gambanuchu-samaladgi mani-miele, bela na mani-nikadi obeloged.
Rey, igar-innikigwadba-negseedi, yar-nue-innikii sedaed. Ar rey, unnila neggweburgi mani-gaedginbi binsaerdi, neggwebur-wioddaed.
Dule, e-aiga yamo-nueganbi-sunmakedi, e-ai-yardakega sunmakdaed.
Dule-ibmar-isgana-imakedi, dukin e-isguedse yamoleged. Dule-innikiidaeddi, weligwaledba namakdaed.
Dule-nueddaedi, dule-wilemalad-bendakdidaed. Dule-ibmar-isgana-imakeddi, dule-wilemaladgi binsadasulid.
Aimargi-gadi-dodomaladi, neggwebur-oimaker saed. Dule-binsaed-ibegandi, bogidik neg-imaked.
Dule-binsaed-ibedi, dule-binsaedsulidbo abin-abin-imakele, amba ebo-urwodibe, ebo alledibe, gwen igar nudakosurmalad.
Dule-gindakmaladi, dule-nuegan-sae dakdamalad, dule-nuegan-oburgwebidamalad.
Dule-binsaedsulidi uludele, bar galedasulid. Dule-binsaed-ibeddi, nabir san-bargaed wisid.
Dummadga-negdakmaid gakansaedba-ebipiledele, bela ega dummaganga-arbamaladi ibmar-isgana-imakedga guoed.
Dule-wilegedi, mesagwar-dule-imakedbogwa emarbimalad. Bab-Jehová ebobela magar-atake imaksad.
Rey, igar-innikigwadba dule-wilemaladga igar nabogele, e-yar-seedi, degisadeguoed.
Sarsolegedi, nuedgi-sabsur-ibmar-sogedi, binsaed-nikaa dule-imaked. Mimmi-uayasulidaeddi, e-nan-bingedar imaked.
Ibmar-isgana-imakmalad bukidarale, isgued bukidardaed. Dule-nueddamaladdi, dule-isganamar-bergued dakoed.
Be-mimmi be unaele, bonisuli-gudii be-imakoed, weligwaled bega ukoed.
Bab-Dummad-gayaburba barsoglesulile, neggwebur yogasaar nanaddaed. Dule Igar-Maid-sogedba nanadiile, egi ise-nued binsaleged.
Mai, uayasuli-gualile, gayaginbi-ega-ibmar-soged unnisurdaed. Nabir ibsaegala, wis bibyoleged abeledabalid.
Dule nue-binsasulidgi-sunmakedi, nue be dake. Ar dule-binsaedsulid-sunmaked-bursunna, bur bule yogasaar sunmakdaed.
Dule, na e-mai, bipigwad-akar unadii nanassulile, sorba, bukib-binsaed-dummad ega ukoed.
Dule-urwegala, urwed onogerbadaed. Dule-yaisur-urwedi, yeer-isguddaed.
Dule-san-dummarbadaedi, nug-bipii guoed. Dule-san-bipi-imakeddi, nug-dummarbaa guoed.
Dule, ibmar-atursaed-duleba-akaedi, dukin na san-wioged. Dule-ibmar-atursaed-galenonikile, amba dule-eba-akadidse ise-egisar-gunanaidibe geg barsoged.
Ar be dulemar-dobee-itogele, dukin be yamolegoed. Be Bab-Jehováʼgi-bensulile, bonigangi be ollorgudoed.
Dule-bukidar, dummadga-negdakmaid ega-ibmar-imakegala amidamalad. Unnila Bab-Jehováʼbi dulemarga igar-nabomaid.
Dule-innikimaladi, dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmalad isdar dakdaed. Dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmaladi, dule-innikimalad isdar dakdamogad.
Jaqué-machi-Agur-ibmarmar-sogsad. Agur, Itielʼga, degi, Ucalʼga weyob sunmaksad:
“Andi dulemarba bur bule ibmar-wissulid, akusunna an ibmar itoged.
Binsaed-nikaguedi an durdaksasulid, Bab-Dummad-Isligwaledbela an akusunna itoged.
”¿Doa nibnegse nakwiapi? ¿Doa nibneg-akar aidenoniki? ¿Doa e-argangi burwa gaoe? ¿Doa e-mor-dummadgi demar gaoe? ¿Doa napneg-naid-dikarmar omesisa? ¿Ar be wisi, doa we-ibmarmar-imaksa, degi, e-machi-nug be wisbali?
”Bela Bab-Dummad-gayaburbagi bensuli guleged. Bab-Dummadi, sigu-abgaedyob dule-egi-bendakleged-amimalad-irwa gwisgued.
Melle Bab-Dummad bega-sabsur-ibmar-sogega, degi, melle dule-gakansaedga be-imakbaliga, melle-e-gayaburbamar-maid be obulogo.
”Bab-Dummadye, unnila ibmar-sogbo an bese egised. An burgwed-iduale, melle be anga imaksuli guo, be anga we-ibmar-sogbogwad imakedsego:
Igar-isganagi, gakan-igargi, be an-ollor-imake. Melle dule-wilegedga, dule-mani-ibedga be an-imakbalo. Unnila ibmar-nue-abelemaladi be anga ukmai imako.
Ar an mani-ibedga gudele, abakar na be-iealile, abakale an sokalile: ¿Ar doa wede Bab-Jehováʼye? Degine, an wiledibalile, abakar ibmar-atursaarbalile, degidbali, an be-nug-ichoge dakledagoed.
”Melle mai-e-dummad-asabinni e-maigi ichakwa sunmako, adi, melle, we-mai be-ukabsaega, degidbali, be dummad-wilegoed.
”Ar gwen-gwena dulemar gadi-e-bab-ukabsadaed, degi, e-nangi ise-nued binsasurdabalid.
Ar gwen-gwena dulemar san-swilidikye na bidamalad. Degi-inigwele, isguedginbi gudidamalad.
Ar gwen-gwena nuga-nikamaladye na sogdidamalad, yamo bule-bule dulemarga gudidamalad.
Gwen-gwena dulemar dule-wilemalad-wiogega, dule-ibmar-nue-abedimalad-wiogega, es-suidyobi, e-nugar-imaksa gudidamalad, estinyobi, e-akugar-imaksa gudidamalad.
”Nus-abe-gobed, mimmigan warbo nikad, amala unnila weyob sokardamalad: ‘Udage, napi-udage.’ ”Ibmarmar geg wis-nubin-itodamaladi, sogbaa nikabalid. Ibmar-sogbakegwaddi, ‘gusye’ geg sogdaed.
A-ibmarmar, wemalad: Burgwarmalad-meged-galu, napi-dule-burgwarmalad-abedaed. Ome-geg-mimmi-baked, mimmigan-abedaed. Napa diibina napi-sogdaed. Soo-duurmaksiid napi-sapan-abedaed.
”Dule, urwakwaa e-bab-dakele, degi, e-nan-sogedba dasulile, sikwisichid e-ibe ibya-onosun, mula-non-ginnid, dula-gunsun.
”Ibmar-sogbaagwad an geger itoged, ibmar-sogbakegwaddi, an nue-aku itoged.
A-ibmarmar, wemalad: Mogir-billiba-sulubagi-nalla-naguedi, igi an magar itogoe. Akwasaila-dummadgi-naibe-nakwedi, igi an nabir magar itogoe. Demargi-ur-dummad-nadapir-geg-dogedi, igi an nabir magar itogoe. Degine, igi an magar itobaloe, dule abirgunagwar-gudii gubidaed.
”Ome, machered-dikarba-yoleged-e-daed weyobdo: Ome, machered-baid-ebo nog-gobdedaed, a-sorbali, na abalukdedaed. An neg-oakalossurye sogdedaed.
”Dulemar-ibmar-abedasulid-sogbaa nikadi, napneg-wawanmaker saed. Sogbakegwaddi, napneg-giglimaker imaked.
A-ibmarmar, wemalad: Mai reyga megider, geger dakleged. Dule-binsaedsulid mani-ibedga-guder, geger dakleged.
Ome-galagwensuli-nanaed sui-nikuder, geger dakleged. Mai-ome e-dummad-omegi dummadga-guder, bur bule geger dakleged.
”Napneggi ibdurgan-burwigwad sogabake nikad, dule-binsaed-ibedbali bur binsaed-ibeganad.
A-ibdurgan wemardo: Iglimar, sorda-gandikidsurmaladid, degi-inigwele, yor-mosale, e-mas saboddamalad.
Nubimar, dogdar sorda nikasurmalad, degi-inigwele, akwa-ollogana-yaba e-gabedneg sobmalad.
Sesmar, e-idued satemalad, degi-inigwele, darekwaa nadapdamalad.
Asbanmar, baisursunna argangi galemalad, degite, reyneggi gudidamalad.
”Ibmar-sogbaa nikabalid, yeerdakle-gandikidba garmakdidaed. Sogbakegwaddi, gandikidba nanadidaed.
A-ibmarmar, wemalad: Achumigur-nono-wawaad, ibmar-durgan-bamaladba bur buledid, ibmar-abin sikirmaked satedaed.
Gannir-machered, san-dummarbaa imakdidaed. Sibad-machered, e-bebe burwisur-dakledaed. Degine, rey, e-sorda-bila-onomalad-asabin e-ologurgin-sii nadapdaed.
”Dule-binsaedsuliyobi be san-odummosale, melle bar egi be binsao. Ibmar-isgana-imakedgi be binsas-gudiile, melle bar egi be binsao.
Dule, moli-nunis-eguredi, egi e-nunis-gwamakaled amied. Binnasur be asa-ogolele, bega abe ariodagoed. Be urwed-amiele, urwenai be gudoed.”
Rey-Lemuel-ibmarmar-sogsad. E-nana we-igargi Lemuel-odurdaksad:
“Machi, ¿igi an bega ibmar sogsale? An-nukugi-dungued, ¿igi an be-unasale? Bab-Dummadse-ise-egislegaled-mimmi-gued, ¿igi na bega binsaed uksale?
”Melle omeganbina surbinsa itogo. Bukidar reymar omeganse galakumaid.
”Lemuel, reymar sisa-gobedi, igar-nuedsulid. Dule-dummagan-negdakmaidi mumguedi, igar-nuedsurbalid.
Abakale, mumgudedgi, igar-maid iedmalale, dule-wilemaladgi bar binsasuli gudmalale.
Bur be dulemar-burgwedanigus-maidga sisa uke, bur be dulemar-sae-itodiidga vino uke,
adi, itoba na mumgumalagar, ibmar-abesa-gudiid, iemalagar, ise-wilegar-gudiidgi mer bar binsamalagar.
”Dule-belagwadamalad-ular be sunmake, dule-sergan-sated-ibmar-ular be gwisgue.
Wemar-ular be sunmake, igar-napiragwadba ega be igar itoge, dule-wilese-gudimalad be bendake. Dule-ibmar-nue-abesagudimalad be bendake.”
Ome-innikigwadba-e-daed-oyogedi, ¿doa amioe? Ar akwa-nuegan-gargerbamaladba bur sunsogedid.
E-sui egi bensurdaed. E-omeba ibmar nikagudaed, ega ibmar galakusurdaed.
Ome e-suiga, bane-bane ibidar-nuedga gued, ibmar-isganaga ega gusulid.
Ome, lino-dub-baknaddaed, sibad-wawaad-e-absar baknaddabalid, na yeer-itogedba e-gonugargi morgi arbadaed.
Igi-ur-dummagan-ibmar-ukedi, dikasuli-mas-sedanidae, debayobi, ome mas sedanidaed.
Bolegoedba gwichiguardaed, masgi na e-mimmigan ogunnardaed, e-maimarga, neggi-ibmar-imaklegedi urmakdaed.
Nainu-nued amidaed, geb nainu bakdaed, nainugi, uvaʼbi bipirmaknai imakdaed.
Ome, arbaega, guagwar gunaidaed, gandikidba na surgan-minaidaed.
Ome, e-ibmar-ukedi nueganbi nasgumaidaed. Mutikidbali, e-neggi gwallu-dummad akinsisulid, ar mutik-mutik arbasidaed.
Argan-nailik mor-sobed-naku gani sidaed. Argan-baidsik, dub ebisidaed.
Ome, dule-wileged-bendakdaed, dule-ibmar-abesaagudiid-bendakdaed.
Dambed-sibudik-sibudik batealile, e-mimmiganga bukib-binsadasulid. Ar bela e-mimmigan dambed-mor yoyoidbi damalad.
Ome na dukin, ubsan-mor-uki mor-baid makdaed, mor-suir-akwagiid yoidaed, lino-mor-sunsogmalad yoidabalid.
Dulemar bela neggweburgi e-sui mag-dakedbimalad. E-sui, ibmar-dummadga dummagan-abargi simogad.
Ome, lino-mor-nued-sobedi, saderba-mor-nagumalad-imakedi, dulemar-ibmar-ukmaladga manigi ukdaed.
Ome, innikigwadba gudidaed. E-nug dummarbaa gued. Ibmar-guoedga, bukib binsadasulid, ega alledaed.
Sunmakdele, binsaed-nikaa sunmakdedaed, dule-odurdakdele, sabekwaa dule-odurdakdaed.
E-neguya-selemaidgi nue-nakuledaed, e-mani-amiedginbi na mas-gundaed.
E-mimmigan, e-nanga sokardaed, bedi nan-nuedye. E-sui, e-ome-nug odummodamogad. Ega sogdaed:
“Ome-nuegan bukidar nikaye, degi-inigwele, bedi amarba bur bule ome-nuedye.”
Yeerdaklegedi, dule-yamogedid. Yeerdaklegedi, sikwas yeer dakledaed. Ome Bab-Jehová-dobee-nanaeddi, e-nug odummolegoed.
Dulemar, ome-e-ibmar-imaked magar dakmarsun. Bela dulemar-abargi e-nug odummolesun.
Odurdaked-Saila David-machi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi-reyga-megisadi, weyob sogsagusad:
“We-napneggi-ibmar-imaklegedi, binsarsunna imakleged, bela igarga gwen gusulid.”
Dule we-napneggi na gandikidba-alamakdiile, ¿ibu-nued egi amioe? Ibmar-nued amiosuli.
Dulemar gwalulemamaid. Bamaladdi burgwemamaid. Ar napnegdi amba gannar naid.
Dad-ibeler nakwiardaed, argwatedabalid. Na-bia-nakwiardaedse gannar gwae-gwae naddabalid, gannar nakwidabaligar.
Burwa-goledi, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik gollardaed, geb sorbali, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik aibiliddaed. Deyobi, burwa-goledi, gwen bogigusuli, gannar-gannar bipirmakdiguad.
Bela diwarmar demarse nomaid, degi-inigwele, demardi gwen engudasulid. Diwarmar na bia gwalulemai, ase gannar aibirsibalid, adi, agi gannar nodagegar.
Bela we-ibmargi-sunmaklegedi, budar-itoleged uked, gwen egi bar sunmaklebidasulid. Ibya, ibmar-dakedi gwen geggusulid, uaya, ibmar-itogedi gwen geggusulid.
Bato ibmar-gusadi, gannar gunonibaloed. Bato ibmar-imaklesadi, gannar imaklenonibaloed. We-napneggine, ibmar-gwapid sated.
Dule-gwensak, sokardibe: “Be dakena, wedi ibmar-gwapidid.” Ar we-ibmardi, bato gusgu gudiguad, anmar-idu-gudigusmalad-abargi bato gudiguad.
Ibmar-epenne-gusmaladi, bela ielesad. Dule-yoedse-gwalulemaloedi, bela ibmar-yoedse-guoedi, iemarmogoed.
Ani, an emar-odurdakedid, an Israel-yargi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi reyga mai gusad.
An nue-binsaed-nikadba bela we-napneggi-ibmar-imakleged-e-burba-baraminai, degi, egi nergunai an gusad. Bab-Dummad dulemarga we-arbaed-dummad uksad, adi, egi arbadii gumalagar.
Bela we-napneggi ibmar-imaklegedi, an daksad. Bela a-ibmarmar binsarsunna imakleged, gwage-nunmaked ukbalid.
Ibmar-doperegwadi, geg bar gannar innikii gued. Ibmar-satedi, geg ebisleged.
An binsadii gualid: “Emide, an wegi dule-nug-nikadga gunonikid. Jerusalén-neggweburgi an-idu-dummagan-megismaladba an bur nue-binsaed-nikaa gued. Anyobi, dule-baid bela-bela nue-binsaed-nikaa, bela ibmar-wisi megdisulid.
”An ulubgi bela-bela wisgubigualid, nue-binsaed-nikaguedi, wede ibi obarleye. Deginbali, an magar-itobiguarbalid, binsaedsuli-ibmar-imaklegedi, wede ibi obarlebarye, degi, yogasaar-sunmaklegedi, ibi obarlebarye. ”Geb an wisgunonikid, amba we-ibmarse-bakale, gwage-nunmaked ukbalid.
Napiragwa, ar bela-bela nue-binsaed-nikaguedi, bur bule bonigan ukbalid. Ar dule bur bule ibmar-wisguedi, bur bule naibid itobalid.”
An-gwagegi an sogsa gusad: “Emigindi, ibmar-galagwensuli-imakedgi-yeer-itolegedi, an imakdii guoye, an nue-yeer-itodii gubaloye.” Ar amba deyob gudiguedi, binsarsunna imaklebalid.
Alledi, binsa goelleged an daked. Ibmar-galagwensuli-imakedgi-yeer-itogedi, ¿ibiga gue? Ibmarga gusuli.
Geb an wisgubigualid, vino-gobedgi bule an magar neg-itodii guodibe, degi, binsaed-satedyobi galagwensuli ibmar-imakdii guodibe. Adi, an wisguega, dule we-napneggi sikwas-dula-gudiguedgi, na e-ibmar-imakdiidgi ibi-nued amie.
An we-ibmar-dummagan imaksad: Negmar an sobsad, uva-nainu-dummagan an nasiksabalid.
An-nainugine, bukidar ibmar-gullemalad an digsad, dutumar an digsabalid. Sapi-san-nabir-gullemalad akar-akar an digsabalid.
Amar-ogegala, dii-sabogega yaa-dummagan an akwisbalid.
An bukidar mai-machergan, degi, mai-omegan baksad. Maimar-an-neggi-gwalulesmalad an nikusbalid. Jerusalén-neggweburgi-an-idu-dummagan-megismaladba, an bur bule molimar-bebe-nikad nikusad, degi, sibad-wawaadmar an nikusbalid.
An ormar, degi, manimar ichesur nikusad. Rey-bamalad-e-ibmar-nuegan an susad, degi, dule-yar-bamaladgi-bukwamalad-e-ibmar-nuegan an susbalid. Machergan-anga-namakmalad, degi, omegan-anga-namakmalad an nikusgusad. An wergudiidbali, an ome-baigan-bukidar nikusbalid.
Jerusalénʼgi-an-idu-dummaganga-megismaladi, anyobi nug-dummarbaa nikussurmalad. Deginbali, anyobi nue-binsaed-nikaa gussurmarbalid.
Bela an-ibmar-imakbigusadi, an imaksad. Bela ibmar-galagwensuli-imakedgi-yeer-itogedi, an itosbalid. Bela an-arbasadgi an wergudii gusad. We-ibmarmar-imaksadgi an yeer itosad.
Geb sorbali, bela-ibmar-imaksadgi an binsadii gusad. Bela ibmar-imakega an dummad-arbadigusadgi, an binsadii gusbalid. An bela we-ibmarmar dakalid, bela wedi, binsarsunna imaklegedi, degi, gwage-nunmaked ukbalidi, egi ibmar-nued amilesurbalid.
Geb sorbali, an binsadii gualid, nue-binsaed-nikagued, wede ibi obarlege, binsaedsuli-ibmar-imakleged, ibi obarlebali, degi, yogasaar-sunmakleged, ibi obarlebali. Ar dule rey-sorba-megnonikoedi, ¿ibu-ibmar-baid imaknonikosunna? Ibmar-baid-imaked sate. Ar ade, bato bela ibmar imaklesad.
An daknonikid, ar igi neg-meegwad negsichidba bur nued gue. Deyobi, nue-binsaed-nikagued, yogasaar-sunmaklegedba bur nuedid.
Dule-binsaed-ibed, magasar neg daked. Dule-binsaedsuliddina, aku neg daked. An daknonibalid, bela dulemar burgwedsemarbalid.
Geb degine, an sogdesunnad: “Dule-binsaedsulid-burgwedyobi an burgwemogoed. Degisoggu, ¿ibiga an binsaed-ibedga gubisunna?” Degisoggu, an daknonibalid, we-ibmar binsarsunna imaklebali.
Ar dulemar, dule-binsaed-ibedgi, degi, dule-binsaedsulidgi bar binsaosurmalad. Ar birgamar-namaidba bela iedmaloed. Dule-binsaed-ibed, dule-binsaedsulidyobi burgwemogoed.
Degisoggu, an we-napneggi-gudiidi, isdar an itononisunnad. Ar ade, bela we-napneggine ibmar-imakleged nabir anga nosulid. Ar bela we-ibmarmar binsarsunna imakleged, gwage-nunmaked ukbalid.
Deginbali, we-napneggi arbaed-dummad-an-imaksadi, gwen-nabir an daknonisurbalid. Ar bela arbaed-dummad-an-imaksadi, dule-an-sorba-megnonikoedga an obegergebed.
An-sorba dule-reyga-megnonikoedi, binsaed-ibedga guodibe, binsaedsulidga guodibe, amba bai daklegosulid. Degi-inigwele, dummad-an-arbasadgi-ibmar-nikusadi, degi, binsaed-nikaguedgi-an-ibmar-imaksadgi-ibmar-nikusadi, we-reygadga gunonikoed. Ar we-ibmarmar binsarsunna imaklebalid.
We-napneggine, an dummad-arbasad-ulale, an gwen nabir itononisurbalid.
Ar gwen-gwen-dulemar, ibmar-nikuega e-binsaed-nikad ebudamalad, ibmar-nikuega e-ibmar-wisid ebudamalad, degi, ibmar-nikuega e-ibmar-durdaksad ebudamalad. Ar sorbardi, dule-gwen-arbassulidga bela e-ibmar-nikuedi, obegoed. Ar weyob ibmar-guedi, gwen nabirsulid. We-ibmarmar, binsarsunna imaklebalid.
Dule we-napneggi arbaed-dummad-imakedgi, surbinsa-alamaknaidgi, degi, bukib-binsaed-abalagi-alamaknaidgi, ¿ibu-ibmar-nued egi nikue? Sate.
Ar dulega bane-bane wile-itogedbi, degi, arbaed-dummad-imakedbi neg naid. Mutikidse-bakale, gwen obunnosulid. We-ibmarmar binsarsunna imaklebalid.
Degisoggu, unnila masgunnedgi-yeer-itogedi, gobedgi-yeer-itogedi, degi, e-arbaedgi-yeer-itogedi, dulega bur-nued gued. An daksabalid, we-ibmala Bab-Dummadgi danibali.
Ar Bab-Dummad dulegi-nabir-binsasulile, ¿doa nabir mas-gunnoe? ¿Doa yeer itobaloe?
Bab-Dummad dule-yeerdakedga, binsaed-nikagued uked, ibmar-nue-wisi imaked, degi, yeer-itoged ega ukbalid. Ar dule-isganagardina, ibmar-onmakedgi-arbaed ega uked. Adi, sorbali, we-ibmar dule-yeerdakedga ukegar. Ar we-ibmarmar binsarsunna imaklebalid, degi, gwage-nunmaked ukbalid.
Ibmar-imaklegega bela e-wachi nikad. We-napneggine, ibmar-imaklegega bela e-ibagan nikabalid:
Gwaluleged-e-iba nikad, burgwileged-e-iba nikabalid. Ibmar-gwag-digleged-e-iba nikad, ibmar-gwag-ungeleged-e-iba nikabalid.
Oburgwileged-e-iba nikad, onuguleged-e-iba nikabalid. Ibmar-earileged-e-iba nikad, ibmar-sobleged-e-iba nikabalid.
Boleged-e-iba nikad, alleleged-e-iba nikabalid. Dule-burgwisadba wile-itoleged-e-iba nikad, yeer-itogedba gwirleged-e-iba nikabalid.
Akwamar-osamakleged-e-iba nikad, akwamar-weleged-e-iba nikabalid. Angaagwar-imakleged-e-iba nikad, degimaloye-sogleged-e-iba nikabalid.
Ibmar-imaklebienad-e-iba nikad, ibmar-imaklebisulid-e-iba nikabalid. Ibmar-saboleged-e-iba nikad, ibmar-mileged-e-iba nikabalid.
Ibmar-esirmakleged-e-iba nikad, ibmar-makleged-e-iba nikabalid. Sunmaklesulid-e-iba nikad, sunmakleged-e-iba nikabalid.
Sabguleged-e-iba nikad, isdar-dakleged-e-iba nikabalid. Bila-onoleged-e-iba nikad, neg-bogidik-naguleged-e-iba nikabalid.
Ar dule arbaedgi alamaknaiguedi, ¿ibu-nued egi nikue?
An daksad, Bab-Dummadi dulemarga arbaed-dummad uksad, adi, arbaedgi alamaknai gumalagar.
Bab-Dummad e-iba-sogedba bela ibmar-yeerdakle imaksad. Deginbali, dule nabir epenne-ibmar-gusmalad-magar-itogega, degi, yoedse-ibmar-guoed-magar-itogega imaksabalid. Degi-inigwele, dule, bela Bab-Dummad negasailagi-ibmar-imaksad, degi, yoedse-ibmar-imakoed wissulid.
An wisdo, dule na dula-gudiidgine wergudiguedba, degi, ibmar-nued-imakdiguedba, bur ibmar-nued-baidi, sated.
An wisbalid, nabir-masgundiguedi, nabir-gobdiguedi, degi, dummad-arbasadgi-yeer-itodiguedi, Bab-Dummad dulega uksabalid.
Amba an wisbalid, bela-Bab-Dummad-ibmar-imaksadi, degisadegu gued. Na e-ibmar-obinnisadgi ibmar-baid geg nasikleged, geg bar osulolebalid. Bab-Dummad bela deyob imaksad, adi, dulemar e-dobekwaa nanamalagar.
Emi ibmar-bukwadi, bato dikasurgus bukwad. Ibmar-gunonikoedi, bato gudiid. Bab-Dummad gannar-ibmar-guega imaked.
We-napneggine ibmar-baid an daksabalid: Igar-itolegedgi, igar-isgana imakleged. Igar-innikigwad-imaklegedgi, igar-isgana imakleged.
Geb an binsadsunnad: “Bab-Dummad dule-nuedga igar itogoye, degi, dule-isganaga igar itobaloye. Ar ade, bela-ibmar-guedga, igar-itoleged-iba nikaye. Bela-ibmar-imaklegedga igar-itoleged-iba nikabarye.”
An dulemargi binsasbalid: “Bab-Dummad dule-wilubdaknaiye, adi, dulemar na magar itomalagarye, emarde, ibdurganyob gumarye.
Dulemar ibdurganmaryob bergumarmogad. Ebobela ega igar yopira maid. Ebobela na yopira burgwemalad. Ebobela dulagudiguega bunnodigued abeged. Degisoggu, dule ibdurgangi obinsulid. Ar napiragwa, bela wemar gwen nabirsulid,
degi, bela napa-urba megmaloed. Bela napagi danimalad, bela gannar napaga binyemarbaloed.
”¿Ar doa wissunna, dule-e-burba niba naddae? ¿Ar doa wissunna, ibdurgan-e-burbadi neg-urba aideddae?”
An daksasunnad, dule, e-arbaedgi-wergudiguedba bur ibmar-nued-imaked sated. Ade, arbaed-igar ega uklesad. E-burgwisad-sorba ibmar-guoed-dakega, ¿doa we-dule-burgwisad gannar-dagega imakoe?
An dakdebalid, we-napneggine, dule-mesagwar-imakledimalad yaisulid. Dule-mesagwar-gudimaladi bodidii an daksad, dule-gadi-gadi-e-gwage-imakedi sate gudimalad. Dule-mesagwar-gudimaladi, dule-gadi-gadi-e-gwage-imakedi sate gudimalad. Dule-wemar-mesagwar-imakdimaladi, gangued nikamalad.
Degidbali an binsaded, dule-burgwismaladi, dula-gudimaladba bur weligwar gumalad.
Ar degi-inigwele, amba yoo-gwalulemaladdi, bur bule wemarba weligwar gumalad. Ar ade, we-napneggi ibmar-isgana-imaklemalad amba yoo dakmalad.
An daksabalid, arbaed-dummad-imakedi, degi, ibmar-imakedba-nasgumaiguedi, nobed uked. Wedi binsarsunna imaklebalid, gwage-nunmaked ukbalid.
Dule-binsaedsulid, gwen arbasuli ukudmaad burgwidoed.
Sikwas-obunnolegedi, doggus-obicha-arbaedba bur nuedid. Ar doggus-arbaedi, gwage-nunmaked uked.
We-napneggi, ibmar-binsarsunna-imakleged-baid an dakdebalid:
Dule-wargwenad mimmigansuli gudiid, degi, gwenadgansuli gudibalid, bipisaar arbaed indakdisulid. Bato-ibmar-nikadi amba yeer-itosulid, bur bule ibmar nikubied. Gwen binsasurbalid, doaga ede alamaknai. Gwen werguedgi binsasurbalid. Wedi binsarsunna imaklebalid, arbaed-dummad gued.
Dule-ebogwad, dule-wargwenadba bur nuedid. Ar na e-arbadiidgi bur bule ibmar-nuegan nikumalad.
Ar gwensak aimukudele, baid ogwichoed. Ar dule walagwen-gudiiddi, aimukudele, dummad-wilegoed, ar dule-baid-e-ogwisgued sateoed.
Ar dule-ebogwad na walikaa megmalale, na muchub-muchub uee imakmaloed. Ar dule walagwen-megerdi, ¿igi na uee itogoe?
Dule walagwenale, sunna dule-baidse galakued. Ar ebogwardina, sunna dule-baid-abin ganna gwisgumalad. Dub-giapaa-bipirmakaledi, irgwensuli itirsulid.
Sapingwa-wilesakwagwad binsaed-ibed-gudiid, bur nuedid, rey-sered binsaedsuli-gudiidba. Ar we-reyde, dule-ega-binsaed-uked bar abesulid.
Ar we-sapingwa, esgaryagi-mellesii gusdibe, e-yargine wilesakwaa gwalulesdibe,
degi-inigwele, we-napneggine an daksad, we-sapingwa rey-sorba reyga-megnonikile, dulemala eba nanai damalad.
Ar amba dule-bukidar we-sapingwa-gebe-reyga-megidedgi eba nagusdamar-inigwele, degite, dule-danimarmogoedi amba we-rey gwen yeer dakosurmarmogad. Amba we-ibmala binsarsunna imaklebalid, gwage-nunmaked ukbalid.
Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse be nadele, mer be yogasaar ibmar imako. Agi ibmar-odurdaklenaid-itoged bur nuedid, dule-binsaedsurmalad Bab-Dummadga ibmar-ogumakar-ukedba. Ar we-dulemardi, ibmar-isgana-imaknanaid aku-itodamalad.
Bab-Dummad-asabin, mer be ibmar sogdebin imako, deginbali, mer be gwae-gwae binsabalo. Ar Bab-Dummaddi nibneggi maid, bedi, napneggi gudiid. Degisoggu, nue-itoakwaa be ibmar sogo.
Ar dule-gadi-bukib-binsaedi, gabmaile, gadi gwayedaed. Dule-gadi-sunmakedi, yogasaar sunmakdaed.
Bab-Dummadga be ibmar-imakoye-ise-sogar-sogsale, gwae be imako. Ar Bab-Dummad dule-binsaedsulidamalad nabir-dakdasulid. Be ibmar-imakoye-ise-sogar-sogsad, be imake.
Ibmar-imakoye-ise-sogar-soged-sogsadba, degi, imaksulidba, ibmar-imakoye-ise-sogar-soged-sogsulid bur nuedid.
Mer be-gwabin-duku isguega-be-imaked be imako. Geb sorbali, dule-Bab-gayaburba-berbegedga mer be sogo, an ibmar-sogbisulid sogsaye, an noar sunmaksaye. Ar noar be sunmaksadba, binsarsunna Bab-Dummad be ourwoed. Binsarsunna be-ibmar-imaksad be-ibe-obelogega imakoed.
Degisoggu, bukidar-ibmar-binsarsunna-imakleged-abargi, bukidar-gwayed-abargi, degi, bukidar-yogasaar-sunmakleged-abargi, bur be Bab-Dummad-dobekwaa nanae.
Yar-gwensakgi, dule-dummad dule-wileged-sabsur-imake be dakalile, degi, dulemarga igar-nabolegedi innikigwadba imaksuli be dakalile, mer be geger dako. Ar weyob ibmar-gued, ade, dule-dummad eba-bur-dummad-e-bendaked nikad. Deginbali, dule-baid-eba-bur-dummad, eba-bur-dummagan-e-bendaked nikamogad.
Weyob-ibmar-guedi, ¿ibu-nued yar-naid egi nikue? ¿Reyde, nainugi-arbamalad-bendakega mai? Eye, bendakega maina.
Ar dule-manibina-sulibinsa-itogedi, bur bule mani-nikubidaed. Ar dule-ibmar-nueganbina-sulibinsa-itogedi, bur bule ibmar-abedaed. Amba we-ibmarmardi binsarsunna imaklebalid.
Ar mani-bukidar-nikulegele, mani bur bule oeledabalid. Mani-ibed unnila mani-e-wagarbi dakoed egi buu-nasoed. Ibmar-nued egi nikuosulid.
Arbaed-dule, immediki mas-gundibe, wilubba mas-gunbardibe, bonisuli gabdiid. Dule-mani-ibeddina, doggus-mani-nikadba gwen nue gabdisulid.
We-napneggine, boni-dummad an daksad: Dule mani-bukidar-sabogele, egi aibinega gued.
Degi, ibmar-uklegedgi yogasaar-mani-ebulegedba mani yoggued. A-ular, we-dule, machi-nikunonikile, e-machiga bar mani obegosulid.
Ar igi we-napnegse aidenoniki, deyobi, gannar nabaloed. Ar igi we-napnegse uka-swiri noniki, deyobi, e-dummad-arbasadgi-ibmar-nikusadi gwen sedosulid.
We-ibmar, boni-dummadbalid. Ar igi-dule napnegse aidenoniki, deyobi, gannar nabaloed. Ar dule arbaed-dummad-imakedgi, ¿ibi nued amie? Sate.
Deginbali, ar we-dulede, we-napneggine wile-itogedgi, arbaed-dummad-imakedgi, bonigan-abalagi, degi, sae-itogedgi mas-gundiid.
Weyob an daknonikid: We-napneggi-gudiidgi masgunned bur-nuedid, gobed bur-nuedid, degi, arbaed-dummad-imakdiidgi yeer-itodigued bur-nuedid. Ar weyob Bab-Dummad abesad, we anmarga uklesad.
Deginbali, Bab-Dummad, ar doaga mani-bukidar uke, degine, ibmar-nuegan-bukidar ukbali, deyobi, a-dulega, we-ibmarmar-uklesadgi-werguega imakbalid, deginbali, egi masgunnega imakbalid, egi gobega imakbalid. Ar weyob-dulega-guedi, Bab-Dummad uksad.
Ar Bab-Dummad weligwar dule-imaksoggu, dule, we-napneggi-sikwas-gudiidgi dogdar bukib binsasulid.
We-napneggine, dulemar-abargi we-boni nue-nika an daksad:
Bab-Dummadi, abar-dulemarga ibmar-bukidar uked, mani-bukidar-nikuega imaked, deginbali, dule-nug-odummogega imakbalid. Degidbali, we-dulemar na ibmar-abegedba nikued. Degi-inigwele, Bab-Dummad, we-dule e-ibmar-nikuedgi-werguega imaksulid, aka dule-bamalad e-ibmargi-werguega imaked. Weyob-ibmar-guedi, gwen nabirsulid, boni-dummad dakleged.
Ar dule-gwensak mimmigan dulatar-nikadibe (100), degine, birga-undar-gudii gusbardibe, ar ibmar-nuegangi-wergudigussuli-burgwisale, yogasaar-diglesale, an sogdo, bur mimmi-gwensak-burgwar-aidenonikir, bur we-duleba nuedye.
Ar we-mimmi-burgwar-aidenonikid gwen neg daksasulid, degine, negsichigi megidapid. Deyob negsichigi-megidapidgi gwen bar egi binsaledsurbalid.
We-mimmide, gwen dad-ibeler-daksasulid, gwen neg-wisgussulid.
Degi-inigwele, we-mimmi, dule birga-milibo-gudigusadba (2,000), degi, gwen-ibmar-nuegangi-wergussur-gusadba, bur bogidikid nue-nikusad. ¿Ar bela dulemar bergunonikile, burgwed-negse bela naedsemarsursi? Bela naedsemalad.
Dulemar mas-gunnegala arbaedginbi alamakdidamalad, degi-inigwele, e-ukuddi gwen bergusurbalid.
Ar dule-binsaed-ibed, ¿ibuginbi dule-binsaedsulidgi-obinsisunna? Ar dule-wileged, nabir-bonigan-abin-gwisgudiidgi, ¿ibi-nued egi amimosunna? Ar e-bogwad na yopira bonigangi obindimalad.
Ibmar-sanakwa-daklegedi, ibmar-ulubginbi-abelegedba bur nuedid. Ar we-ibmar gwen nabirsurbalid.
Ibmar-gudiidi bato e-nug nika gudiid, ar bato wisgulesad, we, dule gue. Deginbali, dule, gege dule-bur-eba-niga-gandikidbogwa urwed.
Gadi-sunmaklegedgine, yogasaar sunmakleged. Ar we-ibmargi, ¿ibu-ibmar-nued egi amilesunna?
Degisoggu, we-napneggi wis sikwas-gudiidgine, dule wissulid, ibu ega nued noe. Degisoggu, we-napneggi, unnila sikwas-gudigued, gwen nabirsulid. Ar dule-gudiid, burwa-goleyob sikwas-buu nasoed. Ar dule burgwisad-sorba, ¿doa ega sogosunna, igi neg guoye?
Ina-wawadikidba nug-nued-nikuleged, bur nuedid. Gwaluleged-ibaba burgwed-iba, bur nuedid.
Iba-dummad-nonaidse-ataknaedba dule-burgwisadse-ataknaed, bur nuedid. Ar dule bela burgwedsegad, degisoggu, dulemar-dula-gudimalad, burgwedgi binsadii gumalawilubbinad.
Allelegedba boleged bur nuedid. Ar boleged amba wile-ito emar-imak-inigwele, gadi-gadi gwage-imakbalid.
Dule-binsaed-ibed, dule-burgwis-naidse-ataknadele, binsaed-nikaa daed. Dule-binsaedsuliddina, ataknadele, unnila dodogedginbi binsadaed.
Dule-binsaedsulid yamo emar-ogannogedba, dule-binsaed-ibed emarga sabsur-ibmar-soged, bur nuedid.
Dule-binsaedsulidaed-e-alledi, ikomar-gummakder doos-doos-gotedaeyobid, yog-berguar naddaed.
Sabsur-ibmar-imakleged dule-binsaed-ibed-oichoged. Ibmargi-bennuklegar-binsaed-galeged, dule-binsaed-ibed-e-gwage oichobalid.
Ibmar-gebe-imaklegedba, ibmar-nagase-obeloleged, bur nuedid. Dule-na-san-dummarba-imakdiidba, dule-na-ulubgi-bargaagwar-gudiid, bur nuedid.
Mer urwed begi-obinega be imako, ar urweddi, dule-binsaedsulidaedgadid.
Mer be sogo, ibiga ibagan-nasmalad bur nuegan gusye. Weyob-sunmaklegedi, binsaed-ibegan-sunmakedsulid.
Dulemar-we-napneggi-gudimalad binsaed-nikagued-nikale, nuedid. Degine, nainu-nikabalile, doggus bur nuedid.
Binsaed-nikagued emar-bendaked, mani-nikued emar-bendakmogad. Degi-inigwele, binsaed-nikagued bur biriginedid, ar adi, nuedgi-sered-megega dule-imaked.
Bab-Dummad-ibmar-imaksad be dakena: Ar Bab-Dummad ibmar-dopere-imaksadi, ¿doa bar inniki imakosunna?
Bega ibagan-nuegan-nonikile, egi be werguo. Amba bega ibagan-isgana-nonibalile, Bab-Dummadgi-danibarye be binsabalo. Ar dule wissulid, ibagan-danikoedi, igi danibali.
Wegi-wile-itodiidgi an we-ibmar belagus dakdanikid: Dule-nuegan, ibmar-inniki-imakdiid-ular, sabsur-ibitodimalad. Ar dule-isganamardina, ibmar-isgana-imaked-inigwele, aka bur undar-seredi megmalad.
Mer doggus be wilub-obicha an dule-innikigwadye be sogo. Mer doggus be wilub-obicha binsaed-ibed na be sao. Abakalegi na be dukin oitoalile.
Mer doggus dule-isganaga na be imako, mer dule-binsaedsulidga na be imakbalo. ¿Ar ibiga na be durbas burgwed aminonikosunna?
Mer doggus wilub-obicha na be dao, wilubba na be gudii guoed. Ar dule, Bab-Dummad-dobekwaa-gudiile, bela ega ibmar nueganbi gudoed.
Dulemar-bulegan-ambegid (10) neggwebur-semaladba, binsaed-nikagued dule-binsaed-ibed-ogannoged, bur nuedid.
Dule, bela-belad-innikidaedi, bela-belad-ibmar-nued-imakdibalidi, gwen bipisaale isgudisurbalidi, we-napneggine, sated.
Mer yogasaar-sunmaklegedba be aibiro. Adi, be-mai-begi-ichakwa-sunmaked, be itogosulid.
Ar be nue-wismogad, emargi-ichakwa be sunmaksamogad.
Binsaed-ibed-dulega an guoye na sogsagusanad, bela we-ibmar an-binsaed-nikadba an baraminai gusanad. Degi-inigwele, amba bela an ibmar magar-itosulid.
Bela-ibmar-guedi yeer angi gangu noed, amba an magasar-itosulid. ¿Doa we-ibmar bela baramiosunna?
Degisoggu, binsaed-nued-bar-amiega an guarsunnad, ulub-nagasega ibmar-gumaid-bar-amiega an gualid. Degidbali an neg-daknonikid, dule-isgana-gued binsaedsulidaedid, degine, binsaedsulidaedi, igar-gwen-nabirsulidid.
Deginbali, we-ibmar bur boni-dummad an daknonibalid: Ome-isgana, burgwedba bur bule boni uked. We-ome-e-gwage-naidi, sakiyob emar-gaed, e-swidamala, esgoro-dubyob emar-edinned. Ar dule Bab-Dummadbaligwa-gudidibe, we-omese galegosurguoed. Isgued-duledina, we-omese ibitogoed.
Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged sogded: “Bela an ibmar-sog-soggwen baraminai-gusgua, an weyob ogwinmaknonisunnad:
”An ibmar-amidiidi, amba an yoo baramied. An dula-miligwenad-abargine (1,000), dule-machered-amidiidi, an wargwen aminonikid. Ome-nued-gwensakdina, wargwensaale gwen an amissurgusad.
”Degisoggu, unnila webi an magar-itonikid: Bab-Dummad dule-imaksadi, dule-bonisuli imaksanad. Degi-inigwele, dule na e-daedba, dukin na bonigan-amisad.”
¿Doa-dule binsaed-ibedyob gue? ¿Doa-dule bela-ibmar-wisid gudii? Dule, binsaed-nued-nikadbali, e-daklegedi, weligwar-dakleged, degine, e-daedi, nued dabalid.
Degisoggu, an bega soged: Rey-e-ibmar-sogmaidbali be ibsao, ar Bab-Dummad-asabinni deyob-imakoye be sogsad.
Melle be rey-asabin-gwichidgi gwae-gwae-nodebin sao. Mer ibmar-isgana-imakedgi be binsabalo. Ar ade, rey na e-ibmar-imakbiedba ibmar imaked.
Ar rey-e-sunmakedi gargangued nikad, degisoggu, ¿doa ese golosunna ibu be imaknaiye?
Ar dule rey-sogedba daele, gwen akar-guosulid. Dule-binsaed-ibedi na wisid, sana reyba ibsaoe, degine, igi imakbaloe.
Ar bela-ibmar-imaklegedi, e-ibagan nikad. Degine, igi ibmar-imaklebaloed-igar nikabalid. Degi-inigwele, dulega, we-ibmar, boni-dummad gued:
Bonigan-egi-gwisgunonikoed wissulid, degine, dule-ega-ibmar-guoed-soged satebalid.
Dule burgwed-bargaegala, gargangued nikasulid, na degisadegu-gudiguega, gargangued nikasurbalid. Ar burgwed-igargine, gege dule wakinned, dule-isganase-bakale, gege wakinned.
An we-napneggi ibmar-gued bela-bela an nue-wisgubiguargua, an daknonikid: Imbagwenale, dule, e-maiga dule-baid-imakele, ega boniga gunonidaed.
Degine, an daksabalid, dule-isganamar-burgwisale, iba-dummad-abalagi digledaed. Degine, dulemar Babse-goled-negse-nanadimaladdina, na e-neggweburgi-gudigusmaladgi ielededaed, gwen bar egi binsaledasulid. We-ibmar gwen-nabirsulid.
Dule-isgana ibmar-isgana-imaksale, abgayala ega igar nabolesulile, dulemar binsaddamalad, igar-isgana-imakleger, akarsurye. Degisoggu, ibmar-isgana-imakedgi aka gatik burguddamalad.
Dule-isgana bali-bali isguedginbi-alamakdiidi, sunna undar gudii gubalid. An wisbalid, dule-Bab-Dummad-dobekwaa-gudiidi, degi, e-nug-odummodibalidi, bur nued gudii guoed.
Dule-isganamargardina, bela ega ibmar boniga gudoed. Ar unnila sikwas gudii gumaloed, waa-yogguddaeyob gumaloed. Ar we-dulemar, Bab-Dummad-dobekwaa gudisurmalad.
We-napneggi galagwensuli ibmar gued, degine, igarsuli ibmar gubalid. Imbagwenale, dulemar-inniki-gudimalad dule-isganayob ega ibmar guddaed. Degine, dule-isganagardina, imbagwenale ega ibmar nueganbi naddaed. An sogdo, we-ibmar gwen nabirsurbarye.
Degisoggu, an soged: Wergudii gumarsun. Ar anmar we-napneggi-gudiidgi Bab-Dummad-anmarga-ibmar-uksadbali, bur mas-gundii gumarsun, gobdii gumarbarsun, wergudii gumarbarsun. Ar galitodiid-sorba, we-ibmarbi wis anmarga besad. Ar we-ibmar-birgi ibmar-baid sulid.
We-napneggi binsaed-nued-balamiegala, degine, we-napneggi-ibmar-gued-balamiegala, ise-dakale an imaknai gualid. Degidbali, ibginedse-bakale, nue bar an gabdisulid.
Geb deyobi, Bab-Dummad-we-napneggi-ibmar-imaksad an daknonikid. Ar dule Bab-Dummad-bela-ibmar-imaksad bela magar itogosulid. Ibmar-magar-itogegala, aisaar alamaknai guoenad, degite, baramiosurguoed. Ar amba, dule-binsaed-nikarbad sogdibe, an magar-neg-itoye, degi-inigwele, nagase amba magar-itosurmogad.
Bela we-ibmarmar-wisguegala, an egi alamaknai gualid. Wegi an daknonikid, dule-innikidamalad-e-ibmar-imakmaladi, degi, dule-binsaed-ibegan-e-ibmar-imakmaladi, Bab-Dummad-e-argan-yaurgi siid. Anmar amba wissulid sabgued, ibu obare, sae-emar-daked, ibu-obarbali. Amba, anmar-asabinni we-ibmar oyole-inigwele, magar-itolesurdaed.
