Bela dulemar yopira guedbimalad: Dule-innikidaeddibe, dule-ichakwadaeddibe, amba yopira burgwedsemalad. Dule-nueddibe, dule-isganadibe, amba yopira burgwedsemalad. Dule-swilidikiddibe, dule-swilidiksuliddibe, amba yopira burgwedsemalad. Dule-ibmar-ogumakar-ukeddibe, dule-ibmar-ogumakar-uksuliddibe, amba yopira burgwedsemalad. Dule-ibmar-nued-imakdeddibe, dule-ibmar-isgana-imakdeddibe, amba yopira burgwedsemalad. Dule-ibmar-ise-sogar-imakeddibe, dule-ibmar-ise-sogar-imaksuliddibe, amba yopira burgwedsemalad.
We-napneggi, ibmar-imakleged-abargi, we-ibmar gwen nabir nosulid: Bela dulemar na yopira guedsemalad. Deginbali, dule e-gwagegine, ibmar-isganaginbi binsadiid. Dule-gudiidi, unnila galagwensuli binsadiid. Ar bela burgwemaloedbiid.
Degisoggu, dule na dule-bamalad-abargi dula-garmakdiir, wis nubin itoged. Agala an soged: Rey-burgwedba, dule-belagwad-dulagudigued, bur nuedid.
Ar dulemar amba dula-gudimaladi, e-burgwemaloed na wismalad. Dule-burgwismaladdina bar ibmar-abemaisurmalad, ar bar-itomaisurmalad. Deginbali, gwen egi bar-binsalesurbalid.
Ar e-daedi, e-sabguedi, e-sae-itogedi, ibmarbina-sulibinsa-itogedi, burgwisadgi, bergusiid. Ar we-napneggi, gannar weyob-guoedgi-binsaodeeye bar binsamaiosulid.
¡Weligwaledgi mas be gunne! ¡Yeer-itogedgi vino be gobbali! Ar Bab-Dummad be-ibmar-imaksadi, yeer be-ibe daksad.
Na be mor-dagudikmaladbi yodigu guo, gwallu-wawad nonogi be magakwaa-gudigu guo.
Na be ome-bela-bela-abegedbogwa, bane-bane wergudii gusun. Ar Bab-Dummad, we-napneggi sikwas-gudiguega be-imaksad. We-napneggi, ibagan-gwen-nabir-nanamaisursoggu, na be wegi wergudii gusun. We-napneggi-alamakdiid-nukad, we-werguedi wis bega uklesad.
Ibu-ibmar-imaked bega uklenonikile, imakedse be sao, melle be imaksuli guo. Ar be burgwisardi bar arbaosulid, ibmar-wisguleged-igar surbalid, degi, binsaed-nikagued-igar surbalid.
We-napneggi an negdaknonibalid: Abarmaklegedgi-bengulegedgi dule-sabsur-abarmakedbi emargi obinsulid. Bila-onolegedgi dule-gargangued-nikadbi emargi obinsulid. Dule-binsaed-ibedbi mas gunsulid. Dule-ibmar-wisirbaadbi mani-ibedga gusulid. Dule-nue-garda-wismaladbi e-bina soglesulid. Ar bela dulemarga, imbagwenale, ibagan-nued ega nonidaed, imbagwenale, ibagan-isgana ega nonidabalid.
Deginbali, an daksabalid, dule na e-burgoed-ibagan wissurbalid. Uamar-sakigi-galedamaladyob gued, sikwimar-galedamaladyob gued. Ar dulemar ukiagwar boniganse galeardamogad.
We-napneggi an we-ibmar-daksabalid, egi an nue-durdaksabalid:
Neggwebur-bipigwadi dulemar-iche-nika an daksad. A-neggweburgine, rey-buledi neggwebur-suega e-sordamarbo ebiris ambikunoni gusad. We-rey, e-sordamarbo, neggweburgi-dogega dikarba napa arsanyob onakwismalad.
We-neggweburgine, dule-wileged gudiid. We-dulede, dule-binsaed-ibedid. We-dule, e-binsaed-nikadbali, neggwebur-bendaksa gusad. Degi-inigwele, dulemala we-dulegi gwen binsassurmalad.
Andi sogdo: “Dule-wileged-e-binsaed-nikad isdar-daklege-inigwele, deginbali, e-sunmaked itolebisuli-inigwele, ‘ar garganguedba binsaed-nikaa-ibmar-imaklegedi, bur nuedye.’ ”
Dule-binsaedsulidamalad-e-dummad binnasuli-sunmakedba, dule-binsaed-ibed-binnasdikii-sunmaked bur nabir itoleged.
Gingimarba, binsaed-nikagued bur sunsogedid. Ar dule ibmar-soggwengi wis nosale, bela ibmar oichoged.
Gukur-burgwaled neg-nunu-yapanne imaked, degidbali, ina-wawa-sobed-ibe ina-wawadikid oichoged. Deyobi, gaya-isgana-sunmakleged, bela dule-binsaed-ibed-e-sunmaked oichoged, e-nug-nued oichobalid.
Dule-binsaed-ibed-e-gwage ibmar-nued-imakedgi binsaed. Dule-binsaedsulidaed-e-gwagedina, ibmar-isgana-imakedgi binsaed.
Dule-binsaedsulidaed, ar ibu imakalile, e-ibmar-imakedgi magasar na oyoged, ede, dule-binsaedsulidye.
Dule-sapin-dummad-negsemaid bese ulualile, mer be abin-imakdebin sao. Ar san-bargaagwar-imaklegedi, bukidar ibmar-noar-imakleged bargaed.
We-napneggi-gudiidgine, an daksabalid, sapin-dummagan-negsemamaidi, weyob ibmar noar-imakdimalad:
Dule-binsaedsulidaedgala, aka arbaed-nuegan ukleged. Ar dule-bur-nabir-binsamaladgardina, arbaed-baisulid ega ukleged.
An daksabalid, dule-maiga-gudimaladi, moli-birgi-sii gudidamalad. Ar dule-nuga-nikamaladdina, maiga-gudiiyob nagab galitodidamalad.
Dule yaa-matusur-akwisdibe, sunna egi argwaned. Dule gagan-matusulid-eminaidibe, sunna dubgi warmaked.
Dule, akwa mamarye-sogdibe, sunna akwagi nailikgued. Dule sapan mamarye-sogdibe, sunna e-dargagi makleged.
Ar akan e-nugar-berguddibe, e-nugar ebillesurbardibe, ibmar-sikegala, sabsur achiklegergebed. Binsaed-nikaguedgi ibmar-imaklegedi, nuekwagwadgi-ibmar-imaklegedi, ibmar-nued amileged.
Ar naibe gar-ogoledba-ododoleged-iduar, dule-ega-gar-ogoledgi warmaksadibe, dule gwen egi bar mani amiosulid.
Dule-binsaed-ibed-e-sunmaked yeer itoledaed, dule-binsaedsulidaed-e-sunmakeddina, na dukin egi aibined.
Dule-binsaedsulidaed gebe sunmakdele, e-gaya-miedi, gwen nabir sunmaksulid. Deyob gaya-nuedsuli e-sunmaked obeloddaed.
Degite, sunmaknaigusale, gayaburbamar suli-suli amisulid. Dule neg-guoed gwen wissulid. Yoedse ibmar-danibaloed gwen-wissurbalid. Ar dule, we-ibmar, gwen wisguosulid.
Dule-binsaedsulidaed, arbaedgi baisursunna yegued. Neggweburse-naed-igarbela wissurbalid.
Rey amba nuchukwagwar, neggwebur, wilesdakledaed. Degine, e-sapingan-dummaganmoga, unnila wakdaradba iba-onogedgi arbadidamalad, deyob osedoddamalad.
Neggwebur-e-rey dule-nuga-nikaddibe, we-neggweburgi ise-nued binsalesad. Degine, e-sapin-dummagandina, e-wachiba na mas-gunmalad, deyob na niga-ogannomalad. Mumguega ambikusurmalad.
Wiedba neg-uas-nudaklesulile, neg-uas ayariddaed, degine, wiedgi-neg-soblesadbali, neg maluddaed.
Wergulegegala, masgulleged-iba onoleged, yeer-itolegegala, vino goblebalid. We-ibmar-imakegala, mani abeleged.
Reygi mer be ichakwa sunmako, mer egi be ichakwa binsabalo. Deginbali, dule-mani-ibedgine, mer egi be arbakee isdar sunmakbalo. Ar sikwimar-gudidiid sunna be-barsoged, ar sikwimarde sakan-nika nanaed, degisoggu, baisursunna gayamar berbeged.
Diaki be-madu be mete, yoedsega be gannar amioed.
Be-ibmar-nikad, dule-walaguglega (7) be uke, dule-walabaabakadse (8) ega be ukodibe. Ar yoedsega we-napneggi bonigan-gwisgunonikoed be wissulid.
Mogirmar gudure-naddibe, dii wiardaed. Sapi dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik ailaddibe, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik ailaddibe, ar agi megodo.
Dule unnila burwa-goledginbi atakdidibe, ibmar-gwag digosurguoed. Dule mogirmarginbi atakdidibe, ibmar-gwag weosurguoed.
Ar be wissulid, bia burwamar naddae. Be wissurbalid, igi mimmi sapidukugi-mege, degi, igi dungumaidabali. Degisoggu, ar bela Bab-Dummad-e-ibmar-imaked-bursunna, igi be wisguosunna. Geg be wisgued.
Wakudaryala ibmar-gwag be digo, sedogidbali, be baid digbalo. Ar be wissulid, biti bur bega nabir igarga gudoe, wakudaryala-diglesaddibe, sedo-diglesaddibe. Ar wisgulesulid, biti nabir igarga gudodibe. Ar ebobela sanmakdebalodibe.
Neg-meegwadi yeer emar-imaked. Dad-ibeler-gaedi weligwar emar-imaked.
Amba dule undar seredi-megye-sogele, degine, e-ibagangi wergudigus-inigwele, ebinsao, ibagan-bulegan-bukidar itodii gubaloed. Deginbali, bela ibmar-danikoedi, gwen nabirsulid.
Machi-sapin, sapingwa-guedgi gatik be werguo. Nuchukwagwadgi na be yeer-itodii imako. Be-gwage-itogedba na be ibmar imako, be-ibyagwar-neg-dakdiidba na be ibmar-imakbiedba imako. Degi-inigwele, be ebinsao, Bab-Dummad ar bela be ibmar-imaked, wilubdaknonikoed.
Degisoggu, urwed be iego, ibmar-isgana-imaked be iebalo. Be ebinsao, ar sapingudanikidgine, degi, sapingwagwadgine, amba aku neg-itoleged-ibaganad. Ar we-igar gwen-nabirsulid.
Sapingwa-gudiidgi Bab-Dummad-be-obinnisad be ebinsao. Ibagan-bulegan-danikoed-idu, Bab-Dummad be ebinsao. Ar birgamar-bulegan-nonikile, be sognonikoed: “An-seredgussoggu, ibmar-nuegangi bar an wergudisurye.”
Dad-ibeler-gaed bar be itogosulid-iduale, Bab-Dummad-be-obinnisad be ebinsao. Nii-gaed bar be daksuliguoed-iduale, Bab-Dummad-be-obinnisad be ebinsao. Niisgwamar-gaed bar be daksuliguoed-iduale, Bab-Dummad-be-obinnisad be ebinsao. Bega dii-dummad-wisad-sorba, gannar mogirmar-nagunonikoedyob-guoed-iduale, Bab-Dummad-be-obinnisad be ebinsao.
Ibagwengine, be-argan, neggi-nakulemaladyob-gued wawanmakdoed, be-mali, bila-onomalad-dulemaryob-gued nollomakdoed. Be-nugarmar ibmar-gwag-naged-akwamaryob-gued, ichegusadbali, bar ibmar bayogosulid. Be-ibya, yawagak-seniganaba-atakmaladyob-gued, bar atakosulid.
Be-uaya, yawagak-neg-imbamaryob-gued, atudoed. Bega ibmar-gwag-naged-akwamar-goled, boggumai gudoed. Bega sikwimar-namaked bergudoed, bela namakmalad bar be itogosulid.
Neg-matusulidgi-nanalegedgi be dobe itononikoed, igarba-bonisar-nanalegedgi dobe be itononibaloed. Be-sailagia, ibmar-durba-sibudiksiiyob osibumakdoed. Ses-nanaeyob arbaed-dummad be nanadii guoed. Ibmar-gullegedi, bar bega nued-gulle gunonikosulid. Ar ade, dule degisadegu-yoggued-negse nadapid, bar gannar dagegarsulid. Bega-dule-bomaladdi, galimba-ebiris obiryamakdoed.
Mani-dub-itired-idu, or-nog-mared-idu, Bab-Dummad-be-obinnisad be ebinsao. Dii-weenaidgi mete-mared-idu, dii-weed-bipirmaknaid-bibisged-idu, Bab-Dummad-be-obinnisad be ebinsao.
Ar napagi be danisoggu, napaga be gannar binnidoed. Be-burbadi gannar Bab-Dummadse naoed. Ar Bab-Dummad bega burba-uksadid.
Odurdaked-saila weyob soged: “We-napneggi-ibmar-imaklegedi, binsarsunna imakleged, bela igarga gwen gusulid.”
Odurdaked-saila, binsaed-ibedbar-inigwele, dulemar-odurdakdii gusbalid. Bela nue-ibmar-balaminai gualid, sogedba balaminai gusad. Deginbali, binsaed-nuegan-narmaksad bukidar ilemaknai gusbalid.
Odurdaked-saila gayaburba-nuegan ise-amiar imaksagusad. Degine, gayaburba-nuegan innikigwadba narmaksa gusad.
Dule-binsaed-ibegan-e-sunmakedi, gammi ur-semaidaebayobi, emar-nied. E-binsaed-nuegan-onmaksadi, buarmar-neg-ganikidyob gued. We-binsaed-nuegan, Bab-Dummadgi danikid.
Machi, egi be binsabaliga napi an bega sogbargwelo: Gardamar-bukidar-narmakleged berguosulid, degine, gardamar-doggus-durdaklegedi, dulega geg-gued uked.
We-ibmar-sunmaklesad, wese bergunonisunnad: Unnila be Bab-Dummad-dobekwaa-gudii nanao, e-Igarmar-Mamaidba be ibsao. Ar dulega, we-ibmarbi unnila ibnuedga gued.
Ar ibmar-nued-imaklesadi, ibmar-isgana-imaklesadi, Bab-Dummad bela wilubdaknonikoed. Amba ibmar dukuar-imaklesdibe, bela wilubdakbaloed.
Salomón we-namakleged-birigined narmaksad.
¡Bitigi be an-wagar-usana gadina! Be-sabgued vino-goblegedbali, bur bule yeer itoleged.
Be-ina-wawadikid-e-yapannedi, nue-yeer yapanned. Ar be-sunnadi, ina-wawadikidyob gued. ¡Agala, yagana nue-bebina sogmalad!
¡Be an-nide! ¡Gwae beba be an-nide! ¡An-rey, be-gabednegse be an-sede! Anmar wergumarsun, anmar yeer-itomarsun. Be-sabguedgi, vino-goblegedbali, bur bule anmar egi wergue. ¡Agala, bebina nue sogmalad!
¡Jerusalén-neggwebur-bunamala! An uka sichii gued, an yeer dakleged. Cedar-dulemar-dordoneg-sichigan-bubukwadyob an-uka sichii dakleged. Salomón-mor-dummaganyob an yeer dakleged.
Mer an-uka-sichigwadgi be atakmala, ar dad-ibeler-gaedba, deyob an gusad. An-susmar anse ulusmalad, e-uva-dub-nainu-akwega an-imaksamalad. A-ulale, an-uva-dub-nainu bar an nue akwissurgusad.
¡An-sui-nue-sabesailad! Anga be soge, be-sibadmar-gagangi-omanaegala, ¿bia be omanaddae? ¿Bia yorukudba be obunnogega seddae? ¿Ar ibiga an dule-negsuligudidaeyobi, be-aimar-sibad-bukwad-abargi an be-amidii guoe?
Omegan-yeerdaklemaladba, bur be yeer dakleged. Be-sui-nue-sabesailad-amiegala, sibad-gannarba be nae. Be-sibad-burwigan masgi-omanae, dule-sibad-edarbemalad-e-dordoneg-dikarba be omanae.
Be, an-ome-nue-sabesailadid. Bee be Faraón-ur-ebipimalad-moli-omegan-nuegan-yeerdaklegedyob be gued.
Ibiyob be-wagar yeerdaklege, be-wagar oluamar-abargi yeer dakleged. Ibiyob be-dukar yeerdaklege, wingwamar-naid-abargi yeer be-dukar dakleged.
Anmar bega oluamar-olobiid soboed, oluamargi manimar-nanai bega imakoed.
Rey e-megedgi yollekwaa megisale, an-ina-wawad, wawadik-oburmakdedaed.
An-sui, ina-wawadikid binasgargi-atinnar-sagu-bipigi-seledidaedyob, anba gabdiid.
An-sui, Engadiʼye-neg-nugadgi dutu-nuegan-nigwichiyob, anga gued.
An-ome-nue-sabesailad, ¡ibiyob be yeer daklege! ¡Doggus nued be dakleged! ¡Be-ibyamar, nuumaryobi gued!
¡An-sui-nue-sabesailad! ¡Ar ibiyob be yeer daklege! ¡Machered-nued be daed! Gaganmar-aramakmamaidi anmar-gabedga guoed,
anmar-neg-nagubirmar urwarmar mamaid, anmar-neg-uas ciprés-e-urgomar mamaid.
Sarón-neba-naidgi dutu-gwichidyob an gued. Nebagi dutu-lirio-digar-gwichidyob an gued.
An-ome-nue-sabesailad, ikoganba dutu-lirio-gwichiyobi, omegan-abalagi gudiid.
An-sui-nue-sabesailad sapimar-abalagi manzana-sapi-gwichiyobi, sapingan-abalagi gudiid. A-sapi-urba-sigedi yeer an itodaed, e-sana, yeer gulledaed.
An-sui, yeer-masgullegedse an-semai gusad, agi e-sabed anga nue-oyosad.
Uva-odinnolegaledgi an-niga be ogannomala, manzanaʼgi an-niga be ogannomala, sui-abegedbina an nue-soged.
Bitigi, e-sakwa-sapiled an-nono-urba mesisana gadin. Bitigi, e-sakwa-nueddi angaagwar an-imakena gadin.
Omegan-Jerusalénʼginmalad, goe-sapurbarmalad-nukad an bemarga ise-wilegagwar soged, melle be an-ome-nue-sabesailad an-ibe odakmalo, melle be ese gormalo, na atakbiedba atakdagoed.
¡An-sui-nue-sabesailad-e-gaya gordani an itoged! ¡Be dakmala! ¡Wegi danikid be dakmala! Yalaganba ichomakdanikid, yar-mulluganba icho-icho danikid.
An-sui-nue-sabesailad goe-sapuryob daed. An-sui-nue-sabesailad goe-sapur-senigwadyob gued. Be dakmalana, anmar-galu-naba gwichid, galu-imbaba atakgwichid, arbakee yawagak-senigwad-ollo-ollogwadba an-dakgwichid.
An-sui-nue-sabesailad anga sunmaksad. Weyob anga sogded: “An-ome-nue-sabesailad, be gwisguye. ¡Ome-yeerdakleged, be anba dagye!
Be dakena, dii-wied-ibagan bato nasye, dii-wied bato bergusye.
Dutumar bato sapurba ainiarye. Namakleged-ibagan noniye. Suirgwamar-namakmalad, bela anmar-yargi itoleye.
Higuera-sapi bato sanmakdeeye, uva-dub durbamakgwisye, e-dutumar bato oyapachaye. ¡An-ome-nue-sabesailad, be gwisguye. Ome-yeerdakleged, be anba dagye!”
Igi nuu akwa-imbaba, degi, yar-imbaba yaa-olloganagi dukue, melle be deyob an-idu dukue. Be-wagar anga be oyoge, be-sunmaked-itogega be an-imake. Ar be-gayaburba yeer itoledaed, be-wagar yeer daklebalid.
Achu-asdubingiidmar anmarga be gamala. We-achu-senigana nainu-oichoged gudimalad. Ar anmar-ibe uva-dubmar-durbamakgwismalad wiogedid.
An-sui-nue-sabesailad angadid, an egadmogad. Dutumar-imbagi sibadmar-akwedii daed.
An-sui-nue-sabesailad, dad-argwaned-iduale, negsichilealile, anse be dage. Goe-sapurbalidyobi be abarmakdage, yar-Beterʼye-nugad-yalaganba be abarmakdage.
Mutik-gabmaidgine, an-sui an amialid, an-sui-na-nue-sabesailad an amialid. An-gabmaidgi an aminaigusanad, an amissurgusad.
Geb an gwisguded, neg-imbaba an aminadgusad. Galimbaba an aminaded, ibmar-uklebukwadgi an aminaded. An-sui-nue-sabesailad an amidii gualid. An amidigusanad, an amissurgusad.
Dule-nakulemalad galimbaba-bipirmakdimaladgi an-abingunonimalad. Geb amarse an egisded: “¿An-sui-nue-sabesailad be daksasurmala?”
An a-dulemargi sikwas-aibategua, an-sui-nue-sabesailad an aminonikid. Angaagwar an gasad, bar an indaksasulid. Deyobi an-nan-negse an sesad, an-gwalulesad-negse an sesad.
Omegan-Jerusalénʼginmalad, goe-sapurbarmalad-nukad an bemarga ise-wilegagwar soged, melle be an-ome-nue-sabesailad an-ibe odakmalo, melle be ese gormalo, na atakbiedba atakdagoed.
¿We ibu waayobi neg-dulesulidganba ainakdani-daklege? Ina-wawadikid-mirra-abargi danikid, ina-wawadikid-incienso-abargi danikid, dutumar-wawadik-yapanmalad-abargi danikid.
¡Be dakmala! Salomón-e-moli-ur danikid. E-yalabali sordamar-niga-gandikmalad e-dulapaa (60) danikid. Israel-sordamar-niga-gandikmalad-abargi sulesmaladid.
Wemar bela es-suid-nikamaladbiid, bilagi-urwemalagala odurdaklesmaladid. Neg-mutikidba e-isdarmalad-ainiardaed-ular, e-dikargi es-suid-nika-nika gudimalad.
Rey-Salomón e-sii-seleged-ulu sobsad, Líbano-yargi sapimar-nuegan-gwismalad-e-urgogi sobsad.
Ulu-e-suarmar, manigi-sobsabalid, e-bargamaladdi, orgi sobsabalid, e-siged, mor-suir-akwagiidgi oginnar nasiksabalid. Ulu-negyabali, ibmar-imaklesadi, bunamala-Jerusalénʼginmalad imaksad, ise-nudakar imaksamalad.
¡Omegan-Sión-yarginmalad, nodamala! Rey-Salomón be dakdamala. E-nan-ega-ologurgin-imaksad-yoi danikid. Ome-nikued-ibagi-yosad-yoi danikid. Wergued-dummad-itoged-ibagi-yosad-yoi danikid.
Be an-ome-nue-sabesailad, ibiyob be yeer daklege, doggus wilub-obicha be dakleged. Be-ibyamar, be-muswe-batenaid-imbaba nuumaryobi, yeer dakleged. Be-saila-batenaidi, sibadmar-Galaad-yargi danagwen ichomakar-aidedanidamaladyob, be-saila-batenaidi, yeer dakleged.
Be-nugarmar, sibad-wawaadmar, e-absar-siklesad-sorba, oglesadgi dagudik-nakwedanidamaladyob dakleged. Degine, be-nugarmar, bela emaladbi daklebalid, bela amba sogedba bubukwad. Degidbali, yeer dakleged.
Be-gakuli-daklegedi, morgo-gisigwadyobi dakleged. Be-sunmakedi, ibiyob yeer-itole an-imake. Be-wagar, be-muswe-batenaid-imbagi mammi-gisigwadyobi yeerdakleged.
Be-dukar-daklegedi, David-e-neg-matusulidyobi yeer dakleged. We-neg-matusulidi, akwamar-yamo-sobaledgi sobaled. Be-dukargi, neg-matusulidgi miligwen-sigu-abgamalad-nanaiyob naid. We-sigu-abgamalad, bila-onomalad-bulegangadid.
Be-mam-abinbela-naidi, goe-sapurmar-emarbi-daklegedyob dakleged. Goe-sapurmar dutumar-imbagi gagan-mananaidaeyobi, be-mam yeer dakleged.
Dad-ibeler-nakwialile, negsichid miledele, ina-wawadikid-mirra-yarse an nakwenaoed, ina-wawadikid-incienso-yar-mulluse an nakwenaoed.
Be an-ome-nue-sabesailad, nue be yeer dakleged. Be swilimakar dakleged.
An-ome, Líbano-yar-akar anba be dage, Líbano-yargi-gudiidgi anba be dage, Amana-yar-akar be aidedage, Senir-yar-akar be aidedage, Hermón-yargi be aidedage. Achumigur-e-negmar-akar be aidedage, achu-barbad-e-yarmar-akar be aidedage.
An-ome-nue-sabesailad, gebe be an-daksagua, bela-belagwad be an-binsaed ganonikid. Be-win-dukarba-naidgi an-edichayob be an-imaknonikid. Agi an-gwage begadga gunonikid.
An-ome-nue-sabesailad, be-sabgued ibiyobi itolege. Be-sabgued, vino-goblegedba bur bule yeer itoleged. Be-ina-wawadikid-yapannedi, bela-ina-wawadikid-bamaladba bur bule yeer yapanned.
An-ome-nue-sabesailad. Be-gakuligi, acha-uugi achanis-aryomaiyob gued. Be-gwabin-urba, nunis-aryomaiyobi gued, egi achanis-aryomaiyobbalid. Be-mormar-yapannedi Líbano-yar-yeer-yapannedyobi yapanned.
An-ome-nue-sabesailad, be an-bun gued. Dutugalu-emakar-naiyob be gued. Dii-nued-aryomaid-emakar-naiyob be gued.
Be-nuu, nainu-nued-naidgi, manzanaʼmar digar-gwisnanaeyobi gued. E-san-gullegedi yeer-gulle-nanaed. Be-nuu nainugi, dutu-nardo, degi, dutu-azahar nigwis-nanaedyob gued.
Be-nuu nainugi ibmar-wawagana-nuegan, akar-akar egi digar-bukwayob gued: Egi dutu-nardo-digaleyob gued, dutu-azafrán-digaleyob gued, dutu-cálamo-digaleyob gued, ina-canela-digaleyob gued, ina-mirra-digaleyob gued, ina-áloe-digaleyob gued, degi, dutumar-baigan-nuegan-digaleyob, be-nuu gued.
Igi diwar nainu-oge, deyob be gued. Dii-sukemakmaidi, Líbano-yar-akale aidedanidaeyobi, be gued.
Burwa-dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid, be gordage. Burwa-dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid, be dage. An-dutugalugi be gordage. E-wawadikid-oyapandagega be imakdage. Be an-sui-nue-sabesailad, be-dutugaluse be dage. E-sanmakgwichid-yeer-gulleged be gundage.
Be, an-ome-nue-sabesailad, an-bunbalid. An-dutugaluse an dogsad, agi an-mirra-wawadikid an aminonikid, agi an-ina-wawadikid an sunonikid. Agi an-achanis an nue-masad, agi an-achanis-e-uu an nue-guchabalid. Agi vino an nue-gobsad, nunis an nue-gobsabalid. An-aimar, mas-nued be gunmala, gatik be gobmarbali, immee gudii be imakmala.
An gabmaidgine itoakwaa an gabmaid. Agine, an-sui yawagakba gorgwichi an itoalid: “An-ome, an-buna, nuu-yeerdaklegeyob be yeer dakleged. ¡Anga yawagak be egae! Ar boo-batenaidba an-nono waradikgusad, ar neg-mutikidba-boo-batenaidba, an-sailagia waradikgusad.”
Bato an mor esusad. ¿Gannar an mor yobarsunde? Bato nag an enuksabalid. ¿Gannar an nag ollibi-gubarsunde?
An-sui yawagakgi-yaa-ollo-siidgi e-argan odosad. Deyob an daksagua, bela an-gwagese an-ebusad.
An-suiga an yawagak-egaegala, yog gwisguar an imaksad. An-argangi mirra-wawadikid ariomaid, an-goomar-imbaba bela ariomaid, yawagak-eduedgi deemaknai gusad.
An an-sui-nue-sabesailadga yawagak-egasgua, bar gwichisulid, an-idu naded. An-idu-nadedbali, an naibi itononikid. Aisaar an amisanad, an amissurgusad. An ese gornaigusbalinad, an-abin-imaksasurbalid.
Agine geb, dulemar-nakulemalad nakuledimargua, an-aminonimalad. A-dulemala an-sarsononimalad, an-naibi-imaksamalad. Dulemar-galugi-nakulebukwad, sabsur-an-ibe mor esusmalad.
Jerusalén-bunamala, ise-wilegagwar an bega sogmar. Bemar an-sui-nue-sabesailad-abingualile, ega be sogmalo, sui-abegedba an uelledye.
Omegan-bamaladba-bur-yeerdakleged, be anmarga soge, “¿ibugi be-macheredde, machergan-bamaladgi obinsunna? ¿Ibugi obinsunna, emide be weyob anmarse egisnaigu?”
An-sui-nue-sabesailad, machered-nued dakleged, e-uka sichisaar-daklebalid. Dule-miliambegwad-abargi (10,000) magasar dakleged.
An-sui-e-nono, or-nuedyob yeer dakleged. E-sailagia, sinni-sinni nikad, sikwisichidyob sichii gued.
E-ibyamar-gwabogwad-daklegedi, nuumar diwar-gakanaba-simalayob dakleged, nunisgi-obsayob dakleged. E-ibyamar innikimakar bukwad.
E-wagardi, wawadikid, ina-wawadikid egi digar-naiyobid. E-gakuli dutumar-daklegeyobid, agi mirra-nis egi dedemaknaiyobid.
E-swidamardina, or-suarmar-daklegeyobid, akwa-nuegan egi nanaiyobid. Bela-e-abagan, elefante-nugar-daklegeyob, swilidikid dakleged. Akwa-nuegan-zafiroʼye-nugad, bela egi ebiris naiyobid.
E-malimar-warbogwaddina, akwa-nued-mármol or-nued-sobaled-birgi-gwigwichidyob dakleged. E-gwisgued, yeerdakle gwisgued, Líbano-yargi-urwar-gwigwichidyob dakleged.
E-gakulide, bela osidikid, bela e-daklegedi, machered-nued itoged. Jerusalén-bunamala, ar deyob an-sui dakleged, ar deyob an-ai dakleged.
Omegan-bamaladba-bur-be-yeerdakleged, ¿bia be-sui-nue-sabesailad nade? ¿Bitisik nade? Anmar beba bulakwaa aminaoe.
An-sui e-dutugaluse aidenaded, ina-wawadikid-bukwadse naded, dutumar-imbaba-garmakdii imaknaded, dutumar-gwanega naded.
Ani an, an-sui-nue-sabesailadgadid, an-sui-nue-sabesailad, angadmogad. Dutumar-imbaba na e-ibmar-durgan akwediid.
Be, an-ome-nue-sabesailad. Ar igi Tirsa-neggwebur yeer daklege, igi Jerusalén-neggwebur yeer daklege, igi niisgwamar-niba-nanaid geger daklege, deyob be yeer dakleged.
Mer bar be an-daknai gue, ar be an-daksadbali, an bebina-sognonikid. Be-saila-batenaidi, sibadmar-Galaad-yargi danagwen ichomakar-aidedanidamaladyob, be-saila-batenaidi, yeer dakleged.
Be-nugarmar, sibad-wawaadmar, e-absar-siklesad-sorba, oglesadgi dagudik-nakwedanidamaladyob dakleged. Degine, be-nugarmar, bela emaladbi daklebalid, bela amba sogedba bubukwad. Degidbali, yeer dakleged.
Be-wagar, be-muswe-batenaid-imbagi mammi-gisigwadyobi yeerdakleged
Ar rey-omegan e-dulapaa (60) gued, rey-omegan-dikarbarmalad e-dulabake (80) gubalid, degi, yagana-bukidar gubalid,
degi-inigwele, unnila wargwenna nuu-yeerdaklegedyobid angad gudiid. E-nan, a-omegwa na nue sabedid, ega wargwenna guedid, na we-napnegse odesadid, a-bina bur gadi-sogedid. Yagana, a-ome-dakarmale, egi ise-nued binsadamalad. Rey-omegan, degi, e-omegan-dikarbarmalad, bunagwa-e-nug odummodamalad.
¿Ar we doawa, yeerdakleged? Ar bolegoedba neg-ainakwiardaeyobi, mutikidba nii-daarmakenaidaeyobi, dad-ibeler daarmakenaidaeyobi, niba niisgwamar gananaidaeyobi, ber yeer dakleged.
Sapimar-Nogalʼye-nugad-bukwadse an aidesad, yar-imbagi dutumar-binigan-dakega an aidesad, abakale, uva-e-muumar ainisale, abakale, manzana-e-durbamar ainisale.
Degine, naded an itossulid, an yeer-itogedbali, an-dummad-naba urgi-gwichi an itoalid.
Ome-Sulamʼgined, be dage, be dage. Gannar be anmarse dage, anmar nue be-dakbied. ¿Ar Ibiga be an-dakbimala? ¿Ibiga bemar emar-abargi-dodonai be an-dakbimala?
An-yagwa-yeerdakleged, be-nag, nag-uka-yoid yeer dakleged. Be-duawar-billikwaa-daklegedi, dule-or-sobed ormar-yeerdakleged-sobsayobi, yeer dakleged.
Be-simu-daklegedi, noga-dirbikwagwadgi, vino enamakarsiiyobi dakleged. Be-saban-daklegedi, orosgi-dakleged-trigo-dunnumaksiidgi, dutumar ebiris-nanaiyobi, yeer dakleged.
Be-mam-abinbela-naidi, goe-sapurmar-emarbi-daklegeyobi, yeer dakleged.
Be-dukar-daklegedi, neg-matusulid-elefante-nugargi-soblegaleyobi, yeer dakleged. Be-ibyamar-daklegedi, Hesbón-neg-nugad-e-diamar, Bat-Rabim-e-yawagak-naba dakarmakbukwayobi, yeer dakleged. Be-asu-daklegedi, Líbano-yargi neg-matusulid, Damasco-neggwebursik negadakegwichiyobi, yeer dakleged.
Be-nono-daklegedi, Carmelo-yar-magasar-daklesiyobi, yeer dakleged. Be-sailagia-ilemakmaid, dub-suir-akwa-daklegeyob dakleged. Be-sailabali, rey binsaed-galenai gusad.
An-ome-nue-sabesailad, ibiyobi be yeerdaklege, be-sabgued yeer an-imaked.
Be-daklegedi, ogobwar-innikimakar-gwichiyobi yeer dakleged. Be-mam, ogobmar-naidyobi yeer dakleged.
Weyob an sogded: “Ogobgi an nakwenaoe, e-san an gwannaoe.” Be-mam, uva-duk-dukwen-naidyobid. Be-gaya-yapannedi, manzana-yeer-yapannedyobid.
Be-gaya-itolegedi, vino-nued goblegedyob itoleged. Igi vino, binnasdikii gaya-yaba ariomaidae, bela gakuli waradik imake, nugarse-bakale waradik naddae, deyobi be-gaya itoleged.
Ani an, an-sui-nue-sabesailadgadid. Nue-anbina-sogedbali, angi nue-wergudiid.
An-sui-nue-sabesailad, anba be dage, sapurba anmar nae, dutugan-imbaba oibodii anmar imaknae.
Neg-oibosale, anmar uva-nainuse naoed, abakale, e-muumar ainisale, abakale, e-dutumar-ainisale, abakale sapi-granada-e-dutumar ainisale. ¡Agi an bega sabgued oyogoed!
Gagan-mandrágora-e-san-yapanned bato magar itoleged. Anmar-yawagak-nagaba bukidar akar-akar sapi-sanmar bubukwad. An-ome-nue-sabesailad, sapi-sanmar-binigan an bega sabosad, sapi-sanmar-dinnagana, an bega sabosbalid.
Be, an-sus-gargwenadina yeerbana, an-nangi be nuugusmogana yeerbana. Degina, igarba an be-abingunonikidgi an be-ibe wagar uoenad, dule gwen anga akar sogosulinad.
Argangi-gasa an be-imakoenad, an-nan-negse an be-sedoenad, agine, sabgued-igargi be an-odurdakoenad. Vino-wawadikidgi be-ogobega an be-imakoenad, an-nur-granada-nisgi an be-ogobbaloenad.
Bitigi, e-sakwa-sapiled an-nono-urba mesisana gadin. Bitigi, e-sakwa-nueddi angaagwar an-imakena gadin.
Omegan-Jerusalénʼginmalad, an bemarga ise-wilegagwar soged: “Melle be an-ome-nue-sabesailad an-ibe odakmalo, Melle be ese gormalo, na atakbiedba atakdagoed.”
¿We doa negsulidganba e-sui-gukingi birikwaa-mai-akas nakwedaniki? Manzana-sapi-urba, an be-odaksad. A-sapi-urbali, be-nan nunmakedgi be-odenoniki gusad.
Be-gwagegine an-sedii be gue. Be-swidagine an-wilub narmakar be sedii imake. Ar sabgued-e-ganguedi burgwed-igaryobid, gege dule e-igar gaed. Suibina-soglegedi, sulibinsa emar-imaked. Sabgued-itolegedi, soo-dummad-gwabunyemaiyob itoleged. Bab-Dummad deyob imaksad.
We-sabgued-sooyobidi, dii-dummadi gege oginned, diwarmarbela gege we-sabgued obelobalid. Dule-gwensak sabgued-bakega, bela e-ibmar-nikad ukdele, we-dulegi dodoledoed.
Anmar-bun senigwad, amba yoo e-nuu mullugudaged. Dule anmarse nikuega egisdanikile, ¿igi anmar abin sogosunna?
Ar galu-matusulidyob-guena, anmar e-birgi nega-dummad-manibiid soboenad. Ar yawagakga-guena anmar urwala-e-urgo egi nasikoenad.
An galu-matusulidyob gued, ar an-mam, neg-suigan-warbo-gwichiyob gued. Agala, an-sui-nue-sabesailadga, an gwage-bogidikid uked.
Salomón, Baal-Hamón-yargi nainu-gwensak nikanad, ega akwemalaga, dulemarga manigi-urmaksagusad. E-nainu-sanmaksale, we-dulemar ega war-wargwen mani-sibu-milibo (2,000) senonidamalad.
Salomón, mani-milibogwad be sue, bemar-dule-nainu-akwemalad, mani-sibu-dulataled-ilabakegwad (400) be sumarmoga. Ar an-nainudina, unnila angadid.
Be, dutugalu-abargi gudiid, anmar-aimar be-sunmaked itobigudimalad. Be-gaya-itogega be anmar-imake.
An-sui-nue-sabesailad, gwae be dage. Goe-sapuryob be abarmakdage, yalamar-wawadikid-yapanned-abargi gwae be abarmakdage.
Judá-e-reymar: Uzías, Jotam, Acaz, degi, Ezequías, amar-negdakmamaidgine, Amoz-machi-Isaías, Judá-yargi, degi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi neg-guoed daksad.
¡Nibneggi-bukmalad, an-itomalo! ¡Napneggi-bukmalad, an-itomalo! Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Ani an an-mimmigan akwisad, an na odummosad, degi-inigwele, angi gwisgudmalad.
Moli-bebe-nikad-alugwasualed, e-ibed magar daked. Moli-uayasuid, moli-urbed-galu-e-ibedgad magar daked. Degite, Israel-dulemardi, akusunna itomalad, an-dulamardi, aku ibmar dakmalad.
”Dulemar-nue-isgus-bukwamalad, ¡ibitosmar! Dule-nue-isguedgi-bipirmaksa-bukwamalad, ¡ibitosmar! Dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmalad-e-wagan-bukwad, ¡ibitosmar! Dule-gwage-isgus-gudimalad-e-mimmigan-bukwad, ¡ibitosmar!” Ar bemar, ¡Bab-Jehováʼgi bangudmalad! ¡Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaled isdar dakdemalad! ¡Gannar sorsik aibiridmalad!
¿Ibiga amba sabsur-odurdakledii gubimarsunna? ¿Ibiga uayasuli-gudii gubimarsunna? Bela e-nono, ise-nailikguar siid, bela e-gwage nued naisulid.
Bela e-nag-duku-akale, nonosega, e-san-nued wis naisulid, bela oitolesadbi nanaed. E-san, gudure-gudure nanaid. E-yaamar-bukwadi, nunu-yapanne nanaed, ar gwen nugussuli nanaed, morgi-obipirmakar naisurbalid, olivo-gwallugi maglegarsurbalid.
E-yala, nue-bergus naid. E-neggweburmar, bato soogi-ogumakles bubukwad. Emar-sunnagwad na dakmaloed, igi-dule-baigan e-ibmar-digar-nanaid gutemaloe. E-yala, olloo naioed, dule-bamaladse e-yala obelolesadyob naguoed.
Sión-yala, uva-nainugi binsa dukued-neg olloo-siidaedyobi daklenaded. Melón-digar-naidgi, binsa neg-ollobi-siidyobi daklenaded, neggwebur, dule-isdarmaladse ebirilessiidyob gued.
Ar Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad anmar-gwenna-gwenna-odulossulina, Sodoma-dulemaryob anmar gumogoenad, Gomorra-dulemaryob anmar obelolemogoenad.
Sodoma-e-dummagan, Bab-Jehová-ibmar-soged be itomar. Gomorra-neggwebur, anmar-Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maid be itomar.
Bab-Jehová soged: “Be-ibmar-ukleged-bukidaradi, ¿ibi-nuedga anga wis gue? Ar gwen an abemaisulid. Ar sibad-wawaad-machergan-ogumakar-anga-ukleged an budar dakgusad. Ar ibdurgan-wardummagan-e-gwallu-anga-ukleged an budar dakgusad. Moli-bebe-nikad-machergan-e-ablis an abesulid, sibad-wawaadmar-e-ablis an abesulid, sibad-machergan-e-ablis an abesulid, we-ibmarmar, gwen bai an daksulid.
¿Ibiga be an-asabin danimala? ¿Doa bega ibdurgan-sedamaloye sogsa? Unnila anse-goled-neg-imba-oichogega be nonidamalad.
Melle bar be anga ibmar-ukleged-gwen-igarga-gusulid sedamalo. Ar ina-wawadikid anga ibmar-isganaga gued. Nii-binidgi, iba-onoleged an budar dakgusad, obunnoged-ibagi, iba-onoleged an budar dakgusad, dulemar-bular-onmaknonidamalad an budar dakgusad, be-an-nug-odummomalad, aka bur an-ourwe damalad, bar an itobisulid.
Bemar nii-binid-gwisguedgi iba-onogedi, an budar itogusad. Itoakwaa-iba-onolegedi, an budar itogusad. Ibmar-nuedga gwen anga gusulid, abali, an budar itogusad.
Bemar anse-goledgi argan-onakwialile, an bemar-dakosulid, wagar-biir an bemar-idu imakoed. Ar gandikidgi bemar anse gornanaile, an bemar-itogosulid. Ar bemar dulemar-ibe ablis eosmalad.
”¡Isguedgi be bangumar, swilidik be gumar! ¡An-asabin ibmar-isgana-imakedgi be bangumar! ¡Melle bar ibmar-isgana be imakmar!
¡Igar-nuegan-imaked be durdakmar! ¡Igar-napiragwad be imakmar! ¡Dule-mesagwar-imaklediid be bendakmar! ¡Dule-sergan-satedga be igar nabomar! ¡Siamar-ei-sui-burgwismalad-ular, be gwisgumar!”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Be dagmar, anmar igar nudakmargwelo. Bemar-isgued, ginnitibiyob-gue-inigwele, boo-sibudikidyob-dakle naoed. Bemar-isgued, mor-ginnidyob-gue-inigwele, sibad-wawaad-e-absar-dagudikid-daklegedyob naoed.
Ar bemar an-sogedba nanamaloye sogele, be-yargi ibmar-nuegan-sanmakoedi be gunmaloed.
Ar bemar amba an-itosulile, angi be gwisgudmalale, es-suidgi be ogilolemaloed.” Ar Bab-Jehová, e-sunnagwad deyob soged.
Neggwebur-innikigwad, ¿ibiyobi gambanuchusaedga be gusa? Gebe-iduar, igar-napiragwadbi be imakdidaenad. Igar-innikigwadbi begi nai gusanad. Emide, unnila dule-gindakmaladbi begi gudigusmarsunnad.
Gebeunni be maniyob-gumalanad, emidi, durganga-binnideyob be gudnanaed. Vino-nuedyob be gumalanad, emidi, vino dii-sunnabi-goblegeyob be gudnanaed.
Be-dummagan-neg-dakmamaid dulegi-gwisgumaladid. Amarde, dule-ibmar-atursamalad-e-sordamalad. Manigi-dule-binsaed-gaedgi bela na yeer itodamalad, dulemar-ega-ibmar-uked unnila abedamalad, dule-sergan-sated-ular sunmakdasurmalad, siamar-ei-sui-burgwismalad-e-igar gwen bai dakdasurmalad.
A-ulale, Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, weyob soged: “¡Wese ugaksun! An-isdarmaladga an igar nudakoed, an-isdarmalad an buged imakoed.
Gannar an-argan an bemarse oyogoed, bela be-isgued an elioed, degi, bela begi ibmar-isgana-naid an osulogoed.
Bega dule-igar-nabomalad gebe-iduar-bukusadyob an oambikuoed, dule-be-unamalad gebe-iduar-ambikusadyob an oambikuoed. Degisoggu, Neggwebur-Innikigwadye be-nugsamaloed, Neggwebur-Sogedba-Daedye be-nugsamaloed.”
Sión-yala, igar-innikigwadba bela-belad bendaklegoed, dulemar e-isguedga-bukib-binsamalad igar-napiragwadba, bela-belad bendaklegoed.
Degi-inigwele, dule-uayasulidamaladdi, isguedgi-gudimaladdi, obelolegoed. Ar dule-Bab-Jehová-obandimaladdi, oburgwilegoed.
Bemar we-sapimarbina nue-sogdimaladgi bemar nue-bingedar itomaloed, we-dutugalubina be nue-sogdimaladgi bemar nue-undar bingegumaloed.
Bemar, sapi-e-gagan-dinguddaeyob gudmaloed, dutu-digaled dii-sate-gugwichidyob gudmaloed.
Dule-gala-ibedi, gagan-durgan-milegeyob naoed, e-arbaedi, ilagwen-bergus naoed, ebobela soogi-ogalegoed, dule gwen soo oginnosulid.
Amoz-machi-Isaías, Judá-yargi, degi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi neg-guoed-daksad, sogsad:
“Ibagan-bergued-mosale, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-yala bur yala-sunsogedga sii guoed, yala-mulluganba bur nug-dummarba sii guoed, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad bela we-yalase duurmaknonikoed.
Bukidar neggwebur-bamalad nonimaloed, sognonimaloed: ‘Dagmar, anmar Bab-Jehová-yalase nakwenamar, Jacob-e-Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse nakwenamar. Ar Bab-Jehová, e-Igar-Maidgi anmar-odurdakoed, adi, anmar e-igargi nanadii guegar.’ Ar ade, Sión-yalagi Bab-Jehová-igar-maid-odurdakleged nodagoed, Jerusalénʼgi Bab-Jehová-gayaburba ainidagoed.
Bab-Jehová, dulemar-yar-baid-baidsik-bukmaladga igar-nabogoed, neggwebur-bukibgi-nakulegega guoed. Dulemar, e-es-suidmar napa-imuedga obinyemaloed, eswar-swiswidikmalad gagan-sikedga gudoed. Yar-gwensak, yar-baidbo bar na abin-abin urwosurmalad. Bila-onogega bar odurdaklenai guosurmalad.
Jacob-wagan be dagmar, Bab-Jehová-anmar-nidiguega, anmar imakmar.”
Bab-Dummad, be-dulamar be obachad, be Jacob-e-wagan obachad. Ar be-dulamar-yargi, dad-nakwed-dorgan-niisgwagi-nerguarmaladi, bukidar bukwad. Filistea-dulemaryob, yoo-ibmar-guoedgi-sunmakmalad-bukidar nikamalad, Be-dulamar, ar dule-bamaladbo igar mesdamalad.
E-yalagi, mani-sunnabi engus bukwad, olo-sunnabi engus bukwad, e-ibmar-nuegan gege ebisleged. E-yalagine, moli-bukidar nikad, e-moli-ur-bila-onomalad gege ebisleged.
A-ukinbali, e-yala ibmar-bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad-sunnabi engus bukwad, ar dulemar, e-argangi-ibmar-sobsamalad-asabin sindigale, sigdimalad, e-googi-ibmar-obinnismalad-asabin sindigale sigdimalad.
Ar weyob, dulemar, e-asabin sindigar-sigedba na nug-wiodimalad, ar dulemar, e-asabin na nug-bipii imakdimalad. Begi-isgusadi, melle ega be elio.
¡Israel-dulemar! Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-sabsur-oyoged-idu be dukumar, e-gangued-dobesaila-dakleged-idu be dukumar, akwasailagan-ollogan-yaba be dogmar, e-idu be napa-yaba dukumar.
Dule-san-dummarba-imakmalad, sabsur-obingegsalemaloed, dule-san-dummarba-imakmalad, san-bipii imaklemaloed. A-ibagangi, unnila Bab-Jehová-e-nugbi odummolegoed.
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad ibagwengi nonikoed, bela-dulemar-na-san-dummarba-imakmaladgi, dulegi-mesagwar-sunmakmaladgi, gwichigunonikoed, dule-na-san-bule-bule-samaladgi, gwichigunonikoed. A-e-nugmar bipii imaknonikoed.
Bela dulemar Líbano-yalagi-urwar-suigan-gwichiyob-san-imakmaladgi, gwichigunonikoed, bela urwar-matusurmalad-bukwadyob-san-imakmaladgi, gwichigunonikoed. Bela Basán-nebagangi sapi-dummaganyob-san-imakmaladgi, gwichigunonikoed.
Bela dulemar yala-dummagan-matusurmaladyob-san-imakmaladgi, bela yala-mullu-mullugan-nuga-nikamaladyob-san-samaladgi, gwichigunonikoed.
Bela dulemar neg-suigan-bukwadyob-san-imakmaladgi, bela galu-matusur-akwabiidmalad-gandikidba-bukwadyob-san-imakmaladgi, gwichigunonikoed.
Bela dulemar Tarsis-ulu-dummaganyob-san-imakmaladgi, bela ulu-dummagan-yeerdaklemaladyob-san-imakmaladgi, gwichigunonikoed.
Dule-san-dummarba-imakmalad, nug-bipii gudoed, dule-dogdar-obicha-san-imakmalad san-bipii gudoed. A-ibagangi, unnila Bab-Jehová-e-nugbi odummolegoed.
Bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imaklemalad bela-naitinaga obelolegoed.
Bab-Dummad dulemar-sabsur-odurdaksokalile, dulemar Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-sabsur-oyoged-idu, e-gangued-dobesaila-dakleged-idu, akwasailagan-ollogan-yaba ubodmaloed, idu napa-ollogana-yaba dogdemaloed.
A-ibagine, dulemar e-bab-dummagan-nug-odummogega-orgi-sobsamaladi, manigi-sobsamaladi, sapur-nusaga, degi, uksirga midmaloed.
Bab-Dummad dulemar-sabsur-odurdaksokalile, dulemar, Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-sabsur-oyoged-idu, e-gangued-dobesaila-dakleged-idu, dulemar akwasailagan-ollogana-imbaba ubodmaloed, akwasailagan-ollormalad-yaba dogdemaloed.
Degisoggu, melle be dulegi bensuli-gudii guo. Ar duledi, unnila sikwas dula gudiid. E-dula-gudiidi, unnila buu naddaed.
Isaías Jerusalén-dulemarga, degi, Judá-dulemarga sogded: “¡Nue bogi be an itomalo! Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi Jerusalén-neggweburgi, degi, Judá-yargi, bela ibmar-nabir-gullemalad obelogoed: Bela masgullemalad, bela gobedmarse-bakale, obelogoed.
Bab-Jehová, bela we-dulemala, Jerusalén-neggweburgi, degi, Judá-yargi, osulogoed: Bela dule-gandikmalad, bela dule-bila-onomalad, dule-igar-nabomalad, e-gayaburba-barsogmalad, dule-ibmar-guoedgi-iduakwaa-sunmakmalad, girmar-dummagan,
sorda-bila-onomalad-e-idumalad, dule-nug-nikamalad, dule-binsaed-dakmalad, galagwensuli-ibmar-sobmalad, degine, dule-burgwismaladse-gabgin-ibmar-egismalad, wemar, bela obelogoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “An negsemalaga, sapingana urboed. Dule-dummaganga-gumalaga, masmala-ibmar-abes-abesdamalad urboed.
Dulemar na muchub-muchub sabsur-imakdemaloed: Dule e-neg-dikarba-maidbo, na abin-abin nagudmaloed. Sapingwa, dador-sarsodoed. Dule-binsaled, dule-nug-nikadbo na sabsur-imakdemaloed.
”Dule-gwensak e-bab-neggi e-gwenadga sogdagoed: ‘Ar bedi mor-nued-ise-nudakar be yoisoggu, we-neg-gagalenaid nudake, be anmar-dummadga gue.’
Geb e-gwenaddi e-abin sogdagoed: ‘An nersuli. Ar an-neggi mas sated, morbela satebalid. Melle neggwebur-dummadga-guega be an-imake.’ ”
Ar Jerusalén-neggwebur nue-bergus mellesiid, Judá-yar nue-oitoles naid. Ar e-sunmakedi, e-ibmar-imakedi, Bab-Jehováʼgi ise-yolegaled. Amarde, Bab-Dummad-e-gangued-yeerdakleged bai daksulid.
E-ichakwadamaladgi na dukin e-daed barsoged. Sodoma-dulemar-isgusadyobi, e-isguedgi bule-bule-gudiid odukusurmalad. ¡Emar na dummad-wilesmar! Na dukin sabsur-odurdaklegega gunanaid.
Dule-napira-nanadiidga be sogmalo, “bega ibmar nueganbi guoye.” Ar na e-arbadiidgi nue-ibmar nikuoed.
¡Dule-isgana, be nue-wiles! Ar bega ibmar-nuegan guosulid, ar be-arbasadgi na be odurdaklegoed.
Bab-Jehová sogbalid: “¡An-dulamar, be nue-wilesmar! Sapinganse mesagwar-gudimalad, Omegan ega dummadga-negdakmamaid. ¡An-dulamar, be nue-wilesmar! Ar dule-be-idumaladi begi dododimalad, ar igar-isganaba be-nidimalad.”
Bab-Jehová, e-dulemarga-igar-nabogega, gwichigudasokalid. Dulemar-sabsur-odurdakega, gwichigudasokalid.
Bab-Jehová, girmar-dummagangi, degi, dummagan-negsemamaidgi, gwichigudasokalid. Bab-Dummad ega weyob sognonikoed: “Ar bemar uva-nainu-naid bela obelosmalad. Be-negyagi dule-wilemalad-ibe-be-ibmar-atursasmalad bukwad.
¿Doa bega sogsa, an-dulamar mesagwar imakmaloye? ¿Doa bega sogsa, dule-wilesagwar-gudimalad be wiomaloye?”
Bab-Jehová weyob sogbalid: “Omegan-Sión-yalaginmalad san-bule-bule-imakmaladi, emargi-obine-itogedba bule-bule nanamalad. A-omegan dule-mesagwale dakdaed. San-bule-bule-imakedba, e-maligi ibmar-nanaid-ogolegala, yamo nag-bana-bana nadapdamalad, adi, e-ibmar-maligi-naid-goled itomalagar.
A-ulale, ani, omegan-Sión-yalaginmalad-e-nonogi, boni-yaa-dummagan yaisur-nikuega imakoed, an bela amar-nono swana imakoed.”
A-ibagine, Bab-Jehová, we-ibmarmar osulogoed: Maligi-ibmar-nagumalad, bebegi-ibmar-nasiklemalad, morgi-ibmar-nasiklemalad.
Bela dukargi-ibmar-nasiklemalad, sakwagi-ibmar-nasiklemalad, muswe-wagar-odukumalad.
Dunwemar, maligi-ordubyob-ibmar-nasiklemalad, saderba-mordub-atillemalad. Ina-wawagan-nuegan, olargan-matar-dummagan,
olarganmar, olasumar.
Ibagi-mor-yoleged-gargerbamalad, mor-dummagan, mor-suigan, mor-sakwa-metegana.
Isbe-wagar-dakmalad, lino-mor-nued, mor-obipirmakar-nonogi-silemalad, degi, dukarba-biar-mor-nasiklemalad. Bela e-ibe we-ibmarmar osulolegoed.
A-ibagine, ina-wawadikidbi-yapannedi, nunu-yapanne naoed. Saderba-mordub-atillemalad-muchubbi, saderba gasdub nasikdemaloed. Ise-gwialed-muchubbi, sailagia-sate gumaloed. Ibagi-mor-gargerbamalad-yoleged-muchubbi, wilegedba mor-yaara-dakle yodmaloed. Wagar-yeerdakleged-muchubbi, bingedar-dakle itodmaloed.
Be-machergan es-suidgi oburgwiledmaloed. Be-dule-bulegan bila-onolenaidgi oburgwiledmaloed.
Bela dulemar ogormakdemaloed, burgwed-ibagi-mor-yoleged yodmaloed. Neggwebur bela olloo dakle nadoed.
A-ibagangine, omegan-walagugle (7) machered-wargwengi alamakdamaloed, ega sogdamaloed: “Anmar anbo-nikue, ar be an-nikguele, anmar na dukin mas amioed, anmar na dukin mor bakbaloed, unnila anbo-nikubi anmar be-abeged. Adi, anmar melle bingegudii gumalagar.”
A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová, sapi-siklesad gannar ainiega imakoed. We-sapi-gannar-ainioedi, yeerdaklegedga guoed, degi, gandikidba-yeerdaklegedga gubaloed. Ibmar-durbamar-welemaloedi, Israel-dulemar-besmalad-e-nug-odummogega guoed, degi, e-nug-ogannogega gubaloed.
Degine, Sión-yalagi napi-dula-bemaloedi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi napi-dula-bukumaloedi, bilegoed: Dule-islidikidmarye, degi, bela Jerusalénʼgi-gudimalad-e-nug-narmakar-mamaidse-bakar, deyob bilegoed.
Bab-Dummad, sabsur-odurdakleged-igar mesnonikile, degi, geb sabsur-odurdakdele, omegan-Sión-yalaginmalad-e-isgued osulogoed, degi, Jerusalén-dulemar-ablis-eosmalad-e-isgued elioed.
Geb degine, Bab-Jehová, ibgine, Sión-yalagi, dulemar-ambikuoedgi mogir-gudure nasikoed. Mutikdi, ibegwar soo-gwabunye-gwichi imaknonikoed. Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-yeerdaklegedi atued-dummadyob-dakle bela neg-gasa naguoed.
Adi, ibgine, dad-ibeler-uedikgued-idu negsichii-imakedyob naguoed. Dii-wiedgi, degi, burwa-dummad-noedgi ega dukuedga naguoed.
An-ai-nued-nuggi an namakoed, e-uva-nainugi an namakoed. An-ai-nued-e-uva napa-nuedgi digar naigusad.
Na napa nudaksagusad, akwa-murugan obelosgusad. Uva-dub-sailagan-nuegan digsagusad. Nainu-abargine neg-suid sobsagusad, uva-egured-galu sobsagusbalid. Uva-san-nuegan-ega-sanmaked abedii gusanad, aka ega uva-soledbi sanmaksad.
Bab-Jehová soged: “Judá-dulemar, Jerusalén-dulemar, be anga sogmardo. Emide, uva-soledbi-sanmaksadi, ¿wede doagine? ¿Angine? ¿Uva-nainugine?
¿Ar ibu-ibmar an-uva-nainuga an imaksasuli? ¿Ibu-ibmar bar an ega imakosunna? Ar uva-san-nuegan-anga-sanmaked an abesanad. Ar degite, ¿ibiga uva-san-soled sanmaksasunna?
An bega sogmalodo, igi an-uva-nainu an imakoe: An e-ibe galu-emakaled earoed, adi, bela berguegar. An e-galu-matusulid e-ibe earbaloed, adi, bela egi annalegegar.
Bela swanga-nai an imakoed, bar uva-dub diglegosulid, bar nuekwaa emilegosulid. Ikomarbi, degi, gagan-ikobimaladbi ainidagoed, bar mogirmar egi dii-owiega an imakosulid.”
Israel-dulemar Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-e-uva-nainu gued. Judá-machergandi ega uva-yeerdakle-digaledga gued. Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemar ega igar-innikigwad-imaked edarbediinad, emide dakalid, unnila dule-ablis-eodimaladbi gudimala. Bab-Jehová, ega igar-napiragwadba-nanaed edarbediinad, emide dakalid, unnila suli-suli-itogedba binnasuli gormakdimala.
Dulemar emar-idu neg-sobe-sobe-gudimalad, ¡dule-wilesmar! Emar-ibe nainu-sue-sue-gudimalad, ¡be duledar-wilesmar! Dule-bamaladga wis napaneg-ollogwad nasiksulid. Na wargwen we-neggweburgi-gudimaladyob itoged.
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob an-uayagwar anga ibmar-sogsad: “Negamar-bukidara obelolegoed. Neg-dummagangi, neg-yeerdaklegedgi, dule gwen megosulid.
Uva-nainu-dummagan sogapaa naidi, unnila bari-gwagwen wis vino egi amilegoed. Ibmar-gwag galón-gwaambe-diglegoedgi (10), unnila galón-gwagwen wis egi welegoed.”
Dulemar wakudaryalaba-mumguega-gwisguardamaladi, ¡duledar-wilesmar! Mumgusii mutikguddamaladi, ¡be duledar-wilesmar!
Be-iba-onomaladgi vino-bukidar nikadamalad, gar-arpaʼmar ogorleddaed, degi, gar-liraʼmar, damborʼmar, degine, gar-flautaʼmar ogorleddaed. Degi-inigwele, bemar Bab-Jehová-ibmar-imaksadgindi, binsadasurmalad, e-ibmar-saedginbela bar binsadasurbalid.
An-dulamar an-itobisurmalad-ulale, gales seledmaloed. E-dule-nuga-nikamalad mas-gunsulidba burgwidmaloed, dule-bukidar gobsulidba burgwidmaloed.
A-ulale, burgwarmalad-meged-galu-e-yaa sabsur-argas maid. Agine, dule-nuga-nikamalad, e-mumguedgi-yeer-itodimalad, neg-uanse doledmaloed. Dule-binsarmalad, e-isguedgi-wergudimaladba neg-uanse doledmaloed.
Dulemar sabsur-ibitomaloed, emarse ibmarbina-wiledii gudmaloed. Dule-san-dummarba-imakdimalad, binge itodmaloed.
Ar Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi igar-innikigwadba e-nug ogannolegoed, Bab-Dummad-Isligwaled igar-napiragwadba na san-swilidikid oyogoed.
Sibad-wawaad-senigana, e-nainu-sunnadyobi, egi gagan-ara-aramalad-madii gudmaloed. Sibad-omemardi, dule-mani-ibmala-e-neg-ollo-ollo-bukmaladgi gagan-madii gudmaloed.
Dule isguedse-ebipiledimalad, ¡duledar-wilesmarsun! Dule urdubgi-isgued-ebipidimalayob-gudidiid, ¡be dule-wilesmar!
Na sogdimalad: “Bab-Dummad gwae dagye. Gwae ibmar imakdaye, adi, anmar e-ibmar-imakoed dakegarye. Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Isligwaled e-ibmar-imakbied gwae imakdaye, adi, anmar e-ibmar-imakoed wisguegarye.” Deyob-sogdidiid, ¡duledar-wilesmarsun!
Dulemar, igar-isgana igar-nueganga-imakdidiidi, ¡duledar-wilesmar! Dulemar, igar-nuegan igar-isganaga-imakdimaladi, ¡dule-wilesmar! Dulemar, negsichid neg-meegwadga-imakdimaladi, ¡duledar-wilesmar! Neg-meegwaddi, negsichidga-imakdimaladi, ¡dule-wilesmar! Dulemar, ibmar-gagbireged ochigwadga-imakdimaladi, ¡duledar-wilesmar! Dulemar, ibmar-ochigwad gagbiregedga-imakdimaladi, ¡dule-wilesmar!
Dule, binsaed-ibedga na san-sadimaladi, ¡duledar-wilesmar! Dule, nue-ibmar-wisidga na san-imakdimaladi, ¡dule-wilesmar!
Bemar vino-gobedsik-bulegan-gudimaladi, ¡be duledar-wilesmar! Bemar inna-gagbid-sobedsik-bulegan-sogdimaladi, ¡dule-wilesmar!
Bemar dule-baiganse-manigi-baklegar, dule-ibmar-isgana-imaksad-galessiid-onodamaladi, ¡duledar-wilesmar! Bemar dule-ibmar-oakalossulid-obanagwar-imakdimaladi, ¡dule-wilesmar!
A-ulale, igi-soo-ditismaked gagan-ogumakdedae, igi-gagan-dinnagwad soo-abin gummakdedae, deyobi, bemar gummakmaloed. Igi sapi-mali napa-urba-nunguddae, igi e-dutu, ukub-miledeyob-mileddae, deyob bemar berguoed. Ar bemar, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-Maid-e-Igar obatemalad, Israel-e-Bab-Jehová-Isligwaled-e-gayaburba isdar-itodmalad.
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová e-dulemarse sabsur-urwed, a-ulale, sabsur-odurdaked, yalagan ese giglimaked. Muigan, durgan-milegeyob, galimbaba omileded. Deyob-imaksa-inigwele, Bab-Jehová, amba sae-itomaid, amba dulemar-sabsur-odurdakmaid.
Bab-Jehováʼdi, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-dikasur-bukwadse-golegala, bander onakoed. Bela yar-naidgi-bukwamaladse wigooed, we-dulemar gwae-gwae abarmakar-abarmakar nonimaloed.
We-dulemar, dutusurmalad, gwen yeguosurmalad. Unnila, guagwar gudii gumaloed, gwen gabbie itogosurmalad. E-musirba-mor-atinnaimalad gwen ei achikosulid. Nag-uka-e-dubmar e-ibe gwen itirosurbalid.
E-sigumar ise-swiswidikidbioed, e-warsimar bela gachii ganikidbimaloed. E-molimar-e-sapat akwayobi dutusulidbioed, e-moli-ur-bila-onomalad-e-yandamar burwa-bipirmakaledyobi guoed.
Sorda-bila-onomalad-e-goledi, achumigur-nono-wawaadyob goledbioed. Achumigur-nono-wawaad-e-mimmigan-uurmakeyobmaloed, e-nugar ogotemaloed. Dule ese-galesale, dule gwen egi suosulid.
A-ibagangine, we-dulemar Israel-dulemargi demar-dummad-arwemaiyobi gwichigunonikoed. Dule, Israel-yar-naid-dakalile, bela negsichidbi-nai dakdagoed, dad-ibeler-idu mogir-sichid nai guoed.
Rey-Uzías-burgwisad-birgagine, ani Isaías, Bab-Dummad ologana-biriginedgi-sii an daksad. E-mola-duku ese-goled-neggi bela batenai an daksad.
E-birgine, dule-nibnegginmalad-Serafínʼye-nugmalad gukunanai an daksad. A-dulemar sakan-nergwa (6) nikamaladbiid: Sakan-warbogwadgi e-wagar odukunanaid, sakan-warbogwad-baidgine, e-malimar odukunanaibalid, degine, sakan-warbogwad-baidgindi, gukunanaid.
Muchub-muchubbi, binnasuli sognanaid: “Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, Bab-Jehová-Isligwaledid, Isligwaledid, Isligwaledid. Bela napneggi e-gangued-yeerdaklegedi neg-gasa naid.”
Serafínʼmar-binnasur-gornanaidbali, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-yawagak-bargamalad e-sailamarse-bakale, giglimakded, geb Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg bela waa daasa sigisad.
Geb an binnasuli goted: “¡An duledar-wiles! ¡An bergussun! Ar ande ibmar-isganabi-sogdiid-duled, dulemar-ibmar-isganabi-sogdimalad-abargi an gudiid. Emide, an Rey-daksad, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad an daksad.”
Degidgine, Serafín-gwensak ansik gukualid. Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi soo-gasiidgi soo-weed-esgorogi sogun-ara-arad-wesadi sedanikid.
Geb a-sogungine, an-gakuli ebunonikid, agi anga sogded: “Be dake, we-sogun-ara-arad be-gakuli-ebusadi, bega isgued elinonisunnad. Bab-Dummadgi be isgudiidi, emide isgussulidyobi be daklenadsunnad.”
Geb degidgine, Bab-Jehová-e-sunmaked an itosad. Weyob soge an itosad: —¿An doa-dule barmidoe? ¿Doa anmar-anar naoe? Geb abin an sogded: —Ani be an-barmide, ani an naoe.
Geb Bab-Jehová anga sogded: —Be nae, we-dulemarga be sogna: ” ‘Be ibmar nue-itomalo-inigwele, akusunna be itomaloed. Be ibmar nue-dakmalo-inigwele, akusunna be dakmaloed.’
We-dulemar-e-gwage dutusuli be imako, akusunna ibmar-itogega be imako, akusunna ibmar-dakega be imako. Degisulile, e-ibyagwale ibmar-dakdoed, e-uayagwale ibmar-itodoed, degi, e-gwagegi magar-ibmar-itodoed, e-isguedga bukib binsadmaloed. Degidbali, nudake an dakledagoed.”
Geb an ese egichided: —Bab-Jehová, ¿sanagwadse an be-nuggi sunmakdii gusunnoe? Bab-Jehová anga sogded: —Bela neggweburmar-obelolegedse be an-nuggi sunmakdii guoed. Bela negmar-ollo-ollo-ambikuedse be angi sunmakdii guoed. Dulemar a-neggweburmargi-bar-gudii-guosulidse be an-nuggi sunmakdii guoed. Nainumarbela-swiri-naguedse be angi sunmakdii guoed.
An bela-dulemar-e-yalagi dikasuli ononnogoedse be angi sunmakdii guoed. Bela e-yala-olloo-naguedse be an-nuggi sunmakdii guoed.
Ar dulemar e-dulataledgi (100) amba e-ambe (10) besale, bela amba amar berguoed. Ar sapi-emisgwa-siklesad-e-sailabi gannaa-siidaedyobi wis bemaloed. Geb we-dulemar-bemaloedi neggwebur-islidikidga guoed.
Deunni, Rey-Acaz Judá-yargi negsemaid. Acazʼde Jotam-e-machid, degi, Uzías-e-wagwabalid. A-we-reymar-warbogwad Jerusalén-neggwebur sussurgusmalad.
Weyob Rey-David-negga-gusadse gayaburba nonikid: Siria-dulemar Efraín-dulemarbo atosmarye. Degi, Rey-Acaz nue-dobe itonaded. E-neggweburginmalad bela dobedba wawanmakdemalad. Igi-sapimar burwaba banamakgwisdae, ayobi wawanmakdemalad.
Geb degi, Bab-Jehová Isaíasʼga sogded: “Be-machi-Sear-Jasubʼbo, Acaz-abinguega be nae. Bia dii-gammu-maid dii-wilad-dummad-siid-akar dii-sedanidae, a-bergunaid-nagaba be abinguoed. We-dii-gammude, mor-odidued-neg-igar-nalemaidsik maid.
Acazʼga be sogo: ” ‘¡Nue salakalo! ¡Melle be dobguo! Siria-rey-Rezín-sabsur-urwed-abin, melle be gwayo. Remalías-machi-Peka-abin, melle be gwayebalo. We-dulemar-warbogwad-abin melle be gwage-nunmak-itogo. We-reymar-warbogwad unnila, igi soogi-waa-ainakwialir yog berguar-naddae, ayobi gumalad.’
”Acazʼga be sogbalo: ‘Efraín-dulemar Remalías-machi-Pekaʼmala, Siria-dulemarbo, bemar-wiogega na atosmalad.
Ar ade, sogsamalad: Anmar Judá-yalagi gwisgunae, anmar e-dulemar ogwayenae, anmar we-yala e-ibe suoed, geb anmar agi Tabeel-machi reyga omesoed.’
”A-ukinbali, Acazʼga be sogbalo: ‘Ani Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob sogbarye: We-ibmar-deyob-sogmaladi, bipisaale guosurye.
Ar Damasco-neggweburbi Siria-yala-e-nonoga wis siid, ar Rezínʼye-nugadi Damasco-neggwebur-e-reyga wis maid. Birga-dulapaa-gakatarsega (65), Efraín-yala berguoed, bar neggweburga sii guosulid.
Samaria-neggweburbi Efraín-yala-e-nonoga wis-simogad, Remalías-machidi, Samaria-neggwebur-e-reyga wis-maimogad. Ar bemar angi benmalale, bemar wegi ambikuosurmalad.’ ”
Bab-Jehová, Acazʼga sogdebalid:
—An be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-gued. Anse wilubga-guega ibmar-gegerdakleged-imaked be egise. Sunna bega ibmar-gegerdakleged nibneg-birigi imakodibe, bela-bela napa-uluse imakodibe.
Acaz abin-sogded: —Bab-Jehová, an be-wilubdakosulid. An bese bipisaale ibmar egisosulid.
Geb degi, Isaías sogded: “Emisgine, bemar, David-wagan, nue be an-itomalo. ¿Ar be dulemar-ourwed nubin be itosursi? Ar emide be, deyob an-Bab-Dummad-ourwebimarmogad.
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová-sunnagwad ibmar-guoed-e-wilub oyogoed: Yagwa-wargwen gurgin-nika guoed, degi, goe nikunonikoed. Emanuelʼye onugsaoed.
Goe achanisbi madii guoed, moli-nunis-ollikwagwadbi madii gubaloed. Mag-neg-itogusadse we-ibmarmar indakoed.
Ar mimmi-mag-neg-itoged-iduale, igid ibmar-nuedi, igid-ibmar-ichakwabali, reymar-warbogwad-ese-be-gwayediidi, e-yalamar bela ibitomaloed.”
Isaías, Acazʼga sogbalid: “Bab-Jehová, Judá-yargine Asiria-e-rey barmidagoed. Begine, be-dulemargine, degi, be-wagangine, ibagan-bulegan barmidagoed. Efraín-yala, Judá-yalagi-bangusad-akale, a-ibmarmar-gwen-dakledsulidi, begi barmidagoed.”
A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová, Egipto-sorda-diwar-dukuba-dikasur-bukmaladse wigooed. Amala gukurmaryobi bemarse barmidagoed. Degi, Asiria-yalagi-bukmaladse wigobaloed. Bemarse burmaryobi barmidagoed.
Amar bela nonimaloed, ibe-dummagan-imbaganba ambikunonimaloed, akwasaila-ollogana-yaba ubononimaloed, gagan-moodo-ikoyaisur-naidgi bukunonimaloed, molimar-dii-gobmalad-nagaba ambikunonimaloed.
A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová, Asiria-e-reyga Éufrates-diwar-obakar-Israel-dulemar-bukmalad-sabsur-odurdakega urmakoed. Bela e-sailagia swanga imaklegoed, bela e-sigamala, ei immilegoed, alu-sigase-bakale ei immilegoed. Bela-bela-wilemalaga imaklegoed.
A-ibagangine, dule-wargwen moli-bebe-nikad-bunolo-wargwen wis akwedii guoed, sibad-ome-warbo wis akwedii gubaloed.
We-ibmar-durgan ega nunis-bukidar nika guoed, e-nunis-ollikwagwad-madii guoed. Dule-we-yargi-bemaloedi, unnitiba moli-nunis-ollikwagwad achanisba madii gumaloed.
A-ibaganginbali, uva-nainugi uva-miligwen-digar-naigusadi (1,000), mani-sibu-miligwen-gargegus-gusadi, emidi ikomar-nainuga guoed, degi, gagan-ikobimalad-nainuga guoed.
Bela yala iko-sunnabi naguoed. A-sapurgi, warsibi-annika nanadii gumaloed, sigubi-annika nanadii gumaloed.
Gebe-iduale, a-yala-mullugangi memed-weregedgi ibmar-nabir digledaenad. Emisgindi, ikomar-dobedba, gagan-ikomar-dobedba, bar dule ese warmakosulid. Unnila, we-gaganmar, moli-bebe-nikad-e-masga, sibad-wawaadmar-e-masga guoed.
Bab-Jehová anga sogsad: “Urgo-matar-dummad be sue, agine be nug-narmako, nuekwaa magar-daklege be narmako. ‘Maher-Salal-Hasbazʼye be narmako.’
Degine, dule-irwa-anse-goled-Urías, degi, Jeberequías-machi-Zacarías, be-barsoged-innikigwadga-gumalaga an bega amioed.”
Geb agine, an Bab-gayaburba-barsoged-bundorse an gochad, geb gurgin-nika gunonikid, geb susugwa ega uklenonikid. Geb degi, Bab-Jehová anga sogded: “Maher-Salal-Hasbazʼye be onugsae.
Ar mimmi nanaye-gordagoed-iduale, babaye-gordagoed-iduale, bela Damasco-neggwebur-e-ibmar-nuegan-nikadi Asiria-e-reyse sulegoed. Degi, Samaria-neggwebur-ibe ibmar-nuegan seledbaloed.”
Bab-Jehová gannar anga sogdebalid:
“We-Judá-neggwebur, Siloé-dii-binnalee-aryomaidgi bangudmalad, bur Rezín-dobee nanadmalad, bur Remalías-machi-dobee gudmalad.
A-ulale, Bab-Dummadi, we-dulemargi Éufrates-diwala-dummad onosokalid: Ar Asiria-e-rey, bela e-garganguedba, Judá-yalagi-yolegega barmidagoed. Bela e-diangan-mamaid odogoed, bela e-dii-gakamar akudaklege imakoed.
Judá-yalase, bela swada-dogoed, dii dukarba-engus naguoed. ¡Emanuel! Be-yala-naidgi, Asiria-sordamar dognonikoed. We-Asiria-rey sulubagi-sakan-nalla-napase-aidedanidaedyobi, begi dognonikoed.”
Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad, bela-yar-baid-baidgi-dikasur-bukmalad, we-ibmar-an-sogoedi nue be itomalo: Aisaar bemar bila-onodamaloenad, degi-inigwele, be bergumaloed. Aisaar be guagwar bila-onoged-iduar bukumaloenad, degi-inigwele, bemar girgumaloed. Aisaar be guagwar bila-onoged-iduar bukumaloenad, Degi-inigwele, bemar nue-ibitomaloed.
Be igarmar-amimalo-inigwele, bega igarga guosurmalad. Aisaar be ibmargi sunmakmalo-inigwele, bega igarga guosurmalad. Ar ade, Bab-Dummad anmarba gudiid.
Bab-Jehová weyobi anga sabsur ibmar sogsad, iduakwaa anga sogsad, melle we-dulemar-daedba be nanaoye. Weyob anga sogsad:
“Melle bemar we-dulemar-sogedyob be sogmalo, we angi gwisgunaye. Ar bela ibmarmar-guedi, egi gwisgunaiye sogdamalad. Melle be we-dulemar-ibmar-dobedi, dobgumalo, melle be gwayebalo.
Unnila be ani Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadbi dobguo, bur be anga islidik nanamalo. Unnila an-nugbi be odummomalo, unnila anbi be dobgumalo.
Ani an bemar-neg-islidikidga guoed. Degi-inigwele, Israel-dulemar-sogabogwadga akwasailaga an guoed, adi, agi goo-warmakmalagar. A-akwa-dummad, dule-omukuedga guoed. Jerusalén-dulemar-idu sakinaiyobi an naguoed, amar-idu galu-ibmar-gaed-siidyob an guoed.
Bukidar goo-warmakmaloed, bukidar aimukumaloed, bukidar wilemaloed. Sakigi-galesayobi, ibmar-gaed-galugi-galesayobi, gales nagumaloed.”
Geb degi, Isaías, eba-nanaimaladga sogded: “An bemarga ibmar-sogsamaladi, gwagegi be sedii imakmalo. An be-odurdaksamalad, melle be sogmalo.
”Ar Bab-Jehová, urwedba Jacob-wagan-idu wagar-aibiris sigisad. Bab-Jehováʼgi an benguosulid, ar an wisid, an egi bendaklegoe.”
Be an-dakmalana, emisgindi wegi an Bab-Jehová-anga-mimmigan-uksadmala an gudiid. Anmar, Israel-yargi, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-Sión-yalagi-maidga ibmar-guoed-e-wilubga gumalad, iduakwaa-ibagan-guoed-sogedga anmar ega gumalad.
Dule bemarga sokarmalale: “Dule-ibmar-e-burbagan-wismaladse be ibmar-wilubagan egisnamarye, yoedse-ibmar-guoed-barsogmaladse be ibmar-wilubagan egisnamarye.” Weyob be sogo: “¿Ar dulemar e-bab-dummaganse geg idakmarsogeye? ¿Ar dulemar dule-burgwarmaladse geg idakmarsogeye?”
An bemarga sogdo: “Bab-Dummad-Igar-Mesisadgi bur be nanamalo, e-ibmar-sogsadgi bur be binsamalo.” Ar dule, we-igarmargi-nanasulile, igar-napiragwad amiosulid.
Bemar, napneggi suli-suli-itoarmalale, ukudmaada-itoarmalale, be uludamaloed. Niba atakgwichi, be-reygi be gwisgudmaloed, Bab-Dummadgi be ukabsaar sunmakdemaloed.
Be napneg-dakdagogua, unnila boniganbi-nai be dakdemaloed, negsichidbi-nai be dakdemaloed. Bemar negasichidginbi-gudii gumaloed.
We-ibmarmar-guoed-sorbali, dule-suli-suli-itodigusadga bar negsichid naguosulid. Epennegwa, Bab-Dummad, Zabulón-dulemar-yala sabsur-odurdaksa gusad, Neftalí-dulemar-yala sabsur-odurdaksa gusbalid. We-yarmar Galilea-yargi bukwamalad. Yoedsega, Galilea-yargi nued binsanonikoed, e-nug-dummarbaa imakoed. Galilea-yala, Jordán-diwarsik, degi, demarse-nalemaidsik naid. A-yalagi, dule-Bab-wissurmalad bukwad.
Dulemar-negsichidgi-gudigusmaladi, neg-meegwad daksamalad. Negsichidgi-bukwagusmaladga, neg mee gunonikid.
Bab-Jehová, bee be, dulemar-omelosad, bee be, bela-bela-weligwar-itogega imaksad. Igi dule ibmar-gwag-weenaile, weligwar itodae, deyobi, be-asabinni weligwale na itomaloed. Igi dule ibmar-nuegan-miminaile, weligwar itodae, deyobi, be-asabinni weligwale na itomaloed.
Bee be, dulemar-wilebukwagusad ollor-imaksad, sabsur-imaklebukwadgi be bendaksad, mesagwar-imaklebukwadgi be ollor-imaksad. Ar igi be, Madián-dulemar-obelosgusa, deyobi, be e-isdarmalad imaksad.
Bila-onolegedgi-sapat-yolesmaladi, degi, bela mor-ablisbi-gusmaladi, soo-yagi ogumaklegoed, sooga bela binyoed.
Ar susugwa-gwensak anmarga gwalulesad, mimmi-gwensak anmarga uklesad. A-machi gandikidba negseoed, weyob nugguoed: Binsaed-Daked-Wilub-Obichadye, Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadye, Bab-Degisadeguadye, Neg-Bogidikid-E-Dummadye, nugguoed.
E-gangued bela nasguoed, e-neg-bogidik-seoed bela nasguoed, gwen berguosulid. David-ologangi dummadga sigoed. E-yalagi dummadga negseoed. E-negseoedi, igar-napiragwadba yar-seoed, innikigwadba negseoed, emi-ibase, degisadegu negseoed. Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad we-ibmar-imakoedi, e-sabgued-oyomaidba, deyob imakoed.
Isaías, Israel-dulemarga sogdebalid: “Bab-Jehová Jacob-waganse e-gayaburba barmialid, Israel-dulemarse e-gayaburba nonikid.
We-ibmar bela dulemar wisgumaloed, Efraín-dulemar bela wisgumaloed, Samaria-dulemar bela wisgumaloed. Ar we-dulemar-san-dummarba-imakdimalad, yeer-sogdimalad, weyob sogdimalad:
‘Ar negmar ayarele, akarsulid. Ar anmar gannar akwagi-nuesaar sobmaloed. Ar higuera-sapiwar-nagubirga-mamaid babatidele, baisulid. Ar anmar a-muchub urwar mesoed.’
”Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová, Rezín-sordamargi e-isdarmalad barmidagoed Bab-Dummad e-sunnad Rezín-sordamargi e-isdarmalad-gwisguega imakoed.
Siria-dulemar dad-nakwedsik-bukwadi, degi, Filistea-dulemar dad-argwanedsik-bukwadi, ilagwen-obeloga Israel-dulemar-imaksamalad. ”Weyob-gus-inigwele, Bab-Dummad-urwedi amba bogigumaisulid. Amba Israel-dulemargi urwemaid.
”Degi-inigwele, dulemar Bab-Dummad-sabsur-e-odurdaksad amba aku daksamalad. Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad e-bendakega gwen amissurmalad.
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová, ibagwen-nuedi Israel-dulemar-obelogoed. Ibmar-dula-e-nono-egwanneyobi imakoed, ibmar-dula-e-bunnu-immieyobi imakoed. Sapi-ana-sikeyobi imakoed, sapi-e-war-immieyobi imakoed.
Ar ibmar-dula-e-nono, girmar-dummagan-e-wilubganad, dule-nuga-nikamalad-e-wilubganad. Ibmar-dula-e-bunnu, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad-gakansaar-odurdakmaladid.
We-neggwebur-idumaladi, igar-noaledba dulemar-sesmalad. Dule-eba-selesmaladi, aku neg-itodmalad, yoggudmalad.
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová, sapingan-gwen-yeer dakosulid, dule-sergan-satemalad-gwen-yeer dakosulid. Siamar-ei-sui-burgwismalad-gwen-yeer dakosulid. Ar bela wemala, isgumaladbiid, ibmar-isgana-imakmaladbiid, galagwensuli sunmakmaladbiid. ”Weyob dulemar imakles-inigwele, Bab-Dummad-urwedi amba bogigumaisulid. Amba anmargi urwemaid.
”Ibmar-isgana sooyobi gued. Igi-soo-gadele, gagan-ikobiid bela biin-imake, ikomar bela biin-imake, deyobi, ibmar-isgana-imaklegedi gued. Igi soo-gaedi sapurgi sapi-bukwadi bela obeloge, degi, geb burwa-bipirmakaledyob, waa ainakwiddae, deyobi, ibmar-isgana-imakedi gued.
Ar Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-urwedbali yala duu gadoed. Dulemar e-sapanga guoed. Dulemar na e-gwenadgan wiledakosulid.
Gwen-gwen, mas-satedba e-argan-nuedsik ibmar-bukwad gutemaloed. Degi-inigwele, amba ukudmaada itomaloed. Baigana, e-argan-sapiledsik ibmar-bukwad gutemarbaloed. Degi-inigwele, amba immelegosurmarbalid. Dulemar e-mimmigangi aibitemaloed, e-mimmigan-gutemaloed.
Manasés, sabsur-Efraín-imakoed, Efraín, sabsur-Manasés-imakmogoed. Geb ebobela Judá-yalagi sabsur-gwichigudmaloed. ”Weyob dulemar imakles-inigwele, Bab-Dummad-urwedi amba bogigumaisulid. Amba anmargi urwemaid.”
Dule, igar-isgana-omesmalad, be duledar-wilesmar. Dule, dulemar-idu igar-yeer-gangu-omesmalad, be duledar-wilesmar.
Bemar, dule-wilemalad-ibmar-nikuega be imaksurmalad, an-dula-wilesagwa-gudimaladga be igar nudaksurmalad. Siamar-ei-sui-burgwisadi, be wiodimalad, dule-sergan-sated-ibe be ibmar atursadimalad.
Bemar sabsur-odurdaklealile, ¿bemar igi imakoe? Boni-dummad bannaba-nosa begi-dani be dakalile, be-bendakega, ¿doase be goloe? ¿Bia be-ibmar-nuegan be odukumaloe?
Ar be bar oakalogosurmalad. Ar bemar gales seledmaloed. Emar-gales-bukwad-abargi be mesagwar gumarmogoed. Sulile, burgwarmalad-imbagi be oburgwilemarmogoed. Weyob bemar imaklego-inigwele, Bab-Dummad-urwedi, amba bogigumaiosulid, Bab-Dummad amba amargi urwemaioed.
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “An bela-bela sae-itoged, Asiria-e-Rey anga sabsur-odurdaked-suaryobi guoed. A-suargine, an sabsur-dulemar-odurdakoed. An isdar-itogedbali, a-suar an ebugoed.
Yala-nue-isgus-naidse an barmidoed, dulemar an-ourwega-imakbukwadse an barmidoed, adi, ibmar ei atursanaega, e-ibmar ei bela weenaegar. Igi-dule dii-dii napa-imake, deyob-emar-imaklegega an barmidoed.
Ar Asiria-e-reydi deyob-imakodeeye gwen binsassulid, deyob-imakedgi gwen binsassulid. Unnila dulemar-obelogedginbi binsaed, unnila bukidar yar-baigan-osulogedginbi binsaed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Ar ade, Asiria-e-rey weyob soged: ‘¿Ar reymarde anga dummaganga-arbabukwadbisursi?
¿Ar Calno-neggwebur, Carquemis-neggweburyob gussursi? ¿Hamat-neggwebur, Arfad-neggweburyob gussursi? ¿Ar Samaria-neggwebur, Damasco-neggweburyob gusmosursi?
An ibmar-bab-dummadyob-imakleged-yalamar obelos gusad. A-yalamar, Jerusalén-neggweburba, degi, Samaria-neggweburba, bur bule melu ibmar-bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad nikagusana, degite, an obelosad.
An igi Samaria-neggwebur-imaksa, degi, igi e-ibmar-bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladse-bakale, an obelosa, deyob an Jerusalén-neggwebur imakoed. E-ibmar-bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladse-bakale, an obelomogoed.’ ”
Bab-Jehová, Sión-yalagi-ibmar-imakoed bela-obelosale, degi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi-ibmar-imakoed bela-obelosale, sogdagoed: “Asiria-e-rey-san-dummarba-itogedba an sabsur-odurdakoed, emar-saedakedba an sabsur-odurdakoed.”
Ar ade, Asiria-e-rey weyob soged: “We-ibmar an-ganguedba an imaksad, an-binsaed-nikaa-daedba an imaksad, ar ande, nue-ibmar-wisid-duled. Ani an neggweburmar-e-abingunanaid ogwasad, ani an e-ibe ibmar-nuegan atursasad, ani an sorda-bila-onoged-buled-guedsoggu, an e-reymar-obelosad.
E-yalamar bela e-ibe an susad. Igi dule sikwi-e-akwa-bukwad weedae, deyobi, an e-ibe e-yalamar susad. Igi dule sikwi-uu sudae, deyobi, dule-e-ibmar-nuegan-nikad an susad. An-abinni, dule-wargwensaale gochasulid, dule gwen akar sogsasulid.”
Isaías weyob soged: “¿Ar akande sunna dule-e-ebunaidba bur san-gannarbaa na imaksi? ¿Ar sunna esnali-sapisikedde dule-e-ebunaidba bur bule-bule na san-imaksi? ¿Gaapoledde, dule-e-ganikidgi obinosi? ¿E-nabiedba naosi? ¿Bia be daksa, suar-garagwadi, sapiwar-dummad-nakwaa imake? Deyob be dakdisulid.
”A-ulale, Bab-Jehová, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, Asiria-e-rey-sorda-bila-onomalad-bulegangi boni-dummad barmidagoed. Amar-e-nug-odummoleged-muchubbi, uelleged-dummad ega ukoed, uellegedi sooyobi uegu egi nasikoed.
Bab-Dummad-wargwenna-guedi, Israel-dulemarga-neg-meegwadyobi-guedi, soo-gaeyobi gudoed. Bab-Jehová-Isligwaled soo-gwichigumaidyob gudoed. Ibagwen-nuedi, Asiria-sordamar-obelogoed, ikomaryobi, gagan-ikomaryobi, soogi bela obelogoed.
Bab-Dummad, bela Asiria-e-sapur-yeerdakle-nanaidi, e-nainu-nanaidi, obelogoed. Dule-geg-bar-gugus-gegumaiyobi bela ibmar nasikoed.
Sapur-naidgi sapimar napi-ichee ambikuoed. Ichegwadbali, burwigana sunna ebisge guoed.”
A-ibagangine, Israel-dulemar-napi-bemaloedi, Jacob-wagan-napi-gudimaloedi, dule-e-obelosmaladba bar naguosurmalad. We-napi-bemaloedi, Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Isligwaledba, nue innikigwadba nagumaloed.
Israel-dulemar-napi-bemaloedi, gannar Bab-Dummadba nagudmaloed, Jacob-wagan-dula-napi-gudimaloedi, Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadba gannar nagudmaloed.
Israel-dulemar, bemar ukub-demar-gakaba-mergueyob-guen-inigwele, unnila bemar napi-ichee gannar nonimaloed. Israel-dulemar-obelolegoye bato soglesmaid. Bela ega igar nabolegoed.
Ar Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, Israel-dulemar-obelolegoye bato sogsad. Ar deyob yargi-gudimaladgi imakoed.
A-ulale, Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nika-Maid weyob soged: “An-dulamar, be Sión-yalagi-bukwamalad, melle be Asiria-dulemar dobee itomalo. Asiria-sordamar gaapoledgi be-sarsomalo-inigwele, begi suar-oyodamalo-inigwele, melle dobgumalo. Igi-Egipto-dulemar bemar-imaksagusa, deyob bemar-imakdago-inigwele, melle be dobgumalo.
Emisgwasaale, bemargi an-nue-sae-itogedi berguoed. An-urwedi, be-isdarmaladgi yoledoed.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, Asiria-dulemar-sabsur-odurdakoed. Bab-Jehová, igi-akwasaila-Orebʼye-nugadgi Madián-dulemar-imaksagusa, deyob Asiria-dulemar-imakoed. Bab-Dummad, igi-Egipto-dulemar-igarba-nadapgu e-gaapoled-oyosgu, egi demar-arwega-imaksagusa, deyob Asiria-dulemar-sabsur-imakoed.
A-ibagangine, bemar we-boniganba-galitodiidi bela bega berguoed, bemar gangudoedba, sabsur-wilediidgi be ollorgudmaloed.
Be-isdarmalad-Asiria-sordamar Ajatʼye-neg-nugadgingus naid, Migrónʼye-neg-nugadgi nadapid, Micmasʼye-neg-nugadgi e-ibmarmar obesad.
Diwar-dinnagwadgi obakmamaid, degi weyob sogmalad: “Gebaʼye-neg-nugadgi anmar obunnomaloye.” Ramá-dulemar dobedba wawanmakdemalad, Saúl-neggwebur-Gabaaʼginmalad duurmakdemalad.
¡Omegan-Galim-neggweburginmalad binnasur be oimakmala! ¡Omegan-Lais-neggweburginmalad be itomala! ¡Anatot-neggwebur be abinsamarmoga!
Madmena-dulemar wakitemalad, Gebim-dulemar dukudmalad.
Emi-ibagi, Asiria-sordamar Nobʼye-neg-nugadse ambikunonimaloed. Sión-yalagi gwichiguega, guagwar ambikumaloed. Siónʼde, Jerusalén-e-yalad.
¡Nue be dake! Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-abin, sapi-anagan doos-doos naded. Sapi-suigan bibichis nanaed, sapi-dummagan e-abin ailade nanaed.
Sapi-moodo-naidi, akangi immided, Líbano-yargi sapimar-yeerdakle-bukwad bela berguded.
Sapi-siklesad-gannar-ainieyobi, dule-Isaíʼye-nugadgi dule-gwensak nodagoed. E-wagangine, a-dule danikoed.
A-dulegi Bab-Jehová-E-Burba megoed: Nue-binsaed-nikagued ega ukoed, nue-ibmar-magar-itoged ega ukoed, binsaed-nued-uke imakoed, degi, gangued-nika imakoed, gurgin-nikarba imakoed, degi, Bab-Jehová-dobee-nanadii imakoed.
We-dule, Bab-Jehová-dobee-nanaoedba yeer-itodii guoed, dulemar-daklegedba dulemarga igar nabogosulid, dulemar-ibmar-sogedba igar nudakosulid.
Dule-wilemaladga igar-napiragwadba igar nabogoed, degi, igar-innikigwadba dule-belagwadaedga igar nudakoed. E-sunmakedba dule-bukwad-obelogoed, e-ibmar-sogedba dule-isgana-oburgoed.
Igar-napiragwadi, molidub-saderba-naiyobi, oyodii guoed. Innikidaedi, e-musir-edinnedyobi, oyodii guoed.
Achu-burburud, sibad-wawaad-senigwad-ebo gudii guoed. Achu-barbad, sibad-bipi-ebo dodomai guoed. Moli-bebe-nikad-sapingwagwad, achumigur-nono-wawaad-bipigwadmala garmakdii gumaloed. Machi-bipigwa a-ibmar-durgan-idudii guoed.
Moli-bebe-nikad-ome, wiob-omemala garmadii guoed, e-mimmigana bulakwaa gudii gumogoed. Achumigur-nono-wawaad, moli-bebe-nikad-alugwasualedyob gagan-madii gumogoed.
Goe-susugwa-amba yoo-mam-iargued, naibe-buled-galu-dikarba dodonai guoed. Mimmi-gebe-mam-iargusadi, naibe-nued-e-yaa-yaba e-argan ododii guoed.
An-Yala-Islidikid-Naidgi gwen dulemar neg-oichodii guosurmalad, gwen oakalogosurmalad, ar ade, bela yar-naidgi, Bab-Jehová-magar-dake nanadii gumaloed. Muu-billi-dii-bela-engus-naiyobi, bela Bab-Dummad-magar-dake gumaloed.
A-ibagangine, Isaí-e-wagangi-dule-danikoedi, dulemar-iduedga guoed. Bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad ese duurmaknonimaloed. E-neg-megoedi gandikidba-yeerdaklege guoed.
A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová bela e-dulamar-amba-yar-baid-baidgi-mimiles-bubukwad gannar-sedagega imakoed. We-yarmargi mimiles bubukwad: Asiria-yalagi, Egipto-yalagi, Patros-yalagi, Cus-yalagi, Elam-yalagi, Sinar-yalagi, degi, Hamat-yalagi, degine, demar-gakagi-besmalad. Wemar gannar senonikoed.
We-dule-danikoedi, dule-ebiega bandergwichiyobi guoed, bela-dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad ese duurmaknonimaloed. Deginbali, bela Israel-dulemar, degi, Judá-dulemar, galesadba-akar-akar-aisakis-bukwamalad gannarse danakwaa urboed.
Efraín-dulemar nobed surgudoed, Judá-dulemar-e-isdarmalad bela obelolegoed. Efraín-dulemar, Judá-dulemargi bar nobguosulid, Judá-dulemarmoga Efraín-dulemar-mesagwar bar imakosurmogad.
Aka, emar ebogwa, Filistea-dulemargi dad-argwanedsik-bukmaladgi gwisgudmaloed. Emar ebogwa, dulemar-dad-nakwedsik-bukmalad-ibe ibmar atursadmaloed. Edom-dulemar, Moab-dulemar, degi, Amón-wagan, amarse sabsur-wilemarmogoed. Amar-sogedba ibmar imakmaloed.
Bab-Jehová, Egipto-demar-sukun-naid bela dinna nasikoed. Éufrates-diwargi e-argan oyogoed, egi burwa-uereged barmidagoed, geb we-diwargi dian-sogagugle (7) mesoed, adi, nabir nagab obakmalagar.
Igi-Israel-dulemar Egipto-yargi-nosmargu, ega nanaed-igar maigusa, deyobi, Israel-dulemar-Asiria-yargi-napi-besmaladga nanaed-igar mai gumogoed.
A-ibagangine, weyob be sogdoed: “Bab-Jehová, be anse ulus-inigwele, an bega namakoed. Be-urwediid bergunonikid, be an-gwage baisur-itogega imaknonikid.
Bab-Dummad, an-abonogedid. An egi benguosulid, an dobee itogosulid. Bab-Jehová, be an-ogannogedid, Bab-Jehová, anga namakedga gued, be an-abonogedga gued.”
Deginbali, bemar abonolegedgi weligwar itomaloed, bela-bela be Bab-Dummad-e-abonolegedgi yeer itomaloed.
A-ibagangine, weyob sogledoed: “Bab-Jehováʼga be namakmar, e-nug be odummomar, bela-dulemar-napneggi-bukmaladga e-ibmar-imakedgi be sunmakmar, e-nug-dummarba-guedgi be sunmakmar.
Bab-Jehováʼga ega-namaklemaladgi be namakmar, ar ade, ibmar-gegerdaklemalad imaksad. We-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad bela we-napneggi dulemar-wisguega be imakmar.
Sión-yalagi-bukmalad, weligwaledba be namakmar, weligwaledba be gormakmar. Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaled, bemar-abargine Dule-Gandikidid.”
Bab-Dummad Amoz-machi-Isaíasʼga Babilonia-dulemar-berguoedgi sunmaksad:
Yala-swire-naidgi bander be mer-mer imakmar, sorda-bila-onomaladse be binnasuli gormar. Argan ese be oyomar, adi, dule-nuga-nikamalad-yawagakba ubomalagar.
Anga-nug-salegarmaladga bato an igar-uksad. Anga-dule-bulegan-gumaladi, an-nakwedgi-na-yeer-itodimaladi, an guakwaa urbisad, adi, anga sabsur-dulemar-odurdakegar.
¡Be itomar! Yalaganba neg-oimake itoleged, dulemar-ichesur-oimakedyob itoleged. ¡Be itomar! Neggwebur-dummagan-atosmalad-oimaked, be itomar, mala-gollomakedyob e-oimaked itoleged. Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, bila-onogega, sorda-bila-onomalad-guagwar urbenaid.
Neggwebur-dikasulidba danimalad, yarmar-bergunaid-akale danimalad. Bab-Jehová, e-urwedba-ibmar-ebulemalad sedanikid, adi, bela napneg obelogegar.
¡Be bomarsun! Bab-Jehová-urwemaid-iba omosad, Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad bemar sabsur-odurdakoed-e-iba danikid.
A-ulale, bela argan nollomakdoed, bela dulemar niga-argwatemaloed.
Bela-belad dobe-itodmaloed, suli-suli-itomaloed, nunmaked-dummadi egi nagudmaloed. Igi-sior-muu-neggi-ugakgunair nunmaked-itodae, deyobi, egi nunmaked nagunonikoed. Dukin-dukin geger na dakdemaloed, e-wagarmar-daklegoedi, bela-bela dobed-nika daklemaloed.
¡Be dakmar! Bab-Jehová-urwed-e-iba danikid: Iba-buled dani, yeer-gangued-iba, bela-belad-urwed-iba dani, napneg ollobi daarmakar nasikoed, agine, bela dule-isgubukmalad obelogoed. Bab-Jehová soged:
“Niisgwamar mogir-biriba-nanaidi bar gaosulid, niisgwamar-danar-danar nanaidi, bar ibegwar gaosulid. Dad-ibeler-noalile, sichii naguoed, bar nii ibegwar gaosulid.
Napneggi-dulemar-bukwad e-isgudiid-nukad an sabsur-odurdakoed, dule-isganamar e-ibmar-isgana-imakdiidba an sabsur-imakoed. Dule-na-san-dummarba-imakmaladi, na san-dummarba-imakega bar guosurmalad. Dule-bulegan-na-san-dummarba-imakmaladi, na san-dummarba-san-saega bar guosurmalad bela nug-bipi-gumalaga an imakoed.
Dulemar, olo-sunsoged-icheguedba bur ichee-bukuega an imakoed. Dulemar, Ofir-or-nued-icheguedba ichee-bukuega an imakoed.
A-ulale, ani Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, an-urwemaid-ibagangi an-urwedba nibneg giglimakega an imakoed. Napneg e-naidgi ainirega an imakoed.
Dulemar igi-goe-sapur balegillemaidae, deyob, balegillegoed, e-neggweburse duurmakdemaloed. Igi-sibad-wawaad e-idugedsuli duurmakmadaedyobi gumaloed, wala-walagwen e-yarse wakitemaloed.
Doa-dule galenonikile, ewarar oburgwilegoed, dule yogasaar-galesale, es-suidgi oburgwilegoed.
Dulemar-wagaba e-mimmigan omukudmaloed, e-negmar-ibe ibmarmar atursadmaloed, e-omegan e-ibe gagadmaloed.
Babilonia-dulemargi Media-dulemar gwichiguega an imakoed. We-dulemar mani bai dakdasurmalad, orgi gwen weligwar itodasurmalad.
E-sigugi ese sapingana, yagana, oburgwilegoed, goe-gwarugana gwen wile dakosurmalad, burwigana gwen bai dakosurmalad.
Babilonia-neggwebur, be yeerdakleged, gandikidba be yeer-dakleged, Caldea-dulemarga be san-dummarbaa gusiid. Emidi, Sodoma-neggweburyob be guoed, Gomorra-neggweburyob be guoed. Ani an Bab-Dummad gued. Igi an we-neggweburmar obelosa, deyob an be-imakmaloed.
Bipisaale, bar dulemar egi ambikuosulid, dulemar-sorba-danimaloedi bar egi ambikuosurmalad. Árabe-dulemar we-yargi bar megosulid. Sibad-wawaad-edarbedi, bar egi e-sibad-wawaadmar oambikuosulid.
Unnila nega-dulesulidganba ibmar-durgan-ursilimaladbi bukuoed. E-negmargine, irmonbi ena ambikuoed, nuu-dummad-malisuiganbi a-yargi ambikuoed, sibad-omegan-sapurbarmaladbi gudidioed.
E-neg-gandikmaladgi achu-sapurmarbi gordioed, e-reynegmargi achu-sapur-uaya-gannareged-bunnu-wawaadmarbi gordioed. Babilonia-neggwebur, Bab-Dummadse be sabsur-odurdakleged-igar omodanigusad, bar bega ibamar obannolegosulid.”
Ar Bab-Jehová wile Jacob-wagan-daknonikoed, gannale Israel-dulemar-sunonikoed. E-yala-sunnadgi-bukuega imaknonikoed. Dule-yar-baiganginmalad ese megnonimaloed, Jacob-waganba garmakdii gumaloed.
Dulemar-bukidar Israel-dulemar-bendakmaloed, Israel-yarse sedmaloed. Geb degi, Israel-dulemar, e-galesgusmalayobi Bab-Jehová-yargi e-maiganga amar-imaknonimaloed. Degi, Israel-dulemar, dulemar-mesagwar-e-imaksamaladgi dummadga gumaloed.
Israel-dulemar, Bab-Jehová be-bukib-binsadigusadgi baisur-itoge be-imaknonikile, degi, be-nunmak-itodigusadgi, be-ise-mesagwar-imaklesadgi, Bab-Jehová bemar-ollor-imaknonikile,
Babilonia-e-reygi we-sabsur-emar-obingesaar-namaklegedgi be weyob namakmaloed: “Dule-emar-mesagwar-sadiid, igi-gusa be dakmarsunna. E-urwedi, igi-bergus be daksunna.
Bab-Jehová dule-isganamar-e-suar bibichisad, dulemar-yeer-neg-gangu-semamaid-e-gaapoled bibichisad.
We-gaapoled dulemar-sabsuli-wiodii gusad, urwedgi dulemargi-obindii, degi, balengindii gusad.
Emidi, bela napneg bogigus naid, weligwaledba binnasuli namakmalad.
Baryawarse-bakale, degi, Líbano-urwarse-bakale, Babilonia-e-rey, be-bergusadga wergumalad, weyob sogmalad: ‘Be-bergusad-akale, bar dulemar anmar-omukudisurmalad.’
Be-ibmar-imaksad-ular, neg-urba burgwarmalad-galu bebina itosmaid, be-abindakagwar maid. Be-ibmar-imaksad-ular, dule-burgwarmalad odaklealid. Amala dule-dummaganga megismaladid. Ar bela reymar-yar-bamaladgi-megisgusmaladi be-abin ainidagega, e-ologanagi-bubukwadgi ogwislealid.
Bela wemar ibmar sogdamaloed, bega weyob sogdagoed: ‘Anmaryobi be ganguedsuli gunonisunde. Be anmaryobi gunonimosunde.’
Be-san-dummarba-na-be-imakdiid napa-uluba melledsun, be-gar-arpa-goled bergunonimosun. Emisgindi, nusu-imbagi be megmosunnoed, nusubi ber biini be megmosunnoed.
”Niisgwa-dummad-bolegoedba-gaardaed, ibiyobi be niba-nai argwannoniki. Bee be, bela-bela dulemar-wiodiidid, napnegse be e-gwallenonisunnad.
Be-gwagegi weyob be sogsa gusanad: ‘Nibnegse an naoye. Bab-Dummad-e-niisgwamar-birigi an-ologana an sioye. Dad-nakwed-argan-sapiled-akar bab-dummad-baigan-e-yalagi, dummadga an negsemai guoye.
Mogirmar-bur-birise an nakoye, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Biriginedyob an guoye.’
Emide, burgwarmalad-galuse be balimellealid, bela neg-ulubalidse be egwallesad.
Dulemar-be-dakmaladi, nue-nuu be-dakmaloed, ar ade, geger be-dakmaloed, weyob binsadmaloed: ‘¿Wee we, napneg-wiodigusadi? ¿Wee we, yalamar-ogwayedii gusadi?
¿We-dule we, napneg nega-dulesulidga imaksadi? ¿We-dule we, yalamar obelodii gusadi? ¿We-dule we, esgaryagi-dulemar-gales-bukwad gannar e-negse-naega gwen imakdasulidi?’
Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-e-reymardi, nug-nikadba nuegwadgi e-neg-uangi digar-digar mamaid.
Ar bedi napa-ulugi-maidgi be-onosmalad, igi durgan-nunud mileddae, deyob be-imaklesad. Dule-es-suidgi-oburgwilegar-burgwismaladi, neg-uluba-melledmaladi, bela be-omurus mamaid. Dule, muigi dii-dii-annasadyobi be dakleged.
Bedi gwen reymar-diglegeyobi nuedgi be diglegosulid, ar be-yala be obelosad, be-dulamar be ogilosad. ”Bipisaale dule-isganamar-e-wagan bar obarlegosulid.
Babgan-isgusad-ulale, e-mimmigan ogilolegega, ibmar-oburgwileged-neg guagwar imakmalo. Adi, wemar melle yar-seedgi bar binsamalagar, adi, melle bar napneggi neggweburmar-urbegar.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob soged: “We-dulemargi ani an gwichiguoed, ani an Babilonia-yala osulogoed, e-nuga an obelogoed, dulemar-dulagudimaladi ani an obelogoed, e-masmala, e-wagana ani an obelogoed. Weyobi, ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi soged.
Neg-matabi-naguega an imakoed akwanuku-negga an obinyoed. Gwalagi-negdurwieyob Babilonia-yala an imakoed, bar gudii an imakosulid. Weyobi ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi soged.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob ise-sogar imaksad: “Igi an igar-mesisa, deyob sogedba guodo. Igi an sogsa, deyob sogedba imaklegodo.
An-yalagi, an Asiria-dulemar obelogoed, an-yarmar-birgi, an amar-ogilogoed. An-neggwebur bar ese mailedii guosulid, ibmar-buleganba bar galitodii guosulid.
