We-igarde, ani an weyob bela yalamarga igar-mesisad. We-igarde, ani an weyob bela yalamarse an oyosad.”
Ar Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob sogsasoggu, ¿doa e-igar gaosunna? Ar e na igar mesisad, degite, ¿doa e-igar gaosunna? ¡Suli, dule gwen e-igar gaosuli!
Rey-Acaz-burgwisad-birgagine, Isaíasʼse we-gayaburba nonikid:
“Bemar bela-Filistea-dulemar, yala-be-wiodigusad-bergusadba, melle be weligwar itomalo. Ar yala-baid bela-bela be-isdaradga guoed, naibe-nued-gukualedba bur bule isganaga guoed.
Ar dule-wileganadi, nue-mas-gundii gumaloed. Ar dulemar ibmar-abesa-gudimaladi, ibmar nue-nikagudii gumaloed. Degi-inigwele, Filistea-dulemar, an be-wagandi ukudba oburguoed, be-dule-dula-napi-bukwadi bela an obelogoed.
Filistea-dulemar, gwage-nunmak-itogedba be binnasuli bomarsun. ¡Bela bemar dobe-itogedba be wawanmakmarsun! Ar ade, sorda-bila-onomalad dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik waa-ainakweyob melledanikid, dule bela danagwena duurmakdanikid.
¿Igi-be we-yalaga-dule-garda-berbemalad-abin be sogoe? Weyob be sogoed: ‘Ar Bab-Jehová Sión-yala sisad, ar agi dule-wile-itodimalad dukued-neg amioed.’ ”
Isaías, Moab-neggwebur-berguoedgi iduakwaa sunmaksad. Moab-neggwebur-Arʼye-nugad bela ayarisad, mutiki bergusad. Moab-neggwebur-Kirʼye-nugad bela ayarisad, mutiki bergusad.
Dibón-neggweburginmalad, e-bab-dummadse-goled-negse nadmalad, adi, e-bab-dummadga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailase bonamalagar. Moab-dulemar Nebo-neggwebur-bergusadga, degi, Medeba-neggwebur-bergusadga, ogormakbukwad. Bela sailagia-swiri-swiri imaksamalad, aku-sigamarse-bakale, bela enismalad.
Bela-dulemar boedbimalad, galimbabali wile-itoged-mor yoyoidbimalad. Neg-ubebbali ogormakdemalad, dulemar-bukidar-ambikuedgi dulemar boedbimalad.
Hesbón-dulemar, degi, Eleale-dulemar, wile-itogedba binnasuli e-bendakmarye gordidimalad, e-binnasur-gordiidi Jahaza-neggweburse magar itoleged. A-ulale, Moab-sorda-bila-onomalad dobedba-binnasuli gorbukwad, bela-bela egi dobed nagunonikid.
Moab-yar-ulale, an nue-bukib binsaed, E-dulemar, Zoar-neggweburse duurmakmamaid, Eglat-Selesiyáʼye-neg-nugadse duurmakmamaid. Luhitʼye-neg-nugadba ise-boar-boar nakwemamaid. Horonaim-neggwebur-igarba ise-boar-boar nadapmalad.
Nimrim-dianmar bela dingusad, gagan-ara-aramalad bela dingusad. Bar gagan-ara-aramalad nikagussulid, bela gagan-ara-aramalad bergusad.
A-ulale, dulemar-bukidar e-ibmar-nuegan-nikamaladi Sauce-sapimar-dian-maid-obakar sesmalad.
Dulemar-binnasuli-bodiidi, bela Moab-yalagi itolesad. Dulemar-akigindiidi, bela Eglaim-neggweburse warmaksad, degi, Beer-Elimʼye-neg-nugadse warmaksad.
Dimón-dian bela ablisbi-naid, bonigan napi-egi an barmidagoed: Moab-dulemar-duurmakmaidgi achumigur-nono-wawaad an barmidagoed. Amba dulemar-napneggi-bukwadgi achumigur-nono-wawaad an barmidagoed.
Isaías sogdebalid: “Sela-neggwebur-nega-dulesulidgi-siid-akale, Sión-yalase, Israel-yala-dakmaidga be sibad-wawaad-senigana barmidmar.
Moab-dulemar-omegan, nuu-e-uugi-ise-gwayar-noddaedyobi, Arnón-diwargi obakmamai guoed.
”Moab-dulemar, Sión-dulemarga weyob sogdanimalad: ‘Be igar-amimala, be sogmalo igi be imakmaloe. Neg-ibginedgine mutikidyobi negsichidbi be anmarga nasike. Dule-gwakiar-duurmakarmaladi be odukue, melle dule-dukudimalad be urmako.
Itoba Moab-dulemar-gwakiar-duurmakarmalad be bemar-walik dukudii imako, dule-e-obelobigudiidgi be wis bendako.’ ”Mesagwar-imakleged-ibagan bergusale, sabsur-odurdakleged-ibagan bergusale, napneggi dule-obeloged bergudoed.
Geb Rey-David-wagwa-gwensak, Israel-reyga megnonikoed. E-yar-seoedi, innikigwadba yar seoed, binsaed-nikaa yar seoed, nueganbi dulemar-idugoed, dulemarga igar-naboged ega gwae imaknonikoed.
”Anmar itodiid, Moab-dulemar doggus na san-dummarba-imakmarye. Wemar na bule-bule-na-san-imakdimalad. Dule-buledye na sogdimalad. Doggus-e-sunmakedgi emar-mesagwar imakdimalad. Ar binsarsunna deyob-damalad anmar nue-wisid.
Degisoggu, Moab-dulemar ogormakdemaloed, bela e-yalaga boedbimaloed. Kir-Hareset-uva-maduga bomaloed ega bukib-binsamaloed, bukib-binsaedba ega wile itomaloed.
Ar Hesbón-dulemar-nainu bela dingusad, Sibma-neggwebur-e-uva-nainu deyob naimogad. Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-negsemamaid, uva-nainu-nuegan obelosmalad. E-dubagan-Jazer-yalase-warmaknanainadgi, nega-dulesulidganse-warmaknanainadgi, e-dubagan-demarse-batenanainadgi, bela dii-dii imaksamalad.
A-ulale, an Jazer-yala-e-uva-nainubina booed, an Sibma-neggwebur-e-nainuga bomogoed. An Hesbón-dulemarga, Eleale-dulemarga an-ibyanis aryogoed. Ar dule-weligwar-imakega bar e-nainugi ibmar-gwagmar nikuosulid, ibmar-gwagmar gwen bar weelegosulid.
Nainugi bar wergulegosulid. Uva-nainugi dulemar bar namake itolegosulid, binnasuli dulemar-goled bar itolegosulid, uva-egurelegedgi dulemar bar uva egured daklegosulid, uva-welegedgi binnasur-gorledaedi ani an osulosad.
Degisoggu, an-gwage, Moab-dulemar-ular, Kir-Hareset-neggwebur-ular, gar-arpa-dub-nakwamaknaiyobi, wile-itonaid.
Ar Moab-dulemar aisaar na e-bab-dummaganga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailase-namalo-inigwele, bendakleged amiosurmalad, yegudamaloed. E-bab-dummadse-goled-neg-islidikidse e-bab-dummadse gornamalo-inigwele, gwen ega igarga guosulid, bela bergus naoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob epenne Moab-dulemargi ibmar-guoedi sogsagusad.
Emidi, Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Igi-dule unnila birgapaa arbadae, deyobi, birgapaasega Moab-yala-e-yeerdaklegedi, berguoed. E-dulemala burgwemaloed. E-dula, unnila napi-ichee bemaloed, garganguedsuli gumaloed.”
Isaías, Damasco-neggweburgi iduakwaa sunmaksad: Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob sogdo. “¡Damasco-neggwebur-siid be nue-dakmar! ¡Bar neggweburga sii guosulid! ¡Nue bibichis sigoed!
Aroer-neggweburmar ollobi melledoed, gagan-ara-aramaladbi naguoed. Agine, sibad-wawaadmar dobed-nikasuli gagan-madii gumaloed.
Efraín-dulemar-e-neggwebur-gandikid-siid berguoed, Damasco-neggwebur-Siriaʼgi-siid bergumogoed. Aram-dulemar-napi-durgumaloedi, e-ibmar-nuegana Israel-dulemargadga guoed.”
Bab-Dummad sogdebalid: “Siria-yala-gandik-siid bela bergusale, Israel-dulemar-e-gangued bela nollomakdemogoed.
Dule-ibmar-gwag-weed ibmar-gwag-welesadyobi, Israel-dulemar-e-gangued guoed. Dule na e-argangi ibmar-gwag-weesayobi, Israel-dulemar-e-gangued berguoed. Refaim-nebagi ibmar-gwag-welesad-besmaladyobi, Israel-dulemar ichee bemaloed.
Degine, igi-dule olivo-san-osiamaksale, e-anagan-matusulid-dukugi napi gwabo, gwapaadibe, nagusdae, deyobi, Israel-dulemar napi-ichee bemaloed. Ar igi olivo-san bela e-sapi-anagangi gwabake, gwaatardibe napi-nagusdae, deyobi, napi-bemaloed.” Deyobi, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad sogdo.
A-ibagine, Israel-dulemar, e-Obinnisad amidagoed. Israel-dulemar, e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaledse gannar atakdemaloed.
Bar bab-dummad-Baalʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-sobsamaladgi binsadosurmalad. Bar bab-bundor-Asera-sobarmalad-dakdosurmalad, ina-wawad-ogumaked-ailase naosurmalad. Ar we-bab-dummagan-ibmarmar e-argangi sobsagusmaladid.
A-ibagine, Israel-e-neggwebur-gandikmaladi, ollobi mellede gumaloed, sapurbi-moodo, negmar-ollobi-mellenaiyobi naguoed. Igi Israel-dulemar Canaán-e-neggweburmargi dognonigusmargu, neg-imaksamala, deyob bela-neg-ollo naguoed.
Ar bemarde Bab-Dummad-bemar-abonoged be iesmalad, Bab-Dummad bemarga-akwasailayob-gued be iedmalad. A-ulale, bemar amba ibmar-durba-nuegan digmalo-inigwele, amba neggwebur-baidsik-uva-danikid digmalo-inigwele, bela boniganba ibmar-gwag isgudoed.
Amba bemar-uva-digsad bega dungumalo-inigwele, banegi e-durba ainidago-inigwele, bonigan egi nonikoed. Ar bemar ibmar-gwag-weemaloedi, bela boniganba ibmar-gwag isgudoed.
Bukidar dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-uurmakbukwadi, ¡duledar-wilesmar! Demar-uurmakmaiyobi dulemar uurmakbukwad. Dulemar-binnasuli-oimakbukwadi, ¡duledar-wilesmar! Dii-wilasailad uurmakmaidyobi dulemar oimakbukwad.
We-dulemar, demar-uurmakmaid-dagumakmaidyob-damar-inigwele, Bab-Dummad ese-binnasur-uludele, duurmakdedamalad. Igi yarbali gagan-dinnagana burwa-abin seleddae, deyobi, dulemar duurmakdedamalad. Igi ukub burwa-binnasur-goledba mileddae, deyobi, dulemar duurmakdedamalad.
¡Sedogusale, dobed-dummad egi nagusdamalad! Oibosale, dule-isganamar bar dakleddasulid. Weyob dulemar-anmar-wiodimalad guodo. Anmar-ibe dule-ibmar-atursadimaladga, weyob ega igar idu maid.
Isaías sogdebalid: “Gwimar-uurmaked-yala, ¡nue-wilessun! Cus-diwarba-bukmalad, ¡be duledar-wilesmar!
Ur-nagwaryob-daklegedgi-sobaledba Nilo-diwarba dule-garda-berbemalad-barmimalad, ¡be duledar-wilesmar! ”Dule-garda-berbemalad-gandik-nanamalad be gwae-namar, dule-mullusurmaladse be namar, uka-sichigwadba-uka-dakaar-gamaladse be namar, we-dulemar-bela-dobesar-daklemaladse be namar, dulemar-gargandikmaladse be namar, dulegi-obin-san-sadimaladse be namar, yala-emargi-obinsiidse be namar. A-yala, diwarmar-iirmakmaid-yalad.
”Bemar, bela we-napneggi-bukmalad, yar-imbaba bander-nakwiali be dakalile, degi, gar-trompeta-gollali be itoarmalale, asiki be atakbukwa imakmalo, Napneggi-bela-bukmalad, nue be dakmalo, nue be itomalo.”
Bab-Jehová weyob anga sogsad: “Isaías, an-neg-maid-akale, dulemar-nue-dakmai an imakoed. An golosulid, bogi-mai an dulemar-dakmai imakoed. Dad-ibeler yorgi-duurmaknadaeyobi, bogidik-mai an dulemar-dakmai guoed. Ibmar-welenaidgi dad-ibeler duurmaknaile, boo-mileardaeyobi, bogidik-mai an dulemar-dakmai guoed.
Ar uva-weleged-iduale, e-dutu batialir, degi, nue-uva-san-nagualir, e-anagan an sike-sike imaknonikoed. E-anagan-binigan an sike-sike imakoed.
Deyobi, bela we-dulemar gumogoed. Ibdurgan-sapurbarmaladga miledoed. Yorgi, nuu-ibmar-burgwarmalad-gunmalad-masga guoed. Dii-wied-ibagangine, bela ibdurgan-sapurbarmalad-masga guoed.”
A-ibagangine, we-dulemar Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadga ibmar-ukleged sedmaloed. We-dulemarde, dule-mullusurmaladid, uka-sichigwadba uka-dakaar-gamaladid. We-dulemar, bela-dobesar-daklemaladid, dulemar-gargandikmaladid, dulegi-obin-san-sadimaladid. A-yala, diwarmar-iirmakmaid-yalad. A-dulemarde, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadga ibmar-ukleged sedmaloed. Sión-yalase ega sedmaloed, bia Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-e-nug-obarilege, ase Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-ukleged sedmaloed.
Egipto-yar-guoedgi iduakwaa sunmaklesad: Bab-Jehová be dakmala. Mogir-gwae-gwae-iirmakmaid-birgi-sii, Egipto-yalase danikid. Egipto-e-bab-dummagan e-abin wawanmakbukwad. Egipto-dulemar nue dobe-itomalad.
Bab-Jehová soged: “Egipto-dulemar na abin-abin-urwemalaga an imakoed, na e-gwenad-e-gwenad-egi-gwisgumalaga an imakoed, dulemar-na-e-aimarbo-urwega an imakoed, neggweburmar-na-abin-abin-urwemalaga an imakoed, yalamar-na abin-abin-urwemalaga an imakoed.
Egipto-dulemar suli-suli itodamaloed, bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladse idakdemaloed. Dule-burgwarmalad-e-burbase idakdemaloed, bab-dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-bundorse idakdemaloed. Yoo-ibmar-guoed-soged-dulese idakdemaloed, anmar ibu imakoye. Degi-inigwele, e-igarmar igarga-guega an imakosulid.
Egipto-dulemargi dule-bulegan yar-seega an imakoed. Rey-isgana yar-seega an imakoed. Ani Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad soged.
”Demar-naid dingudoed, Nilo-diwar-maid bela dinna naoed.
Dian-akwiar-mamaid sunnasuli yapanne gudoed, Nilo-diimar-iirmakmaidi, iremai gudoed, bela dinna naoed. Nallayob-daklemaladi, degi, nagwaryob-daklemaladi, bela burgwidoed.
Nilo-diwar-gakaba ibmar-digarmaladi, bela burgwidoed, Nilo-diwar-gakaba ibmar-nanaidi, bela bergudoed, bela swiri naoed, bar daklegosulid.
Bela dule Nilo-diwargi-ua-somaladi, degi, bela saki-miar-ua-gamaladi, bukib binsadmaloed, bela bodmaloed.
Bela dule lino-mor-nued-sobedgi-arbamaladi, degi, saki-sobedgi-arbamaladi, suli-suli itodamaloed.
Ua-galugi-arbamaladi, nue-wiles itodamaloed, ar bela e-sakimar itiridoed.
”Zoán-neggwebur-e-dummagan, dule-binsaed-ibedye be sogdimalad, bemar dule-gegeganad. Ar bemar Faraónʼga binsaed-isgana ukdimalad. Ar igi yogasaar bemar sogmalosunna: ‘Anmar binsaed-ibedye, epenne-reymar-binsaed-ibegan-megismaladse binsaed amismaladye.’
”Egipto-rey, ¿be-dule-binsaed-ibegande bega igigudmarsunna? Emide, be-dule-binsaed-ibegan bega sogmardo, ibu Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, Egipto-dulemargi imaksokali, igi-Egipto-dulemar-idu igar-amismaidi, bega sogmarbardo.
Zoán-neggwebur-e-dummagan dule-binsaedsulidga nadmalad, Menfis-neggwebur-e-dummagan ese yamolesmalad. We-neggwebur-e-dummagan, Egipto-yala noar sesmalad.
Ani an Bab-Jehová dule-binsaed-dakmaladgine, suli-suli-neg-itoged-burba egi nasiksad. Bela Egipto-dulemar-ibmar-imakedi, noarsaila imakdemalad. Igi-dule-mummudi, agar-agar banamakdii, debayobi, Egipto-yala banamaksiid.
Gege bar Egipto-yar-ulale, ibmar imakleged. Ar dule-dummagana, dule-ibmar-wismaladi, dulamar-bukwadi, degi, sordamala, gege bar Egipto-yar-bendakega ibmar imakmalad.”
A-ibagangine, Egipto-dulemar, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad sabsur-e-odurdakega egi gwisgualile, omeganyobi dobe itodmaloed.
Egipto-dulemar Judá-dulemar-dobe itodamaloed. Ar Judá-dulemargi wis binsadmalale, bato dobed egi nagudmaloed. Ar ade, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi Egipto-dulemar-idu igar-bulegan amisad.
A-ibagangine, Egiptoʼgi neggwebur-gwaatale Canaán-dulemar-gayaba sunmakdemaloed, degi, ise-sogar Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadga sogdemaloed: Anmar be-sogedba damaloye. A-neggwebur-gwagwenad nugguoed, Herez-neggweburye.
A-ibagangine, Egipto-yalagi Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila sigoed. Geb degine, yar-abingunaid-nagaba Bab-Jehováʼga akwa-dummad ogwismarbaloed.
Ar a-akwa-dummadi Egipto-dulemarga e-wilubga guoed. Adi, oyogega, Egipto-dulemar Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-e-nug odummomarmoye. Ar Egipto-dulemar Bab-Jehováʼse mesagwar-dule-e-imakmaladgi e-ollor-imakega gotemaloed. Bab-Jehová ega dule-e-abonoged, degi, dule-e-ular-gwisgued barmidagoed, adi, mesagwar-dule-e-imakmaladgi ollor-imakegar.
A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová Egipto-dulemar magar-e-dakega imakoed, ede, nue-Bab-Dummad guye. Geb Egipto-dulemar magar daknonimaloed, wede, Bab-Jehová nue-Bab-Dummad guye. Degi, Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-oburgwar ukdemaloed, ibmar-gwagmar ega ukdemaloed. Bab-Jehováʼga ise-ibmar-imakoye-sogmaloedi, na sogedba ega imakmaloed.
Bab-Jehová bonigi Egipto-dulemar-naibi-imaknonikoed, geb a-sorbali, onugubaloed. Geb degi, Egipto-dulemar Bab-Jehováʼba gannar nagudmaloed, degine, Bab-Dummad wile amar-dakoed, degi, onuguoed.
A-ibagangine, Egipto-akale, Asiria-yalase igar-dummad megoed. Geb Asiria-dulemar Egiptoʼse nanabukwa gumaloed, degi, Egipto-dulemar Asiriaʼse nanabukwa gumarmogoed. Egipto-dulemar, Asiria-dulemarbo Bab-Jehová-nug odummobukwa gumaloed.
A-ibagangine, yala-sogapaa ambikumaloed: Egipto, Asiria, Israel. Degi, wemar-yalagi neggwebur-bamaladba egi nued binsalegoed.
Ar ade, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad bela we-yalamargi ise-nued binsaoed, weyob sogdoed: “Egipto an-dulamarga gued. Egi nued binsalesun. Asiria-dulemargi nued binsalesun, ani an urbisad. Degi, Israel-dulemargi nued binsalesun, wedi angadid. Ani an we-dulemar susad.”
Ibagwengine, Asiria-e-rey-Sargón, e-sordamar-bila-onoged-e-dummad, e-sorda-bila-onomaladmala, Asdod-neggweburse barmisgusad. Geb agine, Asdod-dulemargi bila-onosgusad, geb egi nakwisadba Asdod-neggwebur-sunonigusad.
A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová Amoz-machi-Isaíasʼga sunmaksad. Weyob ega sogsad: “Wile-itoged-mor-yoid be esue, nag-uka-yoid be ungebali.” Isaías deyob imaksad, uka-swili gudigusad, degi, nag-swili gudigusbalid.
Degine, Bab-Jehová weyob sogded: “Igi an-mai-Isaías birgapaa uka-swili e-abganbi-odukudii gusa, degi, nag-swili gudii gusa, Egipto-yalagi ibmar-guoed-e-wilub oyoged, Etiopía-yalagi neg-guoed-e-wilub oyobalid.
Deyobi, Asiria-e-rey, Egipto-dulemar-uka-swili, unnila e-abganbi-odukuale, nag-swili, degi, ber bela sor-daledi, gales sedmaloed. Amba deyobi, Etiopía-dulemar-e-sapingana, degi, e-dulemar-sergan gales seledmarmogoed. A-ulale, bingedar itomaloed.
Dulemar Etiopía-dulemargi bensurmaladi, degi, Egipto-dulemarba-san-dummarbaa-imakdimaladi, nue bingedar itodmaloed, nue bela-bela dobe itodmaloed.
A-ibagangine, dulemar demar-gakagi-bukmalad sogdemaloed: ‘Be dake, we-dulemar anmar-bendakega gudimalansursi. Ar wemarse anmar, Asiria-e-reygi-anmar-ollor-imakega bendakleged amidimalansursi. Emidi, be dake: ¿Igi anmar bar bendaklegosunna? Anmar bar wakinned, sate.’ ”
Bab-Dummad Isaíasʼga nega-dulesulidgan-demar-dikarba-naidgi-neg-guoedi oyosad: Neguevʼba burwa-bipirmakaled-nanaedyobi, dule-yar-sumalad nega-dulesulidganba-danikidi, bato modanikid.
Anga yeer-gangue negburgan oyolesad: Dule-emar-yardakedi, dule-yardaked. Dule-wiogedi, dule-wioged. Elam-dulemar, ¡gwichigunae! Media-dulemar, ¡oitonae! Dule-wile-itogedba-bodimalad bar boega imaklegosulid.
A-ulale, an-abagan nunmakedba wawanmaked, an nunmaked-dummad itoged. Sior muu-neggi-ugakgunair abagan nunmakdaeyobi, an nunmak itoged. An dule-sunmaked-itogedi, suli-suli-ito an-imaked. An ibmar-dakedi, dobed-dummad anga uked.
An aku-itogusad. Dobedba an wanwan-itoged. Sedogusale, negdambegwad an yeer-itodaenad. Emide, aka gwayed anga uked.
Sorda-dummagan iba-ononanaid, mas-bukidar gullenaid. ¡Sorda-dummagan, be guagwarmalo! ¡Be-sigu-abgamalad be nudakmala!
Ar Bab-Jehová anga weyob sogsad: “Dule-nakuleged be ogwicho. Bela-ibmar-dakoedi, bega-sogega be imako.
Moli-ur-bila-onomaladgi dulemar ebo-ebo moli-uayasuigan-birgi-sii-dani be dakalile, igi dulemar ebo-ebo moli-yargan-muremalad-birgi-sii-dani be dakalile, yog-gollar be imako.”
Degi, dule-nakuleged binnasuli goted: “Dummad, bane-bane nakuleged-neg-suid-niba an nakulegwisguad. Mutikidbali, an nakulegwisguad. An bangusisulid.
¡Be dake! Dulemar moli-ur-bila-onomaladgi danimalad, ebo-ebo danimalad.” Geb dule-gwensak binnasuli goted: “¡Babilonia-neggwebur bergus! ¡Babilonia-neggwebur bela oitoles! Bela ibmar-wilub-sobarmalad e-bab-dummadga-imakmalad napagi omileded.”
Geb Isaías sogded: “Sordagan, ibmar-gwagyob napagi-omilede be gusmaladid. Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad an-uayagwar anga we-ibmar-sogsadi, an bemarga sognaid.”
Isaías, Duma-yalagi neg-guoedgi iduakwaa sunmaksad: Dule anse binnasuli Seir-neggwebur-akale goled: “Nakuleged-dule, ¿sana neg-mutikid berguoe? Nakuleged-dule, ¿sana neg-ibguoe?”
Geb an-abin sogded: “Neg-ibgued omodani, neg-mutikgued omodanibar. Ar be gannar anse egisbiele, gannar egisbalodo. Gannar be anse egisbiele, gannar be anse dagodo.”
Arabia-dulemargi iduakwaa sunmaklesad: Dedánʼginmalad, danar-danar duurmakmadaed, nega-dulesulidganba sapur-moodonaidgi ambikumalad.
Uku-uku-itodimalad-abin be ainimarsun, ega be dii ukmarsun. Tema-yarginmalad, dule-wakinmamaidga be mas ukmarsun.
Ar ade, es-suidgi-gwakialidba duurmakmamaid, es-suid-daarmakaledgi-gwakialidba duurmakmamaid. Ar ade, e-idu warsi yaa-gwichidgi-gwakialidba duurmakmamaid, bila-onolegedgi-gwakialidba duurmakmamaid.
Ar Bab-Jehová weyob anga soged: “Birgagwensega, Cedar-yala-e-yeerdakleged an obelogoed. Igi dule-manigi-arbaed birgagi e-arbaed ega bergunonidae, deyobi an imakoed.
Dule-sigugi-urwemalad-bulegan-Cedarʼginmalad, napi-ichee durgumaloed.” Ar ade, Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová deyob soged.
Isaías, Negburgan-Daked-Nebagi yoedse-ibmar-guoedgi sunmaksad: ¿Igi be itomala? Emide, bela bemar neg-uas-birgi be nakwemamaigu.
Bemar, dulemar-e-itoleged-damalad-neggweburad, bemar, oimakedginbi-gudidamaladid, ibagibi be negdakdimalad. Ar be-dule-burgwismaladi, es-suidgi gwen burgwissurmalad, bila-ononanaidgi gwen burgwissurmalad.
Bela be-dummagandi, danar duurmakdemalanad, degi-inigwele, gwen egi warsi-miledsuli galedapmalad. Bela be-dulemar-galesmaladi, aisaar wakinye sokarmalanad, bela galedapmalad.
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová weyob sogsad: “Be angi bangumar. Mer be anse gormar. Melle an-gwage baisur-itoge be imakmar. An-dulamar-bela-bergusad-ular, an boesii imakgwelo.”
Ar Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, Negburgan-Daked-Nebaga gwayed-dummad-iba nasiksad, suli-suli-itoged-iba nasiksad, nug-bipi-gued-iba nasiksad. Galu-matusulid-earleged-iba nasiksad, yalaganba binnasuli-gordigued-iba nasiksad.
Elam-yar-sorda-bila-onomalad moli-birgi-sii e-warsi oniarmalad. Kir-yar-sorda-bila-onomalad e-sigu-abgamalad oniarmalad.
Be-neba-yeerdaklemaladgi ur-bila-onomaladi, engus nanaid. Sorda-bila-onomaladi, degi, e-molimala, bela neggwebur-yawagak-doged-ebilis bukwad.
Judá-dulemar bendakleged-sate gudmalad. A-ibagine, bemala Sapurba-Neg-Dummad-siidgine, bila-onogedgi-gingimar-ebulemalad-bukwadi, be daksagusmalad.
David-neggwebur-e-galu-matusulid bukidar marar-marale be daksa gusmarbalid. Degine, dii-saboleged-urbalid-siidgine, dii be wesmarbalid.
Jerusalén-negmar-bukwad be ebichismarbalid. Galu-matusulid-mararmalad-nudakmalaga, abala, a-negmar-bukwad be earismarbalid.
Galu-matusulid-abinnidgi, be dia sobsamalad, adi, dii dia-epennegwadgi-sabolesiid, dia-soblesadse ogwaegar. Degi-inigwele, we-dule-ibmarmar-imaksadgi be binsaed-nikaa gwen gussurmalad. Degine, we-dule dikasurgus-we-ibmar-guoed-mesisadi, aku be daksamalad.
Isaías sogdebalid: “A-ibagangine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, boega bemarse gochanad, bukib-binsaega bemarse gochanad. Sailagia-swiri-saega bemarse gochanad, mor-sommed-yoega bemarse gochanad.
Degi-inigwele, aka bemar weligwar itodmalad. Yeer-itogedba be iba onodmalad. Moli-bebe-nikad be oburgwidmalad, sibad-wawaad be oburgwidmalad. Moli-sana be gutemalad, vino be gobdemalad.” Degine, be weyob sogdemalad: “Anmar mas-gunmala, anmar gobed-gobmala, ar anmar banedse burgwemalosursi.”
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad an-uayagwar anga weyob sogsad: “We-isguedi an bemarga osulogosulid. Ani, Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nika-Maid, an soged.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob Isaíasʼga soged: “Sebna be aminae, ar ade, reyneg-daked-dummadid. Ega be weyob sogo:
‘¿Ibu be wegi sanai? ¿Doa bega igar-uksa neg-uangi be yaa-gwisega? ¿Ibiga be nibali ise-sobale be yaa gwisnai? ¿Ibiga be akwasailagi nuesaale-megega be yaa gwisnai?
” ’Ar Bab-Jehová dikasuli be-barmetoed. Dule-gandikid-emar-gaeyobi, Bab-Jehová be-gaoed, ise-sabsur be-metoed.
Ogob-baparmakeyob be-imakoed, yar-dummadgi be-balimetoed. Agi, be burgoed. Agi be-ur-bila-onomalad-yeerdaklemalad bedapoed. Be-dummadga binged-dummad be guoed.
Be-gangi be siidgine, an be-onogoed. Be dummadga-maidi, an be-oberguoed.’
”A-ibagine, an-mai-Hilcías-machi-Eliaquimʼse an goloed.
Be-mor-dummad-suid an ega yooed. Be-molidub an ega nasikoed, degine, be-negseed-igar an ega ukoed. Jerusalén-dulemarga, degi, Judá-dulemarga, e-babayob guoed.
Rey-David-waganga-ibmar-sogega an ega igar ukoed. Eliaquim igar-ukele, dule igar-gaosulid, gwen dule egi akar sunmakosulid. Eliaquim igar-uksulile, ibmar guosulid.
Igi esgoro ise-bioklegar-gwisdae, deyob an Eliaquim dummadga-megega imakoed. Egine, e-neg-yaginmalad nug-gannarba itomaloed.
Bela e-neg-yaginmalad egi weligwar-itomaloed, degi, bendakdemarmogoed: E-masmala, e-wagan, bela-e-gwenadgan-bamalad, degine, e-aimarse-bakale, bendakdemaloed.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob sogbali: “A-ibagine, ani an, Eliaquim, bela-e-gwenadgan, bela dulemar-egi-bengussurmalad obelononikoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi, deyob an soged.”
Bab-Jehová Isaíasʼga Tiro-neggwebur-guoedi oyosad: Quitim-yar-akale, Tarsis-ur-selaganse gayaburbamar nonikid. Tiro-neggwebur bergussiid, e-negmar, degi, e-ur-nagumalad, bela ei bibichisad. Abali, amar bukib-binsabukwad.
Tiro-dorgan, boo be ambikumar. Sidón-dulemar-ibmar-ukedgi-arbamalad, boo be ambikumar. Be-selamar bega ibmar-nuegan-bukidar berbesmalad.
E-masgullemaladi, Nilo-diwar-e-ana-gwensakgi danikid. Tiro-neggwebur, dulemar-yar-baid-baid-bukwadbo, mani-onobukwa gusad. Nilo-diwargi-ibmar-gwag-welegedgi mani-amibukwa gusmalad.
Sidón-dulemar, be bingedar itomarsun, bemar, muu-billi-ibedga gumalad. Emidi, muu-billi weyob sogsad: “An bipisaale gwen abganba an galitodisulid, an gwen mimmi bakdisulid. An gwen mimmigan odummodisulid, an gwen bunamala ibmargi odurdakdisulid.”
Egipto-yalase, Tiro-neggwebur-bergusad-gayaburba warmaksale, Egipto-dulemar Tiro-neggweburga bukib-binsadmaloed.
Tarsis-neggweburse be namar, demar-gakagi-bukwamalad, be bukib-binsamar.
Tiro-neggweburde, ¿neggwebur-weligwaledinsursi? We-neggweburde, ¿bur dikasurgus siidinsursi? We-dulemarde, ¿dikasur-aineba bur nanadimaladinsursi?
¿Doa Tiro-neggwebur-weyob-guega igar amisa? We-neggwebur nuga-nika siidinad. E-dulemar-ibmar-ukedgi-arbamaladi, dule-nuga-nikamaladinad. Dulemar-ese-ibmar-bakmaladi, bela mag-dakedbimalanad.
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad we-igar mesisad, adi, dulemar-nug-gannarba-nikad ei obelogega, bela dule-napneggi-nuga-nikamalad-e-nug bipii imakegar.
Tarsis-dulemar, sapurgi be arbamarsun, ar ur-nagumaladde, bela be-ibe bergusad. Ar bar bemarse Tiro-urmar dognonikosulid.
Ar Bab-Jehová muu-billigi e-gangued oyosad, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-ogwayega imaksad. Bab-Jehová, Canaán-neggwebur-gandikmalad-obelogega imaksad.
Degi, Bab-Jehová, Sidón-dulemarga weyob sogsad: “Sidón-dulemar, be wese bergunonisun. Be-neggwebur-dummad bela bergussun, bar be weligwar itogosurmalad. ”Ar be Quitim-neggweburse obakmalo-inigwele, amba bogidiki gwen be itogosurmalad.
”¡Caldea-neggweburgusadi be dakmala! ¡Bar we-neggwebur sisulid! Ar Asiria-sordamar we-neggwebur bela obelosad. Ibmar-durgan-ursilimalad nega-dulesulidganba-gudimalad-e-negga imaksad. Neg-matusulid-gandikmalad sobsa gusmalad. Reyneg-gandikmalad bela ei earis gusmalad, akwamarbi ganna-ganna napi-obesmalad.
”Tarsis-ur-selagan bukib-binsabukwamalad, ar e-ur-nagumalad bela bergusad.
”A-ibagangine, Tiro-neggwebur ieles-guoed, bar egi binsalegosulid. Rey-birga-dulapaa-gakambe (70) dula-gudiguedyobi, e-ieleged-iba guoed. Geb birga-dulapaa-gakambegwad-sorba (70), Tiro-neggweburgi, gambasamalad-e-namaklegedyobi egi namaklegoed:
‘Gambasaed-ieles-gudiid, gar-arpa be sue, neggwebur be ebirnae. Namaked-bur-nued be ogolo, namaklemalad-bukidar be namako, adi, dulemar bee-ebinsamalagar.’ ”
Birga-dulapaa-gakambegwad (70) bergunonikile, Bab-Jehová Tiro-dulemar gannar e-ibmar-ukedgi-arbamalaga imakdebaloed. Degine, bela-neggwebur-baiganbo gannar ibmar-ukedgi arbadmaloed.
Ar e-mani-onogoeddina, degi, e-ibmar-ukoeddina, Bab-Jehováʼga ukdemaloed. E-manimar, degi, e-ibmarmar gwen sabolesii guosulid. Ar e-mani-onomaladi, dule-Bab-Jehová-nug-odummomaladga uklegoed, adi, nue-immedik-gudii gumalagar, degi, mor-nuegan-yoi-gudii gumalagar.
Dakmalana, Bab-Jehová napneg-swaana imaksad, bela napneg obelonaid. Bab-Dummad e-dulamar-ononnonaid.
Bela deyobi we-dulemala gumarmogoed: Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, degi, bela dulamar. Mai-e-dummadga-gudimalad, degi, e-maimar. Dummagan-omeganmar, degi, mai-omeganmar. Ibmar-ukedgi-arbamalad, degi, ibmar-bakedgi-arbamalad. Mani-gaar-ukmalad, degi, dulegi-mani-gamalad. Mani-ibegan, degi, dule-wileganamar. Wemala, bela deyob gumarmogoed.
Napanega bela swaanga naguoed, bela e-ibmarmar sulegoed. Ar Bab-Jehová deyob sogsad.
Napneg ibitosad, napneg bela-bela oitolesad. Dule-gala-ibegan, bela e-gangued bergusad, dule-napneggi-nuga-nikamaladi, bela yogguded.
Napneggi, bela isgued neg-gagasnaid, ar ade, e-dulemar, Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba gwen nanassurmalad. Igar-Maidgi annasmalad. Dule bipisaale Bab-Dummad-Ebo-Degisadegu-Igar-Mesisadba gwen nanassurmalad.
A-ulale, napnega ukabsales naid, ar e-dulamar-nukad deyob gusad. Agala, soo napneggi aidesad, unnila dulemar napi-ichee bukusmalad.
Uva-nainumar isgus naid, vino-binid bar daklesulid. Dulemar-yeer-itogedba-namakdidamaladi, emidi, bukib-binsaedba ogormakdimalad.
Damborʼmar-goledi, bergus-nanaed, gar-arpaʼmar-goledi, bergus-nanaed, dulemar-oimakedi, bela bergusad.
Namakbukmalale, bar vino gobsurmalad. Dule-mummuganga inna-gagbid isguded.
Neggwebur nue-bergus siid, olloo selenaid. Bela neg-yawagakmar, atiar-atiar bubukwad.
Galimbabali, dulemar vinoʼbina binnasuli oimakdimalad, wergulegedi bela bergusad, yeer-itolegedi bela yogguded.
Neggwebur bela-bela nue-bergus sigisad, neggwebur-yawagak-dummad bela daas-daas gusad.
Weyob napneggi dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad imaklemaloed. Igi olivo-sapi-san gwallealir, e-san obatega, binnasuli-osiamaklege, deyobi gumaloed. Uva-batisbukwayob gumaloed.
Dulemar napi-ichee-besmaladi, weligwaledbali binnasuli oimakdemaloed. Dad-ibeler-argwanedsiki, Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-yeerdakleged weligwaledba oimakmaloed.
Degisoggu, nebaganba Bab-Jehová-nug be odummomar. Demar-gakaba, Bab-Jehová-Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-nug be ogannomar.
Bela napneg-naidgine, anmar namakleged itoged. Weyob soged: “Dule-innikigwad odummolesun.” Ar andi an sogdo, an duledar-wilesye. Bela-bela an nunmak-itogedba, an burgwebied. Dule-yardakmaladi, unnila dule-yardakdimalad. Dule-yardakmaladi, emar-yardakedginbi binsadimalad.
Dulemar-napneggi-bukmalad, gwayed-dummad be-edarbebukmalad, be-iduar neg-bulegan naid, yardakleged-igar be-idu naid.
Dule gwayed-dummadgi unni-nosale, igar-buleganse galedapoed. Dule igar-bulegangi unni-nosbalile, amba yardakleged-igarse galedapbaloed. Ar ade, dii-dummad wioed. Dii-dummadi napneg-sailagan owawanmakoed.
Negabandur-dummadi napneg mamaroed, napa-daas-daas-imakedse saoed, bela napa goa-goa guoed.
Dule-mummu-banamakdiiyobi, napneg naguoed. Neg-uas-baisursunna-ayaredyobi, napneg ayaridoed. Dulemar-isguedbali napneg bergudoed, napneg gannarse bar guosulid.
A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová nibagi-negsemamaid sabsur-odurdakoed, napneggi, reymar-yar-semamaid sabsur-odurdakbaloed.
Esgaryaba odolemaloed, agine, mellesii gumaloed. Geb sorbali, sabsur-odurdaklemaloed.
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, Sión-yalagi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi, gandikid-yeerdaklegedba yala seoed. Degiidbali, dad-ibeler sichii nadoed, nii sichii nadmogoed. E-girmar-dummagan bela Bab-Dummad-e-gangued dakmaloed.
Bab-Jehová, be an-Bab-Dummadid. An bega namakoed, an be-nug odummogoed, ar be ibmar-gegerdaklemalad imaksad. Be-Igarmar epennegwad-akale bela napiragwadbiid, degi, inniki maiguad.
Neggwebur akwamarbi ganna-ganna be urbisad, neggwebur-gandikid, bela oitolesad. Dule-bamalad-e-neggwebur bela oitolesad, neggweburga bar sigissulid.
A-ulale, dule-gandikmalad be-nug odummoged, a-ulale, neggweburgi dule-gandikmalad be-dobee itomalad.
Ar be dule-wileged-suli-suli-itodiidga be niga ogannosad. Dule-ibmar-abesa-gudiid, be bendaksa gusad. Igar-bulegan-idu be, e-bendakedga gusad, dad-ibeler-gaed-irwa ibmar-nagueyob ega be gusad. Dule-isganamar-e-bunnoedi, burwa-dummad-noeyobi, galu-matusulidgi-gwichigueyobi gued, nega-dulesulidganba neg-diopisur-itolegeyobi gued.
Igi nega-dulesulidganba neg-diopisuli itoledae, deyobi, be dule-yar-baidginmalad-oimakedi, bogidik imaked. Igi mogir dad-ibeler-idu negsichii imakdae, deyobi, dule-bulegan be obeloged.
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi sogded: “Sión-yalagine, bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladga, an mas-nuegan-yeer-gullemalad bukidar imakoed. Vino-nuegan-sunsogmalad an bukidar imakoed. Mas-bur-yeer-gullemalad-nuegan, degi, bur vino-sunsogmalad-sulearmalad an imakobaloed.
Ani we-yalagine, mor-dummad dulemar-odukunaidi, esirmakoed. Mor-dummad-dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-odukunaidi, esirmakoed.
Ani Bab-Jehová, burgwed-igar degisadegu obelogoed. Degi, bela dulemarga ibyanis elioed, bela napneggi, e-dulamar-mesagwar-gudiid onogoed.” Ar Bab-Jehová, e-sunnad deyob sogsad.
A-ibagangine, weyob sogledagoed: “Eye, ar we, anmar-Bab-Dummadid. Anmar egi bensulid, ar we, anmar-abonosad. We, Bab-Jehová gued, egi anmar bengussulid. Anmar wergumarsun, Bab-Jehová-anmar-abonosadgi anmar weligwar itomarsun.”
Isaías sogdebalid: “Bab-Jehová we-yala akoed, Moab-yaladi sabsur-odurdaklegoed, igi durgangi annaledii dae, deyob Moab-yala imaklegoed.
Igi dule-dapumaknadapir, sakwa-onakwiddae, degine, aka dii-urba dogdedae, deyobi, Moab-dulemar e-san-dummarba-itogedbali, aisaar sakwa-onakwesii gumaloenad. Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová, we-dulemar e-san-dummarba-imakmalad ei obelogoed. Gannarse we-dulemar barguosulid.
Bab-Jehová ei galu-matusurmalad, degi, neg-gandikmalad bibisgoed, bela napaga obinyoed.”
A-ibagine, dulemar Judá-yargi we-namaked namakdemaloed: “Anmardi neggwebur-gandikid nikamalad. Bab-Jehová, neggwebur-gandikidi, galu-matusulidyobi, degi, neg-abingaed-gandikidyobi anmar-bendakega imaksad.
Jerusalén-neggwebur-e-yawagak egamar, adi, dule-nuegan innikii-Bab-igargi-nanamalad ubomalagar.
Dule-beginbi-binsaedi, bogidikidgi-gudisaega be imakoed, ar begi bensulid.
Bab-Jehováʼgi-bensuli be gudii gumar, ar Bab-Jehováʼbi akwasailayobi degisadegu gued.
Bab-Jehová, dule-gannarba-san-sadimaladi sabsur-imaked, neggwebur-san-dummarba-imakedi, ogalakued. Napase-balimetega imaked, napabi-nai imaked.
Dule-wilegana, degi, dule-nollogana, we-neggweburgi dii-dii annamaloed.
”Dule-innikimalad-e-igar innikigwadbiid, Bab-Jehová, bedi dule-innikigwad gued, bee be, dule-innikigwadga igar inniki imaked.
Bab-Jehová, anmar begi bensurmalad. Be-igar-nabolemalad-innikimaladgi bensurmarbalid. Anmar begi-binsadii gubied, be-nuggi-binsadii gubied.
Mutikidbali, degi, ibginedbali, an be-amidaed. Be igar-innikigwad napneggi ukdele, bela dule-napnegginmalad durdakdedamalad, ibi igar-innikigwadi.
Bab-Jehová, be dule-isganamar wiledakda-inigwele, degite, amba igar-innikigwad durdaksurmalad. Napneggi dule-nuegan-abargi-gudimar-inigwele, galagwensuli gudimalad, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadsuliyob be-dakdamalad.
”Bab-Jehová, be sabsur-odurdaked-igar guagwar ega be nasiksad, ar emardi degite aku dakmalad. Be anmar-bela-bela-sabed we-dulemarse be oyoge, adi, bingedar itomalagar. Dule-isganamar-idu be soo-sisadgi obeloge.
”Bab-Jehová, be anmarga bogidikid uked, ar bela anmar-ibmar-imakedi, be-ganguedba anmar imaked.
Bab-Jehová, be anmar-Bab-Dummadid. Dummagan-baigan anmar-dummaganga gusmalanad, degi-inigwele, anmar bur be-nugbi odummoged.
We-dummagan bato burgwismalad, bar durguosurmalad. Bato napaga gusmalad, bar gwisguosurmalad. Ar be we-dummagan sabsur-odurdaksad, bela be obelosad. Dulemar melle egi bar binsaega be imaksad.
Bab-Jehová, be anmar-yala onasguega imaksad, be anmar-yala onasgusad, dule-gandikidga be gusad. Bela yarmar-abingunanaid-onasguega be imaksad.
Bab-Jehová, anmar suli-suli-itodigua, anmar bese gochagusad. Be anmar-sabsur-odurdaknaigua, anmar ulubgi-nunmaked-abalagi bese gochagusad.
Igi sior-gurgin-nikad e-boni-itoalile, nunmakedba binnasuli gollardae, deyob, Bab-Jehová, anmar be-asabinni nunmakedba binnasuli gorsii gusad.
Anmar binnasuli bese gochamar-inigwele, degi, nunmakedgi bese gocha-inigwele, unnila boniganbi anmar abingasad. Gwen anmar napnegse emar-bendaked senonisulid, napneggi-dulemar-bukib-bukuega gwen gwalulessurmalad.
”Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová, be-dula-burgwarmalad gannar dula gudii gumaloed. E-muimar gannarse dula gumaloed. ¡Dulemar-burgwar-mamaidi, be gwisgumar! ¡Weligwaledgi binnasuli be gormar! Bab-Jehová, igi be bolegoedba, be-boo-miedi, gaganmar odungudae, deyobi, be-dula-burgwarmalad gannar be odulogoed.
”¡An-dulamar! Be-negyaba be ubomar. Yawagak be edumalo. Wis ichee be dukumalo, Bab-Jehová e-urwed-berguedse be dukumalo.
Itoakwaa be bukumalo, ar Bab-Jehová e-maidgi noesokalid. Dulamar we-napneggi-bukmalad egi isgusadba sabsur-odurdakdasokalid. Napnega ablis-aryosadi, oyogoed, napnega dulemar-burgwismaladi, bar odukumai guosulid.”
Isaías sogded: “A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová, naibe-dummad-Leviatánʼye-nugad sabsur-odurdakoed. Naibe-sinni-sinnid-Leviatánʼye-nugad sabsur-odurdakoed. Bab-Jehová e-es-suid-gandikidgi, degi, e-es-suid-dummadgi achu-simudubaled muu-billi-yagi-maidi oburgoed.
A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová weyob sogdoed: ‘Uva-nainu-nued-sulealedga be namakmar:
Ani, an Bab-Jehová, uva-nainu-edarbedga an gued. Bali-bali an-uva-nainu an oged. Melle dule ani oakalogega, mutikidbali, ibginedbali, an-nainu an edarbed.
An ese bar urwesulid. Ar amba ikomar uva-nainugi nikana, gagan-ikobimalad amba uva-nainugi nikana, an ebo ulusaled, an bela ogumaksaled.
Ar Israel-dulemar e-irwar gwisgubi an-abegele, anbo igar nudakergebed. Anbo igar nabogergebed.’
”Yoo ibagan nonikoed, Jacob-wagan ambikunonikoed, Israel-dulemar gannar ainidagoed, nue-nasgumai gudagoed. E-ibmar-nuegan napneg-dirbirmakar-naidgi iirmakmai gudoed.
Ar igi Bab-Jehová dule-baigan-sabsur-imaksa, ¿deyobi Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemar-sabsur-imaksasi? Suli. Ar igi Bab-Jehová dule-baigan-ogilosgusa, ¿deyobi Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemar-ogilossi? Suli.
Ar Bab-Jehová e-dula-sabsur-odurdaksad, e-yalagi-bukwadgi onosad. Igi burwa-ued nega-dulesulidganba-gordae, deyobi, Bab-Jehová, Israel-dulemar-neggwebur-dikasurmaladse-odurdaklegega barmeted.
Jacob-wagan-e-isgued, weyob osulolenonikoed, e-isgued-osulolegegala, weyob imakmalargebed: Bela bab-dummagan-e-ailamar-bukwad obelomalargebed, we-ailamar, akwasib-ebillegeyob imakmalargebed. Deginbali, Jacob-wagan, bab-bundor-Asera-e-wilub bipisaale bar ogwissulirgebed, degine, bali ina-wawadikmalad-aila obukusulirgebed. Geb degidbali, Bab-Jehová, Jacob-wagan-e-isgued osulogoed.
”Ar neggwebur-gandikid-siid bela oitoles siid, neg olloo mellesiid. Igi-nega-dulesulidganba dule sate, deyobi siid. Moli-bebe-nikad-senigwad-gagan-maed-negga guded, moli-bebe-nikad-senigwad-obunnoged-negga guded. Sapi-gaganmar bela ese bergued.
Geb sapi dingudele, e-anagan bibichiddaed. Geb omegan, sapanga aminonidamalad. Ar Israel-dulemar neg-gunaid nue-akusunna itomalad. A-ulale, e-Bab-Dummad-e-obinnisadi, we-dulemar-wiledaksulid, a-ulale, e-Bab-Dummad-e-obinnisadi, we-dulemarga igi-barsaye sogosulid.”
A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová, Éufrates-diwar-suke-aryomaid-akale, degi, Egipto-dian-maidse dulemar-egwaoed. Ar bemar Israel-dule-gumaladdi, igi-dule-sapurgi-arbaed ibmar-gwag gagagwen weedae, deyob bemar war-wargwen welemaloed.
A-ibagangine, gar-trompeta-dummad gordagoed. Asiria-yalase, degi, Egipto-yalase, dulemar-galesa-selesgusadi, Jerusalén-Yala-Islidikidse Bab-Jehová-nug odummononimaloed.
Efraín-dule-mummugan san-dummarba-imakdimalad, ¡duledar-wilesmar! E-dummagan neba-nued-mullu-birgi dutu-dinnagana-bukwayobi gumalad. Dulemar-vinoʼse-ebipiledimalad, ¡be duledar-wilesmar!
Bab-Jehová dule-gwensak-yeer-gangued, be-idu amisad, dule-dutusulid be-idu amisad: We-dule, bela ise-urwedgi sabsur-be-imaknonikoed, we-dule, dii-gwamakar-wieyobi gangued, burwa-dummad-dule-obelogedyobi gangued, dii-burwaba-mesa-wiedyobi gangued, diwar-dummad-noedyobi gangued.
Efraín-dule-mummugan san-dummarba-imakdimalad, ¡duledar-wilesmar! Egi dii-dii annalegoed.
We-dutu e-gangued-yeerdaklegedi, neba-nued-mullugwagi-gwichidi, dingudoed. Igi higo-san-gorogwad gwallegoed-iduar dule bato daksayalaba, gwandae, degi, geb gundae, deyobi gumaloed.
A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, e-dula-napi-ichee-bemaloedgala, ologurgin-yeerdaklegedga guoed, ibmar-yeerdakleged-bebegi-nagued-gandikidga guoed.
Bab-Dummadi, dule-igar-nabogedga igar-innikii-imaked-burba ukoed. Neggwebur-yawagakgi-nakulemaladga niga-ogannogoed.
Amba dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladi, degi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmaladi, vinoʼba bipirmakdemarmogad, inna-gagbid ebipiledimarmogad. Vinoʼba binsaedsuli nadmalad Inna-gagbid-gobedba yoledimalad. Negburgan-dakalile, wawanmakdedamalad, ibmar-sokarmalale, suli-suli-ito naddamalad.
Bela mesemar aged-sunnabi bukwad, gwen neg daarmakar naisulid, bela isgusnaid.
Deginbali, an-annik weyob sogmalad: “¿Ar wis doamar-odurdaknai itoge? ¿Doamarga Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsognai itoge? ¿Burwigan-gebe-mam-iargusayobi anmargi binsae?
¿Burwigan-gebe-garda-absoged-durdaknaidyobi anmargi binsae? Gannar-gannar anmarga igar-mamaid sognaid, ise-sogar-ise-sogar we-igargi anmar-odurdaknaid. Nugmargi gwagwagwen-gwagwagwen anmar-odurdaknaid.”
Emigindi nabir, ar bemar Bab-Dummadba ibsasulile, Bab-Dummad bemarga gaya-baidba sunmakoed, a-gaya bemar aku itomaloed.
Bab-Dummad bemarga bato weyob sogsa gusad: “Wegine, neg-bogidikid-negad. Dule-yegusgudiid wegi obunnogoed.” Degi, sogsabalid: “We-neg, obunnoged-negad.” Degi-inigwele, bemar gwen itossurmalad.
Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová, burwigana-gebe-garda-absoalidga-sunmakedyob ega sunmakoed. Gannar-gannar ega igar-mamaid sognai guoed, ise-sogar-ise-sogar we-igargi amar-odurdaknai guoed. Nugmargi gwagwagwen-gwagwagwen amar-odurdaknai guoed. Amar nanadmalale, gebe-burwigan-nag-obialidyob gumaloed: Yarganba ailadmaloed, nailikgumaloed, gege bar gwisgue gumaloed.
Jerusalén-neggwebur-e-dummagan-bingedsulidamalad, Bab-Jehová-gayaburba be itomar.
Ar bemar weyob sogmalad: “Anmar burgwed-igarbo igar amisad, anmar burgwed-galubo igar amismalad. Boni-dummagan anmargi danikile, anmarse warmakosulid, ar ade, anmar-gakansaedi anmar napiragwadyobi daksad, anmar-emar-yardakedi anmar igar-nuediyobi daksad.”
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nika-Maid weyob soged: “¡Be dakmala! Ani an Sión-yalagi akwa-bur-nued-sulealed negsailaga mesisad. Akwa neg-gaega, akwa-nued an ebusad, adi, neg gandik sii guegar. Ar dule agi bensulile, suli-suli itogosulid.
Ar ade, we-neg-soblegoedi igar-napiragwad-wilubsaega an imakoed, igar-innikigwad-wilub-imakega an imakoed. Dii-gwamakar-wimaladi bela bemar-gakansaed-igar-napiragwadyob-imakdimalad obelogoed, diimala, bela bemar-neg-dukued odogoed.
Degidbali, bemar burgwed-igarbo-igar-mesisadi bar igarga-guosulid. Burgwed-galubo-igar-amismaladi bar gangued-nika guosulid. Boni-dummagan bemargi danikile, bela bemargi gwichigunonikoed.
Be-isdarmalad bemargi-gwichigued-ilibali, ese be bergudii guoed. Bane-bane, mutikidbali, ibginedbali, bemargi nanagwichi guoed.” Bonigan-daniye itoarmalale, bela-belad nue-dobe itodmaloed.
Gas-bipigwadgi-megeyob gumaloed, atued-bipigwadgi-atueyob gumaloed.
Bab-Jehová, Perazim-yalagi-ulusadyob, uludagoed. Gabaón-nebagi e-urwed-oyosadyob, oyodagoed. Bab-Dummad bato guagwarmaid, ukiarmakale, weyob-ibmar-imakdisulid imakoed.
Emigindi, bemar melle bar Bab-Jehováʼgi dodomalo, adi, melle bur bule be sabsur-odurdaklemalagar. Ar Dummad-Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, bela neggweburmar-obelolegoedgi-sunmaksa an itosad.
Be itomar, nue be an-gayaburba itomar. Nue be bogi an-itomar, an-ibmar-soged be itomar:
Sapurgi-arbaed-dule, ibmar-digega napa imued. A-dule, ¿obunnosuli napa-imuedginbi alamakdii guode? Suli. ¿Unnila bane-bane napa-swaana, degi, gwisar-gwisar imaknai guode? Suli.
Ar bela napa guakwaa imaksale, ¿gagan-wawagan-gwag-eneldoʼye-nugad mie-mie imakdasursi? ¿Ibmar-gwag-cominoʼye-nugad digdasursi? Geb a-sorba, ¿ilekwaa-orosgi-dakleged-trigo digdasursi? ¿Orosgisaar-dakleged-cebada digdasursi? ¿Nainu-gakabali orosgi-saardakleged-centenoʼye-nugad digdasursi? Eye, deyob imakdado.
Ar ade, Bab-Dummad weyob ibmar-imakega dule-odurdaked, igi dule ibmar imakoe, aba odurdaked.
Ar gagan-wawagan-eneldo-gwag, orosyob omukulesulid. Ibmar-gwag-cominoʼye-nugad-birgine, e-gwag-oniega ibmar-ukusulid obipirmaklesulid. Ar ade, gagan-wawagan-eneldo-e-gwagmar suar-bipigwadgi obateledaed, Ibmar-gwag-cominoʼye-nugad suar-nollogwadgi obateledaed.
Oros-gwagmar omukulenaile, sabsur-ubikwaa imaklesulid. Deginbali, ibmar-gwag naglenaidbi geg gued. E-birgine, ibmar-ukusulid-nanaega imakleged, ar molimardi, ibmar-gwagmar ubimaksulid.
We-binsaedi, bela Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadgi danibalid. E-binsaed-dakedi, innikigwadid, e-binsaed-nikadaedi, sunsogedid.
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “Ariel-neggwebur, be nue-wilegoed. We-neggwebur, David-sorda-ambikusad-negad. Gatik birga-irba iba-onodii be nanamar.
Degi-inigwele, Ariel-dorgan, an begala bonigan onogoed. Ar ogormaksii be guoed, bukib-binsasii be guoed. Bela neggwebur soose ogumaklegoed, ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi ibmar-ogumaklegeyob guoed.
An-sorda-bila-onomalad bela be-ebilis an urboed. Bela neggwebur-dikarbali, bila-onoged-galumar an emakoed, bila-onoged-aila an be-iduar soboed.
Mesagwar be imaklegoed, napagi mellemai be guoed. Be-ibmar-biedi wis-bollee-itolege guoed. Be-gayaburba galudor-sunmakedyob itolege guoed. Napayala be sunmakmaile, unnila wis bipi-bollee itolege guoed.”
Be-isdarmalad-ichesulidi, ukub-buruyob guoed. Dule-gandikmalad-bukidaradi, gagan-durgan-dinnagana burwaba seleddaedyobi, imaklegoed. Ukiarmakagwale, ilagwen-saale imaklegoed.
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, bese nonikoed. Mala-abalagi, negabandur-abalagi nonikoed. Neg-oimakagwaled-abalagi nonikoed, burwa-ololed-abalagi, burwa-dummad-abalagi nonikoed. Degine, soo-duurmakwichid-abalagi nonikoed.
Dula-bukidar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad Ariel-neggweburgi-gwisgumaladi, bela e-neg-gandikmalad-ei-earbimaladi, bela neggwebur-ebirdimaladi, bela bergudmaloed. Boo-dadabin-berguddaeyobi, bergudmaloed.
Dula-bukidar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladi, Sión-yalagi-bila-onomaladi, ukudba burgwidmaloed. Dule gabidele, na mas-gunsiiye gabdakdamaloed, gobsiiye gabdakdamaloed. Degi-inigwele, ataas-nadele, ukudmaada itodamaloed. Gammu dinare itodamaloed.
Bemar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad, dule-binsaedsulidyob be gudii gumarsun. Dule-aku-atakedyob, ibmar-akudake be gudii gumarsun. Mummuyobi be aibandii gumarsun Inna-gagbid gobsabayobi be aibandii gumarsun.
Bab-Jehová bela-belad bar-ibmar-daksuli be-imaksad. Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad-ibe burbar-geg-ibmar-dake imaksad. Negburgan-dakmalad bar negburgan-daksuli imaksad.
Negburgan-bemarga-oyolegedi, garda-bipirmakaled-sakdigaleyobi guoed, be aku itomaloed. Ar dule-garda-wisidga, we-garda-bipirmakar-maid be uksale, ega be sogele: “Wis be anga absoye.” We-dule, be-abin weyob sokaliled: “An bega absogosurye. Ar ade, sakdigar maiddeeye.”
Ar dule-garda-wissulidga, we-garda-bipirmakar-maid be ukye sogele, ega be sogele: “Wis be anga absoye.” We-dule, be-abin weyob sokaliled: “An garda wissur-absoye.”
Bab-Jehová weyob Isaíasʼga sogded: “We-dulemar an-nug-odummoye soged. E-sunmakedgi an-nug-ogannoye soged. Degi-inigwele, unnila asginbi an-nug odummomalad. E-gwage-ulubgindi angi gwen binsasurmalad. An-dobee-nanaye-sogmaladi, ar gwen an-igar-maidba nanasurmalad. Unnila dulemar-igar-mamaidba nanamalad.
A-ulale, we-dulemar gannar ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-dakega an imakoed, geb geger dakdemaloed. E-dule-binsaed-ibegan e-binsaed-nikadi, an ei osulogoed, degi, e-dule-nue-ibmar-wismalad ibmar-wissulidga an imakoed.”
Dulemar Bab-Jehová-idu-dukumaloye-na-bimaladi, ¡be duledar-wilesmar! E-igar-dukuar-imakdimaladi, negsichigi igar-isgana-imakdimaladi, ¡be dule-wilesmar! Ar we-dulemar na binsadimalad: “¿Ar doa anmar-dakoe? ¿Doa anmar-wisguoe? Gwen dule anmar-dakosuli. Gwen dule anmar-wisguosuli.”
¡Ibiyob be gakansadamala! ¿Ar dule-napsagi-arbaed, napsabo emarsi? Ar ibmar-soblesadde, dule-e-sobsadga sogosi: “Be an-sobsasuli.” Napsa-sobaled, sunna dule-napsagi-arbaedga sogosi: “Amba be ibmar wissuli.” Suli, gege deyob soged.
Líbano-yala emisgwasaale, napa-nuedga guoed, gadi-ibmar-sanmakedga guoed. Napa-gadi-ibmar-sanmakedi, sapurga naguoed.
A-ibagangine, uaya-satemaladi, dule ega garda-bipirmakar-maid absoalile, magar itodmaloed. Dule-ibyasurmaladi, magar atakdemaloed, negasichid bar ega naguosulid.
Dule-wilemaladi, gannar Bab-Jehováʼgi yeer-itodmaloed, dule-ibmar-abesa-gudimalad Israel-e-Bab-Jehová-Isligwaledgi weligwar-itodmaloed.
A-ibagangine, sabsur-dule-imakmaladi, dule-isgudimaladi, bela yoggudoed. Ibmar-isgana-saedginbi-binsadidamaladi, bela obelolegoed.
Yogabinne-dulegi-gakansaar-gwisgumaladi, dule-igar-nabomalad-yamoged-dulemala, degi, dule-e-bendaked-satedgi yamo-gakansaale-sunmakmaladi, bela obelolegoed.
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová Abraham-bendaksadi, weyob Jacob-waganga soged: “Emi-iba-onodoedgi, bemar Jacob-wagan bar bingedar itogosulid, dobedba bar niga-argwanosulid.
Israel-e-mimmigan bela e-dulemargi an-ibmar-imaksad magar daksamalale, bela an-nug-odummodmaloed, degi, bela Israel-dulemar Jacob-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaled-nug odummodmaloed. Israel-e-Bab-Dummadgine binsaed-nikaa gudmaloed.
Dulemar aku-neg-itodimalad, magar neg-itoge namaloed. Dule-geg-boo-gudidamaladi, an-igar-maid itodmaloed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob sogsad: “Bemar-uayasuli-damaladi, ¡be duledar-wilesmar! An-wissuli-igar-imakmaladi, an-ega-ibmar-sogsulidba ibmar-imakdimaladi, isguedginbi-nanadimaladi, ¡dule-wilesmar!
Anse-idaksuli Egipto-yalase igar amibukmalad. Faraónʼgi bendakleged-amiega ese naddamalad. Egipto-dulemargi bendakleged amibukmalad.
We-Faraón-be-bendakedi, be-bingeguega guoed Egipto-dulemargi be dukued-amiedi, nug-bipii be-imakoed.
Zoán-neggweburgi e-dummagan ega mamai-inigwele, Hanes-neggweburse e-garda-berbemalad mosa-inigwele, gwen bendakosurmalad.
Bela Israel-dulemala, neggwebur ega ibmar-nued-imaksulidba bingedar itodmaloed. Ar Egipto-dulemar wis gwen ega ibmar-nued imakosulid. Unnila we-dulemala, emar-obingegsaedginbi binsadimalad, dulemar-isdar-obelogedgi binsadimalad.”
Isaías sogdebalid: “Bab-Jehová weyob Neguev-e-ibmar-durgan-guoedgi sunmaksad: ‘Israel-dulemar, Egipto-yalase bela e-ibmar-nuegan, moli-uayasuidgi semamaid, bela e-manimar moli-yargan-muregedgi semamaid. Nega-dulesulidganba obakmamaid, ar ade, nega-bulegan naed, ar a-nega, achumigur-bulegan nika-naed, naibe-bulegan nika-naed, degi, naibe-gukuar-gukuar-nanamalad nika-naed.
Egipto-neggwebur gwen emar-bendakosulid. A-ulale, weyob an bied: Ibdula-ursiliye, gwen dule-oakalosulidye.’ ”
Bab-Dummad weyob Isaíasʼga sogdebalid: “Emisgwa be, we-ibmar dulemar-wagab narmak. Urgogi be narmakar-omeso, adi, ibagan-danikoed-idu degisadegu narmakar-oyomai guegar.”
Geb Isaías sogdebalid: “Ar we-dulemar uayasulidamalad, dule-isgana gumalad, Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maid itobisurmalad.
Emide, dulemar-yoedse-ibmar-guoed-sogedga sogdamalad: ‘Melle bar be negburgan-daked sogmarye.’ Bab-gayaburba-barsogmaladga sogdamarbalid: ‘Melle bar be anmarga Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-napiragwad sogmarye. Binsa nabir ibmar-nuegangi be anmarga sunmakmarye, binsa gakangi be anmarga sunmakmarye.’
Muchub-muchub sokarmalad: ‘Bab-Igargi be bangumar, melle Bab-Dummadba be ibsamar. Melle bar be anmarga Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaledgi sunmake.’ ”
A-ulale, Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaled weyob soged: “An-bemarga-ibmar-soged be itobisurmalad, mesagwar-gued bur be abemalad. Igar-isgana bur be itodmalad. Bur be we-igar-isganaba be akasmalad.
A-ulale, we-isguedi, bemargi gwichiguoed. Igi-galu-matusulid marar-gwichile, ukiagwar ailaddae, deyob bemargi isgued gwichigudagoed. Ukiagwale, ilagwensaale bemargi babatedagoed.
We-isguedi, napsa-bormo ise bela-belad goa-goa-mareyob guoed. Igi napsa-bormo bipisaale, gwen e-goa bar sogun-weega abelesurdae, igi bar diagi dii-weedga ebulesurdae, deyob we-isgued guoed.”
Ar weyob Bab-Jehová-Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaled soged: “Dule e-isguedga-bukib-binsaedgi bendaklegoed, nued-nanaedgi, bendaklegoed. Bargaagwar-gudiidgine, degi, angi-bensuli-nanaedgine, gannaleged siid. Ar degi-inigwele, bemar an-abesulid.
Ar bemardi weyob sogmalad: ‘Anmar moligi wakinmaloe.’ Degisoggu, deyob bemar wakinmalargebdo. Bemar weyob sogmarbalid: ‘Moli-gwae-gwae-abarmakedgi anmar wakinmaloe.’ Degi-inigwele, dule-be-baleginmaloedi, beba bur bule abarmake gumaloed.
Dule-gwensak-bemar-oburgwebied-asabinni, bemar-milibalidi (1,000), dobedba duurmakdemaloed. Dule-e-ataled-bemar-oburgwebied-asabinni, bela bemar, dobedba duurmakdemaloed. Igi yar-birgi suarbi ganna-gwisdae, deyobi be gumaloed. Igi-yar-mullugi ibmar-wilub gwisdae, deyobi bemar napi-bemaloed. Deyobi bela neg-olloo nadoed.”
Isaías sogdebalid: “Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová, wile-bemar-dakegala, bemar-abitomaid. Bemarga e-sabgued-nikadi, oyobied. Ar Bab-Dummad-Jehová, igar-innikigwad imakedid. Dule-Bab-Dummadgi-bensuli-gudimaladgi, nued binsalesad.”
Sión-dulemar Jerusalén-neggweburgi-mamaid, bipisaale, bar be boosurmalad. Bab-Dummad be-bendakega ese binnasuli be gornanaile, Bab-Dummad-dule-wiledakedi, wile be-dakoed. Be-itosayalabali, be-abinsaoed.
Ar Bab-Jehová igar-bulegan bemarga barmidago-inigwele, degi, wile-itoged-ibagan bemarga barmidago-inigwele, be-odurdaked-saila bar bemargi dukuosulid, bemar-sunnagwad be dakmaloed.
Ar be igar-noar aibatedibele, be-yarganbali dule bese-gole be itogoed, weyob bega soge be itogoed: “Noar be aibatemala, wesik igar-mai. Wesik be namala.”
Degisoggu, be-ibmar-sobarmalad-bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad-manibiidi, be-ibmar-wilubgan-orbimaladi, bela ibmar-isedyob be metemaloed. Be sogdemaloed: “Wegi-bukwad be nae.”
Degisoggu, be ibmar-gwag digele, Bab-Jehová bemarga dii barmidagoed. Ibmar sanmakdagogu, nue-sanmakoed, degi, yeer-gullemaladbi guoed. A-ibagangine, be moli-bebe-nikamalad nainu-dummagangine, gagan-madii gudoed.
Moli-bebe-nikad-alugwasuarmalad, degi, moli-uayasuigan be-nainugi-arbamaladi, gagan-nuegan bato egwaar-guagwar-bukwad-madii gumaloed.
Bab-Dummad be-isdarmalad-obeloged-ibagine, e-neg-suigan ayaridele, yala-matusurmaladbali, degi, bela yala-mulluganbali dianmar megidoed, diimar iirmakdoed.
A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová bemar-nailikgusmalad bemarga nudakoed, ar bemar e-dulaga gumalad. Nii-gaedi, dad-ibeler-gaeyob mee gadoed, degi, dad-ibeler-e-gaedi, ilagugle-wilub bur bule mee-gaeyob (7) gadoed. Dad-ibeler-gwagugle-mee-ganaiyob (7) dad-ibeler gaoed.
Isaías sogdebalid: “Be dakmar, Bab-Jehová-sunnagwad bannaba-dikasuli danikid. E-urwedi, soo-gwabunye-gwichidyobi, waa-bupurmakgwichiyob danikid. E-gaya, degi, e-gwabin-duku, soo-ginnitibi-gwichiyobi dakleged.
Bab-Dummad-e-ibmar-sogedi, diwar-nollosur-uurmakmaid-neg-odogeyob gued. Bab-Dummadi, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-oros-omukueyobi-imakega danikid, adi, bela obelogega danikid. Moli-gaya-bargaed-yoiyobi dulemar imaksad, adi, igar-baidsig sedegar, adi, yoggumalagar.
Ar bemardi, Islidikid-Iba-onolegedgi-namaklegedyob namakdemaloed, gwage-ulubgi, be weligwar-itodmaloed. Igi dule, Bab-Jehová-yalase-nadapile, Bab-Jehová-Israelʼga-akwasailayobi-guedse-nadapile, gar-gammu ogornadapdae, deyobi bemar itomaloed.
”Bab-Jehová, e-gayaburba-gandikid-itomalaga dulemar-imakoed. Bemarga e-gangued weyob oyogoed: Soo-ginnitibi gwichigudoed, malamar aidedoed, diimar suamakdoed, dii-gwamakarmaladi babatidagoed.
Bab-Jehová e-gayaburbaba, Asiria-yala obelogoed. E-ganguedba obelogoed.
Bab-Jehová we-dulemar-sabsur-odurdaked-ilibali, gar-panderoʼmar gotoed, degi, gar-arpaʼmar gotoed. Bab-Jehová Asiria-dulemarbo-urwenaile, e-sakwa minaidbioed.
Ar Bab-Jehová, Asiria-dulemarga, degi, e-reyga, sabsur-odurdakleged-neg bato dikasurgus guagwar sisad. Yaa-dummad-matusulid-yabali soo-duurmaked sobsad, degi, sapanmar-ichesuli urbisad. Bab-Jehová soogi buu imakdogu, soo-azufre-gwabunye-gwichiyobi, gadoed.”
Isaías weyob sogded: “Egipto-dulemarse-bendakleged-amibukmaladi, ¡duledar-wilesmar! Egipto-molimargi-bensurmaladi, degi, e-moli-ur-bila-onomalad-bukidar-nikadgi-bensurmaladi, ¡duledar-wilesmar! E-sorda-bila-onomalad-ganguedgi bensurmaladi, ¡duledar-wilesmar! Ar Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaleddi baisur-dakmalad, ar Bab-Jehová-amiedgindi gwen binsasurmalad.
Degi-inigwele, dule Bab-Dummad yamogosulid, ar ade, dule-binsaed-ibed maid. Boni-dummagan barmidagoed, ar ibmar-sogsale, sogedba imakedsedaed. Bab-Dummadi, dule-isganamar-e-neguyagi gwichiguoed, dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmalad-bendakdamaladgi gwichiguoed.
Ar Egipto-dulemardi, unnila dule gumalad, Bab-Dummadsurmalad. E-molimala, sanakwaa gumalad, burbarsurmalad. Ar Bab-Jehová, e-ganguedba dulemar-sabsur-odurdakdele, dule-isgana-bendakmalad-obelogoed, ese-bendaklesmarmogad-obelobaloed, bela ebobela bergumaloed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob anga sogsad: “Igi achumigur-nono-wawaad sibad-wawaad-gasa-uurmaknaile, dule-sibad-edarbemalad ese urwed itodasuli, degi, igi-achumigur-nono-wawaad-senigwad mas-gasa-uurmaknaile, dulemar ogwayenaile, gwen dobdasuli, deyobi, ani an-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, Sión-yalabina-urwega, e-yar-mulluganbina-urwega, an aidenonikoed.
Igi-nuumar e-mimmigan uugi-bukwale, edarbesidae, deyobi, ani Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, Jerusalén-dulemar-edarbemogoed, dule-isganamargi ollorsaoed, e-ular gwisguoed, bendakoed.”
Israel-dulemar, ar doagi bemar dummad-nosmala, ase be gannar namarsun.
A-ibagangine, bemar war-wargwen, bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad-manigi-sobaled, degine, orbi-sobaled, be metemaloed. Bab-Dummadgi-yolediidba bemar-sunnagwad be sobsagusmalad.
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “A-ibagine, Asiria-dulemar es-suidgi burgwemaloed, degi-inigwele, dulemar imakosulid. Es-suidgi-wakinnegala, duurmakdemaloed. E-sapingan-bila-onomaladdi, maiga imaklemaloed.
E-rey bela-belad nue-dobe itodoed, e-dummagana e-bander-ies wakitemaloed.” Bato guagwar Sión-yalagi Bab-Jehová-e-soo gasiid, Jerusalén-neggweburgi soo-yaa-matusulid bato dule-isdarmalad-idu guagwar siid.
Be dakmar. Rey-wargwen innikigwadba yar-seoed, degi, dummagan-neggwebur-semaladi, napiragwadba negsemaloed.
Dummagan-neggwebur-semaladi, burwa-irwa dulemar-odukueyobi, dulemarga gumaloed. Burwa-dummagan-noed-irwa dulemar-odukueyobi, ega gumaloed. Neg-dinnagwadba dian-maidaeyobi, ega gumaloed. Nega-dulesulidganba akwa-dummad-negsichi-imaksidaeyobi, ega gumaloed.
Bela-belad nue-nakuledii gumaloed, nue-bogimakar dulemar-sunmaked-itodii gumaloed.
Nue-itoakwaa ibmar-imake gumaloed. Nuekwa-sunmake, magar-nue-neg-itoge gumaloed.
Dulemala, dule-binsaedsulidaed dule-nuga-nikadye bar biosurmalad. Gadi-dule-yamogedi, sae-dakledoed.
Ar dule-binsaedsulidaedi, binsaedsuli sunmaked, yogasaar sunmaked. Igar-isganaginbi binsadidaed, igar-isganabi imakdidaed. Bab-Jehováʼgi gakansaar sunmakdidaed. Dule-masgunbigudiid ogunbidasulid, dule-ukudmaada-itodiid ogobbidasulid.
Gadi-dule-yamogedi, dule-yamogedgi alamakdidaed, igar-isgana-imakedgi alamakdidaed, e-gakansaedgi dule-wilemalad-wiodidaed. Dule-gakansaedi, dule-ibmarbina-sogdiid ega igar-naboye-gordidamaladga, gakansadidaed.
Ar dule-nuga-nikaddi, degisulid. Igar-nueganbi imakdidaed, e-igar-nuegan-imakedba e-nug dunguoed.
Omegan-gwen-bai-itosurmalad, ¡be nue an-itomar! Bunamala-gwen-bai-binsadisurmalad, an bemarga-ibmar-sogoedi nue bogimakar be an-itomalo.
Emide, bemar bela nueganbi-bukwa daklemalad, birgagwensega bemar, dobedba-wawanmakdemaloed. Ar ade, uva-sanmar bar welegosulid, ibmar-gwagmar bar welegosulid.
Omegan-gwen-bai-itosurmalad, ¡be nue dobee itomarsun! Bemar-baisur-itodimalad, ¡dobedba be wawanmakmarsun! We-mor be yoimalad esumarsun, wile-itoged-mor be yomarsun.
Nainu-yeerdaklege-naidga, degi, uva-nainu-nuegan-naidga, be bukib-itogedba binasgar be bibyomarsun.
Degine, an-dulamar-e-yar ikomar-yaisulidga gudoed, gagan-ikobimalad-yaisulidga gudoed. Deginbali, bela neg-yagi weligwar-gudimaladga, neggweburgi ibabi-dakdimaladga be wile-itomarsun.
Ar reynegmar olloo melledoed, dulemar-neggwebur bela olloo sigoed. Reyneg, degi, neg-gandikmalad, akwa-dummagan-ollogan-bukwayobi degisadegu bukuoed. Sapur-moli-uayasuid-obunnoged-negga guoed, sibadmar-mas-maed-negga guoed.
Geb Bab-Dummad-Burba anmargi aidenonikoed, nega-dulesulidi, napa-nuedga gudoed, napa-nuedi, nainu-nued-daklege nadoed.
Degisoggu, bela neggweburmar-ilibali, igar-napiramalad, degi, igar-innikimalad oyolemai guoed.
Igar-napiragwadi, bega gwage-bogidikid ukoed. Baisur-itoge be-imakoed, degisadegu dobsuli-nanadii be-imakoed.
An-dulamar neg-bogidikidgi-gudii gumaloed, nega-nuedgi-mamai gumaloed, neg-boo-itolegedgi-obunnomamai gumaloed.
Ar amba sapurdi egi dii-gwamakaled babatidoed-inigwele, bela neggwebur ibitogoed-inigwele, bemargindi nued binsalemarsun.
Bemar, dii-gakanaba-ibmar-digmaladi, moli-bebe-nikad-alugwasualed-esikar-imakdimaladi, degi, moli-uayasuid-esikar-imakdimaladi, bemargindi nued binsalemarsun.
Asiria-dulemar-dule-wiodimalad, gwen be wioledisulidi, ¡be duledar-wilesmar! Asiria-dulemar-dule-yamodimaladi, gwen be yamoledisulidi, ¡be dule-wilesmar! Be dulemar-obelosale, be bergumarmogoed. Be dulemar-yamosale, be yamolemarmogoed.
Bab-Jehováʼye, wile be anmar-dake. Ar anmar begi bendakleged edarbediid. Bane-bane wakudaryalabali, anmarga be niga-ogannoged. Suli-suli-itoged-ibagine, anmar-abonogega be gued.
Be-gayaburba mala-goledyob-goledbali, dulemar gwakiar duurmakdedamalad. Be-gangued be oyodele, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad aisakiddamalad.
We-dulemar-e-ibmar-nikadgi, e-isdarmalad ses-burwigana-bateyobi egi nonimaloed. E-ibe bela ibmar-nuegan sunonimaloed.
Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummolegoed, ar nibneggi negdakmaid. Bab-Jehová, igar-innikigwad-imakega Sión-yala-imakmaid, emarga-ibmar-nabir-guega imakmaid.
Bab-Dummadi, dobsuli-gudiguega anmar-imaked. E-binsaed-nikadaed, degi, bela e-ibmar-wisid, bela-bela bendakleged anmarga uksad. Bab-Jehová-dobee-nanaedi, anmarga ibmar-nuedga gued.
Be nue dule-gandikmalad-gordidiid itomar, ibiyobi neg-galimbaba binnasuli oimakdemala. Neg-bogidik-saedgi-sunmakdimaladi, bela-belad ogormakdemalad.
Dulemar bar igarba daklesulid, igar-ollo maid, dulemar bar igarba iirmaksulid. Na-ebo-igar-mesismaladi bichismalad. Dulemar, dule-we-igar-maid-wismalad isdar dakdemalad. Dulemargi bar binsaed-nika dasurmalad.
Bela dulemar bukib-binsaedbimalad, Líbano-yala bela dinguded, e-dakleged bela yogguded. Sarón-neba bela nega-dulesulidga naded. Basán-yala, degi, Carmelo-yala, e-yeer-ara-ara-dakleged yogguded.
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Emisgindi, an ibmar imakgwersunno. Emisgindi, an-nug odummolesunnoed, emisgindi, an-nug ogannolesunnoed.
Asiria-dulemar igar-amimaladi, unnila e-igarmar binsaledga gued, igarmar-isganaga gued. Ar an buu imakdogua, bergudoed.
E-sorda-bila-onomaladi, ikomar-sooyagi-gummaknaidyobi, gumaloed. Bela burubi gumaloed.
”Bemar, dikasuli-bukwamalad, an ibmar-imaksad, be nue itomar. Bemar, itaka-bukmalad, an-gangued be dakmar.
Dule-isgumalad Sión-yalagi dobe itobukmalad. Dule-isganamar dobedba wawanmakbukmalad. Weyob sogbukwamalad: ‘¿Doa-anmar, soo-dule-obeloged-nagaba megoe? ¿Doa-anmar, soo-dummad-gege-bergued-duurmaksiid-nagaba megoe?’
Unnila dule-igar-innikigwadba-nanadiidbi, degi, napiragwadba-sunmakdiidbi, nibneggi mai guoed. Dule ibmar-isganagi-mani-onodisulidbi, dule emarse-manigi-bakledisulidbi, nibneggi mai guoed. Dule emar-gindakmaladba ibsadisulidbi, ibmar-isgana-imakleged dakbidasulidbi,
dule-weyob-daedi, nibneggi mai guoed. Akwasaila-gandikmalad e-dukued-negga guoed, masgullemalad ega uklegoed, gobed ega gwen surguosulid.”
Isaías, Israel-dulemarga sogdebalid: “Bemar-sunnagwad, rey-e-gangued-yeerdaklegoed be dakmaloed, bemar-yala dungumai be dakmarbaloed.
Bemar dobee-itosadgi-binsadmardibe, na be sogdemaloed: ‘¿Bia wede mani-ebisged nade? ¿Bia wede mani-daked nade? ¿Bia wede nakuleged-neg-matusurmalad-dakdiid nade?’
Bar be we-dulemar-isgana dakosurmalad. We-dulemar, e-gwabinduku-aku-itolemaladid, e-sunmakedi, magar-itolesurmaladid, ber oburagwar sunmakmaladid.
”Sión-yala be dakmar, ar a, anmar-ibamar-onoged-neggweburad. Bemar-sunnagwad Jerusalén-neggwebur be dakmaloed. A-neggwebur, bogi-meged-negad, nuesaale sobar siid. Bipisaale e-abgamalad-suar ungosulid, e-abgamalad-dubmar itirosurbalid.
Jerusalénʼgi, Bab-Jehová anmarga e-gangued oyogoed. Diwar-dummagan-maiyob, degi, diimar-iirmakmaiyob guoed. Ar a-diwargine, ur-gammi-nikamalad iirmakosulid, degine, ur-gandikmalad egine iirmakosulid.
Ar ade, Bab-Jehová, anmar-idugedid. Ar Bab-Jehová, anmarga dummadga negdakmaidid. Ar Bab-Jehová, anmar-e-reyd. ¡E na anmar-abonogoedid!
”Asiria-ulumar-e-dub nollomakded. E-urmor-buar geg-nue-gwisgue egemakwichid, degine, e-urmormar geg argaed. E-isdarmaladi, degi, dule-muya-muyamaladse-bakale, ei ibmar atursamaloed.
Ar Bab-Dummad bela dulemar-Siónʼgi-mamaid-e-isgued osulogoed, degine, bipisaale dule-gwensak sogosulid: ‘An uelleye.’ ”
Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad, gayaburba-itogega wese be walikgudamar. Dulamar, nue-bogimakar be itomar. Napneg-naid, nue itogo. Bela-egi-ibmar-bukwamalad, nue-itomarmogo. Napneg-bipirmaknaidgi-bukmalad, bela itomogo. Bela-napneggi-ibmar-sanmakedi, nue-itomarmogo.
Bab-Jehová, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladse bela urwemaid. Amar-sorda-bila-onomaladse bela urwemaid. Bab-Dummad, bela bemar-obeloged sogmaid, bela bemar-ogiloged sogmaid.
Dule-girgumaloedi, bela omiledoed, e-muimar nunusaila yapatoed, e-ablismar yalaganba suurmakdoed.
Niismar-mogir-imbaba-nanaid bar daklegosulid, bela mogir atudoed. Igi garda obipirmakledae, mogir deyob guoed. Bela niismar-e-dakarmakmalad berguoed. Uva-sapi-gagan-dinguddaedyobi, dakle naoed. Higuera-sapigi e-san-dingusnai-daedyobi, dakle naoed.
Bab-Jehová weyob sogye: “Bato mogir-imbaba, an-es-suid guagwar naid. Be dakmalana, Edom-dulemargi es-suid igi-gwichigudani be dake, ar an we-dulemar bela ogilogoye sogsad.”
Bab-Jehová-e-es-suid bela ablisbi naid, sibad-omemar-ablisgi obagwar naid, sibad-wawaad-senigana-ablisgi obagwar naid. Bela e-es-suidgi e-gwallu darwagwar magaled. Sibad-wawaad-machered-mirwa-gwallugi darwagwar magaled. Ar Bab-Jehová, Edom-yargi Bosra-neggweburgi ibmar-durgan oburgwenaid. Edom-yalagi ibmar-durgan yeer ogilonaid.
Moli-bebe-nikad-ursirmalad egi gwichigudmaloed. Moli-bebe-nikad-sapingana, degi, moli-bebe-nikad-machergan egi gwichigudmaloed. Edom-yalagi ablisbi bipirmaknai guoed, e-napagi, e-gwallumarbi neg-ganai guoed.
Ar ade, Bab-Jehováʼga buged-imaked-iba gued, buged-saed-birga gued, adi, Sión-yala bendaklegegar.
Edom-yar-e-dianmala baryaga binnidoed, e-ukub, azufreʼyob uediki naguoed, barya-uedikidyobi diopisuli napa naguoed.
Bane-bane barya uediki-ganaidbi guoed, gwen akinnosulid, e-waa bupurmagwichidbi guoed. E-yala degisadegu ollobi-nai guoed, bipisaale, bar dulemar egi iirmakosurmalad.
Noomargii-daklemalad egi neg-egwannoed, akwanuku-negga gudoed. Egine, irmonmar e-uu sobdoed, degi, sikwisichimar e-uu urbidoed. Bab-Dummadi we-yala bela gagaoed, degi, walagwen-ollobi-selenai imakoed.
Dule-nuga-nikamalad-sate guoed, yalaye bar bilegosulid. Bela dule-gandikmalad bar daklegosulid.
E-reynegmargine ikomarbi bipirmakdoed, e-neg-gandikmaladgi dakemar-sunnabi bipirmakdoed, degi, gagan-iko-ikomaladbi engudoed. Achu-sapur-uaya-gannagana-e-negga gudoed, nuu-dummad-malisuigan-megega gudoed.
Nega-dulesulidganba ibmar-durgan-ursilimalad-bukwadi, achu-sapurmarbo atodoed. Sibad-sapurmar, e-sordaganse gotemaloed. Irmon agi ambikumarmogoed, a-neggine signonimaloed.
A-neggine, irmonmar e-uu soboed, degi, e-akwamar urbidoed. E-sakan-urbali, nuekwa e-akwamar urboed, nuekwa e-mimmigan akoed. Agine, mulamar ambikumogoed, abirgunar-abirgunar ambikumogoed.
Bab-Jehová-gardase be idako, agi be nue-absogo: “Bipisaale we-ibmar-durgan gwen beosulid, abirgin-abirgin egad-egad nikamaloed. Ar Bab-Jehová-sunnagwad igar weyob uksad, Bab-Dummad-Burba weyob oambikusad.
Ar Bab-Dummad ega negmar amisad, ega yala uksad. Degisadegu, wemar we-yalagi bukwa gumaloed, degisadegu, egi gudii gumaloed.”
Nega-dulesulid weligwale itodoed, napa-dinnagwad weligwale itodoed, nega-dulesulidgi gagan ainidoed, dutu-achunnedyob dakledoed.
Bela nega-dulesulid weligwar itodoed. Ar Bab-Dummadi nega-dulesulidga Líbano-yalayobi neg-dakle imakoed. Degi, igi Carmelo-yala daklege, deyobi, neg-dakle ega imakoed. Igi Sarón-neba yeerdaklege, deyobi, neg-dakle ega nasikoed. Ar Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-yeerdakleged dakmaloed. Anmar-Bab-Dummad-e-gangued bela dakmaloed.
Dule-argan-nollo-itomalad, be ogannomarsun. Yokor-wanwanmalad, be ogannomarsun.
Dule-dobeganaga weyob be sogmar: “Gandik be samala, melle be dobgumar. Be-Bab-Dummad danikoed, bemarga buged-imakega danikoed. Bab-Dummad-sunnagwad bemar-bendaknonikoed.”
Geb degine, dulemar-aku-atakmalad magar atakdemaloed, dule-uaya-yallirmalad magar dule-itoge gumaloed.
Geb deginbali, dule-muya-muyamalad, goe-sapuryob ichomake gumaloed. Dule-geg-sunmakmalad, weligwaledba binnasuli gotemaloed. Ar nega-dulesulidganba diimar suurmakdoed, nega-dinnaganba diimar aryodagoed.
Napa-dinnagana dii egi sigega an imakoed. Neg-dinnagana-naigusadgi, ibe makumakar aryogwichioed. Achu-sapur-uaya-gannagan e-negga-gusadgi, nargammugi-daklemaladbi guoed, degi, naiwargi-daklemalad-negga guoed.
Agine, igar-dummadsaar mai guoed. A-igar, Igar-Islidikidye bilegoed. Dule-isgudimalad egi gwen nanaosulid. Dulemar-uaya-satedamalad egi gwen iirmakosurmogad. Unnila dulemar we-Igarbarbi-nanadimaladbi egi nanamaloed.
Bipisaale, agi achumigur-nono-wawaad gwen nika-guosulid, ibmar-durgan-dulegi-aibined ese gwen nonikosurmogad. Ibmar-degimalad gwen daklegosulid, unnila dulemar-bendaklesmaladbi iirmakmai guoed.
Bab-Jehováʼgi dulemar-bendaklesmaladbi, gannar Sión-yalase yeer-itogedgi dognonimaloed. Weligwale itodmaloed, yeer itodmaloed. Bukib-binsaedi egi yoggudoed, wiles-itogedi egi yoggudbaloed. Bela weligwaledbi itodmaloed.
Rey-Ezequías birgambe-gakabakegus (14) Judá-yalagi negsemaidgi, Asiria-e-rey-Senaquerib bela Judá-neggweburmar-sakdigar-bukmaladgi gwisgunonikid. Geb bela, Senaquerib, a-neggweburmar sunonikid.
Asiria-e-rey-Senaquerib, Laquis-neggwebur-akale, sordamar-e-dummadi, sorda-bukidaradmala, Jerusalén-neggweburse Rey-Ezequíasʼbo sunmaknaega, barmisad. Jerusalén-neggwebur-mosmargu, Morsan-Odoleged-Neg-siid-igarba Nakwale-Dian-Maid-e-gammu-yoid-nagaba ambikudapmalad.
Agine, Rey-Ezequías-neg-dakdiid-Eliaquim, Asiria-sorda-bukmaladse nonigusad. Degi, neg-gusmalad-narmaked-Sebna, degine, rey-sikwi-Joa, eba nonigusmarmogad. Eliaquimʼde, Hilcías-machid. Rey-sikwi-Joaʼdi, Asaf-machid.
Degi, Asiria-sordamar-e-dummad amarga sogded: —Rey-Ezequíasʼga be sogmalo, weyob Asiria-dulemar-e-rey-gandik-maid sogye: ‘¿Ar doagi be nue-bensurye be soge?
Bede soged, binsaed an nue-nikaye, sorda-bila-onomalad an nue-nikabarye. Ar unnila binsa gayaginbi be ee gordiid. ¿Ar be doagi-bensurye be soge, emide be anba ibmar imakbisulid?
An be-dakedi, Egipto-yar gaapoled-masar-darga-darga-daklegedyobidgi be bensuli an be-dakdo. Ar dule, aba-naile, sunna e-argangi e-darga-dargadgi makleged. Ar we-masar, Egipto-dulemar-e-rey-Faraón gued. Bela-dulemar-egi-bensurmaladga deyob ega gued.
Be anga sogele: An-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼgi an bensurye. Ar degitega, e-neg-matusurmalad, e-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailamar, Ezequíasʼde obelossursi. Judáʼginmaladga, degi, Jerusalénʼginmaladga sogsasursi: ¿Unnila we-neg-matusulid-Jerusalén-neggweburgi-siidginbi Bab-Dummad-Jehová-nug-odummomaloye?’
”Emisgwa, an bega sogo, an-dummad-Asiria-e-rey-ebo be igar-omes: Dule-moligi-nanamalad be amiele, an bega molimar milibo (2,000) ukoed.
Degi-inigwele, an-sorda-dummadsulid be osikirmakosulid. Ar bede, Egipto bega, e-moli-urmar, degi, bega e-sorda-moligi-sii-urwemalad, ukoye be soged.
Ar andega wese, ¿Bab-Jehová-sogedba bemar-obelogega danisur be an-dake? Eye, Ar Bab-Jehová anga sogsad: ‘We-yarse be naoye, be we-yar obelogoye.’ ”
Degine, Eliaquim, Sebna, degi, Joa, weyob Asiria-sordamar-e-dummad-abin sogdemalad: —Be-maimarga wis Arameo-gayaba be sunmake, ar anmar mag-itomalad. Mer anmarga Hebreo-gayaba be sunmake, ar dulemar galu-matusulidgi-bukmalad anmar-itobukwad.
Asiria-sordamar-e-dummad ega sogded: —Ar an-dummadde, ¿unnila bemargarbi ibmar-sogega an-barmiarsi? ¿Be-dummadgarbi ibmar-sogega an-barmiarbarsi? ¿Ar dulemar-galu-matusulidgi-bukmaladga-sogega an-barmiarbarsursi? Ar bemaryobi, we-dulemarde dukin e-ibmar-isgana na gunmaloed, dukin e-winsus na gobmaloed.
Geb degine, sordamar-e-dummad gwichibin-imaksad, geb binnasuli Hebreo-gayaba goted: —Asiria-e-rey-gandik-maid-e-gayaburba be itomar.
Weyob rey soged: ‘Melle Ezequíasʼse yamolemalo. Ezequías amba angi naosulid, anse oitolegoed.
Ezequías bemarga sokardibe: Bab-Jehováʼgi mer be bengumarye, Bab-Jehová anmar-bendakoye. Asiria-e-rey we-neggwebur obelogosurye. Melle be Ezequías-itomalo.’
”Ar weyob Asiria-e-rey soged: ‘Anbo igar nabomar, anse be dagmar. Geb bemar gannar be-nainumargi uva-naid be gundii gumaloed, higuera-sapi-e-san be gundii gumarbaloed. Degine, bemar be-diagi na be dii-gobdii gumaloed.
Geb sorba, bemargadyob-yar-daklegedse an bemar-nidoed, orosgi-dakleged-yalase an bemar-nidoed, vino-yalase, madu-yalase, degi, uvaʼmar-nainu-yalase, an bemar-nidoed.
” ’Melle be Ezequías-itomalo, ar yamo bemar-yamogoed, bemarga sogdagoed: Bab-Jehová anmar-bendakoye. ¿Ar yar-bamalad-e-bab-dummagande, Asiria-e-rey-annik bemarga yar-susa be daksi?
Ar Hamat-e-bab-dummadi, Arfad-e-bab-dummadi, Sefarvaim-e-bab-dummadi, Hena-e-bab-dummadi, gwen Samaria-neggwebur angi sussurmalad.
Degite, ¿bitid-yar-bamalad-e-bab-dummagan bemar-yar-angi-suega angi obicha be dake? Ar degitega, ¿igi-Bab-Jehováʼde Jerusalén-neggwebur-bendakoye be binsasunna? Bendakosuli.’ ”
Degine, dulemar, abin boo bukusad, bipisaale gwen-abin-imaksasurmalad, ar ade, Rey-Ezequías ega weyob igar-uksad: “Melle abin-imakmaloye.”
Geb degine, reyneg-dakdiid-Eliaquim Hilcías-e-machi, degi, ibmar-gusmalad-narmaked-Sebna, degine, reyga-garda-narmaked-Asaf-machi-Joa mor-dubamakagwale Rey-Ezequíasʼse nadmalad, adi, oyogega, ede bukib-binsamarye. Geb bela Asiria-sordamar-e-dummad-ega-ibmar-sogsad, Rey-Ezequíasʼga sogdapmalad.
Rey-Ezequías deyob ibmar-itosgua, e-mor-yoid siir-siir imaksad. Geb wile-itoged-mor yosad. Geb Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negse naded.
Degi geb Rey-Ezequías, dummad-reyneg-dakdiid-Eliaquim, degi, ibmar-gusad-narmaked-Sebna, degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-sergan wile-itoged-mor-yoyoi, Amoz-machi-Isaías-daknamalaga barmisad. Isaíasʼde, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogedid.
Isaíasʼga sognonimalad: “Weyob Rey-Ezequías soged: ‘Emi-iba-naidi, suli-suli-itoged-iba naid, sabsur-odurdakleged-iba naid, degine, bingegued-dummad-iba naid. Igi ome muu-neggi-nagudele, na abagan-nollo-naddae, deyob emi-iba naid.
” ’Bitigine, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, Asiria-sordamar-e-dummad-ibmar-sogsadi, bela itosana gadin. Ar ade, Asiria-e-rey, e-sorda-dummad, Bab-Dummad-Dula-Maidgi-dodoar-sunmakega barmiar gusad. ” ’Bitigine, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, we-dule-gayaburba-itosadba sabsur-odurdaksunnana gadin. Bab-Dummadse Israel-dulemar-napi-gudimaladga be gorsun.’ ”
Rey-Ezequías-e-dummagan Isaíasʼse nadmargu,
Isaías ega sokalid: “Weyob be-dummadga be sogmalo: ‘Bab-Jehová weyob sogye: Be we-dule-ibmar-soge-itosadgine, Asiria-e-rey-e-dummagan angi ise-yolegar-sunmaksadgine, mer be gwayo.
¡Be dako! Senaquerib gayaburba-isgana-itogega an imakoed. Geb gannar e-yarse naoed. Geb e-yargi, es-suidgi oburgwemalaga an imakoed.’ ”
Asiria-sordamar-e-dummadi, Asiria-e-rey, Laquis-neggweburgi-mai-nadye-wisguargu, balimakde gusad. Libna-neggwebur-ebo bila-ononai Asiria-e-rey-dakdapid.
Geb agine, Rey-Senaquerib wisgualid, Etiopía-dulemar-e-rey-Tirhaca, ebo bila-onogega egi daniye. Deyob-wisguargua, gannar Rey-Ezequíasʼse dule-gayaburba-berbemalad barmisad,
ega sogegar: “Judá-e-rey-Ezequías, be-Bab-Dummad-egi-be-bensurgudiid bega-sogedi: ‘Asiria-e-rey Jerusalén-neggwebur suosurye.’ Mer be-Bab-Jehováʼse be yardaklego.
Ar Asiria-e-rey bela yarmar-obelos-gusadde be wisgussursi. Ar degite be, ¿san-onogo be itoge?
Ar an-babgan Gozán-neggwebur-obelosgusadi, Harán-neggwebur-obelosgusadi, Resef-neggwebur-obelosgusadi, Edén-wagan-Telasar-neggweburgi-bukwad-obelosgusbalidi, degitega, ¿e-bab-dummagan bendaksa be daksi?
Degite, ¿bia Hamat-dulemar-e-reyde, Arfad-dulemar-e-reyde, nadmarsunna? ¿Bia Sefarvaim-dulemar-e-reyde, Hena-dulemar-e-reyde, Iva-dulemar-e-reyde, nadmarsunna?”
Degine, Rey-Ezequías, dule-gayaburba-berbemalad-abin garda susad, geb absosad. Geb a-sorbali, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negse naded. Geb Bab-Jehová-asabin garda nallaa imaksad.
Geb degi, Ezequías weyopira Bab-Jehováʼse goted:
“Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nika-Maid, Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad, baliwiturmar-wagar-darbakegwad-abargi be negsemaid. Unnila bebi we-napneg-naid-e-Bab-Dummadga be gued. Be nibnega nasiksad, napnega be obinnisbalid.
Bab-Jehová-Dula-Maidye, nue be an-itoye, nue be anmar-gunaid be dakye. Igi Senaquerib begi ise-yolegar anga gayaburba-barmiali, nue be itoge.
”Bab-Jehová, ar nue napiragwa, Asiria-e-reymar we-neggweburmar, e-yarmar, obelosad.
E-bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad bela soogi-ogumaksabalid. Ar wemar Bab-Dummadsurmalad, suarmar-sobaled nanaed, akwa-sobarmalad nanaed. Dulemar sobsananaedid.
Emidi, Bab-Jehová, be-anmar-Bab-Dummadid, wis be we-dulegi anmar-bendake, adi, dulemar bela we-napneggi-bukmalad be-wisgumalaga, unnila beebi, Bab-Jehová wargwenna maiye.”
Geb degi, Amoz-machi-Isaías, Rey-Ezequíasʼse weyob gayaburba barmisad: “Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad, weyob soged: ‘Be anga Asiria-e-rey-Senaqueribʼgi ibmar-sogsadi, bela an be-itosye.
Ani an Bab-Jehová, weyob Rey-Senaqueribʼnik an soged: Senaquerib, Siónʼginmalad sae be-dakmalad, begi dodomalad. Jerusalénʼginmalad wakite-be-dakmargu, bega nono-ege-ege imakmalad.
Senaquerib, ¿doanik be isdar-sunmaksa? ¿Doagi be ise-dodoar-sunmaksa? ¿Doaga urwedgi be ibmar sogsa? ¿Doa-abin san-dummarba be itosa? Ar be Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwalednik be isdar sunmaksad.
Bega-gayaburba-berbemaladba be Bab-Jehováʼgi ise-yolegar sunmaksad. Weyob be sogsad: An-moli-ur-bila-onomaladgi Líbano-yar-dummagan-birigi an nakwisye. E-urwarmar-dummagan-bubukwad, ani an ei siksa naiye. E-baryawarmar-yeerdaklegwismaladi bela an ei immisye. E-yar-birse an nakwisye, e-neg-sergan-nanaid bela an ei wisgusbarye.
Dule-baigan-yargi, ani an dii-yaamar urbisye, we-diimar an gobsaye. An-nanaedba, bela Egipto-diwarmar an odinnosye.
” ’Senaquerib, ¿ar be wissursi? Ar bato an dikasurgus we-ibmarmar-guoed an ega igar mesisad. Bato yola-birgabargus weyob-imakega an igar amisad. Emisgwa, geb an we-ibmarmar oyoalid. Aga be nabir neggwebur-sakdigar-bukmalad be obelos nanaed.
E-dulemar gaganmar-naiyob be-abin naded, gwen be-abin imaksasulid, be-abin nollo nadmalad. Be-abin bingegudmalad. Amarde nainugi gagan-dutugana-naiyob, be-abin nadmalad. Neg-uas-birgi-gagan-ainialir dinguddaeyob, be-abin nadegusmalad.
” ’An nue bela-belad be-wisid, sanase be signonidae, sanagwadse be aineba naddabali. Sanagwadse be dognonidabali. Deginbali, sanadgine be angi isdar-sunmakardabali, bela an nue be-wisid.
Ar be, an-annik sunmaksadi, be-angi-apor-sunmaksadi, an bela itosad. Degisoggu, be-asugi esgoro-wardummad an yooed, mer bar be sunmakega be-gaya an edinnoed. Degine, bia be danigusa, gannar a-igarba an be-barmidoed.’ ”
Isaías, Rey-Ezequíasʼga weyob soged: “Rey-Ezequías, we-ibmarmar bega e-wilubga guoed: We-birgagine, ibmar-gwag-gwen-diglessuli-ainiardaed be gunmaloed. Baid-birgasega, ibmar-gwag-diglessulid-sanmakoedi amba be gunmarbaloed. Geb birgapaasedina, sunna ibmar-gwaggi be arbamaloed, degi, nabir be weemarbaloed. Sunna uvaʼgi be arbamaloed, degi, geb nabir e-san be gunmaloed.
Judá-wagan-abala-san-onosmaladi sapi-malimar-ainiardaedyobi, gannar ainidagoed, e-anagan gannar nikudoed.
Ar Jerusalén-neggweburgi wis ichee dulemar bedapoed, amba Sión-yargi bukumaloed. Ar Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad e-dulamargi-bela-bela-sabgued-nikadba, we-ibmar imakoed.”
Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová, Asiria-e-reynik weyob soged: “Senaquerib we-neggweburse gwen dogosurguoed. We-neggweburgi sigu-wargwensaar miosulid. We-dule, bila-onogega we-neggweburse sigu-abgaedyalaba gwen urwosulid. Deginbali, neggwebur-galu-matusulid-dikarba, gwen napa-nakwemaid imakosulid.
Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi, an soged: We-dule, gebe-danigusadba gannar naoed. We-neggweburgi gwen dogosurguoed.
”An we-neggweburgi nued-binsasoggu, an-mai-Davidʼgi nued-binsabarsoggu, we-neggwebur an bendakoed, we-neggwebur an obelogosulid.”
A-mutikidgine, Bab-Jehová-e-baliwitur, Asiria-sorda-bukwadgine, mili-dulabakebak-gakatar (185,000) dulemar-ogilosad. Degine, neg-oiboargu, bela dulemar burgwar-mamaitibi oiboalid.
Degidgine, geb Asiria-rey-Senaquerib nadegusad, gannar Nínive-neggweburse nonigusad, agine megidapid.
Ibagwengi, Rey-Senaquerib bab-dummad-Nisrocʼse-goled-neggi, e-bab-dummadse-gorsiidgi, e-masmala Adramelec, degi, Sarezer, es-suidgi Senaquerib-oburgwismalad. Geb agine, Ararat-yalase wakitegusmalad. Senaquerib-sorbali, e-machi-Esar-Hadón yar-sesad.
A-ibagangine, Ezequías bela-bela nailikgumai burgwednaga gusad. Geb Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Isaías Amoz-e-machi, Ezequías-dakega ese nade gusad. Degi, ega sogdapid: “Bab-Jehová weyob soged: ‘Be bar-gwisguosurye, be burgoye. Degisoggu, be-neg-yaginmaladga igargan napi-nue be ukoye.’ ”
Geb degine, Ezequías, galusik aibilisa imaksad. Weyob, Bab-Jehováʼse isedar-gollar imaksad:
“Bab-Jehováʼye, be an-ebinsao. Andi be-sogedba bega arbasad. Napiragwadba an beba nanasad. Be-ibmar-abegedba andi bega ibmar imaksad.” Degi Ezequías bela-belad isedar-boale meremai gusad.
Geb degine, Isaíasʼse Bab-Jehová-gayaburba nonikid, ega weyob sognonikid:
“Ezequíasʼse be nae, ega be sogo: ‘Bab-Jehová, be-dad-dummad-David-e-Bab-Dummad weyob sogye: Anse be gochadi, bela an be-itosye, be-ibyanis-aryosadi an daksabarye. Degiirdi, birgambe-gakatar (15) napi-gudii-guega an be-imakoye.
Asiria-e-reygi an be-ollorsaoed, we-Asiria-neggwebur-e-reygi an be-bendakoed. Ani an, we-neggwebur-irwa gwisguoed.’ ”
Geb Isaías, Ezequíasʼga sogded: “Bab-Jehová-bega-ibmar-sogsad mag be dakegala, we-ibmar-wilub Bab-Jehová bega oyogoed:
Acaz-wachi an gannar sorsik wachi-irgwen-wilub osikirmakoed.” Geb agine, dad-ibeler-naidi gannar wachi-irgwen-wilub sorsik sikirmaksad.
Judá-e-rey-Ezequías, nailikgumaigusad-sorbali, gwisgusgua, weyob garda narmaksad:
“An weyob sogmai gusad: ‘¿An nabir-gudiid-ibagangi nue-an-burgwesunnode? ¿Burgwed-galuse an megnaedgadsunde? ¿Bar an wegi daklegosuli gusunnode?’
An sogsabalid: ‘We-napneggi bar an Bab-Jehová-dakosulid. We-napneggi-dulemar-bukwad bar an dakosurbalid.’
