An-annik an-neg susmalad, urwedigi an-annik susmalad. Sibad-wawaad-edarbed-e-dordoneg-obipirmaklegeyobi an-neg imaksamalad. Dule-mormaked, mor-maknaiyobi be an-san imaksad. Emide, Bab-Dummad, mor-maknaid-bergusadgi-e-dikarmar-sike-sike-imaklegeyobi an-imaksad. An-ibagan baisursunna be obelononikid.
Ogormaksii an neg-oiboalid. Achumigur-nono-wawaad-garmar-bibisgeyobi an-imaknonikid. Irgwennaar be an-obelononikid.
Wirsob-boedyobi an bosad, nuu-dabgalayob-dakleged-boedyobi an bosad, nuu-sibu-uurmakedyobi an bosad. An-ibya niba-atakedbali, yegusad. Bab-Jehová an suli-suli-itogusad, be an-bendakdage.
”Ar ¿igi bar an sogosunna? Ar e-sunnagwad anga sogsad. Ar deyob imaksado. Ulubgi an-isdar-itogedi, bar gabbisuli an-imaksad.
Bab-Jehová, be-sogedbali dulemar dula gudidimalad. An deyobi be-sogedba an dula-gudii gumogoed. Bee be, anga san nudaksad, bee be, anga burba uksad.
An suli-suli-itosad, emidi, an bogidik itoged. Be an-sabedbali yaa-dummad-dule-obelogedgi be an-bendaksad, begi isgussuliyob be an-daksad.
Neg-uan-mamaidi, gwen be-nug ogannogosulid. Dule-burgwarmaladi, gwen be-nug odummosulid. Dule-yaa-dummadse-batemamaidi, be-innikigwadba-daedgi gwen sunmakosurmalad.
Unnila dula-gudimaladi, be-nug-ogannoged, igi an emi-ibagi be-ogannoge, deyob be-ogannomarmogad. Bela babgan na e-mimmiganga be-innikidaedgi sunmakmaloed.
”Bab-Jehová an-abonogoed. Degisoggu, anmar bane-bane Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neggi, igar-dub-nikamaladba namakmaloed.”
Geb degi, Isaías sogded: —Higo-san ollimakmalo, geb rey-abagangi yaa-siidgi be mage-mage imakmalo. Agine nabir nugudoed.
Geb degi, Ezequías, Isaíasʼga sokalid: —An nabir Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negse naknaega, ¿ibi-wilubgi nabir magar an daksale?
A-ibagangine, Babilonia-e-rey-Merodac-Baladán, Rey-Ezequíasʼse dule-gayaburba-berbemalad barmisad. Amarba Ezequíasʼga garda barmisad, degi, ibmar-binsa-ega-ukleged ega barmisbalid. Merodac-Baladánʼde, Baladán-e-machid. Ar Merodac-Baladánʼde wisgusgusad, Ezequías bela-bela-nailikgumaidi, emidi, nue-nugunoniye.
Ezequías weligwaledgi we-dulemar-abindaksad, degine, dule-gayaburba-berbemaladga, bela e-ibmar-nuegan-gargerbamalad-bukwad oyosad: Manimar, ormar, ina-wawadikmalad, olivo-gwallu-wawadikmalad, degi, bila-onogedgi-ibmar-ebulemalad-sabolebukwad bela oyosbalid. Degine, bela ibmar-nuegan-sabolebukwad-neggi ega ibmarmar oyosbalid. Ezequías, e-negsemaidgi bela e-neggi-ibmarmar-bukwad, oyosad.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Isaías, Rey-Ezequías-daknaded. Geb ega sogdapid: —¿Bia we-dulemar daniki? ¿Ar igi bega we-dulemar soge? Geb Ezequías ega sogded: —We-dulemar dikasur danimalad. Babilonia-neggwebur-akale an-dakega danimalad.
Geb gannar Isaías, Ezequíasʼga sogded: —¿Ibu be-negyagi daksamala? Ezequías abin-sogded: —Bela an-negyagi ibmar-bukwad daksamala. Bela ibmarmar-bukwad an ega oyosad.
Geb degi, Isaías, Ezequíasʼga sogdesunnad: —Nue Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-e-gayaburba be itogo:
‘Ibagan danikoed, bela be-neggi-ibmarmar-bukwadi, bela be-dadgan-emi-ibase-ibmar-urbisadi, Babilonia-yarse seledoed. Bipisaale ibmar gwen beosulid.
Be-mimmigan-abala, be-wagan-abala, Babilonia-e-reyneggi maiga-guega seledmaloed.’ Deyobi Bab-Jehová soged.
Geb Ezequías, Isaíasʼga sogded: —Nueddo. Bab-Jehová-gayaburba be anga sognonikidi, yeer an itodo. Ar Ezequías e-ulubgindi binsasad: “Amba an-maidgine, neg nueganbi, degi, bogidik-nai guoed.”
Anmar-Bab-Dummad soged: “An-dulamar-e-gwage ogannomar, baisur-ito be imakmar.
Jerusalén-dulemarga nue-sabedgi be sunmakmar, ega be sogmar: ‘Be maiga-arbadigusmalad-ibagan wese bergunoniye, be-isgusmalad bato bega bennuklesye. Bemar isgusad-nukad unniguar bato ilabo-wilub sabsur-odurdaklesye. Bab-Jehová bemarga isgued elisye.’ ”
Gayaburba binnasuli goled, weyob soged: “Bab-Jehováʼga nega-dulesulidganba igar mayemar, anmar-Bab-Dummadga nega-dinnaganba igar swilidik mesmar.
Bela nebagan swilidik imakmarsun, yalamar, degi, neg-mullugana omatolesun. Degine, napa-muru-muru-mamaid innikii imakmarsun, igar-bire-bire-mamaid innikii imakmarsun.
Agine geb Bab-Jehová-e-gandikid-yeerdakleged bela dulemarga oyolegoed.” Ar Bab-Jehová-sunnagwad deyob sogsad.
Gayaburba weyob soged: “Binnasuli be soge.” An ega weyob soged: “¿Ibu an binnasuli sogosunna?” Geb anga soged: “Bela dulemarga be soge: ‘Dulemar gaganyobi gued. E-yeerdaklegedi, nainugi-dutu-achunneyobi gued.
Bab-Jehová-e-buu-imaked egi nasale, gagan baisur-dinguddaed, dutumala, baisur-dinguddamogad. Ar dulemar gagan-ara-aramaladyobi gued.
Gaganmala baisur-dinguddaed, dutumala, baisur-dinguddamogad. Ar anmar-Bab-Dummad-Gayaburbadi, degisadegu maiguad, berguosulid.’ ”
Bab-Dummad sogded: “Sión-yalagi be nakwenae, gayaburba-nuegangi be sunmaknae. Yala-matusulidse be nakwenae, Jerusalén-neggweburga, gayaburba-nuegangi be sunmaknae. Ise-gandikidba be sunmaknae, binnasuli be sunmako, melle be dobe itogo. Judá-neggweburmarga be soge: ‘Be nue-dakmar. Wegi anmar-Bab-Dummad-danikid be dakmar.’
”Bab-Jehová-gandikidba-danikid, be dakmar. Bab-Jehová e na negsemaid. E-dulamar-ollor-imaksadi, ebali nidanikid. Ibidar-nued-amisadi eba sedanikid.
Bab-Jehová e-dulamar-bendakdanikid. Igi sibad-wawaad-edarbedi, e-sibad-wawaad-mimmi nakwaa imakdae, geb e-binasgargi semaidae, degi, sibad-wawaad-milesmalad nue nimaidae. Deyobi, Bab-Jehová e-dulamar bendakdanikid.”
¿Doa dii-naid e-argangi wilubsasa? ¿Doa mogir-naid e-goomargi wilub-imaksa? ¿Doa ibmar-wilubsaedgi ukub-naid urbisa? ¿Doa ibmar-wilubsaedgi yar-dummagan wilubsasa? ¿Doa ibmar-wilubsaedgi yar-mullugana wilub-imaksa?
¿Doa Bab-Jehová-E-Burba bela balamioe? ¿Doa ega binsaed-ukedga guoe?
¿Ar doase Bab-Jehová ibmar-magar-itogega binsaed-amissunna? ¿Ar doa igar-inniki-imaked-igarba Bab-Jehová-odurdaksasunna? ¿Doa ega ibmar-nue-wisigued uksasunna? ¿Doa binsaed-nikaa-daed-igarba Bab-Jehová-odurdaksasunna? Suli, dule bipisaale wegiid-igarba Bab-Jehová-odurdaksasulid.
Ar dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladi, Bab-Jehová-asabinni unnila bormoyagi dii-gwagwen-argwachayobi gumalad. Degi, ibmar-wilubsalegedgi ukub-ichesaar wilubsalegedyob gumalad. Ar Bab-Jehová dupgan-nanaidi, ukub-buru-aidikueyobi daked.
Líbano-yargi-sapanmar-nikadi, Babga-ibmar-ogumaklegedgi-ebulegega unnisulid. Líbano-e-ibmar-durgan-nikadi, Bab-Dummadga-ogumaklegega, unnisurbalid.
Bab-Jehová-asabinni, bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladi, ibigwensuli gumalad. Egala, gwen ibmar-nuedga gusulid.
¿Doa-ebo be Bab-Dummad-wilubdakoe? ¿Ibu-ibmar-sobaledbo be wilub-imakoe?
Dule-ibmar-sobmaladi, esgorogi ibmar-bab-dummadyob-imakleged sobmalad. A-sorba, dule-or-sobedi, a-ibmar-birgi or-nasikmalad, geb ega manidubmar sobbalid.
Ar dule-wilegeddi, e-bab-dummad-sobega suar-gege-nunguedi amied. A-sorbali, dule-wileged, dule-ibmar-nued-sobed amied. Adi, ega nuekwaa suar-bab-dummadyob sobega, melle ege-ege gwisguegar.
¿Ar ade, bemar wissurmarsi? ¿Bemar itossurmarsi? ¿Bato gebesailagine bemarga soglessursi? ¿Napneg-nagusad-akar bemar odurdaklessurmarsi?
Ar Bab-Jehováʼdi napneg-dirbir-naidbirgi negdaksiid, dulemar-bukwadi sesmaryobi ega gued, bai daksulid. Bab-Jehová mor-dummad-nallaa-imaklegedyobi mogir-imaked. Bab-Jehová mor-neg-egalegedyobi, mogir-billi egadaed, adi, egi megegar.
Bab-Jehová, dule-gandikmalad obelodaed. Dule napneggi-dummadga-negsemamaidi, ibmar-isganayobi obeloged.
A-dummagan sapiwar-nue-diglessuliyobi gumalad, ibmar-gwag-nue-diglessuliyobi gumalad, sapi-saila napa-yaba e-malimar-nue-ainissulidyobi gumalad. Ar Bab-Jehová egi buu-imakdele, dingudmaloed, ar gagan-dinnaganayobi burwa-dummadba seledoed.
Bab-Jehová-Isligwaled weyob soged: “Degite, ¿doabo bemar an-wilubdakmalosunna? ¿Doa anyobi-daklege gusunna?”
Niba be nue atakmar, ¿doa bela we-ibmarmar obinnisa? Bab-Jehová e na niisgwamar-onied, sog-soggwen ilemaked, e-nugbali ese goled. Bab-Jehová-e-ganguedi, ibiyobi dummarba gue. E-garganguedi, ibiyobi gandiki negsemai.
Jacob-wagan, ¿ibiga be Bab-Jehová-dikarba sunmake? Israel-dulemar, ¿ibiga be urwakwaa Bab-Jehová-dakmala? Be sogmalad: “An-igarmar Bab-Jehováʼgi dukumaiye. An-Bab-Dummad an-ibmar-imaked baisurdakye.”
¿Ar ade, be wissursi? ¿Be wisgussursi? Ar Bab-Jehová Bab-Dummad-degisadeguadid, napneg-bipirmaknaid bela obinnisadid, budar-itoged nikasulid, gege geggubalid, e-nue-ibmar-wisidi, gege balamileged.
Bab-Jehová dule-yegusmaladga gangued uked, E na dule-nollo-itomaladga gandikidba gangued uked.
Sapingana dutusur-inigwele, geggusdamalad, budar-itogusdamalad. Masmala yoleddamalad, aimukuddamalad.
Degi-inigwele, dule-Bab-Jehováʼgi-bensurmaladdi, gannarse gangued nikumaloed, sulubagi-gukueyobi gumaloed: Abarmakdii gumaloed, gwen gegguosurmalad, igala-suid-nanadii gumaloed, gwen gegguosurmalad.
Bab-Dummad weyob soged: “Neggwebur-demar-gakaba-bukmalad, bogi an-abin ambikumalo. Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad, gandik be imakmar. Walikaa be dagmar, be sunmakmar. Anmar igar-nabogega ambikumar.
”¿Doa dad-nakwedsik, dule-gusgu-emargi-obinmaid wese-dagega imaksa? ¿Doa we-dulega dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad urmaksa? ¿Doa reymar-seega imaksa? ¿Doa ukub-milegeyobi es-suidgi dulemar-obelogega imaksa? ¿Doa e-warsi-abin-ibmar-durgan-mileddaedyob dulemar-imaksa?
Gwen nanadisulid-igarba, binnasuli dule-balegindanikid.
¿Doa weyob imaksa? ¿Doa nabir we-ibmar bursuli-guega imaksa? ¿Doa gebesailaunni dulamar-ainakwedanikidse gocha? Ani an Bab-Jehová guedi, bela we-ibmarmar imaksad. Ani an gebesailaginedid, ani an berguedse gudii gubaloed.
”Neggwebur-demar-gakaba-bukmaladi, dani-daksamalad, dobe-itodmalad. Napneg-naid-ugakaase abin giglimakded. Bato egi danimalad, bato walikgusmalad.
Muchub-muchub e-aimar-bendakdemalad, muchub-muchub burba-ogannodmalad.
Dule-ibmar-sobedi, dule-orgi-arbaed ogannoged. Dule-mardogi-ibmar-sobedi, dule-esgorogi-arbaed-ogannoged, ega weyob soged: ‘Arbaed-nued be imaksa.’ Geb sorba, ibmar-sobaled-bab-dummadyob-imakleged nue-esgorogi bioked, adi, melle ege-ege gwisguegar.”
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “Israel, bedi an-maiga gued. Be, Jacob-wagan, an bemar-susadid, An-ai-Abraham-wagan be gumalad.
Ar napneg-naid-ugakaase an be-susad, nega-sukungan-dikasulidba an bese gochad. An bega sogsad: ‘Be an-maiga gued.’ Ani an be-susad, an be-obachasulid.
Melle be gwayo. An beba gudiguad. Melle be suli-suli-itogo. Ani an be-Bab-Dummadid. An be-ogannogoed, an be-bendakoed, an-sakwa-gandikid-nuedsikidgi an be-ganikioed.
”Dule-isdar-be-dakmaladi, bingegudmaloed, nug-mesagwar gudmaloed. Dule-begi-gwisgudimaladi, bela bergudoed, gudisurmaladyobi naoed.
Be be-isdarmalad-amidiguo-inigwele, gwen be amiosulid. Bebo-bila-onomaladi, bela bergudoed, gudisurmaladyobi naoed.
Ar ani an be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová gued. An be-argan-nuedsikid-ganikidid. Ani an bega soged: ‘Melle be gwayo, ani an be-bendakoed.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Bemar-Israel-dulemar ichee-gue-inigwele, melle be gwayemalo. Bemar-Jacob-wagan-gandik-gusur-inigwele, melle be gwayemalo. Ar an-sunnagwad an be-bendakoed. Ani an Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaled gued. Ar an be-Bendakedid.
”Ibmar-gwag-egwaed-binidyobi an be-imakmaloed, e-nugar-abinbela-datarmakar-nikayobi an be-imakmaloed. Yarmar be obelogoed, swana be imakoed. Yar-mullugana gaganbi naguega be imakoed.
Oros-gwag-burwaba-mileddaedyobi be imakoed. Burwa-noedba aisakidmaloed. Ar bedi, angi weligwar itogoed. Bedi, angi Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaledgi nug-gannarba itomaloed.”
Bab-Dummad sogdebalid: “Dule-wilemalad, degi, dule-ibmar-abesa-gudimalad, gobega dii amididamalad, degi-inigwele, amidasurmalad. Uku-uku-itogedba gwabin-dinna itogusdamalad. Degi-inigwele, ani Bab-Jehová-guedgi an amar-itogoed. Ani an Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-guedgi, an amar walagwen metosulid.
Yalamar-biribali, diwarmar-iirmakega an imakoed, nebaganba ibemargi-dii-aryogega an imakoed, nega-dulesulidganba dii-ambikuega an imakoed. Neg-dinnaganba ibemar-aryomai an imakoed.
Nega-dulesulidganbali, urwarmar, acacia-sapimar, an digoed. Baryawarmar, degine, olivo-sapimar an digoed. Napa-isganagi, ciprés-sapimar an digoed, pino-warmar, degi, abeto-sapimar an digoed.
Adi, dulemar dakega, degi, wisgumalaga, egi binsamalaga, degi, magar-itomalagar, Bab-Jehová we-ibmarmar-imaksaye, Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaledi, we-ibmarmar obinnisye.”
Bab-Jehová Jacob-dulemar-e-Rey, ibmar-sobaled-bab-dummadyobi-imaklemaladga sogded: “Be-igar be sogmardo. E-wilubmar be oyomardo.
Wese be dagmar, ibmar-guoed be sogmar. Gebesailagi ibmarmar-gusnanaedi, anmarga be soge, anmar egi binsaegar, degi, ibmar-gusadi, anmar magar-itomalagar. Igi-neg-guoe anmarga be sogmar.
Yoedse-negguoed be anmarga sogmar, adi, anmar wisgumalagar, bemar bab-dummagan gumarye. Bemar ibmar imakmala, nueddibe, ichakwadibe, adi, anmar dakega, degi, anmar ese gwayegar.
Ar bemar binsarmaladid, ar be-ibmar-imakmaladi, binsa ibmar-imaklemaladid. Ar dule-begi-bensurmaladga ibmar-nuedga be gusurmalad.”
Bab-Dummad sogdebalid: “Dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik, dule-gwensak-dagega an imaksad. An-ese-gochad, an-itosad. We-dule, dad-nakwedsik an-nug odummogoed. We-dule, dule-dummagan-negsemamaid-birgi dule-napsa-sobed-napsagi-dii-dii-annanaiyob imakoed.
¿Ar doa we-ibmar-guoed gebesailaunni anmar-owisosa? ¿Ar doa abgayala we-ibmar-guoed anmar-owisosa? Adi, anmar sogega, eye, nabir sogye. Ar dule gwen we-ibmar-guoed sogsasulid, dule gwen owisossurbalid. Dule-we-ibmar-guoed-soged, gwen dule itossurbalid.
Ar ani an abgasaila Sión-dulemarga bato an sogsad: ‘Be dakmarye, bato wegi bukmarye.’ Ani an Jerusalén-neggweburse dule-gayaburba-berbeged-nued barmisad.
An-dikarbali an atakded, dule gwen an daksulid. Emar-imbagi dule-ega-binsaed-daked gwen an daksulid. An ibmar-ese-egichidgu, gwen an-abinsassurmalad.
Ar bela we-bab-dummagan-baigana binsa-ibmar-imaklemaladyobi gued. E-ibmar-imakmaladi, gwen nabirsulid. E-ibmar-sobarmalad-bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladi, unnila uka-olloo daklemaladid. Binsa-ibmar-daklemalad gued.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “We, an-mai-gued. Ani an we-dule-sediid. Ani na susad. An egi yeer itoged. An-burba an ega uksad. Ani Bab-Jehová, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladga igar-innikigwad imakoed.
We-dule, binnasuli golosulid, sabsuli sunmakosulid. Galimbaba binnasuli sunmakdii itolegosulid.
Nargammu-bisgedanigwichidi bar bisgosurmalad. Gwallu-gwillo-binnagamaidi gwen oginnosulid. Igar-napiragwadbali igar nabogoed.
We-dule, napneggi igar-napiragwad-omesedse gwen wieguosulid, gwen galakuosulid. Demar-gakaba-neggwebur-bukmalad, we-dule-e-odurdaked abdakbukwad.”
Bab-Dummad-Jehová mogir-billi obinnisadid, mogir-billi nasiksadid, napneg onasosadid, bela egi-ibmar-sanmaked onasosadid, dulemar-bukwadga niga-ogannogedid, dulemarga burba-dulad-ukedid. We-Bab-Dummad-Jehová weyopira soged:
“Ani an Bab-Jehová gued. Ani an bese gochad, igar-innikigwad-imakega an be-semai gusad. Ani an be-odenonikid, an-dulamarga an dulemarbo-igar-mesisad-e-wilubga-guega an be-imaksad. Dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-magar-neg-itomalaga, gwallu-meegwadyobi an be-ogwisgunonikid.
Adi, be dulemar-aku-atakmaladga ibya egaegar, be dule-esgaryagi-bukmalad onogegar, degi, be dule-esgaryaba-negsichidgi-bukmalad onogegar.
”¡Ani an Jehová gued! ¡Deyob an nugad! An-nug-odummolegedi, dule-baidgadga guosulid. An-nug-odummolegedi, ibmar-sobaled-bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladga an ukosurbalid.
Ibmar-iduar-an-sogsagusmalad bela gusad. Emisgindi, ibmar-gwapidmarbi an sogbalid. Iduakwaa ibmar-guoed an bemar-owisoged.”
Bab-Jehováʼga namakleged-gwapidgi be namakmar. Bemar-muu-billigi-iirmakbukwad, ega be namakmar. Demar-yagi-ibmar-dula-bukmalad, Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar. Napneg-ugakagi-bukmalad, Bab-Jehová-nug ogannomar. Bemar demar-gakaba-bukmalad, Bab-Jehová-nug be odummomar.
Nega-dulesulidganba-bukwamalad, bemar binnasuli gormar. Cedar-dulemar neggwebur-burwigangi-bukmalad, bemar binnasuli gormar. Sela-dorgan, yeer-itogedba be namakmar, yeer-itogedba yala-birgi binnasuli be gormar.
Gandikidba be Bab-Jehová-nug odummomar, neggwebur-demar-gakaba-bukmaladgi binnasuli Bab-Jehová-nug be odummomar.
Bab-Jehová dule-bila-onogedyob nodagoed. Dule-bila-onoged-urweyobi uludagoed. Binnasuli urwedgi bila-onodagoed, e-isdarmaladgi obinoed.
Bab-Jehová soged: “An dikasurgusa bogidik gudigusad, an gwen sunmaksasulid, an gwen ibmar sogsasulid. Emisgindi, an binnasuli goloed. Ome-ugakgunair binnasuli-bunnonaiyobi, akus-akus-bunnonaiyobi, binnasuli gornai an guoed.
Yalamar, degi, yar-mullugana, an obelogoed. E-gaganmar bela an odinnogoed. Diwarmar neg-dinnaganaga an imakoed, dii-wilagana an odinnogoed.
Dule-aku-atakmalad, igar-dakdisurmaladba an nidoed, nanaledisulid-igarba an nidoed. Amar-asabinni, negsichidi neg-meegwadga an imakoed. Amar-idu, neg-muru-murumalad an innikii imakoed. Deyob an imakoed, an gwen amar-obanosulid.
Dulemar ibmar-sobaled-bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladgi bengudisurmaladi, nue-bingegus bangudmaloed. Akwa-sobarmaladga-sokardamaladi, ‘be anmar-bab-dummaganaye,’ a-dulemala, nue-bingegus bangudmaloed.”
Bab-Dummad weyob soged: “¡Dule-uaya-yallirmalad! Nue be itomarsun. ¡Dule-aku-atakmalad! Nue be atakmarsun.
¿Doa an-maiba bur bule akusunna ataksunna? ¿Doa an-gayaburba-berbergedba bur bule uaya-yallirsunna? ¿Doa an-nuggi-barmilesadba bur bule akusunna ataksunna? ¿Doa Bab-Jehová-e-maiba bur bule akusunna ataksunna?
Be ibmar-bukidar-daksa-inigwele, degite, be amba aku daked. Uaya be olloo-sii-inigwele, be ibmar-itosulid.”
Bab-Jehová, e-igar-innikigwad-sabedbali, yeer-itosad. E-igar-maid-dummarba-guedbali, degi, gandikid-guedbali, yeer-itosad.
Ar we-dulemarde atursaledidimalad, sabsur odurdakledidimalad. Bela akwa-dummagan-yaba gales-bukwamaladid, esgaryaba mellesmaladid. Ei-ibmar atursales gudidimalad, dule gwen bendakdisurmalad. Ei ibmar sules gudidimalad. Gwen dulemar gannar-ega-ibmar-ukmarye sogdisurmalad.
¿Doa bemar we-ibmar itogoe? ¿Doa bemar yoedse-we-ibmar-guoed nue-itogoe?
¿Doa ibmar-sulesmaladyobi Jacob-wagan-uksa? ¿Doa ibmar-atursalealedyobi Israel-dulemar-uksa? ¿Ar Bab-Jehová e-dulamar egi isgusgusad urmaksasursi? Eye, urmaksa. Ar ade, Bab-Jehová-igarba nanassurmalad, e-Igar-Maid-sogedba ibsassurmalad.
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová egine ulusad, bila egi onosad. Soogine sabsur-odurdaksad, degi-inigwele, amba aku-itosmalad. Sabsur-odurdakles-inigwele, amba eba ibsassurmalad.
Jacob-wagan, Bab-Jehová-be-obinnisadi soged, Israel-dulemar, Bab-Dummad-be-urbisadi, weyob soged: “Melle be dobguo, ar ani an be-nudaksad. Be-nugba an bese gochad. Be an-mimmi gued.
Be dii-obaknaile, an beba nadapmogoed. Be diwar-obaknaile, be gundilegosulid. Soo-birgi be nadapile, gwen be gummakosulid. Soo-duurmakedi gwen begi naguosulid.
Ar ade, ani an be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová gued, an Israel-dulamar-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaledid, an be-Abonogedid. Ani an, be-onogega, Egipto-dulemar-urmaksad. Be-muchub Etiopía-yar, degi, Seba-yar an urmaksad.
An be-muchubbi dulemar-urmakoed, an be-san-burba-muchubbi, dule-bamalad an urmakoed. Ar an bela-belad bemar-sabed. Be an-asabinni, ibiyob be yeerdaklege, be duledar-nued gued.
Melle be dobguo. Ar an beba gudiid. Dad-nakwed-akale, an be-anagan sedagoed. Dad-argwaned-akale, an be-urboed.
Dulemar-dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladga an sogoed: ‘¡An-dulamar anga udage!’ Dulemar-dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladga an sogoed: ‘¡Melle an-dulamar gamalo!’ Be anga an-masmala-dikasuli-bukwad sedage, be anga an-bunamala-napneg-ugakaase-bukwad sedage.
An-nugba-ese-gollemaladi, be anga bela seda. An-nug-odummogega an obinnisadi, be anga seda. Ani an obinnisad, ani an urbisad.”
Bab-Dummad soged: “Dule-aku-atakmalad, amba ibya-nika-inigwele, be anga onimar. Dule-uaya-yallirmalad, amba uaya-nika-inigwele, be anga onimar.
Dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad bela be oambikumar. Bela dulemar danar ambikumar. ¿Doa we-dulemar-abargi we-ibmar-guoedgi iduakwaa anmarga sunmaksa? ¿Doa ibmar-gusmalad anmarga sogsa gusa? E-daksamalad be oyomardo, nabir-sogmarye be sogmardo, adi, dule-baigan itomalagar, degi, sogmalagar: ‘Napiraye.’ ”
Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemarga soged: “Bemar an-barsogega be gumar, anga-arbaega an bemar-susad, adi, bemar magar-an-dakmalagar, melle angi bengumalagar. Adi, be magar-itomalagar, an doa gue. An-iduale, bab-dummad-baid gwen megissulid, gwen an-sorba bab-dummad-baid megosurbalid.
Ani an Bab-Jehová gued. An-imbagi, dule-abonoged-baid sated.
Ani an bemar-owisosad, ani an bemar-bendaksad. Ani an bemarga sunmaksad. Bemar-abargi, gwen bab-dummad-baid gudii gussulid. Ani an gudii gusad. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi soged: ‘Bemar an-barsogega be gumarye, Ani an Bab-Dummad guye.’
Ani an gebe-negasaila-akale Bab-Dummad gued. Dule gwen angi wakinnosulid. An-ibmar-imakedi, dule gwen obelogosulid.”
Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Isligwaled bemar-bendakmaidi, weyob soged: “Bemar-ulale, Babilonia-neggweburse sorda-bamalad an barmidoed. Dulemar-wakindiiyobi an bela Babilonia-dulemar-imakoed. Caldea-dulemar urmar-nikadba na nug-dummarba-itodimalad, bela an obelomogoed.
Ani an Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Isligwaledid. Ani an bemar-e-rey gued, Israel-dulemar-obinnisad gued.”
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “Ani an demargi igar-mesisgusad, dii-wilasailadgi igar-egasgusad.
Egipto-sordamar, moli-birgi, degi, moli-ur-bila-onomaladgi, Israel-dulemar-bargananai-gusmargua, Bab-Jehová, Egipto-sordamar-bela-obelosgusad. Gwallu-gwillo-akichayob amar-imaksagusad.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Ibmar-nasmalad be iemar, melle bar ibmar-gusmaladgi be binsadii gumar.
Ibmar gwapidmar an imakoed. ¿Ar bato ibmar-imaklenaid aku be dakmarsi? Ar nega-dulesulidganba an igar mesnaid, neg-dinnaganba an diwarmar mesnaid.
Ibmar-durgan-sapurbarmalad-ursilimalad, an-nug ogannomalad. Achu-sapur-uaya-gannagana, nuu-dummad-dukar-suid-avestruzʼye-nugmalad, an-nug odummomalad. An an-dulamar-susad-ogobega, nega-dulesulidganba dii-suurmakega an imaked, neg-dinnaganba diwarmar-megega an imaked.
We-dulemar angadga-guega an urbisad, an-nug ogannomalaga an urbisad.
”Degi-inigwele, bemar, Jacob-wagan, gwen an-nug odummossurmalad. Israel-dulemar, bemar angi wiegudmalad.
Anga bemar sibad-wawaad-sapingana-ogumakar uksasurmalad, ibmar-durgan-anga-ukedgi gwen be an-nug ogannosurmalad. An bese-ibmar-gwag-ukleged-egichedgi-wieguega, an bemar-imaksasulid. Ina-wawagan-oburmakedgi-budar-itogega, an bemar-imaksasulid.
Be anga gwen masar-wawadikmalad baksasulid. Gwen be ibmar-durgan-oburgwileged-e-gwallugi an-yeer-itogega, be an-imaksasulid. Aka bur be be-isgumaladgi isdarsunna-itogega be an-imaksamalad. Be-isgumaladi, budarsunna-be-dakega an-imaksad.
”Degi-inigwele, ani, an nue-be-sabsoggu, a-ulale, an bega isgued elied. An be-isguedgi bar binsaosulid.
Be angi ibmar-soged-nikale, igar-nabogedneggi be anga sogdado. Be ibmar sogdo, adi, magar-daklegega, bule-nabir be ibmar imaksasuli.
Ar be-dad-sailaginedi isgusad. Be-odurdakmaladi, angi dummad-nosmalad.
A-ulale, anse-goled-neg-dakmalad-dummagan nug-bipii an imaksad. Jacob-wagan-bela-obelolegega an imaksad. Israel-dulemar-mesagwar-imaklegega an imaksad.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “An-mai-Jacob-dulamar, Israel-dulamar-an-na-susad. ¡Emigi, nue be an-itogo!”
Weyob Bab-Jehová-be-obinnisadi, sapibeneggi be-omesisadi, be-bendakmaidi, soged: “Jacob-dulamar, melle be dobgu, be an-mai gued, Jesurún, ani an be-susad.
Napa-dinnaganaba dii-suurmakega an imakoed, nega-dinnaganaba dianmar an omesoed. Be-wagangine, An-Burba an odegoed, be-anagangine, ise-nued an binsaoed.
Gagan-oglegwichiyobi gumaloed, dianmar-gaka-nagaba sapi-senigana-gwigwichi-daeyobi gumaloed.
Dule-gwensak sogdagoed: ‘An Bab-Jehováʼgad gued.’ Dule-baiddi ‘Jacobʼye’ nugguoed. Dule-baidmoga e-argangi weyob narmakoed: ‘Ani an, Bab-Jehováʼgadi.’ Geb Israel-nug e-nugga imakoed.”
Weyobi, Bab-Jehová, Israel-dulemar-e-Rey, Israel-dulemar-Bendakmaidi, degi, Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, soged: “Ani an gebesailadid, anse bergunaibalid, Bab-Dummad-baidi sulid.
¿Doa anyob gusunna? ¡Dule anyobile, sunmakdo! An an-dulamar-urbisad-akale, ibmarmar-gusad sogdo. ¡An-asabin, yoo-ibagan-guoedgi sunmakdo!
¡Melle be gwayemar, gandik be imakmar! ¿Ar bato an bega sogsasursi? ¿Dikasurgus an be-owisossursi? Ar bemar an-barsogega gumalad. ¿Ar Bab-Dummad-baid maisi? Suli. ¿Bab-Dummad-baid bebina-sogedi maisi? Suli. Gwen Bab-Dummad-baid-gudii an dakdisulid.”
Dule ibmar-bab-dummadyob-imakleged-sobmaladi, ibmar-nuedga gusulid. E-ibmar-bur-yeerdakle-sobarmaladi, gwen ibmar-nuedga gusulid. E-sobmaladi, na wismalanad, we-ibmar-bab-dummadyob-imaklegedde, aku atakmalad, uaya yallirmalad.
Dule-bab-dummad-baid-sobedi, we-ibmar ega ibmar-nuedga gusulid. Degi, esgoro-diregwadgi bab-dummadyob-imakleged-sobedi, we-ibmar ega ibmar-nuedga gusulid.
Bela dule-ega-san-uksamaladi, bingedar itomaloed, we-ibmar-sobedgi-arbamaladi, unnila dulemar gumalad. Bela bular ambikudamarsun, bela dagmarsun. Ar bela ise-gwayar bukudmaloed, nue-bingedar itodmaloed.
Dule-esgoro-sobed, esgoro amied. Geb soo-ginnitibidgine, esgoro mesed. Geb mardogi sarsogar bab-dummadyob-imakleged sobed. Ise nuesaar imaked. Ar dule-esgoro-sobedi, mas-gunsuli-arbanaile, gobsurbalile, nolloleddaed.
Dule-ibmar-sobedi, suargi-ibmar-soboed dubgi wilub-imaked. Geb esgoro-garagwadgi ibmar sobed, ibmar-orokwaa-saedgi wagar-wilub-onoged. Geb a-sorbali, akwa duleyob-daklege, degi, yeerdaklege sobed, adi, neg-bipigwad-yaba ogwisegar.
Dule-baigan nikabalid, urwar-digmalad. Geb dii-wiedi a-urwarmar odummoged. Geb urwar siklegega bukidar nika gunonikoed. Ciprés-warmardibe, barya-warmardibe, sapurba digdamalad, nue-odummogedse imakdamalad.
Geb dulemar e-anagan soo-ogaega imakdamalad. Dule waegala, sapan-negabala ogadamalad. Egi soo-ogasale, madu yodamarbalid. Deginbali, egi suar-nuchu sobdamarbalid. Geb e-nug-odummoddamalad. Ibmar-sobaled-bab-dummadyob-imakleged sobdamarbalid. Geb asabin yokorgi-sindigar sigdamalad.
Abala, a-suar, sapanga imakdamalad. Egine, geb na mas dudamalad, degi, san nariddamarbalid, geb nue-immelesdamalad. Geb deginbali, egi wadamarbalid. Sogdedamalad: “Soo-gasgu, wis uka-uegus-itole.”
Geb suar-gwabgusadgi, suar-nuchu sobdamalad, e-bab-dummadga imakdamalad. Geb asabinni yokorgi-sindigar sigdamalad, e-nug odummoddamalad. Geb ise-wilegar ega sogdedamalad: “Be an-bendake, ar bee be, an-bab-dummadid.”
Ar we-dulemar ibmar wissurmalad. Akusunna ibmar itomalad. Ar nue-atakmar-inigwele, akusunna ibmar dakmalad. Neg-aku-itomaladid, akusunna ibmar-itomaladid.
Amba ibmar-wisgued napid. Amba magar-ibmar-itoged abeged. Ar gwen weyob binsasurmalad, weyob sogsurmalad: “Suar, abala madu-yoega an ebusad, abala an egi san-narisbalid, a-san an guchad. ¿A-suar-gwabgusadgi, an ibmar-isgana sobode? ¿Ar we-suar-asabin ande yokorgi-sindigar sigode?”
Ar we-dulemar sooburu-maeyobi gumalad. Dukin e-binsaedbali yamoledimalad. Geg na-dukin agi onomalad, degi, geg sogbalid: “¡We an-argan-nuedsik-ibmar-ganikidi, ibmar-binsaledid!”
Bab-Dummad weyob sogded: “Jacob-wagan, we-ibmar be insao. Ani an be-obinnisad, be an-maiga-gued, Israel-dulemar, an gwen be-iegosulid. Israel-wagan, ar be an-maiga gued.
Burwa-sibugana-yogguddaedyobi, an bega be-ibmar-isgana-imaked, osulosad. Degi, boo-aisakiddaedyobi, an bega be-isgued osulosad. Gannar be anse dage, ani an be-nudaksad.”
Isaías weyob sogded: “Mogir-billi, Bab-Jehová-ibmar-imaksadgi weligwaledgi be namak. Napa-yaa-matusurmalad, gandikidba be gormakmar. Yalamar, sapurmar, degi, bela e-sapimar, binnasuli be namakmar. Ar ade, Bab-Jehová Jacob-dulemar-bendaksad, Bab-Dummadi e-gandikid-yeerdakleged Israel-yalagi oyosad.”
Weyob Bab-Jehová-be-bendakedi, sapibeneggi-be-omesisadi soged: “Ani an Bab-Jehová gued, bela ibmar-obinnisadid. Ani an wargwen mogir-billi egasadid. Ani an dukin napneg onasosadid. Dule gwen an-bendaksasulid.
”Ani an Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogedyob-san-imakdamalad-e-ibmar-sogedi, ega guega an imakdasulid. Nergan an obingesadaed. Dule-binsaed-ibegana sikirmakega an imakdaed. E-binsaed-nikaa-daedi, gannar-gannar-ibmar-obaredga an imakdaed.
Ani an an-maimar-gayaburba ogannodaed. Degi, anga-gayaburba-berbemalad anse-ibmar-egisedi, sogedba-guega an imakdaed. ”Ani an soged, ‘Jerusalén-neggwebur gannar sigoye, Judá-neggweburmar gannar bukuoye, e-neg-bibichismalad, gannar an nudakoye.’
Ani an demar-wilasailad odinnoged. Degi, diwar-odinnogega an igar ukbalid.
Ani an Rey-Ciroʼgi soged: ‘Anga sibad-wawaad-edarbed guye. An-ibmar-abegedi anga sogedba imakoye. Jerusalén-neggwebur gannar sigoye. Anse-goled-neg-e-saila gannar megoye.’ ”
Isaías soged: “Bab-Jehová, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad Ciro-urbalikwaa-nanaega imaksad. Ciroʼde, Bab-Jehová-nuggi-reyga-nugsalesadid. Degi, Bab-Jehová, Ciro reymar-e-gangued-obelogega imaksadid, Ciro-abinni, yawagakmar-argaega-imaksadid, yawagakmar-mer-bar-atuega-imaksabalidid.”
Bab-Jehová weyob Ciroʼga soged: “Ani an be-idunadapi guoed, ani an yalamar-omatogoed. Ani an bega esgoro-gordikid-yawagakmar mamaroed, ani an bega yawagak-eduged-esgorobiid bibisgoed.
Ibmar-nuegan-gargerbamalad-dukuar-bukwad an bega ukoed. Ibmar-nuegan-dukuar-bukwad an bega ukoed. Adi, be wisguegar, ani an Bab-Jehová gued. Ani an Israel-dulamar-e-Bab-Dummadid. An be-nugba bese goledid.
An, an-mai-Jacob-sabedbali, degi, an Israel-dulamar-susadbali, an bese be-nugba goled. Be aku an-dak-inigwele, an bega nug-gandikid uked.
Anbi an Bab-Jehová gued, dule-baid sulid. An-imbagi, Bab-Dummad-baid sulid. Be aku an-dak-inigwele, an be-ogannogoed,
adi, dulemar dad-nakwedsik-bukmalad, degi, dad-argwanedsik-bukmalad wisgumalagar, an-imbagi Bab-Dummad-baid sulid. Anbi an Bab-Jehová gued, dule-baid sulid.
Ani an neg-meegwad nasiksad, ani an negsichid nasikbalid. Ani an dulemar-nued-gudiguega imakbalid, ani an boni-dummagan ukbalid, ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi, bela we-ibmarmar imakmaid.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “¡Nibali, dii-boomiedyobi igar-innikigwad an barmidsun! ¡Mogir-imbaba dii-wiedyobi igar-napiragwad an barmidsun! ¡Napneggi igar-innikigwad maiguguega an imaksun! ¡Abonoleged an barmidsun! An Bab-Jehová-guedgi an we-ibmarmar obinnisad.”
Bab-Dummad sogbalid: “Dule na e-obinnisadbo urwele, ¡duledar-wiles-dakle! Ar dule napsa-nog-goayobi, napsa-nog-goamar-abargi-milediidyob gued. Ar napsa dule-e-sobedga weyob sogosi: ‘¿Ibu be imaknai? Be-ibmar-imaknaid nue be imaknaisulid.’
”Dule e-babga sogele: ‘Ibiga be an-baksa.’ Dule-deyob-sogedi, ¡duledar-wiles-dakle! Dule e-nanga sogele: ‘Ibiga be napnegse an-odesa.’ Dule-deyob-sogedi, ¡duledar-wiles-dakle!”
Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaled, Israel-dulemar-urbisad, weyob soged: “¿Ar igi-an-mimmigan-yoedse-guoed be anse egichosi? ¿An-ibmar-obinnisadgi bemar anga igar-ukosi? Suli.
Ar ani an napneg nasiksad. Ani an dulemar urbisad. An-argangine, mogir-billi an nasiksad. E-niisgwamarga ani an igar uksad.
Ani an gandikidba Rey-Ciro-ogwichisad, an ega igarmar nudakoed. Ciro anga an-neggwebur gannar urboed, an-dulamar-gales-bukwad anga onogoed. Ciro, an-dulamar-onogoedi, manigi-baklegar onogosulid. Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad deyob soged.”
Weyob Bab-Jehová soged: “Egipto-e-ibmar-nuegan, degi, Etiopía-e-ibmar-nuegan, begadga gumaloed. Sabeo-dule-burwisurmaladi, be-sorba esgoro-dubgi ebipilemai gumaloed. Bemar-asabinni yokorgi-sindigar bukumaloed, ise-wilesakwaa bemarga sogdamaloed: ‘Unnila Bab-Dummad wargwenna-mai, Bab-Dummad-baid suli. We-Bab-Dummadi, bemarba naid.’ ”
Bab-Dummad, be, Israel-dulemar-Abonogedid, be Bab-Dummad-akudaklegedid.
Bela dulemar ibmar-bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad-sobmaladi, bingedar-itoge gumaloed, degi, san-bipii gumaloed. Bela bular na san-bipi gumaloed.
Israel-dulemar Bab-Jehováʼgi-nue-bendaklesmalad, bendakles sadegumaloed. Bali-bipisaale, bingedar-itogosurmalad, bali-san-bipi imaklegosurmalad.
Ar ade, weyob Bab-Jehová soged: “Ani an Bab-Jehová gued, Bab-Dummad-baid sulid. Ani an mogir-billi-obinnisadid. Ani an napneg-nasiksadid. Ani an napneg-ilemakar nasiksadid, binsa-ollobi-nasikega an imaksasulid, dulemar egi ambikuega an imaksad.
Gwen an bemarga we-napneg-naidgi negsichidgi-dukuar an sunmaksasulid. Degi, gwen an Jacob-waganga weyob sogsasulid: ‘Neg-olloledgi be an-amimalo.’ Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi igar-napiragwadbi an soged, degi, an igar-innikigwadbi soged.”
Bab-Jehová sogbalid: “Dule-yar-baid-baidginmalad bemar-wakindimalad be atomar, be anse dagmar. Akusunna-ibmar-itomaladi, ibmar-sobarmalad-bab-dummadyob-imakleged sedimalad. Degine, bab-dummagan-gwen-e-abonogosulidse gordimalad.
Be sunmakmar, ibmar-imaksad be sogmar, na be muchub-muchub egisnanai be samalo. ¿Doa bato dikasurgus iduakwaa we sogsa? ¿Doa epenne bato we-ibmar sogsa? ¿Ar ade, ani an Bab-Jehová we-ibmar sogsasursi? Baid Bab-Dummad sulid. Ani an Bab-Dummad-Innikidaedid. Ani an Dule-Abonogedid. Baid Bab-Dummad sated.
”Bela napneg-ugakagi-bukmalad be abonolemalagala, anse be gannar dagmar. Ar ade, ani an Bab-Dummadid, Bab-Dummad-baid sated.
An-nuggi an ise-sogar-imaksad, an napiragwadba ibmar-sogsad, ibmar gusuli-guosulid guedsegad. Bela-dulemar an-asabin yokorgi-sindigar sigmaloed, bela-dulemar anga ise-sogar imakmaloed.
”Wemar angi sogmaloed: ‘Unnila Bab-Jehováʼgi igar-innikigwad danikid, degi, gargangued eginbi danibalid.’ ” Dulemar isdar Bab-Dummad-daksamaladi, Bab-Dummad-asabin nonimaloed, bingedar itomaloed.
Bela Israel-e-wagan bendaklegoed, degi, bela Bab-Jehová-nuggi gannarba gumaloed.
Babilonia-dulemar e-bab-dummad-Belʼye-nugad dugdir naded, bab-dummad-Neboʼye-nugad balimelleded. Wemar-e-wilubgan-sobarmalad, ibmar-durgan-nabir-ibmar-semaladgi sesmalad. Ar ade, wemar-e-wilubgan yeer-aidikued, bela ibmar-durgan-nabir-ibmar-semalad-ebilis nasikdamalad, ibmar-durgan nue-yegus itodamalad.
Bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad dugdir nadmalad, napagi babatided, gwen dukin na bendaksasurmalad, degidba gales selesmalad.
Bab-Dummad weyob soged: “Jacob-wagan, be an-itomar, bela Israel-dulemar be an-itomar. Sapibeneggi be maigu, an nue-be-akwisad, an nue-be-nidii gusad.
Amba bemar seredgusale, bato bemar nono-dagudikgusale, amba an nue-be-nidii guoed. Amba an-sunnagwad an be-sedioed. Ani an bemar-obinnisad, ani an bemar-bendakdii guoed. Ani an be-sedioed. Ani an igar-bulegangi be-ollorsaoed.
”¿Doa-ebo be an-wilubdakoe? ¿Doa-ebo emar-daklege be an-imakoe? ¿Doa-yopira an-daklege be an-imakoe? Suli. Gege be emaryob be an-imaked.
Ar dulemar gwenna-gwenna, binsa e-or sagumargi-bukwadi, obelodamalad, e-manidi, nibirgi wilubsadamalad. Geb dule-ibmar-sobed amidamalad, adi, bab-dummadyob-imakleged sobegar. A-bab-dummadyob-imakleged-nug-odummogega, e-asabinni yokorgi-sindigar sigdamalad.
Geb a-sorbali, a-bab-dummadyob-imakleged, gukingi-mai seddamalad. Geb e-gwisguedgi ogwisgudapdamalad, bar onirdasurmalad. Ar dule amba we-ibmar-sobaledse binnasuli-gornaile, amba e-abinsaosulid. Degine, amba dule-bukib-binsadiid egi gwen bendaklegosulid.
”Bemar, uyasulidamalad. We-ibmar be ebinsamalo. ¡Nue na be binsamalo, nue be itomalo!
Epenne ibmar-dikasurgus-gusmalad be ebinsamalo. Ani an Bab-Dummadid, dule-baid sated, Ani an Bab-Dummadid, dule-anyobid sulid.
Ani an sailanagi yoedse-ibmar-guoed owisoged. Ibmar yoedse-guoedi amba dikasuli-gued-idu an soged. An soged: An-ibmar-abegedi sogedba guoed, an-ibmar-abegedba an imakoed.
Dule-gwensakse dikasuli dad-nakwedsik an gochad, sulubagiyob dikasuli danikoed, a-dule, anga an-ibmar-abeged-imakoed. An-ibmar-sogsadi, sogedba-guega an imakoed. An-igar-amisadi, an imakoed.
Gwage-dutusurmalad, be an-itomar. Igar-napiragwadgi-dikasurgudimalad, be an-itomar.
An-igar-napiragwadi dikasur maisulid, an-abonogedi bato warmaksad. Sión-yala-abonoleged an imakoed, Israel-dulemarga an-gandikid an ukoed.”
Bab-Jehová sogbalid: “Babilonia-yala yagwa-yoo-sui-nikuedyobi be guedi, be aidege, napagi be sige. Caldea-dulemar-e-sisgwayobi be guedi, napagi be sige, ar be-ologana bergusad. Bar bese ome-nued-dakleye gorlegosulid, degi, ome-bakagwaledye gorlegosulid.
Obnaged-akwa be sue, ibmar-gwag egi be nage. Muswe be unge, sabure-bayaa be sae, dua swiri be imake, diwargi be obake.
Be-uka-swiligwadi bela daklegoed, bela be-abganse-bakale, daklegoed. Be dummad-bingeguoed. An buged be-imakoed. Bela dulemar isgusadbi an dakoed, an ega e-isgued gwen eliosulid.”
Anmar-Bendakedi, Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaledid. Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadye nugad.
Bab-Dummad weyob soged: “Caldea-dulemar-sisgwa bogi be sige. Neg-gubyagwaled-yaba be doge. Ar dule bar be-biosulid: ‘Rey-bundor yar-baid-baid-nanaid semaidye.’
An-dulamala an-oulus gusad. A-ulale, a-dulemar an obachagusad. Be-argan-yaurgi an uksagusad. Degi-inigwele, gwen be wiledaksasulid. Dule-sergangala arbaed-dummad be uksagusad.
Weyob be sogsa gusad: ‘¡Gusgu bela yar-semaigu an guoye!’ Degi-inigwele, gwen be binsassulid, an berguodeeye, gwen weyob-guodeeye be binsassulid.
”Emigindi, Rey-bundor-ibmarbina-surbinsa-itoged, be nue-itogo: Emide, na be nued-gudii itoged, na be dukin-weyob sogdiid: ‘Anbi an weyob guye, dule-baid anyobid surye. Bipisaale, an gwen machered-sate guosurye, an gwen mimmigansuli guosurbarye.’
Ar ibagwennaa ukiarmakale, ibmar-sogbobela bega guoed: Mimmigansuli be gunonikoed, degi, machered-sate be gunonikoed. Ar be bukidar ina-isgana-imako-inigwele, degi, bela ibmar-burbamar be oyogo-inigwele, we-ibmar be-bendakosulid.
Ar be be-ibmar-isgana-imakedgi be bengussulid. Ar be sogsagusad: ‘We-ibmar-isgana-imakedgi dule an-dakdisuli.’ Be-binsaed-nikadaedi, be-ibmar-wisidaedi, dukin be-yardaksad. Ulubgine na be weyob sogsad: ‘Anbi an weyob guye, dule-baid anyobid surye.’
Begine, boni-dummad nonikoed, mer begi-yolegega be imakoenad, degi-inigwele, we-boni begi yolegedsegad. Begine, boni-dummad-nagunonikoed, gwen be gaosulid. Boni-dummad begi danikoye gwen be binsadisulidgi, ukiarmakale begi gwisgunonikoed.
”Ibmar-burbamar-wisid-oyogedgi be alamakdii gudo. Ina-isgana-imakedgi be alamakdii gudo. Ar nuchukwagwad-akale, egi be arbadiid. Abakar wis be-ibmar be-bendakalile, abakar wis be nabir bonigan-ogwayealile.
Bukidar-bega-binsaed-uklesadba, be budar-itogusad. Emisgi, dule-niisgwaba-bega-ibmar-dakar-sogmalad dagmarsun: We-dulemar mogirmargi-ibmar-nanaidba-nergumaladid, niisgwa-dakedba-ibmar-sogmaladid, degi, nii-irba iduakwaa-ibmar-guoed-sogmaladid. We-dulemar boni-dummagan begi-danikoedgi be-bendakmarsun.
Be-dake, we-dulemar gagan-durganyob-gumalad, bela soo obelogoed. Na-dukin soo-gwabunyedgi san-onogosurmalad. Ar we-soo, neg-uee-imakedyobsulid, geg be walik siged. Geg be we-soo-asabin siged.
Weyob dulemar-bebo-alamakdigusad gumaloed. Ar be nuchukwagwad-akale, bebo-ina-isganagi-arbasmalad weyob gumaloed. Na wala-walagwen e-itolegedba nademaloed, ar dule-wargwensaale be-bendakosulid.”
Jacob-wagan, we-igar-an-bega-sogoedi, nue be itomalo. Judá-wagan Israel-dulemarye-biledimalad, nue an-itomalo. Bemar Bab-Jehová-nuggi be ise-sogar-ibmar-sogdimaladi, Israel-e-Bab-Dummadse be gordimaladi, napiragwadgi be imakdisurmalad. Igar-innikigwadgi be imakdisurmalad.
Bemar neggwebur-islidikidginmaladye na be sogdimalad, degine, Israel-e-Bab-Dummadgi-bensurmalad, Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadye-nugadgi be bensurmalad, nue be itomalo.
Bab-Dummad weyob soged: “Ibmar-gusmaladi, bato an dikasurgus egi an sunmaksad. Yoo-ibmar-guoed-iduale, bato an egi iduakwaa sunmaksad. An-sunnagwad dulemarga an oyosad. Ukiarmakale, an imaksad. Bela deyob gunonikid.
Ar ade, bato an wisid, bede nue gwage-dutusulid, be-dukar-war esgoro-gannaregedyobid, be-bebe-gar esgoro-gordikidyobid.
A-ulale, an bega dikasurgus we-ibmar sogsad. Iduakwaa we-ibmar-guoed an bega oyosad, adi, melle be sogegar: ‘An-ibmar-bab-dummadyob-sobaled, we-ibmar imaksaye. An-ibmar-wilub-sobaled, degi, an-suar-sobaled we-ibmar-guoed sogsaye.’
Bela we-ibmarmar-gusad be itosad, bela be daksad. Degite, ¿bemar we-ibmarmar-gusad sogosursi? ”Emisgi, an ibmar-binigan bemarga an sogoed. Be-idu ibmar-dukuar-mamaidi, akudaklemaladi, an bemarga sogoed.
We-ibmarmar emiskwaa imaklesmaladid, dikasurgus imaklesurmaladid. Emi-ibagine, amba egi-sunmakleged be itodisulid, adi, melle be sogegar: ‘Eye, dika bato an wisbinye.’
Bipisaale, gwen we-ibmar be itodisulid, gwen be wissurbalid. We-ibmar gwen be iduar itodisulid, gwen bega iduar be-uaya, magasar-itogega argassulid. Ar an nue be-wisid, be emar-yardakmaladid, be gwalulesad-akale, uayasulidaedye be-bimalad.
”An, an-nug-sabed-ulale, an-urwed an bargaed. An-nug-odummoleged-ulale, an na san-bargaed, adi, melle be-obelogegar.
¡Be dakena! An swilidik be-imaksad. Degi-inigwele, mani-swilidik-imaklegedyob an be-imaksasulid, sabsur-wile-itolegedgi an be-wilubdaksad.
An we-ibmar-imaksadi, an-ulale an imaksad, an na dukin-sabed-ulale, an deyob imaksad. ¿Sunna an-nug obanagwar-imakmalaga an imakosi? Suli. An-nug-odummolegedi, dule-baidgadga an ukosulid.”
Bab-Jehová weyob sogbalid: “Jacob-wagan, be an-itoge, Israel-wagan, ani an bese gochad. Ani an Bab-Dummadid. Ani an gebesailaginedid, anse bergunaibalid.
An-argangine, napneg an nasiksad, an-argan-nuedsiki, mogir-billi an egasad. Ani an e-nugba ese gochagu, bela nagunonikid.
”Bela bemar ambikumar, be an-itomar: ¿Doa we-ibmar-guoed iduakwaa sogsa? Ani Bab-Jehová, an dule-gwensak-susad Babilonia-yalagi an-ibmar-imakbied imakoed, Caldea-dulemargi gwichiguoed.
Ani an we-ibmarmar sogsad. Unnila ani an we-dulese gochad. Dagega, an imakoed, e-ibmar-imakoedgi emargi obinoed.
”Anse be walikgudamar, an ibmar-sogoedi, nue itomalo: Gebesailaunni an gwen dukuar sunmaksasulid, ibmarmar gualile, bato an gunaidaed.” Emide, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, E-Burba-gandikidba an-barmialid.
Weyobi Bab-Jehová be-Bendakedi, degi, Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaled, soged: “Ani an Bab-Jehová gued, bemar-Bab-Dummadid. Ibmar-nueganba be-odurdakedid, ibu-igarba be nanaoe, a-igarba be-iduedid.
An-igarmar-mamaidba be uaya-nika gudigusana, diwar-aryomadaedyobi ulubgi bogidikid be nikuoenad, demar-mullumakmadaedyobi be baisur-itodii guoenad.
Be-wagan ukub-naidyob-mergu guoenad, be-mimmigan ukub-merguedyob-mergu guoenad. E-nuga gwen-alliosulinad, an-asabinni, gwen weyob guosulinad.”
¡Babilonia-yalagi be ainimar! ¡Caldea-dulemargi be wakinmar! Bemar Babilonia-yalagi-noedgi binnasuli weligwaledba be we-igargi sunmakmalo. We-ibmar dulemar-wisguega be imakmalo, bela yala-naid-ugakaase gayaburba be mimimalo. Weyob be sogmalo: “Bab-Jehová, e-mai-Jacob-wagan bendaksaye.”
Nega-dulesulidganba-seargua, gwen ukud mechasurmalad. Bab-Jehová emargala, akwasailagi dii-aryogega imaksad. Akwa-marisgusadgi dii-binnasur ega aryogega imaksad.
Bab-Jehová soged: “Dule-isganagardi gwage-bogidikid sateye.”
Dikasur-demar-gakaba-bukmaladi, be an-itomar. Neggwebur-bannaba-bukmaladi, an-ibmar-sogoed itomalo: Gwaluleged-iduale, Bab-Jehová bato anse gochad. Sapibeneggi-mai, bato an-nug bisad.
Es-suid-swiswidikidyobi an-gayaburba imaksad. E-argan-yaurgine an-odukusad. Sigu-daarmakaledyob an-imaksad, e-sigumar-saboged-yaba an-odukusad.
Bab-Dummad anga weyob sogsad: “Israel-wagan, be an-maiga gued. Begine, an-nug odummolegoed.”
Geb an abinsaded: “Binsarsunna an arbasad. Binsarsunna an gar-itosad, gwen ibmar-nued an nikgussulid. Degi-inigwele, an-ibmar-imakedi, Bab-Jehováʼgi siid. Bab-Dummad anga-ibmar-nuegan-ukoed bato guagwar sisad.”
Emide, Bab-Jehová soged: “An e-maiga-guegala, sapibeneggi-mai anga burba uksad. Adi, Jacob-wagan gannar eba nanaegar, Israel-dulemar gannar ese ambikudagegar. Ar ande Bab-Jehová-asabin an-nug gannarba gued. Agala, an-Bab-Dummad anga niga-ogannoged.”
Bab-Dummad weyob e-maiga soged: “Be an-maiga-guedgi, unnila be anga Jacob-waganbi gannarse nudakosulid. Unnila be anga Israel-dulemarbi gannar-e-yarse sedagosurbalid. Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladga, neg-meegwadga-guega an be-imakbalid, degi, bela napaneg-naid-ugakaasega, an-abonoleged-igar-sedega an be-imakbalid.”
Bab-Jehová, Israel-dulemar-ollor-imakedi, Bab-Dummad-Isligwaledi, weyob soged, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladse mesagwar-gulediidga, isdar-daklediidga, degine, dummagan-negdakmamaid-e-maiganga, weyob soged: “Reymar be-dakdamalogu, gwisgudmaloed. Dule-dummagan-nuga-nikamalad be-dakdamalogu, be-abin dulluu imakmaloed. Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Jehová-Isligwaled-ular, be-nug odummodmaloed. Ar ade, Bab-Dummad, dule-napiragwadid, degi, na e be-susadid.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Iba-nuegangi an be-itosad, degi, abonoleged-ibagangi an be-bendaksad. Emigindi, an nue-be-akoed, degi, an begine dulemarga igar mesoed, adi, be gannarse neggwebur-urbegar, degine, nainumar-olloo-nanaid be mimiegar.
Adi, dule-galesmaladga weyob be sogegarba: ‘Be ainimarye.’ Degi, dulemar-negsichidgi-bukmaladga weyob be sogegarba: ‘Bemar ollorgusmarye.’ ”Bemar, igarbali, be-ibdurganga gagan-ara-aramalad amimaloed, bela nega-dulesulid-yar-mullugangi gagan-ara-aramalad be amimaloed.
Bemar ukudmaada itogosurmalad. Dad-ibeler-gaedi, degi, neg-ueguedi, budar-itoge be-imakosurmalad. Ar dule-wile-be-daked, be-nioed, dian-aryomamaidba be-sedoed.
Bela an-sapurmar-nanaidgi igar-mamai an imakoed, an-igarmar an omesoed.
¡Be dakmalana! Wemarde dikasuli danimaloed. Gwen-gwen dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik danimaloed, baigandi, dad-argwanedsik danimarmogoed, degi, baigandina, Sinim-yar-akar danimaloed.”
Nibneg-naid, be weligwaledba, ¡binnasuli gole! Napneg-naid, ¡be wergusun! Sapurmar, ¡gandikidba be namakmar! Ar Bab-Jehová e-dulemar-gwage armaked, e-dulemar-wilesagwa-gudimalad wiledaked.
Degi-inigwele, Sión-yalagi-bukmalad weyob sogsad: “Bab-Jehová walagwen an-meted, Bab-Jehová an-iesad.”
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “¿Ar sunna nan-gwensakde e-mimmi-iesi? ¿Ar sunna e-mimmi-baksad sabgusuli gusi? Ar we-nande, e-mimmi-nue-ieye-sogele, andi an gwen be-iegosulid.
An-argangi-sobar-naiyobi an be-sediid. Be-galu-matusurmaladi, an iedisulid.
Bega-neg-sobmaladi, begi gwae-gwae danimalad. Be-obelomaladdi, begi bangudmalad, bei neg-ollomaksamalad begi bangudmalad.
Nue be-atake, be-dikarba nue be neg-dake. Bela bulakwaa ambikunonimalad, bese danimalad.” Bab-Jehová soged: “An dula-maisoggu, bela wemar, ibmar-nuegan-ebulegedyobi gumaloed, abirgin-nikued-mor-yolegedyobi gumaloed.
”Be-yala obelosmar-inigwele, akwamarbi ganna-ganna obesmar-inigwele, degi, olloo nasiksamar-inigwele, be-yala be-dulemarga unniguosulid. Dule-be-wiosmaladdi, dikasuli bemargi bukwa gumaloed.
Be-mimmigan-bei-yoggusye-na-be-bisadi, bega sogdamaloed: ‘Dogdar we-yala anga bipii noye. Anga be neg-amiye, agi nabir an gudisaegarye.’
Geb degi, be binsadoed: ‘¿Doa we-mimmigande anga baksasunna? An mimmi satenad, ar an geg mimmi bakenad. An ononnoles gudiinad, emarse-obanagwar an gudiinad. Ar we-mimmigande, ¿doa anga odummossunna? Ar an walagwen gudiinad, emide, ¿ar bia wemarde danimarsunna?’ ”
Bab-Jehová-Bur-Biriginedi weyob soged: “Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladga an igar ukoed, neggwebur-bukmaladsik an-bander an onakoed, adi, wemar, e-sakwagi-mai bega be-mimmigan-sedamalagar, degi, e-gukingi-mai bega be-bunamala-sedamarbaligar.
Reymar e-mimmiganga be-imakmaloed, degi, rey-omegan be-nanga gumaloed. Be-asabinni, dulluu napase imakmaloed. Degi, maligi ukub-naile, bega elimaloed. Geb agi, be wisgumaloed, ani an Bab-Jehová gued. Dule-angi-bensurmaladi, bingedar itogosurmalad.”
Dule-bila-onomalad bila-onogedgi-ibmar-susadi, ¿sunna e-ibe be susi? Geg gue. Dule-galesadi, ¿sunna dule-isgana-e-gasadgi wakinnosi? Suli.
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Dule-bila-onoged bila-onogedgi-ibmar-susadi, e-ibe sulegoed. Deginbali, dule-isgana dule-gasa-sesadi, gannar e-annik sulegoed. Ar andi, dule-begi-urwedimaladgi an be-bendakoed. An-sunnagwadi, an be-mimmigan bendakoed.
Be-isdarmalad na dukin e-san-gunmalaga an imakoed. Vino-gobeyobi, na dukin e-ablisgi-mumgumalaga an imakbaloed. Degisoggu, bela dulemar wisgumaloed, ani an Bab-Jehová gued. Ani an be-Abonogedid. Ani an Jacob-waganga dule-gandikid gued. Ani an be-bendakedid.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Israel-dulemar, ¿an bemar-nan obachasi? Degite, ¿bia abirgin-meted-gardade nadsunna? Anga be oyodo. ¿An doa-dulemarga bemar-egi-mani-ganikidyobi an be-uksamarsunna? An deyob be-uksasurmalad. Ar be-isgued-ular, na be dukin uksamalad. Bemar uaya-sate-gusad-ulale, be-nan oballedsunnad.
An nonigua, ¿ibiga dule-sate an daknonisunna? An gotegua, ¿ibiga dule gwen an-abin-imaksasursunna? ¿Ar bemar-bendakosurye, be angi binsamala? ¿An bemar-onogega, garganguedsuli be an-dakmala? Ar an sunna, demar, ilagwensaale dinna saed. Ar an sunna, diwarmar, nega-dulesulidga-nai imaked. Uamar e-mas-satedba burgwideled. Dii-dingudedba uamar bela nungudeled.
An sunna mogir-billi nega-gubyagwaledbi-nai an imaked, mor-sichid-naidyobi an imaked.”
Bab-Jehová binsaed-ibegan-sunmaked-gwabinduku anga uksad, adi, dulemar-geggus-gudimalad-e-gwage gadi-gadi-imakegar. Bab-Dummad bane-bane wakudaryalabali an-odaked, ibmar-itogega an-imaked, adi, dule-ibmar-durdaknaidyobi an ibmar durdakegar.
Bab-Jehová ibmar-magar-itogega an-imaksad, an eba uayasuli gussulid, an eba ibsassuli gwen gussulid.
Dulemar-an-bibyonanaidga an-yargan an oyosad. Dulemar-an-siga-sabsur-ungemaladgi, an-aku an gwen odukussulid. Degine, dule-angi-dodomaladgi, degi, angi-wiakmaladgi, an-wagar an gwen odukussulid.
Ar Bab-Jehová-Bur-Birigined an-bendaked, degisoggu, mesagwar-imaklenaidgi an bai itossulid. A-ulale, akwasailayob an na gandik imaksad. Ar an wisid, an bingeguosulid.
Dule-an-irwa-gwisguedi, an-nagaba gudiid. ¿Degisoggu, doa anbo gala-itobie? Dule anbo-gala-itobiele, ¡anse dagdo! Dule angi gwisgubiele, ¡anga ibmar sogdado!
¡Ar Bab-Jehová-Bur-Birigined an-bendakdaed! ¿Doa sabsur-odurdakleged-igar anga mesosunna? Ar an-isdarmaladdi, ilagwen-berguar gudoed, igi mor suuse-gulledae, deyobi namaloed.
¿Doa bemar-abargi Bab-Jehová-dobee gudii? ¿Doa Bab-e-mai-sogedba nanadii? Dule sated. Dule-negasichidba-nanadiidi, neg-meegwadba-nanadisulidi, a-dule, Bab-Jehováʼgi bensuli guoed, e-Bab-Dummadgi alakwaa naguoed.
Ar bemar na soo ogadamalad, na be gwinnur ogadamarbalid. Bemar na be soo-ogadamaladgi be nanabukmalad, na be gwinnur-ogadamaladgi be nanabukmalad. Degi-inigwele, an we-ibmarmargi sabsur-bemar-odurdakoed: Igar-bulegangi be sabsur-odurdaklemaloed.
Bab-Dummad weyob soged: “Bemar, igar-innikigwadba-nanadimalad, be an-amidimalad, be an-itomar: Bemar, dad-Abraham-wagan gumalad.
Be nue-dakmar, ar dad-Abraham bemar dad-dummadid, degi, muu-Sara bemar-urbisadid. An Abrahamʼse gochagua, na sana-walagwen gudiinad. Degi-inigwele, an egi nued binsasad, an ega dula omelosad.
Ani Bab-Jehová, Sión-yala wiledakedsegad. Bela e-neg-bibichismaladi, wiledakoed. E-nega-dulesulidgan Edénʼgi-nainu-nued-naigusayobi, imakoed. E-nainu-geg-ibmar-egi-sanmakedi, an-nainuga guoed. A-nainugine weligwar-itomaloed, egi wergumaloed. Anga namaklegedgi namakmaloed, dog-nuedye anga sogmaloed.
”An-dulamar, nue be an-itomar. An-neggweburmar, nue be an-itomar: Ar ani an ibmargi-odurdakleged-igar onioed, an-igar-napiragwadi, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladga neg-meegwadga guoed.
An-igar-naboged, bato walik-gusad. An-abonoleged-igar bato igarba abarmakdanikid. An-ganguedi, dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladga igar nabogoed. Dule-demar-gakaba-bukmaladi, angi bensurmalad, an-ganguedgi, bendakleged abdakmalad.
Niba be atakmar, napneggi be atakmarbar. Waa-berguddaedyobi, mogir-billi bergudoed, mor-nunguddaedyobi napneg nungudoed. Gukur-burgweyobi, e-dulemar burgwidoed. Degi-inigwele, an-abonogeddi, degisadegu maiguoed. Degi, an-igar-napiragwaddi, noargumai gwen guosulid.
”Bemar, igar-napiragwad-wismalad, be an-itomar. Gwagegi-an-igar-sedidimalad, be an-itomar. Dulemar-begi-ichakwa-sunmakedi, melle be dobgumalo, sabsur-e-ibmar-sogedgi, melle be niga argwanmalo.
Ar we-dulemar unnila mor suuse-gulledaedyob gumaloed, mor-wawaad nusmarse-gulledaedyob gumaloed. Ar an-igar-napiragwaddi, degisadegu maiguoed, an-abonoged-igardi, maigu guoed.”
Bab-Jehová, ¡be atake! ¡Be atake! ¡Gandikid-mola be yoe! Epenne be-gangued be-dulamarga-be-oyosayob be oyoge. ¿Ar bee be, Rahab-obelossursi? ¿Ar bee be, ibdula-demargined obelossursi?
¿Ar bee be, demar-odinnosgussursi? ¿Ar bee be, a-dii-wilasailad odinnossursi? ¿Ar bee be, dule-bendaklesmalad-obakega demar-wilasailadgi igar-omesisgussursi?
Bab-Jehováʼgi-bendaklesmalad gannar nonimaloed, weligwaledgi namakagwale Sión-yalase dognonimaloed. Weligwar-itodiidi, magasar na e-wagargi oyomaloed. Wergudii gumaloed, na yeer itomaloed. Bukib-binsadiidi, gwage-nunmak-itodiidi, bela bergudoed.
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Ani an bemar-gwage baisur-itoge imakedid. ¿Ar ibiga be dulemar-dobe? Ar wemardi, unnila gagan-durganyob gumalad.
¿Bab-Jehová-be-obinnisad be iesde? ¿Bab-Jehová-mogir-billi-nasiksad bato be iesde? ¿Bab-Dummad-napneg-nasiksad bato be iesde? ¿Bane-bane be-isdarad-be-obelobi-gudiidgi be gwayedii guode? ¡Adi surbali! ¿Sabsur-dule-odurdakdiid-e-urwedde, bia nadsunna?
Dulemar-esgaryagi-gales-bukmaladi, emiskwaa onolemaloed. Esgaryagi burgosurmalad, gwen ega mas galakuosurmalad.
Ani an be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová gued. Ani an demar-osukamakedid, ani an demar-uurmakega imakedid. Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadye an nugad.
Be-gwabindukugine, an-gayaburba an nasiksad. An-ganguedbali an be-anar gwisgusad. Ani an mogir-billi nasiksad, ani an napneg nasiksad. Degine, Sión-yalagi-bukmaladga an weyob sogsad: ‘Be an-dulamar guye.’ ”
¡Jerusalén-dulemar! Be gwisgumar, be gwisgumar. Bab-Dummad-e-urwed be itosad. Be bela-belad ulubse surbinsa-itoge be gusad, geg bar be gwisgu gusad.
Bela be mimmigan-nikusadi, gwen wargwensaale, be-idugega gussulid. Bela be mimmigan-odummosadi, bipisaale, gwen argangi be-gassulid.
We-bonigan-sogbogwad begi nonigusad: Be-neggwebur bibichisgusad, degi, be-neggwebur obelolesgusad. Ukudba be gala-itosgusad, es-suidgi oburgwilesgusad. ¿Doa wile be-dakoe? ¿Doa be-gwage baisur-itoge imakoe?
Be-mimmigan galakusmalad. Goe-sapur-bebe-suid sakigi-galesnaidaeyob gusmalad, galimba-dikarba mellemamaid. Egine, bela Bab-Jehová-e-urwedi gwichigusad, bela be-Bab-Dummad-urwedi egi gwichigusad.
Emisgindi, dule-bukib-binsadiid, vino-gobedginsuli be mummu-gudiid. An-bega-ibmar-sogoed be ito.
Be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bur-Birigined, e-dulemar-ular-sunmakedi, weyobi soged: “An-urwedgi an sabsur-bemar-odurdaksad an obelosad. We-an-urwedi bipisaale bar be itogosulid.
Dulemar-sabsur-be-odurdakdimalad an odurdakoed. Ar we-dulemar bega weyob sogsa gusmalad: ‘Napagi balimellemai be imakmarye, adi, anmar begi annamalagarye.’ Ar deyob be imaksa gusmalad, ega napagi mellemai be gusmalad, bela dulemar be-birgi annas gusmalad.”
Sión-dorgan, ¡be atake! ¡Be atake! ¡Gandikid-mola be yoe! Neggwebur-islidikid-Jerusalén, be-mor-gargerbamalad be yoe. Ar dule-abgan-uka-duku-sikarsurmaladi, degi, dule-Bab-Dummad-wissurmaladi, bar bemarse dogosurmalad.
¡Jerusalén-neggwebur, be gwichigue! ¡Olli be obate! ¡Gannar ologanagi be sige! Sión-yala-sisgwa, be galesgua, dukargi-esgoro-dub-nasiklesad be unge.
Ar Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Bemar manigi be uklessulid, bemar manigi be onolegosurbalid. Bemar binsa-onolegoed.”
Ar Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-Jehová weyob soged: “Epenne an-dulamar, Egipto-yalase nadegusad. Agine, na megisgusmalad. Emide, Asiria-sordamar binsarsunna an-dulemar-mesagwar imakalid.”
Emide, Bab-Jehová soged: “¿Ibi an wegi imakdii? Ar binsarsunna, an-ibe an-dulamar-gasa sesmalad. E-negsemamaid an-dulamargi dodomalad. Bane-bane an-nuggi dododigudamalad, bogigudisurmalad.
Degisoggu, a-ulale, a-ibagangine, an-dulamar an-nug wisgunonikoed. A-ibagangine, ani an ega sunmaknaidi, an e-walik gwisgunonikoed.”
Dule yar-imbaba-gayaburba-nued-sedanikidi, dule-gayaburba-bogidikid-berbegedi, ibiyobi yeer daklemala. Dule gayaburba-nuegan-barsogedi, degine, dule abonoleged-igargi-sunmakedi, ibiyobi yeer daklemala. Dule, Sión-dulemarga weyob-sogedi: “Be-Bab-Dummad negdakmaiye.” Dule-deyob-sunmakmaladi, ibiyobi yeer daklemala.
¡Be itoge! Be-dule-nakulemalad binnasuli-gorbukmalad, weligwaledbali gandikidba gorbukmalad. Ar ade, na e-ibyagwale dakbukmalad, Bab-Jehová gannar Sión-yalase daniki.
Jerusalén-dulemar, na be bular-weligwar-namaklegedgi be namakmar. Ar ade, Bab-Jehová e-dulemar-baisur-itogega imaksad, degi, Jerusalén-neggwebur bendaksad.
Bab-Jehová, bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladga e-gangued oyogoed. Bela napneg-naid-ugakaase-bukmaladi, anmar-Bab-Dummad-e-abonoged dakmaloed.
Bemar, Babse-goled-neggi-ibmar-ebulemalad-semaladi, be nomar, be agi ainimar. ¡E-dulemar-abargi-gudiidgi be nomar! ¡Be san-urukmar! ¡Melle ibmar-swilidiksulid be ebumalo!
Degi-inigwele, mer be gwae-gwae itomalo. Mer be gwae-gwae-abarmakdemarbalo. Ar Bab-Jehová bemar-idumai guoed. Israel-e-Bab-Dummad be-sorba-nai guoed.
Bab-Jehová soged: “An-mai emargi nakoed. E-nug odummolegoed, dule-dummadga guoed, degi, ologanagi sigoed.
Dulemar dakdamalogu, bukidar geger-dakmaloed, ar e-wagar-daklegedi bar aa daklegosulid, ar e-daklegedi, bar dule-daklegosulid.
Amba deyob dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladi, geger dakmarmogoed. E-asabinni, reymar gwen-sunmakosurmalad, ar weyob-ega-ibmar-soglessulid dakdamaloed, degi, weyob-ibmar-itossurmalad na magar itononimaloed.”
¿Doa anmar-ibmar-sogsad bengussuli? ¿Doase Bab-Jehová na e-gangued oyosa?
Bab-Jehová, e-mai sapi-e-nii-dutugwad-dungueyobi odummosad. Sapi-e-mali napa-isganagi dogdedaeyobi, e-mai-odummosad. E-mai yeer daklesulid, gandik daklesurbalid. E-daklegedi, wilubba dakleged. Dulemar baisur-dakmalad.
Dulemarse obanagwale gusad. Mesagwale gusad. Gwage-nunmaked-itodii gusad. Undar-odurdakledii gusad. Dulemar gwen-dakbisuli gusmalad. Dulemarse obanagwale gusad. Gwen anmar bai daksasurmalad.
Degi-inigwele, anmarga anmar-bonigan sesad, anmar-anar, anmar-nunmaked itosad. Anmardi egi binsaed, Bab-Dummad we-dule-naibi-imaksaye, sabsur-imaksaye, degi, mesagwar-imaksaye.
E na, anmar-uaya-sated-ular, naibigusad. E na, anmar-isgued-ular, bela-bela sabsur-bibyolesgusad. Anmarga gwage-bogidikid-ukegala, anmar-ular, bela-bela sabsur-odurdaklesad. Anmar e-naibigusadgi nugunonimalad.
Anmar bela sibad-wawaad-yoggusgudidaedyobi, yoggus gudimalanad. Na wala-walagwen e-itolegedba gudidimalanad. Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová bela e-maigi anmar-isgued nasiksad.
Sabsur-imaklenaigu, mesagwar-imaklenaigu, gwen e-gaya itolessulid. Igi-sibad-wawaad-senigwad e-oburgwilegedse selesdae, deyobi, gaya-itosuldgi selemai gusad. Igi-sibad-wawaad ega-e-absar-siked-abin, gordasuli, deyobi, dulemar-asabin Bab-Jehová-e-mai gaya nikussulid, degi, dulemar-asabin gwen gochasurbalid.
Gasmargua, ega igar-amismargua, oburgwismalad. Gwen bai daksasurmalad, e-bina sogsasurmalad. E-wagan-danikoedgi gwen binsassurmalad. Dulemar-bukwad-abargi gandikidgi onolesad, an-dulamar-isgued-anar, oburgwilesad.
Gwen e-sunmakedgi emar-yardaksasur-inigwele, gwen ibmar-isgana-imaksasur-inigwele, dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmalad-abargi burgwisad, degi-inigwele, mani-ibgan-abargi diglesad.
Ar Bab-Jehová, mesagwar-guega imaksad, sabsur-wilegega imaksad. E na dulemar-isgued-anar san-uksasoggu, a-ulale, na suitiba gudii guoed, bela e-waganmar-dakoed, Bab-Jehová-sogedba bela ibmar imakoed.
Sabsur-wilegoed-sorbali, magar-daknonikoed, e-sabsur-wilesadi, binsa wilessuli, degidbali na yeer-itononikoed. Bab-Jehová soged: “An-mai-innikigwadi, e-ibmar-wisidbali, dulemarga igarmar nabogoed. E na dule-ibmar-isgana-imaked sedoed.
A-ulale, dule-dummagan-abargi an osimogoed, e-ibmar-suoedi dule-gandikmaladbo mimioed. Ar ade, na burgwegala, e-san uksad. Dulemar-isgumaladyob imaklesmogad. Dule-bukidarad-e-isgumalad na sesad, dule-isgumalad-irwa gwisgusad.”
Bab-Jehová sogded: “Be, omegwa-geg-baked, gwen be mimmi-nikudisulid, weligwaledba be binnasuli-gole. Be, gwen-muu-neggi-boniba-galitodisulid, binnasuli be namake. ¡Weligwaledba be binnasuli-gole! Ar ani Bab-Jehová soged: Ome-wilesagudiid, bur bule ome-sui-nikadba mimmigan nikuoye.
”Be-dordoneg-siidi, be odummo, be-dordoneg-siidgi atued-dummagan-nanaid be egae. ¡Melle dobe-dobe be imako! Dordoneg-e-dubamar be osugue, e-dordoneg-bargamalad be ogannoge.
Ar be-argan-nuedsiki, degi, be-argan-sapiledsiki be nasgudoed. Be-wagana yar-baigan suoed, be-wagana neggweburmar-olloganagi ambikudoed.
”Melle be dobe-itogo, ar be bingeguosulid. Melle be gwayo, ar be-nug mesagwar guosulid. Be yagwaunni bingegusadi be iegoed. Bei-machered-burgwisgu, bingedar be itosadgi bar be binsaosulid.”
Ar Bab-be-obinnisadi, be-suiga gued. A nugad: “Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadye.” Be-bendakedi, Israel-dulamar-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaledid. A bilegoed: “Bela-napneg-naid-e-Bab-Dummadye.”
Be ome-wilesakwagudiidyob Bab-Jehová bese gornonikoed. Ome-suli-suli-itodiidyob Bab-Jehová bese gornonikoed. Igi ome dogdar yagwa-guedgi machered-nikusale, machered gannar metedae, deyob gudiidgi Bab-Dummad bese gornonikoed.
Bab-Jehová-be-ollor-imakedi soged: “Unnila sikwas an be-obachad. Degi-inigwele, na bela-belad ulubgi wile-be-dakedgi gannar an be-abingaoed.
Unnila sikwas-sae-itogedgine, an be-idu bangusad. Degi-inigwele, sabgued-degisadeguad-nikadgine, an wile be-dakoed.”
Bab-Dummad sogdebalid: “Angardi Noé-ibaganyobi gued, igi an Noéʼga ise-sogar sogsa gusa, muu-dummad bar napneggi murosurye. Deyobi, an bega ise-sogar soged, bar an bebo urwosulid, bar an iisedi bega ibmar sogosulid.”
Bab-Jehová-wile-be-dakedi soged: “Amba yalamar-bukwad baidsik ainirye-sogele, degi, yar-mullugana giglimakdele, andi amba an be-sabedi gwen gwagosulid. Anbo be igar-bogidikid-omesisadi, andi obelogosulid.”
Bab-Jehová-soged: “¡Be dake! Neggwebur-nue-wilesagwa, burwa-dummadba oitolesad. Dule a-neggwebur baisur-itogega-imaked sated. ¡Akwa-nuegan-yeerdaklemaladgi an be-soboed! Akwamar-zafiros-birgi an be-sioed.
Be-galu-matusulid-birgine, an akwa-rubí-nuegan e-bargaedga mesoed. Be-yawagakmar akwa-gargemalad-gaemaladgi an soboed. Degi, bela be-galu-matusurmalad, akwa-gargemaladgi an soboed.
Ani Bab-Jehová, bela be-mimmigan odurdakoed, be-mimmigan gwage-bogidikid nika gudii guoed.
Igar-napiragwadi gannarbaa an be-imakoed. Mesagwar-gudii bar be itogosulid. Bali dobee be itogosulid. Begine, gwayed-dummadi bangudoed, gwen be-walikaa guosulid.
Dule begi gwichigualile, an eba-nai guosulid, dulemar-yogasaar begi gwichiguarmalale, bese galakudmaloed.
”Ani an dule-esgoro-sobed-soo-oduurmakedi obinnisad. We-dule, na bilagi-ibmar-ebulemalad sobed. Ani an dule-emar-obeloged obinnisbalid, adi, bela dule-obelogegar.
Dule begi-nakwega, bila-onogedgi-ibmar-ebuleged-yeer-ganguedi, gwen begi obinosulid. Dulemar begi yogasaar-sunmakmaladi, boo-sigega be imakoed. We-ibmarmala anga-arbadimaladga an ukoed. Angine, igar-innikigwad danikid.” Deyobi, Bab-Jehová soged.
Bab-Jehová sogbalid: “¡Dule-uku-uku-itodimaladi, dii gobdamar! Dule-mani-surmaladi, ibmar-sudamar, vino be sudamar, moli-nunis be sudamar. Gwen be bennukosulid, binsa bega uklegoed.
¿Ar ibiga be binsarsunna mas-nuedsulidgi be mani-oesunna? ¿Ar ibiga binsarsunna be ibmar-yeer-ito-be-imaksulidgi mani-misunna? Be nue an-itomar, bur be mas-nued gunmar, ar be mas-nuegan-gullegedgi na be yeer itomaloed.
Nue be bogi itomar, be anse dagmar. Be nue an-itomar, adi, be dula gudii gumaloed. An bemar-ebo degisadegu igar mesoed, adi, an-mai-David-sabedba an-ega-ibmar-sogsa-gusadba guegar.
Dulemargala, we-David, an-barsogega an nug-imaksad, degi, dule-yar-bamaladga-e-odurdaked-sailaga-guega an nug-imaksad, degine, dummadga an nug-imaksad.
Israel-dulemar, dulemar-dakdisurmaladbina be goloed, degi, dule-aku-be-dakdimarmogadi, bese abarmakdanimaloed. Ar ani an be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaled, be-nug odummosad.”
Bab-Jehová be amimar, ar emisgwa, Bab-Dummad amilegedgined, Bab-Dummadse be gormar, ar ade, be-walikaa gudiid.
Dule-ibmar-isgana-imaked, e-igar-isgana-imakedgi bangusun, dule-isgana, e-binsaed-isganagi bangusun. Bab-Jehová amisun, ar ade, Bab-Jehová dule-nuedid, isgued-eliedid. Ar anmar-Bab-Dummad wile be-dakoed.
Bab-Jehová soged: “An-binsaedi, bemar-binsaedyobsulid, an-daedi, bemar-daedyobsulid.
Igi mogir, napneggi dikasur nai, deyobi, an-daedi, bemar-daedba bur-dikasur-akalad. Deginbali, deyobi an-binsaedi, bemar-binsaedba bur-dikasur-akarbalid.
Ar dii-wiedi, degi, dambed-sibudikid-batedi, ibmar-imaksasuli geg gannar ainakwedaed. Bina we-ibmar imakgwelergebed: Napa-owardikuergebed, napagi-ibmar-oniergebed, ibmar-gwag-osanmakergebed, adi, dule-ibmar-digedga, ibmar-gwag-ukega, degine, dulega masgunned ukegarbar,
deyobi, gayaburba an-gayagi nodele: Anse ollobi nonikosulid, an-ibmar-abegedba ibmar saoed, an-ibmar-sogedba ibmar imakoed.
Bemar weligwaledba ainidmaloed, bogidikidgi gannar be-yalase be momaloed. Be-nadapidbali yalamar, degi, yar-mullugan, binnasuli-weligwaledba namakdemaloed. Degi, bela sapimar-bukwadi, argan ogotemaloed.
Gagan-ikobimalad-muchubbi, ciprés-sapimar ainidagoed. Dakemar-muchubbi, mirto-sapimar dungudagoed. We-ibmarmala, ani an-Bab-Jehová-nug ogannogoed, we-ibmarmala, degisadegu e-wilubga naiguoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Igar-innikigwad be imakmar, igar-nued be oyomar. Ar an-abonolegedi, warmakdanigusad, an-igar-innikigwadi, sanar-guoed.
Dule, an-igarmarba nanadiile, degi, sogedba eba gudiile, we-dule, dule-weligwaledid. Dule, obunnoged-ibagi obunnodiile, gwen egi nodisulile, degi, dule ibmar-isgana-imakdisulile, we-dule dule-weligwaledid.”
Dule-ainebalidi e-binsaedba Bab-Jehová-nug-odummodiile, geg weyob binsaed: “Bab-Jehová e-dulemar-imbagi an-obanguoye.” Dule-alugwasualed geg weyob sogmogad: “Sapi-dingus-gwichidyob, an dakleye.”
Ar Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Ar dule-alugwasuarmalad obunnoged-ibagi obunnodimalale, an-ibmar-abegedba ibmar-imakdimalale, an-igar-mesisadba nue-nanadimalale,
an-neggweburgi, anse-goled-negyaba, galugi an ega e-nuga ise-narmakar nasikoed. We-ibmala ega mimmigan-nikuedba bur bule guoed, degine, an ega nug-degisadeguad ukbaloed, bipisaale gwen e-nuga ielegosulid.
Dule-ainebarmalad anga-arbaega anba-akasmaladi, an-nug-ogannogega anba-akasmaladi, an-nug-odummogega anba-akasmaladi, an-yalase an nidoed. Bela obunnoged-ibagi-obunnodimalad gwen angi-nodisurmaladi, degi, anbo-igar-mesisad-sogedba-gudimaladi,
an-yala-islidikidse an nidoed. Anse-goled-neggi an weligwar-imakoed. Anga ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi ibmar-ukmaloedi an abingaoed. Degi, anga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukmaloedi, an abingabaloed, ar an-nega, bela dulemarga anse-goled-negye nugguoed.”
Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-Jehová weyob soged: “Israel-dulemar e-yargi-gudisurmaladi, gannar e-yargi-ambikuega imaked. An-dulamar dagega an imakoed, bato an Israel-dulemar-baigan-urbisadbo, an oatogoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Bela ibmar-durgan-sapurgi-gudimaladi, degi, bela ibmar-durgan-ursirmaladi, be dagmar, an-dulamar be obelodamar.
Bela Israel-dulemar-nakulemaladi aku-atakmalad, ar wargwensaale, ibmar-daksurmalad. Ar bela achu-gwabinsulidyob gumalad, ar geg urwemalad. Gadi-gabmalad, wiegalamalad, yeer gabed itodamalad.
Bemar achumar-gadi-mas-gunnedyobmalad, immeleged itodasurmalad. Bemar sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad, ibmar akusunna itomalad. Na war-wargwen e-itolegedba gudidii nanaed, bela na e-ibmar-abegedba wala-walagwengi gudidiid.
Binnasuli be gormar, bemar sogmala: ‘¡Dagmar, anmar vino sunamar! ¡Anmar mumgue, inna-gagbid gobe! Anmar banedse emiyobi ibmar imakbaloed, emiba anmar bur bule imakmaloed.’ ”
Dule-innikidaedi burgwemamaigusad, dule gwen bai daksurmalad, dule-bega-arbamalad-nuegan, burgwemamaigusad. Ar dule aku itodamalad, ibiga dule-nuegan isgued-ular burgwiddamala.
Ar dule-igar-nuedba-nanaedi, nuedgi burgwemalad, neg-uangi obunnomegisdamalad.
Bab-Jehová sogded: “Bemar, ome-ina-isgana-imaked-mimmigan, negsichigi-galagwensuli-gambanuchuganba-nanamalad-e-wagan, be anse walikgudamar.
¿Doagi be dodoye sogmala? ¿Doaga be binnasur gaya-maa-maa-imake? ¿Doaga be gwabin buud-buud-imake? ¿Ar bemar isgued-mimmigansursi? ¿Ar bemar gakansamalad-wagansursi?
Bemar wag-ulu-sapi-urba, degi, bela sapi-dummagan-urba, galagwensuli guddamalad. Bab-dummadsurmalad-e-nug-odummogega diangangi, degi, akwa-yaa-ollogangi burwigana be oburgwiddamalad.
Dian-akwa-swirimalad, begadga gumaloed. We-akwa-swirigangi be bergudmaloed. We-ibmar-asabinni, vino be eosmalad, degi, ega be ibmar-gwag-uklemalad uksamalad. Degite, ande we-ibmarmar-abinni, ¿bogi sigode? ¡Adi surbali!
Yar-matusulid-birigine, be-meged be omesisad, yar-matusulidse be nakwisad, agi bab-dummadsulidga ibmar-ogumakar-ukega be nakwisad.
Be-yawagak-daksiki, degi, e-suarmargine, bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad be nasiksad. Be angi bangusad, dule-baid-asabinni uka-swili be gwisgusad. Be-meged-dummad-omesisadgine, be megisad. Doamarbo be megbigusa, amarbo be igar nabosad. Amarbo be megisgua, e-abgan be daksad.
Bab-dummad-Molocʼse be nanasad. Ega be olivo-gwallu berbedii gusad, be-ina-wawagan ega be omelosad. Be be-nuggi-sunmakmalad dikasuli barmisad. Amala, dule-burgwarmalad-burbase binsaed-amiega, be barmisad.
Bali-bali-nanaedba be yegus-inigwele, degite, gwen be sogsasulid: ‘An wesegoye.’ Aka bur be gangusad. A-ulale, gwen be galakussulid.
”¿Doa be-ogwayisa? ¿Doa dobguega be-imaksa? Emide, be an-yardakdiid. Gwen be angi bar binsassurmalad. Gwen bai be an-daksasurmalad. ¿Ar be an-dobsurmarsunde? ¿Ar an undar bogi-gudigusadba be deyob damarsunde?
Emisgi, an be-ibmar-imakedi an barsogoed, gwen bega ibmar-nuedga guosulid.
Ar dule-be-bendakega be binnasuli gollalile, we-ibmar-sobarmalad-bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad gwen be-bendakosulid. Bela we-ibmarmala burwaba seledoed, unnila buu-imakedgi yoggudoed. Ar dule angi-bensuli guele, napaneg egadga guoed, an-yala-islidikid na egadga suoed.”
Bab-Jehová sogded: “Weyob sogdamaloed: ‘Igar-nudakmar, igar-nudakmar, igar-mesmar, an-dulamar-idu igar-isgana nudakmar.’
Ar ade, ani an Bab-Dummad-degisadegu-maidid, an-nuga Isligwaledid, weyob an soged: Ani an niba-maid, neg-isligwaledgi an maid, degi, dulemar-bukib-binsadimaladgi, degi, gwage-eikwaa-imakmaladgi an burbar maibalid. Adi, dulemar-gwage-eikwaa-imakmaladga niga-ogannogegar, degi, dule-bukib-binsadimalad baisur-ito imakegar.
An degisadegu an-dulamargi gwisgudii guosulid, degisadegu an amarse urwedii guosurbalid. Ar degisulile, bela an dulemar-obinnisadi an-abin bergudo-itole.
Emar-isgued-ular, an ese ulusad. An-urwedgine, an sabsur-imaksad. An egi bangusgusad, degi-inigwele, aka igar-isganaba bur nanadmalad.
E-damaladi, an daksad, degi-inigwele, an ega nudakoed. Idudii an guoed, baisur-itoge an imakoed. Degine, dule-ega-bukib-binsadimalad,
weligwaledgi weyob namakmalaga an imakoed: ‘Dikasuli-bukmaladga gwage-bogidik gusun, degi, walikaa-bukmaladga gwage-bogidik gusun.’ An-dulamar an isgussulidyob-dakoed. Ani, an Bab-Jehová-guedgi, deyob soged.
Ar dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmaladi, demar-arwemaiyob gued, geg bogi meged. Igi demar-arwemair, ibmar-isgana mie, degi, ollimar-miardae, deyob dule-isganamar gued.
An Bab-Dummadi soged: ‘Dule-isganamargala gwage-bogidikid sulid.’ ”
Bab-Dummadi Isaíasʼga sogded: “Gandikidba be binnasuli gole, melle be bogguo, gar-trompetaʼyob be binnasuli gole. An-dulamarga e-nodiid be soge, Jacob-waganga e-isgudiid be soge.
Ar bane-bane anse gordimalad, dulemar igar-innikigwad-imakdiiyobi, degi, An-Igar-Mesisadgi bangussurmalayobi, An-Igar-Mamaid wisgubimalad. Igar-inniki-imakleged anse egismalad, ar anse walikgudabimalad.
Degi, ar anga weyob sogmalad: ‘¿Ar ibiga anmar mas-gunsuli bese-golega gudiguoe? Ar bede aku-anmar-daked. ¿Ar ibiga anmar be-ular san-wiomarsunna? Ar bede baisur anmar-dakbalid.’ ”Bemar mas-gunsuli-gudigued-ibagi, mani-onogedgi be arbadamalad, degi, dule-bega-arbamalad be sabsur-imakdedamalad.
Ar unnila bemar urwegala, degi, abin-abin-imakmalagala, na sarsomalagala, be mas-gunsuli gudii damalad. Ar be-itobi be an-abemalale, be mas-gunsuli-gudigued imakmardo. Degi-inigwele, melle emi-imakedyobi be imako.
Weyob mas-gunsuli-gudiguedgi, ¿dule na dukin san-wiodii imakoye an sogsasi? Nargammu-dopee-daklegedyobi, ¿nono-dullu-gudiguoye an sogsasi? Gwage-naibid-oyogega, ¿wile-itoged-mor-yoi gudiguoye an sogsasi? ¿We be bimarsunde, mas-gunsuli-gudigued an yeer dakye? Degi, ¿Bab-Jehová-iba-nued guye?
”An-ular-mas-gunsuli-gudigued-iba an susadi, ¿igar-isgana obelogegarsursi? ¿Dule-sabsur-arbaega-imakleged onogegarsursi? ¿Dule-mesagwar-saledimalad bendakegarsursi? Degine, ¿bela igar-isganaba-ebipiledimalad onogegarsursi?
Ar mas-gunsuli-gudiguedi, ¿dule-ukudmaada-gudiidga be-mas be ukegarsursi? ¿Dule-negsuli-gudimalad akwegarsursi? ¿Dule-morsatemaladga mor-ukegarsursi? Degine, ¿melle be-gwenadgan-obanegarsursi?
Ar be weyob mas-gunsuli-gudigued imakele, igi-wakudar-dad-ibeler noardae, deyobi be guoed. Boni-be-nikadi, yog-bega nugudoed. Be-igar-inniki-imakedi bega igar egaoed, gandikidba-an-yeerdaklegedi beba gudioed.
Be anse golele, an be-abinsaoed. Be anse-bendakleged-egisele, an bega sogoed: ‘¡Wegi an gwichiye!’ ”Dule-mesagwar-imaked-igargi be banguele, dulegi-gwisgued-igargi be noele, degi, yogasaar-emargi-gakansaedgi be banguele, igi-negsichidgi neg-ibegwar-naddae, deyobi be-daedi naoed.
Dule-ukudmaada-gudimalad be bendakdele, degi, dule-ibmar-abesa-gudiidga be ibmar-ukdele, igi-yoruku-neg-mee-dakledae, deyobi be-daedi guoed.
Ani an Bab-Jehová gusgu be-idudii guoed. Nega-dinnaganba an bega mas-ukdii guoed, an bega be-garmar ogannogoed. Igi-dutugalu ogles-naidae, deyobi be guoed, igi-ibe-aryomaidaedi, geg dii-bergue, deyobi be guoed.
Dikasurgus-neg-bibichismaladi gannar bemar soboed. E-sailamar dikasurgus-mamaidi, ogannomaloed. Be weyob bilemaloed: ‘Galu-matusurmalad-bibichisad-nudakmaladye, negmar-bibichisad-gannar-sobmaladye.’ ”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Obunnoged-ibagi be obunnodimalale, gwen egi be nodisurmalale, an-iba-islidikidgi be-itolegedba be ibmar-baigan-imaksulile, be ani Jehováʼgine wergued amimaloed. Weyob be obunnoged-iba-bimalale: ‘Weligwaled-ibaye.’ Degi, weyob be iba-islidikid-bimarbalile: ‘Bab-Jehová-nug-odummoged-ibaye.’ Be angine, wergued amimaloed. Obunnoged-ibaga be bagagwar-gumalale, mani-onogedgi-arbasulidgi be an-nug-odummomalale, degine, walagwengi be-itolegedba-yogasaar-sunmaksulidgi be an-nug-odummomalale,
be angine, wergued amimaloed. Neggwebur-e-dummaganga an be-imakmaloed, degi, be-dad-Jacobʼba be ibmar-nikuoedgi be yeer itomaloed.”
Bab-Jehová anmar-abonogega, ganguedsurye soglesulid. Degi, aku-anmar-itoye soglesurbalid, ar bela magar anmar-itoged.
Ar bemar-isguedi, Bab-Dummadgi-banguega bemar-imaked. Ar be-isgumaladi, Bab-Dummad bemar-idu wagar-aibirar-megega imaked, adi, melle bemar-itogegar.
Ar bemar ablisbi argan sedimalad, degi, goonumar isguedbi na be sedimalad. Be-gwabin-duku unnila gakansaedgi sunmaked, be-gaya unnila igar-isganaginbi sunmaked.
Dule igar-innikigwadgi-sunmaked sulid, dule napiragwadgi-igar-naboged sulid. Gakansalegedgi bensurmalad, na muchub-muchub gakansamalad. Binsaed-isganagi binsadamalad, degi, igar-isgana imakdedamalad.
Dulemar, naibe-nuegan-e-akwa-bukwayobi binsaed-isgana sedimalad, diba-nagueyob, igar-isgana amimalad. Dule, binsaed-isgana we-naibe-akwayob gunnele, burgoed. Ar dule, we-naibe-akwa marele, ega naibeyob binsaed-isgana ainidagoed.
Dibagi geg mor sobleged, dule diba-soblealed geg e-morga imaked. Dule-ibmar-imakedi ibmar-isganabi-imakmalad, e-ibmar-samaladi, unnila sabsur-neg-gagaed.
A-dulemar ibmar-isgana bur-imakmalad, bur dule-ibmar-akalodisulid-ibe ablis eomalad. E-binsaedi, galagwensur-igar-isganagi binsamalad. E-ibmar-imakedi bela neg-oichoged.
Gwage-bogidikid-igar gwen wissurmalad. E-ibmar-imakedgi igar-innikimalad naisulid, unnila igar-noarmaladbi onoardaed. Ar dule we-igar-isganamarba nanadiile, gwage-bogidikid-igar wisguosulid.
Isaías sogded: “A-ulale, igar-napira-maid anmargi banguded. Degi, igar-innikigwadi anmargi aibated. Neg-meegwadi anmar abdakdii gusanad. Degi-inigwele, neg-gubyagwaledgi anmar bukudapid. Neg-ibegwaledi anmar abdakdii gusanad. Degi-inigwele, anmar negsichidgi bukudapid.
Dule-aku-atakmaladyobi, anmar galu-ebu-ebu gudimalad. Dule-ibyasurmaladyobi, anmar negsichidgi acha-acha gudimalad. Neg-mutikidyobi, anmar neg-ibgine yoleddamalad. Anmar bonisuli-inigwele, burgwaleyob na gudimalad.
Bela anmar wiob-uurmakedyob, uurmakbukwad. Nuu-sibu akiginnedyob, anmar akiginbukwad. Aisaar igar-innikigwad-imaked anmar na abdakbukwanad, gwen imaklessulid. Ollorgued-igala anmargi amba dikasulid.
”Be wisid, anmar-isguedi bukidarad. Anmar-isguedi, anmargi aibined. Anmar-ibmar-isgana-imaked anmarba gudiguad. Anmar isguedgi-gudiidi, na magar itomalad.
Anmar, uayasuli gusad. Anmar, Bab-Jehová-obachamalad. Anmar, Bab-Dummad-iedmalad. Anmar, dogdar dule-mesagwar imakmalad, degi, dogdar dule-yardaksamalad. Anmar-binsaedgi-gakansaed-ainiedi, anmar dulemarga sogsamalad.
Igar-napira-maidi isdar-daklege gusad, degi, igar-napiragwadi amba anmargi dikasulid. Dulemar-ambikuedgi igar-nabirid-oyoleged bergusad. Binsaed-nikadaedi, bar anmar oyosurgusad.
Dule ibmar-nabir-imaked, bar daklesulid. Ar dule isguedgi bangudele, bela e-ibmar-nikadi ei obelodamalad. ”Bab-Jehová bela igar-innikimalad-bergusa-dakargu, nabir-itossulid.
Bab-Dummadi, dule igar-nuegangi bar-binsasuli dakargu, geger dakalid. A-ulale, Bab-Dummad na e-gangued oyogoye binsaalid. Adi, anmar-abonogegar, e-igar-innikigwadba anmar-abingaegar.
Bab-Dummadi e-igar-innikigwadi, sigu-abgaedyobi yooed, degi, bormo-gurginyobi abonoleged-igar sioed, buged-imaked-mola yooed, urwed-mola yooed.
Dule-ibmar-imaksamaladba sabsur-odurdakoed. Neggwebur-demar-gakaba-bukmaladga buged-imakoed: E-isdarmaladse urwoed, degi, e-isdarmaladgi buged-imakoed.
”Dad-argwanedsikmalad Bab-Jehová-nug dobgudmaloed. Dad-nakwedsikmalad Bab-Jehováʼgi binsaed-nikaa gudmaloed. Ar ade, diwar-gwichigudanidaedyobi Bab-Jehová na e-buu-imakedba danikoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Dule-bendakedi, Sión-yalase danikoed, Jacob-wagan-e-isguedga-bukib-binsaega imaknonikoed.
”An bemarbo igar mesed, An-Burba bemargi maigu guoed. Be-gwabindukugine, an bega an-gayaburba-nasiksadi, bar begine alliosulid. Degi, be-mimmigangine, be-wagangine, bar an-gayaburba alliosulid, emi-ibadse degisadegu guoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “¡Jerusalén-dulemar, be gwichigu! ¡Bela ibegwale be gumar! ¡Be-neg-ibegwaledi bese warmaknonikid! Ani Bab-Jehová-gued. An-gangued-yeerdaklegedi begi ibegwar naid.
Be dake, neg-gubyagwaledi napneg-gasanaid. Degi, negsichidi, dulemargi naid. Degi-inigwele, an-ibegwaledi begi mee-gaoed. ¡Begine, an-gangued-yeerdaklegedi oyolegoed!
Dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladi, be-neg-meegwadba gudii gumaloed, degi, reymar be-neg-ibegwaledba nanadii gumaloed.
”Nue be atake, be-dikarba be nue neg-dake: Bela danar-ambikusmalad, bese danimalad. Be-mimmigana dikasuli bese danimaloed. Be-bunamala argangi-annikaa nidanimaloed.
Weyob be dakoed, degi, weligwaledba be yeer itodoed, ise-weligwaledba be-gwage dik-dik naguoed. Degi, be-gwage ise-yeer itonaoed. Ar begala neggwebur-demar-gakagi-bukmalad-e-ibmar-nuegan senonimaloed. Degi, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-e-ibmar-nuegan bese warmaknonikoed.
Be-walik moli-yargan-muremalad engudoed. Madián-dulemar-e-moli-yargan-muremalad, Efa-dulemar-moli-yargan-muremalad engudoed. Bela Sabá-neggweburginmaladi bese nonimaloed, bega ina-wawagana, degi, ormar senonimaloed. Degine, an-nug-odummogagwale danimaloed.
Bega, Cedar-neggwebur-e-sibad-wawaadmar ambikunonikoed. Degi, Nebaiot-neggwebur-e-sibad-wawaad-machergan bega ibnuedga guoed. Adi, an-ailagi anga ibmar-nued-uklegedga guegar. Degi, ani an, an-nug-odummoleged-neg yeerdaklege an imakoed.
”Mogiryob-nasdamalad, ¿wede doamala? Nuu-sibuyob e-uuse nadapdamalad, ¿wede doamala?
Neggwebur-demar-gakaba-bukmaladi angi benguosurmalad. Tarsis-ur-dummagan, ur-dummagan-idudanikid. We-urmar, dikasuli be-mimmigan-sedanikid, degi, e-ormar, e-manimar sedanikid, adi, an-nug-odummolegegar. Ar ani an Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaledid, ar ani an gandikidga be-imaksad.
”Dule-ainebarmalad bega gannar galu-matusurmalad soboed, degi, e-reymar bega arbamaloed. An-urwedgi an sabsur-be-odurdaksa-inigwele, an-sabguedgi an ise-wile be-dakoed.
Be-yawagak argasigu guoed, mutikidbali, degi, ibginedbali gwen atiosulid. Bega dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-e-ibmar-nuegan seledanikoed, e-reymar bese ilekwaa seledanikoed.
Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladi, degi, yalamar-nanaidi, beba ibmar-imaksulile, bela obelolegoed.
”Líbano-yala-e-ibmar-nuegan-nikadi, bese warmakoed, ciprés-sapi-warmar, baryawarmar, degi, abeto-sapi-warmar bese warmakoed. Adi, an-neg-islidikid yeerdakle imakega, an-mali-onakwed-gana-neg-siid-e-nug ogannogegar.
Dulemar-mesagwar-be-imakmalad-e-mimmigan, bese dulluu-ambikunonimaloed. Bela dulemar isdar-be-dakmaladi, be-asabin sindigar-signonimaloed, degi, weyob be-bimaloed, ‘Bab-Jehová-neggweburye, Sión-yala, Israel-dulamar-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwaledgadye.’
”Be walagwen-melledgus-inigwele, degi, be isdardakles-inigwele, dule gwen be-igarba nanassur-inigwele, degisadegu nug-dummarba-guega an be-imakoed, degi, dulemar weligwar be-imakega an imakoed.
Dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-e-mas be gunnoed, reymar-e-ibmar-nuegan bega uklegoed. Degisoggu, na be wisguoed, ani an Bab-Jehová be-Abonogedid. Ani an Jacob-wagan-e-Bab-Dummad-gandikid be-bendakedid.
