”Esgoro-gordikid-muchubbi an bega olo sedagoed, esgoro-muchubbi an bega mani sedagoed. Urgo-muchubbi an bega esgoro-gordikid sedagoed, degi, akwamar-muchubbi an bega esgoro sedagoed. Neg-bogidikid-naguega an imakoed. Degi, igar-innikigwadi negseega an imakoed.
Bipisaale bar be-yargi sabsur-imaklegedi, be itogosulid. Bar be-yalagi neg-bibichedgi, degi, neg-obelogedgi sunmaklegosulid. Ar ade, weyob be-galu-matusurmaladgi soglegoed: ‘Abonolegedye.’ Degi, be-yawagakmardi weyob bimarbaloed: ‘Bab-Dummad-nuggi-namaklegedye.’
Bar dad-ibeler bega neg-ibgi, neg-meegwadga guosulid, degi, nii bar bega mee gaosurbalid. Ar Bab-Jehová bega gwallu-meegwad-degisadeguadga guoed. Be-Bab-Dummad be-gangued-yeerdaklegedga guoed.
Dad-ibeler bar bega argwanosulid, degi, nii-gaedi gwen mommolegosurbalid. Ar ani Bab-Jehová be-gwallu-meegwadga degisadegu guoed. Geb agi be-wile-itodiidi bergunonikoed.
”Degisoggu, bela innikigwadga be-dulemar guoed, degi, bela be-dulemar napneg gaoed. Sapi-ainiedyob ainidamaloed. Ani an deyob imakoed. An-sunnagwad an imakoed, an-nug odummolegoed.
Dula-ichegwadi bur miliba (1,000) mergudoed, bur-neggwebur-bipigwadi, neggwebur-gandikidga guoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová gued. We-ibmarmar-guoed-e-ibagan warmaknonikile, gwae-gwae-guega an imakoed.”
“Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bur-Birigined-E-Burba angi maid. Ar ade, dule-wilemaladga gayaburba-nuegangi-sunmakega, Bab-Dummad an-susad. Bab-Dummad an-barmialid, dule-gwage-nunmak-itodimaladga gwage-armakegar. An-barmialid, dule-galesbukmalad-onogedgi sunmakega, degi, dule-esgaryagi-galesbukmalad onogegar.
Bab-Dummad an-barmiarbalid, Bab-Jehová-birga-nuedgi sunmakega, degi, anmar-Bab-Dummad-buged-mai-imakoed-e-ibagi sunmakegar. An-barmiarbalid, bela dule-wile-itodimalad-e-gwage armakega,
degi, Sión-dulemar-gwage-nunmak-itodimalad-niga ogannoegar. An-barmialid, nonogi-buru-biin-gudiid-muchub, ega ologurgin ukegar. An-barmialid, wile-itoged-muchub, weligwaledba ega gwallu-wawad ukegar. An-barmialid, bukib-binsadiid-muchub, ega weligwar-itoged ukegar. Geb degine, wemar weyob biledmaloed: ‘Igar-innikigwad-urwar-sapimarye.’ Bab-Jehová na e-gangued-oyogega digsad.
”Negmar-epennemalad-bibichis-bukwadi, gannar sobmaloed. Negmar-birgabargus-akwamarbi-omilededi, gannar nudakmaloed. Neggweburmar-bibichis-bukwadi, gannar obinomaloed. Dikasurgus akwamarbi-neggwebur-omilededi, gannar nudakmaloed.
Dule-ainebarmaladi, be-sibad-wawaadmar akwemaloed. Dule-neggwebur-baidsikmaladi, be-nainumargi, degi, be-uva-nainumargi, bega arbamaloed.
Ar bemardi weyob biledmaloed: ‘Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled Bab-Jehováʼgadye.’ Bemarga sogdemaloed: ‘Anmar-Bab-Dummadga ibmar-imakmaladye.’ Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-e-ibmar-nuegangi, be yeer itomaloed. E-ormar-sunsogmaladi, be yomaloed.
”An-dulamar, e-binged-dummad-itosmalad-muchub, ibmar-nuegan ilabo-wilub abingamaloed. An-dulamar, e-nug-isgusad-muchub, ibmar-ega-uklegoedgi yeer itomaloed. Deyobi, na e-napagine ibmar-ega-uklegoedi, ilabo-wilub abingamaloed, degisadegu weligwale gudii gumaloed.
”Ani an Bab-Jehová, igar-innikigwad-sabedid, ar ibmar-atursaeddi, degi, igar-isgana-imaklegeddi, an isdar-daked. An-inniki-daedgi an bemarga ibmar-buged-ukleged ukoed. An bemarbo igar-degisadeguad mesoed.
Be-wagana, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-imbagi, nug-nika gumaloed. Be-mimmigan neggweburmar-imbagi nug-nika gumaloed. Dulemar dakarmalale, magar dakmaloed, sogmaloed: ‘We-dulemar, Bab-Jehová dulemargi-nued-binsasmalad e-waganad.’ ”
“Bab-Jehováʼgi an bela-bela yeer itoged, an-Bab-Dummadgi an weligwar itoged. Ar ade, abonoleged-mormar anga yosad, degi, igar-innikigwad-imaked-morgi an-edusad. Machered ome-nikunair, igi ibmar-yeerdakleged bebegi-yoidae, deyobi an gued. Ome sui-nikunair, igi ormar-nasikdae, deyobi an gued.
Ar igi napa ibmar-muugan-oniega imake, degi, igi nainu ibmar-gwag-niega imake, deyobi, Bab-Jehová-Bur-Birigined, bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-abargi, igar-innikigwad, degi, namakleged, ainidagega imakoed.”
An Sión-neggwebur-sabed-ulale, an bogiguosulid. An Jerusalén-neggwebur-sabed-ulale, an obunnogosulid. Geb Bab-Dummad-e-Igar-innikigwad-imaked magar-daklegedse, an bogiguoed. Geb Bab-Dummad-bendakleged, gwinnur-gaedyob-guedse, an obunnogoed.
Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladi, be-igar-innikigwad-imaked dakmaloed. Bela reymala be-gangued-be-yeerdakleged dakmaloed. Nug-gwapid be nikuoed, Bab-Jehová-sunnad bega nug ukoed.
Bab-Jehová-e-argangine, ologurgin-yeer-gaedyob, be guoed. Be-Bab-Dummad-e-argan-yaurgine, ibmar-yeerdakleged-reymar-bebegi-nasiklegedyob, be guoed.
Wargwen-mellededye, bar be-biosurmalad. Napabi-naidye, be-yala biosurmarbalid. An egi-yeer-itogedye, be bilegoed. An-sanwaye, be-yala bilegoed. Ar Bab-Jehová begi yeer itogoed, be-yala sui nikuoed.
Ar sapingwa na e-yagwabo-nikunaiyobi, gannar-be-urbed, deyobi bebo nikuoed. Ar igi-sapingwa yagwa-ebo-nikuoedgi weligwar-itodae, deyobi, be-Bab-Dummad, begi yeer itogoed.
Jerusalén-neggwebur, be-galu-matusurmaladgi, sorda-nakulemalad an urbisad. Wemala, bipisaale gwen mutikidbali, ibginedbali, gaya bogiguosurmalad. Bemar, Bab-Jehováʼse-gormalad melle be obunnomalo.
Ar Jerusalén-neggwebur gannar urbedse, degi, Jerusalén-neggwebur-nug-nika imakedse, melle be, Bab-Dummad obunnogega imakmalo.
Bab-Jehová na e-argan-gangued-nikadba, weyob ise-sogar imaksad: “Bipisaale be-ibmar-gwag be-isdarmalad-e-masga-guega bar an ukosulid, degi, vinoʼgi be nue-arbasgusadi, dule-ainebarmaladi be-ibe gobosurmalad.
Dule ibmar-gwag-wesmaladi, an nug odummobukwa ibmar-gwag gunmaloed. Dule uva-san-wesmaladi, anse-goled-neg-islidikid-neg-imbagi, vino gobmaloed.”
¡Jerusalénʼginmalad, be ainimar! ¡Yawagak-bukwadgi, be ainimar! ¡Dulemar-idu igar nudakmar! ¡Igar-dummad be mesmar! ¡Bela akwamar be onirmar! ¡Dulemar igar-maid-magar-dakega be bander onakwe!
Bab-Jehová bela-dulemar-napneggi-bukwadga, weyob sogsad: “Jerusalén-dorganga be sogmar: ‘¡Bato be-abonoged danikid! Na e-nakwisad-ibmar eba sedanikid, na e-ibmar-buged-ukleged eba danikid.’
Dulemar-islidikidye, be bilemaloed. Bab-Jehováʼse bendaklesmaladye, be bilemaloed. Neggwebur-abelegedye, be-neggwebur bilegoed. Neggwebur bipisaar wargwen-melledsulidye, be-neggwebur bilegoed.”
Edom-yar-akar danikid, ¿wede doawa? Bosra-neggwebur-akar mor-ginnidbi-yoi danikid, ¿wede doawa? Mor-nudakar-yoi danikid, ¿wede doawa? Gandikidba binna-binnagwad danisulid, ¿wede doawa? “Ani an danikid. An igar-innikigwadba-sunmakedid, an dule-abonogega-gangued-nikadid.”
¿Ar ibiga be-mor ginnitibi daklege? Ar be-mor, uva-egured-galugi dule-uva-egured-e-moryob dakleged.
“An walagwen uva-egured-galugi uva-egurusad, dule-bamalad gwen anba gunai gussulid. An-sae-itogedgi an egi annasad. An-urwedgi an maataa imaksad. E-ablis an-morgine milesad, degi, bela an-mor ese isgusad.
Buged-mai-imaked-iba bato an mesisad. An-dulamar-bendakleged-iba bato warmaksad.
Dule-an-bendaked an edarbisanad, degi-inigwele, dule gwen an-bendaksasulid, dule-wargwensaar-an-bendakbi-gussulid geg an itoged. Dukin an-ganguedgine an emargi obichad. An-urwedi sikirmakega an-imaksasulid.
An-sae-itogedgi, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-birgi an annasad, an-urwedgi an amar-obelosad. E-ablis napagi-milegega an imaksad.”
Bab-Jehová-e-sabgued-dummad an ebinsaoed, e-ibmar-dummagan-imaksadgi an namakoed. Bab-Jehová bela anmarga ibmar-imaksad-ular, an ega namakoed. Wile-anmar-daked-ular, degi, dummad-anmar-sabed-ular, an ega namakoed. Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemarga ibmar-nuegan-bukidar-imaksad-ular, an ega namakoed.
Ar Bab-Dummad weyob sogsad: “Ar napiragwa, wemar an-dulamalad, mimmigan-an-yardakmalosulidid.” Deyobi, e-suli-suli-itogedgine, Bab-Dummad bendaknonikid.
Bab-Dummad dule-abonogega, dule-e-nuggi-sunmaked, degi, baliwitur, barmiarsulid, na e-sunnad dule-abonosad. E-sabedgine, degi, e-wile-dule-dakedgine, bendaknonikid. Gannarse ogwichisad, na e-ganguedba sesad. Epennegwadyobi deyob imaksad.
Degi-inigwele, Israel-dulemar Bab-Jehováʼba ibsassurmalad, E-Burba-Isligwaled-wile-itogega imaksamalad. A-ulale, Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemar-e-isdaradga gunonikid, Bab-Dummad e-sunnad egi bila-onosad.
E-dulamar, epenne neg-gusmalad-ebinsadmalad, degi, Moisés-ibagangi neggusad-ebinsadmalad, weyob sogdemalad: “Dule demar-obakega anmar-idunadap-gusadi, emide, ¿bia gudii? Dule Israel-dulemar-e-iduedi, ¿bia nade? Bab, E-Burba-Isligwaled-Moisésʼgi-mesisad, ¿wede bia nade?
Dule e-gangued-nikadba Moisés-argan-nuedsik, Moisésʼba nadapigusad, emide, ¿bia nade? Bab, dulemar-asabin demar-egasad, adi, degisadegu e-nug-dummarba-guega, ¿wede bia nade?
Igi-moli nega-dulesulidganba gwen ibmargi-yolesuli nadapdae, deyobi, muu-billi-odinnosadba dulemar-obakega-imaksadi, ¿wede bia nade?”
Igi-moli-bebe-nikamalad nebase gagan-manonidamala, deyobi, Bab-Jehová-E-Burba, Israel-dulemarga obunnoged uksad. Bab-Jehová, be-nug-dummarba-guega, weyobi, be-dulamar-idumai be gusad.
Bab-Dummadye, mogir-billi-akale, be nue atake. Be-neggandikid-islidikid-yeerdakleged-akale, be nue negdake. ¿Bia be-sabed-dummarbad, degi, be-gangued nade? Be-wile-dule-daked, degi, be-sabgued anmar daksulid.
Degi-inigwele, be, anmar-Babad, ar Abraham amba aku-anmar-dakele, degi, dad-Israel amba aku-anmar-dakbalile, be, Bab-Jehová, be anmar-Babad. Gusgu be Anmar-Ollor-Imakedye nugad.
Bab-Jehová, ¿ibiga be-igargi banguega be anmar-imake? Bab-Jehová, ¿ibiga be, mer be-dobgumalaga, anmar-gwage-dutusur imake? Be-maigan-sabed-ulale, be gannar dage. Be-dulamar-danar-danar-bukwad-sabed-ulale, be gannar dage.
Be-dulamar ichesaale be-neg-islidikid akwisad. Emidi, anmar-isdarmalad bela be-neg-islidikidyaba ubosad.
Emidi, anmala, be-anmar-dummad-iduedga-megissulidyob bukwad. Anmala, begadga-gussulidyob bukwad.
Anmar-Bab-Dummadye, bitigi be nibneg egasana gadin, bitigi be aidealina gadin. Ar be-abin yarmar giglimakdeled. Be-isdarmalad-abargi be-nug be oyodele, igi soo sapan-ogader dii-ogwakgwarmakdae, deyobi, be-abin dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladi gudmalaled, be-abin wawanmakdemalaled.
Be aidenonigu, ibmar-geger-itolemalad, ibmar-gegerdaklemalad, anmar abdakbuksulid be imaksad, be-asabin yarmar giglimakded.
Negasaila-akale, dule-egi-bensurmaladga ibmar-dummagan-imaked dakledisulid, dule-baid-beyobid gwen itoledisurbalid.
Dule-weligwaledgi-igar-innikigwad-imakdiid be abingaed, be-igarba-nanadimalad be abingabalid. Ar anmar isgussoggu, be sae-itoded. Ar anmar dikasurgus isguedginbi gudidimalad. ¿Ar wede anmar sunna abonolede?
Ar anmarde bela ibmar-isganayob gumalad. Bela anmar-igar-inniki-imakedi, siamar-yokor-bisgemalad-e-mor-ebusadyob gued. Bela anmar gagan-dinguedyob gumalad. Anmar-isguedi, burwayobi anmar-oseleged.
Dule-wargwensaale, be-nug obarsulid, begi-bendakleged-amiegala gwen gandik-imaksurmarbalid. A-ulale, be-wagar be anmar-idu odukusad, degi, anmar-isguedba-berguega be anmar-imaksad.
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová, bee be anmar-Babad. Anmar napsa gumalad. Bedi napsa-sobedga gued, bela be anmar-obinnisad.
Bab-Jehová, melle be bela-bela sae-itoge. Melle be degisadegu anmar-isgued ebinsadii gue. Wis be wile-anmar-dake, ar anmar bela be-dula gumalad.
Be-neggweburmar-islidikmalad nega-dulesulidganga gunonikid. Siónʼse-bakale, nega-dulesulidganga gunonikid, Jerusalén-neggwebur ollobi-daarmakarnai gunonikid.
Anmar-bese-goled-neg-yeerdakleged-islidikid, bia an-babgan bega namakbukdamala, bela soose gummaksa siid. Bela anmar-ibmar-bur-nuegan-nikadi, bergusad.
Bab-Jehová, weyob-ibmarmar-gusadgine, bede, ¿gwen ibmar akar imakosuli? Bede, ¿ibmar sogosurde? ¿Binsarsunna be bukib-binsaega anmar-imakode?
Bab-Jehová soged: “Dule-an-egisdisurmaladse an magarosad, an doa-dule gue. Dule-an-amidisurmalad an-amiega an imaksad. Dule-baigan-an-nug-odummodisurmaladga, an sogsad, wegi an gwichiye.
Dule-uayasulidamaladse, igar-isganaba-nadapmaladse, e-binsaedba-nanadimaladse, bane-bane, an-argan an oyomai gusanad.
We-dulemar, bali-bali an-ourwega an-imakmalad. Dutugalumargine, bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imaklemaladga ibmar ukmalad. Ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailamargi, ina-wawadikmalad ogumakmalad.
We-dulemar, neg-uangi sigmalad, mutikidbali, dukuar oibosii damalad. Sin-san gundamalad, e-esmedmargi ibmar-nis-isgana dudamalad.
We-dulemar sogmalad: ‘¡Be anmargi bannabagudii samalo! ¡Melle be anmarse walikaa gumalo!’ An bemarba bela-bela dule-islidikid gued. ”We-dulemar, waayobi gwen-nabir-ito an-asu-imaksulid, bane-bane soo-duurmaksiiyob gued.
An-asabin bela e-ibmar-imaked narmakar naid, an sunmaksuli guosulid. An sabsur-odurdakoed, na nunmak itomaloed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Bemar-isgued-ulale, degi, be-babgan isgusad-ulale, an sabsur-be-odurdakoed. Ar we-dulemar yar-birgi ina-wawadikmalad-ogumakdii gusmalad, yar-mullugangi angi-gwisgudii gusmalad. Epenne e-ibmar imaksamaladba, na dukin sabsur-odurdaklemalaga an imakoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Dule-wargwen uva-san-dukgwen-nued-amisale, sogdaed: ‘An oichogosurye, ar ade, amba nis nikaye.’ Deyopira, an an-maimar-sabed-ulale, belamakale, an-maimar an obelogosulid.
Jacob waganmar-nikuega an imakoed, Judáʼgi, dulemar-an-yarmar-gamaloedi, an onidagoed. Anse-sulegarmaladi we-napaneg gamaloed, a-napagine, an-maimar megmaloed.
An-dulamar-an-amidimaladga, Sarón-neba sibad-wawaad-galuga guoed, Acor-neba-naidi, moli-bebe-nikamalad-galuga guoed.
”Ar bemar angi-banguddamaladdi, bemar an-yala-islidikid-ieddamaladdi, es-suidgi-oburgwilegega an be-imakmaloed. Bemar bab-dummad-ibmar-bukidar-ukedgala, degine, bab-dummad-deyob-guoye-sogmaidgala, guagwar mas, degi, vino ukdamaladdi,
es-suidgi-oburgwilegega an be-imakbaloed. Bela bemar dukar-egwallegega sindigar sigmaloed. Ar an bemarse gochamalanad, bemardi gwen an-abin-imaksasurmalad. An bemarga sunmaksanad, bemardi, gwen an-itossurmalad. Aka bur an-asabin ibmar-isgana imaksamalad, degi, an-ibmar-abesulidi bemar imaksabalid.”
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gangued-Nikad weyob soged: “An-maimar mas-gunmaloed, bemardi, ukudmaad gudigumaloed. An-maimar gobed-nika gudimaloed, bemardi, gobedsuli gudigumaloed. An-maimardi, weligwar-itodii gumaloed, bemardi, bingedar-itodii gumaloed.
An-maimar weligwaledgi namakmaloed, bemardi, suli-suli-itogedgi binnasuli gormaloed, nue wiles-itogedba akiginmaloed.
Anse-sulegarmaladi, emar-ukabsamalaga bemar-nug ebumaloed. Ani Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bur-Birigined bemar-oburgoed, ar an-maimargardi, nug-baid an ukoed.
Dule, neggweburgi ise-nued-binsaleged egichialile, an-innikigwad-gued-nuggi egisoed. Dule, neggweburgi ise-sogar-ibmar-imakalile, an-innikigwad-gued-nuggi imakoed. Suli-suli-itolesadi, bela ielesad, an-asabin an bela elisad.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Nue an-itomalo. An nibneg-binid, napneg-binid, an obinyesokalid. Ibmar-nasmalad bar obarilegosulid, bar egi binsalegosurbalid.
An-ibmar-obinyesokalidba bur be weligwar-itomala, degisadegu be yeer-itomala. An Jerusalén-neggweburga yeer-itoged nasiksokalid, an e-dulemarga weligwar-itoged uksokalid.
An Jerusalén-neggweburba, weligwar itogoed, an-dulamarbo an yeer itogoed. Jerusalénʼgi bar boed itolegosulid, deginbali, suli-suli-itogedba-gormaked bar itolegosurbalid.
”Jerusalénʼgi mimmigan gwalulesale, bipigwadgi bar burgosurmalad, deginbali, dadormar bar sapingwaa burgosulid, selebaa megmaloed. Ar dule birga-dulatar-nika (100) burgwele, amba nuchukwaa burgwisye soglegoed. Ar dule birga-dulatarse (100) warmaksasulirdi, dule-isganaye egi soglegoed.
An-dulamar, negmar sobmaloed, egi megmaloed. Uva-dubmar digmaloed, e-san gunmaloed.
Dule-baid-megega neg bar sobosurmalad. Deginbali, dule-bamalad uva-san-gunnega, uva-dubmar bar digosurmarbalid. Ar an-dulamar-e-ibagan, sapimar-ibaganyob guoed. Anse-sulegarmaladi, na e-ibmar-imakmaladgi yeer itomaloed.
Binsarsunna arbanai guosurmalad, deginbali, mimmigan-wiogega, mimmigan nikuosurmalad. An-dulamar na e-sunnagwad, degi, e-waganmoga, Bab-Jehová egi ise-nued-binsasad-dulemarga guoed.
Anse-goled-iduale, ani an abinsaoed. Amba sunmaknanaidgine, bato an itogoed.
Achu-sapur, sibad-wawaad-senigwadbo mas-gundii gumaloed. Achumigur-nono-wawaad, moli-bebe-nikad-alugwasualedyob gagan-madii guoed, degi, naibe unnila ukub-burubi madii guoed. Bela an-yar-islidikidgine, dule, dule-baid-onailiksadii guosulid, degi, ibmar-obelodii guosurbalid. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi deyob soged.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Nibnega an-ologana gued, napneg an-nag-onakwed gued. ¿Ibi-neg be anga sunna sobsamarsunnale? An-obunnoged-neg, ¿bia be anga sobmalosunna?
Ani Bab-Jehová soged: Ar belagwable we-ibmarmar ani an obinnisad, deyobi nagunonikid. ”Ani an dule-wilemalad, dule-suli-suli-itodimalad, degi, an-gayaburbaba binsaed-nika-nanadimalad, an yeer-daked.
Ar dulemar anga moli-bebe-nikad-machered ogumakar ukedi, dule-gindakmaladyob gumalad. Ar dulemar anga sibad-wawaad-senigana-oburgwedamaladi, bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladga achu-nono-bisgar-ukmaladyob gumalad. Ar dulemar anga ibmar-gwag ukdamaladi, bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladga sin-ablis-ukdamaladyob gumalad. Ar dulemar an-nug odummogega anga ina-wawadikid obupurmakdamaladi, bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad-e-nug-odummomaladyob gumalad. We-dulemar na dukin e-itolegedba igar susmalad, e-ibmar-isgana-imakedgi na yeer itodimalad.
An ega sabsur-odurdakleged ukmogoed, bela-belad-ibmar-dobmalad an egi barmidoed. Ar an gochagua, gwen dule an-abin-imaksasulid. Ar an sunmaksagua, gwen dule an-itossulid. Aka bur an-asabin ibmar-isgana imaksamalad, an-ibmar-abesulid imaksamarbalid.”
Bemar Bab-Jehová-gayaburba-dobee-nanadimalad, Bab-Jehová-gayaburba be itomala: “Be-gwenadgan-sae-be-dakdimaladi, degi, an-nug-ular-be-obandimaladi, dodoakwaa weyob sogmalad: ‘Bab-Jehová, e-gargangued oyoge, adi, anmar bemar-weligwar-itoged dakegar.’ Ar isdar-be-dakmaladdi bingegumaloed.”
Neggwebur-akale, gayaburba binnasuli goled, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi gayaburba goled: “We-gaya, Bab-Jehová-gayaburba gued, e-isdarmaladga sabsur-ibmar sognaid.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Jerusalén, boni-itodaged-iduale, bato mimmi nikusad. Jerusalén, yoo-bonigan-itodaged-iduale, goe-susugwa baksad.
¿Doa weyob ibmar-soglege itodii? ¿Doa weyob ibmar-oyolege dakdii? ¿Ar dulemar-yargi-bukued ilagwen-bukuar bukusi? ¿Ar neggwebur-gwagwen ukiagwale gwalulesi? Degi-inigwele, Sión-yardi abga-bonigan-itoaliyalaba mimmigan nikusad.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar ani an sikwi-aidegega imaked, degite, ¿an geg sikwi-odegega imakde? Ar ani an dula-nikuega-imaked, degite, ¿an sikwimar-aideged-igar gaode?
”Bemar, Jerusalén-neggwebur-sabmaladi, Jerusalénʼba be weligwar-itomala, e-ular, be yeer-itomala. Bemar, Jerusalénʼba bukib-binsadimaladi, be weligwaledgi ichomakmala.
Ar Jerusalén-neggwebur nanyobi e-mamgi be-onumaloed, immerbaa be gumaloed. E-nunis-ena-ena-nanaid immelegedse bemar gobmaloed, egi be nue-yeer itomaloed.”
Ar Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “An Jerusalén-neggweburgi dii-nollosur-aryomaidyobi gwage-bogidikid nasikoed. Dulemar-yar-baigangi-bukmalad-e-ibmar-nuegan diwar-engumaidyobi, Jerusalénʼga-ukega an imakoed. Jerusalén, goemaryobi mamgi be-onumaloed, e-sakwagi angaagwar be-semai guoed, e-nukugi be-mesmaloed.
Nan igi na e-mimmi-gwage armake, deyobi an bemar-gwage armakoed. Bemar Jerusalén-neggweburgi gwage armaklemaloed.”
Bemar weyob ibmar-dakalile, gwagegi bemar weligwar itodmaloed, gagan-aramakdedyobi bemar gannar gannaledmaloed. Bab-Jehová e-maimar-abargi e-gangued oyogoed, e-isdarmalad-abargi e-urwed oyogoed.
Bab-Jehová bato soo-abargi danikid. E-bila-onoged-ur-napagined burwa-ooredyob dakleged. Bab-Dummad, e-sae-itoged urwedgi oyononikoed, e-sabsur-odurdaked soo-aramakwichiyob guoed.
Bab-Jehová, bela dulemarga soogi, degi, es-suidgi igar-nabogoed. Bukidar Bab-Jehováʼse burgwemaloed.
Bab-Jehová soged: “Dulemar-san-islidik-imakmaladi, degi, san-swilidik-imakmaladi, dule-negabargi-nadapidba nadapmalad, adi, bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad-dudumar-galuse-dogega. Bela-wemar na mesa burgwemaloed. Dulemar-sin-gunmalad, nusa-gunmalad, degi, ibmar-baigan-isemalad-gunmalad, bela-mesa bergumaloed.
”Ani, an e-ibmar-imaked-ulale, degi, e-binsaed-ulale, bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad, degi, gaya-akar-akar-sunmakmaladi oatosokalid. We-dulemar danimaloed. An-gangued-yeerdakleged dakmaloed.
”An ega wilub-oyogoed, abala dule dula-bemaloedi, we-yarmarse an barmidoed: Tarsisʼse, Futʼse, Ludʼse (we-dulemarde sigu-mied-dulemalad), Tubalʼse, Javánʼse, dikasur demar-gakaba-neggwebur-bukmalad an-nug-itodisurmaladse, degi, an-gangued-yeerdakleged-dakdisurmaladse an barmidoed. ”Wemala, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladga, an-gangued-yeerdaklegedgi sunmakmaloed.
Dulemar be-gwenadgan-yar-baid-baidgi-gudidimalad, an-yala-islidikid-Jerusalénʼse, anga ibmar-uklegedyobi seledagega imakmaloed: Abala, molimargi be-gwenadgan-sedamaloed. Bamaladdi, moli-ur-napagined-bila-onomaladgi, e-gabmaladgi, moli-uaya-senigwadmargi, degi, moli-yargan-muremaladgi sedamaloed. ”Ar igi-Israel-dulemar anse-goled-negse bormo-swilidikidgi anga ibmar-gwag-ukleged sedanidamala, deyobi, be-gwenadgan-sedamaloed. Ani Bab-Jehová deyob soged.
”We-be-gwenadgan-seledamaloedi, abala dule-irwa-anse-golemaladga, degi, Levita-dulemarga an suoed.
Ar igi an-asabinni nibneg-gwapid, degi, napneg-gwapid degisadegu-nai-guoe, deyobi, be-waganmar degisadegu-bukwa an imakoed. Degi, bemar-nug degisadegumogoed. Ani Bab-Jehová deyob soged.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Nii-binid-gwisgued-ilibali, degi, obunnoged-ibagan-ilibali, bela dulemar an-nug-odummodii gumaloed.
Ainidmaloed, geb dule-angi-gwisgusmalad-e-muigan omilede dakmaloed. ”Ar nus-e-san-gunnedi gwen burgosulid, deginbali, soo-e-san-ogumaknaidi gwen ginnosurbalid. Bela dulemarga ibmar-imadga guoed.”
Hilcías-machi-Jeremías we-gayaburbamar sogsad. Jeremíasʼde dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-gwenadgansik danikidid, Anatot-neggweburginedid. Anatot-neggweburde, Benjamín-yalagi siid.
Deunni, Amón-machi-Josías reyga birgambe-gakapaagus (13) Judá-yargi-maidgi, Jeremíasʼse Bab-Jehová-gayaburba nonikid.
Deginbali, Josías-machi-Joacim Judáʼgi reyga-maigusadgi, Bab-Jehová-gayaburba Jeremíasʼse nonigusbalid. Josías-machi-Sedequías Judáʼgi birgambe-gakagwensak-gaka-nii-walataledgi reyga-maid-bergusadse, Bab-Jehová-gayaburba Jeremíasʼse nonigusbalid. Wegisundo, a-ibagangi, deunni, Jerusalén-dulemar Babilonia-neggweburse gales-selesgusmalad.
Bab-Jehová-gayaburba anse nonikid, weyob anga nonikid:
“Jeremías, amba yoo be sapibeneggi-mege bato an be-susad. Amba yoo be gwalulege, bato angadga an be-imaksad. Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladga an-gayaburba-barsogedga bato an be-nug-imaksad.”
An weyob Bab-Jehová-abin sogded: “¡An duledar-wiles! Bab-Dummad-Jehová, amba an machi-swilid. An wissulid, igi an dulemar-abargi sunmakoe.”
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová anga sogded: “Melle be soge: ‘Amba an machi-swiliye.’ Ar bia an be-barmidoe, aba be naoed. An bega-ibmarmar-sogoedi, bela dulemarga be sogmogoed.
Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi bega soged: Melle be dulemar-abin gwayo. Ani an be-bendakega beba gudii guoed.”
Geb agine, Bab-Jehová e-argan anse-oyoalid, geb an-gakuli ebusad. Agine weyob anga sogded: “Be-gwabindukugi an bega, an-gayaburbamargi-sunmakoed an nasiksad.
Emi-ibagi, yarmar-selemamaidgi, degi, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi gargangued-nika an be-imaked: Adi, be dulemar-ononnogega, yar-selemamaid-obelogegar, Dulemar-osulogega, yar-selemamaid-bibisgegar. Gannar dulemar-urbega, gannar yarmar-selemamai guegar.”
Geb Bab-Jehová anga soged: “Jeremías, we-ibmar, ¿ibu-ibmar be dake?” Bab-Jehová-abin an sogded: “We an dakedi, sapi-almendro-ana an daked.”
Degi, Bab-Jehová anga sogded: “Nabir-be-soge, inniki be daksad. An-ibmar-sogsadi, sogedba-guega an imakedsegad.”
Geb Bab-Jehová gannar anga sognonibalid. Weyob anga sogded: “¿Jeremías, we-ibmar, ibu-ibmar be dakbali?” Bab-Jehová-abin an sogded: “We an dakedi, bormogi-dii-gwakwarmaknai an daked. A-dii-gwakwarmaknaid dad-nakwed-sapiled-akar aryodani an daked.”
Geb Bab-Jehová anga odaloded: “Dad-nakwed-sapiled-akale, bela we-yalagi-dulemar-bukwadgi, boni-dummagan an barmidoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Dulemar-dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik-bukmaladse an golesokalid. A-dulemar Jerusalén-neggwebur-doged-yawagakse, e-ambikued-negmar urbenonikoed. Bemar-galu-matusulid-akwabiid-asabin ambikunonimaloed, degi, bela Judá-neggweburmargi gwichigunonimaloed.
Dulemar bela-belad-isgusmalad-ular, an egi gwichiguoed. Ar ade, angi bangudmalad. Bab-dummad-baiganga ina-wawadikid ogumakar ukdemalad. Degine, e-ibmar-sobsamalad, e-bab-dummadyobi imakdemalad.
”Jeremías, bedi guakwagudii sao. An bega bela-ibmar-sogoedi, be sognao. Melle be we-dulemar dobguo. Degisulile, ani an dulemar-asabin-gwayega an be-imakoed.
Emi-ibagi, neggwebur-gandikidyob an be-imaksad. Bubawar-esgorobiidyob, an be-imaksad, degi, galu-matusulid-esgoro-gordikidbiidyob, an be-imaksad. An be-ogannosadi, bela we-yalagi dulemar-bukwadgi-yolegega an be-imaksad. Judá-e-reymargi-gwichiguega an be-imaksad, e-dummagangi-gwisguega an be-imaksad. Degine, e-dule-irwa-anse-gormaladgi-gwisguega an be-imaksad. Bela dulemar-e-neggweburginmaladgi-yolegega an be-ogannosad.
We-dulemar bela begi gwisgunanai gumaloed, degi-inigwele, begi obinosurmalad. Ar ani an, be-bendakega beba gudii guoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi, we-ibmar an bega soged.”
Bab-Jehová-gayaburba weyob anse nonikid:
“Be nae, Jerusalén-dulemarga be sunmakna, ega weyob be sogna, Bab-Jehová weyob-sogye: ‘An ebinsado. Be yagwa-unni anbinarbi be-sogdidaed. Ome machered-abesiidyobi, nega-dulesulidganba be an-balimaksa gusad. Napaneg-ibmar-digar-sulidganba be an-balimaksa gusad.
Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi an bega soged: Bemar-Israel-dulemar, anga be dule-gwage-swilidikmalad gumalanad. Bemar anga, gebe-ibmar-sanmakedyob gumalanad. Dulemar ibigwensur-bemar-imakalile, anse sabsur-odurdakledaed, boni-dummagan an egi barmiardaed.’ ”
Ani Jeremías sogded: Jacob-wagan, Bab-Jehová-gayaburba be nue itomar, Israel-dulamar bela be an-itomar.
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Be-dadgande, ¿ibigi egi-nosa an-daksamarsunna? Emide, angi bangusmalad. Bab-dummagan-ibmarga-gusurmaladba nadegusmalad, agala, be-dadgan ibmarga gussurmarmogad.
Bipisaale, be-dadgan gwen-egichasurmalad: Bab-Jehová-Egipto-yalagi-anmar-onosadi, ¿bia-nadye? Bab-Jehová-nega-dulesulidganba-anmar-idusadi, napa-dii-sateganba, degi, nega-buleganba-anmar-seargusadi, bia-nadye, gwen egichasurmalad. Bab-Jehová-nega-dinnaganba, degi, negasichidganba-anmar-seargusadi, bia-nadye, gwen egichasurmalad. Nega-dulemar-iirmaksurmaladba, degine, dulemar-bukwasulidba-anmar-seargusadi, bia-nadye, be-dadgan gwen egichasurmalad.
Napa-gadi-ibmar-sanmakedse ani an bemar-sealid, bemar agi ibmar-san gunmalagar, degi, e-ibmarmar-nuegan gunmalagar. Degi-inigwele, bemar an-yalase-nonimargua, be an-yala oichononimalad. Ib-isganaga be an-yala imaksamalad.
Dule-irwa-anse-gormalad bipisaale gwen sogsasurmalad: ‘Bab-Jehová ¿bia-nadye?’ Dule-bulegan-an-igar-mamaid-wisimaladi, Bab-Dummadsuliyobi an-daksamalad. Dulemar-idumaladi, angi yoledmalad. An-gayaburba-barsogmaladi, bab-dummad-Baal-nuggi sunmakdemalad, degine, bab-dummad-baigan-ibnuedga-gusurmaladba nanadmalad.
”Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi bemarga soged: A-ulale, an bemargi gwisguoed, degi, amba an be-wagangi gwisgubaloed.
”Quitim-dup-gakase be obakmar, nue be atakmalo. Cedar-yalase dule-gayaburba-berbemalad be barmidmar, nue be igar amimalo. Nue be egismalo, we-dulemarde deyob gusmarmodibe.
Ar neggwebur-gwensak e-bab-dummagan Bab-Dummadsunnadsur-inigwele, e-bab-dummagan-ogwasye gwen an itossulid. Ar bemardi, bab-dummagan-ibnuedga-gusurmaladba-nanaed-ular, be an-obatemalad. Andi bur Bab-Dummad-napiragwadid, Bab-Dummad-gandikidid.
Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi bemarga soged: ¡Nibneggi-bukwamalad, weyob-neg-gunaidgi be gwayemar! ¡Be wawanmakmar! ¡Weyob-neg-gunaid geger be dakmar!
”An-dulamala, ilabo dummad-nosmalad: Ani an bemarga dii-burba-dulad ukedid, emide be angi bangudmalad. Dia-geg-dii-siged be sobsamalad, egi dii-sigsulid. Na-be-walagwengi a-dia be sobsamalad.
”Ar bemarde, Israel-dulemar, ¿be emar-maimarsii? ¿Ar bemarde, maiga-gubukwadgi gwalulesmarsi? Degite, ¿ibiga be galenonimarsunna?
Dule-baigan achumigur-nono-wawaad-uurmakeyobi bemargi oimaksamalad. Achumiguryob bemargi akigichamalad. Bela-swanga be-yala-imaksamalad, be-neggweburmar bela ogumaksamalad. Bar dulemar agi bukwa gussurmalad.
”Menfis-dulemarbela, degi, Tafnes-dulemarbela be-nono mamarismalad.
Ani an bemar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová gued. Ani an igarba-danigu bemar-idusadid. Bemar an-obachamalad-ular, weyob be gusmalad.
Emide bemar, Egipto-yalase Nilo-diwar-gobnabiye-sogedde, ¿ibi-nued egi be amimalo na be itoge? Emide bemar, Asiria-yalase Éufrates-diwar-gobnabiye-sogedde, ¿ibi-nued egi be amimalo na be itoge? Ar gwen egi ibmar-nued be amiosurmalad.
Ani an Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad an bemarga soged: Be-isguedgi na be dukin sabsur-odurdaklemaloed, be angi-yolenanaidgi na be dukin wilemaloed. Nue be binsamar, ‘dule Bab-Jehováʼgi-bangudele, Bab-Dummad-dobsuli-nanadele, we nuedsulid, Bab-Dummad-ieged yeer gangued.’
”Bato dikasurgus bemar angi gwisgusmalad, dikasurgus be angi bangusmalad. Ar bemarde weyob sogsamalad: ‘¡Anmar beba daosuli!’ Bela yar-mullugangi, bela sapi-dummagan-urba, gambanuchu-imakdii be gusmalad.
Uva-dub-nuediyobi, an bemar-digsanad. Bela uva-muu-nueganyobi an bemar-digsanad. Ibiga emide be, ¿uva-muu-isgana-diglesayobi, be gusa?
Ani an Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad an bemarga soged: Amba ibmar-dagudik-imakmaladgi be-isgued be elimarye-sogele, degi, morgaukgi ise-makumakar na be imakmarye-sogele, amba an-asabin be-isgued-e-gutumar nai guoed.
”Ar bemarde igi be sogosunna: ‘An isgussurmarye, bab-dummagan-Baal-e-nugmar an odummossurmarye.’ ¡Nebagi ibmar-imaksamalad be ebinsamar! ¡Be ibmar-isgana-imaksamalad be magar-itomar! Bemar moli-yargan-mureged-abarmakwisdaedyob be gumalad, geg boo be gudii gumalad.
Bemar, igi-moli-sapur-uayasuid-ome nega-dulesulidganba machered-amiegala, burwa-goledba machered-yapanned-itodidae, deyob be gumalad. We-moli-ome nagubigudiile, dule geg e-igar gaed. Ar moli-ome nagubigudiile, machereddi baisursunna ome-amied. Bemar debayobi, gumalad.
”Bemar, Israel-dulemar, melle nag-swili be gudii gumar, ar degiile, na be dukin naibigumaloed. Melle be-gammu na dinguega be imakmar. Ar be sogsad: ‘¡Suli! ¡Geg an na san bargaed! Bur an bab-dummad-baiganbina soged, bur amar-e-nug an na odummodii guoed.’
”Igi dule-ibmar-atursaed daklesale, nue-bingegudae, deyobi, bemar Israel-dulemar, nue-bingegumaloed. Be-reymar-abargi, be-dummagan-abargi, bemar bingegumaloed. Be-irwa-bab-dummadse-gormalad-abargi, degine, be-bab-dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad-abargi, bemar nue-bingegumaloed.
Bemar, Israel-dulemar, suarga be sokardamalad: ‘Be an-babad.’ Akwaga be sokardamarbalid: ‘Be an-nana, begi an gwalulesad.’ Andi wagar-biriar be an-dakdemalad, gwen ansikdi be aibirbisurmalad. Boni-dummagan-noalirdi, negoe be gollardamalad: ‘¡Gwae-gwae be anmar-bendakdage!’
Emide, Judá-dulemar, ¿bia be-bab-dummagan-sobsamalad nadsunna? Neggweburmar-merguedyob bemar bab-dummagan nikamalad. Amarga be soge, bemar-bendakye, adi, be dakmaloed, bule we-bab-dummagan boni-dummagangi bemar-bendakmalodibe.
”Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi bemarga soged: ¿Ibiga bemar angi urwenanai? Bela bemar angi yoledmalad.
”Binsarsunna an-dulamar an sabsur-odurdaksad, gwen an-itossurmalad. Achumigur-nono-wawaadyobi, bemar, be-es-suidgi an-gayaburba-barsogmalad oburgwismalad.”
Bemar, wegi-an-itobukmarmogadi, Bab-Jehová-gayaburba nue be itomarmogo. Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Emide, an Israel-dulamarga, ¿nega-dulesulidyob an gussi? ¿Negasichidyob an gussi? Ibiga an-neggwebur weyob-soge: ‘Anmar na e-itolegedba gudigumaloye, anmar bar be-nug-odummogosurye,’ anga sogmalad.
¿Ar yagwa sui-nikunair, na olo-nuegan-yooedi iego be insae? ¿Sui-nikued-mor-yoed iego be insae? Suli, gege iege. Ar bemar-an-dulamardi, dikasurgus an-ies bukwamalad.
”Bemar, Judá-dulemar, omegan-dikarba-amied nue-wismalad. Omegan-gambasamaladse-bakale, bese ibmar durdaksamalad.
Bela be-morgi dule-wilemalad-e-ablis nanaid, dule-ibmar-oakalossurmalad-e-ablis be-morgi nanaid. Ar wemar gwen-ibmar-atursanai be daksasurmalanad, degite, be oburgwismalad.
Degite, amba be sogmalad: ‘Anmar ibmar-oakalossurye, Bab-Dummad anmarse urwosurye.’ Ar be ibmar-oakalossurmarye-sogmarsoggu, an bemargi gwisguoed.
Ar bemar baisursunna binsaed-ogwaddamalad. Ar igi Asiria-dulemar bemar-yardaksa, deyobi, Egipto-dulemar bemar-yardakmogoed.
Binged-abalagi be Egipto-yargi nodmaloed. Ar ande, we-dulemar-egi-be-bensurmaladi, obachad. Gwen be we-dulemar-abargi nasguosurmalad.”
Bab-Jehová bemarga soged: “Binsa-sogmalo: ‘Dule-wargwen ome-metele, we-ome machered-baid-nikunonikile, machered-idualed, ¿gannar e-omega-gusad-monao be insae? Suli, gege gannar monaed. Ar monaele, bela yar-oichogo-itole.’ Emide bemar, Israel-dulemar, galagwensuli abirgunagwarsuli be nanasmalad. Degisoggu, geg be bar anse warmakmalad.
Nue be yar-mullugan-swana-naid be dake: Bia be galagwensuli-gussuli dakmalodibe. Bemar, Árabe-dulemaryob nega-dulesulidba igar-yalagi mellesii be damalad. Omegan-gamba-imakmaladi, na machered-abindaksidamaladyobi, be gudidamalad. Bemar galagwensuli-isgusmaladbali, we-yala be oichosmalad.
A-ulale, bar bemarga dii wissulid, degi, dii-wied-ibagangi bar bemarga dii wissurbalid. Ar bede ome-gambasaedyob na be san-imaksamalad, gwen bingedar be itossurmalad.
Emisgwasaar be anse weyob gordigusad: ‘Babaye, bipigwad-akale be an-ai-nuedye.’
Be sogsabalid: ‘Babaye, ¿be anmarbo urwedigu guode? ¿Be anmarbo degisadegu sae-itodii guode?’ Deyob be sogdigusmargu, degite, amba bemar ibmar-isgana-imakdii gusmalad.”
Josías-reyga-maiunni, Bab-Jehová anga weyob sognonigusad: “Jeremías, ¿Israel-dule-uayasulidamalad-ibmar-isgana-imaksad be daksa? Bela yar-mulluganse, sapi-dummagan-urba galagwensuli gusmalad.
Bela we-ibmar-isgana-imaksamalad-sorba, gannar anse nonimaloye an binsasanad. Degi-inigwele, gwen anse gannar nonisurmalad. E-gwenadgan-Judá-dulemar-uayasulidamogadi, e-gwenadgan-ibmar-imaksad daksamarmogad.
Ar Judá-dulemar daksagusad, igi an Israel-dule-uayasulidamalad galagwensuli-gued-ular metegusa, an ega ome-meted-garda-uksagusad an-daksamalad. Degite, e-gwenadgan-Judá-dule-uayasulidamalad gwen an-dobee itossulid, e-gwenadgan-Israel-dulemaryob galagwensuli gusmarmogad.
”Israel-dulemar an-yardaksagu, gwen bai itossulid. Aka bur bela yar-oichosad, degi, akwamar-bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladba, degine, suarmar-bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladba galagwensuli nanasmalad.
Bela weyob neg-nagus-inigwele, e-gwenadgan-Judá-dule-uayasulidamalad gwen gwage-ulubgi e-itogedba anse nonisulid, unnila binsa angi dododii gusad. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi bemarga soged.”
Bab-Jehová anga weyob sogdebalid: “Jeremías, Israel-dule-uayasulidamaladi, bur Judá-dule-galagwensuli-nanamaladba bur nued daklesunnad.
Jeremías, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik be nae. We-gaya be sognao. Weyob be sogo: ‘Weyob Bab-Jehová sogye: Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi bemarga soged: Israel-dule-uayasulidamalad, gannar be anse dagmala, an isdar bemar-dakosulid. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi bemarga soged: An wile-dulemar-dakdaedid, isdar an bemar-dakdii guosulid.
Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi bemarga soged: Unnila be-isgusad be magar-itomala, na be angi-nosmalad be magar-itomala. Bela sapi-dummagan-urba bab-dummad-baiganga be ibmar-imaksamalad be magar-itomala, gwen be an-sogedba-nanabigussulid be magar-itomala.’
”Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgine bemarga soged: Bemar Israel-dule-uayasulidamalad, gannar be anse dagmala. ¡Ar ani an be-ibedid! Neggwebur-iliba war-wargwen an bemar-suoed, degine, be-dadgan-iliba war-warbo an bemar-subaloed. Geb Sión-yalase an bemar-nidagoed.
An bemarga dule-be-idumalad dakedba an bega ukoed, adi, wemar an-ibmar-abegedba imakmalagar. Binsaed-nikaa be-semalagar, ibmar-nue-wisidba be-idumalagar.
”Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi bemarga soged: Yoo bemar bukidargusale, nue-mergusale: Bab-Jehová-Dadganbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulugi bar sunmaklegosulid. Dulemar bar a-Ulugi binsaosurmalad, degi, bar a-Ulu obarosurmalad. Degine, bar Ulu-baid sobosurmalad, ar bar abegosurmalad.
”A-ibagangine: ‘Bab-Jehová-ologanaye’ be Jerusalén-bimaloed. Bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad Jerusalén-neggweburse an-nug-odummogega nonimaloed. Bar bemar gwagegi-ibmar-isganagi-binsaedba ibmar imakosurmalad.
”A-ibagangine, Judá-dulemar, Israel-dulemarbo gannar atogoed. Neggwebur-dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik-siidba be danimaloed, bia an, be-dadganga-yar-uksagusadse be bukunonimaloed.
An-sunnagwad an weyob sogsagusanad: Israel an-mimmiga an imakoye, napa-bur-sunsoged an ega-ukoye, an sogsagusad. Baiganba yar-bur-yeerdakleged an ega ukoye, an binsasad. An binsasanad be anse gormaloye, ‘Babye.’ Be angi aibanosurmarye, an binsasanad.
An Bab-Jehová-guedgine bemarga soged: Bemar, Israel-dulemar, igi-ome e-sui-dikarba-galagwensuli-nanae, deyobi, be angi gusmalad.”
Bab-Jehová bemarga soged: “Yar-mullugan-nega-swaan-naidganba, dulemar-oimake itoleged. Israel-dulemar ise-wilegar bobukwa itoleged. Ar e-daed oichosmalad, igar-noaled susmalad, Ani an e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-guedi iedmalad.
”Mimmigan, bemar uayasulidamalad, gannar be anse dagmala, be-galagwensulidamalad ani an bega nudakoed.” Israel-dulemar sogdemalad: “Bab-Jehová, anmar bese danimala, ar be, anmar-Bab-Dummadid.
Ar anmar binsa bab-dummaganse-gorleged-e-yar-mulluganase naoed, binsa a-yalaganba anmar iba-galagwensulid ononamaloed. Bab-Dummad-Jehová, unnila anmar beginbi abonoleged-igar-maid amied.
”Anmar sapingwagwad-akale, galagwensuli bab-dummad-baiganba-nanaed-ular, anmar-masmala, degi, anmar-bunamala, surgunonikid. Anmar sibad-wawaadmar, moli-bebe-nikadmar, degi, bela anmar-babgan-ibmar-amisadi, surgunonikid.
Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼye, anmar begi isgudiguad, anmar-babgan begi nodiguad. Bab-Dummad-Jehová, anmar bipigwad-akale, emi-ibase be-sogedba nanadisulid. Degisoggu, bur anmar bingegumarsun, bela-belad bingedar itomarsun.”
Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi bemarga soged: “Bemar Israel-dulemar, gannar be anse-dagmarye-sogele, mer bar be isgumalo. Be an-asabin ibmar-isgana-bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad-osulogele, mer bar be angi bangumalo.
Ar gakansulidgi, igar-napiragwadgi, innikigwadgi, ‘Bab-Jehová-nuggi an ise-sogar-sogmarye,’ be sogmalale, ar degidbali, ‘dulemar-yar-baid-baidsik-bukwamaladgi anbali egi yeer binsalegoed, degine, anbali egi weligwar itomaloed.’ ”
Bab-Jehová weyob Judá-dulemarga, degi, Jerusalén-dulemarga soged: “Napa-ebuledisulidgi be ibmar digmala. Melle bar iko-imbaba be ibmar digmalo.
Judá-dulemar, Jerusalén-dulemar, an-bemarbo-igar-mesisadbarbi be nue-nai gumala, be-gwage-ulubgi a-igarbarbi nue-nai be gumala. Melle be-ibmar-isgana-imaksamalad-ular, an-urwed sooyobi begi-nodagega be imakmalo. An-urwed, soo-gamaiyob, dule geg oginned.” Bab-Jehová sogdebalid:
“Judá-yalagi, bela be sunmako. Jerusalén-neggweburgi, bela gayaburbamar be mimimar. ‘¡Bela yalamargi gar-trompeta be ogormar!’ Binnasuli gandikidba be gormakmar. Weyob sogmar: ‘Anmar danar-ambikumar, neg-gandikmaladse ubonamar.’
Sión-yarsik bander be oyomar, melle be gannaa sigmala, gwae be duurmakdemar. An bela-belad-dulemar-wiogega dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik boni-dummagan an barmidasokalid.
Bato achumigur-nono-wawaad gagan-imbaba nodanikid, dule, dulemar-akar-akar-bukwamalad-obeloged bato igarba danikid. Be-yala-obelogega, e-yalagi bangualid. Be-neggweburmar akwamarbi ganna-ganna ambikuoed, dulemar bar bukwasuli guoed.”
Ani Jeremías sogded: “A-ulale, wile-itoged-mola be yomar, bukib be binsamar, wile-itogedba be akiginmar, ar Bab-Jehová-bela-bela-urwedi, anmargi urwemaid.”
Bab-Jehová sogbalid: “Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi bemarga soged: A-ibagan warmaknonikile, rey, degi, dummagan-negsemamaid bela dobedba wawanmakdemaloed. Dule-irwa-anse-gormalad gwakidmaloed. An-gayaburba-barsogmalad geger dakdemaloed.”
Ani Jeremías sogded: “An-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, nue be we-dulemar yardaksad, nue be Jerusalén-dulemar yardaksad. Ega be sogsagusanad: ‘Bonisuli be gudii gumaloye.’ Emide be dakena, boni-dummaganba galitonanaid.”
Bab-Dummad an-abin sogded: “Sabsur-odurdakleged-iba warmaknonikile, we-Jerusalén-dulemarga weyob soglegoed: ‘An-neggwebursik nega-dulesulidganba yar-mullugan-bukmalad-akar burwa-uereged gordanikid. We-burwa-gormaid ibmar-gwag-miegarsulid, degi, neg-swiri imakega gormaisulid.’
An we-burwa-barmidagoedi, binnasuli goled. Ar an-sunnagwad, sabsur-odurdakega an we-dulemar imakoed.”
Israel-dulemar weyob sogdemaloed: “Be dake, anmar-isdarmalad mogiryob danikid. E-ur-napagined-bila-onomalad, burwa-ooregedyob gwichigudanikid. E-molimar, sulubagi-gukuedba bur binnasuli abarmakdanikid. ¡Anmar duledar-wilesmar! ¡Anmar bela!”
Bab Jehová soged: “Jerusalén-dulemar, be-gwage-isgudiid be urukmala, adi, be, abonolemalagar. ¿Ar sana be binsaed-isganamargi-binsaed iemaloye be sogmala?
Dan-neggwebur-akale, Efraín-yalagan-akale, gayaburba boni-dummagan-danikidgi-sunmaked noalid.
Dulemar-yar-baid-baidsik-bukwamalad be owisomar, Jerusalén-dulemarga be sogmar: ‘Dulemar-dikasurmalad begi ubodani, Judá-neggweburmargi binnasuli gormakdanimar.’
Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi soged: Dulemar nainu-ebiris-ambikuedyob bela be-ebiris ambikumaloed, ar ade, be angi uayasuli gusmalad.
Be-daed-ular, be-ibmar-isgana-imaked-ular, bemar weyob gunanaid. ¡Ibmar-isgana-imaked bega nunmaked-dummad uksad! ¡Gwage-ulubgi nue nunmak be-imaksad!”
Ani Jeremías sogded: “¡Nue-nunmak itoleged! ¡Suli-suli an itoged! ¡An-gwage-ulub nue-nunmak an itogusad! ¡An-ulubgi an-gwage-ulub nakwamaknaid! ¡An sunmaksulir guosulid! ¡An sunmakergebed! Gar-trompeta-goled an itoged, bila-onomalad-gormaked an itoged.
Sabsur-wilegedi, ukin-ukin danikid, ar bela yalagan sabsur-gusa nagusad. Ukiagwale, an-dordoneg maluded, an-meged-neg ukiagwale ayarided.
¿Ar sanagwadse an-isdarmalad-e-bander bar daksuli an guoe? ¿Ar sanagwadse an-isdarmalad-e-gar-trompeta-goled bar an itogosuli guoe?”
Bab-Jehová soged: “An-dulamar binsaedsurmaladid, aku an-dakmalad. Mimmigan-binsaedsurmaladid, aku neg-itomalad. Ibmar-isgana-imakedsikdi binsaed-ibegan nanamalad. Ibmar-nued-imakeddi wissurmalad.”
Ani Jeremías sogded: “An napneg-dakdegu, bela napaneg gagales-nai an dakalid. Niba an atakdebargu, bela negsichidbi-nai an dakalid.
Yalasik an atakdebargu, yalamar giglimakbukwa an dakalid. Bela yar-mullugan nakwamakbukwa an dakalid.
An atakdegu, dulemar sate an dakalid, bela nuumar duurmaksa nanaed.
An nue-dakdebargu, napa-gadi-sanmakedi nega-dulesulidbi-nai an dakalid. Bab-Jehová ibmar-imaksadbali, bela neggweburmar akwamarbi ganna-ganna-bukwa gusad. Bab-Dummad-urwedbali, bela deyob gusad.”
Bab-Jehová weyobi soged: “Bela yalamar swanga imaklegoed, degi-inigwele, naitinagase an obelogosulid.
A-ulale, bela-yar-naid wile-itonai guoed, nibnega negsichidbi naguoed. An bato sogsabinned, an-ibmar-sogsad bar an ogwaosulid. Bato an imakoye sogsad, bar an igar ogwaosulid.
”Sorda-sigugi-bila-onomalad binnasuli-goledba, degi, sorda-moligi-sii-urwemalad binnasuli-goledba, dulemar bela duurmakdemaloed. Gwenna-gwenna dulemar, bulaganba-doge-doge wakitemaloed, baigandi, akwa-dummagangi nakwidmaloed. Bela neggwebur ollobi naguoed, dule-wargwensaale bar egi gudii guosulid.
”Bemar, Jerusalén-dorgan nue be wilesmalad: ¿Ar igi be binsamala? ¿Ibiga be mor-gargemalad yomala? ¿Ibiga be ormar-nuegan nasikmala? ¿Ibiga be ibya-sigamar magmala? Ar binsarsunna yeerdaklege na be san-imaknanaid. Ar dule-be-abesmalad, isdar be-dakmalad, unnila be-oburgwega be-abemalad.
”Igi-ome na gebe e-igargi-boni-itonaile, binnasuli-gornaidae, deyobi, dulemar-gole an itoged. We-binnasuli-gornanaidi, Sión-dulemar gornaid, akus-akus bunnonaid. Na e-argan-onakwale, weyob sognanaimalad: ‘¡An duledar-wiles-ini! ¡An bela! ¡Dule-gindakmalad an-gasmalad!’ ”
Bab-Dummad soged: “Jerusalén-galimbaba be bipirmaknamar, nue be miamakmalo. Dulemar-ambikuedgi nue be dulemar amimalo. Bemar dule-ibmar-inniki-imaked, dule-ibmar-napira-soged amismalale, an, Jerusalén-neggwebur bar an sabsur-imakosulid.
Ar dulemar sogdamalanad: ‘Bab-Jehová-nuggi an napira sogye,’ degi-inigwele, yamo sogdamalad.”
Ani Jeremías sogded: “Bab-Dummadga an weyob sogded: Bab-Jehová, ¿ar be dule-innikidamalad amisursi? Eye, be amienad. Ar dulemar be sabsur-odurdaksa-inigwele, degite, gwen bai-itossurmalad. Be we-dulemar-e-ibmarmar-obelos-inigwele, gwen gwage-nuguedgi binsasurmalad. Akwaba bur bule e-gwage dutusuli nadmalad, gwen e-isguedga bukib itossurmalad.
”An weyob binsaenad: ‘Unnila dule-wilemaladbi, binsaedsuli ibmar imakye. Be-Igar-Maid gwen magar itosurmarye. Be-ibmar-abemaid gwen imaksurmarbarye.’
Agala, sapin-dummaganse an naoed, an ega sunmaknaoed. Ar we-dulemardi, Be-Igar-Maid wismalad, be-ibmar-abemaidi, wismarbalid. ”Degi-inigwele, amba be-sogedba ibmar-imaksasurmarmogad, Be-Igar-Maidgi annasmarmogad.
A-ulale, achumigur-nono-wawaadse gullemaloed, achu-burburud-nega-dulesulidganbalidse ichimaklegoed. Achu-barbad e-neggwebur-ebiris bina itos gudiid. Bela dulemala neggweburgi-nodmalale, ese ibitolegoed. Ar we-dulemar dogdar begi yolesmalad, ar we-dulemar dogdar begi uayasuli gusmalad.”
Bab-Dummad sogded: “¿Ibiga isgussulidyob an bemar-dakosunna? Ar be-mimmigan an-obachamalad, bab-dummagansurmalad-nuggi ise-sogar sogdamalad. An bemarga mas unnitiba uksad, degite, bemar galagwensuli gudmalad. Bela bemar danagwen galagwensuli gambanuchumarba be gudii gusmalad.
Moli omegi-nakwebigudiyobi, be gudimalad. Dule-baigan-omeganbina be yaisur-gordii damalad.
Ani an Bab-Jehová bemarga soged: A-ular, ¿an bemar-sabsur-odurdakosur be insae? ¿Buged-mai an bemar-imakosurde? An bemar-odurdakergebed.
”Israel-dulemar-e-uvaʼdub-digarmaladba be dagmar, maad-maad be imakdamar, degi-inigwele, mer bela be obelomalo. E-muumar be ungemalo, ar we-muumar bar angadsulid.
Ani an Bab-Jehová soged: Israel-dulemar, Judá-dulemar, uayasuli angi gudmalad.
”Bemar an-obachamalad, ‘Bab-Dummad maisurye’ be sogmalad. ‘Bilagi anmar odurdaklegosurye’ be sogdamalad. ‘Ukumesedgi anmar odurdaklegosurye’ be sogmarbalid.
‘Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmaladdi, binsa-ee-gordimarye’ be sogmarbalid, ‘ar Bab-Jehová-gayaburba egi naisurye’ be sogmalad. ‘Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad deyob-sunmaksamaladba sabsur-odurdaklemarsunye,’ be sogmalad.”
Degisoggu, ani an Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad bega soged: “Weyobi, dulemar sogsamarsoggu, Jeremías, an-gayaburba be-gayagi sooyobi guoed. We-dulemardi, sapanyobi gumaloed, bela bergumaloed.”
Ani an Bab-Jehová bemarga soged: “Israel-dulemar, dule-dikasurmalad an bemarse barmidagoed. Neggwebur-gandikmalad, undargus-bukwamalad an bemargi barmidagoed. Dule gaya-akarsaila-sunmakmalad, e-gaya-be-aku-itomalad an bemarse barmidagoed.
Bela we-dulemala bila-onogedgi buleganad, e-sigumala, dule-ogilogednanaed.
Be-ibmar-wesmalad bei obelomaloed, be-masgullemalad bei obelomarbaloed. Be-masmala, be-bunamala, bei oburgwemarbaloed. Degine, be-sibadmar, be-moli-bebe-nikamalad, bei ogilomarbaloed. Deginbali, be-uvaʼmar, be-higuera-sapimar, bei obelomarbaloed. Be-neggwebur-gandikmaladgi, dule-oakalogosurye-egi-be-binsaedi, bela es-suidgi bei obelolebaloed.”
Ani an Bab-Jehová soged: “A-ibagangine, an belallaa dulemar-obelogosulid.
Dule bese egichiarmalale, ‘¿ibiga anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová weyob anmar-imaksaye?’ Jeremías, ega be sogo: ‘Bab-Dummad sogye: Ar igi-bemar an-obachamala, degine, be-neggweburgi bab-dummad-baiganba be ibsadii gusmala, deyobi, neggwebur-baidgi, dule-baiganga-arbadii be gumaloye.’
Jacob-waganga be soge, Judá-dulemarga be sunmake:
‘Dule-binsaed-satemalad, dule-aku-neg-itomalad, be itomala. Ar bemar ibya-nika-inigwele, be aku-ibmar-dakmalad. Ar bemar uaya-nai-inigwele, be aku-ibmar-itomalad.’ ”
Ani an Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar bemar, ¿bar an-dobsurmarde? Ar bemar, an-dobguewilubmalanad. Ani an ukub nasiksad, adi, demar-abingunaidga guegar. Demar-abingunanaid degisadegu-mai guoed, gwen berguosulid. Amba demar binnasur-arwedago-inigwele, degine, uurmakdago-inigwele, e-igar-abingunanaidgi gwen dogosulid.
Ar we-dulemar gwage-dutusurmaladid, uayasuli angi damaladid. Angi bangus gudimalad, angi aibatemalad.
Wis binsasurmalad, na sogsurmalad: ‘Anmar, anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová dobee nanamarye. Anmarga dii-owimaiye, ibagan-sekalaa dii barmimaiye. Degine, anmarga ibmar-weed-ibagan sekalaa nasikmaiddeeye,’ gwen binsasurmalad.
”Be-isgumaladi, bemargi we-ibmar-nuegan obelosad. Be-isgumaladi, bei ibmar-nuegan gasa siid.
An bensuli, ar bemar-abargi dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmalad gudidiid, nuu-gaega-nakulemaladyob nakuledimalad, dule-gaega yamo emar-yardakmalad gudidiid.
Sikwimar garbagi-ena-bukwadyobi, e-negmargi ibmar-atursasmaladi, ena-ena bubukwad. A-ulale, bemar dule-buleganga gudmalad, deyob, dule-mani-ibmalaga gudmalad.
Be wardungudmalad, san-dummarbaa be gudmalad. Bemar-ibmar-isgana-imakmaladi gege bergued. Dule-babgan-satemalad nabir-nued-gudigumalaga ega be igar nabosurmalad. Dule-wilegana-e-ibmar-nikue-wilubmogad be bendaksurmarbalid.”
Ani an Bab-Jehová soged: “¿We-ulale, sabsur-bemar-odurdakosur be an-insae? Weyob-dule-damaladi, buged-mai ¿imakosur be an-insae? An imakoe.
”Be dakmala we-napneggi, gwayed-dummad naid. ¡We-ibmar-gunaid gwen nabir-daklesulid!
An-gayaburba-barsogmalad, unnila gakansaale sunmakmalad. Dule-irwa-anse-gormalad, na e-itolegedba negsemamaid. An-dulamarde, weyob-abeye soged. Ar bela ibmar bergunonikile, ¿bemar igi-gudmalosunna?”
Bab-Jehová soged: “¡Benjamín-wagan, Jerusalén-neggweburgi be ainimar! ¡Tecoa-neggweburgi be gar-trompeta ogormar! ¡Bet-Haqueremʼgi be waa-obupurmakmar! Ar dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsiki boni-dummad danikid, neg-obeloged danikid.
Jerusalén-neggwebur-yeerdakleged an obelosokalid, gagan-aradikid-naid-yeerdaklegedyobidi, an obelosokalid.
Sibad-edarbemalad, degi, e-sibadmar ese danimalad, neggwebur-ebilis ambikunonimaloed, na wala-walagwen e-itolegedba ibmar imakdemaloed.
”Be-isdarmalad, e-sordamarga sogdemaloed: ‘¡Jerusalén-neggweburgi-bila-onogega guakwamalo! ¡Yorukudbali anmar egi gwisgumaloed! ¡Emide, gwen nabir itolesulid, dad nae-naegusad! ¡Bato neg sedomaid!
¡Anmar nae! ¡Anmar mutiki egi gwisgudapoed! ¡Anmar e-neg-gandikmalad obelogoed!’ ”
Deyob Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nika-Maid soged: “¡Suarmar be immimar! Jerusalénʼgi-dogega napa-nakwemai be sobmalo. Ar e-dulemar ibmar-isgana-imakedbi wismarsoggu, we-neggwebur sabsur-odurdaklegergebed.
Igi dia-yaagi dii-mummurmakmaidae, debayobi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi isgued ainimaid. A-neggweburgi sabsur-imaklegedbi itoleged, unnila ibmar-obelolegedbi itoleged. Ibmar-nued-imakleged an daksulid, unnila boniganbi nomamai an daked, nailikguedbi nomamai an daked.
¡Jerusalén-dulemar! An-bemargi-melle-banguega, be-daed be ogwamala. Ar degisulile, an bela bemar-obelogoed, dulemar bar-ambikuega an imakosulid.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nika-Maid weyob soged: “Israel-dulemar-dula-bemaloedi, bela amiledii gulemaloed. Igi uva-san belallaa weledae, e-gaagi gwen gwagwenad obeledasuli, debayobi, dule-wargwenad gwen obelegosulid.”
Ani Jeremías sogded: “Bab-Dummad, an bese egisdo, ¿wede doaga an sunmakoe? ¿An doa owisogoe? ¿Doa an-itogoe? Ar yamo itogosurmalad, an ega-ibmar-soged aku-itomaloed. Ar be-gayaburbagi dododamalad, ar be-gayaburba itobisurmalad.
Ar Bab-Dummad-isdar-itogeyobi an isdar itogusmogad, agala, geg na san bargagusad.” Bab-Jehová anga sogded: “Be-sae-itoged be soge, burwigana-neg-imbaba-gudimaladga be soge, sapingan-danar-danar-gudimaladga be oyoge. Ome e-suibogwa gales seledmaloed, degine, dule-uka-selebamalad, dadgan-sergan-ebo, gales seledmarmogoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “E-negmar, e-nainumar, degi, e-omegan dule-baigangadga guoed. Ar ani, an-dulamar-we-neggweburgi-bukmalad sabsur-odurdakoed.
”Bipiganase-bakale, degi, serganse-bakale, igar-maisulidba-ibmar-nikuedgi yaisur-itodimalad. An-gayaburba-barsogmaladse-bakale, dule-irwa-anse-gormaladse-bakale, dule-yardakedgi arbadimalad.
Unnila asginbi an-dulamarga sokardamalad: ‘Be-isguedgi be ollorgusye, nueganbiye.’ Sokardamarbalid: ‘Neg nueganbiye.’ Degi-inigwele, neg nueganbi dasulid.”
Ani an Bab-Jehová soged: “¿Bemar ibmar-isgana-imaksadbali, be bingegusmala? Ar bemar, bingedar itossurmalad. ¡Bingeguodeeye gwen binsasurmalad! A-ulale, wemar dulemar-sabsur-odurdaklegoedba, sabsur-odurdaklemogoed. An we-dulemar sabsur-odurdakalile, bela wilemaloed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Ibmar-imakdimalad be melle bar imakmar, be-gudiid be nue itomar. Igar-epennegana be egismar, igid-igar bur nuedye. Melle a-igargi be bangumalo. Deyobi, bonisuli garmakdii be gumaloed. Degi-inigwele, ‘bemar we-igarba nanaosurye’ sogsamalad.
An bemarga gayaburba-berbemalad barmisad, weyob bemarga sogegar: ‘Nue gar-trompeta-goled be itomalo.’ Degi-inigwele, bemar gar-trompeta-goledba ibsaosurmarye sogsamalad.
¡Degisoggu, dulemar-neggwebur-akar-akar-bukmalad be itomar! ¡An-dulamar-wilegoed be nue itomalo!
”Dulemar, bela be an-itomar: Boni-dummad an Jerusalén-neggweburga sedanikid. E-isgudimalad-ulale, boni-dummad an ega sedanikid. Ar an ega ibmar-soged itossurmalad, aka an-igar-maid obachamalad.
Ina-wawadikid Sabá-neggweburgi be sedanidamaladi, ¿ibi-nuedga wis anga guoe? Masaryob-dakleged-wawadikmalad, dikasur-neggwebur-baidgi be sedanidamaladi, ¿ibi-nuedga wis anga guoe? Be anga we-ibmarmar ogumakar-ukmalad an abesulid. We-ibmarmar an yeer daksulid.”
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “An Jerusalén-dulemar-igar oburoed, egi yolemalaga an imakoed. Babgan, e-mimmiganmala, e-aimarmala, degine, e-neg-dikarba-mamaimalad, bela girgumaloed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “¡Be dakmar! Dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik sorda-bila-onomalad danikid. Bela napaneg-ugakaase sordamar-bukib duurmakdanimalad.
Warsiyalaba duurmakdanimalad eswarmar-annik-annik melledanimalad. Dule-isganamalad, wile dule-daksurmaladid. Demar-uurmakemaiyobi, binnasuli oimakdanimalad, e-molimar-birgi abarmakdanimalad. Jerusalén-dulemar, we-dulemar begi-bila-onogega duurmakdanimalad.”
Jerusalén-dulemar sogdemalad: “Anmarse gayaburba nonikid, degidbali, anmar niga argwated. Anmargi dobe-itogedi obined, igi-ome-ugakgunair boniganba-galitonaidae, deyobiyob anmar itoged.
Melle be sapurba ainimalo, melle aineba namalo. Ar anmar-isdarmalad es-suid-guagwar danikid. ¡Bela neg-imbaba neg dulagwar naid!
An-dulamar, wile-itoged-mor be yomala. Burugi baparmakmai be imakmala. Igi-dule na e-mimmi-wargwennagwad-ei-burgwisar bina boe, debayobi be ise-boale bomala. Ar dulemar-anmar-obelogedi, emisgwa anmargi danikid.”
Bab-Dummad anga sogded: “Jeremías, be an-dulamar-daed-argaega, e-daed-balamiega, amar-abargi-egi-nakulegega, an-be-ogwichisad.
Bela we-dulemala uayasulidamalad, gakansaedbi dakdimalad. Na dule-nuedga san-imakmar-inigwele, bela dule-isganamarbiid.
Ar soo-binnasur gadele, gingwa soo-abin daluddaed. Ar dulemardina, gwen san-islididik gusulid. Gwen igarga gusurmalad.
A-ulale, we-dulemar ibmar-isganaye bileged. Ar angala ibmar-isganaga gumalad.”
Bab-Jehová Jeremíasʼga weyob sognonikid:
“Jeremías, anse-goled-neg-dogedse be gwisguna, agine weyob be sogo: ‘Bemar bela Judá-dulemar-we-yawagakgi-ubomalad, Bab-Jehová-gayaburba nue be itomaloye.
Weyobi, Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad soged: We-yalagi-gudii amba an bemar-imakega, be-daed be ogwamar, be-ibmar-imaked be ogwamar.
Melle dulemar-bega-gakansaar weyob-sogmalad be itogo: Wegi we Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg siid. Wegi we Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg siid. Wegi we Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg siid. Agala, neg akarguosulid.
” ’Ar bemar be-daed be ogwamalale, be-ibmar-imaked be ogwamalale, degine, na be muchub-muchub igar-innikigwad be imakmarbalile, an wile bemar-dakoed. Be-dadganga-an-yala-uksadgi bemar degisadegu gudii an imakoed.
Deginbali, be dule-be-neggweburginedsulid-sabsur-imaksurmalale, degi, sergan-satemalad be mesagwar-imaksurmarbalile, degi, ome-ei-sui-burgwisad be mesagwar-imaksurmarbalile, an wile bemar-dakoed. Degi, we-yargi be dule-ibmar-oakalossulid-binsa-gindaksasurmalale, deginbali, bab-dummad-baiganba be isgumalaga bar be nanasurmarbalile,
we-yalagi, be-dadganga-an-yala-uksadgi amba gudii an bemar-imakoed.
” ’Ar bemar, gakangi be bensurmalad. Ar we-gayamardi gwen nabiridsulid. Gwen ibmar-nued bega uksulid.
Bemar gadi-ibmar-atursamalad, emar-gindakmalad, abirgunagwarsuli-galagwensuli-nanamalad, ibmar-imakedseye be ise-sogar binsa-sogdamalad, bab-dummad-Baalʼga ina-wawadikid ukmalad, degine, bab-dummad-baigan-akudakmaladse be gordimalad,
degite, be an-itoged-negse be anse nonidamarbalid, weyob be sognonidamalad: Wegi anmar nued gudimarye. Geb sorba gannar be isgunaddamarbalid.’ ”
Ani an Bab-Jehová soged: “¿Ar bemar binsasi, anga neg-nugsalegarsiid atursamalad-neg-sogeye? Ar an-sunnagwad deyob an bemar-dakdiid.
”Silo-neggweburgi anse-goled-neg-sigisadse be namar. A-nega gebesailagi an megega susanad. Agi an-dulamar-isgusadba an neg-imaksad be dakmalo.”
Ani an Bab-Jehová soged: “Degi-inigwele, amba bemar deyob gudimarbalid. An bemarga bali-bali sunmakdigus-inigwele, be anba ibsassurmalad. An bemarse gochamar-inigwele, be an-abin-imaksasurmalad.
”Igi an Silo-neggweburgi anse-goled-neg-siid an imaksagusa, deyobi, anse-goled-neg-siid egi bemar-bensulidi, an imakbaloed. Degine, an be-dadganga we-yala-uksadi, degi, bemarga an we-yala-uksadi, Silo-neggwebur-imaksayob an imakbaloed.
”Igi-an bela be-gwenadgan-Efraín-waganmar-obachagusa, deyobi, an-asabin an be-obanmarmogoed.”
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “Be, Jeremías, melle we-dulemarga be anse golo. Melle we-dulemarga be anse wilesagwa golo, melle we-dulemarga be anse ise-wilegar golo. Melle be angi alamaknai guo, ar an be-itogosulid.
¿Ar Judá-neggweburgi-ibmar-imakmalad be aku daksi? ¿Jerusalén-neg-imbaba-neg-gunaid be aku daksi?
”Mimmigandi sapan-urbenanaidamalad, babgandi soo-ogananaidamalad, omegandi madu-omukuardamalad, adi, Rey-Bundor-Nibnegginedga madu-ukmalagar. A-ukinbali, yamo an-ourwega bab-dummad-baiganga-ibmar-ukega vino eodamarbalid.
Ani an Bab-Jehová soged: ‘Weyob ibmar-imakmaladi an-wiomarye bimalanad. Aka na dukin egi isdar-binsananaid, na dukin bingegumaloed.’
”A-ulale, ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, an soged: ‘We-yalagine an gwichiguoed, dulemargi an yolegoed, ibmar-durgangi an yolegoed, sapimargi, degi, ibmar-sanmakbukmaladgi an gwichiguoed. Degi, an-urwedi soo-gamaiyob bar galegosulid.’ ”
Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob soged: “Bemar bela ibmar-ogumakar-uklemalad, ibmar-uklemaladba be anga ukmarbalo. E-sandi be gunmalo.
”Deunni, an Egipto-yargi bemar-dadgan-onosgua, anga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukmaloedgi, degine, anga-ibmar-ukmarbaloedgi an ega sunmaksasulid.
Unnila an ega weyob igar uksad: ‘An-sogedba be damaloye. Adi, ani an bemar-Bab-Dummadga guegarye, degine, bemar, an-dulamarga gumarmogagarye an sogsad. Deginbali, an bemarga-igar-ukoedba be nanamaloye an sogsad, adi, bemar nueganbi we-yalagi-gudigumalagarye, an sogsad.’
”Degi-inigwele, be-dadgan an-itossurmalad, an-sogedba ibsassurmalad. Aka bur e-binsaed-isganamarba nanasmalad. Anba bur nanae-wilubmala-inigwele, aka bur angi bangudmalad.
”An Egipto-yargi-be-dadgan-onosad-iba-akar, emi-ibasega, an bemarga bane-bane an-gayaburba-barsogmalad barmidii gusad.
Degi-inigwele, amba be an-itosurmalad, an-sogedba be ibsassurmalad. Aka be be-dadganba bur bule uayasuli nadmalad, bur bule be isgudmalad.”
Bab-Jehová anga sogdebalid: “Jeremías, ega be bela ibmar-sogo, degi-inigwele be-itogosurmalad. Ese be golo-inigwele, be-itogosurmalad.
Geb agi weyob ega be sogo: ‘We-neggweburmala, Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼba ibsassurmalad, e-odurdaked abessurmalad. Bela e-ibmar-napira-sogmalad bergusad, ibmar-napira-soglegedgi gwen bar sunmaklesulid.
Sailagia be siksun, sailagia be misun, yar-mullugan-swiliganba be bonae. Ar dulemar-an-ourwega-imaksamaladi an obachad, agala, an egi bangusad.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Bemar, Judá-dulemar, ibmar-isgana-an-sae-daked be imaksamalad. Bemar, be-ibmar-bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad-isganamar an-itoged-negyagi-urbismaladba be ichosmalad, an-itoged-neg-angi-sunmakleged be oichosmalad.
”Deginbali, bemar Ben-Hinom-nebagi bab-dummadsulid-Tofetʼga aila be sobsamarbalid, adi, a-ailagi be-mimmigan be ogumakmalagar. Ar an bemarga we-igar gwen uksasulid, bipisaale an-binsaedgi gwen nossulid.
Ani an Bab-Jehová soged: Ibagan nonikoed, Tofet-aila bar Tofet-ailaye bilegosulid, degi, Ben-Hinom-neba Ben-Hinom-nebaye, bar bilegosurbalid. Agala, Gindakmalad-nebaye bilenonikoed. Napaneg-baid-satedbali, Tofet-aila-siidgi be dule-burgwarmalad digmaloed.
We-neggweburginmalad-e-muigan ibmar-durgan-gukumalad-e-masga guoed, achu-sapurmar-e-masga guoed. Dulemar we-ibmar-durgan ogwayosurguoed.
Judá-neggweburmargi, degi, Jerusalén-neg-imbaba weligwar-itoleged an obelogoed. Degine, wergulegedgi-namakleged an obelobaloed, deginbali, abirgin-nikulegedgi-namakleged an obelobaloed. Ar ade, we-yala bela ollobi naguoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “A-ibagangine, reymar-garmar, degi, Judá-dulemar-garmar-neg-uangi-mamaid bela onomaloed. Degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-garmar, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad-garmar-mamaid bela onomarbaloed. Deginbali, Jerusalén-dulemar-garmar bela onomarbaloed.
Bela-a-garmar dad-abin, degi, nii-abin, degine, niisgwamar-abin urbilegoed. Ar ade, wemar dad, nii, degine, niisgwamar sabgusmalad, ega ibmar imaksamalad, degine, we-ibmarmarse ibmar egichismalad, e-nugmar odummosmarbalid. Dulemar we-garmar-digega bar garmar weosulid. ¡Ibmar-isganamaryob napagi omiledoed!
Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad soged: An we-dule-isganamar galagwensuli aisakis urboed. Amar dula bar gudii gubigudagosurmalad, burgwebi bur gudamaloed. Ar deyob guoed.”
“Jeremías, we-dulemarga be sogbalo, Bab-Jehová weyob sogye: ‘Dulemar aimukusale, ¿gwichibin imakdasursi? Dule wis igar-noaledba-aibatele, ¿gannar igar-nabirid-amidasursi?
Degite, ¿ibiga bemar igar-noaledba aibatemarsunna? Jerusalén-dulemar, ¿ibiga be nue-an-obachamarsunna? Unnila gakan-igargi be alamakdimalad, gwen anse gannar be dagbisurmalad.
Dule-sunmaked nue an itodii gusanad, dakega, dule-wargwen igar-nuedba sunmakdiidibeye. Dulemar e-isguedga gwen bukib binsasurmalad, e-ibmar-isgana-imaksamalad aku itomalad. Bela dulemar, igi moli bila-onolenaidgi-abarmakwisdae, deyobi, e-itoleged-e-itolegedba nanabukmalad.
Ar dabgalamarbela ibagan-nagumaid wisid. Sapur-nuumar, degi, wirsobmarbela wisid, sanase neg-baidse obakmaloe. Ar bemardi, an-dulamar-gumaladi, an-igar-mamaiddi gwen wissurmalad.’
”Ar ibiga be sokardamala: ‘Anmar binsaed-ibegana, anmar Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maid sedimala.’ Ar dule-garda-narmakmaladbela gakansaar odurdakmalad, Bab-Dummad-igar weyob-maiye sogdidamalad.
We-dule-binsaed-ibegan nue-bingegumaloed, na dukin ise-yardaklegar gumaloed. Ar an-gayaburba itossurmalad, degisoggu, ¿bia e-binsaed-nikagued nadsunna?
A-ulale, an e-omegan machergan-baiganga ukoed, degi, an e-nainumar dule-baiganga ukbaloed. Ar bipigana, serganse-bakale, igar-maisulidba ibmar-nikuedgi binsamalad. Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladse-bakale, ibmar-amimalagala, emar-yardakar arbadimalad.
Unnila asginbi an-dulamar-nudakdimalad. Unnila ega sokardamalad: ‘Nueganbi, bonisuli.’ Ar degi-inigwele, nueganbi-dasulid, aka bur bule neg ege naid.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Weyob ibmar-isgana-imaksamaladba, degite, ¿bingedar-itosurmarde? Suli, degite amba bingedar itosurmalad. ¡Ar bingegued wissurmalad! A-ulale, dulemar-sabsur-odurdaklegoedba, wemar sabsur-odurdaklemogoed. An we-dulemar sabsur-odurdakalile, bela wilemaloed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Bela an bemar-obelogoed, uva-san e-nainugi berguedyob an bemar-obelogoed. Higo-san e-sapigi satedaeyob an bemar-imakoed. Degine, e-gagan-dinnaganbi-nanaidaeyob an bemar-imakoed. A-ulale, an bela bemarga ibmarmar-uksadi, gannar an bemar-annik suoed.”
Geb dulemar sogdemalad: “¿Ibi anmar wegi gannaa sabukwa? Dage, anmar neggwebur-gandikmaladse nae, agi anmar itoba burgwemaloed. Ar anmar Bab-Dummadgi dummad-isgusad-ular, anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová anmar-obelonaid. Dii-ina-nusubiid-gobega anmar-imaksad.
Nueganbi-naoye anmar bisanad, degi-inigwele, anmar ibmar-nued gwen daksasulid. San-nued-gumaloye an bisanad, degi-inigwele, anmarga dobed-dummad uksad.
Dan-neggwebur-akale, molimar-abarmakdanikid itoleged. Molimar gotele, bela yala giglimakdedaed. Yala-naid obelodanikid, bela yalagi-ibmar-bukwad obelodanikid. Neggweburgi-siid, degi, bela e-dulemar-bukwad obelodanikid.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “An bemargi naibe-nuegan barmidoed, bemargi warmakoed. We-bonigan-nudakegala, inamar sulid.”
An bela-belad nue-nunmak-itogedbali, an-gwage-ulubgi an burgwebidar itogusad.
Bela neggwebur-imbaba an-dulemar-ogormakbukwad itoleged, “¿Bab-Jehová Sión-yalagi bar gudisursi? ¿E-reyde a-yargi bar maisurmosi?” Bab-Dummad abin-sogded: “¿Ar ibiga bemar be-bab-dummagangi an-ourwega an-imakmala? ¿Ibiga be-bab-dummagan-ibmar-nuedga-gusurmaladgi an-ourwega an-imakmala?”
Israel-dulemar sogded: “Ibmar-weed-ibagan bergus, neg-yolad bergus, ar anmardi gwen bendaklessurmalad.”
Geb an abin-imaksad: “An-dulemar-nunmak-itogedbali, an nunmak-itomogad. An nue bukib-binsaedba, bela-belad angi dobednagusad.
¿Ar Galaad-yalagi ina-wawadikid sursi? ¿Agi ina-duledmarde sursi? ¿Ar ibiga an-dulemarde bonigan-abgadii gumalosunna?”
Ani Jeremías, an-neggweburginmalad-girgusadba, ibginedba, degi, mutikidba, an bodii guega, an-nono, dii-aryomaiyob guena yeerban. An-ibyanis, dii-aryogwisdaeyobi gusana yeerban.
An nega-dulesulidganba, obunnoged-neg nikana yeerban. An-neggwebur-mete an naoenad. We-dulemargi an banguoenad. Ar bela we-dulemala, galagwensur-nanamaladid, ar bela we-dulemala, dule-yardakmaladid.
Bab-Jehová soged: “Gakansamalaga guakwaa gudidamalad, warsi-guagwar-ganikidyob gudidamalad. We-yalagine, igar-napiragwad sated, gakansaed neg-gagas naid. Aka bur nue-ege neg-nadapid. Ani an Bab-Dummad-gued gwen an-daksurmalad.
”Be-aimar-warwargwengi nue salakarmar, melle gwenadganse-bakar, egi be bensuli guo. Ar bela gwenadganmar dule-yardakedbiid. Bela aimar, na e-aimar-dikarba yogasaar sunmakdimalad.
Na muchub-muchub yardakdimalad, dule-wargwensaale, napiragwadgi sunmaksurmalad. Na gakansaedgi nue-durdaksa gudimalad, gakansaedginbi binsadimalad.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Be, Jeremías, dulemar-yardakmalad-abargi be gudiid, amar emar-yardakmaladba magar an-dakbisurmalad.”
A-ulale, ani Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob soged: “¿Ibu-ibmar-baid bar an-dulamarga an imakbalosunna? An we-dulemar urukergebed, an we-dulemar wilubdakergebed.
Ar e-gwabin-duku sigu-dule-gindakedyobid, unnila gakansaar-sunmakedbi wismalad. E-aibo nuedgi sunmakdaed, ar e-ulubgindi yamogedgi binsadamalad.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Degite, a-ulale, ¿an sabsur-odurdakosurde? An sabsur-odurdakergebed. ¿We-dulemar an buged-mai imakosurde? An imakergebed.
”Yalaganga boega an be-imakoed, yalaganga akiginnega an be-imakoed. Nega-dulesulidgan-e-gaganmarga oakudii an be-imakoed, ar bela neg-olloo nai guoed. Ar dulemar bar agi gudii guosulid, molimar-goledi bar itolegosurbalid. Bela nuumarse-bakale, ibmar-durganse-bakale, duurmakdemaloed.
”Jerusalén-neggwebur napi akwabi ganna-ganna-bukwa an imakoed, achu-sapur-uaya-ganna-ganna-e-negga an imakoed. Judá-neggweburmar-e-sailaga-gubukwad neg-ollobi an sioed, dulemar-sate an imakoed.”
Ani Jeremías weyob sogded: Ar we-ibmar magar-itogegala, ¿doa binsaed-ibed-gudii? ¿Ar doaga Bab-Dummad sunmaksa, adi, dule-baidga we-ibmar-sogmogagar? ¿Ar ibiga anmar-yar bergusnai? ¿Ibiga anmar-yar nega-dulesulid-naidyobi dule gwen nanasuli ollo-nai?
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar Israel-dulemar an-Igar-Maid an ega uksadgi aibatemalad. An-sogedba ibsassurmalad, a-Igarba nanassurmalad.
Aka e-binsaed-isganaba nadmalad, bab-dummagan-Baalʼmarba nanasmalad. E-babgan-e-odurdaksadba nanasmalad.”
Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob sogbalid: “We-dulemar ibmar-gagbiremalad-gunnega an imakoed, degine, dii-ina-nusubiid-gobega an imakbaloed.
Wemar, yar-baid-baid-nanaidgi-aisakiega an imakoed. Wemar, degi, e-babgan we-yarmar-gwen-dakdisurmaladse an oduurmakoed. Es-suidyalaba an baleginnoed, bela obelogedse an imakoed.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob soged: “Nue be itomar. Omegan-dule-burgwismaladga-bomaladse be gornamar. ‘Bur nue-yeer-bomalad dagmaloye,’ be sogo:
Gwae-gwae dagmalo. Anmar-ular bodamala. Anmar-ibyanis bela-bela aryogoed, anmar-ibyanis ena-ena naoed.
Sión-yala-akale, dule-boedi, degi, dule-akiginnedi, weyobi, itoleged: Anmar nue oitolesmar, nue-anmar-obingegsasmalad. Anmar we-yalagi nomalargebed, ar bela anmar-neguyamar obelosmalad.
”Omegan, an-gayaburba nue be itomar. An-ibmar-soged nue be itomalo. Be-bunamala, bukid-binsaleged-namakedgi be odurdakmar. Be-aimar muiga-bolegedgi weyob be odurdakmar:
‘Burgwedi, anmar-negse dognoniki, anmar-neg-yawagakba dogsad. Burwigana-magaba-gudidimalad obelolesad, sapingana-magaba-ambikulegedgi-bukmalad obelolesad.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Muimar, napagi ibmar-isganayob omilede guoed. Igi dule-ibmar-gwag-wesale, napagi-babatismalad-omileddae, gwen bar dule wedasuli, deyobi, muimar napagi omilede guoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Dule-binsaed-ibed, melle na e-binsaed-nue-nikadgi san-dummarba itogo. Dule-gandikid, melle na e-gangued-nikarbadgi san-dummarba itomogo. Dule-mani-ibed, melle na e-mani-nikarbadgi san-dummarba imakmogo.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar dule na nug-dummarba-imakbiele, magar-an-dakedgi na nug-dummarbaa imakdo. Ar dule na wergubiele, ani Bab-Dummad-Jehová-gued-magar-an-dakbalidgi, wergusundo. Ani an dulemar-sabgumaiye, degi, ani an igar-innikii-imakedye, be wisidba, be wergusundo. Ani an igar-maidba we-napneggi-ibmar-imakedgi be wergusundo. Ar weyob ibmar-imaklegedi, an yeer daked.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Bela dule-abgan-uka-duku-sikarmalad, anse-sabsur-odurdakleged-ibagan ega danikid.
An we-dulemar sabsur-odurdakoed: Egipto-dulemar, Judá-dulemar, Edom-dulemar, Amón-dulemar, Moab-dulemar, degine, bela dulemar-nega-dulesulidganba-bukwamalad, dulemar-burgwarmaladse-golega na nono-swiri-imakmaladi, wemar an sabsur-odurdakoed. Ar bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad, degi, Israel-dulemarse-bakale, e-gwage-ulubgine anba dasurmalad.”
Israel-dulemar, Bab-Jehová-sunmaked be itomar,
weyob soged: “Dulemar-yar-baid-baidsik-bukmalad-e-daedba melle be damalo. Nibneg-akar ibmar-yogasaar-oyolegar-be-dakele, melle be gwayemalo. Dule-bamalad-dobee-itodamaladyob, melle be dobgumalo.
Ar dulemar-e-bab-dummaganse-goled-igar-maidi binsaled gued. We-dulemala, sapurba-nadele, suar-immidamalad, geb dule-ibmar-sobed, esbipigi suar-sobdaed.
Geb egi mani matak-matak nasikdamalad, ormar matak-matak nasikdamarbalid. Melle-aimukuegala, esgorogi biokdamalad.
”We-bab-dummagan, ibmar-digar-naidgi, ibmar-sikwimar-ogwayed-gwichidaeyob gued, geg sunmaked. We-ibmarmar dule yamo sear imakergebed, geg walagwen nanamalad. Melle be we-ibmarmar dobgumalo, ar gwen be-oakalogosulid, bemarga gwen ibmar-nued imakosurbalid.”
Ani Jeremías sogded: “Bab-Jehováʼye, dule beyobid sulid, bedi dule-dummadid, be-nuga gandiki gued.
Dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad-e-Rey-be-gued, ¿doa be-dobguosuli? ¡Bela be-dobgumalargebed! Ar be dulemar-binsaed-ibegan-abargi, reymar-negsemamaid-abargi, dule-beyobid sulid.
Bela dulemala, gegeganad, binsaedsurmaladid, suar-sobarmalad-ibmarga-gusurmaladse ibmar-durdaksamaladid.
Tarsis-yala-akale, mani-matargana sedanidamalad, Ufazʼye-neg-nugad-akale, olo sedanidamarbalid. We-ibmarmargine, bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad sobdamalad. Geb ega mor-arad, mor-ginnid makdamalad. Dulemar-orgi-arbamaladi, manigi-arbamaladi, degi, ibmar-sobedgi-arbamaladi, bela we-ibmarmar imakmalad.
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehováʼdi, Bab-Dummad-napiragwadid, Bab-Dummad-dulasaila-maidid, e-Reyga-maigu degisadeguadid. Bab-Dummad uludele, napaneg ogiglimaked, dulemala, e-urwed-abin gege gwisgumalad.”
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “Jeremías, weyob be Israel-dulemarga sogo: ‘Bab-dummagan-gwen-nibneg-imaksasulidi, degi, gwen napneg-nasiksasulidi, nibneg-urbali bela we-napneggi berguoed.’ ”
Bab-Dummad, e-ganguedba napneg nasiksad, e-binsaed-nikadbali, napneg ilemaksad, e-ibmar-wisidbali, nibneg nasiksad.
Bab-Dummad sunmakdele, nibneggi diimar uurmakardaed, magatibali, mogirmar ainakwiardaed, mala-ibyed-abalagi, dii owidaed, burwa-galumargi, burwa onidaed.
Bela dulemar binsaedsulidamaladid, aku-neg-itomaladid. Bela-dule-orgi-arbamaladi, e-ibmar-sobedgi bingedar itomalad, e-ibmar-sobarmaladi, dule-yardakmaladid, burba satemalad.
We-ibmarmala binsaledid, binsa dodolegedid. E-sabsur-odurdakleged-iba-nonikile, bela berguoed.
Jacob-e-Bab-Dummaddi deyobsulid, ar e, bela ibmar-imaksadid. E-nuga, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadye nugad, Israel-dulemardi, egadiga gued.
Bab-Dummad weyob soged: “Be-ebiris bukwamalad, be-ibmarmar-napagi-omileded be sue-sue imakmar.
Ar ani Bab-Jehová weyob soged: Emisgindi, an we-neggweburginmalad we-yargi dikasuli an barmidoed. Suli-suli-itogega an imakoed, dule-bamaladse-galegega an imakoed.”
Ani Jeremías sogded: “¡An duledar-wiles! ¡An nue-ibitos! An boni-nikadi geg-nudaklegedid. Ar an-bonisoggu, an na gala-itosunnodo.
An-dordoneg ayaris siid, bela dordoneg-e-dubmala itiris bukwad. An-mimmigan-an-obachamaladi, bela amar girgusmalad. Anga-neg-sobed dule sated, anga-mor-dummagan-onakwed dule sated.
Dule-negdakmamaidi, binsaedsulidga gusmalad, gwen Bab-Dummad-amiedgi binsassurmalad. A-ulale, igar-nued ega gussulid, e-dulemala, yogasaar-aisakis gudimalad.
”¡Be itomar! ¡Gayaburba-gwensak noni! Dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik, sorda-bila-onomalad danikid. Judá-neggwebur achu-sapur-uaya-gannagana-e-negga guoed, bela Judá-neggwebur akwabi ganna-ganna sigoed.”
Ani Jeremías weyob Bab-Dummadse goted: “Bab-Jehováʼye, an wisid, dule-e-san-burba dulegadsulid. Deginbali, e-guoedi na wissurbalid.
Bab-Jehová, igar-maidba be an-odurdake, melle urwedgi be an-odurdako. Ar urwedgi be an-odurdakele, be an-wiogoed.
Bur be dulemar-aku-be-dakmaladgi be-urwed be oyoge. Dule-be-nug-odummosurmaladgi be-urwed be barmidage. Ar Jacob-wagan-wiosmalad, bela naitinagase obelosmalad, degine, bela e-negmar obelosmarbalid.”
Bab-Dummad weyob Jeremíasʼga sognonikid:
“We-igar-maid nue be itogo, geb Judá-dulemarga, degi, Jerusalén-dulemarga be sogo.
‘Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová weyob sogye be sogo: Dule we-igar-sogmaidba dasulile, iwiguoye.
We-igala, an-sunnagwad bemar-dadganga an narmaksad. Deunni, Egipto-yala-esgoro-duleged-negyobidgi sabsur-wilebukwa-onosgu, an ega we-igar uksad. An ega weyob sogsad: An-bega-ibmar-sogedba be nanamalo, an-bega-igar-ukedba be damalo. Bemar an-neggweburga gumaloed, ani an bemar-Bab-Dummadga-guoye an ega sogsad.
Ar be anba ibsamalale, bemar-dadganga an ibmar-ise-sogar-sogsad an imakoed. Deunni, an sogsagusad: Yala-nued-gadi-ibmar-sanmaked an bemarga ukmaloye. Ar emi bemar a-yalagi be bukwamalad.’ ” Geb agine, Bab-Dummadga an sogded: Bab-Jehová, ar deyobdo.
Bab-Jehová anga sogdebalid: “Bela we-gayaburba Judá-neggweburgi, degi, bela Jerusalén-galimbaba be sogo. Weyob be sogo: ‘We-igar-mamaid be itomarye, we-igar-maidba be damarye.
An Egipto-yalagi bemar-dadgan-onosad-akale, emi-ibase an-sogedba-nanamarye an sogdaniguad.
Degi-inigwele, an-sogedba nanasurmalad, gwen an-itosurmalad, unnila na e-binsaed-isganaba nanadimalad. A-ulale, we-igargi-bonigan-mamaid an egi barmialid. Ar igar-sogmaidba nanamaloye an ega sogsad, degi-inigwele, a-igar-sogedba nanasurmalad.’ ”
A-ukinbali, Bab-Jehová anga sogsabalid: “Judá-dulemar, degi, Jerusalén-dulemar angi uayasuli gudmalad.
E-babgan-isgusadyob gannar isgudmarmogad. Amarde gwen an-sogedba nanasurmalad. Bab-dummad-baiganba ibmar-imakdii gudmalad. Ar Judá-dulemar, degi, Jerusalén-dulemar, an E-Dadganbo-Igar-Mesisad bichismalad.
A-ulale, ani an Bab-Jehová soged: An egi boni-dummagan barmidoed, a-bonigangi gwen san-onogosulid. Anse wile-itogedgi-gormalo-inigwele, an itogosulid.
”Geb degine, Judá-dulemar, degi, Jerusalén-dulemar, bab-dummadganga-ina-wawadikid-ukdamaladse bendakleged egisnamaloed. Degi-inigwele, boni-dummagan-ibagan-warmaknonikile, a-bab-dummagan gwen e-bendakosurmalad.
Judá-dulemar, be-neggweburmar-merguedyobi, bab-dummagan-nika be gudimalad. Jerusalén-galimbamar-mergueyobi, bab-dummadse-goled-ailamar be sobsamalad. Ar bemar, a-ailamargi Baalʼga ina-wawadikid uksamalad. We-ibmar-imaksamalad na be dukin bingegumalagalad.
”Ar bedina, Jeremías, melle we-dulemarga be anse golo. Melle we-dulemarbina anse-goledgi wilenai be guo. Ar e-bonigangi-e-bendakye anse gollarmalale, an itogosulid.
An-Israel-dulemar-sabesailadde, nue-isgusad-sorba, ¿ar ibu an-negyaba sadimarsunna? ¿Ar wede binsamarsunde, anga-ibmar-uked-ular, an emargi boni-dummagan bar barmidosurye? ¿Deyobi wergudigumaloye binsamarsunde?”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Olivo-sapi-aradye, e-sanmar-yeerdaklegedye an be-nug-imaksanad. Emisgindi, mar-binnasuli-goled-abalagi, an bemargi soo odesad, be-sapi-anagan bela gummaksad.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, we-yalagi bemarga-ibmar-nasiksadi, bemargi boni-dummad-barmidagoye sogsad. Bemar Israel-dulemar, degine, Jerusalén-dulemar, be ibmar-isgana-imaksamalad-ulale, bonigan begi barmilealid. Ar bemar Baalʼga inamar-wawadikid-ogumakar-ukdigusmaladgi isdar-itogega be Bab-Jehová-imaksamalad.
Bab-Jehová wisguega an-imaknonikid, agi an magar itononikid. Dule-e-ibmar-isgana-imaksamalad anga oyononikid.
Ar andi, angi-igar-amilenaidi wissulid. Igi sibad-wawaad-sapingwagwadi oburgwilegedse-selemaidae, deyob an selemaid. An-isdarmalad angi weyob sogmalad: “Anmar we-sapi-e-san-nika-gwichid omukue, dulemar-abargi we-sapi anmar osuloge, adi, mer bar dulemar egi binsamalagar.”
Ar be, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, be igar-napiragwadba dulega igar-nabogedid. Bedi, dulemar-ulubgi-ibmar-itoged-wisidid, magar be dulemar-binsaed-dakedid. Ar be an-bendaksadba an begi bensulid, degisoggu, be we-dulemar-buged-mai-imakoed-dakega be an-imake.
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, Anatot-dulemarnik sunmaksad. Anatot-dulemar be-oburgwebigudimaladid, degi, weyob begi sogsamaladid: “Melle be anse-oburgwilegega, mer be Bab-Jehová-nuggi sunmakoye.”
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob Anatot-dulemarnik soged: “We-dulemar anse sabsur-odurdaklemaloed. E-sapingana, es-suidgi oburgwilegoed, e-mimmigana, ukudba burgwemaloed.
Anatot-dulemarga sabsur-odurdakleged-iba-nonikile, boni-dummad an ega nasikoed. Wargwensaale, we-dulemar durguosulid, bela burgwemaloed.”
Ani Jeremías Bab-Jehováʼga sogded: “Bab-Jehová, an bebo abin-abin-imakdele, be gusgu nabir-ibmar-sogdaed, ar bedi dule-innikigwadid. Degi-inigwele, an bese igar-soggwen wis egisgwersunno. ¿Ar ibiga dule-isganamarga ibmar-nueganbi naddae? ¿Ar ibiga dule-emar-yardakmalad gwen-bai itodasurmala?
Bee be we-dulemar urbedaed, sapimaryobi bonisuli ganguddamalad, deyob dunguddamalad, sapi-sunmakedyobi nasguddamalad. Unnila asginbi be-nug-ogannodimalad, e-gwage-ulubgindi begi binsadisurmalad.
Bab-Jehová, bedi be an-wisid. Be an-dakdiid, be an-wisid igi an begi binsae. Igi sibad-wawaad e-oburgwileged-negse-selemaidae, deyob be we-dulemar sede. Oburgwileged-ibaga be we-dulemar saboge.
¿Sanagwadse we-napade gannar sanmakdoe? ¿Sanagwadse wede gaganmar gannar ainidagoe? Emide, bela we-dulemar-isgued-ulale, ibmar-durgan girgumamaid, degi, bela nuumar burgwemamaid. Ar we-dulemarde sogmalad: ‘Bab-Dummad anmar-ibmar-imaked dakmaisurye.’ ”
Bab-Dummad, Jeremíasʼga sogded: “Dule-abarmakmaladbo be abarmaknaile, be yegusdaedde, degite, ¿igi-be dule-moligi-abarmakmaladbo be benguosunna? Yar-bogidikidginbela be dobe-itodaedde, degite, ¿igi be Jordán-bula-naidgi be dobe itogosuli?
Ar be-gwenadganbela, be-galagwenmalad-inigwele, begi dododimalad, begi yoledimalad. Ar we-dulemar ibmar-nuegangi amba bega sunmakmalale, melle be we-dulemar itogo.
”An-dulamargi an bangusad, an-dulamar an na obachad. An-dulamar-na-sabesailadi e-isdarmaladga an urmaksad.
Ar an-dulamar, achumigur-nono-wawaad sapurba-gudiiyob angi gudmalad. Binnasuli angi uurmakdemalad, a-ulale, an isdar-daked.
An-dulamar, igi nuu-e-absar-akar-akar-daklemalad sulubagise-balegilledidaeyobi gued. ¡Bela be dagmar! Bela ibmar-durgan-ursirmalad, dulemargi-aibinega egi be dagmarsun.
Bukidar dule-isdarmalad-e-dummagan, an-uvaʼmar-digaled obelosad, an-nainu bela oichosmalad. An-nainu-yeerdaklegedi, nega-dulesulid-ollonaidga imaksamalad.
Bela an-nainu wiosmalad. An-sunnagwad an daksad, bela nainu-olloo imaksamalad, bela swanga imaksamalad. Ar dulemar yala gwen bai-daksurmarsoggu, bela yala swanga nagusad.
Bela yala-mullugan-negasulidganba, dule-isganamar nonimalad. Bab-Jehová-e-es-suid bela we-yala obelogoed, bela naga-nagase obelogoed, gwen dule-wargwenga neg-bogidikid naguosulid.
Bemar orosgi-dakleged-digsamalan-inigwele, ikomarbi bega ainisad. Be arbasmaladi, binsa be arbasmalad. Bab-Jehová-e-urwed-ulale, bemar-ibmar-wessulidbali be bingegumaloed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Dule-isganamar yar-baigan-dikarba-bukmaladi, an-dulamar-ibe an-yar-uksad-obelosmaladi, an bela e-yalagi we-dulemar-onogoed. Deyob an Judá-dulemar we-dulemar-abargi onomogoed.
Geb an onosad-sorbali, wile an an-dulamar dakoed, gannar na e-negmarse-dagega an imakoed, e-yalamarse-dagega an imakoed.
