Ar we-dulemar-yarmar-baidginmaladi, an-dulamar-Baal-nuggi-ise-sogar-ibmar-imakleged odurdaksa-gusmaladid. Ar we-dulemar, an-dulamar-abargi gudigubimalale, an-igarmar-mamaid abingamalargebed, ise-sogar an-nuggi imakmarmogargebed. Weyob sogmalargebed, ¡Bab-Jehová-dula-maid-nugginye!”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar dule an-sogedba dasulirdi, bela an obelogoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob anga sogsad: “Jeremías, sasirdub-lino be bakna, be-saderba be edinno. Melle we-sasirdub-lino be owardikuo.”
Igi-Bab-Jehová-anga-sogsa, aba an imaksad. Sasirdub-lino an baksad. Geb agine, an-saderba an edichad.
Geb Bab-Jehová anga weyob sognonibalid:
“Be sasirdub-lino-baksadi, be-saderba-naidi be unge. Éufrates-diwarse be nae, akwa-maraled-yaba sasirdub be odukuo.”
Igi Bab-Jehová anga-sogsa, aba an imaksad. Geb an Éufrates-diwarse naded, sasirdub-lino akwa-maraled-yaba an odosad.
Ibagan-undar-nasadgi, Bab-Jehová anga sokalid: “Jeremías, Éufrates-diwarse be nae, sasirdub-lino-akwa-maraled-yaba-odosgusad be sunae.”
Geb agine, an Éufrates-diwarse naded. An akwa-akwisad, agine, akwa-maraled-yaba-sasirdub-odosgusadi, an onosad. Sasirdub-lino bela nungusad, gwen bar nuedsulid.
Geb Bab-Jehová weyob anga sognonibalid:
“Ar igi be we-sasirdub nunu-daksa, deyopira an Judá-dulemar-na-san-dummarba-imakdiid imakoed. Jerusalén-dulemar-na-san-dummarba-imakdimarmogad deyob an imakbaloed.
We-dule-isganamar an-ega-ibmar-soged-itobisurmaladi, na e-gwage-binsaedba ibmar imakmalad. Amar bab-dummaganba-nanadmaladi, bab-dummagan-e-nug odummodmalad. Amala bela sasirdub-lino-nunudyob gumaloed, gwen bar nued guosurmalad.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar igi sasirdub-lino dule-saderba-atinne, deyopira an bela-Israel-dulemar, degi, bela-Judá-dulemar, an-Igar-Maidgi alakwaa-naguega an imaksanad. Adi, an-neggweburga-guega, an-nug-ogannodiguega, angi nue-binsaed-nikaa-nanamalaga, degi, an-gandikid-yeerdakleged-egi-oyolegega an imaksanad. Degi-inigwele, an-sogedba ibmar imaksasurmalad.”
“Jeremías, an-dulamarga be sogbalo: Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová weyob sogye: ‘Bela metemargi vino enolegoye.’ Bega sokarmalale: ‘¿Ar anmar bela metemargi-vino-enolegoed wissurmarsi?’
Geb agine be, emarbin-sogdoed, weyob Bab-Jehová sogye: ‘Bela dulemar we-yalaginmaladi an omumsaoye. Wemar an omumsaoye: Reymar-e-dad-Davidʼgi-danimalad, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, degi, bela Jerusalénʼginmalad an omumsaoye.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Na muchub-muchub-sarsomalaga an imakoed, babgana, e-mimmiganbo-sarsomalaga an imakbaloed. An we-dulemar bai-dakosulid, wile an ebinsaosulid. An we-dulemar obelogoed.”
Ani Jeremías dulemarga weyob sogded: “Israel-dulemar, nue-bogimakar be an-itomala.” Bab-Jehová-sunnagwad sogsad: “Melle na be san-dummarbaa imakmarye.
Begi Bab-Jehová negsichid barmidaged-iduar, be gandikidba e-nug-ogannomar. Bemar negsichidgi yoledigumaloed-iduale, Bab-Dummad-nug be odummomar. Ar bemar, neg-meegwad edarbedimalad, degi-inigwele, Bab-Dummad bega negsichid nasiknonikoed, bela-belad neg gudure imakoed.
Ar bemar anba-ibsasulile, an bemarga walagwengi arbakee bemar-san-dummarba-imakedba an bodii guoed. An yaisuli-boedbali an-ibyanis ariodii guoed, geg an sagusadse bodii guoed. Ar Bab-Jehová-e-dulemar, dikasuli gales-seledmaloed.
”Reyga, degi, e-nanga be weyob sogo: ‘San-bipii na be imakmala. Bemar, rey-gangi-siidgi be aidemala, napagi be sigmala. Ar be-ologurgin-yeerdakleged-yoega bar bega igar maisulid.’
Neguev-neggweburmar bela e-isdarmaladse ebililesbukwad, dulemar geg-noe bukwamalad. Bela Judá-dulemar yar-baidse selesmalad, bela yar-baidgi ambikusmalad.
”¡Be atakmala! Dulemar-dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik-danikid be nue dakmala. ¿Bia dulemar-akwega-bemarga-uklesad nade? ¿Bia we-dulemar-be-yeerdaksamalad nade?
Wede igi be sogosunna, Bab-Dummad, be-ai-nueganga-guega be odurdaksadi be-dummaganga nug-imaksar. Naibid-dummad be itomaloed. Sior-gwensak muu-neggi-ugakgunaile, nunmaked-dummad abinganaidae, debayobi, ulubgi be nunmaked itogoed.
”Na be dukin weyob sokarmalale: ‘¿Ibiga wede deyob anmar wilearye?’ Ar be galagwensuli-isgusad-ulale, uka-swili be-imakmaloed. Be galagwensuli-isgusad-ulale, be-gagamaloed.
¿Ar dule-uka-sichidi, e-uka ogwao be insae? Gege na e-uka ogwaed. ¿Ar achu-sapur-uka-mata-matad, e-uka ogwao be insae? Suli. Gege ogwaed. Ar bemar deyobmodo. ¿Ar bemar ibmar-isgana-imakdimaladgi, ibmar-nuegan imakmalosi? Suli. Ar bemar bato ibmar-isgana-imaked nue-durdaksamalad.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Igi nega-dulesulidganba-burwa-goledi, gagan-dinnagan-oaisakie, deyobi, an bemar-oaisakioed.”
Bab-Jehová sogbalid: “Ar weyob be odurdaklemalargebed, na weyob be wilemalargebed. Ar bemar an-iedmalad, ar gakansaedgi bur be bensuli gudmalad.
Uka-swili an bemar-imakoed, be-abgangi be bingegugwichiguedse an be-imakoed.
Bemar-galagwensuli-ibmar-isgana-imaked an daksad. Nainumargi-ibmar-imaksad, yar-mullugangi-ibmar-imaksad, an bela daksad. Bemar galagwensuli-negsichigi-nanaedi, emarga-agumakedi, degine, bemar-gambanuchu-saedi, an daksad. ¡Jerusalén-dulemar! ¡Na be duledar-wilesmar! ¿Ar sanagwadse be isguedgi-gudigumaloye be sogmala?”
Dii bar wimaisulid-ular, Bab-Jehová Jeremíasʼga sunmaknonikid. Ega weyob sognonikid:
“Judá-dulemar nue-bukib binsabukmalad, e-neggweburmar bergumamaigusad. Judá-neggweburgine, bela oakubukmalad, Jerusalén-dulemar bela binnasuli bobukmalad.
Dule-nuga-nikamaladi, dule-ega-arbamalad ega dii-amiega barmiddaed. Dia-dummagan-siidse naddamalanad, degi-inigwele, diimar satedaed. Binged-abalagi gannar e-gwidu-ollo-ollo negse nonidamalad. Nue-naibi-itogedbali, e-nono gasa imakdamalad.
Yalagi dii bar wisulidbali, napamar daas-daas naded. Dule-sapurgi-arbamaladi akusunna na itogusmalad, bukib binsagusmalad.
Ar goe-sapurmarbela, gaganmar-bergusad-ular, sapurgi e-mimmi-mete naddamarsunnad.
Moli-sapur-uayasuid, yar-mullugan-swiligangi achu-sapur-uaya-gannagannayob, masbina asa-nakwa-nakwa gudidamalad. Ar gaganmar-satesoggu, e-ibyamar mommoleddaed.”
Ani Jeremías Bab-Jehováʼga sogded: “Bab-Jehová, anmar-isgued amba anmargi-yolena-inigwele, be-nug na-be-nue-sabedbali be anmar bendakdage. Ar anmar-isgued bukidargusad, anmar begi nue-isgusmalad.
Bab-Dummad, ar be Israel-dulemar-abonogedid. Israel-dulemar suli-suli-itoalile, begi bendakleged. ¿Ar ibiga degite, be we-yalagi dule-baidyobi bakar-nadapi be gusunna? Emide be, igi dule-aineba-danikid ibagwen-wis-gabis-naddaedyob be gued.
¿Ar ibiga be akusunna-ibmar-itogedyob be dasunna? ¿Ar ibiga be dule-bilagi-urwed gege-dule-bendakedyob be dasunna? Bab-Jehová, be anmar-abargi gudiid, bela dulemar wisid, anmar begadga gued. Melle be anmar-obane, wile be anmar-dake.”
Bab-Jehová weyob bemarnik soged: “Ar be-itolegedba-gaamakdiid bur yeer-itomalad, gwen bogigusurmalad. A-ulale, an bemar-abingabisulid. Emisgindi, aka be, bemar-isguedgi-binsaega be an-imakarmalad, degisoggu, bemar-isgued-ular, be anse sabsur-odurdaklemarsunnoed.”
Geb Bab-Jehová weyob anga sokalid: “Jeremías, melle we-dulemar-bendakega be anse wilesakwaa golo.
Ar anse-goled-ular, mas-gunsuli-gumalale, amba an itogosulid. Ar amba anga ibmar-ogumakar-ukmalale, anga ibmar-gwagmar-ukmalale, amba an abingaosulid. Es-suidgi an we-dulemar obelogoed, degi, ukudgi, boni-dummagangi an we-dulemar obelogoed.”
Bab-Jehová-abin an sogded: “¡Bab-Dummad-Jehová! ¡Nunmaked-dummaddo! Ar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogedye-sogdimaladi, sunmakdimalad, we-dulemarde es-suidgi burgosurmarye, ukud-dummad-naguosurye sogmalad. Unnila, bede, we-yalagi ega neg-bogidikid-degisadeguad-ukoye sogdimalad.”
Geb Bab-Jehová an-abin sogded: “Wedi, gayaburba-barsogmalad an-nuggi gakansaar sunmakdimalad. Gwen an we-dulemar barmissulid, gwen an ega an-nuggi-sunmakega igar uksasurbalid, gwen an ega sunmakdisulid. We-dulemar-sunmakmaladi, unnila binsa yogasaar na wargwen-ibya-apuredba sunmakdimalad, binsa ee gordimalad, dukin-yogasaar-e-itogedba sunmakmalad.”
A-ulale, weyob Bab-Jehová soged: “We-dulemar an gwen-barmissulidi, an-nuggi sunmakmarye-sogmaladi, degine, na sogmarbalidi, we-yalagi dulemar es-suidgi burgosurye, ukud-dummad naguosurye. Ar wemala, na ukudba burgwemaloed, e-sunnagwad es-suidgi burgwemaloed.
”Degine, dule-we-sunmakmalad-itosmaladi, Jerusalén-neggwebur-neg-imbabali ukudba mellemamai gumaloed, es-suidgi oburgwilemaloed, igarba-mellemamai gumaloed. E-omegan-e-muimar, e-masmala-e-muimar, e-bunamala-e-muimar gwen dule digosurmalad. Ar dule-muimar-digedbela sate gumaloed. Ar bela e-isgumalad egi aibinega an imakoed.
”Be, Jeremías, we-dulemarga weyob be sogo: ‘Bane-bane an ise-boale gudii guoed, ar an-dulemar-na-nue-sabedi, nue-dummad wilesad. Bela-belad nue-sabsur odursaklesad.
Sapurba an nadele, es-suidgi-dulemar-burgwisad-e-mui omilede an dakdaed. Neggweburgi an dogdele, ukudba-dulemar-burgwisad-e-mui omilede an dakdaed. Ar Bab-gayaburba-barsogmaladdi, degi, dule-irwa-Babse-gormaladbela, neg-gunaid akudakmalad.’ ”
Ani Jeremías, Bab-Dummad-abin sogded: “Ar be Judá-dulemar nue-obachad, isdarsun be Jerusalén-dulemar daked. ¿Ibiga be dogdar sabsur-anmar-wiosa? Aisaar anmar bendakleged edarbediinad. Emide, gwen anmar ibmar-nued abingassulid. Anmar san-nued-gudigued edarbediinad, aka gwayed-dummad anmarga nonikid.
Bab-Jehová, anmar, anmar-isgusad magar na itoged. Anmar-babgan-begi-isgusad anmar magar-dakbalid. Anmar begi dummad-isgusad.
Be-nug be nue-sabedbali, melle be isdar anmar-dake. Be-ologana-yeerdakleged-e-neg melle be isdar-dake. ¡Be anmarbo-igar-mesisad nue be ebinsae! ¡Melle be anmarbo-igar-mesisad bisge!
Bab-Dummad, ¿ar bab-dummagan-imbagi, gwensak dii-nabir-owied gudisi? Suli. Bab-Dummad-Jehová, ¿ar bee be, dii-owisursi? ¿Ar nibnega e-itolegedba dii-owiardasi? Suli. Ar bela be we-ibmarmar imaksad. A-ulale, anmar begi bensurmalad.”
Bab-Jehová anga sogsad: “Amba Moisés anse danidibe, Samuelʼdibe, Judá-dulemar-ular-sunmakega, amba an Judá-dulemar bendaksasuliled. ¡Judá-dulemar, angi be obane! Ega be soge, ‘¡be namarye!’
Bega sokarmalale: ‘¿Bia anmar naosunna?’ Ega be sogo, weyob Bab-Jehová sogye: ‘Dule bonigi-burgwemaloye ega-igar-maidi, bonigi burgwemaloed. Dule es-suidgi-burgwemaloye ega-igar-maidi, es-suidgi burgwemaloed. Dule ukudba-burgwemaloye ega-igar-maidi, ukudba burgwemaloed. Dule gales-seledoye ega-igar-maidi, galesa seledmaloed.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “We-dulemargine, we-boni-dummagan-sogabake an barmidoed: Bila-onoleged, adi, agi-burgwemalagar. Achumar, adi, e-muimar-ebipiegar. Mulamar, adi, e-san-gunmalagar. Geb ibdurgan-sapurbarmalad, adi, bela e-san-obelomalagar.
”We-dulemargi an ibmar-imakoedi, Ezequías-machi-Manasés Judá-e-reyga-megisadi, Jerusalénʼgi ibmar-isgana-imaksad-ular, bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad dobee-itogegala an we-bonigan barmidoed.
Jerusalén-dulemar, ¿doa wile be-dakoe? ¿Doa bebina booe? ¿Doa be-egisoe, bede nueganbi-sogeye?”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Bemar an-obachamalad, be angi bangudmalad. Degisoggu, an bemargi gwichiguoed, an bemar-obelogoed. An wile-bemar-dakdiid budar-itogusad. Wese-ugaksun.
Gagan-durgan-burwaba-mileddaedyobi, neggweburgi an bemar-oaisakioed. Mimmigansuli an bemar-imakoed, bela an bemar-obelogoed, ar be-daedi na be ogwassurmalad.
Omegan-ei-sui-burgwismaladi, demargakaba-ukub-naiyob an omelogoed. Yorukudbali, sapingana-e-nangangine, burgwed-igar an egi barmidoed. Ukiagwale, an egi suli-suli-itoged nasikoed, an egi dobed-dummad nasikoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Bukidar-mimmigan-nikusmaladi, negoedmaloed, burgwidmaloed. Na bingedar itodmaloed, san-bipii itodmaloed. Dad-ibeler-gaedi ukiagwar ega akitoed. Dule-burgosurmaladdi, e-isdarmaladse-es-suidgi-oburgwilegega an imakoed.”
Jeremías binnasuli sogded: “¡Nana! Nue-nunmak an itoged. We-napnegse unnila dulemarbo-abin-abin-naguega be an-odesad. ¡Dulemarbo-urwega be an-odesad! ¡Bur an gwalulessulina nabirinad! Gwen dulemargi an mani gadisulid, gwen dulemar angi mani gadisurmogad, degite, bela dulemar an-ukabsadimalad.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Napira an bega soged, we-ibmarmargi an be-ollorsaoed. An be-isdarmaladi, boni-dummagan-ibagangine, suli-suli-itoged-ibagangine, begi-wilegega an imakoed.
”¿Sunna dule esgoro-dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik-danikid bisgesi? ¿Sunna dule esgoro-gordikid-dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik-danikid bisgesi?
Bemar-isgumalad-ulale, an be-isdarmaladga binsa maniginsuli, be-manimar, be-ibmar-nuegan, an ukoed. Bela be-neggweburgi be ibmar-nikamaladi, an ega binsa be-isdarmaladga ukoed.
Yar be dakdisurmaladgi, be-isdarmaladga mailedigumalaga an bemar-imakoed. An-sae-itogedi soo-gwabunye-gwichiyobi bemarbina itosnaid.”
Ani Jeremías, Bab-Jehováʼga sogded: “Bab-Jehová an be-ular-wilediid be nue-wisid. ¡Melle be an-iege! ¡Be an-bendakdage! ¡Dulemar an-balegindimalad buged-mai be imake! Be-gwae-gwae-itosurdaedba, melle we-dulemarse-burgwega be an-imake. Be nue-an-dake, an be-ular uasoledid.
”Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, be-anga sunmaksagua, bela-belad sogedba an abingasad. An be-gayaburba-itoargua, yeer-ito an-imaksad, ar an begadga gued.
Dule-ibagibi-gudimaladba an gwen akadisulid. Gwen an amarba wergudisurbalid. Be anse nonikid-akale, an walagwen nanadiid, ar bebi be anba gudiid. Isgued-sae-dakega be an-imaksamogad.
”¿Ar ibiga an-nunmaked geg bergue? ¿Ar ibiga an-naibigusad gege nugue? ¿Ar ibiga an-nuguedde ganna-nai? Be anga dian-dinnaa maiyob naded, ar be dii-aryomaisulidyob guded.”
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Gannar be anse dagye-sogele, gannarse an be-onudakoed, be anga arbadii guoed. Yogasaar be-itolegedba be sunmaksulile, unnila napiragwadba be sunmakele, bee be, anga gayaburba-berbegedga guoed. We-dulemarba be mer ibsao, ar wemar bur be-sunmakedba ibsamaloedid.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Galu-esgoro-gordikid-matusulidyobi, we-dulemarga an be-imakoed. We-dulemar bebo urwemaloed, degi-inigwele, begi obinosurmalad. Ar ani an be-bendakega guoed. We-dulemargi ollorguega an be-imakoed.
Dulemar-isganamargi an be-onogoed, dulemar-bulegangi an be-ollorsaoed.”
Bab-Jehová-gayaburba weyob anse nonikid. Weyob anga sognonikid:
“Melle be we-yargi ome-nikuo. Melle be mimmigan nikubalo.”
Ar Bab-Jehová weyob we-yargi mimmigan-gwalulesmalad-annik soged, e-nangan-annik sogbalid, degine, e-babgan-annik sogbalid:
“Wemala, bonigan-dummagangi burgwemaloed, gwen dule ega boosurmalad. Geb degine, e-muimar gwen dule nuedgi digosurbalid. Bela e-muimar ibmar-isganayob napagi-omilede guoed. We-dulemar es-suidgi oburgwilemaloed, ukud-dummad egi gwichiguoed. E-muimar, ibdurgan-gukumalad-e-masga guoed, achu-sapurmar-e-masga gubaloed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob sogbalid: “Melle dulemar-bonanaid-negse be dogo, de-ukinbali, melle ega be bonabalo, degine, melle be e-naibi-itodiid baisur-itogega be imaknabalo. Ar ade, an we-dulemargi an-bogidikid-ega-uksadi, an e-ibe obelosad. An-sabguedi an e-ibe osulosad, an-wile-dule-dakedi an e-ibe osulosbalid.
We-yalagine, bela dulemar burgoed: Dule-nuga-nikamaladdibe, dule-binsarmaladdibe, bela burgwemaloed. Gwen dule ega boosulid, gwen dule nuedgi e-mui digosurbalid. Degine, gwen dule e-ular, na e-san-naibisaosulid, degi, gwen e-ular, saila-swiri imakosurbalid, wile-itoged-iba ega gwen dakosulid.
”Deginbali, gwen dule, dule-burgwisadga-bonaidgala-e-gwage-baisur-ito-imakega, masgunned ukosurbalid. Deginbali, gwen dule, ega gwage-baisur-ito-imakega gobed ukosurbalid. Degine, amba e-nan-burgwisdibe, e-babdibe, gwen dule ega ibmar ukosurbalid.
”Melle iba-onolenaid-negse be dognao. Melle be mas-gunnegala, gobbaligala, a-dulemar-abargi be signao.
Ar Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad soged: ‘Bela we-yalagine, yeer-itolegedi, weligwaled-oyolegedi, an obelogoed. Deginbali, abirgunagwaledgi-weligwar-namakleged bela an obelobaloed. We-ibmar-guoedi, e-ibagangi guoed, na emar-sunnagwad e-ibyanugi dakmaloed.’
”Bela be we-dulemarga we-ibmarmar-sogsale, we-dulemar bega sogdamaloed: ‘¿Ibiga Bab-Jehová weyob anmar-imakbiye soge? ¿Ibu-ibmar-isgana anmar imaksasunna? ¿Ibugi anmarde anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼgi nossunna?’
Geb a-dulemar-abin be sogdoed, Bab-Jehová weyob sogye: ‘Be-dadgana angi aibachagusmalad, bab-dummagan-baiganba nanadgusmalad, abali ibsadgusmalad, a-e-nug odummodgusmalad. Ar andi an-iedgusmalad, an-Igar-Maidba nanassurmalad.
” ’Ar bemardi bur bule be-dadganba isgudmalad. Na wala-walagwen e-itolegedba nanadmalad, gwen an-sogedba be ibsadisurmalad.
A-ulale, bemar, we-yalagi-bukwadi an be-onomaloed. Be yala-akudakmaladse, be-dadgan-a-yala-daksasurmarmogadse an bemar-ebipidoed. A-yalagine, bane-bane bab-dummagan-baiganse be gordii gudmaloed. An wile bemar-dakosulid.’ ”
Bab-Jehová weyob sogbalid: “Dulemar bar weyob-sogosulid-ibagan danikid: ‘¡Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummomarye, ar Egipto-yalagi Israel-dulemar-onosadiddeeye!’
Bur sogdemaloed: ‘Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummomarye, ar Asiria-yalagi, degi, Babilonia-yalagi Israel-dulemar-bukwa-onosadiddeeye, degine, bela yalamar-bamaladgi galesbukwad-onosbalididdeeye.’ Ani an gannar an e-dadganga-yala-uksagusadse an barmidoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Bukidar an be-isdarmalad begi barmidagoed. We-dulemala, ua-galegeyob be-gamaloed. Geb an bukidar be-isdarmalad-baigan barmidabaloed. We-dulemala, ibmar-makedyob, sapurbali, yar-mulluganbali, degine, akwa-dummagan-mararmaladbali, be-balegindiguega an imakoed.
”Ar an bela bemar-ibmar-imaked an wisid. Bipisaale angi soggwenad dukumaisulid. Ar bemar-ibmar-isgana-imakedi, gwen angi dukuosulid.
Gebedgine, bemar-isgusad-ular ilabo-wilub bemar sabsur-odurdaklegoed. Ar be-bab-dummaganyob-ibmar-imaklemaladgi be an-yala oichosmalad, sunnasuli ibmar-isganabi-yapannega be an-yala imaksamalad.”
Bab-Jehováʼye, an suli-suli-itogedgine, be an-ganguedga guedid, be an-ogannogedid, be an-edarbedid. Bela yalamar-ugakaase-bukmaladi bese danimaloed, bega sognonimaloed: “Anmar-dadgan bab-dummadsulid e-bab-dummadga na imaksamalad. Gwen ibmar-nued abingassurmalad, unnila ibmar-igarga-gusulid na abingasmalad.
¿Ar sunna dulemar na dukin e-bab-dummagan sobsi? Eye, degi-inigwele, we-ibmarmarde gwen bab-dummagansulid.”
Bab-Jehová Jeremíasʼga sogded: “A-ulale, an we-dulemar odurdakoed, an we-dulemarga an-ganguedi an ega oyogoed. Adi, wisgumalaga, ani an Bab-Jehová gued.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Judá-dulemar-e-isguedi, e-gwagegi, esgoro-swiswidikidgi narmakar naiyobid, akwa-diamante-e-dukugi narmakar naiyobid. Judá-dulemar-e-isguedi, Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-e-bebegi sobles naid.
Ar be-mimmiganse-bakale, bab-dummad-bundor-Asera-e-wilubgan-sobsadi, ega e-ailamar sapi-dummagan-nagaba-sobsadi, nue ebinsamalad.
Degi, yar-mullugangi sapurba-neg-ollornaidgi aila-sobar-bukwamarbalidi, nue ebinsamarbalid. ”Bemar-isgued-ulale, bela be-yargine, be-manimala, be-ibmar-nuegana be-isdarmaladga an ukoed, degine, be-bab-dummaganse-goled-negmar an ega ukbaloed.
Na be dukin an-bemarga-yala-uksadi be surgumaloed. Be yar-dakdisulidgi, be-isdarmalad-e-maiga an be-imakoed. Ar be, nue an-oulussoggu, an-urwed, soo-geg-ginnedyobi, bemargi degisadegu gusunnoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “¡Dule dule-baidgi-bensuli-gued, duledar wilesun! ¡Dule, dulegi-bendakleged-amidiid, duledar wilesun! ¡Dule angi-banguedi, duledar wilesun!
A-dule, sapi-matugana nega-dulesulidganba-nikadyob gumaloed: Neg-nuegan-nonikir, gwen werguosulid, unnila nega-dulesulidganba garmakdii guoed, napa-balubiidgi gudii guoed, agine, gwen dulemar gudidasurmalad. Debayobi, dule Bab-Dummadgi-banguder guoed.
”Ar dule angine-bensuligueddi, anginbi-bendakleged-edarbediiddi, egi nued binsalesad.
A-dule, sapi-diwar-naba-gwichidaedyobi gued, igi sapi-malimar diwarse-bategwichile, neg-ued-nonikile, gwen akar-gusuli, e-gagan aramakwisgudae, debayobi, a-dule gued. Deginbali, igi a-sapi yolagi gwen akar-gusuli birga-irba gusgu sanmakgwisdae, deyobi, we-dule gued.
”Dule-binsaedi, ibmar-baiganba bur bule isganad, dule-yardakedgi binsadaed. ¿Ar wede doa dule-binsaed magar-dakosunna?
”Unnila ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi, dulemar-ulubgi-binsaed magar-daked, dulemar-binsaed balamied. Degidbali, an e-ibmar-isgana-imakedba sabsur-odurdaked.
”Dule igar-maisulidba mani-ibedga-guedi, nuu-butu, igi nuu-baid-akwa-akwedae, deyobi gued. Dule-deyob-mani-ibedga-gusadi, sikwas-gudiidgi, gannar mani-sate gunonikoed, gannar dule-wilegedga gudoed.”
Ani Jeremías, an weyob sogded: “Bab-Dummad, anmar-bese-goled-nega, ologana-gandikidba-yeerdakleged-negad, sailanagi bato agi be-nug odummoledanikid.
¡Bab-Jehová, be Israel-dulemar-bendakega gued! Dulemar begi-aibatemaladi, bingegudmaloed. Dulemar begi-banguddamaladi, ukubgi-ibmar-narmaklegeyob yoggudmaloed. Ar Bab-Jehová-dii-nuedyob-gued iedmalad.
”Bab-Jehová be an-nudake, adi, an nuguoed. Be an-abonoge, adi, an abonolegoed, unnila an be-nugbi odummoged.
Ar dulemar anga sokardaed: ‘¿Ar bia Bab-Jehová-anmarga-ibmar-sogsadde? Anmarga-ibmar-sogsadi anmarga imakbi an abedo.’
Bab-Jehová, an bega-ibmar-sogsadi be nue-wisid, ar an be-asabinni an bega ibmar sogsad. Degi-inigwele, an begi alamaknai gussulid, be we-dulemar sabsur-odurdakye, be we-dulemargi boni-dummagan-barmidaye an bega sogsasurbalid.
Bab-Dummad, melle be an-ogwayega gue, ar boni-dummagangine, bee be an-bendakedid.
¡Baba, melle bingeguega be an-imake! ¡We-dulemar be obingegsae! ¡Melle dobe-itogega be an-imake! ¡We-dulemar be odobgue! ¡Ibagan-bulegan ega be barmidage! ¡We-dulemar be obeloge! ¡Ilabogwadse be wioge!”
Bab-Jehová weyob anga sogsad: “Be nae, neggwebur-yawagakse be gwisguna, bia Judá-reymar ubodae, degi, bia noardae, ase be gwisgunao. Geb, a-sorbali, bela Jerusalén-neggwebur-yawagak-bukmaladse be gwisgunabalo. Weyob be ega sogo:
‘Judá-dulemar-e-reymar, Bab-Jehová-gayaburba be itomar. Degi, bela Judá-dulemar, bela Jerusalén-dulemar we-yawagakgi-dogdimalad, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba be itomar.’ ”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Nue salakarmalo. Obunnoged-ibagi melle be ibmar-semalo, melle Jerusalén-yawagakgi ibmar-odomarbalo.
Deginbali, melle obunnoged-ibagi, be-negyagi ibmar-onomarbalo, degi, bipisaale, a-ibagi melle be arbamarbalo. We-obunnoged-iba iba-islidik be dakmalo. Igi an be-dadganga sogsagusa, deyob be dakmalo.
Degi-inigwele, be-dadgan an-itossurmalad, gwen an-sogedba ibmar imaksasurmalad, bur gwage-dutusuli gudmalad, gwen an-itossurmalad, degine, e-odurdaked abessurmarbalid.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar bemar an-sogedba ibmar-imakmalale, gi we-neggwebur-yawagakba be ibmar-odosurmalale, unnila we-iba, iba-islidikidga be imakmalale, a-ibagi be ibmar-imaksurmalale,
we-neggwebur-yawagaknaba reymar, degi, reymar-masmala Rey-David-ologanagi sigmaloed. Reymar, reymar-masmala Judá-dulemar-abargi, degi, Jerusalén-dulemar-abargi ur-napaginedgi-sii dogmaloed, degi, moli-birgi-sii ubomaloed. We-neggweburgi dulemar bukwagu gumaloed.
”Judá-dulemar danikoed, dulemar-Jerusalén-neggwebur-dikarba-bukmalad danimaloed, degi, Benjamín-yalagi-bukwamalad danimarmogoed, degine, Sefela-yalagi-bukwamalad danimaloed. Degine, yalaganba-bukwamalad, degi, Neguev-yalaganba-bukwamalad danimarmogoed. Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negse Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ukega, ibmar-uklemalad sedanimaloed, degi, ibmar-ogumakar-uklemalad, orosgi-dakleged, degine, ina-wawagan, sedanimaloed. Deginbali, Bab-Dummadga dog-nuedye-sogega-ibmar-ukleged sedanimarbaloed.
Ar bemar anba-ibsasulile, an-igar-maidba obunnoged-iba iba-islidikidga be imaksurmalale, degi, Jerusalén-yawagak-dummagangi be ibmar-odomalale, an a-yawagakmar ogumakoed, dule gwen-oginnosulid, bela Jerusalén-reynegmar an ogumakoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob anga sognonikid:
“Jeremías, napsagi-ibmar-sobed-dule-negse be nae, agi an bega ibmar sogo.”
Geb an napsagi-ibmar-sobed-dule-negse nadsunnad, degi, an modapgu, napsa-e-obipirmakedgi ibmar-sobnai an dakdapid.
Napsagi-ibmar-sied-sobnaid e-ibe isgunonikile, gannar sobdedabalid, egi bela nued-noedse imakdaed.
Agine Bab-Jehová-gayaburba anse nonikid, anga weyob sognonikid:
Bab-Jehová soged: “Israel-dulemar, ¿geg an napsagi-ibmar-sobed-duleyob an bemar-imakmosi? Bemar Israel-dulemar, igi-napsagi-ibmar-sobed-dule napsa-imake, deyobi, bemar an-argangi gumalad.
”An dula-bukwad-gwensak-obelogedgi-sunmakbiele, yar-gwensakgindibe, an-itogedba sunna an sunmaked. Sunna an bela we-dulemar-sabsur-odurdakedgi an sunmakbalid.
Ar we-dula-bukwad-gwensak-bukwadi, e-isguedga-ulubgi-bukib-binsaele, ibmar-isgana-imaked iemarsogele, an sabsur-odurdakoye-sogsad bar an odurdakosulid.
”Deginbali, an sunna bega neggwebur-onasguedgi sunmakbalid. An sunna neggwebur gangued-nika-imakedgi sunmakbalid.
Degi-inigwele, ar emar an-asabin ibmar-isgana-imakele, an-sogedba dasurmalale, bar an emarga ibmar-nued-imakedgi binsaosulid.
”Jeremías, emisgindi, Judá-dulemarga be sogo, degine, Jerusalén-dulemarga be sogbalo. Bab-Jehová weyob sogye ega be sogo: ‘An bemar-idu boni-dummagan urbenaiye, bemar-sabsur-odurdakedgi an binsanaiye. Bemar igar-isganagi bangumarye, be-daed be ogwamarye, be-ibmar-imaked nue be imakmarye.’
Degi-inigwele, bega sogdamaloed: ‘Suli, anmar imakosuli. Anmar, anmar-itolegedba ibmar imakoed, anmar ibmar-isgana-abegedba na ibmar-imakdii gumaloed.’ ”
Ar Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Dule-yar-baid-baidgi na be egismardo: ‘¿Doa weyob ibmar-imakdimar be itosa?’ ¡Suli! Weyob ibmar itoledisulid. Ar Israel-dulemar, ibmar-isgana yeer-gangu imaksamalad.
Ar Líbano-yalaganba boo-sibudik-bated, ¿berguoe be insae? Yalaganba dii-dammipegwad-aryomaid, ¿berguo be insae? ¡Suli! Berguosuli.
Degi-inigwele, an-dulamar an-iedmalad. Bab-dummagan-binsagumaladga ina-wawadikmalad ogumakar ukdemalad. Igar-nued gebesailagi an ega-uksadgi bangudmalad. E-igar-isganaba nanadmalad, igar-gwen-nabirsulidgi gudii gudmalad.
A-ulale, e-yar-naid nega-dulesulidga imaksamalad, egi-dodolegega imaksamalad. Dulemar egi nasdamaladi, geger-dakedbali, nono-ege-ege imakdemaloed.
Dad-ibeler-nakwedsik burwa-goled-neg-imakedyobi, an bemar-imakoed, an be-isdarmalad-asabin bemar-oaisakioed. Be sabsur-odurdaklemaloed-ibagi an bemar-bendakosulid, an bemar-idu wagar-biir imakoed.”
Dulemar weyob Jeremíasʼgi sogdemalad: “Anmar Jeremíasʼgi-gwisguega igar amimargwelo. Amba anmarga dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad igar-maidgi-anmar-odurdakega surguosulid. Degine, dule-binsaed-ibed anmarga-binsaed-uked surguosurbalid. Anmarga Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged surguosurbalid. Anmar melle we-dule-ibmar-soged itomalo. Anmar naibid ega ukega, e-sunmaked-egi-aibinega imakmalo.”
Ani Jeremías Bab-Dummadga weyob sogded: “¡Bab-Jehováʼye, nue be an-itoge! ¡Dulemar angi-gwichigunanaid nue be itoge!
¿Ar ibmar-nued-imaklegedi, ibmar-isgana-imaklegedga gunonidasi? Ar we-dulemala an-metemalaga, an-idu yaa-dummad-akwisa gunanaid. Bab-Dummad, an bese-gochagusad be ebinsae, adi, melle we-dulemar be sabsur-odurdakegar.
Agala, e-mimmigan, ukudba be oburgwesunna, e-isdarmaladse es-suidgi-burgwega be imaksunna. E-omegan-ibe, e-suimar-oburgwega be imake, e-omegan, e-mimmigansuli be imake. E-suimar, gindaklegar be oburgwe. E-masmala, bilagi es-suidgi-burgwega be imake.
Egi, ukiagwale dulemar-ibmar-atursamalad be barmidage, adi, gwakidedba binnasuli oimakde gumalagar. An-gamalaga an-idu yaa-dummad akwismalad, an-nag-gaega an-idu dubmar nasiksamalad.
Bab-Jehová, bedi we-dulemar-an-oburgwedgi-binsananaidi be wisid. Melle e-ibmar-isgana-imaksamalad be baisur-dako, melle be e-isgusmalad iego. Bab-Jehová, be-asabin galakumalaga be imako. Sae-itogedgi be sabsur-odurdako.”
Bab-Jehová weyob anga sogsad: “Napsagi-ibmar-sobed-dulese be nae, ese be napsa-buglu bako. Geb a-sorbali, be-bardaknamalaga neggwebur-girmar-dummaganse abala be golo, degi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-idumaladse abala be gorbalo.
”Geb agine, Hinom-nebase be namalo. A-neba napsa-sobmalad-e-yawagak-asabin naid. Agine, an bega-ibmar-sogoedi be sogoed.
Weyob be sogo: ‘Judá-e-reymar, degi, Jerusalén-dorgan, Bab-Jehová-ibmar-soged be itomar. Weyob Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad soged: We-nebagi boni-dummad an barmidagoed, dulemar we-ibmar-itomaloedi geger itomaloed.
” ’Ar Israel-dulemar an-obachamalad. We-neba oichosmalad, egi ina-wawadikid bab-dummagan-baiganga ogumakar uksamalad. Ar Israel-dulemar we-bab-dummagan-akudakmaladga, e-dadgan we-bab-dummagan-akudaksamarmogadga, degine, Judá-e-reymar we-bab-dummagan-akudaksamarmogadga ina-wawadikid uksamalad. Emide, we-nebagi dule-neg-oakalossurmalad-e-ablis-bukidar eosmalad.
” ’Bemar Baalʼga ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila be sobsamalad. Agi be-mimmigan ega be ogumakar uksamalad. Ar gwen an bemarga we-igar uksasulid, we-ibmar-imakmaloye an bemarga sogsasulid, bipisaale gwen an-binsaedgi danisulid.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ibagan nonikoed, Tofet-aila bar Tofet-ailaye bilegosulid, degi, Ben-Hinom-neba bar Ben-Hinom-nebaye bilegosurbalid. Gindakmalad-nebaye bilenonikoed.
We-nebagine, Judá-dulemar-e-igar-mesismalad an obelogoed, degi, Jerusalén-dorgan-e-igar-mesismalad an obelobaloed. E-isdarmalad-e-oburgwebigudimaladse es-suidgi-oburgwilegega an imakoed. E-muimar, ibmar-durgan-gukumaladse-gullegega an imakoed, degi, achu-sapurmarse-gullegega an imakbaloed.
”We-neggwebur dule-bar-bukwasuli an imakoed, egi-dodolegega an imakoed. Dulemar we-neggweburgi-nadapile, geger dakdemaloed, e-dule-bergusadgi dododmaloed.
Be-isdarmalad bela bemar-ebilis-ambikunonikidbali, be suli-suli itodmaloed. Na be dukin be-mimmigan be gutemaloed, degi, be-aimar be-gutemarmogoed.
”Bela be we-ibmarmar-sogsale, dulemar-beba-gudimalad-wagab napsa-buglu be mamaroed.
Geb amarga be sogoed, weyob Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad sogye: ‘We-yala-naidi, degi, we-neggwebur-siidi, bela an obelogoye. Igi napsa-buglu-mamarisale, gege bar gannarse-nugue, deyobi, an we-yala imakoye. Dulemar, e-muimar-digegala, napneg-satedbali, Tofetʼye-neg-nugadgi digdemarsunnoye.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “An bega ibmar-sognaidi, deyobi, an we-nebagi, degi, e-dulemargi imakoed. We-neggwebur Tofet-aila-sigoedyobi an imakoed.
”Bela Jerusalén-neggweburgi negmar-bukwadi, degine, Judá-dulemar-e-reymar-negmar-bukwadi, Tofet-ailayob guoed. Bela we-negmar-e-ailamar-birgi ina-wawadikmalad niisgwamarga uklesad. Degine, a-ailamar-birgi bab-dummad-baiganga gobed-eosgusmarbalid. A-negmala, Tofet-ailayob isgus bukuoed.”
Jeremías, Bab-Jehová-ega-ibmar-sogsad Tofet-ailase-sogdii nonigua, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-imbagi gwisgunonikid. Geb bela dulemarga weyob sogded:
“Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob soged: ‘Ar we-neggwebur, degi, bela e-neggwebur-burwigan-dikarba-bukwamaladi, an-ibmar-sogedba imaksasurmarsoggu, bela boni-dummagan-barmidagoye-an-sogsadi, an bemargi barmidasunnoye.’ ”
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Pasur Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neggi dummadga-gudiid. Pasurʼde Imer-machid. Pasur, Jeremías Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoggwichi-itosgua,
Jeremías-sarsomalaga dulemar-barmisad. Geb Benjamín-neggwebur-yawagak-biribalid-nagaba, Bab-Dummadse-goled-negmobin sepo-maidgi Jeremías-odosad.
A-bangine, Pasur, Jeremías-sepogi-galessiidgi-onosgua, Jeremías ega sogded: “Bab-Jehová bar Pasurʼye be-biosulid, emisgi Magor-Misabibʼye be-bioed. A-sogleged: ‘Gwayed-dummad-neg-naidye.’
”Ar Bab-Jehová weyob soged: ‘Na be dukin gwayed-dummadga guoed, degi, be-aimar-ogwayedga be gubaloed. Be-aimar e-isdarmaladse es-suidgi oburgwilegoed, be-sunnagwad be dakoed. Bela Judá-dulemar, Babilonia-e-reyga an urmakoed, geb a-rey, Babilonia-yarse bemar-sedoed, sulile, es-suidgi be-oburgwemaloed.
” ’Deginbali, be-isdarmaladga an bemar-neggwebur-e-ibmar-nuegan ukoed. Bela be-ibmar-sanmakmaladi, be-ibmar-gargemaladi, degi, bela Judá-dulemar-e-reymar-ibmar-nuegana an ega urmakoed. Bela we-ibmala, atursamaloed, Babilonia-yalase bela sedmaloed.
Pasur, bedina, bela-be-negyaginmaladbo, Babilonia-yalase gales be ebipiledmaloed. A-yalagi be burgoed, agine be diglegoed. Be-aimarga be gakansaale ega sunmaksadi, deyob gumarmogoed.’ ”
Ani Jeremías Bab-Dummadga weyob sogded: “¡Bab-Jehová, be nue an-binsaed gasad! ¡Nue an bese binsaed galesad! Ar be anba bur dutusurgusoggu, be angi obichad. Bela-dulemar angi dodogedbimalad, anga alledibidamalad.
An sunmaked-ilibali, unnila an sogdedaed. ¡Belamarye! ¡Ibagan-bulegan daniye! Agala, be-gayaburba mesagwar-guega an-imaked, degi, angi-dodolegega an-imaked.
An sogdibe: ‘Bar an begi binsaosurye, bar be-nuggi an sunmakosurye, aka bur bule be-gayaburba an-ulubgi soo-duurmaksiiyobi naddaed, an-galamarse-bakale, ebuged. Aisaar an-sunmaked na bargaye sogdaenad, degi-inigwele, gege an na bargaed.
Dule-bukidar sabsur-uasogagwar-sunmake an itoged.’ Weyob sogmalad: ‘¡Bela gwayed-dummad neg-naiye!’ Weyob sogmarbalid: ‘¡We-dulegi anmar gwisgunamala! ¡Anmar dummaganga barsognamala!’ An-aimar-nueganbela begi-isguega an-imakbimalad, amarbela weyob sogmalad: ‘Sunna Jeremías anmarse binsaed galeged. Deyobile, anmar egi obinoed, anmar buged-mai imakoed.’
”Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová, bee be anba gudiid, bila-onoged-gandikidyob be anba garmakdiid. Degisoggu, dulemar an-balegindimaladi, angi obinosulid, anse galakumaloed, igarga guosurmalad, bingedar itomaloed. Degisadegu, suli-suli-itodii gumaloed, bipisaale dulemar we-ibmar iegosurmalad.
”Be, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadid. Bedi dule-innikigwad-e-daed balamied. E-gwage-ulubgi-ibmar-itoged be wisid, degi, e-binsaed magar be daked. Degisoggu, be we-dulemar-buged-mai-imakoed-dakega be an-imake. Ar an-bonigan an bega uksad, emidi, begi siid.
”¡Bab-Jehová-nuggi be namakmala! ¡E-nug be odummomala! Ar Bab-Dummad dule-wilemalad abonoged, dule-isganamar-e-ganguedgi ollorsaed.
”¡Ibiga an we-ibagi gwalulesdibe! ¡Iba-isganaga gusun! ¡Ibiga we-ibagi an-nan an-odesdibe! ¡Iba-isganaga gusun!
Dule an-bab-weligwar-imaksadi, deun ega weyob sogsagusgu, susugwa bega uklesye. ¡We-dule iwigusun!
We-dule, Bab-Jehová-neggweburmar-sabsur-obelosgusadyob gumosun. Degi, we-dule, wakdaradbali, neg-oimake itosun, yorukudbali, dule-bila-onomalad-oimake itosun.
¿Ibiga Bab-Dummad, an sapidukugi-maidgi burgwega an-imaksasuli? Adi, an burgwar aidesanad. An-nan anga neg-uanga gusanad.
¡Ibiga an sapibeneggi-maid aidesdibe! ¿Unnila an boniganba-galitogega nonide? ¿Unnila bukib-binsaega an nonide? ¿Unnila emarse bingegudiguega an nonide?”
Bab-Jehová Jeremíasʼga ibmar sognonigusad. Deunni, Rey-Sedequías, Malquías-machi-Pasur, degi, Maasías-machi-dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Sofoníasʼbo Jeremíasʼse barmiargusad, adi, ega weyob sogmalaga:
“Jeremías, be anmar-ular Bab-Jehováʼse idake, ega be soge, ibiga Babilonia-Rey-Nabucodonosor anmargi bila-ononaiye. Abakale, Bab-Jehová, anmarga ibmar-dakledisulid imakalile, anmargi we-dulemar-banguega nabir imakalile.”
Jeremías we-dulemar-abin sogded: “Be Rey-Sedequíasʼga sogmalo,
Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová weyob sogye: ‘Ani an, be-sordamar-bila-onomalad Babilonia-e-rey-sordamarbo bila-ononaid-abin sikirmakega an imakoed. Bela Caldea-sordamar neggwebur-ebilis-ambikuega an imakoed. Be-sordamar neggwebur-yaba gwayis-bukuega an imakoed.
An-sunnagwad an bemargi gwichiguoed. An-gangued an bemarse oyogoed, an ise-urwedgi, an sae-itogedgi an bemargi gwichiguoed.
” ’An dulemar onaibisaoed. Boni-dummad an barmidoed. A-bonigi bela ibmar-durganse-bakale, degi, dulemar we-neggweburginmaladse-bakale, burgwemaloed.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Deyob-gusad-sorbali, geb an Babilonia-e-reyga Judá-e-rey-Sedequías an ukoed, e-dummagan an ukbaloed, degine, dulemar bonigi-burgosurmaladi, bilagi-burgosurmaladi, degi, ukudba-burgosurmaladi, Babilonia-Rey-Nabucodonosorʼga an ukoed. E-isdarmalad-oburgwebigudimaladga amar an urmakbaloed. Geb Nabucodonosor es-suidgi amar-oburgoed, igi-barsaye ega gwen-sogosulid, wile gwen-dakosulid.”
Bab-Dummad Jeremíasʼga weyob sogsad: “We-neggweburga be sogo, weyob Bab-Jehová sogye: ‘An bemarga igar sogbo uked, igid-igar be sumalodibe, dula-gued-igardibe, burgwed-igardibe.
Dule we-neggweburgi beoedi, es-suidgi-burgoed, degi, boni-dummadgi burgoed, igi ukudba burgodibe. Ar dule we-neggweburgi-nooeddi, bela-Caldea-sordamar-ebilis-bukwadse-naoeddi, burgosulid, nabir san-onogoed.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar an we-neggwebur sabsur-imakoye sogsad, wile an dakosulid. Degisoggu, Babilonia-e-reyga urmaklegoed, a-rey we-neggwebur-ogumakoed.
”Judá-e-reyneg-yaginmaladga be sogmogo, ‘Bab-Jehová-gayaburba be nue itomarye.’
Rey-David-e-waganga weyob-Bab-Jehová-sogye be sogo: ‘Bane-bane wakudaradba igar-innikigwad imakmalo. Dule-mesagwar-gudiid, mesagwar-imaked-dulegi be ollor-imakmalo. Adi, melle bemar-ibmar-isgana-imaked-ulale, an-urwedi bemargi sooyobi gwichiguegar. Ar an-urwed, geg dule gwen bargassuliled.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Jerusalén-dulemar, an bemargi gwichid, neba-e-nanaga be siid, yalaganba-neba-nanaid-e-akwa-dummadga be gusiid. Emide, be weyob sogmalad: ‘¿Doa anmar-oakalononikosunna? Dule akar anmar-imakosulid. ¿Doa anmar-neggweburgi dogosunna? Dule anmargi dogosuli.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Bemar-ibmar-isgana-imaksadba an sabsur-bemar-odurdakoed. Be-sapurgi an soo odegoed. We-soo bela sapur-dikarba-ibmar-nanaid obelogoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob anga sogsad: “Jeremías, reynegse be nae, agi Judá-dulemar-e-rey dad-David-ologanagi-siid-asabin be we-gayaburba sogo.
Deginbali, Rey-e-dummaganga-arbamaladga, degi, e-dulamar-we-yawagakba-ubomaladga be sogmogo: ‘Bab-Jehová-gayaburba be nue itomarye.’
”Weyob Bab-Jehová soged: ‘Igar-innikigwad be imakmarye, igar-napiragwadba be nanamarye. Dule-mesagwar-gudiid, mesagwar-imaked-dulegi be ollor-imakmarye. Melle Judíoʼsurmalad be sabsur-imakmaloye, degi, melle be babgan-satemalad wiomaloye, degine, melle be siamar-e-sui-burgwismalad wiomarbaloye. Deginbali, melle wegine dulemar-ibmar-oakalossulid-ablis eomarbaloye.
” ’Ar bemar we-ibmar-sogedba-damalale, we-reyneg-yawagakbali reymar-ubomai, Rey-David-e-ologanagi sigmai gumaloed. Reymar, e-dummagan-abargi, degi, e-dulamar-abargi moli-urgi-sii, degine, moli-birgi-sii ubomai gumaloed.
Ani an, Bab-Jehová-guedgi soged: Ar bemar we-gayaburba-bega-soged be itosurmalale, an-sunnagwad an bemarga innikigwadgi ibmar-sogdo, we-reynega bela akwamarbi-bukwa an imakoed.’ ”
Bab-Jehová, weyob Judá-e-reyneg-annik soged: “Be angala Galaad-yaryobi gued. Líbano-yala-biriyobi, be anga gued. Degi-inigwele, napira an bega soged, nega-dulesulidga an be-imakoed, neggweburmar-dulesulidga an be-imakoed.
Dulemar-be-obeloged an begi barmidoed, e-gingimar-nika-nika begi namaloed. Be-urwar-buarmar-bur-yeerdaklemalad bei omukumaloed, geb bela soogi bei ogumakmaloed.
”Dule-bukidar we-neggweburgi nasmalogua, e-sordaganga sogdamaloed: ‘¿Ibiga Bab-Jehová weyob we-neggwebur-dummad imaksa?’
Geb na e-sordagan sogdamaloed: ‘Ar we-dulemala, e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-ebo-igar-mesisadi obachamaladdeeye, bab-dummagan-baiganba ibsasmaladdeeye, a e-nug-odummodii gusmaladdeeye. A-ulale, weyob we-neggwebur gusye.’
Melle rey-burgwaledga be bomalo, melle a-ular be bukib binsamalo. Bur be rey-gales-selesadga be bomala, we-rey bar gannar wese-aibirosulidga bur be bomala, degi, e-gwalulesad-yar-bar-dakosulidga bur be bomala.”
Bab-Jehová weyob Josías-machi-Salum, e-bab-sorba-Judá-e-reyga-megisadga-annik soged: “Salum, bar wese gannar aibirosulid.
Bia gales-selesa, agine burgoed, we-yarse bar gannar nonikosulid.
Dule igar-maisulidba-e-neg-sobdiidi, degi, ibmar-isgana-imakedgi e-gabedneg-nibalid-sobdiidi, ¡we-dule, duledar-wiles! Dule, ega-binsa-dule-arbaega-imakdiidi, degi, ega-arbaed-bennukdisulidi, ¡we-dule, duledar-wiles-ini!
Dule na sogdiid: ‘An na neg-dummadi-soboye, neg-obunnomalad burwisuli aila-dummad-birgi imakoye.’ We-dule, e-neg yawagak-atakmalad-dummagan-nika imakele, deginbali, urwar-urgo ebirgi nasikele, geb e-maged-ginnidgi magbalile, ¡we-dule, duledar-wiles-ini!
”¿Ar be urwar-neggi-maidba, be reyga megode? Ar be-babdi amba iba-dummagan-onodigusan-inigwele, ar degite, amba igar-innikigwadba nanadii gusad, igar-nuegan-mamaidba nanadii gusad, igar-innikigwad-imakdii gusbalid. A-ulale, ega nueganbi ibmar gusad.
Deginbali, dule-wilemalad-bendakdii gusbalid, dule-ibmar-satemalad-wile-dakdii gusbalid. ¿Ar we-soglesursi, we-dule magar-an-daksaye? Ani Bab-Jehová soged: We sogleye, magar an-dakdii gusye.
”Unnila bedi maniginbi be binsadiid, mani-amiegala yogasaar be ibmar imakdiid. Ar bedi dulemar-gindakedginbi be binsaed, unnila mesagwar be emar-imakdiid, sabsur-emar-imaked be gudiid.”
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová Judá-e-rey-Josías-machi-Joacim-annik weyob soged: “Dule bipisaale Joacim-burgoedbina bukib-binsaosulid, ega weyob binnasuli boosurmalad: ‘¡Gwenadye! ¡Duledar-wilesmarye! ¡Bunaye! ¡Dule-wilesmarye!’ Degi, ega weyob binnasuli boosurmarbalid: ‘¡Dummadye! ¡Be bergudsunye! ¡Anmar-rey, be anmar-idu nadsunye!’
Moli-uayasuid-diglegeyobi diglegoed, illi-illir ebipimaloed. Jerusalén-neggwebur-magaba metemaloed.”
Bab-Jehová, Jerusalén-dulemarga weyob sogdemogad: “Líbano-yarse be naknamar, agi be binnasuli ogormaksii gumalo, Basán-yargine, be binnasuli bosii gumalo, Abarim-yarmar-akale, be bodii gumalo. Ar dulemar-be-bendakmalo-sogmaladi, bela ogilolesmalad.
Bemar nued-gudiunni, an bega sunmaksamalanad. Aka be sogdegusmalad: ‘Anmar be-itobisurye.’ Ar be dungudanikid-akale, deyob be damalad, gwen be an-itobisurgusmalad.
Be-sapin-dummagan-gudimaladi, burwa-dummadse ebipiledmaloed. Bebina-sogdimaladi, gales seledmarmogoed. Na be-isgued-ulale, bingedar be itodoed, mesagwar be imakledoed.
Emide be, Líbano-yargi be maid, urwargi be uu-sobsayobi be gued. Ar emisgindi, be dummad-naibid itosunnoed, igi ome-muu-neggi-nai, nunmaked-itonaidyobi, be nunmaked itonai guoed.”
Judá-Rey-Conías, Joacim-e-machid. Bab-Jehová, Coníasʼnik weyob soged: “An-dula-maidgi inniki an bega soged: Amba an bela-bela bebina-soged-inigwele, be wegi-gudiidgi amba an be-bar-metedsegad.
Be-oburgwebi-gudimaladga an be-urmakoed, be bela-bela-dule-dobgudimaladga an be-urmakoed. We-Babilonia-e-rey-Nabucodonosorʼga, degi, Caldea-dulemarga an be-ukmaloed.
Be, be-nanbogwa, yar-baid-gwen-be-dakdisulidse an be-barmetoed. Be gwalulessulid-yargi, be-nanbogwa an be-oburgwemaloed.
Gwen bipisaale be-yar-naidse be gannar aibirosulid.
”¿Ar we-Coníasʼde nog-maraled-gwen-bar-dule-abesulidyob gude? ¿Ar ibiga wede yar-baid-gwen-dakdisulidse, e-mimmiganmala barmelledsunna?
¡Israel-dulemar! Bab-Jehová-e-gayaburba be itomar.”
Weyob Bab-Jehová soged: “We-dule, dule-wargwenadye be gardagi narmakar meso, dule gwen igarga gudsulidye be gardagi sogo. Ar e-mimmigan-wargwensaale, Judá-yar-seegala David-e-ologangi sigosurguoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “¡Dummagan duledar-wilesmar! Dummagan an-neggwebur-dula-wiodimalad, bela-neggwebur-oaisakidimalad, ¡duledar-wilesmar!”
A-ulale, Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, weyob dummagan-e-dulamar-sedimaladga soged. “Ani an Bab-Jehová soged: Bemar an-dulamar-oaisakismalad, an-dulamar-ononnosmalad, gwen be bendaksasurmalad. Degisoggua, bemar ibmar-isgana-imakmaladba an sabsur-bemar-odurdakoed.
”An-dulamardi, an-sunnad gannar e-yargi-ononnolesgusadse-dagega an imakoed. Gannar e-nainumarse-dagega an imakoed. Agine na nasgumai gumaloed, dula-mergumai gumaloed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “An-dulamar-seegala, ani an ega e-idumalad ukoed. Degisoggu, an-dulamar bar dobee itogosulid, degi, bar gwayosurmalad. Bela bukwagumaloed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “An Rey-David-e-wagwa-gwensak-barmidaged-ibagan danikid. Igar-innikigwad-imaked an ogwisgunonikoed. A-dule, binsaed-nikaa negsemai guoed. Igar-innikigwadba, degi, igar-napiragwadba ibmar-imakdii guoed.
A-ibagangine, Judá-dulemar abonolegoed, Israel-dulemar dobsuli-bukwa guoed. ‘Bab-Jehová, anmar-abonogedye,’ ega nug nasikmaloed.”
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Bar weyob-soglegosulid-ibagan daniye, Bab-Jehová Egipto-yalagi-Israel-dulemar-onosad-e-nug odummomarye.
Bur sogdemaloed: Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummomarye, ar a Israel-dulemar-Babilonia-yargi-bukwa onosaddeeye. Ar Bab-Jehová, bela Israel-dulemar-yar-bamaladgi-oaisakisadi, agi bukwa onosaddeeye sogdemaloed. Degisoggu, Israel-dulemar na e-yalagi bukwagumaloed.”
Ani, Jeremías, an Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmaladga an ibmar soged: “Bab-Jehová-nuggine, degi, e-gayaburba-islidikid-anga-uksadbali, an bela-belagwad an-ulubgi an naibid-dummad itoged. Bela an-abaganmar wawanmaked, ber dule-mummudyob an dakleged, dule-inna-gagbidba-aibandiiyob an dakleged.
We-yala ukabsales-naid-ulale, galagwensuli-negsichigi-yoledimalad doggusad. We-yala nue wiles-itonaid, nega-dulesulidganba gagan-nanaid bela dinguded. Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad, igar-isganaba nanadmalad, e-garganguedi, igar-innikigwadga ebusurmalad.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmaladi, dule-isganamalad. Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladi, dule-isganamarmogad.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “A-ulale, e-igarmar ega masimakmaiyob guoed. Negasichidba balimelledoed, agi mellemai gumaloed. E-sabsur-odurdakleged-birgagi an egi boni-dummad barmidagoed.
”Bab-gayaburba-barsogmalad-Samariaʼginmaladi, e-ibmar-isgana-imakmalad an daksad. We-dulemala, Baal-nuggi gayaburba barsogsamalad, degi, yogasaar igar-isganabali an-dulamar-naega imaksamalad.
Bab-gayaburba-barsogmalad-Jerusalénʼginmalad, we-ibmar-isgana-gegerdaklemalad-imaksad an daksad: Galagwensuli negsichigi-nanamalad, gakansaagwar nanadimalad, dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmalad ogannomalad, adi, melle dule-wargwensaale na e-daed ogwaegar. Bela we-dulemar anga, Sodoma-dulemaryob gued, bela Jerusalén-dulemar anga, Gomorra-dulemaryob gued.”
Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob gayaburba-barsogmaladnik soged: “Mas-solemalad-gunnega an imakoed, dii-isgana-gobega an imakoed. Ar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad-Jerusalénʼginmalad, bela yala-oichosmalad.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob soged: “Melle be an-gayaburba-barsogmalad-e-sunmaked be itomar. Ar binsa gakansaar bega igar-nueganbi sunmakmalad, na emar wargwengi gaya-onoardamalad, gwen an ega ibmar-sogdasulid sokardamalad.
Dule-isdar-an-dakmaladga sokardamalad: ‘Bab-Jehová sogye, bemarga igar-nueganbi namaloye.’ Dule-e-binsaedba-ibmar-imakmaladga sokardamalad: ‘Bemargi bonigan danikosurye.’
”Wede, ¿doa an-asabinni binsaed-amisii gusa? ¿Doa an-sunmaked-itosii gusa? ¿Doa an-ibmar-sogsadba ibmar-imaksa? Wemar wargwensaale gwen deyob gussulid.
An-urwedi burwa-dummadyob urwedigi nodagoed, burwa-bipirmakaledyobi gwichigudagoed. Dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmaladgi, gwichigunonikoed.
An-urwedi gwen-bogguosulid. Bela an-ibmar-abemaid-imakedse geb an-urwed bogguoed. Bela we-ibmarmar-gusadgi magar-itononimaloed.
”We-dule-gayaburba-barsogmalad an barmissulid, degi-inigwele, an-gayaburba-barsogegala, sulibinsa abarmakdemalad. Gwen an ega ibmar-sogsasulid, degi-inigwele, yogasaar gayaburba sogsamalad.
Ar we-dulemar angi binsaed-amisana, an-dulamarga an-gayaburba sogsamalanad, ibmar-isgana-imakmaladgi an-dulamar-obangusanad.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “¿Ar an weginbi gudidasi? ¿Ar an dikasuli gudidasurbarsi?”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar mer e-dakega, ¿sunna dule an-idu dukusi? Suli, gege an-idu dukued.” Bab-Jehová soged: “¿Ar an bela napneggi gudisursi? ¿Ar an bela nibneggi gudisursi? Ar an bela neg-gani maid.
”Gayaburba-barsogmalad, gakansaar weyob an-nuggi-sunmake an itosad: ‘¡An negburgan daksaye, an negburgan daksaye!’
¿Sanagwadse gayaburba-barsogmalad gakansaar sunmakdii gumaloe? ¿Ibmar-daksasulid-wargwengi-obinyedimalad sanagwadse bar sogosurmala?
Na muchub-muchub negburgan-dakedgi-sunmakmaladba, an-dulamar angi-banguega imakbimalad, igi e-dadgan bab-dummad-Baal-ular an-ied-gusmaladyob imakdimalad.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Gayaburba-barsoged negburgan-daksale, ar e-negburgan-daksad sogodo. Ar dule an-gayaburba-itosale, napiragwadba an-gayaburbagi sunmakodo. ¿Ar gagan-dinnagwadi, ibmar-gwagbogwa emarsi? Suli, geg emar gued.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “¿Ar an-gayaburbade sooyobi gangusursi? ¿An-gayaburbade, mardo-akwa-mamardaeyob gusursi? Eye, deyob gue.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “A-ulale, gayaburba-barsogmaladgi an gwichid. Ar ade, na muchub-muchub yogasaar sogdamalad, ‘Bab-Dummad anga sunmaksaye.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Gayaburba-barsogmaladi, an ega sunmaksayobi na yogasaar-e-itolegedba-sunmakdimaladgi an gwichid.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Gayaburba-barsogmaladgi an gwichid. Negburgan-daksasulidgi gakansaale sunmakdimalad. An-dulamarga deyob gakansaale sunmakedba, igar-noaledba an-dulamar-seddamalad, yamo-binsaed-gaale, ega sunmakmaladba an-dulamar-binsaed gadamalad.” Bab-Jehová soged: “Ani an, gwen we-dulemar barmissulid, gwen an ega igar uksasurbalid. We-dulemar, an-dulamarga igar-nued gwen senonisulid.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Israel-dulemar bese egichiardibe, gayaburba-barsogmaladdibe, dule-irwa-anse-gormaladdibe, ‘Bab-Jehová igi-sogye.’ Ega weyob be sogo, ‘Bab-Jehová sogye, an bemargi banguoye.’
Ar gayaburba-barsoged-gwensak-sokardibe, dule-irwa-anse-gormaladdibe, Israel-dule-gwensakdibe, weyob sokalile, ‘¡We, Bab-Jehová-gayaburbaye!’ Deyob dule sogsale, we-dule anse sabsur-odurdaklegoed, bela e-neg-yaginmaladse-bakar anse odurdaklegoed.
”Ar dule-gwensak e-gwenadganse, degi, e-aimarse bur weyob egisewilubbid: ‘¿Igi Bab-Jehová sogsa?’ Weyob egisodibe, ‘¿igi Bab-Jehová soge?’
Degi-inigwele, melle bar weyob sogmalo: ‘Weyob Bab-Jehová sogye.’ Ar dule deyob sogele, na dukin e-ibmar-sogedba sabsur-odurdaklegoed. Ar ade, bemar Bab-Dummad-Dula-Maid-gayaburba oakalodmalad, ar bemar Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-gayaburba oichodmalad.
”Jeremías, weyob be gayaburba-barsogmaladse be egiso: ‘¿Bab-Jehová igi-bega sogsa? ¿Bab-Jehová igi-bega soge?’
”Ar sogdemalale, ‘Bab-Jehová weyob sogye.’ ”Jeremías, ega be weyob sogo: ‘Bab-Jehová weyob sogye: An bemarga sogsad, melle be Bab-Jehová-weyob-sogye be sogmaloye.’
”Bemar deyob sogsasoggu, bar an bemargi binsaosulid, an-asabin an be-balimetemaloed. An bemarga, degi, be-dadgangala-yala-uksadi, an obelogoed.
Degisadegu, bingedargudii an bemar-imakoed, nug-gannarbaa bar be guosulid, dulemar gwen we-ibmar iegosurmalad.”
Babilonia-Rey-Nabucodonosor, e-yarse Judá-dulemar-gasa sear gusad. Wemar selealid: Judá-e-rey-Jeconías. Jeconíasʼde Joacim-e-machid. Judá-e-dummagan, dule-ibmar-sobedgi-arbamalad, dule-esgoro-sobedgi-arbamalad, selearmalad. Wemar-selesad-sorbali, Bab-Jehová, ese-goled-neg-asabin, anga higo-san garba-gwabo oyosad.
Garba-gwagwengine, higo-san-nuegan bukwad, gebe-goresmaladyob daklebukwad. Garba-baidgindina, higo-san-isgana bukwad. Ar nue-isganabisoggu, geg-gulleged.
Degidgine, Bab-Jehová anga sokalid: “Jeremías, ¿we ibu be dake?” Geb an e-abin sogded: “Higo-sanmar an dakdo. Gwensak, nueganad. Baigandi, isgana-nanaed, geg-gulle an daked.”
Geb agine, anse Bab-Jehová-gayaburba nonikid. Weyob anga sognonikid:
“Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová weyob soged: ‘Judá-dulemar Babiloniaʼse-gales-selesmaladi, an we-higo-nueganyob dakoed.
We-dulemala an nue-akwedii guoed, gannar we-yarse-dagmalaga an imakoed. Emisgindi, we-yalagine nasgumaiguega an imakoed, an obelogosulid. We-yalagi an urboed, an ononnogosulid.
Magar-itomalaga an imakoed, adi, wisgumalagar ani an Bab-Jehová gued. Emala anga an-dulamarga guoed, ani an e-Bab-Dummadga gumogoed. Ar bela-belad e-gwagegi-itogedba, anse gannar nonimaloed.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Judá-e-rey-Sedequíasʼdi, degi, e-dummagana, degine, Jerusalénʼgi-gudimaladi, Egipto-yarse-abar-wakitemaladi, higo-san-isganayob an dakoed, higo-san-geg-gullemaladyob an dakoed.
Bela yalamar-nanaidga we-dulemar boni-dummaganyob an imakoed, adi, an bia-oduurmakoe, agi isdar-dakmalaga an imakoed. Amar-sae-dakmalaga, mesagwar-dakmalaga, degine, ukabsamalaga an imakoed.
We-dulemargine, bila-onoleged an barmidoed, ukud-dummad an egi barmidoed, degine, boni-dummagan an egi barmidbaloed. Bela an e-dadganga, degi, an ega-yala-uksadgi obelogedse an imakoed.”
Jeremíasʼse Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-nonikidi, ega Judá-dulemargi sunmaknonikid. Deunni, Josías-machi-Judá-e-rey-Joacim birgabakegus reyga-maidgi, Bab-Dummad Jeremíasʼga sunmaknonikid. Deunni, Babilonia-Rey-Nabucodonosor birgagwengus negsemaid.
Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Jeremías, bela Judá-dulemarga, degine, Jerusalén-dulemarga weyob sogded:
“Amón-machi-Josías birgambe-gakapaagus (13) Judá-e-reyga-maid-akale, emi-ibase, birgadurgwen-gakapaagusad (23) Bab-Jehová anga sunmakdanikid. A-akale, an bemarga-sunmakdanikidi an boggudisulid. Degite an bemarga-ibmar-sogedba be gwen imakdisurmalad.
”De-ukinbali, Bab-Jehová bemarga ega-gayaburba-barsogmalad barmimaiguanad, degi-inigwele, bemar gwen itossurmalad, gwen eba be ibmar imaksasurmalad.
We-dulemar bega sogsamalanad: ‘Igar-isganagi be bangumala, melle be igar-isgana imakmala. Adi, nabir bemar, degibi, degisadegu, Bab-Jehová-bemarga-yar-uksadgi, be-dadganga-yala-uksadgi, be bukwa gumalagar.
Degi, melle bab-dummagan-baiganse be gormalo, melle be e-nug-odummomalo. Melle be ibmar-isgana-imakmaladba an-ourwemalo. Adi, an sabsur bemar-imakosulid.’ ”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Emide, bemar an-sogedba ibsassurmalad, aka be be-ibmar-isgana-imakedba be an-oulusmalad. Na be dukin sabsur-wilemalaga na be imaksamalad.”
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob soged: “Bemar an-sogedba be ibmar-imaksasurmarsoggu,
dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik-dulemar-bukwadi an bemargi barmidagoed. Degine, anga-arbaed Babilonia-Rey-Nabucodonosor an barmidabaloed. We-yalagi-gwichiguega an barmidagoed, degi, bemargi-gwichiguega, be-neggweburmar-nagaba-neggweburmar-bubukwadgi-gwichiguega an barmidagoed. Bela naitinagase an obelogoed. Bemargi dodolegega an imakoed, isdar-daklemalaga an bemar-imakoed. Bela yala olloo naguoed.
”Weligwaledba-binnasuli-neg-oimakleged an obelogoed, yeer-itolegedba-binnasuli-gorleged an obelogoed. Ome-nikuedgi-namaklegedi bar namaklegosulid, degi, ibmar-naged-akwa-goledi bar golosulid, degine, mutikidba bar gwallu gaosulid.
Bela we-yala akwamarbi-bukwa an imakoed, gwayed-negga binyenonikoed. We-dulemala birga-dulapaa-gakambe (70) Babilonia-e-reyga mailemaloed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Birga-dulapaa-gakambe-gunonikile (70), Babilonia-e-rey-na-isgued-ular, an sabsur-odurdaknonikoed, degi, Caldea-dulemar-bukwad-yala, bela ilagwen-obelogar an imakoed.
Bela an ibmar-sogsadi, we-dulemargi-guega an imakoed, degi, bela we-gardagi narmaklegar-maidi, degi, Jeremías dulemargi-sunmaksadi bela guega an imakoed.
Caldea-dulemar dulemar-baiganse mailemarmogoed, rey-gandikmaladga ibmar-imakdii gumarmogoed. Degidbali, na e-damalad-ular, degi, e-ibmar-imakmalad-ular, sabsur-odurdaklemaloed.”
Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad anga sogsad: “Be we-vino-nog-an-ganikid be sue, an-urwed-nogad. Bela yarmarse an be-barminaidgi dulemar-gobega be imako.
We-dulemar gobsamalale, banamakdemaloed. We-dulemar, bila-onoged-an-barmidagoedgi suli-suli itodmaloed.”
Geb an Bab-Jehová-annik nog susad. Geb bia Bab-Dummad dulemarse-an-barmisa, a-dulemar an bela ogobsad.
We-dulemar an ogobsad: Jerusalén-dulemar, Judá-dulemar, Judá-e-reymar, bela e-dummagan an ogobsad, adi, obelogegar. E-neggweburmala, akwabi ambikusmalad, egi-dodolegedga gusmalad, degi, ukabsalegega an imaksad, igi emi-ibagi amba deyob daklege.
Egipto-e-rey-Faraón we-noga-gobega an imaksabalid, degi, bela ega-arbamalad, e-dummagan, degine, bela e-dulamar, we-nog-gobega an imaksad.
Degi, bela Egipto-yalagi dule-baigan-mamaidi, bela Uz-yala-e-reymala, we-nog-gobega an imaksad. Deginbali, bela Filistea-yala-e-reymar we-nog-gobega an imaksad. We-reymar gobsamalad: Ascalón-neggwebur-e-rey, Gaza-neggwebur-e-rey, Ecrón-neggwebur-e-rey, degine, Asdod-dulemar. Wemar bela we-nog-gobega an imaksad.
Deginbali, Edom-dulemar, Moab-dulemar, degine, Amón-wagan, we-nog-gobega an imaksad.
Deginbali, bela Tiro-neggwebur-e-reymar, Sidón-neggwebur-e-reymar, we-nog-gobega an imaksad. Degi, Mediterráneo-demar-naidsik gakaba-neggwebur-bukmalad-e-reymar, we-nog-gobmalaga an imaksad.
Deginbali, Dedán-neggwebur-e-rey, Tema-neggwebur-e-rey, degine, Buz-neggwebur-e-rey, degi, bela nono-swiri-imakmalad, we-nog-gobega an imaksad.
Degine, bela Arabia-e-reymar, bela nega-dulesulidba dulemar-akar-akar-bukwad-e-reymar, we-nog-gobega an imaksad.
Deginbali, bela Zimri-neggwebur-e-reymar, Elam-neggwebur-e-reymar, degine, bela Media-yala-e-reymar, we-nog-gobega an imaksabalid.
Bela dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik-reymar-mamaidi, degi, wegi-itaka-mamaidi, dikasur-mamaidi, degi, bela napaneg-naid-ugakaase-mamaidi, we-nog-gobega an imaksad. Geb bela wemar-gobsad-sorbali, Babilonia-e-rey we-nog gobmogoed.
Geb Bab-Dummad anga weyob sogsabalid: “We-dulemarga weyob be sogo, Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob sogye: ‘Be we-nog gobmar, be mumgumar, be sakar-sakar agmar, degidba bar be gwisguosurmalad. Ar an bemargi bila-onoleged barmidoedgi be girgumaloed.’
”Ar yapa be-abin we-nog-sumalale, yapa gobmalale, ega be sogo, weyob Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad sogye: ‘Bemar we-nog gobergebye.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Neggwebur-angadga-gusadga bato an boni-dummagan barmidasokalid. ¿Sabsur-bemar-imakosurye be binsamala? Mer degi-binsamalo, ar bemar anse dummad-odurdaklegoed. Ar dulemar-bukwadbina an es-suid onosbinned.
”Emi, Jeremías, we-dulemarga bela we-ibmar an bega-soged be soge: ‘Bab-Jehová, nibneggi binnasuli urwemaid, e-neg-islidikid-akale, malayob e-sunmakedi goled. E-dulabina nue-itos maid. Igi-dulemar uvaʼgi-annanair binnasuli-gornanaidae, deyobi, Bab-Jehová, bela dulemar-napneggi-bukwadgi binnasuli goled.
E-gollomakedi, bela yalamar-ugakaase gollomaked, ar Bab-Jehová dulemar-akar-akar-bukwadgi urwemaid. Ar Bab-Dummad bela dulemarga igar-itogedid, dulemar-ibmar-isgana-imakmaladi ese oburgwilegoed.’ Deyobi, Bab-Jehová sogsad.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, weyob soged: “Yalamar-nanaid-iliba, boni-dummagana nomai guoed. Burwa-dummadi bemargi gwichigualid, bela yalamar-ebilis begi danikid.”
A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová, a-dulemar-ogilogoed, bela napaneg-ugakaase napagi-omilede guoed. Dulemar ega boosulid, dulemar gwen e-muimar-digega weosurbalid, ibmar-isganayobi napagi-omilede gumaloed.
Dummagan-negsedimalad, be akiginmar, binnasuli be gormar. Dulemar-idudimalad, napagi be bindumakmar, ar girgued-ibagan bemarse owarmaksad. Bela be yogasaar aisakidmaloed, degi, moli-bebe-nikad-sapingana-wardadaganayobi be oburgwilemaloed.
Dummagan-negsedimaladi, Bab-Jehová-idu dukuosurmalad. Dulemar-idudimaladi, gwen wakinnosurmalad.
Dummagan-negsedimalad-binnasuli-goled be itomar, dulemar-idudimalad-akiginned be itomar, ar Bab-Jehová bela e-nainumar obelonaid.
Bab-Jehová bela-bela-e-urwedba, gagan-nebagi-yeerdakle-nanaid bela obelosad,
Igi achumigur-nono-wawaadi, e-galugi-noardaeyobi, Bab-Jehová e-dulamargi noalid, e-yala bela olloo nasiksad. Bela Bab-Jehová-e-urwedbali es-suidgi oburgwilesmalad.
Josías-machi-Judá-e-rey-Joacim, gebe reyga-megideunni, Bab-Jehová Jeremíasʼga sunmaknonikid, ega weyob sognonikid:
Bab-Jehová soged: “Jeremías, anse-goled-neg-imbagi be gwisguna. Bela an bega-ibmar-sogoedi, Judá-dulemar-anse-goled-negse an-nug-odummodanimaladga a-gayaburba be sogo. Melle be soggwenad odukuo.
Abakalegi be-itoarmalale, degi, e-isguedgi banguarmalale. E-isguedgi bangudmalale, adi, an e-isgumalad-ular bar sabsur-odurdakosulid. Gebe an binsasadyobi bar an imakosulid.
”Jeremías, ega be weyob sogoed, Bab-Jehová weyob sogye: ‘Ar bemar an-itosurmalale, an bemarga-igar-uksadba be dasurmalale,
degine, an-gayaburba-barsogmalad bega-ibmar-soged be itosurmalale, an sabsur-bemar-odurdakoed. Ar an-gayaburba-barsogmalad an bemarga barmimaiguad, degi-inigwele, eba be ibsadisurmalad.
Degisoggu, igi an Silo-neggweburgi anse-goled-neg an imaksa, deyobi, an wegi anse-goled-neg an imakbaloed. We-neggwebur, bela dulemar-baiganga ukabsaleged-neggweburga an imakoed.’ ”
Bela dulemar, Jeremías Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-ibmar-sogsadi itosmalad, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, degi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmaladi, bela itosmalad.
Jeremías bela Bab-Jehová ega-igar-uksad dulemarga sogsagu, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmaladi, degi, bela dulemar, Jeremías-gasmalad. Geb weyob ega sogsamalad: “¡Be anmarse oburgwileged-nika!
”¿Ibiga Bab-Jehová-nuggi be weyob sunmake? Emide be soged: We-itoged-nega Silo-neggweburgi-gusadyob gumogoye, degi, we-neggwebur bela olloo-naguoye, dulemar sateguoye be soged. Weyob be sunmakedsulid.” Bela dulemar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-bukmaladi Jeremíasʼgi gwichigudmalad.
Judá-dulemar-e-dummagan deyob neg-gunaiye itoarmargu, reyneggi-bukwa, Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse nadmalad. Geb yawagak-binid-nagaba ambikudapmalad.
Agine dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladi, degi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmaladi, dummaganga, degi, bela dulemargala sogdemalad: “We-dule oburgwilegergebed, ar we-neggweburnik sabsur-sunmaksad, ar bemar-sunnagwad itosmalad.”
Degi-inigwele, Jeremías, bela dummaganga, degi, bela dulemarga sogded: “Ar bemar, bela be we-ibmar-itosmaladi, ar Bab-Jehová we-neggweburnik-sunmakega, degi, we-itoged-neggi-sunmakega an-barmialid.
Degisoggu, be-damalad be ogwamar, be-ibmar-imaked be ogwamar, Bab-Dummad-Jehová-sogedba be damar. Adi, Bab-Jehová sabsur-bemar-odurdakoye-sogsad bar imakosulid.
Ar andina, bemargi siid, igi-be an-imakbimala. Be-itolemalad, be-dakedba be an-imakmalo.
Degi-inigwele, be ebinsamalo, be an-oburgwemalale, na be dukin bemargi, degi, bela we-neggwebur-dulamargi be dule-neg-oakalossulid-ablis eonaido. Ar nue-napira an bemarga soged, Bab-Jehová we-ibmar-sogega an-barmialid.”
Geb dummagana, degi, bela dulemala, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladga, degi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmaladga weyob sogsamalad: “We-dule oburgwilegewilubsulid, ar anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-nuggi anmarga sunmaksad.”
Geb degine, gwenna-gwenna girmar-dummagan dulemar-danar-igar-itobukwadga weyob sogdemalad:
“Epenne, Ezequías reyga-maiunni, Moreset-neggweburgined-Miqueas bela Judá-dulemarga weyob sogsa gusad: ‘Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob sogye: Sión-neggwebur nainu-imulegeyob guoye, Jerusalén-neggwebur bela bibisgoye, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-siid-yala, bela sapurbi-nai guoye.’
”¿Ar Judá-e-rey-Ezequíasʼde, degi, bela Judá-dulemarde Miqueas-oburgwissi? Suli, oburgwissuli. ¿Ar Ezequíasʼde bur Bab-Jehová dobgussursi? Eye. Ar Bab-Jehováʼse bendakleged-egichisad. Ar Bab-Dummadi, Judá-dulemar-sabsur-odurdakoye-sogsadi bar imaksasulid. Degi-inigwele, anmardi na dukin boni-amisokalid.”
Deginbali, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-baid gudii gusbalid. A-dule, Semaías-machi-Urías, Quiriat-Jearimʼginedid, Bab-Jehová-nuggi gayaburba-barsogdii gusmogad. A-dule, Jeremíasʼyobi Jerusalén-neggweburnik, degi, we-yalanik yolegar sunmaksamogad.
Rey-Joacim deyob itoargua, degi, ega-arbamalad, degine, dule-dummagan, deyob, Urías-soge-itoarmargua, Rey-Joacim, Urías-oburgwebigualinad. Degi-inigwele, Urías e-oburgwebimarye-wisguargua, dobgud gusad. Degidbali, Egipto-yarse wakite gusad.
Geb Rey-Joacim, Egipto-yarse Acbor-machi-Elnatán barmisgusad, degi, dulemar-baigan eba barmisgusbalid.
Geb wemala, Egipto-yargi Urías-gasa seargusmalad. Agi geb Rey-Joacimʼse ninonigusmalad. Geb degine, Rey-Joacim, es-suidgi Urías-oburgwega igar-uksa gusad. Degi, yogasaar-dulemar-diglemaladgi e-mui-metemaloye sogsa gusad.
Degi-inigwele, Safán-machi-Ahicamʼdi, Jeremías-ular gwisgusad. We-dule, Jeremías-oburwemalaga dulemar-imaksasulid.
Rey-Josías-machi-Joacim Judá-e-reyga-megidgu, Bab-Jehová Jeremíasʼga sunmaknonikid:
Bab-Jehová weyob anga sogsad: “Moli-dukarba-suar-meged be sobo, degi, geb e-dubmar-nagued be imakbalo. Deyob be imaksale, geb be-dukarba we-suar be edinno.
Geb a-sorba, be we-reymarse gayaburba barmido: Edom-e-reyse, Moab-e-reyse, Amón-e-reyse, Tiro-e-reyse, degi, Sidón-e-reyse. Be an-gayaburba, garda-berbemalad-danimaloedba be barmidoed. We-dulemar Judá-e-rey-Sedequías-dakega Jerusalénʼse danimaloed.
”Be a-dulemarga sogoed, be-reymarga weyob be sogoye: ‘Ani an Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová Bela-Gangued-Nikad, weyob sogye:
Ani, an-ganguedba, an-surgan-gandikidba an we-napneg nasiksad. Ani an dulemar-obinnisad, degi, an bela egi ibmar-durgan-bukwamalad urbisad. Ar doaga an we-ibmarmar ukbie, an-itolegedba an uked.
” ’Emide, bela we-yalamar an-mai-Babilonia-e-Rey-Nabucodonosorʼga an uksad. Deginbali, bela ibmar-durgan-nabir-akwilemalad, degi, sapurbarmaladse-bakale, an Rey-Nabucodonosorʼga uksabalid, adi, e-urbaligwa gudii gumalagar.
Bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladi, Babilonia-yalaga wileged-iba-nonimogoedse Rey-Nabucodonosor-e-maiga gumaloed, e-machi-maiga gumaloed, degi, e-wagwa-maiga gumarbaloed. Weyobi, Babilonia-yala, rey-gandikmaladse, degi, yalamar-baiganse mailemogoed.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ani Bab-Jehová sogye: ‘Neggwebur-dummagan-gwensak, reymar-gwensak, Babilonia-rey-Nabucodonosorʼba dabisurmalale, yapa ega mailemalale, ani an a-dulemala, es-suidgi, ukud-dummadgi, degi, bonigan-dummagangi obelogoed. Bela-naitinagase, Nabucodonosor, we-dulemar-obelogega an imakoed.
” ’Degisoggu, be-gayaburba-barsogmalad, be-nermar, be-dule-gabdaked-odulomalad, be-niisgwaba-dakar-ibmar-sogmalad, be-ina-isgana-imakmalad, bega sokarmalale, melle be Babilonia-e-reyba ibsamaloye, melle be itomalo.
Ar we-dulemar bemarga gakansaar-sunmakmalad, unnila we-neggweburgi-banguega be-imakbimalad, adi, an be-barmetemalagar. Deyob be burgwemalaga be-imakbimalad.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad Babilonia-e-rey-maiga-guoye-sogmaloeddi, degi, a-sogedba-nanamaloeddi, e-yargi-bukwa an imakoed, adi, agi arbabukwaguega, nued-garmakdiguega, an imakoed.”
Ani Jeremías, an Judá-e-rey-Sedequíasʼga sunmaksabalid. Amba weyob an ega sogsabalid: “Be dula-gudiguega, Babilonia-e-rey-maiga be guo, a-sogedba be nanao, e-dulamar-sogedba be ibsao.
¿Ar ibiga be, be-dulamarmala, es-suidgi burgwebimarsunna? ¿Ibiga bemar ukudba, degi, boni-dummaganba burgwebimarsunna? Ar Bab-Jehová sogsad: ‘Dulemala Babilonia-e-reyba-ibsaosulidi deyob gumaloye.’
”Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad bega-sogmaladi, Babilonia-e-rey-sogedba be mer damaloye, we-dulemar melle be itomalo. Ar bega-ibmar-sogmaladi, yogasaar-gakansaar sunmakmalad.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “An we-dulemar barmissulid. We-dulemar yogasaar-gakansaale an-nuggi sunmakdimalad. Unnila we-dulemar we-neggweburgi-an-be-onogega bega sunmaknanaid. Ar deyob bemar-burgwemalodo, bega-Bab-gayaburba-barsogmaladse-bakar, burgwemarmogodo.”
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladga an sogsabalid, degi, bela dulamarga an weyob sogsabalid, Bab-Jehová weyob sogye: “Melle be Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad itomala. Bega-sogmaladi, ‘emisgwasaar gannar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ibmar-ebulemalad Babilonia-yargi-bukwad seledanikoye,’ we-dulemar unnila binsa gakansamalad.
Melle be we-dulemar itomala. Be dulagudigumalaga bur Babilonia-e-rey-sogedba be ibsamala. ¿Ar ibiga Jerusalén-neggweburde obeloledagosunna?
”Ar wemar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-berbemalad-sunsogmaladile, deginbali, nue an ega sunmakdibalile, ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nika-Guedgi, anse ibmar egismardo. Anse egismardo, anse-goled-neggi-ibmar-bukwadi, reyneggi-ibmar-bukwadi, Jerusalénʼgi-ibmar-bukwadi, melle Babilonia-yarse seledega imakye.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad soged: “Ar buar-sailamardina, dii-sied-sailamardina, dii-sied-abingaedsailamardina, degi, ibmar-bamalad-nuegan Jerusalén-neggweburgi-besmaladdina,
Babilonia-Rey-Nabucodonosor sessurgusad. Deunni Nabucodonosor, Jerusalénʼgi Babiloniaʼse Joacim-machi-Judá-rey-Jeconías-sesgu, Judá-dulemar-nuga-nikamalad-sesgu, degi, Jerusalén-dulemar-sesbargu, we-ibmarmar sessulid.
”Ar Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, ese-goled-neggi-ibmar-besmaladgi, Judá-e-reyneggi-ibmar-besmaladgi, degi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi-ibmar-besmaladgi, weyob soged:
‘Bela we-ibmarmar-besmaladi Babilonia-yarse seledoed. Agine bukwa guoed. An gannar bemar-sedagoed-ibase, we-ibmarmar gannar geb an Jerusalén-neggweburse sedagoed.’ ”
Deunni, birgabake-gaka-nii-walatargus Judá-Rey-Sedequías reyga megdagedgine, Azur-machi-Hananías Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged, Gabaón-neggweburgined, anga weyob Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi, dulemar-abargi, degi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-abargi sogded:
—Weyobi Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová sogye: ‘Babilonia-rey maiga-bemar-imakdidii an obelogoye.
Birgabosega, Babilonia-rey-Nabucodonosor Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ibmarmar-bukwad-sesadi gannar an sedagoye.’
Hananías anga sogdebalid: —Bab-Dummad-sogye, ‘Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi sogye: Joacim-machi-Judá-e-rey-Jeconías gannar wese-dagega an imakoye, degi, bela dule Judá-yalagi, Babiloniaʼse gales-selesgusmalad an gannar wese sedagoye.’
Geb ani Jeremías bela Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-bukmalad-abargi, degi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-abargi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Hananíasʼga an sogded:
—¡Degir-nabir! Bitigi Bab-Jehová deyob imaksana gadin. Be-ibmar-sogsadba Bab-Jehová ibmar-imaksana gadin. Babilonia-yar-akar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-ibe ibmar-selesmalad gannar selenonikina yeerban, bela dule-gales-selesmalad gannar wese aibirismalana gadin.
Degi-inigwele, an bega ibmar-sogoedi, dulemarga an ibmar-sogoedi, nue be itogo:
Epennegwa anmar amba satedgine, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad, bila-danikoedgi sunmaksamalad, ukud-dummad-naguoedgi sunmaksamalad. Deginbali, neggweburmargine, yalamargine, boni-dummagan-danikoedgi anmar-idu sunmaksamarbalid.
”Ar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-wargwen neg-akarguosurye-sogele, napiragwadba deyob gusale, agi daklenonidaed, we-dule, nue Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-innikigwadi, Bab-Jehová-nuggi barmilealedi.”
Geb agi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Hananías, an-dukarba-suar-atinnar-naid unnusad, geb bichisad.
Agine, Hananías bela dulemar-bukwad-abargi sogded: —Bab-Jehová weyob soged: ‘Igi we-suar bichisa, deyobi, birgabose Babilonia-e-rey-gangued an obelogoed. Dulemar bar e-maiga guosulid.’ Hananías deyob-sogsagu, Jeremías e-iduar nadsunnad.
Hananías, Jeremías-dukarba suar-atinnar-naid-bichisad-ibagan-sorba, Bab-Jehová, Jeremíasʼga weyob sognonikid:
“Be nae, Hananíasʼga be sogna, weyob Bab-Jehová sogye: ‘Suar-an-dukarba-naid be bichisadi unnila wedi sualad, degi-inigwele, we-anale, esgoro-suar an imakoed.
Ar Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob soged: Bela we-dulemargi esgoro-aidikid-dukarba-nagueyobi Babilonia-e-reyga-mailegega an imakoed. A-dulemala, a-reyba ebipiledii gumaloed. Bela ibmar-durganse-bakar, Babilonia-e-reyba ibsamalaga an imakoed.’ ”
Geb degi, Jeremías, Hananíasʼga sogded: —Hananías, nue be an-itogo. Bab-Jehová dulemarse be-barmiarsulid. Emide, be we-dulemar gakangi-bensuliguega be imaksad.
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová weyob soged: ‘Be we-napaneggi an be-osulogoed. Ar be angi-gwisguar dulemarga sunmaksad, degisoggu, we-birgagi be burgoed.’
Deyobi gusad, a-birga-nii-walagugledgi (7) Hananías burgwenonikid.
We-garda, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Jeremías, Jerusalén-neggwebur-akale girmar-dummagan-gales-selesmaladga barmisad. Degi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladga, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmaladga, degine, bela dulemar Nabucodonosorʼse Jerusalénʼgi-gales Babiloniaʼse-selesmaladga garda barmisad.
Deunni, Rey-Jeconías, e-nanmala, ega-arbamaladmala, Judá-e-dummaganmala, Jerusalén-e-dummaganmala, Jerusalénʼgi-gales selesgusmalad-sorba, we-garda barmilesad. Degi, Rey-Jeconías, dule-ibmar-sobedgi-arbamaladmala, degi, dule-esgoro-sobedgi-arbamaladmala, Jerusalénʼgi-gales selesgusmalad-sorbali, we-garda barmilesad.
Deunni, Judá-Rey-Sedequías, Babilonia-Rey-Nabucodonosorʼse Safán-machi-Elasa, Hilcías-machi-Gemaríasʼbo barmisgu, Jeremías eba garda barmismogad. Gardagi weyob sognaid:
Weyobi, Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová Bela-Gangued-Nikad, Jerusalén-akar gales Babiloniaʼse-bemar-sealid soged:
“Neg be sobmalo, agi be megmalo. Ibmar be digmalo, a-e-san be gunmalo.
Abirgin be nikumalo, be mimmigan nikumalo. Be-mimmiganga abirgin be ukmalo, adi, bega wagan-urbemaloed. Gatik Babilonia-yalagi dula-mergumai be imakmalo, melle dula-iregega be imakmalo.
”A-ukinbali, bemar-bukwad-yargi be nue-arbamalo, ega be anse-gormalo. Ar Babilonia-yargi nueganbi ibmar-nadapile, bemarga ibmar-nueganbi namarmogoed.”
Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová Bela-Gangued-Nikad soged: “Melle be Bab-gayaburba-barsogmaladse binsaed-galemalo, melle be nermar bemar-abargi-gudimaladse yamolemalo. Melle be e-gabdaked itomalo.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar bemarga an-nuggi-sunmakye-sogmaladi, binsa gakansadimalad. Ar we-dulemar gwen an-nuggi-sunmakega an barmissulid.”
Ar weyob Bab-Jehová soged: “Bemar Babilonia-yargi-gudiid birga-dulapaa-gakambe-gunonikile (70), geb an bemarse ataknonikoed. An ibmar-imakoye-sogsadba an bemarga ibmar imakoed. Gannar Jerusalénʼse an bemar-sedagoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “An bemargi-ibmar-imakbied an nue wisid, ibu an imakbie. An bemarga bonigan-ukedgi binsasulid, bemar nueganbi-garmakdii-imakedgi an binsaed. Yoedse be yeer-itodii-gudigumalaga an binsaed.
”Geb agine, bemar an-nug-odummodmaloed, be anse-wilesakwaa-gornonimaloedi, an bemar-itogoed.
Ar bemar bela-belad gwagegi an-amimalale, be an-amimaloed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Be an-amimalaga an be-imakmaloed. Bemar-gales-selesmaladi, gannar an bemar-sedagoed. Bela dulemar anse yar-baid-baidse-selesgusmalad an onogoed. Bemar oaisakiles-bukwadgi an bemar-onogoed. Bia be bukwa gales-selesgusmala, ase gannar an bemar-sedagoed.” Bab-Jehová soged.
“Ar bemar weyob sokalile: ‘Bab-Jehová, Babiloniaʼgi anmarga e-gayaburba-barsogmalad barmiarmoye.’ ”
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová David-ologanagi-Rey-siidnik soged, bela dulemar we-neggweburgi-bukmaladnik sogbalid. Deginbali, bemar-gwenadgan bemarba gales-selearsurmaladnik soged.
Bab-Jehová Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob soged: “We-dulemar-besmaladgine, bila-onoleged an egi barmidoed, ukud-dummad an egi nasikoed, boni-dummagan an egi barmidoed. Higo-san-nunumaladyob an imakoed. Higo-san ise-nunudba geg-gulledaedyob an imakoed.
”We-dulemargi bilamar an egi barmimai imakoed, degi, ukud-dummadi, boni-dummagana an egi barmimai imakoed. Bela we-napaneggi-yalamar-bukwad-ogwayega an imakoed. Degine, an bia oaisakioe, agi be deyob-guoedba dulemar-ogwayega an wemar-imakoed. Degi, ukabsalegega, ima-daklegega, egi-dodolegegala, an imakoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Bemar an-gayaburba itossurmalad, gwen eba be ibsassurmalad. An bemarga, an-gayaburba-barsogmaladba gayaburba-barmimai-barmimai gusanad.
”Emisgwa bemar-gales-selesgusmalad, we-yalagi-mamaimalad, Jerusalénʼgi Babilonia-yarse an bemar-sealid, be an-sogedba damar.”
Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob Colaías-machi-Acabʼnik soged, degi, Maasías-machi-Sedequíasʼnik sogbalid. We-dulemar bemarga an-nuggi yogasaar-gakansaar sunmakdimalad: “We-dulemar an Babilonia-Rey-Nabucodonosorʼga urmakoed, a-dule, bemar-wagab we-dulemar-oburgoed.
”Degisoggu, Judá-dulemar gales Babiloniaʼse-selesmalad emar-ukabsamaloed, weyob sogdemaloed: ‘Bab-Jehová igi Sedequías Acab-ebo, Rey-Nabucodonosorʼse soogi ogumaklegega imaksa, deyobi, be-imakmogana gadin.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar we-dulemar, Israel-yargi ibmar-isgana imaksamalad: Galagwensuli emar-omeganba negsichigi nanasmalad, gakansaale an-nuggi sunmaksamarbalid. Bipisaale an ega gwen ibmar-sogsasulid sogsamalad. We-ibmala an bela wisid, ani an we-ibmar daksadid.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Jeremías, Nehelam-machi-Semaíasʼga be sogmogo,
weyob Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová Bela-Gangued-Nikad sogye: ‘Bee be, be-nuggine, bela dulemar Jerusalénʼgi-bukmaladse be garda barmisye. Maasías-machi-dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Sofoníasʼse, degi, bela dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladse be garda barmisye, ega be sogoed. We-gardagi weyob soglenaiye:
Sofoníasʼye, Bab-Jehová, ese-goled-neggi neg-dakega, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Joiada-muchub be-onug-imaksaye. Deginbali, Semaías be sogsibalid, dule yogasaar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogedye na gordiile, esgaryaba be odogoye, esgoro-dubgi be edinbaloye.
” ’De-ukine, gardagi be sogbalid, ¿ibiga wede Anatotʼgined-Jeremías be gasurmala? Emide, bemar-abargi Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogedyob gudiid.
Emide, Jeremías we-Babilonia-yarse anmarga garda barmialid, gardagi weyob sognaid: Bemar gales-bukwadi undar-birgaba-bukwa gumaloye. Degisoggu, be neg sobmaloye, agi be megmaloye, ibmar be digmaloye, a-e-san be gunmaloye anmarga gardagi sognaid.’ ”
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Sofonías, Jeremíasʼga we-garda absosad.
Agine, Jeremíasʼse Bab-Jehová-gayaburba nonikid, ega weyob sognonikid:
“Babiloniaʼgi dulemar-galesbukmaladga gayaburba be barmido. Weyob be sogo, Bab-Jehová, Nehelam-machi-Semaías-annik weyob sogye: ‘Semaías bemarga yogasaar-gakansaar gayaburba sogsad. Gwen we-gayaburba an barmissulid. Bemar-binsaed-gaega be-imaksamalad.’
”Ani an Bab-Jehová, an soged: We-dule Nehelam-machi-Semaías an sabsur-odurdakoed, degine, e-wagan an sabsur-odurdakbaloed. Ar dulemar-angi-banguega imaksad. Bipisaale, e-neg-yaginmaladi, dula-gudii guosulid, adi, melle an-ibmar-nuegan-imakoedgi an-dulamarga bar sunmakegar.”
Bab-Jehová Jeremíasʼga sognonikid.
“Ani Israel-dulemar e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová soged: An bela bega ibmar-sogsad gardagi be narmako.
Ar ibagan danikid, an-dula-Israel-dorgan, degi, an-dula-Judá-dorgan gales-bukmalad gannar an wese sedagoed. An e-dadganga-yala-uksadse an sedagoed, a-yalagi na yeer-itobukwa gumaloed.”
Bab-Jehová Jeremíasʼga Israel-dulemargi sunmaksad, degi, Judá-dulemargi sunmaksad.
Weyobi Bab-Jehová soged: “Dule dobedba binnasuli-gorbukwa itolesad, gwayale-gwayale oimakbukwa itolesad, neg-bogidikid itolesulid.
Yamo be dakena, ese be egisena, machergan, omeganyobi muu-neggi nagusogeye. Degite, ¿ibiga machergana, siamar-muuneggi-nagueyobi, musiragi alamaknanai an daksunna? ¿Ar ibiga e-wagarmar bela sipuu daklesunna?
¡Duledar-wiles! Ibagan-bulegan, ibagan-weyobid-dakledisulid omos. Jacob-dulemarga, suli-suli-itoged-ibaga guoed, degi-inigwele, we-ibagan-bulegangi ollorgumaloed.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad soged: “An-dulamar mailediidgi an onogoed, atinnaryob-ebipilediid an esikoed. Dulemar-baigan-e-maiga bar guosurmalad.
Unnila bemar be-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼsebi, be gordii gumaloed. Be-e-reyga be arbadii gumaloed. Rey, Davidʼyobid an bemarga barmidagoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “An-dula-Jacob-wagan, melle be gwayemar. An-dula-Israel-wagan, melle be dobee itomar. Jacob-wagan, ar an we-yargi be-onogoed, ar be-wagan-Babiloniaʼse-gales-selesmalad an onogoed. Gannar be bogidik-gudii guoed. Dobedsuli be garmakdii guoed, dulemar bar be-ogwayosurmalad.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “An be-bendakega be-yalaba gwichid. Bia an be-oaisakismala, a-yarmala an bela-naitinagase obelogoed. Degi-inigwele, bemardi an be-obelogosulid, unnila igar-innikigwadba an sabsur-bemar-odurdakoed, an bemar-odurdaksuli an guosulid, an bemar-odurdakedsegad.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Be-boni-amisad geg nudakleged, be-boni-yaa-siidga bendakleged-igar sulid.
Bega-igar-nudakega dule-be-ulagwisgued sated, ar be-boniga bendakleged-igar sulid, ar be-boni-nikadga nugued-igar sated.
Bela bebo-galagwensur-nanasmalad be-iesmalad, bar bemar-amiedgi binsasurmalad. Be, dummad-ibmar-isgana-imaksad-ulale, degi, be, dummad-isgusad-ulale, an be-sarsosad, degi, a-ulale, an be-odurdaksad. Igi dule-isgana dule-sabsur-imakdamalayob an bemar-imaksad.
¿Ibiga nunmakedba be binnasuli gole? Ar be-bonide gege-nudakleged. Be, dummad-ibmar-isgana-imaksad-ulale, degi, be dummad-isgusad-ulale, an weyobi bemar-imaksad.
”Bela be-wiomaladi, bela wiolemarmogoed, bela be-isdarmalad gales-seledmaloed. Begi-dii-dii-annamaladi, egi dii-dii annalemarmogoed, bela dulemar-bei-ibmar-sumaladi, bela ei ibmar sulemarmogoed.
Gannarse an be-onudakoed, be-boni-amisadi an bega osulogoed. Ar be-isdarmalad sogmalale, Sión-yala oballessiiye, dule bar Sión-yalagi binsasurmarye. Deyob sokarmalar, gwen akarsulid.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Jacob-wagan-gales-bukmalad gannar an sedagoed, Jacob-wagan an nue-wiledakoed. Neggweburmar gannar e-ambikusadgi ambikuoed, reyneg gannar iduar-sii gusadgi sigoed.
Neg-galimbabali, dog-nuedgi-namakleged itoledagoed, degi, weligwaledba binnasuli-oimake itoledagoed. Be-anagan an bega omelomai imakoed, bega ichegumai guosulid. Be-nug-ogannodii an imakoed, mesagwar-imakledii be guosurmalad.
Be-mimmigana, idualedyobi gumaloed, an-asabinni gannarse-bukwa gumaloed. Ani an, bela dule-mesagwar-be-imakmalad obelogoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Bemar-abargi, bemar-iduged nodagoed, a-dulegine, bemarga-negseed danikoed. An-walikaa-guega an imakoed, anba gudii guoed. Degite, ¿doa an-walikaa anse-dagega guakwasunna?
Bemar anse alile, be an-dulaga gumaloed, ani an, bemar-Bab-Dummadga gumogoed.
”An-urwedi burwa-dummad-goleyob gued. Burwa-bipirmakaledyobi gwichigualid, dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmaladgi, gwichigunonikoed.
An-urwedi gwen-bogguosulid, bela an-ibmar-abemaid-imakedse, an-urwed bogguoed. Geb bela we-ibmarmar-gusadgi, be magar itononimaloed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “A-ibagangine, ani an bela Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummadga guoed, Israel-dulemala an-dulaga gumarmogoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Es-suidgi-burgwissurmaladi, nega-dulesulidganba obunnoged-aminadapmargu, egi-nued an binsasad.”
Bab-Jehová anmarse dikasurgus magarosad, anmarga weyob sogsad: “Gusgu degisadegu an be-sabgudanikid, a-ulale, amba nue-wile an be-dakdiid.
Israel-dulemar, gannar an be-urbemaloed. Gannar neggweburga an be-imakoed. Gannale gar-pandereta be suoed, weligwaledba be dodonai guoed.
Gannar Samaria-yala-mullugangi, uvaʼmar be nasikmaloed. Dulemar uva-digmaloedi, e-uvaʼgi yeer-itodii gumaloed.
