Bab-Jehová weyob Amón-dulemarnik soged: “¿Ar Israel-dulemarde mimmigan satesi? ¿Ar e-sorba ibmar-gamaladde satesi? ¿Ar ibiga bab-dummad-Milcomʼde Gad-neggwebur-susa? ¿Ar ibiga Milcom-e-dulemar we-neggweburmargi mamai?”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ibagan dani, Rabáʼgi Amón-dulemar-bukmaladgi bila-onoleged-itolegega an imakoed. Bela e-neggweburmar bibisgoed, bela e-neggweburmar gummakoed. Israel-dulemar, dulemar e-annik neg-susmalad-annik, gannar neggwebur sumaloed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Hesbón-dulemar, Hai-neggwebur-bibichisadga be bomar. Rabá-bunamala, Haiʼga be binnasuli gormakmar. Bukib-binsaed-mor be yomar, ega be bukib binsamar. Gannar-gannar abarmakgwichi be imakmar. Ar bab-dummad-Milcom dule-irwa-ese-gormaladbo, degi, ega-arbamaladbo-galesa selesad.
Amón-dulemar, ¿ibiga be be-nebaganba san-dummarba imake? ¿Ibiga be be-nebagan-gadi-sanmakedba nug-dummarba itoge? Amón-dulemar-uayasulidaed, unnila be be-ibmar-nuegan-nikadgi-bensuli gudiid, be weyob soged: ‘¿Doa angi gwichiguoe? Dule angi gwichiguosuli.’ ”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi soged: “Dulemar-be-yar-nagaba-bukmaladi, be-ogwayega an imakoed, degine, be-baleginnega an saoed. Bela bemar we-yalagi onilemaloed. Dule-wakinmaloedi, dule gwen gannarse bar-urbosulid.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Bela we-ibmar-guoed-sorbali, Amón-dulemar-gales-selesmaladi, gannar an sedagoed.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob Edom-dulemar-annik soged: “¿Temán-yargi dule-binsaed-ibegan satesi? ¿Dule-binsaed-ibegan-ebinsaedde bergussi? ¿E-binsaed-nikad bela bergussi?
Dedán-dulemar, be wakinmala, gannar sorsik be namala. Yaa-ollogan matusur-bukmaladba be dukunamala. An Esaú-wagangi boni-dummad barmidsokalid, sabsur-odurdakleged-iba ega omosad.
Uvaʼmar welealile, abala obatilesdaed. Mutikidba atursaed-dule ibmar-atursanonikile, unnila e-ibmar-abegedbi na sesdaed.
Degi-inigwele, andina, bela Esaú-dulemar obelogoed. E-dukubukmalad an balamioed, gwen bar dukuosurmalad. E-mimmigana, e-gwenadgana, degine, dulemar-e-neg-dikarba-mamaidi, an obelogoed, bar bukwa guosurmalad.
Be anga be-mimmi-babgan-satemalad obego, ani an bega akoed, be-omegan-ei-sui-burgwismalad, ani an bega nioed.”
Weyob Bab-Jehová soged: “Sabsur-odurdakleged-igar-ega-maisurmaladbela sabsur-odurdaklesad. Edom-dulemar, be-bulesunna, ¿sunna be sabsur-odurdaklegosur be insae? Be sabsur-odurdaklegergebed, be agi wakinnosulid.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “An-nuggi an-dukin ise-sogar weyob soged: Bosra-neggwebur ukabsalegoed, isdar-daklegedga guoed, degi, mesagwar-daklegedga guoed, degine, ollobi-selenai guoed. Degisadegu, e-neggweburmar bibichis bukuoed.”
Bab-Jehová-gayaburba an itosad, dule-gayaburba-nued-berbegedi dulemar-abargi weyob ibmar-soge an itosad: “Be danar-ambikumar, Edomʼgi be gwichigudamar. Bila-onoged-idu be guagwar bukumar.
”Edom, an, neggwebur-baiganba bipii be-imakoed, dulemar-abargi mesagwar an be-imakoed.
Akwasaila-dummagan-olloganba be bukwamaladi, yala-dummaganba be mamaidi, be dukin emar-ogwayedgi yamolesmalad, be san-dummarba-samaladgi yamolesmalad.” Bab-Jehová soged: “Bemar sulubagiyobi nibaduku be-neg be sismalale, amba an bemar-ibe obelogoed.
Edom-yala-wilegoedi, bela-belad wilegoed. Dulemar a-yar-nagaba-nasmaloedi, geger Edom-yala-wilesadi dakdamaloed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Sodoma-neggwebur-wilesadyobi, Gomorra-neggwebur-wilesadyobi, degine, neggweburmar-e-dikarba-bukmalad-wilesadyobi, Edom-yala gumogoed. Dulemar, agine gwen bar gudii guosulid, degi, dulemar egi gwen bar ambikuosulid.
”Achumigur Jordán-diwar-bulaganba, gagan-nuegan-naidse nodanidaedyobi, ukiagwale, an Edom-dulemargi gwichigudagoed. Edom-dulemargi an dule-nug-imaksadi dummadga an mesoed. Ar ade, ¿doa anyobsunna? ¿Doa angi obinosunna? ¿Biti-sibad-edarbed angi gwisguosunna? Dule angi obinosuli.
Be an-itomar. An Edom-dulemarga igar-mesisad be itomar. Temán-dulemarga igar-mesilesad be itomar: Emar-imbagi sapingan-senigana ebipiledmaloed, e-gagan-nanaidi, swanga naguoed.
Edom-neggwebur-berguoedi neg-ogiglimakoed, Demar-Ginnidye-nugadse e-gollomaked itolegoed.
Sulubagi sakan-nallaa-danidaeyobi Bosra-e-isdarmaladi, Bosra-neggweburgi gwichigudanikid. A-ibagangine, Edom-sorda-gandikmaladi, ome-e-boniganba-galitonaidaeyobi gumaloed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob Damasco-dulemar-annik soged: “Hamat-neggwebur, degi, Arfad-neggwebur, bato garda-isgana-wisgusmaladba suli-suli itobukwad. Ar bela-belad nue-dobe itomalad, geg bogi na ambikumalad.
Damasco-dulemar geger itogusad, aisaar wakinye sokalinad, degi-inigwele, dobedbali geg wakinne gusad. Ome-e-boniganba-galitonaidaeyobi, Damasco-dulemar dobed itobukwad.
Ibiyobi neggwebur-nuga-nikad-idu duurmakmamai. We-neggweburde weligwar itosiidid.
Ani Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi soged: A-ibagangine, e-sapingana, neg-imbabali, omilede guoed, degi, bela e-sorda-bila-onomaladi girgumaloed.
Damasco-e-neg-gandikmalad an ogumakoed, Ben-Adad-negmar an obelogoed.”
Cedar-neggwebur, degi, Hazor-neggwebur, Babilonia-rey-Nabucodonosorʼse oitolesgusad. Emide, Bab-Jehová weyob we-neggweburmar-annik soged: “¡Dakebinne! Cedarʼgi be gwichigumar. Be dad-nakwe-dorgan-obelomar.
E-ibe e-dordonegmar, e-molimar, ei sulegoed. E-ibe e-atued-dummagan seledoed, degi, e-ibmar-nuegan, e-moli-yargan-muremalad seledoed. Dulemar ega weyob oimakdemaloed: ‘Bela aineba neg-dobegwale itoleged.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Hazor-dulemar, gwae be abarmakdemar, be gwae wakinmar, yaa-ollogan-matusur-bukmaladba be dukunamar. Babilonia-rey-Nabucodonosor bemarbina igar aminaid, bemarbina igar amisgunaid.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Dakebinne, we-neggwebur-san-dummarba-itogedgi be gwichigunamar, amar na dukin bensuli gudidimalad. We-dulemar dobe itosulid, baisur itomalad, bannabaa bachikii mamaimalad, amargi be gwichigunamar.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “E-moli-yargan-muremalad ei be sumalo, bela e-moli-bebe-nikamalad ei be sumalo. E-dulemar an yogasaar oaisakioed, napa-neg-bergunaidse an barmidoed, amba bia gudimalale, bonigan an egi barmidoed.
Hazor-neggwebur, achu-sapur-uaya-gannagan-negga guoed, degisadegu olloo neg naguoed. Dule-wargwensaale, egi gudii guosulid, gwen dule egi bukwa guosurbalid.”
Judá-e-rey-Sedequías gebe reyga megidedgine, Bab-Jehová, e-gayaburba-barsoged-Jeremíasʼga Elam-dulemargi sunmaknonikid.
Ega weyob sognonikid: Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi soged: “Elam-e-warsi an bibisgoed, e-gangued-sunsogedi, an ei obelogoed.
Burwa-dummagan an egi barmidoed, bela-napaneg-ebilis an egi burwa sedoed. Napaneg-ugakaase an oaisakioed. Elam-dulemar bela neggwebur-ugakaase ambikuoed, bela neggweburmargi ambikuoedbiid.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Elam-dulemar, e-isdarmalad-abin gwayega an imakoed, dule-e-oburgwebigudimalad-abin dobguega an saoed. An-sae-itogedi an egi oyogoed, boni-dummagan an egi barmidoed. Bila-onoleged an egi barmidoed, bela obelogedse an imakoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Elamʼgi an-ologana an sioed. Elam-e-rey an obelogoed, e-dummagana an obelobaloed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ibagan nonikoed, Elam-dulemar-gales-selesmaladi, gannar an sedagoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob e-gayaburba-barsoged-Jeremíasʼga Babilonia-yar-Caldea-dulemar-neggwebur-annik soged:
“Dulemar be owisogo, dulemar bela-wisguega be imako. Dulemar-owisoged-bander be onako, melle be soggwenad odukuo. Weyob be sogo: ‘¡Babilonia-yala sulegoed! ¡Bab-dummad-Bel nue-bingedar itogoed! ¡Bab-dummad-Merodac nue-gwakidoed! E-wilubgan-sobarmaladi, bingedar itomaloed, e-babyob-imaklemaladi, bela wawanmakdoed.’
Dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik-bukmaladi egi gwichiguoed, bela ollobi e-yala nasikoed. Dulemar, degi, ibmar-durganmar duurmakdemaloed, dulemar agi bar ambikuosulid.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “A-ibagangine, Israel-dulemar, Judá-dulemar, ise-boale, an-e-Bab-Dummad-guedgi anse abarmakdanimaloed.
Ansega egisdanimaloed, bia Siónʼse-naed-igar maiye. Ar a-igarbali nadapi gumaloed. Siónʼse modapile, anbo igar degisadegu omesmaloed, a-igar bar iegosurmalad.
”An-dulamar sibad-wawaad-yoggus-gudiiyobi gusmalad. E-edarbemaladi yogasaar-sesmalayob gusmalad, igar-oes sapurba-gudiiyobi imaksamalad. Yala-mulluganba-bipirmakdiiyobi gusmalad, e-galu-ies-gudimalayobi wilesmalad.
E-isdarmalad dakarmalale, obelodamalad, e-isdarmaladi sokardamalad: ‘Anmargi sisuli. Ar wemar Bab-Jehováʼgi isgusmalad. Bab-Dummad ega ibmar ukmainad, e-dadgan we-Bab-Jehováʼgi ibmar-abdakdii gusmaladinad.’
”Mimmigan, Babiloniaʼgi-gudimalad be ainimar, we-yalagi be wakinmar. Sibad-machered, sibad-wawaad-idunadapdaeyobi, be dulemar-idumar.
Ar ani an, Babilonia-idu, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik, neggwebur-dummagan-bukwad gilamaknaid. Babilonia-yalabina guakwaa bukumaloed, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiled-akale, Babilonia-yalagi gwichigumaloed. E-sigumala, sunsogmaladid, sigu-miledele, nosaa maksurmaladid.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Babilonia-ibe bela ibmarmar welegoed, dulemar-ibmar-weemaloedi na yeer itomaloed.
”Bemar, Babilonia-dulemar, an-dulamar-ibe-ibmar-atursamalad, be weligwar itomar, be wergumar. Moli-bebe-nikad-sapingwagwadyobi, gagan-ara-aramalad-birgi be gwirmar, molimar-goleyobi be gormar.
Ar bemar-yala, bela mesagwar guoed, egi be gwalulesmaladi, nue bingedar itogoed. Bemar-yala napa-negadulesulidga naguoed, nega-dinnaregedga, degi, bela napabi-nai guoed.
An-urwed-ulale, bemar bar-ambikuosulid, bela swanga naguoed. Dulemar Babilonia-yalagi-nasmalale, geger dakdamaloed, nue-oitolesnai dakdamaloed.
”Bemar-sigugi-urwemalad, guagwar be Babilonia-dikarba ambikumar. Egi be sigu mimar, melle be sigu sabomalo, ar we-dulemar angi dummad-isgusmalad.
Binnasuli be Babilonia-dikarba gormakmar, weyob be sogmar: ‘¡Babilonia-sordamar galakude! ¡E-neg-suigan marwide! ¡E-galu-matusulid-akwabimalad ayaride!’ We-ibmar-gunaidi Bab-Jehová buged imaknaid. Igi Babilonia-dulemar bemar-imaksa, deyobi bemar Babilonia-dulemar imakmogo. Bemar-wiosayobi be wiomarmogo.
Babiloniaʼgi ibmar-digmalad be obelomar, degi, Babiloniaʼgi ibmar-gwag-wemalad be osulomar. Dulemar, bila-onolenaid dakdamalogu, Babiloniaʼginsurmaladi e-yalase gannar namaloed, e-neggweburse wakitemaloed.
”Israel-dulemar sibad-wawaad-yoggus-gudimalayob gued, achumigur-nono-wawaadse balegilledimaladyob gumalad. Gebegine, Israel-dulemar Asiria-reyse dolesad, geb sorba, Babilonia-rey-Nabucodonosorʼse bela e-garmar bibichilesad.”
A-ulale, Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged: “An Babilonia-rey sabsur-odurdakoed, degi, an e-yala sabsur-wiobaloed, igi an Asiria-rey sabsur-odurdaksa, deyobi, an imakmogoed.
An Israel-dulemar gannar e-yalase-naega imakoed, Carmelo-yalagi, Basán-yalagi nue mas-gunbukwa an imakoed. Degine, Efraín-yalagi, Galaad-yalagi nue-immelebukwa an imakoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “A-ibagangine, Israel-dulemar-e-isguedi amilegoenad, degi-inigwele, amilegosulid. A-ibagangine, Judá-dulemar-e-isguedi amilegoenad, degi-inigwele, amilegosulid. Ar ani an bemaloedga isgued elioed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Merataim-yalagi be gwichigunamar, degi, Pecod-dorgangi be gwichigunamar. ¡Ogilomalo, bela naitinagase be obelomalo! An bega igar-uksadba be imakmalo.
”Neggweburgine bila-onolegega binnasuli-oimake itoleged, nue-dummad wilemaloed.
Babilonia-yala, be mardoyobi, dulemar-sabsur-imakedinad, emigindi, be yarmar-bamalad-imbagi olloo mellesiid.
Bee be, yamoleged-galu sisad, agine na be dukin galesad. Galesadi gwen be itossulid, ukiagwale be galesad. Babilonia, ar be angi-gwisgusadba be daklenonikid, degidbali, be galesad.
An-gingi-sabolebukwad an egasad, an-sae-itoged-gingimar an onisad. Ani an Bab-Jehová-bur-dutusulidi, Bela-Gangued-Nika-Maidi, Babilonia-yalagi igar-soggwen an imakergebed.
Napneg-ugakagi-bukmalad, Babilonia-yalagi be gwichigumar. E-ibmar-gwag-sabolebukwad ei be egamar, ibmar-gwag-weemaloedi, danar-danar be oambikumalo. Bela nagase be obelomalo. ¡Melle ibmar be obemalo!
E-moli-bebe-nikad-sapingana bela be oburgwemar. Oburgwileged-negse be sedmar. Babilonia-dulemar, duledar-wilesmalad, sabsur-odurdakleged-iba ega nonikid.
Dulemar-duurmakmaid-e-sunmakedi be itomar. Babiloniaʼgi-wakinmamaid-e-sunmakedi be itomar: ‘Bab-Jehová, ese-goled-neg-earismalad-ular, Babilonia-yar buged-imaknaiye,’ Sión-yalase sogdanimalad.
”Be Babilonia-sordamar-idu sigugi-urwemalad danar oambikumar, dulemar-warsi-yaa-saemaladi bela be urbemar. Babilonia-ebilis be ambikumar, melle dulemar-wakinnega be samalo. E-ibmar-imaksamaladba be sabsur-imakmarmogo, dulemar-wiosmaladba be wiomarmogo. Ar we-dulemarde Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Jehová-Gwage-Isligwaledgi gwichigusmalad.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “A-ulale, a-ibagangine, e-sapingana neg-imbaba omiledoed, degi, bela e-sorda-bila-onomaladi, girgumaloed.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad soged: “San-dummarba-imakmalad-yala, an begi gwichiguoed. Emide, sabsur-odurdakleged-ibagan bega nagunonikid.
San-dummarba-imakedi, gowarmakdoed, aimukudoed, dule e-ogwisega bendakosulid. Bela e-neggweburmargi an soo ogaoed, bela e-neggwebur an soogi ogumakoed.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, weyob soged: “Israel-dulemar, Judá-dulemar, mesagwar gudidimalad. E-isdarmaladi gasa bukwad, gwen onobisurmalad.
Ar dule-e-bendakeddi, dule-dutusulidid, ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadye nugad. Gandikidgi an bendakoed, nega-bogidikid an ega nasikoed. Babilonia-yalagindina, an dobed-dummad nasikoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Babilonia-dulemar oburgwilegoed, e-dummagan, degi, e-dule-binsaed-ibegan, ogilolegoed.
Ega-gayaburba-gakansaar-barsogmaladi, oburgwilegoed, amar binsaedsulidga naddamalad. E-sorda-bila-onomaladi nue-dobe-itomaladi ogilolegoed.
E-molimar, oburgwilegoed, e-ur-napaginmaladi, osulolegoed. Sorda-bila-onomalad-ainebarmalad-bennuklegarmaladi, bela girgumaloed. Omeganyob dobgudmaloed. E-ibmar-nuegana obelolegoed, e-ibe atursalegoed.
E-diimar dinguoed, bela dinna guoed. Ar Babilonia-yala bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad-yalad, amala, suli-suli dule-imakmaladid.
”A-ulale, nega-dulesulidganba ibdurgan-ursirmaladi, achu-sapurmarbo gudii gumaloed. Agine nuu-dummad-dukar-suidmar gudii gumarmogoed. Dulemardi Babiloniaʼgi bar-bukwa guosulid, degisadegu, olloo nai guoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “An Sodoma-neggwebur-imaksayobi, Gomorra-neggwebur-imaksayobi, degine, amar-dikarbali neggweburmar-bukwad-wiosayobi, an Babilonia-yala imakoed. Bar agine dulemar bukwa guosulid, agine bipisaale dulemar bar megosulid.
”Dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsiki, sorda-bila-onomalad danikid, napneg-ugaka-akale, bela neggwebur-dummagan-bukwad, degine, reymar-bukidar danikid.
Sigumar-annik-annik danimalad, eswar-swiswidikmalad annik-annik danimalad. Dule-ursirmalad nanaed, wile-dule-daksurmaladid. Moligi-sii danimalad. E-uurmakedi, demar-uurmakmaidyobi gordanikid. Babilonia-yeerdakleged, we-dulemar bebina danimalad, we-dulemar begi gwichigudanimalad, bila-onoledanikiyob ilemakar danimalad, dule-wargwenadyob ilemakar danimalad.
Babilonia-rey, dulemar-egi-bila-onodanikid wisgusad, deyob-itosgua, dobedbali wawanmakded, na egine suli-suli-itoged nagusad, ome-e-boniganba-galitonaidaeyobi, itoalid.
Achumigur Jordán-diwar-bulaganba, gagan-nuegan-naidse danidaeyobi, ukiagwale an Babilonia-dulemargi gwichigudagoed. Babilonia-dulemargi an dule-susadi an onugsaoed. ¿Ar doa anyobsunna? ¿Doa angi obinosunna? ¿Biti-sibad-edarbed angi gwisguosunna? Dule angi obinosuli.”
Ani Jeremías soged: “Bab-Jehová Babilonia-dulemarga-igar-mesisad, be itomar. Babilonia-dulemarga igar-mesilesad, be itomar: ‘Emar-imbagi sapingan-senigana ebipiledmaloed, e-gagan-nanaidi, swanga naguoed.
Babilonia-neggwebur-berguoedi neg-ogiglimakoed, e-gollomakoedi neggwebur-baiganse itolegoed.’ ”
Weyob Bab-Jehová soged: “Babilonia-yalagi dule-obeloged-burwa an ogoloed, Caldea-dulemar-angi-yoledimaladgi an burwa barmidoed.
Dulemar oros-uka-milegedyob-dulemar-imakedi, Babilonia-dulemargi an barmidagoed. Adi, Babilonia-dulemar bela sate imakegar. E-sabsur-odurdaklegoed-ibagi, igar-baid-baidsik egi ainidamaloed.
Dule-sigumiedi, melle warsi-yaa-imakega be imakmalo, degi, melle esgoro-mor-yoega be samalo. Melle e-sapingana wile be dakmalo, bela naitinagase e-sorda-bila-onomalad be obelomalo.
Babilonia-yalagi burgwar omiledmaloed, neg-galimbabali e-muimar omiledoed.
Israel-dulemar, degi, Judá-dulemala, angi-isgusmar-inigwele, we-yalagi isgued-omelosmar-inigwele, degite, ani Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummadi, gwen an egi bangussulid.
”Babilonia-neggweburgi be wakinmar, be wala-walagwengi san bendakmar, melle Babilonia-isguedba be burgwemalo.
Babilonia-dulemar an-argan-yaurgine, nog-gobed-orbiidyobi gued. Bela napaneg-naid-omumsadiid. Neggwebur-dummagana bela a-vino gobsamalad, degidbali, neggweburmar suli-suli itodmalad.
Degi, ukiagwale, Babilonia-dulemar galakude gusmalad, degine, bela oitoles gusad. A-ulale, akigindemalad, ega be ina sedamala, nabir sunna nugualile.
” ‘Babilonia-dulemarga anmar ina-nued daksanad, degi-inigwele, gwen nugussulid. Anmar mete nasunna, e-yala-yalase gannar namarsun. Ar Babilonia-dulemar-e-isguedi bela nibnegse warmaknaid, degi, bela mogirsega warmaknaid.’
”Israel-dulemar soged: ‘Bab-Jehová anmarga igar nudaksad. Be dagmar, Sión-yalagine, Bab-Jehová-ibmarmar-imaksadgi anmar sunmakoed.’
”¡Sigumar be oswiswimakmar! ¡Sigu-abgamalad be nasikmar! Bab-Jehová, Babilonia-dulemar-obelogega, Medo-dulemar-e-reymar ogannosad. We-ibmar-guoedi, Bab-Jehová buged imakegalad, ar Babilonia-dulemar ese-goled-neg-bibichismalad-ular, deyob imakoed.
Babilonia-galu-matusulidgi-gwichiguega, bander be oyomar. ¡Sordamar be ogannomar! ¡Dule-nakulemalad be urbemar! ¡Dukued-galu be sobmar! Bab-Jehová ibmar-imakbiedi imakoed, Babilonia-dulemargi-ibmar-sogsadi, sogedba imakoed.
Bemar, Babilonia-dulemar, diwar-dummagan-nagaba be mamaimalad, ibmar-nuegan-bukidar be nikamalad. Emide, be-ibagan-bergued warmaknonikid, be-gudigued wese gwinmaknonikid.
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad e-sunnad weyob ibmar-imakedse sogsad: ‘Ses-bukibayobi, an be-neggweburgine be-isdarmalad enogoed, begine obinmaloedbali, binnasuli gormakdemaloed.’
”Bab-Jehová, e-ganguedgi, napneg nasiksad, e-binsaed-nikadbali, napneg ilemaksad, e-ibmar-wisidbali, nibneg obinnisad.
Bab-Dummad binnasur-sunmakedbali, nibneggi diimar-uurmakega imakdaed, magatibali, mogir-ainakwega imakdaed. Mala-ibyed-abalagi, dii-owiardaed, burwa-galumargi, burwa-oniardaed.
”Bela dulemar binsaedsulidamaladid, aku-neg-itomaladid. Bela dulemar-orgi-arbamaladi, e-ibmar-sobedgi bingedar itomalad, e-ibmar-sobarmaladi, dule-yardakmaladid, gwen burba-dulad nikasulid.
We-ibmarmala, binsaledid, binsa egi dodolegedid, e-sabsur-odurdakleged-iba-nonikile, bela obelolemaloed.
Jacob-e-Bab-Dummaddi, we-ibmar-sobarmaladyobsulid. Ar Jacob-e-Bab-Dummadi, bela ibmar-saedid, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadye nugad. A-Bab-Dummad Israel-dulemar, egadiga-guega na susad.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Babilonia, bemar anga mardoyobi gued, be angala bila-onogedgi ibmar-ebulegedyob gued. Bebali, an neggwebur-dummagan bibisged, degi, dulemar-baid-baid-bukmaladi beba an obelobalid.
Bebali, molimar, degi, sorda-moligi-sii-urwemaladi, an obelobalid. Bebali, ur-napaginmalad-bila-onogedgi-ebulemaladi, degi, e-onanamaladi, an obelobalid.
Degi, bebali, machergana, omeganse-bakale, an osulobalid. Bebali, sergana, sapingana an obelobalid. An bebali, masmala, yagana, obelobalid.
Bebali, sibad-edarbemaladi, degi, e-sibad-wawaadmar an osulobalid. Bebali, sapurba-arbamaladi, e-moli-bebe-nikamalad-abin-abinnid-napa-imumaladse-bakale, an obelobalid. De-ukinbali, dummagan-negsemamaid, degine, dummadga-arbamaladi, bebali an obelobalid.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Babilonia-dulemar Sión-yalagi-ibmar-imaksadba, bemar-wagab an Babilonia-buged-imakoed, bela e-dulemar an buged-imakoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Babilonia, an begi-gwichid, be emar-obeloged-yalad, bela be napa-obelogedid. Begine an-surgan an oyodoed, akwasaila-akale an be-balimetoed, degi, yala-gummakaledga an be-imakoed.
”Ani Bab-Jehová soged: Be-akwamar, neg-sobega suosurmalad. Be-akwamar negsailaga-sigega bei suosurmalad. Ar bela be-yala ollobi naguoed.
”Neggweburgi bander be onakmar. Dulemar-imbagi gar-trompeta be ogormar. Babilonia-sordamargi-gwichiguega, Ararat-sordamar be urbemar. Mini-sordamar, degine, Askenaz-sordamar be urbemar. Bila-onolegedgi sorda-idued-dummad-dule-idugega be amimar. Sesmar-duurmakmaiyobi, molimar egi duurmakmai be imakmar.
Babilonia-neggweburgi-gwisguega, neggweburmar guagwar be urbemar. Babilonia-sordamargi-gwisguega, Media-yar-e-reymarse be gormar. Degine, Media-e-dummagan, Media-e-negsemamaid be onmakmar, degi, Babilonia-neggweburgi gwisguega bela yalamarse be gormar.
Napa wawanmaknaid, bela giglimaknaid. Bab-Dummadi, Babilonia-dulemargi-ibmar-sogsad imaknaid, Babilonia-yala nega-dulesulidga, degi, dulemar bar egi bukuosulidga imaknaid.
Babilonia-sorda-bila-onomaladi, bila-onoged boggusmalad. Neg-gandikmaladba dukus bukusmalad. E-gala-ganguedi, nollomakdemalad, omeganyobi dobe itodmalad. E-negmar dule-isganamarse ogumaklesad, e-yawagak-bargamalad ei bibichismalad.
Gayaburba-berbegedi, baid-gayaburba-berbeged-sorbali abarmakmaid, Babilonia-reyga-sogega: ‘Bela dule-baigan be-ibe neggwebur susye,
dule-isdarmaladi, diwar-obaklemamaidgi bukusmarye, nakuleged-negmar-bukwad ogumaksamarye, degi, bela sorda-bila-onomaladi gwakidmarye.’ ”
Ar Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged: “Babilonia-yalaga odurdakleged-iba omosad, Babilonia-yala-yeerdaklegedi, orosgisaar-dakleged-welesayobi daklegoed. Bela swanga naguoed.”
Jerusalén-dulemar soged: “Babilonia-rey-Nabucodonosor an-obelosmalad, suli-suli an-imaksamalad, bate-olloo-mellesiiyobi an-imaksamalad. Ibdula-dummad-demargined-dule-doeyob an-dosad, angi-immelesadba, a-sorbali, gannar agsad.”
Jerusalén-dulemar sogmalad: “Babilonia-dulemala igi anmar-wiosa, deyobi, Babilonia-dulemar gumarmosun.” Sión-dulemar sogmalad: “Igi Babilonia-dulemar anmar-ablis eosmala, deyob e-ablis ei ariomosun.”
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Israel-dulemar, be-ibmar-imaksadgi an bemar-bendakoed, ani an bemarga buged-mai imakoed. Ani an Babilonia-demar odinguoed, e-dii-sailagan-ariomamaid ani an dinnaa saoed.
Babilonia-neggwebur akwamar-dunnumake-bukwadga gudoed, achu-sapur-uaya-gannagan-negga gudoed. Neg-dobed-dummadga gudoed, egi dodolegega gudoed. Nega-dulesulidga, gudoed.
Babilonia-dulemar bulale achumigur-uurmakebayobi uurmakdemaloed, achumigur-bipiganabayobi akigindemaloed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Neg-diopisur-itoarmalale, ani an ega gobed dakoed. Wergumalaga an omumsaoed, suitii gabemai-saegala, geg atake an imakoed.
Igi sibad-wawaad-senigana e-oburgwileged-negse seleddae, debayobi, an sedoed. Igi sibad-machergana, degi, sibad-wawaad-machergana, e-oburgwileged-negse seleddae, debayobi an sedoed.
”¡Be dakena! Babilonia-neggwebur napneg-naidgi-nuga-nika-siidi, igi bergus-sii be dake. Igi dule-baiganse sabsuli-sules be dake. Be dake, igi Babilonia-yala, dulemar-baiganga dobed-yalaga-gude be dake.
E-isdarmaladi Babiloniaʼgi demaryobi mulusad. Demar-weleganyobi egi arwisad.
Babilonia-neggweburmar bela olloo nagusad. Nega-dinnaregedyobi-dakle nagusad, nega-dulesulidyob-dakle nagusad. Dulemar bar egi bukwasulid, a-yalagi dulemar gwen bar iirmakbuksulid.
Babiloniaʼgine an bab-dummad-Bel sabsuli-odurdakoed. Ibmar-dosadi gannar agega an imakoed. Dulemar-baigan bar ese dagosurmalad, degine, Babilonia-galu-matusulid-akwabiid bela ayaroed.
”¡Mimmigan, Babiloniaʼgi be ainimar! Na be wala-walagwengi Bab-Dummad-urwedgi be san bendakmalo.
Neggweburgine, dulemar-sunmakedgi, melle dobgumalo, melle gegegwa be itomalo. Birga-ilibali gayaburbamar baid-baid ainimai guoed. Babilonia-yalagi galagwensuli-neg-gued-gaya ainimai guoed, Dummagan-negsemaladi na muchub-muchub yolenanai gumaloed.
Babilonia-bab-dummagan-obelogoed-ibagan bato omosad. Bela Babilonia-yala bingegunai guoed, muimarbi yala-enosa naguoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Babilonia-galakuoedga, nibnega, napnega, degi, bela egi ibmarmar-bukwadi, weligwaledba binnasuli namakmaloed. Ar e-isdarmaladi dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsiki Babiloniaʼgi danimaloed.
”Babilonia-dulemala, Israel-dulemar-oburgwisadbali, oburgwilemarmogargebed. Degine, bukidar dulemar-baigan-oburgwisbalidbali, Babilonia-dulemar oburgwilemarmogargebed.
Israel-dulemar, be es-suidgi-burgwissurmaladi, gwae be wakitemala. Ar bemar dikasuli be bukwamalale, Bab-Jehová-nug be odummomalo. Melle Jerusalén-neggwebur be iemarbalo.”
Bemar sogmalad: “Anmargi dulemar isdar-sunmake-itogedba anmar bingedar itoye. Anmar-mesagwar-imaklegedi anmar-wagar-gisii imakye. Ar dule-bamaladi bese-goled-negse dogsamalad-ulale, anmar bingedar itoye.”
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová soged: “Ibagan danikid, a-ibagi, an Babilonia-bab-dummagan obelogoed. Babilonia-yalagine dulemar-naibigumaloedi bukidara akigitemaloed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar Babilonia amba e-galu-matusulid-akwabiidi nibnegse imakye-sogele, degi, nibali e-bubawarmar ogwisye-sogele, amba an e-obelogega e-isdarmaladi an egi barmidoed.
”Babilonia-yala-akale, binnasuli e-dulemar-sabsurgunaidba-bobukwadi magar itoleged.
Bab-Jehová Babilonia-yala bela obelonaid, dulemar-oimakbukwad bela obelonaid. Babilonia-e-isdarmaladi demar-mullugan-uurmakmaiyobi, e-dolewar binnasuli uurmakbukwad.
Babilonia-e-isdarmaladi Babilonia-yala-obelogega, egi gwichigudanimalad. Babilonia-sordamar-bulegan bela galemaloed, e-sigumala bela ei bibisgelegoed. Ar Bab-Dummad-Jehová dulemar na e-odurdaklemaloedbali ega ibmar imaked.”
Ani an Rey-guedi, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged: “Babilonia-e-dummagan, degi, e-binsaed-ibegan, an omumsaoed. Ega-negsemamaid, an omumsaoed. E-sordamar-dummagan, degi, e-sorda-bila-onomaladi an omumsabaloed. We-dulemar degisadegu gabidmaloed, bali gannale atakosurmalad.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged: “Babilonia-galu-matusulid-akwabiid e-mata-dummad, bela nagase babatoed. Degi, e-yawagak-matusurmaladi ogumaklegoed. Dulemar binsarsunna alamaksamalad, degine, binsarsunna gar-itosmalad, unnila sooga alamaksamalad.”
Weyobi Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Jeremías, Nerías-machi-Seraíasʼga igar uksad. Deunni, Sedequías birgabakegus-negsemaidgined. Seraías, Judá-rey-Sedequíasʼbo Babiloniaʼse nadmalad. Agine Seraías dulemar-idumai gusad. Seraíasʼde Maasías-wagwad.
Jeremías bela Babiloniaʼgi boni-dummagan-danikoedi garda-suid-bipirmakaledgi narmaksagusad. Wegisundo, Babilonia-yalagi ibmarmar-gumaloedi bela narmaklesad.
Jeremías, Seraíasʼga weyob sogsad: “Babiloniaʼse be modapile, bela we-gardagi ibmarmar-sognaid be absogo.
”Seraías, geb a-sorbali, Bab-Jehováʼga weyob be sogo: ‘Bab-Jehováʼye, bede sogsa gusad: Ani an bela we-yala obelogoye, degisadegu ollobi-nai an imakoye. Dulemar, bipisaale bar urbega an imakosurye, degine, ibmar-durganse-bakale, dulemarba ambikuosurye. Bela ibmar-sate guoye, be sogsad.’
”Bela be we-garda-suid-bipirmakaled-absosale, egine be akwa edinno. Geb agine Éufrates-diwargine be a-garda metoed.
Geb a-sorbali, be weyob sogo: ‘Igi we-garda dii-ulak-dogde, deyobi, Babilonia-yala dogdemogoed, bipisaale bar gannale Bab-Dummad egi bonigan barmidagoedgi san-onogosulid.’ ” Wesega Jeremías-sunmaksadi bergunaid.
Sedequías gebe-yar-seargu, deun birga-durgwen-gakagwensak (21) nikad. Degi, Jerusalénʼgi birgambe-gakagwensak (11) yar-sesad. E-nana Hamutalʼye nugad. Hamutalʼde Jeremías-Libnaʼgined-e-sisgwad.
Sedequías Bab-Jehová-ibmar-abemaisulidi, Bab-Dummad-asabin imaksad. Ar ade, Joacim-ibmar-imaksadba ibmar imaksamogad.
Degidbali, Bab-Jehová sae-itogedbali, Jerusalén-dulemar e-asabinni ononnosad, degi, Judá-dulemar e-asabinni ononnosbalid. Geb a-sorbali, Sedequías Babilonia-reygi gwichigude gusad.
Babilonia-dulemar-e-rey, Nabucodonosor Sedequías-birgabakebakgus Judá-yar-semaidgi, Tebet-nii-yoid-ibambegwadgi, Jerusalénʼgi-gwichiguega, Jerusalén-neggweburse sorda-bila-onomalad-abargi aligusad. Geb bela Jerusalén-neggwebur-ebilis ambakusmalad. Degine, egi gwichigumalaga neggwebur-dikarba napa-nakwemaid sobsamalad.
Babilonia-sordamar birgabo Jerusalén-neggwebur-ebilis ambikusad. Deunni, Sedequías birgambe-gakagwensakgus (11) reyga maidgined.
Amba a-birga-naidgi, nii-warbaked-ibabakebakgi, bela-belad ukud-dummad Jerusalén-neggweburgi nagunonikid. Degisoggu, neggweburgine dulemarga masgunned sate gunonikid.
Geb degine, Jerusalén-dulemar galu-matusulid-akwabiid neggwebur-ebirnaidgi yaa ollomaksamalad. Ar Babilonia-sorda-bila-onomalad neggwebur-ebilis-bukwa-inigwele, degite, a-mutiki, rey, degi, e-sordaganmala, neggweburgi wakitemalad. Agine, galu-matusulid-darbogwad-imbagi yawagak-siidba rey-dutugalu-naidsik ainidmalad. Arabá-igarba wakitemalad.
Degi-inigwele, Babilonia-sordamar, Rey-Sedequías-balegite gusmalad, geb, Jericó-nebagi bargadapmalad. Bela Sedequías-sorda-bila-onomalad, Sedequías-idu duurmakdemalad.
Geb Babilonia-sordamar, Rey-Sedequías-gasmargu, Hamat-yarse Ribla-neggweburse Babilonia-e-reyse sesmalad. Agi ega Rey-Nabucodonosor odurdaklegoed-igar mesisad.
Geb Babilonia-rey, Sedequías-wagab, Sedequías-mimmigan dukar-egwannar oburgwismalad. Deyobi, Judá-dulemar-nuga-nikamalad oburgwilesmarmogad.
Geb a-sorbali, Babilonia-rey, Sedequías-ibe ibya-onomalaga imaksad, degine, esgoro-gordikid-dubgi-edinnega imaksabalid, adi, Babilonia-yarse sedmalagar. Agine, Sedequías e-burgwedse esgaryagi mellesii gusad.
Nabucodonosor birgambe-gakabakebakgus Babilonia-yar-semaidgi, nii-walataled-ibambegi, dule-nakulemalad-e-dummad Nabuzaradánʼye-nugadi Jerusalén-neggweburse nonigusad. Nabuzaradánʼde Rey-Nabucodonosorʼga arbaedid.
Nabuzaradán, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-siid ogumaksad, degi, reyneg-siid ogumaksabalid. Degine, negmar-bukwad bela ogumaksanaed, deginbali, sapin-dummagan-arbamalad-e-negmar, bela ogumaksabalid.
Degi, Babilonia-sorda-bila-onomalad Nabuzaradánʼba-gudimarmogadi, galu-matusulid-akwabiid Jerusalén-neggwebur-ebirnaid bela wawannismalad.
Deginbali, Nabuzaradán bela Jerusalén-neggweburgi napi-dulemar-besmaladi Babilonia-yarse sesad. Amardi, wemalad: Dule-ibmar-sobedgi-arbamalad, dulemar-rey-Nabucodonosorʼba-nagusmalad, bela sesad.
Nabuzaradánʼdi dule-wileganabi napi-obesad. Adi, uva-nainumar-akwega, degi, nainumargi ibmar-digega obesad.
Babilonia-sordamar, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-buarmar-esgoro-gordikidgi-sobaledi bibichismalad, degi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi argan-enuked-dii-simalad esgoro-gordikidgi-sobarmalad bela ogoamaksamarbalid, degine, dii-sied-dummad esgoro-gordikidgi-sobaled ogoamaksamarbalid. Geb Babilonia-yarse esgoro-gordikid sesmalad.
Deginbali, bormomar, degi, bormo-buru-wemalad, gwillo-dub-siked-dislamar, degi, nog-dummagan, degine, buru-weemaladi, sesmarbalid. Degine, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi bela ibmar-ebulemalad esgoro-gordikidgi-sobarmalad, bela Babilonia-yalase sesmalad.
De-ukinbali, sorda-bila-onomalad-e-dummad-Nabuzaradán, san-gamalad-iko-dummagan sesbalid. Sianarmar, nog-dummagan-abe-bomimalad, nog-suigan, bormomar, gwallu-simalad, degine, nog-baigan, sesbalid. Bela-ibmarmar-olobimalad, degine, manibimaladi, sesbalid.
Bab-Dummadse-goled-negga Salomón, buarmar-warbo esgoro-gordikidbiid-sobsagusadi, degi, dii-sied-dummad-e-urbali moli-bebe-nikad warambe-gakabo-siidi (12), degi, argan-enuked-dii-simalad-sobsagusadi, bela-belad aidikusoggu, e-aidikued wisguledsulid.
Buarmar dalibake-binasgarse sugu-sugu nanaed, e-wardunguedi daligwen-bisgise dungued, e-songuedi goo-walabake-wilub songubalid. E-yaabali yaa-olloo siid.
Buar-nono-e-esgoro-gordikidbi-sobaledi buar-nono-birgi-siidi, daligwen-gaka-bisgise sugued, degine, e-gakuligine guseb-dummaganyobi esgoro-gordikidbi sobarnanaid, geb a-sobaled-uki sakiyob ebilis naibalid. Buarmar-warbogwadgi ibmar-sobar-nanaidi bela emarbi dakleged.
Buar-wargwengine, gwadulabake-gakambe-gakanergwa (96) guseb-dummaganyob magar-dakle nanaid. Bela saki-dikarba guseb-dummaganyob-nanaidi gwadulatar (100) mergued.
Degine, sorda-bila-onomalad-e-dummad-Nabuzaradán, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummad-Seraías gasbalid. Nabuzaradán, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-sorbalid-Sofonías, degi, dule-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-yawagak-dakmalad walapaa gasbalid.
Geb degi, Nabuzaradán, Jerusalén-neggweburgi sorda-bila-onomalad-daked-gwensak gasbalid. Degine, walagugle (7) dule-reyga-ibmar-imakdimalad neggweburgi-gudimaladi gasbalid. Deginbali, sorda-bila-onomaladga-garda-narmaked-idued gasbalid, a-dule, dulemar-nug-semaidid. De-ukinbali, Nabuzaradán, dule-neggweburgi-gudimalad-dulapaa (60) gasbalid.
Sorda-bila-onomalad-e-dummad-Nabuzaradán dulemar-gasgu, Ribla-neggweburse Babilonia-e-rey-maidse sesad.
Geb Rey-Nabucodonosor, Hamat-yargi-neggwebur-Ribla-siidgi, dulemar-oburgoye sogsad. Weyobi, Judá-dulemar galesa e-neggweburgi selesgusad.
Dulemar Nabucodonosorʼse weyob-mergue gales-selesmalad: Nabucodonosor birga-guglegus (7) Babiloniaʼgi reyga-maidgine, milipaa gaka dulagwen-gakapaa (3,023) Judío-dulemar gasa sesagusad.
Geb birgambe-gakabaabakgus (18) Babiloniaʼgi reyga-maidgine, Nabucodonosor Jerusalén-dulemar dulataled-ilabaabak gaka dulagwen-gakambe-gakabo (832) gasa sesagusbalid.
Nabucodonosor birga-dulagwen-gakapaagus (23) reyga-maidgine sorda-bila-onomalad-e-dummad-Nabuzaradán, Judá-machergan dulataled-ilagugle gaka dulabo-gakatar (745) gasa, Babiloniaʼse segagusad. Bela dulemar, milibake gaka dulataled-ilanergwa (4,600) galesa selesgusad.
Babilonia-e-rey-Evil-Merodac, birgagwengus gaka iba-durgwen-gakatar-megidagedgi, Judá-e-rey-Joaquín esgaryagi-mellesiid onosad. Deunni, birga-durgwen-gakambe-gaka-guglegus (37), Joaquín, Babilonia-neggweburse galesa selenonigusad-akaled.
Geb, Evil-Merodac, nueganbi Joaquín-akwisad, degi geb, Evil-Merodac, e-sorda-reymar-imbagi, Joaquín dummadga Babilonia-neggweburgi osisad.
Deginbali, Joaquín, esgaryagi-mor-yoleged bar-yossulid, degi, rey-imbagi bane-bane mas-gundii gusad.
De-ukinbali, Rey-Evil-Merodac, bane-bane Joaquínʼga ibmar-abelemalad-bakega mani-ukdii gusad. Deyobi, Joaquín burwa-dulega-gued-ibase nanadii gusad.
Sión-neggwebur dulemar-bukidar-nikagusanad, emidi, ibiyobi walagwen-ganna sigisa. Jerusalén-neggwebur, neggwebur-bamaladba-bur-nuga-nika-sigisanad, emidi, ome-ei-sui-burgwisadyobi siid. Jerusalén-neggwebur, neggwebur-bamalad-e-dummadga-sigisanad, emidi, neggwebur-bamalad-e-maiga siid.
Mutikidbali, naibid-dummad-itogedbali bela-bela boed, e-wagarbali e-ibyanis suurmakmaid. Dulemar-nue-sabye-sogdimalad-abargi, e-gwage-baisur-ito-imakedi, wargwensaale sated. Bela e-aimar egi aibichamalad, e-isdarmaladga gunonimalad.
Judá-dulemar esgoro-dubgi-atinnale, yar-baidse gales selesmalad. Dule-ainebarmalad-abalagi-gudidimalad, gwen obunnoged amisurmalad. Bela-balegindimalad, Judá-dulemar-bargasmalad, sabsur-odurdaksamalad.
Sión-neggweburse-naega igarmar-mamaidi, wiles dakleged, ar e-itoakwaa-ibagan-onolegedse dulemar bar nanasurmalad. Bela e-yawagakmar bergus gwigwichid. E-dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad bodimalad. E-yagana, wile itodimalad. Jerusalén-neggweburgi bela nunmakedbi neg-nagusad.
E-isdarmalad, e-dummaganga gunonimalad, e-isdar-dakmalad, ibmar bur bule nikudmalad. E-isgued-bukidar-nikad-ulale, Jerusalén-dulemar Bab-Dummadse sabsur-odurdaklenonimalad. E-mimmigan gales aineba selesmalad, e-isdarmaladse ebipilesmalad.
Sión-neggwebur epenne e-yeerdaklesigusadi, bela bergunonikid. E-dummagan, goe-sapur-gagan-maega-amididamaladyob gaamakdimalad. E-balegindimalad-abin geggus wakitemalad.
Jerusalén-neggwebur, e-ibagan-isgana-nasad ebinsaed, e-dulemar-gales-selemamaigusad, ebinsaed. Epenne bela-ibmar-nuegan-bukidar-nikagusad, ebinsaed. E-dulemar, e-isdarmaladse-galesmargua, dule-bamalad gwen bendaksasulid. E-isdarmalad, Jerusalén-dulemar-galakus-daksagua, egi dodonai gusmalad.
Jerusalén-neggwebur bela-bela isgusad. A-ulale, ib-isganaga gunonikid. Jerusalén-neggwebur-ayaris-sii-dakarmargua, dulemar, iduar Jerusalén-nug-odummodimalad, emidi, isdar dakmalad. Jerusalén-dulemar na boed, binge-itogedba na wagar odukued.
Bela e-mor nue-isgusad, na e-berguoedgi binsassulid. Ukiagwar oitolenonikid, dule-bamalad gwen-wile daksasulid. Emidi, soged: “Bab-Jehováʼye, an-wile-itoged be dake. An-isdarmalad angi obichad.”
Jerusalén-neggwebur e-ibmar-nuegan-nikadi, e-isdarad bela e-ibe susad, E-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi, dulemar-Bab-Dummad-akudakmalad-ubosmalad Jerusalén-dulemar daksamalad. Bab-Jehová, be a-dulemarga igar-mesisanad, mer an-igar-itoged-negse dogmaloye.
Bela Jerusalén-dulemar bodimalad, masgunned amidimalad. Na dulagudigumalaga, e-ibmar-bur-nuegan masbina ogwaed. Ise-boale sogmalad: “Bab-Jehováʼye, be dake, ibiyobi an-wionanai.”
Sogdebalid: “Bemar-igarba-nadapmalad, be an-dakmala, ¿gwen-bai be an-daksuli? Bab-Dummad-sabsur-an-wionaiyobi, ¿bia be deyob dule-wilenai daksamala? Ar Bab-Jehová na nue-uludgua, we-nunmaked anga barminonikid.
”Bab-Jehová, nibneg-akale, soo barmialid. A-soo, garmarse-bakale, an-ogumaksad. An-iduale, saki nasiksad, gannar sikirmakega an-imaksad. Walagwen an-meted, bali-bali nunmaked-itogega an-imaksad.
”Bab-Jehová-sunnad an-isgued oatosad, an-isgued akwa-dummad-aidikuedyob angi naid. An-dukarba anga nasiksad, an-gargangued nolloo imaksad. Bab-Jehová, an-isdarmaladga an-urmaksad, an geg amar-abin-imaked.
”Bab-Jehová, an-neggweburgi bela sordamar-bulegan onisad. Angi yolemalagala, dule-bamaladse gochad, an-sapingan-oitogegala, dule-baiganse gochad. Igi uva-nis-egurega uva-birgi annaledae, deyobi Bab-Jehová, Judá-e-bunamala imaksad.
”Bela we-ibmala boega an-imaked, boedba nue an ataksurgusad. Dule-an-gwage-baisur-ito-imaked an-walik gudisulid, dule-wis-gadi-gadi-an-imaked, an daksulid. Ar an-isdarmalad anmargi nakwissoggu, an-mimmigan wargwen melledmarsunnad.”
Sión-dulemar, bendaklegegala gornanaid, ar dule-e-gwage-baisur-ito-imaked sated. Bab-Jehová-igar-mesnonikidba, Jacob-yar-naid-dikarba-neggwebur-bukmalad, emidi, Jacob-e-isdarmaladga gunonikid. Jerusalén-neggwebur ibmar-durwaga gunonikid, ibmar-isganaga gunonikid.
“Bab-Jehová, innikigwadba ibmar-imakedid, ar andi, e-igar-mamaidgi aibichad. Bemar bela dulemar, nue an-itomala, an-wile-itonaid be nue dakmala. An-sapingana, bela-gales aineba selesmalad, an-bunamala, bela-gales aineba selesmalad.
”An-aimarse, an iseedi gornai gusanad, aka bur angi aibichamalad. An-dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, an-girmar-dummagan, na dulagudigumalaga mas-amidigu, neggweburgi burgwismalad.
”Bab-Jehová, an-nunmak-itonaid, be dake. An burgwe itoged. An beba bela-bela ibsassursoggu, an-gwage suli-suli-ito naded. Neg-magabali, an-mimmigan, es-suidgi oburgwilenanaid, wegi negyabali, burgwed neg-gasa naid.
”Dulemar an-gormaknaid itosmalad, ar dule-an-gwage-baisur-ito-imaked sated. Bela an-isdarmaladi, an-wilenaid wismalad, be igi-an-imaksadgi wergumalad. An igi-wilesa, deyobi wilemarmosun. Be sabsur-odurdaklemaloye-sogsagusadi, an-isdarmaladgi gwae be barmidasun.
”Bab-Jehová, bela an-isdarad-e-isgumalad be dake. An-isgusad-ular, igi be sabsur-an-odurdaksagusa, deyobi be an-isdarmalad imakmoga. Bato an bukidargus nunmaked-itodanikid, nue-angi obin an itogusad.”
Bab-Jehová na e-uludedbali, ibiyobi Sión-neggwebur-yeerdaklegedgi negsichid nasiksa. Bab-Jehová nibneg-akale, Jerusalén-neggwebur-yeerdakle-siid omukusad. Bab-Jehová e-iba-uludedgi na ese-goled-neg, we-napneggi-siideeye binsassulid.
Bab-Jehová bela Jacob-wagan-e-negmar-bukwadi, gwen-wile-daksasuli obelosad. Bab-Jehová na e-uludedbali, Judá-yar-yeerdakleged-e-neg-gandikmalad bibichisad. Bab-Jehová, Judá-e-rey-dummadga-maid-egwachadba, Judá-yar-nug bipii imaksad. Judá-e-dummaganga-mamaid-egwachadba, Judá-yar-nug bipii imaksad.
Bab-Jehová, uludgua, bela Israel-e-gargangued obelosad. Anmar an-isdarmaladbo-urwenaigua, Bab-Jehová anmar-bendaksasulid. Soo-dummad-bela-ibmar-obelogedyobi, Jacob-e-yar-naidgi soo ogasad.
Bab-Jehová anmar-isdaradyob warsi guagwar gasad, e-swida-nuedsikid guagwar oyosgwichid. Bab-Jehová anmar-isdaradyob, anmar-gwenadgan-ogilosad. Bab-Jehová na e-urwedi, sooyobi Sión-yeerdakleged-e-negmargi odesad.
Bab-Jehová anmar-isdaradyob na imaked: Israel-yar obelosad. Bela Israel-e-reynegmar bibichisad, Israel-e-neg-gandikmalad omukusad. Bab-Jehová Judá-yar-yeerdaklegedgi boedbi, wile-itolegedbi, neg nasiksad.
Bab-Jehová e-maid-neg sosganeg-siiyobi earisad, e-onmakedneg-siidi omukusad. Bab-Jehová, Sión-dulemar na e-iba-itoakwaa-onoleged-iegega imaksad, e-obunnoged-iba-iegega imaksad. Bab-Jehová nue-uludedbali, rey-maid obachad. Dule-irwa-ese-goled obachad.
Bab-Jehová, na e-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila obachad, na e-neg-islidikid isdar daksad. E-reynegmar-e-galumar, e-isdarmaladga urmaksad. E-isdarmalad, iba-dummad-nonaiyob, Bab-Jehová-neggi oimakdemalad,
Bab-Jehová, Sión-neggwebur-yeerdakleged-e-galu-matusur-ebirmaidi, omukuedgi binsasad. Obeloged-igar ilemakar mesisad, gwen-wile-daksasuli galu-matusur-maid obelosad. E-arsanyob-maidgi, e-galumar-birgi nunmak-itoged nagusad, bela we-ibmarmar malusad.
Jerusalén-neggwebur-e-yawagakmar bela aimukusad, Bab-Jehová bela yawagak-edimalad bibichisad. Jerusalén-e-rey yar-baidsik yoggus gudiid, e-sapin-dummagan, yar-baidsik yoggus gudidimalad. Bab-Dummad-igar bergusad, Bab-Jehová, e-gayaburba-barsogmaladga bar negburgan oyossulid.
Sión-neggwebur-yeerdaklegedgi girmar-dummagan, napayala bogidik sigismalad. Girmar-dummagan, nunmak-itogedba na e-nonogine, sogun-buru eosmalad, wile-itoleged-mor yosmalad. Bunamala-Jerusalénʼginmalad, bingedbali, napase dulluu nono imaksamalad.
Boedbali, bar an nue ataksurgusad, an bela-bela gwage nunmak itoged. An-neggwebur-ibitosadbali, an-niga bela argwachad. Burwigana, degi, goemala, neg-imbabali, burgwemamaid.
Burwigana e-nanganse egichardamalad: “¿Bia masde? ¿Bia gobedde?” Mas-satedbali, burwigana neg-imbabali, binna-binna burgwiddamalad. E-nan-nukugi napi-bunnomai burgwiddamalad.
Jerusalén-yeerdakleged, ¿ibu an begi obarosunna? ¿Doabogwa an be-wilubsaosunna? Jerusalén-neggwebur-swilidikid, be-gwage-baisur-itogega, ¿ibu an bega oyogergebe? Be-naibi-gusad, demar-wiladyob gued. ¿Doa gannar be-nudakoe?
Be-Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad, gakansaale negburgan-daksad bega sogsamalad, be-yardakale bega sogsamalad. Be-isgued gwen barsogsasurmalad, melle be-gamalaga gwen be-bendaksasurmalad. Bemarga gayaburba-gakansaaled sogsamalad, a-gayaburbagi, melle be bensuliguega be-imaksamalad.
Dulemar-igarba-nadapmalad, be-dakarmalale, begi dodoar argan ogotedamalad. Jerusalén-neggwebur-yeerdakleged, be-asabin akar-akar gunanadaed. Wigoar-wigoar sognanaidaed: “¿Ar we-neggwebur nue-yeerdaklegedye sogmaladi? ¿Ar we-neggwebur, bela napneg-yeer-ito-imakedye sogmaladi?”
Jerusalén-dulemar, bela be-isdarmalad begi-sunmakdemalale, begi isdar sunmakdedamalad. Nue-sae-be-dake, dodoar weyob sognanaid: “Anmarse dula dolesad. Anmar bela-bela-iba-edarbediid nonikid, anmar-sunnad daksasunnad.”
Bab-Jehová ibmar-imakega na igar-amisadi, sogedba imaksad, na dikasurgus ibmar-sogsadi, bela imaksad. Bab-Jehová be-wiledaksasuli, be-obelosad, be-isdarmalad begi-dodogega imaksad, begi-yolenanaid-e-gangued ogannosad.
Sión-dulemar, Bab-Dummadse, ise-wilegar gornanaid. Sión-neggwebur-yeerdakleged-galu-matusulid-nika-siid, mutikidbali, ibginedbali, diwaryobi be-ibyanis aryomai be imake. Mer be boed bogigue, mer be be-ibyanis-aryomaid bogiguega imake.
Be gwisgue, mutikidbali be ise-gollar imake, wachi-iliba be ise-gollar imake. Bab-Jehová-asabin ibmar-ukleged-uknaiyob, gwage-nunmaked-itogedbali na be bosii imake. Be-mimmigan-mer-burgwegala, Bab-Dummadse argan-onakwar be gorsii imake. Be-mimmigan ukudbali burgwemamaid, neg-imbaba burgwis mellemamaid.
“Bab-Jehováʼye, be dake, nue be itogena: ¿Doa-dule be weyob imaksagusa? ¿Ar omegan na e-mimmigan gunmarsunnode? ¿Na e-mimmigan-egi-danimalad gunmarsunnode? Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neggi, ¿ar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad oburgwilemalode? ¿Ar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad oburgwilemalode?
”Sapingana, degi, dule-serganse-bakale, neg-imbaba burgwar mellemamaid. An-sapingana, degi, an-yagana, es-suidgi oburgwilesmalad. Be-uludedbali, be wemar oburgwisad, bela-bela-wiledaksuli, be wemar oburgwisad.
”Iba-dummad-onolegedse-danimalayob bela bonigan angi dagega be imaksad. Bab-Jehová-Ulusad-ibagi, dule-wargwensaale, san-onossulid, bela burgwismalad. An-gwenadgan an odummosadi, an ibmargi-odurdaksagusadi, an-isdarmalad, bela an-ibe ogilosad.”
An-sunnagwad, Bab-Jehová-uludedbali sabsur-dule-odurdaked an itosad.
Negsichiganaba an-nimai gusad, neg-meegwadba an-nimai gussulid.
Bali-bali, wachi-iliba, sabsur-an-odurdaknai gusad.
Bab-Jehová, an-san, degi, an-uka-dunnumakega imaksad, an-ibe an-garmar bibichisad.
Bab-Jehová angi bonigan ebiris nasiksad, angi wileged-dummad ebiris nasiksad.
Dulemar-undargus-burgwismaladyob, negsichigangi-gudiguega an-imaked.
Bab-Jehová negyaba-mellesii an-imaksad, gege an wakinned, esgoro-dub-dummagangi an-edichad.
An-bendakegala, an binnasuli gornai-inigwele, Bab-Jehová an-ese-gornaid budar an-itoged.
An-iduar, an-igargi akwamar misad, an-ibe an-igar oburusad.
Bab-Jehová, wiob mas-gaega matarmakdiidyobi anbina gudiid, achumigur-nono-wawaad masbina matarmakdiidyobi anbina gudiid.
An-san-oichimakega igargi an-obachad, mer bendakleged-amiega, walagwen an-obesad.
Guagwar warsi-gasad, e-sigumar an-makega imaksad.
E-saboged-yaba sigumar-onosadgi gwagegi an-maksad.
Bela an-dulemarga an dodoedga gunonikid, bane-bane angi-dodolegar namakmalad.
Bab-Jehová nunmaked-dummad anga uksad, ina-gagbidgi an-ogobsad.
Bab-Jehová napagi an-omukusad, olli-maega an-imaksad.
Gwage-bogidikid an-ibe obelosad, weligwar-itoleged bar an ebinsasulid.
A-ulale, an soged: “An-gargangued bergusad, Bab-Dummadgi an ibmar-edarbediid bar an dakosulid.”
An-wile-itodiid, an-neg-sate-gaamakdiid, be ebinsao. Ar we-ibmarmar, naibid-dummad anga uked.
Bane-bane an we-ibmargi binsadiid, a-ulale, bar an ibmar imakbisuli itoged.
Degi-inigwele, an ibmar-soggwendi ebinsaed, we, mer suli-suli-itogega an-imaked.
Bab-Jehová-sabgued-dummad-nikad-ular, anmar bergussulid, e-wile-emar-daked gege bergued.
Bab-Jehová-e-wile-emar-daked bane-bane binoleged. Bab-Jehová-sogedba-ibmar-imaked dummarba gued.
Degisoggu, an soged: “Bab-Jehováʼbi anga unni gued, agala, an egi bensulid.”
Bab-Jehová, dule-egi-bensur-gudimaladgi nued daed, bela dule-e-amidimaladgi nued daed.
Bur-nuedid, anmar doga-doga-itosulidgi, Bab-Jehová-anmar-bendakdagoed edarbed.
Bur-nuedid, dule sapingwagwad-akale, bonigan-abalagi ganna-gudigued durdaked.
Melle ese be gole, itoba bogidik sigoed, ar Bab-Jehová deyob ega igar mesisad.
Nue-bingegusa, wagar napase dulluu imakoed, abakale, amba Bab-Dummad e-bendakalile.
Dule-e-ibe-wagar-bibyonaidga, baid-wagar oyobalo, deyobi, nue bingeguoed.
Bab-Jehová anmar-obachad, degi-inigwele, deyob-anmar-imakmai sadeguosulid.
Nunmak-itoge anmar-imaked, degi-inigwele, anmar-wile dakbalid, ar e-sabgued dummarba gued.
Bab-Jehová anmar-naibi imaked, anmar-wile-ito imaked, ar deyob-anmar-imakedgi wergudeeye soglesulid.
Bab-Jehová weyob-ibmar-imaklemalad abemaisulid: We-napneggi bela-dulemar-esgaryagi-mellebukwad sabsur-imakleged, abemaisulid.
Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-asabin dulega-igar-nabolesulid, abemaisulid.
Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-asabin dulega-innikigwadba-igar-itolesulid, abemaisulid.
¿Doa Bab-Dummad-ega-igar-uksuli ibmar-soged nabir imakoe?
¿Ar Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-igar-ukedbali ibmar-nuegan, degi, ibmar-isgana gusursi?
¿Ar ibiga dule na e-isgusadba sabsur-odurdaklealir urwedii guoe?
Anmar na anmar-daedgi nue-binsasii imakmala, anmar Bab-Jehová-amimala, gannar ese dagmala.
Anmar, Bab-Dummad-nibneggi-maidse-golega argan onakwe. Anmar, Bab-Dummad-nibneggi-maidga anmar-binsaed soge.
Anmar isgusad, anmar uayasuli nanadii gusad, Bab-Jehová, be anmarga anmar-isgued elissulid.
Bab-Jehová, be nue-urwedbali be anmar-baleginned, wile-be-anmar-daksuli, be anmar-obeloged.
Anmar-bese-goled mer be itogegala, be mogir-imbaba dukusad.
Dulemar-yar-baid-baid-bukwamalad-abargine, ibmar-isganayob be anmar-barmeted.
Bela-anmar-isdarmalad sunmakdemalale, anmargi ichakwaa sunmakdedamalad.
Anmar, dobgued-dummad itosmalad. Anmar, omukulesmalad. Anmar, ibmar-sate gusmalad. Anmar, nunmaked-dummad itosad.
An-neggwebur-e-saila-gusiid-nue-ibitosadbali, an-wagarba diwar-aryomaiyob ibyanis aryomaid.
An-ibyanis gwen bogigusuli aryomaid, dule-an-gwage-baisur-ito-imaked sated.
Bab-Jehová nibneggi-maid-akale, geb anmar-dakedse an gadi-gadi itononikoed.
An-neggweburgi-omegan-gudidiid sabsur-odurdaklenaid-ulale, bela-bela an-gwage an nunmak itoged.
An ibmar-akar-imaksasuli an-isdarmalad binsa an-baleginnanaid, nuuyobi an-gasmalad.
Dula napa-urba an-odosmalad, an-iduar noed akwa-dummadgi edismalad.
Bela diiba an-nono-dogdegua, an na belaye sogded.
Bab-Jehová, an dia-dummadgi gulluyaa mellesigua, an bese gochagusad.
An-bese-wilesagwa-gornaid be itosad, an-ise-gollar-gornaid be itononikid.
An bese gochad, be anse nonikid, be anga sognonikid: “Mer be dobguye.”
Bab-Jehová, bee be anbali nagusad, be an-bendaksad.
Bab-Jehová, nue-an-wiosmalad be daksad, be anga innikigwadba igar nudake.
Buged-mai angi-imakbimalad be daksad, an-oakalobimalad be daksad.
Bab-Jehová, dule-angi-urwe-nanaid be itosad, an-oakalobimalad be daksad.
Bab-Jehová, an-isdarmalad angi-sunmaknanai-osedoddaed be wisid, angi-gwisgumalaga igar-aminanaid be wisid.
Bab-Jehová, be dake, na ibu imaknanadibe, angi dodonanadamalad, e-namakedgi angi-dodoar namakmalad.
Bab-Jehová, wemar na bela e-ibmar-isgana-imaksad-ulale, be sabsur-odurdake.
Ibmar-aku-itogega be imake, be ukabsasunna.
Bab-Jehová, be-sae-itogedbali be wemar baleginne, we-napneggi be bela obeloge.
¡Or gudure daklegusad! ¡Or-nued e-gaed bar nue dakarmaksulid! Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ormar-bukwadi, bela negmar-imbaba omileded.
Sión-dulemar bur bule epenne olo-nueganba e-bina soglegenad, emidi, napsa-nogyob daklemalad, dule-napsagi-arbaed e-ibmar-imakedyob dakleged.
Achu-sapurmarbela na e-mimmigan-onuegala ega mam uked. Ar Jerusalén-omegandina, igi nuu-dummad-dukar-suidmar dule-negasulidganba na e-mimmigan-mete-naddamala, deyobi, e-mimmigan metemalad.
Burwigana ukudmaad-itogedbali, e-gwabinmar achaa gayagi nagusad. Burwigana aisaar mas egisenad, degi-inigwele, dule gwen ega uksulid.
Dulemar iduar mas-nuegan gundidamalanad, emidi, igarbali ukudba burgwemamaid. Dulemar iduar mor-nuegan-gargerbamalad yodamalanad, emidi, ibmar-isgana-abargine gudimalad.
Jerusalén-dulemar-e-isguedi, bur bule Sodoma-dulemar-e-isgusadba gued. Sodoma-neggwebur yog-berguar gusad, gwen dule bendaksasulid.
Jerusalén-e-dummagan, boobali bur sibudik daklenanaenad, moli-nunisba bur sibudik daklenanaenad. E-abagan akwa-bisgi-ginnigwadba bur bule gisii daklenanaenad, akwa-nued-zafiroʼyob daklemalanad.
Emidi, e-daklegedi negsichidba bur gudure daklemalad, igarbali aku daklemalad. E-uka, sapanyobi dinnaa dakleged. E-uka-dinnagwadbali e-garmar buus-buus dakleged.
Dulemar-es-suidgi-burgwismalad bur nuedid, dulemar-ukudba-burgwismaladba. Ar wemala, napaneg ega ibmar-gwag-osanmaksasulid-ulale, binna-binna ukudba burgwemamai gusmalad.
Nangan-sabed-nikamalad, na dukin e-mimmigan-dunanai gusmalad. Jerusalén-neggwebur-ibitonaigua, we-nangan na e-mimmigan masga imaksamalad.
Bab-Jehová bela-bela e-sae-itoged bar bargassulid, bela-bela e-sabsur-urwed oyosad. Sión-neggwebur ogumaksad, bela Sión-neggwebur-e-neg-sailase-bakar, ogumaksad.
Reymar-we-napneggi-negsemamaidi, Jerusalén-e-isdarmalad, Jerusalén-e-yawagakgi dognonimaloye-soglesad, bengusmalad. Dulemar-we-napneggi-gudidimaladi, Jerusalénʼgi-gwisgudidimalad, Jerusalén-e-yawagakgi dognonimaloye-soglesad, bengusmarmogad.
Neg-gunonikidi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad-e-isgusad-ulale, deyob neg-gunonikid. Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-isgusad-ulale, deyob neg-gunonikid. Neggwebur-neg-imbaba dule-ibmar-oakalossurmalad-e-ablis-eosmalad-ulale, deyob neg-gunonikid.
We-dulemar ibyasuliyob igarba gudidimalad, e-argan ablis-sunnabi gudidimalad. Deyob-gudimaladbali, dule-wargwensaale, e-morse-bakale, gwen e-ibe ebubisulid.
Dulemar iseed ega sogmalad: “Dule-swilidiksurmalad, wegi be namala. Be nomala, be nomala. Mer be anmarse achamala.” Dulemar-Bab-Dummad-akudakmalad yar-baid-baid-bukwamaladi sogmalad: “We-dulemar neg-sate gaamakdidimaladid, wakindimaladid. Wegi geg bar gudii gumalad.”
Bab-Jehová uludedba wemar-obachad, bar we-dulemargi binsassulid. Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladdeeye bar egi binsalesulid, dule-selebagusmalad bar wile daksurmarbalid.
Anmar binsarsunna bendakleged-edarbediidbali, geg nue atakgusad. Aisaale, anmar, anmar-neg-matusulid-birgi dule-gwen-anmar-bendakmalosulidsik atakgwis damalanad.
Ar anmargi nakuledidii nanaed, geg bar anmar galimbaba nanaed. Anmar-bergued modanikid, anmar-bergued-wachi bato nonikid, anmar-ibagan bato belad.
Anmar-balegindimalad, sulubagimarba bur bule nanamalad. Yalaganba anmar-balegichamalad, nega-dulesulidganba anmar-iduar dukuar bukus gusmalad.
Dule-Bab-Jehováʼse-nug-imaklesad, a-dule-isganamar-e-sakigi galesmogad. We-dule, anmar-bendakoedinad. Ar anmar we-dulegi sogdimalanad: “Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladgi, we-dule, anmar-bendakdii guoye.”
Edom-dulemar, Uz-yargi rey-bundoryob be gudimalad, be yeer-itomala, be wergumala. Ar bemar sabsur-odurdaklegedsemarmogad. Be-ibmar-nikadi bela be-ibe surgunonikoed.
Sión-neggwebur-yeerdakleged, be-sabsur-odurdakleged bergunonisunnad. Bab-Dummad aineba gales-selemai bar be-imakosulid. Bedina, Edom-dulemar, Bab-Dummad, be-isgusadbali sabsur-be-odurdaknonikoed, bela be-isgusad magar-daklege imaknonikoed.
Bab-Jehováʼye, anmar-gusadi be ebinsae, anmar-wiolenaid nue be dake.
Anmarga-ibmar-uklegoye-soglesadi, dule-bamalad anmar-ibe susad. Anmar-negmar, dule-anmar-yarginsurmalad anmar-ibe susad.
Anmar bab-sated, anmar dule-sergan-satedga gunonikid. Anmar-nangan suisuli gunonimalad.
Anmar dii-gobedi bennukergebed, anmar sapanmar bakergebed.
Anmar-balegindimaladi, bato anmar-bargadanikid. Anmar nue-geggus gudidimalad, anmar obunnoged sated.
Anmar mas-gunned-amiegala, Egipto-dulemarse argan-oyonai gualid. Anmar mas-gunned-amiegala, Asiria-dulemarse argan-oyonai gualid.
Anmar-babgan isgusmaladba burgwismalad. Anmardi, amar-isgusad-ulale, Bab-Dummadse sabsur-odurdaklesmalad.
Emide, maiga-gudidimalad, anmar-dummadga gunonimalad. Amargi anmar-onogega dule sated.
Anmar mas-amiegala, nega-dulesulidganba burgwednaga gudii gusmalad.
Anmar ukudmaad-itogedbali, uelledmalad. Anmar-abagan diopi-diopisur itoleged.
Sión-neggweburgi omegangi nue-dodolesad, Judá-neggweburmargi yagangi nue-dodolesbalid.
Anmar-dummagan argangi-atinnar bannu-bannu nasiklesmalad, anmar-dadormargi dadormardeeye gwen binsalessulid.
Anmar-sapingan ibmar-gwag-nagega imaksamalad. Burwigana sapan-gwaad-seedbali ibitodii guarmalad.
Neggwebur-yawagak-noedgi sapin-dummagan bar ambikusurmalad. Sapingan bar namaksurmalad.
Anmar bar weligwar itosulid, anmar-weligwaledgi-gwiled wile-itogedga binyenonikid.
Anmar ologurgin bar sisurgusad. ¡Anmar duledar-wiles! ¡Anmar isgusad!
Anmar gargangued bergumaid, a-ulale, anmar nolloo atakgusad.
Ar Sión-yargi bar dule gudisulid, Sión-yargine, unnila ibdurgan-sapurbarmaladbi gudinanaed.
Degi-inigwele, be Bab-Jehová, degisadegu negsemaid, be reyga degisadegu maid.
Bab-Dummad, ¿ibiga be anmar-iesdae? ¿Ibiga be undar anmar-iege?
Bab-Jehová, gannar anmar bese-dagega be anmar-imake, geb gannar anmar bese dagoed. Anmar iduar igi-gudigusa, deyob be gannar anmar-imake.
Innikigwadba be anmar-obachad, bela-bela be anmar-isdar daksad.
Dakleargua, birga-dulagwen-gakambegwadgi gaka nii-walabakegwad-ibataledgine, dulemar-gales-selesmalad-abargi Quebar-diwar-gakaba-sii, nibneg argade an dakalid. Agine, Bab-Dummad anga negburgan oyosad.
Ezequiel negburgan-daksadi, deunni, Rey-Joaquín birgatargus gaka nii-walatargus gales-seleargusad-akaled.
A-ibagangine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Buzi-machi-Ezequielʼye-nugadi, Caldea-dulemar-yargi, Quebar-diwar-gakaba gudigu, Bab-Jehová ega ibmar-sognonikid. Agi, Bab-Jehová-e-gangued egi aidenonikid.
Geb degine, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik burwa-dummad daniki, degi, soo-binnasur-gaed-abargi mogir-dummad neg-ibegwar-imakdaniki an dakalid. Soo-abargine, esgoro-gordikid-gaedyobi, ibmar gae an dakalid.
Soo-abargine ibdula walabake duleyob-daklege an dakarbalid.
A-ibdulamala, wagar darbake, sakan walabake nika nanaed.
E-malimar bela innikimakaled, e-nagmar moli-bebe-nikad-sapingwagwad-gooyob dakleged. Esgoro-gordikid-dakarmakedyobi e-nagmar dakarmaked.
E-sakanmar-urba, e-dikar-sogabakegwadgi dule-arganmar nanaid. We-ibdulamar-walabakegwadi wagarmar, degi, sakanmar nikadbimalad.
E-sakanmala na muchub-muchub egi warmaknanaid. Ar nanadmalale, geg bar sorsik namalad, unnila asabinbi darekwaa nadapdamalad.
Ibdula-walabakwegwad-e-wagarmar weyob-dakleged: Wagar-asabinnidi, dule-wagaryob dakleged. Wagar-argan-nuedsikidi, achumigur-nono-wawaad-wagaryob dakleged. Wagar-argan-sapiledsikidi, moli-bebe-nikad-wagaryob dakleged. Wagar-yarganbalidi, suluba-wagaryob dakleged.
Ibdulamar na e-sakan nallaa-imaknanaid, ibdula-baid-e-sakanbo warmaknanaid. Geb sakan-abinnid-baidgi na e-abagan-odukunanaid.
Ibdulamar-warbakegwadi asabinbi darekwaa nadapdamalad, geg bar sorsik namalad. Ar bia Bab-Dummad-Burba-niddae, abali naddamalad.
We-ibdulamar-dakarmakedi, sogun-aramaksiiyob dakleged. Ibdulamar-abargine, acha-gwallu-duurmaked-bipinmakwichiyob dakleged. Soo duurmakwichidgine, mar ibyegwichid.
Ibdulamar mala-ibyeyobi sabsur nanae, an daksad. Mala-ibyeyobi gannar noni damarbalid.
An ibdulamar-dakgwichidgine, an dakarbalid, napagi e-nagaba-e-nagaba ibmar-dirbiled-bipirmaked sii, deyob an dakarbalid
Ibmar-dirbiled-e-daklegedi, degi, e-sobaledi emarbi dakleged, emarbi sobarbalid. Akwa-nued-topacio-dakarmakeyobi dakarmakmalad. Ibmar-dirbiled-bipirmakedi, baid-ibmar-dirbiled-e-yagi yoibaliyob dakleged.
Ibmar-dirbiled-bipirmakmaladi, e-bipirmakedba bipirmaksidaed, geg bar sorsik bipirmakdaed.
Ibmar-dirbiled-gwabakegwadi, e-olasuga-gunanaid burwisur nanae an daksad. A-olasuga-gunanaidgine, bela ebilis ibyayob bubukwa an daksad. Nue-dobe an ito naded.
Ar ibdulamar nanadele, ibmar-dirbiled bipirmakdedamarmogad. Ibdulamar niba nakwidele, eba niba nakwiddamarmogad.
Ar bia Bab-Dummad-Burba niddae, abali ibdulamar naddamalad, ar ibmar-dirbiled-bipirmakmalad aba naddamarmogad, ar ade, ibdulamar-e-burba ibmar-dirbiled-bipirmakedgi maid.
Ar ibdulamar nanadmalale, ibmar-dirbiled bipirmakdedamarmogad. Ar ibdulamar boo-nagusmalale, ibmar-dirbiled-bipirmakmalad boo nagusdamarmogad. Ar ibdulamar niba nakwidele, ibmar-dirbiled-bipirmakmalad niba nakwiddamarmogad, ar ade, ibdulamar-e-burba ibmar-dirbiled-bipirmakedgi maid.
Ibdulamar-nono-birgi neg-ollor-dummadyob ise-dalallamakeyob-dakle naid. A-ibmala, yeerdakleged.
Neg-ollor-dummadyob-naid-urba, ibdulamar na e-sakan innikimakale, nallaa imakdedamalad. E-sakanmar, ibdula-baid-e-sakanbo warmaknanaid. Geb sakan-abinnid-baidgi na e-abagan-odukunanai an daksad.
E-nanamaladbali, e-sakanmar-goled an itosad. E-sakanmar-mermermakedba-goledi diwar-uurmakeyob gole an itosad. Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-binnasur-sunmakedyobi, gole an itosad. Dule-bukidar-oimakbukwadyob, e-sakanmar gole an itosad. Sorda-bila-onomalad-oimakbukwadyob, gole an itosad. Ibdulamar na boo-nagusmalale, e-sakan odeddamalad.
Ibdulamar na e-sakan-odesmaladba boo-nagusale, e-nono-birgi neg-ollor-dummadyob-naid-birgi gayaburba gollardaed.
Neg-olloled-dummad-naid-birgi rey-gan siid. Akwa-nued-zafiroʼgi-sobaledyob-daklege siid. Zafiro-ganayob-daklegedgine ibmar duleyob-daklege sii an daksad.
Ibmar duleyob-daklegedgi e-sader-akar, nonosega, soo-yagi esgoro-gordikid-dakarmakeyob, dakarmake an daksad. Geb e-sader-akar e-naga-dukusega, sooyobi ibmar-gae an daksad. Bela ebilis neg-mee nai an daksad.
Igi dii-wisale, sue megnonidae, deyobi bela ebilis neg-meegwad nai an daksad. Weyobi, Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-yeerdaklegedi an daksad. Deyob an daksagua, yokorgi-sindigale, napase-dulluu wagar-ebulegedse an imaksad. Geb dule anga-sunmake an itosad.
Bab-Jehová weyob anga soged: “Dule-machi, be gwisgue. An bebo sunmakgwelo.”
Anga-sunmaksad-sorbali, Bab-Dummad-Burba angi ubononikid, gwisguega an-imaksad. Geb degine, dule-anga-sunmaknaid an itosad.
Anga sogded: “Dule-machi, Israel-dulemarse an be-barminaid. We-dulemar uaya-satemalad, angi yoledmalad. We-dulemala, degi, e-dadganse-bakale, emi-ibadse angi yoledanigumalad.
”Dulemar-aku-ibmar-itomaladse, dulemar-gwage-dutusurmaladse an be-barminaid, amarga be sogoed: ‘Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob sogye.’
”Ar we-dulemar beba ibsamalodibe, surbardibe, ar ade, dule-uayasatemaladid. Degi-inigwele, na wisgumaloed, emar-abargi Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged gudiiye.
Dule-machi, melle be we-dulemar-dobgue, e-sunmakmalad melle be dobgubali. Ar be iko-abargi, degi, diormar-abargi amba be gudii-inigwele, melle be we-dulemar-dobgue. E-ibmar-sogmalad melle be dobgue, degi, wemar-abin melle be gwaye. Ar wemardi, uaya-satemaladid.
Ar we-dulemar beba ibsamalodibe, surbardibe, ar ade, dule-uayasatemaladid. Degi-inigwele, we-dulemarga an-gayaburba be barsogoed.
Dule-machi, an-bega-ibmar-sogedi be itogo, melle wemaryob uaya-sate be guo. Be-gaya be egae, an-bega-ibmar-uksokalid be gunno.”
Geb degine, argan-gwensak ansik-oyolenai an dakalid. A-argangine, garda bipirmakar-mai an dakalid.
An-asabinni argangi garda-bipirmakar-maid egasad. A-garda abinbela narmakar naid. A-gardagine, bukib-itoleged-igar, wile-itoleged-dummad-igar, degi, buged-mai-imakleged-igar narmakar nai an dakalid.
Bab-Jehová anga sogded: “Dule-machi, we-garda-bipirmakaled be gunne. Geb a-sorba Israel-dulemarga be sunmaknao.”
Gaya an egasad, geb garda-bipirmakaled-gunnega an-imaksad.
Anga sogdebalid: “Dule-machi, an bega we-garda-bipirmakaled-uknaidi, immelegedse be gunne.” Geb agine, an guchad. An guchagua, we-garda achanisyob ochii gulleged.
Anga sogdebalid: “Dule-machi, Israel-dulemarse be nae, an-gayaburba be barsognae.
Dulemar-bebo-gwabin-akar-sunmakedse, degi, aku-be-itomaladse an be-barminaisulid. Israel-dulemarse an be-barminaid.
Dulemar-bukidar na gwabin-akar-akar-sunmakedse, degi, e-sunmaked be aku-itogedse an be-barminaisulid. Ar amba a-dulemarse an be-barminaina, we-dulemar be-itosmalaled.
Ar Israel-dulemardi be-itogosurmalad. Ar an-ega-ibmar-soged itobisurmalad. Ar bela Israel-dulemar uaya-satemaladid, gwage-dutusurmaladid.
Degi-inigwele, wemaryob uaya-sate, degi, gwage-dutusuli an be-imakoed.
Akwa-diamante-geg-mamaredyobi an be-imakoed. Akwa-dummadba bur-dutusur an be-imakoed. Degisoggu, amba we-dulemar uaya-sate-gumalad-inigwele, mer be dobguo, mer be ese gwayebalo.”
Anga sogdebalid: “Dule-machi, an bega-ibmar-sogoedi be nue itogo. Nonogi bela be gao.
Emigindi, be-dule-gales-bukwamaladse be nae. Ar beba ibsamalodibe, surbardibe, ar bedi ega be ibmar-sogoed. Weyob be sogoed: ‘Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob sogye.’ ”
Geb agine, Bab-Dummad-Burba nakwaa an-imaksad, geb an-yarganbali gayaburba binnasuli mar-gollomakeyobi-gole an itoged. Weyob soge an itoged: “Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-yeerdaklegedi e-maidgi dummarba gued.”
Ibdulamar na muchub-muchub-e-sakanmar-warmakedba e-sakanmar-uurmakedi an itosbalid. Deginbali, ibmar-dirbiled-ibdulamar-walik-nanaid-e-goled an itosbalid. Wemar-goledi mar-gollomakedyobi binnasuli goled.
Bab-Dummad-Burba nakwaa an-imaksad, an-sesad. Ar andi sae-itogedgi, degi, urwedgi an naded. Bab-Jehová e-argangi gandikidba an-ganiki an itoged.
Deyobi, an Tel-Abibʼse, Israel-dulemar Quebar-diwar-gakaba-bukwamaladse an modapid. Geb agi, wemar-abargi ibagugle (7) an megisad. Aku-itoge, ibi-an-imakodibeye, ibi-an-sogbalodibeye, an binsadii gusad.
Ibagugle-gusgua (7), Bab-Jehová weyob anga sognonikid:
“Dule-machi, Israel-dulemar-owisogega an be-nug-imaksad. Degisoggu, an bega ibmar-sokalile, an-nuggine be sunmakoed.
An dule-isganaga weyob sogele: ‘Be burgoye.’ Ar we-dule-isgana nabir dula-gudiguega ega be ibmar-sogsulile, igar-isganaba-nanadiidgi ega be sunmaksulile, we-dule, na e-isgudiidba burgoed. Degi-inigwele, e-burgwisad an begi atakoed.
Ar be dule-isganaga ibmar-sogsale, degi-inigwele, na e-isgudiid amba iesulile, degi, e-sunnasurdaed ogwasulile, we-dule, na e-isgudiidba burgoed. Ar bedi be ollorguoed.
Deginbali, dule-nueddaedi na igar-nuedba-nanadiidgi bangudele, ibmar-isgana-imakdele, geb an we-dule burgwednaga-imakele, ega be ibmar-sogergebed. Ega be ibmar-sogsulile, we-dule, e-isgusadba burgoed, degi, bela na e-ibmar-nuegan-imaksad ebinsalegosulid. Degi-inigwele, e-burgwisad an begi atakoed.
Ar dule-nued melle-bar-isguega ega be ibmar-sogerdi, degi, na bar isgued-imaksasulile, dula-gudii guoed. Ar ade, ega be-ibmar-sogsadba ibsasad, bedi be ollorgunonikoed.”
Geb agi, Bab-Jehová na e-gangued angi odenonikid, degi, anga sogded: “Be-gwisgue, sapurba be nae. Agi, an bega sunmakoed.”
An gwisgusad, degi, an sapurba naded. Degi, Quebar-diwar-gakaba Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-yeerdakleged-daksayobi, e-gangued-yeerdakleged an daksabalid. Geb an napase-dulluu wagar-ebulegedse an imaksad.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-Burba angi aidenonikid, geb gwisguega an-imaksad. Weyob anga sogded: “Be-negse be nae, mer bar neg-magaba noo.
Dule-machi, mer be bar-noega dulemar be-edinmaloed. Mer bar emar-abargi-gudiguega deyob be-imakmaloed.
Be-gwabin aibirgi achaa-naguega an imakoed. Degidbali bar-sunmaksuli be guoed. Wemarga bar be ibmar-sogosulid, ar uaya-satemaladid.
Geb an bega ibmar-sogdele, be-gwabin nolloo an imakoed. Weyob ega be sogdoed: ‘Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob sogye: Dule, an-ibmar-soged-itobiele, na itogodo. Dule, an-ibmar-soged-itobisulile, mer itogodo. Ar dulemarde uaya-satemaladid.’ ”
Bab-Dummad-Burba anga sogsabalid: “Dule-machi, napsa-ginnid-akwa be sue. A-akwagine, Jerusalén-neggwebur-e-wilub be sobo.
Sorda-bila-onomalad bela Jerusalén-neggwebur-ebilis-bukwa be sobo. Degi, sordamar-ambikued-neg-matusulid neggwebur-ebilis be sobbalo. Degine, napa-arsanyob-dakleged-wargwen neggwebur-galu-matusulidse-warmakgwichi be sobbalo. Deginbali, galu-matusulid-omukuega suar-wardummagan-ebuleged be sobbalo.
Esgoro-madareged be amibar. Geb a-esgoro-madareged, neggwebur-bebo-abingunaid-abargi, galu-matusulidyob be omeso. Geb Jerusalén-neggwebur-asabin be gwisguo, egi bila-onosokaliyob be gwisguo. We-ibmar-sobaledi, Israel-dulemarga neg-guoed-e-wilubga guoed.
”Be-argan-sapiledsik yollekwaa be mego. Israel-dulemar-e-isgued-bargamai be guoed. Ar ibabigwa be deyob megoe, abali Israel-dulemar-e-isguedi begi naguoed.
Iba-dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulabake-gakambe (390) be deyob yollekwaa mai guoed. We-ibagan bega oyoged, wegi-birgamergu Israel-dulemar isgudii gusmarye.
”Ar we-ibagan gwinmaksale, geb be-argan-nuedsik be yollekwaa megoed. Geb iba-dulabo (40) Judá-dulemar-e-isgued begi naguoed. Ar we-ibagan bega oyoged, wegi-birgamergu, Judá-dulemar isgudii gusmarye.
A-sorbali, sordamar-bila-onomalad Jerusalén-neggwebur-ebilis-bukwadsik be atakoed. Geb asiki surgan be oyogoed, agi sabsur-urwar ega be ibmar-guoed sogdoed.
Melle be bigni-bigni megegale, dubgi an be-edinnoed. Geb sorda-bila-onomalad Jerusalén-neggwebur-ebilis-bukwad-e-ibagan-gwinmakedse deyob be mai guoed.
”Degine, we-ibmarmar be amibalo: Ibmar-gwag-trigoʼye-nugad, ibmar-gwag-cebadaʼye-nugad, ingwagi-dakleged-habasʼye-nugad, ingwa, obgi-dakleged-mijoʼye-nugad, degi, avena. We-ibmar-gwagmar bormogi be eogo. ”Geb madu-sobega be omukuo. We-ibmala iba-dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulabake-gakambe (390) sapiledsik yollekwaa be megoedgi be-masga guoed.
”Bane-bane wachi-sekalaa be gundioed. Nibir-negabala be gundii guoed.
Deginbali, wachi-sekalaa nog-gwapaa be dii gobbaloed.
Dulemar-saa sapanga be imakoed. Agine, madu be yooed. Geb cebada-maduyob dulemar-wagab be gunnoed.”
A-sorbali, Bab-Jehová anga sogdebalid: “An Israel-dulemar yar-baid-baidse-oaisakioedgi weyobi na mas-isgana gunmaloed.”
Geb Bab-Jehováʼga an sogded: “¡Bab-Dummad-Jehová! An-gaya-yaba bipisaale ibmar-isgana dogdisulid. An-dungualid-akale, emi-ibase, bipisaale ibdurgan-burgwar-amilesad-e-san an gundisulid. Deginbali, ibdurgan achusapurmarse-oichimaklesad an gundisurbalid. Ibdurgan-isemalad-e-san an-gaya-yaba bipisaale dogdisulid.”
Geb Bab-Jehová an-abin sogded: “Degirdi, be-madu be yoegala dulemar-saa-anale, moli-bebe-nikad-e-saa sapanga be ebugo.”
Geb sorba anga sogdebalid: “Dule-machi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi mas-sate an imakoed. Dulemar mas-ise-mimiar gunmaloed, surbinsa-itogedgi mas-gunmaloed. Deginbali, dii-ise-mimiar gobmarbaloed, degi, dobedgi gobmarbaloed.
Ega mas galakudoed, dii galakudbaloed. Na muchub-muchub-e-gwenadgan-burgwemamai dakarmalale, na dobe itodmaloed. Na e-isgudimalad-ular, deyob burgwemamai gudoed.”
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “Dule-machi, esbipi-nugar-datarmakaled be ami. A-esbipigi, sailagia swiri be imako, siga be esibalo. A-sorbali, nibir be amio. Geb sailagia be sikoedi, dana-dana be urbo.
Ar sorda-bila-onomalad Jerusalén-neggwebur-ebilis-bukwamalad-e-ibagan gwinmaksale, be sailagia sogapaa-dana-dana-urbisad-soggwenad neggwebur-negabargi be ogumakoed. Baid-sailagia-soggwenadi es-suidgi be immi-immi imakoed, geb neggwebur-dikarmarba be mie-mie saoed. Sailagia-dangwen-napi-besadi, burwaba be mioed. Andi es-suidyalaba Jerusalén-dulemar-baleginnoed.
We-sailagia ichee be suoed, geb be-mordukugi be edinnoed.
A-sorbali, amba we-sailagia ichesaar be subaloed, geb ogumakega be soogi mioed. We-ibmar bela Israel-dulemar-gummakoed-e-wilubga guoed.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged: “We-Jerusalén-neggwebur-siidi, neggwebur-bamalad-abargi, degi, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad-abargi an sisad.
Ar Jerusalén-dulemardi an-Igar-Mamaidgi, an-Igar-Mesisadgi yolesmalad. Ar bur bule neggwebur-bamaladba, degi, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamaladba ege gusmalad, ar ade, an-Igar-Mamaidba, degi, an-Igar-Mesisadba ibsasurmalad.
”A-ulale, ani, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged: Ar bemar be-dikarba-dulemar-bukwadba bur bule uaya-sate gusmalad, ar ade, an-Igar-Mamaidba, an-Igar-Mesisadba ibsassurmalad. Deginbali, we-dulemar-be-dikarba-bukmalad-e-igar-mamaidba bemar nanadisurbalid.
”Degisoggu, ani, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged: Jerusalén, an begi gwichi, bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad-wagab an sabsur-be-odurdakoed.
Be-galagwensuli-ibmar-imaksad-ulale, an-ibmar-imakdisulidi, an begi imakoed. Geb sorbali, we-ibmar-imakoedi an bar imakosulid.
A-ulale, bemar-abargine na babgana ukudbali e-mimmigan-gutemaloed, amba deyopira, na mimmigan e-babgan-gutemarmogoed. Ani an sabsur-bemar-odurdakoed. Dulemar-san-onomaloedi, bela we-napneg-dirbir-naidgi an oaisakioed.
”Degisoggu, ani an, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi dukin-ibmar-ise-sogar an soged: Ar bemar na be-ibmar-isgana be-bab-dummadyob-imaklegedgi, degi, be-ibmar-ima-daklemaladgi anse-goled-neg-islidikid be iwisasmalad. A-ulale, an bar wile bemar-dakosulid, an bemar-oberguoed.
Be-dulemar sogapaa-mimilegoed-soggwenadi, na boniganba, degi, ukudba girgumaloed. Neggwebur-galimbaba burgwemai gumaloed. Baid-sogapaa-mimilesad-soggwenadi, be-neggwebur-dikarmarba es-suidgi burgwemai gumaloed. Baid soggwen-besadi, bela we-napneg-dirbir-naidgi an oaisakioed. Andi es-suidyalaba Jerusalén-dulemar-baleginnoed.
”Deyob anse-gusale, geb an-sae-itogedi bogilegoed. An deyob Jerusalén-dulemar-imaksale, geb an-urwedi galegoed, geb an yeer-itogoed. An-nobedgi an wemar-sabsur-odurdaksale, geb wemar wisgumaloed, ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi weyob ibmar-sogsale, sogedba imakdaed.
”Jerusalén-neggwebur, akwamarbi-ganna-ganna-bukwa an be-imakoed. Bela dulemar-be-dikarba-bukwamaladi begi dodogega an imakoed. Bela dulemar be-walik nasmaloedi, be-gusadi dakmaloed.
An urwedgi, sae-itogedgi, an sabsur-bemar-odurdaksale, bela begi dododmaloed, isdar begi sunmakdemaloed. Dulemar-be-neggwebur-dikarba-bukmaladga iduakwaa-ibmar-sogedyob be gumaloed. Begi-binsaed-amimalaga be guoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi, we-ibmar soged.
”An bemargi sigu-dule-ogilogedyobi ukud-dummad barmidagoed. An bemar-obelogega imakoed, mas sate be gumaloed. Ukud-dummad naguoed.
Ar an bemargi ukud-dummadi, degi, ibdurgan-ursilimaladi barmidagoed. Wemala, bei mimmigan-obelogoed. Bemala boni-buleganbali, ablis-aryomaidbali na be bukib-binsadii gudmaloed. Ar ade, be-dulemar es-suidgi-burgwega an imakoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi weyob soged.”
Bab-Jehová anga sogded:
“Dule-machi, Israel-yarmarsik be atake. Yoedse egi ibmar-guoed be soge.
Ega be soge: ‘Israel-yarmala, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-gayaburba be itomala. Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyobi yarmarga, yarmar-mullumarga, diwarmarga, degi, nebamarga soged: Bemargi bila-onoed an barmidagoed. Be-bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladga-ailamar-bukwadi, an obelogoed.
E-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailamar an earoed, e-ina-wawadikid-ogumakar-ukleged-ailamar an bibisgoed. Deginbali, be-dulemar be-bab-dummadyob-imakleged-wawasur-yapanned-asabin burgwemalaga an imakbaloed.
Israel-dulemar-e-muimar na e-bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imakdimalad-asabin an mesoed. E-garmar e-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-ebilis an mioed.
Ar bia be mamai, a-neggweburmar berguoed, e-bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imakdimaladse-goled-ailamar ayaroed. Na e-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila bela berguoed, e-bab-dummadyob-imakdimalad-wawasur-yapanmalad akwabi dunnumaksii guoed, degi, e-ina-wawadikid-ogumakmalad omukulegoed. Bela e-ibmar-sobsamalad berguoed.
Be-dulemar bemar-abargi, burgwemai guoed, degidbali geb bemar wisgumaloed, ani, an Bab-Jehová gued.
” ’Degi-inigwele, abar an be-dulemar es-suidgi oburgosulid. Amardi, bela we-napneggi dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamaladse an oaisakioed.
Dulemar-burgosurmalad na biti-yargi gales bukudapmaloe, agi, an-ebinsadamaloed. An-ebinsadamaloed, emar angi nosmalad-ulale, igi an wile-itosa, degi, igi angi aibachagusmala, deginbali, igi na e-bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imakdimalad-wawasur-yapanmaladba nadegusmala, bela ebinsadamaloed. Na e-isgusmaladba, degi, na e-ibmar-isgana-imaksadba na ima-itomaloed.
Geb degidbali na wisgumaloed, ani an Bab-Jehová gued. Ar an weyob ibmar-imakoye-sogsa-gusadi, an binsa sogsagussulid.’ ”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged: “Be argan-ogole, be dii-dii-annae, be binnasur-gole, weyob be soge: ‘Israel-dulemar e-isgued-dummad-imaksad-ulale, nunmak-itoleye.’ Ar ade, es-suidgi burgwemaloed, ukudba, degi, boniganba burgwemaloed.
Dule-dikasur-bangu-gudiidi na boniganba burgoed. Dule-wegi-walikaa-gudiidi na es-suidgi burgoed. Dule dula-beoeddi ukudba burgoed. Ar ade, an bela-bela-sae-itogedgi an deyob wemar-imakoed.
E-muimala na e-bab-dummadyob-imakdimalad-wawasur-yapanmalad-imbaba, ega-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-ebilis omiledoed. Bela dule-e-muimar yar-mullugan-matusulidgi, yarmar-birgi, bela sapimar-bulamakwichid-urba, bela sapi-encina-bulamaksiid-urba omiledoed. Ar wemargine, na e-bab-dummadyob-imakdimalad-wawasur-yapannedga ina-wawadikid ogumaksa gusmalad. Geb degidbali na wisgumaloed, ani an Bab-Jehová gued.
An wemar-sabsur-odurdakoed. An e-yala nega-dulesulidganga imakoed. Na e-mamaidi, nega-dulesulidgan-akale, Diblatʼye-neg-nugadse, bela dulemar-sate an imakoed. Geb degidbali na wisgumaloed, ani an Bab-Jehová gued.”
Bab-Jehová anga sogded:
“Dule-machi, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi Israel-dulemarga weyob-sogye be soge: ‘¡Neg-bergued omosad! Bela Israel-yar-bergued omosad.
Israel-yar, be-bergued omosad, an-urwed be-itogoed. Be-daedba an bega igar-nabogoed, be-ibmar-isgana-imaksadba an sabsur-be-odurdakoed.
Bipisaale, isgussuliyob an be-dakosulid, an wile-be-dakosurbalid. Be-ichagwadaed-ulale, degi, be-ibmar-isgana-sae-daklemalad-imaked-ulale, an sabsur-be-odurdakoed. Degidbali be wisguoed, ani an Bab-Jehová gued.’ ”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged: “Sabsur-odurdaklegedi ukin-ukin danikid.
Neg-bergued omosad. Israel-yar, be-bergued warmaksad, napiragwa, be-bergued warmaksad.
Israel-dulemar, be-wachi omos. Wachimar nae-naegus. Ibagan owarmas. Yarmargine, dobegwar neg-itoleged, weligwar-itoleged bergusad.
An-sae-itoged bemargi an barmidsokalid, an-urwedi bemargi an oyosokalid. Be-ibmar-isgana-imakedba an bega igar-nabogoed, be-ibmar-isgana-sae-daklemalad-imaksadba an sabsur-be-odurdakoed.
Bipisaale, isgussuliyob an be-dakosulid, an wile-be-dakosurbalid. Be-ichagwadaed-ulale, degi, be-ibmar-isgana-sae-daklemalad-imaked-ulale, an sabsur-be-odurdakoed. Degidbali be wisguoed, ani an Bab-Jehová gued.
”Bato ibagan warmaksad, bato weginbinned. Israel-yar, be-ibagan-bergued nonikid. Igar-innikigwad-imakleged bar imaklesulid, bela san-dummarba-imakedbimalad.
Dule-sabsur-imakleged nasgumaid, ibmar-isgana imakedbi neg naid. Bemar-ibmarmar gwen bipisaale bar beosulid, bemar-ibmar-nuegan, bemar-ibmar-obinebaka-nikadi, gwen bipisaale bar bukuosulid.
Wachi mosad. Iba warmaknonikid. Dule-ibmar-baked, melle be yeer-itoge, dule-ibmar-uked, melle be bomoga. Ar an-urwed bela Israel-dulemar-sabsur-odurdakoed.
Ar dule-ibmar-uked amba dula-beo-inigwele, na ibmar-uksad bar amiosulid. Ar dulemar-sabsur-odurdaklegoed-negburgan-daklesad osulolegosulid, na dule-wargwensaale, e-isgued-ular durguosulid.
”Ar amba gar-trompeta ogormaloen-inigwele, na guagwar-bukumaloen-inigwele, degite, dule wargwensaale bila-onolegedse naosulid. An-urwed bela Israel-dulemar-sabsur-odurdakoed.
”Neggwebur-magaba bila-onolenai guoed. Neggweburgindi, bonigan-aininai gumogoed. Ukud-dummad-itoged nai guoed. Dule sapurba-gudiile, es-suidgi iblolegoed. Ar dule amba neggweburgi-gudiile, boniganba burgoed, degi, ukudba burgoed.
Dulemar-durgumaloeddi, wakitemaloed, nuu-sibu-sapurbarmaladyob yalaganba gudimaloed, na dukin e-isguedga bodimaloed.
Bela swidamar nollomakdoed, bela malimar dobedbali wawanmakdoed.
Wile-itoged-mor na yomaloed, dobed-dummad itodimaloed, bela na bingegudimaloed, bela na e-sailagia swiri gudimaloed.
Igarba e-mani midmaloed, ibmar-isganayob, ordi dakdemaloed. Bab-Jehová-urwed-ibagi e-mani, degi, e-or gwen e-bendakega guosulid. We-ibmar-nuegan e-ukud-itoged ega obelogosulid, immerba-imakega guosurbalid. Ar olo, emar-isguega imaksad.
Na ormar-yeerdakleged-nikadba, san-dummarbaa imakdemalad. A-ormargine, e-bab-dummaganyob-ibmar-imakdimalad sobsamalad. A-ulale, we-ormar an ibmar-isganaga imakoed.
Dule-ainebarmalad dagega an imakoed, adi, e-ibe ibmar-atursamalagar. Dule-isganamar e-ibe ibmar sedmaloed, e-ibe ibmar oichomaloed.
We-Israel-dulemargi an bangudoed, anse-goled-neg oicholegoed. Ar dule-yar-bamaladsikmalad we-yarse ubononikoed, anse-goled-neg oichononimaloed.
”Esgoro-dub guagwar be urbe, ar we-yargine, dule-gindakmalad yaisulid, we-neggweburgine, sabsur-emar-imakmalad doggus obichagusad.
E-negmar-suega, dule-bur-isganamaladi an barmidagoed. Deyobi, dulemar-gandikmalad na san-dummarba-imakdimaladi, an obelogoed. Deyobi, e-bab-dummaganse-goled-negmar oicholegoed.
¡Dobed-dummad nagunonikoed! Neg-bogidikid amimaloenad, degi-inigwele, neg-bogidikid nikuosurmalad.
Ibagan-sabsur-odurdaklemalad ukin-ukin danikoed, gayaburba-isganamar bali-bali itoledagoed. Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged ega negburgan-dakega amimaloenad. Ega gwen negburgan dakosulid. Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladi, igar-maidgi geg bar dule-odurdake gumaloed, girmar-selegan, binsaed-nuegan bar ukdosurmalad.
Rey, wile-itodoed, dummad-negdakmaid, bukib-binsadoed. Dulemar, bela dobee-itodoed. E-damaladba an sabsur-odurdakoed, e-ibmar-imakedba an ega igar-nabogoed. Degidbali wisgumaloed, ani an Bab-Jehová gued.”
Birganergwagus gaka nii-walanergwagusad-ibataledgi anmar gales-selear-gusmaladgi, an Judá-girmar-dummaganmala an-neggi-sii, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-E-Burba ukiagwar angi aidenonikid.
Geb agine an dakalid, ibmar duleyob-gwichi an dakalid. E-nono-akar saderwalabaladse esgoro-gordikid-dakarmakeyobi gaed. Geb saderwalabalad-akar, e-nagse sooyob gaed.
Ibmar-duleyob-daklegedi ansik argan oyoalid. Geb sailagiagi an-gasad. Geb agine, Bab-Dummad-Burba niba nakwaa an-imaksad. Geb burbar Jerusalén-neggwebur-dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik an-sesad, ar bia neggwebur-yaba yawagak gwichi, ase an sesad. Agi bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imakleged gwichid. We-ibmala Bab-Dummad-ourwega imaked.
Ar igi an nebagi negburgan-daksagu, Bab-Dummad-e-gangued-yeerdakleged an daksa gusa, deyobi, Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-e-gangued-yeerdakleged an dakarbalid.
Geb Bab-Dummad anga sogded: “Dule-machi, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik be atake.” Asik an atakdesunnad. Asik an atakdegu an dakalid, ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-e-yawagak-naba, bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imakleged gwichi an dakalid. We-ibmar Bab-Jehová-ourwega imakedid.
Anga sogdebalid: “Dule-machi, Israel-dulemar we-neggi ibmar-isgana-imadaklemalad-imakmalad, ¿be dake? Weyob-ibmar-imakmaladi, an-neggi banguega an-imakmalad. Ar degi-inigwele, amba be yoo nue bela be ibmar daked. Ar bur bule be ibmar-isgana-imadaklemalad be dakoed.”
A-sorbali, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-imba-dogedse an-sesad. Geb galugine, yaa-gwagwen olloo-sii an daksad.
Geb anga sogded: “Dule-machi, galugi yaa-siid be odungue.” Geb yaa-siid an odungusad. Deyob an imaksagu, yawagak an dakalid.
Bab-Dummad anga sogded: “Be doge. Agi ibmar-isgana-imadaklemalad-imaklemalad be dake.”
