“Ani, Daniel, an we-ibmar-daksadbali an bela-bela dobe-itoded, degi, nue an bukib-itodbalid.
Geb degine, dule-gwensak-gwichidse an walikaa-naded, geb an ese egichided, an we-ibmar-daksadi, ibu obarye. Geb weyobi anga odulosad:
” ‘We-ibdula-unid-walabakegwad, we-napneggi reymar-walabake neg-ganonimaloedid.
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-e-sordagan-islidikmaladga negseleged uklegoed. Wemar, degisadegu na negsemaloed.’
”Geb degine, an nue-wisgubi gualid, we-ibdula-unid-bakegwad bur ibu-burba oyoge. We-ibdula-bakegwaddi bamaladba bur akarsaar-dakleged, bela-bela sunnasur-dakleged. Nugar esgorobi nikad, degi, gonasimar esgoro-gordikidbi nikbalid. We-ibdula, dulemar-goa-goa imaked, degi, dulemar-dobalid. A-sorbali, sanmar-obichad-birgi dii-dii annadaed.
Geb an egisdebalid, ibdula na e-nonogi ambe (10) bebe-nikad, we, ibu obarbarye. Amba deyobi an wisgubiguarbalid, e-nonogi bebe-senigwad noargusad, geb ese walapaa bebemar-idualed-bibichisad, ibu obarbarye. We-bebe-senigwad bur bule gargangued-nika dakleged, ar ade, ibyamar nikad, degine, bule-bule sunmakbalid.
”An deyob dakgwichidgine, we-bebe-senigwad dule-islidikmaladbogwa bila-onod gusad, geb amargi nakwisad.
Geb degine, Dule-Selebagwad nonikid, geb Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-e-dule-islidikmaladga igar-nabononikid. Geb agine, dule-islidikmaladga negsemalaga iba nonikid.
”Dule-Selebagwad-nuga-nikadi, weyob anga odulosad: ‘Ibdula-unid-sogabakegwadi, we-napneggi negseleged-sogabakegwadga gunonikoed. Negseleged-bamaladbali dikasur-akar negseoed. Bela napneggi-dulemar-gudimalad ese dolemaloed, ese annalemaloed, degine, ese ubi-ubi gumaloed.
Bebe-ambegid (10) oyoged, a-negselegedgine warambe (10) reymar negsenonikoye. Amar-sorbali, rey-baid negsenonikoed. We-rey, reymar-idualedba akarsaila negsenonikoed. We-reyse walapaa reymar-idualed galakumaloed.
We-rey, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Biriginedgi isdar-sunmakoed. Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-e-dule-islidikmalad-wiogega imakoed. Ibagan-mamaid, igarmar-mamaid ogwabigudagoed. Dule-islidikmalad we-rey-urbaligwa birgapaa-negabar gudimaloed.
Dule-Igar-Naboged signonikoed, bebe-senigwad-ibe e-gangued osulolegoed, geb obergulegoed. Degisadegu bebe-senigwad bar gwisguosulid.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-e-sorda-islidikmaladgala, bela we-napneggi yarmar-nanaid-e-nug-dummarbagued, ega uklenonikoed, gandikidba-negseleged, ega uklenonikoed e-yarmar-dummarba-gued, ega uklenonikoed. Bab-Dummad-sorda-islidikidmalad-e-negseleged degisadegu guoed. Bela we-napneggi dummagan-negsedimaladi, e-urbaligwa nanadii gumaloed, degi, eba ibsadii gumarbaloed.’
”Dule-Selebagwad-nuga-nikad wese anga sunmaksad. Andi, Daniel, an we-ibmar-daksadba an bela-bela bukib-itod gusad, abali an-wagar sipuu daklenaded. Degi-inigwele, an we-ibmar-daksad an na gwagegi wargwen sedii gusad.”
“Rey-Belsasar birgapaagus-negsemaidgine, ani, Daniel, an negburgan-baid daknonibalid.
A-negburgan-dakmaidgine, an Elam-yargi, Susa-neggweburgi, Ulai-diwar-dikarba an gudii an na dakalid. Susa-neggwebur neggwebur-bamalad-e-sailaga siid.
An gabdakmaidgine, sibad-wawaad-machered diwar-dikarba gunai, an dakalid. We-sibad-wawaad-machered bebe-gar warbo mullusur-nikad. Degi-inigwele, gwensak bur-baidba suid. We-bur-suidi sorba nosad.
”Dad-argwanedsik, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik, degi, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik sibad-wawaad-machered na e-bebe-gargi dulemar-naibi-imaknai, an daksad. Ibdula-wargwensaale, geg ebo urwed, deginbali, dule-wargwensaale, e-ganguedgi geg ollorgubalid. Sibad-wawaad-machered na e-itolegedba ibmar imaked, degi, e-gargangued bur bule gangumaid.
”We-ibmar-daksadgi an binsagwisgua, ukiagwar dad-argwanedsik sibad-machered daniki an dakalid. We-sibad-machered e-ibya-gwabogwad-siid-abargi bebe-gar-dummad gwichid. Gwen-napagi-warmaksuli, gwae-gwae bela napneggi nasad.
We-sibad-machered, sibad-wawaad-machered-bebe-gar-warbo-nikadgi sabsur-yoledapid. We-sibad-wawaad diwar-gakagi an daksagusadid.
”An daksad, igi sibad-machered, sibad-wawaad-macheredgi sabsur yoledapi. E-ibe bebe-gar-warbogwad bichisad. Sibad-wawaad-machered, sibad-machered-abinsaega gwen gargangued-nika gussulid. Degisoggu, sibad-macheredi, sibad-wawaad-machered-omukusad, e-birgi dii-dii annasad. Dule-wargwensaale, sibad-machered-e-ganguedgi, sibad-wawaad-bendaksasulid.
”Sibad-machered bur bule gargangumai gualid. Ar na bela-bela bur gargangued-nikadgine, e-ibe bebe-gar-bur-suid bichisad. A-anale, walabake bebe-gar-dummagan noalid. We-bebe-gar-walabakegwadi burwa-sogabake-gormaidsiki nogwismalad.
We-bebe-gar-walabakegwad-gwensakgine bebe-gar-senigwad-baid noalid. We-bebe-gar-senigwad bela-bela dungusad, geb dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik, dad-nakwedsik, degi, yar-yeerdaklegedsik e-gangued nasgumai gualid.
”We-bebe-gar-senigwad bela-bela dungussoggu, niisgwamar-nanaidse warmaksad. Geb abar-niisgwamar obatisad, e-birgi dii-dii annasad.
We-bebe-gar-senigwad niisgwamar-e-dummadbali bur bule na san-dummarbaa imaksabalid. We-bebe-gar-senigwad bane-bane ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged osulosad. Degi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg oichasbalid.
Anmar-dulemar-uaya-sulidaed-ulale, e-dulemar-bila-onomalad igar-innikigwad-mamaid oichosmalad, deginbali, bane-bane ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged obelosmarbalid. We-bebe-gar-senigwad ibmar-imakbiedba ibmar imaksad. Bela ega ibmar nueganbi nosad.
”Geb degine, dule-islidikid-gwensak sunmake an itosad. Dule-islidikid-baid, dule-islidikid-sunmaknaidse egisded: ‘Bane-bane-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi, anmar-ibmar-daknaidi, ¿sanagwadse berguoe? Isgued-dummad-gunaidi, ¿sanagwadse berguoe? Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi isgued-imaklenaidi, ¿sanagwadse berguoe? Bab-Dummad-e-sordagan sabsur-imaklenaid, ¿sanagwadse berguoe?’
”Geb we-dule ega sogded: ‘Milibo gaka dulataled-ilapaa (2,300) ibagan naguoed. Geb a-sorbali, Bab-Dummad-Neg-Islidikid, swilidik gunonikoed.’ ”
“Ani, Daniel, an negburgan-dakmaidgine, degi, an wisgubi-gumaidgine, we ibu-burba obare, ukiagwar an-asabin duleyob-daklege gwisgunonikid.
Geb Ulai-diwar-gakaba, dule-gwensak binnasur-gole an itosad. Weyob soged: ‘Gabriel, negburgan-oyolesad we-dulega be oduloge.’
”Gabriel, an-gwichidse walikaa-nonigua, an ise-gwayar naded, geb an napase wagar dulluu imaksad. Ar edi anga sogded: ‘Dule, we-negburgan be daksadi, wedi yoedse neg-berguoedgi guoed.’
”Gabriel anga sunmaknaigua, an negoeded, napagi an melleded. Agine, an-ebunonikid, geb gwisguega an-imaksad.
Anga sogdebalid: ‘Emigindi an bega sogo, yoedse Bab-Dummad-urwed-e-iba bergudele, igi neg-gunonikoe. Ar we-negburgan-daklesad napneg-bergued-mosar guoed.
Sibad-wawaad-machered-bebegar-warbo-nikad be daksadi, adi, Media-yar-e-rey-e-wilub, degi, Persia-yar-e-rey-e-wilub gued.
Sibad-machereddina, Grecia-yar-e-rey-e-wilub gumogad. We-sibad-machered e-ibya-gwabogwad-siid-abargi bebe-gar-dummad-gwichidi, gebesaila-Grecia-e-rey-megnonikoed-e-wilub gued.
Bebe-gar-bichisgusad-anar bebe-gar-walabake-noargusadi, Grecia-yargine neg-sogabake-selegoed-e-wilub gued. We-negseleged-sogabakegwad gebe-negselesadyobi gangued nikumalosulid.
” ’We-negseleged-sogabakegwad-bergunadapile, dulemar-igar-mamaidgi-annadimalad-e-isgued wilub-obicha-gusale, rey-wargwen na san-dummarba-imaked, degi, igar-dukuar-mamaid magar-oduloged, negsenonikoed.
” ’E-gangued bur bule gangumai guoed, degi-inigwele, we-gangued egi danisulid. We-rey, yeer ibmar-bibisgoed. Bela ibmar-imaked ega nueganbi guoed. Na e-itolegedba ibmar-imakoed. Dule-bulegan-obelogoed, Bab-Dummad-e-sordamar ese burgwemaloed.
” ’We-rey nue-binsaed-nikadba emar-binsaed-gamai guoed, na emargi-obinye binsaoed. Ukiagwar, bukidar dulemar-gwen-akar-guosurye-binsamaladi ese berguoed. We-rey, Dule-Bur-Nuga-Nikadgine gwisgunonikoed, degi-inigwele, we-rey, burgwenonikoed, dulese burgosulid.
” ’Bega we-negburgan-oyolesadi, napiragwadid. Degi-inigwele, mer be emarga sogo, ar emiskwaa guosulid, amba bukidar ibagan napid.’
”Ani, Daniel, an bela-bela nolloo itonaded. Geb an undarsaar uellemai gusad. An gannar gwisgusadgine, reyga-negselemaidgi an gannar arbadbalid. Degi-inigwele, an we-negburgan-daksadbali, bela-bela bukib-binsadii gualid, ar ade, an magar-itosulid.”
“Media-yargined, Asuero-machi-Darío, Babilonia-dulemar-e-reyga megnonikid.
Rey-Darío birgagwengus negsemaigua, ani, Daniel, an ibagwengi Jeremías-garda-narmakar-maid-absosigua, an magar-itononikid, bia-narmakar-nai, deun Bab-Jehová Jeremíasʼga-sogsagusgu: ‘Birga-dulapaa-gakambe (70) Jerusalén-neggwebur bergus sigoye.’
Geb degine, an-Bab-Dummad-Dule-Dummadse an goted, an ega ise-wilegar ibmar-sogded. Aginbali, an mas guchasurbalid, an wile-itoged-mor yosbalid, degi, an bukib-itogedba, sogun-e-buru-birgi sigisbalid.
An-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼse an goted, weyob anmar-isgued an barsogded: ” ‘Bab-Dummadye, be Dule-Dummadid, be Dule-Gandikidid. Ar bedi dulemar-be-sabgudimaladbo, degi, be-Igar-Mamaidba-ibsadimaladbo igar-mesisale, na sogedba be ibmar-imakdaed. A-ulale, an na magar-itoged:
Anmar nue-isgusad, anmar ibmar-isgana imaksad, anmar sunnasur-gudigusad, degi, anmar uayasuli-gudigusbalid. Anmar Be-Igar-Mamaidgi, degi, Be-Igar-Uksadgi bangusad.
Anmar be-maimar-be-gayaburba-barsogmaladba ibsassurmalad. We-dulemar be-nuggi anmar-reymarga, anmar-dummaganga, anmar-babganga, degi, bela anmar-dulemarga sunmaksagusmalad.
” ’Bab-Jehová, bedi innikigwadba ibmar-imakedid. A-ulale, anmar binge-itoged. Anmar Judá-yarginmalad, Jerusalén-neggweburginmalad, degi, bela Israel-dulemar-bamalad, bela-bela emi-ibagi binge-itomarmogad. Deginbali, beba-uayasuli-gusmalad-ular, be itaka-yar-baid-baidse barmisgusmaladi, degi, be dikasur-yar-baid-baidse-barmilesgusadi, bela-bela emi-ibagi binge-itomarmogad.
” ’Bab-Jehová, ar begi isgusmalad-ulale, anmar, anmar-reymar, anmar-dummagan, degi, anmar-dadgan, nue-binge-itomalad.
Ar anmar beba uayasuli-gusmala-inigwele, bedi, anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, amba dule-wile dakmaid, degi, dulega isgued elibalid.
” ’Anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, anmar beba ibsassulid, degi, Be-Igar-Maidba ibsassurbalid. A-igarmar, be-maimar-be-gayaburba-barsogmaladba be anmarga uksanad.
Bela Israel-dulemar Be-Igar-Maidgi bangudmalad, beba ibsabisurmalad. A-ulale, anmar-isgusadbali, be anmarga ib-isganamar-sogsagusadi, anmargi aibinnonikid. We-ib-isganamar, be-mai-Moisés-Igar-narmaksadgi narmakar maid.
” ’Be anmarga, anmar-dummaganga, weyob sogsagusad, bemar nuekwaa nanasulile, an bemargi boni-dummad barmidagoye. Emidi, bela be we-ibmar-sogsagusadi, be imaksad. Jerusalén-neggweburgi neggusadyobi, bipisaar we-napneggi deyob gudisulid.
” ’Anmargi, bela we-bonigan, Moisés-Igar-narmaksadba gunonikid. Ar degite, anmar Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼse bendakleged gwen amissulid. Anmar-isgued anmar gwen iessulid, deginbali, anmar be-igar-innikigwad-maidba nanasurbalid.
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová, be we-bonigan-nasiksad, be anmargi barmialid. Ar be, anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, bela be-ibmar-imaked innikigwadid. Ar degi-inigwele, anmar beba gwen ibsassulid.
” ’Anmar-Bab-Dummad, deun be-dulamar be Egipto-yargi onosgusgu, be-gangued be oyosgusad. Deyobi, a-iba-akale, emi-ibase be-nug dummarbaa gunonikid. Anmardi isgusad, degi, ibmar-isgana imaksad.
Bab-Dummad, be-ibmar-innikigwad-imakedba, be-urwed, be-sae-itoged, Jerusalén-neggweburgi mer be bar imake. Ar Jerusalén be-neggwebur gued, be-yar-islidikid gued. Anmar-isgusadbali, degi, anmar-dadgan-isgusadbali, anmar-dikarba bela-dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad Jerusalén-neggweburgi, degi, be-dulamargi dodobukwamalad.
” ’Degisoggu, anmar-Bab-Dummadye, emi an bese goled, bese ise-wilegar-gornaid be an-itoge. Bab-Dummad, be-nug-dummarba-gued-ulale, be dake igi bese-goled-neg sigisa. Be-sabgued be anmarga oyoge.
Anmar-Bab-Dummad, be nue anmar-itoge. Be dake anmar-bergussiid, deginbali, be-nug-odummoleged-neggwebur-bergussiid be dakbali. Bab-Dummad, anmar bese anmar-innikidaed-ular, ise-wilegar gornaisulid. Unnila be-dule-wiledakmaid-ular, anmar bese wilenaid.
” ’¡Bab-Dummadye, be anmar itoge! ¡Bab-Dummad, be anmarga isgued elie! ¡Bab-Dummad, be nue-anmar-itoge, be anmar-bendake! An-Bab-Dummadye, be-nug-dummarba-gued-ulale, be-neggwebur-ulale, degi, be-dulamar-be-nug-odummodimalad-ulale, be gwae anmar-bendakdage.’ ”
“An-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼse amba an gorsii gualid, an ega an-isgusad barsognai gualid. Degi, an-Israel-dulemar-e-isgusad an barsognai guarbalid. An ese e-yar-islidikidga gorsii guarbalid.
An amba Babse gorsiidgine, baliwitur-Gabriel, an iduar-negburgan-daksadgi daksagusadi, an-siidsik binnasur gukualid. Deunni, sedogidba ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-wachi modanikid.
Gabriel magar-ibmar-itogega an-imaksad, geb anga sogded: ” ‘Daniel, emidi an bese-nonikid, adi, bela we-ibmar be magar itogegar.
Gebe-onodeyala Bab-Dummadse be gotegua, bato Bab-Dummad be-abin-imaksad. A an bega sogega danikid, ar Bab-Dummad nue be-sabed. Degisoggu, an bega ibmar-sogsokalid be nue itogo, adi, be negburgan-daksad magar itogegar.
” ’Be-dulemar, degi, be-neggwebur-islidikid, isgued mer bar imakmalaga, igar-maidgi-gwisgudiid mer bar egi gwisguega, itoged-dulapaa-gakambe (70) nasiklesad. Degi, e-ibmar-isgana-imaksad Bab-Dummad ega eliega, igar-inniki-imakleged degisadegu mesmalaga, itoged-dulapaa-gakambe (70) nasiklesad. Negburgan-daklesad, degi, ibmar-yoedse-guoed-soglesadguega, degi, Bab-Dummadse-Goled-Bur-Neg-Islidikid swilidik-imakmalaga, itoged-dulapaa-gakambe (70) nasiklesad.
” ’We-ibmar be magar-itogergebed, be nue-wisguergebed: Jerusalén-neggwebur gannar-soblegega igar-uklesad-akale, Dule-Dummad-Nugsalesad nonikoedse, Itoged-gugle (7) naguoed. A-sorbali, itoged-dulapaa-gakabo (62) nagubaloed. Geb degine, Jerusalén-neggwebur, e-igar-dummagan, degi, e-galu-matusurmalad gannar soblenonikoed, A-ibagan, bukib-itoged-ibagan, degi, wile-itoged-ibagan guoed.
” ’We-itoged-dulapaa-gakabo (62) nasad-sorbali, Dule-Dummadga-nug-Imaklesad oburgwilenonikoed. We-Dule-Dummadga-nug-imaklesad, neggwebur-sate, degi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sate guoed. Ar ade, rey-wargwen-yar-baidsikid e-sordamar-bila-onomaladmala obergunonikoed. Muu-dummad-noedyobi neg-bergued nonikoed. Neggweburmar-bergued bila-onoleged-berguedse bergudapoed.
” ’Itoged-ilagwen, we-rey-isgana dulemar-bukidarbo igar-mesnai guoed. Ar degi-inigwele, itoged-negabar-gusale, ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged, degi, ibmar-uklemalad-mer-bar-ukmalaga imakoed. Geb ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi ibmar-isgana-isemalad ogumaknai guoed. A-sorbali, Bab-Dummad, dule-weyob-ese-goled-neggi-ibmar-imaksadga, bergued-igar-megisadba obergunonikoed.’ ”
Persia-yar-e-rey-Ciro, birgapaagus negsemaidgine, Daniel, Beltsasarʼye-nugbalid, sorda-bila-onomalad-bukidar-merguedgi gabdaksad. We-gayaburba innikigwadid, degi, magar-itogega dutusur gued. Ar degi-inigwele, Daniel, we-gayaburba magar-itogedse na imaksad, geb negburgan-daksad magar itononikid.
“A-ibagangine, ani, Daniel, itoged-ilapaa an wile-itodii gusad.
Agine, an mas-nuegan guchasulid, an san guchasulid, an vino gobsasulid, deginbali, geb we-itoged-ilapaagwad gwinmaksadse an ina-wawagwad maksasurbalid.
Nii-gebe-yoleded e-iba-dulagwen-gakabakegi (24), an Hidekel-diwar-dummad-gakaba gudiidgine,
an niba atakded, geb an dakalid dule an-asabin lino-mor-yoi gwichi, degi, molidub-orbiid nai gwichid. We-orde Ufaz-yargi danikid.
E-abagan akwa-topacio-gordikidyob gaed. E-wagar mar-dakarmakmaiyob dakleged. E-ibyamar soo-gwabunye-gwichidyob dakleged. E-sakwamar, degi, e-nagmar esgoro-gordikid-dakar-dakar-gaedyob dakleged. E-sunmaked dulemar-bukidar-sunmakedyob itoleged.
”Anbi, Daniel, we-negburgan daksad. Dulemar-anba-gudimalad we-ibmar-daksasurmalad, ar ade, gwakidmalad, dukuega abarmakdemalad.
An we-negburgan-daksagua, dule-wargwensaar an-walik bessulid. An nig-argwated, an-wagar sipuu naded, an bela nolloo itonaded.
Geb degine, dule anga sunmake an itoalid. Dule anga sunmaknai an itoargua, an negoeded, geb napagi asgunar an aimukuded.
Agine, dule an-ganonikid, geb napagi-akani yokorgi-sigega an-imaksad.
Anga sogded: ‘Daniel, be gwisgue, ar an be-dakega an-barmilealid. Bab-Dummad bela-bela be-sabed, degisoggu, an bega ibmar-sogsokalid be nue-itogo.’ ”Weyob anga sunmaknaidgine, an gwisgusad, degi-inigwele, amba an wawanmakgwichi gusad.
Geb degine, we-dule anga sogded: ‘Daniel, mer be dobgue. Gebe-iba-onodedgi be ibmar-egichisad Bab-Dummad be-itosad, deunni na be sogsagusgu, an we-ibmar magar-itogedseye, degi, Bab-Dummad-asabin an na san-bipii imakoye. A-ibmar-bega-sogega an wese nonikid.
An bese iduar danikoenad, degi-inigwele, an geg dagegusad, ar ade, iba-durgwen-gakagwensak (21) Persia-yar-e-dule-dummad mer an bese dagega an-imaksad. An walagwen Persia-yar-e-reymar-walik besagusad. Agine baliwitur-e-dummad-bur-nuga-nikamogad, Miguelʼye-nugad an-bendaknoni gusad.
Emigindi, an bega ibmar-odulogega nonikid, be-dulemar yoedse ibagan-bergudele igi gumaloe. Ar a-ibagangi ibmar-guoed-e-negburgan bega oyolesad.’
”Weyob anga ibmar-sognaigua, unnila an napaginbi atakgwichid, an gaya-makles gwisgusad.
Geb degine, gwensak duleyob-itoged an-gakuli ebunonikid, geb an nabir sunmakded. Dule-an-asabin-gwichidga an weyob sogded: ‘Dummad, an we-negburgan-daksad-ulale, an surbinsa-itoged, an nolloo itoged.
Degisoggu, ¿igi an bebo sunmakosunna? Ar ade, an bela-bela nolloo itoged, ar uunnila an bunnogwisbalid.’
”We-duleyob-itoged gannar an-ebusbalid, geb gargangued anga uksad,
agi anga sogdebalid: ‘Mer be dobgue, mer be bukib-binsae. Bab-Dummad be-sabed. ¡Niga be ogannoge! ¡Gandik be imake!’ ”Anga sunmaknaigua, an niga gangumai gualid, geb an ega sogded: ‘Dummad, ar be anga niga-ogannossoggu, be anga sunmake.’
Geb anga sogded: ‘¿Be wisi, an ibiga be-dakdaniki? Ar emigindi, Persia-yar-e-dule-dummadbo bila-onogega an gannar naergebed. An a-bogwa bila-onoged-bergusale, Grecia-yar-e-dule-dummad nonikoed.
Ar we-iduale, an bega sogoed, garda-sunsoged-maidgi ibu narmakar-mai. An wemarbo urwenaidgine, unnila Miguelʼbi an-bendaked an nikad. Miguel, be-sorda-bila-onomalad-iduedid.’ ”
“Dule-anbo-sunmaknaidi, anga sogdebalid: ‘Media-e-rey-Darío birgagwengus-negdakmaigua, ani an e-nig-ogannononigusad, degi, ani an bendaknonigusbalid.’ ”
“Dule-anbo-sunmaknaidi, anga sogdebalid: ‘Emigindi, an bega ibmar-innikigwad sogoed. Persia-yargine, amba rey walapaa megnonikoed. Wemar-warbaagwad-sorbali, rey-baid megnonikoed. We-rey, bur bule reymar-idualedmarba ibmar-ibed megoed. We-rey, e-ibmar-bukidar-nikadba gargangued-nikunonikile, bela dulemar Grecia-yar-selemaidgi-aibinmalaga imakoed.
” ’Geb-sorbali, rey-wargwen-buled megnonikoed. We-rey yeer-ganguedgi yar-senonikoed, na e-ibmar-imakbiedba ibmar-imakoed.
Degi-inigwele, na-nue-yar-semaigusale, e-yar-semaid mamaridoed, geb sogabake e-yar mimilegoed. We-rey, e-waganga e-yar-semaid obegosulid. Deginbali, e-yar-semaid Bab-Dummad e-ibe mamarnonikoed, geb dule-bamaladgala uklegoed. We-rey-iduar-negsesayobi, reymar-sorba-megnonimaloed bar gangued nikuosulid.’
”Dule-anbo-sunmaknaidi, anga sogdebalid: ‘Dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-rey gangued-nikarbaa gunonikoed. Degi-inigwele, e-sordamar-bila-onomalad-dummad-gwensak eba bur bule gangued-nika gunonikoed. We-sorda-dummad na e-yar-semaidgi gannarbaa negseoed.
” ’Birgamar-sikwas-nasadgine, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-rey, degi, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey na atonai gumaloed: ” ’We-reymar-ebogwad, neg-bogidikid-amimalagala, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-rey na e-sisgwa dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-reyga ukoed, nikuegar. Degi-inigwele, we-ibmar igarga-guosulid. Ar rey-sisgwa negseosur guoed. Deginbali, e-sui-rey undar negsemogosulid. Ar ade, rey-sisgwa, e-sui-rey, e-bardakmalad, e-machi, degi, eba-nanaimalad bela oburgwilemaloed.’
”Dule-anbo-sunmaknaidi, anga sogdebalid: ‘A-ibagangine, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-rey-e-sisgwa-ibe, rey-e-gwenad-gwensak rey-gana sunonikoed. Geb we-dule-rey-gan-susadi, e-sordamar-bila-onomaladmala, rey-dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikidgi bila-onodagoed. Amar, reyneg-gandik-siidgi ubononikoed, geb bila-onogedgi obinnonimaloed.
” ’Aginbali, e-ibe Egipto-yarse e-bab-dummagan-bormogi-sobaled, degi, e-ibmar-bamalad-orgi-sobaled, manigi-sobaled, sedbaloed. Geb birgamar-undarsaar dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-reygi bar bila-onogosulid.
” ’A-sorbali, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-rey-e-yargi doged-imakoenad. Ar degi-inigwele, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey gannar e-yarse nae dakledagoed.’
”Dule-anbo-sunmaknaidi, anga sogdebalid: ‘Geb degine, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey-e-masmala nue sae-itodmaloed. Geb dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-reygi-bila-onodagega sordamar-bukidar onmakoed. E-machimala e-sordamar-bila-onomaladmala, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-yar-suega dagoed. Diwar-dummad-noedyobi, bela e-idu-ibmar-bukwad bibisgoed, geb reyneg-gandik-siidse bila-onononikoed.
” ’Weyob-negguoed-ulale, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-rey bela-bela uludoed. Geb dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-reygi bila-ononaoed. Dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey na sordamar-bukidar-nika-inigwele, ese galakuoed.
” ’Dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-rey na nakwis-itogedbali, na san-dummarba imakdoed, geb miliba dulemar-oburgoed. Degi-inigwele, e-nakwisadi, undar-degisadegu guosulid.
Ar dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey gannar sordamar-bila-onomalad-bamalad onmakoed. Idualedba bur bule sordamar-bukidar omelogoed, degi, bur gingi-nuegan nikamarbaloed. Geb sikwas birgamar-nasad-sorbali, gannar dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-reygi bila-onononikoed.’
”Dule-anbo-sunmaknaidi, anga sogdebalid: ‘Daniel, a-ibagangine, dulemar-bukidar dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-reygi gwisgudamaloed. Igi be negburgan-daksagusa, deyobi be-dulemar-isganamar wemar-abargi naimogoed, degi-inigwele, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-reygi obinmalosulid.
” ’Geb degine, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey nonikoed, degi, neggwebur-galu-matusulid-dikarba arsanyob napa mesoed. Geb we-neggwebur-gandikid ese sulegoed. Dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-sordamar-bila-onomalad abinsamalosulid. Amba e-sordamar-buleganse-bakale, abingwisgumalosulid, ar abinsamalad, sateoed.
” ’We-rey-neggwebur-suoed na e-itolegedba ibmar-imakoed, ar dule e-abin-imaked, sateoed. Geb yeerdakleged-yargine ambikumaloed. Degi, we-yardi bela gaoed.
” ’Deginbali, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey bela-bela gangued-nikadbali, bela-dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-yar-suega danikoed. A-ulale, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-reybo igar-mesnonikoed. Dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey na e-sisgwa ega ukoenad, adi, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-rey-e-negsemaid-oberguegar. Degi-inigwele, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-rey-e-negsemaid oberguosulid.
” ’Degisoggu, demar-gakaba-neggwebur-bukwamaladgi bila-ononaoed. Degi, bukidar we-neggweburmar ese sulegoed. Degi-inigwele, sordamar-bila-onomalad-e-dummad-gwensak, we-rey-na-san-dummarba-imakdiid obelononikoed. Degidbali, we-rey-bingeguega imakoed.
” ’A-sorbali, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey, e-yargi negmar-gandikid-bukwadse gannar nonikoed. Degi-inigwele, we-rey nailikguoed, agi burgwenonikoed, bar amimalosulid.
” ’Dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey-sorbali, rey-baid megnonikoed. We-rey, na e-yar-semaid ibmar-bukidar-nikuegala, dule-wargwen dulemargi-mani-gaega barmidoed. Degi-inigwele, we-rey sikwas ibagan-nasad-sorbali, oburgwilenonikoed, bila-onolenaidgi burgosulid.
” ’We-rey-sorbali, dule-isgana negsenonikoed. We-dule gwen reyga megedwilubsulinad. We-dule-isgana, dulemar-baisur-binsabukwa, ukiagwar egi nonikoed. Ibmar-nueganbi-sogedbali dule-yardakar rey-gangi signonikoed.
” ’Diwar-dummad-noed-ibmar-bukwad-bibisgedaeyobi, we-dule-isgana, e-isdarmalad-e-sorda-bila-onomalad bela oberguoed. Deginbali, dule-dummad-ebo-igar-mesisad oburgwebaloed.
Dulemar-ebo-igar-mesmaloed ese yardaklegoed, amba ichesaar-sordamar-nika-inigwele, rey-gangi signonikoed.
” ’We-dule-isgana, dulemar-yar-baidginmalad baisur-binsabukwa egi dognonikoed. E-ibe bur nainu-nuegan-nanaid sunonikoed. E-babgan, degi, e-dadgan-ibmar-imaksasulid imakoed: Bila-onosadgi ibmar-nuegan-susad, e-sordamar-bila-onomaladga mimioed. Neggweburmar-galu-matusur-nikamalad-suega igar-aminai guoed. Ar weyob neg-guoedi, undarsaar-gunai guosulid.
” ’We-dule-isgana na gargangued-nika-itogedba, degi, na gandikid-nika-itogedba e-sordamar-bila-onomalad-bukidar-abargi dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-reygi bila-onononikoed. Dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-rey e-sordamar-bila-onomalad-bukidar-abargi gandikidba abin-imakoed. Degi-inigwele, egi nakosulid, ar yardakmaloed.
Amba eba-mas-gundimaladse-bakale, egi aibinmaloed. E-sordamar-bila-onomalad galakumaloed, bukidar burgwemaloed.
” ’We-reymar-warbogwad, na mese-gwagwengi mas-gunbukwa gumaloed, degi-inigwele, na muchub-muchub naibi-imakedginbi binsabukwa gumaloed. Na muchub-muchub gakansabukwa gumaloed. Ar we-ibmardi ega igarga guosulid, ar ade, amba yoo ibagan-bergued omoed.
” ’Dad-nakwed-sapiledsikid-rey ibmar-nuegan-bukidar-nika e-yarse gannar nonikoed. Geb degine, Igar-Islidikid-Maidba ibmar imakosulid. E-igar-amisadba ibmar imakoed. Geb sorbali, e-yarse gannar naoed.
” ’Ar ibagan-megisad-mosale, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey gannar dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-reygi bila-onononikoed. Ar emigindi, idualeyob bar nakosulid.
Ar abin-imakega, bila-onoged-urmar-diakined-Quitim-dupginmalad abin-nodagoed, geb dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey we-urmar-dobgudedba sikirmakdoed. Geb Igar-Islidikid-Maid sae-dakdoed. Gannar sorsik-nadapidgi, dulemar-Igar-Islidikid-Maid-obachamaladgi nued-binsaoed.
” ’We-rey-e-sordamar-bila-onomalad, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-oichonai, degi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi neg-gandikidsiid-oichonai gumaloed. Deginbali, bane-bane Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-ogumakar-uklemalad osulomarbaloed. Geb ibmar-ised Bab-Dummad-ibmar-abesulid ogwismaloed.
” ’We-rey, nued-dulemarga-sunmakedgi, dulemar-Igar-Maidgi-annadimalad-e-binsaed gaoed. Ar dulemar e-Bab-Dummad-sabgudimaladdi, we-rey-abin ganna-gwisgumaloed, eba ibsaosurmalad.
” ’Dule-binsaed-ibegan dulemar-bukidar odurdakmaloed. Degi-inigwele, abar es-suidgi oburgwelemaloed, abar soogi ogumaklemaloed, abar bela-ibmar-nikmalad e-ibe-atursamaloed. Abar emar-maiga-gumalaga yar-baidse seledmaloed.
” ’Abar dule-binsaed-ibegan, balegillearmalale, e-bendakmalad onogwen guoed. Unnila ibmar-abeged-ular, dulemar-bukidar eba atononimaloed.
Abar dule-binsaed-ibegan-balegillemaloedi, we-wilubdakleged ega bur bule swilidik-imakega guoed, bur nue-inniki-nanadigumalaga guoed, adi, ibagan-bergued-mosale, swilidik gutu-sate gumalagar. A-ibagan-moegala, amba dikasur napid.’ ”
“Dule-anbo-sunmaknaidi, anga sogdebalid: ‘Dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey na ibmar-imakbiedba ibmar imakoed. Na dukin san-dummarbaa imakoed, bab-dummagan-birgi na dummarbaa itogoed. Bab-Dummad-napiragwadgi bela-bela isdar-sunmakdii guoed. Bab-Dummad sabsur-odurdakedsega, e-ibmar-imaked nasgumai guoed. Ar Bab-Dummad na ibmar-imakoed, imakedsegad.
” ’Dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey na e-dadgan-e-bab-dummagangi binsaosulid, omegan-e-bab-dummagan-bur-nue-sabgudiidgi binsaosulid, deginbali, bab-dummagan-baigangi binsabalosulid. Ar ade, we-bab-dummaganba bur bule na san-dummarbaa imakoed.
Wemar-anale, we-rey, neg-gandikmalad-e-bab-dummad-nug odummogoed. E-dadgan, we-bab-dummad-nug odummossurmalad. We-bab-dummadga or, mani, akwa-nuegan, ibmar-mani-gargerbamalad ukoed.
” ’Neggwebur-gandikmalad-susad-bendakegala, sordamar-bab-dummagan-baid-nug-odummodimaladse goloed. We-rey, dulemar-dummadga-maid-magar-e-dakmalad-e-nug odummogoed, dule-bukidarad-e-dummadga onugsaoed, degi, ega nainumar ukbaloed.
” ’Ar ibagan-bergued-nonikile, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsikid-rey, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-reygi bila-onononikoed. Degi-inigwele, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey, bila-onoged-ur-napaginedgi, moli-birgi-sii-urwemaladgi, degi, bukidar bila-onoged-ur-diakinmaladgi abin-imakoed. Dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey, burwa-dummad-noedyobi yarmargi ubononikoed, diwar-dummad-noedyobi negmar ese bibisgoed.
” ’Deginbali, anmar-yar-yeerdaklegedgi ubononimogoed. Bukidar dulemar-yar-baidginmalad ese burgwemaloed. Degi-inigwele, Edom-dulemardi, Moab-dulemardi, egi wakinmaloed. Deginbali, Amón-dulemar bur bule-mergue egi wakinmaloed.
” ’Dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-rey-e-sordamar-bila-onomalad, yarmar-baigan-bukidar sunonikoed, Egipto-yarse-bakale, egi onogosulid.
Egipto-yar-ibe ibmar-ormargi-sobaled, ibmar-manigi-sobaled, degi, bela ibmar-nuegan-nikad suoed. Deginbali, Libia-yar, degi, Etiopía-yar subaloed.
” ’Degi-inigwele, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik-neg-gunaid, degi, dad-nakwedsik-neg-gunaid gardagan-isgana ese nonikile, bela-bela dobgudoed. Geb degine, bela-bela uludedba ibmar-oberguedgi, degi, dulemar-bukidar-ogilogedgi binsadoed.
” ’Geb e-dordoneg-dummad, bia demar-nai, degi, bia yar-yeerdakleged-islidikid-sii, amar-imbagi dordoneg soboed. Agi e-ibagan-bergued nonikoed, dule-wargwensaale gwen bendakosulid.’ ”
“Dule-anbo-sunmaknaidi, anga sogdebalid: ‘A-ibagangine, Miguel daklenonikoed. Miguel, baliwiturmar-e-dummadid, degi, be-dulemar-bendakedid. A-ibagine, nunmaked-dummad nagunonikoed. We-napneggi dulemar-ambikusad-akale, deyobi nunmaked nagudisulid. Degi-inigwele, a-ibagangine, bela be-dule-e-nugmar Gardagi-Narmakar-Nanaid bendaklemaloed.
A-ibagi, dulemar-bukidar napa-urba-mamaid gannar durgudamaloed: Abala, degisadegu-dula-gudiguega durgumaloed. Bamaladdi, degisadegu-binge-itodiguega, degi, surbinsa-itodiguega durgumaloed.
Dule-binsaed-ibegana nibneg-gaeyobi, e-nug-ogannoledii guoed. Igar-innikigwadgi dulemar-odurdakdimaladi, niisgwamar-gaeyobi, degisadegu e-nug-ogannoledii guoed.
” ’Be, Daniel, we-gayaburba mer be emarga sogo. Garda-dummad-maid ibagan-berguedse be ediar-mesoed. Ar dule-bukidar na gatik-ibmar-wisgubiedbali, baid-baidsik neg-onodii gumaloed.’
”Ani, Daniel, an-asabin dule-warbo-gwichi an daksabalid. Wargwena diwar-gakaba gwichid, baiddi diwar-gaka-obakaledgi gwismogad.
We-ebogwad-wargwenad, diwargi dule-linoʼmor-yoid-gwichidse egisded: ‘We-ibmar-gegerdakleged-guega, ¿bule bangu napi?’
”Diwargi-dule-linoʼmor-yoid-gwichid nibnegse argan-onaksad, geb Dule-Degisadegu-Dula-Maid-nuggi ise-sogar imaksad: ‘Birgapaa-negabar napid. Dule-islidikidmalad-e-balegilleged-bergusadse, bela we-ibmar gunonikoed.’
”Ani Daniel, weyob-ibmar-sogsadi an itosanad, ar degite, an magar-itossulid. Degisoggu, an ese egisdesunnad: ‘An-dummad, bela weyob ibmar-gusad-sorbali, ¿igi neg-guoe?’
”Dummad-linoʼmor-yoid an-abin-imaksad: ‘Daniel, mer be bukib-binsae, igi be emisgwa-gudii, na deyob be gudii sae. Ar bela we-ibmarmar dule wisguosulid, ibagan-berguedse dukuar megoed.
We-ibmar-soglesadgi dule-bukidar wilemaloed. A-sorbali, bur swilidik gunonimaloed, bur islidik gunonimaloed, degi, bur dule-nued gunonimaloed. Dule-isganamardi, amba na e-ibmar-isgana-imakdii gumaloed. Dule-isganamala, we-neg-gunaid magar dakmalosulid. Ar dule-binsaed-ibegandi, bela magar negdakmaloed.
” ’Bane-bane-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged osulolenonikid-iba-akale, geb Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ibmar-ised Bab-Dummad-ibmar-abesulid-ogwismaloedse, ibagan miligwen dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabake-gakambe (1,290) naguoed.
Dule bensuli iba-miligwen dulataled-ilapaa gaka durgwen-gakambe-gakatar (1,335) edarbedigusadgi, ise-nued binsalesad.
” ’Bedi, Daniel, mer be galakuo. Be-ibagan-berguedse be dobsuligudii imako. Ar ibmar-bega-sabolemaid-abingaegala, bedi ibagan-bergunonikile, gannar burgwarmalad-abargi be gwisgunonikoed.’ ”
Deunni, Judá-dulemar-e-reymar Uzías, Jotam, Acaz, degi, Ezequías, negsemamaigusad-ibagangine, degi, Israel-dulemar-e-rey Joás-machi-Jeroboam neg-semaigusmogad-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová weyob Beeri-machi-Oseasʼga sunmaknonikid.
Gebedgi, Bab-Jehová weyob Oseasʼga sunmaksad. Weyob ega sogsad: “Be nao, ome-gambasaed be nikuna, ebo be anagan-nikuo. Ar Israel-dulemar bela nue-isgusbukwad, ar bela angi bangudmalad.”
Degine, geb Oseas Bab-Dummad-sogedba imaksad. Agi, Oseas Diblaim-e-sisgwa Gomerʼye-nugad nikunonikid. Degiidbali, Gomer gurgin-nika gunonikid, geb ega susugwa uklenonikid.
Geb degine, Bab-Jehová Oseasʼga sogded: “We-susugwa Jezreelʼye be onug-imako. Ar ade, emisgwasaale, an Jehú-e-gwenadgan sabsur-wiogoed. Ar Jehúʼde Jezreel-nebagi dulemar-ogilos gusad. Deyob an Israel-yar-selemaid ilagwen-obelogar imakoed.
We-ibagangine, Jezreel-nebagi Israel-dulemar-e-bila-onomalad-e-gargangued an obelogoed.”
Geb ibagan-nasadgi, Gomer gurgin-nika gunonibalid, geb ega bunolo uklenonikid. Degine, geb Bab-Jehová Oseasʼga sogded: “We-goe Lo-Ruhamaʼye be onugsao. A-sogleged, ‘wiledaklegarsulidye.’ Ar ade, bar an Israel-dulemar wiledakosulid, ar e-isgusmalad an ega eliosulid.
Unnila Judá-dulemarginbi an ise-wile binsaoed, a-dulemardi an bendakoed. Bila-onogedgi Judá-dulemar-bendakegala, warsi an abesulid, es-suid an abesurbalid, molimar an abesurbalid, dule-moligi-sii-urwemalad an abesurbalid. Ar anbi walagwen unni gued. Ar ani an e-Bab-Dummad gued, ani an bendakoed.”
Lo-Ruhama mam-iargusgu, Gomer, gannar gurgin-nika gunonibalid, geb gannar ega susugwa-uklenonikid.
Agine, Bab-Jehová Oseasʼga sogded: “Lo-Ammiʼye be onug-imako. A-sogleged, ‘an-dulamarsulidye.’ Ar bemar bar an-dulasurmalad, degine, bar an be-Bab-Dummadsurmogad.
”Ar ibagwengine, Israel-dulemar ukub-merguedyob dule-bukib-gunonimaloed. Dogdar-merguedba geg wilubsalege, geg ebislege gunonimaloed. Bia e-annik soglesa, ‘an-neggwebursulidye,’ agine, ‘Bab-Dummad-Dula-Maid-e-mimmiganye’ bilenonikoed.
Judá-dulemar, Israel-dulemarbo ambikunonimaloed, agi, e-iduedga dule-gwensak onugsanonimaloed. Gannar dule-soggwennayob e-yargi ambikudmaloed. Ar Jezreelʼga iba-dummad nagunonikoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Agine be-gwenadganse, ‘Bab-Dummad-dulamarye’ be gormaloed. Be-bunmarsedi, ‘Wiledaklegarmaladye’ be gormarbaloed.
”Be-nan abargi-odolegega be imakmar, egi be yolemar. Ar we-ome, bar an-omesulid, bar an e-suisurmogad. Melle gambasamalad-damaladyob bar san-imake, machergan-egi-wergued obeloge.
Ar deyob imaksulile, igi-gwalulesad-ibagi aidenonigusadyobi an imakoed. Uka-swili an imakoed. Nega-dulesulidganga an imakoed. Napa-dinnaregedga an saoed, uku-uku-itogedba-burgwega an imakoed.
An e-mimmigan wile dakosulid, ade, gambasaed-mimmiganad.
E-nande, gambasaedid. Ar we-ome-mimmigan-baksadde bingedsulidaedid. Ar ade, we-ome weyob sogsad: ‘An-suiganmarba an nabie, amar anga masgunned ukdaed, amar anga gobed ukmarbalid, amar anga mor-wawaad, degi, lino-dubgi-mor-sobaled ukdamarbalid, amar anga olivo-gwallu, degine, gobed-nuegan ukdamarbalid.’
A-ulale, ani an Bab-Dummad, an e-iduar igar omuroed, e-iduar ikomar-mie-mie an saoed, adi, degidbali, bar igar amiosulid.
Ar e-suiganbina surbinsa miamakdii guoed. Gwen amisulidbali weyob sogdoed: ‘Bur an-sui-sailaginedse an gannar naoe, iduardi bur an nued gudiinad.’
Ar we-ome ani an ega masgunned-ukedye binsassulid, ani an ega vino-binigan-ukedye binsassulid, degi, olivo-gwallumar-ukedye, gwen binsassulid. Ar ani an ega manimar, olomar an ega omelosad. Degite, ¿igi-wede we-ibmarmar imaksasunna? ¡Aka Baal-bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad egi sobsad!
”A-ulale, ibagan-omosadgi, e-annik gannar an bela an-ibmar-gwagmar-ega-uksad, an-vino-nuegan-ega-uksad an suoed. Mor-wawaad an ega yoega-uksad, degi, lino-dubgi-mor-sobarmalad an ega-uksad, bela gannar an ei sunonikoed.
E-suigan-asabinni obingegsaegala, uka-swana an ogwisguoed. We-ibmargi gwen wakinnosulid, ar guedsegad.
E-wergudiid bela an ei obelogoed: E-ibamar-onoged, e-nii-binigangi ibamar-onoged, degi, e-obunnoged-ibamar, e-itoakwaa-ibamar-onogedgi ibamar-onoged, e-ibe bela an obelogoed.
E-uva-nainumar an ei bela maada imakoed, higuera-sapimar an ei bela obelogoed. Ar ‘we-ibmar an-suigan anga uksaye’ gordiid. Sapurbi-moodo nai an imakoed, ibmar-durgan-sapurbarmalad bela e-ibmar-naid ei gunmalaga an imakoed.
An we-ome sabsur-odurdakoed, ar bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladga ina-wawagan-oburmakdii gusad. E-suiganba-naega olargan biiri yodii gusad, ordubmar ena nasikdii gusad, ar gwen angi binsassulid, agala, an sabsur-odurdakoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi we-ibmar soged.
”Anbina-sogega an imakoed: Nega-dulesulidganba an sedoed, ega sabedgi nuekwaa an sunmakoed.
Agi, Acor-nebagi, uva-nainumar gannar an ega obiroed, sabsur-odurdakleged-neba an ega weligued-nebaga imakoed. A-nebagine igi-nuchukwa-unni angadga gusa, degi, igi-Egipto-yargi-noargusgu angadga an imaksa, deyob an gannar imakoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “A-ibagangine, ‘an-dummadye’ be anse golosulid. ‘An-suiye’ be anse goloed.
Be-bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad-e-nug-biega bar an be-imakosulid, degi, bipisaale bar ese be gorsii guosulid.
A-ibagine, we-ibmar-durgan mer bese achamalaga an imakoed: Ibmar-durgan-sapurbarmalad, mulamar, ibmar-durgan-unimalad. Deginbali, we-yargine, warsigi-urweleged an obelobaloed, es-suidmargi-urweleged, bila-onolemaladi an obelobaloed, adi, bela na dobedsuli gabdii gumalagar.
An-omega degisadegu an be-imakoed, igar-soglemaidba an-ome-sunnadga an be-imakoed. Ar an bela-bela be-sabsoggu, deyob an be-imakoed.
An be-nikuoed, an be-dikarba noosulid. Degidbali, magar be an-daknonikoed, ani an Bab-Jehová gue.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “A-ibagine, mogirmar dii-wiega an imakoed, geb abali, napaneg ibmar-gwag-oniega an imakoed.
Degidbali, trigoʼmar ainidagoed, vino-binid bukidar ainidagoed, olivo-gwallumar obinebakaoed. Bela we-ibmarmala, an Jezreel-neba-onasguega imakoed.
An-dulamarga napaneg an uknonikoed, angadgarbi an-dulamar an imakoed. ‘Wiledaklegarsurmaladi’ an wiledaknonikoed. ‘An-dulasurmaladse, an-dulamarye,’ an gornonikoed ‘An-Bab-Dummadye,’ anse gormarmogoed.”
Bab-Jehová gannar anga sogdebalid: “Be nae, we-ome-negsichigi-galagwensuli-nanaedse be monae, ar ade, dule-baid-e-ai-nuedga gudiid. Igi an Israel-dulemar-sabe, deyob be sabguo. Ar Israel-dulemar amba bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladba nanamar-inigwele, degi, uva-madu-olo bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladga-uklemalad gundimar-inigwele, amba an wile daked.”
Degisoggu, mani-sibugan-gwaambe-gakatar (15) an-ome-e-ai-nuedga-gudiid an bennuksad, degi, orosgisaar-dakleged-cebadaʼye-nugad galón-gwadulabake-gakabo (82) an ega uksabalid.
Geb an-omega an sogsad: “Be anbo iba-undar-nanadii guo. Galagwensuli bar be nanaosur. Bar bipisaale be machered-baidbo negsichigi nanaosur. ¡Anbela an ome-baidse achaosulid!”
Ar Israel-dulemar undar reysuli, degi, dule-negseedsuli gudii gumaloed. Degine, bar ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi ibmar-ukdii guosurmalad, degi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-mor-yoi guosurmalad, degine, ibmar-wagar-wilubganmar-sedii guosurmarbalid.
Geb sorbali, Israel-dulemar gannar na e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová amidmaloed, degi, e-rey-David amidmaloed. Ibagan-bergued-mosale, Bab-Jehová-dobekwaa gunonimaloed, degi, Bab-Dummad-e-nued-binsaed-egisnai gunonimaloed.
Israel-dulemar, Bab-Jehová-gayaburba be nue itomar, Bab-Jehová dulamar-bukwadga igar-nabogesokalid. Bab-Dummad weyob soged: “Ar an-dulamar-abargine, dule-innikidaed bergusad, emar-sabgued bergusbalid, an-igar-amimalad bergusbalid.
Aka bur we-ibmarmar burgusad: Gakangi yamo-ise-sogar-sogleged, gakansaed, atursaed, negsichigi-abirgunagwarsuli-nanaed, dule-gindakmalad. ¡Dulemar gindaklemamaigus nanaed!
A-ulale, yar-naidgi wile-itoleged-dummad nagunonikoed, egi-dulemar-gudidiidi niga-galakudmaloed. Sapurgi ibmar-durgan-bukwamaladi, bela burgwidmaloed, nuumala, uamarse-bakale, bela girgudoed.
”Melle bemar dule-bamaladgi na be gwisgumalo, melle be dule-bamaladse urwemarbalo. An-urwenaidi, unnila dule-irwa-anse-goledgi an urwenaid.
Ar bemala ibginedbali, degi, mutikidbali, oitolenonimaloed. Bemarbali dule-an-gayaburba-barsoged ibitononimarmogoed. ¡Be-nan an be-ibe obelogoed!
Ar an-dulamar aku an-daksamaladbali bela burgwismalad. ”Ar be aku an-daksamarsoggu, dule-irwa-anse-goled-igargi an be-obanmarmosunnad. Ar be an-igar-mamaid be obachasoggua, be-wagan-danimaloed an iemosunnoed.
Ar dule-irwa-anse-gormalad-mergudedbali, aka bur bule angi yoled-nanaed. Degisoggu, an e-nug-odummoged-anar, anse wilemaloed.
An-neggwebur-e-isguedgi mas gundimalad, aga bur gatik an-neggwebur-isgued abemalad.
Degi-inigwele, dule-irwa-anse-gormalad sabsur-anse odurdaklemaloed, degine, dulamar e-damaladba sabsur-anse odurdaklebaloed.
”Bab-Jehováʼgi bangusmalad. Agala, aisaar mas-gunmalo-inigwele, gwen immelegosurmalad. Degine, negsichigi-galagwensur-nanamalo-inigwele, gwen dula-omelogosurmalad.
”Vinoʼgi mumgudimaladbali, gambasamaladbali, oes gudidimalad, bar itodisurmalad.
An-neggwebur-dulamar suar-nuchuse idakmalad, a-suar ega ibmar sogdaed. Galagwensur-negsichigi-nanamaladbali aku-neg-itoge gudmalad. Negsichigi-galagwensur angi-yolegar nanadimalad.
Yar-birigangine, yar-mullugangine, sapimar-urba e-bab-dummaganga ina-wawad oburmakdamalad, degi, ibmar-ogumakar ukdamarbalid. A-ulale, e-bunamala, galagwensuli negsichigi-nanaddamalad, degi, e-balamar abirgunagwarsuli negsichigi yoleddamalad.
Be-bunamala galagwensuli negsichigi-nanadimalad-ular, be-balamar abirgunagwarsuli negsichigi-yoledimalad-ular, an sabsur-odurdakosulid. Ar ade, e-suimarmoga gambasamaladba nanadimarmogad, degi, bab-dummagan-neggi-gambasamaladbo ibmar-ogumakar ukmarbalid. Degisoggu, neggwebur aku-neg-itogedbali, bela bergudoed.
”Ar Israel-dulemar galagwensuli negsichidgi nanadimalad, Judá-dulemar, bemardi mer be deyob damarmogad. ”Judá-dulemar, melle Gilgalʼye-neg-nugadse be namalo, melle be Bet-Avénʼye-negye-nugadse be namalo. Melle be ‘Bab-Jehová-nuggi’ ise-sogar-imakmalo.
Ar Israel-dulemar moli-bebe-nikad-bunolo-uayasulidyob guded. Degisoggu, ar igi sibad-wawaad-sapingana nainu-olloledgi gagangi omalenaidae, ¿ar Bab-Jehová, deyob Israel-dulemar-imakoe? Bar deyob imakosulid.
Efraín-dulemar bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladgi alakwaa seledimalad. Mer ese bar gormar, ar na deyob nanabimarye soged.
Ar Efraín-dulemar sisa-gobed ei bergudele, gambasaedgine burguddamalad. Ar e-dummagan-yar-semaladbela, igar-isgana-imakedbina sogdamalad,
A-ulale, e-bab-dummaganga ibmar-ogumakar-ukmalad-ular, bingegunanai gudmaloed, burwa-ooregedbali bela bergumaloed.”
“¡Dule-irwa-anse-gormalad, nue be an-itomalo! ¡Israel-e-dulemar, nue be bogi an-itomalo! ¡Reyneg-yaginmalad, nue be an-itomalo! ¡An bemargi yolesokalid! Bemar Mizpaʼye-neg-nugadgi an-neggwebur-yardaklegega imaksamalad, Bemar Tabor-yalagi an-dulamar-yardaklegega imaksamarbalid.
Bemar Sitim-nebagi dia-yaa-matusulidyobi an-neggweburga gusmalad. A-ulale, an sabsur-bemar-odurdakoed.
An wisid, Efraín-dulemar igi-damala, an Israel-dulemar-daed ise-wisimakarbalid. Emide, Efraín-dulemar galagwensuli-negsichigi nanadmalad. Israel-dulemar bela isgudmalad.
”Na ibmar-isgana-imakmaladbali, geg anse gannar-dagega gumalad. Ar galagwensuli negsichigi-nanaedi, an-geg-magar-dake e-imaked.
Israel-dulemar na e-san-dummarba-imakdimaladi, na dukin-egi-yolegega imakoed. Ar Israel-dulemar, Efraín-dulemar, na e-isguedgine dukin yolemaloed. Judá-dulemarse-bela deyob eba gumarmogoed.
E-sibad-wawaadyalaba, e-molimaryalaba, an-amidii gumaloenad, degi-inigwele, gwen an-amiosurmalad. ¡Ar an e-idu bangudoed!
Ar angi bela dodosmalad. Bab-baigangad mimmi nikusmalad. Degisoggu, bemala, be-nainumala, niigwengi ilagwen-berguar guoed.” Bab-Jehová soged:
“Gabaa-neggweburgi moli-bebe-gar be ogormar, Ramá-neggweburgi gar-trompeta be ogormar. Bet-Avén-neggweburgi binnasuli be bila-onogedgi-gormakedyobi be gormakmar: ‘Benjamín-neggwebur, nue-salakar.’
Israel-dulemar, innikii an bemarga soged, ibmar-guoedi an oyogoed. Ar Efraín-neggwebur sabsur-odurdakleged-ibagi bela olloo melledoed.
Judá-dulemar-e-dummagana, dule-nainu-odogedyob gued. Degisoggu, an-urwedi, dii-dummad-noedyobi an emargi onogoed.
Efraín-dulemar mesagwar imakledisunnad, e-igar-nabolemaladgi egi gwisguledisunnad, ar ade, bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladba bur nanaed abemalad.
Degisoggu, an Efraín-dulemarga samuyob an guoed. Deginbali, Judá-dulemarga sibebyob an guoed.
”Efraín-neggwebur, na e-boni-nika dakargua, Judá-neggwebur, e-boni-yaamar dakarmogua, Asiria-yalase abarmakdemaloenad, Asiria-e-reyse bendakleged aminamaloenad. Degi-inigwele, Asiria-e-rey gwen e-bendakosulid, degi, gwen Judá-neggweburga boni-yaamar nudakosurbalid.
An Efraín-neggweburgala, achumigur-nono-wawaadyobi an guoed, Judá-neggweburgala, achumigur-nono-wawaad-senigwadyobi an guoed. An-sunnagwad an gaoed, geb an saga-saga imakoed, dule-wargwensaale, gwen bendaknonikosulid.
Agine geb an gannar an-maidse nonikoed. Na magar e-isgusad-itononimaladse an indakoed. Na magar e-isgusad-itononimalale, degine, angi-yolesmalad na magar-itononimalale, suli-suli itodmaloed. Degidbali, geb bela-belad an-amidii gumaloed.”
Israel-dulemar sogdemalad: “Dagmar, gannar anmar Bab-Jehováʼse namalo. Bab-Dummad an-ichimaksa-inigwele, amba anmar-nudakoed. Anmar-onaglik-imaksad-inigwele, anmar-nudakoed.
Ibabogwad-sorbali, anmarga burba-dulad ukoed, ibapaagine, gannar anmar-ogwisguoed. Geb, anmar e-asabin deyob gudii gumaloed.
Anmar magar Bab-Jehová-dakmarsun, e-Igarmar-Mamaidi anmar durdakmarsun. Igi dad-ibeler-noedyobi, Bab-Dummad anmarse magar-guoed, dii-wiedyobi anmarse nonikoed. Igi gebe-dii-argwaned napa-nudakdae, deyobi anmarse nonikoed.”
Bab-Jehová sogded: “Efraín-dulemar, ¿igi-an bemar-saergebe? Judá-dulemar, ¿igi-an bemar-imakergebe? Ar bemar-an-sabed, mogir bolegoedba-ainakwialir-berguddaedyob guddaed, boo wakudaryalaba-ainakwialir-berguddaedyob guddabalid, deyobi, be-an-sabgued berguddaed.
A-ulale, an-gayaburba-barsogmaladbali, an bemar-wiosad. An-sunmakedgine an bemar-onaglik-imaksad. An-igar-naboged mar-aidegeyob bemar-oitononikoed.
Ibmar-uklemalad an abemaisulid, bur an-sabgued an bemar-abemaid. Ibmar-ogumakar-uklemalad an abemaisulid, unnila dulemar magar-an-dake-gumalad an abemaid.
Bemar Adánʼyobi gumalad: Bemar, anbo-igar-mesisad bichismalad. Ar bemar, angi aibichamalad.
Galaad-neggwebur dulemar-ibmar-isgana-imakmalad-neggweburad. E-dule-ibmar-imakmaladi, bela ber ablis-eogedbi gudinanaed.
Dule-irwa-anse-gormaladi, Siquem-neggwebursik igar-nalemaidbali, emar-atursaega danagwen bin itos-bukwadamalad. Igi dule-ibmar-atursamalad, yogasaar ibmar-isgana-imakmala, deyobi, dule-irwa-anse-gormalad ibmar-isgana imakdamalad.
Israel-yala-naidgi, ibmar-gwen-nabirsulid an daksad: A-yalagine, Efraín-dulemar galagwensuli negsichigi-nanabukmalad, Israel-dulemar bela isgus bukmalad.
”Judá-dulemar, be-isgued-nukad, bemar sabsur-odurdakleged abdakdiid.”
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “An-dulamar an na bendakbienad, an Israel-yar nudakbienad, degi-inigwele, Efraín-dulemar-isgued wilub-obichad, degi, Samaria-dulemar-isgued wilub-obichabalid. Ar ade, wemar gakangi gudimalad. Ar dule-atursaedyobi ibmar-atursaegala, negyaba dogmalad, gandikidgi danagwen galimbaba ibmar-atursaddamalad.
Ar we-dulemar, gwen binsadasurmalad, na e-ibmar-isgana-imakmalad angi gwen yoggumaisurye. Ar e-ibmar-isgana-imakmaladi, bela na egi e-ebiris naid. We-ibmar, bela an-asabin oyolenaid.
”E-ibmar-isgana-imakmaladgi, e-rey-yeer-itogega imakmalad. Degi, e-gakansamaladgi, e-dummagan-yeer-itogega imakmarbalid.
Bela we-dulemar, negsichigi abirgunagwarsuli yoledimaladid. Ar we-dulemar madu-yoed-soo ginnitibisiiyob gumalad, ar igi dule-madu-sobed bar soo-ogannoged abesurdae, unnila madu-mued edarbesidae, deyobi we-dulemar gumalad.
Rey-ibagi, dummagan, vinoʼgi mumguddamalad. Rey, galagwensuli guddamogad. Deyobi, rey, dule-galagwensuli-mumgumalad e-aimarye na sognagusdaed.
Urwed-onogega, e-gwage madu-yoed-diopisur-naddaedyob naddaed. Mutikgusale, e-urwed geb boggusiid. Neg-oibosale, e-urwed gannar egi noardaed.
We-dulemar, madu-yoed-soo-diopisulidyobi gumalad. E-dummagan-negsemamaid-obeloddamalad. Bela deyobi e-reymar-obelosdamalad. Degite, wemar-wargwensaale, an-amiega gwen anse gorsurmalad.
”Efraín-dulemar neggwebur-baigan-angi-bengudimaladba apuruded. Ar an-dulamar, madu wagar-nailik-akwigusadyobi gumalad.
Dule-baigan Israel-dulemar-e-gangued ei obelonanaid, degite, Israel-dulemar, deyob-neg-gunaid akusunna itomalad. Bela e-ibe e-gargangued obelosmalad, degite, amba aku itomalad.
Israel-dulemar e-isguedga gwen wile-itobisurmalad, an e-Bab-Dummad-guedgi, gwen an-amibisurmalad. Na e-san-dummarba-imaked geg anse-dagega e-imaked.
”Efraín-dulemar nuu-aku-neg-itogedyob gumalad, gwen magar neg-itosurmalad. Imbagwenale, Egipto-dulemarse bendakleged egisdedaed, imbagwenar, Asiria-dulemarse bendakleged egisdedabalid.
Ar deyob bendakleged-egisnadmalale, nuumar-galegeyobi an egi saki obatoed. E-isgued-ular, an ilagugle (7) sabsur odurdakoed.
¡Duledar-wilesmarsun! Ar angi bangusmalad. Angi gwisgusmaladba bergumarsunnoed. Ar sunna an na bendakenad, degi-inigwele, ar emardi unnila anga gakansaar sunmakmalad.
Anse innikigwadgi gorsurmalad, unnila, e-gasgi bomamaidamalad. Ibmar-gwag-nikuegala, vino-binid-nikuegala, na dukin esgi san-wionanaidamarbalid. Degi, angi aibitedamarbalid.
Amba an-igargi an odurdaksad-inigwele, amba an ega e-surgan-ogannosad-inigwele, degite, amba angi-aibinega angi ichakwa-binsananaid.
Gwen anse Bab-Dummad-Bur-Biriginedse dagbisurmalad. Warsi-biir-daklegedyob gumalad. E-dummagan sabsur-sunmakmaladbali, es-suidgi oburgwilenai gumaloed, degine, Egipto-dulemar egi dodonanai gumarbaloed.”
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “¡Gar-trompeta be ogole! Ar sulubagi anse-goled-neggi sigdanikid. Ar Israel-dulemar, anbo-igar-mesisad obelosmalad, an-Igar-Maidgi yolesmalad.
Emide, anse wiledanimalad. Weyob sogmalad: ‘Israel-Bab-Dummadye, be anmar-Bab-Dummadid, anmar wisye.’
Degi-inigwele, Israel-dulemar igar-nued obachamalad, a-ulale, e-isdarmalad e-baleginmaloed.
An-sogedbarsuli reymar-omesdimalad. Yogasaar dulemar-an-akudaked dummaganga nug-imakdimalad. Na dukin san-wiomalaga e-manimargine, e-ormargine, bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad sobdimalad.
¡Samaria-dulemar! Moli-bebe-nikad-sapingwagwad bab-dummadyob be sedimalad be metemala. An bemargi an nue-urwed. ¿Ar sana bemar san-swilidiksuli-gudii gumaloe?
¡Israel-dulemar! We-moli-bebe-nikad-sapingwagwad Bab-Dummadsulid. Ar wede, dule-sobedid. Samaria-dulemar-e-moli-sobaled, an bela bibisgoed.
”Ibmar-isgana be imaksamalad, degisoggu, boni-dummad begi aibinnonikoed. Trigo-e-war san sated, degisoggu, madubur nikuosulid. Ar trigo-e-war wis e-san-nikunonikile, dule-bamalad-e-masga guoed.
Israel-yar bela ibitosad, emi-ibagi, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad-abargi bai daklesulid.
Israel-dulemar aka Asiria-dulemarse bendakleged egichisgusmalad. Moli-sapur-uayasuid-aku-neg-itogedyob angi bangudmalad. Efraín-dulemar, igi-ome mani-amiega sui-bamaladbo mege, deyobi gudmalad.
Efraín, bendaked-amiega, we-neggwebur-bamalad-manigi-bennus-inigwele, gwen ega igarga guosulid. Anse neggwebur-bamalad-dikasuli-bukwadse gales barmiledmaloed. Rey-buledsega, dummagansega sikwas sabsur-odurdakledii gumargweloed.
”Efraín-dulemar, na be-isgued-eliegala, bemar bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladga ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-bukidar sobsamalad. Ar wede, unnila isgued-ailaga be obinnismalad.
Ar sunna an bemarga igar-nuegan-narmakar bukidar uksaled, degi-inigwele, ar bemar an-igar gwen bai daksasurmalaled.
Be anga ibmar-ogumakar-uked yeer-itodamalad, be a-san gundamarbalid. Degi-inigwele, ulubgi-napiragwadgi-imaksulidba we-ibmar-imakleged, an gwen nabir daksulid. Degisoggu, bemar-isgued an iegosulid, an sabsur-bemar-odurdakedsemalad. Gannar bemar Egipto-yarse namaloed.
Israel-dulemar, ani an bemar-obinyedid, degite, bemar an-iedmalad. Nega-dummagan-yeerdaklemalad be sobdemalad. Judá-dulemar, neggwebur-galu-matusurmalad omelodmalad. Degi-inigwele, bela bergumalaga, e-neggweburmargi, e-galu-matusurmaladgi, soo an odegoed.”
Oseas, Israel-dulemarga sogded: “Israel-dulemar, mer be weligwar-itomar, mer be neggwebur-baiganyob iba-onomar. Ar bemar galagwensuli nanadmalad. Be-Bab-Dummadgi be bangudmalad, bab-dummad-baigan-nug be odummodmalad. Bela ibmar-gwag-omukuleged-neggi gambasaed-e-mani-bennukleged bur be abeged.
A-ulale, ibmar-gwagmar, uvaʼmar gwen be-oimmogosurmalad. Vino-binid bar yeer-goblege guosulid.
Efraín-dulemar Bab-Jehová-yargi bar ambikuosurmalad, gannar Egipto-yarse-namaloed. Asiria-yargi mas-isemalad gunmaloed.
Bab-Jehováʼga bar vino-eoleged ukosurmalad, e-ibmar-Bab-Dummadga-ukmalad, bar ega ibnuedga guosulid. Madu-gullegoedi dulemarga madu-dule-burgwaled-neggi-gullegedyob ega guoed. Dule a-madu-guchale, swilidiksuli guoed. Unnila sikwas nabir-itogega ega guoed. Degi-inigwele, we-madu, Bab-Jehová-negse seledosulid.
”Bab-Dummadga-iba-onolegedgi ¿ibu-be imakmaloe? Bab-Dummadga-itoakwaa iba-onolegedgi, ¿ibu-be imakmarbaloe?
Amba sabsur-odurdaklegedgi be wakinye sogmalale, Egipto-dulemarse be galemaloed, degi, Menfis-neggweburgi be-digmaloed. Be-ibmar-nuegan-manigi-sobarmaladgi, dakemar ammurudoed, be-dordonegmargi ikomar ammurudoed.
Sabsur-odurdakleged-iba noni, buged-imakleged-iba noni. Israel-dulemar, ¡be wisigarmar! Be-isgued dogdargusad, isdar-emar-dakedi be baligannosad. Emide bemar, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged dule-gegegwaga imakmalad. Deginbali, nia-saedga be Dule-Bab-Dummad-burbaba-ibmar-soged imakmalad.
Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogedi, Bab-Dummadmala, Efraín-neggweburga nakulegedga gumalad. Wemar-yolemalagala, bemardi sakiyob e-idu galumar-urbedamalad, deginbali, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi bemardi wemar-sae-dakdamarbalid.
Bemar Gabaaʼgi-dulemar-gusmaladyobi, nue bela-belad be isgudmalad. Ar Bab-Dummadi, be-isgued iegosulid, be-isguedba sabsur-bemar-odurdakoed.”
Bab-Jehová sogded: “An Israel-dulemar-aminonigu, nega-dulesulidganba uva-san-amilegedyob an amisgusad. An gebe e-dadgan-dakargua, higuera-sapigi-e-san-dutuu-ainidanikiyob an daksad. Degi-inigwele, emar aka bab-dummadyob-imakleged-Baal-Peorʼba nanadmalad. Abali na isgudmalad, dule-isguedga gudmalad. We-bab-dummadbina sulibinsa-itode gudmalad.
Efraín-dulemar-e-ibmar-nuegan-bukidar-nikadi bar daklegosulid. Nuu-gukudeyob guoed. E-omegan bar gurgin-nika guosurmalad, bar mimmigan-nikuosulid. E-dula bar sapibeneggi-mai guosulid.
Ar amba e-mimmigan-dungumamai-dakdemalale, we-napneggi amba an ei obelogoed. An egi bangudele, ¡dummad-wilemaloed!
Efraín-yala, Tiro-yalayob-dakleged. Yala-nuedgi bukwamalad. Degi-inigwele, Efraín-dulemardi burgwed-igarba na e-mimmigan-semamaid.”
Oseas sogded: “Bab-Jehová, ega be ibmar-ukbied ukdo. Ega e-omegan mellegega be imake, e-omegan-e-nunismar be odinnoge.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Israel-dulemala, Gilgal-neggweburgi bela isguali gudmalad. De-akale, an bemar isdar dakded. Bemar-isgued-ulale, anse-goled-neggi an bemar-onioed. Bar an bemar-sabguosulid, ar ade, bela be-dummagan uayasulidamalad.
Efraín-dulemar galakuded: Sapi-mali-dingudedyob nadmalad, sapi-bar-sanmaksurmaladyob nadmalad. Amba na mimmigan-nikudmalale, an ei oburgoed.”
Oseas Israel-dulemarga sogded: “Ar bemar, an-Bab-Dummadba ibsassurmarsoggu, Bab-Dummad bemar-obanoed. Neggwebur-baigan-abargi yarsuli be gudii gumaloed.”
Oseas sogdebalid: “Israel-dulemar uva-saila-yeer-sanmakedyob guenad, ichesuli sanmakdaenad. Ar bur bukidar-sanmakdedaed-inigwele, aka bur bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladga bukidar ailamar sobdedamalad. Ar e-yar nue-nasguddaed-inigwele, aka bur bule e-bab-dummaganga ailamar yeerdakle imakdedamalad.
Ar we-dulemar darbo-binsadamalad, agala, Bab-Dummad, e-isgumalad-ular sabsur odurdakoed. Bab-Jehová e-bab-dummagan-ailamar bela obelogoed, e-akwa-sobar-gwismalad bela ei obelobaloed.
”Ar sunna weyob sogmalad: ‘Ar anmar Bab-Dummad-dobsuli-gudii gusye, a-ulale, anmar reysuli gudimarye. Ar anmar rey-nikana, ¿ibugi wis anmar-bendakoena?’
Ar unnila binsa sunmakdamalad, gakansaar ise-sogar ibmar-sogdamalad, binsa dulemarbo igar-omesdamalad. Agala, abin-abin-imakmalad, gagan-isgana-ainiardaedyobi noardaed.
Samaria-dulemar, Bet-Avén-yargi moli-bebe-nikad-sapingwagwad-orbiid-e-nug-odummodiidga bukib-binsanonimaloed. E-dulemar, a-ulale, na wiles itononimaloed, e-dule-irwa-ese-gormaladmoga bukib ega binsadmarmogoed, ar ade, e-ibe dikasuli yar-baidse sedmaloed.
Moli-bebe-nikad-sapingwagwad-orbiidi, Asiria-yarse rey-maniga-guega seledoed. Efraín-dulemar bingegumaloed. Israel-dulemardina, na e-bab-dummadga-ibmar-imakdimaladgi dummad-bingegunai guoed.
Samaria-dulemala, e-reybogwa obelolemaloed. Diwar-noedba suarmar-selemaidaedyobi selemai gumaloed.
Bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad-e-negmar, yarmar-birigi-bukwamaladi bela bibislegoed. Israel-dulemar egi isgudidamaladid. E-aila-matusurmaladgi gagan-ikobimalad egi ammurnai gudoed. Degisoggu, yarmarga sogdemaloed: ‘¡Be anmargi batedage!’ Yar-mulluganga sogdemaloed: ‘¡Be anmar-omursunna!’ ”
Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemarga sogded: “¡Bemar, Israel-dulemar! Gabaaʼgi-neggusad-akale, be isgudanigumalad. De-akale, bemar gwen isgued iesurmalad. A-ulale, bemar be-isguedba Gabaa-yargi bila-onolegoedgi be obelolemaloed.
An-itolegedba an bemar sabsur-odurdakoed. Bemargi-yolemalagala, neggwebur-baigan-atomalaga an imakoed. Agi bemar sogbo-ibmar-isgana-imaksadba, an sabsur-bemar-odurdakoed.
Efraín-dulemar moli-bebe-nikad-bipigwad-nuekwa-odurdaklegaledyobinad, ibmar-gwag-weed yeer-itodaenad. An ega yapa e-dukargi suar nasikgusanad. Emisgindi an, Efraín-dulemar-e-dukargi suar nasiksunnoed. Judá-dulemar napa-imuedga gudsunnoed, Jacob-wagan napa-imulesad-durwinai gudsunnoed.”
Oseas Israel-dulemarga sogded: “¡Bab-Jehová-amiega be guakwamalo! Ar bemar nainu-binidyob gumalad. Gwagegi igar-napiragwad be nasikmar, adi, egi sabgued-igar be amimaloed. Geb agine, Bab-Jehová, bemar-bendakegala, bemarbina danikoed. Ar igi dii-wiedi, napa-dinnaregedgi batenonidae, deyobi, Bab-Jehová bemar-bendaknonikoed.
Ar bemar, ibmar-isgana imaksamalad, agala, bemar boni-dummaganba galitonanaid, gakan-imaksadbali be ibitonanaid. Ar ade, bemar, be-moli-ur-bila-onomaladmargi bensulid nikusmalad, ar sorda-bila-onomaladgi be bensulid nikusmarbalid.
Emide, be-neggweburgine bila onoledoed, bela be-neg-gandikmalad bibichidoed. Igi Rey-Salmán bila-ononaidgi Bet-Arbel-neggwebur-obelosgusayob negguoed. Deunni, nangan na e-mimmiganbo sabsur-odurdaklegar burgwis nanaed. Deyob neg guoed.
Weyobi Betel-dulemar bemar-imakoed, ar bemar doggus-isgued wilub-obichaa nikad. Neg-oibononikile, Israel-e-rey yog-berguar guoed.”
Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemarga sogded: “Bipigwaunni an be-sabgusad, Egipto-yar-akale an-machise an gochagusad.
An bur bule bese gornaigusdae-inigwele, aka bur bule be angi banguddaed. Aka bur bule be bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladga ibmar-ogumakar ukdedaed. Bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladga ina-wawadikmalad be oburmakdedaed.
Ani an Efraín-dulemar nanaedgi odurdaksad, ani an argangi seali gusad. Ani an be-onudaked-gudiid-inigwele, degite, gwen deyob be an-daksasulid.
Sabedgi an be-nisad, wiledakedgi an be-sesad. Mailediidgi an be-onosad, wiledakedgi masgi an be-oguchad.
”Egipto-yarse be naosurmalad, Asiria-dulemar bemar-dummadga guoed. Ar ade, anse bemar dagbisur-gusmarsoggua, a-nukad be deyob gumaloed.
Be-yargine bila-onoleged nagunonikoed, be-isdarmalad bela be-yawagak-bargamalad bibisgemaloed, bela be-ibmar-imakoed-igar-mamaid obelolenonikoed.
Bemar, an-neggwebur-gumaladi, angi nue-banguega be alamaknanaid. Degisoggu, amba anse gorye sogmalale, bar an bendakosulid.
”Efraín-dulemar, ¿igi an be-iegosunna? Gege an be-ieged. Israel-dulemar, ¿igi an dule-bamaladga be-urmakosunna? Gege an be-urmaked. Ar gege an Adma-neggwebur-urmaksadyob bemar-urmaked, gege an Zeboim-neggwebur-iesayob bemar-ieged. An-ulubgine, an-gwage bemar-sabedba bipirmaksiiyob itoleged, bela an-samurmar bemar-sabedba nakwamaksiiyob itoleged.
Bar an begi urwosulid, bar an Efraín-obelogosurbalid, ar an dulemaryob gusulid. Ar an Bab-Dummad-Isligwaled gued, an-neggwebur-abargi an gudiid.
”An achumigur-nono-wawaadyob uurmakdoed, geb bemar anba ibsadmaloed. An binnasuli-uurmakdele, be-wagan, dad-nakwed-akale, dobed-abalagi anse nonimaloed.
”Egipto-yala-akale, nuu-emar-dobgudiiyobi, dobed-abalagi anse nonimaloed. Asiria-yala-akale, sikwi-emar-dobgudiiyobi, dobed-abalagi anse nonimaloed. Ani an e-negmargi-megmalaga imakoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi we-ibmar soged.” Bab-Jehová sogded:
“Efraín-dulemar dummad-anga gakansadimalad. Israel-dulemar gusgu an-yardakdimalad. Judá-dulemar angi aibacha gudimalad, bemar, angine dikasur-yoggus gudimalad.”
“Efraín-dulemar unnila burwa-goledba gudidimalad, dad-nakwedsik-burwa-goled-sorba gudidimalad. Aka bur bule emar-wionaigusdamalad, bane-bane gakanginbi gudimalad. Asiria-dulemarbo igar mesdidamalad, Egipto-dulemarga olivo-gwallu ukdidamarbalid.”
Oseas weyob sogded: “Bab-Jehová, Judá-dulemargi yolenonikoed, Jacob, e-ichakwadaedba sabsur-odurdaklegoed, e-ibmar-isgana-imaksadba sabsur-odurdaklegoed.
Jacob, gwaluleged-iduale, bato sapibeneggi e-ia-yamosad. Degine, bato uka-selebagwadgi, Bab-Dummadbo gala-maada nagusad.
Baliwiturbo bengusgusad, baliwiturgi obicha gusad. Jacob, ise-boale baliwiturga sognaigusad: ‘Wile be an-dakye.’ Ar Bab-Dummadi Betel-neggweburgi Jacob-abingusad, agine Jacobʼbo sunmaksad.
Jacob, Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadbo sunmaksad. A-Bab-Dummadi, Bab-Jehováʼye nugad.
Israel-dulemar, ar bemardina, be-Bab-Dummadse be gannar dagergebed, sabgued be oyogergebed, igar-napiragwad be imakergebed, Bab-Dummadgi-bensuli be nanaergebbalid.”
Bab-Dummad Israel-dulemarga sogded: “Bemar Canaán-dulemar-ibmar-ukmaladyobid. Ar we-dulemar, gadi emar-yardakmalad, yamo nibir-isganagi dulemarga ibmar-wilubsadamalad.
Efraín-dulemar na san-bule-bule-sunmakmalad. Weyob sogmalad: ‘Ibiyobi an ibmar-ibedga gusa, ibmar-bukidar an nikad. Dule gwen angi isgued amiosulid, degine, an-arbadiidgi dule gwen isgued amiosurbalid.’
”Ar bemar Egipto-yargi-bukwamalad-akale, bato ani an bemar-Bab-Dummadid. Gannar dordoneggi-megmalaga an bemar-imakoed. Igi nega-dulesulidganba an bemar-imaksagusa, deyob an bemar-imakoed.
Ani an anga-gayaburba-barsogmaladba an bemarga sunmaksad. Wemar bukidar-negburgan-dakega an imaksad. Wemarbali an burbar-sunmaklegedgi an sunmaksad.
”Israel-dulemar-Galaad-yargi-gudimalad dule-isgumaladid. Gilgalʼye-neg-nugadse naddamalad, agi, moli-bebe-nikad oburgwedamalad, adi, e-bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladga ogumakar ukegar. Agala, e-aila-matusurmalad bela an ei bibisgoed, e-nainugi e-aila-akwamarbi-omilede an imakoed.”
Oseas weyob sogded: “Be-dad-Jacob, Aram-yarse wakite gusad, agi ome-nikuega sibad-wawaad-edarbedgi arbas gusad.
Bab-Jehováʼdi, Egipto-yargi Israel-dulemar-onogegala, degi, amar-akwebaligala, dule-e-gayaburba-barsoged ebusgusad,
Degi-inigwele, Efraín-dulemar e-Bab-Jehová-ourwega imaksamalad, Bab-Dummad-sae-itogega imaksamalad. Agala, Bab-Jehováʼdi, wemar emar-ablis-eosmalad-nukad sabsur-odurdakoed. E-isgumaladba na dukin odurdaklemaloed.”
Gebeunni, Efraín-dulemar, Israel-yargi nuga-nikarbamaladinad. Ibmar-sogdemalale, dulemar, dobee itodamalad. Emide, Efraín-dulemar, bab-dummad-Baalʼye-nugad-e-nug odummod gusmalad. A-isgued-nukad, Efraín-dulemar burgwenoni gusad.
Degi-inigwele, amba bur bule isguedgi nanabukmalad. Dulemar-ega-ibmar-sobmaladga sogdedamalad: “Be anga bab-dummagan-imaklegoyob-manibiid be sobye.” Geb a-dulemar na e-dakedba ega sobdamalad. Degi, bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad-e-wagar-uddamalad, degine, dule-ogumakar-ukleged ega ukdedamarbalid.
Agala, igi-bolegoe-boo-bate, igi-boo wakudaryalaba-milege, deyob gumaloed. Igi-gagan-dinnagana burwaba-seleddae, igi-waa soogi-ainakwider seleddae, deyob gumaloed.
Bab-Dummad Israel-dulemarga sogded: “Israel-dulemar, Egipto-yargi be bukwamargua, bato an bemar-Bab-Dummadid. An-imbagi Bab-Dummad-baid be nikuosurmalad, an-imbagi Abonoged-baid be nikuosurbalid. Unnila anbi be-Bab-Dummadga gued.
Ar ani an nega-dulesulidganba, napa-uedikidba be gudigu be-akwisad.
An bemarga masgunned uksagusad, agi bemar nue-immeles gusmalad. Degi-inigwele, ar bemardi san-dummarbaa itosgusmalad, degidbali, be an-ies gusmalad.
Degisoggu, an bemarga achumigur-nono-wawaadyob gumaloed. An bemar-idu achu-sapur-barbadyob dukumaloed.
Igi wiob-ome ei mimmigan-sulesale, uluardae, deyobi an bemargi gwichigudoed. Be-gwage-dubmar-mamaid an bei itiroed. Achumigur-nono-wawaadyobi an bemar-obelogoed. Ibdurgan-ursilimaladyob an bemar-ichimakoed.
”Israel-dulemar, ani an bemar-obelogoed, ar bemar, be-bendakdiidgi be gwisgunanaid.
Ar bemar gordigusmalad: ‘Anga be rey-udaye, dule-negsemalad be anga udabarye.’ Degite, bemar-neggwebur-bendakega, ¿bia be-reymarde? ¿Bia dulemar-bega-negsemaladde?
An-urwedgi an bemarga rey-uksad, an-urwedgi an bemar-annik susbalid.
Efraín-dulemar-e-ibmar-isgana-imakmaladi nue-narmakar maid, bela an e-isgumalad semaid.
Israel-dulemarga gwaluleged-ibagan nonikinad, degi-inigwele, igi sikwi muu-neggi aidegega geg nuekwaa mege, deyobi be binsaedsuli gusmalad.
”¿Degite, amba neg-uan-e-ganguedgi bemar-bendakbi be an-abede? ¿Burgwedgi an bemar-bendakode? Burgwed, ¿bia be-boni-dummadgande nadsunna? Neg-uan, ¿bia be-dule-obeloged nadsunna? Burgwed, neg-uan, be dagmar, wile bar an wemar-dakosulid.
”Ar bemar, Efraín-dulemar, be-gwenadgan-abargi be nasgudele, ani an bemar-obelogoed. Igi-burwa-dad-nakwedsikid nega-dulesulidgansik-goledi, dianmaid, degi, diwarmaid dinnaa imake, deyobi an bemar-imakoed. Geb agi, be-isdarmalad be-ibe bela be-ibmar-nuegan sumaloed.
Samaria-dulemar, e-isgusad-nukad, an sabsur-odurdakoed, ar e-Bab-Dummadgi yolesmalad. E-dulemar bila-onogedgi burgwemaloed, e-mimmigan napagi sabsur-omukulenai gumaloed. E-omegan-gurgin-nikamalad-ibe, saban sabsur-egalenai guoed.”
Oseas Israel-dulemarga weyob sogded: “Israel-dulemar, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼse be gannar dagmar. Ar bemar na be-isguedgi-argwanega na be imaksamalad.
Bab-Dummadga be ibmar-sogmaloedi, nue egi be binsamalo. Bab-Jehováʼse gannar be namar, ega be ise-wilesakwaa weyob be sogmaloed: ‘Be anmarga isgued elie, begi-isgussulidyob be anmar-dake. Wiledakedgi be anmar-abingae, ar anmar na be-nug odummobimalad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, Asiria-dulemar gwen anmar-bendakosulid, bar anmar molimar-bila-onoged-birgi nakosulid. Anmar, anmar-ibmar-sobsamaladse anmar-bab-dummaganye, bar golosulid. Bab-Jehová, unnila begine babgan-satemalad wile daklesiid.’ ”
Bab-Dummad Israel-dulemarga weyob sogded: “Ani an bemar-isgued nudakoed, wile-be-dakedba an be-sabgumaloed, ar ade, bar an bemarse urwosulid.
Boo-milegedyob an Israel-dulemarga guoed. Dutu-achunnedyob an Israel-dulemar-imakoed. Igi Líbano-urwarmar-e-sailamar neg-urba-diglegwichi, deyobi, an bemar-imakmaloed.
E-anagan nasgudoed, olivo-sapi-gandikidba-yeerdaklegwichiyob bemar guoed. E-yapannedi, Líbano-urwar-yeer-yapannedyob yapanmaloed.
An-argan-yaurgi gannar ambikunonimaloed, orosgi-dakleged-trigoʼyob dungudmaloed. Uva-dub-ainiedyob e-wagan ainidoed, Líbano-yar-e-vinoʼyobi, nug-dummarbaa gumaloed.
Efraín-dulemar, Bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad be iemarsun. Ani an bemar-abinsadiidid, ani an bemar-edarbediidid. Baryawar-aramakgwichiyob an gued, be-sanmakedi angi danikid.”
Ar dule, binsaed-ibedile, we-ibmarmar magar itogoed. Ar dule, nue-ibmar-wisile, we-ibmarmar magar itogoed. Bab-Jehová-igarmala bela innikigwadbiid. A-igarbali, dule-innikimalad nanamalad. Dule-uayasulidamaladdi, we-igargi yoleddamalad.
Bab-Jehová Petuel-machi-Joelʼga gayaburba sognonikid. Joel, Israel-dulemarga weyob sogded:
“Bemar, sapin-dummagan-gumalad, nue itomalo. Bela we-yargi-gudidimalad, nue itomalo. Ses-danagwen-gudimalad-ibmar-guchagusad-obesadi, sorba ses-dummagan-gudidimalad gunnonimalad. Geb ses-dummagan-gudidimalad-ibmar-guchagusad-obesadi, sorba ses-sapingana gunnonimarmogad. Geb ses-sapingana-ibmar-guchagusad-obesadi, sorba ses-burwigana gunnonimarmogad. Be-dadgan-ibagangi, ¿ar weyobi neg-gusa? Bemar-emi-dulagudimaladgi, ¿ar bemar weyob neg-dakdimala? Emi, be-mimmigangala, be we-ibmar sogmala, adi, be-mimmigan na e-mimmiganga sogmarmogaga, deginmoga, a-mimmigan na e-wagan-danimaloedga sogmarmogoed.
<range>
<range>
”¡Mummugan, atakmala, be bomala! Bela-gadi-vino-gobmalad be nunmak itomala, ar ade, vino-binid bemar-annik sulesad.
Ar dule-yar-baidgi-bukmalad-gandikmalad-bukidar, an-yargine ubononikid. E-nugarmar, achumigur-nugarmaryobi nikamalad. E-nugar-suigan, achumigur-e-ome-nugaryobi nikamalad.
An-uva-dubmar-digar-naid obelosmalad. An-higuera-sapimar daas-daas-imaksad. Bela e-uka yaas-yaas-imaksamalad, e-anagan swanga imaksamalad. Bela omukusmalad.
”An-dulemar, yagwa wile-itoged-mor-yoi na machered-abesiid-ei-burgwisadba-boedyobi, bomalad.
Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neggi ibmar-gwag-orosgi-dakleged-ukleged bar uklesulid, degi, vinoʼmar bar uklesurbalid. Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad Bab-Jehováʼga-arbamaladi, bomarmogad.
Nainumar bela swanga nanaid, e-napamar bela dinna naded. Bela ibmar-gwag-orosgi-dakleged bergusad, vinoʼmar bela dinguded, olivoʼmar bela berguded.
”Bemar, sapurgi-arbamalad, bemar uva-dubgi-arbamalad, ibmar-gwag-trigoʼye-nugad-bela-dingusadba, ibmar-gwag-cebadaʼye-nugad-bela-dingusadba, be bomala. Ar bela ibmar-gwagmar-welesadi oitolesad.
Uva-dubmar bela dinguded, sapi-higueraʼye-nugad, bela burgwided. Sapi-granadoʼye-nugad bela dingudmogad, ogobgi-dakleged, manzana-sapimar, dingudmalad. Bela sapimar-gwigwichid dingudmalad. Dulemar-e-yeer-itodiidse-bakale, e-ibe bergunonikid.”
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, be wile-itomar, wile-itoged-mor be yomar. Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ukleged-ailagi-arbamalad, naibid-dummad be itomar. An-Bab-Dummadga-arbadimalad, be dagmala, wile-itoged-mor-yoi, be oibomar, ar ibmar-gwagmar, degi, vinoʼmar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi bar uklesulid.
Bela dulemarse gormala, mer-bar-mas-gulleged-iba be nasikmalo. Be-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼse-goled-neggi, girmar-dummagan be onmakmala, bela dulemar-we-yargi-gudidimalad be onmakmala, agi Bab-Jehováʼse ise-gollar imakmala.
¡Iba-buledi danikid! ¡Bab-Jehová-e-iba bato warmakdanikid! Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nika-Maid-e-iba, ibmar-bergued-iba guoed.
Anmar-masgulleged, ¿anmar-wagab anmar-ibe sulenai gussursi? Anmar-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi anmar-wergued, anmar-yeer-itoged, ¿anmar-ibe osulolessursi?
Ibmar-gwag diglesa-inigwele, degite, bela nungusad. Ibmar-saboleged-neg isgus-sii. Ibmar-gwag-saboleged-negmar bela bibichisad. Ar ibmar-gwagmar bela dingusmalad.
Ibiyobi molimar masbina gornanai. Moli-bebe-nikamalad masgunned satedbali oes gaamakdidimalad. Sibad-wawaadmar deyobi gudidimarmogad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, an bese ise-wilegar goled, ar ade, nainumargi gagan-nanaid soo ogumaksad, bela sapimar-gwigwichid ogumaksad.
Bab-Jehová, amba ibmar-durganse-bakale, bela-bela be-amimalad, ar ade, bela diwarmar-mamaidi dingusad, nainumargi gagan-nanaid soo ogumaksad.
Sión-yargine gar-trompeta ogormar, an-yar-islidikidgi neg-owisoleged-gar be ogormar. Bela dulemar-we-yargi-gudimalad wawanmakmar, ar ade, Bab-Jehová-danikid-e-iba mosad, ar bato nue-warmaksad.
A-ibagi, negasichid nagunonikoed, neg gudure sigoed. Mogirmar-gudureged nagunonikoed, neg daas sigoed. Igi neg-oibodanikile, bela yarmargi neg-mee imakdanidae, deyobi, dule-bukidar dule-bulegana danimaloed. Epenne we-dulemaryobid dulemar gwen dakledisulid, deginbali, yoedsega dulemar-deyobid gwen daklegosurbalid.
We-dulemar sooyobi gumalad, bela ese ibmar gummaked. We-dulemar-nonikoed-iduale, soo bela ibmar-ogumaked, we-dulemar-nasad-sorbali, soo bela ibmar-obeloged. We-dulemar, amba yoo dagegua, we-yar-naidi, Edén-nainuyobi daklegenad. We-dulemar, we-yargi-nasmargua, e-sorbali, yar, nega-dulesulidganyob nagusad. E-ganguedgi ibmarmar geg wakinned.
E-gangued, moliyob gangumalad. Dulemar-moli-birgi-abarmakmaidyob abarmakmalad.
Yar-birgi ichomakdemalale, bila-onomalad-ur-napagined-gollomakedyob, oimakmalad. Igi-gagan-dinnagana soose-gummakdele, gormamaidae, deyobi gollomakmalad. Igi-bila-onomalad-bulegan, bila-onogega guagwar bukmala, deyobi gumalad.
We-dulemar-asabin bela dulemar-we-napneggi-bukmalad gwakidmalad, bela e-niga argwatemalad.
Bila-onomalad-buleganyobi urwemalad, bila-onomaladyobi galumar-birgi nakwe-nakwe imakmalad. Bela ilekwaa na e-igarba namaloed gwen igar-baid-baidsik-nadapi gumalosulid.
Na muchub-muchub-yolenanai gumalosulid, na ilemakar nadapmaloed. Sigu-egi-milemamaid-abinni, amba ilekwaa nadapi gumaloed.
We-dulemar neggweburgi sabsur ubononimaloed, galumar-matusulid-mamaid-birgi abarmakdimaloed. Negmargi nakwe-nakwe imaknonimaloed, dule-atursamaladyobi, yawagak-seniganaba dognonimaloed.
We-dulemar-bila-onomalad-abin napneg wawanmakdoed, nibneg giglimakdoed. We-dulemar-abin dada, degi, nii sichii nadoed, bela niisgwamala bar gaosulid.
Bab-Jehová, e-sordamar-idu-nadapi, maryob e-gaya-goled itogega imakoed. Bab-Jehová-e-sordamala bukidarad, e-igar-uksadba-ibsamaladi, gege ebisleged. Bab-Jehová-danikid-e-iba gwayed-dummadid, dobed-dummadid. ¿Doa abin-gwisguoe?
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Emigindi, bela-bela be-gwage-ulubgine be an-amimala, mas-gunsuli be gudii gumar, be bomar, degi, be naibi itomar.”
Wile-itogedbali, mer mor-esirmakedgi be binsamar. Unnila gwagegi nunmaked-dummad-itonai be gumar. Be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová be gannar amimar, ar ade, Bab-Dummad, dule-nuedid, dule-wiledakedid, Gwae-gwae urwesulid, bela-bela emar-sabgumaid, sabsur-odurdakoye-sogda-inigwele, igi-barsaye sogdedaed.
Abakale, Bab-Dummad binsaed gwakalile, igi-barsaye sokalile, deyobi, anmargi ise-nued binsaoed. Ibmar-gwag-ukleged, degi, vinoʼmar, Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼgadga guoed.
Sión-yar-birgi gar-trompeta ogormalo, dulemar-onmakega ese gormalo, masgullesulid-iba nasikmalo.
Bela dulemar-bukwad-onmakega imakmalo, bela dulemar swilidik ambikumalo. Sapin-dummagan bela onmakmalo, burwigana onmakmalo, goemarse-bakale, onmakmalo. Emisgwa-ome-nikusad e-gabedneggi nodage, emisgwa-sui-nikusad e-gabedneggi-maidgi nodamoga.
Bab-Dummad-neg-yawagak-siid, degi, ibmar-ukleged-aila-siid, amar-imbagi, dule-irwa-Babse-gormalad Bab-Jehováʼga-arbamaladi, be bomala. Weyob sognanai be gumala: “Bab-Jehováʼye, be wile be-dulamar dake. Mer be-dulamar-nug-oichogega be imake, mer dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad be-dulamargi dodogega be imake. Ibiga dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad sogmaloe: ‘¿Ar bia e-Bab-Dummad nadsunna?’ ”
Geb degine, Bab-Jehová na e-sabgued e-yarga oyosad, e-dulamar egi-isgussuliyobi daksad.
Bab-Jehová e-dulamarga weyob sogded: “An bemarga ibmar-gwag ukoed, vinoʼmar, degi, olivo-gwallu ukbaloed. Bemar we-ibmarmargi immelemaloed. Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad bemargi dodomalaga bar an imakosulid.
”Dule-dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik-danikid an bemargi-banguega imakoed, a-dule, dule-buksurmaladsik, dule-negasulidganba an balimetoed. E-sordamar-idu-danimalad, dad-nakwedsik-demar-naidgi, didulegega an imakoed. E-sordamar-sorba-danimaladdi, dad-argwanedsik-demar-naidgi, didulegega an imakoed. E-muimar nunguega an imakoed, sunnasuli-yapannega an imakoed.” Bab-Jehová ibmar-dummagan imakoed.
An-yargi-bukmalad mer-dobgumala, bur weligwar itomala, wergumala. Ar Bab-Jehová ibmar-dummagan imakoed.
Ibdula-sapurbarmalad, mer dobgumala, ar gaganmar aramakdagoed. Sapimar bela sanmakdagoed, sapi-higueraʼye-nugadi, degi, uva-dubmar yeer sanmakdagoed.
Sión-dulemar weligwar-itomar, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼba be wergumarsun. Ar be-Bab-Jehová e-iba-sogedba bega dii owioed. Ar igi epenneunni, ibmar-digleged-idu dii owidae, degi, ibmar-gwag-weleged-idu dii owidae, deyobi bemarga dii-wied-ibagan nasikoed.
Ibmar-gwag-saboged-negmar ibmar-gwag ena sigoed. Ibmar-gwagmar-egured-negmar vino ena sigoed. Olivo-gwallu ena sigbaloed.
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ses-danagwen-gudimalad, ses-dummagan, ses-sapingana, ses-burwigan, birga-nasmaladgine bemar-ibe bela ibmar-gwag guchagusad, gannar bemar a-ibmarmar-nikuega an be-imakoed.
Bemar obinebaka, nue-immelegedse gunmaloed, geb be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-nug be odummomaloed. Ar ani be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, bemarga ibmar-gegerdakleged imakoed. An-dulamar bar bipisaale, bingeguosurmalad.
Geb degine, wisgumaloed, ani an Israel-dulemar-abargi gudiiye. Ani an e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová gued. Anyobid dule-baid sated. An-dulamar bar bipisaale, bingeguosurmalad.”
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “We-ibmar-gusad-sorbali, An-Burba bela-dulemargi an odenonikoed. Be-masmala, degi, be-bunamala, an-gayaburbagi sunmakdemaloed. Selebagusmalad gabdakdemaloed, sapingana negburgan dakdemaloed.
A-ibagangi, An-Burba, mai-machergangi, mai-omegangi, an odenonibaloed.
Ibmar-gegerdakleged nibneggine, napneggine, an oyogoed. Ablisbi neg-nagunonikoed, soo-dummad oyolegoed, degi, waa-bupurmagwichi neg gudoed.”
Bab-Jehová-e-iba-dobegwar-itoleged-danikoed-idu, e-iba-gwayed-dummad-danikoed-idu, dad-ibegwar-ganaidi negasichidga gudoed, nii-ganaidi ablisgi-oglesayobi ginnitibi daklenonikoed.
Bela dulemar e-Bab-Dummadga Bab-Jehová-imakmaladi, abonolemaloed. Ar igi Bab-Jehová sogsagusa, deyobi, Sión-yargi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi, abonoleged nikaoed. Bab-Jehová na dulemar-susagusadi, dulemar-dula-bemaloed-abargi gudii imakoed.
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “A-iba-nonikile, Judá-yarginmalad, degi, Jerusalén-dulemar, yar-baid-baidse-gales-selesgusmaladi, an gannar e-yarse senonikoed.
Bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad an onmakoed, Josafat-Nebase-ambikuega an imakoed. Agine, an-Israel-dulamar-sabed-nukad, an we-dulemala sabsur-odurdakoed. Ar we-dulemar, an-dulamar yar-baid-baidse-oaisakiega imaksamalad, an-yar-naid mimismalad.
We-dulemar ibmargi-wilubdakar an-dulamar-mimismalad. Omegan-gamba-imaked-muchub, burwigana uksamalad. We-dulemar na mumgumalaga, vino-muchub, bunamala manigi uksamalad.
”Sidón-neggwebur, Tiro-neggwebur, degi, bela Filistea-yarginmalad, ¿ibiga bemar angi yolenanai? ¿Ar bemar bugedmai an-imakbimala? Ar deyob be an-imakbimalale, bemar-bugedmai-an-imakbimalad, bemargi emiskwaa aibinega an imakoed.
Ar bemar an-ibe or, mani atursasmalad. Deginbali, bemar an-ibmar-nuegan be-bab-dummadgan-negse be sesmarbalid.
E-yargi-dikasur-banguega bemar Grecia-dulemarga Judá-dulemar, degi, Jerusalén-dulemar uksamalad.
”Emigindi, bemar wisgubi an abedo, bemar doa-dulemarga Israel-dulemar-uksamala, amar a-yargi-bukwadgi an onogoed. Ar igi bemar an-dulamar-imaksamala, deyobi an bemar-imakmarmogoed.
Judá-dulemarga be-masmala, be-bunamala, an manigi ukoed. Geb Judá-dulemar, Sabá-dulemarga ukmarmogoed. We-Sabá-dulemar dikasur yar-baidgi bukmalad.” Bab-Jehová weyob sogsad:
“Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamaladga, be weyob sogmala: ‘Bila-onogega guakwaa ambikumala, Sordamar bila-onogega be barmide, Bela dule-bila-onomalad-bulegan urwega be guagwar bukumala.
Napa-imumaladgi es-suigan be sobmala, es-doperegwadgi eswar be sobmala.’ Dule-gegegwad soge: ‘¡An dule-gandikidye!’
Dulemar-anmar-yar-dikarba-bukwamalad, gwae be dagmala, Josafat-Nebase be ambikudamala.” Bab-Jehová, be-dule-gandikmalad be odedage.
“Dulemar-yar-baidgi-bukwamalad, be dagmala, Josafat-Nebase be dagmala. A-nebagine, dulemar-yar-baidgi-bukwamaladga igar-nabogega an signonikoed.
Orosgi-dakleged-trigo goresale, igi es-doperegwadgi weledae, ayobi, an we-dulemar-imakoed. Uva-goresale e-nis-eguregala igi birgi gwirlege, ayobi, an we-dulemar-imakoed. Igi vino e-sigedgi engusadba dikarba aryomaidae, ayobi, we-dulemar-e-isgusad doggus wilub-obichad.”
Neba-Decisiónʼye-nugadgine, dulemar-bukidara onmakdanikid. Neba-Decisiónʼye-nugadgine Bab-Jehová-e-iba warmakdanikid.
Dad-ibeler-ganaid, degi, nii-ganaid bar gaosulid. Niisgwamar bar gaosurbalid.
Bab-Jehová Sión-yar-akale, achumigur-nono-wawaadyobi binnasuli gordagoed. Jerusalén-neggwebur-akale, mar-goleyobi binnasuli sunmakdagoed. Bela napneg-naid, nibneg-naid, giglimakdoed. Ar Bab-Jehováʼdi e-dulamarga dukued-negga gunonikoed, Israel-dulemarga ganguedga gunonikoed.
Bab-Jehová e-dulamarga sogded: “Geb degine, bemar wisgunonikoed, ani an be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, an-yar-Sión-islidikidgi an maid. Jerusalén-neggwebur islidikidga gunonikoed. Sordamar-yar-baidginmalad gandikidba bar egi ubogosurmalad.
”A-ibagi, yarmargine, vino-osidikid aryonai gudoed, yar-seniganagine, moli-nunismar aryomai gudoed, Judá-dianmargine, diimar aryomai gudoed. Anse-goled-neggine, dii aryodagoed, we-dii, neba-Sitimʼye-nugad-ognai gudoed.
Egipto-yar-naidi, sabsur-Judá-dulemar-imaksamalad-nukad, bela ibitogoed. Edom-yar-naidi, sabsur-Judá-dulemar-imaksamalad-nukad, nega-dulesulidganga binyoed. Ar wemar, Judá-yargine dulemar-gwen-ibmar-oakalossurmalad-ibe ablis eos gusmalad.
Judá-yargi, degi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi, degisadegu dulemar bukwa gudoed.
Dulemar-ibe-ablis-eosmalad, ¿baisur an dakoe? Suli, baisur geg an daked. An buged-mai imakedsegad.” Bab-Jehová, Sión-yargi megnonikoed.
We, Amós-e-gayaburbado. Amósʼde Tecoa-neggweburginedid, sibad-wawaad-akwed-duled. Amós, Israel-yargi birgabose negabandur-noed-iduar, negburgan daksad. Deunni, Uzías, Judá-e-reyga-maid, degi, Joás-machi-Jeroboam, Israel-e-reyga maidginmogad.
Amós sogded: “Sión-yala-akale, Bab-Jehová uludagoed, Jerusalén-akale, mar-goledyob e-gayaburba gordagoed. Sibad-wawaad-nikamalad-e-nainugi gagan-ara-ara-nanaid bela bergudoed. Carmelo-yar-birigi-gagan-nanaid dingudoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Damasco-dorgan-e-isgued nue-wilub-obicha naid. Sabsur-e-odurdaklegoedi, an ega osulogosulid. Ar ade, Damasco-dorgan undar-beedse Galaad-dulemar-wiosad. Esgoro-nugar-nikadgi-ibmar-durwilegeyobi Galaad-imaksamalad.
Ani an Rey-Hazael-e-neg, soogi ogumakoed, Ben-Adad-e-neg-gandikmalad bela gummakoed.
