Damasco-neggwebur-yawagak-esgoromar an bibisgoed, Avén-nebagi dule-bukwad an obelogoed. Bet-Edénʼgi dummaganga-mamaid an osulogoed. Siria-dulemar yogasaar-gales Kirʼye-yar-nugadse barmiledmaloed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi we-ibmar soged.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Gaza-dorgan-e-isgued nue-wilub-obicha naid. Sabsur-e-odurdaklegoedi, an ega osulogosulid. Ar ade, Gaza-dorgan, bela neggweburmargi-dulemar-bukwad galesa sesmalad, geb Edom-dorganga maiga manigi uksamalad.
Ani an Gaza-neggwebur-e-galu-matusulid, soogi ogumakoed. E-neg-gandikmalad-bukwad bela gummakoed.
Asdod-dorgan-bukwamalad an osulogoed. Ascalón-neggweburgi dummagan-mamaid an obelogoed. Ecrón-neggweburgi gannar an-ganguedba an gwichigudoed, Filistea-dule-napi-ambikumaloed bela an obelomogoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová Bela-Gangued-Nikadi we-ibmar soged.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Tiro-dorgan-e-isgued nue-wilub-obicha naid. Sabsur-e-odurdaklegoedi, an ega osulogosulid. Ar ade, Tiro-dorgan, bela dulemar-gasa-sesmaladi, Edom-dorganga maiga manigi uksamalad. Na gwenatigwar-gued-igar-ebo-mesismalad iesmalad.
Ani an Tiro-galu-matusurmalad, soogi ogumakoed. E-neg-gandikmalad-bukwad bela gummakoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Edom-dorgan-e-isgued nue-wilub-obicha-naid. Sabsur-e-odurdaklegoedi, an ega osulogosulid. Ar ade, Edom-dorgan, e-gwenadgan-wile-daksasulid. Es-suidyalaba balegicha gusmalad. Ar na saed-itoged ulubgi bargadsurmalad, e-urwed gwen iessurmalad.
Ani an Temán-neggwebur, soogi ogumakoed, Bosra-neggwebur-e-neg-gandikmalad bela gummakoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Amón-dorgan-e-isgued nue-wilub-obicha naid. Sabsur-e-odurdaklegoedi, an ega osulogosulid. Ar Amón-dorgan, na e-yarmar-abingunanaid onasogega, Galaad-omegan-gurgin-nikamalad-ibe saban-maris nanaed.
Ani an Rabá-neggwebur-e-galu-matusurmalad soogi ogumakoed, e-neg-gandikmalad bela gummakoed. Bila-onolenaidgi oimaknanaidaeyob, sabsur-oimaknanai gumaloed. Burwa-dummad-uurmakmaiyob, neg-oimaknai guoed.
Amón-dorgan-e-rey gales seledoed, bela e-dummagan eba gales seledmogoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi we-ibmar soged.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Moab-dorgan-e-isgued nue-wilub-obicha-naid. Sabsur-e-odurdaklegoedi, an ega osulogosulid. Ar Moab-dulemar, Edom-e-rey-garmar ogumaksad, burubi-guedse imaksad.
Ani an Moab-yala, soogi ogumakoed, Queriot-neg-gandikmalad bela gummakoed. Moab-dulemar bilagi-oimaknanaid-abalagi berguoed, gar-trompeta-gornaid-abalagi burgoed.
E-dummad-negsemaid, e-dulemar-wagab an osulogoed. E-dummagan belagwable an eba obelogoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi we-ibmar soged.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Judá-dorgan-e-isgued nue-wilub-obicha naid. Sabsur-e-odurdaklegoedi, an ega osulogosulid. Ar Judá-dorgan, e-gakansamaladba Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maidgi aibatemalad, Bab-Jehová-Igar-Sogmaidba nanassurmalad. Bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladba nanasmalad, e-dadgan-nanasadba nanasmarmogad.
A-ulale, ani an Judá-yargi soo barmidoed, Jerusalén-e-neg-gandikmalad bela gummakoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Israel-dorgan-e-isgued nue-wilub-obicha naid. Sabsur-e-odurdaklegoedi, an ega osulogosulid. Ar Israel-dorgan, dule-nued manigi uksamalad, Israel-dorgan, dule-wilese-gudimalad sapat-gwagwen-muchub uksamarbalid.
Dule-wilegana sabsur-ise-wilegar imaksamalad, mesagwale imaksamalad. Wileganaga igar-maidba igar nabossurmalad. Baba, galagwensuli ome-wargwengi nanadidaed, a-omegi, e-machi galagwensuli nanadidamogad. Weyob an-nug-isligwaled oichosmalad.
Amarde, yogasaaledgi bab-dummaganga-ibmar-ukleged-ailamar-dikarba, mor-manigi-siid, na megega ebudamalad. Dule-mani-ganikid-ibe-vino-sulesadi, e-bab-dummaganse-goled-neggi gobdamalad.
”We-dulemar-wagab, Amorreo-dulemar an obelosad, amar-ibe e-ibmar-nikumaid an osulosad, e-gandik-bukwad an ei osulosad. Ar Amorreo-dulemar urwaryobi sugu-inigwele, encina-sapimaryob dutusur-inigwele, an obelosad.
”Egipto-yargi-noega an bemar-imaksamalad. Nega-dulesulidganba birga-dulabo (40) an bemar-idudii gusad, adi, Amorreo-dulemar-bukwamalad-e-yala bemarga ukegar.
Deginbali, be-mimmigan-imbagi, an-gayaburba-barsogmalad an nugsasad. Be-sapingan-imbagi, dulemar-anga-nugsalesad an susbalid. A-dulemarde, Nazareo-duleye bilesmalad. Israel-dulemar, ¿weyob ibmar-gusadi napirasursi? Deyobdo. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi we-ibmar soged.
Degi-inigwele, dule-anga-nugsalesad Nazareoʼye-bileged, vino-gobega be imaksamalad. An-gayaburba-barsogedga be sogsamalad: ‘Mer Bab-Jehová-gayaburbagi sunmakoye.’
”Israel-dorgan, a-ulale, an sabsur-apor bemar-imakoed, igi ur-dummad-napagined orosgwaggi-dakleged ena-danikir, ibmar-birgi-nasar ibmar gullu-gullu imake, deyob an bemar-imakoed.
Dule-gwae-gwae-abarmaked, angi wakinnosurguoed. Dule-dutusulid, dukin e-garganguedba bendaklegosulid. Dule-gandikidbela, dukin na e-san bendakosurmogad.
Dule-sigumied, an-abin gwisguosurguoed. Dule-gwae-gwae-nanaed, angi wakinnosurguoed, dule moligi-sii-wakinmaile, na san-onogosulid.
A-ibagi, sorda-bila-onomalad-bur-gandikmaladi, uka-swili wakinmai guoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi we-ibmar soged.”
¡Israel-dulemar, we-gayaburba be nue itomalo! Bab-Jehová bemar-annik, degi, bela Egipto-yargi dulemar-noargusmalad-annik weyob soged:
“Bela-dulemar-napneggi-bukwad-abargi unnila bemarbi an be-susad. Degi-inigwele, bela-bemar-ibmar-isgana-imaksadbali, an sabsur-bemar-odurdakoed.”
¿Dule na ebo igar-amisulile, sunna ebo-nued-gudiguo be ebinsae? Suli.
¿Achumigur san ganisulile, uurmako be ebinsae? Suli. ¿Achumigur-sapingwa, e-gubya-yaba san ganisuli-maile, uurmako be ebinsae? Suli.
¿Nuu-galu-yaba mas-sisulir, nuu galego be ebinsae? Suli. ¿Nuu-galu walagwengi ibmar-galesuli atido be ebinsae? Suli.
¿Neggweburgi gar-trompeta gollalile, dulemar dobedba oimakardasur be ebinsae? Eye. ¿Neggweburgi boni-dummadgan-noedi, Bab-Jehová imaksur be ebinsae? Eye.
Ar napiragwad, Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maidi, e-gayaburba-barsogmaladga ibmar-sogsasuli geg ibmar imaked.
Ar achumigur uurmakalile, ¿doa dobguosur be ebinsae? Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maid sunmakele, ¿doa e-gayaburba barsogosur be ebinsamoga?
Asdod-e-neggandikmaladgi binnasur be sogmalo, Egipto-yar-neg-gandikmaladgi binnasur be sogmarbalo. Weyob be sogmalo: “Samaria-yar-birse be ambikudamar, agi dobed-dummad-naid be dakdamar, agi sabsur-wilenanaid be dakdamar.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Bemar, igar-innikigwadba geg nanamalad: Ar bemar sabsur-urwedgi-ibmar-sumaladid, reyneggi a-ibmar sabomaladid.”
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maid weyob soged: “Be-isdarmalad-wargwen gandikidgi be-yar sunonikoed. Be-neggandikmaladi bela bei earmaloed. Be-reynegmargi-ibmar-nuegan-bukwad bela bei sumaloed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Igi-sibad-wawaad-edarbedi, e-sibad-wawaad achumigurse-galealile, aisaar na bendaknaidae, degi-inigwele, unnila e-malibi, e-uayadukubidibe na gadapdae, deyobi, wis Israel-dorgan-Samariaʼgi-bukwadi san-onogoed. Deyobi, wis Israel-dorgan-Damasco-neggweburgi gan-mua-muadgi-sigmaladi, san-onogoed.”
Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nika-Maid weyob soged: “Nuekwa be an-itomalo. Jacob-dulemarga iduakwaa be ibmar sogmarmogo.
”Israel-dorgan e-ibmar-isgana-imaksad-ulale, an sabsur-odurdakoed-ibagine, Betelʼgi e-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailamar an obelogoed. Ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi moli-bebegiid-bukwad an bibisgoed, bela napagi an mioed.
Dii-wied-ibagi-obunnoged-negmar bela an bibisgoed, yorgi-obunnoged-negmar bela an eyaroed. Akwa-marfilʼye-nugadgi negmar-sobarmalad bela an osulogoed. Bukidar nega-dummagan-bubukwadi an eyaroed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi we-ibmar soged.”
Bemar, omegan-Samariaʼginmalad, an bega ibmar-sogoed be itomar: Bemar, Basán-yalagi moli-bebe-nikad-ome-wardummaganyob gumalad. Bemar, dule-wilegana sabsur-wiobukmalad, ise-mesagwale, be dule-wilegana imakbukmalad. Be-suimargarbela be sogbukwadamalad: “Vino anga sedaye.”
Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maidi, e-san-isligwaledba ise-sogar soged: “Bemargi ibagan-dani, bemar belagwable akegi ebipilemai gumaloed, achwer-nugar-dummagangi-gales be ebipilemai gumaloed.
Bemar neggwebur-galu-matusulid-ayaroedbali ilekwaa ainimai gumaloed. Geb Hermón-yarse be-metemaloed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi weyob soged.”
“Betel-neggweburse be namar, ase be isgunamar. Gilgal-neggweburse be namar, bur bule ase isgudii be sanamar. Bane-bane wakudaryalaba ibmar-ukleged be uknamar. Ibapaagi ibmar-ambegi-gwensak-ukleged (10%) be uknamar.
Dog-nuedye-sogega, madu-ina-nikad be ogumaknamar. Bela dule be owisomala, na ibmar-ukleged e-itoleged-ukbiedba ibmar sedamaloye. Ar Israel-dulemar, weyob abemalad. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi weyob soged.”
“Ani an bela be-neggweburmargi ukud-dummad nasiksad, bela be-dulemar-bukwadga masgulleged an osulosad. Degite, bemar deyob-gusmar-inigwele, gwen gannar anse aibilissurmalad. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi weyob soged.
”Nii-warbaase ibmar-gwag-welegoed-iduale, dii bar an owissulid. Unnila neggwebur-gwagwengi dii an owisad. Neggwebur-baidgindi dii an owissulid. Nainu-gwensakgi dii-winai gusad. Baid-nainugindi dii wissulid, abali, nainu dingude gusad.
Degisoggu, dulemar neggwebur-baid-baidse dii-amidii gusmalad. Wis-gobsamar-inigwele, amba uku-uku-itogedi surgussurmalad. Degite, bemar deyob-gusmar-inigwele, gwen gannar anse aibilissurmalad. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi weyob soged.
”Be-ibmar-digarmalad bonigangi an obelosad, neg-uedikidba an dinare imaksad. Sesmar be-nainugan obelosad, sesmar be-uva-digar-nanaid oburgwisad. Sesmar be-higuera-sapimar obelosad, degi, be-olivo-sapimar obelosbalid. Degite, bemar-ibe deyob-ibmar-gus-inigwele, bemar gwen gannar anse aibilissurmalad. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi weyob soged.
”Egipto-dulemargi bonigan an barmisgusayobi, an bemargi barmisgusad. Es-suidgi be-sapingan an oburgwisad, e-molimar-galesmalad an ogilosbalid. Dule-burgwismalad-e-mui-yapanned neg-gagasa an nasiksad. Degite, bemar deyob-gusmar-inigwele, gwen gannar anse aibilissurmalad. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi weyob soged.
”An Sodoma-neggwebur-wiosayobi, degi, Gomorra-neggwebur-wiosayobi, an bemar-wiosmogad. Bemar suar soose-negabar-gummaksayobi gusmalad. Degite, bemar deyob-gusmar-inigwele, gwen gannar anse aibilissurmalad. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi weyob soged.
”Israel-dulemar, be anse aibilissurmalad-ulale, an begi gwichigumogoed. Israel-dulemar, begi an gwisguosoggu, an-iduar guakwa be gudimalo. Ar bemar we-ibmar-guoedi igar-gaosurmalad.”
Dule-yarmar-nasiksadi, burwamar-obinnisadi, dulemarga-ibmar-guoed-sogedi, Bab-Jehováʼye nugad. Neg-meegwad, negsichidga obinyedi, yarmar-birgi-nanaedi, Bab-Jehováʼye nugad, Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadid.
Israel-dulemar, nue itomalo, gayaburba-wile-itoged-namaklegedgi, an bega namaksokalid.
“Israel-dulemar yagwa-swilidik-yeerdaklegedyobid, be sabsur-omukulesmalad. Bar be gannar gwisguosulid. Napagi meremai be guoed, dule-be-ogwised sate guoed.”
Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maid, Israel-dulemarga weyob soged: “Neggwebur-gwensak sorda-miligwen (1,000) bila-onogedse-naele, unnila dulatar (100) durgumaloed. Ar neggwebur-gwensak dulatar (100) bila-onogedse-naele, unnila e-ambe (10) durgumaloed.”
Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemarga weyob soged: “Be an-amimalale, be dula-gudii gumaloed.
Melle be Betel-neggweburse bar namala. Gilgal-neggweburse melle be bar namala, degi, Beerseba-neggweburse melle be bar namarbali, ar ade, Gilgal-dulemar galesa seledmaloed, degi, Betel-neggweburdi bela berguoed.”
Bab-Jehová be amimala, adi, be dula-gudii gumaloed. Degisulile, Bab-Jehová José-wagangi sooyobi aidenonikoed, We-soo, bela Betel-neggwebur ogumakoed. Dule we-soo-oginnega sate guoed.
Igar-innikigwadi, igar-isganaga be imakmalad. Bur Igar-napiragwadi obanagwar be imakmalad.
Bab-Dummad niisgwa-danaled Pléyadesʼye-bileged obinnisad, degi, niisgwa-baigan Oriónʼye-bileged obinnisbalid. Bab-Dummad neg-sipusulidi, neg-meegwadga imaked, degi, neg-meegwad, negsichidga imakbalid. Bab-Dummad demar-bukibse goled. Geb napneggi dii-owiega imaked. ¡E-nuga, Bab-Jehováʼye nugad!
Bab-Jehová neggandikmalad osuloged, dule-ambikued-neggandikmalad osulobalid.
Bemar, igar-nudaked-neggi dule-igar-nudakega-arbamaladi, isdar dakmalad, degi, dule-napira-ibmar-soged, isdar be dakmarbalid.
Ar bemar, dule-wilegana ibigwensuli imakmarsoggu, degi, orosgi-dakleged-trigoʼgi, mani-galeged-bennuked ega be igar-mesismarsoggu, a-ulale, be-akwa-neg-sobsamaladgi, be megosurmalad. Degine, nainugi be-uva-naid-e-vino gwen be gobosurmalad.
Bemar-ibmar-isgana-yaisur-imaksad an wisid, be-isgumalad-yaisulid an wisid. Bemar, dule-innikigwad ibgwensur imaked, igar-nabolemaladgi emarse be manigi baklemalad. Degine, igar-nabolegedgi dule-wileganagi be gwisgumalad.
Agala, weyob neg-gunaidgine, dule-binsaed-nikadaedi bogi gudidaed. Ar ade, we-ibagande nuedsulid.
Melle igar-isgana be amimala, bur igar-nued be amimala, adi, be dula-gudii gumaloed. Degidbali, Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, bemarba gudii guoed.
Igar-isgana be obane, igar-nuedbina be soge, igar-nabiroleged-neggi, igar-innikigwadba igar be nabomala. Abakale, Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nika-Maid, José-wagan-besmalad wile dakalile.
Agala, Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nika-Maid weyob soged: “Bela-dule-ambikumaladgi, dulemar-ise-boale itolegoed, degi, bela galimbaba wile-itolegedba binnasur-gornanai itolegoed. Bomalaga sapur-dorganse gorlegoed, degi, bomalaga dulemar-manigi-bomaladse gorlegoed.
An sabsur-bemar-wiodanikile, bela uva-digarmaladba dule-boe itolegoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi weyob soged.”
Dule, Bab-Jehová-sabsur-odurdaked-iba-abitogele, ¡duledar-wilesmar! ¿Ar ibiga we-ibade edarbesunna? Ar we-iba negasichidbi naguoed, neg-meegwad naguosulid.
Dule aisaar achumigur-idu-wakinmaiyob guoenad, degi-inigwele, wiob-abingudagoed. Deyobiyobi, a-iba ega guoed. Dule e-negyaba-dogmaile, galugi akadapiyob guoed, galugi-akadapidba naibegi-warmaksayobi guoed. Deyobiyobi, a-iba ega guoed.
Bab-Jehová-sabsur-odurdaked-ibade negasichidbi-nai guoed, neg-meegwad-nai guosulid. Bela neg-gubyagwaledbi-nai guoed, neg dale-dalesaar daklegosulid.
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “Ibamar be anga onogedi, an isdar-daked. Bemar bulakwaa an-nug-odummogega itoakwaa-anse-gormaladi, yeer-ito an-imaksulid.
Ar bemar anga be-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged ukele, an abingaosulid. Ibmar-gwagmar anga be ukele, an abingaosurbalid. Amba gwenatigwar-guega moli-bebe-nikad-senigana-wardummagan-ukleged, an be-ibe abingaosurbalid.
Be-namaked-oimaksiid an itobisulid. Be-gar-cítara-goled, an itobisulid.
Bur, dii-aryomaiyobi, igar-naboleged galesuli selemai abeleged, degi, diwar-suurmakmaiyobi, igar-innikimalad selemai abeleged.
”Israel-dulemar, bemar birga-dulabo (40) nega-dulesulidganba gudigusmargua, ¿anga be napiragwadgi ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged uksamarsi? ¿Anga be napiragwadgi ibmar-ukleged uksamarsi? Suli.
Emide, bemarde nuchu-Moloc-e-neg-sobaled be semamaid. Degi, nuchu-Quiún be semamaid. Wemarde niisgwa-e-nuchumar-nanaed, bemar we-ibmarmar-sobsamaladi, gwen Bab-Dummadsulid.
Degisoggu, dikasuli Damasco-neggwebur-dakasik an be-balimetemaloed.” Bab-Jehová deyob soged. E-nuga, Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadye nugad.
Amós sogdebalid: “Dule-Sión-neggweburgi-baisuli-itodimalad, ¡duledar-wilesmar! Samaria-yargi-dobsulidba-gudidimalad, ¡duledar-wilesmar! Dule-nug-nikamalad neggwebur-dummagangi-mamaid, ¡duledar-wilesmar! A-dulemarse Israel-dulemar bendakleged egisnaddamalad.
Calne-neggweburse be namar, nue be dakmalo. Agi bukwa, Hamat-neggwebur-dummadse be namarbalo. Geb sorba Filistea-neggwebur-Gatʼye-nugadse be namarbalo. ¿Ar bemarde we-neggweburmargi bur obinmarde? ¿Bemar-yarde bur we-yarmarba dummadye sogde?
Bemar iba-isgana obangumarye be bimalad, aka, be neg-nue-gagaled-iba warmakega imakmalad.
Be-gabed-megmaladgi elefante-nugar-goamar nanaid, a-megedgi na be megdimalad, degi, be-gan-siged-mua-muad-dummadgi be bilikwaa sigdimalad. A-gangi-sii, bemar sibad-wawaad-mimmigan-e-galugi-sulearmalad gundimalad, degi, moli-bebe-nikad-senigana-wardummagan be gundimarbalid.
Bemar, David-namakeyob namakye be sogmalanad, yogasaar be namakmalad. Gar-cítaraʼba be namakdedamalad. Be-itoleged, gar-gormalad be obinyedamalad.
Bemar nog-dummagangi vino be gobdimalad. Degi, ina-wawadikid-nuegan be ebudimarbalid. Ar José-e-wagan-e-neg-bibichisadba nunmaked-dummad, eba nunmak be itosurmalad.
A-ulale, emidi bemar-inse dulemar-galesa-seledmaloed-iduar seledmaloed, deyobi, dulemar-galagwensur-iba-onomalad berguoed.”
Bab-Dummad-Jehová na dukin ise-sogar imaksad. Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob soged: “Jacob-wagan san-dummarba-imaked an isdar-daked. E-neg-gandikmalad an sae-daked. Agala, e-neggwebur e-isdarmaladga an urmakoed, degi, bela e-ibmar-nikadi an e-isdarmaladga urmakoed.”
Weyob neg gudoed: Dule neg-gwagwengi e-ambe (10) dula besale, bela burgwemaloed.
Geb e-gwenad-gwensak muimar-ogumakega, a-negse muimar-sudanikile, dule-neggi-gudiidga weyob sogdoed: “¿Dule-baid amba be-walik gudii?” Geb dule weyob abin sogdoed: “Suli.” Geb degidgine, ega sogdoed: “¡Boogwa! Anmar geg Bab-Jehová-nug obared.”
Ar Bab-Jehová igar-ukdoed: Neg-dummagan bibisgeye, degi, neg-burwigana ubigwar imakye.
¿Ar molimar akwa-dummagan-imbaba abarmaksi? ¿Ar akwa-dummagangi nabir moli-bebe-nikad napa imusi? Ar bemardi, igar-innikigwad, ibmar-isganaga obinnismalad. Igar-innikigwad-selemaid, boniga be obinnismalad.
Bemar ibmar-gwen-imaksasulidgi be wergudimalad. Be sogmalad: “Anmar-ganguedgi anmarde gargangued nikusmarye.”
Degisoggu, Israel-dulemar, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi soged: “Bemargi neggwebur-soggwen gwichiguega an imakoed. A-neggwebur ise-mesagwale bemar-imakoed. Hamatʼse-doglemaid-akale, Arabá-diwar-maidse, bemar ese odurdaklegoed.”
Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maid, we-negburgan anga oyosad: Reyga ibmar-gwag-orosgi-dakleged-ukleged-welesad-sorba, a-gwag gannar ainiali an dakalid. Agi Bab-Jehová sesmar-bukidar urbenai an dakarbalid.
Degi, sesmar napaneggi gaganse-bakale, bela obelosgua, binnasuli an goted: —An-Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maidye, an bese wilesakwaa egisye, Jacob-waganga isgued be eliye. ¿Ar igi Jacob-wagande bar bukuosunna? Unnila ichee gumalad.
Degidgine, Bab-Jehová wiledakde, sogded: —Degir nabir, an deyob neg imakosulid.
Geb degi, Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maid, negburgan-baid anse oyosbalid: An daked, Bab-Jehová dule-sabsur-odurdakega soose gote. Degi, soo napa-urba demar-wilasailad dinnaa imaksad. Degine, nainugan bela swanga imaksad.
Deyob an daksagu, binnasuli an goted: —Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼye, bese wilesakwaa an egisye, soo be oginye. Degisulile, ¿ar igi Jacob-wagande bar bukuosunna? Unnila iche gumalad.
Degidgine, Bab-Jehová wiledakde, sogded: —Degir nabir, an deyob neg imakosulid.
Bab-Jehová, anga negburgan-baid oyosbalid: An daked, Bab-Jehová galu-matusulid-nuekwa-sobaled-nagaba gwichi. Degi, neg-wilubsaed-dubgi-gingwa-naid e-argangi-gani, an dakalid.
Degi, Bab-Jehová anse egichialid: —Amós, ¿wede ibu be dake? An abin-sogded: —Dubgi gingwa-nai an daked. Degidgine, Bab-Jehová anga sogded: —Dubgi-gingwa-naidi, an-Israel-dulemar-abargi an obatoed, adi, wilubdakega, bule inniki-gudimardibeye. Inniki-gudisulile, bar an ega e-isgued eliosulid.
Isaac-wagan-e-bab-dummaganse-goled-ailamar bela osulolegoed, degi, Israel-e-bab-dummaganse-goled-negmar bela bibisgoed. Jeroboam-e-gwenadgan es-suidgi an oberguoed.
Degidgine, Betel-neggweburgined-dule-irwa-Babse-goled-Amasías, Israel-rey-Jeroboamʼga gayaburba barmisad: “Amós, Israel-sordamar-abargi begi gwisgudiid. Ar Amós-sunmakedba Israel-dulemar binsaed-galediid.
Ar ade, Amós sogdiid: ‘Rey-Jeroboam es-suidgi burgoye. Israel-dulemardi e-yargi gales seledmarmogoye.’ ”
Geb degi, Amasías, Amósʼga sogded: —¡Dule-negburgan-daked, be wegi-gudiid be nae! Ar be mas-gunbiele, Judá-yarse be nae. Agi, Bab-Jehová-igargi be sunmaknae.
Melle bar Betel-neggweburgi, Bab-Jehová-igargi be sunmaknoniko, ar Betelʼde, rey-e-neg-islidikidid, rey-e-bab-dummadse-goled-negad.
Amós, Amasías-abin sogded: —An Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-dulesulid, an a-machisurbalid. Unnila, an sibad-wawaad-edarbed-dule gued, higuera-sapigi an arbaed-dulebalid.
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová sibad-edarbedgi an-onosad. Anga sogsad: ‘An-gayaburbagi be an-Israel-dulemarga be sunmaknaye.’
Degisoggu, Amasías, Bab-Jehová-gayaburba be itoge: ”Bede soged: ‘Mer Bab-Jehová-ibmar-imakoedgi Israel-dulemarga gandikidgi sunmakoye. Mer Bab-Jehová-gayaburbagi Isaac-waganga gandikidgi sunmakbaloye.’
”Agala, Bab-Jehová weyob bega soged: ‘Be-ome neggweburgi ibmarbina na san-urmakdii guoed. Be-masmala, degi, be-bunamala es-suidgi oburgwilegoed. Be-napamar wilubsaar mimilegoed. Degi, bedi, be-yargi burgosulid. Israel-dulemardi e-yargi dikasuli gales seledmaloed.’ ”
Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maid, negburgan anga oyosbalid: Garbagi sapi-san-gorogwad-bukwa an daksad.
Degi, anse egichided: —Amós, we, ¿ibu be dake? Degi, an abin-sogde: —Garbagi sapi-san-gorogana-bukwa an daked. Degidgine, Bab-Jehová anga sogded: —Israel-dulemar-e-bergued-ibagan warmaknonikid. Ibmar-san-gorogwayobi berguoed. Israel-dulemarga e-isgued bar an eliosulid.
Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maid sogded: —A-ibagangi, reyneggi-namaklemalad, boedga guoed. Dulemar-bukidar yogasaar burgwar-burgwar omilede gumaloed. Degi, bogidikidgi muimar yogasaar metemaloed.
Nue be an itomalo, bemar, dulemar-wilegana sabsur-imakmalad, bemar, dule-wilegana obelodimarbalid.
”Bemar sogmalad: ‘Anmar ibmar-gwagmar manigi ukega, ¿sana we nii-gebe-gwisgusad-e-iba berguoe? Anmar ibmar-gwag-orosgi-dakleged-trigo manigi ukega, ¿sana we itoged-iba berguoe?’ ”Bemar ibmar-nibirgi-uked bur ichee-gued abediid. E-manidi odummoged abediid. Emar-yardakega nibir-nuedsulid ebudamalad.
Orosgwaggi-dakleged-e-solamar bemar manigi ukdamalad. Bemar dule-wilegana manigi bakdamarbalid, degi, dule-ibmar-abedimalad nag-uka-gwagwengi unnir bakdamarbalid.”
Bab-Jehová, Jacob-dulemar-e-san-dummarba-imakedgi, ise-sogar sogded: “Ibmar be imaksamaladi, an gwen iegosulid.
Deyob bela neg-guoed-ulale, ¿napade giglimakosuli? ¿Bela e-dulamar boosurmala? Bela napa, Nilo-diwar-engumaiyobi megoed, dogdoed. Agi Egipto-diwar-ilideyobi, ilidoed.”
Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maid sogdebalid: “A-ibagi, yorukudba dad-galegega an imakoed, degi, napneggi ibginedba negsichid an nasikoed.
Be-iba-onomalad ise-bukib-binsaleged-ibaga an imakoed. Degi, be-namakmalad, namakmalad-ise-bukib-binsaedga an imakbaloed. Bukib-binsaleged-e-mor-yoega an bemar-imakbaloed. Degi, be-nono swanga-imakega an be-imakbaloed. Machi-wargwennagwad-burgwisar, ega bonanaidaeyob ise-boar bemar bomaloed, degi, ibagan nunmaked-dummad-nai bergudoed.”
Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maid sogdebalid: “Ibagan-danikid, napneggi an ukud-dummad nasikoed. We-ukudde, masgulleged an obarsulid, degi, uku-uku-itogedgi-dii-gobleged an obarsurbalid. An obaredi, dulemar an-gayaburba-itobiedba uku-uku-gudiguoed, an obared.
Degisoggu, dulemar, Bab-Jehová-Gayaburba-amiega, igarsuli demar-mataganba namaloed. Igarsuli dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik, degi, dad-nakwedsik gudii gumaloed. Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová-gayaburba gwen amiosurmalad.
”A-ibagine, yagana-yeerdaklemalad, sapingana-gandikmalad, uku-uku-itogedba negoedmaloed.
Dulemar Samaria-dorgan-e-isgudiidga ise-sogar sogdamaladi bergumaloed, bar-durguosurmalad Amarde sogmalad: ‘Dan-neggwebur-e-bab-dummad-dula-gudiidba ise-sogar an bega sogye.’ Degi, sogdamarbalid: ‘Beerseba-neggwebur-e-bab-dummad-dula-gudiidba ise-sogar an bega sogye.’ ”
Dule-Dummad ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-dikarba-gwichi an daksad, degi, anga sogded: “Buarmar-e-bargamalad be omukue, adi, buarmar giglimakega, dulemar-e-nonogi babatidoed. Dulemar-burgosurmaladdi es-suidgi an osulogoed. Dulemar-wargwensaar wakinnosulid, wargwensaagwar durguosulid.
Israel-dulemar neg-uan-napa-uluba dukuye-sogele, amba an onogoed. Ar amba nibanegse nakweye-sogele, amba an amar-odegoed.
Amba Carmelo-yar-birba dukuye-sogele, ase an aminaoed, degi, an gaoed. Demar-mata-wilasorse angi dukuye-sogele, amba naibe-demargined egi-warmakega an barmidoed.
Israel-dulemar, e-isdarmaladse-galesa selenadapidgine, an igar-ukoed, es-suidgi amar-oburgwegar. Israel-dulemargi nue an nakulegoed. An egi-nakulegoedi, ibmar-nued ega imakegarsulid. Ibmar-isganaga imakegalad.”
Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maid, Bela-Gangued-Nikad-Maid napa ebugele, napa maludoed. Napa mullumakmai megoed, Egipto-diwar-Nilo-maiyob megoed, degi, bela dule-bukwamalad ise-boar gumaloed.
Bab-Dummad nibaneggi na e-neg nasiksad, degi, napaneggi e-neg-sailagan nasiksabalid. Dii napaneggi-owiegala, demar-mata-obupurmakega imaked. E-nuga, Bab-Jehováʼye nugad.
Israel-wagan, Bab-Jehová soged: “¿Ar bemarde anga Etiopía-dulemaryob-gusursi? ¿Ar ande Egiptoʼgi Israel-dulemar-onissursi? ¿Caftor-yargi Filistea-dulemar an onisbarsursi? Degi, ¿Kir-yargi Arameo-dulemar an onisbarsursi?
”Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maidi, we-yar-isgus-naidgi nakulemaid. Jacob-wagan napneg-naidgi an obelogoed, degi-inigwele, an bela obelogosulid.” Bab-Dummad-Jehová soged.
“Igi ukub bugbugi egwalealile, napagi akwa-gwagwensaar argwansuli, deyobi, Israel-dulemar neggwebur-baigan-abargi, an egwaoed.”
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “Bela an-dulamar-isgudimalad, es-suidgi burgwemaloed. Bela sogdimaladi: Bonigan anmarse gwen nonikosurye. Anmar-oakalogosurye. Dule-deyob-sogdimaladi, bela burgwemaloed.”
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “A-ibagi, David-meged-neg-ayarisadi, an soboed. Neg-yaa-ollogan-ambikusadi, an edioed, degi, e-neg-bibichismalad iduar-sobaledyob, gannar an sobbaloed.
Adi, Israel-dulemar, degi, bela dulemar an-nug-odummodimaladi, Edom-neggwebur, degi, bela neggwebur-bamalad suegar.”
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “Ibmar-san-bukidar-welegoed-ibagan danikid, ibmar-gwag-digleged-ibagan-naidgi, amba oros-gwaggiid-dakleged, welenai guoed. Uva-digleged-ibagan-naidgi, amba uva-egurlenai guoed. Yar-dummaganba vino-binid aryomamai guoed, bela yala-senigana-imbaganba suurmakmai guoed.
An-Israel-dulemar-galesmalad an gannar e-yarse sedagoed. Neggweburmar-bergusad gannar na sobmarbaloed, agi na ambikumaloed. Uva-dubmar digmaloed, degi, e-vino gobdii gumaloed. Ibmar-digedgi arbamaloed, a-ibmar-sanmakoedi, gundii gumaloed.”
Be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová soged: “Israel-dulemar e-yargi an urboed, adi, mer yar-an-ega-uksadgi, bar onilegegar.”
Abdías-negburgan-daksad. Anmar, Bab-Jehová-e-ibmar-soged itosad. E-gayaburba-berbeged-wargwen, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwadse barmilesad. A-dule, weyob soged: “Anmar ogusmar. Anmar we-neggweburgi bila-ononamar.” Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad Edom-dulemarnik weyob soged:
“Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad-abargi an bur san-bipii be-imakoed. Bela dulemar isdarsunna be-dakmaloed.
Na be-gwage-ulubgi be-san-dummarba-itogedi be-yardaksad, Akwa-dummagan-imbaba be-siid, nibaduku be siid. A-ulale, na be binsaed, ‘¿doa napagulluse an-egwannosunna?’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Sulubagiyob amba be matusuli gukudiile, amba niisgwamar-imbaba be-uu siile, agi-gudiidgi amba an be-egwannoed.
”Ar dule-ibmar-atursaed mutikidba be-ibe ibmar atursadanikile, ¿unnila ibmar-abegedbi be-ibe sussulir be insae? Eye. Ibmar-abegedbi be-ibe susaled. Ar bedi bur bule ibitogoed. Ar uva-weemalad, be uva-nainuse nonikile, ¿uva-e-solamar obessulir be insae? Obesale. Ar bedi bur bule ibitogoed.
Esaú-e-ibmar-nuegandi, bela sulegoed. Bela e-ibmar-nuegan-gargerbamalad e-ibe sulegoed.
Bela dule-beba-nanaidi, be-yar-abingunaidse be-ononnomaloed. Be-aimala be-yardakmaloed, be-dummadga gunonimaloed. Dulemar-bebo-masgundimalad, begi aibinmalaga be-yardakmaloed. Edom-dulemarde deyob-guoed itogosurmalad.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “A-ibagi, Edom-dulemar-dule-binsaed-ibegan, an obelogoed, Esaú-yargi dule-ibmar-wisimaladi, an obelogoed.
Temán-neggwebur, be-sorda-bila-onomalad, dobedba wawanmakdemaloed. Esaú-yargi bila-onolenaidgi bela dulemar burgwemaloed.
”Esaú, be be-urba-Jacob-nue-wiosadbali, be dummad-bingeguoed, degisadegu be berguoed.
Jacob-e-sorda-bila-onomalad dule-baiganse gales-selemamaigua, bedi agi, unnila dakgwichi gusad, gwen be bendaksasulid. Dule-baigan, Jerusalén-e-yawagakba ubomamaigua, e-ibmar-nuegan-susmalad-miminanaigua, gwen be bendaksasulid. A-dulemaryob be gusmogad.
Esaú, be-urba-sabsur-imaklenaigusad-ibagi, ega be allewilubsulinad. Be-urba-sabsur-obingelenaigusad-ibagi, ega be allewilubsulinad. Judá-dulemar-ogilolenaigusad-ibagi, be yeer-itogewilubsulinad. E-suli-suli-itonaigusad-ibagi, egi be dodogewilubsulinad.
Esaú, an-dulamar-sabsur-odurdaklenaigusad-ibagi, e-neggwebur-yawagakba be dogewilubsulinad. E-sabsur-odurdaklenaigusad-ibagi, be yeerdakgwichi guewilubsulinad. E-wilenanaigusad-ibagi, e-ibe be ibmar-nuegan-gargerbamalad suewilubsulinad.
Jacob-dulemar-wakinmamaid-oburgwegala, igarmar-abingunanaidgi idu be gwisguewilubsulinad. E-suli-suli-itonaigusad-ibagi, dule-burgwissurmalad e-isdarmaladga be urmakewilubsulinad.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar bela dulemar-sabsur-odurdaked-e-ibagan warmaksad, Edom, ar igi be dule-imaksa, deyobi, be gumogoed. Igi be dulemar-imaksagusa, emigi be bela itomogoed.
Israel-dulemar, igi-bemar anse an-yar-islidikidgi sabsur-odurdaklesgusmala, deyobi, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad anse sabsur-odurdaklemogoed. Sabsur-odurdaklegoedba bergudmaloed. Dule-bukussuliyobi gumaloed.
Ar Sión-yargindina, dule-gwenna-gwenna san-onomaloed, amala swilidikidga gumaloed. Jacob-wagan gannar e-ibmar sumaloed.
Jacob-wagana, sooyobi gumaloed, José-wagandi, soo-gaeyobi gumaloed. Esaú-wagandina, gagan-dinnagwadyob gumaloed, soogi gummakmaloed, soose bergumaloed. Degisoggu, Esaú-wagan-abargine, dule-wargwensaar durguosulid. Ani an Bab-Jehová deyob soged.”
Neguevʼginmalad, Esaú-yar sumaloed. Sefelaʼginmaladdi, Filistea-dulemar-yar sumaloed. Israel-dulemar, Efraín-yar sumaloed, Samaria-yar sumarbaloed. Benjamín-wagan, Galaad-yar sumarmogoed.
Israel-sorda-bila-onomalad-gales-selesgusmalad Canaán-dulemar-abargi-gudimaladi, Sarepta-neggweburse yar-sumaloed. Jerusalén-dorgan-Sefarad-neggweburse-selesmaladdi, Neguev-neggweburmar sumaloed.
Israel-dulemar-galebukwa-nosmaladi, Esaú-e-yar-semai-gumalaga Sión-yarse naknonimaloed. Bab-Jehová na we-yar-dakmai guoed.
Bab-Jehová, Amitai-e-machi-Jonásʼse gornonikid. Ega weyob sognonikid:
“Jonás, Nínive-neggwebur-dummadse be nao. A-dulemarga be sogo, anse ibitomaloye. Ar Nínive-dulemar-e-isgued doggus wilub-obicha-gusad, e-ibmar-isgana-imakmalad anse warmaksad.”
Ar Jonásʼdi Bab-Jehováʼba gwen ibsassulid. Bab-Jehováʼgi-wakinnegala aka Tarsis-neggweburse naedgi binsaali gusad. A-ular, Jope-neggweburgi urmar-naguedse nade gusad. Jopeʼse modapgua, Tarsis-neggweburse ur-nae-sognai dakdapid. Geb Jonás agi ur-bennuksad, eba naegar. Deyob Bab-Jehováʼgi dikasur-wakinnega Tarsis-neggweburse nadegusad.
Agine, Bab-Jehová mataba burwa binnasur-golega imaksad. Geb degidbali, demar bela-bela dunguded, degisoggu, ur mared-naga-gualid.
Ur-selamar bela-bela gwayidmalad, geb, neg-isgued-wis-bargaegala, war-wargwen na e-bab-dummad-e-bab-dummadse gotemalad. Deginbali, selamar ur ukuu imakegala, ur-yagi-ibmar-bukwadi demarse midmalad. Jonásʼdina, ur-sukun-yaba-aides megisad. Agi, ise-nue-gabar megisad.
Agine, ur-seed Jonás-gabmaidse nonikid, geb ega sogded: —Ar bedi, ¿ibu be samai weyob be gabmaigu? ¡Gwisgue! ¡Be-Bab-Dummadse be gole! Ar abakale, be-Bab-Dummad wile anmar-dakalile, nabir anmar-bendakalile, adi, anmar burgosulid.
Geb selamardi, na dukin-dukin sogdemalad: —Anmar wilubdakgwelo. Agi, anmar dakoed, doa gudiidibe, doa-nukad anmargi burwa-dummad noali. Agi, wilubdaknanai-guarmalad. Geb Jonásʼgi yolenonikid.
Degisoggu, selamar Jonásʼse egisdemarsunnad: —Anmarga be soge, ¿wede ibiga anmargi burwa-dummad noali? ¿Be ibigi arbae? ¿Bia be daniki? ¿Be bialidi? ¿Bede, igid-dule?
Geb Jonás dulemar-abin sogded: —Ani, an Hebreo-dule, Bab-Jehováʼse-gordiid-duled. Ar we-Bab-Dummad nibneg-e-dummadid, demar nasiksabalid, napneg nasiksabalid.
Agi, selamar bela-bela dobgudmalad. Geb Jonásʼga sogdemalad: —¿Igi be neg-imaksa? Ar ega Jonás sogsasoggu, selamar wisgunonimarsunnad, Jonás Bab-Jehováʼgi wakindii.
Degine, demar bur bule dungumaisoggu, Jonásʼse egichidmalad: —Anmarga demar nabir bogilegegala, ¿igi anmar be-imakosunna?
Jonás abin-sogded: —Ar an-nukad we-burwa-dummad nomaid. Degisoggu, gasa be an-imakmala, demargi be an-metemala, ar degii geb demar bogilegoed.
Degine, selamar aisaar gakase-warmakega sabsur-gamminanai-gusmalanad, degi-inigwele, demar-dungueddi baligannosad. E-urdina, sunnale dogsar gunaid, degisoggu, demar-gakase ur-sessur-gusmalad.
Geb degine, selamar Bab-Jehováʼse binnasur gotemalad, ega sogdemalad: “Bab-Jehováʼye, melle be we-dule-ular anmar-oburgwe. Ar we-dule ibmar-oakalossulile, melle e-burgoed, anmargi be nasiko. Bab-Jehová, ar bedi na ibmar-imakbiedba be imakmaid.”
Agine, selamar Jonás-gasmalad, geb, demargi metemalad. Jonás-melledgua, demar yog bogilegargusad.
Selamar bela deyob daksamargua, Bab-Jehová-dobee-ito-nadmalad. Geb Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-ogumakar uksamalad, deginbali, ise-sogar na weyob sognanai-guarmalad: “Bab-Jehová-sogedba anmar gudii-guoye, deyob anmar imakergebye.”
Ar Bab-Jehováʼdi Jonás-ua-dummadse-dolegegala, idu guakwaa ua-dummad-nasiksad. Jonás ua-dummadse-dolesgua, e-saban-yaba ibapaa megisad.
Geb degine, Jonás ua-sabanyaba-mai, e-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼse goted.
Ega sogded: “An dummad-wilenaidgi, an bese gochad. An bese gochagua, be an-itononikid. Bato an burgwarmalad-neg-gullugi-mai an gochad. Agi, Bab-Jehová be an-bendaknonikid.
Demar-wilasolase, dii-ulak be an-barmeted. Be-demar-ebilemaid, bela angi nasad. Be-demar-dummagan-nukamakmaidi, bela angi bipirmaksad.
Weyob an binsanonikid: Bab-Jehová nue an-obachasunye. Degi-inigwele, an gannar ese-goled-neg-swilidikidsik an nabaloye.
Bela diimar dukarse an-ebiris-nagusad, demar-wilasailad bela an-ebirisad, demar-gaganmar an-nonogi bela bipirmaksad.
Bela-bela demar-napa-ulubse an megdapid. ¡Bato an napa-ulubgi-mellesigua, gwen bar noed an itossulid! Degi-inigwele, be an-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-gued, an gulluba-mellesiidgi be an-onononikid.
”An na nue-burgwe-itogua, Bab-Jehová, an begi binsaded, agi an bese goted. An-bese-goled, bese mosad, bese-goled-neg-swilidikidse warmaksad.
”Dulemar-bab-dummaganse-gormaladdi, Bab-Dummad-e-sabgued gwen bai daksurmalad.
Andina, an weligwar-namakedgi, an bega ibmar-ogumakar ukoed. An bega ibmar-imakoye ise-sogar an sogsad, an imakedsegoed. ¡Bab-Jehová, unnila bebi sunna dule-abonoged!”
Geb agine, Bab-Jehová Jonás-onogegala, ua-dummad-agega imaksad. Geb neg-dinnagwadgi ua agsagua, Jonás neggunasse nononikid.
Degine, geb ilabogi, Bab-Jehová Jonásʼga gannar sogdebalid:
“¡Jonás! ¡Gwisgu! Nínive-neggwebur-dummadse be nae. An bega-ibmar-sogoed a-dulemarga be sognao.”
Agi Jonás, gwichibin imaksad, geb, Nínive-neggweburse nadegusad, Bab-Jehová-ega-sogsadba. Ar Nínive-neggwebur bipisursoggua, egi naegala ibapaa-nanaleged.
Jonás, Nínive-neggweburgi dognonikid, geb, ibagwen-dummad gandikidgi weyob sunmakdii gualid: “Iba-dulabose (40) Nínive-neggwebur berguoye.”
Agine, Nínive-dorgan Bab-Dummad-ega-sogedi nue-itosmalad. Degisoggu, serganmala, degi, bipiganase-bakar, bar mas-guchasurmalad, bela mor-sommed-ai-aid yosmarbalid, adi, oyogegar, emarde e-isguedga na wile-itomarye.
Nínive-e-rey we-gaya-itoargua, na e-rey-gangi-sii gwichibin-imaksad. Geb e-rey-mor-yoid-esusad, agi mor-sommereged yosad. Deginbali, buru-birgi sigisbalid, oyogegar, ede na e-isguedga bukib-binsamoye.
Geb degine, rey na e-dummaganmala, Nínive-neggweburginmaladga igar-uknonikid. Weyob sognonikid: “Bela dule-gwablemakar melle mas-gunmalo, melle dii gobmarbalo, bela molimarse-bakar, sibad-wawaadmarse-bakar, bela-ibmar-durganse-bakar, melle masgi-ogunmalo.
Deginbali, dulemar mor-sommed yomalo, degine, e-ibmar-durganse-bakale, egi mor-sommereged nasikmalo. Bab-Dummadse bela-bela gandikidgi gormalo. Degi, na war-wargwen e-daed-sunnasulid iemalo, degine, e-ibmar-isgana-sabsur-imakdimalad bela iemamarbalo.
Abakale, Bab-Dummad, wile anmar-dakalile. Bela-bela sabsur-anmar-odurdaksokalidgi, bar sabsur-anmar-odurdakarsulile, adi, melle anmar burgwemalagar.”
Bab-Dummad Nínive-dorgan e-isguedga na bukib-binsasa, degi, e-ibmar-isgana-imaked mete daksagua, na sognonisunnad, we-dulemar-osulogoye an sogsadi, emigindi, bar an sabsur-odurdakosurye.
We-ibmar-gusad bela-bela Jonás-sae-itogega imaksad. Sae-itogedba, sabsur-uluded.
Geb Jonás, Bab-Jehováʼse goted. Weyob ega sogded: —Bab-Jehová, ¿ar an we-obarissursi, deunni an-yargi an gudigu? Agala, an Tarsis-neggweburse nadegusanad. Ar an nue-wisid, be, Bab-Dummad-emar-saberbadid, be, wile-emar-dakedid. Be wissur-gwae-gwae urwebalidid. Ar be, dulemar-nue-sabsoggu, emar-sabsur-odurdakoye be sogdaenad, degite, be sorba sogdedabalid, be-isgued bergusye.
Bab-Jehováʼye, degisoggu, an bega soged, bur be an-oburgwesunna. Bur an dula-gudiidba burgwisunnana gadinad.
Bab-Jehová, Jonás-abin sogded: —Ar weyob be urwenaidde, ¿ibmar-nued na be sanaye sogsunde? Gwen ibmar-nuedsulid.
Geb Jonás neggweburgi nodegusad, dad-nakwedsik sigwidapid. Agi, neg-matarkwaa sobsad. A-neg-urba, negsichigwagi sigisad. Geb neggwebursik ataksii gusad, adi, dakegar, igi Nínive-neggwebur gudodibeye.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová Jonás-siidgi dagargii-dakleged-urwa dunguega imaksad, adi, Jonás a-urwa-urba dukuegar, degine, urwesiidbali wis yeer-itobaligar. Agi Jonás, we-urwa-urba-dukusiidgi yeer-itos-gusad.
Neg-oiboargua, Bab-Dummad, dagargii-dakleged-urwa nusse gullegega imaksad. Degisoggu, urwa dingussunnad.
Dad nakwiargu, Bab-Dummad, dad-nakwedsikid-burwa diopisur-golega imaksad. Degisoggu, Jonásʼgi dad-dummadi-ganai-gualid. Degidbali, Jonás, sulibinsa-ito-naded, na neg negoe-itoged. Agala, burgwebi-guarsunnad, geb, weyob sogded: “Bitigi an burgwissunnana gadina, ar dula-gudiidba bur-nuedid.”
Agine, Bab-Dummaddi Jonásʼga sogded: —¿Ar dagargii-dakleged-dingusadbina nue be urwe? Jonás, Bab-Dummad-abin sogded: —Eye, nue-bela-bela an sae-itoged.
Geb degine, Bab-Jehová Jonásʼga sogdebalid: —¿We-dagargii-dakleged-urwa, mutiki-dungusad, a-banedgine, mutiki burgwisbalid, a-bina be bukib-binsade? Emide be, gwen digsasulid, be gwen odummossurbalid.
Ar deyob be itogele, an-bulesunna, ¿ar an Nínive-neggwebur wiledakosur be an-insae? Ar we-Nínive-neggwebur-dummadgi dulemar-aku-neg-itomalad mili-dulanergwa-gaka (120,000+) bukwad, degine, moli-bebe-nikamalad bukidar-bukwabalid. ¿Amarde an wiledakosursi? An wile dakoed.
Judá-dule-e-reymar Jotam, Acaz, degi, Ezequías, negsemamaid-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová dule-Moreset-neggweburgined-Miqueasʼye-nugadga sunmaksad. Miqueas, Samaria-yalagi-negguoed, degi, Jerusalén-yalagi-negguoed weyob negburgan daksad. Miqueas, Bab-Jehová-ega-sogsadba weyob sogded:
“Dulemar, bela we-yalagi-bukmalad be an-itomar, bela napneggi-bukmalad, nue-bogimakar be itomalo. Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nika-Maid, ese-goled-neg-akale, bemargi-gwisguega sunmakoed.
¡Dakmala! Bab-Jehová, e-maidgi bato noalid, bato aidealid, yar-mullugan-imbaba gannamakdanikid.
E-nanaedbali yarmar abin maludoed. Ibmar-gwallu-soo-abin-daluddaedyobi yar gudoed, igi diwar-noedbali, nebagan negabar-argaddae, deyobi, nebagan argadoed.
Bela we-ibmarmar Jacob-wagan-Bab-Dummadgi-gwisgusadbali guoed. Israel-dulemar-isgued-ular, deyob, guoed. ¿Ar bia Jacob-wagan Bab-Dummadgi gwisgusmala? ¿Ar Samaria-neggweburgi isgusmarsursi? ¿Ar Jerusalén-neggweburgi, Judá-dulemar e-bab-dummaganse-gorleged-neggi isgusmarsursi?
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová soged: ‘An Samaria-neggwebur akwamarbi dunnumaksii an imakoed. E-akwamar nebaganba an mioed, bela swanga an imakoed. Unnila e-yala uvaʼmar-digega guoed.
Bela e-bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad bibislegoed. Bela bab-dummagan-neggi-gambasamaladga ibmar-uklesmalad, ogumaklegoed. Bela we-ibmarmar-soblesmalad an obelogoed. Ar ade, galagwensuli-nanamalad-manigi, we-ibmarmar-soblesadi, gannar amar-maniga an imakoed.’ ”
Miqueas sogded: “Agala, an booed, bukib-binsaedba an binnasuli goloed, nag-swili an gudii guoed, uka-swili an gudii guoed. Achu-boeyobi an gordii guoed. Irmonyobi an akigindii guoed.
Ar ade, Samaria-e-naibigusadi, gege nudakleged. E-naibigusadi, bela Judá-yalase warmaksad. Bela Jerusalén-neggweburse an-dulemar-bukwadse nasgusad.
Melle be bomalo, melle Gat-neggweburgi be ibmar sogmalo. Napayala nunmakedba, Bet-Le-Afra-neg-ukubgi be bindumakmar.
Safirʼginmalad, uka-swiri binged-abalagi be-yargi be nomar. Zaanánʼginmaladdi, ainiega sikirmaksamalad. Betesel-neggweburgi ogormakdemalad, bar bemar bendaklegosulid.
Marotʼginmalad, ibmar-nued-gued abebukwad, ar Bab-Jehováʼdi, Jerusalén-neggwebur-dogedse bonigan barmialid.
”Laquis-dorgan, bemar ur-bila-onomaladgi moli be nasikmar. Ar ade, be-neggwebur-Jerusalénʼgi isgued noalid, bemargine, Israel-dulemar-e-isgued noalid.
Degisoggu, Moreset-Gat-neggweburga degimaloye be sogmalo. Aczib-neggwebur-e-negmar, Israel-dulemar-e-reymar-yardakega gued.
”Maresa-dorgan, dule-wargwen be-ibe-yarsuega, an bemargi barmidoed. Adulam-akwasaila-yaa-ollogwadyaba Israel-dule-bulegan dukunamaloed.
Degisoggu, be-mimmigan-sabed-ulale, be bukib-binsae, aku-siga be esie, mula-nono-swirigwadyobi be-nono swiri be imake, ar ade, be-mimmigan yogasaar-gales dikasuli begi seledmaloed.”
Dule, igar-isgana-imakedgi-binsamalad, duledar-wilesmar. Ar megidele, igar-isgana-imakedgi, binsamaidamalad. Neg-oibosale, igar-isgana imakdedamalad, ar ade, e-ibmar-imakbiedba imakdamalad.
We-dulemar, emar-nainubina sokalile, e-ibe susdamalad, egadga imakdedamalad. Emar-ibe negmar susdamalad, egadga imakdedamalad. E-neg-ibed-mesagwar imakdedamalad, degi, e-neg-ibed-mimmigan-mesagwar imakdedamarbalid. E-nainu-ibed-mesagwar imakdedamalad, degi, e-nainu e-ibe susdamarbalid.
Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Emigine, ani, an we-dulemar-isganagi bonigan barmidamogoed, we-bonigangi gwen wakinnosurmalad. Bar san-dummarbaa na itogosurmalad, ar ade, e-sabsur-odurdakleged-wachimar omosad.
A-ibagan-omosale, dule-bamalad egi dododmaloed, ega we-naibi-itoleged-namakleged weyob egi dodoar namakmaloed: ‘Anmar bela bergusmala. An-dulamar-ibe nainumar miminanaid, ibiyobi anmar-ibe nainumar sunanai. Dule-isganamar, anmar-nainumar miminanaid.’ ”
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová-sordagan-onmakbukwad-abargi, we-dulemarga napa-mimilegedgi ega napa uklegosulid.
We-gayaburba-barsoged-napiragwadsurmalad anga soged: “Mer bar be anmarga ee-gordii samala. Mer be anmarga soge, be wilemaloye.”
Jacob-wagan weyob sogmalad: “¿Bab-Jehová e-san-bargaagwar-imaked bergussi? E-daedde, ¿weyobsi? ¿Ar dule-inniki-nanadiidga Bab-Dummad-gayaburba ibnuedga gusursi?”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar bemar an-dulamarga gumalanad, degi-inigwele, emi-ibagi be an-isdarmaladga gudmalad. Dulemar-igarba-baisurbinsa-nadapdamalad-ibe sordamar-be-isdarmaladyobi, e-ibe be mor-nuegan atursasdamalad.
An-dulamar-omegan e-neg-nuegangi be ononnosmalad. A-omegan-e-mimmigan-ibe, be e-wergued osulosmalad.
”¡Ogusmar! ¡Be namar! We-nega, obunnoged-negsulid. Bela nue-isgus naid, bela oitoles siid.
Ar dule-gwensak yogasaar-gakansaedgi weyob sognonikile: ‘An bemarga-sunmakega, vino be anga udamaloye, sisa be anga udamaloye.’ We-neggwebur Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogedyobi, we-dule-dakdoed.”
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “Jacob-wagan, an bemarga nue-napira-soged, bela be-dulemar gannar nuekwa an urboed. Israel-wagan, an bemarga nue-napira-soged, bemar-napi-besmaladi, an gannar danar urboed. Igi sibad-wawaad galu-yaba danale-bukwadae, deyobi, an bemar-urboed. Degi, igi sibad-wawaad gagan-araramaladgi bukwadae, deyobi, an bemar-urboed, degine, binnasuli dule-bukidarayob oimakdemaloed.”
Ega igar-mayedi, emar-idumai guoed, deginbali, emarmoga, igar-egamai gumarmogoed. Amar, igar-bulegangi ollorgumaloed, degi, namaloed. E-reydi, amar-idumai guoed. Bab-Jehová, na e-sunnagwadi emar-idumai guoed.
Geb degine, an sogded: “Jacob-dulemar-negsemamaid, Israel-dulemar-e-dummagan, nue be an-itomar: Bemar bur igar-innikigwad-imaked-durdaked ¿nabirsursi?
Ar bemar igar-nued bur isdar dakmalad, igar-isgana aka be yeer dakmalad. An-dulamar be wiodimalad, mesagwar be imakdimalad.
Bemar ibgwensur an-dulamar imakdimalad. E-ukamar e-ibe be edared. E-garmar bis-bis e-ibe be imaked. Igi san-olomakar esmed-yagi onakledae, deyobi, an-dulamar be wiodimalad. San-narilegedyobi, an-dulamar be imakdimalad.”
Bemar ibagwengi Bab-Jehováʼse gotemaloed, edina, bemar-abin imakosulid. Ar bemar dogdar isgusgudiidba, a-ibagangine, bemar-idu banguoed.
Bab-Jehová weyob bemar-annik soged: “Bemar Bab-gayaburba-barsogmalad, dulemar-yamodimalad, igar-noaledba an-dulamar-sedimalad: Unnila dule-bega-masgunned-ukmaladgarbi, igar-bogidikidgi be sunmakdamalad, ar dule-bega-masgunned-uksurmaladgardi, bila-onoged be obariddamalad.
Degisoggu, an bar bemarga an-ibmar-sabiedi sogosulid. Bipisaale bar an bemarga an-gayaburba sogosulid. Bar anga-gayaburba-barsogmalad bemarga yoedse-ibmar-guoedgi sunmakosurmalad. ”An-gayaburba-barsogmalad bar sunmaksuli guoed e-ibagan bergudoed.
An-gayaburba-barsogmaladi, bingedar itodmaloed. Nergan aku neg-dake gudmaloed. Ar bela wemar bar-ibmar sogosurmalad, ar ade, an gwen ega ibmar sogosulid.”
Andi, Miqueas, Bab-Jehová-Burba nue-nika gudiid. Igar-napiragwadi, degi, garganguedi, an nue-nika gudiid. Adi, Jacob-dulemar ibmar-isgana-imakmaladgi an sunmakegar, degi, Israel-dulemar-isgudiidgi an sunmakegar.
Jacob-dulemar-negsemamaid, Israel-dulemar-e-dummagan, be nue an-itomalo. Bemar igar-innikimalad bur be obandimalad. Bipisaale, bemar igar-maidgi binsaed-nika dasurmalad.
Ablis-eogedgi Sión-neggwebur be sobsamalad igar-isgana-imaklegedba be Jerusalén-neggwebur sebukmalad.
Be-dummagan-negsemaladi, dule-baiganse-manigi-baklegar igar nabomalad. Be-dule-irwa-Bab-Jehováʼse-gormaladi, manigi-bennuklegar dule-odurdakmalad, degi, be-Bab-Jehová-gayaburba-barsogmaladi, manigi-bennuklegar dulega sunmakmalad, aka bur Bab-Jehováʼga weyob sogdedamalad: “¿Ar Bab-Jehováʼde anmarba gudisursi? Degisoggu, anmar akar-guosulid.”
A-ulale, bemar-nukine Sión-neggwebur nainu-imuar-naidaedyob guoed. Jerusalén-neggwebur akwamarbi ganna-ganna-bubukwa guoed. Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-e-yala, gannar sapurbi moodo naguoed.
Ibagan-bergued-mosale, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-yala bur yala-biriginedga guoed, yala-mulluganba bur nuga-nika guoed. Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad bela ase nonimaloed.
Dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-bukidar-nonikoedi, sognonimaloed: “Dagmar, anmar Bab-Jehová-yalase nakwenamar, Jacob-e-Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse anmar namar. Bab-Dummad, e-sunnad, e-igar-maidba anmar-odurdakoed, degi, anmar e-igarba nanadii gumaloed.” Ar ade, Sión-yalagi Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maid-odurdakleged danikid, Jerusalén-neggweburgi Bab-Jehová-gayaburba ainidagoed.
Bab-Dummad, dulemar-yar-baid-baid-abargi dulemarga igar-nabogoed, neggwebur-gandikmalad-bukibga, degi, dikasurmaladga igar-nabogega guoed. E-es-suidmar napa-imuedga gudoed, e-ila-swiswidikmalad es-dopegwadga gudoed. Dule-yar-baid-baidginmalad, bar abin-abin urwosurmalad. Bila-onogega, bar guagwar-gudii guosurmalad.
Bela dulemar bogidik e-uva-dubmar-urba-bukwa gumaloed, degi, bogidik e-higuera-sapi-urba-bukwa gumaloed, dule-bamaladi, gwen amar-ogwayosulid, ar ade, deyobi, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad sogsad.
Ar bela dulemar e-bab-dummagan-nug ogannomalale, akarsulid, ar anmardi, anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-e-nugbi odummodii guoed.
Bab-Jehová weyob sogded: “A-ibagangine, dulemar-nailikguarmalad nuekwa an urboed. Dulemar-yar-baid-baidse-mimilesmalad bulakwaa an oambikuoed, degi, sabsur-imakledimalad nuekwa an oambikuoed.
Dulemar-nailikguarmalad napi besmaloed. Amarde, neggweburga an imakoed. Dulemar-yar-baid-baidse-mimilesmaladgi, dulamar-bela-bela-gangued-nikadga an imakoed. Ani Bab-Jehová ega Sión-yalagi yar-seoed, degisadegu yar-semai guoed.
Sión-yala, Jerusalén-neggweburgi be siid, neg-matusulid-nakulegedga be gunonikid. Be epennegwadyobi, gannar gangued-nika be guoed, Jerusalén, epenne be negsesadyobi, gannar be negseoed.”
Emide, Jerusalén, ¿ibiga be binnasuli gole? ¿Ar be, rey satesi? ¿Ibiga begi naibid-dummad noniki? ¿Ar bega-binsaed-uked burgwissi?
Sión-dulemar, ome-ugakgunaidaedyob, be binnasuli gole, be binnasuli akiginne. Ar be-neggweburgi be nooed, magabali gaamakdii be guoed. Babilonia-yalase be naoed. Geb agine, be ollorgunonikoed, Bab-Jehová be-isdarmaladgine be-onogoed.
Emigindi, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwad-bukidar begi-gwisguega atosmalad. Weyob sogmalad: “Sión-yala-ibe anmar ibmar sunae. ¡Bitigi, Sión-yala galakusa an daksamalana yeerbanye!”
Degi-inigwele, we-dulemar Bab-Jehová-e-binsanaidi, degi, e-ibmar-imakbiedi wissurmalad. Ar wemar wissurmalad, Bab-Jehová oros-dugmaklegedyobi e-saboleged-neggi e-urbemaloed.
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “Sión-dulemar, ¡ogusmar! Oros-omukueyob be dulemar imaknamar. Ar ani an moli-bebe-esgorogi-sobaledyobi gargangued an bega ukoed. Moli-e-nag-goonasi-esgoro-gordikidgi-sobaledyobi, an bega gargangued ukbaloed. Adi, bukidar neggwebur-bamalad napabi-nai be imakegar, degi, bela e-ibmar-nuegan be ei subaligar. Geb agine, a-ibmarmar anga be ukoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová Napneg-E-Dummadga gued.”
Jerusalén-dorgan, be-sorda-bila-onomalad guagwar be urbemar. Ar ade, anmar-isdarmalad bela anmar-ebiris bukmalad. Israel-dulemar-e-dummad-negsemaidi, sabsur-wiolegoed.
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “Belén-Efrata, ar bedi Judá-yargi-neggweburmar-bukwadba bur bipigwadid. Begine, dule-Israel-yala-seoed nodagoed. We-dulede, amba yoo-napaneg-nague bato gudibinned.”
A-ulale, Bab-Dummad, omegwa-goe-baknonikoedse be-isdarmaladga be-urmakmaloed. Geb degine, Israel-dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-napi-besmaladi, Israel-dulemar-baiganbo bular bukunonikoed.
Geb a-dule Bab-Jehová-e-ganguedba, e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-e-nug-gandikidba, e-dulemar-idugoed. Dulemar, dobedsuli gudii gumaloed, ar ade, a-dule bela napaneg-naid seoed.
Ar a-dule neg-bogidikid senonikoed. Ar Asiria-dulemar anmar-yar-subiguarmalale, anmar-neg-gandikmalad-bibisbiguarmalale, a-dule, anmar-bendaknonikoed. E-abin e-gugle (7) dummagan barmidoed, degi, e-baabak (8) neggwebur-sapin-dummagan barmidabaloed.
Wemala, gandikidba dadsaila-Nimrod-yala Asiriaʼye-nugad semai gumaloed, Asiria-dulemar anmar-yar subiguarmalale, degi, anmar-yar-abingunanaidgi dogbiguarmalale, a-dule, anmar-bendakoed.
Igi Bab-Jehová wakudaryala boo-bomiardae, degi, igi gagangi dii-owiardabali, debayobi, Jacob-wagan-napi-besmaladi, neggwebur-bamalad-abargine gudii gumaloed. Gaganmar gwen dule-eoged abdakdasulid deyobi, gumaloed.
Igi achumigur-nono-wawaad, ibdurgan-sapurbarmalad-imbagi gudidae, debayobi, Jacob-wagan-napi-besmaladi gumaloed. Igi achumigur-senigwad sibad-wawaad-bukwadgi-gudiidgi, sibad-wawaad-gasadae, gwen-odulodasuli, debayobi, Jacob-wagan neggwebur-bamalad-imbagine gudigumaloed.
Bab-Jehová, bee be, be-isdarmaladgi gwichiguoed, bela be-isdarmalad be obelogoed.
Bab-Jehová weyob Israel-dulemarga sogded: “A-ibagangine, an be-molimar ogilogoed, degi, be-moli-ur-bila-onomalad an obelogoed.
An bela be-neggweburmar obelogoed, degi, be-neg-gandikmalad bela an obelogoed.
Bela dulemar ina-isgana-imakmalad an obelogoed, degi, bar be nergan-nika guosurmalad.
An bela be-bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad obelogoed, degi, akwa-dummagan-islidikmalad an bela obelobaloed. Bipisaale, be-ibmar-sobsamalad-asabin bar sindigar be sigosurmalad.
Be-bab-bundor-Asera-e-wilub-gwismalad an bemar-ibe ungoed, degi, bela be-neggweburmar an obelogoed.
Dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad an-sogedba-dasurmalad ise-urwedgi, degi, sae-itogedgine, an buged imakoed.”
Israel-dulemar, Bab-Jehová-ibmar-sogedi be nue itomar: “Be gwichigumar. Be boni-nikagudiid yarmar-asabin be sognamar. Yar-mullugana be-itogega be imakmar.”
Yalamar, Bab-Jehová-urwed be itomar, napa-e-saila-gandikmalad, nue be bogimakar itomar, Bab-Jehová, e-dulemarga igar itosokalid, Israel-dulemargi gwisgusokalid.
Bab-Jehová sogded: “An-dulamar, ¿igi an bemar-imaksa? Be anga-sogmala, ¿ibigi an begi nosa?
Ar ani an Egipto-yalagi bemar-onosadid, maigagudiid-yalagi an bemar-ollor-imaksadid. Ani an bemarga Moisés, Aarón, María, barmisgusadid, adi, amar bemar-idumalagar.
An-dulamar, be-ebinsamala, Moab-dulemar-e-rey-Balac bemar-wiogega bemar-idu igar amisgusanad. Beor-machi-Balaam, igi Balac-abin sogsagusa, a be nue-ebinsamala. Deginbali, Sitimʼye-neg-nugad-akale, Gilgal-neg-nugadse-be-nonigusmaladi, be ebinsabali. Magar be an-dakmala, ani an, Bab-Jehová bemar-onosadid.”
Emide be sogmalad: “Anmarde, ¿igi Bab-Jehová-walikaa gumalosunna? ¿Igi anmar Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-asabin sindigar sigmalosunna? ¿Moli-bebe-nikad-birgagwenad-ogumakar-ukleged, an ega ukega sedoe?
An sibad-wawaad-machered miliba (1000) Bab-Jehováʼga uker, Bab-Jehová ¿yeer itogoe? Olivo-gwallu bute-miliambe (10,000) an ega uker, ¿yeer itogoe? An ibmar-isgana-imaksad-ular, ¿an-machi-sailagined an ukoe? An-machi-sunnad, ¿an-isgued-ular, an ukoe?”
Ar Bab-Jehová bato bega sogsad ibu ibmar-nuedi. Bab-Jehová be-daed-abemaidi, bato bega sogsad: Igar-napiragwad-imaked be-abemaid, dule-wiledaked be-abemaid, e-asabin gwage-eikwadaed be-abemaid.
Jerusalén-dulemar, Bab-Jehová-ibmar-soged nue be itomar: Dule Bab-Dummad-dobee-nanadiile, a-dule, dule-binsaed-ibedid. Sabsur-odurdaklenaid nue be itomala. Bega dule-odurdakleged-barmialidi, nue be itomala.
“¡Dule-isganamar! Ande be-ibmar-nuegan ibmar-isgana-imakedba-amisad, ¿baisurdakode? Degi, ande be ibmar-wilubsamalad-isgana, ¿baisurdakode? ¡Adi surbali!
Ar ande, dule ibmar-wilubsaed-nuegansulid-ebudiid ¿igi yeer dakosunna? Degi, ibmar-wilubdaked-ebudiid, ¿an igi yeer dakosunna? ¡Geg an yeer daked!
Dule-mani-ibegan, sabsur dule-imakedid. Bela neggweburginmalad, gakansilimalad. Na e-ibmar-sogedi bela gakansaedbiid.
Emisgine, ani an sabsur-be-imakmaloed, bemar-isgued-ular, an bemar-obelogoed.
Na be mas-gunmalo-inigwele, gwen be immelegosurmalad, amba ukudmaada be gudii gumaloed. Be ibmar-gwag weemaloe-inigwele, be-ibe berguoed. Ar be ibmar-soggwensaar-gaoedi, ani an bila-onolegedgi be-ibe obelogoed.
Be ibmar-digmaloedi, gwen be weosurmalad, degi, be olivo-gwallu-egurmaloedi, gwen be ebugosurmalad. Vino-onogega uva-nis-egurusadi, be gobosurmarbalid.
”Rey-Omri-igar-mesisadba be nanadimalad, bela Rey-Acab-e-wagan-ibmar-isgana-imaksadba be ibmar-imakdimalad. Amar-ibmar-imaksadyobi be nanadiid. A-ulale, an bemar-obeloged imakoed. Be-dulemar bingedar-itogega an saoed. Dulemar-begi-dodoedi, an imakoed.”
Miqueas sogded: “¡An duledar-wiles! Ibmar-gwag-yorgi-weleged-abin an nonisulid. Uva-solagan-weleged-abin an nonisulid. Degisoggu, uva-san-dukgwenad bar an daksulid, degi, an higuera-san-gunnegala gwen an daksurbalid.
Dule-wiledakmalad bela neggweburgi obelolesad, we-yargi dule-innikimalad bergusad. Bela dule-oburgwedgi-binsadimaladi, na muchub-muchub yamodidimalad.
Ibmar-isgana-imakedgi dule gwen egi obinsulid. Dule-dummagan-negsemamaid, degi, dule-igar-nabomalad, dule-bamaladse manigi-baklegar, igar nabomalad. Dule-gandikmalad e-itolegedba ibmar egismalad, e-ibmar-abegedba ega ukdamalad.
A-dulemar-abargi wis-dule-nuegan-gudimaladdina, bur bule sapi-ikobiidyob gued. A-dulemar-abargi dule-bur-innikigwaddina, bur bule ikomaryob gued. Suli-suli-itoleged-e-ibadi begi danikid, Bab-gayaburba-barsogmalad bega-ibmar-sogsadyobi, sabsur-odurdakleged-iba bato bega warmaksad.
Degisoggu, melle be-ai-ibmar-soged be itogo, degi, melle dule-baid-bega-ibmar-soged be itogo. Be-ome-ebo be sunmakalile, nue-itoakwaa be sunmako.
Ar ade, masmala, e-sergangi binsaedsuli guded, bunamala, nangangi obited, balamar, sak-omegangi obited, degi, e-isdarmaladi, e-neguyaginmalad nanaed.
Degi-inigwele, ani Miqueas, Bab-Jehováʼgi an bensulid, Bab-Dummad-an-abonogedi, an edarbedii guoed. An-Bab-Dummadi, an-itogoed.”
Miqueas weyob sogded: “An-isdarmalad-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad, mer be an-odurdaklegedgi weligwar itomala. Ar an galakus-inigwele, amba an gannar gwisguoed. An negsichidgi gudii-inigwele, ar Bab-Jehová neg-meegwadga anga gued.
Ar Bab-Jehováʼgi an isgusad, degisoggu, Bab-Dummad-anga-igar-nudakedse, degi, anga-igar-nabogedse an e-urwed itogoed. Geb Bab-Jehová, igar-nued anga oyogoed, degi, e-an-abonosadgi an werguoed.
An-isdarad anga sokardaed: ‘¿Bia be-Bab-Jehováʼde? A-dule, an-dakalile, bingedar itodoed.’ An-sunnagwad an-ibya-nuki e-wilegoed an dakoed. A-dule, neg-imbaba-olligi-annalegedyobi guoed.
”Jerusalén, gannar be-galu-matusurmalad-sobledele, be-yar-abingunanaid nasgudoed.
A-ibagangine, dule-bamalad, Asiria-yala-akale, Egipto-yalase-dulemar-bukwad, bese nonimaloed. Nilo-diwar-akale, Éufrates-diwarse-dulemar-bukwad, bese nonimaloed. Demarsik-bukmalad-akale, demar-baidsik-bukmaladse-dulemar-bukwad, bese nonimaloed. Deginbali, yar-dummagansik-bukmalad-akale, yar-dummagan-baidsik-bukmaladse-dulemar-bukwad, bela bese nonimaloed.
Dule-isgusmalad-ular, we-napneg olloo naguoed, deyobi, neg naguoed.”
Bab-Jehová, be-dulamar be nue ako, be-mimmigan walagwengi sapur-nuedgi-bukmalad be nue akwedii be guo. Epennegwadyobi be Basán-yalase, degi, Galaad-yalase be sede.
Egipto-yalagi Israel-dulemar-onosgu, ibmar-dakledisurmalad-oyosayobi, be oyoge.
Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladi, be-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad dakmaloed. Be-gandikid-dakoedba bingedar itodmaloed, geger-dakedba gaya-gadmaloed, degi, uaya-atidmaloed.
Igi-naibe napagi yaarmakar-nanae, deyobi, nanamaloed. Ibdula-unimalad-unimakedyob gumaloed. E-dukued-neggi dobed-abalagi nodamaloed, be-asabin dobedgi ainidamaloed. Anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, bese, gannar we-dulemar nonimaloed.
Bab-Dummad, ¿ar doa beyobid e-mimmigan-besmaladga isgusad-elied gudii? ¿Doa beyobid ibmar-isgana-imaksad bela ei-ieged gudii? Ar be degisadegu, urwedii guosulid, ar ade, bur bule anmar-sabguedgi be binsaed.
Gannar wile be anmar-dake. Anmar-isgued be osuloge, anmar-isguedgi mer bar be binsae.
Jacob-waganga, be-ibmar-inniki-imaked, be oyoge, Abraham-waganga, dule-ise-wiledaked be oyoge. Epennegwa anmar-dadganga ise-sogar-imaksayobi, be ibmar imake.
Nahúm-negburgan-daksad-e-garda. Nahúmʼde Elcos-neggweburgined. We-gardagi Bab-Jehová Nínive-neggweburgi neg-guoed sogsad.
Bab-Jehová, unnila dule-ebarbi-nanabi abeged, buged-mai dule-imakedbalid. Bab-Jehová dule-buged-mai-imakedid, e-isdarmaladse urwedid. Bab-Jehová, dule-egi-yoledimalad buged-mai imaked, e-isdarmalad ese sabsur-odurdakleged.
Bab-Jehová wissur gwae-gwae urwed. Bab-Jehová bela-bela gangued nikad. Bab-Jehová dule-ibmar-oakalosad sabsur-odurdakedsegad. Bab-Jehová burwa-oored-abargi, burwa-dummad-abargi gudidaed, mogir Bab-Jehová-e-nanaedba ukub-ainakweyobi gued.
Bab-Jehová demarga ibmar binnasur sogdele, demar dinnaa naddaed. Bela diwarmar dinnaa guega imakbalid. Basán-yar, degi, Carmelo-yar bela dinguded, Líbano-yar-dutumar bela dingudbalid.
Bab-Jehová-asabin yarmar giglimakdedaed, yar-mullugan babatiddaed. Bab-Jehová-asabin napneg giglimakdedaed, Bab-Jehová-asabin napneg-dirbir-naid, degi, bela egi bukmalad wawanmakdedaed.
Bab-Jehová-e-urwed-abin, ¿doa gwisguoe? Bab-Jehová-e-sae-itoged-abin, ¿doa gannarbaa gwisguoe? Bab-Jehová-e-urwedi, soo-gwabunye-gwichidyobi gued, e-asabin akwasailagan bela ese ubigwar gued.
Bab-Jehová, duledar-nuedid, suli-suli-itogedgine, anmar-odukuedid. Dule-egi-bensurmalad-bendakedid.
Bab-Jehová Nínive-neggwebur diwar-dummad-noedbali obelogoed. Bab-Jehová amba negsichidgine e-isdarmalad-baleginnoed.
Bab-Jehováʼgi-gwisguega, ¿ibiga bemar igar-isgana aminanai? Bab-Jehová bela bemar-giir imakoed, bemar-wiledakega bar iba-baid nasikosulid.
Bemar gagan-dinnagwadyobi bergumaloed, ikomar-dinnagwadyobi bergumaloed, Dule vino-doggus-gobsadba bar-itodisurdaedyobi bemar guoed.
Be, Nínive-neggwebur, begi dule-binsaed-uked-isgana gwalulesad. A-dule, Bab-Jehováʼgi igar-isgana amied.
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Asiria-dulemar nollosurgumala-inigwele, bergumaloed. Asiria-dulemar dula-bukidar-inigwele, burgwemaloed. Bedi, Judá-dulemar, an sabsuli-be-wiosmala-inigwele, bar deyobi, an be-wiogosurmalad.
Dulemar-sabsur-be-imakdimaladgi an be-ollor-imakoed, bar be maiga-gudii guosurmalad.”
Bemardi, Nínive-dorgan, Bab-Jehová bemarga igar-mesisad: “Mimmigan bar be nikuosurmarye, adi, be-nug mer bar degisadegu obarledii guegarye. Be-bab-dummadse-goled-neggi ibmar-wagar-sobarmar-bukwad, esgoro-gordikidgi ibmar-bab-dummadyob-sobar-bukwad, an obelogoed. Ar be dule-isganasoggu, an bega neg-uan guagwar sioed.”
¡Be dakmala! Dule-gayaburba-nuegan-berbegedi, dule neg-bogidik-naguoedgi-sunmakedi, bato yalaganba danikid. Judá-dulemar, be-iba-onomaladgi, be wergumala, Bab-Jehováʼga be ibmar-ukoye-sogsad be uke. Ar dule-isganamar bar be-yarse ubogosurmalad, ar bela Bab-Jehováʼse giir gusmalad.
Nínive-dorgan, bemargi dule-ibmar-obeloged gwichigudanikid, be-neggandikidgi, be nakulegwichi imake. Be-igarmarba be nakulemala, es-suid be guagwar gamala, bela bemar na niga ogannomala. Danale be ambikumala, adi, na be gargangued nikumalagar.
Ar Bab-Jehová Jacob-dulemar-e-yeerdakleged gannar obinoged. Israel-dulemar-e-yeerdakleged gannar obinoged. Ar dule-atursamalad e-ibe ibmar susmalanad, bela e-ibe uva-dub obelosmalanad.
E-sorda-bila-onomalad-bulegan-e-sigu-abgamalad, ginnitibi magaled, sordamar-bila-onomalad mor-ginnigan yoimalad. E-ur-napaginmalad guagwar bila-onogega-nanaidi, soo-gaeyobi dakarmaknanaid. Sorda-bila-onomalad e-eswarmar-gani-gani, sakwa bipinmakdanimalad.
E-ur-napaginmalad neg-imbaba gwae-gwae oabarmakdemalad, binnasuli dulemar-danar-bukumaladgi iirmakdidimalad. Acha-gwallu-gaeyobi urmar daklenanaed, mar-gaeyobi dakar-dakar gamalad.
Nínive-e-rey e-sordagan-bila-onomalad-buleganse goled, we-sordagan duurmakdegua, na muchub-muchub yolenanai gusad. Egi-ubodanimalad-abin-bukuega, galu-matusulidsik abarmakdemalad,
degi-inigwele, yawagak-dummagan-diwar-abgamaid argaded, reyneg aimukuded.
Rey-ome gales selemaid, omegan-ega-arbamaladi nuu-akiginmaiyobi selemamaid, nue-nunmak-itogedbali bonadapmalad.
Nínive-neggwebur dii-sied-mamarisadyob gued, e-diimar ariomaid. Ese gornanaid: “¡Mer be abarmakmala! ¡Be gannar dagmala!” Ar dule-wargwensaar gwen gannar aibirsulid.
¡Mani be sumala! ¡Or be atursamala! Nínive-neggwebur e-ibmar-nuegan yaisulid, manimar bukidar nikad, ibmar-yeerdaklemalad bukidar nikbalid.
Nínive-neggwebur bergus siid, dule-sate siid, napabi-nai nagusad. Dobedbali dulemar nig-argwatemalad, e-yokormar nollomakded. Bela e-abagan wawanmakded, e-wagarmar bela sibudiki daklenaded.
Achumigur-nono-wawaad-e-neg, ¿bia nade? Achumigur-e-mimmigan-e-neg, ¿bia nade? A-neggine, achumigur-machered, e-ome, degi, e-mimmigan, dule-e-ogwayed-sate, dobsuli mamaidaenad.
Achumigur-machered na e-mimmiganga san-goa-goa-imakdidaedi, ¿bia nade? Na e-omeganga ibdurgan-oburgwedaedi, ¿bia nade? Na e-megedgi ibdurgan-oburgwisad-urbedidaedi, ¿bia nade? Na e-neggi san-sabodidaedi, ¿bia nade?
Bab-Jehová Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob soged: “Emigindi, an bemargi gwisguega danikid. Be-urmar-napagined-bila-onomalad burubi-sii an imakoed, be-achumigur-burwigana an es-suidgi oburgoed. Ibmar-atursamaladi be-yargi an osulogoed, be-dule-gayaburba-barsogmalad bar bipisaale itolegosulid.”
Neggwebur-dulemar-ablis-eogedbi-siid, be ¡duledar-wiles! Bela begi neg-gakansalegedbi naid, begi bela-bela ibmar-atursalegedbi naid, ibmar-atursaedi gwen be indaksulid. Be deyob gusiidi, be ¡duledar-wiles!
Molidub-suid-goledi bato itoleged. Ur-napaginmalad-e-nagmar-bipirmaknaid-goled bato itoleged. Moli-nag-goledi bato itoleged, bila-onomalad-ur-napaginmalad e-gollomakedi bato itoleged.
Sorda-moli-birgi-sii-bila-onomalad-danimalad itoleged. Es-suid-e-dakarmaked mag dakleged, eswar-dakar-dakar-gaed mag dakleged. Dulemar-burgwarmaladi yaisulid. Muimar odunnumakded, muimar baid-baidsik omileded, dulemar a-muimargi yolenanaid.
Ar ome-gambasaed macherganga yamo-yamo-gudidaed-ular, deyobi neg-gunonikid. We-omede, dule-binsaed-gaed-buledid. E-gambanuchu-saedgi dulemar-yardaksad, e-inamar-isgana-imakedgi dulemar-yardaksabalid.
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob soged: “¡An bemargi gwisguega danikid! Be-sabure wagarse an be-ibe onakoed, adi, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad uka-swiri be-dakmalaga, dule-yar-dummaganginmalad be-binge-itoged dakmalagar.
Begine an ibmar-isgana mioed, an be-nug oichogoed, dulemar-abargi-oyolegega an be-imakoed.
Bela dule-be-dakmaloedi begi bangudoed. Sogdemaloed: ‘Nínive-neggwebur bergusye. ¿Doa eba wile itogoe? ¿Bia dule-wile-e-daked an ega amioe?’ ”
¿Ar bede Tebas-neggweburba bur-nuedsi? Ar Tebas-neggweburde diimar-abargi siinad, Nilo-diwar-sukamakmaid-walik siinad, Demar e-napa-odinnogaledyob guenad, diimar e-galu-matusulidyob guenad.
Etiopía-yar, Egipto-yar, Tebas-neggwebur-bendaksimalanad, bela-bela gangued nikamalanad. Fut-yar, Libia-yar, Tebasʼba naimalanad.
Degi-inigwele, Tebas-dulemar yar-baidse ononnolesmalad, yar-baidse gales-selesmalad. E-mimmigan igar-abingunanaidgi sabsur-omukulenai gusmalad. E-dule-nuga-nikamalad ibmarba-wilubdakar mimilesgusmalad, e-dule-dummagan-negsediid esgoro-dubgi edilles gusmalad.
Be, Nínive-neggwebur, be-omumsamarmogoed, neg-itosuli be gudii guoed. Be-isdarmalad-ulale, neg-dukued amidii be gumogoed.
Bela be-neg-gandikmaladi higuera-sapi-san-gordik-siiyobi gued, ar dule osiamakele, dule-gunnega-gwichid-e-gaya-yaba argwaned.
Be dake, be-isdarmaladbo be bila-ononaidgi, be-sorda-bila-onomalad omeganyobi damalad. Be-neggwebur-e-yawagakmar argasii guoed, ar be-yawagakgi-suar-biir-biir-megmalad soose gummakoed.
Nínive-neggwebur, be-isdarmalad be-neggwebur-ebiris-ambikunonimaloed-iduar, dii be enomar, be-neg-gandikmalad be ogannomala. Napa-olli-ollid-birgi be gwisgue, napsa-ginnid-birgi be annae, akwa-napsa-ginnidgi-sobaled be sobe.
Degi-inigwele, soogi be burgwemaloed, es-suidgi be girgumaloed, be-isdarmalad sesmaryobi giir be-imakmaloed. Ses-burwiganayobi be mergumai gumala, sesmaryobi be gwalulemai gumala.
Be-dula ibmar-ukedgi-arbamaladi, bur bule nibneggi-niisgwamar-nanaidba merguded.
Be-dummagan seseyobi gumalad, be-sordamar-e-dummagan ibmar-gukumalad-gar-satedyobi gumalad. We-ibmarmar neg-dambegwadgine galu-matusurmaladgi achaa nagudamalad. Ar dad-nakwialirdi gukuddamalad, bar daklegosulid, dule wissulid bia naddamala.
Asiria-e-Rey, dule-bega-negdakmamaid bela-bela gabmamaid, be-sordamar-ise-welegar-imaklesmalad gabidmalad. Be-dulamar yala-imbaganba aisakis gudidiid, amar-onmakega dule sated.
Be-nailikgusadi gege nudakleged, be-yaa-siid-nudakega ina sated. Dulemar deyob-be-gusadi be-wisgumaloedi, bega yeer-itomaloed. Ar ade, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad-bukidara be sabsur-imaksa gusad.
Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Habacuc negburgan-daksagua, we-gayaburba ega soglesad.
Bab-Jehováʼye, ¿sanagwadse an bese bendakleged egisnaiguoe? Emide, gwen be an-itosulid. ¿Sanagwadse dulemar-sabsur-imakledimalad-ular, an bese gornaiguoe? Emide, gwen be anmar-bendaksulid.
¿Ibigala, igar-innikwad-imaklesulid-dakega be an-imake? ¿Ibiga ibmar-isgana-imaklenaid-dakega be an-imake? Unnila neg-gagalenaidbi, degi, dule-sabsur-imaklegedbi an daked. Urwelegedbi, degi, na abin-abin-imakmaladbi neg-naid.
Agala, igar-maidba ibmar-imaklesulid, igar-innikigwad-imakleged bar imaklesulid. Dule-isgana dule-nued-balegindiid, dulemarga igar-innikigwadba igar nabolesulid.
Bab-Jehová sogded: “Dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad be dakmala. Nuekwaa be dakmala, geger-dakbukwa be gumala. We-ibagangi ibmar-gegerdaklemalad an imaksokalid, amba dule bemarga a-ibmar-imaklegoed-odulogele, bemar amba bengumaloed.
Caldea-dulemar an bemargi bila-onodagega imaknaid, we-dulemar, dule-isgana-nanaed, binna-binnasuli ibmar-imakmaladid. Dule-baid-ibe napa-suega bela napneg-ebirdii damalad.
We-dulemar dule-buleganad, dule-ogwayemaladid, na e-sogedba igar-innikigwad-imakleged imakmaladid. Na e-nugbi-dummarbagued amidimaladid.
E-molimar, achu-barbadba bur bule abarmakmalad, achu-sapurba bur bule ursirmalad. E-sordamar-moli-birgi-bila-onomalad sabsur-abarmakmalad, we-sordamar dikasur danimalad. Igi sulubagi e-mas-daksale, binnasuli egi melleardae, deyobi dulemargi mellear damalad.
We-dulemar unnila emar-sabsur-imakega danimalad, e-nadapmaladba neg-dobedbi nasiknadapmalad. Ukub-weeyobi dulemar-gamalad.
Reymar-mamaidgi burgunagus damalad, sapin-dummagan-negsemamaidgi dodonagus damarbalid. Neggwebur-galu-matusur-nikamaladga allenana damalad, ar ade, a-neggweburmargi-dogegala arsanyob napamar sobmalad.
We-dulemar burwa-dummadyobi bela ese ibmar oitoledaed. E-gangued e-bab-dummadga imakdimalad. Agi e-isgued siid.”
Be, Bab-Jehová, bato be negasaila-akale gudiid. Be, an-Bab-Dummad-isligwaled, be degisadegu dula maid. Be, Bab-Jehová, igar-innikigwad-imakmalaga be Babilonia-dorgan urbisad. Be, akwasaila-dukuedyob anmarga gued. Anmar-sabsur-odurdaked-oyogega be Babilonia-dorgan urbisad.
Be, bela-bela dule-swilidikgusoggu, ibmar-isgana be abesulid. Dule-sabsur-imakleged be yeer daksurbalid, degite, ¿ibiga be dule-isganamar baisur-daksunna? Dule-isganamar dule-nuegan-sabsur-imaknaid be dakmaidgi, ¿ibiga be gayamakar maisunna?
Uamar-e-idued-satedyobi be dulemar-imaksad, ibmar-unimalad-e-idued-satedyob be dulemar-imaksad.
A-ulale, Babilonia-dorgan achwergi-uasoeyobi dulemar-gamalad. E-sakigi ua-galesar-ebipidamaladyobi dulemar-ebipimalad. E-saki-ollo-ollogwad-imbaba ua-galesnanaid-weedyobi dulemar-wemalad, degidba, yeer itomalad, weligwar itomalad.
A-ulale, Babilonia-dorgan na e-sakiga bab-dummadyobi ega ibmar-ukleged ukmalad. E-sakiga ina-wawadikid ogumakmalad. Ar e-saki-nukad na e-masgunned bukidar nikad, e-mas yeer gullebalid.
Ar deyobi, Babilonia-dorgan, dulemar-wiogega, ¿na e-saki-midii gumaloe? ¿Dulemar-gwen-wiledaksuli gindakdii gumaloe?
Habacuc sogdebalid: An nakuledii imakoed, aila-birgi an edarbegwichi imakoed. Bab-Jehová anga-ibmar-sogdagoed an nue-itoagwar itogoed, an ega ibmar-sogsad igi-an-abin-imakdagodibe.
Bab-Jehová an-abin-imaksad: “Be negburgan-daknaid narmake, urgogi magar-daklege, be nuekwaa narmako, adi, nabir baisursunna absolegegar.
Ar negburgan-oyolenaidi, na e-iba-sogedba gunonikoed, bela a-ibmarmar-gunadapid, bela guedsegad. Ar we-ibmar gwen emiskwaa guosur-inigwele, be abitogo, ar bela guedsegad.
”Dule-isgana e-gwagegi innikidasulid. Dule-gwage-swilidikiddi, Bab-Jehováʼgi-bensulidgi gudii guoed.
Napiragwa, ibmar-bukidar-nikuedi dulegi aibined. A-ulale, dule-na-san-dummarba-imakedi, undar-gudii guosulid. Ar a-dule, neg-uan-mui-dodaeyobi sulibinsa ibmarbina itoged. Burgwedyobi bogigudisulid, napi-ibmar abedaed. Bela yarmar-nanaid ese sulemaid, bela dulemar ese galemamaid.”
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “Dulemar-galesmaladi, yoedsega, dulemar-e-gasmaladgi burgunanai gumaloed, galagwensuli egi sunmaknanai gumaloed. Weyobi ega namaknanai gumaloed: ‘Dule, emar-ibe-ibmar-suedba mani-ibedga-guedi, ¡duledar-wiles! Dule, emar-ibe ibmar-galemalad egadga-omelodimaladi, ¡duledar-wiles! ¿Sanagwadse be deyob-gudiid indakoe?’
Bese dulemar-mesagwar-imaklediid, ukiagwar begi gwisgudagoed. We-dulemar wawanmakega be-imaknonimaloed, sabsuli be-annik ibmar sunonimaloed.
Ar be yarmar-bamalad-ibe ibmar atur-imaksasoggu, yarmar-bamalad-bese-atursalessurmaladdi, be-ibe ibmar atursamarmogoed. Ar emar-ibe be wilub-obicha ablis-eosad, degi, we-yar-naidi be sabsur-imaksad, e-neggwebur be sabsur-imaksad, e-dulemar be sabsur-imaksabalid, a-ulale, deyobi be-imakmarmogoed.
”Dule atursaale ibmar-ena na e-neg-siedi, ¡duledar-wiles! Ar na binsasanad, deyobi na e-neguya bendakoye, deyobi bar an wiledii guosurye.
”Weyobi be binsaedba na be-neguya bingeguega imaksad. Bukidar be dulemar-ogilonai-gusadba, na be dukin obeloed amisad.
A-ulale, akwa-galumarse-bakale, degi, urgomar nagubirga-mamaid-bakale, begi aibitemaloed.
”Dule emar-ibe-ablis-eogar neggwebur-sobed, ¡duledar-wiles! Dule-sabsur-imakedgi neggwebur-urbed, ¡duledar-wiles!
Ar ani Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gangued-Nikadi, dulemar-e-ibmar-imaked, ¿soogi-ogumaklegega igar mesissursi? Dulemar binsarsunna, ¿geggus-alamaknaiguega igar mesissursi?
Ar igi-dii demar-enarkwaa sigisdae, deyobi napnega Bab-Jehová-e-gargangued-yeerdakleged magar-dake guoed.
”Dule e-ai-omumguedi, ¡duledar-wiles! Dule e-ai-uka-swana-dakega, vinoʼgi e-ai-omumguoedi, ¡duledar-wiles!
Degidba na be dukin be-nug oichosad, gwen be na be-nug odummossulid. Degisoggu, be vino gobmosunna, an na be Bab-Dummad-akudaked oyosunna. Bab-Jehová e-argan-nuedgi bingegued-nog-ganisiid gobega be-imake, be-nug-dummarba-nikad, bipii imakega imake.
Babilonia-dorgan, be Líbano-yar-sabsur-imaksagusad begi aibinoed. Be ibdurgan-ogilosgusad, dobguega be-imakoed. Ar be dulemar-ibe doggus ablis eosad, e-yar-naid be sabsur-imaksad, e-neggweburmar, degi, e-dulemar be sabsur-imaksad. A-ulale, be sabsur-odurdaklemogoed.
”Duleyob-ibmar-sobaledi, ¿ibi-nuedga wis gue? Ibmar-nuedga gusuli. Nuchu-esgoro-diregwadgi-sobaledi, ¿ibi-nuedga wis gue? Unnila gakansaedginbi emar-odurdaked. Dule nuchu-gege-sunmaked-sobedi, unnila na e-arbaedginbi bensulid.
Dule suar-sobaledga sogdibe: ‘¡Atake!’ ¡We-dule, duledar-wiles! Dule akwa-sobaledga sogdibe: ‘¡Gwisgue!’ ¡We-dule, duledar-wiles! Ar we-ibmarmar amba bela or egi-ebiris-nai-inigwele, amba bela mani egi-ebiris-nai-inigwele, gege ibmargi be-odurdaked, ar burba sated, unnila uka-ollobi gued.
Ar Bab-Jehováʼdi na e-neg-islidikidgi maid. Bela dulemar Bab-Jehová-asabin gaya-bogidik gumala.”
Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Habacuc, Bab-Dummadse-goled. We-Bab-Dummadse-goledi, Sigionot-gar-goledba gorlegoed.
Bab-Jehová, be-nug-dummarba-gued an itosad, Bab-Jehová be-ibmar-imaksadi, be-dobekwaa-nanaega an-imaked. Bab-Jehováʼye, emi anmar-dulagudiidgi be gannar a-ibmarmar imake, be gannar a-ibmarmar oyoge. Bab-Jehováʼye, be uludele, be-dule-wiledaked mer be iego.
Bab-Dummad neg-Temánʼye-nugad-akale, danikid, Dule-Isligwaled yar-Paránʼye-nugad-akale, danikid. Bab-Dummad-e-gangued-yeerdakleged bela nibneg-gasad, bela dulemar-we-napneggi-bukwadi e-nug odummomalad.
E-dakarmakedi, mala-dakarmakmaiyobi gued. E-argangine malamar milemaid, agine, e-gargangued dukuar maid.
Bab-Dummad-daged-idu, bonigan-bulegan ainied. Bab-Dummad-sorbali, soo-ginnitibi danidaed.
Bab-Dummad gwisgunonikile, napaneg giglimakde daed. Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwad-dakdele, dulemar wawanmakde daed. Bela yar-dummagan-dikasurgus-bubukwad malud daed, yar-senigana-sergan-bubukwad babatid daed, ar Bab-Dummad-igardi degisadeguad.
Cusán-dulemar-danar-danar-bukwadi, suli-suli-itobukwa an daksad. Madián-dulemar-bukwadi, bela-bela dobe-itobukwa an daksad.
Bab-Jehová, ¿diwarmarse be ulus gusa? ¿Suke-iirmakmaidse be urwemai gusa? Be-moli-birgi-sii be abarmakmaigua, be-ur-napagined-gege-galakuedgi be nakwisgua, ¿demarse be nue-urwemai gusa?
Be-warsi na be guagwar ganikid, be-saguyaba sigumar be enosad. Be napaneg-marisadgi dii-iirmakega imaksad.
Yarmar-bubukwad be-dakdedba wawanmakdemalad. Mogirmala, diidar-dummad owinonikid, muu-billi binnasuli uurmakded, demar-mullugana dunguded.
Be-mala-ibyemaidba, dad-ibeler geg gaed, be-mala-dakarmakmaidba nii geg noed.
Sae-itodiidba, napneggi be bipirmakdiid. Urwedgine, be dulemar-sabsur-imaked.
Be-dulamar-bendakegala, be noalid, na be dule-nug-imaksad-bendakegala, be noalid. Dule-isganamar-e-rey-nono, be maad imaksad, bela e-negsemaid e-ibe be obelosad.
E-sordamar-e-nono, be-eswargi be buudu imaksad, we-sordamar an-oaisakiega burwa-dummadyobi, angi yolenonikid. Dule-wileged dule-e-bendaked-satedba, igi dule egi yolenonidae, deyobi, we-sordamar bela-bela-yeer-itogedba angi yolenonikid.
Be-moli-birgi-sii, be demargi bipirmakdiid, demar-binnasuli-arwemamaid-birgi, be bipirmakdiid.
An deyob itosgua, bela an-gwage-ulubse an-ebusad, an be-gaya-itosgua, an-gakuli wawanmakded. Bela an-garmala gulleded, an-nagmar bela nollomakded. Degi-inigwele, andi binnalee, anmar-wionanaid-e-sabsur-odurdaklegoed-iba-nonikoedi, an edarbed.
Ar amba sapi-higuera sanmaksulile, uva-dubmar sanmaksurbalile, andi Bab-Jehováʼgi yeer itogoed, Bab-Dummad-an-abonogedgi, an weligwar itogoed. Amba olivo-sapi e-san nikusulile, amba nainumargi ibmar-gwag welesurbalile, andi Bab-Jehováʼgi yeer itogoed, Bab-Dummad-an-abonogedgi, an weligwar itogoed. Amba sibad-wawaadmar e-galugi bar bukwasulile, amba moli-bebe-nikad wargwensaale, e-galugi bar bukwasurbalile,
andi Bab-Jehováʼgi yeer itogoed, Bab-Dummad-an-abonogedgi, an weligwar itogoed.
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, an-ogannogedid. Goe-sapur-gwae-gwae-abarmakeyobi, an-imaked, nega-matusulidganba nanaega an-imaked. Gar-gormalad-dub-nikadba-namaklegega narmaklesad. Namakmalad-e-iduedga narmaklesad.
We, Bab-Jehová-e-gayaburbad. Amón-machi-Josías, Judá-yargi-reyga-maiunni, Bab-Jehová we-gayaburba Cusi-machi-Sofoníasʼga sognonigusad. Sofoníasʼde Gedalías-wagwad, Amarías-wagwa-yokorginedid, degi, Ezequías-wagwa-daksikidid.
Bab-Jehová soged: “We-napneggi bela ibmar-bukwadi, an obelogoed.
Dulemar-bukwadi, ibdurgan-bukwadi, an obelogoed. Sikwimar-gukudimaladi, uamar-gudimaladi, an obelogoed. Bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imakledimalad, an obelogoed, dule-isganamar, an obelogoed. Dule-we-napneggi-gudiid, an obelogoed.” Bab-Jehová deyob soged.
Bab-Jehová sogbalid: “Judá-yarginmalad an sabsur-odurdakoed, bela Jerusalénʼgi-gudimalad an sabsur-odurdakoed. Jerusalénʼgi ibmar-Baal-bab-dummadyob-imaklediidi, an bela obelogoed. Dule-Baalʼga-arbadimalad-e-nug, an obelogoed. Dule-irwa-Baalʼse-gormalad-e-nugse-bakale, an obelogoed.
Dulemar na e-neg-niba niisgwamar-nug-odummogega, niisgwamar-asabin-sindigar-sigmalad, an obelogoed. Dulemar, sindigar-sii an-nuggi ise-sogar-ibmar-sognaid, degi, bab-Milcom ise-sogar-ibmar-sognaidamarbalid, an obelogoed.
Dulemar-angi-bangudmalad, degi, an amisurmarbalid, degi, anse idaksurmarbalid, an obelogoed.”
Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maid-asabin bogidik sigmalo, ar Bab-Jehová-e-iba bato mosad. Bab-Jehová ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged guakwaa urbisad, ese-dagega-gorlesmaladi swilidik imaklesmalad.
Bab-Jehová sogbalid: “Anga-ibmar-uklegoed-e-ibagi, dule-dummaganga-mamaid, an sabsur-odurdakoed, rey-masmala, an sabsur-odurdakoed. Bela dulemar dule-ainebalidyob-mor-yomalad, an sabsur-odurdakoed.
A-ibagine, anse-goled-neg-yawagak-dogedgi nag-obiar-dogmaladi, an sabsur-odurdakoed. Dulemar, emar-sabsur-imakedba e-bab-dummagan-neg ibmar-enasii-imakdimalad, an sabsur-odurdakoed. Emar-yardakedba e-bab-dummagan-neg ibmar-enasii-imakdimalad, an sabsur-odurdakoed.”
Bab-Jehová weyob sogbalid: “A-ibagine, Yawagak-Uaye-nugad-akale, dule-e-bendakega binnasuli-gornanai-gumaloedi, itolegoed. Neggwebur-binid-akale, dule-akiginmalad, itolegoed. Yarmar-mullugan-akale, wile-itogedba-binnasur-oimakmaladi, itolegoed.
”Mactesʼginmalad, binnasur be gormakmarmoga. Ar a-ibagine, dule-manigi-ibmar-ukmalad bergunonikoed. Mani-muchub-ibmar-ogwamalad bela burgwemaloed.
A-ibagine, Jerusalén-neggweburgi gwallu-mee an imaknonikoed. Dulemar-vino-sabolebukwadyob dobsuli-bukwamalad, an sabsur-odurdakoed. We-dulemar binsamalad: ‘Bab-Jehová ibmar-nued imakosulid, ibmar-isgana imakosurbalid.’
A-ulale, ibmar-nuegan bela e-ibe sulegoed, e-negmar, bela swana naguoed. Neg-sobnanai-gumaloenad, degi-inigwele, egi gwen megosurmalad. Uva-dub digmaloenad, degi-inigwele, e-vinoʼdi gwen gobosurmalad.”
“Bab-Jehová-e-urwed-dummad-iba bato walikgudanikid, a-iba gwae-gwae modanikid. Bab-Jehová-e-urwed-dummad-ibagine, sabsur-gormaknanai gumaloed. Dule-buledse-bakale, binnasuli-gornai guoed.
A-iba, urwed-dummad-iba, naguoed. Wile-itoged-iba, surbinsa-itoged-iba, naguoed. Bela ibmar-bergued-iba, ibmar-bibisged-iba, naguoed. Negsichid-nagued-iba, neg-gudureged-iba, naguoed. Boo-bela-bela-babated-iba, mogirmar-sichigan-nagued-iba, naguoed.
Gar-trompeta-goled-iba, bila-onogega oimaknanaigumaloed-iba, naguoed. A-ibagi, neggweburmar-sakdigar-bukwadgi-bila-ononaegala, igar uklegoed. Negmar-matusur-gwigwichidgi-urwenamalaga, igar uklegoed.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Dulemar angi isgusmalad. A-ulale, bela-bela-surbinsa-itogega an imakoed. Ibyasuliyob gudii gumaloed.” E-ablis ukubyob milemai guoed. E-sanmar ibmar-isganayob milemamai guoed.
Bab-Jehová-urwed-ibagi, e-mani gwen e-bendakosulid, e-or gwen e-bendakosurbalid. Bab-Jehová-e-sae-itogedbali, bela napneg-naid berguoed. Bela-dulemar-napneggi-gudidimalad, ilagwen-obelolegar ese imaklemaloed.
Geb ani an Sofonías sogded: “Dulemar-bingedsurmalad, be bulakwaa ambikudamala, Bab-Jehová-asabin na be san-bipii imakmala.
Bab-Jehová-igi-neg-imakoye-sogsagusad-guoed-idu, be deyob na be san-bipii imakmala. A-iba, ar igi-gagan-dinnagana burwaba-seleder berguddae, deyobi bergudoed. Bab-Jehová-bela-bela-e-urwed bemargi-yoleged-idu, be bulakwaa ambikudamala. Bab-Jehová-e-urwed-iba bemargi-yoleged-idu, Bab-Jehová-asabin na be san-bipii imakmala.
Napneggi bela na san-bipi-imakdimalad, Bab-Jehová amimala. Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maidba-gudidimalad, Bab-Jehová amimala. Igar-inniki-imaked be amimala, san-bipi-imaked be amimala, abakalegi, Bab-Jehová-e-urwed-ibagi, na be dukued amiarmalale.”
Gaza-neggwebur dule-sate guoed, Ascalón-neggwebur napabi-nai guoed. Asdod-neggweburgi-dulemar-bukwadi, ibginedbali onilegoed. Ecrón-neggwebur bela swiri naguoed.
Demar-gakaba-bukwamalad-Cereteo-dorgan, ¡be duledar-wilesmar! Filistea-dulemar-e-yar-Canaán, Bab-Jehová weyob be-annik soged: “An be-oberguoed, begi dulemar bar gudii an imakosulid.”
