[Jesús gebe-itoged-iba-naguded-wakudaryalaba-durgusgua, gebesaila María-Magdalenaʼse na sanar magarosad. A-omegi, Jesús nia-walagugle (7) onosgusad.
A-ome nadgua, geb dulemar-Jesúsʼba-gudigusmalad owisosad. Amardi bukib-binsabukwad, degi, bobukmarbalid.
Ar amar, Jesús dula-gudiiye itoarmargu, degi, María-Magdalena daksaye itoarmarbargu, bengusmalad.
A-sorba, Jesús na e-sapingan-warbo-sapurba-nadapidse dule-baidyob magarosad.
Amar-warbogwad, gannar Jerusalén-neggweburse nonimalad, geb sapingan-baigan owisosmalad. Ar sapingan-warbogwad-ibmar-sognonikid, sapingan-baigandi bengusmarbalid.
Geb napidgine, Jesús na e-sapingan-ambe-gakagwensakad-mas-gunbukwadse (11) na sanar magarosad. Jesús, e-sapingan amba egi benmarsoggu, degi, dulemar-gannar-e-durgusad-daksamalad-ega-sogsad benmarbarsoggu, na e-sapinganga binnasur ibmar sogsagussunnad.
Jesús e-sapinganga sogded: “Bela dulemar-we-napneggi-bukmaladse be namar, bela amarga Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi be sunmaknamar.
”Ar dule-angi-bensulid, degi, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imaked, abonolegoed. ”Ar dule-angi-benguerdi, na e-san-burba degi-odurdakle-sii sadeguoed.
”Dulemar-angi-bensurmalad, we-ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisurmalad imakoed: An-nuggi niamar-onioed, degi, gaya-gwapidba sunmak gumaloed.
E-argangi naibe-bulegan gamaloed. Ina-nusu-gobsamalale, gwen-akar gumalosulid. Dulemar-gegumalad-birgi e-argan-mesmaloed, geb a-dulemar nugumaloed.”
Bab-Jesús e-sapinganga ibmar-sogsad-sorba, Bab-Dummad, Jesús nibnegse sesad. Geb Bab-Dummad-argan-nuedsik sigidapid.
Jesús-sapingan nadmargu, bela neggwebur-iliba Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi sunmakdemalad. Bab-Jesús nue amar-bendaksad, degi, ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisurmalad-imakdemaladba Bab-Jesús oyosad, e-sapingan e-Gayaburba-napiragwadgi sunmakdimarye.] Be itomargua.
Aisaar bukidar dulemar igar-napiragwad anmar-abargi-gusadi ilemakar-nasikoeyobi na binsasmalad.
Igi gebesaila Jesús-sapingan na e-sunnad Jesús-daksamala, deyobi a-igargi anmar-odurdaksamarmogad. Ar Bab-Jesús we-dulemar e-igargi-sunmakega barmisgusad.
Dummad-Teófilo, nue an we-igargi ise-nergusmogad. Degisoggu, an dakdo, bur an bega Jesús-igar gebesaila-onoded-akar, nue ilemakar narmakergebe.
Adi, be nue-wisgumogagar Jesús-igargi-be-odurdaklesadi we napiragwadi, gakansuli.
Deunni, Rey-Herodes, Judea-yargi negdakmaigu, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-wargwen, Abíasʼsikid mai-gusad. A-dulede, Zacaríasʼye nugad, e-omedi Aarón-wagansikidid, Elisabetʼye-nugad.
Emide, ebobela, Bab-Dummad-asabin igar-innikigwadba damaladid. Bab-igar-uksadba, degine, Bab-Dummad-sogsadbali nanamalad-dulemalad. Agala, Bab-Dummad egi ibmar akarsoged sated.
Ar amarde, mimmi-satemalad, ar ade, Elisabet geg mimmi-baked, degine, bato amarde, seredgusmarbalid.
Ibagwengine, Abías-e-gwenadgansikmaladga Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbaega ibagan nonikid. Deunni, Zacarías Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-golega arbanonimogad.
Na gusgu igi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad nugsalege, deyob Zacarías nugsalealid, adi, Bab-Dummadse-Goled-Neg-Islidikidgi dogegar, ina-wawadikid obupurmakegar.
Degine, ina-wawadikid-ogumaked-wachigi, deun bela-dulemar magaba Bab-Dummadse gorbukwa gusmalad.
Zacarías, Bab-Dummad-Neg-Islidikidgi ina-wawadikid ogumaknaidgi, Bab-Dummad-baliwitur-wargwen, Zacaríasʼse ukiar magar-gunonikid. Ina-wawadikid-ogumakleged-aila-naba, argan-nuedsik gwichi dakalid.
Zacarías, deyob Bab-Dummad-baliwitur-dakargu, gwakided, bela nue-dobee ito naded.
Ar baliwiturdi ega sogded: “Zacarías, melle be dobgu, ar Bab-Dummadse-be-goledi Bab-Dummad be-itosad, be-ome-Elisabet bega mimmi-wargwen-bakoedi, Juanʼye be onugsao.
Be mimmi-nikuoedba, be yeer itogoed, be weligwar itogoed, degine, be-mimmi gwalulenonikir, bukidar dulemar egi weligwar itomarmogoed.
”Ar be-mimmide, Bab-Dummad-asabin dule-dummadga guoed. Vino gobosulid, degi, inna-gagbid gobosurbalid. Degine, amba muu-neggi mai, bato Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled bela-bela nika guoed.
Deginbali, we-mimmi gannar Israel-dulemar Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼba-nanamalaga imakoed.
Ar be-mimmi-Juan, Elíasʼyobi Dule-Dummad-idu-nadapi guoed. Deyob Bab-Dummad-Burba, degi, Bab-Dummad-gangued-nika guoed. Adi, babgan gannar na e-mimmiganbina itogerba guega, degi, dule-galagwensuli-gudimaladi dule-nueganga imakega, binsaed-nikaa damalaga, degi, guagwar dulemar-urbega, adi, Bab-Dummad-abingamalagar.”
Degi, Zacarías baliwiturga sogded: —Degite we-deyob-guoedi, ¿igi-an wisguosunna? Ar ande seredgusad, an-omede bato seredgusmogad.
Baliwitur abin-imakdegu, ega sogded: —Ani an Gabriel-gued, Bab-Dummad-asabin, Bab-Dummad-sogedba an ibmar imakega an gwichid. Ani an bega sunmakega, we-gayaburba-nued-sogega an barmilealid.
We-ibmar-an-bega-sogsad e-ibagan mosale, we deyob gunonikoed. Emide, be an-bengussoggu, geg bar sunmake be guoed. Be-mimmi-gwalulesad-sorba, geb be gannar sunna sunmake gunonibaloed.
Ar dulemardi, magaba Zacarías edarbebukmalad. Degi, ibiga Zacarías dikasurgus Bab-dummadse-goled-neg-islidikidyaba yoggumaiye binsaarmalad.
Zacarías agi noargu, geg emarga sunmake gusad. Agi magar daksamalad, we, Bab-Dummadse-Goled-Neg-Islidikidgi wis ibya-apurus danikirgebye. Zacarías dulemarga sunmaksasulid, unnila argangi-oyogar emarga sunmaksad.
Geb Zacarías, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-ibmar-imaked bergusgu, na e-negse nadsunnad.
Geb a-ibagan-sorbali, e-ome-Elisabet gurgin-nika gunonikid. Agine, Elisabet nii-walatar bar nossulid. Agi sokalid:
“Bab-Dummad angi nabir binsanonikid. An mimmi-niksulidba dulemar-mer-bar-isdar-an-dakmalaga, aga anga mimmi-uknonikid.”
Elisabet nii-walanergwagus (6) bonigwar gudiidgi, Bab-Dummadi, Galilea-yarse, Nazaret-neggweburse, yagwa-gwensak Maríaʼye-nugadse baliwitur-Gabriel-barmialid.
A-yagwade, na Joséʼye-nugad-ebo-nikuega bato igar-nabogar gudiid. Joséʼde Rey-David-wagwad.
Baliwitur María-maidse dognonigu, ega sognonikid: —¡Naa, degite! ¡Bab-Dummad begi nued binsasad! Bab-Dummad beba gudiguad. Baigan-omeganba Bab-Dummad bur nued begi binsasad.
Maríaʼdi baliwitur-dakargu, ibmar-ega-sogedba dobe-itoded, binsaded, wede, baliwitur weyob anse gornonikid ibi obarsunye.
Degi, baliwitur ega sogdesunnad: —María, mer be dobgu, ar Bab-Dummad nabir begi binsasad.
Emigindi, be gurgin-nika gunonikoed, mimmi-gwensak be nikuoed, Jesúsʼye a-mimmi be onugsaoed.
We-mimmide dule-dummadga guoed, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-e-Machiye soglegoed, degine, Bab-Dummad, igi epenne Rey-David, reyga-mesisgusa, deyobi Bab-Dummadi Rey-David-e-wagwa-imakmogoed.
Degine, we-Jesús, Jacob-dulemar-negsemai degisadegu guoed. E-negsemai-guoedi gwen berguosulid.
Geb degi, María, baliwiturga sogded: —¿Ar wede igi guosunna? Ar amba an yagwad.
Baliwitur, Maríaʼga sogded: —Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled begi aidenonikoed. Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-e-gangued be-edunonikoed. Degisoggu, Dule-gwage-islidikid-gwalulegoedi, Bab-Dummad-Machiye soglenonikoed.
Degine, be-gwenad-Elisabet, bato seredgusadgi, geg mimmi-bakye-enik sogmaladi a-bela gurgin-nika gunonikid. Emide, nii-walanergwagus (6) gurgin-nika gudiid.
Ar ade, Bab-Dummadgardi ibmar-geg-gudeeye soglesulid, bela ega ibmar guedbiid.
Geb degi, María sogdesunnad: —Andi, Bab-Dummad-e-mai gued. Be-sogedba be anga imakdo. Degi, baliwitur, Maríaʼgi banguded.
A-ibagangi, María, Judea-yalaganba neggwebur-gwagwense gwae nade gusad.
Zacarías-negse dogdapgu, Elisabetʼse gordapid.
Elisabet, María-ese-gole-itosgu, dule-e-sapi-dukugi-maid ber dulagwar itoded. Degi, Elisabet bela-bela Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled-nika gunonikid.
Elisabet binnasur goted, sogded: —Baigan-omeganba bur nued Bab-Dummad begi binsasad, be-dula-sapi-dukugi-maidgi bur-nued binsasbalid.
Ar wede, ¿ibiga weyob angi nued binsalesa, emide, an-Dummad-e-nan anse ataknonigu?
”Be anse gornonikid-itodeyalaba, an-sapi-dukugi-maid weligwar-itogedba ber dulagwar itoded.
Be we-ibmar bengussulidba begi nued-binsalesad. Ar Bab-Dummad-bega-ibmar-sogsadba we-ibmar bela bega guoed.”
Geb degi, María, sogdemogad: “An-ulub-akar Bab-Dummad-nug an odummosun.
An-burba, Bab-Dummad-an-abonogedgi weligwar itosun.
An e-mai-bundor-binsaled-inigwele, Bab-Dummad an-sunonikid, nued angi binsanonikid, emigindi, bela dulemar angi sogmaloed, nued-egi-binsalesad-duleye.
Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, anga ibmar-dummagan imaksad, e-nug, Isligwaledye nugad.
Bab-Dummad dulemar-e-dobee-nanadimalad wile daked, degine, a-e-waganse-bakar, wiledakdii sadeguoed.
Bab-Dummadi, e-gangued na e-arbaedgi oyosad, dulemar-na-san-dummarba-imakdimalad-osulosad.
Bab-Dummadi, dule-dummagan-negsemamaid-obelosad. Dulemar-na-san-bipi-imakdimalad-odummosad.
Degine, dulemar-ukumesdimaladga ibmar-bukidar uksad. Degine, dulemar-mani-ibgan, ibmar-sate barmisad.
Bab-Dummadi, e-mai-Israel-dulamar-bendaksad, amar-wile-daked gwen iessulid.
Bab-Dummadi deyob anmar-dad-Abrahamʼga sogsad, degi, e-waganga sogsagusad, e-wiledaked degisadeguoye.”
María, Elisabet-walik nii-walapaa megialid, geb a-sorba María, na e-negse gannar aligusad.
Elisabet e-ibagan warmaknonigu, mimmi-nikunonikid, susugwa ega uklenonikid.
E-neg-dikarba-mamaid, degine, e-gwenadgan itoarmargu, Bab-Dummad Elisabetʼgi nabir binsasye, degi, nue wile daksaye, Elisabetʼba wergusmarmogad.
Geb ibabaabakgine (8), susugwa-gwalulesad-sorba, e-abgan-uka-duku-sikega, Moisés-Igar-Maidba-imakega, senonimalad. Degine, e-bab-Zacaríasʼba mimmi-nug-imakbiguarmalad.
Ar e-nandi, weyob sokalid: —Suli. Deyob-nugguosuli. Juanʼye nugguoe.
Elisabetʼga sogdemalad: —¿Ibiga deyob be onugsabie? Ar be-gwenadgande deyob nugsurmalad.
Geb e-babse argangi-sunmakar egichiarmalad, goe igi-onugsaoye.
Zacarías urgo-bipigwa egichisad, agi susugwa-nug narmaksad. Juanʼye nugguoye sogsad. Bukmaladi bela geger itoarmalad, wede ibiga deyob onugsabie.
Geb a-gines, Zacarías gannar nabir sunmakded. E-gwabin-bipinmakdegu, Bab-Dummad-nug ogannoded.
Bela-e-neg-dikarba-mamaid dobe itonadmalad. Bela Judea-yalaganba we-ibmar-deyob-gusadi gaya mimileded.
Ar dulemar deyob bela-we-gayagan-itoarmalale, na e-gwagegi binsadmalad, sogdemalad: “Ar we-mimmide, ¿doa-dulega guosunna?” Ar dulemar bela wismalad, we-mimmibali Bab-Dummad-gangued gudii.
Juan-e-bab-Zacarías, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled bela-bela nika gunonikid. Bab-Dummad-nuggi sunmakdesunnad, sogded:
“Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-nug odummomarsun, ar ade, e-dulamarse na ataknonikid, degine, isguedgine, e-dulamar-onononikid.
Bab-Dummadi, e-mai-David-wagwa anmarga barmialid. Bab-Dummadi, anmar-Abonoged-gandikid anmarga ogwisnonikid.
Ar igi gebesaila anmarga e-gayaburba-barsogmalad-islidikmaladba-sunmaksa, deyob gusad.
Isdar-anmar-dakdimaladgi, degi, sae-anmar-dakdimaladgi anmar-bendakoye sogsad.
Adi, Bab-Dummad anmar-babgan wile dakegar. Degine, amar-ebo-igar-islidik-mesisad ebinsaegar.
Bab-Dummad na e-nuggi anmar-dad-Abraham-ebo napiragwadgi igar-mesisadi, ede, imakedseye sogsad.
Bab-Dummadi isdar-anmar-dakdimaladgi anmar-onogoye sogsad, adi, dobsuli anmar ega arbaegar.
Bab-Dummadga nue-gwage-islidikidgi, degi, nue-napiragwadgi burgwedse anmar ega arbadii guegar.
”Mimmi, bedina, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Dummad-e-gayaburba-barsogedye be bilegoed. Ar bede, Dule-Dummad-barmiledagoye-sogsad-idu, igar-mayega nadapi guoed.
Be abonoged-igargi e-neggwebur-odurdakega be guoed. Adi, Bab-Dummad dulemarga isgumalad-eliegar.
Ar anmar-Bab-Dummadi ise-wile-anmar-dakedba, neg-meegwadyob anmarga dule-barmialid. A-dule, nibneg-akale, dad-nakwedanikiyobi danikid.
Adi, negsichidgi-bukmalayobid, Bab-Dummad-akudakmalad, gwallu-mee-imaklegeyobi, Bab-Dummad-magar dakegar. Degi, dule burgwileged-dobmalad ega osulogegar. Degine, igar-bogidikidba anmar-niegar.”
Degine, mimmi dungumai, e-burba gangumai gusad. Juan, Israel-dulemarga Bab-Igargi-sunmakdedse nega-dulesulidganba gudii gusad.
Amba yoo Jesús-gwaluleged-idu, deun Augusto-César saila-dummadga Romaʼgi maigu, igar mesialid, bela-dulemar-bukwad ebisoye, igi mergudibeye.
Deun, Cirenio, Siria-yargi dummadga negdakmaiun, dule-ebisleged gebe imaklesad.
Bela ebislemalagala na e-neggwebur-e-neggweburse nadegusmalad.
José, Galilea-yargi, Nazaret-neggweburgi-gudii Judea-yarse, Rey-David-neggweburse, Belénʼye-neg-nugadse aligusmogad. Ade, José, David-e-wagwad, aga Belénʼse nonigusad.
Adi, a-neggweburgi e-ome-Maríaʼmala ebislegegar. Deun bato ebo nikuoye igar-maid. Degine, deun María bato gurgin-nika gudiid.
Belén-neggweburgi-gudimaladgine, Maríaʼga nagued-ibagan warmaknonikid.
Degine, gebe ega susugwa uklenonikid. Geb samorgi-obirmas, moli-omaed-urgi mimmi-mesisad, ar ade, emarga gabedneg sate gusad.
Deun, a-ibagi Belén-neggwebur-dikarba, sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad, e-sibad-wawaad mutik edarbebukwa gusmalad.
Agine, Bab-Dummad-e-baliwitur-wargwen ukiar amarse nonikid, degine, Bab-Dummad-e-yeerdaklegedi bela emar-ebilis ibegwar ganonikid. Degidbali, sibad-wawaad-edarbemaladi nue dobe itoarmalad.
Ar baliwiturdi amarga sogded: —Mer be dobgumar, ar bemarga gayaburba-nued, bela dulemar-weligwar-saed an sedanikid.
Rey-David-gwalulesad-neggweburgi, Belénʼgi, emi-ibagi bemarga Cristo gwalulesad. A-dule, Dule-Abonogedid, Dule-Bur-Dummadid, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duled.
Magar be itomalagala, weyob-mai be dakdapmaloed: Mimmi samorgi-anwar moli-omaed-urgi mai be dakmaloed.
Degine, ukiar, baliwitur-abargi bukidar baliwiturmar-nibnegginmalad-baigan, Bab-Dummad-nug ogannonanai daklealid. Weyob sognanaid:
“Nibneggi bela-bela Bab-Dummad-nug odummomarsun. Dule-nuegangi-yeer-binsalesmaladga, we-napneggi neg-bogidikid nagusun.”
Degine, gannar baliwiturmar nibnegse nadmargu, sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad na ga sokarmalad: “Anmar Belén-neggweburse nae. Neg-gusad anmar daknae. Ar Bab-Dummad anmar-owisosad.”
Degisoggu, gwae-gwae armarsunnad. José, Maríaʼbo sii, degi, mimmidi, moli-omaed-urgi mai daknonimalad.
Deyob daksamargu, sibad-wawaad-edarbemaladi, baliwiturmar-ega-mimmigi-sunmaksadba, dule-baiganga sogsamalad.
Ar bela-dulemar sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad-ibmar-sogedi, geger itosmalad.
Ar Maríaʼdi, bela na e-gwagegi wargwen sedii gusad, agi binsadii gusad.
Ar sibad-wawaad-edarbemaladi, ega-ibmar-soglesadba-ibmar-gusadi bela-daksamalad, degi, bela itosmalad. Degidbali, gannar armargu, Bab-Dummad-nug-odummodani, degi, ogannodani gusmalad.
Jesús ibabaabakgus (8) gwalulesadgi, Judíoʼmar-igar-maidba imakegala, e-abgan-uka-duku siksamalad. Jesúsʼye onugsasmalad. Ar igi baliwitur amba yoo María gurgin-nikued-idu ega sogsagusa, aba deyob onugsasmalad.
Moisés-Igar-Mesisadba na san-uruked-ibagan-imaked-bergusmargua, José, María-ebo, Bab-Dummadga Jesús-ukega Jerusalénʼse Jesús-senonimalad.
Ar igi Bab-Dummad-igargi narmakar mai: “Ar gebesaila machigwa-inse nangi aidenonikile, Bab-Dummadga be ukoed, adi, unnila egadga guegar.” Éxodo 13:2, 12
Degine, Bab-Dummad-gardagi narmakar-naibalid, Bab-Dummadga we-ibmar-ukoye: “Sapur-nuu-gwabodibe, wagnuu-mimmigan-gwabodibe.” Levítico 12:8 We-igar-maidba imakegala, na nonimalad.
A-ibagangine, dule-wargwen, Simeónʼye-nugadi, Jerusalénʼgi gudigusad. A-dulede, dule-gwage-nuedid, Bab-Dummad-dobee-nanadiidid, na Israel-bendakleged-edarbedimogad-duled. Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled a-duleba gudiguad.
Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledi Simeónʼga sogsad: “Be burgosurye, Bab-Dummadi, dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsadi be dakedsegoye.”
Geb Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled-sogedba, Simeón Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse nonikid. José, María-ebo Moisés-Igar-Maidba-imakegala Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse mimmi-Jesús-senonimalad.
Agine, Simeón na e-swidagi mimmi-mesisgua, Bab-Dummad-nug-odummoded, weyob sogded:
“Bab-Dummad-Bela-Negsemaid, an be-mai gued. Emigindi, be-ibmar-sogsadyob, bogidikidgi be an-sedsun,
ar ade, an-ibyagwar Bab-Dummad-dule-abonogoed-barmialid an daksad.
Bab-Dummad, we-mimmi, dulemar-bukwad-abargi be guagwar barmialid.
Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladga neg-meegwadga guoed. Degi, we-mimmi, Israel-dulemarga gandikidba-be-nug-odummogedga guoed.” Isaías 42:6; 49:6
José, degi, María, Simeón-Jesúsʼgi-ibmar-sognaid geger itomalad.
Geb degi, Simeón, Joséʼga, degi, Maríaʼga sogsagu, Bab-Dummad begi nued binsaoye. A-sorbali, mimmi-e-nan-Maríaʼga sogded: —We-mimmi sulesad, Israel-yargi dulemar-dummagan-bukidar onogegar, degi, dulemar-binsarmalad dummaganga imakegar. We-mimmi Bab-Dummad-wilubga guega nonikid, oyogegar, Bab-Dummad sunna nabir dulemar-abonoye. Ar degi-inigwele, dulemar-bukidar mimmi-abingaosurmalad.
We-mimmiba bukidar-dulemar-gwage-binsananaid magar daklegoed. María, ar begardi be-san-burbagi es-suid-yolenaiyob be nunmak itogoed.
Agine, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-bundor Anaʼye-nugadi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi gudimogad. A-omede, Fanuel-sisgwad, Aser-e-wagansik danikidid. Anaʼde bato nue-seredgusad. Unnila birgagugle (7) sui-nika gudigusad.
Emide, birga-dulabake-gakabake (84) nikad. A-mukwade Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi gudigudaed, gwen nodisulid. Ibginedba, degi, mutikidba Bab-Dummadse gordii, degi, Bab-Dummadse-golega mas-gunsuli gudidaed.
Simeón deyob sunmakgwichidgi, Ana nonimogad. A-mukwa, Bab-Dummadga Jesúsʼgi dog-nuedye sogsagusad. Degi, Ana bela Jerusalénʼgi dulemar-Bab-Dummad-abonogoed-edarbedimaladga mimmigi sunmakdedaed.
José, María-ebo bela Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba ibmar-imaksad-sorba, gannar Galilea-yarse na e-neggwebur-Nazaretʼse-nonimalad.
Degine, mimmidi dungumai, gangumai, degine, nue-binsaed-ibed-gumai gusad. Ar Bab-Dummad a-machi-bipigi nue nabir binsadii gusad.
Birga-irba Jesús-e-babgan, Oburgwilegoenad-Iba-daknaega Jerusalénʼse naddamalad.
Jesús birgambe-gakabo-nikadgi (12), e-babganba Jerusalénʼse nadmogad.
Ibamar-bergusgu, Jesús-babgan gannar Nazaretʼse armargu, machigwa-Jesúsʼdi Jerusalénʼgi besad. José, degi, e-nan-Maríaʼdi Jesús-besad wissurmalad.
E-babgandi, dulemar-danar-danimaladba Jesús daniye bimalanad. Ibagwengus-nanaedgine e-gwenadgan-abargi, degine, mag-dakmalad-abargi Jesús-amiarmalad, gwen amissurmalad.
Ar amissurmarsoggu, gannar Jerusalénʼse Jesús-aminonimalad.
Geb ibapaagine amidapmalad. Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi, Moisés-Igar-Mesisad-nue-wisimalad-abargi-sii, amar-itosii, degi, amarse ibmar-egichii dakdapmalad.
Ar itobukmaladi bela geger dakmalad. Nue-ibmar-wisi Jesús-dakmalad. Degine, nue-imas Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar-abin-imake dakmarbalid.
E-babgan, dummagan-abargi-sii Jesús-dakarmargu, geger dakarmalad. E-nan Jesúsʼga sogded: —Machi, ¿ibiga we deyob be anmar-imaksa? Emide, an be-babmala surbinsa bebina miamakdimalad.
Geb degi, Jesús ega sogded: —¿Ar ibiga be an-amidimala? ¿Ar be wissurmarsi an-Bab-arbaedgi an arbaergebed?
Ar e-babgandi, Jesús-ega-ibmar-sogedi magar-itossurmalad.
Jesús e-babganba gannar arsunnad, Nazaretʼse nonisunnad. Jesús na e-babgan-sogedba gudigussunnad. Ar e-nandi bela we-ibmarmar na e-gwageginbi sedii, egi binsadii gusad.
Ar Jesúsʼdi ibmar-nue-wisidgi, e-dunguedgi, degine, Bab-Dummad-nue-nabir-egi-binsaedgi, degi, dulemar-nued-egi-binsaedgi, dungumai gusad.
Birgambe-gakatargus (15) Tiberio-César Romaʼgi-negdakmaidgi, Poncio-Pilato deun Judea-yargi dummadga maid. Degi, Herodes Galilea-yargi dummadga maimogad, e-urba-Felipe Iturea-yargi, degi, Traconite-yargi dummadga maimogad. Degine, Lisanias, Abilinia-yargi dummadga maimogad.
Deunni, Anás, Caifás-ebo dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummadga maimogad. A-ibagangine, Bab-Dummad Zacarías-machi-Juanʼse gornonikid. Deun, Juan nega-dulesulidganba gudiid.
Juan bela Jordán-diwar-dikarba-neggwebur-bukmaladse nadegusad. Dulemarga Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igargi sunmakdii gusad, degi, na e-isgumaladga bukib-binsamarye sogdii gusad. Adi, e-daed gwagmalagar, adi, isguedgi abonolemalagar.
Epenne Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Isaías, Juanʼnik weyob narmaksagusad, deun sogsagusgu: “Dule-wargwen nega-dulesulidganba binnasur sunmaknonikoed, dulemarga sognonikoed: ‘Dule-Dummad-idu igar-mayemar, igar-swilidik mesmar.
Bela nebagan swilidik guoed, yarmala, degi, neg-mullugana, omatolegoed. Igar-bire-bire-mamaid innikii imaklegoed, igar-muru-muru-mamaid oswirmaklebaloed.
Bela dulemar Bab-Dummad-abonoged-wisgumaloed.’ ” Isaías 40:3-5
Dulemar-bukidar Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imakega Juanʼse duurmaknonidamalad. Juan amarga sogdedaed: “¡Ar bemar naibe-bulegan-mimmiganyob gumalad! ¿Ar doa Bab-Dummad nue-urwe-danikoed-idu-wakinned bemar-odurdaksa? Bab-Dummad-diigi-oglegedgi bemar nuguosurmalad.
Degisoggu, be-daedgine na be oyomar, bemar nue-gwagsamalad, be-isguedga na be bukib binsasmalad. ”Mer unnila na be sogmalo: ‘Anmar Abraham-wagan gumarye. A-ulale, Bab-Dummad anmargi nabir binsaergebye.’ Suli, degisuli. Ar be Abraham-wagwasulile, akarsulid, ar Bab-Dummad sunna we-akwamar Abraham-waganga imaked.
”Deginbali, ar bato akan guar sapi-maligi yoid. Ar degisoggu, sapi nue sanmaksulile, a-sapi siklegoed, ogumaklegega soogi melledoed. Deyob Bab-Dummad dulemar-imakmogoed.”
Ar degi, dulemar Juanʼse egichiar dasunnad, ega sogdedamalad: —Degite, ¿ibu anmar imakmarsunnoe?
Juan, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Dule suba-gobo nikale, dule-subasulidga gogwen ukmogo. Amba deyob masgunnedsik imakbaloed.
Roma-dummadga-mani-gaedgi-arbamaladi, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imakega Juanʼse nonimarmogad. Amar ega sogdemarmogad: —Odurdaked-saila, ¿anmardi ibi imakmarmogoe?
Juan amarga sogded: —Melle dulemargi wilub-obichaa be mani gamalo, ar unnila bemarga igar-uklesadba be mani gamaloed.
Degine, suar-ibmala ese egichiarmarmogad: —Anmardi ¿ibi imakmarmogoe? Juan, abin-sogded: —Mer emar-annik gannadba mani suo, degine, mer binsa aimar-ogakansao. Ar bemar na be-bennuklegedgi, gusbin be itomalo.
Dulemar Juan-sunmaked-itobukmaladi Cristo-edarbebukmarsoggu, na e-gwagegi binsabukmalad, we-Juan, Cristo-sogeye. Cristo sogleged, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duleye.
Juan abin-imakdegu, bela dulemarga sogded: “Ar andi, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imakedid. Unnila diigi an emar-ogdiid, ar dule-baid-danikoeddi, ar bur anba dule-dummadid. Ar e-sapat-dubse-bakar, geg an ei esiked. Ar a-duledi, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledgi, degi, soogi be-ognonimaloed.
”Igi dulemar oros-gwag egwamala, deyob, a-dule, oros-gwag-egwaega bato guagwar e-argangi bigbi-gani gwichid. Degi, oros-gwag-nued e-urbed-neggi nue urboed, e-ukadi soogi ogumakoed. Ar we-soode, geg soo-ginnedid, degi-gasii-sadeguad-sood.” We sogledo, dule-dummad oros-gwagyob dulemar-imaknonikoye.
Weyobi, Juan bukidar dulemar-unadii gusad, Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi dulemarga sunmakdii gusad.
Herodes dummadga-maigu, e-urba-Felipe-ome-Herodíasʼye-nugad-nikusad-ular, degi, bela-ibmar-isganamar-imaksad-ular, Juan sabsur Herodesʼga ibmar sogsad.
Ibmar-baid-isgana imaksadbali, Herodes esgaryagi Juan-meted.
Degidgine, bela dulemar Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imaknanaigua, Jesús Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar imaksamogad. Jesús Bab-Dummadse gotegu, nibnega argade gusad.
Jesúsʼgi Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled sanale, nuuyobi aidenonikid, degi, nibneggi gayaburba gollar gusad, sogded: “Be An-Machi-sabed-sunnad gued. An beba weligwar itoged.”
Jesús na e-arbaed imakdegu, deun birga-durgwen-gakambe (30) nikad. Jesús, José-e-machiye bimalanad. Jesús-e-dad-dummagan, wemalad: José, Elí-machi.
Elíʼdi, Matat-machid. Matatʼdi, Leví-machid. Levíʼdi, Melqui-machid. Melquiʼdi, Jana-machid. Janaʼdi, José-machid.
Joséʼdi, Matatías-machid. Matatíasʼdi, Amós-machid. Amósʼdi, Nahúm-machid. Nahumʼdi, Esli-machid. Esliʼdi, Nagai-machid.
Nagaiʼdi, Maat-machid. Maatʼdi, Matatías-machid. Matatíasʼdi, Semei-machid. Semeiʼdi, José-machid. Joséʼdi, Judá-machid.
Judáʼdi, Joana-machid. Joanaʼdi, Resa-machid. Resaʼdi, Zorobabel-machid. Zorobabelʼdi, Salatiel-machid. Salatielʼdi, Neri-machid.
Neriʼdi, Melqui-machid. Melquiʼdi, Adi-machid. Adiʼdi, Cosam-machid. Cosamʼdi, Elmodam-machid. Elmodamʼdi, Er-machid.
Erʼdi, Josué-machid. Josuéʼdi, Eliezer-machid. Eliezerʼdi, Jorim-machid. Jorimʼdi, Matat-machid.
Matatʼdi, Leví-machid. Levíʼdi, Simeón-machid. Simeónʼdi, Judá-machid. Judáʼdi, José-machid. Joséʼdi, Jonán-machid. Jonánʼdi, Eliaquim-machid.
Eliaquimʼdi, Melea-machid. Meleaʼdi, Mainán-machid. Mainánʼdi, Matata-machid. Matataʼdi, Natán-machid.
Natánʼdi, David-machid. Davidʼdi, Isaí-machid. Isaíʼdi, Obed-machid. Obedʼdi, Booz-machid. Boozʼdi, Salmón-machid. Salmónʼdi, Naasón-machid.
Naasónʼdi, Aminadab-machid. Aminadabʼdi, Aram-machid. Aramʼdi, Esrom-machid. Esromʼdi, Fares-machid. Faresʼdi, Judá-machid.
Judáʼdi, Jacob-machid. Jacobʼdi, Isaac-machid. Isaacʼdi, Abraham-machid. Abrahamʼdi, Taré-machid. Taréʼdi, Nacor-machid.
Nacorʼdi, Serug-machid. Serugʼdi, Ragau-machid. Ragauʼdi, Peleg-machid. Pelegʼdi, Heber-machid. Heberʼdi, Sala-machid.
Salaʼdi, Cainán-machid. Cainánʼdi, Arfaxad-machid. Arfaxadʼdi, Sem-machid. Semʼdi, Noé-machid. Noéʼdi, Lamec-machid.
Lamecʼdi, Matusalén-machid. Matusalénʼdi, Enoc-machid. Enocʼdi, Jared-machid. Jaredʼdi, Mahalaleel-machid. Mahalaleelʼdi Cainán-machid.
Cainánʼdi, Enós-machid. Enósʼdi, Set-machid. Setʼdi, Adán-machid. Adánʼdi, Bab-Dummad-machid.
Jesús, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled nue-nikagudii, Jordán-diwargi banguded. Geb degi, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled nega-dulesulidganba Jesús-sesa gusad.
Agi iba-dulabo (40), nia-saila Jesús-wilubdakdii gualid. A-ibagangine, Jesús mas-gunsuli gudigusad, degisoggu, ukudmaada itoalid.
Agi Jesúsʼga nia-saila sokalid: —Ar be Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadiile, we-akwaga be soge: ‘Maduga be binyeye.’
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, nia-sailaga sogded: —Noar be soge, ar Bab-Dummad-gayaburbagi weyob narmakar naid: ‘Dule maduginbi dula-gudii guosulid, [bela Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-itogedgi dula gudigubaloed].’ Deuteronomio 8:3
Geb degi, nia-saila yar-matusulidse Jesús-sesad. Agi belagwable-napneg-naid-ugakse ega ukiagwar ilagwen-oyoar imaksad.
Agi nia-saila Jesúsʼga sokalid: —We-neggweburmar-an-bega-oyosadi bela e-ganguedi, degi, e-gandikidba-yeerdaklegedi an bega ukoed. Ar bela we-neggweburmar anga uklesad. Degisoggu, ar doaga an ukbie, an aga ukoed.
Degisoggu, be an-asabin Bab-Dummadyob an-nug-odummogega yokorgi sindigar sigele, we-neggweburmar bela begadga guoed.
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Nia-saila be angi bangu. Ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi weyob narmakar naid: ‘Bab-Dummad-be-Dummad-e-nug be odummodii nanao. Unnila agarbi be ibmar imako.’ Deuteronomio 6:13
Geb degi, nia-saila Jerusalénʼse Jesús-sesbalid, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-uas-birgi ogwisdapid. Geb Jesúsʼga sogded: —Ar be Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadiile, napase be ichomakdo.
Ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi weyob narmakar naid: ‘Na e-baliwiturmar be-edarbega bega barmidagoed, e-argangi be-gamalagar.
Adi, melle be akwagi gowarmakegar.’ Salmo 91:12
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Nabir be sogendo, ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi weyob narmakar sognaibalid: ‘Melle Bab-Dummad-be-Dummad, be wilubdako.’ Deuteronomio 6:16
Ar nia-saila bela Jesús-wilubdaked bergusgua, sikwas wis egi bangud gusad.
Jesús gannar Galileaʼse nonigu, nue Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled-gangued-nikadba nonikid, degi, bela neggweburmar-dikarba-bubukwad Jesús-ibmar-imakdiid wisguarmalad.
Jesús, Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggi dulemar-odurdakdii gualid. Bela Jesús-nug-odummogedbi gusmalad.
Jesús Nazaret-neggweburse nonikid, ar ade, agi dungusadid. Obunnoged-ibagi, Jesús na gusgu e-daedba Judíoʼmar-onmakednegse dogdapid. Agi Bab-Dummad-Garda-absogega gwisguded.
Ar ade, Jesúsʼga Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Isaías-narmaksad uksamalad. Jesús a-garda-egasgu, weyob-narmakar-naid absoded:
“Bab-Dummad-e-Burba angi maid. Ar ade, dule-wilemaladga gayaburba-nuegangi-sunmakega, Bab-Dummad an-susad. Bab-Dummad an-barmialid: Dule-gwage-nunmak-itodimaladga gwage-armakegar. Dule-galesbukmaladga binnasur sogegar, bemar ainimarye. Dule-ibyasuli-gudimaladga ibya-egaegar. Dule-mesagwar-gudimalad-ollor-imakegar.
Bab-Dummad-e-birga-nuedgi sunmakega, an-barmialid.” Isaías 61:1-2
A-sorba, Jesús Bab-Dummad-Garda-obipirmasgu, Judíoʼmar-onmakednegdaked-dulega garda-uksagu, sigisad. Agi-bukmalad bela Jesúsʼginbi atakbukwa gusmalad.
Geb degi, Jesús sogded: —Emi-ibagi, bemar-abargi we Bab-Dummad-Gardagi-narmakar-naid sanar-gunonikid.
Bela-dulemar-bukmaladi, Jesúsʼgi nuedbi sunmakedbimalad. Geger dakmalad, ibiyobi Jesús yeer sunmake. Degine, sogdemalad: —¿Ar wede, José-machisursi?
Jesús amarga sogded: —An wisi, wegi-sogleged be anga sogdamaloed: ‘Ina-duled, na be dukin san nudake, adi, be anmarga nue-ibmar-wisid oyogegar. Ar Capernaúm-neggweburgi bukidar ibmar-imaksaye anmar be-itosmaladi, wegi be-neggweburgine be imakmoga.’
Degi, Jesús sogdebalid: “Napira an bemarga soged, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-wargwensaar na e-neggweburgi geg e-nug odummoleged.
Napira an bemarga soged, deunni, Elías-ibagangi, bukidar Israel-yargi, mukwamar-ei-sui-burgwismalad gudigusad. A-ibagangine, deun birgapaa-abala dii gwen wissulid, degidbali, bela napneggine ukud-dummad nagunonigusad.
Degite, Elías a-mukwamarse gwen barmilessulid. Bur Sarepta-neggwebur-Sidónʼgi-siidse mukwa-wargwen-ei-sui-burgwisadse barmilesgusad, adi, a-mukwa ega mas-ukegar.
”Deginbali, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Eliseo-ibagangi, bukidar Israel-yargi, dulemar-naibe-buna-yaa-maleged nikagusmalad, degite, amar gwen nudaklessulid. Bur Siria-dule-Naamánʼye-nugadi nudaklesad.”
Ar deyob Jesús-ibmar-soge-itosmargu, onmakedneggi-bukwamalad bela sae-itodmalad.
Dulemar gwisgudmargu, Jesús-ise-onoar imaksamalad, geb neggwebur-magaba yar-birse Jesús-sesmalad, ar ade, a-yar-birgi neggwebur siid. Adi, a-neggwebur-gulluba egwanmalagar.
Degi-inigwele, Jesúsʼdi emar-abargi ganna-ganna noded, emar-abargi bangudsunnad.
Jesús, Galileaʼse Capernaúmʼye-neggwebur-nugadse nonikid. Geb obunnoged-ibagi dulemar-odurdakdii gualid.
Dulemar Jesús-ibmar-odurdakedi, geger-itomalad igi-Jesús dulemar-odurdake. Ar ade, Jesúsʼde nue-igar-wisi sunmaked.
Agi onmakedneggi dule-wargwen, niaburba-isgana-nikad-siid binnasur goted,
sogded: —Jesús-Nazaretʼgined, mer anmarse be achao, ¿ibiga be anmar-wiodaniki? ¿Be anmar-obelogega daniki? An be-wisi be doa-dule, be-dule-gwage-islidikidid, be Bab-Dummad-nuggi-danikid-duled.
Jesús niase binnasur-uluded, ega sabsur weyob ibmar-sogded: —¡Mer be sunmak! Dulegi-maid be noe. Geb degi, nia emar-abargi dule-balimetegu, dulegi-maid nodegusad. Dule gwen akar-gussulid.
Deyob ibmar-gusadi bela geger dakdemalad. Na agi sokarmarsunnad: —¿Wede igid-gayaburba-barsunna? Nue-burba-nika, gandikidba, niamarga ibmar soged. Niamar Jesús-ega-sogedba ibmar-imakdedamalad.
Degi, bela Galilea-yalaganba Jesús-dulemar-nudakdiid wisgudmalad.
Geb degi, Jesús Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggi-siidgi nodsunnad. Geb Simón-negse nadsunnad. Simón-sakbundor ise-uellegar mai dakdapid. Jesúsʼgi wilenaigusmalad, adi, Simón-sakbundor-nudakegar.
Degi, Jesús Simón-sakbundor-walik gwisgunonigu, uellegedga sabsur-ibmar sogded. Agi uelleged yog-akinnar naded. Geb Simón-sakbundor yog gwisguar imaksad, geb a-sorba emarga yog-ibmar-imakar imaksad.
Dad-argwategu, obunnoged-iba-bergusgu, bela galagwensuli-bonigan-nikamalad Jesúsʼse senonimalad. Jesús bonigan-nikamaladgi e-argan mesisad, geb bela amar-nudaksad.
Deginbali, Jesús bukidar niamar-onisbalid. Niamar ainider, binnasur-gote, sogdedamalad: “¡Bedi Bab-Dummad-Machi!” Ar Jesúsʼdi niamarse uluddaed, osunmakega gwen imakdasulid, ar ade, niamar wismalad, we, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-dule-gue.
Neg-oibosgu, Jesús neggweburgi bangudsunnad, nega-dulesulidganba nadsunnad. Dulemar Jesús-amidii guarmalad. Dulemar Jesús-amismargu, mer-egi-banguega, egi wilenaigusmalad.
Ar Jesúsʼdi amarga sogded: —Ar neggwebur-baiganse Bab-Dummad-negdakmaid-e-gayaburba-nuedgi an sunmaknabalirgebed, ar a-ular, an barmilealid.
Jesús Galileaʼgi Judíoʼmar-onmakednegmargi Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi sunmakdii gusad.
Ibagwengine, Jesús Genesaret-mata-dummad-naid-gakaba gudii, dulemar-bukidar ese nonimalad. Bab-Dummad-gayaburba itomalagala na barmesnanai guarmalad.
Agi Jesús ur-warbo gakagi-nai dakalid. E-ibmaladi dii gakagi, saki enukbukmalad.
A-ur-wargwengi Jesús nakwisad. Dakleargu, a-ur Simónʼgad daklealid. Jesús, Simónʼga sogded: —Wis be-ur matasik be onoge. Jesús a-urgi sigisad, agi-sii dulemar-bukidar-gakagi-bukwad-odurdakded.
Jesús odurdaked-bergusgu, Simónʼga sogded: —Matasik be-ur be sede. Be agi ua-gaega saki mioed.
Simón, abin-imakdegu, ega sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, anmar ua-gananai oiboalid, degite, anmar gwen gassurmalad. Degiile, be-sogedba an saki miodo.
Na saki-mismargu, bukidar-ua-gasmalad, agidbali saki achirmakbigualid.
Geb degi, na e-aimar-ur-baidgi-gunanaidse achasmalad, adi, emar-bendakdamalagar. Geb ese nonimargu, ulu-walabo ua-enosmalad. Ua-enadbali ur-dogbi-gualid.
Simón-Pedro ua-bukidar gales dakdegu, Jesús-abin yokorgi sindigar sigisad, ega sogded: —Dummad, angi be bangu, andi isgudiid-duled.
Ar ua-bukidar-galesadba, Simón bela-belad dobe itoalid, degine, bela-eba-gunanaid bela-belad dobe itodmarmogad.
Degine, Simón-e-aimar Jacobo, degi, Juan, wemarde Zebedeo-masmalad, amarde dobee itodmarmogad. Geb Jesús Simónʼga sogded: —Mer be dobgu. Emisgindi, igi bemar ua-gae, debayobi, napneggi dulemar-gaega an be-odurdakmaloed, adi, dulemar anba nagumalagar.
Geb gakase ur senonimargu, bela ibmar obesmalad. Degi, geb Jesúsʼba nadmarsunnad e-sapinganga guegar.
Jesús neggwebur-gwensakgi-gudigu, dule-wargwen naibe-buna-yaa-maleged-yaisur-nikad ese nonikid, yokorgi sindigar Jesús-asabin signonikid. We-dule Jesúsʼgi wilenaigusad, ega sokalid: —Dummad, an wisid, be an-nudakbiele, sunna be an-nudaked.
Geb degi, Jesús e-argan ese achadgu, dule-ebusad, geb degi, ega sogded: —Nugubi an be-abe. ¡Be nugusun! Degi, dule-boni-nikadi yog-nuguar-gusad.
Jesús dule-nugusadga sogded: —Melle dule-baiganga an be-onudaksad be sogo. Unnila dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledse be nae, aga be-nugusad be oyonae. Degine, be swilidik guegala, Moisés-Igar-Mesisadba-imakega Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ukleged be sedo. Adi, amar be-nugusadi nue-wisgumalagar.
Aka bur bela-belad Jesús-nug dungumai gualid. Bela Jesús-ibmar-imakdiid wisguarmalad. Dulemar-bukidar Jesús-itogega, degine, e-nudakega duurmaknonidamalad.
Ar Jesúsʼdi walagwen-Bab-Dummadse-golega dulemar-satedba dulemargi banguddaed.
Ibagwengine, Jesús dulemar-odurdaksigu, Fariseoʼmar, degi, Judío-igar-nue-wisimalad bukwagusmogad. Amar bela Galilea-yargi, degi, Judea-yargi, degi, neggweburmar-bubukwadgi danimalad. Degine, Jerusalén-neggweburgi danimarbalid. Agi Bab-Dummad-gangued dulemar-gegumalad-nudakega Jesúsʼba gudigusad.
Degi, daklealid, dulemar e-ai-wargwen-abagan-burgwar-nikad e-gabedgi-mai sedanimala. Amar Jesús-siidse negyaba e-ai-odobiguarmalanad, adi, Jesús-asabin mesmalagar, ega nudakegar.
Ar dulemar bukidarsoggu, geg odogedbali, neg-birgi nakwismalad. Geb neg-uas-egasmalad, abali, dule-abagan-burgwaled e-gabedgi-mai odesmalad. Jesús-siid-innik omesismalad.
Jesús a-dulemar egi gwen bensuli dakdegu, dule-gegumaidga sogded: —An-ai, be-isgudigusad, bega obelolesun.
Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar, degi, Fariseoʼmar, na e-gwagegi binsadmalad, sogdemalad: “¿Wede doa-dule, Bab-Dummadgi dodogu? ¿Unnila Bab-Dummadbi dulega isgued elisursi?”
Ar Jesús ulubgi-dulemar-binsaedi magar-daksad. Degisoggu, amarga sogded: —¿Ibiga ulubgi be deyob binsabukmala? ¿Geg isgued osulo be an-insasi?
An dule-bonigwaledga sogdibe: ‘¡Be-isgunaid an bega osulos!’ Ar igi an sogbarsundibe: ‘¡Nugusun, be nae!’ Degite, ¿igid bur-baisursunna imaklesunna? Suli, ebobela baisursunna imaklesuli.
Degisoggu, ani Dule-Machi, dule-bonigwaled an nudakoed, adi, bemar wisguegar, igi dule-bonigwaled an sunna nudake, debayobi, we-napneggi dule-gwage-isgunaid sunna an nudakbalid. Jesús dule-abagan-burgwar-nikadga sogdesun: —Ani an bega soged: Be gwisgu, be-egi-maid na be sede, be-negse be nae.
Degi, dule-bonigwaled yog-nuguar-gusgu, emar-abargi yog-gwichibin imaksad, degi, na e-gabedgi-maid na gadebin imaksad, degi, geb e-negse nadsunnad. Na Bab-Dummad-nug-odummonadapi gusad.
Agi belagwapa geger-dakedbimalad, bela Bab-Dummad-nug odummodmalad. Nue-dobe-itomala, sogdemarsunnad: “Emi-ibagi, ibmar-gegerdakleged an daksamalad.”
Jesús dule-nudaksadgi-gwichi nadgu, dule-wargwen Roma-dummadga-mani-gaedgi-arbaed-Levíʼye-nugadi dakalid. Mani-galeged-neggi sii, mani-gasii dakalid. Jesús, Levíʼse gote, ega sogded: —Anba be dage, an-sapinga guegar.
Degi, Leví gwisgusgu, Jesús-sapinga-guega bela ibmar-obes, Jesúsʼba naded.
Leví, e-neggi Jesúsʼga iba-dummad onosad. Agi dulemar-Roma-dummadga-mani-gaedgi-arbamalad bukidar bukwa gusmalad, degi, dule-baigan mese-naba emarba mas-gunbukwa gusmarmogad.
Agi Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar, degi, Fariseoʼmar, Jesús-sapinganga sunmakarmalad, sokarmalad: —¿Ibiga dulemar-Roma-dummadga-mani-gaedgi-arbamaladba, degi, dulemar-baigan-isgudidimaladba, we-Jesús mas gunne, degine, eba gobbali?
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Dule-gegusurmalad ina-duled abesulid, unnila dule-gegumaladbi ina-duled abedamalad.
Dule-innikii-nanadimaladse-golega an nonisulid. Dule-isgudimaladse-golega, an nonikid. Adi, na e-isguedga bukib binsamalagar, mer bar isgumalagar.
Geb degi, dulemar Jesúsʼga sokarmalad: —Juan-sapingan imbagwenar Bab-Dummadse-golega mas-gunsuli gudidamalad. Amba deyob Fariseo-sapingan gudidamarmogad. ¿Ibiga be-sapingandi geg deyob damala? Be-sapingandi mas-gundii damalad, gobdidamarbalid.
Jesús, abin burbar sogded: —Dulemar, ome-nikued-ibase nonimalale, mas gunsurmar be insae. Suli, mas gunmala. Ar dule-ome-nikunaidi ega mas uked. Ar ade, ome-nikunaidi amar-abargi gudiid.
Ar ibagan nonikoed, dule-ome-nikunaid e-idu seledoed. A-ibagan nonikile, agindi, Bab-Dummadse-golega mas-gunsuli gudigumalodo.
Geb degi, Jesús ega burbar sunmakdebalid, sogdebalid: “Ar dule, mor-seredgi matu-nasikega, geg mor-binid matuga nasiked. Ar deyob imakele, unnila mor-binidbi achirmakosulid, deginbali, mor-binid mor-seredgi-matumakar-naid isdar daklebalid.
”Deginbali, dule bipisaale, vino-binid ibmar-uka-bugluga-sobaled-seredgi bardisulid. Degir, vino-binid mudele, we-buglu-sered esirmako-itole. Degir, binsa vino-wiogo-itole, degi, bugluse-bakar, binsa miledo-itole.
A-ulale, vino-binid buglu-binidgi balileged, adi, ebobela nabir igarga guegar.
”Deginbali, dule vino-sered gobsale, sorba vino-binid bar gobbisurguardaed, ar ade sogdedaed: ‘Vino-sered bur vino-binidba nuedye.’ Dule-igar deyobmodo, igar-sered geg igar-binid-ebo atoged.”
Ibagwengine, obunnoged-ibagi, Jesús orosgi-dakleged-digaled-abargi-nadapgu, e-sapingan orosgi-dakleged gwane-gwane imaknadapi gusmalad, degine, e-san-onogegala e-argan-abin iir-iir-imaknadapgusmalad, geb gutedamalad.
Degi, gwen-gwen Fariseoʼmar-Jesúsʼba-nadapmaladi, Jesús-sapinganga sokarmalad: —¿Ar ibiga bemar ibmar-gwag gwane-gwane nadapmala? ¿Obunnoged-ibagi mer arbaoye igar-maisursi? Emide bemar igar-maidgi annanaimalad.
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, ega sogded: —An-sapingan igar-maidgi annanaisulid. ¿Ar bemar David-ibmar-imaksad absodisurmarsi? Deun, David, degi, e-sordamar ukumecharmargu, igi imaksamala.
”Ar David Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse dognoni gusad, degi, Bab-Dummadga-madu-uklesad guchagusad. Ar David, degi, e-sordamar a-madu gunnedsulinad, ar ade, madu-isedid. ¿Unnila dule-irwa-Babse-gormaladbi we-madu-gunnoye igar-maisursi? Degite, ¿David, degi, e-sordamar igar-noar-imaksar be insae? Suli, ar ukudba nabir madu guchamalad. Degisoggu, an-sapingan nabir imaksamarmodo.”
Geb degi, Jesús sogdebalid: “Ani Dule-Machi, obunnoged-iba-e-Dummadid.”
Obunnoged-iba-baidgi, Jesús, Judíoʼmar-onmakednegse dognonigu, emar-odurdaksii gusbalid. Agine, dule-wargwen, sakwa-nuedsik-argan-burgwaled sii gusad.
Agi Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar, degi, Fariseoʼmar, Jesús-argabukwa-gusmalad, dakega, bule obunnoged-ibagi Jesús dule-nudakodibeye, adi, egi sogmalagar, obunnoged-igar-maidgi annadiiye.
Ar Jesúsʼdi nue-wisid igi binsabukmala, a-ular dule-argan-burgwaledga sogded: —Dage, neg-abarse be gwisguda. Geb agi neg-abargi dule gwisgunonikid.
Geb degi, Jesús sogded: —Ibmar-soggwen an bemarse egisbimardo: Obunnoged-ibagi ibmar-nued-imakedi, wede, ¿igar-nuedi? Ibmar-isgana-imakedi, wede, ¿igar-nuedi? ¿Igid bur-nabiri? ¿Dule-oburgwedi? ¿Dule-odurguedi? ¿Igi bemar sogsunna?
Jesús bela dulemar-dikarba-bukmalad-daksagu, dule-argan-burgwaledga sogded: —Be-argan be onak. Dule na e-argan-onakgwidgu, yog-nuguar-naded.
Dummagan-bukmalad sae-itodmalad, na sunmakarmalad, igi anmar Jesús-imakmalargebye.
Deun, a-ibagangine, Jesús Bab-Dummadse-golega yarse nade gusad. Agi Bab-Dummadse-gorsii oibosad.
Oibosgu, eba-nanaimaladse gochad. Agi ambe-gakabo (12), e-sapingan-bur-dummaganga-guega susad. Amar-sulesad, e-sapingan-bur-dummaganye onugsanonikid.
Sulesmaladi, wemalad: Simón, a Jesús, Pedroʼye onugsasbalid, degi, Simón-e-urba-Andrés, Jacobo, Juan, Felipe, Bartolomé,
Mateo, Tomás, Alfeo-machi-Jacobo, Simón, Zeloteʼye-bimarbalid,
Jacobo-e-machi-Judas, degine, Judas-Iscariote, darba-Jesús-uknonikid-dule.
Jesús e-sapingan-ambe-gakabogwadmala (12), e-sordagan-bamaladmala, gulluse aidenonikid. Agi nebagi dulemar-bukidar-bukwamalad. Amar, wemalad: Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-baigan, Judea-yalaginmalad, Jerusalénʼginmalad, degi, demar-gakaba-bukmalad: Tiro-dorgan, degi, Sidón-dorgan. Amarde, bela Jesús-itogega nonimalad, degi, ega bonigan-osulogega nonimalad.
Agi dulemar niaburbase-nue-wiledigusmalad nudaklesmalad.
Bela dulemar-bukidar Jesús-ebubidamalad, ar ade, e-gangued-nikadba, bela dulemar-onudakdiid.
Jesús e-sapingan-dakdegu, sogded: “Bemar-wilemalad, bemargi nued binsalesad, ar Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid, bemargadid.
Bemar-emi-uku-mesdimalad, bemargi nued binsalesad, ar bemar immerbaa itononimaloed. Bemar-emi-bodidimalad, bemargi nued binsalesad, ar bemar allenonimaloed.
Ani Dule-Machi, an-nug-ular, dulemar isdar be-dakarmalar, dulemar be-obannarmalar, dulemar be-ichoarmalar, degi, be-nuggi sunmakarmalar be dule-isganamarye, bemargi nued binsalesad.
A-ibagangi, dulemar sabsur-be-imaksadba, be wergumaloed, be weligwar itomaloed, ar nibneggi bemarga ibmar-uklegoedi dummarbagwad. Ar e-babgan bemar-idu amba sabsur Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad-wiosmarmogad.
Ar bemar mani-ibgan, ¡duledar-wilesmar! Ar bato bemardi wegi yeer itodimalad.
Ar bemar wegi-immedik-itodimalad, ¡duledar-wilesmar! Ar be ukud itononimaloed. Ar bemar emi-alledimalad, ¡duledar-wilesmar! Ar bemar nunmaked itononimaloed, degine, bemar bononimaloed.
Ar bemargi bela-dulemar nuedbi sunmakarmalar, ¡be duledar-wilesmar! Ar deyob e-babgan Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad-napiragwadsulid imaksamarmogad.”
Jesús sogdebalid: “Ar bemar an-itobukmaladgardi an sogdo: Dule-isdar-be-dakdimalad be sabgumar, dule sae-be-dakmaladga ibmar-nuegan be imakmar.
Dulemar-be-ukabsadimaladgi nued be binsamar. Dulemar-be-ogakansadimaladga Bab-Dummadse ega be gormar.
”Ar dule-wargwen wagargi be-bibyosale, wagar-baid ega be oyobalo. Dule mor-suid bei susale, mer be-mor-baid ega be uksuli guo, ega be ukbalo.
Ar doa-dule bese ibmar egichialir, ega be uko. Ar dule be-ibe-ibmar susale, mer ese be gannar bar egiso.
Ar igi-dulemar be-imakbi be abege, deyob dulemar be imakmogoed.
”Ar dulemar-be-sabmaladbi be sabguele, ¿Bab-Dummadgi ibi-nued be amiosunna? Be ibmar-nued amiosuli. Ar dulemar-isgudimalad deyob dule-e-sabmalad sabgumarmogad.
Ar dulemar-ibmar-nued-bega-imakmaladgarbi ibmar-nued be imakmogale, ¿Bab-Dummadgi ibi-nued be amiosunna? Ibnued be amiosuli. Ar dulemar-isgudidimalad amba deyob imakmarmogad.
”Ar unnila dule-gannar-bega-ibmar-ukoedgarbi be ibmar ukele, ¿Bab-Dummadgi ibi-nued be amiosunna? Ibnued be amiosuli. Ar dule-isgudimaladi dule-isgudimaladga ibmar ukdamarmogad, adi, sorba gannar ega ukbaligar.
”Degisoggu, be-isdarmalad be sabgumar, ibmar-nued ega be imakmar. Ibmar-bei-abeged ega be ukmar, mer gannar-bega-ibmar-uked edarbedii be gumalo. Ar bemarga ibmar-uklegoed bur-dummarba gued. Degine, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-e-mimmiga bemar gunonikoed. Ar Bab-Dummad bela dulemar-sunnasurdamalad, degi, dulemar-isganamar wiledakmaid.
Ar igi be-Bab, dulemar-wiledakmaimoga, ayob bemar dulemar-wiledakmarmosundo.”
Jesús sogdebar: “Mer yogsaar be sogo, we dule-isganaye, adi, melle Bab-Dummad deyob begi sogmogagar. Mer be sogo, we-dule-sabsur-odurdakye, adi, melle Bab-Dummad sabsur be-odurdakmogagar. Dulemar begi nossuliyob be dako, adi, Bab-Dummad egi nossuliyob bemar-dakmogagar.
”Aimarga ibmar be uko, adi, Bab-Dummad bega ibmar ukmogoed. Bab-Dummad bega ibmar-wilubsaleged-nuedgi, nue-gindilegar, nue-gwamakar, degi, nue-enargwaagwadgi ibmar ukoed. Ar be ibmar wilub-imakedgine, Bab-Dummad bega ibmar wilubsamogoed.”
Geb degi, Jesús burbar emarga ibmar sogded: “¿Ar dule-ibyasulid, sunna dule-ibyasulid-idumai guosi? Suli. ¿Ar ebobela yaa-guregedgi argwachasulir be insae? Argwachale.
”Dule-ibmar-durdaknaid geg e-sailaba dummad gued. Ar ibmar-durdaknaid obelosardi, sunna e-odurdakedyob gumogodo.”
Jesús burbar sogdebalid: “¿Ar ibiga be-gwenad-ibyagi durgan-maid magarsunna be dake? ¿Ar ibiga be-ibya-yaba-suar-maiddi akusunna be dake?
”Ar igi be-gwenadga be sogoe: ‘Be-ibya-yaba-durgan-maid an bega onogweloye.’ ¿Ar be-ibya-yaba suar-maiddina? ¡Bemar yogasaar-darba-sunmakmaladid! Suar be-ibya-yaba-maid-insa be onoge. Geb agi nabir be atakoed. Adi, agi nabir be-gwenad-ibya-yaba-durgan-maid be onogoed.”
Jesús sogdebalid: “Sapi nuedile, geg san-isgana nikued, e-sanmaked nued sanmaked. Ar sapi isganale, geg san-nued nikued, e-sanmaked ichakwa sanmaked.
Ar sapimar war-wargwen na e-sanmakedgi dakleged. Ar higo-san ikogi sanmaksulid, degine, uva-san gwen sapi-ikogangi welesulid.
”Anmar-dule amba deyobmodo, dule-nued, na e-gwagegi ibmar-nued-nikadba ibmar-nued onoged. Ar dule-isganadi, na e-gwagegi ibmar-isgana-nikadba ibmar-isgana onomogad. Ar dule-sunmakedi, gwagegi-ibmar-naidba na sunmaked.”
Jesús sogdebalid: “¿Ibiga be anse, ‘Dummadye, Dummadye,’ gormala? Ar degite an-ibmar-sogedba be dasurmalad.
”Ar bela dulemar anse danikile, an-ibmar-soged itogele, degi, eba daele, an bega sogmalo, we-dule doasunnaa dae. Weyobdo:
We-dule-gwensak na neg-sobbargu, yaa akwisad, matusur akwisad, degi, neg-e-saila akwa-birgi mesisad. Diwar noargu, diwar binnasur a-neggi yolenonikid, degite, gwen neg ogiglimaksasulid, ar ade akwasaila-birgi neg nue-sobar siid.
”Ar dule an-gayaburba-itogele, ar a-sogedba imaksasulile, adi, we-dule weyobmodo: Dule neg-sobsagu, unnila napa-birgi sobsad, neg-e-saila mesissulid. Diwar noargu, a-neggi binnasur yolenonikid, neg-ayarided, neg dummad-bibichisdo. Be itogua.”
Jesús bela dule-e-itobukmaladga ibmar-sogsad-sorba Capernaúmʼse dognonikid.
Roma-dule-sorda-dulatar-sediid-e-mai (100) ise-uellegar maid, burgwedani maid. A-dulede, na e-mai nue-sabed.
Roma-dule-sorda-dulatar-sediid dulemar-Jesúsʼgi-sunmak-itoargu, Jesúsʼse Judío-girmar-dummagan barmialid, adi, Jesúsʼga sogega e-negse dagye, e-mai ega nudakdaye.
Judío-dummagan Jesúsʼse nonimargu, egi nue-wilenai gusmalad, ega weyob sognanai gusmalad: “We-dule-e-mai wis be bendakergebed,
ar Roma-sordamar-dummadde, anmar-neggwebur-nue-sabed, degine, anmarga onmakedneg sobsabalid.”
Jesús amarba nadsunnad. Neg-modanigusgu, Roma-dule-sorda-dulatar-sediid Jesús-abin e-aimar barmialid. Adi, amar Jesúsʼga weyob sogmalagar: “Dummad, an-negse be dogsulir, akarsulid, ar be an-negse gwen dogedwilubsulid,
degine, an bese gwen dagedsurmoganad. Ar unnila be sogsa-sae, an-mai yog-nuguar naoed.
”Amba an dummad nikmogad, a-sogedba an damogad. Degine, ani an dummadmogad, ani an sordamar-sedimogad. Ar sorda-wargwenga an sogdibe: ‘Be nae,’ yog naar daed. Sorda-baidga an sogbardibe: ‘Be dage,’ yog dagar daed. Degine, an-maiga an sogdibe: ‘Be we-imake,’ yog-imakar daed.”
Jesús deyob Roma-dule-sorda-dulatar-sediid ega ibmar-soge itoargu, geger-itoded. Geb degi, Jesús dulemar-e-sorba-duurmakdanimaladga sogded: “An bemarga sogmar, gwen an Israel-yargi weyob dule-angi-nue-bensulid an dakdisulid.”
Ar dule-barmilesmalad gannar negse nonimargu, daknonimalad, mai-uellemai-gusad bato nugusa. Ar ade, bato Jesús bannapaa we-dule nudaksad.
Jesús, Roma-sordamar-dummad-e-mai-nudaksad-sorba, Naínʼye-neggwebur-nugadse nadapgu, e-sapingan eba nadapi gusmarmogad, degine, bukidar dule-baigan eba nadapi gusmarmogad.
Neggweburse-doged-yawagak-mosgu, dulemar neg-uanse dule-burgwisad-dignadapi gusmalad. A-burgwaled, ome-ei-sui-burgwisad-e-machi-wargwensakadid. Naín-neggweburginmalad bukidar a-omeba nadapi gusmarmogad.
Agi Dummad-Jesús dakargu, nue-wile a-ome-dakded, ega sogded: —Mer be boe.
Jesús dule-burgwar-maid-selemaidse warmakdapgu, dule-mui-semamaid gwisgusmalad. Geb degi, Jesús a-egi-selemaid-ebusgu, sogded: —Sapingwa, an bega soge, be gwisgu.
Geb degi, dule-burgwar-maid gwisgusad, geb agi yog sunmakdeguad. Geb Jesús a-sapingwa e-nanse sessunnad.
Bela-dulemar dobee itodmalad, geb degi, Bab-Dummad-nug odummodmalad, sogdemalad: “Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-wargwen anmar-abargi gwisgunoni. Bab-Dummad na e-dulemarse ataknoni.”
Bela Judea-yalaganba, degi, neggweburmar-a-dikarba-bubukwad bela Jesús dule-burgwaled-odulosad wisguarmalad.
Deunni, Diigi-dule-oged-Juan-e-sapingan bela Jesús-ibmar-imaksad Juanʼga sognonimalad. Agi Juan na e-sapingan-warbose gochad.
Geb Jesúsʼse barmisad, adi, ese egisegar: —Ar epenne Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-an-bemarga-barmidagoye-sogsadi, ¿ar be a-dule? ¿Anmar dule-baid amba edarbemaloe?
Dule-warbo-barmilearmalad Jesúsʼse nonimalad, ega sognonimalad: —Anmar bese ibmar-egisega Diigi-dule-oged-Juan anmar-barmialid. Bega sogega, bede, Bab-Dummad-epenne-dule-wargwen-an-bemarga-barmidagoye-sogsad-dule-sogeye. Anmar dule-baid amba edarbemalo-sogeye.
Agine, Jesús, Juan-sapingan-wagab, bukidar dulemar-gegumalad, galagwensuli-bonigan-nikmalad, niaburba-nikmalad, degine, dulemar-ibyasurmalad nudaksad.
Geb degi, Jesús, Juan-sapingan-abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Be namar, Juanʼga be ibmar-itosmalad sognamar, degi, ega be ibmar-daksamalad sognamar: Dulemar-ibyasurmalad mag-atak an imaksad, dule-muya-muya-nanamalad nued-nanae an imaksad, dulemar-naibe-buna-yaa-maleged-nikmalad swilidik an imaksad, dulemar-uaya-yallirmalad nabir-mag-ito an imaksad, dulemar-burgwismalad gannar-durguega an imaksad, degine, dulemar-wileganaga Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi an ega sunmaknonikid.
”Degine, Juanʼga be sogbalo: ‘Ar dule-an-bensuliddi, a-dulegindi nued binsalesye.’ ”
Diigi-dule-oged-Juan-sapingan-warbogwad nadmargu, Jesús, Juanʼgi dulemarga sunmakalid, sogded: “¿Ar ibiga nega-dulesulidganba bemar arbisunna? ¿Nargammu-burwaba-aibangwichi-dakega bemar arbi? Suli.
”Degite, ¿ar ibi-dakega bemar arbisunna? ¿Bemar dule-wargwen-mor-nued-yoi-gudiid-dakega arbimala? Suli. Ar dulemar mor-nued-yoi-gudimaladdi, wergudimalad, amardi reymar-negyagi gudidimalad.
”Ar degite, ¿ibi-dakega bemar arbimarsunna? ¿Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-dakegala? Eye. An bemarga sogmalad, a be daksamalad, degine, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogedba bur bule bemar daksamalad, ar ade, we-bur-dule-dummadid.
Ar we-dulegine bato narmakar sognaid, Mesíasʼgi sunmaknaigu, Bab-Dummad soged: ‘Be-iduale, anga-gayaburba-berbeged an barmidoed, Adi, be-iduar bega igar-mayegar.’ Malaquías 3:1 We-gayaburba-barsoged, Diigi-dule-oged-Juanʼdo.
”Ani an bemarga soged: Dulemar we-napneggi-gwalulemaid, Diigi-dule-oged-Juanʼba bur-dummad sated. Ar degite, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidgi bur dule-bipigwadi, Juanʼba bur-dule-dummadid.”
Bela dulemar Jesús-itosmalad, degi, Roma-dummadga-mani-gaedgi-arbamaladse-bakar, sogdemalad, Bab-Dummad-igar-napira-maid inniki-maiye, ar amar, Diigi-dule-oged-Juan-diigi-ogedgi oglesmalad.
Ar Fariseoʼmardi, degi, Moisés-Igar-odulomaladdi, Bab-Dummad-igar-emarga-uklenaid gwen abingassurmalad, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar Juan-imakedi, gwen imaksasurmalad.
Geb degi, Jesús sogdebalid: “Degite, emi we-dulemar-bukmaladde, ¿ibubo wilubdakar an egi sunmakoe? ¿Doa sunnaa damar be insae?
Wemar-damaladi, masmala dulemar-bukidar-ambikuedgi ambikumaladyobdo. Ar dulemar-bukidar-ambikumaladgi muchub-muchub na gorbukmalad. Weyob sogbukwa damalad: ‘Anmar gar ogochamalanad, gwen be dodossurmalad. Anmar bukib-binsae namaksamalanad, gwen be bossurmalad.’ Degisoggu, bemar we-masmala-binsaedsulidyob damalad.
”Diigi-dule-oged-Juan we-napnegse nonigu, dule-baiganyob mas-gunsuli, degi, gobsuli gudigusad. E-annik bemar sogsamalad: ‘Wedi nia egi naiye.’
”Ani Dule-Machi, andi nonigu, mas gunnonikid, gobnonikid, an-annik be sogmalad: ‘We-dule, gadi-masgunned-duleye, gadi-vino-gobed-duleye. Roma-dummadga-mani-gaedgi-arbamalad-e-aiye, degi, dulemar-galagwensuli-isgudimalad-e-aiye, be an-annik sogmalad.’ ”
Geb degine, Jesús sogded: “Ar dule Bab-Dummad-e-ibmar-wisidi, ibmar-nuegan-imakedgi mag dakledaed.”
Ibagwengine, Fariseo-wargwen Jesúsʼgi wilenaigusad, e-negse mas gunnaegar. Jesús, Fariseo-negyaba dogsagua, mese-naba mas gunnega sigidapid.
A-neggweburgine, ome-wargwen, ome-isgudiid-dule, itoargu, Jesús, Fariseo-neggi mas-gunsiiye, gwallu-wawagwad alabastro-akwagi-bute-sobaledgi senonikid.
Ome Jesús-yarganba, e-mali-dikarba ise-boar signonikid. Agi, ome na e-ibyanisgi Jesús-e-mali owardikusad. Geb degi, e-sailagiagi odinnosbalid. Ome Jesús-mali suk imaksad, gwallu-wawad Jesús-maligi eosbalid.
Fariseo-Jesúsʼnik-gochadi degi-daksagua, na e-gwagegi binsasigualid: “Ar Jesús, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogeddina, wisindo, we-ome, doa-dule, degine, we-ome-e-ebunaidi, igidaedbali. Ar we-ome isgudiid-duled.”
Geb degi, Jesús sunmakdegu, sogded: —Simón, ibmar-gwensak an bega sogbido. Simón, abin-sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, be soge.
Jesús sogded: —Dulemar-walabo dule-gwensakgi mani gasmalad: Wargwen egi dulataled-ilatar (500) mani gasad, baiddi, dulatar (100) egi mani gasad.
Ar ebobela geg bennuke gusmalad. Degisoggu, mani-ibed amarga sogsagusad: ‘Akarsurye, mer bar an-bennukmaloye.’ Emide, be anga sogena: We-dule, ¿doa bur sab be insae?
Simón, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —An insagua, bur dumma-egi-mani-ganigusad, an insado. Jesús, abin-sogded: —Napiragwad be sogsado.
Jesús ome-siidsik aibilisgua, Simónʼga sogded: —We-ome be dakena. An be-negse dognonigu, gwen be anga an-nag enukega dii uksasulid. Ar we-omedi e-ibyanisgi an-nag enuksad, degine, e-sailagiagi anga an-nag odinnosbalid.
Dog-nued-noniye be anga sogega, be an-wagar ussulid. Ar we-omedi an be-negse dogsad-akar an-nag usiguad.
”Be an-nonogi anga gwallu-wawad gwen eossulid, ar we-omedi an-naggi gwallu-wawad eosad.
Ar degisoggu, an bega sogsun, we-ome-dummad-isgudiid ega bela elilesad, ar ade, we-omede dummad-an-sabgusad. Ar dule unnila ichee ega isgued-elilesale, ichee sabgumogad.”
Geb degi, Jesús omega sogded: —Be-gwagegi be isgudigusad nugussun.
Dulemar-mesegi-eba-mas-gunbukmalad, na ulubgi binsadmalad, sogdemalad: —¿Ar wede doa-dulesunna, isguedse-bakar, elied?
Ar Jesúsʼdi omega sogded: —Be-angi-bensulidba isguedgi be abonolesun. Degisoggu, ulubgi gwage-bogidikidba be nasun.
A-ibagan-sorbali, Jesús bela neggwebur-dummagan-onodii, degi, neggwebur-burwigana-onodii gualid. Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid-gayaburba-nuedgi sunmakdii gualid. E-sapingan-e-ambe-gakabogwad (12) eba gudigusmarmogad.
Degi, abala omegan niaburba-isgana-nika-gusmalad nugusmalad, gwen-gwen-gegudiid nugusmalad. A-omegan, wemalad: María, Magdalenaʼye ese gordamalad. We-omegine sogagugle (7) niaburba onolesad.
Degine, Chuza-e-ome-Juana. We-Chuzaʼde Rey-Herodesʼga neg-daked-dummadid. Deginbali, Susana, degi, omegan-baigan-bukidar Jesúsʼba gudigusmarmogad. A-omegan, na ibmar-nikamaladba Jesúsʼga ibmar-imakdii gusmalad.
Dulemar-bukidar neggwebur-baid-baidginmalad Jesúsʼse ambikunonimalad. Amarga, Jesús burbar sunmakded, sogded:
“Ibagwengine, dule-wargwen-ibmar-gwag-digedi ibmar-gwag dignaded. Ibmar-gwag-dignaigusgu, abala ibmar-gwag igargi babatisad. Igargi-babatismaladgi dulemar annasmalad. Geb degi, a-sorbali, sikwimar-gukudimalad a-ibmar-gwag manonimalad.
”Abala, ibmar-gwag, akwamar-birgi babatisad. Dunguargu, dinguded, ar ade, akwamar-birgi neg nisarsulid, dinnagwad.
”Abala, ibmar-gwag, iko-abargi babatisad. Ibmar-gwag dunguargu, ikomar eba dungudmogad. Ikomar ibmar-gwag-ichosad. Degisoggu, ibmar-gwag gwen sanmaksasulid.
”Ar ibmar-gwag napa-nuedgi-babatismaladdi, dungudgu, nue-sanmaksad, bela-bela san-nikusad.” Ar weyob Jesús dulemarga sunmaksigu, binnasur sogded: “An-bemarga-ibmar-soged bemar mag nue-itobiele, nue-itomar.”
Geb degi, e-sapingan Jesúsʼse egichialid: —Ibmar burbar be anmarga sogsadi, ¿wede be, ibu obarsunna?
Jesús na e-sapinganga sogded: —Ar bemargardi, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid-igar-burbar-mamaid osanalegoye maid. Dulemar-baigangardi, ega burbar soglegoed: ‘Adi, dulemar ise-dakar imakmar-inigwele, mer mag dakmalaga, degi, ise-itogar-imakmar-inigwele, mer mag itomalagar.’ Isaías 6:9
”Ar emi burbar an bemarga sogsadi, weyobdo: Ibmar-gwag, Bab-Dummad-gayaburbad.
”Ibmar-gwag-igargi-babatismaladi, we Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-sunmaked-e-wilubganad. Nia-saila sorba nonigu, dulemar-gwagegi Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-nagusad ei osulononikid, adi, mer Bab-Dummadba damalaga, mer isguedgi abonolemalagar.
”Ar akwagi-babatismaladdi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba itosmargu, nue-weligwar abingasmalad. Ar wemar unnila asginbi Bab-abingasmarsoggu, ibmar-gwag-digaled-maligan-askinnegwadyobdo. Degisoggu, ichee wis Bab-Dummadba nanasmalad, ibagan-bulegan ega nonigu, Bab-Dummadgi bangudmalad.
”Ar iko-imbaba-babatismaladdi, we-dulemar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba abingasmalando. Ar undargusgu, we-napneggi-ibmar-nanaidse, degi, manise, degi, we-napneggi-unnila-yeer-itodiguedse, binsaed-galedmalad. Amar ibmar-gwag-gwen-sanmaksasulidyob gunonikid.
”Ar napa-nuedgi-babatismaladdi, wemardi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-itosad nue abingasmalad. Gwage-nuedgi, gwage-napiragwadgi, gwen-galakussuli Bab-Dummad-gayaburbaba nanasmalad. Degisoggu, amar ibmar-gwag-nue-sanmaksamaladyob gunonikid.”
Jesús sogdebar: “Dule gwallu ogasale, gwen ulu-yaba sisulid, degi, e-gabed-urba siega amba gwen imakdisurbalid. Dule gwallu ogasale, niba gwallu-siedgi osidaed, adi, dulemar dognonikir, gwallu-meegwad mag dakegar.
Debayobi ibmar bipisaale dukusulid. Be-ibmar-saed bela wisgulegedsegad. Amba be dukuar ibmar-saoen-inigwele, bela dulemar wisguedsegad, bela negache noedsegad.
”Degisoggu, nue be binsaergebed. Ar dule-ibmar-nikadga bur bule ega gatik ibmar uklegoed, ar degine, dule-ibmar-satele, amba ibmar-nikuo-itogedi e-annik sulegoed.”
Jesús dulemar-odurdaksigu, geb degi, e-nan, degine, Jesús-urbamar, Jesúsʼse nonimalad. Ar dulemar bukidarsoggu, geg Jesúsʼse warmak guarmalad.
Jesús-owisosmarsunnad, ega sognonimalad: —Be-nan, degi, be-urbamar magaba gwismalad, be-dakbimalad.
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Dule-Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-itomalad, degi, ebadamalad, a an-nanad, degine, amar an-urbamalad.
Ibagwengi, Jesús na e-sapinganmala urgi nakwisgu, amarga sogded: —Mata-dummad-obakar namargwelo. Geb degi, nadmarsunnad.
Urgi nadapmargu, Jesús gabided. Geb degi, egi mataba burwa-dummad noalid. Ur, dii-ena nagusad. Degidbali, ur doged gualid.
Geb degi, e-sapingan Jesúsʼse nonimargu, Jesús-odaksamalad, ega sogdemalad: —¡Odurdaked-saila, anmar-ur dogmai, anmar bela! Jesús ataksagu, burwaga, degi, demarga binnasur sogded: “Be bogidik sae.” Geb degi, burwa boo naded, neg swilidik sigisad.
Jesús e-sapinganga sogded: —¿Ar ibiga be Bab-Dummad-bengusmala? E-sapingan dobe itodmalad, degine, geger dakdemarbalid. Na muchub-muchub sogdemalad: “¿Wede, doa-dulesunna? Burwa, degi, demarse-bakar, eba ibsaed.”
Geb degi, Jesús na e-sapinganmala Gadara-dulemar-bukwadse modapmalad. A-negde, Galilea-mata-obakar naid.
Jesús urgi-aidesgu, dule-wargwen dule-nia-dikasurgus-nikad, Gadara-neggweburgined, ese nonikid. A-dule mor-yoisur gudidaed, degine, neggi gabsurbalid, neg-uan-yaba gabdidaed.
We-dule Jesús-dakargu, binnasur gormakded. Jesús-asabin yokorgi sindigar sigisad, sogded: —Jesús, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-Machi, ¿ibiga be anse achadaniki? ¡Melle be mesagwar an-imako!
Ar Jesús niaburbaga sogsad, “dulegi-maid be noe.” Dakargu, dikasurgusa dulegi niaburba maid. Ar esgoro-dubgi a-dule-mali, degi, e-argan edindamar-inigwele, degite, iidi esgoro-imakdaed. Degine, nega-dulesulidganba, nia, dule-sesdaed.
Jesús, a-dulese egichiarsun: —¿Igi be nuga? Dule, abin-sogded: —Ichesulidye an nuga. Ar ade, niamar-bukidar egi maid.
Niamar Jesúsʼgi wilenai gusad, melle niamar-wilegoed-galuse e-barmidye.
Deun, sinmar-bukidar yargi mas mananai gusad. Niamar Jesúsʼgi wilenai gusad, sinmargi e-odoye. Jesús amarga sogded, nabirye, ase be dognamarye.
Niamar, dulegi ainidgu, sinmarse ubodapid. Sinmar yar-weregedgi babatidgu, matase babatidapid. Agi bela gundoledapmalad.
Ar sinmar-edarbemalad sin-gundilesad-daksamargu, duurmakdemalad, neg-igarba-bukmaladga, degine, neggweburgi, sinmar-gusad sogdapmalad.
Degi, dulemar neggusad-dakega ainiarmalad. Jesúsʼse nonimargu, daknonimalad, dule-nia-nika-gudigusadi Jesús-naba nue mor-yoi sii, nue-nugus sii. Dulemar deyob dakarmargu, dobee itodmalad.
Ar dulemar-dule-nugusad-daksamaladi, dulemar-nonimaladga sogdemalad, dule-nia-nika-gudigusadi igi nugusa.
Geb degi, bela dulemar Gadara-yar-dikarbarmalad, bela dobee itodmargu, Jesús e-yargi-noega, egi wilenaigusmalad. Degi, Jesús urgi-nakwisgu, gannar nadsunnad.
Dule-nia-nika-gusadi, Jesús-e-sedega, Jesúsʼgi wilenaigusad. Ar Jesús egi bangusokargua, ega sogded:
“Be-negse be nae, be sogna, ibibayobi Bab-Dummad nue-wile be-daksa.” Dule nadgua, bela neggweburgi sunmakdii gualid, igi Jesús ega ibmar-dummagan imaksa.
Jesús gannar Capernaúm-neggweburse nonigu, dulemar-bukidaradi weligwar Jesús-abingasmalad, ar ade, bela Jesús-edarbedimalad.
Geb degi, machered-wargwen, Jairoʼye-nugadi Jesúsʼse nonikid. Jesús-mali-naba sindigar yokorgi signonikid. E-negse naega, Jesúsʼgi wilenaigusad. Jairoʼde, Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggi dule-dummadga gudiid.
Dakargu, Jairo unnila bunolo-wargwenna nikad, birgambe-gakabo nikad (12). A-bunolode, burgwedani maid. Jesús, Jairo-negse nadapgu, dulemar-bukidara, ali-ali Jesúsʼgi yolenanai gualid.
Dulemar-bukidarad-abargi ome-gwensak birgambe-gakabogus (12) boni-nalur-nika-gudiidi, gudimogad. A-ome, bela mani-nikadi inadurgangi ollomaksad, ar degite, gwen nudaklessulid.
A-ome, Jesús-yarganba nonikid, ei-morduku ebunonikid. Ome, Jesús-morduku ebusgu, boni-nalur-nika-gudiid yog-galegar naded, yog-nuguar gusad.
Geb degi, Jesús sogded: —¿Wede doa an-ebusa? Bela sulidbiye ega sogmalad. Pedro, degi, e-walik-bukmalad, Jesúsʼga sogdemalad: —Odurdaked-saila, dulemar-bukidar ali-ali be-barmesnana-naded, degite, be sogde: ‘Wede, ¿doa an-ebusye?’
Ar Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Dule-an-ebusad mag an itoged. Ar angi an-gangued node an itosad.
Degi, ome dakdegu, ibmar-gusadi gwen dukuar gussuli, ise-wawanmakar Jesúsʼse nonikid, e-mali-naba yokorgi sindigar signonikid. Bela-dulemar-bukwad-abargi sognonikid, ede, ibiga Jesús-morduku ebusye, degine, ede, Jesús-morduku-ebusgu, yog-nuguar nadye sognonikid.
Jesús omega sogded: —Omegwa, be nue an-bengussursoggu, be nugussun. Gwage-bogidikidgi be-negse be nasun.
Amba Jesús omega sunmakgwichi, dule-wargwen, Jairo-neggi-danikid, Jairoʼga sognonikid: —Be-bunolo bato burgwisye, mer bar odurdaked-sailagi bega be-bunolo-nudakega bar wileye.
Jesús deyob dule-soge itosgu, Jairoʼga sogded: —Melle be dobgu. Unnila melle be bengu, be-bunolo nuguoed.
Jesús, Jairo-negse dogdapgu, dulemar eba gwen doged imaksasulid, unnila, Pedro, Jacobo, Juan, degi, bunolo-e-bab, degine, bunolo-e-nan, amarbi eba dogsamalad.
Jesús modapgu, dakdapid bela bobukmala, degi, binnasur ise-wilegar bunologa bonanai. Jesús amarga sogded: —Mer bomar, bunolo burgwar-maisuli, unnila gabmai.
Bela-dulemar-bukmalad Jesúsʼgi dodoarmalad, ar ade, wismalad we-bunolo burgwar mai.
Ar Jesúsʼdi, bunolo-argangi-gasgua, binnasur sogded: —Bunolo, be gwisgu.
Geb degi, bunolo-e-burba gannar ese nonigu, yog-gwisguar imaksad. Geb degi, Jesús sogded, bunologa masgunned ukmarye.
Bunolo-e-babgan deyob ibmar-gusadi geger dakarmalad. Jesúsʼdi sogded, mer dule-baiganga sogmaloye.
Jesús na e-sapingan-ambe-gakabogwad-danar-oambikusgu (12), bela amarga igar-uksad, Bab-Dummad-ganguedba dulemargi niamar-oniegar, degine, dule-uellemalad-nudakegar.
Geb degi, Jesús e-sapingan-barmisad, adi, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidgi sunmakegar, degi, dulemar-uellemalad nudakbaligar.
Jesús e-sapinganga weyob sogsad: “Mer igarba ibmar sedmalo, suar-gaapoled suli, sagu suli, masgunned suli, degine, mani surbar. Deginbali, unnila mor-yoigwabi be namaloed.
Ar doa-negse be dogdapoe, a-negginbi be megoed. Ar a-neggi-mai geb be baid-neggweburse namaloed.
”Ar bia be-abingassurmalar, a-neggweburgi be nodmaloed, geb be-naggi-olli-nanaid be nue eli-eli samaloed, adi, dulemar mag be-dakmalaga bemar ega Bab-Dummad-igargi sunmakapmala. Degisoggu, emargindo, ar Bab-Dummad-igar yapa abingamalar.”
Jesús-sapingan-ambe-gakabo-guedi (12) bela neggweburmar-burwiganase Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi sunmakdii guarmalad, degi, dulemar-gegumalad-nudakdii gusmarbalid.
Dummadga Herodes-Antipas-maidi, Jesús-bela-ibmar-imakdiid-itoargu, geger nue-ito naded. Ar ade, abar sogmalad: “We-Jesús, Diigi-dule-oged-Juan-burgwisad gannar durgusye.”
Baigan sogmarbalid: “We-Jesús, epenne-Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Elíasʼye-nugad, gannar noniye.” Degine, baigandi sogmalad: “We-Jesús, epenne-Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-wargwen-gudigusad gannar durgusye.”
Herodes-Antipasʼdi sogded: “An diigi-dule-oged-Juan-ibe dukar-egwachadde, degite, dulemar an egi-sunmake-itogedde, ¿wede doasunna?” Degisoggu, Herodes-Antipas Jesús-dakbiguarsunnad.
Jesús-e-sapingan-bur-dummagan-e-ambe-gakabo-gued (12), gannar Jesúsʼse nonimargu, bela ibmar-imaksamalad Jesúsʼga sognonimalad. Jesús amarbi bachikii, nega-dulesulidganba neggwebur-Betsaidaʼye-nugad-dikarba sesad.
Dulemar wisguargu, Jesús Betsaida-neggwebursik nadye, dulemar ase nadegusmarmogad. Jesúsʼse nonimargu, Jesús dulemar-abingasad. Geb degi, amarga Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidgi sunmaksigisad, degine, dulemar-nudakleged-abemalad nudaksabalid.
Ar neg-sedogusgu, e-sapingan-ambe-gakabogwad (12) Jesúsʼse nonimalad, ega sognonimalad: —Dulemar be barmid, adi, igarba negmar-bukwadse, degi, negmar-gwa-gwagwen igarba-bukwadgi sunna obunnomaloed, degi, agi masgunned sunna amimarbaloed. Ar wegindi, anmar nega-dulesulidgangi bukmalad.
Jesús e-sapingan-abin sogded: —Bemar ega masgunned ukmar. E-sapingan, abin-imakdemarmogad: —Anmar unnila madu gwaatar, degi, ua ukabo nikmalad. Ar degiir anmar we-dulemar-ichesulidga mas baknaergebed.
Ar ade, macherganbi miliatar (5,000) mergued. Geb degi, Jesús e-sapinganga sogded: —Danar-danar, e-dulabogakambe-dulabogakambe, (50-50) be urbemar.
E-sapingan deyob imaksamalad, bela deyob dulemar-urbismalad.
Geb degi, Jesús madu-gwaataled susgu, ua-ukabogwad susbargu, niba atakdegu, Bab-Dummadga dog-nuedye sogsad. A-sorba, madu bisge-bisge imaksad, degidbali ega merguded. Geb e-sapinganga ukded, adi, amar dulemarga ukmarmogagar.
Degine, bela-dulemar-gudidimalad nue-immeles mas guchamalad. Mas-guchad-sorba, Jesús-sapingan madu-obichadi, degi, ua-obichadi, garba-gwaambe-gakabo-mergu (12) wesmalad.
Ibagwengi, Jesús, Bab-Dummadse bachiki gorsigusgu, deun e-sapingan eba bukwa-gusmogad. Amarse Jesús egichialid: —¿Doaye dulemar an-annik sogmala?
E-sapingan, abin-sogdemalad: —Gwenna-gwenna Diigi-dule-oged-Juanʼye benik sogmalad. Baigandi sogmalad, be Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Elíasʼye. Agi baigan sogmarbalid, be Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-wargwen-epenne-gudigusad, gannar durgusadye.
Jesús na e-sapinganga sogded: —Bemardina, ¿doaye an-annik sogmarmosunna? Geb degi, Pedro, Jesús-abin sogded: —Be Cristo, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-dule.
Geb degi, Jesús e-sapinganga sabsur sogded, melle dulemar-baiganga bipisaar sogoye ede Cristoʼye, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-dule-sunnadye.
Degi, Jesús sogdebar: —Ani Dule-Machi, nue-wilegergebed. Judíoʼmar-girmar-dummagan, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degine, Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar, amar gwen an-abingaosurmalad, an-oburgwemaloed. Geb degine, ibapaagi gannar an durgubaloed.
Degine, Jesús bela-dulemarga sogded: “Ar dule-wargwen an-sapinga gubiele, na dukin san iegergebed. Bato burgwenadapidyobi, bane-bane nakrus-semaiyob anba nanaergebed.
”Ar dule-wargwen anba-naid-ular burgwebisulir, e-san-burba ei yogguodo. Ar anba-naid-ular burgwenonikirdi, adi, na-e-san-burba yogguosurdo.
Ar dule-wargwen napneg-naid bela egadga imaksar, degi-inigwele, edi na bergusar, e-san-burbadi yoggusale, ega, ¿ibi-nuedga napneg-naid-egadga-imaksad gus be insae? Suli. Ega ibmar-nuedga gussuli.
”Ar dule-gwensak an-nuggi bingegusale, degi, an-gayaburbagi bingegusbalile, ani Dule-Machi, a-dulegi an bingegumogoed. An-gangued-yeerdaklegedgi an danikoedgi, degi, an-Bab-gangued-yeerddaklegedgi an danikoedgi, degine, baliwitur-yeerddaklegedgi an danikoedgi, a-dulegi an bingegumogoed.
”Ar napira an bemarga soged, gwenna-gwenna wegi-bemar-bukmalad burgosulid, amba dula-gudii, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid bese noni be dakedsegad.”
Jesús ibabaabakgus-e-burgoedgi-sunmaksad-sorba (8), Jesús, Pedro, Juan, degi, Jacobo-sesagusad. Bab-Dummadse-golega yar-birse nakwided.
Jesús Bab-Dummadse gorsigusgu, e-san-dakleged gwagded, e-mor bela dagudik, dakar-dakar dakle naded.
Geb agi Jesús-sapingan-warbaagwadi dakarmalad, dulemar-epenne-dula-gudigusmalad, Moisés, degi, Elías, Jesúsʼmala sunmakgwichi.
Amar, gwallu-meegwad-abargi, Jesús-Jerusalénʼgi-burgoedgi-sunmakgwichi, degi, Jesús-we-napneggi-bangudoedgi-sunmakgwichi, dakarmalad.
Pedro, degi, baigan-eba-gudidimalad, gabed egi nue-obin itomar-inigwele, nue ataksamargu, Jesús-gangued-yeerdakleged daksamalad, degi, dule-warbo Jesúsʼba-gwichid daksamarbalid.
Degi, amar-warbogwad Jesúsʼgi bangudsokarmargu, Pedro, Jesúsʼga sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, we, anmar wegi gudiid nueddo. Anmar wegi neg-matargana-gwapaa sobmalodo: Gwagwen bega, baid Moisésʼgar, geb baid Elíasʼgarmo. Ar ade, Pedro itosulid, yogsaar gole-gole gwichid.
Ar weyob Pedro sunmakgwichi, mogir emar-birgi nagunonikid. Mogir emargi dognonigu, dobe itodmalad.
Degi, mogir-imbaba gayaburba gollalid, sogded: “We An-Machi-sabedi gued. We, be nue-itomar.”
Degi-sunmaked-bergusgu, Jesús-sapingan dakarmalad, unnila Jesúsʼbi wargwen gwichi. A-ibagangi, Jesús-sapingan dulemar-baiganga ibmar-daksamalad gwen sogsasurmalad, bela daksadi, odukusmalad.
A-oibosadgine, Jesús na e-sapingan-warbaagwadmala yar-birgi-gudiidgi aidearmargu, dulemar-bukidar ese nonimalad.
Agi dule-wargwen, dulemar-bukidarad-abargi binnasur gote, sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, an-machi anga wis be dake, ar webi wargwen an wis nikad.
Dakargu, burba-isgana an-machigi nagunonikir, binnasur gotedaed, degine, binnasur wawanmakdedaed. Gayaba maku-maku guardaed, burba-isgana sabsur-imakdaed, degine, bar indakbisur guardaed.
Be-sapingangi an wilesanad, adi, ega burba-isgana onogegar. Be-sapingan gwen ega burba-isgana onossurmalad.
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Bemar, Bab-Dummadgi-bengumalad-dulemar. Bemar, Bab-Dummad-igar-oakaloged-dulemar. ¿Sanase bemar-abargi an gudiguosunna? ¿Sanase mag be itomaloe? Budar an bemar-daked danikid. ”Be-machigwa anse be sedage.”
Machigwa Jesúsʼse danikidgi, niaburba machigwa-balimeted, degi, binnasur owawanmakded. Geb degi, Jesús burba-isganase sabsur-uluded. Geb machigwa-onudaksasunnad. Geb a-sorba, e-babga machigwa-uksasunnad.
Bela dulemar, Bab-Dummad-e-gangued geger dakedbimalad. Bela dulemar Jesús-ibmar-imakedi, geger-dakbukmaladgine, Jesús e-sapinganga sogded:
“We an-ibmar-sogoedi nue be itomalo, mer be iemalo. Ani Dule-Machi, an-oburgwemalaga dulemarse uklegoed.”
Weyob Jesús ega ibmar-sogedi e-sapingan aku itosmalad. Ar ade, emarga odukuar sunmaklesad, adi, aku-itomalagar. E-sapingan na dobedbali Jesúsʼse egichissurmalad, wede ibi ega nue-obarena.
Geb degi, Jesús-e-sapingan na muchub-muchub abin-abin imakarmalad, doa-bur-dummadga guoye.
Ar Jesús, e-sapingan-gwage-binsanaid mag daksagu, machi-bipi-wargwen-susad. Geb e-nagaba ogwichisad.
Agine, e-sapinganga sogded: “Ar dule, an-nuggine we-machi-bipi-abingaele, an-abinganaido. Degi, ar dule, an-abingaele, dule-an-barmialid abinganaido. Ar ade, bemar-imbagi doa-bur-bipigwadi, a, bur dule-dummadid.”
Juan, Jesús-abin imakdegu, sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, anmar dule-wargwen be-nuggi niamar-onodii daksado. A-dule, anmar-sordasursoggu, anmar ega sogsado, mer bar Jesús-nuggi niamar-onogoye.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Mer a-dule-ibe igar-bisgo. Ar dule anmargi yoledisulile, a-dule, anmar-sordado.
Jesús nibnegse-naed-e-ibagan warmaknonigu, Jesús, Jerusalénʼse nue-nae sokarsunnad.
Jesús igarba nadapgu, e-iduale dulemar-barmisad. Amar nadgu, Samaria-neggwebur-bipigwadse dogdapmalad, adi, agi guagwar idu neg-amimalagar.
Ar dulemar-aginmaladi Jesús-Jerusalénʼse-nadapid magar daksamarsoggu, gwen-abingassurmalad.
E-sapingan Jacobo, degi, Juan, deyob daksamargu, Jesúsʼga sogdemalad: —Dummad, igi epenne Elías nibneg-akar soo odesa, ¿deyob anmar nibneg-akar soo odedabi be abege? Adi, wemar bela-ogumakegar.
Geb degi, Jesús amarsik atakdegu, amarga sabsur sogded: —Ar bemar wissulid igid-burba be gumala.
Ar ani Dule-Machi, nonigua, dulemar-san-burba-obelogega an nonisulid. An nonikid, dulemar-san-burba-abonogegar. Geb degi, Jesús na e-sapinganmala neggwebur-baidse nadmarsunnad.
Jesús na e-sapinganmala nadgua, dule-wargwen igarba ega sokalid: —Dummad, ar bia be naoe, an beba naiguoed.
Jesús a-dulega sogded: —Ar usmardi na e-gubya nikad, sikwimar-gukudimaladi na e-uu nikamarmogad. Ar andi Dule-Machi, neg sated.
Jesús, dule-baidga sogded: —An-sapinga-guega, anba be dage. Dule abin-sogded: —Dummad, bina an-babse an nagwelo, an-bab-burgwedse geb beba an naoed.
Jesús ega sogded: —Ar dulemar-burbar-bato-burgwar-gudidimaladi, na e-burgwarmalad digoed. Ar bedi, nae, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidgi dulemarga be sunmaknae.
Geb degi, dule-baid Jesúsʼga sogdemogad: —Dummad, an beba naoed, ar bina an-neg-yaginmaladga degimaloye an sognagwelo.
Jesús aga sogded: —Ar dule neg-imuddibe, gwen yarganba bar-ataksurdaed. Ar degisulile, dule yarganba atakele, e-napa-imunaid ega biir-biir imulego-itole.
Deyob we-ibmar-gusad-sorba, Jesús e-sapingan-baigan e-dulapaa-gakambe (70), bela na e-naoed-neggweburmarse ebo-ebo e-iduar barmisad.
Jesús amarga sogded: “Napira an bemarga soged, nainugi ibmar-gwag-weleged bukidarad, ar e-weemaladdina ichee gued. Degisoggu, nainugi ibdula-gwag-weleged-e-ibedse be wilesakwaa egismar, adi, e-nainuse ibdula-gwag-wemalad-barmidagegar.
”Be namar, sibad-wawaad-sapingwagwadyob, achu-burburmalad-abargi, an bemar barmidmar.
Mer mor-sagu sedmalo, mani-sagu surbar, degi, sapat surbar, degine, melle igarba dule-absomarbalo.
”Ar doa-negse be dogdapmalale, agi bina be soggweloed: ‘We-neggi bemar gwage-bogidikidgi gudigusunye.’
”Ar a-neggine dule-gwage-bogidikidgi-nanaed maile, be-ega-sogsadyob a-dulegi gwage-bogidikidi beoed. Ar degisulirdi, ega-be-sogsadyob gwen guosulid.
Bemar unnila neg-gwagwenginbi be gabmaloed. Degine, ibu bemarga gunnega, gobega ukarmardibe, be gunno, be gobo. Ar ade, dule-arbaedi bennuklegergebed. Mer neg-baid-baidgi gabdii gumalo.
”Ar biti-neggweburse be dogdapmardibe, agine, be-abingasmalale, ibi-masgunned bega ukarmalale, be gunnoed.
A-neggweburgi dule-gegumaladi be nudakoed, degine, dulemarga be sogoed: ‘Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid bemarse warmaksasunye.’
”Ar biti-neggweburse be dogdapmardibe, agine be-abingassurmalale, be e-galimbaba noalidgi, be sogmaloed:
‘Be-neggwebur-olli-anmar-sapatgi-nagusadse-bakar, anmar elimarsun. We oyoged, bemarginye, bemar yapa Bab-Dummad-igar-abingamaladye. Degi-inigwele, be wisgumalo, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid bemarse warmaksad.’
”Ani, Jesús, an bemarga soged, Bab-Dummad-igar-nabogoed-ibagangi, neggwebur-be-abingaosulid, Sodoma-neggweburba bur bule sabsur-odurdaklegoed.”
Jesús sogdebar: “¡Corazín-dorgan be duledar-wilesmar! ¡Betsaida-dorgan be duledar-wilesmar! Ar bemar sabsur-odurdaklenonikoed. Ar Tiro-neggweburgi, degi, Sidón-neggweburgi we-ibmar-dakledisurmalad imaklesana, a-neggweburmar bato dikasurgus sagumor-ai-aid yosmalanad, degine, burugi obsamarbalinad, adi, oyogegar, emarde, na e-isguedga bukib ulubgi nue-itosmarye.
Degisoggu, an bemarga sogsun, Bab-Dummad-igar-nabogoed-ibagangi, bemar bur bule Tiro-dorganba, degi, Sidón-dorganba sabsur-odurdaklemaloed.
”Emide, bemar Capernaúm-dorgan, ¿nibneggi, nued abingalegoye be binsamala? Suli. Aka be nega-uluba odurdakleged-negse be balimelledmaloed.”
Jesús, dulapaa-gakambe-barminaidga (70) sogdebar: “Ar dulemar be-itomalale, an-ega-ibmar-soged-itonaiyob gumalodo. Ar dulemar be-abingasurmalale, an-abingasurmalayob gumalodo. Ar dulemar an-abingasulile, dule-an-barmialid-abingasurmardo.”
Jesús e-dulapaa-gakambe-barmisadi (70), gannar nonimargu, ise-weligwar-ito nonimalad, Jesúsʼga sognonimalad: —Dummad, niamarse-bakar, be-nuggine anmar-sogedba ibmar imaksamalad.
Jesús amarga sogded: “Mer be na san-dummarba itomalo. Nia-saila-Satanás, mar-gaedyob nibneggi argwannali an daksad.”
Jesús e-sapinganga sogdebar: “Emide, bemarga gangued an uked, naibemar-birgi, degine, diormar-birgi annaegar. Degine, bela be-isdarad-Satanás-ganguedgi-nakwega bemarga gangued an uked. Amar gwen be-oakalogosurmalad.
Degi-inigwele, niaburbamar bemar-sogedba ibmar-imakedgi mer be weligwar itomar. Bur be bemar-nug-nibneggi-narmakar-naid-ular be wergumar.”
Geb agi Jesús, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledba nue-weligwar ito naded, sogded: “Baba, an be-nug odummosun. Bedi, nibneg-e-dummadid, napneg-e-dummadid, degine, bedi, dulemar-ibmar-wismalad-idu, dulemar-ibmar-magar-itomalad-idu, we-ibmarmar odukusad, aku-ito be imaksad. Dulemar-baisursunnagwadga bur be osanalosad, adi, amar magar itomalagar. Eye, Baba, ar ade, deyob be abesad.”
Jesús sogdebar: “Bela-ibmarmar an-Bab anga uksad. Dulemar wargwensaar Bab-Dummad-Machi-mag-daked satemalad, unnila Bab-Dummadbi mag daked, degi, Bab-Dummad-akudakmarbalid. Unnila E-Machibi mag Bab-daked, ar doaga E-Machi na e-Bab-osanalobie, agarbi na osanaloged.”
Jesús na e-sapinganse aibilidgu, amargarbi sogded: “Dulemar bemar-ibmar-dakedyob-dakmarmogadgi egi ise-nued binsalesad.
Ar ani an bemarga sogmalad, bukidar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad, degi, reymar, emi-bemar-ibmar-daked, dakbigusmalanad, amar gwen daksasurmalad, degi, amar emi-bemar-ibmar-itoged, itobigusmalanad, amar gwen itossurmalad.”
Agine, Moisés-Igar-Mamaid-oduloged-wargwen, gwisgualid, Jesús-yardakega yamo sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, ¿burba-geg-bergued an nikuegala, ibu an imakergebe?
Jesús, abin-sogded: —¿Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidgi igi narmakar maisunna? ¿Igi be absodisunna?
A-dule, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —‘Bab-Dummad-be-Dummadbi, bela-belad be-gwagegi be sabguoed, bela-belad be-san-burbagi, bela-belad be-ganguedgi, bela-belad be-binsaedgi be sabguoed.’ Deuteronomio 6:5 ” ‘Ar igi na be san-sabgue, deyobi dule-baid be sabgumogoed.’ ” Levítico 19:18
Jesús aga sogded: —Nued be an-abin-imaksad. Ar be sogsadyob be imakdo, geb agi be degisadegu dula gudiguoed.
Ar Moisés-Igar-Maid-oduloged-nue-wisid na dukin dule-nuedga-imakbisoggu, Jesúsʼga sogded: —¿Degite, doa-dule-baid an sabguergebsunna?
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: “Ibagwengi, dule-wargwen Jericó-neggweburse, Jerusalén-neggweburgi aidedani gusad. Igarba danigu, atursamalad-argangi gusad. Atursamalad sarsosmargu, bela ei ibmar susmalad, burgwedani mete nadmalad.
”Dakargu, Judío-wargwen, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled, a-igarba aidedani gusad. Dule-naibigus-mellemaid-daksagu, egi bakar nasad.
”Amba deyob Judío-baid, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-e-bendaked-Levita-dule, dule-naibigus-maid-walikgusgu, daksamogu, egi bakar nasa gusmogad.
”Ar dule-wargwen, Samariaʼgined, igarba nadapmogu, dule-naibigus-maid-daknonimogad. Ar we-dule, Judíoʼsur-inigwele, dule-naibigus-maid-dakdegu, nue-wile dakded.
Samariaʼgined dule-naibigus-maidse-warmakdapgu, e-nailikgusmaladgi ega ina imaksad, ibmar-gwallu, degi, vino, egi eosad. Geb degi, ega nue-morgogi edichabalid. Geb moli-uayasuid-birgi-onakwisa meged-negse senonikid. Agi nue-akwisad.
”A-banedgine, Samariaʼgined nasokargu, mani-gwabo onosad. Neg-dakedga mani uksad, geb ega sogded: ‘Nue we-dule be anga ako. Degine, igi-mani-napi egi be misale, gannar an aibilisar, an be-bennuknonikoed.’ ”
Moisés-Igar-Maid-oduloged-nue-wisidga Jesús sogded: —Be itogua, we-dulemar-e-warbaagwad ¿doa bur dule-nailikgusad sabedgi bendas be itosunna?
Moisés-Igar-Maid-oduloged-nue-wisid Jesúsʼga sogded: —Ar dule bur-nue dule-nailikgusad-wile-daksad, a-dule, bur dule-baid nue-sabgusdo. Geb degi, Jesús ega sogded: —Igi-Samariaʼgined dule-baid-bendaksad, deyob be imaknamosundo.
Jesús na e-sapinganmala igarba nadapgu, neggwebur-gwensakse dogdapid. A-neggweburgi ome-wargwen, Martaʼye-nugadi, e-neggi Jesús-abindaksad.
We-omede urba-nikad, Maríaʼye-nugad. María, Jesús-walik sigisad, Jesús-ibmar-odurdaked itosii gusad.
Ar Martaʼdi ibmar-saedginbi binsanaisoggu, obir-obir gunaid. Marta, Jesúsʼga sogded: —Dummad, an-urba wargwen arbaega-an-imaknaid ¿be baisur dake? Ega be soge, wis an-bendakye.
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, ega sogded: —Marta, Marta, ibmar-imakedba be surbinsa itonaid, obir-obir be itonaid.
Ar unnila ibmar-soggwenbi bur-nuedid. Ar Maríaʼdi ibmar-soggwen-bur-nued susad, an-sunmaked-itoged. A-ibmar Maríaʼgi gwen egwallegosulid.
