Geb amarga sogded: —We-dule-be-anga-senonimalad, egi be anga sognonimalad, we-dule, neg-gagadiiye. Ar bemar-wagab an ese ibmar egichisad. Degite, we-dule neg-ichodiiye bemar sogedi, gwen an deyob daksulid.
Ar Herodesʼbela gwen-neg-oakalossuli daksamogad. A-ulale, gannar anse we-dule barmialid. Degisoggu, Jesús gwen-neg-oakalossursoggu, oburgwilegewilubsulid.
Unnila an nue-sabsur-odurdakoed. A-sorba, an we-dule onogoed.
Ar ibagi, gusgu Pilatoʼde igar-maidba dule-wargwen-esgaryagi-mellesiid onodaed.
Ar dulemar-bukidar-bukwaddi bela dule-wargwennayob oimakdemalad, sogdemalad: —¡We-Jesús be oburgwe! ¡Barrabás be anmarga onoge!
We-Barrabásʼde Jerusalénʼgi, Roma-dulemargi gwisgusad-ular, degi, dule-oburgwisbalid-ular, esgaryagi metegusmalad.
Pilato Jesús-onobiedba idu-sogsadyobi gannar dulemarga sogdebalid.
Ar dulemardi oimakdemarbalid: —¡Nakrusgi bioke! ¡Nakrusgi bioke!
Geb Pilato gannar ilapaagi dulemarga sogdebalid: —Ar degite, we-dulede, ¿ibu-ibmar-isgana-imaksa be dakmarsunna? Ar gwen ibmar-isgana imaksasur an daked. Degisoggu, oburgwilegewilubsulid. Unnila an nue-sabsur-odurdakoed. A-sorba, an we-dule onogoed.
Ar dulemardi binnasuli oimakdemalad, nakrusgi Jesús-biokye, sogdemalad. Ar degite, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degi, dulemar-oimakbukwad-sogedba bur imaklesad.
Geb degi, Pilato dulemar-egisbukwadba imaksasunnad, Jesúsʼga nakrusgi-oburgwed-igar mesissunnad.
Pilato, dulemarga, Barrabás-Roma-dulemargi-gwisgusadi, emar-oburgwisad-ular-esgaryagi-mellesiid, onossunnad. Geb Pilato suar-ibmalaga Jesús-uksasunnad, adi, dulemar, e-itolegedba Jesús-imakmalagar.
Roma-suar-ibgan Jesús-sesmargu, dule-wargwen Jerusalénʼse-dani abinguarmalad. We-dulede, Cireneʼginedid, Simónʼye nugad. Gandikidgi a-dule-gasmalad, agine, e-gukingi nakrus-mesismalad, adi, Jesús-sorba nakrus-semai guegar.
Dulemar-bukidar Jesús-sorba duurmaknadap gusmalad. Omegandi, Jesúsʼga bonadapi, degi, bukib-binsaedba ega oimaknadapi gusmalad.
Jesús omegansik aibiridgua, amarga sogded: “Omegan-Jerusalénʼginmalad, mer anga be bomar. Na dukin be bomar, be-mimmiganga be bomar.
Ibagan nonikoed, dulemar sogdamaloed: ‘Omegan-geg-mimmi-nikumaladgi ise-nued binsalesye. Omegan-gusgu-muu-neggi-geg-gurgin-nikumaladgi ise-nued binsalesye. Degi, omegan-mimmigan-onussurmaladgi ise-nued binsalesye,’ sogdamaloed. ‘Ar we-omegandi na-e-mimmiganba gwen wilegosulid.’
Geb degi, dulemar sabsur-wilenaidba yarmarga sogdemaloed: ‘¡Be anmargi batedage!’ Yar-mulluganga sogdemaloed: ‘¡Be anmar-omursunna!’ Oseas 10:8
”Anbela an gwen-neg-oakalossulid-inigwele, weyob an-imaknanaid. Dule-neg-oakalosar-bulesunna, bur bule wiomalodo.”
Suar-ibgan dule-isganamar-warbo oburgwemalaga Jesúsʼba semai gusmarbalid.
Nonogarye-neg-nugadse mosmargu, agi nakrusgi Jesús-bioksamalad. Dulemar-isgana-warbogwad nakrusgi bioklesmarmogad. Wargwen, Jesús-argan-nuedsik ogwichismalad. Baiddi, Jesús-argan-sapiledsik ogwichismalad.
Degi, Jesús sogded: “Bab-Dummad, we-dulemar isgussuliyob be dako, ar wissurmalad ibu imaknanai.” Degi, suar-ibgan Jesús-morgi dodoarmalad, wilubdaknai-guarmalad, igid-mor emargadga guodibeye. A-sorba, Jesús-mor mimismarsunnad.
Degine, dulemar-bukidar neg-gunaid dakbukwa gusmalad. Ar neggwebur-dakmamaidi, Jesúsʼgi dodonai gusmalad, sogdedamalad: —Ar ede, dule-baigandi nabir bendaksad. Ar we Cristoʼle, Bab-Dummad-susadile, na dukin bendakdo.
Amba suar-ibgan Jesúsʼgi dodonanai gusmarmogad. Geb gobega, vino-gagbid ega senonimalad,
ega sogdemalad: —Ar be Judíoʼmar-e-Reyle, na be dukin bendakdo.
Jesús-nakrus-birgi, Griego-gayaba, Latín-gayaba, degi, Hebreo-gayaba, weyob narmakar-nai gusad: We-Jesús Judíoʼmar-E-Reyd.
Dule-isgana-wargwen, Jesús-dikarba-nakrusgi-biokar-naimogad, Jesúsʼgi isdar-sunmaknai gusmogad, ega sogded: —Ar be Bab-Dummad-dule-yoedse-barmidagoye-sogsad-dulesursi. Degite, na be dukin bendake. Be anmar-bendakmoga.
Agine, nakrusgi-biokar-naid-baid, Jesúsʼgi-isdar-sunmaknaid-abin-imakded, ese uluded, ega sogded: —Ar Jesús-sunnaa be burgwe-sognaimogad. Degite, ¿be Bab-Dummad-dobsurde?
Ar anmardi nabiridba wilenaid. Ar anmardi, ibmar-isgana-imaksadba odurdaklenaid. Ar we-duledi, gwen ibmar-isgana imaksasulid.
Geb degi, Jesúsʼga sogded: —Be Reyga-negdakmaidgi-danikir, be an-insao.
Geb degi, Jesús, abin-sogded: —Napira an bega soged, emi-ibagi Neg-Nued-naidgi be anba gudiguoed.
Degine, yorukugusgua, bela napneggi negsichid nagusad, wachi-irbaase naigusad.
Degine, dad-ibeler gwen bar gassulid. Jerusalénʼgi Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi, Neg-Islidikid-irwa-mor-naid, negabar achirmakde gusad.
Geb degi, Jesús binnasur goted, sogded: “Baba, be-argangi an-san-burba an uksun.” Deyob-sogsad-sorba, Jesús burgwided.
Roma-sorda-dulatar-sediid (100), weyob-ibmar-gusad daksagu, Bab-Dummad-nug ogannoded, sogded: “Ar we-dule, dule-nueddaed-napiragwadid, gwen-ibmar-oakalossulid.”
Bela dulemar-bukidar, Jesús nakrusgi-burgwenaid-dakbukmalad, bela we-ibmargan-gusad daksamargu, bela-bela na bukib binsadmalad, na dukin-dukin binasgargi sarsonanai negse nadmalad.
Ar bela Jesús-mag-dakmaladi, degi, omegan-Galilea-akar-eba-bipirmakdimaladi, bannaba we-ibmar-gunaid-dakbukwa gusmalad.
Deun, Judío-igar-nabiromalad-wargwen, Joséʼye-nugad mai-gusmogad. A-dulede, Arimatea-neggweburginedid, Judea-yala-dolad. José dakleargu, dule-nuedid, dule-igar-napiragwadbadaed-duled.
We-dulede, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid nue edarbedimogad-duled. Joséʼdi, Jesús-oburgweye sogsamaladba gwen naigussulid, degine, emar-ibmar-imaksamaladba gwen akassurbalid.
We-dulede, Pilatoʼse nadegusad, Jesús-mui egisdapid.
José, Jesús-nakrusgi-burgwar-naid odesgu, atued-sibugi nue-obipirmaksad. Geb degi, José akwa-gwisar neg-uanga-siid-yaba, yoo-dule-egi-diglegedgi Jesús-mesisad.
Deun, a-ibagi, Ibmar-Guagwar-Sied-Ibad, bato obunnoged-iba warmakdanikid.
Omegan-Galilea-akar-Jesúsʼba-danigusmalad, José-Arimatea-sorba nadegusmalad. Neg-uan-siid daksamalad, degi, Jesús-diglesad bia mesilesad daksamarbalid.
Omegan negse-nonimargu, ina-biseb-wawaad, degine, gwallu-wawagwad-nuegan guagwar urbismalad, adi, Jesús-muigi eonamalagar. Geb degine, omegan Moisés-Igar-Maidba obunnoged-ibagi obunnosmarsunnad.
Itoged-iba-gebe-nagudedgine, wakudaryalaba omegan neg-uanse nadmalad. Gwallu-wawagwad-guagwar-imaksamalad sesmalad.
Omegan neg-uanse-mosmargu, bato akwa-dummad-neg-uan-yawagakgi-siid ainirar-sii dakdapmalad.
Neg-uan-yaba dogdemargu, Bab-Jesús-e-mui sate dakarmalad.
Jesús-mui-satedbali, omegan aku itobukmalad, wede igi gusa. Agine, machergan-warbo, mola-sibu-ise-dakar-dakargaed-yoimalad ese gwisgunonimalad.
Ar omegan nue dobe itomaladbali, napase e-bebe-ebulegedse dulluu imaksamalad. Machergan-warbogwad omeganga sogded: “¿Ar ibiga bemar dule-burgwarmalad-abargi dule-dula-gudiid be amimala?
Wegi bar maisuli, gannar durgusa. Ar Jesús amba Galileaʼgi-gudigu, igi bemarga sunmaksa, a be insamala.
Deun, Jesús bemarga sogsagusmalad: ‘Ani Dule-Machi, dulemar-isgudimaladse an uklegergebye, nakrusgi an bioklegergebye, degi, ibapaagi an gannar durguergebye.’ ”
Geb omegan Jesús-ibmar-sogsad ebinsadmalad.
Omegan-neg-uanse-gudimalad nonimargu, bela ibmar-gusad Jesús-sapingan-ambe-gakagwensakadga (11), degi, bela dule-baiganga, sogsamalad.
Omegan Jesús-e-sapingan-bur-dummaganga ibmar-sognonimaladi, wemalad: María-Magdalena, Juana, María Jacobo-e-nan, degi, omegan-baigan-eba-gudimalad.
Ar Jesús-sapingandi omegan-ega-ibmar-soged itossurmalad, binsa ee gordii daksamalad, egi bengusmalad.
Ar Pedroʼdi neg-uanse abarmakde gusad. Neg-uan-mosgu, yaba atakdegu, atuedbi bukwa daksad. Ar Pedro weyob-ibmar-gusad geger daksad, gannar negse aligusad.
Degine, amba a-ibagi dulemar-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-warbo Emaús-neggweburse nadap gusmalad. A-neggwebur Jerusalénʼgi wachi-irbo-nanalegedgi egi siid.
Amar-ebogwadi bela ibmarmar-gusadgi sunmaknadap gusmalad.
Degi-muchub-muchub-sunmaknadapmaladgine, Jesús-sunnad ese warmaknonikid, eba nade gusmogad.
Ar wemar-warbogwad aku Jesús-dake gusmalad. Ar ade, Jesús-dakega emar-ibya bargalesad.
Jesús amarga sogded: —¿Ibigi be sunmaknadapmala? ¿Ibiga be bukib itomarbali?
Gwensak, Cleofasʼye-nugadi, abin sogded: —¿Ar bebi wegi Jerusalénʼgi bela emi-ibmar-gusad wissurde?
Geb Jesús, abin-sogded: —¿Ibu-ibmala? Geb abin-imakdemalad: —Jesús-Nazaretʼginedgi bela-ibmarmar-gusad ¿be wissursi? We-Jesús Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged, gandikidba nued Bab-Dummad-asabin, degi, dulemar-asabin ibmar saed. Degi, gandikidba-sunmaked-dulebalid.
Degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degi, anmar-neggwebur-dakmamaid Roma-dummadga Jesús-uksamalad, adi, oburgwemalagar. Geb nakrusgi Jesús-bioksamalad.
”Ar anmardi we-Jesúsʼgi, Israel-dulemar-abonogoedye binsadii gusad. Emide, ibapaagus deyob neggusad-akalad.
”Ar omegan-anmar-abargi-bipirmakdimarmogadi, geger-ito anmar-imaksad. Ar a-omegande wakudaryalaba neg-uanse nadegusmalad,
degi-inigwele, Jesús-mui neg-uangi amissurmarlad. Degisoggu, gannar anmarse nonimargu, anmarga sognonimalad, emarde ibya apurusmarye, baliwiturmar-daksamarye. A-baliwiturmar ega sogsamarye, Jesús dula gudiiye.
”Degine, a-sorba, abala anmar-sordamar neg-uanse nadegusmarmogad. Ar igi-omegan-sogsamala, deyob dakdapmalad. Gwen-Jesús daksasurmarmogad.”
Geb degi, Jesús amar-warbogwadga sogded: —Bemar akusunna itomalad. Bemar Bab-gayaburba-barsogmalad-sogsamalad-bengumalad-dulemarbalid.
Ar Cristoʼde nibnegse dummadga-megnaed-iduar bela-bela weyob wilegergebed.
Geb Jesús we-dulemarga Bab-Garda-narmakar-maidba egi-sunmaklenaid bela sogsad. Moisés-sogsad-narmakar-naidgi onoded, degi, bela Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogsamalad egi-sogsamaladse ega ibmar sogsad.
Neggwebur-nadapmaladse warmaksamargu, Jesúsʼdi yamo nadegusaeyob imaksad.
Ar emar-warbogwad Jesúsʼgi ise-alamaknai gusmalad, ega sogdemalad: —Anmarba be beeye, bato neg sedogusye, bato neg mutikgudaniye. Degisoggu, Jesús, emarba bessunnad.
Degi, mas-gunnega mese-naba sigdemargu, Jesús madu-susa imaksad. Geb Bab-Dummadga dog-nuedye-sogsagu, madu bisge-bisge imaksad, geb emarga uksad.
Geb degi, e-warbogwad Jesús-mag-dakdemalad. Degi-sii emar-idu binnided, gwen bar daksasurmalad.
Geb degi, ebogwad na muchub-muchub sokarmalad: “Anmarga igarba Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sunmakdanigu, anmar-gwagede, ¿nue-weligwar itodani-gussursi?”
Wemar-warbogwad a-gines, a-wachigi, gannar Jerusalénʼse aligusmalad. Jerusalénʼse nonimargu, Jesús-sapingan-ambe-gakagwensakad (11), degi, dulemar-baigan-eba-bukmarmogad danar-bukwa daknonimalad,
sogbukmalad: —Ar Dummad-Jesús nue-gannar durgusye, Simónʼse Jesús magarosye.
Geb emar-ebogwadi, e-sordagan-bukmaladga sogsamarmogad, igi-igarba gusmala, degine, igi-emarde Jesús madu-bisge-bisge-imaksagu, magar daksamala.
Jesús-sapingan amba we-ibmar-gusadgi sunmakbukmala, Jesús emar-abargi gwisgunonikid. Amarga sogded: —¡Na, degite! Ulubgi bogidik be gudii gumarsun.
Abin bela-bela gwakidmalad, nue-dobe itodmalad, emarde sergan-dakye bimalad.
Ar Jesúsʼdi amarga sogded: —¿Ar ibiga be nue-dobe itomarsunna? ¿Ibiga be beneyob itomarsunna?
An-argan be dakmala, an-nag be dakmarbali. Ar amba an-sunnad an gued. Be an-dakmar, be an-ebumar, ar an-sunnad an gued. Ar burbadi san sulid, garmar surbalid. Ar andi san nikad, garmar nikbalid. Be an-dakmalana.
Deyob-soggwichidgi, emarga e-argan, degi, e-nag oyoded.
Ar e-sapingandi yeer-itogedbali, degi, weligwaledbali, Jesús-durgusad geger dakmalad. Degisoggu, Jesús amarga sogdesunnad: —¿Masgunned be wis nikmala?
Geb ega ua-naraled bisgar uksamalad.
Jesús e-sapingan-annik susgua, amar-asabin guchad.
Jesús amarga sogded: —Amba an bemar-abargi gudigu, bemarga bato weyob an sogsad: ‘Moisés-Igargi-Angi-Narmakar-Maidi, bela angi guergebye. Degi, Bab-gayaburba-barsogmalad-angi-narmaksamaladba, degine, Salmosʼgi angi-narmakar-maidba bela angi guergebye an bemarga sogsamalad.’
Degisoggu, Jesús Bab-Dummad-Gardagi-ibmar-sognaid e-sapingan-magar-itogega imaksad.
Jesús amarga sogded: “Weyob-narmakar-naid: ‘Cristo wilegergebye, ibapaagi gannar durguoye.
Degine, bela we-napneg-naid-ugakaase angi sunmaklegoye. Adi, na dulemar e-isguedga-bukib-binsamalagarye, e-daed ogwamalagarye, degidbali, Bab-Dummad dulemarga isgued elinonikoye. We-igarmargi sunmaklegedi Jerusalén-akar onodoye sognaid.’
Ar bemar-sunnad we-igargan-angi-gusad daksamarsoggu, baiganga bemar sogmarmogo.
”Emide, an-Bab bemarga sogsagusad, an bemarga ukoye, a an bemarga barmidagoed. Jerusalén-neggweburgi be edarbemalo, nibneg-akar burba-gangued bemarse nonikoedse.”
Degi, Jesús, Betaniaʼse e-sapingan sesagusad. Agi na e-argan niba-onakwidgu, e-sapingangi ise-nued binsasad.
E-sapingangi-ise-nued-binsagwichidgi, Jesús emargi banguded, nibnegse nakwide gusad.
Geb e-sapingana, Jesús-nug-ogannodmalad. Nue-weligwaledba gannar Jerusalénʼse aligusmalad.
Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi gudigudamalad, Bab-Dummad-nug-ogannodii, degi, Bab-Dummadgi-nued-binsabukwa damalad. Be itomargua.
Gebe-negasailaunni bato Gayaburba gudiid. We-Gayaburba, Bab-Dummadba gudiid, degi, we-Gayaburba, Bab-Dummad gued.
We-Gayaburba, gebe-negasailaunni bato Bab-Dummadba gudiid.
We-Gayaburbaba bela ibmar obinnilesad. We-Gayaburba-imaksasuli, ibmar-obinnilesad gwen ambikussulid.
We-Gayaburbagi san-burba-dulad maid. We-san-burba-dulad, dulemarga gwallu-meegwadga gued.
Gwallu-meegwad, negsichid-mee imaked, degine, negsichid gege gwallu-meegwadgi obined.
Bab-Dummad, dule-wargwen barmiargusad. We-dule, Juanʼye nugad.
We-dule, gwallu-meegwad-barsogega nonikid, adi, bela dulemar a-gwallu-meegwad mer bengumalagar.
We-dule-Juanʼye-nugadi, gwallu-meegwadsulid. We-dule, unnila gwallu-meegwad-barsogegala nonikid.
We-gwallu-meegwad we-napnegse-danikidi, napiragwadid. We-gwallu-meegwad bela dulemarga neg-mee imaked.
We-gwallu-meegwad we-napneggi gudigusad. Ar we-napneg a-sogedba nagus-inigwele, degite, dulemar-we-napneggi-bukmalad akudaksamalad.
We-gwallu-meegwad e-dulemarse nonikinad, e-dulemar gwen abingassurmalad.
Ar bela dulemar we-Gayaburba-abingasmaladdi, e-nuggi-bengussurmaladba, amarga Bab-Dummad-e-mimmiganga-guega igar-uknonikid.
We-dulemala, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledba gwalulenonimalad. Dulemar-sogedba gwalulessurmalad, dulemar-igarginsulid, dulemar-binsaedginsurbalid. Wemar Bab-Dummad-sogedba Bab-Burba-Isligwaledgi gwalulenonimalad.
We-Gayaburba, anmaryobi sanale san-nika gunonimogad, degine, anmar-abargi sanale gudigusmogad. Anmar e-gangued-yeerdakleged daksamalad. Unnila Bab-Machi-Wargwenna-Gued-e-gangued-yeerdakleged anmar daksamalad. We-dule, nue-dulemar-sabe nanadii gusad. Degine, igar-napiragwadgi nanadii gusbalid.
Diigi-dule-oged-Juan a-dulegi sunmaksagusad, sogdegusad, deun binnasur gotegusgu: “An a-dulegi bemarga sunmaksa gusmalad: ‘Dule-wargwen an-sorba-danikoedi, a, an-iduedid, ar a-inse an-idu gudiguad.’ ”
Ar a-dule, bela-bela anmargi nued binsamaisoggu, belagwapa ibmar-nikadba ibmar-nuegan anmarga ukmaiguad.
Ar Bab-Dummad Moisésʼba dulemarga igar mesisad, dulemar igi nanaergebe. Ar Bab-Dummad na e-nue-sabeddi, degi, e-igar-napiragwaddi, Jesucristoʼba anmarga uknonikid.
Dule gwen Bab-Dummad dakdisulid. Unnila Bab-Dummad-Machi-Wargwennagwad, e-Babba-mesa-gudiid, a, anmarga Bab-Dummad-osanalononikid.
Diigi-dule-oged-Juan weyobi Jesúsʼgi sunmaksagusgu, weyob gusdo. Deunni, Judíoʼmar-dummagan Jerusalén-akar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, degi, a-bendakmalad-Levitaʼmar barmiargusad, Juanʼse-egismalaga: —¿Be doa-dulesunna?
Juan gwen yapa-soge gussulid. Innikigwadba sogsad: —Ani an Cristoʼsulid.
Degi, gannar Juanʼse egichidmarbalid: —Degite, ¿be doa-dulesunna? ¿Be Elías? Juan, abin-imaksad: —Suli, an a-dulesurbali. Juanʼga sogdemarbarsunnad: —Degite, ¿be Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged anmar edarbediiddi? Juan, abin-imakdebalid: —Suli, an a-dulesuli.
Degi ega sogdemarsunnad: —Degite, ¿be doa-dulesunna? Ar anmar dule-anmar-barmialidga sogergebed, be doa-dule. Degite, ¿doa-duleye na be sogsunna?
Juan, abin-sogdegusad: —Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Isaías sogsa gusad: ‘Dule-wargwen nega-dulesulidganba binnasur sunmaknonikoed, dulemarga sognonikoed: Dule-Dummad-idu igar mayemar, igar swilidik mesmar.’ Isaías 40:3 Ani an a-duledo.
Dulemar-Juanʼse-barmilear-gusadi, Fariseo-sapingan gumalad.
Amar Juanʼse egichiarmalad, ega sogdemalad: —Ar bede Cristo-sulidde, degi, Elías-surbalidde, degine, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-anmar-edarbediid-surbalidde. Ar degite, ¿ibiga be Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar imakdisunna?
Juan, amar-abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Andi Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imakedi, unnila diigi dule-ogdiid. Ar bemar-abargi dule-wargwen-gudiiddi aku be dakmalad.
A-dule an-sorba-danikidi, we an-iduedid. Ar anba bur dule-dummadsoggu, e-sapat-dubse-bakar geg an ei esiked.
We-degigusadi, Betania-neg-nugadgi, Jordán-diwar-obakar, bia Juan Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imaknai, agi deyob gusdo.
A-banedgine, Juan, Jesús-ese-dani-dakargua, sogded: “Be dakmalana, we-dule, Bab-Dummad-Sibad-Wawaad-E-Mimmid, bela dulemarga we-napneggi isgued-osulogedid.
We-dulenik an sogsagusad: ‘Dule-wargwen an-sorba danikid, a-dule an-iduedid, ar ade, a-inse an-idu gudiguad.’
Aku a-dule an dakmoganad. A-ulale, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar an imaknonikid. Adi, Israel-dulemar Bab-Dummad-epenne-barmidagoye-sogsad-dule magar dakmalagar.”
Juan, Jesúsʼnik sogsagusbalid: “Nibneg-akar Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled nuuyobi aidedani, an daksad. Degi, a-dulegi signoni an daksad.
An a-dule akudakmoganad. Ar Bab-Dummad E-diigi-ogleged-igar-imakega-an-barmialidi, anga sogsad: ‘Dule-wargwengi Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled nuuyob-aidedani, degi, egi signoni, be daksale, we-dule, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledgi dulemar-ogoed-duledo.’
We deyob an daksad. Degisoggu, an sogdo, we-dule, nue-Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadye.”
A-banedgine, Diigi-dule-oged-Juan, degine, e-sapingan-warbogwadmala iduar-gudigusadgi gannar gudiid.
Deunni dakalid, Jesús e-walik gudii. Geb Juan sogded: —Be dakmalana, we-dule, Bab-Dummad-Sibad-Wawaad-E-Mimmid.
Juan-e-sapingan-warbogwad degi-soge-itosgu, Jesúsʼba nadegusmalad.
Jesús sorba-atakdegu, dule-warbogwad eba-dani-dakargu, amarga sogded: —¿Ibu be amimala? Amar, abin-sogdemalad: —Rabí, ¿bia be mai? (Rabí sogleged, odurdaked-sailaye).
Jesús amarga sogded: —Be dagmar. Degi, be dakmaloed bia an mai. Amar Jesúsʼba nadegusmalad, degi, daksamalad bia Jesús mai. A-ibagi Jesús-walik osedosmalad, ar ade, bato sedosad.
Dule-warbogwad Juan-sunmak-itosgu Jesúsʼba nadegusmaladi, wargwenadi Andrésʼye-nugad, Simón-Pedro-e-urbad.
Andrésʼde, e-ia-Simón-inse aminaded. Simón-amisgu, ega sogded: —Anmar Mesías-amisad. (Mesías sogleged, Cristoʼye).
Geb degi, Andrés, Jesúsʼse e-ia-Simón-senonikid. Jesús, Simón-nuu-dakdegu, ega sogded: —Be, Simón Jonás-machi, emigindi, Cefasʼye be nugguoed. (A sogleged, Pedroʼye).
A-banedgine, Jesús Galileaʼse naesokargu, Felipe-dakalid, ega sogded: —Anba be dage.
Felipe, Betsaida-neggweburginedid. Andrés, degi, Pedro, a-neggweburginmarmogadid.
Felipe, Natanael-aminaded. Amisgu, ega sogded: —Anmar dule-wargwen amisad. Igi Moisés e-Igar-Mesisadgi-narmaksagusa, degi, igi Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad narmaksagusmarmoga, yoedse dule-wargwen danikoye, a-dule anmar amisad. A-dule, Jesúsʼye-nugad, Nazaretʼginedid, José-machid.
Natanael, abin-sogded: —¿Ar Nazaret-neggweburgi sunna ibmar-nued nodasi? Felipe, abin-sogded: —Be anba dage, adi, be-sunnad be dakoed.
Jesús, Natanael-ese-warmakdani-dakargu, Natanaelʼgi sogded: —Wedi, Israel-dule-sunnadid, dule-nuedid. We-dule, e-gwagegi emar-yardaked gwen naisulid.
Natanael Jesúsʼga sogded: —¿Wede igi be an-wisi an deyobid? Jesús, abin-sogded: —Amba yoo Felipe bese goleunni, deun sapi-higuera-urba amba be sigua, bato an be-daksad.
Natanael Jesúsʼga sogdesunnad: —Rabí, be Bab-Dummad-Machid, Israel-e-Rey-sunnadid. A-ular, be an-wisid.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —¿Higuera-sapi-urba-sii an be-daksaye an bega sogsad-ulale, be an-bensuli? Weba bur bule ibmar-dummagan be dakoed.
Jesús sogdebar: —Napira an bemarga soged, emi-onodedgi bemar nibneg-argade, degi, Bab-Dummad-e-baliwiturmar Dule-Machigi nakwemai, degi, aidemai, be dakoed.
A-ibapaagwad-sorba Galilea-yargi, Caná-neggweburgi, dule-wargwen ome-nikuna gusad. Agine, Jesús-e-nan sii gusmogad.
Dule-ome-nikusokalid, Jesúsʼse, degi, e-sapinganse, a-ibase-dagmalaga ese gochamogad.
Iba-onolenaidgi emarga-vino-galadgua, Jesús-e-nan Jesúsʼga sokalid: —Vino emarga berguded.
Jesús, e-nan-abin sogded: —Omegwa, ¿ibiga deyob be anga soge? An-ibagan amba yoo warmaked.
Jesús-e-nan, neg-ibed-e-maiganga sokalid: —Jesús, ibi imakye bemarga sokalile, a-sogedba, bela be imakmalo.
Deunni, agine mete-akwa gwanergwa (6) dii-siega bukwad. We-metemar, Judíoʼmar e-iba-swilidik-gued-ibagi ebumalad. A-mete-gwagwengi sunna galón-gwadulagwen-wilubdibe (20), galón-gwadulagwen-gakambe-wilubdibe (30), dii siged.
Jesús maimarga sogded: —Bela metemargi dii enomar. Bela nue-ena mete-enosmarsunnad.
Geb Jesús amarga sogdebar: —Emigi be dii weemar, dule-iba-sailaga-gusiidse be sedmar. Degi ase sesmarsunnad.
Iba-sailaga-gusiid bia vino-danikid-wissuli, dii-vinoʼga-binnisad gobsad. Ar maigan-dii-wesmaladdi, wismalad, bia vino daniki.
Geb iba-sailaga-gusiid ome-nikunaidga sogded: —Ar bela dulemar vino-nued-inse mimidamalad. Geb bukidargus-gobmalad-sorba vino-akusaaled mimiddamalad. Ar bedi, vino-nued amba we-wachise sabosad.
Jesús we-ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisurmalad gebe Galilea-yargi, Caná-neggweburgi, imaksa gusad. Agi Jesús, e-gangued-yeerdaklegedi oyosad. Degine, e-sapingan Jesús-nue-bensuli gunonimarsunnad.
We-degigusad-sorbali, Jesús, e-nanmala, e-urbamarmala, degi, e-sapinganmala, Capernaúmʼse aided gusmalad. Agine, dogdar melu megissurmalad.
Deunni, Judíoʼmar-iba, Oburgwilegoenad-Iba-warmakdanikidgi, Jesús Jerusalén-neggweburse nadegusad.
Jesús Babse-goled-negse-dogdapgu, dulemar-moli-bebe-nikad-ukmalad, sibad-wawaad-ukmalad, degi, nuu-ukmalad, bukwa dakdapid. Degine, dulemar agi-mani-ogwabukwa dakdapalid.
Jesús ibmar-bibyoged-dub-sobsagu, Babse-goled-neggi bela dule-ibmar-ukbukmalad onosad. Sibad-wawaadmar, moli-bebe-nikamalad, onisbalid. Deginbali, dulemar-mani-ogwabukwad-e-mani bikin midbalid. E-ibe mesemar obichabalid.
Jesús dulemar-nuu-ukbukmaladga sogded: —We-ibmarmar bela be seedmar. Melle an-Bab-nega ibmar-ukleged-negga be imakmar.
Degi, Jesús-e-sapingan ebinsadmalad, igi Bab-Dummad-gardagi narmakar nai: “An bese-goled-negbina-nue-soged-ular, egi nue-nobe an itoged.” Salmo 69:9
Judíoʼmar, Jesús-abin-imakdemala, ese egisdemalad: —Be anmarse oyogega, Bab-Dummad bega-igar-uksaye weyob be ibmar-imakega, ¿ibi-ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid be anmarga imakosunna?
Jesús, abin-imakded, amarga sogded: —We-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-siid be earmar. An ibapaagi gannar soboed.
Judíoʼmar geb abin-sogdemalad: —We-Bab-Dummadse-goled-negde, birga-dulabo-gakanergwa (46) soblenai gusad. Emide, ¿bede ibapaagi gannar sobode? Geg be sobed.
Ar Jesúsʼdi na e-sangi sunmaknaid, akwa-neg-sobaledgi sunmaknaisulid.
Degisoggu, Jesús-burgwisgu, gannar durgusgu, geb e-sapingan insaas-nadmalad, Jesúsʼde bato deyob sogsagusad. A-ular, Jesús-e-sapingan, Bab-Dummad-Gardagi-narmakar-naidi, degine, Jesús-ibmar-sogsadi, nue-ulubgi abingasmalad, gwen bengussurmalad.
Jesús, Oburgwilegoenad-Ibagi Jerusalénʼgi-gudigu, ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisurmalad-imaksadba, bukidar Jesús-bensuli gunonimalad.
Ar Jesúsʼdi bela dulemar-daed wissoggu, dulemar-bengusad, ar wisid dulemar eba nue-naisuli.
Jesús dule-ega-ibmar-soged gwen abesulid, ar wisid dulemar ulubgi igi binsamala.
Dule-wargwen Fariseo-sorda, Nicodemoʼye-nugadi, Judíoʼmar-abargi nue-nug-nika gudigusad.
We-dulede, mutik Jesúsʼse nonikid, ega sognonikid: —Rabí, odurdaked-saila-dummad, anmar wisid, be anmar-odurdakegala Bab-Dummad be-barmialid. Ar Bab-Dummad we-duleba gudisulile, we-dule gege ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisurmalad imaked.
Jesús, Nicodemo-abin-imakded, ega sogded: —Napira an bega soged, dule gannar gwalulesulile, gege Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid daked.
Nicodemo Jesúsʼse egisdesunnad: —¿Ar igi dule-sered gannar gwalulegosunna? ¿Ar sunna gannar gwalulegega e-nan-nukugi gannar megosi?
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Napira an bega soged, ar dule diigi, degi, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledgi gwalulesulile, gege Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidse doged.
Ar dule wegi-sanale gwalulesale, we, sanaledgadid. Ar dule Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledgi gwalulesardi, we, burbaledgadid.
Degisoggu, mer geg be itoge, an bega soged: Be gannar gwalulegergebye.
”Burwa-goledi e-itolegedba goled, unnila, e-goledbi be itoged. Burwa-danikiddi be wissulid, degi, be wissurbalid, bia nadapbali. Deyobmodo, dule Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledgi gwalulesar.”
Nicodemo, Jesús-abin-sogded: —¿Wede, igi gusunna?
Jesús, Nicodemo-abin-sogded: —Bede Israel-dulemar-odurdakedsailadde, ¿we-igar amba be aku itode?
Napira an bega soged, anmar ibmar-wisidba sunmakmalad. Anmar ibmar-daksadba sogmalad, degi-inigwele, bemar anmar-ibmar-bega-sogedi yapa be abingamalad.
Ar ibmar-we-napnegginmaladgi an bemarga sunmaksad, degite, be benmalad. ¿Ar igi be bengussurmalarsunna an bega ibmar-nibneggined sogdemalar? Be bengusmalaled.
”Dule nibnegse gwen nakwissulid, unnila, ani Dule-Machibi nibneggi-mai aidenonikid.
”Ar igi Moisés nega-dulesulidganba naibe-onakwisgusa, debayobi, ani Dule-Machi, nakrusgi niba onailemogargebed.
Adi, doa-dule angi bengussulile, mer yogguega, burba-geg-bergued angi nikuegar.”
“Ar Bab-Dummad bela we-napneggi-dule-bukwad nue-sabgussoggu, E-Machi-Wargwenna-Guedi barmialid, adi, dulemar-isgued-anar burgwegar. Ar doa-dule Bab-Dummad-Machigi bensuli-gunonikile, burba-geg-bergued nikuoed, adi, mer bar degisadegu, sabsur-odurdaklesii guegar.
Ar Bab-Dummad we-napnegse na E-Machi-barmiargu, dule-we-napneggi-bukmalad-sabsur-odurdakega barmiarsulid. Na E-Machi-barmialid, adi, dule-we-napneggi-bukmalad E-Machigi abonolemalagar.
”Ar doa-dule Bab-Dummad-Machigi bensulile, we-dule sabsur-odurdaklegosulid. Ar dule, Bab-Dummad-Machi-Wargwenna-Gued-e-nuggi-benerdi, bato ega sabsur-odurdakleged-igar maid.
”Gwallu-meegwad we-napnegse nonikid. Degi-inigwele, dulemar bur ibmar-isgana-imakmalad-ulale, bur gwallu-meegwadba negsichid sabgusmalad. A-ular, dulemar sabsur-odurdaklegoed.
”Ar bela dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmaladi, gwallu-meegwad isdar dakdamalad, gwalluse dagbisurdamalad, adi, melle e-ibmar-isgana-imakdiid neg-meegwadse osanalolegegar.
”Ar dule igar-napiragwad-imakdiiddina, gwalluse nonidamalad, adi, e-ibmar-imakdiid na oyogega, ede Bab-Dummadba ibsadiiye.”
A-sorbali, Jesús e-sapinganmala Judea-yalase nadmalad. Agi undar gudii gusmalad, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar imakdii gusad.
Deunni, Diigi-dule-oged-Juan Salim-neggwebur-walik, Enón-neg-nugadgi, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imaknai gusmogad, ar ade, agi dii wilarbad. Dulemar Bab-Dummad-diigi-oglegega Juanʼse nonigusmalad.
Ar deunni, amba yoo Juan esgaryagi melleged.
Agi Juan-sapingan Judíoʼmar-ebo swilidik-gued-igargi abin-abin imakarmalad.
Juan-sapingan, e-dummad-Juanʼse nonimalad, ega sognonimalad: —Odurdaked-saila, dule-Jordán-diwar-obakar-beba-gudigusad, egi be nued-sunmaksad, a-dule, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar imaknaimogad. Dule-bukidar ese duurmaknadapmalad. Degisoggu, be sordamar-sate guoed.
Juan, e-sapingan-abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Ar dule Bab-Dummad-ega-ibmar-uksulile, gege ibmar nikued.
Ar bemar-sunnad an-itosmalad, an sogsagu: ‘Ani an Cristoʼsurye, andi unnila e-idu-igar-mayega barmilearye.’
”Ar ome-nikulenaid-ibagi, dule-ome-nikunaidbi ome-nikuoed. Ar machered-e-aidi, e-dikarba-gwichid, unnila sui-e-sunmaked-itogwichid. Weligwar sui-ibmar-soggwichid itogwichid. Emigindi, an dule-ome-nikunaid-e-aiyobmogad. An nue-weligwar itomogad.
Jesús-nug bur dunguergebed, andi bur nug-bipii guergebed.”
Diigi-dule-oged-Juan sogdebalid: “Ar dule-nibneggi-danikidi, bela dulemargi obined. Dule-napneggineddi, unnila napnegginedid, napneggined-ibmarbi sunmaked. Ar dule-nibneggi-danikiddi, bela dulemargi obined.
”We-dule-nibneggi-danikidi nibneggi-ibmar-daksadba, degi, nibneggi-ibmar-itosadba, sunmaked. Degite, dulemar a-dule gwen-itobisurmalad.
Ar dule, dule-nibneggi-danikid-sunmaked abingaele, we sognaido, Bab-Dummad-ibmar-soged, napiraye.
Ar Bab-Dummad we-dule-barmiarsoggu, a-ulale, we-dule-nibneggi-danikidi, Bab-Dummad-e-gayaburba sunmaked. Ar Bab-Dummad E-Burba ise-obinagwar uked, ise-wilubsaar uksulid.
”Ar Bab-Dummad nue na e-Machi-sabsoggu, bela ibmar E-Machiga uksasunnad.
”Ar doa-dule Bab-Dummad-Machigi bensuli-gunonikile, a-dule, burba-geg-bergued nikuoed. Ar dule Bab-Dummad-Machigi bengunonikirdi, burba-geg-bergued gwen nikuosulid. Aka bur Bab-Dummad-dule-sabsur-odurdaked-igar itogoed.”
Dummad-Jesús wisguargu, Fariseoʼmar weyob dulemar-sunmake itoye: Jesús, diigi-dule-oged-Juanʼba bur bule dulemar-Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged imakdiiye, degi, bur bule sapingan nikbarye.
(Ar Jesúsʼdi Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar imakdisulindo, e-sapingan imakdiinad).
A-ular, Jesús Judea-yargi bangudsunnad, gannar Galilea-yarse nadegusad.
Galileaʼse naegala, Samaria-yargi naergebed.
Jesús, Samaria-yalase, Sicar-neggweburse nonisunnad. Bia dad-Jacob e-machi-Joséʼga nainu-uksad-walik, ase nonisunnad.
Agine Jacob-dia-akwisad siid. Jesús nanasadba yegussoggu, obunnogega a-dia-dikarba sigisad. Deun, bato yorukugusad.
Ome-wargwen, Samariaʼgined, dii-suega a-diase nonikid. Jesús a-omega sogded: —Anga be dii wis-udage.
Ar ade, Jesús-sapingan neggweburse mas-bakega naded.
Judíoʼmar, degi, Samaria-dorgan na ebo geg sunmakmarsoggu, ome-Samariaʼgined, Jesús-abin sogded: —Ar be, Judío-duled. Andi Samariaʼginedid, ar ¿ibiga be anse dii egise?
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, ega sogded: —Ar Bab-Dummad-ibmar-uked be wisina, degine, doa-dule bega soge: ‘Anga dii gobega be udaye,’ ese be dii egisoenad, degine, e bega dii-burba-nikad ukoenad.
Ome, Jesús-abin sogded: —Dummad, ar be dii-weed sated, deginbali, dia matusurbalid, degite, ¿bia be dii-burba-nikadi onogosunna?
¿Ar be anmar-dad-Jacobʼba bur dummadsi? Anmar-dad we-dia anmarga uksad. We-dii na gobsad, degi, e-mimmigan, e-molimar, we-dii gobsamarmogad.
Jesús, ome-abin sogded: —Ar doa-dule we-dii-gobsale, gannar uku-uku itobaloed.
Ar dii-an-ega-ukoed gobsardi, bar gannar uku-uku itogosulid. Ar dii-an-ega-ukoeddi, dii napa-urba-aryomaiyobi, burba-geg-bergued e-ulubgi nikuoed.
Ome, Jesúsʼga sogded: —Dummad, melle an bar gannar uku-uku itogega, we-dii be anga udage. Adi, an melle wese gannar bar dii wedagegar.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Be nae. Be-suise be gornae, degi, gannar be dagbalo.
Ome, abin-sogded: —An, sui sated. Jesús, abin-imakded: —Nabir be soged: ‘An, sui sateye.’
Ar be walatargus sui ogwadanikid. Emi sui-be-nikadi be-suisurbalid. Ar nabir be-sogsad.
Ome, Jesús-abin sogded: —Dummad, an be-dakgua, be Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged an be-dakdo.
Anmar-dadgan-Samaria-dulemar, we-yargi Bab-Dummad-nug odummosmalad. Ar bemar-Judíoʼmardi soged, Bab-Dummad-nug-odummogega Jerusalénʼgi, Bab-Dummadse golergebye.
Jesús omega sogded: —Omegwa, napira an bega soged, mer be an-bengu. Ibagan dani, be Babse-golega, be Bab-nug-odummogega, be we-yarse danikosulid, degine, be Jerusalénʼse naosurbalid.
Bemar Samaria-dulemar be wissurmalad, doa-e-nug bemar odummonanai. Anmar-Judíoʼmardi wismalad, ar doa-e-nug anmar odummomala. Ar ade, dulemar-abonoleged Judíoʼmargi danikid.
Ar ibagan dani, emigindi, bato nonikid, ar dulemar-Bab-Dummad-nug-odummomalad, nue-burbar, degi, napiragwadgi Bab-Dummad-nug odummomaloed. Ar Bab-Dummad dulemar-degi-ese-goled amidimogad.
Bab-Dummad, burbaled. Ar dule-Bab-Dummadse-goledi, burbar, degi, napiragwadgi ese gormogargebed.
Ome, Jesúsʼga sogded: —An wisi, Mesías nonikoed. (Mesías sogleged, yoedse-Dule-Wargwen-Barmiledagoye-soglesad). We Cristoʼye soglebalid. A-Cristo nonikile, bela anmarga ibmar sognonikoed.
Jesús, ome-abin sogded: —Ani an a-duled, bebo-sunmaksiid.
Agi e-sapingan nonikid, amar Jesús ome-ebo-sunmaksiid, geger dakdemalad. Degi-inigwele, gwen ega sogsasurmalad: “¿Ibu omese be egichii? ¿Ibigi ome-bebo be sunmaksii?”
Degi, ome e-gwidu-mete neggweburse nadsunnad. Neggweburse modapgu, macherganga sogdapid:
—Be dagmar, dule-wargwen bela an-ibmar-imaksad-anga-sogsad, be dakdamar, ¿abakalegi we-dule Cristoʼsua?
Degi, dulemar neggweburgi ainiarmargu, bela Jesúsʼse nonimalad.
Degi-gunaigua, e-sapingan Jesúsʼgi wilenai gusmalad, ega sognai guarmalad: —Odurdaked-saila, wis mas be gungwele.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Andi masgunned an nikad, a-masgunned bemar wissurmalad.
Degi, e-sapingan muchub-muchub sokarmalad: “Ar dule-wargwen masgunned ega senonisua.”
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Dule-an-barmialidba an ibmar-imaked, degi, an e-arbaed-obeloged, an-masgunnedid.
Ar bemarde sogsursi: Ibmar-gwag-weed-iba, amba nii-walabake napye. Andi an bemarga sogdo, nue be atakmar, nainu be dakmar. Ibmar-gwag welegega bato guagwar naid. Deyobi, dulemar abonolegega, guagwar bukwad.
”Ar dule-abonolegedgi-arbaedi bennukleged. Degi, burba-geg-berguedga arbabalid. Degisoggu, dule-abonolegega, dule-gebe-Bab-gayaburba-odurdakedi, degi, dulemar-Babgadga-guega-imaked-ebo, na wergumalad.
”Ar we-ibmar-sogleged nue-napira sogleged: ‘Dule-gwensak ibmar-gwag-digedid, dule-baiddi, ibmar-gwag-weedid.’
Bemar ibmar-gwaggi-arbassurmalad-weega an bemar-barminanaid. Dule-baigan arbasmalad, bemar a-arbasadgi dogdemalad.”
Bukidar Samaria-dorgan, Sicar-neggweburginmalad Jesús-bengussurmalad, ar ade, ome Jesúsʼgi sogdiid: “Bela an-ibmar-imaksad anga sogsaye.”
Degine, bukidar Jesúsʼse Samaria-dorgan duurmaknonimalad, egi wilenaigusmalad: “Anmar-walik be beeye.” Jesús amar-walik ibabo dulemar-odurdakega megissunnad.
Ome-ibmar-sogsadba, bur bule bukidar dulemar Jesús-ibmar-sogsadgi bengussurmalad.
A-ulale, omega sokarmalad: —Anmar-Jesúsʼgi-bensulidi unnila be anmarga ibmar sogedginsulid. Ar anmar-sunnad itosmarmogad. Anmar nue-wisid, we-dule napneggi dule-isgubukmalad-abonoged-sunnadid. We-dule, Bab-Dummad-Dule-Wargwen-Barmiledagoye sogsad-duled.
Jesús, Sicar-neggweburgi ibabo megisad-sorbali, Galileaʼse naega Samaria-yargi nodegusad.
Ar Jesús na e-sunnad sogsa gusmogad, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogedi e-neggweburgi geg e-nug odummoleye.
Jesús Galileaʼse nonigu, Galilea-dorgan nuedgi abindaksamalad, ar ade, ibase arbimarmosoggu, agi daksamalad, igi Jesús Jerusalénʼgi ibmar imaksa.
Degisoggu, Jesús gannar Galilea-yarse nonigu, Caná-neggweburse, bia dii vinoʼga obinnisadse, nadegusad. Deun, Capernaúm-neggweburgi dule-dummad-reyga-arbaed-e-machi uellemaid.
We-dule itoargu, Jesús, Judea-yarba-gudiid Galilea-yarse noniye, Jesúsʼse nadegusad. Jesúsʼgi wilenaigualid, adi, e-machi ega nudaknaegar. Ar ade, e-machi burgwedani maid.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisurmalad, degi, ibmar-gegerdaklemalad bemar daksasulina, be an-benmalanad.
Dule-dummad-reyga-arbaed, sogded: —Dummad, an-machi-burgwed-idu gwae be anba dage.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Be nae, be-machi dula gudiid. Reyga-arbaed Jesús-degi-ega-sogsad gwen bengussulid. Degisoggu, e-negse nadegusad.
Negse monadapgu, e-maigan abin-noarmalad. E-dummad-abingusmargu, ega sogdemalad: —Be-machi bato nugusad.
Degi, dummad e-maiganse egichialid igi-wachigi e-machi nuguar gusye. Abin-sogdemalad: —Sae, wachi-irgwengi uelleged gichaye.
Machigwa-e-bab mag itosad, a-wachigi Jesús ega sogsa gusad, be-machi dula gudiiye. Machigwa-e-bab, degine, bela e-negginmalad, Jesúsʼgi bensuli gunonimarsunnad.
Jesús Judea-yargi-gudiid Galilea-yarse nonigu, we-ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid ilabogus Galileaʼgi imaknonido.
We-ibmar-degigusad-sorbali, Judíoʼmar-iba nagunonikid. Agi Jesús Jerusalénʼse nonikid.
Jerusalénʼgi, Sibad-Wawaadye-Yawagak-nugad-naba, dii wilasar naid. A-dii-wilasar-naidi, Hebreo-gayaba Betesdaʼye bileged. A-dii-naid-ebiris doged-imba gwaatar siid.
A-neg-doged-imbamargi bukidar bonikwamalad mamaid, ibyasurmalad, geg-nanamalad, bela-abagan-burgwarmalad, mamaid. Amar dii-sukamaked edarbe mamaimalad.
Ar ade, imbagwenar baliwitur, dii-wilasar-naid-osukamakega aidenonidaed. Ar doa-dule-inse a-dii-wilasar-naid-sukamaksad-sorba diigi-aidesale, ibi-boni-nikadibe, yog-nuguar naddaed.
Agine, dule-wargwen birga-dulagwen-gakambe-gakabaabakgus-uellemaid (38) maimogad.
Jesús a-dule meremai dakalid. Jesús wisguargu, we-dule dikasurgus boni-abgan-burgwaled-nikamaiye, a-dulega sogded: —¿Be nugubie?
Dule-abagan-burgwaled abin-sogded: —Dummad, dii-sukamaksad-sorba dule-diise-an-odeged sate daed. Ar an aidedogu, bato dule-baid an-iduar aidesdaed.
Jesús ega sogded: —Be gwisgu, be-egi-gabed na be sede, be nae.
Jesús-degisogsad-sorba, dule yog-nuguar naded, e-gabed na susa nadsunnad. A-ibagi, deun obunnoged-iba naid.
Agi Judíoʼmar dule-nugusadga sogdemalad: —Emi-ibagi obunnoged-iba naid. Degisoggu, be-egi-gabed be sededsulid.
Dule-nugusad, abin-sogded: —Dule-an-nudaksad, ar anga sogsad: ‘Be-egi-gabed be sedye, be naye.’
Degi, dule-nugusadse egisdemarsunnad: —¿Ar doa bega sogsa, Be-egi-gabed be sedye, be naye?
Ar Jesúsʼde bato dulemar-bukidar-gunanaid-abargi banguded. Degisoggu, ar dule-nugusad, wissulid, doa ega deyob sogsa.
A-sorbali, Jesús, dule-nugusad Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-dakargu, ega sogded: —Emide be nugussoggu, mer be bar isguo. Abakalegi aka bur bule boni-dummad begi danikile.
Dule-nugusad nadegusad, geb Judíoʼmar-owisodapid, Jesús e-onudaksaye.
A-ulale, Judíoʼmar Jesús-bareginnarmarsunnad, Jesús-oburgwebi guarmalad. Ar ade, obunnoged-ibagi we-ibmarmar imakdiid.
Degi, Jesús abin-sogded: —An-Bab gusgu arbanaiguad, degisoggu, an arbadimosundo.
A-ulale, Judíoʼmar bur Jesús-oburgwebi guarmalad, ar ade, Jesús obunnoged-ibabi bisgedisulid. Ar Bab-Dummad an-Bab-sunnadye sogdibalid. Deyob sogdiidbali na Bab-Dummadbo emar imakdiid.
Geb degi, Jesús Judíoʼmarga sogded: —Napira an bemarga soged, Bab-Dummad-Machi wargwengi e-ibmar-imakbiedba ibmar imaksulid, unnila e-Bab-dakedba ibmar imaked. Ar bela e-Bab-ibmar-imakedi, E-Machi a-sunnaa bela ibmar imakmogad.
Ar Bab na Machi-sabsoggu, bela ibmar-imakedi E-Machiga oyoged. Ar weba bur bule ibmar-dummagan Bab ega oyogoed, adi, bemar bur bule geger dakmalagar.
Ar igi Bab dule-burgwar-maid gannar oduloge, ega san-burba-dula-gued uke, amba E-Machi deyobmodo, ar doaga san-burba-dulad ukbie, ega ukodo.
Ar emigi Bab bar dulemarga igar itogosulid. Ar ade, E-Machiga we-igargan uksad,
adi, igi E-Bab-nug ogannodamarmoga, deyobi bela dulemar E-Machi-nug ogannomogagar. Ar dule E-Machi-nug odummosulile, E-Bab-nug odummosurmogad. Ar ade, Bab na E-Machi barmialid.
”Napira an bemarga soged: Ar dule an-sunmakedba daele, degi, Bab-an-barmialidgi bengusulile, a-dule burba-geg-bergued nikuodo. A-dule bar sabsur-odurdaklegosulid. Ar burgwar-gudiidgi nosad, dula gudii gunonisunnad.
Napira an bemarga soged: Ibagan danikoed, emigindi, ibagan nonisunnad. Dule-burbar-burgwar-gudimalad Bab-Dummad-Machi-e-gayaburba itononikoed. Ar dule-a-gayaburba-itomaloedi durgunonikoed.
Ar igi Bab na-dukin dula-gudigued-nika, amba deyob, na E-Machiga na-dukin dulagudigued uksamogad.
Deginbali, ar Dule-Machi-gusoggu, Bab ega dulemarga-igar-itogega igar uksabalid.
”We-igar mer geger be itomar. Ar ibagan danikoed, dulemar-neg-uangi-burgwar-mamaidi, bela Bab-Dummad-Machi-e-gayaburba itomaloed.
Ar dule-ibmar-nued-imaksamaladi, burba-dulad-nikuega gannar durgunonimaloed. Ar dule-ibmar-isgana-imaksamaladdi, odurdakleged-negse-naega gannar durgunonimarmogoed.”
Jesús Judíoʼmarga sogdebalid: “Geg an na dukin wargwengi ibmar imaked, unnila an-Bab-anga-sogedba an dulemarga igar itoged. An-igar-itogedi, innikigwadgi an itoged. Ar wargwen an-itolegedba an ibmar imaksulid, an-ibmar-imakedi, an-Bab-an-barmialid-sogedba an imaked.
”Ar an na dukin ibmar barsogele, an-ibmar-sogedi napiragwadsuliled.
Emigindi, dule-baid an-barsoged, a-ular, an wisid, dule-an-barsoged napiragwadba an-barsogdiid.
”Bemar, Diigi-dule-oged-Juanʼse dulemar-barmiargusad, egisega, be Mesías-sogeye. Juan dulemar-abin-imaksagu, napiragwadgi sogsagusad.
Ar dule-we-napneggined an-barsogega an abingasulid. Degi-inigwele, bemar-abonolemalaga Juan-ibmar-sogsad an bemarga sogmalad.
Ar igi acha-gwallu gummake, degine, mee-gae, deyobi, Juan gudigusad. Ar bemar unnila a-gwallugine wis-ichesaar yeer-itodii abesmalad.
”Ar Juan-an-barsogdigusadba bur bule an na dukin ibmar-barsoged nikad, an doa-dule gue. We, an-barsogedid: Ibmar-imakega Bab arbaed anga igar-uksad. We-ibmar-an-imakdiidi bato oyonaid, Bab an-barmiarye.
Bab-an-barmialidi, bato angi sunmaksa gusad. Bemala bipisaale e-gaya-sunmaked be itodisurmalad, degine, e-dakleged be dakdisurmarbalid.
Deginbali, E-gayaburba bemargi gwen naisurbalid. Ar ade, bemar Bab-bemarse-dule-barmialidi, be a-dule benmalad.
Bab-Dummad-garda-narmakar-maid nue be baramimar, ar agi burba-geg-bergued baramilesiye, be sogmalad. Ar a-gardagi angi sunmaknaid, an doa-dule gue.
Degi-inigwele, bemar burba-geg-bergued-nikuega anse yapa dagmalad.
”Dulemar-an-nug-odummoged, an abingasulid.
Ar an bemar-wisid, bemar, Bab-Dummad-sabsurmalad.
An-Bab-nuggi an bemarse nonikid, degite, be an-abingasurmalad. Ar dule-baid na e-nuggi danikirdi, be a-dule abingasmalaled.
¿Ar igi bemar Bab-Dummad-bensuli gumalosunna? An na be muchub-muchub-san-ogannoed amidimalad. Ar Bab-Dummad-wargwenna-guedgi nug-gangued-danikiddi, bemar amisurmalad.
”Mer be binsamalo, ani an-Bab-asabin bemargi gwisgumaloye. Suli. Moisésʼgi be bendaklegoye binsadimaladi, a-dule, bemargi gwisgumaloed.
Ar Moisés-ibmar-sogsad be bensurmalana, be an-bensurmarmogando. Ar Moisés angi ibmar narmaksad.
Ar Moisés-ibmar-narmaksad be benmalale, degite, ¿igi an-ibmar-sogedgi be bensuli gumalosunna? Geg gued.”
We-degigusad-sorbali, Jesús Galilea-mata-dummad-obakar nade gusad. We-mata-dummad Tiberias-Mataye nugbalid.
Dule-bukidar Jesúsʼba nadegusmalad, ar ade, boni-nikamaladgi ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid-imakdiid daksamalad.
Degidgine, Jesús yar-birse-nakwisgu, agi e-sapinganmala sigdapmalad.
Deun Judíoʼmar-iba, Oburgwilegoenad-Iba bato omosad.
Jesús atakdegu, dakded, dulemar-bukidar ese nonimala. Agi Felipeʼga sogded: —Wemar madu-gunmalaga, ¿wede bia anmar madu bakoe?
Unnila Jesús binsa Felipe-wilubdakega weyob Felipeʼga sogsagusad, ar edi bato wisid igi imakoe.
Felipe, Jesús-abin sogded: —Belagwapa wis madu bipi-bipi-gunmalaga dule-nii-walabaabak-arbasad-manigi (8), madu-bakele, amba madu unnisuliled.
Geb degi, e-sapin-baid-Andrés, Simón-Pedro-e-urba, Jesúsʼga sogded:
—Wegi machigwa-wargwen cebada-madu-gwaatar wis sediid, degine, ua-burwigana wis ukabo sedibalid. ¿Ar wede unniosi? Ar dule bukidarad.
Geb degi, Jesús sogded: —Nabir. Dulemar be urbemar. Agine, gagan-bukidar naid. Agine, dulemar ambikusmargu, geb machergan miliatar-wilub-mergu (5,000) daklealid.
Jesús madu-susgua, Bab-Dummadga dog-nuedye-sogsagu, e-sapinganga madu uke-uke imaksad. Geb e-sapingan dulemar-gagan-birgi-bukmaladga ukdemogad. Jesús amba deyob ua-imaksabalid, ar bule-mergu abemala, abali ega uksamalad.
Bela dulemar immelesmargu, Jesús, e-sapinganga sogded: —Mer binsa mas milegega, bela gwabgusad be wemar.
Cebada-madu-gwaataled bela guchamalad-sorba, gwabgusadi garba-gwaambe-gakabo-mergu (12) wesmalad.
Dulemar, Jesús-madu-gwaataled-omelosad-daksamaladi, sogdemalad: “We, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged we-napnegse-nonikoed-sunnadye.”
Ar Jesús, dulemar ise-ebipiar reyga-guega e-imakdanimalo-daksagu, e-iduar yarse walagwengi banguded.
Dad-argwategu, Jesús-sapingan, Jesús-ega-sogsadba demar-gakase aidenonimalad.
Urgi nakwismargu, Capernaúmʼse-namalaga mata-dummad obakdemalad. Deun, bato neg nue-mutikgusad, Jesúsʼdi amba yoggumaid.
Ar burwa binnasur-gormaisoggu, demar dunguded.
Jesús-sapingan wachi-irbogus, igi, wachi-irbaagus-gammimaladgindibe, dakarmalad, Jesús demar-birgi daniki, e-urse warmakdaniki. Deyob dakarmargu, dobguarmalad.
Jesús e-sapinganga sogded: “Ani an daniki, mer be dobgumar.”
Geb degi, e-sapingan weligwar urgi Jesús-abindaksamalad, degine, bia na nadapmaladse warmaksamarsunnad.
A-banedgine, dule-bukidar Jesúsʼba-mata-obakar-gudimaladi, wisguarmalad ur-wargwen-naigusadgi unnila Jesús-sapinganbi nadmarye. Jesúsʼdi e-sapinganba urgi nadsurye.
Ur-baigan-Tiberias-neggweburgi-danimaladdi, bia dulemar Bab-Jesús Babga-dog-nuedye-sogsad-sorba madu-omelosad-guchamalad-walik nagunonikid.
Ar dulemar, Jesús-daklesur-dakargu, degi, e-sapingan-sate-dakarmargu, Jesús-amiegala, urgi Capernaúm-neggweburse nadegusmalad.
Dulemar mata-dummad-obakar Jesús-amismargu, ega sogdemalad: —Odurdaked-saila, ¿sana wese be noniki?
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, emarga sogded: —Napira an bemarga soged, be an-amimaladi, an-ibmar-dakledisulid-imaksadba be an-amisurmalad. Ar bemar madu-nue-immedik-guchadba be an-amimalad.
Mas-baisursunna-bergumaladga mer be arbamar. Mas-anmarga-burba-geg-bergued-ukedga be arbamar. Ar a-masdi, sunna bemarga, Dule-Machi ukoed. Ar a-dulegine, Bab-Dummad bato e-wilub nasiksad, burba-geg-bergued nikumalagar.
Degi, Jesús-abin sogdemarsun: —Degite, ¿ibu an imakmalosunna Bab-Dummadga ibmar-imakegar?
Jesús, abin-imakded: —Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-imaked wedo: Bab-Dummad-bemarga-dule-barmialidgi-bengusuli gued.
Jesús-abin sogdemalad: —Degite, ¿ibi-ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid be anmarga imakosunna? Adi, anmar dakega, degi, mer begi anmar benguegar, ¿Ibi-ibmar be imaksunna?
Ar anmar-dadgandi nega-dulesulidgangi maná-guchamalad. Bab-Dummad-gardagi sognaid: ‘Madu-nibneggined-gunmalaga an imaksad.’ Éxodo 16:4; Salmo 78:24
Jesús amarga sogded: —Napira an bemarga soged, Moisés bemarga madu-nibneggi-danikid uksasulid. Ar an-Bab madu-nibneggi-danikid-sunnad bemarga uked.
Ar Bab-Dummad-madu nibneggi-aidenonikidi, we-napnegginmaladga burba-duladi uked.
Jesúsʼga sogdemalad: —Dummad, madu-degiid be anmarga ukdigu imake.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Ani an madu-burba-duladid. Ar dule anse danikile, bar gwen ukumesosulid. Ar dule an-bengusulile, bar gwen uku-uku itogosulid.
”An bemarga epenne bato sogsad, ibmar-dakledisulid imaksa be an-daksamar-inigwele, degite, amba be an-benmalad.
Ar Bab bela dulemar-anga-ukedi, anba-naguega anse dagoed. Ar dule anse danikile, gwen an obanosulid.
”An-itolegedba ibmar-saega nibneggi an danisulid. Dule-an-barmialid-sogedba an ibmar-imakega nonikid.
Bab-an-barmialidi we abemaid: Bela dulemar-anse-nonikidi gwen wargwensaar oyoggubisur an-abeged. Adi, ibagan-napi-naguoedgi a-dulemar an gannar odulogegar.
”Dule-an-barmialid we abemaid: Bela dulemar-E-Machi-dakoedi, degi, egi bensuli-gunonikile, burba-geg-bergued nikued. Degine, ani, ibagan-napi-naguoedgi a-dulemar an odulogoed.”
Degi, Judíoʼmar, Jesúsʼgi sunmakedbi guarmalad, ar ade, Jesús sogsad, ani an madu-nibneggi aidenonikidye.
Judíoʼmar Jesúsʼgi sogdemalad: —¿Ar wede Jesús, José-machisursi? Degine, e-bab, e-nan, ¿anmar mag daksursi? Ar degite, ¿ibiga sogsunna? ‘Nibneggi an aidenoniye.’
Jesús amar-abin-imakde, sogded: —Mer be muchub-muchub angi isdar sunmakmar.
Ar Bab-an-barmialid, anse-dule-dagega imaksulile, gege dule-wargwensaale anse daged. Ibagan-napi-naguoedgi, dule-anse-nonimaladdi, ani an a-dule-odulogoed.
Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad-gardagi narmakar maid: ‘Bab-Dummad na e-igargi bela dulemar-odurdakoed.’ Isaías 54:13 ”Degisoggu, bela Bab-itosmalad, degi, egi durdaksamarbalid, anba-naguegala anse danimaloed.
”Dule-wargwensaar Bab-daksaye an sogsulid. Unnila dule-Bab-Dummadgi-danikidbi Bab-daksad.
Napira an bemarga soged: Ar dule angi bensulidi, a-dule, burba-geg-bergued nikad.
”Ani an madu-burba-duladid.
Ar be-dadgan nega-dulesulidgangi maná-guchamar-inigwele, bela burgwismalad.
”An bemarga madu-nibneggi-aidenonikidgi-an-sunmakedi, a-madu dule guchale, bar burgosulid.
Ani an a-madu-duladid, nibneggi aidenonikidid. Ar dule-wargwen a-madu-guchale, bar burgosulid, degidula sadeguoed. An madu-ukoedi, we an-sanad. We-napneg-naidgi dule-bukmalad-dula-gudiguega an-san an ukoed.”
Agi Judíoʼmar abin-abin imakarmalad, sokarmalad: “Anmar e-san-gunnegala ¿igi anmarga e-san ukosunna? Geg gued.”
Jesús amarga sogded: —Napira an bemarga soged: Ar bemar Dule-Machi-e-san gunsulile, degine, e-abe gobsurbalile, bemar burba-dulad nikuosurmalad.
Ar dule an-san gunnele, degi, an-abe gobele, a-dule burba-geg-bergued nikuodo, degine, ibagan-napi-naguoedgi, ani an a-dule odulogoed.
Ar an-sana, masgunned-sunsogedid, degine, an-abe, gobed-sunsogedbalid.
Ar dule-an-san-gunmalad, degi, an-abe-gobmalad, anginbi gudigumalad, degine, an egi gudigumogad.
”Ar igi Bab-dulamaid an-barmiali, degine, igi Babgi an dula gudimoga, deyobi, dule an-san-guchale, a-dule angi dula-gudii gumogoed.
Ani an madu-nibneggi-aidesadid. We-madu-nibneggi-aidesadi, be-dadgan-maná-guchadyobsulid. Ar maná-gucha-inigwele, amardi amba burgwismalad. Ar dule we-madu-guchardi, bar burgosulid, degisadeguoed.”
Jesús Capernaúmʼgi dulemar-odurdaksigusgu, Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggi we-ibmar sogsagusad.
Bukidar-Jesúsʼba-gudimaladi weyob Jesús-soge-itosmargu, sogdemalad: “We-ibmar-sogedi gwen nollo sogsulid. ¿Ar doa eba ibsaoe?”
Ar Jesús na wissoggu, e-sapingan muchub-muchub we-igargi sunmaknanai, amarga sogdesun: —¿We-an-bemarga-sogedi, be isdar itomala?
Ar Dule-Machi nibneggi-mai-gusadse gannar nakwemai be dakarmalar, ¿igi be sogsamalarsunna?
Ar Bab-Dummad-Burbabi dulagudigued uked. Dule-sandi, binsaledid. An bemarga-ibmar-sogsadi, we burba-napiragwadid, degine, dula-gudiguedbalid.
Ar gwenna-gwenna bemar an-benmalad. Ar ade, Jesús gebesaila-akar bato wisid doamala e-benmala, degine, doa darba e-ukbaloe.
Jesús sogded: —A-ulale, an sogsad, dule, anba-naguegala Bab anse-sedasulir, gege anse dagye.
Degidgine, bukidar Jesús-sapingan Jesúsʼgi bangudmalad, bar Jesúsʼba gudigussurmalad.
Geb degi, Jesús na e-sapingan-warambe-gakabogwadga (12) sokalid: —¿Bemar nabimarmoga?
Simón-Pedro, abin-sogded: —Dummad, ¿doaba anmar naosunna? Ar bebi unnila burba-geg-bergued-igar nikad.
Ar anmar begi bensulid, degine, anmar wisid, be Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duled. Bab-Dummad-Dula-Maid-E-Machi-sunnadid.
Jesús, Pedro-abin sogded: —¿Ar warambe-gakabo (12) an be-susmarsursi? Gwensak bemar nia gued.
Jesús, e-sapingan-ambe-gakabogwad-wargwengi Simón-machi-Judas-Iscarioteʼgi deyob sogsagusad, ar a-dule, Jesús-darba-uknai guoedid.
We-degigusad-sorba, Jesús Galilea-yalaganba bipirmakdii gusad. Ar ade, yapa Judeaʼgi gudigued, ar Judíoʼmar e-oburgwebimalad.
Deun, Judíoʼmar-Neg-Matargana-Iba-onoged bato mosadgined.
E-urbamar Jesúsʼga sokalid: —Wegi be noe, Judeaʼse be nae. Adi, be-sapingan be-ibmar-imaked dakoed.
Ar dule-wargwen mag-e-dakbi abegele, geg odukuar ibmar imaked. Ar be ibmar-dakledisulid-imakdiid, bela dulemar-wagab be imakdo.
E-urbamar weyob Jesúsʼga sogsamardo, ar ade, e-urbamarse-bakar, Jesús-benmalad, we Mesíasʼye.
Jesús e-urbamarga sogdesun: —An Jerusalénʼse-naed-ibagan angardi amba yoo moed. Ar bemargardi ibagan bato gusgu guagwar naidaed.
Ar we-napneg-naidgi-dulemar-bukwad geg isdar bemar-daked. Ar andi isdar an-dakmardo, ar ade, an ega sogdiid, bemar-ibmar-imakdimaladi isganaye.
Bemardi, ibase be namala. Ar angardi, amba an-ibagan yoo mosoggu, andi naosurgweled.
Deyob Jesúsʼdi, e-urbamarga sogsagu, Galileaʼgi bessunnad.
Jesús, e-urbamar-ibase-naded-sorba, ibase nade gusmogad. Jesús emar-wagab nadsulid. Arbakee nadegusad.
Judíoʼmar ibagi Jesús-amidii guarmalad, sokarmalad: “¿Wede bia dule nade?”
Agine dulemar-bukidarad-abargi Jesúsʼgi uurmakarmalad, gwenna-gwenna sokarmalad: “We-Jesús, dule-nuedid.” Baigandi sogmarmogad: “Suli, we, dule-yardakdiidi.”
Ar dulemar Judíoʼmar-dummagan-dobedba, bakar-buud Jesúsʼgi gwen sunmaksasurmalad.
Ar Neg-Matargana-Sobarmalad-E-Iba-onolenaid negabargusgu, Jesús Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse nonikid. Agi dulemar-odurdaksii gusad.
Judíoʼmar-dummagan geger Jesús-dakdemalad, sogdemalad: “We-dule dummaganse gwen ibmar durdaksasulid, ar degite, ¿igi nabir ibmar-nue-wisi dulemar-odurdake?”
Jesús amarga sogdesun: —An-ibmar-odurdaked angadsulid, Bab-Dummad-an-barmialid-sogedba an dulemar-odurdaked.
Ar dule Bab-Dummad-sogedba nanabiele, mag dakoed, an-ibmar-odurdakdiid Bab-Dummadgi danidibe, igidibe, an-ibmar-odurdakdiid an na dukin onosdibe.
Ar dule wargwengi e-sogedba ibmar-sogdiile, a-dule na nug-dungued amidii daed. Ar e-barmialid-nug-odummogega gudiirdina, adi, we napiragwaddo, a-dulegine, gakan naisurdo.
”¿Ar Moisés bemarga igar-uksasursi? Degite, bemar a-igargi nanadisurmalad. ¿Ibiga be an-oburgwebimarsunna?”
Dulemar, Jesús-abin sogdemalad: —Nia begi nai. ¿Ar doamar be-oburgwebie?
Jesús amarga sogded: —Obunnoged-ibagi unnila ibmar-dakledisulid-soggwen an imaksad-ulale, ¿geger be an-dakmarde? Emide, be sogmargu, an dule-isganaye.
Moisés bemarga abgan-uka-duku-siked-igar mesismalad. Degi-inigwele, we-igar Moisésʼgi noarsulid, ar dadgan-akar bato gusgu a-igar danikid. Obunnoged-ibagi mer arbaoye igar-mai-inigwele, degite, bemar Obunnoged-ibagi abgan-uka-duku-siked-igar imakbukwad.
”Ar bemar Moisés-Igar-Mesisadba ibmar-imakegala, amba obunnoged-ibagi-bakar, bemar abgan-uka-duku-siked-igar imakbukwad. Degite, ¿ibiga bemardi obunnoged-ibagi an dule-nudaked, sae be an-dakmarsunna?
Melle dule-daklegedba be sogo we-dule, dule-nuedye, igi, we-dule, dule-isganaye. Suli. Innikigwadba be sogoed.”
Jerusalénʼginmalad gwenna-gwenna sokarmalad: “¿Ar dummagan we-dule-oburgwega amidimarsursi?
Emide, be dakena, bela-dulemar-abargi sunmakgwisgu, degite, gwen ega akar sogsurmalad. ¿Ar dummagande nue-magar itononimarsi? We, Cristo-sunnadid, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye sogsad-dule.
”Ar anmar wisid, we bia daniki. Ar Cristoʼdi nonikile, anmar wisguosulid, bia daniki.”
Jesús Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi dulemar-odurdaksigu, binnasur sunmakde, sogded: —Bemar mag-an-dakmalad, degine, be an-wismarbalid an bialidi. An-itolegedba wargwen an danisulid, ar Bab-Dummad-napiragwadid an-barmialid. A-duledi bemar akudakmalad.
Andi a-dule mag an daked, ar agi an danikid. Ar a an-barmialid.
Agine, dummagan Jesús-gabiguarmalanad, degite, gwen gassurmalad, ar ade, yoo e-burgwed-ibagan omoged.
Dulemar-bukidar Jesúsʼgi bengussurmalad, sokarmalad: “Cristo nonikile, ¿bur bule we-dulebali ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid imako be insae? Gwen deyob imako an insasurdo.”
Fariseoʼmar dulemar-sognanaid itosmalad, Jesús, Mesíasʼye. Degisoggu, Fariseoʼmar, degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan Jesús-gaega suar-ibmala barmismalad.
Geb Jesús dulemar-e-itobukwadga sogded: —Napi-ichesaar an bemar-abargi gudiid. Dule-an-barmialidse an naesokalid.
Be an-amimalo-inigwele, gwen be an-amimalosulid. An gudiguoedsega geg be namalad.
Degi Judíoʼmar na ga sokarmarsunnad: “¿Ar wede bia naoe? Anmarde bar amiosurmalad. Griegoʼmar-abargi-Judíoʼmar-aisakis-bukmalad-odurdakega, ¿wede naoe?
¿We ibi obarsunna? We sogsad: ‘Be an-amimalo-inigwele, gwen be an-amimalosurye. An gudiguoedsega, geg be namarye.’ ”
Napi-iba-dummad-naidgi, Jesús gwisgusgu, binnasur sunmakded, sogded: —Ar dule-wargwen uku-uku itodiile, anse dage. Anse dii gobdage.
Ar dule an-bensulile, Bab-Dummad-gardagi sognaiyobi, e-ulubgi diwar-burba-nikad aryomai guoed.
Jesús diwar-burba-nikadye-sogsagusadi, we Bab-Dummad-Burba dulemar-egi-benguosurmalad-abingaoedgi sunmaksad. Deunni, amba yoo Bab-Dummad-Burba nonikid, ar ade, Jesús-nug amba yoo bela-bela ogannoleged.
Bukidar-dulemar-abargi gwenna-gwenna weyob-Jesús-ibmar-soged itosmargu, sokarmalad: “Ar we-dule, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-napiragwadid.”
Baigandi sogmalad: “We, Cristo-sunnadid.” Degine, baiganmo sogmarmogad: “¿Ar Cristoʼde, Galileaʼgi danikosi? Suli, agi danikosulid.
¿Ar Bab-Dummad-gardagi sognaisursi? Cristo Davidʼgi danikoye. Belén-neggweburgi, David-epenne-gwalulesadgi danikoye.”
Ar Jesús-ulale dulemar na egi bachikgudmalad.
Gwenna-gwenna Jesús-gabiguarmalan-inigwele, gwen gassurgusmalad.
Suar-ibmala-Babse-goled-neg-edarbemalad-barmilesmaladi gannar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummaganse, degi, Fariseoʼmarse nonimalad. Fariseoʼmar ega sogdemalad: —¿Ibiga bemar Jesús-sedanisurmala?
Suar-ibmala abin-imakdemalad: —Dule-wargwensaale we-duleyobi gwen sunmakdisulid, nue-yeer sunmaked.
Geb Fariseoʼmar, abin-imakdemalad: —¿Bemar ese yardaklesmarmosunde?
Be dakdimala, dummad-wargwen, degine, Fariseoʼmar, a-dulegi, ¿bensur gued? Suli.
We-dule-baigandi, Moisés-Igar-Mesisad-wissurmaladba Jesúsʼba nagudmalad. A-ulale, we-dulemardi bato nue-ukabsales bukmarsunnad.
Nicodemo, ibagwengi mutik Jesúsʼse-nonigusadi, e-sordamar-Fariseoʼga sokalid:
—Anmar-igar-maidgi, sunna dule-wargwenga amba yoo igar-itoged-iduar bato soglesi, ¿be dummad-nosye, bega sabsur-odurdakleged-igar maiye? Suli, degisulid.
Fariseoʼmar, Nicodemo-abin-imakdemalad: —¿Ar be Galileaʼginmogadi? Bab-Dummad-Garda-narmakar-naidgi nue be baramie. Be dakoed, bipisaale Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged gwen Galileaʼgi danisulid.
[Geb degi, dummagan e-neg-e-negse nadmarsunnad.
Geb degi, Jesús Olivos-yarse nadsunnad.
Banedgine, Jesús wakudaryala Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse gannar nonigu, dulemar-bukidar ese nonimalad. Jesús sigisgua, dulemar-odurdakded.
Deun Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar, degi, Fariseoʼmar, Jesúsʼse ome-wargwen-negsichigi-galagwensuligunai-galesad senonimalad. Dummagan dulemar-abargi ome-ogwisnonimargu,
Jesúsʼga sogdemalad: —Odurdaked-saila, we-ome negsichigi galagwensuligunai gasmalad.
Emi anmarga Moisés igar mesisad, omegan-deyobdamalad akwagi-makar oburgoye. Degite, bedina, ¿igi be sogmosunna?
Fariseoʼmar Jesús-wilubdakegala yamo deyob ese egichismalad. Adi, Jesúsʼgi sorba gwisgumalagar. Jesúsʼdi, napase dulluu imakdegu, e-googi napa narmak-narmak imaksigisad.
Ar Fariseoʼmar Jesúsʼse gannar-gannar egisnanaimarsoggu, Jesús gwisgusad, geb abin-sogded: —Ar bemar-wargwenad na be isguedsuli-itogele, a-inse akwa omegi metedo.
Jesús gannar napase dulluu imakdebargu, gannar napagi narmaksigisbalid.
Ar Fariseoʼmar degii-Jesús-soge-itosmargu, mag na ulubgi e-isgudiid itosmarsoggu, war-wargwen ainidmalad. Dule-sergan-inse ainidmalad, geb sapinganse-bakar, ainidmarmogad. Unnila Jesús ome-negabargi-gwichid-ebo bessunnad.
Jesús gannar gwisgusgu dakded, dulemar sate, unnila omebi-gwichi, geb omega sogded: —Omegwa, ¿bia dulemar-begi-gwisgunanaid nadmala? ¿Wargwensaar bar begi gwisgussurmala?
Ome, abin-sogded: —Dummad, dule-wargwensaar angi gwisgussulid. Geb Jesús omega sogdemosun: —An begi gwisguosurmogad. Be nae. Mer be bar isguo.]
Gannar Jesús dulemarga sunmakdebargu, sogded: —Ani an we-napneg-naid-e-gwallu-meegwadid. Ar dule anba dagele, negsichidgi nanaosulid, gwallu-meegwad nikuoed.
Fariseoʼmar Jesúsʼga sogdemalad: —Be-ibmar-sogedi, na be dukin-barsogsoggu, a-ular, be-ibmar-sogedi, geg anmar abingaed.
Jesús, Fariseoʼmar-abin sogded: —An-ibmar-sogedi, an na dukin soge-inigwele, ar wedi napiragwadid. Ar an wisid, bia an daniki, degine, bia an nabaloe. Ar bemardi wissurmalad, bia an daniki, degine, bia an nabaloe.
Ar bemardi unnila we-napneg-igar-maidba sogmalad, we, dule-isganaye, we, dule-nuedye. Andi an sogsulid we, dule-isganaye, we, dule-nuedye.
Ar dule-wargwenga an igar-nabogele, an-igar-nabogedi napiragwadba an imaked. Ar ande, wargwengi an igar-nabosulid, an-Bab-an-barmialid, a-anbo an imaked.
Bemar-igar-maidgi sogmaid, dule-warbo barsoged-nikale, wemar-ibmar-sogedi napiragwadye, abingalegoye.
Ani an na dukin angi an ibmar-barsoged. Bab-an-barmialid, angi ibmar sogmogad. Degisoggu, an-ibmar-sogedi, napiragwaddo.
Geb degi, Jesúsʼga sogdemarsun: —¿Bia be-babde maisunna? Jesús, dulemar-abin sogded: —Ar be aku an-dakmalad, degine, be aku an-Bab-dakmarbalid. Ar be mag an-dakmalana, be an-Bab-mag-dakmarmogoenad.
Weyob Jesús Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi, mani-weleged-naba-sii, dulemar-odurdaksigu sunmaksagusad. Dule-wargwensaale gwen Jesús-gassurmalad, ar ade, amba yoo e-galeged-ibagan omoged.
Jesús gannar Judío-dummaganga sogdebalid: —An naesokar. Be an-amimalo-inigwele, be an-amimalosulid. Bemardi be-isguedba be burgwidmaloed. An-naedse, geg bemar warmaked.
Geb degi, Judío-dummagan sogdemar: “Ar ibiga soge: ‘An-naedse, geg bemar namarye.’ ¿Ar ede na dukin oburgwedgi binsae?”
Jesús amarga sogded: —Bemardi weginmaladid, andi nibnegginedid. Bemardi we-napnegginmaladid, andi we-napnegginedsulid.
A-ulale, an bega sogsagusmalad, be an-bengumalale, degi, an doa-dule-gue be bengumarbalile, be-isguedba na be burgwemaloye.
Judío-dummagan Jesúsʼga sogdemarsun: —¿Ar be doasunna? Geb Jesús, abin-sogded: —Ar iduar bato an bega sogsamalad, an doa-gue.
Bemar-noar-nanadiidbali ibmar-bukidar an bemargi-soged nikad. Ar dule-an-barmialiddi napiragwadbi ibmar soged. Andi, an a-itosadba, we-napneggi-bukmaladga an ibmar sogdimogad.
Judío-dummagan, Jesús e-Babgi-ega-sunmaked, aku-itosmalad.
A-ulale, Jesús sogdebar: —Ar bemar, ani Dule-Machi, nakrusgi-biokegala niba onakwismalale, geb bemar wisgunonimaloed, an doa-gue. Degine, an-itolegedba an ibmar imakdisulid. Ar an-Bab-an-odurdaksadba an sunmakdiid.
Ar an-Bab-an-barmialid anba gudiid, wargwen an-metedisulid. Ar ade, an bela-ibmar-imakedi, an-Bab-nabir-itoge an imaked.
Jesús-weyob-sunmakedba, bukidar egi bensuli gunonimalad.
Jesús, Judíoʼmar-egi-bengussurmaladga sogded: —Ar bemar an-gayaburba-sunmakedgi nue eba nanaele, bemar an-sapingan-sunnadga gumaloed.
Degine, bemar igar-napiragwad wisgunonimaloed, degine, igar-napiragwad isguedgi bemar-ollorsanonikoed.
Judíoʼmar, Jesús-abin sogdemalad: —Anmar, Abraham-e-wagan gumalad. Anmar dule-maiga gwen gudisurmalad. Degisoggu, ¿ibiga be anmarga soge: ‘Bemar ollorgunonikoye?’
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Napira an bemarga soged, dule-isguedgi-gudimaladi, isgued-maiga gudidimalad.
Dule-maiga-arbaedi geg neg-yagi gudigu gued. Ar neg-ibed-e-mimmirdi negyagi gudigu guodo.
Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad-Machi isguedgi bemar-onononikir, geb be nue-napira ollorgunonimaloed.
An wisi bemar Abraham-wagan gumalad, degi-inigwele, an-ibmar-sogsad be benmalad-ulale, an-oburgwebimalad.
An-ibmar-sogedi, an-Bab-walik-an-ibmar-daksadba an sunmaked. Ar bemardi ibmar-imakedi, be-bab-ibmar-itosadba be imakmarmogad.
Judío-dummagan Jesús-abinsadmargu, sogdemalad: —Abraham, anmar-dadad. Jesús, abin-sogded: —Bemar Abraham-wagan-sunnadina, Abraham-ibmar-imaksadyob be ibmar imakdimarmoganad.
Bab-Dummadgi an-ibmar-napiragwad-itosad an bemarga-sogsad. Degite, be an-oburgwebimalad. Dad-Abrahamʼdi gwen deyob gussulid.
Bemardi, be-bab-Satanás-ibmar-imaked be imakdimalad. Geb degi, Judíoʼmar Jesúsʼga sogdemalad: —Anmar negsichidgi gwalulesadsurmalad. Anmar bab-nika gwalulesmalad. Bab-Dummad anmar-babad.
Geb Jesús amarga sogded: —Ar Bab-Dummad bemar-babana, be an-sabmalando. Ar an Bab-Dummadgi danikid. An-itolegedgi an danisulid, Bab-Dummad an-barmialid.
¿Ibiga nue-akusunna an-ibmar-soged be itomala? Ar ade, bemar an-ibmar-soged yeer-itosurmalad, aga be aku itomalad.
Ar nia-saila bemar-babad, degine, be-bab-ibmar-abegedba be damalad. Ar gusgu, gebesailaunni nia-saila dule-gindakedid, degine, igar-napiragwadgi bangusad, ar igar-napiragwad nia-sailagi naisulid. Ar nia-saila gakansaar sunmakdele, gusgu na e-daedba sunmakdedaed. Ar ade, gusgu gakansaerbad, degine, dulemar-gakansaed-e-babad.
Ar andi ibmar-napiragwad bemarga soged, degite, be an-abingasurmalad.
”¿Doa-dule, isgudiiye angi sogoe? Ar igar-napiragwad an sogele, degite, ¿ibiga be an-itosurmarsunna?
Ar dule Bab-Dummadgadile, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-sunmaked itoged. Bemar, Bab-Dummadgadsulid, a-ulale, bemar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba itosulid.”
Judíoʼmar, Jesús-abinsadmalad, ega sogdemalad: —Anmar nabir sogmalad, be Samaria-dulemar-isganayobmoye, degine, nia begi naiye.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Angi nia naisulid. An-Bab-nug bur an odummodiid. Bemardi an-nug ichodimalad.
An-nug-odummoged an amidisulid. Ar dule-wargwen an-nug-odummoged maid, a sogoed, an dule-nueddibe, an dule-isganadibe.
Napira an bemarga soged, dule an-gayaburba-sogedba-daele, we-dule burgosulid.
Geb degi, Judíoʼmar Jesúsʼga sogdemalad: —Emigindi, anmar nue-wisdo, begi nia naid. Abraham, degi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmaladdi burgwismalad. Emide, bedi soged: ‘Ar dule-wargwen an-gayaburba-sogedba-daele, burgwed itogosurye.’
Ar bede anmar-dad-Abrahamʼba ¿bur dummadsi? Dad-Abrahamʼdi burgwisad. Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad burgwismarmogad. ¿Ar be doaye sogsunna? Amarba, ¿be-bur dummadye be sogsunde?
Jesús, Judíoʼmar-abin sogded: —An na dukin san-odummogele, an-san-odummodiidi, we binsaleddo. Bab-Dummad bemar-Bab-Dummadye be sogmaladi, a-Bab-Dummadi an-Babad, a, an-nug odummoged.
Bemardi a-Bab-Dummad akudakmalad, andi a-Bab-Dummad mag daked. An bemarga sogdibe, a-Bab-Dummad aku an dakye, bemar-sunnaa an gakansasaled. Andi a-Bab-Dummad mag an daked, degine, e-gayaburbaba an nanadibalid.
Anmar-dad-Abraham weligwar an-danikoed-dakoedba itosad. An-nonikid-daksagu, nue-weligwar itononikid.
Geb degi, Judíoʼmar ega sogdemalad: —Amba be birga-dulabo-gakambe (50) niksulid, degite, ¿Abraham be daksade? Be daksasulid.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Napira an bemarga soged, amba yoo Abraham-gwalulege, bato an gudiid.
Degidgine, Judíoʼmar akwagi-Jesús-makega akwa gadebinmalad. Jesúsʼdi emar-idu dukusad, degi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi nodsunnad. Degi, emar-abargi-node nadsunnad.
Jesús nadapgu, machered-wargwen muu-neggi-ibyasuli-gwalulesad dakalid.
Jesús-sapingan Jesúsʼse egichiarmalad: —Odurdaked-saila: ¿Ibiga we-dule, ibyasuli gwalulesa? Weyob we gwalulesadi, ¿e-babgan-isgusad-ulale, igi, e-isgusad-ulale?
Jesús e-sapingan-abin sogded: —We-dule, e-isgusad-ulale, weyob gwalulessulid. Degi, e-babgan-isgusad-ular, weyob gwalulessurbalid. We-dule ibyasuli-gwalulesadi, adi, Bab-Dummad-ibmar-imaked we-dulegi oyolegegalad.
Yoo mutik-gued-iduar, anmar dule-an-barmialidga arbaed imakergebed. Ar neg-mutik-gued danikid. Agi, dulemar bar arbaosulid.
An we-napneggi-gudiidgi, an gwallu-meegwadyob gued. Ani an dulemar-bukwadga igar-napiragwad oyonaid.
Jesús deyob-sogsad-sorba, napagi-wiaksagu, napa wiigi olli-olli imaksad. Degine, e-googi olli-ollid-wesgu, dule-ibyagi mage-mage imaksad.
Geb degi, Jesús dule-ibyasulidga sogded: —Dii-wilasar-naid-Siloéʼye-nugadse be-ibya be enukna. (Siloé sogleged, Barmilesadye). Agine dule-ibyasulid ibya-enukega nadsunnad. Ibya enuksagu, bato sunna mag-atake gunonikid.
E-neg-dikarba-mamaid, degine, dule-ibyasuli-gudidaed-mag-dakmaladi, sogdemalad: “¿Ar we, dule-ibyasuli, degi, aimarse mani-egisdidaedsursi?”
Abar sokarmalad: “We, a-dule.” Baigandi sokarmarmogad: “Suli, binsa we a-sunnaa dakleged.” Geb degi, e-ibeddi sokalid: “Ani an a-dule.”
Ese egichiarmarsunnad: —¿Igi nabir magar be atake gusa?
Dule-nugusad, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Dule-wargwen, Jesús-nugadi, napa olli-olli imaksad. Agine an-ibyagi mage-mage imaksad. Geb anga sokalid: ‘Siloéʼse be-ibya be enuknae.’ Degisoggu, an ase nadsunnad. An-ibya an enuksagu, mag-atake an gunonisunnad.
Geb degi, ega sogdemalad: —¿Bia a-dule nadsunna? Dule-nugusad abin-sogded: —An wissuli, bia nade.
Dule-ibyasuli-gudigusad Fariseoʼmarse senonimalad.
Ar ade, Jesús napa olli-olli-imaksadi, degi, dule-ibyasulid-onudaksadi, obunnoged-ibagi imaksad.
Fariseoʼmar dule-ibyasuli-gudigusadse egisdemarmogad: —¿Igi nabir be ibya nugusa? Dule-nugusad, abin-sogded: —Jesús an-ibyagi olli mage-mage imaksad. Degi, an ibya-enuksagu, mag-atake an gunonikid.
Fariseoʼmar abar sogdemalad: “We-dule Bab-Dummadgi danisulid. Agala, we-dule obunnoged-ibagi dule-nudaksad.” Fariseo-baigandi sogmalad: “Ar dule isgudiile, ¿sunna ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisurmalad imaksi? Suli, geg imake.” Agala, Fariseoʼmar na abin-abin imakarmarsunnad.
Fariseoʼmar gannar dule-ibyasuli-gudigusadga sokarmalad: —Dule-bega-ibya-nudaksadgi, ¿igi be sogmosunna? Dule-nugusad, abin-sogded: —Andi an soged, we, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-duleye.
Ar Judíoʼmardi we-dule-ibyasuli-gudigusadi benmalad. Emidi, ibya-nikusye mag-atakye-soged benmalad. A-ulale, dule-ibyasuli-gudigusad-e-serganse gochamarsunnad.
Ese egisdemalad: —¿Ar we be-machi-sunnadi? ¿We, be-ibe ibyasuli-gwalulesye be sogmaladi? Ar degite, ¿ibiga emigindi nabir ataksunna?
E-sergan sogdemalad: —Anmar wisi, we anmar-machid, ibyasuli gwalulesad.
Emigindi, mag-atakeddi an wissurmalad, ibiga nabir mag-atake. Anmar wissurbalid, doa ega nabir ibya nudaksa. Ar bato dummadsoggu, ese be egismardo, na e bemarga sogoed, doa ega ibya nudaksa.
Dule-ibyasuli-gudigusad-e-sergan Judío-dummagan-dobedbali, weyob sogsamalad. Ar ade, Judío-dummagan bato igar-itosmalad, dule-wargwen sogdibeye, Jesús, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duleye, Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggi onomaloye.
A-ulale, dule-ibyasuli-gudigusad-e-sergan sogsamalad: “Bato dummadsoggu, ese be egismarye, doa e-onudaksa.”
Degine, Fariseoʼmar dule-ibyasuli-gudigusadse gannar gochamargu, ese egisdemalad, ega sogdemalad: —Bab-Dummad-asabin napiragwadba be anmarga sogo, igi be nugusa. Anmardi wismalad, we-dule, dule-isganad.
Dule-nugusad, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —An wissulid, we-dule, dule-isgudiiddibe. Unnila ibmar-soggwennaa an wisid. Iduardi, aku an atakenad, emigindi, mag an ataked.
Fariseoʼmar gannar dule-ibyasuli-gudigusadse egichiarmarbalid: —¿Igi be-imaksa? ¿Igi-nabir bega ibya nudaksa?
Dule-nugusad, abin-sogded: —Ar bato bega an sogsamalad. Be an-itossurmalad. ¿Degite, ibiga gannar be itobimarsunna? ¿Ar bemar e-sapinganga gubimarmosi?
Fariseoʼmar dule-ibyasuli-gudigusadse uluarmalad, ega sogdemalad: —Bee be, Jesús-e-sapindo. Anmardi, Moisés-e-sapinganad.
Anmardi wisid, Bab-Dummad Moisésʼga sunmaksad. We-duledi, anmar wissulid, bia daniki.
Dule-ibyasuli-gudigusad abinsadgu, sogded: —¡Ar deyobi! ¡We-ibmar nue-aku itolegedid! Bemardi wissurmalad we-dule bia daniki, degite, angardi ibya nudaksad.
Ar anmar wisid, Bab-Dummad dule-isgudimalad ese gollalile, itosurdaed. Ar dule-wargwen Bab-Dummad-dobee nanadiirdi, degine, Bab-Dummad-sogedba ibmar imakdiirdi, Bab-Dummad, a-dule ese gollalile, adi, itodaed.
Ar bipisaale, gwen itoledisulid, dule-wargwen, dule-gusgu-ibyasuli-gwalulesadga ibya nudaksaye.
We-dule Bab-Dummadgi danisulina, gege deyob ibmar imakenad. Ar emigindi, deyob, ibmar-imakdisoggu, we-dule, Bab-Dummad-akar danido.
Fariseoʼmar abinsadmargu, ega sogdemalad: —Bede, isguedgi gwalulesadde, ¿be anmar-odurdakde? Be anmar-odurdakosulid. Degi, Judío-dummagan, dule-ibyasuli-gudigusad, Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggi onosmarsunnad.
Jesús itoalid, Fariseoʼmar Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggi dule-ibyasuli-gudigusad onosmarye. Geb degi, Jesús a-dule-amisgu, ega sogded: —¿Dule-Machigi be bensuli?
Dule-nugusad, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Dummad, ¿a-dule, doa-dulesunna? Adi, mer an egi benguegar.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —A-dule bato be daksad. Ani an a-duled, bebo sunmakgwichid.
Dule-ibyasuli-gudigusad, abin-sogded: —Dummad, an begi bensulid. Geb degi, Jesús-nug-odummogega Jesús-abin yokorgi-sindigar sigisad.
Jesús sogded: —An dulemarga-igar-nabogega, we-napnegse an nonikid. Dule-aku-atakdimalad mag-ataksaega an nonikid. Degi, dulemar-mag-atakmalad, aku-atak-imakega an nonikid.
Degine, Fariseo-gwenna-gwenna Jesús-walik-gwichimalad, Jesús-degi-soge-itosmargu, ega sogdemalad: —Ar ¿anmar aku atakmarmode?
Jesús, amar-abin sogded: —Ar bemar aku-atakena, be isgued niksurmalanad. Emigindi, bemar sogsoggu, Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maid nue mag an dakmarye. A-ulale, be-isgued begi naimarsundo.
Jesús sogdebar: “Napira an bemarga soged: Dule sibad-wawaad-galu-emakaled-yawagakgi dogsulile, yarganba dukuar dogele, we-dule, sibad-wawaad-atursaeddo, degi, dule-atursili-sunnaddo.
Ar dule yawagak-siidgi dogerdi, we-dule, sibad-wawaad-ibedsunnadid.
”Yawagak-daked we-dulega yawagak-egaed, geb sibad-wawaad na e-edarbed-gayaburba mag itoged. Sibad-wawaad-edarbed e-sibad-wawaadse na nugba-nugba goled. Degine, galu-yaba-bukwadgi onoged.
Sibad-wawaad-edarbed bela e-sibad-wawaad-onisale, sibad-wawaad-idunadap daed. Sibad-wawaad eba nadapi daed, ar ade, e-edarbed-e-gayaburba mag itomalad.
Ar e-edarbedsulidbardi naddasurmalad, aka bur e-idu duurmakdedamalad, ar ade, e-gayaburba aku-itomalad.”
Jesús weyob dulemarga odukuar-ibmar-sogsadi, aku-itos gusmalad, ibi ega obarisa.
Jesús gannar emarga sogdebarsun: “Napira an bemarga soged: Ani an sibad-wawaad-galu-emakaled-e-yawagak-sunnadid.
Dulemar-odurdakega an-idu-nonimaladi, atursamaladid, degi, gandikidgi atursamaladid. Degi-inigwele, Sibad-wawaadmardi amar-gayaburba itossurmalad.
Ani an yawagak gued. Dule angi dogele, a-dule abonolegoed. Sunna doged, degi, sunna nobalid, masgunned gusgu nikaguoed.
”Dule-atursaed danikile, unnila sibad-wawaad-atursaegala, oburgwegala, degine, osulogega, nonidamalad. Andi an nonigua, burba-dulagudigued-ukega an nonikid, degine, bela ulubgi yeer-itodiguega an nonikid.
”Ani an sibad-wawaad-edarbed-nuedid. Sibad-wawaad-edarbed-nued na sibad-wawaad-ular, e-san-burba na uked.
”Ar sibad-wawaad-edarbed-manigi-arbaeddi, sibad-wawaad-edarbed-nuedsulid, ar ade, sibad-wawaad egadsulid. A-ulale, achu-burburud-danikile, sibad-wawaad-mete naddaed. Degisoggu, achu-burburud sibad-wawaad-ganonikogu, sibad-wawaad-oduurmakega imaked.
Dule-manigi-arbaed wakitedaed, ar ade, unnila bennuklegega arbaed. Degisoggu, sibad-wawaad-baisur daksundo.
”Ani an sibad-wawaad-edarbed-nuedid. An-sibad-wawaad mag an daked, degi, mag an-dakmarmogad.
Igi Bab nue-an-wisi, deyobi, an Bab-wismogad. Degine, an-sibad-wawaad-ular, an-san-burba an na uked.
An Sibad-wawaad-baigan we-galu-yabalidsulid, an nikbalid. Amar anse an sedamogargebed. Deyobi, amar an-gayaburba itomaloed. Degine, sibad-wawaad dangwennaa guoed, degine, e-edarbed wargwennaa nikubaloed.
”Burgwega an-san-burba an uked, adi, gannar an subaligar. A-ulale, Bab nue an-sabed.
Gege dule an-san-burba angi sued, ar ade, an-sunnad na wargwengi an uked. Ar ani an-san-ukega, degi, an gannar subaliga, an gangued nikad. An-Bab we-igar-anga-uksadba an imaked.”
Judíoʼmar Jesús-wegi-sogsad-ular, muchub-muchub abin-abin na imakarmalad.
Bukidar Jesúsʼgi sogdemalad: “We, nia-nika gudiid. We, akargualid: ¿Ar ibiga be itomala? Mer be itomala.”
Baigandi sogmogad: “We-ibmar-sogedi, we nia-gayasulid. ¿Ar niade sunna dule-ibyasurmaladga ibya nudaksi? Suli, degisulid.”
Deunni, Jerusalénʼgi Bab-Dummadse-Goled-Neg-Gannar-Nudaklesad-Iba naid. A-ibagangine, dii-wied-nii naid.
Deunni, Jesús Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-ubeb-Salomónʼye-nugadsik, bipirmakdiid.
Judíoʼmar bela Jesús-ebilis-ambikusmargu, ega sogdemalad: —¿Bule-undar-sui yootee be anmar-obinsaega imakoe? Ar be Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-dulele, anmarga bakar be soge. ¿Ar be Cristo-sunnadi?
Jesús, amar-abin sogded: —Ar bato an bega sogsamalad, bemar an-benmalad. An-Bab-nuggi-an-ibmar-saedi, a bemarga sognaid, an doa-dule gue.
Ar bemar an-sibad-wawaadsursoggu, a-ular, be an-itosurmalad.
An-sibad-wawaad an-gayaburba mag-itomalad, an mag daked, degine, anba naddamalad.
Ani an ega burba-geg-bergued uked, bipisaale amar gwen berguosurmalad, degisadegumaloed. Degine, bipisaale dule gege angi an-sibad-wawaad sued.
An-Bab anga-sibad-wawaad-uksadi, a-Bab, bela bur dule-dummadid. Degine, bipisaale dule-baid gege an-Babgi an-sibad-wawaad sued.
Ani, an-Babbo, anmar wargwenna gued.
Degi, Judíoʼmar, Jesús-makega gannar akwa gasmarbalid.
Jesús Judíoʼmarga sogded: —Ibmar-nuegan-bukidar an-Bab-nuggi an bega oyosmalad. ¿Igid-imaksad-ular, akwagi be an-makbimarsunna?
Judíoʼmar, abin-imakdemargu, sogdemalad: —Be-ibmar-nued-imakdiid-ular, anmar akwagi be-makbisurmalad. Be Bab-Dummad-nuggi-dododiid-ular, anmar akwagi be-makbied. Ar be we-napnegginedid, emide, Bab-Dummadga na be imaked.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —¿Ar bemargi Moisés-Igargi narmakar maisursi? ‘An bemarga sogsa gusad, bemar bab-dummagan gumarye.’ Salmo 82:6
”Ar Bab-Dummad Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-abingasmaladse, bab-dummaganye gochagusad. Ar Bab-Dummad-Garda geg anmar bisged. Degisoggu, noar an sogsasurdo.
Ar Bab ega-arbaega an-susad, degine, we-napnegse an-barmialid. Ani an Bab-Dummad-Machiye, an sogsad-ulale, ¿be anga sogmalode: ‘Be Bab-Dummad-nuggi dododiiye?’
An-Bab-ibmar-imaked an imaksulile, mer be an-ibmar-soged itomardo.
Ar an an-Bab-ibmar-imaked imakerdi, be an-benmar-inigwele, an-ibmar-imakdiidgindi, mer be bengumalo. Adi, be wisgumalaga, degine, mer be bengumalaga, Bab angi gudiid, degine, an Babgi gudimogad.”
Agine, Judíoʼmar gannar Jesús-gabiguarmalanad, degi-inigwele, Jesús egi nabir wakichagusad.
Jesús gannar Jordán-diwar-obakar, bia Juan iduar Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imaknaigusa, ase nadegusad. Agi Jesús megidapid.
Ase dulemar-bukidar Jesúsʼse nonigusmalad, degi, sogdemalad: “Ar Juan ibmar-wilubgan-imakledisulid imaksasur-inigwele, bela we-Jesúsʼgi-ibmar-sogsadi napira sogsad.”
Agine, dulemar-bukidar Jesúsʼgi-bensuli gunonimarsunnad.
Dule-wargwen, Betaniaʼgined, Lázaroʼye-nugadi uellemaid. We-Betania-neggweburde María, degine, e-ior-Marta-e-neggweburad. We-omegan, Lázaro-e-bunmalad.
We-María, gwallu-wawadgi Bab-Jesús-magsagusadid. María e-sailagiagi Dummad-Jesús-e-nag odingusii gusadid. Deunni, María-e-sus-Lázaro uellemaid.
A-ulale, Lázaro-e-bunmar dulemar-barmisad, adi, Jesúsʼga sogega: “Dummad, dule-nue-be-sabedi, uellemaiye.”
Jesús, degi-itosgua, sogded: “We-Lázaro-uellemaidi, burgwegarsulid. Bab-Dummad-nug-odummogega we uellemaid. Adi, we-uellemaidgi Bab-Dummad-Machi-e-nug odummolegegar.”
Dakargua, Jesús, nue-Marta-sabed, e-urba-María-sabbalid, degine, nue-Lázaro-sabbalid.
Ar deyob sabe-inigwele, Jesús Lázaro-uellemaiye-wisgusgu, amba ibabo e-gudiidgine gudii gusad.
Geb a-sorba, Jesús e-sapinganga sokalid: —Anmar gannar Judeaʼse namala.
E-sapingan ega sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, emichaale Judíoʼmar akwagi be-makbigusmaladde, degite, be ¿gannar nabarde?
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Ar neg-ibgined ¿wachi-irambe-gakabo (12) niksursi? Dule neg-ibgi gudiile, geg yoleged. Ar ade, we-napneggined-neg-meegwadba gudiid.
Ar dule neg-mutikidgi gudiirdi, yoledo, ar agindi gwallu-meegwad sulid.
Jesús deyob-sogsad-sorba, e-sapinganga sogdesunnad: —Anmar-ai-Lázaro gabmaid, odakega an ese naergebed.
E-sapingan ega sogdemalad: —Dummad, ar Lázaro gabmaile, nuguodo. Degite, ¿ibiga be nabisunna? Mer be nae.
Jesús degisogsagusadi, sognaindo: “Lázaro burgwar maiye.” Ar e-sapingandi, gabed-sunnad ega obarye bienad.
Geb agi Jesús bakar-buud sogdesunnad: —Lázaro burgwis maiye.
An Lázaro-walik gudigussulid-ular, an yeer itoged, adi, bemar mer angi bengumalagar. Degisoggu, anmar Lázaroʼse namargwelo.
Degi, Tomás, Dídimoʼye-bimarbalid, e-sordamarga sogdesunnad: —Anmar Jesúsʼba burgwega eba namarmoga.
Degi, Jesús Betania-neggweburse nonigu, Lázaro bato ibabakegus neg-uangi diglesmai daknonikid.
Betania-neggwebur, Jerusalénʼgi itakaa siid, unnila wachi-abala-nanae-wilub bangu siid.
Judíoʼmar-bukidar, Lázaro-burgwisad-ular, Martaʼse, degi, Maríaʼse nonigusmalad. Adi, amar-e-gwage baisur-itoge imakegar.
Marta, Jesús-daniye-itosgu, e-abin nadegusad. Maríaʼdi neggi besad.
Marta Jesúsʼga sogded: —Dummad, be wegi anmar-abargi-gudigusana, an-sus burgwissulinad.
Degi-inigwele, an wisbardo, ar ibu Bab-Dummadse be egisele, Bab-Dummad bega ukoed.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Be-sus gannar durguoed.
Marta, abin-sogded: —An wisi, ibagan-berguder, an-sus dulemar-gannar-durguoed-ibagi gannar durguoed.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Ani an gannar dule-odurguedid, degi, ani an burba-geg-bergued ukbalidid. Ar dule angi bensulile, ar burgwar-mai-inigwele, gannar durguoed.
Bela-dula-gudidimaladi angi bensulile, e-san-burba berguosulid, degisadeguoed. Weyob-an-bega-soged, ¿be bensuli?
Marta, Jesús-abin sogded: —Dummad, eye, an bensuli. Be, Bab-Dummad-Machid. Be Cristo, we-napnegse-danikoye-soglesgusadid.
Marta deyob sogsad-sorbali, e-urba-Maríaʼse gornaded. Ega arbakee sogdapid: —Odurdaked-saila noniye. Bese gorye.
Deyob ega-soge-itosgu, María yog-gwisguar imaksad. Jesúsʼse nade gusad.
Jesús deun amba yoo neggweburse doged, ar bia-Marta-e-abingusadgi amba gudiid.
Judíoʼmar-wis-María-gwage-baisur-itogega-imakega eba e-neggi-bukmaladi, María gwae-gwisgus-node-daksamargu, eba nodmarmogad. Amardi binsamalad: “María neg-uanse nad-dakleye, ase bonad-dakleye.”
María, Jesús-siidse-modapgu, Jesús-dakdegu, e-abin sindigar sigdapid, ega sogded: —Dummad, be wegi anmar-abargi gudigusana, an-sus burgwissulinad.
Jesús, María-ise-boale dakdegu, degine, Judíoʼmar-María-gwage-baisur-itoge-imakega-nonimaladi, ise-boarmarmoga dakdegu, ulubgi nue-nunmak itonadmogad, degi, nue-María-wile dakded.
Jesús Maríaʼga sogded: —¿Bia bemar Lázaro-digsamala? Jesúsʼga sogdemalad: —Dummad, be dage, be dakdage.
Degi, Jesús boded.
Geb Judíoʼmar sogdemalad: —Nue be dake. Ibiyobi Jesús, nue-Lázaro-sabe.
Geb Judío-baigan sogdemarmogad: —Ar we-Jesús, dule-ibyasulidga ibya egasad. Lázaro-mer-burgwega ibmar imakewilubbinad.
Jesús nue-ulubgi-bukib-itodbargu, neg-uanse nonikid. Neg-uandina, akwa-yaa-ollogwadid, e-doged-idu akwa-dummad siid.
Jesús dulemarga sogdesunnad: —Akwa-dummad onirmar. Dule-burgwisad-e-bun-Marta, sogded: —Dummad, ¿Ibiga akwa be onirbie? Bato ibabakegus diglesad. Degisoggu, bato nun yapanned.
Jesús, Marta-abin sogded: —¿An bega sogsasursi? Be angi bensulile, Bab-Dummad-gangued be dakoye.
Geb dule-burgwisad-diglesad-dogedgi akwa-dummad-siid onirismalad. Geb degi, Jesús niba-atakdegu, sogded: —Baba, be an-itossoggu dog-nuedye an bega soged.
